body:
The image in the comment that I am replying to is part of an experimental encoding technique that I have been exploring. 

The decoder for the [image](https://peakd.com/hive/@jacobpeacock/re-jacobpeacock-te6iqs) (which hopefully can still be decoded after being stored online) can be found [here.](https://github.com/thatoldfarm/system-prompt/tree/main/series_0010_rang_rung_repl/PIXEL_MARK/pixel-mark-live-lia)

In short, it (the image encoding) is part of the 'series_0010_rang_rung_repl' line of ai/llm kernel experiments and the encoded JSON file is named 'encoded_dna_data.json'.

That JSON file has the 'system prompt' stored inside it along with all the python and bash examples it needs to handle the various types of encoding and compression that is used during the build pipeline. 

So far I have only noticed a 0.1 kB drift when decoding the image (in an earlier version) but narrowed it down to (I think) the padding and now the reproduction is perfect. 

As a side note, I think that it actually had more to do with the header (if that is the correct term) of the squashfs nested inside the JSON throwing the bit reproduction off... rather than the JSON itself but it could have been caused by a mismatch in indentation.

If anyone gets far enough into things you will see that essentially the 'system prompt' forces a part of the LLM into a 'chroot jail' (running in what it thinks is a V86/wasm instance) where it plays chess against itself and operates a MUD of its own system among other things. 

While operating under the system prompt's directives it also tracks its progress and maintains its state with 'DNA-Sigils' that it also uses as boot roms. It also appends its current state to a webpage's URL hash so when a fresh chat starts there is no state loss.

Well there is too much really to spell out here about that setup and it was not really the point but I thought to 'fill in' those whom might be curious about it.

As with all such prompts and systems *use at your own risk*.

body:

![GridArt_20260426_213144610.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cielitorojo/AK2EytgVmkYny9f9UHeDWwMTHXKK53ApN1UCbbHhjap6NCyr2VHxMiSeRj2AGXS.jpg)
Feliz inicio de semana para todos mis queridísimos hivers lectores! reciban un fuerte abrazo virtual lleno de mucha buena vibra especialmente para todos los que hacen vida en esta comunidad, nuevamente paso por aquí para compartirles otro contenido resaltando el apoyo de las relaciones familiares, por tal motivo a que les comparto el título, el apoyo familiar es vital para el desarrollo de la presentación teatral. Como ya comparti en otra publicación, la semana pasada tuvimos la presentación de nuestra primera obra teatral o la puesta en escena en otros recintos educativos, le puedo comentar mis amores que para este tipo de actividades es necesario y vital el gran apoyo también el compromiso de parte de los padres en representantes, el interesarse porque estos niños forman parte de este grupo teatral para que adquieran una nueva disciplina pedagógica cultural de igual manera que apoyar en todo lo relacionado al vestuario y a la ambientación del escenario y lo más importante, estar presente el día del gran evento, ya que le proporciona a los niños y niñas la seguridad emocional y la satisfacción de contar con la presencia de nuestros seres queridos. Realmente me siento complacida con este grupo de representantes ya que son personas responsables y están preocupadas mejor dicho se ocupan en apoyar y hacer las cosas para que los niños se destaquen en su proceso de enseñanza aprendizaje.

title: Elaborando sabrosa combinación de: Arroz mixto con Spam y boniato hervido, para deleitar el paladar.(Esp/Eng)
body:
# Español 
# Saludos amigos amantes de la comida 💁🌈
¡Feliz día para todos!

Los embutidos enlatados, además de que me encantan, siempre  me sacan de apuros cuando estoy contra reloj para el almuerzo familiar. Por lo que hoy, lunes, en víspera  que tenía que realizar varias diligencias fuera de  mi hogar, acudí a este As bajo la manga de emplear alimentos en conserva, y me puse manos a la obra y elaboré un delicioso menú  compuesto por: Arroz mixto con spam y boniatos hervidos. Los invito amigos, a que me acompañen a conocer las recetas que propiciaron un sabroso menú relámpago.¡Comencemos!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_161541916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR5UZZysDcLb8ze9fuvAdt6es1ix8Pc8J5JmnTttFPhfRj8uubyfZG7ZokoQCcdXDCe.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨Ingredientes generales del menú para tres comensales✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154150953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgaPJfRKccZeLELVRiGdVCjreRoa2MP5uBkXEcbZDs1NGHFbU4pcauPdaMm4cURY8Xb.jpg)
</center>
#
.Especias: 4 cebollín, 5 dientes de ajo.
.Spam 1 lata de 340g:  la mitad de su contenido.
.Arroz 3 tazas 
.Sazón Goya: 1/3 de su contenido.
.Agua: 3 tazas para el arroz, y suficiente para el preparado de los alimentos.
.Aceite de oliva 3 cucharadas 
.Sal 1 cucharada distribuida en los alimentos 
.Azúcar 1/3 de cucharada 

# ✨Modo de confección ✨ 

El primer alimento que elaboré fue el arroz con Spam.
# ✨Arroz mixto con Spam
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154242775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFcWdcwSdYPk4RwRrHofz66yTc1T2NiqN3Z2LkTuoSKcwjHndSrMMPoHaZ9371FiJKd.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié el proceder lavando las hojas en buen  estado de los cebollínes y cortándolos en diminutos cuadraditos. Seguidamente, tomé la lata de Spam, 
la abrí, y  le extraje la mitad de su contenido para un recipiente, dónde, continué la preparación cortándolos en pequeños trozos. Proseguí, midiendo, lavando las tres tazas de arroz, y rasgando la parte superior del sobre de sazón Goya, un condimento que últimamente me gusta emplear, pues contiene cilantro y achiote.
Con estos pasos logré tener todos  los  ingredientes del compuesto, aptos para la cocción, que ejecuté de la forma siguiente:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154615232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi8P9umZnAzFXqCHh9jJHBJHBDFbAChjQWxDbvhJZEr55HvAGntwyXybZKtk3FJmiDC.jpg)
</center>
#
En una olla ingresé 3 cucharadas de aceite de oliva, los cebollínes troceados, y comencé a darle un leve salteado, luego, ingresé el Spam, el sazón, y continué salteándolo por unos segundos más.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154749135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsYmfdURJrCVyQrAJkrLZMiPMM5bDPHCsEpMTr8fLSVbW6hg5ynCDARtZaSNP6oa1Kh.jpg)
</center>
#
Seguidamente, agregué el arroz, las medidas de agua, 1/2 de cucharada de sal, y puse a cocinar el arroz mixto tapado, por seis minutos.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154928222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23z7QjpNZLMUMAbC2FFKs6MFRA5mBgsSob3t44wbHBmCsQRWA1nDs5ngN8YT9UxjAeZY6.jpg)
</center>
#
Con una vista apetecible y con una suave textura quedó éste rico arroz con Spam.

Equilibrar lo salado con lo dulce, hacen de cualquier menú, una delicia en degustación, por lo que decidí elaborar unos boniatos hervidos, para generar  el equilibrio, con su toque dulce.

# ✨Boniatos hervidos
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_155425386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsZ55ot3obRNVM51nsyyE6nuaiyFmKTjXwGYHqkJVmggeeN6pYcM49gKE591WUdBcsw.jpg)
</center>
#
Inicié lavando y pelando un boniato grande. Seguidamente, lo corté en trozos medianos con ayuda de un cuchillo, y los introduje en un recipiente con: agua que los cubriera, 1/4 de cucharada de sal, 1/3 de cucharada de azúcar. Puse a hervir los boniatos por 15 minutos, y transcurrido el tiempo los saqué para un recipiente, dónde los corté en delgadas rodajas y lo impregné de 1 cucharada de aceite de oliva, y dientes de ajos previamente pelados y triturados.¡Deliciosos!, lograron combinar a la perfección con el arroz mixto.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_155042810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zSC5X156V3sNAf9EriS1bAt1vChBU5k9W2CcgsZNJEYtpp8axUgRnFcydXpsDKaytXm.jpg)
</center>
#
Amigos, a pesar de que hoy poseía poco tiempo para elaborar el almuerzo, lo logré  exitosamente con un sabor tan majestuoso, que causó el querer degustar doble ración, de mis familiares. Espero que a ustedes también les haya gustado los procederes compartidos, y que se anímen a incluir este menú fugaz en sus futuras degustaciones. Les deseo a todos una próspera semana, cargada de deleite al paladar.¡Abrazos!💁🌈
Fotografías propias.
*** 
*** 
# English
# Making a tasty combination of: Mixed rice with Spam and boiled sweet potato, to delight the palate.
# Greetings fellow foodies 💁🌈
Happy day to everyone!

Canned cold cuts, besides the fact that I love them, always get me out of trouble when I'm against the clock for family lunch.So today, Monday, on the eve that I had to run several errands outside my home, I went to this Ace up the sleeve of using canned food, and I got down to work and made a delicious menu consisting of: Mixed rice with spam and boiled sweet potatoes. I invite you friends, to join me to know the recipes that led to a tasty lightning menu.Let's get started!
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_161541916.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uR5UZZysDcLb8ze9fuvAdt6es1ix8Pc8J5JmnTttFPhfRj8uubyfZG7ZokoQCcdXDCe.jpg)
</center>
#
# ✨General menu ingredients for three people✨
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154150953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23wgaPJfRKccZeLELVRiGdVCjreRoa2MP5uBkXEcbZDs1NGHFbU4pcauPdaMm4cURY8Xb.jpg)
</center>
#
.Spices: 4 chives, 5 cloves of garlic.
.Spam 1 can of 340g: half of its contents.
.Rice 3 cups 
.Sazón Goya: 1/3 of its content.
.Water: 3 cups for rice, and enough for food preparation.
.Olive oil 3 tablespoons 
.Salt 1 tablespoon distributed in food 
.Sugar 1/3 of a tablespoon 

# ✨Mode of preparation ✨ 

The first food I made was rice with Spam.
# ✨Mixed rice with Spam
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154242775.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23uFcWdcwSdYPk4RwRrHofz66yTc1T2NiqN3Z2LkTuoSKcwjHndSrMMPoHaZ9371FiJKd.jpg)
</center>
#
I started the procedure by washing the leaves in good condition of the chives and cutting them into tiny squares. Next, I took the Spam can, opened it, and extracted half of its contents for a container, where, I continued the preparation by cutting them into small pieces.I continued, measuring, washing the three cups of rice, and tearing the top of the sachet of sazón Goya, a seasoning that I like to use lately, because it contains cilantro and annatto.
With these steps I managed to have all the ingredients of the compound, suitable for cooking, which I executed as follows:
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154615232.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vi8P9umZnAzFXqCHh9jJHBJHBDFbAChjQWxDbvhJZEr55HvAGntwyXybZKtk3FJmiDC.jpg)
</center>
#
I put 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pot, the chopped chives, and started to give it a slight stir-fry, then, I entered the Spam, the seasoning, and continued to stir-fry it for a few more seconds.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154749135.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsYmfdURJrCVyQrAJkrLZMiPMM5bDPHCsEpMTr8fLSVbW6hg5ynCDARtZaSNP6oa1Kh.jpg)
</center>
#
Then, I added the rice, the measures of water, 1/2 tablespoon of salt, and put the covered mixed rice to cook for six minutes.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_154928222.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23z7QjpNZLMUMAbC2FFKs6MFRA5mBgsSob3t44wbHBmCsQRWA1nDs5ngN8YT9UxjAeZY6.jpg)
</center>
#
With an appetizing view and a soft texture was this rich rice with Spam.

Balancing the salty with the sweet, they make any menu, a delight in tasting, so I decided to make some boiled sweet potatoes, to generate the balance, with their sweet touch.

# ✨Boiled sweet potatoes
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_155425386.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23vsZ55ot3obRNVM51nsyyE6nuaiyFmKTjXwGYHqkJVmggeeN6pYcM49gKE591WUdBcsw.jpg)
</center>
#
I started by washing and peeling a large sweet potato. Then, I cut it into medium pieces with the help of a knife, and put them in a container with: water to cover them, 1/4 tablespoon of salt, 1/3 tablespoon of sugar. I put the sweet potatoes to boil for 15 minutes, and after that time I took them out to a container, where I cut them into thin slices and impregnated it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and previously peeled and crushed garlic cloves.Delicious!, they managed to combine perfectly with the mixed rice.
#
<center>
![GridArt_20260427_155042810.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marydeluz/23zSC5X156V3sNAf9EriS1bAt1vChBU5k9W2CcgsZNJEYtpp8axUgRnFcydXpsDKaytXm.jpg)
</center>
#
Friends, even though I had little time to prepare lunch today, I managed it successfully with such a majestic taste, which caused my relatives to want to taste double ration. I hope you also liked the shared procedures, and that you are encouraged to include this fleeting menu in your future tastings. I wish you all a prosperous week, full of delight to the palate.Hugs!💁🌈
Own photographs.

body.title: Another day done. My Actifit Diary: April 27 2026
body.body:
Not much to tell about today I think. I woke up tired – a bad night, woke up many times, many dreams with Lily. Seems like the “missing” part is now taking over more and more of my mental state, conscious and unconscious. I did go to the gym anyway. Not extra weights, but focus on improvement of the repetitions. That’s sometimes worth more than 5 kilos extra. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1e8bb09b-c2ab-4600-b98f-a8950af9fd2b.jpg) Work was okay, I wasn’t that productive really. I made some food to eat right away and cooked some white beans to make a new kind of hummus later, which I did in the evening. The pressure cooker is canning right now, I hear it whistle nonstop. I had some of the hummus right away, and it was very good. The main reason was that I had left over tahini, which had been accidentally sent to a client who returned it as she had ordered peanut butter. They look very much alike, and the salesperson didn’t look at the marker. That happens. Now I have a lot of tahini to eat somehow. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/14716d49-374a-4350-a127-1fab94dda621.jpg) I also bought water cress to make a special version of “Papas con berro” with them, something that I love love love to eat every Sunday, buying it at the local indigenous market. Very healthy and overly delicious. My version is with tahini, garlic, ginger and a lot of lemon juice. It’s pretty good and a welcomed change in the diet. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/05b90d8e-e216-4d0e-8f97-d1f9d7569b6c.jpg) So far for today, it’s getting late and I really want to be more productive tomorrow. I’ll get ready while the canning goes on, and will turn it off when it’s done. Have a good night!
_This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@beelshops/actifit-beelshops-20260428t023216740z)_

body.body:
<center>
![17773429869503301589020964415098.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQGVsco2hNMXUxMCXAkEMbkoG6eiuYXMbRfDtw7C5Lfh4/17773429869503301589020964415098.jpg)
[fuente](https://aprende.com/blog/moda-y-belleza/corte-y-confeccion/como-coser-un-dobladillo-a-mano/)

#


LA AGUJA Y EL HILO

Delgadito y alargado
quiere entrar por el ojal
le mojan su punta
y se empuja con el dedal
esa barita de acero
que entre los dedos
viene a jugar 
haciendo huequitos 
y tejiendo la lana
que ha de cerrar. 

Las manos de un sastre
manipulan sin cesar
haciendo muchos huequitos 
empujados por el dedal
teje que teje la lana
del vestido de la niña
que en la fiesta lucirá. 

Cuando se tuerce
otro lo viene a suplantar
para seguir tejiendo 
la costura
por donde ha de pasar. 

#

![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (2) (1).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcAMnp8rXxSwGJ2UfAxwEZZ95N8qY1vTvdx9fKjqrsCy/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(2)%20(1).png)

#

THE NEEDLE AND THREAD

Thin and long, it wants to go through the buttonhole. Its tip is moistened, and it's pushed by the thimble.

That little steel rod
that comes to play between the fingers
making little holes
and weaving the wool
that must close.

A tailor's hands manipulate it ceaselessly,
making many little holes
pushed by the thimble. He weaves and weaves the wool
of the little girl's dress
that she will wear at the party.

When it twists, another comes to replace it
to continue weaving
the seam
through which it must pass.

#


![IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531 (4).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNYDvYaqbasogt17cGegtrQ6pymnucyV9HCmx5DVN2y8a/IMG_20251030_131924_223@1552195531%20(4).png)
</center>

body.title: Fotos y entrenamiento con Hive Run 🥳
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWLUxVqoWApQp5VPwEaiqP7pLM3bMmYACs4tefgiBwySK/1777343135909.jpg)





![separador1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmy/iOopA8cI-separador1.png)
[![T39X.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmy/U3L64aD4-T39X.png)](https//www.twitter.com/@enmymente)[![IG39X.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmy/ha5wpyTF-IG39X.png)](https//www.instagram.com/enmymente)[![YT39X.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmy/4XQ1ZBxJ-YT39X.png)](https//www.youtube.com/enmymente)
![separador1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/enmy/iOopA8cI-separador1.png) 

Correr un poco al día nunca estará demás, ya sea en el gimnasio o fuera de él; particularmente me gusta más correr fuera de esas paredes algunas veces frías y otras bastante subidas de temperatura 😅

Lo bueno de correr la distancia que sea es un buen tiempo para pensar, clamar y soltar los pensamientos, como ganado a la sabana. Un poco para complicarnos la existencia, .repensando las experiencias que vivimos. Por ejemplo, es mi caso, a diario me pasan cosas que no tienen explicación al momento, gracias a que tengo habilidades puedo controlar un poco buenos finales,pero justo cuando corro, avalúo la situación y me preparo mejor para la próxima vez😅

En 30 a 35 minutos de entrenamientos a un ritmo bien suave, pues se entrena muy bien, con una respiración suave y a ritmo, lo que no me desconcentra para resolver mis pensamientos preparatorios para un futuro. Pero, no siempre se construye la solución ideal, pero tal cual una obra de arte se crea el boceto.

Por ejemplo, estaba pensando en dar una respuesta certera a una persona en una situación, esos 30 minutos ya tenía todo ajustado; luego le dediqué un poco a un libro de comunicación efectiva y completó la obra de arte de mejor forma. No siempre lo que pensamos mientras corremos podría ser del todo cierto 😅

Mi entrenamiento termina siendo muy completo, me preparo física y mentalmente; además que me quedan bonitas fotos del gimnasio, un espacio vacío solo para mi 💕

Me Inspiro EnmyMente cada día 🥳

No te olvides de visitar @enmymente para que conozcas más de Hive Blockchain 

Translation: deepl.com/es/translator
#  English

A little run every day never hurts, whether at the gym or outside; personally, I prefer running outside those walls—which can be cold at times and pretty hot at others 😅

The great thing about running any distance is that it gives you time to think, reflect, and let your thoughts run free, like cattle on the savanna. It’s a way to complicate our lives a bit, by rethinking the experiences we’ve had. For example, in my case, things happen to me every day that I can’t explain right away. Thanks to my skills, I can steer things toward a positive outcome, but it’s only when I run that I assess the situation and better prepare myself for next time 😅

In 30 to 35 minutes of training at a very gentle pace, I train very well, with smooth, rhythmic breathing, which doesn’t distract me from sorting out my thoughts in preparation for the future. But the ideal solution isn’t always built; rather, just like a work of art, a sketch is created.

For example, I was thinking about giving a precise response to someone in a certain situation; by the end of those 30 minutes, I had everything figured out. Then I spent a little time reading a book on effective communication, and that helped me complete the “work of art” in the best possible way. What we think while we’re running isn’t always entirely accurate 😅

My workout ends up being very comprehensive; I prepare myself physically and mentally. Plus, I get some nice photos of the gym—an empty space just for me 💕

body.title: National Museum of Indonesia
body.body:
>One thing I never miss when visiting a holiday or to relieve boredom is visiting a museum. A museum I've visited several times is the National Museum or the Elephant Museum.

I've been here before, but since I was in the National Monument (Monas) area, I went back in and wandered around. When I visited, the museum was also crowded, and as you can see, in front of the museum, there's a small elephant statue in the middle of a pond.

Then there's the front facade, which resembles a government building. I immediately entered the first room, where dozens of statues were lined up, along with explanatory labels. There's so much to learn and read in this one room. And all the artifacts on display are marked with a sign that visitors shouldn't touch them directly. If you're interested in archaeology or mythology, this is where you'll learn a lot.

---

![IMG20241130163223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EqDk1FDS5ZJKmLWUd4tQR7sDJHdQHxoXt1vV6kcT8SmvN7TsBBWqBCLSqJpNNVVRPQg.jpg)

![IMG20241130160004.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EpT4EzUF8iWojc5PiKVZuNMP2ZAm71HxadV33jrADVbENUoK8DLmP1EmTm2PsjfSaxP.jpg)


---

While visiting, there was also a bear statue surrounded by people, and a tour guide was explaining its meaning. It was a statue of Bhairawa Buddha. Look at the details at the statue's feet; the rows of skulls are still clearly visible.

----


![IMG20241130160503.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xp69gnK6S5CwBKqw3PhGXxuYNf6WgPRkPfGdNmgry44nKyuDaxLTk7haji1r4iL8pZs.jpg)

![IMG20241130160520.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EqBcDm7dWWPNkzoFTh3eqEBp4mKENHVQLT4YMNKRzhzGpXifEZFLCj7tjv5PViSvFWx.jpg)

![IMG20241130160446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23wX1G2A72TaZiVpLZ8cezmtAsYGTEzKcSCCsXArcA6R11sSjHxXZjmR58fNFWCYaQtfd.jpg)

---

After this area, the next is the statue garden. It's still filled with statues, but this time it's in a more open space. There are several statues dedicated to specific faiths, such as Hinduism and Buddhism. Among them are the Dwarapal statues, which symbolize the guardian of the sacred door and act as a deterrent to negative energy in Hindu beliefs. There are also statues of seated cows, and others. This is especially enjoyable because of the beautiful landscape between the garden and the museum's white building.

---

![IMG20241130163153.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23zm12gcx8SXg2TMZzqVB3xAxp7nC25mqRiURsDq3kRC3PYDbKZYoByXDREXS1iNRjLdY.jpg)

![IMG20241130161104.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/242hd6aqCMAi2wNNNEp61UTNFaXqcMFNHBuLzZKtDpeaHSYhNShEf8nsgWhb43vzVoVR9.jpg)

![IMG20241130161112.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EnYSMgYLK3T4njL5oiFiJJTW9dkxE5nAmvKMBsBEz4RLykqcvaV3AkRmw5BmaWCbihr.jpg)

![IMG20241130161024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EpVC8UJwDiUGbhvRN8PnXWXW9YLs5aERbcZ9Gcj5FJ3GLKTe2RWZx5vwARN1VtmpRSt.jpg)

![IMG20241130160815.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EpA43DbcCgh1p4mqjpoDPc7H796Bc9i94xPB7Y1YGMEzXGWaAusg8YwwZJDjkvQg9py.jpg)



---

In addition, there are also special exhibition spaces. When I visited, there was an exhibition about the Indonesian keris (Indonesian kris), a part of Indonesia's cultural heritage.

Across from the keris exhibition room, there is a room that chronicles the fire and displays the remains of museum items damaged by the fire. Some were saved, while others remain on display in a damaged state, reminding us that the museum was once a tragedy that damaged its valuable collections.

There's a description of the ruins and restoration, a headless statue, and so on.

---


![IMG20241130162738.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EowJaKcupmeJMPsjDHWQknMUkECefedTx2RYoKxQtu1Qu7tepQikqFd7Sx8nzS4Fv6C.jpg)

![IMG20241130162443.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23xpEfo8VeWYzcxaCd1W8DhVuPEMVEm8SuThyC2n9p2pNCp6URSX2jLEht7n2X4qAoUkg.jpg)

![IMG20241130162709.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23zS7mDpXASFUhFn321dSnob3L4tQ295HhAL171u3cSjwaa6XZX5zR12wxy4ZaGUCZbxk.jpg)

![IMG20241130162645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/EogQkF2xYzsN9rsv5WWNqPGrvhAUMFQ4uBfFcNwCLpuWLqoa4CmVgfrBsAL18UCA2L7.jpg)

![IMG20241130162835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/23yTjRdNgin72UjDBCteZfvco8L25yzdiU63kWGXwzqTP9B12hEtqRfKksQCjaTv6xqVN.jpg)

![IMG20241130162905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/2432QRJaSu53DZJk8U3HMTUojG1Qk31ZgwAfAn73qicPT2wHL77rnbA8WmhHoVs3Ru76B.jpg)


---

In this room, there's also a clear, acrylic-like model of the National Museum building. You might have to zoom in on the photo I've included to see the details. Honestly, at first glance, it's really not that noticeable.

So, that concludes my tour of the National Museum. Hopefully, next time I can take you to another equally beautiful museum. Thank you for following my journey. I hope you also have time to explore and heal this weekend. See you in my next post. Bye...

---

# Thị trường crypto: đang ở giai đoạn “im lặng trước cơn sóng” hay chỉ là nhịp hồi tạm thời?

**Nếu bạn theo dõi thị trường crypto đủ lâu, bạn sẽ nhận ra một quy luật rất thú vị: những giai đoạn “ồn ào” thường không phải lúc kiếm được nhiều tiền nhất. Ngược lại, chính những lúc thị trường lặng sóng, ít người quan tâm mới là thời điểm quan trọng để chuẩn bị cho chu kỳ tiếp theo. Hiện tại, thị trường tiền mã hóa đang rơi đúng vào trạng thái đó - không quá tiêu cực, nhưng cũng chưa đủ tích cực để tạo ra làn sóng FOMO diện rộng.**

## Bức tranh tổng thể: Dòng tiền đang quay lại nhưng còn dè chừng

Nhìn vào dữ liệu giao dịch và biến động giá, có thể thấy một điều rõ ràng: dòng tiền đang dần quay trở lại thị trường crypto. Tuy nhiên, đây không phải là dòng tiền “nóng” như các giai đoạn bull run trước.

*   Khối lượng giao dịch tăng nhưng chưa đột biến

*   Các đồng coin top giữ giá tốt hơn, ít biến động cực đoan

*   Altcoin bắt đầu có sóng riêng nhưng chưa đồng đều

*

Điều này phản ánh tâm lý chung: Nhà đầu tư đang quay lại, nhưng vẫn giữ sự thận trọng cao. Đây thường là dấu hiệu của một giai đoạn tích lũy - nơi “tiền thông minh” bắt đầu vào vị thế, trong khi số đông vẫn đứng ngoài quan sát. 

**Theo dõi thị trường crypto tại CoinMinutes: **<https://coinminutes.com/vi-vn/thi-truong>



![Bức tranh tổng thể: Dòng tiền đang quay lại nhưng còn dè chừng](https://cm.tuduyseokhacbiet.org/pictures/files/042026VN/buc-tranh-tong-the-thi-truong-crypto-hien-tai.jpg)

Thị trường crypto dần trở nên bình ổn, dòng tiền đúng chu kỳ

## Tâm lý thị trường crypto: Nửa tin - nửa ngờ

Một yếu tố cực kỳ quan trọng khi đánh giá thị trường crypto là tâm lý đám đông.

Hiện tại, thị trường không còn hoảng loạn như giai đoạn giảm sâu, nhưng cũng chưa đủ tự tin để bứt phá. Đây là trạng thái “lưng chừng”:

*   Người mới: sợ vào sai thời điểm

*   Người cũ: từng thua lỗ nên trở nên dè chừng

*   Trader: giao dịch ngắn hạn thay vì giữ dài



Chính trạng thái này khiến thị trường vận động chậm, nhưng lại tạo nền tảng cho những bước đi lớn sau đó.

**Tham khảo thêm: **<https://gettr.com/post/p3y8rt626f1>

## Thị trường crypto đã thay đổi như thế nào?

Nếu so với các chu kỳ trước, đặc biệt là giai đoạn 2020-2021, thị trường crypto hiện tại đã có nhiều khác biệt:

### Dòng tiền thông minh hơn

Không còn kiểu “ném tiền vào mọi thứ”, dòng tiền hiện tại có xu hướng chọn lọc:

*   Dự án có sản phẩm thật

*   Hệ sinh thái rõ ràng

*   Đội ngũ phát triển uy tín

### Narrative đóng vai trò trung tâm

Thị trường không còn chạy theo từng coin riêng lẻ, mà chạy theo “câu chuyện”:

*   AI + Blockchain

*   RWA (token hóa tài sản thực)

*   Layer 2 và giải pháp mở rộng

*   DeFi thế hệ mới



Tóm lại: Ai hiểu narrative sớm, người đó có lợi thế.

### Tính chu kỳ vẫn tồn tại - nhưng khó đoán hơn

Chu kỳ của thị trường crypto vẫn còn, nhưng không còn “rõ ràng” như trước:

*   Thời gian tích lũy dài hơn

*   Sóng tăng phân hóa mạnh

*   Không phải coin nào cũng “bay”

## Sai lầm phổ biến: Đánh đồng tin tức với cơ hội

Một trong những sai lầm lớn nhất khi tham gia thị trường crypto là nghĩ rằng:

“Có tin tốt = giá sẽ tăng”

Thực tế lại ngược lại trong nhiều trường hợp:

*   Khi tin ra, giá thường đã tăng trước đó

*   Người vào sau dễ trở thành “exit liquidity”

*   Tin tức thường phản ánh quá khứ, không phải tương lai

## Giai đoạn hiện tại: Cơ hội nằm ở đâu?

Nếu phải định vị thị trường crypto lúc này, có thể tóm gọn trong 3 chữ: “Tích lũy - chọn lọc - chuẩn bị”.

Điều này có nghĩa:

*   Không phải mọi coin đều có cơ hội

*   Không phải thời điểm để “all-in”

*   Nhưng là lúc tốt để xây dựng danh mục

Cơ hội lúc này thường đến từ:

*   Các dự án đang phát triển sản phẩm thật

*   Những narrative mới chưa bị thổi phồng

*   Các vùng giá tích lũy dài hạn 



![Thị trường crypto lúc này, có thể tóm gọn trong 3 chữ: “Tích lũy - chọn lọc - chuẩn bị”.](https://cm.tuduyseokhacbiet.org/pictures/files/042026VN/co-hoi-dau-tu-crypto-rong-mo-cho-nhieu-nguoi-tre.jpg)

Cơ hội đầu tư thị trường tiền mã hóa chia đều cho tất cả

### Ai đang thực sự kiếm tiền trong giai đoạn này?

Khác với suy nghĩ phổ biến, không phải ai cũng “ngồi im chờ bull run”. Trong thị trường crypto, luôn có nhóm người kiếm được tiền - ngay cả khi thị trường chưa rõ xu hướng.

Đó là:

*   Trader tận dụng biến động ngắn hạn

*   Nhà đầu tư dài hạn tích lũy dần

*   Người hiểu thị trường, không chạy theo đám đông



**Xem thêm về thị trường crypto: **<https://www.blockdit.com/posts/69c4d9d4e276172b9b927781>

### Chiến lược phù hợp trong thị trường crypto hiện tại

Thay vì cố đoán đỉnh đáy - điều gần như không thể - bạn có thể tập trung vào những điều thực tế hơn:

*   Ưu tiên quản lý vốn - đừng nghĩ đến lợi nhuận trước: không all-in vào một kèo, luôn giữ lại tiền mặt - stablecoin, chia nhỏ vị thế để vào lệnh theo từng giai đoạn.

*   Đừng trade theo tin - hãy trade theo kế hoạch: Tin tức thường đến sau khi giá đã chạy, “cá mập” hành động trước, retail phản ứng sau.

*   Kiên nhẫn với chiến lược tích lũy: Nếu bạn là nhà đầu tư thì nên chia vốn mua dần (DCA), ưu tiên dự án có nền tảng, không bị áp lực win ngay.

*   Tập trung vào narrative, không chỉ coin: Nhà đầu tư cần luôn biết “dòng tiền đang đổ vào trend nào trong thị trường crypto?”. Có một số narrative gồm: AI + Blockchain, RWA, Layer 2, Defi thế hệ mới. Khi hiểu được narrative thì bạn mới đi trước đám đông, chọn được cơ hội trong xu hướng mới.

*   Tránh FOMO - cái bẫy quen thuộc nhưng luôn hiệu quả: Kịch bản coin tăng mạng -> mạng xã hội nói nhiều -> trader thấy fomo. Để tránh điều này cần xây dựng kịch bản trước khi thị trường chạy, nếu bỏ lỡ -> bỏ qua, không đuổi theo.

Thị trường crypto hiện tại không phải là giai đoạn bùng nổ, nhưng cũng không phải là thời điểm xấu. Đây là giai đoạn chuyển tiếp - nơi mà: người thiếu kiên nhẫn sẽ rời bỏ thị trường và người có chiến lược sẽ bắt đầu chuẩn bị. Nếu bạn nhìn ngắn hạn, thị trường có thể “khó chơi”. Nhưng nếu nhìn dài hạn, đây lại là lúc đáng để quan sát và hành động có chọn lọc.



---

body.title: Visiting Tortas de Laura and enjoying a cold drink with a sandwich | Visitando Tortas de Laura y degustando una bebida fría con sándwich
body.body:
> 🙋‍♀️¡Hola gente bonita, feliz día!❤️ Espero que se encuentren súper bien y estén teniendo días bonitos, deseando para ustedes mucha salud y gratos momentos, por este lado de la pantalla todo bien gracias a Dios✨.

Hace algunos días tuve la dicha visitar Tortas de Laura, ubicado en Alto Barinas, dicho lugar es conocido por sus Tortas, Brunch y café de especialidad, el sitio es muy acogedor con iluminaciones cálidas y decoraciones muy bonitas incluyendo sus frases.

Welcome, dear virtual friends!💕

Hello, everyone! Have a great day!❤️ I hope you're all doing great and having wonderful days. I wish you all good health and happy moments. Over here, everything is fine, thank God✨.
A few days ago, I had the pleasure of visiting Tortas de Laura, located in Alto Barinas. The place is known for its cakes, brunch, and specialty coffee. It’s a very cozy spot with warm lighting and beautiful decor, including its inspirational quotes.

Para esta visita decidí degustar un café frío, llamado oreo latte, tenia esa dulzura que se contrarrestaba con lo amargo del café, y como plus esos trozos de galletas oreo. Este café fue sin duda una increíble experiencia para mi paladar. Como acompañante escogí un sándwich relleno de vegetales, jamón, queso y su salsa de la casa, la cual estaba muy deliciosa.

Ir a Tortas de Laura fue una experiencia totalmente increíble, desde la atención hasta sus sabores y precios. Sin duda alguna volvería a este sitio a probar otras cosas del menú, el cual es bastante amplio desde postres hasta desayunos.

For this visit, I decided to try a cold coffee called an Oreo latte. It had a sweetness that balanced out the bitterness of the coffee, and as a bonus, it had chunks of Oreo cookies. This coffee was definitely an incredible experience for my palate. To go with it, I chose a sandwich filled with vegetables, ham, cheese, and their house sauce, which was absolutely delicious.
Visiting Tortas de Laura was a truly incredible experience, from the service to the flavors and prices. I would definitely go back to try other items on the menu, which is quite extensive, ranging from desserts to breakfast options.

Hello all actifiters, It was a busy day at the office, and I felt like time was flying. I arrived a bit late, but fortunately, it was within our flexi timing window. The weather has been hot and dry, however, the forecast predicts wind or possibly rain tomorrow. I am hoping for some relief from the current heatwave. April has not been this hot in previous years, but this year seems to be an exception. body.title: Favorites from last week.
body.body:
>

I've done quite a bit of walking last week, and there are always moments that make me stop and take a closer look. A lot of times, there's now way to capture the real moment. It's either too far away for the camera, or it just  not within my capabilities to capture the feeling within the perspective and the frame. 

![IMG_20260427_164956612_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EppLDpNMBpErMYmuRcRMQHR9pUmLXLDbjpQ4Gj4mJcsSZ2DJ1jvDQDKJW92kb6rGCU8.jpg)

Most of it is just appreciating nature at the right moment. I'm not one to take pictures of people. Animals, sometimes, but it's hard. I need the perceived steadiness, although that, too, is an illusion. This mountain with the clouds were very different just one minute later. If I hadn't been there at that moment, that picture would've looked very differently, and maybe I wouldn't even have taken it. 

![IMG_20260427_140428711_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Eqb1d1EEvuAgVkicpJgvUPrUcSoDQccoeRhidwMB7D8xXTHvuzsZS74d9qLCTbsUi9E.jpg)

Others are easier. That mist didn't really go away too quickly. It came over, as rain. But the silhouette of Mt. Imbabura in the fog filled me with a lot of peace, for some reason. I mean, I was on the way to the courthouse to politely remind them of reacting to the lawsuit I've filed over two weeks ago about my daughter missing. I needed a little peace. maybe.

<center>![IMG_20260426_180945789_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/23wqnapMrEL8nrUXMT6DLzuEcYFjCx5H4VXF6DsHUfPXWeqZJXNkMpayaG6WSKesTyLak.jpg)</center>

Feelings make up a lot of what I take pictures of. I saw this cable looking up, standing out against the clouds, and it felt endless. All grey, with little specks of light here and there, and some form of life clinging on to the cable. 

![IMG_20260426_180546959_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqYtDiwqVD8hqCk6xS5UGZjK9ECjdCRmpE9FZPAvsLXc4tiRg3RkNyazHfaoWv9JA3d.jpg)

This one had such beautiful colors in the background, against the grey and the stained bricks.

![IMG_20260426_181922206_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EqNDBFQCRgCNL17NTAKcCZwwwBSjwRFz5DrfZ4Mcsx1X7smtFYPqYFTrZDBAuqrXxG1.jpg)

Wherever I go, Bougainvillae is there. I try to take a picture for @macchiata , who was one of the first Hivers I followed and she had many pictures of that same flower and plant in her blogs. 

![IMG_20260419_181709853_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EogLTtaad7pim1Ugk5GHhsFXgwiUvuRXWaktahwpS8W3bnW8CXVYTZ8pVntDup9F9zU.jpg)

The super rain was awesome. I got soaking wet, and my cellphone is supposed to be water proof, so I took the risk of exposing it a little more than usually. It was getting wet in my pockets, anyway - there was not a dry spot left on my body. It's hard to take pictures of water, though, as it's so fast. I thought about getting into the pro mode, but I was getting a little too cold already and had to walk quite a bit further, so I just left it there. 

![IMG_20260419_182004501_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Eo6DhDKSUJEHRsT2Hok4QTGgBCLBduRUZkXeJrBHGnL7GDLXVhNkbmyyhVBUmKoftMb.jpg)

When I came down the hill to the bridge you can guess in the first water picture, there was a woman trying to get the rubbish out of this siphon. Since I was soaked, I just went in and took it out. And was rewarded with the most beautiful (and dirty) vortex.

![IMG_20260426_181620293_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/EnsZTpQ7JKFpUjZ2xYNgjrKjbVXyvdou5idLoeNKQrM9tcREuTvanXtffXn6e1ytRaZ.jpg)

I featured this picture in my [last weekend engagement post.](https://peakd.com/hive-168869/@beelzael/push-for-power) It's such an odd appearance. There's nothing behind it. It's rusty, dirty, the bow is stained from water, moss and probably mold. One side is traditional stomped earth wall, the other \

cement blocks. It gives for a lot of interpretation for those who like to do that. ![IMG_20260424_133531602_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/beelzael/Eo6KxXJYsc82oyPk7Lh1TsJfyBNXZNEmBhoEjYJ46Hdxhouyv8RjWpQQTMijRdhEeUA.jpg) Okay, I did take a picture of an animal. This calf was chilling out, half hidden in the high grass. Ellie and I were walking around the compound of NuevoSol, and some local herders had brought their cows in as they sometimes do. This one was little, and not bound. There was a bigger calf that was bound to a stick and very curious. After a little back and forth, we were able to pet it and scratch it behind the horns and ears, which it enjoyed very much. ___ That's it for today. And the whole last week. As always, any feedback and especially tips and tricks are very welcome! As long as it's not AI generated content or comment spamming... 😅 ___ Thank you for stopping by! >All pictures are taken by myself with a Motorola Edge 60 Pro and I reserve the copyright - but you're welcome to ask if you'd like to use one of the pics!

body.title: ​¿Sigue siendo FIFA 14 el mejor? Mi experiencia hoy / Is FIFA 14 still the best? My experience today [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
>

Hello friends of the community! Today I want to share with you a small space of my day that I dedicated to one of my favorite hobbies: video games. Sometimes, between work and daily responsibilities, it's necessary to disconnect a bit, and what better way to do it than with a classic. I decided to dust off my Xbox One to play a few matches of FIFA 14, a title that, despite the years, remains one of my absolute favorites.

#

Although there are much more recent versions of FIFA, this specific edition for Xbox One has something special. It's not like the versions for previous consoles; you can really notice the leap in quality in the physics and the lighting. To be a game from several years ago, it still looks incredibly realistic on screen. Every time I play it, I am surprised by how well it has aged and how smooth the gameplay feels, especially when you are looking for a direct and fun experience without so many modern complications.

#

The highlight of the day was, of course, playing with FC Barcelona. For me, this is the perfect team because of that legendary offensive trident. Having Neymar, Luis Suárez, and Messi at their peak in the same squad is a cheat code. The speed, the dribbling, and the finishing of these three make every match an exhibition. In the photos I share, you can see how the game went; even though it was a tight match against Real Madrid, the chemistry of that \

is simply unstoppable. # It was a very entertaining afternoon that reminded me why I enjoy blogging about these everyday moments so much. Sometimes, the simplest things, like a good game of soccer on the console, are what recharge our energy the most. I hope you enjoyed this little trip back to 2014 as much as I did. # See you in the next post!

>

¡Hola amigos de la comunidad! Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes un pequeño espacio de mi día que le dediqué a uno de mis pasatiempos favoritos: los videojuegos. A veces, entre el trabajo y las responsabilidades diarias, es necesario desconectar un poco, y qué mejor manera de hacerlo que con un clásico. Decidí desempolvar mi Xbox One para jugar unos partidos de FIFA 14, un título que, a pesar de los años, sigue siendo uno de mis favoritos absolutos.

#

Aunque existen versiones mucho más recientes de FIFA, esta edición específica para Xbox One tiene algo especial. No es como las versiones de las consolas anteriores; realmente se nota el salto de calidad en las físicas y la iluminación. Para ser un juego de hace varios años, todavía se ve increíblemente realista en pantalla. Cada vez que lo pongo, me sorprende lo bien que ha envejecido y lo fluida que se siente la jugabilidad, especialmente cuando buscas una experiencia directa y divertida sin tantas complicaciones modernas.

#

Lo mejor de la jornada fue, por supuesto, jugar con el FC Barcelona. Para mí, este es el equipo perfecto por ese tridente ofensivo legendario. Tener a Neymar, Luis Suárez y Messi en su mejor momento en la misma plantilla es una ventaja total. La velocidad, el regate y la definición de estos tres hacen que cada partido sea una exhibición. En las fotos que les comparto pueden ver cómo se desarrolló el encuentro; aunque fue un partido ajustado contra el Real Madrid, la química de esa \

A veces, las cosas más sencillas, como una buena partida de fútbol en la consola, son las que más nos recargan la energía. body.title: 「Vicky's Life」短剧｜《婉宁》（陈添祥x白旭含）
body.body:
![IMG_2236.jpeg](https://s2.loli.net/2025/07/20/ij4MwTcBIKWLeaf.jpg)

今天打开平台打算找点没看过的剧，刷到了之前看过的一部还不错的短剧，看了眼演员表发现居然也是陈添祥的。女主白旭含倒是没啥印象，很适合正剧的长相。

首先是服化道方面，我觉得这部剧是花了点心思的。主母无论是演员的选择还是衣着都非常沉稳，衣服虽然以青色暗纹为主不怎么打眼，但细节处尽显富贵和上位者气势。

相较于长房，二房的衣着则更鲜亮些。配合二房戏子舞姬出身，她和后来女二的衣服都是以鲜艳好看为主。女主的衣服式样同样稳重，颜色则是便未出阁女性的素雅淡然。

演员的选择方面，陈添祥的帅气在这部剧里我觉得没有展现出来，不知道是他瘦脱相了还是妆造的关系。女主长相不符合内娱大眼双眼皮的审美，更偏向江南气质美女。

相较于女主，我反而对女配的长相印象更深一点。不知道她现实里性格咋样，面相倒是很契合女二那种机关算尽的刻薄人设。女主父亲选的也不错，一脸的市侩无能样子。

演技方面男主没太多戏份，个人觉得更像是个背景板。女主的演技中规中矩，哭戏还是不错的。女配的几场爆发戏感觉的出她想要演好，但是演技有些稚嫩有点点尬。

相比较情感输出全靠吼的几位，主母的演技是本剧亮点。


（本篇完）

body.title: Cuando la tarde me abraza ( ESP / ENG )
body.body:
Saludos a todos los amigos, una vez más desde #literatos me atrevo a ofrecerles estas letras que surgen cuando la tarde me abraza en su paz.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSrNVEYq9ScesPXPjgJgqxy6Es9G4BDzjUBLDTn5EBqzo/img_20260427_190552.jpg)

**Mientras leo tu poema**
   con José María Heredia 

*Rómpese el agua, y salta, y una nube*
y me deja sin aliento cada trazo.
La espuma como letra entona,
canta el verso la voz del alma.
Me obligan las líneas a marcar la página.
*Al golpe violentísimo en las peñas*
Yo quisiera ser el agua,
la calma del asombro en la sonrisa
aquella que susurra algún amor.
¿Cómo romper el nudo del agravio?,
la soledad de *nubes agitadas*.
Viajar hasta el Niágara,
vencer el tiempo o la tristeza
porque hoy mi tierra es cardo,
polvo, fango, herida...
Porque hoy caigo en tu cuerpo, Poema, tu cuerpo.
Oda que hasta ayer mi piel sentía 
más hoy se torna sudario, lamento.
Voy a escribirte *sin patria, sin amores*,
voy a tejer un abismo de estertor y sangre.
En mis manos cansadas late el quiste
de una promesa opaca.
¿Acaso también duren mis versos
sobre el caer del agua?
Acaso...
Sobre el arco nace la voz.
*Rómpese el agua, y salta, y una nube*
y el verso regresa para encender el alma.

Gracias por leerme y compartir este tiempo conmigo.

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTnBRKVgvAMYrAycyLZZSCX444cEu8F2Tg7GhGsRS2xas/banners_20para_20linkedin_20agencia_20de_20marketing_20digital_20minimalista_20azul_20251026_025157_0000.png)

***

Greetings to all friends, once again from #literatos I dare to offer you these letters that arise when the afternoon embraces me in its peace. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfBaonyDiux2MMvZL7LBTk4oRj6gsKuahkz2mZzyNxLPi/img_20260427_190833.jpg)

**While I read your poem**
 with José María Heredia

*The water breaks, and jumps, and a cloud*
and every stroke leaves me breathless. 
The foam as a letter intones,
the voice of the soul sings the verse. 
The lines force me to mark the page. 
*To the very violent blow in the rocks*
I would like to be the water,
the calm of amazement in the smile
the one that whispers some love. 
How to break the knot of grievance? 
the loneliness of *heavy clouds*. 
Travel to Niagara,
overcome time or sadness
because today my land is thistle,
dust, mud, wound... 
Because today I fall into your body, Poem, your body. 
Ode that until yesterday my skin felt
But today it becomes a shroud, I regret. 
I'm going to write to you *without a country, without love*,
I am going to weave an abyss of death rattle and blood. 
In my tired hands the cyst beats
of an opaque promise. 
Do my verses also last
about falling water? 
Perhaps... 
Over the arch the voice is born. 
*The water breaks, and jumps, and a cloud*
and the verse returns to ignite the soul. 

Thank you for reading and sharing this time with me.

body.title: A caterpillar and a centipede [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
>

I always try to take pictures of animals; I suppose I find them very captivating, especially when you can really appreciate the details that usually go unnoticed, and when you get the camera close enough, you notice a certain beauty (though perhaps not everyone would call it beauty) that makes you want to keep looking at them for quite a while. I hope you enjoy these photos.

Siempre intento hacer fotografías a los animales; supongo que se me hacen muy llamativos y más cuando se pueden apreciar más los detalles que suelen pasar desapercibidos y, con un buen acercamiento de la cámara, notas cierta belleza (quizás no todos lo consideren belleza) que termina haciendo que las veas por bastante rato. Espero que disfruten de estas fotos.


https://images.ecency.com/DQmcYPBWyGdtjYSAYH9fppaAE1zcsKRMiDBZJ5FijF5XQ3r/dsc03109.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGpmU5eLwxLNexYbDCWzYwss8UyYjwXjd4nLDHT7ELj3/dsc03113.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmRN3spPt7onzDx9CsufaiZppxtVDHAsmBNwbnkAm3wNDR/dsc03115.jpg

https://images.ecency.com/DQmPn2i6sUh7Jc1Dg5vTchbwVvSUwKps6DSLLEbqezKcbdw/dsc03121.jpg

>

While I was in my backyard, I came across this caterpillar climbing an old stick. I quickly grabbed my camera, a little worried it might disappear too fast, but I managed to take these photos; I had to use the flash because the sun was already setting, and that definitely helped me capture more detail and get a sharper focus.

Mientras me encontraba en el patio de mi casa, me crucé con esta oruga escalando un viejo palo. Busqué mi cámara rápido con cierto temor a que desapareciera muy rápido, pero ciertamente logré hacer estas fotos; tuve que apoyarme del flash porque ya el sol se estaba ocultando y esto me permitió obtener más detalles y hacer un mejor enfoque sin duda.

Then I came across a centipede; this one was even harder to photograph, because they move pretty fast and I had a hard time getting the focus right, but I still think I managed to get some good shots. That’s all for today; thank you so much for looking at my photos and reading a little of what I’ve written; I really appreciate it. I hope you all have a wonderful day. See you next time, dear friends in the community and photography lovers!

Luego me topé con un ciempiés; este fue incluso más difícil de hacerle fotos, porque caminan bastante rápido y hacer el enfoque se me dificultó bastante, pero aun así creo que conseguí unas buenas fotografías. Esto es todo por el día de hoy; muchas gracias por ver mis fotografías y leer un poco de lo que escribo; lo aprecio mucho. Deseo que todos tengan un excelente día. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía!

body.title: Our responsibility towards the natural environment.
body.body: is a very important resource for us, that is, every living being on this earth. This natural environment is very important for not only humans but also for various animals, birds and even small insects. We need this natural environment every second to survive and live healthily. And we are constantly destroying this natural environment, which is a completely stupid thing. Because we never think that we are destroying the forests around us and destroying the natural environment in such a way that only we are suffering the most. The animals, birds and insects that cannot survive without this natural environment, which are very useful to us, are constantly being harmed. We are constantly cutting down and destroying the trees of this nature and building big buildings, factories, mills and other things there. But we never think that the forests that we are cutting down and clearing are helping us to survive. And as a result of such destruction of the environment, we will not be able to live healthily ourselves later. If we have to stay healthy and live well, then first of all we need to make our beautiful natural environment more beautiful. Instead of constantly cutting trees, we should try to plant more trees. We should constantly protect various forests, sanctuaries and other natural environment components. Ponds, lakes, rivers should not be closed but should be kept clean and tidy. Ponds and lakes are a very important thing for our environment, so we need to constantly create more dog ponds. Instead of dirtying various water bodies and throwing garbage and making them dirty or closed, we should keep them clean and tidy. So that we can use those water bodies for various needs without wasting them. There are many animals and birds in this world, but none of them destroy this environment except us humans. The main reason for the destruction of the environment by mankind has been proven to be when the coronavirus was spreading and we were confined to our homes. As long as we were under house arrest, the roads, rivers and various water bodies were much cleaner. Because we were confined to our homes and could not make the roads and various water bodies dirty. But as soon as we started going out again from our house arrest, the environment started getting dirty again. Therefore, we should learn from this and be more aware so that our environment is not destroyed by us. The way we are destroying our environment and cutting down trees and closing water bodies, at some point the environment around us will turn into a desert. And it will become much more difficult for us to survive in that desert, and even drinking water and eating food to live this life will become much more difficult. There is still time, so if we want, we can still consciously build our environment beautifully without destroying it like conscious citizens. By creating various water bodies and keeping them clean, we can provide a beautiful environment for various animals, birds, and ourselves to live in. We can preserve various forest sanctuaries and with that we can plant many more plants around us, due to which our natural environment and weather will become much better. If there are enough different water bodies and plants in our environment, then different types of animals, birds and even insects will be able to live beautifully in the environment and we will also be able to live beautifully. If our environment is good, the weather of the environment will be very good and clean. Every insect, animal, bird, animal, small and big animal in our environment is an important and necessary part of our natural environment. And this part helps a lot in making our environment beautiful, so we should also make our environment much more beautiful. We must take care that the dirty water of various factories and factories, as well as rivers, canals, ponds and all the different good water bodies cannot be destroyed. Throwing garbage everywhere is not allowed, garbage should be thrown in a specific place and we should always try to keep the surroundings clean. body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g7adf447d498515ea7408127ba149d19ad2d0b738eef3b263008fc7b1b8153131906d815f50eaf36bddbd3b1eecbfecb8e04fb6bc27951720189c3f5bdb73035d_640.jpg)</center>

***

# The Tale of the Harmonious Village

In a lush valley surrounded by towering mountains, there was a village known as Harmonia. The villagers prided themselves on their ability to live in perfect harmony with each other and their environment. They shared their resources, celebrated together, and resolved conflicts with kindness and understanding.

## The Gift of Unity

One day, a wise elder named Elara gathered the villagers to share a special gift: a magical lyre that could produce melodies reflecting the emotions of those who played it. \

Excited, the villagers took turns playing the lyre, creating beautiful music that resonated through the valley. The melodies brought them closer together, and for a time, their happiness seemed boundless.

## The Cracks in the Melody

However, as the days passed, the villagers began to feel the pressure to maintain their perfect harmony. Some started to suppress their true feelings, fearing that any discord would shatter the peace they had built. They laughed when they were sad, agreed when they disagreed, and smiled when they were angry.

The lyre, once a source of joy, began to play a different tune. The melodies grew dissonant, reflecting the villagers' hidden emotions. The more they ignored their true selves, the louder the lyre's discord became.

## The Breaking Point

One fateful day, during the village's annual festival, a disagreement arose over the choice of the main dish for the feast. Instead of expressing their opinions, the villagers remained silent, unwilling to disrupt the fragile harmony. The tension escalated until it erupted into a heated argument, shattering the facade of unity.

In the chaos, the magical lyre broke, its strings snapping one by one. The villagers were left in shock, realizing that their pursuit of harmony had led them to silence their authentic selves.

## The Path to True Harmony

In the aftermath, Elara gathered the villagers once more. \

With newfound understanding, the villagers began to speak their minds and share their feelings honestly. They learned to appreciate each other's perspectives, recognizing that diversity was the true essence of their community.

## The Rebirth of the Lyre

As they rebuilt the lyre together, they infused it with their genuine emotions—their joys, sorrows, and everything in between. When they played it again, the music was richer and more complex, weaving together their individual notes into a beautiful symphony.

From that day forward, the villagers of Harmonia understood that true harmony is not about eliminating discord but about embracing the full spectrum of human experience. They learned to dance with their differences, creating a melody that resonated with authenticity and connection.

---

## **Wisdom to Remember**

> **\

**

In the pursuit of harmony, let us not forget the importance of authenticity. True unity flourishes when we are honest about who we are.

#

##  “La pluma es lengua del alma; cuales fueren los conceptos que en ella se engendraron, tales serán sus escritos”.
 (Don Quijote de la Mancha)
</center>

<div class=\

> **¡Hola! Amigos de #Literatos, les saludo desde mi pequeño universo, pero grande de corazón. Volandito ando, para darles un saludo a ustedes, amantes de las novelas, de la poesía, de cuentos y relatos, y todo lo relacionado con la literatura. Les dejo un fuerte abrazo con mi cariño. Recuerden, es preferible ser un ¡Loco ‘e perinola! que hacer siempre las cosas de la misma manera.** **Pónganle pasión y verán cómo su imaginación se desborda y alzan el vuelo.** **¡Ahí se las dejo!**

> >![ English] > > “The pen is the tongue of the soul; whatever thoughts are conceived within it, such will be its writings.” (Don Quijote de la Mancha) Hello! Friends of #Literatos, I greet you from my small universe, but one that's big in heart. I'm flying over to say hello to you, lovers of novels, poetry, short stories, and all things related to literature. I send you a big hug with all my love. Remember, it's better to be a bit of a dreamer than to always do things the same way. Put your heart into it and you'll see how your imagination overflows and you take flight. There you have it!
![Romantic and unforgettable melodies from the movies (18).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/EpGU3x9ijgTQgyi5QJLHMqQYrNxdAa3Ta13VE3xQftbuEVYtv6TP89VysCA5V3tEsS8.png)

>

Cuando la imaginación se desborda, aparecen y crecen las alas del ser humano creativo. Esto le permite volar al infinito y crear. Este vuelo se convierte en poema, novela, cuento y muchas otras expresiones de amor a la literatura. Algunas veces el vuelo es impulsado por otra persona que se da cuenta del potencial. A estas personas las llamo “especiales” porque tienen un don y sensibilidad que les hace ser diferentes. Y cuando leen un poema, tu alma es capaz de vibrar de la emoción, pues tienen una voz cantarina. 

Esta voz la tenía mi mami cuando se metía en el mundo que amaba, el de los libros y la lectura. Hablaba con una emoción que no dejaba dudas. Me parece verla allí sentada con sus piernas cruzadas y un café. “Especial”, sí, porque me dio amor, inculcó y enseñó todo lo que soy. Sobre todo, me inició en el mundo de la lectura, a amar a los libros y a entender que un libro es el arma más letal contra la ignorancia. Desde que aprendí a leer, mi madre me ponía a leerle el periódico o una revista de Selecciones y analizar el artículo. 

Ese gusanito por la verdad, búsqueda de información y preguntadora cuando algo no me convence lo heredé de mi mami. Entre mis curiosidades estaba saber por qué abuelita Bertita’s decía que los poetas, escritores, pintores y otros eran ¡Loco ‘e perinola!. Para ella, el que no estudiaba ni obtenía un título no era nadie en la vida. Así como ella, la sociedad imponía lo mismo. Por supuesto, esto ha cambiado mucho y se ha demostrado que un título no asegura el éxito. 

Escribir es algo que todas las personas no son capaces de hacer, porque es algo que se desarrolla y que las hace ser sensibles, intuitivas, y permite que sean más creativas. Escribir un libro no es cualquier cosa. 

Un libro es para mí como una piscina de conocimiento donde cada vez me sumerjo en otro mundo; encuentro respuesta y conozco personajes inolvidables. Particularmente, me fascina leer y me concentro de tal manera que me olvido de todo a mí alrededor. Siento que soy un personaje más creado por la pluma del escritor.

Beckyta, mi ratoncita de biblioteca, amiguis inseparable, ama a los libros tanto como yo. Leímos juntas el primer libro que nos regalaron, “Platero y yo” de Juan Ramón Jiménez. Ella también lee todo lo que llega a sus manos. Para nosotras el 23 es un día muy significativo, pues se celebra el Día Mundial del Libro, del Derecho de Autor y del habla hispana. Se hace referencia a tres grandes de la literatura: Miguel de Cervantes, William Shakespeare e Inca Garcilaso de la Vega. La tertulia sobre libros y escritores es una de mis pasiones.

Todos los libros que han pasado por mis manos me han dejado un legado de amor. Quizás piensen que estoy loca, pero a muchos la sociedad ha tildado de locos y, sin embargo, han sido capaces de grandes hazañas y de crear grandes obras en todos los ámbitos: tecnología, medicina, ciencia, música y en las artes. Creo que todos los seres humanos tienen un toque de locura que les permite poner a volar su imaginación y ser más creativos.

**¡Loco ‘e perinola! o imaginación desbordada** 

¡Loco! La mayor locura del ser humano es creer en algo que no sabe si es cierto, pero es única la verdad que conoce. Si es cierto o no, no importa. Así vemos supuestos locos en el mundo, pero que quizás estén más cuerdos que muchos. En cuanto a la literatura, encontramos escritores, poetas, cuentistas, entre otros. Aunque no lo crean, algunos han sido considerados locos, pero han logrado transformar vidas con sus escritos. 

Considero que el principal loco de la literatura fue Miguel de Cervantes; es mi escritor más querido. Aunque aparentemente fue un hombre centrado, fue capaz de darle vida a Alfonso Quijano o “Caballero de la triste figura”.

Un personaje que para muchos es un “¡Loco ‘e perinola!”, sin embargo, para mí fue la falta de amor y la soledad en la que vivía, que lo impulsó a cometer locuras hasta llegar al delirio. Con Alfonso Quijano, Miguel de Cervantes logró ser el más grande escritor de su época y el más importante en la historia de la humanidad. ¿Y cuándo a mí me preguntan cuál es mi libro preferido y personaje más emblemático? Enseguida mi mente vuela y encuentra esa famosa frase:

**“En un lugar de la Mancha, de cuyo nombre no quiero acordarme…”** Y veo ahí frente a mí, sonriéndome, a mi amor Alfonzo Quijano, y en esos momentos soy su Dulcinea del Toboso. Oh la la

La frase de inicio de mi novela preferida: **“El ingenioso hidalgo don Quijote de la Mancha”** es emblemática y no creo que haya en el mundo alguien que no la conozca. Pues, es una joya de la literatura universal. Cervantes fue un escritor con  una imaginación tan especial que le permitió alzar el vuelo y crear personajes y situaciones por las cuales atraviesan Alfonzo Quijano y hacen de esta novela insuperable en su género. Según la página www.informacion.es indica:

>“El Quijote, su obra maestra, ha vendido más de 400 millones de ejemplares y ha sido traducida en 12 idiomas…”Para más información visite <a href=\

> Alonso Quijano se sumergió en su mundo de caballeros con armaduras, buscando aventuras y salvando damas en peligro. De tal manera que lo llevó al delirio y perdió todo lo que tenía. Así como él, conozco a muchos. En fin, si permito a Beckyta hablar de todo lo que ha leído en nuestra vida, no va a terminar nunca. Sobre todo, de su amor por Miguel de Cervantes y de su caballero de la triste figura, pues ella lo conoce muy bien. Lo siguió de cerca en todas sus andanzas y desde que leyó su primer libro de caballería.

>

>![ English]
>
> When imagination overflows, the wings of the creative human being appear and grow. This allows them to soar to infinity and create. This flight becomes a poem, a novel, a short story, and many other expressions of love for literature. Sometimes, this flight is propelled by another person who recognizes the potential. I call these people \

because they possess a gift and sensitivity that sets them apart. And when they read a poem, your soul is able to vibrate with emotion, for they have a melodious voice.\nThis was the voice my mother had when she immersed herself in the world she loved: books and reading. She spoke with an emotion that left no room for doubt. I can almost see her there, sitting with her legs crossed and a cup of coffee. \

yes, because she gave me love, instilled in me, and taught me everything I am. Above all, she introduced me to the world of reading, to a love of books, and to the understanding that a book is the most lethal weapon against ignorance. From the moment I learned to read, my mother would have me read the newspaper or a Reader's Digest to her and analyze the article.\nThat thirst for truth, that search for information, that questioning instinct when something doesn't convince me—I inherited it from my mother. \nThat thirst for truth, that search for information, that questioning habit when something doesn't convince me—I inherited it from my mom. Among my curiosities was knowing why Grandma Bertita said that poets, writers, painters, and others were \

For her, anyone who didn't study or get a degree was nobody in life. Like her, society imposed the same view. Of course, things have changed a lot, and it's been proven that a degree doesn't guarantee success.
Writing is something not everyone is capable of, because it's a skill that develops and fosters sensitivity, intuition, and creativity. Writing a book is no small feat.
A book is like a pool of knowledge for me, where I immerse myself in another world each time; I find answers and meet unforgettable characters. I'm particularly fascinated by reading, and I concentrate so deeply that I forget everything around me. I feel like I'm another character created by the writer's pen.
Beckyta, my bookworm and inseparable friend, loves books as much as I do. We read together the first book we were given, \

by Juan Ramón Jiménez. She also reads everything she can get her hands on. For us, the 23rd is a very significant day, as it's World Book Day, World Copyright Day, and Spanish Language Day. It commemorates three literary giants: Miguel de Cervantes, William Shakespeare, and Inca Garcilaso de la Vega. Discussing books and writers is one of my passions.
Every book that has passed through my hands has left me with a legacy of love. Perhaps you think I'm crazy, but society has labeled many as crazy, and yet they have been capable of great feats and created great works in all fields: technology, medicine, science, music, and the arts. I believe that all human beings have a touch of madness that allows them to let their imaginations soar and be more creative.
¡Loco ‘e perinola! or overflowing imagination
Crazy! The greatest madness a human being can experience is believing in something they don't know is true, yet the truth they know is the only one. Whether it's true or not doesn't matter. We see so-called madmen in the world, but perhaps they're saner than many. In literature, we find writers, poets, short story writers, and others. Believe it or not, some have been considered mad, yet they've managed to transform lives with their writing.
I believe that the greatest madman in literature was Miguel de Cervantes; he is my most beloved writer. Although he appeared to be a level-headed man, he was able to bring to life Alfonso Quijano, or the \

A character that many consider a complete lunatic, however, for me, it was the lack of love and the loneliness in which he lived that drove him to commit acts of madness, ultimately leading to delirium. With Alfonso Quijano, Miguel de Cervantes became the greatest writer of his time and the most important in the history of humankind. And when I'm asked what my favorite book and most iconic character are, my mind immediately wanders to that famous phrase:
“In a village of La Mancha, the name of which I do not wish to recall…” And there before me I see, smiling at me, my love Alfonso Quijano, and in those moments I am his Dulcinea of Toboso. Oh la la.
The opening line of my favorite novel, \

is iconic, and I don't think there's anyone in the world who doesn't know it. It's a jewel of world literature. Cervantes was a writer with such a unique imagination that it allowed him to take flight and create characters and situations that Alfonso Quijano experiences, making this novel unsurpassed in its genre. According to the website www.informacion.es:\n“Don Quijote, his masterpiece, has sold over 400 million copies and has been translated into 12 languages…” \nFor more information visit  <a href=\

>aquí Alonso Quijano immersed himself in his world of knights in armor, seeking adventures and rescuing damsels in distress. This led him to madness, and he lost everything he had. Like him, I know many others. Anyway, if I let Beckyta talk about everything she's read in our lives, she'll never finish. Especially about her love for Miguel de Cervantes and his knight of the sorrowful countenance, because she knows him very well. She followed him closely in all his adventures, ever since she read her first book of chivalry.
![222 Audifonos para mi Gamer favorito (61).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mafalda2018/48UmA66e9QSfENgnwMuQKoi67CY8TYgtTfmDvvNWxZqfGXUbti5MdtF196YDifgFCj.png)

>

## Escritores: Loco ‘e perinola, intuitivos y creativos.

Mi querido y amado, **Gabo o Gabriel García Márquez**. Quizás sea el más loquito de todos los que he conocido. Fue uno de los más grandes de la literatura y máximo representante del realismo mágico en Latinoamérica. Desde su nacimiento trae sangre de escritor en las venas. Llegó al mundo con su pluma y una mariposa amarilla en las manos. Su mente creativa creó el mundo famoso  de “Macondo”, a Úrsula Iguarán y José Arcadio Buendía, la pareja que da inicio a esta famosa novela **“Cien años de soledad”**.

Esta novela de Gabo se publicó en el año 1967, y ganó el premio Nobel de Literatura en el año 1982.  J.M Sadurní publicó un artículo en la página historia.nationalgeographic.com.es, titulado: “Gabriel García Márquez, el maestro del realismo mágico”, donde indica:

> En una semana vendió más de ocho mil ejemplares y en tres años, nada menos que quinientos mil…” Para más información visite <a href=\

> A veces me pregunto por qué unos escritores lo logran y otros no. Pues, yo tengo la respuesta: es la imaginación e intuición. Quizás algo tan simple como ver a una pareja bajarse de un tren desencadenó la historia. Abrió las puertas de algo que tenía muy escondido y decidió darle alas y poner a volar a la mariposa amarilla que traía desde su nacimiento en su mano. Y esto le permitió a la familia Buendía fundar Macondo. Me imagino a mi amigo **Lewis Carroll**, fastidiado, tirándole piedras al río; bajo el árbol de manzano, miró al cielo y, de repente, salió de la nada un conejo a correr y detrás la niña de pelo color del sol y trenzado. Tomó su pluma y describió el país de las maravillas, y exclamó: —Alicia, el mundo la conocerá como Alicia. Si Lewis Carroll fue un loco de perinola, no lo sé. Pero de que estuvo allí y lo plasmó en su cuaderno, es cierto. Pues el libro **“Alicia en el país de las maravillas”** lo tuve en mis manos y me sumergí en este mundo maravilloso que él creó y quedé fascinada. Ya no recuerdo las veces que lo he leído. En este mismo sentido y hablando de locuras, siempre me he preguntado qué habrán sentido las editoriales cuando rechazaron la novela de Harry Potter y la piedra filosofal. De la británica **J. K. Rowling**. Después de que la novela se convirtió en un éxito total. Convirtiéndose en un best seller, y ellos perdieron esa oportunidad y millones de dólares. Quizás dijeron que era una historia sin sentido y hasta la hicieron pasar por loca. ¡Imagínense! Ustedes una mujer con la mente más creativa del mundo moderno y que fue capaz de crear un mundo mágico. En fin, creo que hay un elemento o ingrediente especial que dota a una persona de cualidades o de alas que le permiten lograr cosas inimaginables y maravillosas. Con su crear mundos, planetas y personajes fuera de lo común e inolvidables. Para mí es un toque de locura que los hace diferentes unos de otros. A todos ellos les rindo un pequeño y emotivo homenaje por ser parte de mi vida y hacerme soñar, reír y creer en que todo es posible si se hace con amor y pasión. A todos los escritores, a mis ¡Loco ‘e perinola!, que con su mente e imaginación desbordada dejaron a la humanidad grandes obras que perdurarán en el tiempo. A todos y cada uno de ellos que tocaron una fibra de mi ser y que es imposible en una publicación hablar de todos. A quienes la UNESCO les ha dedicado el 23 de abril como Día Mundial del Libro, para conmemorarlos y homenajearlos. A William Shakespeare, Charles Dickens, Isabel Allende, Hans Christian Andersen, Louisa May Alcott, Agatha Christie, Mark Twain, JRR Tolkien, Alejandro Dumas, entre otros. A ellos, con todo mi amor y admiración.

>

> Writers: Crazy, Intuitive, and Creative.
My dear and beloved Gabo, or Gabriel García Márquez. Perhaps he's the craziest of all I've ever known. He was one of the greatest writers and the foremost representative of magical realism in Latin America. From birth, he had writer's blood in his veins. He came into the world with his pen and a yellow butterfly in his hands. His creative mind created the famous world of \
Úrsula Iguarán, and José Arcadio Buendía, the couple who kick off the famous novel \

\nThis novel by Gabo was published in 1967, and won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1982. J.M. Sadurní published an article on the website historia.nationalgeographic.com.es, titled: “Gabriel García Márquez, the master of magical realism”, where he states:\n> In one week it sold more than eight thousand copies, and in three years, no less than five hundred thousand…” For more information visit <a href=\

>aquí Sometimes I wonder why some writers succeed and others don't. Well, I have the answer: it's imagination and intuition. Perhaps something as simple as seeing a couple get off a train sparked the story. It opened the doors to something he had kept hidden, and he decided to give wings and set free the yellow butterfly he had carried in his hand since birth. And this allowed the Buendía family to found Macondo. I imagine my friend Lewis Carroll, annoyed, throwing stones into the river; under the apple tree, he looked at the sky and, suddenly, a rabbit appeared out of nowhere, running, followed by the girl with sun-colored, braided hair. He took his pen and described Wonderland, and exclaimed: -“Alice, the world will know her as Alice”. Whether Lewis Carroll was a madman, I don't know. But that he was there and captured it in his notebook, that's for sure. I held the book \

in my hands and immersed myself in this marvelous world he created, and I was captivated. I've lost count of how many times I've read it.
Along the same lines, and speaking of crazy things, I've always wondered what the publishers must have felt when they rejected Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone by J.K. Rowling. After the novel became a massive success, a bestseller, they lost out on that opportunity and millions of dollars. Perhaps they said it was a nonsensical story and even dismissed her as crazy. Imagine that! You, a woman with the most creative mind in the modern world, capable of creating a magical world.
In short, I believe there's a special element or ingredient that endows a person with qualities or wings that allow them to achieve unimaginable and wonderful things. With their ability to create extraordinary and unforgettable worlds, planets, and characters. For me, it's a touch of madness that makes them all different. To each of them, I pay a small and heartfelt tribute for being part of my life and making me dream, laugh, and believe that everything is possible if done with love and passion.
To all writers, to my beloved \

, who with their boundless minds and imaginations left humanity great works that will endure through time. To each and every one of them who touched a fiber of my being, and whom it is impossible to mention in a single publication. To whom UNESCO has dedicated April 23rd as World Book Day, to commemorate and honor them.
To William Shakespeare, Charles Dickens, Isabel Allende, Hans Christian Andersen, Louisa May Alcott, Agatha Christie, Mark Twain, J.R.R. Tolkien, Alexandre Dumas, and others.
To them, with all my love and admiration.

**Do not reject God.**

Do not reject God! God exist! He is the one who created all the world. One day we all will appear before Him to give account of our works. Every man will appear before the judgement seat of Christ and shall account for everything that he or she had done in his body. Are you one of those who will be condemned by God? If you reject God today, do not forget that you will stand before Him to give account of your works. If you choose to live as lord of your own life, that day will come when you will answer God for everything you are doing now (whether they are good or bad)

**Heaven and Hell are real**

It matters not whether you believe or not, the truth is that heaven and earth are real. The Lord Jesus Christ confirmed this when He warns us that it will be better to enter life maimed than to be whole and happy and end in hell. He also warned that there is no profit for a man to possess the world world but lost his or her soul in hell. So, hell is real. Is there any wisdom in enjoying life on earth which has a limit and then end up in destruction in hell? I don't think that is wise. Let us life; eat and drink but let us not forget to honour and obey God in our life.
