body.title: Delicious fish recipes
body.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVpeYBALpDPY2JpdSZY2oM1hXxLC2vdEwxx3t7hvTqjLC/076a4973-81a4-4a7f-9c1a-464a4c2c713d.jpg)

Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well. Alhamdulillah, today I have come up with a great recipe for you. The taste of each dish reminds us how healthy the food is and how beneficial it is for our bodies. We should eat it accordingly. Today I have prepared a fish recipe. What do we need to make it, and how do we prepare it? All the details are given below.

 > Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, yo también estoy bien. Alhamdulillah, hoy les traigo una receta estupenda. El sabor de cada plato nos recuerda lo saludable que es la comida y lo beneficiosa que es para nuestro cuerpo. Debemos comerla como tal. Hoy he preparado una receta de pescado. ¿Qué necesitamos para prepararla y cómo la hacemos? Todos los detalles están a continuación.

Horn fish

chopped onion

bay leaf

salt

turmeric powder

dried chili powder

cumin powder

white oil

roasted cumin seeds

Pescado cuerno

​

Cebolla picada

​

Hoja de laurel

​

Sal

​

Cúrcuma en polvo

​

Chile seco en polvo

​

Comino en polvo

​

Aceite blanco

​

Semillas de comino tostadas

Fish is very beneficial for our body, especially for children. Fish is also very beneficial for everyone, from children to the elderly. However, we can prepare this fish recipe in different ways. We should include different types of fish, from small to large, in our daily food list. Apart from this, the people of Bangladesh like to eat fish a lot, which is why they are called Bengalis with fish.

 > El pescado es muy beneficioso para nuestro organismo, especialmente para los niños. También es muy beneficioso para todos, desde niños hasta ancianos. Sin embargo, podemos preparar esta receta de pescado de diferentes maneras. Deberíamos incluir distintos tipos de pescado, desde pequeños hasta grandes, en nuestra dieta diaria. Además, a la gente de Bangladesh le gusta mucho comer pescado, por eso se les llama bengalíes amantes del pescado.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbtKs8pYLDYhLFn4fuQ38pXLXz6ANfMgxuWU9tdxsDkyP/2f0fc578-8020-4a34-90bd-d03735eb5e35.jpg)

To prepare the recipe I am going to make today, first cut the fish well and wash it. Then put it on the stove and add chopped onions and bay leaves. Fry the onions in oil until brown. Don't let them burn. Then add all the spices with a little water. However, I will not add ginger paste and garlic paste. I will cook it a little differently today without them.

 > Para preparar la receta de hoy, primero corta bien el pescado y lávalo. Luego, ponlo al fuego y añade cebolla picada y hojas de laurel. Sofríe la cebolla en aceite hasta que se dore, sin que se queme. Después, añade todas las especias con un poco de agua. Sin embargo, no añadiré pasta de jengibre ni de ajo. Hoy lo cocinaré de una forma un poco diferente, sin ellas.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQPg54jSFSZg3eBbsHVBR62TEzKm8CpFduTLj3iBkYYuf/51d911a2-0137-4f56-9abe-e20c7c384701.jpg)

Then, after waiting for a while, I will put my washed fish here and fry the fish well with oil for two minutes. Then I will add a little water and cover it with a lid for 5 minutes so that the fish is cooked well, and a fragrance will come out from inside my pan as the fish is cooked. Then I will think that it is cooked.

 > Luego, tras esperar un rato, pondré el pescado lavado aquí y lo freiré bien con aceite durante dos minutos. Después, añadiré un poco de agua y lo taparé durante 5 minutos para que el pescado se cocine bien. Cuando esté listo, desprenderá un aroma delicioso.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSySCHrhnpsmTwRrrbxjCnTEGjbtvG9yEX8soYNSWRP2g/c7e17f82-ba7a-449b-ba6a-1b197cb1c01a.jpg)

 > Luego, añade agua suficiente para comprobar la sal y, por último, agrega una cucharada de semillas de comino fritas por encima. Esto realzará el sabor del plato y le dará un aroma incomparable. ¡Listo! No puedes esperar más. Sirve esta receta caliente en un tazón.

It tastes great with hot pulao or rice, and we can keep these types of dishes for lunch or dinner. Till then, you will make such dishes and share with us how you liked them. Until then, stay well, everyone. May Allah protect you.


![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVpeYBALpDPY2JpdSZY2oM1hXxLC2vdEwxx3t7hvTqjLC/076a4973-81a4-4a7f-9c1a-464a4c2c713d.jpg)\n\n > Sabe delicioso con arroz o pulao caliente, y podemos guardar este tipo de platos para el almuerzo o la cena. Mientras tanto, prepárenlos y cuéntennos qué les parecieron. Hasta entonces, cuídense mucho. Que Alá los proteja. ! [Click to reveal] Your spoiler content

body.title: Deliciosa torta de chocolate | Delicious chocolate cake
body.body:
Un saludo muy afectuoso a todos los amigos de esta linda comunidad. Hoy les traigo una receta tan deliciosa y tan provocativa que estoy segura que también va a ser de sus recetas preferidas. La torta de chocolate queda aún más deliciosa si se rellena con una crema bien espesa. Los invito a probarla. >Warmest greetings to all my friends in this lovely community. Today I’m sharing a recipe that’s so delicious and tempting, I’m sure it’ll become one of your favourites too. A chocolate cake tastes even better when filled with a rich, thick cream. I invite you to give it a try. ![IMG-20260425-WA0001.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/2432Wn4bjHRWMZViaCXPKD5e8VEAzcg7ixg3ee86HiH5C29e9qzCNAaUvvcmXMWsC87AD.jpg)
**Ingredientes:** Torta: - 760 gr de harina de trigo - 5 huevos - 440 gr de azúcar - 200 gr de margarina - 500 ml de leche - 100 gr de cacao Cubierta: - 330 gr de azúcar - 5 cucharadas de maicena - 5 cucharadas de cacao - 4 cucharadas de margarina - 420 ml de leche
**Ingredients:** Cake: - 760 g plain flour - 5 eggs - 440 g sugar - 200 g margarine - 500 ml milk - 100 g cocoa powder Topping: - 330 g sugar - 5 tablespoons of cornflour - 5 tablespoons of cocoa powder - 4 tablespoons of margarine - 420 ml of milk
![IMG_20260423_174541.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoAaHeCdA2sAf1BEpYUbQU3qShyE3VURDGnD1Pt9c3x2X6vCmiLKEEVRMsKDrcuLLLM.jpg) **Preparación:** En un bol se mezcla la margarina con el azúcar. Cuando ya estén bien unidos se agregan los huevos y se bate hasta que esté cremoso. Se tamiza la harina y se va agregando poco a poco alternando con la leche. Se tamiza también el cacao, el cual se va agregando con el resto de la leche y se termina de mezclar todo. >**Method:** In a bowl, mix the margarine with the sugar. Once well combined, add the eggs and beat until creamy. Sift the flour and add it gradually, alternating with the milk. Sift the cocoa powder as well, then add it with the remaining milk and mix everything together until smooth. ![IMG_20260423_181416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23tmQTMsRAQHmxSZNFycyCTZARFaE83ejeC4B3UBPDj9AAjEZ5JL46xT4avpopJA9zpEE.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_181533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23wX5R6ZfKjcEA5xxkjn2PGSVJFnYWYbrWM2kU7AB12BWrfwgyK8eLHWeyWUm1qAGu8yA.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_182244.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23wgW5cyrRY48UASts9HgYb5m3G9j3mzzhWDN4dC1fERPnTcbPxq9KDSRwvLvP5HtCtcr.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_183253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23uQtWLG8knFwPyP8GAu6t19Q8iYczvtN5TvCrTZt9gEXaKtn8B1vP9qi74bQDCtJSxgD.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_184040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/Ep3ePrtGC9XGDy7n26dU6p6UbwPZX6ioG9QRsGhSaz4Uus8HwEraCWBmGzCu2JowYbc.jpg) Se pone a precalentar el horno a 180°C. Se e mantequilla y enharina el molde. Se vierte la mezcla en el molde y se lleva al horno de 50 minutos a una hora. Al retirar del horno se deja enfriar durante unos 10 minutos para desmoldar. Se deja enfriar. Aparte, en un tazón se agrega la leche(Se reserva media taza para disolver la maicena), el azucar y se mezcla bien. Se añade la margarina hasta lograr una mezcla homogénea. Luego se va agregando el cacao. Se unen bien todos los ingredientes y se lleva al fuego. Cuando comienza a hervir se va añadiendo poco a poco la la maicena y se termina de cocinar a fuego lento hasta que espese. >Preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease and flour the tin. Pour the mixture into the tin and bake for 50 minutes to an hour. Once removed from the oven, leave to cool for about 10 minutes before turning out. Leave to cool completely. Separately, in a bowl, add the milk (reserve half a cup to dissolve the cornflour), the sugar and mix well. Add the margarine until the mixture is smooth. Then gradually add the cocoa. Combine all the ingredients thoroughly and place over the heat. When it begins to boil, gradually add the cornflour and continue cooking over a low heat until it thickens. ![IMG-20260423-WA0044.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23zGpxHT9ti1LpTtHs7dnT6e1W5wtH8L4UoiMv14ad2Bsrc7sYEMPqzg7e8unjdMAuCZv.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_185939.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EogMQ36enUs2GU45G66uB9CF9Whk4nagGxzWmUHVbq1FCv5dAyB686sEqbFdFvzEa7i.jpg) Se corta la torta por la mitad y se vierte la crema de chocolate en las dos mitades permitiendo que la crema penetre en ella. Luego se coloca una encima de la otra y se va esparciendo la crema sobre la torta cubriéndola toda. ¡Y a disfrutar de esta torta tan deliciosa! >Cut the cake in half and pour the chocolate cream over both halves, allowing the cream to soak in. Then place one half on top of the other and spread the cream over the cake until it is completely covered. Now sit back and enjoy this delicious cake! ![IMG-20260427-WA0038.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23z7Usmud8wb4T6tzq5sids64PyJ9vRw1mQhu2Cm1v3fQyTHurHAUL5uEA9b4VJPDsfwK.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_133111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23u5xwNu8pkQJj21uYEaVm4Rcopzo42LuLNQLdQhBXqBetEoXcxRFqLGPG2P3zD2xgySp.jpg) ![IMG_20260424_133449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EpQwhc11WqUKMt3frSmmBZM4wP3izU2EhHysheDv5TgLgMbUPycWhCcM1X1Yedo7FQg.jpg) ![IMG-20260424-WA0015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/243MBovGayrEeJGELEApsV7X2EUXqudRAMGPhryHb94zxXysoGUEX3p3jkRBqctnagFjt.jpg) ![IMG-20260424-WA0006.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/23y8qHDT3P935mSkn7Wo5gTnxk41VsftZ2cNtNMhukS1TQ9fBYdrgXYUqCreRrtLDirFC.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado la receta que les traje hoy. Deseo verlos muy pronto para compartir con ustedes otra de mis recetas favoritas. >I hope you enjoyed the recipe I shared with you today. I look forward to seeing you very soon to share another of my favourite recipes with you. ![IMG-20260316-WA0032(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzmilabracho/EoCmQBGHdzuUJjfpdZArj42YxMLZHDxgtgVN7w3BNpWLzCkqBsYmXRaU13S2a7XpEjd.jpg) - Fotografías tomadas desde mi celular Redmi 9. - Banner realizado en https://www.canva.com/ - Footer realizado en https://www.canva.com/

body.title: Estelle's Story, In his memory
body.body:
Good evening, dear friends of Hive and Buskeria. I'm so happy to greet you today and wish you a wonderful day. Today I want to share my new story dedicated to Estelle. You'll see that she goes through the hardest thing a singer can go through. The question is whether or not she'll be able to recover from what happens. If you want to know what happens to her, I invite you to keep reading. I hope you enjoy it. With that said, let's begin. Here we go.

> Buenas noches queridos y estimados amigos de hive y Buskeria, me da mucho gusto saludarlos hoy y desearles un hermoso día. Hoy les quiero compartir mi nueva historia dedicada a Estelle. Verán que ella pasa por lo más duro que puede pasar un cantante. La cuestión es si ella podrá recuperarse o no de lo que pasará. Si desean saber qué es lo que le pasará les invito a seguir leyendo. Espero que les guste, con esto mencionado ya podemos iniciar. Arrancamos.

<div class=\

> ![1777224878808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23xySuF1hFawiC1BPWBx6abeArVXuMej3rxNVX8aDqCTaYnyjmYPSzKbV88wVZyLNFFmN.jpg) Image created by me in canva **Post translated with Google Translate** From a young age, they had always been together, inseparable friends. But they were more than friends; they were blood sisters. These are Estelle and Nati. They grew up together, lovingly cared for by their parents. They had a very happy childhood, filled with everything their parents could have wished for. Nati, Estelle's slightly older sister, loved to sing, even though she was very young. There was a karaoke machine with a speaker connected to the house. She loved being able to sing and try to imitate the songs she heard on her father's laptop. She often spent the whole day singing. Her parents sometimes had to call her to go outside and play or to play with Estelle, but she had a great love for music. She wasn't content with just singing herself; she wanted Estelle to sing along with her. But Estelle didn't really like to sing, so she wasn't very enthusiastic. Nati had to insist a lot to get her to sing too. It developed into an acquired taste for the youngest one because she liked to sing more and more, as she noticed that it was very entertaining. > Desde pequeñas siempre habían estado juntas, eran las amigas inseparables. Pero eran más que amigas, eran hermanas de sangre. Esas son Estelle y Nati. Ambas crecieron juntas con todos los cuidados de sus padres. Tuvieron una infancia muy feliz y llena de todos los gustos que pudieron desear y estaban al alcance de sus padres. A Nati la hermana un poco mayor de Estelle le gustaba mucho cantar y eso que tenía muy poca edad. En la casa había un karaoke con un altavoz conectado. A ella le encantaba poder cantar e intentar imitar las canciones que escuchaba en la laptop de su padre. > Muchas veces se pasaba todo el día cantando. Sus padres a veces tenían que requerirla para que fuera a jugar fuera de la casa o para que jugara con Estelle, pero ella tenía un gran amor por la música. No se conformó con solo cantar ella, también quería que Estelle lo hiciera junto con ella. Pero a ella no le gustaba mucho cantar, así que no tenía mucha emoción. Nati tenía que insistirle mucho para que cantara también. Se fue creando como un gusto adquirido para la más pequeña porque cada vez le gustaba cantar más, pues ella notaba que era muy entretenido.

> ![obie-fernandez-uDAr4KFKY40-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23tkpRTHWxLQ2JWEXeuojpkpkF6Rxu8BRAPo3JwKDgN4dEow2fvHGMazBoTrXfhwVTagn.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) What began as a game between them grew stronger until they aspired to be real singers, but most importantly, they wanted to do it together. They wanted to form a duo to achieve success throughout Buskeria. It was almost a shared dream. To reach this goal, they set their minds to it and studied music at one of the most prestigious schools in the nation. Both graduated with honors and top marks. Soon after, they began writing their own songs and performing. Their parents supported them from the start in many ways, buying them equipment and connecting them with the right people in the music industry. They found them good managers and producers, and with their connections, they were able to get a record label to work with them. Thanks to all this help, they were able to get ahead on a solid footing, and it was no wonder that by the age of 26, they had Buskeria completely captivated them. They had become very famous, and both were the most in-demand singers. People lined up for ages to attend their events. Everyone wanted a picture with them, and everyone loved their music. > Lo que comenzó como un juego entre ambas fue fortaleciéndose hasta que desearon ser cantantes de verdad, pero lo más importante es que lo querían hacer juntas. Querían formar un dúo para poder triunfar en todo Buskeria. Era casi un seño compartido. Para lograr esa meta se lo propusieron y estudiaron música en una de las escuelas más prestigiosas de la nación. Ambas se graduaron con títulos de honor y con las más altas notas. Al poco después comenzaron a hacer sus canciones y a cantar. Sus padres las apoyaron desde el inicio de muchas formas, le compraron equipos, las pusieron en contacto con las personas correctas en la música. > Les consiguieron buenos managers y productores, y con sus contactos pudieron hacer que una discográfica trabajara con ellas. Gracias a toda esta ayuda pudieron salir adelante con pie firme, y no era de extrañar que a sus 26 años ya tuvieran a Buskeria completa rendida a sus pies. Se habían hecho muy famosas, y ambas eran las cantantes más demandadas. La gente hacía filas enormes para poder asistir a sus eventos. Todos querían una foto con ellas, y todos amaban su música.

> ![ismael-paramo-I39GqO3Qq2M-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uQLZ1FAqAG6i9C2zG8ioLV1k8UfwJzgg6SRuksGi3i3wZWNdysK1VebwE2ekctBcKVX.jpg) [Source](www.pexels.com) The truth is, things were going incredibly well for both of them. When they were at the peak of their careers, something very sad happened. Nati, the duo's founder, Estelle's role model, the one who had motivated her to pursue music, died of cancer. Unfortunately, it was discovered too late, and little could be done to help her. The repercussions for Estelle's career were devastating. She distanced herself from music for years, unwilling to continue alone without her sister, feeling that without her, the duo was meaningless. It was the saddest thing she had ever experienced. Still with tears in her eyes and the painful memory of her loss, her parents reached out to her once again to offer their support, as they always had. They saw that she had withdrawn from music and wanted nothing to do with it. Seeing this, they offered her advice and asked her what Nati would have wanted. And the answer was obvious; she would have wanted Estelle to stay connected to music, because that had always been her way of finding happiness. She could continue to be happy, for her, for Nati, for that. Because when they saw her singing, they saw a reminder of their beloved daughter, and they would always keep her memory alive. So Estelle changed her mind and didn't turn away from music. Now she will sing with even more passion to keep her sister's memory alive. > Lo cierto es que les iba de lo mejor a las dos. Cuando estaban en la parte más prolífica de sus carreras una cosa muy triste sucedió. Nati, la creadora del dúo, la que siempre fue el ejemplo a seguir de Estelle, la que la había motivado a entrar en la música, murió a causa de cáncer. Lamentablemente le fue descubierto demasiado tarde y no se pudo hacer mucho para ayudarla. Las repercusiones de esto para la carrera de Estelle fueron brutales. Se alejó de la música por años, no quería continuar sola sin su hermana, pues sentía que son ella el dúo no tenía sentido. Fue lo más triste que tuvo que pasar en su vida. > Aún con lagrimas en los ojos y con el triste recuerdo de su pérdida sus padres se acercaron a ella para una vez más darle su ayuda como siempre habían hecho. Vieron que ella se había alejado de la música, y no quería saber nada de ella. Al ver esto la aconsejaron, y le preguntaron que era lo que Nati hubiera querido. Y la respuesta era obvia, ella hubiera querido que Estelle no se alejara de la música, porque esa siempre fue su forma de ser feliz en el mundo. Ella podía seguir siendo feliz, por ella, por Nati, por ello. Porque al verla a ella cantando, veían un recuerdo de su querida hija, y siempre la tendrían en la memoria. Así que Estelle cambió de opinión, y no se alejó de la música. Ahora contentará con más fuerza para mantener viva la memoria de su hermana.

> ![Captura de pantalla (2623).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omztech/23uFTcjNzer4agv9t6aBC1BgJ5xFtDCaUwkBtADCMnhnF5RJBtcJwBc7pvW6DiteqWr83.png) # [Join](https://risingstargame.com) hive's most incredible game, Rising Star , today. **Don't miss the opportunity to become a Rising Star**.

body.title: Book review: The Nightingale and the Rose
body.body:
Warmest greetings to my dear friends who love reading. It fills me with joy to be back with you all in this wonderful community, bringing you a truly beautiful piece. On this occasion, I bring you a story that invites us to reflect on love, compassion, detachment and solidarity: ‘The Nightingale and the Rose’ by Oscar Wilde


![1000423877.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23vsjsESqxTnfkVmGevmWLrwPugieEe2hJg7YmHQiQUqgEVEvA6f6siZTvxrpHkcbipZv.jpg)


In the story ‘The Nightingale and the Rose’, the author tells the tale of a young student who weeps because he has no red rose in his garden for his beloved, who will only dance with him at the Prince’s ball the following night if he brings her a red rose. The young student weeps inconsolably because he fears he will lose his beloved’s love. 

The Nightingale knows the young man, as he sings to him every day at his window, hears his sobs and realises that he is deeply in love with his beloved. Seeing all this, the Nightingale thinks that love is something wonderful, far more so than all the money in the world that could buy the most expensive jewels.

All the other creatures in the garden think the young student is being very dramatic. Why on earth would he cry over a red rose? The Nightingale is the only one who believes the young student’s tears; he does not see him as ridiculous and understands him.

To show solidarity with the student’s painful secret, he takes flight. Spotting a rosebush, he stops to ask for a red rose, offering to sing his sweetest song in return. The rosebush cannot help him, as its roses are white. The Nightingale continues flying in search of another rosebush, but its flowers are yellow. Until he reaches the third rosebush, which tells him that its flowers are red, but that winter has frozen its veins and it will bear no more flowers that year.

Seeing the Nightingale’s persistence, the rosebush tells him that if he wants to get a red rose, there is something he can do to obtain it. It explains that he must make it with music in the moonlight and dye it with the blood of his heart, plunging a thorn into his chest until it pierces through.


![1000423873.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23vsjWWUsGy8sSx9xxMfbERKN3FzcEWyeXnXXJ2nDmCCDzmZgrzBT1VjrkpbXAGJrFXXE.jpg)


The Nightingale begins to ponder the high price he must pay for a rose, but remembering the young student’s tears leads him to reflect that love is better than life itself, and that his bird’s heart is worth nothing compared to a man’s heart.

Having made his decision, the Nightingale flies back to where the student is and tells him to rejoice because he will have his red rose. He promises to sing all night long until the rose is stained with the blood of his heart, and asks only that the student be very happy in return. The student listens to the Nightingale, but cannot understand him, for he knows only how to read books. 

All the other creatures living in the garden could not understand the Nightingale, who would give his life for a red rose, and they asked him to sing one last song. The student, upon hearing him sing, wrote a critique of the Nightingale’s music, saying that his melody lacked both style and sincerity.

When night fell, the Nightingale flew to the rosebush, thrust his breast onto the thorn and sang all night long, whilst blood flowed from his body and, with it, his life. 

At midday, when the student opened his window, he saw a red rose in his garden. He plucked it and ran off to his beloved’s house. He told her they would dance all night because he had found the red rose she had asked him for. But he was taken aback when his beloved told him that the chamberlain’s nephew had sent her jewellery and that she would be dancing with him at the prince’s ball.


![1000423875.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23wCV819Gca7LoDPFLJQz4bkgRFHTUFHFJLibnV1yChNeZtqQL8sGQAJ6Ruz5roHT8AVK.jpg)


The student accused her of being ungrateful, stormed out and threw the rose into the street, where it was crushed by the wheels of a carriage, and went home thinking how stupid love is. He went inside, picked up a book and began to read.

Whilst the Nightingale sacrificed itself for the sole sake of love itself, the Student takes the opposite stance by dismissing love as futile. It is clear that the Nightingale’s loving sacrifice was in vain when the Student reaffirmed his belief in the futility of love. Love is distinguished from the materialistic logic by which many in the world are guided. The futility and vanity with which they view the loving sacrifice is precisely where its beauty lies.

I hope you enjoyed the book I brought you today, ‘The Nightingale and the Rose’. I look forward to seeing you next time when I bring you another of my favourite books.


![1000397427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/luzvicente/23u5b6ajiBKeeZuZKhTdQSA5VtzbFG8AJFYqAhnSTmoyNawPRoDBYMVopYdkUsdjbqvuU.jpg)

body.title: ‎“Dare to Believe?” — Can Arsenal Really Snatch the Title from Manchester City? ‎
body.body:
‎I keep asking myself this question, and honestly, it’s one that doesn’t really have a simple answer, can Arsenal actually pull off a surprise and win the Premier League ahead of Manchester City this season?
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbS8wSr8xKcAbZBFwasHxfxvR3y1kbsUp4epS9Fosi8jh/Goal%20HIC%20-%20LinkedIn%203.jpg%201.webp 

‎
‎[source](https://www.goal.com/en-ng/lists/arsenal-player-ratings-newcastle-premier-league-eberechi-eze/blt006d49a61dc36811)
‎
‎It's incredibly tight while looking at where things stand now. The margins are so small that one slip, one moment of hesitation, one bad result is all it takes to shift the entire story. And if there’s one thing we’ve learned over the years, it’s that Manchester City don’t usually slip when it really matters most.
‎
‎But this season feels a lot different.
‎
‎I can’t help but feel there is a certain maturity watching Arsenal this season. They are different from the team that usually faded when the pressure mounted in previous campaigns. There is more control, more belief, and more resilience in the way they played this season. You can see it in how they manage games, how they respond to setbacks, and how they grind out results even when they are not at their best.
‎
‎Though, still belief alone doesn’t win titles but fixtures do.
‎
‎And this is where things gets really more interesting.
‎
‎When you compare the remaining fixtures right now, it’s not just about who has the “easier” run but it’s about timing, pressure, and mentality. Though Arsenal’s remaining games might look manageable on paper, but football isn’t played on paper like I always said. Those so-called “easier” matches can become traps, especially when every point feels like life or death.
‎
‎Manchester City, on the other hand, thrive mostly in this exact environment. This is their territory. The final stretch of the season is where they become almost mechanical, efficient, ruthless, and relentless. They don’t just win but they suffocate teams with consistency.
‎
‎That’s what makes this race even so fascinating and so brutal.
‎
‎I believe that for Arsenal to truly pull this off, then they need more than just good performances. They need perfection, or something very close to it. Dropping points now is not just a mistake but it’s an invitation for City to take control.
‎
‎But here is the emotional side of me speaking as a football fan…
‎
‎There’s something compelling about Arsenal’s story. The hunger, the near misses and the gradual growth, it feels like a team that has been building toward something. And sometimes, football rewards that kind of persistence.
‎
‎The question is, are they actually ready to handle the weight of expectation all the way to the finish line?
‎
‎Because chasing is one thing. Leading — and staying there is something different entirely .
‎
‎For me, I think Arsenal can do it. But “can” and “will” are two very different realities. Against a team like Manchester City, you’re not just competing for points but you’re competing against a standard that has been perfected over years.
‎
‎So yes, Arsenal can still pull off the surprise and they currently hold a three points advantage over Manchester city with a win against Newcastle United in their last outing. Even Manchester city still still have a game to play.
‎
‎But if they do, it won’t just be a title win.
‎
‎It will be a statement. Not just a statement but a big statement..
‎

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@twicejoy-sports/dare-to-believe-can-arsenal-really-snatch-the-title-from-manchester-city--hap)

body.title: Nuevo lunes de flores 🌺🏵️💐 / New flower Monday 🌺🏵️💐
body.body:
>Saludos hivers. Estos últimos tres días ha llovido bastante, el clima está mucho más fresco, la humedad se empieza a sentir en el ambiente, especialmente de noche, y el cielo ha empezado a volverse gris durante la mayor parte del día. Hoy también estuvo lloviendo así que para darle un poquito de color y alegría a este inicio de semana, decidí hacer un gran ramo de flores para compartirlo con ustedes 💐😁. Son muchas flores así que pueden elegir la que más les guste para que les alegre durante estos nuevos siete días que se nos vienen. Este ramo es tan exótico y original que tiene dos arañas, un buey y un gallo, y hasta tiene una flor de banana 😂, a ver dónde mas van a encontrar uno así jejeje 😁. >Hello hivers! It has rained quite a bit these last three days, the weather is much cooler, the humidity is starting to be noticeable, especially at night, and the sky has been turning gray for most of the day. It rained today too, so to add a little color and joy to the start of this week, I decided to make a big bouquet of flowers to share with you all 💐😁. There are lots of flowers, so you can choose your favorite to brighten up these next seven days. This bouquet is so exotic and original that it has two spiders, an ox, and a rooster, even has a banana flower 😂, tell me where else you're going to find one like that, hehehe 😁.
![IMG_20260427_155510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23uQtb9VLYX2PksWsZ7HrW8M9SzMnTqDorYdHSaGr1uqZdeitPvTQJ8vdTVEwdPYtn8zz.jpg)
Flor de araña blanca (Cleome spinosa) / White spider flower (Cleome spinosa)
![IMG_20260427_155854.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/244A8gdeyRCegc3Ki7HDd4729CzWbzTYKhWKzWVqbqCs76QR3sta4BD3uNghSrELp5sTM.jpg)
Lantana camara
![IMG_20260427_155829.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23vi8FLPHBaZ27swiWBQ1aAmHUREzfH7V1ULA6gLw24amRn7tR9S7ywDBraT4KR4fwHGG.jpg)
![IMG_20260427_160119.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23ynQJJKiNTx9cf9L3d1sevWKMy58bj6Q2fXu9Mf8JFei9GHw8MUD7pMGYJPLX4BVh6jm.jpg)
Trinitaria (Buganvilla) / Bougainvillea

En este ramo incluí varias flores que nunca antes había visto, una de ellas es la flor de araña blanca, conocida también como bigotes de gato por los largos estambres que sobresalen y cuelgan de los pétalos, la encontré justo a la orilla de un puente que está sobre el río, es un arbusto grande y fuerte, resulta que son bastante comunes aquí y las usan mucho como plantas ornamentales ya que florecen constantemente. Lo curioso es que después de verla esa primera vez ahora me la consigo por todas partes 😂🤷🏻‍♀️. >In this bouquet, I included several flowers I had never seen before. One of them is the white spider flower, also known as cat's whiskers because of the long stamens that protrude and hang from the petals. I found it right on the edge of a bridge over the river. It's a large, sturdy shrub, and it turns out they're quite common here and widely used as ornamental plants since they bloom constantly. The funny thing is, after seeing it that first time, now I find it everywhere! 😂🤷🏻‍♀️.
![IMG_20260427_160217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EowFauUeSP73BA1gWssU11R8supBxYLpriTBkLQyM38mRwLS4vixDN4UDgbouX2zVen.jpg)
Lirio Araña (Hymenocallis littoralis) / Spider Lily (Hymenocallis littoralis)
![IMG_20260427_160314.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23yTeoBPpHQsdS5PF1NA2qFkBj9Att7yAK4tHt9yFwKE8DdP94fwbxpCqTizweUPc6Gmk.jpg)
![IMG_20260427_162131.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23tmJB4fijvc8y9NvLPymwiQkig1khLqc8VJdUKd6TZRAUBT1Cqbw8QSbdmBRnaPeKUbR.jpg)

En la plaza principal, que es la plaza Ribas, las áreas verdes están rodeadas de lirios araña, son muy llamativas y resaltan hermosamente cuando el día está muy soleado, cuando tomé estas fotos era mediodía y el cielo estaba totalmente despejado. Por otro lado, hay unas florecitas que están entre mis favoritas por la gran variedad de colores que pueden tener, las hay rojas, fucsia, anaranjadas, lila y amarillas, las flores de lantana, son encantadoras y las mariposas las aman así que son excelentes para atraerlas a nuestros jardines o balcones 🏵️🦋. >In the main square, that's Plaza Ribas, the green areas are surrounded by spider lilies. They're very striking and stand out beautifully on sunny days. When I took these photos, it was midday and the sky was completely clear. On the other hand, there are some little flowers that are among my favorites because of the wide variety of colors they come in, red, fuchsia, orange, lilac, and yellow. Lantana flowers are enchanting, and butterflies love them, so they're excellent for attracting them to our gardens or balconies 🏵️🦋.
![IMG_20260427_161008.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23wgSTVSA2RmduEQ3CgH7tFXfHJXrLdKhAj2rSixpHq62LLrLAt1DuXFtTCdx22tScSvx.jpg)
Lengua de buey (Tibouchina longifolia) / Ox tongue (Tibouchina longifolia)
![IMG_20260427_161155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23wCJ6JnEy612DLzkF5vEQoL7fufE6cpXcjyhtC7eUr5oLYFwGAJMKGdSjTTFnkaDMLqS.jpg)
Ayapana (Ayapana triplinervis)

Otro descubrimiento fueron las flores de Ayapana, tampoco las habia visto antes, son muy pequeñas pero resaltaban entre la resequedad de una ruta de senderismo que hice en las montañas del parque nacional Henri Pittier en Maracay. La foto la hice al mediodía bajo un sol inclemente 🥵 así que ni siquiera pude ver bien lo que estaba fotografiando jajaja 🥴. >Another discovery was the Ayapana flowers, I hadn't seen them before either. They're very small, but they stood out against the dryness of a hiking trail I took in the mountains of Henri Pittier National Park in Maracay. I took the photo at midday under a merciless sun 🥵 so I couldn't even see very well what I was photographing, hahaha 🥴.
![IMG_20260427_161451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/245wBVynhqUfUPNymxNSAcfbqq5yAoD6eqBahmaGefFhB3U7hxtcQZW6Xa1xaC5Drdi8p.jpg)
Cayena (Hibiscus rosa-sinensis) / Cayenne (Hibiscus rosa-sinensis)
![IMG_20260427_161554.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23xefawpUCw24o4kp69nansBobnfXcsn5Js2ToM8x1jDwyi4SEqesxxAXxss5PGADjrja.jpg)
![IMG_20260427_161657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/245mkhGDkaf8XFqN4F3YCzSLLrpvzVxWABTuWj2hzciYzFY2ZkWiJckKPDTi7Xz5MfuU6.jpg)
![IMG_20260427_162320.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/243WTXGjLWH9TH2CcWDaTBianozbD6QUbyGtdZJdrxcU2rB1zgTPkvLxrCnfvGfHU3AU2.jpg)
Campanilla o Algodón bravo (Ipomoea carnea) / Morning glory or wild cotton (Ipomoea carnea)
![IMG_20260427_162416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/EoAdchXowjRT1YzGG3Z87UdZMoNbrwyw2fbPGFKCSywvK9Ypgyv65MVvx3JaL1cN73u.jpg)
Flores secas de Campanilla / Dried flowers of Morning Glory

A veces uno lleva toda la mañana o la tarde caminando por la ciudad haciendo las compras o alguna diligencia y de repente pasamos debajo de un árbol e inmediatamente sentimos una sensación de frescura 🌳🌬️😌, es el momento ideal para tomar agua y escapar unos minutos del sol. Así me pasó un día con la cayena, era casi mediodía y había mucho sol, me detuve un rato para sacar mi botella y beber agua, pero fue después que me percaté que estaba debajo de un arbusto de cayena jajaja, y lo mejor es que estaba lleno de flores 🌺😃, así que aproveché para tomar fotos aunque el resplandor del sol no me permitía ver muy bien la pantalla de mi teléfono 🤷🏻‍♀️. >Sometimes you spend all morning or afternoon walking around the city, doing your shopping or running errands, and suddenly you pass under a tree and immediately feel a refreshing coolness 🌳🌬️😌. It's the perfect moment to drink water and escape from the sun for a few minutes. That's what happened to me one day with the hibiscus. It was almost midday and the sun was intense. I stopped for a bit to get my bottle of water, but it was only later that I realized I was standing under a hibiscus bush, hahaha. And the best part was that it was covered in blossoms 🌺😃, so I took the opportunity to take some pictures, even though the glare from the sun made it hard to see my phone screen 🤷🏻‍♀️.
![IMG_20260427_163335.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/242DLCGPDpJTe6G6F8rP1utugZhZE4MZDmd65zxDfDeeWJxnywzHZrcD3mW3EGeymzgs1.jpg)
Flor de plátano o flor de banana (Musa paradisiaca) / Plane tree flower or banana flower (Musa paradisiaca)
![IMG_20260427_163015.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/242DNg2nVuLvT7os5APP2o3fGzcYJEThgKX4XoAnGQAK6kBuvi3Hk4pE3rDFfGnrSKArP.jpg)
Pseuderanthemum atropurpureum Tricolor
![IMG_20260427_163504.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gatubela/23w2o4CMne2oxERG9ofdMNMWvEkKzRy4hCAbnQVtVBFrS1RhkhPEtGQooga9aV17vw1S7.jpg)
Cresta de Gallo (Celosia cristata) / Cockscomb (Celosia cristata)

Las flores alegran la vista, el ánimo, los espacios y la vida, representan la esperanza para esa planta, ese arbusto o ese árbol, atraen miradas, olfatos y visitantes 🦋🐦🐝🐞, y también a la cámara de alguno que otro curioso como yo 😁. >Flowers brighten the sight, the mood, the spaces and life, they represent hope for that plant, that shrub or that tree, they attract eyes, noses and visitors 🦋🐦🐝🐞, and also the camera of some curious person like me 😁. ¿Les gustó este original y exótico ramo de flores? Espero que sí 😊. Es todo por hoy amigos. Les deseo una semana fenomenal y muy productiva. Muchas gracias por su tiempo. Salud y felicidad infinitas para todos 🌞🍀. >Did you like this unique and exotic bouquet of flowers? I hope so 😊. That's all for today, friends. I wish you a fantastic and very productive week. Thank you very much for your time. Infinite health and happiness for everyone 🌞🍀.
Todas las fotos fueron hechas y editadas por mi con mi celular Redmi 9T y me pertenecen / All photos were taken and edited by me with my Redmi 9T cellphone and they belong to me
> **Gracias por leer, compartir, apoyar, votar y comentar.** Hasta la próxima. ¡Miau!

Incluso en una historia de fantasía, se pueden encontrar ejemplos de viejas frases como:

* La mentira tiene patas cortas.
* No importa cuánto vuele la mentira, la verdad siempre la alcanza.

Y ciertamente que me gusta que se descubran las mentiras con tan solo una pequeña dosis de pruebas reales que respalden una verdad.

---

Even in a fantasy story, you can find examples of old sayings like:

* Lies have short legs.
* No matter how far a lie flies, the truth always catches up.

And I certainly like it when lies are exposed with just a small dose of real evidence to support the truth.

body.title: Another year at the Walk of Mercy. | Otro año en la Marcha de la Misericordia.
body.body:
> **Gratos saludos tengan todos mis queridos amigos de esta comunidad hermosa de Lifestyle es todo un gusto para mi saludarlos en este lunes inicio de semana quiero mostrarle mi caminata un año más en la gran fiesta de la misericordia.** >**Warm greetings to all my dear friends in this wonderful Lifestyle community. It is a real pleasure for me to greet you on this Monday, the first day of the week. I would like to share with you my participation, once again this year, in the great celebration of mercy.** Un año más caminé, la caminata de Jesús de la Divina Misericordia, la cual se celebra un domingo después del domingo de Resurrección, es un momento especial para acercarte en oración y caminar aproximadamente más de 10 km, la misma siempre sale desde la iglesia la Consolación desde la avenida principal de 5 de Julio hasta la ciudad universitaria en lo que vendría siendo un futuro, el santuario de la divina misericordia son aproximadamente muchos kilómetros, pero son cientos de miles de personas las que caminan, y estas son provenientes de todas las ciudades de Maracaibo las cuales se reúnen a caminar junto con Jesús de la divina misericordia, recordando la fuente infinita de paz que nos concede y de grandes milagros. >Once again this year I took part in the Pilgrimage of Jesus of Divine Mercy, which is held on the Sunday following Easter Sunday. It is a special occasion to draw closer to God in prayer and walk a distance of over 10 km. The procession always sets off from La Consolación Church on the main avenue, 5 de Julio, and makes its way to the university campus, which will eventually become the future Sanctuary of Divine Mercy. It is a long walk, but hundreds of thousands of people take part, coming from all over Maracaibo to walk alongside Jesus of Divine Mercy, remembering the infinite source of peace He grants us and the great miracles He performs. ![Cartel (horizontal) collage fotos familia simple colorido blanco_20260427_214505_0000.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWqE3uFVSkw7kJjm82xLHaKGd8jaQP149gYjJY9PVgZZb/Cartel%20(horizontal)%20collage%20fotos%20familia%20simple%20colorido%20blanco_20260427_214505_0000.png) --- La atravesía inició justamente muy cerca de mi casa cuando pudimos agarrar un carrito que este no llevo hasta el centro de la ciudad. ahí estuvimos en la parada de bella vista para poder agarrar hacia la iglesia, la Consolación había muchas personas en la parada hasta que pudimos agarrar un carrito detenernos, él mismo nos dejó justamente muy cerca de la iglesia ya faltaba aproximadamente unos 45 minutos, para que pudiera salir la gran caminata de la misericordia y estaban totalmente las personas concentradas ahí mismo ya que estaban realizando la hora santa un momento especial de gran oración. >The journey began right near my house, where we managed to flag down a minibus, though it didn’t take us all the way to the city centre. There we were at the Bella Vista stop to catch a ride to the church, La Consolación. There were lots of people at the stop until we managed to flag down a minibus to stop for us; the driver dropped us off right near the church. There were about 45 minutes to go before the Great Walk of Mercy was due to start, and people were already gathered there in full force as they were holding the Holy Hour, a special time of deep prayer. ![20260412_143456.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNveeJVsBFD3VnQ6RE2JVjYW36VPbjeYNHUGF8h3v7jp2/20260412_143456.jpg) ![20260412_143500.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTFZqFdSpXgSGeFBVHEj1zQVdBpd3TTQrXepdw3nQ1g6J/20260412_143500.jpg) ![20260412_150859.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNLrFiKKRz6jiAF3wyTLRsc1oShQkJTbXKnrt3ELV6jb8/20260412_150859.jpg) ![20260412_150857.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQ9dQikHjsWuxBkP6kUjUobLYziYkj6n6E2SKRM7qWqe/20260412_150857.jpg) --- Hasta que después salió la gran imagen de Jesús de la divina misericordia, la cual la estaban cargando a los caballeros de la misericordia y también estaba un cordón de jóvenes permitiendo que ninguna de las de las personas estuvieran cerca de la imagen, ya que siempre hay un límite para que se pueda llevar el orden la imagen de Jesús de la misericordia en su 4 esquina, tenía diferente tipo de relicario de varios santos cabe destacar que esta devoción de Jesús de la Divina misericordia se extendió por todo el mundo cuando la religiosa, sor María Faustina, recibió una revelación a Jesús de la misericordia y esta le dijo que le hablara a todo el mundo de su inagotable misericordia. >Then the large image of Jesus of Divine Mercy was brought out, carried by the Knights of Mercy, whilst a line of young people stood guard to ensure that no one came too close to the image, as there is always a boundary to maintain order around the image of Jesus of Divine Mercy at its four corners, It contained various types of reliquaries of several saints. It is worth noting that this devotion to Jesus of Divine Mercy spread throughout the world when the nun, Sister Maria Faustina, received a revelation from Jesus of Divine Mercy, who told her to tell the whole world of his inexhaustible mercy. ![20260412_151723.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTwzcjg8DjeDQePKHbPU41YC4qXvCPqcGjBWk2CgugDiz/20260412_151723.jpg) ![20260412_151729.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX4QZhdiomWKQfTbAwratMBEAXQZP1jDM823NU29ohCFZ/20260412_151729.jpg) ![20260412_151732.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfBfqv8wgE9fW4DF9txxDibJtSxCxwXarhCFUnJ2M4sB6/20260412_151732.jpg) ![20260412_151737.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS3U7u8N8J1CQnM5w3c5QghF5nBH7fTMxH46ziSK1FTF6/20260412_151737.jpg) ![20260412_151738.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdtE4G8hCrDBy8wwE3oXYnh9WXvhntx3YxgNA9ibpabLZ/20260412_151738.jpg) ![20260412_151743.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT1xqXaMxwYPw5YpRcJcEveWA6x1WyGWNikw7crvCQDoW/20260412_151743.jpg) ![20260412_151751.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUg59sGPqPjKHFrkbWtekg2AS5uWc1DNqTgKXYkLEnzc7/20260412_151751.jpg) ![20260412_151754.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTPGnrrddbz4p82rX2vTxGPtNAR2EwjEzu4Qs5g1gbqqp/20260412_151754.jpg) ![20260412_151756.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmarWDc4Cvx3AW9xB1w72QSuyu184SHpYK9Bv5rfht1CE3/20260412_151756.jpg) ![20260412_151801.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQYF8br4VivXHk497hDYcKzmvcWKo8WpwfY5ZvZPptcZ8/20260412_151801.jpg) --- Caminando durante largo trayecto sin ningún problema con bastante hidratación, merienda para poder controlar mi alimentación baja en índice glicemico, ya que debía de perder muchas calorías caminando, eso se lo entregue a Jesús de la Divina Misericordia que me protegiera, para que no me pudiera dar ningún tipo de síncope, ya que había bastante sol, bastante calor y estaba intenso, en su máximo punto el sol estaba no obstante cuando casi faltaba poco para terminar la caminata, me llamó mucho la atención que vi un gran arreglo en globos de la imagen de Jesús de la divina misericordia, esto me fascinó y no pude controlar evitar tomar varias fotografías. >I walked for a long stretch without any problems, staying well hydrated and having a snack to keep my low-glycaemic-index diet on track, as I was bound to burn a lot of calories walking; I entrusted this to Jesus of Divine Mercy to protect me, so that I wouldn’t suffer any kind of fainting spell, as it was quite sunny, quite hot and intense; the sun was at its peak, yet just as I was nearing the end of the walk, I was struck by the sight of a large balloon display depicting the image of Jesus of Divine Mercy, this fascinated me and I couldn’t help but take several photographs. ![20260412_171317.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ4wSsi4kqYmjWB9y1BRJpDgycgoLYk3fzizJdFUA7G3t/20260412_171317.jpg) ![20260412_171325.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbHgAty55jAp8kHQmLbRgccbuy3UKzMg4mizU6gjzQRK9/20260412_171325.jpg) body.title: What The Bible Says About Baptism. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
body.body:
https://youtu.be/aGuYZSfyI-g?si=hDw3Rp1QQP33xurX
The church of God is guided by the doctrines which Jesus Christ left for us. We must understand that pilgrimage is for us to know that we are just passing by through this world. This world is not our home for those of us who are the disciples of Jesus Christ. We are waiting for the return of our Lord. He went away and He promised us that He is coming back for us. We are not living like those who have no such hopes. One of these days, we shall see the Lord return. We shall hear the trumpet of the Lord and the saints shall be gathered to meet the Lord in the air. Understanding this makes us to obediently follow the doctrines of the church which Jesus Christ established.

Baptism was instructed by our Master. He said that everyone who believes in the teachings should be baptized. We cannot deny what the Master teach and still claim to be His disciples. True disciples obey their master in all things. The Lord Jesus Christ said that those who believe in Him should be taught to observe all things whatsoever he had instructed us. As a believer in Jesus Christ, be sure that you have received baptism.

There is no need arguing about baptism. There is no way we can please God in all things if we rejects the teachings that we are taught. Baptism is one of the core doctrines of the church. We will do well to accept baptism as the believers in Jesus Christ.

body.title: ¡Sólo una Silla! [Esp/Eng]
body.body:
>

¡Sólo una Silla!. Para iniciar cualquier entrenamiento; solo hay que tener motivación, disciplina y ganas de hacerlo. El que vive de excusas jamás podrá avanzar y cuando se trata de ejercitar, aquí te ofrecemos las mejores rutinas desde casa sin tener que usar equipamiento sofisticado. En esta oportunidad vamos a darle con todo al núcleo, con una serie de movimientos que se llevarán a cabo, teniendo como material una simple silla o banco. Los ejercicios como siempre, son dinámicos, diferentes y muy buenos para que la región abdominal, cadera, glúteos, piernas y brazos se activen con todo. No te quedes atrás y vente conmigo para que le des movimiento a tu vida. >Just a Chair! To start any workout, all you need is motivation, discipline, and the desire to do it. Those who make excuses will never make progress, and when it comes to exercising, here we offer you the best at-home routines without needing any fancy equipment. This time, we’re going to really target your core with a series of movements using nothing more than a simple chair or bench. As always, the exercises are dynamic, varied, and great for fully engaging your abs, hips, glutes, legs, and arms. Don’t get left behind join me and get your life moving.

![1000449441.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AK6X5Z2JyhJ6eK7XLYo1XTaGXYAEpNqamd4juTANf7Vp5WVDay79BcfLU2JGSLY.gif)Portada de mi Autoría Editada en/Cover of my Authorship Edited in [Canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/)
Logos propiedad de/ logos owned by @hiveio, @fulldeportes
# **
[Fase de Calentamiento]()
** Cuando vamos a realizar cualquier actividad física; siempre es recomendable; es más, debe ser un hábito obligatorio el de realizar ejercicios de calentamiento. Con ellos; ponemos a tono todo el cuerpo y alejamos la posibilidad de adquirir cualquier tipo de lesión. No realices ejercicios bruscos sin antes calentar; no arriesgues tu cuerpo por saltarte un minuto para calentar; vamos, activos. ># **
[Warm-up Phase]()
** >When we are going to do any physical activity, it is always advisable, in fact, it should be a mandatory habit to do warm-up exercises. With them, we get the whole body in tune and reduce the possibility of acquiring any type of injury. Do not do sudden exercises without warming up first; do not risk your body by skipping a minute to warm up; come on, let's get active. [**Calentamiento 1**, **TOQUE DE PIE OPUESTO CON FLEXIÓN DE TORSO**]() [Postura]() Piernas más allá del ancho de hombros; brazos a los lados extendidos hacia abajo. >[**Warm-up 1**, **OPPOSITE-FOOT TAP WITH TORSO BEND**]() >[Stance]() >Feet wider than shoulder-width apart; arms at your sides, extended downward.
![1000449354.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKbE9zYCv8h66cZPjQSnChK2nLdxe9SK53wJDYaCNvXePdz4T6PeTA1AziVogCS.gif)
[Ejecución]() A través de pequeños saltos laterales; se flexiona el torso al frente, se gira la cadera y se tocan los pies con manos opuestas. Son 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >Take small side jumps; bend your torso forward, rotate your hips, and touch your feet with the opposite hand. It’s 3 minutes of action.
![1000449358.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKbE9zYCv8h68RXYmLcw52BhXprvCvz8jBVKPTnzAG5EZ1NCEaUFu7pmSE69m1M.gif)
[**Calentamiento 2**, **TROTE LATERAL ALTERNO CON PAUSA**]() [Postura]() Iniciamos apoyados en un solo pie; se eleva la rodilla de la pierna opuesta. Se extiende hacia abajo el brazo del mismo lado de la pierna elevada y se flexiona el codo del brazo contrario. >[**Warm-up 2**, **ALTERNATING SIDE-TO-SIDE JOGGING WITH PAUSES**]() >[Posture]() >Start by balancing on one foot; lift the knee of the opposite leg. Extend the arm on the same side as the raised leg downward and bend the elbow of the opposite arm.
![1000449360.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKYMfzSeaiMFBMD3mbEEoaE7nEM2D3SfkjmK8o1mjvnV1G2K3og8RUhabZWvMLk.gif)
[Ejecución]() Para ejecutar el movimiento; vamos elevando las rodillas de forma alterna, simulando en sitio el trote. Cuando la rodilla se eleva, hacemos una breve pausa; se acompaña con la extensión y flexión de codos. Son 3 minutos de acción. >[Execution]() >To perform the movement, lift your knees one at a time, simulating a jog in place. When you lift a knee, pause briefly; this is accompanied by bending and straightening your elbows. The exercise lasts 3 minutes.
![1000449381.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKbE4V2pbCPEEok1F3Ec1K75oA9r9kr3cxnz4b4dDJjWHhZngHbN5L8HHX59xrT.gif)
Es muy importante determinar que si el cuerpo aún no está activo para la acción fuerte, se debe calentar un poco más. No olvides hacer pausas de 20 segundos entre ejercicios, y de 1 a 2 minutos entre series; la hidratación es extremadamente importante para reponer los líquidos y sales perdidas durante la acción. Por otro lado, debemos tratar en la medida de lo posible mantener una alimentación balanceada y un descanso adecuado, que contribuyan a la obtención de mejores resultados corporales. >It is very important to determine that if the body is not yet ready for intense activity, it should be warmed up a little more. Don't forget to take 20-second breaks between exercises and 1-2 minute breaks between sets; hydration is extremely important to replenish fluids and salts lost during exercise. On the other hand, we must try as much as possible to maintain a balanced diet and adequate rest, which contribute to achieving better physical results. # **
[Estaciones de Trabajo]()
** Luego de realizar el calentamiento y comprobado de que el cuerpo está apto para la acción fuerte; nos vamos a la ejecución de los ejercicios centrales de la rutina. Si aun sientes que no estás listo, vuelve a calentar, evita lesiones. Recuerda que cada ejercicio debes hacerlo de acuerdo a tu condición física, vamos poco a poco hasta dominar los movimientos. ># **
[Work Stations]()
** >After warming up and checking that the body is ready for the strong action, we go to the execution of the core exercises of the routine. If you still feel that you are not ready, warm up again, avoid injuries. Remember that each exercise should be done according to your physical condition, we go little by little until you master the movements. [**Estación 1**, **CRUNCH ABDOMINAL CON PIERNAS EN SILLA MÁS FLEXIÓN Y EXTENSIÓN DE CODOS**]() [Postura]() Nos sentamos en el piso; flexionamos las rodillas, ubicando las piernas sobre la silla. Elevamos el torso, el cual queda suspendido con brazos extendidos al frente. >[**Station 1**, **AB CRUNCH WITH LEGS ON A CHAIR PLUS ELBOW FLEXION AND EXTENSION**]() >[Position]() >Sit on the floor; bend your knees and place your legs on the chair. Lift your torso so that it is suspended with your arms extended in front of you.
![1000449383.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKNK2W1UFyickerQdqt9z13vGGrJqGviV98qbvm5MpMGZ4tcukk3oRGeXLpLgr6.gif)
[Ejecución]() Desarrollo y fortalecimiento total en el núcleo; brazos y piernas trabajando en segundo plano. Para ejecutar el movimiento; llevamos el torso hacia atrás sin que la parte alta de la espalda toque piso. Al mismo tiempo; los codos se flexionan, llevando los brazos hacia atrás. Serían 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Focus entirely on engaging and strengthening your core; your arms and legs should work in the background. To perform the movement, lean your torso backward without letting your upper back touch the floor. At the same time, bend your elbows, bringing your arms backward. Do 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000449407.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKLsn92g8Xkf6hkUZJuvThefMKYiSfkYv6P1CBY21R7JXzzUjL6uKeHNuGtvqmc.gif)
[**Estación 2**, **PUENTE DE GLUTEO MODIFICADO SOBRE SILLA**]() [Postura]() Aquí nos sentamos en el piso; colocamos los talones sobre la silla con rodillas flexionadas. Manos en el piso detrás de la espalda y extendemos codos. Las rodillas quedan a nivel de la cabeza y cadera a nivel de la silla. >[**Station 2**, **MODIFIED GLUTE BRIDGE ON A CHAIR**]() >[Position]() >Here, we sit on the floor with our heels resting on the chair and our knees bent. Place your hands on the floor behind your back and extend your elbows. Your knees should be at the same level
![1000449411.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKJ1Js2m1TTYPdT9s2L57V86VSjguY9xu39uYxrAgThMwuGWZNDdK9YraeiCbKv.gif)
[Ejecución]() La acción que se ejerce en el núcleo es única; de verdad que mientras baja y sube la cadera, la tensión en piernas y a nivel de brazos es impresionante. Para realizar el movimiento; los brazos deben permanecer tal cual como incian. Solo se debe flexionar el núcleo, bajando y subiendo la cadera de manera controlada. Realizamos 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >The core engagement in this exercise is unique; in fact, as you lower and raise your hips, the tension in your legs and arms is intense. To perform the movement, keep your arms in the same position as when you start. You should only engage your core, lowering and raising your hips in a controlled manner. We do 20 repetitions in 4 sets.
![1000449416.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKKSXPAyVFWHmce5Shcn4Bh6xkKQqB6Ax5e3KvdmxQpPiEd2TqGPAmBkUv6JMJw.gif)
[**Estación 3**, **RODILLAS AL FRENTE INCLINADAS EN SALTO CON APOYO DE ANTEBRAZOS**]() [Postura]() Ubicamos los antebrazos sobre la silla; extendemos las rodillas hacia atrás quedando en plancha inclinada; piernas juntas. >[**Station 3**, **INCLINED FORWARD PLANK WITH FOREARM SUPPORT**]() >[Position]() >Place your forearms on the chair; extend your knees backward into an inclined plank position; keep your legs together.
![1000449418.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/omarcitorojas/AKScffHyXGgg8r4LaAsEsRaYb3s1oG6AxN6u4oTYLxDszkPVn3oZmdECaxWaEB9.gif)
[Ejecución]() Acción constante en el tren inferior; tensión media y superior. Activos en la postura indicada; a través de saltos, abrimos piernas, flexionamos las rodillas y las llevamos al frente. Cada vez que regresamos a la posición incial, hacemos una pequeña flexión de cadera. Realizamos 20 repeticiones en 4 series. >[Execution]() >Keep your lower body engaged; maintain tension in your core and upper body. Keep your body in the correct posture; as you jump, spread your legs, bend your knees, and bring them forward. Each time you return to the starting position, perform a slight hip flexion. body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b9c48cfe-d2cb-42e8-82b9-4efdf920e3de.jpg) Another day. Another report. If you look at the picture you will see my dog walking with someone who isn't me. That would be my wife. She was a bit impatient to go on the walk and left my slowpoke butt behind. I suppose we did have limited time before we needed to get to church and she wanted to go to the early service because she had things she wanted to do today. The biggest thing was visiting a coworker who had questions about saving for retirement. If you read my post in @cinderclaw.gld you would know what the gist of the conversation was. However, it was about 3.5 hours talking about investing, taxes and strategies to work the system to your advantage. What can I say.... I like using the system to full advantage to be sure :) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/dc297935-38e6-46df-a6d9-ed7921d3e673.jpg) They actually lived in a really nice little townhouse complex with a pretty good view from the side of a mountain. Made me a little envious that they had such a nice house. At the end of the day though my house isn't nearly as nice, not nearly as organized or have as a good a view. Still, I have a house and it fits everyone who is there and there is always room for guests so I really should be grateful for that. When I was walking to the house I smiled when I noticed the greenhouses all in rows. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3f8555e5-7114-4e36-80a4-edb599b711b1.jpg) For most people they are hidden from view but for those people living on the side of the mountain pretty obvious to see. After talking investments and taxes? Time to do some writing on Hive of course. Time to walk the dog in the evening. Time to do a little cleaning around the house. In general though? Just a lazy day with my wife and the dog. My son? The oldest was out with his girlfriend. The youngest? Out for an evening partying with friends. Guess that's what happens when you only have one week break from one set of university classes to the next set. Summer session coming up shortly :) Well, for him. I have this week off. Next week I work a lot of shifts before a trip to Europe :)

body.title: ¿Qué hacer cuando el motor general entra en estado caótico? [esp-eng]
body.body:
​
<center>![1000024962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/EpCCm5sfhjj6JaemfN7PpFqEfYmeKDJWWKirjKGtmKJJXM6kwy5bbXx2c3t2RLBdzCG.jpg)</center>

​Bienvenidos a mi blog, un espacio donde podrás hallar un sinfín de cosas. No obstante, los días lunes los tomaré como un día especial de salud y reflexión, el cual tendrá hogar en @holos-lotus, ya que este espacio, o \

como lo consideramos, es el lugar idóneo para este tipo de trabajos reflexivos. ​

¿Qué podemos hacer cuando el motor superior está fallando?

​Cuando la parte superior de nuestro ser —esa que no se ve, que muchos dicen que no siente— es la que mantiene nuestro organismo en óptimas condiciones, tanto en los reflejos como en la salud en general, debemos prestar atención. ​Sin embargo, cuando esta parte, y me refiero a nuestra cabeza, colapsa, comienza a enviar una seguidilla de señales sutiles. A pesar de ello, como he dicho anteriormente en otros trabajos, nos hacemos los sordos y ciegos, a sabiendas de que hay algo detrás de estas sensaciones. ​Muchos aseveran que la mente no se enferma, que es una \

del momento y el entorno, cuando la realidad es totalmente distinta. Claro está que la mente es ese motor, invisible a la vista, el que guarda cada momento vivido y cada experiencia aprendida. Pero de tanto en tanto, su sistema interno colapsa y es ahí donde esta parte importantísima de nuestro ser empieza a pedir ayuda, apoyándose en diversas partes del cuerpo y generando, de manera física y visible, lo que conocemos como \

.

​La mente logra mantener nuestro sistema inmunológico en óptimas condiciones; es decir, una persona feliz no tiene bajas en sus anticuerpos. Pero cuando esta persona se enfrenta al estrés, su estado anímico baja, abriendo la puerta a la enfermedad, ya sea por una dolencia o porque decidió hospedar a algún virus o germen.

​Lamentablemente, cuando el conflicto ya está aposentado en nuestro ser, vemos un deterioro físico notable: baja de peso, mal humor, dolor de cabeza, náuseas, mareos, etc. Ante estos síntomas, la persona ingresa a una nueva puerta llamada \

.

​Pero ante esta nueva puerta, y con el miedo y el desconcierto a flor de piel, la persona se siente susceptible ante miradas o palabras que suenan más a una crítica que a un apoyo real y consciente.

​***Sin embargo, quiero decirte que ese miedo es todo lo normal que pueda haber dentro de este caos que estás viviendo.***

<center>![1000024963.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/243WeH3RFqxCf6UXDSiGe8NJk59FAEcjaMsn3cuZbcn2y23jy4fA17SWGT2TXm1istodD.png)</center> 

**​No** puedes culparte por sentirte débil, por tener incertidumbre o por tener temor, porque eso es un reflejo normal de tu humanidad; es la nueva puerta que comienza a abrirse para buscar la sanidad nuevamente.

​En este punto del cuadro, debemos saber que este proceso tendrá avances, estancamientos y retrocesos —y créeme, sentirás que tus fuerzas se acaban—, pero no te sientas culpable por esto. Siempre habrá alguien a tu lado que se convierta en faro para guiarte por esa oscuridad que atraviesas.

​Y es que cada enfermedad física viene de la mente adolorida, esa que se estresó por dificultades, por dolores del alma, por esas emociones de incertidumbre y por aquellas lágrimas que se quedaron atoradas en el alma.

Ante esta soga que, quizás sin darte cuenta, ha llegado a ti: no la sueltes, sujétala fuerte, sube a tú tiempo, descansa cuando quieras y asciende hacia ese sol cálido que te está esperando, \

.
![1000024964.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/243BpnSfnubVdGw2KL8v3CBgC5WTGCBu4PT7bSCMSa3ctANPRw3m1JjuqzqPW5H3sUZcj.png)
​¿Te has sentido con algún síntoma extraño de manera física y no entiendes el porqué de su llegada? ​Si cierras los ojos y tratas de poner un nombre a esa dolencia, ¿cuál sería? ​¿Tienes algún método de relajación que te guste compartir con todos nosotros? ​Esta no es una iniciativa, pero ten la libertad de redactar tu punto de vista. *** ###
English
***
![1000024962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/EpCCm5sfhjj6JaemfN7PpFqEfYmeKDJWWKirjKGtmKJJXM6kwy5bbXx2c3t2RLBdzCG.jpg)
Welcome to my blog, a space where you’ll find all sorts of things. However, I will treat Mondays as a special day for health and reflection, which will be hosted on @holos-lotus, as this space, or ‘home’ as we consider it, is the ideal place for this kind of reflective work. ​

What can we do when the higher self is failing?

​When the higher part of our being — that which cannot be seen, which many say cannot feel — is what keeps our body in optimal condition, both in terms of reflexes and general health, we must pay attention. ​However, when this part — and I am referring to our head — breaks down, it begins to send a series of subtle signals. Despite this, as I have said previously in other works, we turn a deaf ear and a blind eye, knowing full well that there is something behind these sensations. ​Many assert that the mind does not fall ill, that it is a ‘suggestion’ of the moment and the environment, when the reality is entirely different. It is clear that the mind is that engine, invisible to the eye, which stores every moment lived and every experience learnt. But from time to time, its internal system breaks down and that is when this vitally important part of our being begins to cry out for help, manifesting itself in various parts of the body and generating, in a physical and visible way, what we know as ‘illnesses’. The mind manages to keep our immune system in optimal condition; that is to say, a happy person does not experience a drop in their antibody levels. But when this person faces stress, their mood drops, opening the door to illness, whether due to an ailment or because they have decided to harbour a virus or germ. ​Unfortunately, once the conflict has taken root within us, we see a marked physical decline: weight loss, bad moods, headaches, nausea, dizziness, etc. Faced with these symptoms, the person enters a new realm called ‘fear’. ​But faced with this new door, and with fear and confusion running high, the person feels vulnerable to looks or words that sound more like criticism than genuine, conscious support. ***However, I want to tell you that this fear is as normal as it gets amidst the chaos you are experiencing.***
![1000024963.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/243WeH3RFqxCf6UXDSiGe8NJk59FAEcjaMsn3cuZbcn2y23jy4fA17SWGT2TXm1istodD.png)
**You** must not blame yourself for feeling weak, for feeling uncertain or for feeling afraid, because that is a normal reflection of your humanity; it is the new door that is beginning to open in the search for healing once more. ​At this stage of the journey, we must realise that this process will involve progress, stagnation and setbacks — and believe me, you will feel your strength running out — but do not feel guilty about this. There will always be someone by your side who will become a beacon to guide you through the darkness you are passing through. The fact is, every physical illness stems from a wounded mind—one that has been stressed by difficulties, by the pains of the soul, by those emotions of uncertainty, and by those tears that have become stuck in the soul. Faced with this rope that, perhaps without you realising it, has come to you: don’t let go of it, hold on tight, climb at your own pace, rest whenever you want, and ascend towards that warm sun that is waiting for you, ‘when you and your mind are ready’.
![1000024964.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/243BpnSfnubVdGw2KL8v3CBgC5WTGCBu4PT7bSCMSa3ctANPRw3m1JjuqzqPW5H3sUZcj.png)
Have you experienced any strange physical symptoms and don’t understand why they’ve appeared? If you close your eyes and try to put a name to that ailment, what would it be? Do you have any relaxation techniques you’d like to share with us all? This isn’t a prompt, but feel free to write down your thoughts. ***
![1000009838.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/issymarie2/23tbikLyE8Cv6ctyG8KyiR6HZ7Hd2JSAq7evbE5rrDfvjuHR5TcPBY4D8Jy2bToBZP5R4.png)
**Créditos / Credits:** ​Las imágenes usadas fueron creadas en Gemini AI. El texto fue traducido en DeepL versión free. ​

body.title: Hilton Airport Hotel | Fiumicino, Italy
body.body:
> It gives me great joy to greet you once again from Worldmappin, the Hive community for travelers. Today, I intend to share a new location for our map—and, on this occasion, to give you a closer look at our trip to Italy. Although all our musical activities were scheduled to take place in Rome and Vatican City, given that it is one of the most popular destinations in the world, we had to stay in a rather remote area. Our home for that week was the Hilton Airport Hotel, a luxury property located in Fiumicino—a 40-minute train ride from Termini, in the heart of Rome.
![IMG_20251021_105731.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/245mzyRyGWXggdsoejmuHdnZiWaxDwQfteYcRiRtvtQ8hH9qeQJhfDSYa3Qsnh2wBHcnh.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251014_190555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2eftsdKbhKzhZ9kGf8zRDzBfabLZZUmPFYVjXcxaGbNQKNy4X4CjT5oCXad2fUNXhf.jpg) ![IMG_20251021_105953.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244y3nLbRsnUicNpDFWpPcVYxUzYUF6Xbt4AGLsHa5zx6eTNUgcCgnNYmURrPM73nkA4i.jpg)
Even before landing, I was deeply impressed by the city. Fiumicino sits right by the sea, and—at least in the airport area—there are no mountains visible nearby; this always surprises me, as I have lived surrounded by mountains since childhood. Although it is a separate municipality, it remains part of Rome—and of the Lazio region. In my particular experience, I had no need to venture beyond this area, knowing that our work would take place in Rome, since the airport, the hotel, the bus routes, and the trains all depart from right here.
![IMG_20251014_183905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tmFdvmugJsU1qDb69oiPsCZrcvYSJETxpvd1H6cfn9QoezNVWW3LFN59X8hhJ4Xp1q1.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251018_072746.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23s9Xuo7YYPpLRNhnSysuJS5Z2L67wohSaZtmk1XaV8qpKFXrszS9wpGtzm5CTfGYUqwp.jpg) ![IMG_20251014_184754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/241tfs4TjcRNrhk4Qba9J1RErpaaZjD826ZBWmVVQFpKuZJihH2nPzocAmjWv6ebTYPag.jpg)
Long corridors lead us directly to the hotel, and as you walk through them, you can admire a wealth of art and luxurious architecture—making Fiumicino Airport a preview of all the wonders we will encounter in Rome. The Hilton Airport Hotel is a five-star establishment, and in my opinion, it is quite expensive. I do not know the standard room rates, but a single night here costs around 800 euros for one of the most affordable options. It is often one of the best choices if you are merely on a layover, or if you can no longer find available accommodations in the Roman capital.
![IMG_20251018_072734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/244xwuvGq8hS6hEcyEsma3gJon1SjvmQF3z9FmN3zZ6LEFzLoBPKDTn5bbvr6i6zE1zuz.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251015_085804.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/246avPMyQhFZt1NjX5B6ZQ6ubM6xkPhjwaoQwp9kcdJP5w7TjXw1VbAttXmkkRK1AtMwd.jpg) ![IMG_20251018_072638.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/246axPwbMTCXm1nUQnKWTxtoBkJzF3PyMkmULUevUFwSTBh3cpFTLdXR9Jumbh92cxYaf.jpg)
As part of the Hilton Hotels chain, this establishment offers all the amenities necessary for an extended stay. One of the memories that stands out most in my mind is being surrounded by people of so many different nationalities; furthermore, I rarely heard my own language while walking through the hotel corridors—though my wife and I managed to get by reasonably well using a few phrases in Italian and English. But that is precisely what you can expect to find in places located so close to an international airport. Below, I share a glimpse of the architecture and art that can be admired at the Hilton Airport Hotel.
![IMG_20251014_201058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2mL1JbwpnHCvYJQEpRCRgXSsp6rbZ1Wka2zCDEDzNJ1pzgKXKMgazwcwsZRSQSm11a.jpg) ![IMG_20251016_214556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vsNfckbpj4PTCCedkDCBs5d5FXdgDt8hR2xrjWJ76kykG52mZACVfpeATQarDfRqv3G.jpg) |![IMG_20251020_223512.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xpK97sduCt8ttnPcJdFgriCHwsCaagWNfoNNZgmUpRmT9tjifzEFQ8bGHMiqXJBTxba.jpg)|![IMG_20251020_223529.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyScnWcCKRYQwuxudnfUEnbQW8muXqHkyYQvvfRS5jwjuPZDbpW1g2SyXm7c1D4qL97.jpg)|![IMG_20251017_140045.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uQvQKsbJVDJRT7WMReKxMuKaBfQeVbnFSQsfsthHjwc3RktSmWfD6PE3GQJTzUy3WUL.jpg)| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20251021_072332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23w2ns9kxpWzKCBRzqSib1j4L3udW595wWsZx8VuFttwfdoaVtg6ew7N1v2tbuw7LrAJo.jpg) ![IMG_20251018_072616.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xp6UVKbHAJDhgM2JxzpQ3LELyB8K2TJxcB2Mhu2fKQqBVitRyDRXhoeZdHotkVcJg5z.jpg)
At this venue, we had ample space—enough, in fact, to rehearse with a 200-member children's symphony orchestra that accompanied us in performing classics by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and George Frideric Handel; indeed, I know there were plenty of large halls left over for hosting other events of similar magnitude. My favorite moments were always breakfast and dinner; these meals were served in separate dining halls—each vast, beautiful, and truly luxurious. Our rooms, while simple—standard double rooms—were nonetheless incredibly spacious and luxurious, boasting breathtaking views.
![IMG_20251014_201353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23y92AhPPP7wDcu5vcW9uzXZGxGsudrm6fJ3ktDGrnkfLPkcq2Vj3oNHGwoqJLVKLgPh4.jpg) ![IMG_20251014_201537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xyXCpTJHiqg3PG7MRgKwH6oz6Q2C9xTHijyhGTgq287wcvMAYRt46t3Pdik8fojGWe9.jpg) |![IMG_20251014_201702.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uQk49oRMChzQcyXAd65GEwGu6c9oz4hXgZud7sUJ5v3C2ALEgboimt7cWTS3FwkpsEZ.jpg)|![IMG_20251014_201723.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23y8usLFV24DPnvJ63PdDJ2FNrSjJSxu4kqJsJyKNYKGaL4eRyud5ETZxEwd6LrJ6qLZT.jpg)|![IMG_20251014_201650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23yTYxL4y9YQwGuqLL3oFDmCQ3KZwKoStXZj5GdvmXrB6Yw8YgZREPuLB5SvHc2xdbjoq.jpg)| |-|-|-| |![IMG_20251014_201942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uFTcn5h8jaxRy68X2issPz81CykkFJnYopYT4EhyaZz9m4iHnqvZ1MocQD7qkLWVfPM.jpg)|![IMG_20251014_201922.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wgPuv1USn8SUdgS66rqKdmYVru16VU7xXH8mNZLue1RQZSidvZtMSxppARAz8tNWjoQ.jpg)|![IMG_20251014_201929.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xVGnMLuNnjD4eRXBPix5UUCfs16qmjhbMr5dUxvs95iqBWTpCReyRF2kmyUjR9UcNwF.jpg)| |-|-|-| ![IMG_20251014_201712.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tbyRfGbV8HBc7wmqfSZDGhSeAP4faWkTWs6BzzgGjzJb2AP5EL6qXPW5b17FTvuJhYt.jpg) ![IMG_20251015_075533.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xAVtdi99NwUCqBJn7uyYx1UDepw63cwvwAXXRFKC3DpzK6nuLRiBDxNwRJ6vBdX11P8.jpg)
Our trip to Italy lasted only a week, and—as you may know—Rome and Vatican City itself have so much to offer. We eventually left, yet I still feel as though we didn't get to see all that much—though, of course, it was a business trip after all. Even so, I enjoyed every moment, though I was left wishing I could have explored the Fiumicino area a bit more. That said, like any tourist trying to save a little money, I chose to forgo taxis in favor of buses and trains. The best part was that everything was just a few meters from the hotel, meaning there was no need to even step outside the airport complex.
![IMG_20251014_201106.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23uQyAmYwqojEnkMBpVxVrEyNb4VdkU1nYTSR2DaQ5q6X7TLcXJUGWETwnBgxRVWQT1M9.jpg) ![IMG_20251017_140012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23wC5ZrQR6QHqjZAFWBnzBv4YJU4uEsK9CrzWYteAfwXe2z9dKtribY8VgMZEdcaAx5ck.jpg)

> ![IMG_20251017_113031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/242DGJG1CvQU3nJeT5bFRB6FGRgVqagHbUkJp1CZA4Hi2B5whVtWo28F1H7rGjWGENn1n.jpg) ![IMG_20251020_223435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23xpEqwFEWMPHf8Hbwq1fjgMwtZDGkdEiG8ZC8BBubtzm885cXVEXJvd78D7SRWSAtyr3.jpg) ![IMG_20251017_113021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zS35tyrSfJMMXU2ucqF7jzC7sxdyc7waqwtS4mevrJ2mesMJZJS67nd9TpXc3hNHgT3.jpg) ![IMG_20251017_140241.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23zbUC1zvEjkgVHrQBm4sGrthJPrmTPz1qwkvnk742Nb3himWayAeu1XgCgu18TTnZ1ZK.jpg)
Well, everyone, I hope you enjoyed this post—it’s a bit different from the others, which are usually filled with grand natural landscapes, but architecture and art are always welcome on my blog and in this community that I enjoy so much. As a member of a prominent musical group in my country, I get to enjoy privileges like these—experiences I might not typically be able to afford on my own unless I had a very strong personal interest in them. So, I receive all of this as a blessing; I embrace it wholeheartedly and pray to God that these artistic opportunities continue to multiply. Life is beautiful, and we must never forget that—especially when we have the chance to connect with one another in such special ways. Sending a big hug to everyone reading this, and until the next post! 🙏
![IMG_20251015_090123.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/243fpQubSiHZ6pi8v6QMifpvokEVNUaEqjhAKAQe756UJt2cG44NhMdZsahEAXMYMwuDZ.jpg) ![IMG_20251014_220714.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23tveWPgFYBvN42H2MEtxZmisveUdUe3dzWxRcDv4wfxr7aNoXCYE6deYDVjZBQ7LdqrC.jpg) ![IMG_20251021_101516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23u5xWvP8g28DzCjVWApN6ysj41ipH1sZdXeaMZaXfVmaooSSbpWu1twCZn4ztWR73C2n.jpg) ![IMG_20251021_110128.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23vsNbhFr9q6Y3MUHqmHTnRohyFGtP2kaiX7zr4mfcuna2xUZxXUVjpeiHQRCrHMo6L9E.jpg) ![IMG_20251015_090233.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jesuslnrs/23rz97cekerU4yPxkxMZdFWjw8b3hjCNYhKZ2i7uVuzX96tWr9oDLku5xMFpLfYkAFsm4.jpg) [//]:# (!worldmappin 41.79134 lat 12.25556 long Hilton Rome Airport d3scr)
