body.title: Lunes 27 de abril 2026: Un día exploratorio exitoso [ESP/ENG]
body.body: > Pienso que los cambios son buenos, hacen que nuestro cerebro se active y salga del modo automático, para ajustarse al nuevo escenario. Hoy ha sido un día interesante, a primera hora fui al médico ocupacional quien insistió que debía ejercitarme. Lo mejor es que se lo comenté a unas colegas y me recomendaron un gimnasio que tiene todo lo que necesito: Un buen entrenador, una cuota mensual económica, buena ubicación y suficiente espacio con máquinas de musculación.

> I think change is good; it gets our brains going and helps us snap out of autopilot so we can adapt to the new situation. Today was an interesting day. First thing in the morning, I went to see the occupational physician, who insisted that I needed to exercise. The best part is that I mentioned it to some colleagues, and they recommended a gym that has everything I need: a good trainer, an affordable monthly fee, a great location, and plenty of space with weight machines. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVA6BzfW9FM5zfhsm7UQMjzWsZEuFNHQWgZdjUx8PLvF/173439644.gif
***

> Por otra parte, mi esposo y yo decidimos este fin de semana, cambiar a nuestra hija de la escuela de natación en la que está y de repente hoy nos pusimos de acuerdo para visitar, tanto la escuela de natación que nos pareció la mejor opción, como el gimnasio que mis colegas me habían recomendado. Esperamos que mi hija saliera de sus clases en la universidad y entonces nos fuimos, en primer lugar a la escuela de natación. La señora que nos atendió, nos ofreció un horario flexible que se adapta al horario de estudios de mi hija y además, le hicimos hincapié en que ella recibiera un buen refuerzo de técnicas. Salimos conformes y decididos a inscribirla allí.

> On the other hand, my husband and I decided this weekend to switch our daughter from her current swim school, and today we suddenly agreed to visit both the swim school that seemed like the best option and the gym that my colleagues had recommended to me. We waited for my daughter to finish her college classes, and then we went first to the swim school. The woman who helped us offered a flexible schedule that fits my daughter’s class schedule, and we also emphasized that we wanted her to receive solid technical training. We left satisfied and determined to enroll her there. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmfM1CcH6tYtEwjCinHQKUJ5qpawjaimStZVPBgdGVCF76/image.png
***

> Luego vino la tarea difícil, hablar con su actual profesor de natación para informarle acerca de este cambio. Mi esposo acompañó a nuestra hija, quien se encargaría de esta tarea, lo que me pareció muy maduro de su parte. Ella me cuenta que su entrenador ni se inmutó y le deseó éxito. Pienso que probablemente el profesor de la otra escuela, con el que hablamos, ya le había informado.

> Then came the hard part: talking to her current swim coach to let him know about the change. My husband went with our daughter, who was going to handle this, which I thought was very mature of her. She told me that her coach didn’t bat an eye and wished her success. I think the coach at the other school, whom we spoke with, had probably already told him. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmRehU7nqFgJDFY8HBapKfmrmi7m5TGRQHgbuPRFFngt4J/20260427_210923.jpg
***

> Finalmente, fuimos al gimnasio que queríamos conocer, hablamos con su dueño y quedamos convencidos de que era una buena opción, tanto, que hasta mi esposo, que nunca ha entrenado en un gimnasio se animó a inscribirse. Luego regresamos a casa, con la sensación de que habíamos avanzado bastante en las tareas planteadas para esta tarde y muy conformes con los resultados. Estos cambios representan una reestructuración de nuestra rutina, pero sabemos que lo vale y que es para bien. Estoy emocionada de pensar en lo positivo que será esto en nuestras vidas.

> Finally, we went to the gym we’d been wanting to check out, talked to the owner, and were convinced it was a good choice—so much so that even my husband, who’s never worked out at a gym before, decided to sign up. Then we went home, feeling like we had made good progress on the tasks we’d set for ourselves that afternoon and very pleased with the results. These changes represent a restructuring of our routine, but we know it’s worth it and that it’s for the best. I’m excited to think about how positive this will be for our lives. ***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNXbhFS2nNKxLEmkbasJH3jZMV5HyFqAcnV5F1efaTDC/20260427_212016.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png

> Y estos son mis pensamientos para compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.

> And these are the thoughts I’d like to share with you today, my friends. Every day offers us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, stroke by stroke. To you, thank you for joining me in this reading. ***
https://images.hive.blog/350x350/https://images.ecency.com/DQmYmNTSoQ7tHfuKVDmksrsS9RzBg8HAqYnXghQXaHbi7Yt/image.png Thank you very much

body.title: What I Don’t Take Lightly Anymore… and What I Pay Attention To Now. Ladies of Hive Community Contest #286 [EN/ES]
body.body:
🇬🇧 In English  

---

## What I Don’t Take Lightly Anymore… and What I Pay Attention To Now  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanWU2MMYT7tze7pQW2du5chkEE8rHBzjHmzriac3cbvK/pexels_businessman_1284460_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/businessman-shadows-man-person-1284460/)

---

Hello dear @ladiesofhive community 

This week’s questions made me think about how much of what shapes us comes from what we decide not to ignore anymore.

###  About school bullying and how I see it now  

I don’t think bullying is always about visible aggression. What has made the biggest impact on me over time is realizing how often it is normalized in subtle ways—comments, exclusions, repeated behaviors that are dismissed as “not that serious.”

But for the person experiencing it, it is serious.

If I think about how I would approach it, especially if it involved someone close to me, I would start from something very simple: not minimizing what they feel.

I would want them to understand that what they are experiencing is valid, even if others try to downplay it.

And I would encourage communication—not only speaking up, but also learning to recognize early when something doesn’t feel right, instead of normalizing discomfort for too long.

As an adult, I also believe responsibility doesn’t end with awareness. It includes stepping in when possible, even in uncomfortable situations, because silence often protects the wrong side of the dynamic.

At the same time, I don’t see the solution as something purely reactive. I think a lot comes from building inner confidence early—so that external voices don’t easily define self-worth.

###  About movies and what actually stays with me  

I don’t lean toward one specific genre. What matters to me is not the type of movie, but the moment it creates in my thinking afterward.

The films that stay with me are usually not the most intense ones. They are the ones that show internal conflict in a quiet way.

I remember a movie where the central theme was not action, but hesitation—how a person deals with decisions that don’t have a clearly right or wrong answer.

What stayed with me was not what happened, but how the character dealt with uncertainty without having guarantees.

It made me reflect on something simple: we often expect clarity before acting, but in reality, many decisions are made inside uncertainty, not outside of it.

And that applies far beyond cinema.

It applies to everyday life, where most choices are not dramatic, but still shape direction over time.

---

In the end, both questions connect to something I pay more attention to now: what we normalize internally, and what we allow to influence how we see ourselves and our decisions.

Thank you for reading 

---

*This is Norayda, learning to observe what she no longer wants to normalize.*

The images are from Pixabay.  
The English version was translated using DeepL Translate.  

---

Thank you for reading.
Special thanks to @bradleyarrow for supporting the community.

---

🇪🇸 En Español  

---

## Lo que ya no tomo a la ligera… y en lo que presto más atención ahora  

---

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmanWU2MMYT7tze7pQW2du5chkEE8rHBzjHmzriac3cbvK/pexels_businessman_1284460_640.jpg)
Fuente [Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/businessman-shadows-man-person-1284460/)

---

Hola querida comunidad @ladiesofhive  

Las preguntas de esta semana me hicieron pensar en cuánto de lo que nos forma viene de lo que decidimos dejar de ignorar.

###  Sobre el acoso escolar y cómo lo veo ahora  

No creo que el acoso escolar sea siempre agresión visible. Lo que más me ha hecho reflexionar con el tiempo es cómo muchas veces se normaliza en formas sutiles: comentarios, exclusiones, comportamientos repetidos que se justifican como “no es para tanto”.

Pero para quien lo vive, sí lo es.

Si pienso en cómo lo abordaría, especialmente si fuera alguien cercano, partiría de algo muy básico: no minimizar lo que siente.

Me gustaría que esa persona entendiera que lo que vive es válido, aunque otros intenten restarle importancia.

Y también fomentaría la comunicación: no solo hablarlo, sino aprender a identificar a tiempo cuando algo no se siente bien, en lugar de normalizar el malestar durante demasiado tiempo.

Como adulta, también creo que la responsabilidad no termina en la conciencia. Implica intervenir cuando sea posible, incluso en situaciones incómodas, porque el silencio muchas veces protege al lado equivocado del problema.

Al mismo tiempo, no veo la solución solo como algo reactivo. Creo que también tiene mucho que ver con construir seguridad interna desde temprano, para que las voces externas no definan tan fácilmente el valor personal.

###  Sobre el cine y lo que realmente me deja  

No tengo un género específico. Lo que me importa no es el tipo de película, sino lo que deja en mi forma de pensar después.

Las películas que más me marcan no suelen ser las más intensas. Son las que muestran el conflicto interno de manera silenciosa.

Recuerdo una película donde el tema central no era la acción, sino la duda: cómo una persona enfrenta decisiones que no tienen una respuesta claramente correcta o incorrecta.

Lo que me quedó no fue lo que ocurrió, sino cómo el personaje convivía con la incertidumbre sin tener garantías.

Eso me llevó a una reflexión simple: muchas veces esperamos claridad antes de actuar, pero en realidad muchas decisiones se toman dentro de la incertidumbre, no fuera de ella.

Y eso aplica mucho más allá del cine.

Aplica a la vida diaria, donde la mayoría de las decisiones no son dramáticas, pero aún así van definiendo el rumbo con el tiempo.

---

Al final, ambas preguntas se conectan con algo a lo que ahora presto más atención: lo que normalizamos internamente y lo que permitimos que influya en cómo nos vemos y cómo decidimos.

Gracias por leer 

---

*Esto es Norayda, aprendiendo a observar lo que ya no quiere normalizar.*

Las imágenes son de Pixabay.  
La versión en inglés fue hecha con DeepL Translate.

body.title: Packaging No. 07  DIY Caja Pequeña con forma de Cámara de Fotografías  y Sirenas (Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>

Hacer un regalito con mucho amor, y que pasado el tiempo te digan: ¡Todavía tengo la cajita guardada, porque me encantó! Esto es lo máximo, por eso siempre he prestado mucha atención a los envoltorios o cajitas, le doy un gran valor, tanto como al mismo regalo. Tenía pendiente hacer una caja pequeña, donde colocar Stickers o incluso cuando regalamos efectivo, hacerlo con una bello Packaging es un gran detalle para agregar valor. Para continuar con mi colección de Packaging, hoy realicé desde cero una Caja pequeña con forma de Cámara de Fotografía, y decorada con temática de Sirena, para llenarla con Stickers de esa misma temática, les mostraré mi proceso y algunos tips... Bienvenidos.

>

Make a gift with a lot of love, and after time they tell you: I still have the box saved, because I loved it! This is the best, that's why I have always paid a lot of attention to the packaging or boxes, I give it great value, as much as the gift itself. I had to make a small box, where we can place Stickers or even when we give away cash, doing it with beautiful Packaging is a great detail to add value. To continue with my Packaging collection, today I made from scratch a small Box in the shape of a Camera of Photography, and decorated with a Mermaid theme, to fill it with Stickers of that same theme, I will show you my process and some tips... Welcome.

![1 Gif.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EpnEHVX1sXcqJkcqsHckCaMuM4cWqnC259wWkdb7KAG4MPp8ADd8PevBvwE85V7PxMW.gif)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xpM3VMWfJXpwsnmX87gsLARRuYyyQtAgT1sJ9o4mcmo9t8qAse2YX4PJmcmF2JKcBVj.png)
> * Canva Pro * Papel Fotográfico * Impresora * Regla, Tijera y Cúter * Punzón o cualquier herramienta con punta * Silicón líquido * Cartulina metalizada dorada * Trozos de poliestireno o anime

> * CanvaPro * Photographic Paper * Printer * Ruler, Scissors and Cutter * Punch or any pointed tool *Liquid silicone * Gold metallic cardstock * Pieces of polystyrene or anime

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23ynhdQmhE37wqYgkFWnrgeNRFHiSADPy4n6txEQ2j3y1hoMeH9WQGFctw8Jx9Zvb4Y1c.png)

>

Trabajo en la App Canva, en su versión Pro y de escritorio. Básicamente con líneas y círculos realicé el diseño de la cámara de fotografía, esto me llevó algún tiempo, ya que lo hice desde cero y realicé varias correcciones. Rellené algunos espacios con Papel Digital decorado. Me gustó mucho el diseño de unas líneas irregulares rosadas y blancas, pero más adelante cambié este diseño, ya les contaré por qué.

>

I work on the Canva App, in its Pro and desktop version. Basically with lines and circles I made the design of the camera, this took me some time, since I did it from scratch and made several corrections. I filled some spaces with decorated Digital Paper. I really liked the design of irregular pink and white lines, but later I changed this design, I'll tell you why.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tSsPMG1rdo3dC9PbuMgHQfjtMenFyCGQKu7BM11sokReGCp4X63tFWMUqGXo2aL6UHX.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23t88hunuXw2SiY8mUn2ybKQxsvjfE3HehxPSGsWpcVagsE77dZTBYCxboBoZD3dfHZXx.png)| |-|-|

>

Alterné el papel digital con un color rosado o fucsia, ya que son mis colores favoritos. Para formar el lente de la cámara de fotografía, realicé varios círculos de diferentes colores para darle ese diseño interesante y profundidad.

>

I alternated the digital paper with a pink or fuchsia color, since they are my favorite colors. To form the lens of the camera, I made several circles of different colors to give it that interesting design and depth.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tw3p2dh1kdsi5Q8mCNcS3bDMKmpiREmQaP2XBmWntmrtc8rfagwyjBwxWAFJZKpGuJr.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/48QvFN73nsVaAyTHCYxR5GVGz9P6QQ9gsHYgiSBNumbb8me56BgcrXZpVugCEv6kWX.png)| |-|-|

>

Sobrepuse los círculos del lente en la cámara y ya estaba listo este primer diseño, que realmente fue como una prueba o prototipo.

>

I superimposed the lens circles on the camera and this first design was ready, which really was like a test or prototype.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23w36268RSrngoAK8brGSqPvWRbmYyTySMKqKXkeDqxi5ZB2wLNhWBHHVuhmDRquV3pTd.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wXJEoMVaJLpdtXPFLYhvNizoSEmf6hA3K3UW7nUV2XyNM3aWdvth4R6BUrGrsPyJ77U.png)| |-|-|

>

Dado que se trataba de una prueba, esta impresión la hice en papel normal, lo que me permitió comprobar la forma o diseño, y realizar algún ajuste oportunamente. Pude comprobar que el papel digital no funcionaba del todo bien, ya que no destacaba en la impresión, así que volví a Canva y elegí un papel digital más llamativo que tenía el diseño de cola de sirena, me gustó mucho y decidí cambiarlo y además incorporar también figuras de la temática de Sirena para hacer Stickers. Y ahora si imprimí en papel fotográfico.

>

Since this was a test, I made this print on plain paper, which allowed me to check the shape or design, and make any adjustments at a time. I could see that the digital paper was not working at all well, since it did not stand out in the print, so I went back to Canva and chose a more striking digital paper that had the mermaid tail design. I really liked it and decided to change it and also incorporate Mermaid-themed figures to make Stickers. And now I printed on photographic paper.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vhwMV4YbX4DvDQjAqJ1F4BzxHD5FBWrBGx7Q3GzeB4ZZGatJLzj3MZVtwduAR4LUCSv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFXuyB9XYifMCjsE6xvpfVnTFaAxxPjUvLwLHHcWYLaCtRRn85C3NVqKQhSux9p1xNv.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFj3zHxtBREy98fLVqDp4nv6JL49s15bpr8ZNKVTPa9C1VSQDE3pvt1rktmLQWyBCsK.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23ynYpWuriH7Dt6QSpH3LsYFWVvHzuPawc6nEwFTxvam4tg8aJ4NocTKf68HQSFsWopwV.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Corté todas las piezas de la caja y los stickers con regla y cúter, y también con tijera. Marqué los doblez con regla y una herramienta con punta Doblé todas las pestañas y comprobé que el diseño funciona y cuadra completamente.

>

I cut all the pieces of the box and the stickers with a ruler and a cutter, and also with scissors. I marked the folds with a ruler and a pointed tool. I folded all the tabs and verified that the design works and fits completely.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/EoK7pTgeBKBdbcyacw7SKnoPafxHVtbq6K9aXmfsMRxE5qBu5nRZ92bKrfocAhU7Mhe.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23vsUqkiSKWLJUgVZujjHEk5p8Kop9MsTUnGx9in25ACUoq3bK6Sct375RDmym2hs72bD.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uQxsqJuS2GH3Z79nr7F96FnrADyYrhn3qccBYg2wRg8JKSUhSrLEj39oGNhM2XEcKBe.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wX3mCG39LqKNuhg2fNtS8F6Zdv47AqonzcYyUKxMVGA6RzV2xexV7KexTzrCAVHH31p.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Armé la caja pegando con silicón líquido. Para el lente de la cámara, decidí hacerlo con más dimensión. Así que imprimí solo algunos, y otros los sustituí por círculos en cartulina metalizada dorada, y a que le daría más brillo e interés.

>

I assembled the box by gluing it with liquid silicone. For the camera lens, I decided to make it with more dimension. So I printed only some, and replaced others with circles on gold metallic cardstock, as it would give it more shine and interest.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/243MFg37GqPnV4qGPDSApE6wSyXQyKT7cehgMjS5BmVYcabC1fr95fKEiCxo9Cuw5dcQd.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23u6FhBYWu1y84aZHsydRkySyMVDKabAHiMqqa36VmtiaNFGW6W8YWtLrgN3bi2fT1PEz.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23x1B26PVCqjKCxZD5Qz6JFhJTKekemvTnKgNxzYQvf2hFm1gn1jUMBRkkQHwH9P2kwwA.png)| |-|-|-|

>

Con algunos trocitos de Poliestireno, que ese material que traen las cajas de electrodomésticos y equipos para protegerlos de golpes, corté cuadrados pequeños, para usarlos entre los círculos del lente, con la finalidad de darles más separación y dimensión. Armé los botones de la cámara con solo círculos y rectángulos, que al armarlos y pegarlos con silicón líquido, quedaron muy bien.

>

With some pieces of Polystyrene, which is the material that boxes of appliances and equipment come with to protect them from impacts, I cut small squares to use between the circles of the lens, in order to give them more separation and dimension. I assembled the camera buttons with only circles and rectangles, which when assembled and glued with liquid silicone, turned out very well.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wMgyDvbdFQ29PRMLQJ951ECKkDJCM8NdmmhZZTLb3DSFy4XyU2mAN8ZkyT6imCr1tbP.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xL75UhFPvDV8B6VboEdjYpk1hsEnnjsWyh964F6XZpqBLes9iayyepGsYPbCy1izfcg.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tc65H5XSk3x5vzmUaBVHPGYCXLer1oMgijHMxsmG1e5pu6pKCJbaS8zzpMwiP6QS8No.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23tvsKGNTG9mnapVkjykP8AG6ayY5BsLEz88ReevveyoShsHVmXMMVDmaUkkp62RJH8Dp.png)| |-|-|-|-|

>

Los Stickers que imprimí con la temática de Sirena estaban bellísimos, y utilicé uno pequeño, una pequeña estrella de mar, para darle un toque simpático a la cámara de fotografías. Con estos detalles finalicé esta Caja con forma de Cámara de Fotografías y temática de Sirenas, que quedó hermosa con estos colores que me encantan y que ciertamente si destacan, así que cambiar el diseño del papel digital fue todo un acierto.

>

The Stickers that I printed with the Mermaid theme were beautiful, and I used a small one, a small starfish, to give a nice touch to the camera. With these details I finished this Camera-shaped Box with a Mermaid theme, which turned out beautiful with these colors that I love and that certainly stand out, so changing the design of the digital paper was a great success.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFZyYE2FbiGJ9azY3XNJbsXvZg6ko9FbqpKjKfKHqkWBsvo1WqtnsBghWf4cNVRdPkn.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23xL2vuc8JhULfa6tthb9M3CeMEMnJUrGitbxzW6R2QKr3g8raWPak9qXGYbZz3333Ahq.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFaWuoS6v5Af3DTApo5Y37MPdR86XuN1HLPrH8GG5U1dw1jKARUaGTp5Q9CekVKkX3Y.png)| |-|-|-|

>

Opcional se le puede colocar una cadenita dorada y algunos stickers, estos pequeños detalles hacen aún más especial el Packaging.

>

Optionally, you can add a golden chain and some stickers, these small details make the Packaging even more special.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23wXA4Qfdcgoc6d4br9j4yRKAAwdpJHcV5TkTGJZERaausZfGiXjynTNer7DpYEKdRHPi.png)

>

La caja a pesar de ser pequeña, tiene una capacidad interesante, para colocar Stickers e incluso se puede realizar un obsequio en efectivo y usar ese depósito para esto. Queda ideal y muy hermosa.

>

The box, despite being small, has an interesting capacity to place Stickers and you can even make a cash gift and use that deposit for this. It looks ideal and very beautiful.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23uFZvgFCQJUejDj8PzgdLxaKUHARu5u7U3eoVpfXmzG2SoGaFWVF1vXpsiZeJEg37gfS.png)

>

Esta Caja me llevó algo de tiempo, solo en el diseño en Canva, hacerla fue muy rápida y divertida. Deseo que les haya gustado y que los inspire a hacer Cajitas. Nos leemos en una próxima publciación.

>

This Box took me some time, just designing it in Canva, making it was very fast and fun. I hope you liked it and that it inspires you to make Cajitas. Us

![Banner Yennys (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yennysferm71/23x1UDsh3wbxYNeRiZGBnoUBHoQ9rTPsHyZDG5vBsdAKvvh3dGMKDer72GHhDuo4CZszq.png)

body.title: We Got 3 Points
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVJT6X5WRyUXxiFtg1W5Ex49Qwqtdea9FQmjYd24SA1MH/1777339354827.jpg)

ဒီနေ့ မနက် ၁ နာရီခွဲမှာတော့ United vs Brentford ပွဲစဉ် ကစားသွားခဲ့၏။ ဒီရာသီ United ၏ ပွဲချိန်တွေက သန်းခေါင်ကျော်‌တွေ အတော်လေး များနေခဲ့၏။ UCL မကန်ရတော့ United fan တွေ အိပ်ရေး မပျက်တော့ဘူးပေါ့ဟု စနောက်ကြသူများကို ဘာပြန်ပြောလို့ ပြောရမယ် မသိတော့ပေ။ ပွဲချိန်တွေသာ ကြည့်တော့ကွာဟု ပြောလိုက်ချင်တော့၏။ 

ဒီတပတ်မှာ Aston Villa က ရှုံးသွားပေမဲ့ Liverpool က နိုင်ထားတော့ အဆင့် ၃ နေရာကို ဖိအားပေးသူက ဆက်လက်ရှိနေဆဲပင်။ Leeds ကိုသာ မရှုံးခဲ့ရင် United အနေဖြင့် ယခုထက်ပို၍ အမှတ်ဖြတ်ထားနိုင်မည် ဖြစ်၏။ Brentford နဲ့ ပွဲမကန်ခင်မှာ Liverpool က ၅၈ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၄၊ Aston Villa ကလည်း ၅၈ မှတ်ဖြင့် အဆင့် ၅ နေရာမှာ ရပ်တည်နေ၏။ United အနေဖြင့် ယခုပွဲစဉ်ကို အနိုင်ရဖို့ လို၏။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYAiN7euFrRiyCd93v7mYh99RMX8g9tDD6gYGCdKKqYYu/1777339354811.jpg)


ရှေ့တပတ်က Chelsea ကို နိုင်ထားတော့ ဒီတပတ် Brentford နဲ့ ပွဲစဉ်ကို စိတ်ပူတာတော့ အမှန်ပင်။ အသင်းကြီးတွေကို နိုင်လေ့ ရှိပေမဲ့ အလယ်အလတ်အသင်းတွေနဲ့ တွေ့ရင် ရုန်းကန်ရလေ့ ရှိ၏။ ထို့ကြောင့် အိမ်ကွင်းပေမဲ့ မနိုင်ခဲ့ရင်တောင် သရေကျအောင် ကစားနိုင်ဖို့ မျှော်လင့်ထားမိ၏။ ပထမပိုင်းမှာ ကတည်းက ၂-၀ ဖြင့် ဦးဆောင်ထားတော့ အနည်းငယ်တော့ စိတ်အေးသွားခဲ့ရ၏။ သို့ပေမဲ့ ယတိပြတ်တော့ နိုင်ပြီဟု မတွေးရဲသေးပေ။ 

တကယ်လည်း တွေးထားသည့်အတိုင်း ဖြစ်လာခဲ့၏။ Brentford အနေဖြင့် Come back moment တွေ ဖြစ်ပေါ်လာဖို့ နီးစပ်ခဲ့ပေမဲ့ United ဂိုးသမား လက်စွမ်းပြ ကာကွယ်နေလို့သာ တော်သေးသည်ဟု ဆိုရပေလိမ့်မည်။ United အနေဖြင့်ကလည်း အပိုင်အခွင့်အရေးတွေ လွဲချော်ခဲ့သောကြောင့် ဂိုး ထပ်မရတော့ပေ။ အမှန်ဆို ယခုထက်ကို ဂိုးပြတ်သွားရမှာ ဖြစ်၏။ ၈၇ မိနစ်မှာ Brentford တို့ ချေပဂိုး ၁ ဂိုး ပြန်လည်သွင်းယူနိုင်ခဲ့ပြီး ၂-၁ ဖြင့် ပွဲပြီး သွားခဲ့၏။

အဆင့် ၃ နေရာနှင့် UCL ဝင်ခွင့်အတွက် လက်ကျန် ပွဲစဉ်တွေကို အာရုံစိုက်ထားဖို့ လိုမည် ဖြစ်၏။ လက်ကျန် ၄ ပွဲကိုသာ သေချာ‌ အားစိုက်လိုက်ရင် အဆင့် ၃ နေရာဖြင့် ပန်းဝင်မည် ဖြစ်၏။ လာမယ့် တပတ်မှာတော့ အိမ်ကွင်းမှာ Liverpool နဲ့ ကစားရမည် ဖြစ်၏။ အနီးကပ် ဖိအားပေးနေသည့် ပြိုင်ဘက်နဲ့ ရင်ဆိုင် ယှဉ်ပြိုင်ရတော့မည် ဖြစ်၏။

_(photos from Premier League Page)_

![7H303lbwI8SflPxS_IMG_20260426_131207.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/evahe/images/7H303lbwI8SflPxS_IMG_20260426_131207/7H303lbwI8SflPxS_IMG_20260426_131207.webp)

</liketuimages>

本来想在湿地公园里吃午饭的，因为都十二点了！可惜都是小吃和饮品，没有正餐，难怪我看到很多人都带食物进来露营吃哈哈！而且路边摆摊的卫生我也信不过！最后还是坐地铁回去小区楼下的港华餐厅吃饭了！

老公叫我团购的，但是我看到套餐不喜欢，想直接吃门口的招牌芝士🧀焗饭和意粉！今天餐厅也是坐满了人，可能因为星期天的关系，都是大人和小朋友一起来的！我看看时间快一点，我们马上点餐！老公要喝海盐西柚苏打，大概十八个大洋，我就喝店里的柠檬茶可以了！

以前读书的时候，高中同学推荐我吃番茄肉酱意粉的，挺好吃的，就是太腻了！今天这里叫肉酱芝士焗意粉是二十五个大洋！老公要了黑椒牛扒芝士焗
米饭三十五个大洋！没想到香港的朋友今天也是吃白芝士焗饭，他要的是黑松露酱的！

虽然我的也很黑暗，就是朋友说的很好吃，也不腻，上菜的时候已经一点半了！弄的挺好吃的，难怪是招牌菜，放门票的牌子上哈哈哈！今天真是有口福了！只是没想到老公的牛扒芝士饭比我的意粉更加好吃，太香了吧！

吃完饭后回来洗完手，还是香香的肉酱的味道！奶香奶香的，难怪是招牌的，一共花了78大洋，如果老公不喝饮品更加划算了哈哈哈哈哈！[666][色]我这辈子吃过最好吃的芝士意粉，他的焗饭都好好吃，咸甜适中！


---

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 28 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ga042b68653e016e944694dba7e8c0888aa520317924cdf903261fddbad98f7da5abcb24f24b0d3bcf957b8ac9c77cf12_640.jpg)
Hoy, mi caminata por la ciudad fue realmente revitalizante. El clima estaba perfecto, con un sol radiante que hacía que todo se viera más vibrante. Comencé mi recorrido en un pequeño parque donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. Una mujer mayor, que tenía una energía contagiosa, se acercó a mí y empezó a contarme sobre cómo lleva practicando yoga durante más de 20 años. Su entusiasmo y amor por la actividad eran inspiradores. Continué mi camino y pasé por una feria de artesanos que se había montado en una plaza. Había un joven artista pintando murales en vivo, y su estilo era fascinante; mezclaba colores brillantes con formas abstractas. Me quedé un rato observando cómo creaba su obra mientras conversaba con él sobre su proceso creativo. Fue genial conectar con personas tan apasionadas por lo que hacen. Cada día es una nueva aventura en la ciudad, y hoy no fue la excepción. Me siento agradecido por las pequeñas interacciones que transforman una simple caminata en una experiencia memorable. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: [ESP/ENG] Mi novio se graduó de administrador / My boyfriend graduated as an administrator 🎓
body.body: > Hola amigos, hace días publique una entrada haciéndoles saber que, tuvimos una misa para agradecer a la divinidad por el grado de mi pareja. Así mismo, unos días después viajamos a Puerto la Cruz para que el recibiera su título como administrador, de la Universidad de Oriente. > Hello friends, a few days ago I posted an entry letting you know that we had a mass to thank God for my partner's graduation. Also, a few days later we traveled to Puerto la Cruz so he could receive his degree in administration from the University of Oriente. ![Black and White Simple Wedding Photo Collage A3 Landscape.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUUBbyfC1ZB1XTnvBbQsm3sxzPQA81MdM9ADunttko5FL/Black%20and%20White%20Simple%20Wedding%20Photo%20Collage%20A3%20Landscape.jpg) El viaje desde mi ciudad, Cumaná, hasta Puerto la Cruz, no fue como esperábamos, el bus donde nos fuimos, no contaba con aire acondicionado, e iba mareada con dolor de cabeza. Al llegar, vi estrellas, de la buena manera, estaba ansiosa por ya llegar en ese momento, había una cantidad grande de personas, entre los graduandos y sus familiares, y ya no había sillas para poder observar el acto más cómodos, por lo que, tuvimos que visualizarlo un gran rato paradas. > The trip from my city, Cumaná, to Puerto la Cruz wasn't what we expected. The bus we took didn't have air conditioning, and I was dizzy with a headache. When we arrived, I saw stars—in a good way! I was so excited to get there. There were so many people, including the graduates and their families, and there weren't any chairs left to watch the ceremony comfortably, so we had to stand for quite a while. ![IMG_20260416_152554.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZZBMi5gSd7oqYSqy2CHhLtFJ7Kd8XMbVWsGZKwJ6xeWd/IMG_20260416_152554.jpg) ![IMG_20260416_135945.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmV95x2pEpFJuL2T1LPNaJBEWnyyCf4xzEMyRc1F5sCEnv/IMG_20260416_135945.jpg) El acto comenzó a las 4pm y terminó como a las 7pm. Me gocé el acto de punta a fin, de verdad que, no se si es porque viví esa experiencia por primera vez, pero, me encantó estar allí. Felicitaba a mi novio a cada momento, porque de verdad el sacrificio que hizo estos últimos años para lograr la meta fue mucho más complicado por el país donde vivimos, Venezuela. > The event started at 4 pm and ended around 7 pm. I enjoyed it from beginning to end; I truly loved being there. I don't know if it was because it was my first time experiencing something like this. I congratulated my boyfriend constantly because the sacrifices he made these past few years to achieve this goal were made even more difficult by the country we live in, Venezuela. ![IMG_20260416_155023.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeWVY1FGpvZH5C5yjhoantbgX3PvQh2X2C5fhkaJPXv7e/IMG_20260416_155023.jpg) ![IMG-20260416-WA0082.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNMiuFVQj95WRRdaUHWHWxwSQ5rgpgLbXvGwUKiiqxngb/IMG-20260416-WA0082.jpg) En una universidad que se vino abajo, desvalijada, quemada, insegura, pero, aún así, profesores y directivos, buscaron la manera de hacer que los estudiantes no perdieran la esperanza, encontrando la fe, dando clases incluso en sus casas y plazas de la zona, es de admirar. Algo que, también viví en mi época, pero, que año tras año, se ha intensificado. > In a university that had fallen into ruin—ransacked, burned, and unsafe—professors and administrators still found ways to keep students from losing hope, finding faith in them and even holding classes in their homes and local squares. It's truly admirable. Something I also experienced in my own time, but which has intensified year after year. ![IMG_20260416_154423.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYrkW5cjs1TkNM3Q8hXsRU1237Z2C9z2mefD6Y8hsUGpX/IMG_20260416_154423.jpg) ![IMG-20260416-WA0140.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQqRd88Mnpv9wq4L2B4mcPB5te2fN4ZVaeFiLUsXU5VVF/IMG-20260416-WA0140.jpg) Siempre se ha comentado que, los profesionales llevan con orgullo haberse graduado de la casa más alta de mi país, la UDO, pero, en estos años se ha demostrado intensamente qué, la universidad de oriente está en todas partes, en una gran cantidad de países, porque hemos llevado la emoción de ser udistas a diversos continentes. Ser graduado de aquí, nos da un caché como profesionales, porque quiere decir que, el nivel de estudios y esmero fue mayor que profesionales de otras universidades del país. > It has always been said that professionals proudly carry the legacy of having graduated from the most prestigious university in my country, UDO. But in recent years, it has been overwhelmingly demonstrated that the University of the East is everywhere, in a great number of countries, because we have carried the pride of being UDO alumni to various continents. Being a graduate from here gives us prestige as professionals, because it means that the level of study and dedication was higher than that of professionals from other universities in the country. ![IMG_20260416_175345.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPGAnmuUcogfXTLdfQGbj5piYBt5nzciP3f1c5dbKaPmZ/IMG_20260416_175345.jpg) ![IMG_20260416_171532.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYWidtDZBKBU43MbBMqHJVt7N72na9Xmu2Vtm8s9uKEYc/IMG_20260416_171532.jpg) Siguiendo con el tema del grado de mi novio, fue el graduando número 450, así que, antes de el llamaron a más de 400 profesionales de todas las áreas, que iban desde ingenierías y licenciaturas de diversas áreas, médicos , entre otros. Aplausos a protocolo, porque mantuvo todo al margen, había un área donde solo los graduandos podían entrar, y mantenían ese orden. La parte que, más me emocionó fue al final, cuando cantaron el himno de la Universidad de oriente. De verdad que, fue un muy bonito acto. > Continuing with the topic of my boyfriend's graduation, he was the 450th graduate, so before him, they called over 400 professionals from all fields, ranging from engineers and graduates in various disciplines to doctors, among others. Applause for the protocol team, because they kept everything under control; there was an area where only the graduates could enter, and they maintained that order. The part that moved me the most was at the end, when they sang the University of Oriente's anthem. It truly was a beautiful ceremony. ![IMG_20260416_161225.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQa7rjPVxGnxoxAFL8PnrCEEbcKXFZcVEyMB6ueWXcpMb/IMG_20260416_161225.jpg) ![IMG_20260416_180958_1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZyvSZsDtY8JRMVcpopHjKFndZ5AneTjHwNNQo4tsFrM9/IMG_20260416_180958_1.jpg) Para finalizar, quiero nuevamente dejar mis felicitaciones a mi novio, por el logro de su meta, como le he dicho, este es el comienzo de una carrera profesional, que aunque ejercía, ahora puede hacerlo legalmente, con título en mano. Me siento muy orgullosa de su logro, y se que tendrá muchas mas objetivos por los cuales celebrar en los próximos años. Aplausos para el y los más de 600 graduandos. > Finally, I want to congratulate my boyfriend again on achieving his goal. As I've told him, this is the beginning of a professional career. Although he was already working in his field, he can now do so legally, with his degree in hand. I'm very proud of his accomplishment, and I know he'll have many more goals to celebrate in the coming years. Applause for him and the more than 600 graduates! ![IMG-20260416-WA0095.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeeot5g9X8HYvR6iUnP7fPaWwaQFYZwT24w9EQmkf6KeW/IMG-20260416-WA0095.jpg) ______ #familyandfriends Fotografía por | Photography by: @mairimmorales, HONOR MAGIC 7 LITE. body.title: Trump to review Iran's \
proposal...Maintaining a nuclear 'red line'
body.body:
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUVsH7E9nM3dKmaEqfsAVw6ujE6oNzsknirCyXGcZTdyx/image.png)

>There are reports that U.S. President Donald Trump is discussing Iran's proposal for an end to the war with his aides, but maintains a key 'red line' such as giving up nuclear weapons.
According to Bloomberg News on the 27th, White House Press Secretary Caroline Levitt said at a briefing that President Trump held a national security team meeting at the White House to discuss Iran's proposal.
\
Levitt said, explaining that Trump will soon express his position on the issue.\n\n>The remarks came after reports that Iran had proposed an \

that included the U.S. lifting the blockade of Iranian ports instead of Iran reopening the Strait of Hormuz.
The proposal is said to include putting off complex issues such as the nuclear program to follow-up negotiations.
However, Trump and his staff are cautious about the proposal, especially regarding the nuclear issue, the outlet said.
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi visited Russia the day before and met with President Vladimir Putin, stressing the strengthening of bilateral cooperation, saying, \

Iran is said to have conveyed its position to mediation countries such as Pakistan that an end to the conflict is possible if the U.S. lifts the blockade on Iran's seas and stops military action.
The U.S., on the other hand, sees the nuclear issue as a key condition for any agreement, and Trump has said he would maintain a maritime blockade without resolving Iran's nuclear program.
[Photo by AFP = Yonhap News]
Shin Hyun Wook (woogi@kbs.co.kr )

There is hardly any additional news about negotiations with Iran.
Still, if the above information is true, we might see a somewhat more forward-looking attitude from Iran.

body.body:
>  ![342120.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23xAe7tD5tfeMXN5E2KW5bX3rNYNm6a6QqyQY4LErmPCSZfbPoHqqeqsZt6qX68TBp1JG.png) Holis, ¿qué tal, amigos? Buenas noches, ¿cómo están? Por aquí todo muy bien, gracias a Dios; espero que por allá también. El día de hoy quería compartirles mi noche del sabado que la verdad estuvo llena tanto de tradición como de color y a mi me encanto, a la danza de mi sobrina la invitaron para el aniversario de otra danza que a la vez iban a recoger fodo y estaban pidiendo una colaboración en las entradas de 800bs pero resulta que nos dieron la información mal y yo que llevaba a mi sobrina no pagaba entrada pero resulta que ya yo la había pagado por suerte mi sobrino fue asi que me toco darle mi brazalete a el para que pudiera pasar.
Hi there, how are you, friends? Good evening, how are you all? Everything’s going very well here, thank God; I hope it’s the same over there. Today I wanted to share with you my Saturday night, which was truly full of both tradition and colour, and I absolutely loved it. My niece’s dance group had been invited to perform at another dance group’s anniversary, which was also a fundraiser, and they were asking for a contribution of 800 bolivianos at the entrance. It turns out we’d been given the wrong information, and as I was taking my niece, I didn’t have to pay for her ticket, but it turned out I’d already paid for it. Luckily, my nephew was there, so I had to give him my wristband so he could get in.
![20260425_190313.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23vhsjC2F9aD3B9eXXF5ETqwPVfF1uS5UUtr3cdhJeJmWk5f42Lox94myUeWY3VRyXZeY.jpg) ![20260425_190823.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uFKXN7SXaEiwnfsqQrL4ujKaY8mLpWHNz14vSFkCrTMSKw1vuN1F3tF4JZ5V3LnUN97.jpg) La noche estuvo muy cargada de color; vinieron danzas de Pedro Gonzales, Villa Rosa, que de aquí a esos lugares es bastante lejos, pero aun así hubo muchísimas danzas de lejos. Les cuento que yo no sabía que iban a hacer rifas y, ¿qué creen?, jajajaja, me gané una rifa. Bueno, el brazalete lo tenía puesto mi sobrino y resulta que él corrió emocionado pensando que era otra cosa y resulta que era una botella y el pobre quedó desilusionado, jajajajaja.
The evening was full of colour; there were dance troupes from Pedro Gonzales and Villa Rosa – which are quite a long way from here – but even so, there were loads of groups from far away. I’ll tell you, I didn’t know they were going to hold raffles, and guess what? Hahaha, I won a prize. Well, my nephew was wearing the wristband, and it turns out he ran off excitedly thinking it was something else, but it turned out to be a bottle, and the poor lad was disappointed, hahahaha.
![20260425_190219.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wMS5PZnFgkeoPzKUzAQ9U44QFQbWUkuAJETQ9cE99YSJxs6pmdPWfgyoDtmjRZmpBSE.jpg) ![20260425_190216.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmDrQwQ68NWyQmq4J3wv3n34kEWSG5QaQki71KiqMgwRGMn49MLwEe8LJE4FNnVKgpY.jpg) ![20260425_194945.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tbkbLQk2opoddYLRMMkTLWco44WNdzHJopz4hwkVuy7znbYyLm9BKUeKkUXvKDH4jj1.jpg) ![20260425_201656.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wC2yUZVxTqc4SvSRPBHnYRijeSQd56L192HSEvq3ib7GYT7dDtrMNo7TyLtfAuxB5vK.jpg) ![20260425_192657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23tmFqyaoiZoE2qAgfUZM3FRqXbyhFzhrUhx1VcAdNpdigGQGvAKXeNndsZHAB6CBLD8y.jpg) ![20260425_192847.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23uQnHmptH3LG6Ng4S8QFyoPc1yFohTPAiJY6FJSUqvh8NtyUSmtceP1euVNY8Yj8i9Mx.jpg) ![20260425_203335.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/EoAZnN6KqnPWbAomCnLZYcNHTbZ3GyesHUJWVs9Nvs5e4YqyU834NJHWSVZwix8TkcP.jpg) ![20260425_203340.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/Eo8RnRgF1bfZ9NU5McWs7w9nwETqz4po8g1aRLea7AMLdmraQotTawgcuFBSArVSsKF.jpg) ![20260425_195208.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/emilypino/23wgFg8pZFZ1fdT4anrdutShZQGJqqDr2DRwxAkhiAKTsWHRH6cjFC7HicUajcS1mRAaw.jpg) Yo también estaba preocupada por mi sobrina pero es que esa niña no deja de sorprenderme ella al principio estaba nerviosa por bailar regueton pero después lo hizo con tanta facilidad que yo quede enamorada siempre de ella, esta vez se nos hizo muy tarde porque estabamos en cosas de mi sobrino y no me dio chance de maquillarla tanto asi que termine maquillandola en unas gradas a la pobre luisa para que no bailara toda fantasma jajajajaja, pero fue un buen rato con danzas de todo tipo, la pasamos super bien ¡Saludos!

body.title: Dropped my phone in some water and got it to miraculously come back to life!
body.body:
The other day I did something really foolish. Some people were having a get together at this fancy bar that has a feature where there is a swimming pool with barstools submerged in the pool and it's a pretty great gimmick actually. The place is called Kala Kala and I have avoided it in the past because during their peak hours that place is packed and really loud. But a friend of mine informed me that during the day almost nobody goes there and it could be a nice spot to sit and hang out and have a few drinks.
https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/31/65/41/b1/caption.jpg?w=800&h=800&s=1 [src](https://dynamic-media-cdn.tripadvisor.com/media/photo-o/31/65/41/b1/caption.jpg?w=800&h=800&s=1) photo taken from the internet because, well, you'll find out in a minute...
I was extra delighted to find out that during the day before 4pm, you are allowed to bring small well-behaved pets with you to this place provided that they do not get in the pool. This is not an issue with Nadi because she hates getting in water so she just sat on a chair in the shade while my friends who were already there beckoned me to come and join them in the water. I put down my dog and like an idiot teenager jumped immediately into the water. Hooray! Right? Well, it took me about 2 sips into my ice cold beer that was handed to me (in a can, no glass in the pool!) before I realized i had made a very critical error in my enthusiasm for joining my friends in the water.

My phone was still in my pocket

I did something really silly at that point and frantically pulled my phone out of my pocket and held it up in the air as if the damage wasn't already done. I would imagine that my phone was completely underwater for a good 5 minutes at that point and I do not have some fancy Apple phone where it is designed to be underwater for prolonged periods of time. I didn't try to turn it on until it has been in the sun for a while but as you might expect, it did not turn on. This kind of ruined my day to some extent because I hate it when I allow my jubilee to get in the way of my sensibility and end up destroying something that costs $500 in just a few minutes. Well, that is what I thought at first anyway but then the advice started coming from my pals about that old trick about putting the phone into some rice for a few days.

>
</center>

I went an extra step and not only put the phone is a box of dry rice but also placed it directly on top of my dehumidifier for extra drying power.   Before I put it in there though I removed the simcards and noticed that one of them had some scorch marks or rust on it and that may have been from a short that zapped the phone in the first place upon getting in the water.  I don't know for sure because it's not like I look at my simcards every day.  

After the first night spend in the rice bed I was pretty happy because my phone switched on but then kind of let down when it was really slow, was getting hot very fast, and then switched off.  Ok, nothing to panic about right?  I'll just leave it in there another day.  Day two was better but the simcards would only stay activated for a couple of minutes at a time and this was not very helpful for data.  I was going to be one of those guys that has to ask for the Wi-Fi password everywhere that he goes.  So I waited yet another day, then cleaned the simcards with rubbing alcohol and dried them very thoroughly, and by day 3, everything was working like it did before!  

But there is something that came out of all of this at the same time though and that was the realization that I should be more prepared for this sort of situation.  I didn't currently have my stuff backed up to an easy-to-access location that could help someone if they lost their phone or it was stolen...or if they behave like a dumbshit and jump into a swimming pool with a phone in their pocket.   

The thing that concerned me most was my 2FA, which I foolishly didn't have backed up anywhere else.   This is primo-level jackass stuff right here.   After that 3 day waiting period that was really stressful had passed, I pulled an old phone out of storage, booted it up and then backed up the 2FA there as well.  It is also probably near time for me to get a new phone anyway and if I end up doing that, I am going to have them show me about backup methods that are a bit more complete.  There probably already is a way but I am one of those sorts of users that doesn't like having his information stored all over the place.

Anyway, this was a stressful couple of days because I was searching my mind frantically trying to think about if my 2FA could possibly be stored somewhere else and if you use 2FA you should probably think the same.   If nothing else, store that thing on a seriously trusted friend or family member's phone.   I already learned this lesson once when a previous phone died and I ended up getting locked out of my MexC account.  I never did regain access to it and while I don't think I had very much in there, it was more than zero and that always kind of hurts.  

Anyway, I don't have a top-end phone and I think that maybe they have improved the technology over the years so that it can withstand being shorted out provided you are patient enough and have access to rice.   I've been told that silica gel or desiccant packets work even faster if you suddenly find yourself in a similar situation. 

This was a wake up call that could have ended up much worse than it did.  Thank you rice!

body.title: Caddyshack Is Pure Comedy Chaos And One Of The Funniest Sports Films Ever Made. It Took Golf, Turned It Into Total Madness, And Somehow Created A True Comedy Classic.
body.body:
Released in 1980 and directed by Harold Ramis, Caddyshack is one of those movies that should not work as well as it does, yet it absolutely does. The film feels loose, unpredictable, and almost like it is barely holding itself together, but that wild energy is exactly what makes it unforgettable.

![IMG_9691.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYM1tWyuzEtskw8Dnrssysoho62evtG5hsTC8oRWG7t4j/IMG_9691.webp)

The story takes place at the exclusive Bushwood Country Club, where the wealthy members take golf far too seriously while the younger caddies and staff are just trying to survive the madness. At the center is Danny Noonan, played by Michael O’Keefe, a young caddy hoping to earn a college scholarship while navigating the strange world around him.

Chevy Chase plays Ty Webb, the laid back and endlessly cool golfer who seems to float through life without stress. Chase gives the role his signature dry humor, and Ty becomes one of the most memorable characters in the film because he treats every ridiculous moment like it is completely normal.

Rodney Dangerfield is absolute chaos as Al Czervik, the loud, rich outsider who crashes into the stiff world of Bushwood and refuses to follow any of its unwritten rules. Dangerfield steals nearly every scene he is in. His one liners and complete disregard for country club etiquette give the movie its rebellious edge.

Then there is Bill Murray as Carl Spackler, the groundskeeper locked in an all out war with a gopher destroying the golf course. Murray’s performance is legendary. It feels improvised, strange, and completely disconnected from the main plot in the best possible way. Somehow the gopher storyline became one of the most iconic parts of the film.

Ted Knight deserves major credit as Judge Smails, the uptight country club villain who represents everything stuffy and self important about the old money crowd. His frustration with everyone around him is comedy gold, especially when matched against Dangerfield’s chaos.

Harold Ramis, making his directorial debut, understood exactly how to let these performers do what they did best. Instead of forcing structure too tightly, he allowed the cast room to create. That freedom gives the movie its unpredictable feel and makes it seem like anything could happen next.

The plot itself is honestly secondary to the comedy. There is the golf tournament, Danny’s coming of age story, and the ongoing class clash between members and staff, but the real appeal is simply watching these characters collide. The movie is driven by moments, not strict storytelling.

What makes Caddyshack such a classic is that it captures the spirit of late seventies and early eighties comedy perfectly. It is irreverent, rebellious, and completely uninterested in playing things safe. It pokes fun at wealth, status, and pretension without ever becoming heavy handed.

The film is endlessly quotable. Lines from Murray, Dangerfield, and Chase have lived on for decades because the humor feels natural rather than forced. Even people who have not seen the movie often know the references.

Visually, it is a simple film compared to modern comedies, but that works in its favor. It feels grounded enough that the absurdity stands out even more. The final tournament sequence and explosive ending are still hilarious because the movie fully commits to the ridiculousness.

Over the years, Caddyshack has become much bigger than just a golf comedy. It is part of comedy history. It helped define the careers of several legends and showed how strong character driven humor could outlast trends.

In the end, Caddyshack is an excellent film because it never tries to be polished or perfect. It is messy, loud, and wonderfully chaotic. That personality is exactly why it still works.

![IMG_0871.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRtHg1bwW3muavmQyQ8zgK9qiDAHhjbpaoPNDeRKXeXHk/IMG_0871.webp)

More than forty years later, it remains one of the funniest and most rewatchable comedies ever made, proving that sometimes the best films are the ones willing to let complete madness take over.

As a reward for our bravery and a sign of brotherhood, we obtained the **Goron's Ruby**, the second Spiritual Stone. body.title: I Kill the First Visionary of the Loop, Wenjie, and DEATHLOOP Gets Even Better
body.body:
![GIF.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23uFH1fnfLJ1rKTBxNsyfxvPjDJYjYHwPupBRrUZVJUdnX1aHePHo5sVsQefkPsSrciXm.gif)


Hello gamers, how's everyone doing? Hope you're all great. We're back with more DEATHLOOP and this time I actually have good news for a change — because after that brutal failed attempt at the laboratory that I told you about last time, I went back in ready, focused, and determined. And this time, things went completely differently. I finally took down Dr. Wenjie Evans, the first Visionary on my list, and on top of that I unlocked one of the most important mechanics in the entire game. Blue weapons started showing up, the Residuum system finally opened up, and honestly DEATHLOOP just jumped to a whole new level of fun. Let me break it all down.

**Finally Making It Into Wenjie's Laboratory**

![0423 (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23vsFwYgQo6aBukMdTRhQgLDzDpfwaKa5osq25EGGpoExSS3zkkwrEvy5kd8H85ceZ4Kv.jpg)

So going in this time I already had a huge advantage over my previous attempt — I knew the layout. I knew where the cameras were, I knew which corridors were packed with clones, I knew where the green and blue annexes connected and how to move between them without walking blindly into a room full of Wenjies waiting to unload on me. Knowledge really is the most powerful weapon in this game, and that's not something I say lightly after spending so many runs getting completely dismantled in that place.

I went in during the afternoon, which is when the lab is fully open and active, and I moved deliberately from the moment I entered The Complex. Hackamajig out early, turrets flipped to my side before pushing deeper, cameras neutralized as I went. The approach was slower than I'd like but infinitely smarter than what I tried last time. And it paid off. The clones were still a problem — make no mistake, there are a lot of them spread across every level and every annex of that lab, and each one requires real ammunition and real attention to put down. But this time I had the resources and the patience to work through them systematically instead of panicking and burning through everything at once. Room by room, floor by floor, I pushed deeper into that laboratory and kept moving forward no matter what the clones threw at me.

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tkk8HVke1eMbJ9B7miXNEKgp6CoBAfePRzaznvGM8W4TgHKZr4LUvsaVJc8uxnMBUT5.jpg)

The structure of the fight itself is genuinely interesting once you understand it. Each clone you eliminate leaves behind a clue pointing toward where the next one is hiding, so the whole thing plays out like a trail you follow through the building. It forces you to keep moving, keep pushing, keep engaging even when your instinct is to stop and catch your breath. There's a real rhythm to it once you get into it, and when you finally take down that last clone and Wenjie goes down for good, it feels earned in a way that very few video game moments do.

**Finding the Residuum Experiment**

![0423 (1)(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23xKhxTcxdmnS4xbtEEkuHuR3piBvmTvMXBqLYUvitvSSextTF9z14rVnsvfGX6dSLRpL.jpg)

Here's where things got really interesting. After putting Wenjie down, the game directed me toward a Portable Harvester sitting near her body. And this is where the whole Residuum system finally clicked into place for me in a way the game had been building toward since the very beginning. You pick up the harvester, use it on Wenjie's remains to absorb the Residuum she leaves behind, and then activate a nearby experiment that she had been running. That interaction is what unlocks the full Residuum Infusion system for Colt.

And I have to say, finding this experiment and understanding what it meant for everything going forward was one of those genuinely exciting game moments. Because suddenly the whole loop structure of DEATHLOOP makes a completely different kind of sense. The Residuum that Wenjie was studying, the glowing chromatic deposits you've been seeing scattered around Blackreef this whole time — all of it connects to this system that essentially lets Colt cheat the loop in a very specific and very satisfying way. It's the missing piece that the early hours of the game were building toward without ever fully explaining.

**Finally Keeping Weapons After Dying**

![0423 (1)(4).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/23tbMP71XQc6tcksnrpMSxJKJyQyKrzhNJ94B35vukdkAaYSkRRydRBFbSKdQ7atraGfh.jpg)

And this is the part I had been waiting for without even fully realizing it. Once the Infusion system is unlocked, you can spend Residuum to permanently lock weapons, trinkets, and Slab powers into Colt's loadout so they carry over between loops instead of disappearing when the day resets. This is enormous. Before this, every new loop meant starting from scratch with whatever basic gear you had, and any interesting weapon or ability you picked up during a run would just evaporate when the cycle ended. It made progress feel fragile in a way that was occasionally frustrating even when the overall loop structure made sense narratively.

Now? Now you invest Residuum into the items you want to keep, and they're yours permanently. And the moment I started doing this, blue-rarity weapons started appearing and entering my loadout — noticeably stronger, more interesting guns with better stats and unique properties that grey common weapons simply don't have. The difference in firepower is immediately noticeable, and knowing that I can now hold onto these weapons across loops without losing them completely changes how I think about every run. Now there's real investment happening. Real progression. Every Visionary kill farms Residuum, every glowing deposit on the map is worth hunting down, and every loop I complete makes Colt meaningfully stronger and better equipped for what's ahead.

The Infusion system also works on Slabs — the special abilities you take from Visionaries — and on trinkets, which are passive upgrades that tweak your performance in various ways. So the buildcraft potential here is genuinely deep. You're not just keeping weapons, you're constructing a version of Colt that gets more refined and more powerful with every loop you run.

**On to the Next One**

![0423 (1)(5).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/venapboyz/2458b2aqtFijWCgM5pNcgVxJ9YZw7eNczmpbckE4uR9NoaGj9BKLtRo2KQzYaXYSjKVih.jpg)

So Wenjie is down, the Residuum system is open, and DEATHLOOP has officially shifted into a completely different gear for me. I still don't know exactly who the next Visionary target is going to be or what their situation looks like, but I know they're out there on Blackreef somewhere, going about their endlessly repeating day completely unaware that Colt is now properly equipped and coming for them. Each Visionary is its own puzzle — a different district, a different time of day, a different personality and set of abilities protecting them. And now that I have the tools to actually retain my progress between attempts, tackling each of them feels like a real campaign rather than just surviving moment to moment. So gamers, stay tuned because this is just getting started. See you in the next one!

​Mi vida como mamá emprendedora: El día a día de equilibrar el hogar, la crianza de mi niña y mi pequeño negocio desde casa.

​Estoy muy emocionada de estar aquí, aprender de todos ustedes y mostrarles que con amor y dedicación se pueden crear cosas maravillosas. ¡Gracias por recibirme!

body.title: Freewrite || Under the Sun, They Still Connect the World
body.body:
![PSX_20260428_075854.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaQhM9HGD8sezynvxPKmUUb4vYppxS82R9C57GLY7VyNQ/PSX_20260428_075854.jpg)
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)
The midday heat was scorching, as if the sun wanted to show its merciless power. In the middle of a sparsely populated street, I saw a worker standing on a tall ladder, intently focused on the interconnected cables above. His red uniform contrasted sharply with the vast blue sky, indicating that he was performing a task not everyone would dare.

Below him, a colleague stood quietly, holding tools and occasionally looking up to ensure everything was running smoothly. There was little conversation between them, just practiced movements and mutual trust. This kind of work might seem simple to some, but behind it lies great risk and responsibility.

I paused for a moment, observing them as they worked amidst the heat, the dust of the road, and the constant traffic. There were no complaints, only a clear seriousness and dedication. It made me realize that many tasks around us often go unnoticed, yet play a vital role in our daily lives.

The cables they were arranging were more than just ordinary connections. It's a pathway that connects many people to the outside world, to information, to communication, even to hope. Without them, many of our activities might come to a standstill.

That brief moment taught me one simple lesson, that every job has value, and everyone who does it deserves to be appreciated. You don't need a grand stage to demonstrate the significance of a contribution. 

Sometimes, it's on a hot roadside like this that we can learn about hard work, responsibility, and sincerity.
![hive dividers-04.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvc788wxsBSQHY3z21o3wSTU7hqRnyYc2JFEn2pEYSev/hive%20dividers-04.png)

Politicians are still busy with politicking, trying to bring down their opponents. Transportation fares are also a pain. Let's see if they'll go down when gas prices drops. Never in my lifetime that I saw fares had gone down despite the drop of fuel prices. They may not admit but businessmen particularly the gas company owners are taking advantage of the situation.

I was quite disappointed last night due to some plans unable to fulfill but anyway, I'll be moving on as I usually do with disappointments. Meanwhile, I'm unable to finish my laundry, and still have some to finish today. My wife isn't quite feeling well, and I hope she'll get better the soonest.

**Henry Augustus Stephen Pierre**, conocido universalmente como **Henry Stephen**, nació el 15 de julio de 1941 en Cabimas, estado Zulia. ### Henry Stephen: Venezuela's First Global Pop Idol

**Henry Augustus Stephen Pierre**, universally known as **Henry Stephen**, was born on July 15, 1941, in Cabimas, Zulia state. His musical training began in the effervescent oil-producing environment of the western part of the country, where he had his first encounters with dance rhythms through the group **Los Técnicos** and later with the gaita group **Los Blanco y Negro**. However, his true vocation awakened with the rock and roll of the fifties. His beginnings in this genre were with **Los Flipers**, where he performed songs by **Elvis Presley** and **Chuck Berry**, laying the foundation for what would be a revolutionary career for modern music in Venezuela.

The definitive leap into history occurred with the formation of **Los Impala**, the band that set the standard for Venezuelan rock and projected national talent abroad. It was the legendary presenter **Renny Ottolina** who, recognizing his magnetic potential, gave him the opportunity to debut as a soloist on the program **Renny Presenta** with the song **\

**. This boost led him to represent Venezuela at the **Montjuïc Festival** in Spain, alongside **Mirla Castellanos**, achieving a notable second place that would open the doors of the European market wide.\n\nIn 1968, contracted by **RCA Victor**, he established himself in Spain for a period of six years. His popularity on the Iberian Peninsula was overwhelming; he participated in musicals, television comedies, and performances in the most exclusive clubs. His most emblematic hit, **\

**, became a global sales phenomenon. During this international stage, **Henry Stephen** had the privilege of sharing stellar stages with figures such as **Aretha Franklin**, **Miriam Makeba**, **Julio Iglesias**, and **Roberta Flack**, consolidating himself as a world-class artist. Upon his return to Venezuela in 1974, he diversified his career by successfully venturing into acting. Under the direction of **Jim Huntley**, he starred in television musical classics such as **The Wizard of Oz** and **The Life of a Boxer**, in addition to participating in high-quality soap operas like **La Encantada**. Until his final years, he remained active both as a soloist and in reunions with **Los Impala**, leaving a legacy of professionalism and joy that consecrates him as the first great showman of Venezuelan pop before the world. #

body.title: Opening the Glide Pack today
body.body:
Opening the Glide Pack today was a great experience. I've opened packs times while playing Splinterlands but todays opening gave me a different feeling. I got some cards together that can be very important not for my collection but also for future battle strategies.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPYGrTuZ9xuWogYi1TkHoJo3SzCsJR4rcVB1TfsJtMzQS/1777338015499.jpg)

* There's always a sense of excitement when opening a pack—what card will I get will I get a Rare will I get an Epic. Will I end up with just normal cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZiY8jSgxKapuqcnKYKwgx9XnBFf5nsCyDL6ABHivrUGZ/1777338015580.jpg)

*. Todays results made it seem like the wait was worth it.

The first thing that caught my eye was the variety of unit cards in the pack.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTJFR1UPpLmr7MRWmZ18she7oi2zLpZ5As3i8fQFmaAU/1777338015728.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ95Rmzig9DhBLXS6CbHyu6YmKSLESzGBs9vEyZuW8WFJ/1777338015649.jpg)

The same pack doesn't just have cards of one type. Cards with different roles.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwXSD57fiK94M5HwEkJkQtq6r8tB7wcoCet9x3byt9LJ/1777338015839.jpg)

Some cards can act as tanks on the frontline some can deal damage from the backline. Some cards can also be used as supports.

## This diversity is the fun of Splinterlands

It's not just about having cards but also about having the right combination of Splinterlands cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd12kFJwoBUreuw8HspmYTrjzzARBSE8yV9HFqtCHZv4E/1777338060845.jpg)

## I really liked getting two copies of the Alfredo card

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwXSD57fiK94M5HwEkJkQtq6r8tB7wcoCet9x3byt9LJ/1777338060645.jpg)

The advantage of getting copies of the same Alfredo card is that I can level up very easily.

This is very important for those who want to play Splinterlands for the term.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYJfUCHHLp9r94jv2BM7roD3h6x5YX21aiTjeP6VDAc7A/1777338060747.jpg)

Because higher level cards mean stats, new abilities and additional advantages in battle.

So I see getting Alfredo as a very positive thing.

## Then I also got two copies of Helmet Kharafax

This will also create opportunities to merge and make quality cards in the future.

Times we are happier if we get Rare or Epic cards but multiple copies of common or common cards can also be very valuable.

Because these types of cards are used the most in Splinterlands battles.

So there is no opportunity to look at these cards as small.

## The Katrebla Gobson card also came in two

I found it quite interesting.

These types of Katrebla Gobson cards often work great in a Splinterlands ruleset.

Not every match is the same in Splinterlands.

Sometimes the mana cap is low melee only sometimes ranged is prohibited and sometimes speed becomes more important.

Then a certain card can turn the match around.

So besides the joy of getting cards I always think about which card to use in which Splinterlands situation.

## Getting two copies of Whistling Damon is also quite satisfying

Because duplicate cards mean the opportunity to strengthen in the future.

In my opinion those who want to progress in Splinterlands do not just look at getting new cards but also look at duplicate cards.

Because in the end you have to merge to build a Splinterlands deck.

## The interesting part of todays pack opening was getting the Epic card Gorth

The feeling of getting an Epic card is always different.

Because they don't come around often and many times they act as a game changer in Splinterlands battle.

Looking at Gorths stats it can be understood that it can be used as an unit.

Because of its high health it has the ability to survive.

In matches where it's necessary to survive for a long time this type of card can be very effective.

## Another notable card is Palidon Rakk

As a card it has good potential.

Sometimes Rare cards don't come into discussion like Epic. In reality they play a huge role in winning Splinterlands matches.

Rare cards often give the value with the right summoner and the right lineup.

So I'm happy to get Palidon Rakk.

## The Alva The Crusher card is also an addition

The card has a strong presence as its name suggests.

This type of unit usually works well in the line and can also attack well.

Cards that can be used as tanks or off-tanks are always needed in the Splinterlands deck.

## The Witch of Warwick card is as unique as it looks

Its use can be strategic.

Sometimes there are cards that even though they don't directly deal damage can affect the match through special abilities.

In Splinterlands not all matches can be won with stats alone.

Abilities often make the difference.

That's why I'm giving this Witch of Warwick card importance.

## The Hugo Strongsword card seems strong as its name suggests

Sword-type melee attacker cards are usually effective in close combat.

If the mana cap is good and the melee ruleset is favorable then such cards can play a role.

## The Bertrol Gobson card has also come to my attention

Sometimes cards with mana costs are the most usable.

Because you can't take expensive cards in low mana matches and you can also use them as support units in high mana matches.

Balanced mana cost cards are always valuable.

## Another good thing about this pack opening

is that it has cards of rarities.

Common Rare Epic—all all it has been a balanced opening.

Sometimes it feels disappointing to get Common and even if you get only a Rare there is not much excitement.

Todays opening had variety, which made the whole experience even better.

## For me Splinterlands is not a game

but a journey of patience, planning and building a Splinterlands collection.

Each pack opening is a chapter in that journey.

Sometimes you get something sometimes you get ordinary results.

If you keep moving forward you eventually create a strong Splinterlands deck.

Todays Glide Pack opening has given me that confidence more.

can be combined and made stronger in the future.

Those who are new often think that only high rarity is enough.

In reality leveling up common and rare cards is often more effective than low level epics.

So I always see getting duplicates as a bonus.

 Now my plan is to analyze which Splinterlands cards to upgrade

which to keep in the battle deck and which to hold based on market value.

In Splinterlands it's not about playing but also about making decisions.

When to upgrade, when to sell, when to hold—it’s all part of the Splinterlands strategy.

Todays Glide Pack opening can be said to be quite successful for me

I'm happy to get cards, multiple Rares and several duplicates.

New cards mean possibilities, new lineups, new hopes for Splinterlands victory.

Now it's just time to use them correctly.

These Splinterlands cards will perform well in the battles ahead

and my collection will become even stronger.

Todays pack opening reminded me again—a combination of luck, planning and patience is the real key to success, in Splinterlands.

body.title: Let's Play Resident Evil Village - Rooftop madness to the floor
body.body:
![Resident Evil Village Rooftop madness to the floor.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tRzbB41sAzpUhmfgDFtuWfD18mg7ti2baoDd85ePmmHCzciZ41nDhmKuPB7LTkLNe3y.gif)

---

# Rooftop is fun and madness before I get back to the floor

With the new sniper rifle weapon in hand and ready to be fired upon whatever is out there, no doubt a whole lot of flying creatures to test my shooting skills, I took the steps out and looked around.

But as I got to the last few steps before being outside, the flying creatures and four of them, had shown up and I was about to have some shooting practice!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.05.57.42.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tvD1ZN8FE6M6P4BtGb6oDHzk8RfS2eEiKqG2iU2rrgeQTGxnCfa7vrbqgsg325TbR1g.png)

It started off with using the handgun which allowed me to get the upper hand on two of them from a safer distance by the room, then as the other two dipped out of sight and then came back up, before diving for me, I had pulled out the shotgun to destroy them both. Quite a few handgun bullets and some misses were had with the first two, but boomy shotgun had no trouble at all.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.06.37.55.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tm7GdA7NT3nuuht7HeTewmK2HpLYZbRhQqy5wfsKa5Ukej5o4EoB34kMNjfwxdQWh3R.png)

The sniper rifle is quite fun and allows killing or hurting things from far, before they can even get anywhere close to me as it was seen with this flying creature. I shot it dead, long range sniping and the other one followed before I admired the beautiful views of the castle from the rooftop area.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.07.06.21.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23u5WwYYT5wJrDPYa2gRLVwvbuHcLk8eJzEtwUUoFJrjkN4G9KD6buu8HVyiB4c2bSdvw.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.07.38.36.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23wWTgLyq4mgGEyQ5oznnBwMo8v537aZgY1286LKBpdLy6dzHTMCQ9Peue8wEnEWMqKAu.png)

I had some of these creatures get hits onto me which brought my health down lower and into the orange.. only had the one lot of meds to heal up with and it was as good a time to use it, in case I had god knows what else to come further on among the rooftops or nearby castle areas. But I held off for the moment while bracing to use it should I get hit another time.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.09.39.76.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tRxWc6Mr4wpnr1zi6NXqvarXHQounhTMoAm29ENxQSxCdba4zLizUaHKnNxEBv29TPY.png)

Now though I had killed off the last of the flying creatures, I believe, so I explored to loot up what I could between valuable items and the usual loot I can use to progress further.

There was a zipline down to another section and looked to be where I should head next. Some vases near it were smashed and some more Lei was collected, before I took this zipline down and managed to find the third mask required for those statues.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.11.45.49.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tm9FnSkNacJC6dKgyfSz754sVzkFGJGZjTdtdoHvkzabEKnX2NTTmdDDPFi4xhxcBbX.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.11.57.65.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23u5tWVuHFnmtwEX9xsy6qAgHYunYLysoC9g1sEUHYNUDAjE2CGd6xD39jVnMRy7Pz9hn.png)

Now the mask was mine and nothing was left up here to loot or kill, I headed down the lift I found before, to see what I could find.

It leads back down to that lift found early on as you just enter the castle, that you couldn't use. But the worst part is I ran into Lady Dimitrescu once more, almost being killed this time and needing to quickly heal on the go as I ran and got away from this evil wench!

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.12.38.20.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swc1NtTizPe6GF393dJ3fZT83jWYQJdgzJXQEf5LYmxiV6C9gar3ZSbcWSmH1mBiPDB.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.13.19.15.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23sxC67Q9zGZThpgacJ2rP47hZBi5hcTptxaRyqAxcaXu8UG5tZT5WaKLy2QDX4GYP2yK.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.13.20.98.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23swfwFqoH2a4ZP5LE1ca5kiCXZus1eNyV1tN6i8dtcFAxNAnrByoRzhen9o6EFwhp8Gz.png)

The running continued until I got to the safe room with the typewriter to save the game. After which I checked out how much I will earn from the new items that are valuable and can be sold.. 13400 Lei I get for the three of them and it comes in handy.

This allowed me to purchase the upgrade to my inventory so I could hold more which will come in handy, along with the recipe for sniper ammo and then upgrading the sniper rifle ammo capacity, so it can hold an additional two bullets.

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.13.53.82.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tbnfShB68HSqPUyjMJB9aPC2YyxAzHk7qdmC9MJWrwyQ7nwYnKSfP989LkRKdX2HSZb.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.14.19.48.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tbkbPEmPEj2f2JT6gsE5kgtKWDfqmcztjcKD2naoLgeArKrg1TxgTQFERmmFx73jyZL.png)

![Resident Evil  Village Biohazard Village Screenshot 2026.01.05 - 22.15.28.85.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thegoliath/23tmBQZh4UZR6EBZB7PbXtuy7PSyM8WCEJ9sn4b2U4JFdTbHuhWTmB2apaZWFUARGwHuG.png)

body.title: My moving to Boston
body.body: When I first decided on [moving to boston](https://beesmovingst.com/locate/massachusetts/boston/), I imagined it would be a mix of excitement and complete stress, and honestly I was ready for the worst part more than anything else. But the experience surprised me in a good way. Once everything was planned out and the right help was in place, the whole process felt way more manageable than I expected. Instead of constantly putting out fires, I could actually focus on the idea of starting fresh in a new city. There were still the usual challenges like packing everything up and dealing with timing, but nothing spiraled out of control. In the end, it felt less like surviving a stressful move and more like stepping into a new chapter without the usual chaos dragging it down.
