body.title: Michael Jackson Child Drawing Fan Art [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![Sin título25.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/AKs2hCkYzUrp5arHQk9MVvYUzfctHvtSsKWEZr8M8ccqMrgWFaUipq8fWXgz6wS.jpg)

Hello dear friends, I'm back again, sharing the Michael Jackson fever. The movie has broken box office records for a film of this genre, especially after receiving negative reviews from critics. The fandom has spoken, and it's been elevated to the highest level. It's incredible; we're witnessing the rise of an artist for all time, because the connection with him from new generations has been impressive. I've already seen the movie, and while I won't give away any spoilers, I can tell you it's definitely worth watching. That's why I created this new drawing, as it depicts Michael Jackson's childhood, and I wanted to use that as inspiration. Here's my drawing of the best of the five Jacksons.

>Hola queridos amigos, estoy aquí de nuevo, compartiendo la fiebre por Michael Jackson, la película ha roto records de taquillas para una película de este género, especialmente luego de que fue evaluada d forma negativa por la crítica, el fandom ha hablado y la ha puesto en lo más alto. Es increíble, estamos en presencia ante un artista de todas las épocas, porque el acercamiento que han tenido las nuevas generaciones ha sido impresionante. Ya pude ver la película, sin embargo no haré ninguna clase de spoiler pero les comento que que vale la pena verla. Es por eso que he realizado este nuevo  dibujo, ya que la infancia de Michael Jackson es reflejada y quise tomar esa parte como inspiración. Aquí les presento mi dibujo acerca del mejor de los 5 Jackson. 


<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>
<center>PROCESS</center>

|![Sin título1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2unie8qHRGo3kHUJuqdo6tfyeW59NZMA8NRou4MwEB6TQv4L8ymyszt8QfmN55xBFD.jpg)|![Sin título2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQvQk2GXJ7z6nSfpN4fBdrgqDaUdFCJxU6kUTHV2kLwkYfAohmUB8RrPpB8aBwwCcf6.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23u6DZQ4b84wxk3a7MVGZiK223EheXRSUwKiQqAwoH3de7CTZSAYw9wqBepG3y27sLa3v.jpg)|![Sin título4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23u6BsYSNLyXEHmvcxf3xd3JwnmWGs91ZJhN65sVHLoCogxDvi43KPtnZt4ueY6SHgLzd.jpg)||

In the first step, I begin sketching Michael Jackson as a child, when he had an afro hairstyle. Using only a pencil, I draw lines to define each part of his face. The lines don't need to be very dark; a fine-tipped pencil is sufficient.

>En el primer paso, continuación comienzo a hacer el boceto de Michael Jackson en su etapa de infancia, donde utilizaba el peinado afro, solamente con un lápiz voy haciendo las líneas pare delimitar cada una de las partes del rostro. No es necesario hacer las líneas muy marcadas, solo basta con utilizar un lápiz de punta fina. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tc5ixazwM1RqzybNnqnWLMjg59DjUNdN2XtjDk4oZYviVCFn353LZmpxMWiMtFra139.jpg)|![Sin título6.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23vi6VCwFNNBN2hf9CkYNuiedcbz4Z7V8MDSw1xVcvXRd3sYezC4BeKBpvPMTWh9mZKos.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título7.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFXkNSoAbfenv7NnjAHjkpHvBiEUYw5EKpCN6VwSJCbggFvBnrg8G4iCsnQKvRehcoH.jpg)|![Sin título8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQxfMnXeuSvW7SZVPCB9P9jCcyN4oUiCvuLht37V1sw6AkjQvLeZQ3GmM78XkCxioKm.jpg)||

When I start using the pen, I use one with a light gray ink. I use this ink to lay the foundation for my drawing. It's like using a light-tipped pencil to create a contrast between the light and dark colors. Then I begin shaping the lower part of the face, starting with the mouth and then the chin area.

>Cuando comienzo a utilizar el bolígrafo, utilizo uno que tiene una tinta que no es muy oscura, la tinta es parecida un poco al color gris, con esta clase de tinta comienzo a establecer la base de mi dibujo. Es como si utilizara un lápiz de punta clara y así hacer un contraste entre los colores claros y oscuros. Entocnes comienzo a darle forma a la parte inferior del rostro, comenzando desde la boca, y luego la zona del mentón.

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título9.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wCGNyij81v8zXJ9xMuK7MYmcHWQzGST7vSSQzcdwGPAirQXNpzXxeSVj68takxnDgCV.jpg)|![Sin título10.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wMf8hFMe6D4bKTanKtRmVgRUDG9sYhTGRdLAcuJrP4STVsK6YtVx692iQHAjLsFiirF.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título11.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2wS9jpgxDgumU88Mwxj8yxi8DK7f311mmxqWvRQes47h1ipAX9pVMzsAGaeYWJX1PQ.jpg)|![Sin título12.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFZnVjD581HuRm13m7GuEqG3ZGYyQHuREBkT84q1Exv3HozeKpQcbTT7h3PN9rj69M5.jpg)||

As you can see, the lines I draw are circular and irregular. I don't define the face clearly; I simply use very light lines to try and give it color. Now, when I'm going to add detail to a part, that's when I use thicker lines, so you can see how the nose gradually emerges. In the same way, I work my way up the drawing until I reach the left eye, and little by little I give it shape, adding more strokes and shadows.

>Como pueden observar, las líneas que hago son circulares y accidentadas, el rostro no lo dejo en claro simplemente, hago líneas muy suaves para tratar de darle color al rostro. ahora, cuando voy a detallar una parte, entonces ahí si utilzo líneas más gruesas, así pueden ver como va apareciendo poco a poco la nariz. De la misma forma voy ascendiendo por el dibujo hasta llegar al ojo izquierdo y poco a poco le voy dando forma, agregando más trazos y sombras. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título13.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23tvnTdnednTf3M6FdRbetA3pMcEDptiafJhZhkM6a5aAs225GkNcTWmfBJRzBk5BdZKc.jpg)|![Sin título14.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQzszGrcuWYTvkqsVnsFhGLGLoVgaKyVhnpDJApsdv8x2ww5cNt8jF7SioK7pcye6ac.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título15.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wMguPtvUArTubW32cUsoNAp9PaZTDCYmzgnxbw3sThcpunTDiKJYSCL4zN9YD7QMvqK.jpg)|![Sin título16.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQvpFv1j89q8PznJEyWjJVLvGzb8dDmegPeQnhzKLFfn9q9W1bfzJxWGpja7V3Hug6w.jpg)||

Up to this point, you can see how, line by line, the face gradually gains volume and contrast. This technique is truly brilliant; unlike others I've used before, it feels very therapeutic because the forms emerge from the chaos of the lines. I continue adding the other eye until I complete the innocent and artistic gaze of little Michael.

>Hasta este punto pueden observar como línea tras línea el rostro va tomando volumen y contraste. La verdad que es geníal esta ténica, a diferencia de otras que he utilizado antes, se siente muy terapéutico, porque del caos de las líneas van saliendo las formas. Así voy agregando el otro ojo hasta completar la mirada inocente y artística del pequeño Michael.

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título17.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23vi5jrbT22PNbe3vfWyZyVCGTpWfM3EPzbBEwU43c9eW2EHqTQ86A8UW5chLzU5bCDTC.jpg)|![Sin título18.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wgU9Du3Q6ojjTUUioidPosecqdFRzV58aAi6wWRYjGJeks1DddW7Y3AiyxmTPU973PY.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título19.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uQy29AXWmRcwKkVT8ivvoaV4x27DJXDS4Nj43SjYT4NmfG2HDwrJwvrSZqRZGW3LmJq.jpg)|![Sin título20.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2uabg7uhEDhPwVoh1apW2xRMAdsKnUUfNB44qkWdGA99cLJJfLWr3ZdvRCEBBySeVr.jpg)||

Here I've taken some close-up photos so you can see each line in detail, and how, all of them joined one on top of the other, they gradually take the desired shape. I'm also slowly outlining the hair to begin filling in that entire area.

>Aquí he tomado unas fotos muy cercanas para que puedan observar con detalle cada línea, y como todas ellas, unidas una encima de la otra van adquiriendo la forma deseada. También voy poco a poco delimitando el cabello para comenzar a rellenar toda esa zona.

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

|![Sin título21.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wqtt9rueyYmnmsTYd2mikrKZnuFoeeLuAfNaCszn7SfyNpdRLv9PwcZrrq9dKjp5aw2.jpg)|![Sin título22.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23w2oL9wZKsQppgo7w1D5YxiytJqffYrqU6qboPswRn2D674ouGrsCH3uxYrqWp8LiZp7.jpg)||
|-|-|-|
|![Sin título23.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23x1BTE1mkJBjDivFVB3tPQtuxjt8zmtppo2mT398joMARPkWdxVAxVemm5SW4jGoviJE.jpg)|![Sin título24.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23wX3G9FhnhuTtzYYoCbohEyXniJJEGnwgFYsDWHyi7LRHyG97yqxS9MEsfdzwSexkCdh.jpg)||

The hair was mainly covered with the first pen I mentioned. Once I finished the entire drawing, I used another pen with a darker, more intense ink. In the photos, you can see how the hair's tone gradually changes. This darker pen gives the hair more volume. And that's how the drawing was finished.

>EL cabello fue cubierto principalemte con el primer bolígrafo que les había comentado. Una vez que terminé todo el dibujo, utilicé otro bolígrafo que posee una tinta más oscuras e intensas, en las fotografías pueden ir observando como el tono en el cabello va cambiando poco a poco. Con este bolígrafo más oscuro el cabello puede obtener más volumen. De esta manera ha quedado finalizado el dibujo. 

<center>![tira.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23uFVzd2aFEPWsPKCcy8dNjK3jTAVPz2QKn9fq1JxwhmNJweDnechmxLuFHx5zytbZdow.jpg)</center>

<center>FINAL WORK</center>


![Sin título26.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xKzeL1iVJXPJ9CQNa8DC7DnpYFBQq3S1pt5YhLBj1hqxr2iLHQyCcnmVizZ8Jva3Xfd.jpg)

![Sin título27.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xKxef8YXTEXkpVUjdnJXvTytR2tQM9Jru9vmSMsv1bs5qMYY7w1qTGP8DwKLuL4t1g7.jpg)

![Sin título28.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23x1B2eQk9VJcgmpHRYnK2nY3QE3uGTmeTXDbsL7atrmKe2DXT8WL72ywCJ8rxbfeASn3.jpg)

![Sin título29.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fixie/23xKzdzMPhvGf8zWVaboLo1d4fzDmdJKrAnDVavbbp2zpYKzVFJb3kmdqB4wrXCmyoWPt.jpg)

So far, what do you think of the result? I really liked this image, especially knowing all the suffering Michael Jackson endured in his childhood, suffering he carried with him until his last days. Yet, he never gave back to the world; instead, he transformed it all into art, which is why he's the King of Pop. I hope you enjoyed this illustration. Until next time!

>Hasta aquí ¿Qué les ha parecido el reusltado? Esta imagen me gustó mucho, especialmente al ser consciente de todo el sufrimiento por el que pasó Michael Jackson en su infancia, sufrimiento que llevó hasta el último de sus días, y al contrario nunca devolvió masl al mundo, al contrario todo eso lo convirtió en arte, por eso es el rey del pop. Espero que les haya gustado esta ilustración, me despido hasta una próxima oportunidad.

Decorative Figure Quilling Technique [Eng-Esp]
body.body:
> ##### **Hello to all my Hive friends... 🐱**
A few days ago, I started a collection of Unown Pokémon. I loved them because, as I mentioned in my previous post, they each represent a letter of the alphabet—and some even include symbols. When I made the first one, which corresponds to the letter A, I thought to myself, “Why not make them all?” and that’s exactly what I’ll do. Little by little, I’ll share each of these interesting Pokémon with you—they’re inspired by ancient symbols and the idea that language holds power. Today, I’m sharing ***\

***, crafted as a decorative figure using the quilling technique. 

I’m sharing this image so you can get an idea of all the different Unown Pokémon that exist, and so you can follow along as I create them and see how similar they are:

<hr>
<hr>

||
|-|
|![file_00000000d6b4720e874ef273956a6999.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/23tcLZ1GLKCiRNtJYVJHoCyGReqZQcT9ADnQXjPv6Zmk3ueRzzms9p2Zw2JBxCKR9HCSp.png)|

<center> **Image Generated by ChatGPT**</center>

<hr>
<hr>

**If you'd like to see my previous work, here it is:** [Pokémon Unown \

](https://peakd.com/hive-130560/@dayadam/unown-pokemon-decorative-figure-quilling)
#### ***Hoping you like it, I leave you my creative process:*** ># **Let's get started:😃**

##### **Hola a toda mi gente de Hive... 🐱** Hace unos días comencé una colección de Pokémon Unown, me encantaron ya que los mismos como mencioné en el anterior post demarcan una letra del alfabeto e incluso están algunos símbolos, al hacer el primero que corresponde a la letra A, me dije porque no hacerlos todos, y pues así lo haré, poco a poco les traeré cada uno de estos interesantes Pokémon que están inspirados en signos antiguos y en la idea que el lenguaje tiene poder. Para hoy les dejo ***\

***, en forma de una figura decorativa en la técnica de quilling. 

Les dejo está imagen para que se hagan una idea de todos los distintos Pokémon Unown existentes y así le podrán hacer seguimiento al que voy elaborando y que tan semejante es:

>• Cintas para quilling. • Aguja para quilling. • Mandril para moldear círculos. >• Cartulinas. >• Guillotina de cortar papel. >• Pega blanca extra fuerte (de carpintería). >• Pincel. >• Tijera. >
- Ribbons for quilling. - Needle for quilling. - Mandrel for shaping circles. - Cardboards. - Paper cutting guillotine. - Extra strong white glue (carpentry glue). - Brush. - Scissors.
![40.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48SpZgefHFSX4tcvQfhpdVsM51fKanb8EdcWXzo36HoQj5CPD6vKMgprVtxnX9E7xG.png)
• I started by making the base shape; all Unown Pokémon share this same base, which serves as their face, and then take on different forms and styles. • The base piece consists of a closed multicolored circle made with 3mm-wide ribbons. We start with white, which will be the eye, then continue winding black ribbon onto the same needle to create a stripe. Next, we use white ribbon for a thicker stripe, and finish with black ribbon to make this final thin stripe. • We’ll use a mandrel to make circles. We’ll wrap 3mm-wide black ribbon around it to create a not-too-thick ring, working from top to bottom using size 7. • Once the ring is ready, we’ll apply extra-strong white glue while it’s still on the mandrel and let it dry thoroughly.
![41.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/48TnU9jLg64ufmgLUHNQeMMZv9Nm5DtPcXhFv9jTCKALifHYrtfxTJ4P3wHScvh1RH.png)
• Comencé haciendo la figura base, todos los Pokémon Unown tiene esta misma base que es su cara para seguir con formas y estilos diferentes. • La pieza base consiste en un círculo cerrado multicolor, con n cintas de 3mm de ancho, comenzamos con el color blanco que será su ojo, continuamos enrollando en la misma aguja sobre en blanco color negro con la cual haremos una franja, luego vamos con el color blanco la cual será una franja más gruesa, para finalizar con cinta negra con la que haremos está última franja fina. • Tomaremos un mandril para realizar círculos, enrollaremos cinta de color negra de 3mm de ancho con ma que realizaremos un aro no tan grueso en la medida número 7 de arriba hacia abajo. • Listo el aro, aplicaremos pega blanca extra fuerte estando en el mandril y dejaremos secar muy bien.
||| |-|-| |![InShot_20260427_174715217.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpVEwCa6MJVaSV4r4Lxx587doM2oJAfwBvGt9mkxGfVfPuBX3ShkLjevwd9zsgeXsNy.jpg)|![InShot_20260427_174820977.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EqFut2cLsZgaaMKeNtLbMN2Cemq6GtbuMWmUpB2t8VQoN2vDmbTwWXiXufL8p84oVUi.jpg)| || |-| |![InShot_20260427_174921820.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/EpJaYXzLaVrpc4BKHmBvzSPP6B1GkkvojpTNhVb95vzmUe5Y4L5mDvTvDpXAURZqt7S.jpg)|
• Take a 3mm-wide black ribbon and make some folds using extra-strong white glue to create a thicker ribbon or strip; let it dry. • Once the ribbon is dry, cut it into 3 equal parts. • Assemble the pieces by gluing two of the thick strips we made earlier to the base piece—one on the bottom and one on the left side. Let it dry thoroughly and be patient. • Glue the last strip to the right side of the ring, and continue to be patient until it dries completely. • Finally, join both parts together as shown in the image, let it dry, and apply a few strokes of extra-strong white glue to the entire piece to protect it and finish this interesting character. >This completes this Pokémon Unown, which corresponds to the letter \

of the alphabet, in the form of a decorative quilling figure.
![S.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dayadam/Eo1xq5mBnfyu766mjzRfzkkxQSiU3xbRk277sqvok1PSSskBeGZ15YzyQw52yZAx3w8.png)
• Tomaremos cinta de color negra de 3mm de ancho, haremos algunos dobleces aplicando pega blanca extra fuerte, esto para hacer una cinta o piensa más gruesa, dejamos secar. • Seca la cinta picaremos en 3 partes iguales. • Procedemos a ensamblar la piezas, pegando en la pieza base 2 de las líneas gruesas que realizamos con antelación, una en la parte de abajo otra en el lado izquierdo. Debemos dejar secar muy bien con paciencia. • En el aro pegue la última línea en la parte derecha, seguiremos teniendo paciencia para que seque muy bien. • Por último unimos ambas partes tal y como pueden ver en la imagen, esperamos que seque y damos algunas pinceladas de pega blanca extra fuerte a toda la pieza para protegerla y terminar con este interesante personaje. >De esta manera finalice este Pokémon Unown que corresponde a la letra \

del alfabeto, en forma de una figura decorativa en la técnica de quilling.

body.body:
> Happy Monday, athletes and healthy-lifestyle enthusiasts! We’re keeping active with this app, ACTIFIT, for our physical and mental well-being.
![GridArt_20260427_193021256.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23xLDrJa4kg72rFqG8ABhu3nUscwY79GWApvqVPhyby3kDSmWLXok6LDMrgsTGFT1RY9v.jpg)

> A promise is a promise, and since I’ve been more active lately, here’s my walk from yesterday. I went out in the afternoon to walk along the Antonio José de Sucre Highway. It was a long walk along that entire stretch, which I like because it’s open, even though cars zoom by at full speed.
![IMG_20260426_180031.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/243WgZz6YNDfPNuPQeJxtJyCxEm1JbbHFWAzFzoQXosHNmZbc87wjwVXVjRH3a1xxULm6.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_180602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/23zS1DrHsYJ52caDcPCg4Xm2HEBKZHMsLLg89p4atqoVuqiQfmL2GoqtsYWSiJhMCC9Dd.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_180544.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wendyth16/2432DXofcsHTGR9TzxSDqbBqK1YgF4DVC4jSevPdEVhtNkZNFSz5BNGCoyRPfWYsoQaaW.jpg)
But there’s plenty of vegetation on either side. The weather was cloudy, and it looked like it might rain. which is something all of us in this city have been longing for, since we’ve been in a water crisis for the past two months. We’ve had a hard time, hoping they’ll resolve it soon. On the way back, we crossed the avenue and saw a horse eating corn cobs.

> I should mention that there are many cornfields along this road, so I stopped to take a picture of it. We got home and it started to rain, so we made it just in time; my body is on the move every day. That’s all for now, my adventurous friends at Actifit.

> >! [spanish,Here]> Feliz lunes, deportistas y dueños del estilo de vida saludable, donde nos mantenemos en movimiento con este Dapp, ACTIFIT, para nuestro bienestar físico y mental. Lo prometido es deuda, pues estoy más activa últimamente, está es mi caminata de el día de ayer, me fui en la tarde a caminar por la autopista Antonio jose de Sucre, fue una larga caminata, por toda esa vía que me gusta porque es despejado, aunque los carros pasan a full velocidad, pero hay bastante vegetación en sus laterales, el clima estaba nublado, amenazaba con llover, es algo que todos los de esta cuidad anhelamos, puesto que tenemos una crisis hídrica desde hace dos meses, hemos pasado trabajo, esperando que solucionen pronto. Al regreso cruzamos la avenida y estaba un caballo comiendo hijas de jojoto, cave destacar que hay muchas plantaciones de maíz por esta vía, así que pare para fotografiarlo. Llegamos a casa y comenzó a llover, así que llegamos a tiempo, mi cuerpo cada día está en movimiento. Cada día me siento mejor y ya se ha vuelto un hábito. Hasta aquí, mis amigos aventureros de Actifit. >_**Photos of my property taken from the Redmi Note 12/// Text translated by DeepL**_

After drawing R367 Axel in previous days, I drew R358 Luke of rising star game in today. Luke is a producer in music industry. But he is new, so he doesn't have too much experience.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQTbGZwt3hX4Y8mH4oCGfe1PCSdn9KDthEavxxoRbCxVc/1777335748096.jpg)


[Image Source](https://www.risingstar.com)



R358 Luke is a rare people card of rising star game. It gives 125 fans, 150 skill, 2 luck and 5 im. 



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPgLpUnyo3ejX2VKfZLoN71iehRnZ6ppBo3ZyheKDf8at/1777335782653.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZTtEp3UvYntC1kMXtgqD42uLQ3XwEgxsBQ9jkHVsGC3/1777335782712.png)


To draw Luke, I drew chibi body sketch and changed it the body posture a little to draw like Luke's body posture. After getting the body posture I wanted, I drew his clothes and face. I tried to draw his face like in the picture. But, my picture look a little different.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbbBvqhnoShqzvdAUbNSTH2vL2LWF3jVNw7XMkzDo4HRu/1777335818974.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEGkFVA7mjuuNRA6bqUDzhjnfTuBYcnULw1guGTtnjCa/1777335819045.png)


After that, I continued to paint the background. At first, I used brown colour to paint the background. But after painting his skin colour which is similar with the background colour, I decided to changed the background brown colour to green colour. 




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcj3LjXvXmPpc41b53FwB4s3HU2uqs7AXz2qb5ZRgSCtu/1777335886924.png)



For his picture, I painted his shirt with black colour and his trouser with blue colour. I painted his beanie hat with grey and white colour. I painted his shoes with black colour. body.title: Guía Decoración - Review Channel [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
> ![guiaaa.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSrgkE2NMcay6tdbtVNJEMQP9QNwsjBR5hCUzCYnTPvZ2/guiaaa.jpg) Hay algo curioso en la plataforma de YouTube es que siempre vas a encontrar ese canal que buscas para que te solucione la vida, ya sea con una reseña, una comida, un podcast y más aún algo que se ha convertido en lo principal para la casa como lo es la decoración. Por eso encontré un canal de YouTube conocido como Guía Decoración, ese lugar al que entras cuando necesitas ideas rápidas, fáciles y sencillas, este es el indicado. El canal de YouTube apenas está creciendo, donde no hay una cara reconocible que te acompañe, y tampoco una intención clara de enseñarte paso a paso, simplemente el canal se caracteriza por contar miles de ideas como si fuera una lluvia de ideas. Donde cada video cuenta con ideas sobre cocinas modernas, baños elegantes, salas minimalistas o fachadas llamativas, que te sirven como inspiración para tu casa o para remodelar algún espacio. >One interesting thing about YouTube is that you’ll always find that channel you’re looking for to make your life easier—whether it’s a review, a recipe, a podcast, or even something that’s become a staple for the home, like interior design. That’s why I found a YouTube channel called Guía Decoración—it’s the place to go when you need quick, easy, and simple ideas; this is the one. # >The YouTube channel is just starting to grow; there’s no recognizable face to guide you, nor a clear intention to teach you step-by-step. Instead, the channel is characterized by sharing thousands of ideas, as if it were a brainstorming session. Each video features ideas for modern kitchens, elegant bathrooms, minimalist living rooms, or eye-catching facades, serving as inspiration for your home or for remodeling a space. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbDByLr3XNkFxCF9qGS93xqkR5ZHpJuo4RgR1ymkKsJWL/image.png) [Source](https://www.youtube.com/@GuiaDecoracion/videos)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

> Sus videos pueden llegar a pararse como Pinterest de soluciones, a diferencia del canal es que todo va mediante un video y puedes imaginarte cómo quedará, ya que las presentan en diferentes partes de la casa y todo está pensado para gustar rápido. Que seguramente al terminar los videos una de esas ideas que gustará y quedara en tu cabeza, por el mismo hecho de ser moderna y elegante, la cual permite que sea diferentes a los demás. Este tipo de contenido y tipo de formato, es demasiado bueno, ya que no tienes que pensar demasiado, no tienes que seguir una explicación compleja. Solo miras, anota, observas y guardas, y pasa lo mismo de siempre muchas ideas y a la final no se hace nada. Aun así el canal ofrece ese contenido ligero, fácil, inmediato y se adapta a todas las edades y funciona especialmente bien cuando no sabes por dónde empezar a decorar cualquier espacio. >Their videos can serve as a sort of Pinterest for design solutions. Unlike other channels, everything is presented through video, so you can easily visualize the final result—they showcase ideas in different parts of the house, and everything is designed to catch your eye instantly. By the time the videos end, one of those ideas is sure to stick with you, simply because it’s modern and elegant, setting it apart from the rest. # >This type of content and format is fantastic because you don’t have to think too hard or follow a complicated explanation. You just watch, take notes, observe, and save the ideas—and just like always, you end up with lots of ideas but don’t actually do anything. Even so, the channel offers light, easy, and immediate content that’s suitable for all ages and works especially well when you don’t know where to start decorating any space. https://youtu.be/aZB2ZPxGkeQ [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aZB2ZPxGkeQ)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

> Llegará un punto que después de ver varios videos, todo empieza a mezclarse, es decir, estilos se repiten y lo único que cambia es la manera como lo narran y quizás eso puede llegar a ser un punto débil, puesto que a medida que avanzan los años las decoraciones cambian y siempre habrá algo nuevo que hacer. Al final este canal de Guía Decoración es exactamente lo que parece, no hay más allá y es ese lugar para inspirarte, no para aprender. Siendo un canal que funciona cuando necesitas algo preciso de ideas rápidas. Además, recuerda que no te va a enseñar a decorar tu casa, pero probablemente te dé una que otra idea para empezar a decorar. >There will come a point when, after watching several videos, everything starts to blend together—that is, styles repeat themselves, and the only thing that changes is the way they’re presented. And perhaps that can become a weakness, since as the years go by, decor trends change, and there will always be something new to try. # >Ultimately, this Guía Decoración channel is exactly what it seems—nothing more—and it’s a place to find inspiration, not to learn. It’s a channel that works when you need quick, specific ideas. Also, remember that it won’t teach you how to decorate your home, but it will probably give you a few ideas to get you started. https://youtu.be/x39S3HlIgJM [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x39S3HlIgJM)
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: A Year Ago in Muswell Hill
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPQSDWiTd2i2fkrPEou43YTvGqvahEJFv6xQCHppbeQYr/emmaedgerononscreen.jpg)

*Emma, Edgeworth, and Ron after out first Farangers podcast.*

Last April I visited Muswell Hill, UK to work with @jompiy, Emma Pugmire, Charles Thomson, and Don Guy. Painting, pastels, music, recording, videography, photography, performance, free art in Camden, all packed into 10 incredibly productive days. Came back with original energy, and spent the rest of spring and summer putting together a [documentary](https://ecency.com/hive-186308/@ronthroop/ecency-film-festival) all about saving Stuckism and so much more.  
This evening I am clearing up space on an SSD, and grabbed a few photos to show.

 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUsPGuyghzzYpqUZDeJGKm9w2fou2fALv4WdMamh3N5H9/womananddogblue2.jpg)

*The Oswego Boondocks Free Art Man had his day in the sun at Camden.*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmat9jE5cspVaftWcMgbSw2bjSCcXzrz3w9rate8roZX3g/emmaaonedgewortgaetstore2.jpg)

*Off to the store with Emma, Aon and Edgeworth for canvas.*

So we could do this:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hmOe_7s1LUA

and this:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcyzvFfk742UUSLDBLCzYUrdusB4Yak4aKGZEuu7K7rqR/ronedgejonron.jpg)

And these (all oil and various sizes):

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPU1cftnpFsgS6c9zDJo6k3kp6BWYfv4H81dN5KwmUKi/20250420_111327.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXRn2f8oCNS5zCHmTTiLosrkGSDD95zHkg8v8Mf8xchjD/20250420_111332.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZSPGBHshQcXmdk3sC58NejKeiLZCzi1ALQf1iW3z5XaD/20250420_111228.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW5uUGBgRHfhU2thP4PbSLtPx7ePPPtfG2P5k2yLvw39R/20250420_111300.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXn15EtqYQBCX9npojApXM5E8TV98XqTUxW72wwceRU3M/20250420_111256.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXr4kgouqqgKVdNFN2UuJ4E9f54TvhTiRrpUnEvHnEVHQ/20250420_111243.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefuMgKy9vjCfze5Y7E5xqutptM4HMDCxQco6wSR8qQTg/20250420_111237.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqUbd7cDAf4acGW7Rwtgg1W5V3HYewgkJSoRwRsFfUrb/20250420_111343.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8yFkPDHhf5ZN1bGktpCe3sAxgU52ujEECkSUjKUDXoG/20250420_111340.jpg)

I will be meeting up again with Black Ivory soon enough, whether that be in London or Thailand, or both. I’d like to make another movie. This one will be about [**Free Art Frees Art**](https://edgeworth.blog/2025/06/19/free-art-frees-art/) and focus on Edgeworth’s passion and commitment to it.

Lastly, preparing for performance with Edgeworths handmade masks and costumes:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWtpSDfr9PygZaE4NBa5trvNZYn7M3m2EiZjHLkSBwWPw/maskspreparation.jpg)

body.body:
Of course you see it all, in your head.   Every bit of the world you describe is consistent.  We see it all.  The descriptions are brilliant.  The idea of a synthetic species descended from humans and birds...amazing.

I feel though (the second time I read this) that it is a part of something larger.  It seems we've dropped in the middle of the story.

The great escape...was there a catastrophe on earth and humans had to leave?  The synthetic planet...because humans need resources? The synthetic creatures...because humans need workers? 

A lot of unanswered questions.  

However, the most intriguing is where you end.     

Kanan will soon be a suitor.  A suitor is synonymous with a hunter.  Then there is 

>Diahna, the exotic stranger,” he said. “Forbidden love.”

Kanan makes Irene uncomfortable with his piercing stare.  What does she really know about the mating habits of this species??

Is it just me, or are you leaving the story open for a rather dramatic development.

You are a great writer.  In this case, I did want to know more.  I'm a reader who likes answered questions :)

body.title: [Esp./Eng.]   La Sabia Ignorancia.   ||   Wise Ignorance.
body.body:
*** *** #
If you prefer the English version, click on the following link 👉 [**HERE**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
***

> Participar en la [iniciativa](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras) de los amigos de @talentos me ha hecho reflexionar sobre la delgada línea que separa la picardía de la malicia. Existe una diferencia abismal, casi ontológica, entre la mala acción de un adulto y la travesura de un niño. El adulto actúa con alevosía, conoce el alcance legal y moral de sus pasos y, por lo tanto, su falta carece de esa luz purificadora que es la inocencia. En cambio, cuando habitamos ese territorio sagrado de la infancia, operamos bajo una lógica distinta, la curiosidad era nuestro único motor y las consecuencias son conceptos abstractos que solo cobran vida cuando aparece el regaño de una madre o el llanto de un compañerito. Una travesura es, en esencia, un experimento científico sin método ni precaución, un salto al vacío donde el paracaídas es la bendita ignorancia del peligro.
# ***
De la ciencia del niño a la malicia del adulto
*** Eran los años sesenta, una década donde el asfalto de las calles todavía nos pertenecía y los patios eran laboratorios de lo imposible. Yo andaba por los nueve o diez años, una edad en la que uno se siente dueño de una sabiduría basada en la observación de los adultos, aunque esa sabiduría sea más bien un espejismo. Recuerdo una tarde calurosa en la que mis primas y yo decidimos que el porche de la casa sería una clínica de alta especialidad. Yo era el doctor principal, investido con una autoridad que me otorgaba el simple hecho de haber encontrado un gotero viejo y limpio. —Doctor, me duelen mucho los ojos —me dijo mi prima, metiéndose de lleno en su papel de paciente sufrida. Yo, con una seriedad profesional que hoy me resulta cómica, busqué algo para «sanarla». Vi un frasco de alcohol isopropílico sobre la repisa. En mi mente infantil, el alcohol lo curaba todo, como el famoso Merthiolate..., las raspaduras de las rodillas, el dolor de muela de los tíos y hasta el mal olor de los pies. Sin meditarlo, llené el gotero. —Cierre los ojitos, que esto es una medicina milagrosa —le advertí, je, je, je.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLbkrh8t8jTg5aaFzwrRVDXPuYz1b27o8nxFVW68ztGG/travesura1.png) [Gracias a la IA Qwen por ilustrar esta publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
Le puse un par de gotas en cada ojo. El resultado fue instantáneo. Aquello no fue una sanación, fue un incendio ocular. Mi prima pegó un grito que debió escucharse en la otra cuadra y salió disparada hacia el chorro de agua del lavandero, mientras yo me quedaba allí, con el gotero en la mano, parpadeando con la misma sorpresa que ella. No había maldad en ninguno de nosotros, solo una fe ciega en las propiedades del alcohol. Al ver sus ojos rojos como tomates, entre risas nerviosas y el susto de recibir un castigo, entendí que los médicos de verdad no usaban esas técnicas, aunque en ese momento mi única defensa fue: «¡Pero si el alcohol limpia todo, prima!». Poco tiempo después, la osadía subió de nivel. Mi hermano Jhonny, que siempre fue el más intrépido o quizás el más ingenuo de la manada, aceptó convertirse en el primer superhéroe volador de la familia. Lo convencimos de que, con una toalla roja amarrada al cuello y una cuerda de tender ropa bien sujeta, podría surcar los cielos desde la platabanda de la casa. El plan era sencillo: nosotros lo lanzaríamos al vacío y la cuerda, de alguna manera mágica que nunca cuestionamos, lo sostendría antes de tocar el suelo.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUB357NCzNvkLsXbXEHdPk46yaodJG5qJ4J1XiWjQ5swo/travesura2.png) [Gracias a la IA Qwen por ilustrar esta publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
—¿Estás listo, Superman? —le preguntamos, mientras le ajustaba el nudo de la cuerda por el cuello, sin entender qué estaba fabricando. Dios, que pena lo que hubiese sucedido... —¡Listo! ¡Hacia el infinito! —respondió él, emocionado, parado al borde del abismo de cemento. Ya lo teníamos casi en el aire, con los pies colgando, cuando el grito de mi madre rompió el hechizo. «¡¿Pero qué carrizo están haciendo pelaos?!». El susto fue tal que casi soltamos la cuerda de golpe. Mi mamá subió las escaleras como un rayo y nos dio un regaño de esos que quedan grabados en el ADN. Solo años después, al ver la escena como adulto, sentí el frío en la espalda al comprender que lo que para nosotros era una aventura épica, para ella era una tragedia en potencia. La inocencia nos impedía ver la gravedad, literalmente. Ya más joven, en el liceo, la aún travesura se transformó en una forma de justicia. Estudiaba segundo año y me había ganado la fama de ser bueno en matemáticas. Mis compañeros, en un despliegue de pereza colectiva, organizaron una cadena de copia para el examen final. «Lo que haga el flaco con lentes, lo repetimos todos», fue la consigna. Me di cuenta de que me estaban usando, así que decidí darles una lección que no olvidaran.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSevcqgCrQ1XyWhtLbF4Div8Z2HWAYUFXNgFPKGY3f9bh/travesura3.png) [Gracias a la IA Qwen por ilustrar esta publicación.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
Durante la prueba, con una calma absoluta, llené mi hoja con los resultados más disparatados que se me ocurrieron. Si la respuesta era 25, yo ponía -1.000. Los vi a todos sudar, copiando mis errores religiosamente. Al final, todos salimos raspados. La profesora, que sabía que yo era un alumno brillante, me llamó aparte días después. —Dime la verdad, ¿qué te pasó ese día? ¿Te quedaste en blanco? —me preguntó, tratando de no sonar severa. Le conté la verdad: la travesura del saboteo colectivo. Ella no pudo contenerse y soltó una carcajada que resonó en todo el pasillo. —Bueno, por lo menos aprendieron que copiar no siempre es un negocio seguro —dijo ella, todavía riendo, y decidió repetirnos la prueba, esta vez con cada quien en un pupitre separado. *Esa es la belleza de las travesuras, son retazos de vida donde el error se convierte en anécdota porque nace de un corazón que todavía no sabe lo que es el dolo (maldad). Hoy, al mirar hacia atrás, entiendo que esas «maldades» sin malicia son las que nos humanizan y nos permiten recordar que, alguna vez, el mundo fue un lugar donde todo era posible, incluso volar con una cuerda al cuello o curar los ojos con alcohol.*
*** *** #
**[𝗘𝗻𝗰𝘂𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼 𝗱𝗲 𝗧𝗮𝗹𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗼𝘀: «Travesuras»](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras)**

## Dedicado a todos aquellos escribas que contribuyen, día a día, a hacer de nuestro planeta, un mundo mejor.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdWiJfhRxoQFbzdHDtvM9Ad3FQAAJg4UBPrFna6YP2mMf/512espa_ol8.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbdpsZFqtrcoLk94sUV8oHkjnx8PAdgfACMfJ9UpcriNF/perfil2026_hecho_con_clipchamp_2_.gif)

*** *** ***
# ***
***

> Taking part in the [initiative](https://peakd.com/hive-147177/@talentos/encuentro-de-talentos-travesuras) organised by our friends at @talentos has made me reflect on the fine line between mischief and malice. There is a vast, almost ontological difference between an adult’s wrongdoing and a child’s mischief. The adult acts with malice aforethought, is aware of the legal and moral implications of their actions and, therefore, their transgression lacks that purifying light which is innocence. In contrast, when we inhabit that sacred territory of childhood, we operate under a different logic; curiosity was our sole driving force, and consequences are abstract concepts that only come to life when a mother’s scolding or a playmate’s tears appear. A prank is, in essence, a scientific experiment without method or precaution, a leap into the void where the parachute is the blessed ignorance of danger.
# ***
From a child’s curiosity to an adult’s mischief
*** It was the 1960s, a decade when the tarmac of the streets still belonged to us and the backyards were laboratories of the impossible. I was about nine or ten years old, an age when one feels in possession of a wisdom based on observing adults, even if that wisdom is really more of a mirage. I remember a hot afternoon when my cousins and I decided that the porch of the house would be a specialist clinic. I was the head doctor, invested with an authority conferred on me simply by the fact that I had found an old, clean dropper. ‘Doctor, my eyes hurt so much,’ my cousin said to me, throwing herself wholeheartedly into her role as a suffering patient. I, with a professional seriousness that strikes me as comical today, looked for something to ‘cure’ her. I spotted a bottle of isopropyl alcohol on the shelf. In my childish mind, alcohol cured everything, just like the famous Merthiolate... scraped knees, my uncles’ toothache and even smelly feet. Without a second thought, I filled the dropper. “Close your eyes, this is a miracle cure,” I warned her, heh, heh, heh.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQLbkrh8t8jTg5aaFzwrRVDXPuYz1b27o8nxFVW68ztGG/travesura1.png) [Thanks to Qwen AI for illustrating this post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
I put a couple of drops in each eye. The result was instant. It wasn’t a cure, it was an eye fire. My cousin let out a scream that must have been heard a block away and dashed towards the tap, whilst I stood there, dropper in hand, blinking in just as much surprise as she was. There was no malice in me, just blind faith in the properties of alcohol. Seeing her eyes red as tomatoes, between nervous laughter and the fear of being punished, I realised that real doctors didn’t use such techniques, though at that moment my only defence was: ‘But alcohol cleans everything, cousin!’ Before long, our daring took it to the next level. My brother Jhonny, who was always the most intrepid—or perhaps the most naive—of the bunch, agreed to become the family’s first flying superhero. We convinced him that, with a red towel tied around his neck and a clothesline securely fastened, he could soar through the skies from the house’s parapet. The plan was simple: we would launch him into the void and the line, by some magical means we never questioned, would catch him before he hit the ground.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUB357NCzNvkLsXbXEHdPk46yaodJG5qJ4J1XiWjQ5swo/travesura2.png) [Thanks to Qwen AI for illustrating this post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
“Are you ready, Superman?” we asked him, as he adjusted the knot of the rope around his neck, without realising what he was getting himself into. God, what a shame if something had happened... “Ready! To infinity!” he replied, excitedly, standing on the edge of the concrete abyss. We were almost up in the air, dangling our feet, when my mum’s shout broke the spell. “What on earth are you lot up to?!” We were so startled we nearly let go of the rope all at once. Mum came storming up the stairs and gave us the sort of telling-off that stays etched in your memory forever. It was only years later, looking back on the scene as an adult, that I felt a chill down my spine as I realised that what was an epic adventure for us was, for her, a potential tragedy. Our innocence literally prevented us from seeing the gravity of the situation. Later on, in secondary school, that same mischief turned into a form of justice. I was in Year 10 and had earned a reputation for being good at maths. My classmates, in a display of collective laziness, organised a chain of cheating for the final exam. ‘Whatever the skinny lad with glasses does, we’ll all copy,’ was the motto. I realised they were using me, so I decided to teach them a lesson they wouldn’t forget.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSevcqgCrQ1XyWhtLbF4Div8Z2HWAYUFXNgFPKGY3f9bh/travesura3.png) [Thanks to Qwen AI for illustrating this post.](https://chat.qwen.ai/)
During the exam, with absolute calm, I filled my paper with the most absurd answers I could think of. If the answer was 25, I’d write -1,000. I watched them all break out in a sweat, copying my mistakes to the letter. In the end, we all just scraped through. The teacher, who knew I was a brilliant student, took me aside a few days later. ‘Tell me the truth, what happened to you that day? Did your mind go blank?’ she asked, trying not to sound too stern. I told her the truth: the prank of collective sabotage. She couldn’t contain herself and burst out laughing, her laughter echoing down the corridor. “Well, at least you’ve learnt that cheating isn’t always a safe bet,” she said, still laughing, and decided to set the test again, this time with each of us at a separate desk. *That is the beauty of mischief: they are snippets of life where a mistake becomes an anecdote because it springs from a heart that has not yet known malice. Today, looking back, I realise that those ‘misdeeds’ without malice are what make us human and remind us that, once upon a time, the world was a place where anything was possible, including flying with a rope around your neck or treating sore eyes with alcohol.*
*** *** #

body.title: Piolín Amigurumi
body.body:
> Saludos querida comunidad, feliz #needleworkmonday 😊, les cuento que me encargaron un amigurumi para llavero de un persona muy clásico , se trata del adorable Piolín, yo estaba encantada de hacerlo porque a pesar de ser un personaje tan popular y que no pasa de moda, nunca lo había hecho antes, así que decidí poner todo mi amor y cariño en este amigurumi sabiendo que hacerlo de un tamaño tan reducido implicaba una gran dificultad a la hora de cuadrar las proporciones, pero estoy feliz de haber cumplido el reto. > Greetings dear community, happy #needleworkmonday 😊, I wanted to tell you that I was commissioned to make an amigurumi keychain of a very classic character, it's the adorable Tweety Bird. I was thrilled to make it because despite being such a popular and timeless character, I had never made one before, so I decided to put all my love and care into this amigurumi knowing that making it so small would be very difficult when it came to getting the proportions right, but I'm happy to have met the challenge.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/Eptds1zCKBoX1KWxfe4VnTbz4G2QCqHD48hhVGArS3VPXMA95zr3gWtUu3FFvZRduaE.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png

Proceso / Process

Trabajé con hilo acrílico y ganchillo de 1.25mm, comencé haciendo las patas que son bastante grandes en comparación al cuerpo, con hilo naranja hice 6 puntos bajos en un anillo, 2 hileras de aumentos para llegar a 18, luego intercalé 2 hileras sin aumentos por una hilera de 3 aumentos hasta llegar a obtener solo 6 puntadas, rellené y cerré con al aguja lanera, luego levante 6 puntos bajos en hice 3 hileras, cambié a hilo amarillo para continuar la pierna haciendo 3 aumentos por 2 hileras hasta obtener 12. Hice los brazos aparte solo con 6 puntos bajos en una nillo y 5 hileras. Uní las piernas para formar el cuerpo e hice una hilera de 6 aumentos para obtener 30 puntadas y continué por 8 hileras, luego agregué los brazos y fui disminuyendo hasta obtener 12 puntadas para el cuello. > I worked with acrylic yarn and a 1.25mm crochet hook. I started by making the legs, which are quite large compared to the body. With orange yarn, I made 6 single crochet stitches in a ring, then 2 rows of increases to reach 18 stitches. Next, I alternated 2 rows without increases with a row of 3 increases until I had only 6 stitches. I stuffed it and closed it with a tapestry needle. Then I made 6 single crochet stitches and worked 3 rows. I changed to yellow yarn to continue the leg, making 3 increases for 2 rows until I had 12 stitches. > > I made the arms separately with just 6 single crochet stitches in a ring and 5 rows. I joined the legs to form the body and made a row of 6 increases to get 30 stitches and continued for 8 rows. Then I added the arms and decreased until I had 12 stitches for the neck.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/irenenavarroart/AK56rF4ouNRg7ePdMFnxrTPJqJyf9JtdckD2pdXaXABe8e2pEHfGNzzV2j5F6aN.jpg https://i.imgur.com/iJNYddI.png
Desde el cuello continúe con los aumentos para la cabeza, también hice unas disminuciones a la altura de las mejillas, luego continúe con aumentos porque piolín tiene una cabeza en forma de bombillo, la parte más difícil fue hacer los cambios de color para el área blanca de los ojos pues debían quedar en el lugar preciso para poder colocar los ojos de plástico, para finalizar bordé los detalles de los ojos, las cejas y el piquito, la cola la hice con un punto puff y con un punto picot en el centro. Me encantó hacer este amigurumi porque no tuve que hacer ninguna costura, pero sobre todo porque la cliente quedó fascinada con el resultado😊 > Starting at the neck, I continued increasing stitches for the head. I also made some decreases at the cheeks, then continued increasing because Tweety Bird has a lightbulb-shaped head. The most difficult part was changing the colors for the white area of the eyes, as they had to be in the precise position to insert the googly eyes. To finish, I embroidered the details of the eyes, eyebrows, and beak. I made the tail with a puff stitch and a picot stitch in the center. I loved making this amigurumi because I didn't have to do any sewing, but above all, because the client was thrilled with the result! 😊

This day, I was at my aunt’s house. Looking through the window, I could only see a few meters ahead because the fog was so dense. To my surprise, it had covered the entire field in front of the house, a rather rare and fascinating phenomenon. 

My aunt has been living in this apartment for a year, and despite my frequent visits, this is the first time I have witnessed such a sight. The landscape seemed almost unreal, as if wrapped in a mysterious veil.

 The moment stayed with me because of its strange calmness and the unusual beauty of the scene.

body.title: Not every thought deserves our attention...
body.body:
>

90% of what goes through our head, is our brain in predictive mode, wanting to control and predict the future, puts us on alert, fear mode, stress and cortisol to a million, overflowing anxiety without solving anything, now, or later, resulting in sleeplessness, useless anxiety because it did not happen what our thoughts suggested, especially the intrusive ones. Being in control of what we think is the first step to living with quality. It's okay to be quiet at home and isolate myself from time to time, doing nothing, not pushing myself to anything, slowing down life, resting and stopping going around as if the world was going to end tomorrow. I share these super functional exercises and with immediate positive results, when fear enters me, fear, and the cortisol discharge almost leaves me speechless or without articulating words: I usually breathe with the longest expiration consciously for two minutes getting my heart to lower its pulsations, which makes my brain interpret it as that I am not afraid, that I am resting, and that there is no need to run away. If you can't sleep because intrusive and distorted thoughts haunt me, I mentally choose a word and start conjuring up words with the first letter in my memory, if you run out, you go with the second letter, you're not going to get to the last letter. When you're already asleep.And after these exercises I feel that I am as the Japanese say, *every day a little better than yesterday*. Thoughts when they are over-thought, distorted with the interpretations that our mind makes, not facts, which are often tinged with fear, beliefs or past experiences, we have to learn to observe them, without getting hooked, this is also a way of taking care of ourselves, because the anxiety that these distorted thoughts generate for us, are often not noticeable on the outside, but inside they consume us. Today you don't have to believe everything that goes through your mind... you can choose what to let in and what to let go. There is no need to run away... When the everyday ceases to be special, we need to recover the power to notice, to be grateful, to enjoy that which is wonderful and that we have there, learning to notice is a faculty with which we are born and that we are losing, but it can be recovered when we become aware of it️️. Time passes and as an adult that becomes a way of living that you don't even feel “weird” because it's already yours, always demonstrating, always producing, always justifying the space you occupy as if at some point someone was going to give you the definitive permission to just be, a pod that ends up being a total self-punishment. Receive a big hug full of Caribbean sun 🇻🇪 Janitze.🌷

body.title: 努力考零分
body.body:
小明拿著成績表，上面老師圈著只拿到43分的【歷史與哲學】科目，一臉沒力氣的跟爸爸說，

“爸我不想再修歷史與哲學了，這科目又悶，畢業後也沒有用到。反正學分夠就可以通過高考了”

爸爸沒說啥，只是輕輕的接過成績表，將近視眼鏡摘下來再看清楚一下，然後戴回眼睛，在成績表上家長簽名那一欄簽了一個，再輕輕的遞給小明說，

“可以的。不過有個條件，就是你得先拿零分。題目中的每一道選擇題都必須作答。問答題也必須寫上最低字數要求。”

小明這下可樂了

“哈！這可容易辦了！下個期考你就準備吃我給你準備的大雞蛋，以後我就不必再看歷史與哲學的臉色了！爸爸你可要遵守你的承諾哈！”

學期考試後，爸爸問小明雞蛋在哪裡？小明心不甘情不願的拿出考卷給爸爸看。爸爸看了一下，37分……

“不錯，有進步。你離零分雞蛋越來越近了” ，爸爸用挑釁的語氣說到。

小明很是不服氣，帶著考卷回房裡，拿出書本把答案一一找出來，才發現原來選擇題裡面的四個答案，竟然有三個很像錯的，但是又對了一半的答案。看來，單靠運氣隨便圈，是不可能拿零分了。下次還需要讀清楚，避開所有可能“對”的組合，再將全部錯的元素加起來，就可以得到最錯的可能了。

兩個星期後，班上的月考來了。小明這次小心的避開所有可能對的答案，細心選擇了他認為最錯的答案。小明這次等派考卷的時候滿面春風，老師派考卷時竟然增了一句……看得出你有努力，加油小明。小明看了考卷，這次竟然考了45分！天哪！竟然比那次43分還高了兩分。

幸好爸爸不知道月考，也不需要家長簽名。小明再一次小心的將每一個有可能“對”的元素找出來。因為，四個答案之中，每一個答案都有對的可能性，但是這四個答案之中，有三個是有可能錯的成份。

三個月下來，小明已經收集全部月考，連上半年還沒跟爸爸打賭拿零分的考卷也整理好了，將所有可能錯誤的元素都背了起來。期考到來，小明信心滿滿的將每一道題目都讀清楚了，再用排除法將有可能“對”的元素全部排除後，找到最不可能對的答案才圈起來。問答題也需要小心。哲學嘛，就算是寫幾個字都有可能不小心拿到分，所以還是需要一百萬個小心避開。

“爸！我終於成功拿到零分了！”

爸爸再一次慈祥的摘下眼鏡，細心看了一下成績表……這一次那個零沒有被圈起來。老師用的紅色鋼筆看得出圈得很大力，而且是很不耐煩的在同一個位置上“零”了好幾回。下面還備註著：叫家長來見我

“恭喜你小明。你已經成功拿到零分了。現在剩下的，就是你可以把歷史與哲學的全部資料扔了，書本藏起來等學期完了再還給學校……或，下次用同樣的方法把對的答案找出來。”，爸爸面帶微笑的說到

---

本故事純憑記憶和想像捏造，如有雷同純屬扯淡。幾十年前老拉叔教導我的時候有說過這麼一段故事，生活中的每一天就像是考卷裡的每一道難題，要用排除法來找出對的答案。但是問題在於，不是每個對的答案都是正確的，所以必須要找出所有可能會錯的答案才能避免踩雷。生活就是一場考試，你不能跳過任何一道考題，都必須作答。你有本事錯到零分，那只證明了一件事，就是你已經知道正確的路要怎麼走。

body.body:
/>

Capt. R.E. Ludlow woke up troubled in the mind, hearing in his head something his niece Garlene had told him over and over again: “If you weren't living in Tinyville, we'd be telling you it was time for you to come our way.”

In other words, glancing blows from two hurricanes and five tornadoes in the latter one had exposed what had been slowly coming out: infrastructure-wise, Lofton County was not safe, not a good place to raise a young family, unless one was living in parts that had embraced wisdom. Tinyville, VA, Big Loft, VA, and the Veteran's Lodge were in excellent condition still, with cleanup commensurate to the weather events at hand. The tornadoes had also missed them entirely – grace, of course, a grace given to most of the county's inhabited areas.

But with great discomfort Capt. Ludlow realized he had returned to Lofton County still thinking it was the region his father and uncle had built up – but Edwin Sr., Edwin Jr., and Edgar Ludlow had all been gone for decades, and their children had moved the company out of Lofton County in disgust. The following generation, hating the honor paid to the Ludlows of the past, had discarded not only their architectural methods, but their deep understanding of the weather, climate, geography, geology, and topography of Lofton County upon which they situated their designs. Edwin had known that occasionally tornadoes visited the county, and his buildings had basements that could double as shelters. Those shelters had saved many, many lives during Hurricane Mneme's tornado spawn. But none of the buildings built after 1990 had this design feature.

In like manner, entire beautiful developments had been built up as gated exclusive communities with foundations worthy of a trailer park, or using 90-foot pylons where 200-foot pylons were needed to get to bedrock. Edwin Ludlow had warned about the second case, for Bayard Heights had been proposed as early as 1952. But it did not matter. _All of them had been taken off the map between Hurricanes Justicia and Mneme_... justice and memory …

“Good morning, Papa!” five-year-old Robert Edward Ludlow III, aka Lil' Robert, said as he stumbled out of his room and interrupted his grandfather's dark thoughts.

Capt. Ludlow looked down at the youngest great-grandchild of Edwin Ludlow Sr., and then reached down and smoothed the blond ringlets from being all over on one side of the child's head.

“Good morning, Robert,” he purred gently, and picked his grandson up. “Right on time for our coffee.”

“Yep – my favorite thing!” Lil' Robert said. “I love you more than I love coffee, though!”

“I love you more than I love coffee, too,” Capt. Ludlow purred and then kissed his grandson, got the coffee, put three drops in his grandson's warm milk, and then put three drops of milk in his coffee. This was their little ritual in the morning, coffee and a chat, before of course Lil' Robert went right back to sleep and usually got tucked back in – but on this day, Capt. Ludlow put him in his car seat, left a note for Mrs. Ludlow, and hit the road for an hour's drive around Tinyville. He wanted to get his first impression of the state of the county after Mneme for himself. He had driven his niece and nephew around and they had seen plenty, but he had largely kept his eyes on the messed-up roads and so had missed a lot of details.

What Capt. Ludlow saw, stopping and looking for himself, staggered him. It was too early for the repair crews to be out looking busy. It was too late to hide, from a man whose father was an architect and engineer, the obvious failure modes of so many structures. There was a lot to see. There was a whole lot to see.

By contrast, Tinyville's fields were still wet, but anyone driving by could see they had been used well as series of catchments graded to flow down into the local creeks and therefore minimize flooding. Piles of sandbags and heavy tarp dropped off at the appropriate return places testified that the town had taken the appropriate measures to make sure people could protect their homes and other structures. The cleanup was coming right along and was almost finished.

Lil' Robert woke up never knowing he had even left his favorite place: his grandfather's strong arms.

“Papa!” he said as his grandfather carried him into the house, and kissed his grandfather's bearded chin.

And the baby boy was asleep again as his grandfather laid him down on the sofa and then knelt down, trembling.

“My Father in Heaven, I thank You!” the captain said. “I did not know the Veteran's Lodge and Tinyville would be two of only three safe places in Lofton County – I could not have kept my family safe on my own! I thank You for leading me!”

Lil' Robert kept on snoozing with a smile, knowing he was perfectly safe.

body.title: I won Hourly Bullet Arena
body.body:
![Screenshot_20260428-003146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23swgX7mMWqLvvL7Z93PKercrQqp4wCRa7NUcvPge5jMMStXpZcQwx6Tnoot213BLfV2k.jpg)

Feeling nostalgic for missing all the chess tournament last weekend due to my failure to set a reminder when I got more work to do, I decided it would not be a bad idea if I play some bullet, but this time, a bullet tournament. So I played the hourly bullet arena.

I'm 2300 rated in bullet so I was surprised to be among the top 10 players on the starting ranking. 
![Screenshot_20260427-235948.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23t76tG4U4CgHeLUkaJWKxewMUXUxgXTFqwbQLqrqX8B7KoENjouzjJawpDWrywfVuQbh.jpg)

At first I got a slow start against a 250 rated player. I did not play well as I became too passive in the game which got me to waste more time thinking on what my next move will be and that is a rookie mistake when playing bullet. 

![Screenshot_20260428-004242.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23y96qUsQiJFKyxhWCxMZ4FhwNcup7zgrgn4ZF7sZBzdscooWVNG8yLTvN1UEPaT8K93G.jpg)

My position was getting worse as my opponent was launching an attack on my kingside while I was busy eating pawns. That was bad of me and I knew it but I felt if I will retreat with my pieces, it will be difficult for me to find the best defending moves in the game and it is bullet. 

Being a strong player, it was no surprise that my opponent for the attack on my king by opening up the files around the king and launching an attack. 


![Screenshot_20260428-005148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23wMqCqc86AszQcvonWmQQgtUbGqKUBptvRRA2GwwPS1St8RP7RVkT1AsUW6K8dqQECg9.jpg)

This game is a product of a poor sac I made just to gain some initiative in the game. Earlier on, I sense that I was losing so instead of going down without a fight, I decided to sac and this allowed my opponent to blunder. Quickly, after bringing the white queen for exchange, I wasted no time to find the rook check as that is the only move that wins on the spot. Bullet is funny because it is very fast and the moment you make a blunder, just keep playing like nothing happened, you could actually win on time or better your opponent returns the favour by blundering as well.

After my first two losses, it was a streak for me down to the last game. Finishing on 38 points and a rating performance of 2450. It is impressive for me and I sure do have so spectacular bullet techniques.
 
![Screenshot_20260428-005958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/southgamer/23swgX7mNbZpt4K4BkwdAUhvPKWEzDS3Uz7ysdeiA6amxrHBeyBqzWa7UnE8TFAeTLpGw.jpg)

I would be lie if I say I am not excited by this. Chess is exciting when you are winning. Our of 195 players and I could win the arena. Bullet is fun, a nice way to pass time, if you do not want to do  deep thinking, just fun play.

body.title: Day 47 : Where do you get your protein?
body.body:
#
Combatting high food prices

Today I went to the grocery store because my sons wanted protein bars and they wanted me to make some sandwiches for their lunches for the upcoming weeks. $82 on what was supposed to be two or three items but as often happens a few more items got added to the list. One thing did strike me as I was shopping today and that was most of the items on the list were proteins. Meat, Yogurt, and cheese were all on the list in addition to the protein bars. Of course the prices of individual items were all over the place with the cheapest being $1.99 for a protein bar to $25 for a four pack of garlic coil sausage. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23uQtN7zsevsiP5tc2iL59iJfmPLB16dDZnATXvM1a1g8mPjVJYXfj7jLFBPtq3FcpWaG.png) Image: A bunch of items I bought today and a few I added for price comparison later. Then I thought about how I purchased things and there were four different cost cutting measures that I utilized and thought ***Hmm... maybe I could write an article on that***. Maybe I'll make it required reading for my sons **\

**. Although to be honest? The protein powder didn't do too badly and even the protein bars weren't awful if you use a sneaky trick or two to get the best price. More on that later :)

#
Four different strategies

The first strategy is to do the obvious thing: * Buy items that are on sale But the other things I did? * Price comparison. Sometimes the sale isn't the best deal. * Price matching. Some stores will match other stores sales * Find less expensive alternatives.
### Sale items Today's example: Protein bars Now last week I bought some **\

** Protein bars for $11.99 for a six pack.  Today?  Regular price: $16.99.  Ugh.  I hate paying full price.  I looked at individual bars and at $3 ea or more they were even more expensive.  I checked out all the other brands and everything was the same price or more.

However, I know they go on sale regularly.  I just asked myself.  Did the kids really need it today?  Nope.  They have regular protein powder so they aren't going to have to do without.  Skip the protein bars for today.  

### Price comparison.

Everyone knows a sale when they see one.  The grocery store is no different but here is a tip.  Don't just grab the no-name brand that's on sale in the largest size and expect to get the best deal.  **Do the math** sometimes the best deal is a small package of a brand name.

Today's example:  **Cheese**

* 2kg (4lbs) Cheddar:  Generic Brand -- $27.99
* 700g (1.5lb) Cheddar:  Generic Brand -- $8.49 (sale)
* 400g (.9lb) Cheddar:  Armstrong Brand -- $ 4.44 (sale)

Which is the better deal?  If you don't do the math it is a little hard to decide.  Nothing divides nicely and who wants to break out a cellphone to do the math when there are more groceries to get.  However, notice the 400 = $4.44 that is a multiplier of 1.1 (or $1.10 per 100g)

If I were to pay that much for 700g? $7.77 so $8.49 is a bad deal.
If I were to pay that much for 2000g? $22.20 so $27.99 is a bad deal.

**I bought 3 x 400g packages and smiled**

<hr>
<hr>

### Price Matching 

Then I did a little more thinking about the kids protein bars.  I really hate paying full price **but** I know that the store I was at will match competitor sale prices.  I looked in the app **\

** and found that there was a different store that had single protein bars on sale for $1.99 and they had even more protein than the bars my sons usually eat. 6 bars at $1.99 is $11.94, even cheaper than the brand they usually get. Plus more protein per bar--A win for me.
#
Less expensive alternatives.

Sometimes it is better to just switch to a different protein source. Look for an alternative item that will work just as well. I looked at a premium cut of beef today... I want to say beef tenderloin but I'll admit I looked more at the price tag than the type of meat. $92/kg for the beef. I shook my head in disbelief. Not something I'm going to buy when I know that I can get a T-Bone on sale for $10.88/lb. Or I can get lean ground beef on sale for $9.99/lb. Cut that ground beef with some egg and breadcrumbs and you have a very tasty meat loaf of hamburger. Then again... I could cut that beef with beans and have a very tasty chilli! Or with enough spice I could use ground chicken which is only $2.50/lb. **There are options if you look** Of course figuring out which options are more expensive and which are less expensive makes a difference. For example my mom swears by Quinoa as a good protein source which is plant based. I will agree it is an excellent protein source but it is not nearly as inexpensive as my mom thinks it is. But how do you compare. Just a few days my son asked me if his big container (2kg) of muscle gainer whey protein was a good deal. Honestly it is hard to figure out. But I showed him how to calculate the price per 100G and at his current weight that's the target he should be aiming for (roughly). Goal: 1.0 to 1.2g of protein per kg of bodyweight. At 90kg getting 100g of protein is about right every day (in addition to other vitamins minerals, and nutrients.
# How about a list to prove it? Now there is way more to a food budget than just protein. Protein does tend to be considerably more expensive than carbs and fat though so the protein choice has an outsized effect on the grocery bill. I just grabbed some high protein items around the house and did some math to compare them. It came out much as I expected. | Rank | Protein Source | Cost / Package | Cost per 100g Protein | |------|----------------|----------------|------------------------| | 1 | Dried Soybeans | $0.32 / 100g | $0.89 | | 2 | Black Turtle Beans | $3.49 / 900g | $1.70 | | 3 | Lean Ground Chicken | $10 / 1.82kg | $3.05 | | 4 | 2% Milk | $5.65 / 4L | $3.92 | | 5 | Holiday Luncheon Meat | $2 / 340g | $4.62 | | 6 | Medium Cheddar Cheese | $4.77 / 400g | $5.11 | | 7 | Leanfit Whey Protein | $74 / 2kg | $5.40 | | 8 | Vanilla Greek Yogurt | $6 / 750g | $8.36 | | 9 | PC High Protein Bar | $1.99 / bar | $8.65 | | 10 | Garlic Sausage | $25 / 2kg | $10.42 | | 11 | Quinoa (white) | $1.50 / 100g | $10.71 | | 12 | T-Bone Steak (sale) | $10.88 / lb | $11.43 | | 13 | Smoked Chicken Slices | $3.75 / 175g | $12.85 | | 14 | Smoked Ham | $3.75 / 175g | $12.85 | | 15 | Roast Beef Slices | $3.75 / 175g | $13.09 | | 16 | Quest Protein Bars | $13.49 / 4 bars | $16.06 | | 17 | Beef Tenderloin | $90 / kg | $42.86 | ##### Takeaways? * Beans won the challenge I knew that vegetable sources of protein would be less expensive and soy beans led the way at only $0.89 for 100g of protein. Black beans were almost twice as expensive but they were still the second cheapest from the list. the amusing thing? Those aren't even sale prices. They are just so much cheaper than other sources. * Ground chicken surprised me. I didn't exactly expect lean ground chicken to come up where it did. 3rd place. I would have expected milk and dairy to dominate. I was wrong. Milk products, yogurt, whey protein took the middle ground. At this tier Holiday luncheon meat snuck in as it was on a deeply discounted sale. * Ready to eat and beef. No surprise that convenience food and beef came next. Beef prices have been making the news they are pretty bad. As for packaged convenience food? People have also been telling their children to learn to cook for a long time because packaged food is expensive. However, seeing Beef Tendrloin was just out of sight price wise. $90/kg means I'll save it for fancy dinners where someone else is doing the cooking.

#
Take home message?

A few little tricks can save money with little effort. There are less expensive alternatives out there with a little looking. Buying convenience foods or expensive cuts can break a budget very quickly. Learning to cook can absolutely save money with even a sale T-Bone steak being cheaper than plain sliced ham. But if the budget is really tight? Soy beans are a tiny fraction of the cost of meat and can fill a stomach while giving a complete protein. I may not always choose soy beans but I like to know I can choose them and save money any time I want. Why? Because I've learned how to cook with them when I didn't need to so I can turn to them if I do. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cinderclaw.gld/23vsZGcHLizvwWZHjUpcDhavLwKdjGwDD46BopfZ5wHPS2bWEtBgwuK2tK2nbkUBo2GCN.png) Image: Today's Soy Milk..just finished cooking. Brown bits are from the brown sugar I use to sweeten it Or maybe just switch up my chilli to have beans and chicken so its a fraction of the cost without sacrificing too much on taste. Just my quick take from going to the grocery store today.

body.title: Repairing a crack in the water tank / Reparando una fisura del tanque de agua
body.body:
> Hello, my friends at Hive and @home.solutions. I hope you’re all well and enjoyed the weekend. As for me, I spent it doing some DIY at home because the water supply started to come through and one of the tanks had been damaged. Here in Margarita, this is essential because the water supply is a major issue and in our area it can sometimes go up to two months without any water coming through, That’s why we have several tanks, and one of them—the one that supplies us upstairs—had had a small crack for some time. It had healed itself thanks to a corosillo bush that grew there and, miraculously, plugged it up for a while. But the last time the water came on, it started leaking again and was now emptying faster, so I had to sort that out to be able to fill it up.
ESPAÑOL

Hola mis amigos de Hive y @home.solutions, espero que estén bien y disfrutaran del fin de semana, por mi parte fue de trabajo en la casa porque comenzó a llegar el agua y uno de los tanques se había dañado y aquí en Margarita es necesario porque el problema del agua es fuerte y en nuestra zona a veces pasan hasta dos meses sin llegar, por eso tenemos varios tanques y uno de ellos, el que nos surte arriba a nosotros hace tiempo tenía una pequeña fisura que se resolvió sola por una mata de corosillo que creció ahí y de milagro la tapó por un tiempo, pero la última vez que vino el agua comenzó a filtrar de nuevo y ahora se vaciaba más rápido así que tenía que resolver eso para poder llenarlo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ9GUDgBgoTWKWoTEkmtxKqu41vZYecqR9vQ81XmXZtBm/1777335148792.png) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png I’d already looked online to see how to fix it, and Matías and I got stuck into it on Saturday. We disconnected everything so we could turn the tank over and repair it, but first I took the opportunity to give it a good wash, and then I cleaned the broken part of the tank thoroughly. then I used a hot nail to make some holes, then I took a thick cable, stripped it, and took a strand of wire, which I used to ‘sew’ the tank together, pressing hard to prevent it from staying open where it was broken. Then I took a soldering iron, removed the tip by loosening it with a screwdriver, and where the tip had been I fitted a flat-headed screw. I then plugged in the soldering iron and waited for it to heat up, and took a piece of a tank that had completely split some time ago. placed the plastic from the tank over the stitched section and, using the soldering iron, melted the plastic until the area was completely covered; I then ran the iron along the repair until I achieved a smooth surface. I also carried out this procedure on the inside of the tank to ensure everything was secure. Finally, I waited for it to cool down completely.
ESPAÑOL

Yo ya había buscado cómo repararlo por Internet y con Matías nos pusimos en eso el sábado y quitamos todas las conexiones para poder voltear el tanque y repararlo, pero antes aproveché para lavarlo bien y después limpié bien donde estaba roto el tanque, luego con un clavo caliente fuí realizando unos agujeros, luego tome un cable grueso, lo pelé y tomé un pelo de alambre y con este fuí cosiendo el tanque y apretando duro para evitar que quedara abierto dónde estaba roto. Luego tome un cautín, le retire la punta aflojandolo con un destornillador y dónde estaba la punta coloqué un tornillo con la cabeza plana, después enchufé el cautín y espere que se calentara y tomé un pedazo de un tanque que se había partido hace tiempo por completo, coloqué el plástico del tanque sobre la parte que estaba cosida y con el cautín fuí derritiendo el plástico hasta cubrir por completo la zona y luego lo fuí pasando a lo largo de la reparación hasta lograr una superficie lisa y este procedimiento lo hice también por dentro del tanque para asegurar que todo quedara bien. Ya por último espere que se enfriará bien.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbLD4s8mVJebqzAbra96CcLjrAYU7F8nN58TSjfMkCjNz/1777334430235.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmex7uUbDedW8Q5YGN5xruwKdiN5UFyPUvTZMWx6g16pDe/1777334430371.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQEwzwv7hGgE2zC8FJ1Upu5tWnAjQGxSgo64kNcLHUbm/1777334430475.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfC7ADKHUBt2KzyUmoESRn5D4PbVUycoJf2mNLNXoxoAf/1777334430569.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png Then we turned it over, put it back in place and started reconnecting everything, but unfortunately the water outlet broke. We managed to fix it temporarily with pipe sealant, but it needs replacing because it had already been repaired once before and actually lasted five years like that. but I’m going to wait until the tank empties to do that job and fill it up again. The good news is that the crack has been properly repaired and no water is leaking out, so I’m not worried on that front. Well, friends, that’s all for today. When I make the change to the installation, I’ll drop by to let you know. I hope you have a good week. Best wishes, and see you next time.
ESPAÑOL

Después lo volteamos y lo pusimos en su lugar y comenzamos a poner otra vez las conexiones, pero con la mala suerte que se rompió la pieza de salida del agua, pero resolvimos momentáneamente con pega para tubería pero hay que cambiarla porque ya ella estaba reparada y de hecho duró 5 años así, pero voy a esperar a que el tanque se vacíe para hacer ese trabajo y ponerlo a llenar otra vez, pero lo bueno es que la fisura quedó bien reparada y no se bota nada del agua así que por ese lado estoy tranquilo. Bueno amigos eso sería todo por hoy, cuando haga el cambio de la instalación paso para contarles. Espero que tengan una buena semana. Saludos y hasta otro momento.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeG17bskMivT7A7SoTwDR6sP6qYcWSNqEJXsAn38q97on/1777334430663.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfQ349Vs8iHxPy7ZTU3coi1fq7AxbgpsyNJ6EbqGfyLwP/1777334544496.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT14g4Cv3QdivGmyFrUdaTZaohs7D3Jpf8EkYPqgFTPW7/1777334544405.jpg) https://images.hive.blog/DQmTphUarKuYr5DZnpue1jqNXi6kg3s7koZrrYxYfaQvyGe/18.png
