body.title: Sacrosanct Shanker: Earth's Low Mana Tank!
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQEtrWcd2FZi8RAfQpg9RrmmrYu8R1yUsKoLU781GHs86/image.png)

Hello Splinterlands summoners and welcome by to my blog!

The Sacrosanct Shanker is a four mana tank in the Earth splinter from the core Conclave Arcana set. It's an ideal card to play as a tank in low mana battles and Little League ruleset. In today's post, we'll do a deep dive into this card. We'll check out her lore, stats & abilities and show a sample battle where she is used effectively. 

***
# Lore

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSd6cvWw7QBauw1DbVtR6Q6jvMS4HxuvXkEYHvurEEo7q/image.png)

Arila Maelanoril (Sacrosanct Shanker) is a priestess of Serathera, Goddess of the Wilderness and a deadly assassin. In Thanaloria’s courts she is feared as a killer while maintaining her devotion to her goddess. She protects Rathlorien Silverleaf’s family through both prayers and lethal force when necessary. 

Now, she joins Kaylia’s (Earth archon) army to stop Mahkah Hemlig from invading their forest in the Conclave Arcana’s pursuit of Praetoria’s secrets. 

***

# Stats and Abilities

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmatjFVrBxEyrGjLu9L5WLuH1vJ7vJyDh1g3bimdBG7EnE/image.png)

The Sacrosanct Shanker is a four mana, rare melee card. At maxed levels she deals three melee damage and has four speed. On defense, she has four armor and seven health. She an offensive ability, Cripple and a couple of abilities for sustainability. Rebirth allows her to self resurrect once in battle while Divine Shield enables her to ignore damage from first attack. Since she is an elf, she benefits from the Earth archon's Bloodline Dominion ability, Execute.

She is a good low mana tank especially at higher levels. Unfortunately for Silver level players, her attack is rather limited but her defensive stats is good enough for a low mana tank even at Silver League.

***

# Featured Battle

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTPT5HAcK2axYa5t9qJV3tBEV1GNtCEuQh47JSVgttKmg/image.png)

The battle had a mana cap limit of twenty three. Player Charok had the Earth splinter led by Kaylia Silverleaf archon. It's a low mana battle so he had a level four Sacrosanct Shanker at tank. In second position was another elf, legendary card Taye Loreswift. She increases melee attack with her Inspire ability and has the Reach ability to enable her to attack with melee from second position. In third was a one mana card, Halfling Refugee. In fourth was another elven melee card, Thanalorian Blade who deals two melee damage and had the Opportunity ability. In last position was another melee card, Buttercup Mauler.

His enemy chose Water led by legendary archon Loving the Moo. He had a low mana dual tank combo followed by magic damage dealers. He's at a disadvantage owing to his lower damage output compared to Charok's team. Charok also had the better synergy with an all melee team buffed by Taye Loreswift's Inspire. These advantages led to Charok winning this battle. 

[Replay the Battle](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_a32b9d42d4c52a051cb3441e0c5db254?ref=logen9f)

***

# Come Play Splinterlands!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfAX3xcPAwc8omveh7imyKtqbHntKgVLqLckGTCHSjPyw/image.png)

Start your Splinterlands adventure today with my [referral](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=logen9f). You can play the game for free in the Frontier Mode or take your game to the next level by purchasing a spellbook. body.title: Te regalo una estrella , ESP/ ENG
body.body:
Hoy, 27 de abril , se cumple 3 años desde que  lo vi por primera vez detras de un cristal en el hotel Melia Marina Varadero. En ese instante, supe que queria que estuviera a mi lado toda la vida , entonces como aniversario quise  regalarle algo que trascendiera lo material, algo que nadie mas podria darle.
En junio cumpliremos tres años juntos, y él es mi mayor tesoro: mi esposo, el padre de nuestro hijo, mi compañero de vida, mi amigo. y también mi malcriado favorito. En mis 25 años, es el hombre que mas me ha gustado, aquel cuya mirada siempre logra detener el tiempo.
Mientras muchos regalan bombones, flores o objetos que se desvanecen con el tiempo, yo quise regalarle algo eterno. Algo que, cada vez que mire el cielo, sepa que ahi estoy yo para él. Quise regalarle una estrella.
Él es Libra, nacido el 18 de octubre, y con la aplicacion Stellarium encontramos su constelacion. Alli, limitando la constelacion de Libra, descubri la estrella perfecta: Teta Librae. No tiene certificado oficial, pero para mi es la manera de decirle que nunca nadie mas le regalara una estrella como esta, solo yo.
Esta estrella es mas que un simple punto de luz en el cielo. Es un recordatorio de nuestro amor, de nuestra conexion, de que siempre estaré a su lado, aunque no pueda tocarla. Cada vez que él la mire, quiero que recuerde que hay alguien que lo ama profundamente, que lo eligio y lo seguira eligiendo cada dia de su vida.
No necesito un papel que la respalde; basta con que él sepa que esa estrella le pertenece en espiritu, como le pertenece mi corazon.- 
![IMG_20260109_211149_612.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/244KVGyXFECUDc9P2WaieZ1tM8m9x1fEccL2Vckkixvn2xkUx3ojCHQWxARa2jtfPRxqj.jpg)
Aquí también les dejo una pequeña descripción de qué es la estrella que le regalé a mi esposo
Theta Librae, también conocida como Θ Librae, es una estrella que forma parte de la constelacion de Libra, el \

. Libra no es de las 
![Screenshot_2026-04-26-13-06-41-32.jpg](2)constelaciones mas brillantes del cielo, pero tiene su encanto, especialmente cuando uno empieza a estudiar sus estrellas individuales como Theta Librae.![Screenshot_2026-04-25-21-32-55-90_c0112e866aafbdadcc5ff93fdb2d9e89.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23swkEzw95RXzMW4UYsYfQ38CE2cqt7PkUHBcMiipqsf8yPmANtSU1Q7ZJUeduK6CyiQj.jpg)

![Screenshot_2026-04-25-21-34-25-87_c0112e866aafbdadcc5ff93fdb2d9e89.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/diazktty/23t79QiyGsEvzJJmttPWGgSs4itj4JS7FW9D2jCRtnqEHySyfd7EoNENtn2duK9dkgyUY.jpg)
Today, April 27th, marks three years since I first saw him behind a glass at the Meliá Marina Varadero hotel. In that moment, I knew I wanted him by my side for the rest of my life. For our anniversary, I wanted to give him something that transcends the material, something no one else could ever give him.
In June, we will celebrate three years together. He is my greatest treasure: my husband, the father of our son, my life partner, my friend… and my favorite little troublemaker. At 25, he is the man I have loved the most, the one whose gaze can always make time stand still.
While many people give chocolates, flowers, or objects that fade with time, I wanted to give him something eternal. Something that, every time he looks at the sky, he knows I am there for him. I wanted to give him a star.
He is a Libra, born on October 18th, and using the Stellarium app, we found his constellation. There, on the edge of Libra, I discovered the perfect star: Theta Librae. It doesn’t have an official certificate, but for me, it’s my way of saying that no one else will ever give him a star like this—only me.
This star is more than just a point of light in the sky. It’s a reminder of our love, of our connection, that I will always be by his side, even if he can’t touch it. Every time he looks at it, I want him to remember that there is someone who loves him deeply, who chose him, and will keep choosing him every day of his life.
I don’t need a piece of paper to prove it; it’s enough that he knows this star belongs to him in spirit, just as my heart does.
 Theta Librae (Θ Librae) is one of the stars in the constellation of Libra, and although Libra is not as spectacular at first glance as Orion or Scorpius, each star has its own interest. Theta Librae, specifically, is classified as a yellow giant, which means it is in an advanced stage of its evolution: it has exhausted the hydrogen in its core and is now burning helium and other heavier elements.
Regarding its visibility, it is not one of the brightest stars, but it can be located with a small telescope or even binoculars from dark skies. It is relatively close, in astronomical terms, at about 130 light-years from Earth. Studying it is interesting because yellow giants like Theta Librae help us understand how medium-sized stars evolve and how they will eventually end their life cycles.

body.title: Opening My First Chaos Legion Pack in Splinterlands and Buying an Epic Card in Rising Star Game
body.body:
<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZL6jMaXJH9vbmfMK38FqVQRRqNeV54EnrFS6zVZnX3Ba/card.png</center>

## Splinterlands

I'll soon be starting to play in the Wild format and beginning another journey in Splinterlands. While I wait for the season to start, my focus is on the Frontier format, and I'll take advantage of this time by opening my first Chaos Legion pack.

I chose the Wild format because I want to have fun playing Splinterlands while making money, so I don't like the limit restriction that exists in the Modern format, but I will also play in the Modern format soon.

Unlike the Frontier Format, there are more leagues in the Wild Format, and my goal will be to reach the Champion League.

Now let's see the Chaos Legion in Splinterlands and what the value of this pack is in the game.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdBtN1kvJjfpgM1edRjrbjvbHx1ZggLbnmFYGt3dumqTN/d.png</center>

In Splinterlands, there is an option called Card Packs located in the SHOP. There are several packs in Splinterlands, and I chose the Chaos Legion because it is one of the cheapest options in the game, and for this reason, I believe it is a good option to start a card collection in the game.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUxDZDPCbdSRrqD6krEUAFGG9ygyfYGeWsieQRDdjiF8W/dd.png</center>

As I write this post, the Chaos Legion pack costs 479 Credits, which means it costs approximately $0.48.

I just want to try opening packs in Splinterlands, so I'm only going to buy one Chaos Legion pack. My real goal is to buy the cards on the market because I can choose the cards and not depend on luck, but opening packs is fun.

- To open packs, you need to go to the OPEN option in Splinterlands and select the pack you want to open.

There are potions in Splinterlands that increase your chances of getting valuable cards; these potions are the Alchemy Potion and the Legendary Potion.

Alchemy Potion: This potion increases the chances of getting Gold Foil cards.

Legendary Potion: This potion increases the chances of getting Legendary cards.

Opening the Packs

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXXHSpVE3iQyXqhsYSJUA7KyXXUwL3GGi6HjReHktSqSy/ddd.png</center>

These are the 5 cards I got opening the Chaos Legion pack, and I guess I wasn't lucky because none of these cards are valuable, and their total value doesn't even come close to what I paid for the pack, but it was fun opening the pack.

Now all that's left is to wait for a new season so I can start playing in the Wild format.

------
------

## Rising Star Game

In Rising Star Game, my journey to reach level 10 continues, and that will happen soon. Today I'm adding one more epic card to my collection, and I chose the E283 Vintage Low Rider card.

<center>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeFdsy4aMr8F5WgNRJAK5gXzdgkNqvp6VBaFtWR15g7zY/dddd.png</center>

The E283 Vintage Low Rider card only costs 100,000 STARBITS and will give me another 1100 Fans. I have to admit I loved the design of this card.

Unfortunately, this card won't give me Skill, and that means my EGO will rise again, but I'll solve that problem soon.

You can access the games at the following links: **[Splinterlands](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=arkartus)** and **[Rising Star Game](https://www.risingstargame.com/)**.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@arkartus/opening-my-first-chaos-legion-in-splinterlands-and-buying-an-epic-card-in-rising-star-game-251)

Me has recordado mi infancia. Mi padre era pescador. A veces se ausentaba una semana, a veces meses, buscando ganarse la vida para su familia.

Estoy seguro de que tuvo pensamientos como los que tienes ahora.

A la larga, valió la pena. Mantuvo a su familia: a su esposa y a sus cinco hijos. Hizo lo que tenía que hacer, igual que tú haces lo que tienes que hacer.

Mantente fuerte, amigo. La familia lo es todo. Tú tienes la tuya. Aférrate a ella. Te ayudará a superar cualquier cosa.

You just reminded me of my childhood. My father was a fisherman. At times he could be gone for a week, sometimes for months on end. Looking to earn a living for his family. 

I am sure he must have had thoughts like you are having now.

In the long run, it was worth it. He supported his family. His wife and his five children. He did what he had to do as you are doing what you have to do.

body.title: 电动自行车故障
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![28Ludz0keOIoJenL_4.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/alpha-omega/images/28Ludz0keOIoJenL_4/28Ludz0keOIoJenL_4.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

一个多月前就觉得小电驴有些不对劲，右边挂挡前把感觉有些不太灵。当时不妨碍骑行就没太在意，就继续骑着。直到前两天我骑的时候把档拧到最大档位，松手时候档位居然不回弹，固定住了。这就导致不会减速，必须捏住刹车才行，骑行的时候非常危险，当时我又拧了几下把位才恢复回弹。周末我找了个时间去附近维修店，师傅了解情况后把挡风被揭开，可以看到右侧档位转把旁边的钢丝已经漏出来了。师傅说这个要从总部订购零件，大概要5天至15个工作日，等时间有些长，师傅说可以加急。

如果是1年之内的话在免费维修范围内，现在已经2年了已经出了质保期。于是我扫码付款，总共70块钱。我骑电动车回去后档把已经彻底不能回弹，关掉电动车再启动，彻底挂不上档把了，等于彻底骑不了。今天上班我只能骑共享单车，其实上下班倒没啥，就是不能骑电动车接孩子放学，只能奶奶接孩子走路回来。原本骑电动车5分钟的路程走回家大概20多分钟，好在这段时间天气好，不冷不热还能晒太阳。

今天给维修师傅打电话问了下，零件还没有到。师傅说到了后就电话通知我，车子骑不了到时候我只能推着过去，希望五一假期前可以修好。没有电动车时候不觉的走路麻烦，习惯了电动车的便利，现在突然没有电动车感觉很不习惯。由俭入奢易，由奢入俭难啊。

---

![U1tuP36RxkZ307A8_1002682402.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/U1tuP36RxkZ307A8_1002682402/U1tuP36RxkZ307A8_1002682402.webp)

![LY0VNZq3XDfuTWPc_1002682774.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/LY0VNZq3XDfuTWPc_1002682774/LY0VNZq3XDfuTWPc_1002682774.webp)
![EDdU7mhpTy3v5OSw_1002682825.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/veronicamartinc/images/EDdU7mhpTy3v5OSw_1002682825/EDdU7mhpTy3v5OSw_1002682825.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

Un domingo en familia es un regalo necesario. A veces parece que los tenemos cerca todos los días, pero cuando realmente sacamos la cuenta del tiempo de calidad que pasamos con ellos, nos damos cuenta de que es bastante corto. Por lo menos en mi caso, aunque tengo la fortuna de vivir cerca de gran parte de mi familia, con mi hermano no soy tan afortunada; por eso, cada vez que él nos llama para reunirnos, es un \

inmediato.
A family Sunday is a much-needed treat. Sometimes it feels like we see them every day, but when we really take stock of the quality time we spend with them, we realize it’s actually quite limited. At least in my case, even though I’m lucky enough to live near most of my family, I’m not so lucky when it comes to my brother; that’s why, every time he calls to get us together, it’s an immediate “yes.”
​Además, este fin de semana pudimos buscar a mi sobrina, a la que no vemos tan seguido, así que fue el momento perfecto con las personas perfectas. Nos fuimos a un pueblo que está a unos 20 minutos de la ciudad. Generalmente, cuando vamos para allá, mi hermano es el encargado de organizar todo y, ya estando allá, nosotras nos ocupamos de cocinar, distribuir y servir. Las niñas pudieron bañarse en la piscina; aunque no había mucho sol, sí había bastante humedad y fue bastante refrescante para ellas.
Plus, this weekend we got to spend time with my niece, whom we don’t see very often, so it was the perfect moment with the perfect people. We went to a town about 20 minutes outside the city. Usually, when we go there, my brother is in charge of organizing everything, and once we’re there, we take care of cooking, serving, and setting the table. The girls were able to swim in the pool; although it wasn’t very sunny, it was quite humid, and it was quite refreshing for them.
​Hicimos parrilla y conversamos. De hecho, hasta mi madre me prestó el carro para empezar a practicar. Pasamos un rato súper agradable, comimos delicioso y estuvimos unidos. ¿Qué más se le puede pedir a la vida? ​A veces uno cree ser dichoso cuando gana mucho dinero, cuando tiene muchas cosas o aquello con lo que soñaba cuando era pequeño. Y sí, todo eso es importante, pero la verdadera riqueza la tiene quien puede compartir con su familia, disfrutar de ellos y pasar momentos agradables donde los problemas no importan y todo sucede de una forma tan bonita y genuina.
We had a barbecue and chatted. In fact, my mom even let me borrow her car so I could start practicing. We had a really nice time, ate delicious food, and were together. What more could you ask for in life? Sometimes we think we’re happy when we make a lot of money, when we have a lot of things, or when we achieve what we dreamed of as children. And yes, all of that is important, but true wealth belongs to those who can share with their family, enjoy their company, and spend pleasant moments where problems don’t matter and everything happens in such a beautiful and genuine way.
​Entonces, les dejo un abrazo y la mejor de las vibras a todos. ¡Por supuesto, nos vemos en una próxima publicación!
Well, I'll leave you all with a big hug and lots of positive vibes. Of course, see you in my next post!

昨天忙着赶，着急忙慌的去睡觉，因为今天早上有早八，把发帖这茬子事给忘掉了，昨天也就平平淡淡的过去了。考试后，理应来说就应该给我们放假让我们好好休整一下，结果还有连上四天课才到五一。

反正我最近是听不进去课了，昨天就没有听进去，而且昨天一直在忙一件事情，那就是前天，偶然得到了30个《龙族》的动态视频，这些视频都没有配音，都是静音的。我本来想在朋友圈炫耀一下，结果突然灵机一动，想到可以找我的朋友们帮这些视频配音，凭感觉配一个他们认为可以的音乐。想想就兴奋了。但是其实很多都是我自己配的，因为全程乐在其中的只有我自己，我自己配也没什么，我还嫌不够呢。

然后昨天我就找了六七个人，最后拍出来的视频有十几段，我把这十几段整合在一起，也有一个6分多钟长的视频了。这个过程怎么说呢？有些麻烦，但是吧我却乐得去做，因为我感觉那些，人物又活了起来，虽然说有些配音不是很大，但是细细再评的话，感觉和他们是可以对得上的，他们的故事很丰满了，来配这么一个音乐是很足够的，越想越满足啊！这些陪伴了我很长时间的人物，再一次活生活现的出现在我眼前，真的很感动。

那今天肯定是要认真听课了，早上的这节课是一个水课。我想把昨天的课程补一下然后后面是模电课，我现在跟不上老师了，但是网课老师讲的一点也不赖，那我就跟着网课学吧。今天可不能再一事无成了。

---

body.body: ![Hive-Banner-Green-Rounded.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tGM7REKBsvoBhPiEV5Fvb8tb333qQ8N9x2YfxaF9vWohE9Qf39RUEAn3LfysdgfbYpZ.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260424_175721299.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23xKjpRWTfpUcxvzShAcMPyjigfxu9e7MGsdP8MHCozRZz4kysiCkzTPGnGSEQzm7eWMr.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) >I live naked and barefooted, very close to Earth and Nature, in an 18-acre, off-grid, clothing-optional, food-forest intentional community ([GaiaYoga Gardens](https://gaiayoga.org)), way out in the jungles of Lower Puna, far East Big Island, Hawai'i, and I have for more than 7 years now. Although there are many challenges, I love my life, and I'm immensely grateful to live where and how I do, on my own terms! I would not want to live any other way! 😁🙏💚⚡💥🔥✴️✳️❇️👣🌱✨🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ``` Hive Debt: 22.98% HIVE Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.060 USD HBD/HIVE-Backed Dollar Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.983 USD ALIVE SWAP.HIVE Price: 0.03215338 SWAP.HIVE HEARTBEAT ALIVE Price: 0.07452751 ALIVE BLURT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.00117903 USD QORT Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.144499 USD VOI Fiat-Dollar Price: 0.0001743 USD BTC/Bitcoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 76,713.5 USD BCH/Bitcoin Cash Fiat-Dollar Price: 448.40 USD LTC/Litecoin Fiat-Dollar Price: 55.26 USD Gold Fiat-Dollar Price: 4,683.00 USD Silver Fiat-Dollar Price: 75.59 USD Ranking for Our @aliveandmmb Witness Node: #130 (among all witnesses, including inactive)/#101 (among active witnesses only)/463.4k HP in votes/48 votes in total ``` ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) Warm greetings all! 😁🙏💚✨🤙 I had intended to install OpenClaw in the Artix Linux installation in which I've been conducting my AI-agent experiments and tests, yesterday, though that got postponed because, following and investigating an intuition that I had, I realized that the default installation method for OpenClaw wouldn't work on my non-systemd system, because it has no fallback for any other init system aside from systemd. Thankfully there are multiple ways to get around that, which I've been researching and synthesizing, and from that I now have a pretty good understanding of what I need to do to get everything up and running as I'd like. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_084619676.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23w2cBedvevedy8TUxoi2x4soAHzycuT1rmVECA4h5LTYRN5Fnsg18KmRzPoPuwHhHykK.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_084721300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvXj7xKCK6jMw6UByQN612UKNTjUT56p37cVRf8TV1qP7mrbfshBs8vDJ1ErnRs8MR1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yes, I could have just jumped in and worked through the errors that I encountered, but I really like to be prepared for as many possible issues as I can ahead of time, especially common ones, so I decided to take more time to learn and understand the underlying frameworks upon which I'll be depending, as I implement my AI-Agent master plan on my laptop. I'm learning and understanding so much more now, and I'm getting very close. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_094204526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uEzRZ8cJ9aUPtwjcKpVePhbGuU3PQVR4Vd1i3XtiooL1wevGhtoXAr1n1QuVy7TAjC6.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_094532863_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uQpHR65XTvKSmLJ6MxFEm32cGwp3PQAEwUNUyUeV31z1WFXGYoviQsHw6tDGpy8Y9yE.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) The basic parts of my soon-to-be local AI-agent system are, one, RamaLama, to acquire and manage FOSS (*Free and Open-Source Software*) models via podman-style containers, two, Podman and Podman Desktop, to provide the containerization and assorted tools to work with containers and pods, three, OpenClaw, which will have its daemon gateway server running from a container, and its command-line interface installed separately in my host system, to build, manage, and extend my AI-agent system and team, and four, the various task-specialized AI model and agent combinations, to collaborate and fulfill the desired goals, tasks, or purposes. This AI system will have a few layers, but constructing it in this manner makes the whole process immensely simpler, easier, and quicker than any method that I've found so far. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_145202022.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23z774x67bqEQ1Ev2RBaPLdWjh6HHqSk1y8Nx4yxfcRwLyJ1c9VeZN14LtD3E4GQ4RnQU.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_145429154_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vsNEZGd7ssX5E1Wprg1vMaiAcTAKMicC5TGx9G8VH8zPjmZGX6rQ2PF8e7sfTrFxh5J.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I still need to choose the appropriate FOSS AI models to use in my AI-agent system, which is not an easy decisions all, I've got to say, as there are so many different families of AI models, as well as innumerable iterations and variations, with some able to be run on very-low-end hardware, while others require more-than-consumer-grade hardware resources to function as intended. My laptop is quite high end, but there are a whole bunch of larger models that would not work for me at all, especially if I intend to use multiple models simultaneously in a collaborative AI-agent system. This part could take some time. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150200807.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wWrWyd67DzG2k5f3kmTGHJ6V2hD4jpmoTvA9ZuXYLJn3qYTo7DbY8psfMsn2CxBqmBp.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150253556.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC3YLpimRRVz4awBqDGmuhkKsBxdodnd2oTq2ouDWJJUuDid2P9qmxSxqiFpjE6ZGye.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) I learned of a way to work with Claude Code locally, using my own model, so once I choose a strong-coding model, I'll set it up as my coding-and-development agent, which would then be invoked, directed, and managed by the primary OpenClaw orchestrator/supervisor agent, for which I also still need to choose a suitable model, along with the other specialized agents that I'll create as I go. My most significant limitation in setting up multiple concurrent models and agents will be my laptop's hardware resources, which while excellent in conventional standards, are quite modest for setting up and running larger, more complex model-agent combinations, interactions, and flows. I'm determined to find a sweet spot, however, that will work well with the hardware resources that I do have available. Once the basic system is set up, there's going to be a whole lot of testing, tweaking, experimenting, and refining, as I go. ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150354015_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23uFMFd2dJSHjBd2JoECMnyUAF3qypy9r3EwcxzDH5Rt6KCyCbeFtTXcZYtUsuSyZV2wr.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150620580.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23vhoFuatnvksMXn6iHD2Yf1xjJPCk6C5t8EkCzne7SgJEwcs8Sa4pEY775YcKTXoytAZ.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) Yesterday, I left the Flow House, after finishing up my numerous Sunday Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, by around 3:30PM, focusing on a few small jungle-community tasks. I already had a few days of photos for my posts, so aside from one or two, I didn't take any others. I returned to the Flow House early, as I usually do on Sundays, after making myself some food in Wabisabi, and collecting my jar of leftover superfood fire coffee from the fridge. Of course I did more research into building my local AI system, before finally beginning on my evening Hive tasks. I got through all of my notifications by just about 10PM, and after some asset management, and some more AI research, I went to bed by 1AM, way too late again. I woke up by about 7AM, still feeling that I needed more sleep, preparing the two posts that I had to write today (*this one, and my Weekly-Hive-Goals-and-Progress Update*), doing more AI research, going to make my superfood fire coffee in Wabisabi, then returning to the Flow House to collect the asset data for my goals-and-progress update, and finally to begin writing this post. It's now just after 1:45PM, so it's a really good time to wrap this up, so that I may attend to my few other important Hive-Blurt-'We Are Alive Tribe' tasks, before leaving the Flow House a little later in the afternoon, to focus first on some photography for my posts, and then on jungle-community/land work and tasks. I deeply appreciate y'all so very much! Until tomorrow's edition of these posts! ***Always forward, onward, upward, and whaleward, ho, together we go!*** 😁 🙏 💚 ✨ 🤙 ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150711223.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23wC1a1asvVQzUweUbfMsaJYmW9mK5j1tK7231K2jFHaxt8P7fHfQaw32mgmNz1tCZqe1.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![IMG_20260425_150744151.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23tvZrUYNTquyGtMmsvoYCwALUgAe7RHFRFLoLaQocmoCHgeXsvgKT7k6UQCUhn6ZQLSP.jpg) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23swY1SJijRvUyTXadQzZdxrbHPEg3bhwUH5Ha71Az1EVsufJ3GqtYTKCQcedWbhXumvs.png) ![Hive-Divider-Green-Rounded-3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tydynrain/23t6vW6aH5DR2YDkVqNYUx8BexWwy9N6Z5spVSE48QJrgFzyfjAip7syeyq3K4RmyypRS.png) ### 2026 Life Goals ``` 1.) body.title: Would I answer the midnight call?
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWQc1cxpcH1amSh3WD1VWM7uSZaq8L2ExMxezacubFWmu/1777333702883.jpg)

I’m really glad to be part of this week’s Midnight Owl prompt.

Midnight has always been seen as a unique and sensitive time of the day. For me, if I ever hear my name being called at that hour, I wouldn’t respond. This is largely influenced by the beliefs I grew up with. In some cultures, it is often said that calling someone’s name at midnight is not something to take lightly, as it may not always be ordinary. Because of this, many people choose to stay cautious.

There was a particular incident I once heard about in a nearby community. A young man shared how one of their neighbors suddenly began behaving strangely in the middle of the night. According to him, the man woke up abruptly, as if someone had called him, and started responding to an unseen voice. He kept insisting that someone was calling his name and trying to get his attention. His family members were confused because no one else could hear anything. Within a short time, the situation became serious, and despite efforts to help him, he didn’t survive till morning. The whole event left everyone in shock and fear, especially because no one could clearly explain what happened.

That story stayed with me for a long time and shaped how I react to things like that. Since then, I’ve made a personal decision never to answer if I hear my name being called at midnight. It’s simply a way of protecting myself based on what I believe.

Even at home, we were always advised to be careful and not respond carelessly during such hours. While people may have different views, I believe staying alert and cautious is always wise.

**Thanks for reading.**

> Hello, friends of this wonderful community! Today I’d like to share this beautiful piece of graffiti by the artist Wolfgang Salazar, also known by his stage name [Badsura](https://badsura.com/badsura-y-el-muralismo-una-forma-de-dialogar-con-caracas/). This artist is known for featuring popular figures from Venezuelan culture as the protagonists of his works, as in this case where he immortalized our singer-songwriter, the Venezuelan musician popularly known as [Óscar d'León](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/%C3%93scar_d%27Le%C3%B3n), who is a leading figure in Caribbean salsa music. Talking about him is like talking about our country, Venezuela. This beautiful mural is located specifically on Francisco de Miranda Avenue, right next to the north entrance of the Chacao Metro station (at the intersection with Élice Street), in the municipality of Chacao, Caracas, Venezuela. This location is very busy, as you can see, since it is near a Metro station and several major intersections, so it is always bustling with activity. Consequently, this artwork is viewed by countless people because of its beauty and because it inspires those who recognize the subject of the graffiti; it is impossible not to stop and take a closer look at it and admire it. This artist is very popular for his colorful and intentional style, reaffirming our national identity through iconic figures from our country who have represented us both nationally and internationally across various spheres of our society. They serve as symbols of what Venezuela is—with feeling, rhythm, cadence, and flavor—as in this case with our beloved Óscar D'León. And just like this graffiti, there are many more works by this artist throughout our city, blending urbanism and street art into something beautiful and worthy of admiration. body.title: The 12:23AM Cry — Fiction
body.body:
I finished watching the movie at exactly 12:23 a.m. It was a Christian movie and it made very good sense, one that spoke to me at the exact place, and as expected the movie moved and prompted me to pray, but I refused to... I thought I could do it together with my morning prayer later in the day, time's gone and my eyes were closing.





That was how I adjusted my bread spread, changed the position of my pillow and lay down on the bed.


![1000984867.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJeaxAnPMtAsxjZGNqhG1CWSaSPcBwdnqjDvQSZrqYaBNvb6PqKqSrgeC9DWpmM.png)




It was quiet in a different way, but I didn't pay attention because our house is situated in a new site, houses were far from each other.

Immediately I closed my eyes, I heard a distant cry....

*\

* 

Is it jolted or bolted awake, I sha awake with my eyes wide. I was thinking if I hear well or not. But, that's my name and it's one very few people know.

I sat in my bed for like a minute waiting to see if anything will come up again, I waved it off since I heard nothing and lay my head back to sleep.


Less than 5 minutes after, I heard another loud cry, this time it felt a little close...

*\

* 

I sprang up again. This time a lot more terrified, I made my way quietly to my window, checked through it closed it slowly and dropped my curtain.

I don't mind bearing the heat tonight.

I waited a little to hear a sound or some movements, but nothing came. That was when I noticed that the night was unusually silent. My fear increased.


I stepped back, off my phone torch and and sat on the bed for what looked like forever. After some time I checked my phone and saw that the time was just 12:45 a.m.

What's going on, is this time crawling 🤦?



I waited a few more minutes, didn't hear anything and decides to sleep back, but this time I said a shirt prayer, because my mind returned to the movie I watched earlier and refused to say any word of prayer after.

After saying the prayers, I looked around and waited a bit more, then I laid down back. And for over 10 minutes, I didn't close my eyes. I just stared at the wall I wasn't seeing.



As soon as sleep was carrying me away, the cry came again, this time it was as if the person calling out to me was right there inside the room with me


*\

*


I can't even describe what I felt at that moment, it was beyond fear...maybe shock.


![1000984866.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/AJg2rGTDo3pUCga25BfZVaH92QQGix7Lb55sEx33N321biLqXprGRmoqsXXqFou.png)

Without thinking twice, my default settings took over. It was one I've unconsciously or unknowingly learnt from my mum.


I began to shout at the top of my voice as well...


*\

*


That and many more was what I was saying, praying and declaring at the same time.


Well, few minutes later, I reduced my voice and was just mumbling the prayers.





Then I heard a knock on my door, I wouldn't have opened up if not because I heard my brother's voice.



*\

* I asked


 I almost raised my hands at him because it wasn't in any way funny....



**As I’m making this post, it is 12:45 a.m. here in Nigeria…** 




🌹

**Images are AI generated.**



**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

body.title: Framing What Refuses Rest
body.body:
![1000136239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/EogMP5bXbK6EjCCxuTyqym9pFAzkrWzXe19i8DZKvSGcCPWpS4vuxrSJtKBdbgdU3W1.jpg)






![topfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/jVIY8Tx5-top-feather.png)









<center>I used to chase after the bright things that everyone praised so loudly, I mistook their volume for truth and their shine for  kind of substance,
I used to chase the kind of approval that quickly arrives but leaves me feeling empty once the room falls silent again and again that I cannot even foresee,
I used to chase what appeared expensive from a distance, while disregarding the private cost it demanded from my sleep and my dream stability,
I used to chase after something, but now I wonder if I truly want it deeply or if I’ve simply repeated what I’ve been hearing around me since I was born,
I used to chase, until my own hunger began sounding unfamiliar inside my chest that now it comes with a pattern…





<center>I’ve witnessed enough, people hold what others envy while carrying a heaviness they cannot display beside polished photographs that never sounded real,
I’ve witnessed enough, that smiles often become uniform when admitting disappointment could ruin the image they’ve diligently worked to maintain behind the scenes,
I’ve witnessed enough, how gaining everything visible can still leave hidden corners of a life cold and leaving it unattended only if you could immediately notice,
I’ve witnessed enough, and I’m wondering if I’m admiring their peace or just the way they frame their unrest purpose as noticeable failure
I’ve witnessed enough instances to conclude that appearances frequently demand belief more than they warrant truth…





<center>I turn inward, where quieter measures await without applause or the need for strangers to validate my worth,
I turn inward, where discipline initially feels mundane, yet it ultimately saves me from the chaos I once mistakenly referred to as freedom,
I turn inward, where fairness demands more of me than charm ever did, leaving me with fewer places to hide,
I turn inward, wondering if I’m avoiding the more challenging good because it doesn’t come with the glamour, or the approval of others, or the unfamiliar wound that once you knew,
I turn inward, realizing that some treasures require dedicated practice before they can be truly recognized and put to good use…





<center>I’ve learned slowly that courage rarely appears grand while it’s happening and often feels like shaking in your daily ordinary clothes,
I’ve learned slowly that restraint can feel isolating when excess is celebrated and everywhere made to appear vibrant, lively, and familiar,
I’ve learned slowly that making clear judgments is expensive because it requires me to suppress distractions and prioritize my own values and opinions even more,
I’ve learned slowly, can I continue to choose what steadies me when no one claps for it but ultimately relates a part of me that is unexplainable,
I’ve learned slowly that the deepest gains rarely announce themselves, and are known by the way I begin to live differently, choosing to be alive and unafraid to dream again…





<center>Watchwords:
their volume for truth
private cost it demanded
the frame around unrest
harder good without glitter
least dramatic to announce











![bottomfeather.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/bYIitQga-bottom-feather.png)

***

<center>Here is Tikatarot, who dares you to answer the question, *“Who am I?”..*</center>


***
***

<center>As and will always be reminding you to dream:</center> 
<center>*“As you are still the Master of your destiny and the maker of your dreams…”*</center>



![tikatarot sign.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tikatarot/cUPh7Abd-tikatarot20sign.png)

body.title: 5 Minutes Free Writing - First Impression
body.body:
Good morning all, doing my 5 minutes free writing with prompt - First Impression. Hope you enjoy the story.


![images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRqeZ65dcixD8FTgi0Ok2uC6aeBR7y2XZEbfwPkeJsxYw&s=10](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRqeZ65dcixD8FTgi0Ok2uC6aeBR7y2XZEbfwPkeJsxYw&s=10)
[Source](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcRqeZ65dcixD8FTgi0Ok2uC6aeBR7y2XZEbfwPkeJsxYw&s=10)

\

Linsey's mother was reminding her she gets ready for her blind date.

Let us explore first impression, we create an mental impression of some one or something we encounter within milliseconds. And first impression is the mental note and feelings we had when we encounter for the first time. It's important to note that we would need even more effort to change a bad impression than having a great impression.

We must note that there are occasions when first impression once created, we had no second chance to improve it. An example would be blind date or a job interview. If we were to leave a bad first impression, our date would simply blacklist us and avoid any future contact. Likewise, our interviewer would strike us off and fail us for the interview, no matter how well we know the job won't help.

Therefore, are there any sure win method to create a good first impression? Surely there is, that is to conduct ourselves properly and truly always even in daily momens as you never know, anytime, eyes are watching.

body.title: YOUR PASSPORT AT HOME
body.body:
‎
‎It's very true that information is the life wire of everything. I was actually sharing with my students a personal experience and thought 🤔 about getting an international passport 🛂 with low cost and less crowd.
‎So am asking How can Get Your International Passport Faster.?


![Screenshot_20260427-200321.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23yJBu3VutDq9XngaSPfkh7kGAMuEdQ4haQaVzPCEsYntC5tvU3nFS2T1NXcCdUGZgQpR.png)

‎
‎If you really want things to move faster, go and apply for your international passport in a quieter state not everywhere has the same crowd. 
‎There was a time I had very little… but I made sure the little I had worked for me.
‎During my NYSC in Jos plateau state , I had to manage my allowee. 
‎
‎I was very intentional because I knew where I was going. 
‎My mum had already done so much pushing me through university, so I told myself  I have to do my part. 
‎Studying abroad wasn’t just a wish for me, it was a goal.
‎One of the smartest things I did back then was getting my international passport early.
‎
‎I processed mine in Jos, Plateau State, and I paid just ₦25,000 the exact official fee. That's Nigerian naira.
‎No extra charges, no shortcuts. I simply followed the right process and waited patiently. 
‎Luckily for me, the system was less crowded, and things moved smoothly.
‎
‎That’s one thing many people overlook.
‎
‎Your international passport is not something you should wait to get when you’re “ready to travel.” It is one of the most important documents you need if your dreams are beyond your current location.
‎
‎If you are currently serving (NYSC), this is your advantage:
‎Avoid overly crowded states like Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, or even Akwa Ibom where the demand is high. If you’re in a quieter state, use that opportunity. Go to the Federal Secretariat, locate the immigration office, and begin your process now.
‎

‎Don’t wait until urgency forces you into paying unnecessary money.
‎Start preparing before the opportunity comes
‎I remain your handsome friend John Petra!
‎

body.title: Fundación gana a Gigantes en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División de Futsal
body.body:
> Saludos amigos de Hive y de @fulldeportes, hoy voy a compartir con ustedes la participación del equipo de Fundación en El Torneo Apertura de 2da División, que se llevando a cabo en todo el municipio Zamora, estado Aragua. >Greetings to our friends at Hive and @fulldeportes. Today I’m going to share with you the Fundación team’s performance in the Second Division Opening Tournament, which is currently taking place across the municipality of Zamora, in Aragua state.
![GridArt_20260427_124701484.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xAbufynBiLNr6EmtBtr5pFxUhLb3AUCWGHh26jUH2ma3DZXfKkbi3wUcZyUjoKF8QdV.jpg) Cabe destacar que esta jornada se desarrollo el día domingo 26 de abril en las instalaciones de la cancha del sector Carrizalito, de Villa de Cura, donde Fundación participó en las categorías Sub 8, 10, 12B y Sub 14A, en diferentes horarios. El primer partido inició a las 9:30, con la categoría Sub 14A de Fundación vs Gigantes, en el primer tiempo Fundación, inició con gran intensidad dentro de la cancha, pero no mantuvo una buena defensa y el equipo rival, marca su primer gol, para perder Fundación 1 X 0. >It is worth noting that the tournament took place on Sunday 26 April at the Carrizalito ground in Villa de Cura, where Fundación competed in the Under-8, Under-10, Under-12B and Under-14A categories at various times. The first match kicked off at 9.30 am, featuring the Under-14A category between Fundación and Gigantes. In the first half, Fundación started with great intensity on the pitch, but failed to maintain a solid defence, allowing the opposition to score their first goal, resulting in a 1–0 defeat for Fundación. ![IMG_20260426_092903.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23w2m44x6jBxQabeurmn6KcVF43SQG3mNTHR9JrU79J1xuiFyjuNkg84rDBj9gjMFRn9X.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_092911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23vsFejemi1s5thPrb5YHbZH1d1QMYHURWjMwywGYUGrMNQKWyYtUmn4HhULADKXToSWC.jpg) Después pasaron a jugar el segundo tiempo, el técnico de Fundación hizo un solo cambio y comenzó a atacar a la portería, manteniendo una fuerte defensa, logrando empatar 1 X 1. Luego el portero de Fundación, realizó un disparo directo a la portería del equipo Gigantes, cuyo portera no pudo evitar que la pelota entrara a la portería y de esta forma aumentan el marcador a dos goles. >In the second half, the Fundación manager made just one substitution and began to press forward, maintaining a solid defence, and managed to level the score at 1–1. Then the Fundación goalkeeper fired a shot straight at the Gigantes goal; their goalkeeper was unable to prevent the ball from going in, bringing the score to 2–1. ![IMG_20260426_093235.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23wWrV39PfQfvNjQPipq1JpjKb9rpyxqAwKouC7Y73594hF3YLkerE1nREUNmcHtNSR6U.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_093411.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/2423x5Mh2YYft6Hdwc8iE5YRhBesBtuKMirYBTjKKm8XnW9wrmjGYM2G3AKrzhCPfSmhj.jpg) En los últimos minutos, Fundación, marcó su tercer gol, y Gigantes, logra un contraataque para hacer su segundo gol, y de esta forma la Sub 14A de Fundación gana 3 X 2, en un partido bastante cerrado. Por otro lado las categorías Sub 10 de Fundación se enfrentó a Fama, quedando empatados 1 X 1, Sub 12B, igualmente contra Fama, quedaron 0 x 0 y la Sub 8 gana a Fama 3 X 1. Con estos resultados Fundación, gana dos partidos y dos empatados. >In the closing minutes, Fundación scored their third goal, whilst Gigantes launched a counter-attack to score their second, meaning Fundación’s Under-14A side won 3–2 in a closely contested match. Meanwhile, Fundación’s Under-10s faced Fama, drawing 1–1; the Under-12B side, also against Fama, drew 0–0; and the Under-8s beat Fama 3–1. With these results, Fundación won two matches and drew two. ![IMG_20260426_094648.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23xejyTSKRj1jAFKhXznR7g2f1QMvdQQHPXHKx7HWQwscyY8MPgU1GQk4YPRVVkorezDb.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_100056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/23z7JCncdtg2zT4YqwGK3WuEkyUJZ6wWJXKrXczYYkMPZ4FLa4GEaz8uNRkVVYZXsZ6r5.jpg) ![GridArt_20260427_124259078.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cetb2008/244eXntAB2jDo4nxmrGFtMbkN4FUPzhmUMXaDSbbc6Sd3cmdAuVcMXGaoPWis5x9yvavu.jpg) Espero que les haya gustado, nos vemos en una próxima publicación. >I hope you liked it, see you in a next post. body.body:

![SeQcLeWkVn4IfBpQ_1001374115.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/isgledysduarte/images/SeQcLeWkVn4IfBpQ_1001374115/SeQcLeWkVn4IfBpQ_1001374115.webp)
![5YEiZIeUq9CnTf5r_1001374213.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/isgledysduarte/images/5YEiZIeUq9CnTf5r_1001374213/5YEiZIeUq9CnTf5r_1001374213.webp)
![gnXDRRc4nmvxADWH_1001374406.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/isgledysduarte/images/gnXDRRc4nmvxADWH_1001374406/gnXDRRc4nmvxADWH_1001374406.webp)

Cómo muchos saben la presidente encargada está de gira por el país. Parece reunión de grupo religioso pues le dan ese carácter de oración por el país. Pero pienso yo que es una campaña, pero qué se yo de política ¿cierto? 

Lo que sé es que todo se vuelve un caos durante su visita, calles trancadas, transporte público acaparado para sus movilizaciones. 

Y cómo bien sabe los servidores públicos se ven obligados a asistir y aquellos que esperamos un beneficio del gobierno. Cómo en mi caso que pertenezco a una AVV que es una asociación de vivienda. 

Salimos del Ateneo y fui con Miranda a cumplir pues obvio que sigo por pura fe esperando la construcción de esas casas. 

Justo enfocaron la pancarta de nuestra AVV, deseándo sea tomada en cuenta. 

Llegó súper tarde, no pudimos esperar hasta el final porqué mi hija estaba cansada y el transporte estaba difícil. De hecho duramos una hora esperando un bus y nos montamos casi que de milagro. Pero llegamos sanas y salvas que es lo importante. 

**English Version**

As many of you know, the acting president is touring the country. It looks like a religious gathering because they’re framing it as a prayer for the country. But I think it’s a campaign—though what do I know about politics, right? 

What I do know is that everything turns into chaos during her visit: streets are blocked off, and public transportation is commandeered for her rallies. 

And as you well know, public servants are forced to attend, as are those of us hoping for government assistance. Like me, for instance, since I belong to an AVV, which is a housing association. 

We left the Ateneo, and I went with Miranda to fulfill our duty—since, obviously, I’m still waiting in sheer faith for those houses to be built. 

They actually focused the camera on our AVV’s banner, hoping it would be taken into account. 

He arrived super late; we couldn’t wait until the end because my daughter was tired and getting transportation was difficult. In fact, we waited an hour for a bus and barely managed to get on—it was almost a miracle. But we arrived safe and sound, which is what matters.

body.body:
>


# English

There’s nothing more exciting than going for training or workshops in beautiful places that make learning smooth and refreshing.

Today, I attended a workshop organized by my firm, and all I can say is that the entire experience was awesome! Thanks to the hotel for its hospitality and convenience.

Some workshops can be long, exhausting, and boring but this workshop was great. It was organized to teach us but not get us overstimulated, and I love the idea behind it.

The workshop ended today, but I low-key didn’t want it to end because I had a fantastic time learning and interacting with others.

body.title: Worth the Extra Ride... Cheeseburger Dinner at Golden Mile Food Centre
body.body:
This is a bit of a late post because today I’m sharing about the dinner I had last Saturday, right after a tiring cycling session at Marina Barrage. After a ride like that, I was definitely hungry enough for something rewarding. The funny thing is, even though there are already so many food choices around the Marina Bay area, I still decided to make life a little harder for myself and cycle another 30 minutes just to reach Beach Road. I suddenly missed going to Golden Mile Food Centre, so that became my next destination in search of something truly worth craving.

### And honestly, I’m glad I followed that craving.


![1000134973.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EprS5MRo1ceLkfkYg2AzdguhQ2eYq84ah4cGaXjkQxVEHt4CKfFgpp4t8NEtSifK4UW.jpg)


My dinner choice that night was from Ashes Burnit!, and I got myself their cheeseburger set. The moment I saw it, I already knew I made the right decision. First of all, their signature black bun makes the burger look extra neat and attractive. It is one of those burgers that immediately catches your attention even before you take the first bite. I have to admit, this burger looked almost too good not to photograph. The presentation alone already made the meal feel exciting.


![1000134967.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoCi6JtSMNQpKk3zpB561pAM68mES5Sjgzknep6MquRswSKLyuE3DxtBW4w8uk2jio3.jpg)

![1000134969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoEpVAaLFq4mbwoy5kdvbSPFvXaV9jy1oL1N2VQ5ivChnfCSCk16kaHwdSdJF42vbYp.jpg)

![1000134959.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EoCiYi8Ns2z8HoZTh1BQsqJAHzm9KPTuj72gu8Tu6vyo4nBLBHCJxWSLBkm8oAvfo4j.jpg)

![1000134968.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/23u616CLTbLxwGfUXZcPJc6GTBjpoHp6kb4HZthPDN5TWEFJ9E5vm4KwacmfaWd499Au8.jpg)


What I really liked was how photogenic it was. Even a simple 45-degree angle shot was enough to make it look drool-worthy. That is the power of nicely presented food. It builds excitement even before the tasting begins. It makes you appreciate the effort behind the dish, and it also makes the food feel a little more special. Of course, I had to control my hunger for a while so I could take a few proper photos before leaving a huge bite mark on the burger LOL.


![1000134972.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Ep5mEqTk8ypWhFkfHNTDb1zE91yPv1tEZ5WPf6CTvEWJA8kvYVd5gVfU9DBAdbwyqWq.jpg)


Once I finally started eating, the burger did not disappoint. It was satisfying in the way a good cheeseburger should be. Messy enough to feel indulgent, but still neat enough to enjoy properly. The patty was juicy, the cheese added richness, and the bun itself gave the whole burger a distinct character. I think the bun is really one of the highlights here because it makes the burger stand out visually while still holding everything together nicely. It felt like the kind of comfort food that was perfect after burning so much energy on the bike.


![1000134976.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EqBafzTrxHM634wVQHa82oCGH8SjNSoKWdy1SqiCWxJbXV4Exo1YUb9RTv6tXaPj3BQ.jpg)

![1000134975.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/Eq7LQChhgj2Tv7mJhGmEf3ihNjYgEwDEskSZ9G3J5wagMQYQdn7XFByE1mLGv41rCVx.jpg)


I also want to talk about the fries because even though they may look like just a side dish, they were actually very good on their own. They were freshly cooked, very crispy, and clearly not an afterthought. What made them even better was the savory coating on the outside. That extra layer of seasoning gave the fries more flavor and made them dangerously addictive. So no, the fries were definitely not just there to fill the plate. They actually added a lot to the meal.


![1000134974.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/curamax/EpJXffJX9aorjLcGQSg5RUFAxZaa2x5PhyasbDVVyTj3GRbVYe3EWfpNHf2Gziwx4Lg.jpg)


To complete the combo, I got myself an iced sugar cane juice with lemon, and this turned out to be such a perfect match for the burger. I really liked the balance between the two. The cheeseburger was rich and savory, the fries were crispy and well-seasoned, and then the drink came in with that refreshing sweetness from the sugar cane and the slight tanginess from the lemon. It was such a good combination. The lemon really made the drink feel even more refreshing and honestly a little addictive too.

***After a long cycling session, this was exactly the kind of dinner I needed. It was satisfying, flavorful, refreshing, and worth the extra ride to Beach Road. Sometimes the best part of a food adventure is not just the food itself, but the effort you make to get there. In this case, I would say it was definitely worth it.***

### I’ll definitely be back again for another cheeseburger and sugar cane lemon combo.

## Bon appétit.

body.title: 🦅 Duck or Eagle? The Life Lesson That Transformed My Work [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeaGCwx7jXFq8qzPFNYeooroffhD8GwBsqJggM6NM8y1S/ideogram-v3.0_Duck_or_Eagle_The_Life_Lesson_That_Transformed_My_Work_ENG_ESP_I_was_going_to_th-0.jpg 


I was going to the airport when a taxi driver approached me. The first thing I noticed was a clean and shiny taxi. The driver was well-dressed: white shirt, tie, and well-pressed pants.

The driver got out, opened the door for me, and said: \

I read the card:
> 《Willy's Mission: to take my clients to their final destination in the fastest, safest, and most economical way, providing a friendly environment.》

I was shocked. The inside of the taxi was just as clean. Willy said, \

And as if that wasn't enough, Willy asked me if the air temperature was okay. Then he informed me of the best route to my destination and asked if I would be happy to talk to him or if I preferred that he not interrupt my meditations.\n\nI asked him: \

Willy was phenomenal; he provided limousine service in a normal taxi. He decided to stop making noise and complaining like ducks and to soar above the group like eagles.

It doesn't matter if you work in an office, in maintenance, or are a teacher, public servant, politician, executive, employee, or professional: How do you behave? Do you dedicate yourself to making noise and complaining? Or are you soaring above the others?

Remember: IT IS YOUR DECISION. You have less and less time to change. May your problems be fewer, your Blessings more... and may only Happiness enter through your door.

---

# VERSION EN ESPAÑOL
---

# ¿Pato o Águila? La lección de vida que transformó mi trabajo

Iba al aeropuerto cuando un taxista se acercó. Lo primero que noté fue un taxi limpio y brillante. El chofer, bien vestido: camisa blanca, corbata y pantalones bien planchados.

El taxista salió, me abrió la puerta y me dijo: \

. 

Leí la tarjeta: 
> 《Misión de Willy: llevar a mis clientes a su destino final de la manera más rápida, segura y económica, brindándole un ambiente amigable》.

Quedé impactado. El interior del taxi estaba igual de limpio. Willy me dijo: \
. \n\nAl comenzar el viaje, Willy me dice: \

. Y como si esto no fuera demasiado, Willy me preguntó si la temperatura del aire estaba bien. Luego me avisó cuál sería la mejor ruta a su destino y me preguntó si estaría contento de conversar con él o si prefería que no interrumpiera mis meditaciones. \n\nLe pregunté: \

. 

Willy era fenomenal, hacía el servicio de una limusina en un taxi normal. Decidió dejar de hacer ruido y quejarse como los patos y volar por encima del grupo como las águilas. 

No importa si trabajas en una oficina, en mantenimiento, eres maestro, servidor público, político, ejecutivo, empleado o profesional: ¿Cómo te comportas? ¿Te dedicas a hacer ruido y a quejarte? ¿O te estás elevando por encima de los otros?

Recuerda: ES TU DECISIÓN. Cada vez tienes menos tiempo para cambiar. Que tus problemas sean menos, tus Bendiciones más... y que sólo la Felicidad entre por tu puerta.

body.body:
>

It's almost three weeks now without showing up. Never have I envisaged going MIA like this, but life always happens. 



![IMG_20260423_161903_316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23wCSm6hLQ9rZrYXwa192avCEf8HkJwUMRpFs1MAPT7jxeh8dMqufbhTKK5iF9jDy96tx.jpg)


To worsen it all, a lot happened and my mind went numb. I recently lost someone so dear to me, my childhood friend and it weighed me down. 

It got me thinking deep and wild at the same time. If there's someone not reaching out to you like they used to, then it's high time you checked in on them. They might not be actually ignoring you, they might have been caught in the middle of this world, that it's so hard to figure out. They might be losing their mind, they might be needing a miracle. 


The loss of my dear friend taught me so. Too often we think people's reaction is about us, but when we look clearly we'd see it's not always about us. 
 

Aside grieving, I've been constantly struggling with balancing work life, fun life and social life and I honestly miss the days when I had my superpowers to navigate through it all. 

On Thursday I whispered \

, maybe I'm being too hard on myself. ![IMG_20260423_182537_790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/EpCDLAY1qX4VyEZXxuCk9cFQcAG4rgYQ9Se8kdLcAYqT2AYSgAoJMNPVNnAqXnngdf3.jpg) It's my first time being this version of myself, so why can't I be a little bit kinder to myself while trying to figure life out? My cousin was home with me, so we headed to the beach to ease my mind from everything. I craved serenity, I craved tranquility and I wanted to hear my inner thoughts without the chaos of the world echoing. My happy place, my power house , nature of course called and I answered. I visited that one spot that helps to reset my mind. The beach! ![IMG_20260423_161307_054.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/243WRTGfcCrBjxwKXZEmSdxtLq3NVSp65e1ivwHW17HABNx8o2HxTz28RvAadvASjz4kf.jpg) The body of water was such a beauty to behold, the waves of the sea were healing to my soul and everywhere spoke calmness. It stilled my fears, my worries and anxieties. I decided to live and not just exist. Sadly, someday the world will also move on without me, so I'll make the most of it now I'm here. ![IMG_20260423_170918_272.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23z7DuFeKS53jUn3PfKGurn9UMsk6ViCdejUNNdFKrujg2Ct1b2kxgdHi2pjoFhBMr778.jpg) I wasn't in the mood to run around on the beach, I sat quietly processing every shit that life has thrown my way and I realized that every pain is a lesson if we paid keen attention. ![IMG_20260423_171108_225.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amiegeoffrey/23sdbP19i3CNEUHcbvVr8B3ZuYLw7tCv6nShKiTh1sfiBtKjUuR7AepGoAKqxdhG9Usqu.jpg) My cousin took some nice shots with my device, some of the crafts we could find in the beach. body.title: My reaction if my name is called at midnight.
body.body:
**Greetings everyone and lovers of #midnightowl**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme43647vVdG2T5DsihTWU8bjcFrkSUZSNPDAxLYotDAgA/1777331990675.jpg)

There's this time at home in the village, when I was much younger and my parents will us not to answer a call from a strange voice at midnight or day time. So Peradventure you mistaken answer a strange  and you noticed  nobody around is called your name. Then we believe that its a spirit that call and that when that happens, you will tell someone  around you to call your name so that you will answer. So by doing so you are free from the strange call and they won't have anything to do with you. That's what we grew up knowing. So here comes the question If you got called by your name at Midnight, what would you do?

If am being called by my name at mightnight, first I will scan or check around if am the only one there in the vicinity and if I didn't see anyone, and am outside the house, I will jump up on my feet and run for my dear life and while am running i will be praying and cancelling any spirit that want to initiate me or must have called my name. So I will not stand to tell the story or consume by the strange voice. 

What If am the only one in the room at midnight, I will not answer the call, and I will sit up and remain calm, pray earnestly and anoint myself with my anointing oil, to cancel every strange call and I will as well call one or two persons to keep me company until am free from the fear. When the day breaks I will leave the house for a while.

The above is what I will do if I have such experience and I will like to know my friends, would you do the same or do a different thing altogether.

Thanks for stopping by @amara24 blog. Have a lovely rest 🥰❤️🫂.

body.title: Primer día en la línea de producción
body.body:
<center>![Copilot_20260427_202332.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/morenow/23wMS5Seh7tGsBvvoy9LwhnnJBpmc8mAijLAULZwsTXx8R738jy6pHFb9ta686th3W5SJ.png)</center>


Anoche fui mi primer día en línea de producción, estuve retirando restos de arena o hierro en los orificios de las tapas que llevan encima los motores, en algunas partes le dicen culatas o cabezas, acá le dicen Cabeçote. La tarea no era difícil, pero los implementos de seguridad hacían que la tarea se complicara un poco. 

Utilicé tres herramientas para la tarea, una especie de rotomartillo, una especie de pistola con una gancho que giraba con mucha fuerza y una pistola de aire a presion que debía sostener con las dos manos porque sino no podía controlarla. Todo se maneja con presiones muy altas, con energía neumática o presión de aire. 

Al final de la jornada me dolía un poco la mano, el agarre, era de esperarse ya que una de las herramientas pesaba dos kilos y ese uso constante lastimaba mi antebrazo y los musculos de mi mano. 

Algo curioso, bueno, me perdí en la hora del almuerzo, pensé que iba camino al restaurante pero no sé a donde fui, pase como diez minutos caminando en la fabrica y al ver que todo se ponía más solo y peligroso decidi abrir el mapa, entonces me di cuenta que estaba bastante lejos de mi punto de trabajo y más lejos del restaurante XD, así que tuve que caminar otro trecho para regresar. Lo bueno fue que pude almorzar y reposar, y bueno, no creo que me vuelva a perder. 

Bueno gente, espero tengan una linda noche. 

---

body.title: 今天真是一惊一炸
body.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![0XsDXfYldSx7I4sl_1000202415.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/marygong77777/images/0XsDXfYldSx7I4sl_1000202415/0XsDXfYldSx7I4sl_1000202415.webp)
![GfVDaDSKMvLJnxwG_1000202413.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/marygong77777/images/GfVDaDSKMvLJnxwG_1000202413/GfVDaDSKMvLJnxwG_1000202413.webp)
![mEyQR3KsljCFtec1_1000202420.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/marygong77777/images/mEyQR3KsljCFtec1_1000202420/mEyQR3KsljCFtec1_1000202420.webp)
![WxbLXqHJD3o1319Y_1000202419.jpg](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/marygong77777/images/WxbLXqHJD3o1319Y_1000202419/WxbLXqHJD3o1319Y_1000202419.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

也许是周一上班，一大早浑浑噩噩，欢欢学校今天期中考试，因为手骨折，他不能写字，只有放弃考试了，每每想到这个，有点不痛快，不过，也是没有办法的事，也许这就是人生吧，总有不完美的事情，

一到办公室，我就忙着整理老板办公室，还有清理那些杯子，在洗杯子时，也不知自己在想什么，本想把老板的杯子用开水泡一泡，结果我把一杯开水往自己的手上到，呵呵，把我从恶梦叫醒，一大早，我在做什么呀，我还在睡觉呀，不可思议，赶紧用冷开水冲一下。

然后把相关的东西整理好，来到自己的位，悄悄把跌打万花油察上，这种事，我还不好意思说出来给同事听，说出来，可能别人要笑死，这么炯的事，谁叫这么自己不想事呢，一大早在那里发楞。还好公司的钦水机上的水，不是特别的开，要不我的手要毁容了，这真是人生处处有危险呀。

想着这些，心里面有点不开心，做什么事呀，洗个杯子都出故障，还好有药，察了下，手上没有泡，也没伤痕，只是有点不舒服，用了药之后好多， 去年栽了一盆花，放在办公桌上，原来打算给香港老板 办公室的花换一下，哪知老板办公室花越长越漂亮 ，所以这盆花放我办以室，今天意外发现开花了，真的好开心哟！

养他没有多久哟，就有这么漂亮的花，到了下午，H要我去他办公室，给了一张加工资的单给我，看起来特别的开心，我感觉他好像升职了，也不知有没有，结果他说今天公司的目标没有达到，所以工资加得不高，不管怎么样，有得加就好，欢欢的水果钱回来了，不过，也没有特别的开心，平平淡淡。

到了下班，结果收到一辞工单，神呀，又有人要走，还说待遇太低，这不说工资加少了吗，准备打包走人了，真是酷酷的，今天真是一惊一炸。

 

---

body.body:
<center>

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 5.20.34 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23wCBzU7zW8F5e8EtEQFCJ4ZTf85oWYucPCvFwfNKVfSeM9buV6BWvwUn1eESwqJZ7JVT.jpeg)

![Separador_de_texto_costura-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/EoCh8pE4fzkgoHFSQZ8Riwd7mbVhRgZ1LQ2VHvRaVsfe7p6xURwbpZ3g2gfmjW3miTU.png)

---

  <center>

#### Welcome to my blog//Bienvenidos a mi blog</center>

		
---

<div class=\

> ***Hello #needleworkmonday***. Happy Monday. I’d like to share a lovely upcycling project with you—it’s very practical and makes for a charming, feminine accessory. It’s a cute hair tie—or scrunchie—made from colorful cotton yarn, created by combining many small pieces of yarn in various colors. Here are some instructions on how to make it.
ESPAÑOL

***Hola #needleworkmonday***. Feliz lunes. Les comparto un lindo proyecto de reciclaje, muy útil, es un accesorio muy atractivo y femenino. Una linda goma para el pelo o scrunchies de hilo de algodón muy colorido por ser realizado de muchos pedazos de hilos de varios colores. Paso a dar ciertas indicaciones para su elaboración.

---
#### Step by step//Paso a paso
---
#### Materials//Materiales:
---

> - Scraps of cotton yarn in various colors. - Size 2 crochet hook - 1 elastic band.
ESPAÑOL

- Retazos de hilo de algodón varios colores. - Aguja crochet Nº 2 - 01 goma elástica.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 5.28.12 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/AKF8SAHbRT1iin8Xf73e3RCrCMqgRotyUaSskcsCzruzcPS3t8pfeHEJSMnAQy1.jpeg) ---
#### Abbreviations//Abreviaciones:
---

> ch: chain(s). mp: half point. mpa: half high point. pad: double treble crochet. pat: triple treble crochet. aum: increases. dism: decrease. pa: high point. pr: slipped stitch.
ESPAÑOL

ch: cadena(s). mp: medio punto. mpa: medio punto alto. aum: aumento. dism: disminución. pa: punto alto. pad: punto alto doble. pat: punto alto triple. pr: punto deslizado.

---
#### Process//Proceso:
---

> - R1: Cover the elastic band with single crochet, slip stitch. - R2: Insert yarn, chain 4, double crochet in the same stitch, skip one space, 1 double crochet, 1 chain, double crochet, repeat sequence, slip stitch. - R3: Work 3 double crochets in each space, repeat until the round is complete, slip stitch. - R4: Make a single crochet, 5 chain stitches, in the next single crochet, repeat until the round is complete, fasten off.
ESPAÑOL

- v1: Cubrir la goma elástica, con mp, pr. - v2: Insertar hilo, hacer 4 chs, pa, en un mismo punto, saltar un espacio, 1 pa, 1 ch, pa, repetir secuencia, pr. - v3: Hacer 3 pa en cada espacio, repetir hasta cubrir la vuelta, pr. - v4: Hacer mp, 5 chs, en el siguiente mp, repetir hasta cubrir la vuelta, pr.

![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 5.29.31 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/multifacetas/23u66vb14aj5uCtm3cCJGreV9GtXQTDisGAuqSVBQT56Ph7WqMhwpJDUCiLDja1gvFviK.jpeg) ---

> #### ***... And there you have it: the scrunchie made from yarn scraps*** I’d had this elastic sitting around for quite a while, waiting for its turn, until today when I decided to make a scrunchie out of cotton yarn scraps. The result turned out great—it has a rustic, colorful finish. Plus, it’ll come in handy for me, since the one I had was stretched out. This project is simple, perfect for beginners and crafters. It’s also an ideal gift for our friends and mothers. I’m currently without power, which is why this post is a bit late.
ESPAÑOL

#### ***... Y listo el scrunchies de retazos de hilo*** Tenia esta elástica bastante tiempo esperando su turno, hasta hoy que decidí hacer con los retazos de hilo de algodón. Realmente el resultado fue excelente, un acabado rustico y colorido. Ademas será muy util para mi, ya que la que tenia estaba estirada. Este tejido es sencillo, dirigido a principiantes y a vendedores. Tambien es un accesorio ideal para obsequiar a nuestras amigas y madres. Precisamente estoy sin electricidad, por tal razón la publicación es tardía.

I'd love to hear your thoughts...***

 ## **Hi SLOTHYSAVERS, Peace be upon you all ✨👋 👋,**
  
 **Warm greetings to everyone.🤍🌸** 
  
 I hope you are all doing well, staying healthy, motivated, and full of positive energy 🌟😊  
  
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rajpootg/242Dk6Bch7bvWMBEUBy6vMzufComzU9BZzxqysaJHQuLoB1Ahqy1tATdB2S8EThbPcdrc.png)
  
 ## **Welcome to my Week 17 #SlothySavers update!** 🦥  
  
 Well, another week has passed, and we are already in Week 17. 
Time doesn’t rush past you loudly; it slips by in quiet, ordinary moments. One day feels small, almost forgettable, but when those days stack up, they shape your life in ways you didn’t expect.
We often think big changes need big actions, but most of the time, it’s the small things done regularly that matter. A little effort today, a little patience tomorrow, and it builds without making noise.
There’s no perfect moment waiting ahead. What matters is what you choose to do with the time you already have. Even slow progress is still progress, and it’s worth more than standing still.

Looking back, I'm glad I stayed consistent, still here, still saving, still growing. #Slothysavers by #slothbuzz has been such a great challenge for staying motivated and reminded me that small steps taken over time actually add up to something good.
 I'm not chasing perfection. I'm chasing progress. Every save counts. Every week matters. Every mistake is a lesson. That's the slothy philosophy: keep moving, keep learning, keep building. 😄 
  
 Slow, steady, and stacking, that’s the plan!

body.title: Blessings From The Garden
body.body:
>

First, it's not about the large yield. Even though it's small, it's consistent. I've learned about gratitude, how even a small yield can be a blessing and feel like enough.

![IMG_5329.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK2DKQPG4Fhkc2uHHTcW3UyktZZ9Ztfz3MRzXpENbNFMCi7v6MJQKhkZvU92Tz9.jpeg)



My garden teaches me about contentment. It's also about sharing. I'm learning to grow new types of vegetables in my garden. Then, if I have a surplus, I'll share it with my neighbors.

---
---

![IMG_5330.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK3eaxHXhYQpP72HhQPvkWntsTo9BBLYRd7enhmfqh7NV7HYZs2QVvEM4hDxCer.jpeg)


This morning I picked some vegetables to make for breakfast. You know, it feels like shopping at the market, but I pick the vegetables myself. Fresh and organic. I've nurtured them with my own hands, full of love.

---

![IMG_5334.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMYf8CxL5jrakrowNzK8XDPrigBPitZSo7zSLnfVscY6KtmBHE3Gacf5mcyMWbMGrQr.jpeg)

This morning, there is cabbage plant ready to harvest. Although not all of them are ready yet, there's only one. It's good, at least it's enough for one cooking session.

This is my first time harvesting cabbages grown in this garden. This garden is only 90 meters above sea level. It's quite low and hot, so the cabbage yield is very different from what's usually sold in the market, in terms of size.

![IMG_5336.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EogNGp7rF5bN5Vf84MS5nCbADezX48MfzR2ikTZ62hweqFXnf7tTSFfbauh4iH8XNLG.jpeg)

![IMG_5335.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23wMaeuiXeB6A2rNbeQXHzsYTTLyHRpiZbLAPRacpF2SGBDMAPprwdzQqa668GTay7eKD.jpeg)
But I'm still happy. Because this cabbage is very healthy and has yielded a successful harvest. The inside of the successfully harvested cabbage plant is a pure light green-white. It's very crunchy. It's delicious in salads.


![IMG_5337.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23w2oL9c45n4PdqFZw54hFiPCr9SCdzvPrZrtyR7vnPvPUu8xHgn4YwWqxjPovdE5upCQ.jpeg)
*300 grams of cabbage*

I will harvest the other cabbage plants in stages, like a stockpile in a living refrigerator (garden). ❤️

---

![IMG_5340.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23zGeHs7q3wi6tPP657x8wFwodhHwMBpucLRVWMXM5GkQUhhj4HGYCajs6DeKVTav1oZF.jpeg)

Next, I also harvested chilies. The chili plants I planted in grow bags produce many fruits. You can harvest them green or when they're red. But the red ones are much spicier.

![IMG_5339.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/Eo8Spj92BMMhrEV9abxT2yaDfoRc47TEikdUeyDk66T6uMKm3pDDLut8M8JYhTQhSVR.jpeg)

![IMG_5338.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23tvgfEeYk2Jv71FNKpQsECUbN2Z5YS83BiZQV1wpT8eqZrRaLya6EKfdsW2fJSmbhNRo.jpeg)

I also gave my neighbor some of my chili harvest this morning. Because there were so many chilies. I'm so happy not only for myself but also for being able to share, even if it's not much.

![IMG_2984.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJj1CT9qKM5ACVLuJB5AWzbNGDPwc3FMQAG5Aaoj3XG6hASZk13BkE4eWH8agGk.jpeg)


I remember the chilies in these grow bags were still very small. It did take three months for them to reach their full red color.

---
---
---


![IMG_5331.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AK3eZ2w6jBexPANBHpyoMjAoSHDbYnRkgjfjc2qMSM4EmDZDtAvY3XPmNex2drQ.jpeg)

Well, I also harvested two-colored spinach. A combination of green and red. This spinach is delicious in soup.

---

![IMG_4955.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/23u5xwrqbisyyHoxqxF6TMi79P7ZBduqPpp7Y7SNJNjxiMsh1wQRMozxjxRjyReQEX7Kf.jpeg)

![IMG_4957.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/AJhZ13zhyRVGJaShnasmF415PbgntJX7S7T66yv51fVKovGpYziS53969zVaZJ2.jpeg)


Meanwhile, my cabbage plants look like beautiful flowers. So, besides being edible, these plants certainly make my garden beautiful. They look like ornamental plants before they're harvested.

Every morning and afternoon, I'll drink tea or coffee while admiring the beauty of the plants in my garden. This is a priceless blessing ❤️

![IMG_5333.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EoK5pbPAbnJHwYerfRYP6T5gv9zsrefRSMuFps7SCEMAYL2FaahyaEj8vDXd73NonHn.jpeg)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/anggreklestari/EoGw3TCr4Kn1maaskjFirA4JW2QtfXJJWMSUZSwSbGaBdnukosHutbQQJYJgg2uWn1z.png)


---
---
---


>Best Regards,
Anggrek Lestari


---

She has a goal to share life, poem, and food content that makes others happy and can get inspiration. --- Contact Person: authoranggreklestari@gmail.com Discord: anggreklestari#3009 ---

body.title: “Swamp”这个词给人一种神秘而阴郁的感觉。它让我
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gc84270e4ee6015409d3a0717d860d0e3708a90a6e21eb4ce981195adb00aeb85987d0a82ae40f9368558dff3468f26b5c5d59ebf4591ee956ff27bc584e1d4ca_640.jpg)</center>

***

“Swamp”这个词让我联想到一种神秘而迷人的氛围。沼泽地常常被描绘为一个生机勃勃但又充满未知的地方，那里有丰富的生态和独特的自然景观。然而，沼泽的湿润和阴暗也给人带来一种奇妙的压迫感，仿佛在隐喻着潜藏的危险和未知。在这样的环境中，人们既会感受到大自然的伟大，也会意识到自己在其中的渺小与脆弱。在沼泽的包围中，我似乎能更深刻地体会到生命的复杂与多样。

***

红烧肉是一道经典的中国菜，浓郁的酱香和柔软的肉质总是让我垂涎欲滴。每一口都充满了甜咸的滋味，肥而不腻，令人无法抗拒。尤其是搭配上一碗白米饭，简直是人间美味。在寒冷的天气里，热腾腾的红烧肉更是能带给人一种温暖和满足感，仿佛瞬间驱走了所有的疲惫。每次享用红烧肉，都是一次味蕾的盛宴，让我忍不住想要分享这份美好。
