body.title: Why K Bank Chose Ripple: The Future of Cross-Border Payments
body.body:
https://img.blurt.blog/blurtimage/pichat/8b0db5fcbaae5da8f2f096f63abaefc23be10ed7.png

The landscape of international finance is witnessing a significant shift as South Korea’s leading digital bank, K Bank, has officially entered into a strategic partnership with Ripple, a global leader in enterprise blockchain and crypto solutions. This collaboration marks a pivotal moment in the integration of traditional banking systems with decentralized technology, specifically aimed at revolutionizing cross-border remittance infrastructure.

According to reports from Insight Korea, the primary objective of this partnership is to verify and optimize next-generation remittance technologies. By leveraging Ripple’s established global payment network and advanced infrastructure, both entities seek to enhance three critical pillars of international transfers: transaction speed, cost efficiency, and operational transparency. Current international remittance models often suffer from high intermediary fees and prolonged settlement times; this partnership aims to address these \

through direct blockchain-based verification.

The cooperation is structured into several progressive phases. Currently, the initiative includes a Proof of Concept (PoC) centered on digital wallet integration and the joint development of proprietary cross-border remittance models. Furthermore, both parties are exploring expansion into broader digital asset services. Notably, the project has already entered its second stage of testing, which involves simulating the seamless connection between K Bank’s internal banking ledger and customer accounts. These simulations focus on real-world application, specifically testing on-chain fund transfers targeting strategic corridors in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Thailand.

In addition to technical integration, K Bank is actively evaluating the implementation of Palisade, Ripple’s custody-focused SaaS (Software as a Service) digital wallet solution. This move is designed to bolster regulatory compliance and enhance the efficiency of asset deployment as the bank scales its digital footprint.

From a systems perspective, this move indicates K Bank’s commitment to seeking root-cause solutions for the inefficiencies inherent in legacy banking. By adopting Ripple’s technology, K Bank isn't just following a trend but is utilizing evidence-based data to restructure its value chain. This partnership signals a broader trend where traditional financial institutions are no longer viewing blockchain as a threat, but as a fundamental infrastructure for the future of global liquidity.

Source : [chaincatcher](https://www.chaincatcher.com/article/2261020)

body.title: THERE'S MORE TO YOUR STORY
body.body:
‎What GOD Can bring out OF your worst battles will definitely be enough to fed your entire future.
Take this from me today 
‎
Taking our reading from the Bible‎— Judges 14:14
‎“Out of the eater came something to eat, and out of the strong came something sweet.”
‎


![IMG_20260427_161550_700.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/23vsWvGVjVKKi8wbhqmZGQDznBYgVmWSZHYiVZmDa6qxnbMUyHV5ZqjAKgv7QgRUoe6tU.jpg)

‎In the story of Samson in the Book of Judges, we see something powerful that many people overlook. A place of death became a place of provision. What once threatened his life later became a source of nourishment. This is not just a strange moment—it’s a message.
‎
‎Sometimes, the very thing that tried to destroy you becomes the testimony that sustains you. The battle you thought would end you becomes the breakthrough that defines you. God has a way of transforming pain into purpose.
‎
‎That lion represented fear, struggle, and confrontation. Samson didn’t avoid it—he faced it. And because he faced it, God later allowed something unexpected to come from it. Many people want the honey, but they don’t want to fight the lion.
‎
‎There are “lions” in your life right now—problems, pressures, situations that feel overwhelming. But what if those very struggles are setting you up for something greater? What if God is already planning sweetness where you only see struggle?
‎
‎Notice this: the honey didn’t appear instantly. Time passed. Growth happened. Transformation took place. In the same way, God often works behind the scenes, turning what was once broken into something beautiful—if you’re willing to trust Him through the process.
‎
‎You may not understand why you had to go through certain things. You may still carry questions. But God doesn’t waste battles. He redeems them. He repurposes them. He brings life out of what looked like loss.
‎


![IMG_20260426_153053_754.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnpetra/243BirJDw2RALVoULXYAWEcgjLaeaUdCY3JbRDH7wooEp1BZxuadeXsapxVW8GVVVc94o.jpg)

‎Don’t run from your hard moments. 
Don’t despise the places that hurt you. Those are often the exact places where God will reveal His power the most. Your greatest testimony may come from your deepest trial.
‎
‎What once looked like defeat can become divine provision. What once brought fear can bring faith. What once was bitter can become sweet. That’s how God works—He specializes in turning the impossible into the incredible.
‎
‎So the next time you face a “lion,” remember this: there’s honey coming. Stay faithful. Stay strong. And trust that God is already preparing something sweet from what you’re going through.
‎
‎I remain your handsome friend John Petra. One love keep us together!

body.title: (ENG/ESP) 📸🎨✨ My attendance at the exhibition \
/ Mi asistencia a la exposición \
body.body:
#
ENGLISH CONTENT

Hello to all members of this community, photography and art lovers! I recently had the opportunity to visit the museum in **Barquisimeto, (Venezuela)**, while I was visiting the city known as the \

After being closed for a while, the museum reopened and has been working hard to maintain its mission as a space dedicated to showcasing talent not only in the region but also throughout the country. I follow them on social media, and in addition to art exhibitions, they also frequently host talks and invite artists to participate.
![1000406494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX33i9hHcfhywCuyRhVECPtzNAYbXVzV6f3RRYCa2pMvXts255hkm1U7CX2BDjCRKm3.jpg)

This time, I'll tell you about the exhibition created from the works made by students of the experimental sculpture workshop (I'm so jealous of those who attended, haha), led by the professor and architect **José Ignacio Alvarado**. The exhibition was located in the upper part of the museum, in a spacious room where visitors could stroll around and appreciate each piece in detail.
|![1000406449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVTybryuEMANzWUeSR7FA7TN7Zn7zBwBwFjKmqBFxZfnWQG1fgmdLZgF3Z4zqnGXC83.jpg)|![1000396146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1Gp8mx7PVFqoFThFFeirq69y3oxc56Q6sRi3USCNsqmJfg1EZACLygR5VFrvcPVA.jpg)|![1000396129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoiWBJpQ9XFpxmsYEMrVXzbz8KYrc6CUTGkds2bcT569EFhHskP5sQqhMU3ghhxiFq9.jpg)| |-|-|-|
Using various materials such as plastic, cardboard, wood, and steel, the students created abstract pieces. Each one reflected an interesting and even striking form, making you want to admire it from different angles, since, depending on the perspective, you could get a different view of each sculpture. I found that fascinating, and now that I think about it, it would have been great if I had recorded a bit of each one, but I forgot, haha.
|![1000406451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23zbU4MrzbDzACgJtZEVD33CPHdcpjSk9HuHBrXjK3jUGYKzZ3R43NwwsG9zAosLbPVFe.jpg)|![1000406452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKxj5dzKg2Niykx9GTVgKAhsKQNk6gQNug8Hej85do1LT9LE86U26gW3nAqX2aamAPf.jpg)|![1000406453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2wQDv7rXeAbkCRMp9VZztFRHJzJnA5AtPSNX2WCcPcG5awvPrXkC6WHBEMyXfu6X8c.jpg)| |-|-|-| |*Let be* - **Gabriela Bastidas**|*Cycle of joy* - **Mariana Puerta**|*Elevation* - **Chrystie Mujica**|
|![1000406454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23yTfCFa2m74xg7C8dUTkFhXzwAY3TLDnmJGVnw4MXD5AS29P1bFP2pfyYNMCW3nSB5nt.jpg)|![1000406455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWwRNWdiZeQ5JSFRPF7k9dEuNGjJrii6SyqnYHRDgibZj8krU8vQdPYVpZPwqYR5Zn5.jpg)|![1000406456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/48Kbqy2sqY9TQnTDwatGPeNFgr5uvvcKMzNx9CHd1JhZfphgYNo6TrMaFPXfQ4CYEa.jpg)| |-|-|-| |*Don't stop* - **María Fabiola Colmenárez**|*Indigo* - **Raquel Ojeda**|*My sunset* - **José Ignacio Alvarado**|
Choosing my favorite among them all was difficult, as each piece has its own unique touch. But I love the work *Raquel Ojeda* did on her piece \
I don't know if it's the color of the piece or the spirals, but it makes me think of seaweed or a marine element. In \

by José *Ignacio Alvarado*, I adore the way the sculpture unfolds to the sides, which makes you think of the reddish tones that can be seen during a sunset, and the twilight here is majestically appreciated.
|![1000406457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVKNJ4b7dtBLG7uN49L5gQDG54PoyqpY8tTDEt3WM3XJb11JYXzPevgqWCjqA5J3MnH.jpg)|![1000406458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoCj3nn3ApntMTGovaoKtywS5DTrkPfWCF2VYjVAfCPLyv1rvF7C4WJph8bHwyNmVHc.jpg)|![1000406459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqq2UMhgsLwLF8xAUQJQ56ZzvRU5rMoL1JmuoNTE7cua3Hy9s6RPkqNYDxVRNcdheBW.jpg)| |-|-|-| ||*Impulse* - **Andreina Pérez**|*Dawn* - **Patricia Gudiño**|
|![1000406464.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVHPZzUfWorT29fFAQh5kVBQ1FnwYHscHTrd4Fd2bs689kSFFFN2y93E1oZpmndH5Uc.jpg)|![1000406462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsZCKbx3XFDSsuPdVk68MGuooDJ8ecWWa6DXZMBnVFk5YcodgmWyoKhFQuYqeyhGGzM.jpg)|![1000406463.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23y8x6zmKAB5wQFsa27ZSDgSgN2y2eiEgkn9Jy4XG2wJjFyJLXxTAQ9XzJXzfvkWLChVb.jpg)| |-|-|-| ||*Calm* - **Alvis Durán**|*Progress* - **Dorian**|
It was undoubtedly a fascinating exhibition. I loved it completely. I would have liked to hear the guide's talk about the pieces, but I had arrived a bit late and didn't have much time. But anyway... I hope many more exhibitions like this continue to be shown at the museum and that the public is encouraged to support the enormous artistic talent in the city of Barquisimeto 😌
### ✨ Thank you so much for visiting my post. I hope you found it interesting ✨
![sue hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK9NaQU9qAXpj3XHfJuFuP51PDfBfP12X98dVmWTSaPTVoR2n7vaDfz6sXhAE49.gif)

#
💚 Until next time! 💚

![Separador.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23ydCKUob6Veoru2WkSHzGEJYsVaCtXW1faq9AvNDGGoHQ7EK3BnMYaWz3Kvh37TGkuVa.jpg)
#
CONTENIDO EN ESPAÑOL

¡Hola a todos los integrantes de esta comunidad, amantes de la fotografía y del arte! Hace poco tuve la oportunidad de visitar el museo de **Barquisimeto (Venezuela)**, aprovechando que me encuentro de visita en la conocida como la \

. El museo, luego de una temporada cerrado, volvió a abrir sus puertas y ha estado trabajando arduamente para mantener su labor como un sitio destinado a la muestra del talento que hay no sólo en la región, sino también en el resto del país. Sigo sus redes sociales y además de exposiciones de obras, suelen hacer también conversatorios e invitaciones a artistas.
![1000406494.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wX33i9hHcfhywCuyRhVECPtzNAYbXVzV6f3RRYCa2pMvXts255hkm1U7CX2BDjCRKm3.jpg)

En esta ocasión, les hablaré de la exposición creada a partir de las obras realizadas por estudiantes del taller de escultura experimental (que envidia de la buena le tengo a los que asistieron al taller jaja), por parte del profesor y arquitecto **José Ignacio Alvarado**. La exposición se encontraba en la zona superior del museo, en una sala amplia en donde el espectador podía pasearse y apreciar a detalle cada obra.
|![1000406449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVTybryuEMANzWUeSR7FA7TN7Zn7zBwBwFjKmqBFxZfnWQG1fgmdLZgF3Z4zqnGXC83.jpg)|![1000396146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/Eos1Gp8mx7PVFqoFThFFeirq69y3oxc56Q6sRi3USCNsqmJfg1EZACLygR5VFrvcPVA.jpg)|![1000396129.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoiWBJpQ9XFpxmsYEMrVXzbz8KYrc6CUTGkds2bcT569EFhHskP5sQqhMU3ghhxiFq9.jpg)| |-|-|-|
A través de distintos materiales como el plástico, cartón, madera y acero, los estudiantes realizaron piezas basadas en la abstracción. Cada una reflejaba una forma interesante y hasta llamativa, que te llevaba a querer admirarla desde distintos ángulos, ya que, dependiendo de la perspectiva, lograbas tener una visión distinta de cada escultura. Eso me pareció fascinante y ahora que lo pienso, hubiera sido genial que grabase un poco cada una, pero, se me pasó por alto jaja.
|![1000406451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23zbU4MrzbDzACgJtZEVD33CPHdcpjSk9HuHBrXjK3jUGYKzZ3R43NwwsG9zAosLbPVFe.jpg)|![1000406452.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xKxj5dzKg2Niykx9GTVgKAhsKQNk6gQNug8Hej85do1LT9LE86U26gW3nAqX2aamAPf.jpg)|![1000406453.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23w2wQDv7rXeAbkCRMp9VZztFRHJzJnA5AtPSNX2WCcPcG5awvPrXkC6WHBEMyXfu6X8c.jpg)| |-|-|-| |*Dejar ser* - **Gabriela Bastidas**|*Ciclo de la alegría* - **Mariana Puerta**|*Elevación* - **Chrystie Mujica**|
|![1000406454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23yTfCFa2m74xg7C8dUTkFhXzwAY3TLDnmJGVnw4MXD5AS29P1bFP2pfyYNMCW3nSB5nt.jpg)|![1000406455.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wWwRNWdiZeQ5JSFRPF7k9dEuNGjJrii6SyqnYHRDgibZj8krU8vQdPYVpZPwqYR5Zn5.jpg)|![1000406456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/48Kbqy2sqY9TQnTDwatGPeNFgr5uvvcKMzNx9CHd1JhZfphgYNo6TrMaFPXfQ4CYEa.jpg)| |-|-|-| |*No te detengas* - **María Fabiola Colmenárez**|*Índigo* - **Raquel Ojeda**|*Mi atardecer* - **José Ignacio Alvarado**|
Escoger mi favorita entre todas ellas, fue difícil, ya que cada pieza tiene su toque. Pero me encanta el trabajo que hizo *Raquel Ojeda* en su obra \
. No sé si será el color de la pieza o los espirales, pero me hace pensar en un alga o una pieza marina. En \

, de *José Ignacio Alvarado*, adoro la forma en que se despliega la escultura a los lados y que precisamente, te hace pensar en las tonalidades rojizas que pueden apreciarse durante una puesta de sol y los crepúsculos aquí, se aprecian majestuosamente.
|![1000406457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVKNJ4b7dtBLG7uN49L5gQDG54PoyqpY8tTDEt3WM3XJb11JYXzPevgqWCjqA5J3MnH.jpg)|![1000406458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/EoCj3nn3ApntMTGovaoKtywS5DTrkPfWCF2VYjVAfCPLyv1rvF7C4WJph8bHwyNmVHc.jpg)|![1000406459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23wqq2UMhgsLwLF8xAUQJQ56ZzvRU5rMoL1JmuoNTE7cua3Hy9s6RPkqNYDxVRNcdheBW.jpg)| |-|-|-| ||*Impulso* - **Andreina Pérez**|*Albor* - **Patricia Gudiño**|
|![1000406464.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23xVHPZzUfWorT29fFAQh5kVBQ1FnwYHscHTrd4Fd2bs689kSFFFN2y93E1oZpmndH5Uc.jpg)|![1000406462.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23vsZCKbx3XFDSsuPdVk68MGuooDJ8ecWWa6DXZMBnVFk5YcodgmWyoKhFQuYqeyhGGzM.jpg)|![1000406463.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/23y8x6zmKAB5wQFsa27ZSDgSgN2y2eiEgkn9Jy4XG2wJjFyJLXxTAQ9XzJXzfvkWLChVb.jpg)| |-|-|-| ||*Calma* - **Alvis Durán**|*Progreso* - **Dorian**|
Sin duda, fue una exposición fascinante. Me encantó en su totalidad. Me hubiese gustado poder escuchar la charla del guía sobre las piezas, pero en ese momento había llegado algo tarde y contaba con poco tiempo. Pero, en fin... espero que muchas más exposiciones de este tipo sigan mostrándose en el museo y que el público se anime a apoyar al enorme talento artístico que hay en la ciudad de Barquisimeto 😌
### ✨ Muchas gracias por haber visitado mi publicación. Espero que les haya parecido interesante ✨
![sue hive.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/AK9NaQU9qAXpj3XHfJuFuP51PDfBfP12X98dVmWTSaPTVoR2n7vaDfz6sXhAE49.gif)

#
💚 ¡Hasta una próxima oportunidad! 💚

![Banner_firma.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/suezoe/243qKSX98HnS81RSc373SCdZCWRTfTqNYaNDPUS5jHdkJGkUn7b1TXxBkwrZPgzVjB2WH.jpg)

---
Did I like **We Need to Talk About Kevin?** Well, yes. In my personal rating (which is not relevant at all), I give it a 7/10.  

The 2011 film is a mix of retrospective and present, centered on a writer, mother of a teenager who was born to cause harm. In the leading roles we have the stellar Tilda Swinton as the writer, and the controversial Ezra Miller as Kevin, the dangerous boy.  


---

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmduSs4DWvvqtVXDvuu9Sgwo8YfL2ePMs6oWts9NtTQkJt/20260427_190431.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/xhassanv/status/2043758020652310611?s=19)</sub></center>

---
The first thing that struck me about the movie was the physical resemblance between the two lead actors. In one of the opening scenes, Eva (Swinton) submerges her face in water, and instantly it transitions to Kevin doing the same. It’s a barely perceptible image shift that reinforces the argument of their resemblance.  

Two children played Kevin’s childhood. Both Rock Dude and Jasper Newell had the physical similarity to the lead actors, but their main virtue, in my opinion, was how they conveyed the sense that a cursed seed was slowly growing inside that family’s home.  

I truly felt uncomfortable watching these kids put on hateful faces toward their mother, only to switch to sweet child mode the moment the father entered the scene. This made Eva look like an exaggerated mother in her opinions about her son.  

In fact, while watching the movie I kept wondering when Ezra Miller would appear, since I had already heard on social media that this was the role that “made him the Ezra of today.” But I think the two children had more screen time than Miller. As I said this morning in a #snap, the performances of the young Kevins were far more terrifying than Miller’s.  

And it’s not that Miller did a bad job, but honestly, I can’t conceive how this role supposedly broke his mind, since his scenes didn’t carry that much tension. I sincerely believe Ezra was already “factory-made” that way, and people just connected the dots after the movie. That’s why we shouldn’t blindly trust social media—healthy advice.  

---

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPw45NhPSAt1CnCy5N3fstd8n6CnUf6a6fdTAdJb8Y3K/20260427_190117.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/Gibboanxious/status/2045993344183202304?s=19)</sub></center>

---


The use of the bow left me with mixed feelings, since firearms dominate the landscape in school disturbances in the U.S. But I respect that they didn’t use a rifle as the deadly instrument. The British are very creative in their films, and I think the bow and arrows added important dramatic weight to the scenes where they were used.  

And you—do you think this role broke Ezra Miller, or is it just tabloid press trying to create a myth?  

---
**VERSIÓN EN ESPAÑOL**

---

<sub>En este review traté de no dar spoilers, pero creo que eso es imposible. Así que ¡¡¡Alerta de Spoilers!!!<sub>

---
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHz9EZsJBCSG6udMdPdgtiMr4TrDVpbp6MsTsH2NQ6U7/20260427_184938.jpg)<sub>[X]( https://x.com/graveofireflies/status/2045051674012553300?s=19)</sub></center>

---

¿Me gustó We need to talk about Kevin? Pues sí. En mi calificación personal ( que para nada es relevante) le doy un 7/10.

El filme de 2011 es una combinación entre retrospectiva y presente de una escritora, madre de un adolescente que nació para hacer daño. En los papeles protagónicos está la estelar Tilda Swinton como la escritora, y el polémico Ezra Miller como Kevin, el chico peligro.

-

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmduSs4DWvvqtVXDvuu9Sgwo8YfL2ePMs6oWts9NtTQkJt/20260427_190431.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/xhassanv/status/2043758020652310611?s=19)</sub></center>

---
Lo primero que me impactó de la película fue el parecido físico entre ambos actores protagonistas. En una de las primeras escenas Eva(Swinton) sumerge su rostro en el agua y al instante cambia cambian a la cara de Kevin haciendo lo mismo, siendo esta una transcisión de imágenes apenas imperceptible, y que apoya el argumento del parecido entre ambos actores. 

Dos niños interpretaron la infancia de Kevin. Tanto Rock Dude, como Jasper Newell, tenían el parecido físico con los actores protagonistas, pero su principal virtud para mí fue representar y trasmitir la sensación de que había una semilla maldito creciendo poco a poco en la casa de aquella familia.

De verdad que me sentí muy incómodo al ver a estos pequeños poner esas caras de odios a su madre  y luegoa cambiar a modo de niño dulce en el momento en que el padre entraba en la escena, con lo que conseguía hacer ver a Eva como la madre exagerada en sus opiniones sobre su hijo.

De hecho mientras veía la película me preguntaba en que momento salía Ezra Miller, pues ya había escuchado en redes sociales que este fue un papel que lo convirtió en el Ezra de hoy. Pues creo que entre los dos niños estuvieron más tiempo en pantalla que Miller, sin embargo, como ya dije esta mañana en un #snap, la actuación de los jóvenes Kevin fue mucho más aterradoras que la de Miller.

Y no es que Miller lo haya hecho mal, pero es que la verdad no concibo como este papel trastornó su mente, pues sus escenas no tenían tanta tensión. Sinceramente creo que ya Ezra venía de fábrica así, y simplemente con la película la gente ató algunos cabos. Por eso no podemos creer en redes sociales, consejo sano.

--

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbPw45NhPSAt1CnCy5N3fstd8n6CnUf6a6fdTAdJb8Y3K/20260427_190117.jpg)<sub>[X](https://x.com/Gibboanxious/status/2045993344183202304?s=19)</sub></center>

---
El uso del arco me dejó con sentimientos encontrados, pues las armas de fuego dominan el panorama en las alteraciones del orden en las escuelas norteamericanas. Pero respeto que no hayan usado un rifle como instrumento mortal. Los británicos son muy creativos en sus películas y creo el arco y las flechas fueron un elemento que le aportó carga dramática importante a las escenas donde se usó.

Y tú, ¿crees que este papel, quebró a Ezra Miller, o solo es cosa de la prensa amarilla para generar una mito?

---

title.title: Overcoming Stigma: Changing How New Jersey Views Recovery
title.body:
## Introduction: The Changing Landscape of Substance Use

For decades, the public perception of addiction has been clouded by misinformation, judgment, and a focus on moral failings rather than health outcomes. In New Jersey, as in much of the United States, we are witnessing a pivotal shift in how communities, policymakers, and healthcare providers approach the complexities of substance use disorders.

Moving beyond outdated rhetoric requires a commitment to viewing recovery through a lens of compassion and scientific literacy. By reframing addiction as a chronic health condition, we can dismantle the barriers that prevent individuals from seeking help. This transformation is not just about policy; it is about human connection and restoring the dignity of those currently navigating their path to health.

## Understanding the Roots of Social Stigma

Stigma often stems from a lack of understanding regarding the physiological changes that occur in the brain during active addiction. When society views substance use as a choice, the natural reaction is to ostracize, which serves to deepen the cycle of isolation. This isolation is perhaps the most dangerous side effect of social prejudice.

Addressing this requires community-led initiatives that promote normalization and education. Many organizations have begun hosting[ fun activities for recovering addicts](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/100-activities-during-addiction-recovery/) to prove that life in recovery is vibrant, engaging, and meaningful. By shifting the focus from the act of using to the process of living, we begin to break the psychological chains of shame.

## Integrating Clinical Science into Community Support

Recovery is a highly individualized process that often integrates a blend of behavioral therapy and, where appropriate, Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT). Clinical interventions are designed to stabilize brain chemistry, providing the physical foundation necessary for therapeutic growth.

For many, this includes medical support such as the use of[ naltrexone 50 mg](https://www.choicepointhealth.com/naltrexone-50-mg-film-coated-tablet-benefits-and-administration/), which helps manage cravings and prevents relapse by blocking the effects of opioids or alcohol. Integrating these tools into the broader recovery conversation allows us to move away from \

recovery models. It is an acknowledgment that medicine and community support are not mutually exclusive but are vital partners in the healing journey.

## The Role of Evidence-Based Care

Evidence-based practice is the cornerstone of sustainable recovery, moving treatment away from anecdotal success stories toward consistent, measurable clinical outcomes. When medical professionals and families rely on established research, the success rates of long-term sobriety increase significantly.

The[ National Institute on Drug Abuse (NIDA)](https://nida.nih.gov/) provides an extensive repository of research that highlights why comprehensive, evidence-based treatment programs are essential for reducing relapse rates. By grounding our state-wide approach in these findings, we can ensure that New Jersey remains a leader in fostering recovery environments that actually work for the people who need them most.

## Rebuilding Community and Social Capital

Recovery does not happen in a vacuum; it requires a strong social network and the ability to reintegrate into the workforce and community life. In New Jersey, the push to create \

is a major step toward normalizing the presence of individuals in recovery in professional settings.

When employers provide understanding and flexible environments, they effectively reduce the pressure that often triggers relapse. We must recognize that a stable career is not just an economic benefit—it is a cornerstone of recovery that provides purpose and daily structure.

## Education and Youth Advocacy

The most effective way to change the narrative for future generations is through early education in schools. By moving away from fear-based messaging and toward health-literacy models, we can teach youth about the realities of substance use without resorting to shame.

Programs that involve peer-to-peer mentoring have shown incredible promise in New Jersey. When young people see peers who have overcome adversity, the abstract concept of \

becomes a tangible, achievable reality. This peer-led approach helps demystify the process and humanizes the statistics.

## Legislative Shifts and Policy Reform

Changing the cultural view of recovery also necessitates legal and structural changes. New Jersey has taken significant steps to reform how non-violent substance-related offenses are handled, prioritizing diversion programs over incarceration.

These legal shifts act as a signal to the public that the state views recovery as a public health priority. When the law shifts from punitive to rehabilitative, it encourages more individuals to step forward and seek assistance without the constant fear of legal ruin.

## Creating a Sustainable Future for New Jersey

To sustain this momentum, we must maintain an open dialogue that includes clinicians, survivors, families, and policymakers. The goal is to create a culture where recovery is viewed with the same level of support as recovery from any other medical condition, such as diabetes or heart disease.

As we move forward, the focus must remain on the individual rather than the diagnosis. Every person who steps into recovery changes the lives of their friends, family, and colleagues, creating a ripple effect of healing across the entire state.

# _Bienvenidos a mi blog_ > _Welcome to my blog_ ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGXuZrTPx4zw37uSynRFdxRJ7RLNvyJgzmQK3WSgbTfXejpENryg4uJuU4zFnxXZCUC.png)
# Día del libro 📚💫

> Hola, amigos de Hive, en esta oportunidad, les vengo a hablar sobre el *23 de abril* donde se celebra el *día del libro*, una fecha muy importante a nivel nacional e internacional, también para el sistema educativo y todas aquellas personas que aman los libros, es por eso que esta efemérides la voy a tener como principal ya que leer nos ayuda en la vida 📚 Celebrar el día del libro es ideal para quillas personas que aman estar entre páginas, aquellas que miran la lectura como un ritual, es por eso importante incentivar a las población a alegría ya que es parte de nuestro desarrollo. En lo personal soy una persona que le gustan los libros, pero para ser sincera tengo mucho tiempo sin leer uno en físico, en esta época en donde he andado muy atareada me gusta más tener mi lectura en mi tablet, así es más fácil para mi leer en cualquier momento, además que tengo tiempo que no voy a comprar uno en físico que son los que más me gustan. Es importante incentivar a nuestros niños que son el futuro de esta nación a tener amor por la lectura, es por eso que en mi hijo trato de involucrar la lectura como un hábito de constancia y amor. Desde la comunidad de efemérides le doy la cordial bienvenida a esta gran fecha en este mes de abril, además disculpar a nosotros ppr no trae la iniciativa mensual. Pronto las traigo con mayor tranquilidad. Nos vemos 💫📚

> Hello, Hive friends! On this occasion, I want to talk to you about April 23rd, when World Book Day is celebrated. This is a very significant date both nationally and internationally, especially for the educational system and everyone who loves books. That’s why I’m highlighting this event today; reading truly helps us through life 📚. Celebrating Book Day is ideal for those who love being among pages and those who see reading as a ritual. That is why it’s so important to encourage people to read, as it is a vital part of our development. Personally, I love books, but to be honest, it’s been a long time since I read a physical one. Since I've been so busy lately, I prefer reading on my tablet; it’s easier for me to read at any moment. Plus, I haven't gone out to buy a physical book in a while, even though those are the ones I enjoy the most. It is vital to encourage our children—who are the future of this nation—to develop a love for reading. That is why I try to instill reading in my son as a habit of consistency and love. From the Ephemerides community, I give a warm welcome to this great date in April. Also, I want to apologize for not bringing the monthly initiative yet; I will bring them to you very soon when things are a bit calmer. See you soon! 💫📚 ---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nathyortiz/23tGXuZrTPx4zw37uSynRFdxRJ7RLNvyJgzmQK3WSgbTfXejpENryg4uJuU4zFnxXZCUC.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/805FIIt.jpg)

Le Hive Power Up Day (PUD) a lieu le premier jour de chaque mois et le prochain aura lieu dans quelques jours, **le 1er mai**.

Le Hive Power Up Day est une bonne occasion de s'amuser tout augmentant votre puissance de vote via à power-up de votre compte. HiveBuzz vous permet de **collecter des badges Power-bee** si vous participez au Hive Power Up Day et vous pouvez **gagner une délégation Hive Power** des autres sponsors de cette initiative.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pud-202605)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/es_16.png) Este post está traducido al español - **[aquí](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-es/pud-202605)**</sub>

### 1. Les niveaux Power-Bees

Plus votre power-up est important, plus grande sera votre \

.

<center>![](https://i.imgur.com/eaA0I9y.png)</center>

Voici comment les niveaux sont répartis :

|||
|-|-|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/M48UjG3.png)|Level 1 - Power up at least 10 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/XLLkbtE.png)|Level 2 - Power up at least 50 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/GVfYgM1.png)|Level 3 - Power up at least 100 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/BG6sX9y.png)|Level 4 - Power up at least 500 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/gft89yE.png)|Level 5 - Power up at least 1000 HIVE|

### 2. The Power-Up Helper

Le badge Power-Up Helper vous permet d'obtenir un badge supplémentaire lorsque vous aidez les autres à faire un Power Up.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/125x125/https://i.imgur.com/sSk3nuf.png)</center>

Soyez récompensé pour l'aide que vous apportez ! En aidant les autres à faire un power-up, vous montrez à tous à quel point le soutien mutuel est un concept important au sein de la communauté Hive.

Vous pouvez collecter **un badge PUH chaque année**, ce qui générera un effet de levier important sur la taille de nos délégations de Hive Power.

Si vous participez également au Power Up Month, plus vous avez de badges PUH, plus la délégation Hive Power que vous pouvez recevoir de notre part sera importante. Ceux qui l'ont déjà obtenu les années précédentes ont donc déjà un avantage non négligeable.

Pour plus d'information à ce sujet, [lisez le post d'annonce](/@hivebuzz-fr/pud-helper).

### Comment obtenir votre badge Power Up Day ?

1. Vous devrez effectuer un power-up de HIVE **le 1er jour du mois**. **<div class = \

> IMPORTANT: ** HiveBuzz utilisera des **date et heure UTC** pour valider le moment ou vous aurez effectué votre power-up. Par conséquent, vérifiez votre fuseau horaire et **convertissez votre heure locale en UTC** avant de faire votre power-up !
Pour vous aider à ne pas manquer le bon moment où vous pouvez faire votre power-up, nous avons ajouté un [compte à rebours](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-fr/pud-countdown) sur notre site web. ![](https://i.imgur.com/yHr0zsy.png) 2. Vous devez **faire un power-up d'au moins 10 HIVE** ! Cela vous donnera droit à la plus petite \
. Plus important votre power-up, plus grande sera la \

que vous recevrez.</br>Vous pouvez faire plusieurs power-up. La somme des power-ups effectués sera comptabilisé à la fin de la journée.

3. Il n'est pas nécessaire de faire sotre powe-up en une seule fois. L'ensemble de vos power-up de HIVE seront comptabilisé en fin de la journée.

Suivez scrupuleusement ces règles et ce badge sera le vôtre!

Les badges seront distribués aux utilisateurs répondant aux critères definis ci-avant à la fin du Power Up Day.

### Pourquoi participer au Hive PUD?

La première raison (pour nous) est de s'amuser ensemble.

Ensuite, en plus de rendre votre vote plus précieux et d'augmenter vos récompenses de curation (de même que de recevoir de l'intérêt pour les HP ainsi accumulé), vous renforcerez également votre influence sur la blockchain.

Enfin, ajoutez à cela que plusieur membres de la communauté offrent aux participants de Hive PUD des prix comprenant des délégations, des dons de HIVE et plein d'autres choses sympas, et vous aurez une bonne raison supplémentaire d'y participer.

title.title: Hive Power Up Day - 1 de mayo de 2026
title.body:
![](https://i.imgur.com/0NPOQFQ.png)

El Hive Power Up Day(PUD) toma lugar el primero de cada mes y el próximo será en unos días, **1 de mayo**.

El Hive Power Up Day es una gran oportunidad para divertirse mientras aumenta su poder de voto a través de power-ups en su cuenta. HiveBuzz te permite **coleccionar insignias Power-bee** si participas en el Hive Power Up Day y puedes **ganar una delegación Hive Power** de los otros patrocinadores de esta iniciativa.

<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/en_16.png) This post is translated in English - **[here](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pud-202605)**</sub>
<sub>![](https://arcange.eu/images/flags/fr_16.png) Une version en français de ce post est disponible - **[ici](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz-fr/pud-202605)**</sub>

### 1. Los Niveles de Power-Bee

Mientras más HIVE hagas Power Up en el día del PUD, más grande será tu power-bee.

<center>![](https://i.imgur.com/eaA0I9y.png)</center>

Así es como se distribuyen los niveles:

|||
|-|-|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/M48UjG3.png)|Nivel 1: power up al menos 10 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/XLLkbtE.png)|Nivel 2: power up al menos 50 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/GVfYgM1.png)|Nivel 3: power up al menos 100 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/BG6sX9y.png)|Nivel 4: power up al menos 500 HIVE|
|![](https://images.hive.blog/50x50/https://i.imgur.com/gft89yE.png)|Nivel 5: power up al menos 1000 HIVE|

### 2. El Ayudante de Power-Up 

La insignia de Ayudante de Power-Up te permite obtener una insignia más cuando ayudas a otros a hacer power-up.

<center>![](https://images.hive.blog/125x125/https://i.imgur.com/sSk3nuf.png)</center>

¡Sé recompensado por la ayuda que brindas! Al ayudar a otros a power up, les muestra a todos lo importante que es el apoyo mutuo en la comunidad de Hive.

Puede obtener **una insignia de PUH cada año**, lo que generará un efecto de apalancamiento significativo en el tamaño de nuestras delegaciones de Hive Power.

Si también participa en Power Up Month, cuantas más insignias de PUH tenga, más delegación de Hive Power podrá recibir de nosotros. Aquellos que ya lo han obtenido en años anteriores por lo tanto ya tienen una ventaja significativa.
Para más información sobre esto, [lea el post de anuncio](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pud-helper).

### Como obtener tu insignia de Power Up Day?

1. Deberá hacer power up a HIVEs **el 1er día del mes**. **<div class=\

>IMPORTANTE:** HiveBuzz usará **fecha y hora UTC** para validar cuándo se realiza el power up. Por lo tanto, verifique su zona horaria y **convierta su hora local a UTC** antes de hacer power up. Para ayudarlo a no perderse el momento en que puede hacer su power up, [agregamos una cuenta regresiva](/hivebuzz/@hivebuzz/pud-countdown) a nuestro sitio web. ![](https://i.imgur.com/yHr0zsy.png) 2. **Power-up al menos 10 HIVE**. Esto te garantizara la más pequeña power-bee. ¡Mientras más HIVE haga power up, más grande será tu power-bee!
3. No tienes que hacer un solo power up. Todo el Hive que hagas powered up durante el día será contado al finalizar el día.
¡Sigue estas reglas estrictamente y la insignia estará en tu tablero! Las insignias y delegaciones serán distribuidas a todos los participantes que hayan cumplido con las reglas al finalizar el Power Up Day. ### Por qué participar en el Hive PUD? La primera razón es divertirse. Además, hacer que su voto sea más valioso y aumentar sus recompensas de curación (así como ganar interés en su participación), también fortalecerá su influencia en la blockchain. Finalmente, varios miembros de la comunidad están ofreciendo premios, delegaciones, y otras cosas divertidas a los participantes. --- #
Esta listo y haz Power Up!

title.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 26 2026
title.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b24b7823-1aad-4ff6-8659-0a1d4769ab71.jpg) Hey Actifitters, Yesterday confirmed that in my current form, my run the day before was probably a bit too much, as soreness started to set in. Being like Le Chat was very tempting. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9a0b47d3-1b96-420e-b898-b991efa04f91.jpg) But we can't do that, Kaia wouldn't accept it! So we started our daily walk as usual behind the front yard, where Kaia and Le Chat could get a quick grassy snack. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/2c04cd88-1f31-4898-873a-4445576f5904.jpg) Then we headed to the bigger forest of course. As often, even before we made it into the forest, we met a few deer. This one let me get very close and combined with my phone zoom, that's a great close up. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d0b7a995-fb9f-4c8a-9fdf-a73eca00cb51.jpg) Then Kaia was off-leash on the trails, no more deer for a while. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9e85909d-5e9e-43e2-a41c-e61f4b32308c.jpg) No surprise, my main goal was to catch the sun through the trees. As I mentioned so many times, that's always one of my favorites. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d764e13e-abf8-4ef8-a0f7-f11588145c7d.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8d9b99e9-b437-4392-ba32-c719d4de4e88.jpg) Kaia took full advantage of the off-leash freedom, exploring and chasing everything. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/c3be85f9-f339-4504-8015-ce624dba44f9.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e83b4c0f-b57e-42e4-b6db-accd42f9ff07.jpg) And I kept chasing the sun of course. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/967fb000-35d1-4c45-a9a9-9a8c31776783.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/cd1c7db5-fbb0-4c41-bbd3-0a6bdcc86acc.jpg) We also made our usual sunset stop. Even around 8pm, still plenty of time to catch it. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/80984060-8f72-4be4-a502-1fdc3dd1359c.jpg) We changed up our final loop in the forest a little bit but that didn't fool Kaia, she led us out of the forest with no issues. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/4cdc092d-5ab1-4d6e-84c1-e916cf72c1b4.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/db2065b1-adaf-4b53-b128-11eeefab356a.jpg) When we were done, we still had a beautiful blue sky and the Moon high up already. Always magnificent! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/fdf5ce83-d9cf-4032-9960-09959bfb3334.jpg) Besides our usual walk, there was something I couldn't postpone anymore, the maintenance of the lawn mower. I received all I needed a few days ago, but just didn't want to do it. All filters are now changed, oil is drained and just needs to be refilled, spark plug is changed. It's pretty much all done. But I realized too late I was missing something critical though: gas. I guess the actual yard work will wait a few more days. One more reason I prefer winter, no yard work! As always, thanks for stopping by and see you tomorrow.

Hola a todos, soy Humansleep. En esta ocasión quiero publicar mi trabajo en la comunidad Alien Art Hive. Y aquí también compartiré el proceso de trabajo, ya sea dibujo o boceto.
> The soul cannot scream, The spirit has no lungs to scream with.

---
---
---

That hallway was never truly silent; it was just good at pretending to be silent. Its walls were damp and musty, like lungs struggling to breathe after holding back tears for too long.

No one knows when the passageway appeared. Some say it was born from prayers that failed to reach the heavens. Others believe the passageway is the rotting remnant of the world, a place where lost souls are gathered before being forgotten entirely.

There were no footsteps, not even a single sound inside. Only silence, alive like a hungry creature. In the middle of the hallway, a soul drifted. It had no name, no face. Only a vague form, like mist that had forgotten how to be human.

He doesn’t remember when he died—or whether he ever truly lived. He only remembers the sound of dripping water, the scent of wet earth, and a faint ache in his chest—as if someone had once pulled something out of his body and then forgotten to put it back.

Every second, the hallway seemed to whisper something—not with words... but with a foul feeling. A feeling that clung to my mind like mold on a damp wall.

Those hands slowly reached out from the damp pores of the wall, imparting a touch of cold solitude. Like the longing for a memory of someone long buried but who still refuses to leave.

The silence in the hallway suddenly took on a different quality. It felt heavier. Closer. As if the darkness around me had begun to watch.

The hands kept reaching out, this time more clearly. Like hands... but too long. Like fingers... but too many. Something in the darkness was trying to sense its presence.

The soul cannot scream. The spirit has no lungs to scream with. But there is something worse than a scream. Awareness. It begins to realize that this corridor is not just a place or a space.

This is a living being. That damp wall? Skin. The shifting mist? Breath. And the silence he had always thought was emptiness... is the invisible hands that slowly reach out to every soul lost within it. Gently, slowly, and softly. Almost like love.

But that’s exactly what makes it so terrifying. Because the soul finally understands one thing: This creature doesn’t feed on bodies—it feeds on loneliness. And a soul that has been alone for too long… is the ripest of all meals.

---
---

This work was created with ink on paper, using a pencil.

Sketch:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYMGZAy1Fqg1BMZ4XdrHwzj4k6LUuM3UEq5BdhuykoGz/1777321890642.jpg)</center>

Outline:
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHBjrHncS6JBdmZYQ7bpX61p2K87G6AkA9aLt67FnQ3o/1777322193581.jpg)</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJcGvPdJcukj123xV6tD1HaG9M7E7JgMCknxKcTMJpi2/1777322277140.jpg)</center>

---
---

The corridor grew narrower, the touches more frequent. And for the first time in who knows how long—that soul longed to die again. But in a place like this... even death refused to come.

<center>To Be Continued...</center>

---
---

This is all I can say for right now, sorry if there are wrong words or my typing is not perfect.

Thank you for taking the time just to stop by and see my work, and see you in my next work. 🖐👽

[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-ai-image/blockchain-technology-cartoon-illustration_208594050.htm#fromView=search&page=2&position=46&uuid=dd62a5e6-ef3d-4918-b7ef-d55eecdc4390&query=Marketing%2C+workforce+and+machineries+AI+generated+) 
Another [day](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day), another experience, that's the entrepreneurial [life](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-life). When you think you’ve nailed it but just realized there is room for improvement. Should I be delving into this or make it a [story](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-story) for a different day. Maybe the latter because from the [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) topic above, I have a trio to iron out.  

Sometimes visions can be blurred until you take some needed steps. It can be through writing or [acting](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-acting) it out. I had to do both in the [space](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-space) of two [weeks](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-week). The [world](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-world) is full of problems looking for people to solve it. Just make yourself available and up to the task and you get compensated with [wealth](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-wealth).   

Talking of being up to the task, how up to the task are we? Big dreams need horsepower to scale. When I pitched our [grant](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-grant) [proposal](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-proposal-hive) in writing, there were a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) of things I discovered. First, an [opportunity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-opportunity) beyond what I first saw and to add another, the need for upgrades and advanced processes.  

When pitching our [video](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-video) earlier this week, it was another stunner. I got some [comments](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-comment-hive) and likes although I would have preferred it directly on the grant page asides from my reshared link. The former puts me on a high chance of making it to the next [stage](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-stage) and the latter, well, I can just call it [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) advertisement.  

So what did I learn? What we are lacking; a trio that if I can help resolve as a [manager](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-manager) we will be scaling [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit) beyond what we can currently imagine.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaTmsEBFJWugVcWUZo8pVHqvio4TDhijCRd8toTTfC1Xi/1000174216.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-vector/business-start-up-concept-illustration_5505474.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=8&uuid=dd62a5e6-ef3d-4918-b7ef-d55eecdc4390&query=Marketing%2C+workforce+and+machineries+AI+generated+) 
Many don't even know what we do and some just think it is that road side business again. Of course, we have been working underground and quietly trying to surface a brand overtime and I guess it is [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) we start some needed test running. We are eyeing growth and growth is dependent on [capital](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-capital). This can come in as profit, grants, [loans](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-loans) or [investors](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investor) and it boils down to marketing.   

More eyes need to see and know what we do. This is where I am planning to invest the needed capital to grow our [audience](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-audience). I have talked with several advertisers and marketers. 

The last meeting I had with a proposed advertiser was how possible he sees how weekly [revenue](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-revenue) target in [terms](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-term-insurance) of minimum [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) needed. 

His response was very encouraging, asides from trying to secure a place as our [social media](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-social-media) handler, the figures looked very realistic.  

So what happens next, what if after two or three [months](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month), boom! [contracts](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-contract-real-estate) start kicking in. Maybe it should have been ‘Machineries, Workforce and marketing’. 

Going from this direction means we will have to spend big aforehand. Consider how much it will take us to personally pull out this capital. To cut everything [short](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-short-selling), precise and simple, this is the needed trio.   

We will need a [professional](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-professional) working force to back up our marketing. It is [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) about strategy, one can do little with much no doubt. Nevertheless, one should also consider how much can be achieved with more. If you want a professional worker to comply with you, make everything about your business very professional. From a conducive working environment to efficient machines and needed working equipments.   

To conclude, let me add, our Machineries and equipment are not enough. As we speak, it seems our current office, which we used to call a [warehouse](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-warehouse), is becoming too small to contend with the vision at hand. From pitching, I have a much clearer picture to run with and I won't hesitate to make the most of it.

title.title: Weekly ish Running Update...progress with that aerobic base!
title.body:
Three short but classic runs last  week, showing some progress I think! 

### 20th April - 6K easy...

![Screenshot_20260427_231819_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23vPGiDbLwfesdNNiBks1RhyPQ1dG9TUu34itqGSr9UC6Qx3xPFuucF9oj4Pv6Wcc5Vpo.jpg)

Just a nice easy 6.20 minute paced run, note the low heart rate, I think this is something of a break through! 

### 20th April - slighly lazy 800M intervals 

I headeded to the track and wasn't feeling in the mood for 400s so I bashed out some 800s instead...


![Screenshot_20260427_231703_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23wM4oNst24Fto3ERZ5Kf7Mh1xGV2f7vQy74U9YXUQ4mS9Z6EeCayoiLBcCsgUH1fjVgk.jpg)

So that's one warm up and then 4 proper 800s at a decent pace. 


Paces as below...


![Screenshot_20260427_231750_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/23swgECbxMzwrj2b2dNDPhutyHNPtSqw25dFihBuTo2GzoudLJm7vcrJ5VDUfFf2wm5Ay.jpg)

I am reasonably happy with that as a bar, I was a bit tired, but was still up for a few 200s but had a 5 minute stop and chat with a runner friend and that just cooled me right down so I called it a day easy! 

### 24th April - 6K easy...

![Screenshot_20260427_231642_Garmin Connect.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/revisesociology/EoPN4rHEYrsrpSoFpzoEoiVatFDMKQcpHRzEu6kv5CEzF2TpSiRPUpgH1ZN2XBy7aDm.jpg)

Pretty much a rinse and repeat of the previous slow run, almost exact HR, this is my new base heart rate run, lower I think than in previous weeks. 

### Final thoughts...

This is my new basic running pattern - a classic easy, hard, easy - Monday, Weds, Friday in this case. 

I am quite happy with this...

title.title: Digital Archaeology: Floppy Disk #14 – DEC84.DOC
title.body:
></center>

A summary for those that haven't necessarily been keeping up with this series:

I found a number of 5.25\

disk drive and extracting the contents a several years back. Since then, I have been occasionally posting the content here.

Based on the contents, most or all of these disks were apparently once owned by someone named Connie who used to run the “Close Encounters” Special Interest Group (SIG) on Delphi in the mid 1980s.

The following description of this SIG was found in a document on one of the disks: \

This service was text based and was accessed via a modem and whatever terminal program you had available for your computer to dial in with. Many of these disks have forum messages, e-mails and chat session logs. All of this is pre-internet stuff and I am not aware of any archives in existence today that contain what was on Delphi in the 1980s.

>
</center>

This post includes the contents of DEC84.DOC. Similar to the last few posts in this series, this appears to be a report that gives details on the usage of the SIG (how many hours each user spent in the SIG, etc.). This is in the form of an e-mail from someone named KELLY who was presumably an employee of Delphi. The e-mail is dated January 18th, 1985. 

There are two SIGs (Special Interest Groups) that have been mentioned repeatedly in these files. One is the \
SIG and the other is the \
SIG though I'm not entirely sure they were different. \

is mentioned in this report but maybe this is an alias or the name changed again at some point. \n\nThis report includes username, sessions (number of times the user called), prime minutes (this was probably online time during peak hours when a more expensive per minute charge was applied), and off-prime minutes (probably online time during off peak hours that were either \

with your monthly subscription, or at least much cheaper).

There are also a couple of other e-mails here discussing these reports. One interesting tidbit is that apparently 'SIGOPS' earned royalties (more like a commission if you ask me) based on usage. I guess this makes sense as users paid a monthly fee to access Delphi and also a per minute usage charge.  After all, SIGOPS would have been responsible for running groups that led to people spending more time (and therefore more money) online.

This file is dated September 2nd, 1985 and was in a subdirectory titled \

. This is the last of the SIG usage reports, at least on this disk.
=-= DEC84.DOC =-=
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqKix8q39K7DKoCS31PDrwd52GzLpD6FKN6M677Ynpyp/dec841.jpg)

title.title: Majestic volcano
title.body:
> ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPL91HH2zwxvHfTQTJJrGKWSHuipj9NP3fAWvo7fpi3LW/1777328231440.jpg) ![separator2.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMa7EifqXSjKGqGjSzs4d9eNGjhV129o5S1XYGh2hUVQ/separator2.png) This is Mount Agung, the biggest volcano here in Bali. She is so beautiful and majestic, standing tall and strong. And we can enjoy her posture, from the fertile rice field at her feet, which is there because of her blessing. When I was a kid, I hardly noticed her, as maybe I was too small to understand everything, and during my younger years, I had been mostly away from her, working in the other side of the island, which offered more hope from the Tourism industry. But now in my 30's, I am back to appreciate her beauty and her blessing for the fertile land. Almost most of the day, on a clear day or on an overcast day, she offers me a spectacular view of her and the clouds around her, which is always different every day. The other thing that makes me grateful for her calm state is that I had seen her wrath in 2017, when she showed us her destructive power. Yep, she was awakened, and sent fear all across the area when she was erupted. Somehow, she woke up in the middle of her 100-year cycle. So many geologists predicted that she would erupt big time, but then somehow she slowed down and finally calmed down after a few months and went back to her sleep state. Now everything is back to normal, and we can appreciate her beauty, but as a person who lives solely from her mercy, I have to always remember to not take it for granted, as she can decide to wake up and take everything back. something that most of the active majestic volcanoes do. ||| | || |------------|------------| ------------| ------------| ------------| | Photo Style | Mixed Photography || Accesory | Normal Lens | Location | Bali, Indonesia| |Lighting |Natural Light | | Gear | Infinix note 30 Pro| |Diffuser | None |

Hello all, good day and welcome to my blog. I could remember when we relocated to a new location, and I was to be in school with new faces, people and  characters, to be honest with you I was afraid.
![namikazeminato-young-8208513_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/favour20045/244KZxrvSpx5d5ee2kkis9RdkYp4HeueVsL9aL7FDyBL3W4mGAo8sFWjDrk39NsfPgBk4.jpg)[img sir](https://pixabay.com/photos/young-sea-friend-outdoors-beach-8208513/)

But in my first week of school I the fear was still there but this time it wasn't that much because I began to fit with the environment around me. The next term I was more confidential that before because I start mingling with some of my classmates, which made me feel among the class.. 
School is really a long term process and achievement, because it's either it breaks you or it makes you. School is kind of challenge for me, because if the bills I have to pay and when I go higher the bills follows too.
In my basic school days, I had friends but there was this friend who meant our relationship and was other bond bond became strong just after of basic.
Those days I could remember giving him answers and his giving me on the day of exams.

![sasint-children-1822688.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/favour20045/23wqrWgfD7NGQMPvzUPthrhkb9wiA7hxwZj7Ma87xF8YvUzEFB9cLhyFWYUsc2n7Mwat4.jpg)[img sir](https://pixabay.com/photos/children-splash-asia-sunset-1822688/)

We share things and we act as tho we are from the same house, but he actually lives miles away from me. He made me understand that those who you feel or think are there for, will mess you up when you need the the most, my relationship with him exposed me to many things.
Am glad we are friends till date, true friends must learn how to sacrifice, endure and supportive,
If this quality are not found in you as a friend, then you are not a friend, it's better forw to have one true friend than have multiple who missed all this quality and only causes pains to me. One of the greatest achievements I received from school is my friend..
And am greatfull..
Thank you for reading..

title.title: Crocheted baskets, thoughtful gifts for Mom💝
title.body: > Greetings and blessings, my dear crafting friends. I hope you’re all doing well and staying healthy, and that this week is filled with productivity and creativity. For this Monday with needles, I’m here to tell you that I’m already at that time of year when I start thinking with great excitement about gifts for moms. Mother’s Day is approaching, and I like to get a head start and imagine gifts that convey love in every stitch. That’s why, these past few days, I’ve been knitting with lots of love some little baskets or jar covers for the gifts I’ll have for sale. I’m crocheting these covers using a combination of double crochet and slip stitches on the front, because they create a very special texture. They feel firm to the touch, yet delicate at the same time, and visually they have a charm that makes them unique. Each piece takes shape little by little, and in that process I also find a space of calm and connection with myself.

> Saludos y bendiciones, mis queridas amigas de las agujas. Espero que estén muy bien con salud y bienestar y que sea una semana de mucho provecho y creatividad. Para este lunes de agujas vengo a contarles que ya estoy en ese momento del año en el que empiezo a pensar con mucha ilusión en los detalles para las mamás. Ya se acerca la celebración de las madres y me gusta anticiparme e imaginar obsequios que transmitan cariño en cada puntada. Por eso, estos días he estado tejiendo con mucho amor unas cestitas o fundas para frascos para los regalos que tendré a la venta. Estas fundas las estoy tejiendo con una combinación de puntos altos y puntos relieve por delante, porque crean una textura muy especial. Al tacto se sienten firmes, pero al mismo tiempo delicadas, y visualmente tienen un encanto que las hace únicas. Cada pieza va tomando forma poco a poco, y en ese proceso encuentro también un espacio de calma y conexión conmigo misma. https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23y98QhDrmWymhZfyTZNFWYw6u11UR7wNMrk1LGMdY6ZMAyz6ZH5kyNB3emmkXutStpd9.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23yx3rcDhRFzmKacLkJZ1RndT7DUs1GZY46fJ2xLdWYuQ9hh5JqetsKHCSfDxeTpWbm8V.jpg| |--|--| |https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23z7SWsLXjpSom7WXSUMB6e138EX2RxJyv7rqnLngTmxDCVF5jo4iG5WZb1d49ikVSY5f.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23y8zJfseNYodB8GTAuFMEk9JHTSXMUqaaqj6w2cKY5V71Tp5iFAMsvLeqWToM1ELkDeP.jpg| |--|--| https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aurodivys/23wgqRo1bwnfDcTpN2zX4cHNW25bVGgA7P6nkbUjh2WWfXX6QAwE5ZPpDkNj9CktarytX.png

> For the colors, I went with a classic choice: 100% acrylic yarn in white and pink. There’s something very sweet and soft about this combination, which makes each little basket look beautiful and cozy. I like to think that these shades convey that sense of care and love that moms embody so well. As a finishing touch, I added a pink fabric ribbon that gives them a special, tender touch. As I knit, I imagine the jars filled with little gifts, sweets, messages, or whatever each person wants to give. I’m not sure yet how I’ll present them, but I know they’ll be gifts made with lots of love to honor the purest and most unconditional love in life.

> Para los colores, me fui por lo clásico: hilo 100% acrílico en blanco y rosa. Esta combinación tiene algo muy dulce y suave, que hace que cada cestita luzca hermosa y acogedora. Me gusta pensar que estos tonos aportan esa sensación de cuidado y amor que tanto representa a las mamás. Como complemento les puse una cinta de tela de color rosado que le da un toque tierno especial. body.title: “Thawing”这个词让我想到冬季冰雪融化的过程，带来
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/g3730b6def15cfcb4f15c88fa25a81db7af3c905be53913a10f4b3f8bdfa5a227c8df62d10add0e5962718d7bd124d52792b52deb31987c4ed05024ceee465e63_640.jpg)</center>

***

“Thawing”给人一种温暖而又恬静的感觉，就像是冬季的寒冰在阳光的照耀下慢慢融化，唤醒了沉睡的大地。过程中，有一种期待与希望的交织，仿佛万物复苏、生命重新焕发活力。这种变化不仅表达了自然的轮回，也让我想到了生活中的转变，经历寒冷与压制后，总会迎来新的开始。在这样的时刻，我感受到内心深处的宁静与安慰。

body.title: 🐻 Monedero de osito, ternura hecha con retazos de tela🐻.//🐻 Teddy bear coin purse, cuteness made with fabric scraps 🐻.(Esp-Eng)
body.body:
>Hola amigos de diyhub,un saludo para todos ustedes espero hayan tenido un fin de semana agradable y estén listo para acompañarme en el día de hoy para mostrarles como transforme pequeños retazos de tela en un tierno monedero, está vez no quise tirar nada a la basura,mejor decidí aprovechar cada pedacito de tela.* # > Hello DIY Hub friends, greetings to all of you. I hope you had a pleasant weekend and are ready to join me today to show you how I transformed small scraps of fabric into a cute coin purse. This time I didn't want to throw anything away, so I decided to make the most of every little piece of fabric. --- # #
Materiales/Materials
 #
![1000265030.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPeLjYvpE1X2cZ7kBUbCZbRGSRrJvQhGuAbRphdT2ygxC/1000265030.png)
# * Retazos de tela marrón y blanca * Cierre o cremallera verde * Cuentas negras para ojos y nariz * Hilo y aguja * Tijeras # >* Brown and white fabric scraps >* Green zipper >* Black beads for eyes and nose >* Thread and needle >* Scissors # --- # #
Paso a paso/Step by step
 #
![1000265039.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcoeAF3xhqZcd6G9W6R6nSe3LuroaCJsNJ5FydqtVrWJ6/1000265039.jpg)
![1000265040.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbZdZArD725HVUsA6stFWj7bX2p5ZKsG9LPmkua2tPMga/1000265040.jpg)
![1000265043.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUofurne5WjKtSLpbibPYmWt33NhJ2LpxXKbR1QG2xogM/1000265043.jpg)
![1000265044.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXkTF3pRik6HJYr5nviphbfmkpFgcwpe1E7ShLYyPYeBn/1000265044.jpg)
![1000265041.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS2dRrAarbUw5WvKGTmGy5bHkj61X9rPAazRAqfpPPsQo/1000265041.jpg)
# * #### Paso 1 **

>comencé por marcar el patrón de un monedero de mano pequeño que tenía,y entonces lo marque sobre una hoja de papel,luego pase a marcar lo mismo pero sobre la tela marrón, doble la tela a la mitad de manera que quedará doble y luego marque y recorte la forma,corte dos partes porque sera para la parte de adentro y de afuera.** > * #### Step 1 > I started by marking the pattern of a small handbag I had, and then I marked it on a sheet of paper, then I went on to mark the same thing but on the brown fabric, I folded the fabric in half so that it would be double and then I marked and cut out the shape, I cut two parts because it will be for the inside and outside. ---
![1000265045.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQb3EhYRdwg6KC73SPjospfvHTz2rFPV8FU5Sy8qdWtyZ/1000265045.jpg)
![1000265046.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNiamtX3mq72q3qbo4B7rHpgfeobqZN1uFyW9hMnKvMnG/1000265046.jpg)
# * #### Paso 2 **

>Lugo cosi las dos partes,dejando solo la parte en forma cuadrada de las esquinas de abajo sin coser.Luego cosi el cierre,lo colo del lado de frente a la tela y fui cosiendo un lado primero,y después pase del otro lado del monedero.** > * #### Step 2 > Lugo sewed the two parts together, leaving only the square-shaped part at the bottom corners unsewn. Then I sewed the zipper, placing it on the front side of the fabric and sewing one side first, and then I moved to the other side of the coin purse. ---
![1000265048.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYdGWmFm5Urz19qNwBsX2VDWEVGxAYsybMsB5vgbBtZDZ/1000265048.jpg)
# * #### Paso 3 **

>Después cosi la parte cuadrada de abajo, después de que esa parte estaba cosida le di la vuelta al monedero y así se ve ya una vez cosido todo.** > * #### Step 3 > Then I sewed the square bottom part, after that part was sewn I turned the coin purse inside out and this is what it looks like once everything is sewn. ---
![1000265049.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUnUH1wp8QVjJsrPjmSq6BjZ6qmKqmZmYadYSDi1rQTPw/1000265049.jpg)
![1000265050.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQme1hxm2Q8wj6Yd67vfenGMK25aiGTCJWZj6cVsdjQwE3k/1000265050.jpg)
![1000265051.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPe9wJhep8HUZtnbgJs8Nvj4JePpkUeqyi6SBRxxGD59o/1000265051.jpg)
# * #### Paso 4 **

>Como ya tenía el monedero listo,me puse a hacer la decoración, entonces tome un recorte de tela y marque la forma de arco,que será para hacer las orejas del osito, entonces cosi la forma y luego le di la vuelta,y así se ven las orejitas ya cosidas.** > * #### Step 4 > Since I already had the coin purse ready, I started decorating it. I took a piece of fabric and marked the shape of an arch, which will be used to make the teddy bear's ears. Then I sewed the shape and turned it inside out, and this is how the ears look once they're sewn on. ---
![1000265052.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmxXSTLrytQGKDWSmgQYzpELRaXrbURtxS6KfbBFhkmd/1000265052.jpg)
![1000265053.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUu87aCNnYUa2JZNBZVCgJdXbGH2GeuqJ392Dkh7QRKuD/1000265053.jpg)
![1000265054.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNV3U9naWNTQ92CJ81FfDUAT7cpwaKstPGL1QzstpGioL/1000265054.jpg)
# * #### Paso 5 **

>Ya cuando tenía las dos orejitas listas pase a coser las al monedero,las cosi a los lados.** > * #### Step 5 > Once I had both little ears ready, I proceeded to sew them onto the coin purse, sewing them on the sides. ---
![1000265063.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4cwZcHAeZmZNKaP4UquUZnqqnkPFaagEqQ3vjT7nUCS/1000265063.jpg)
![1000265064.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbeM2ivqe1uhJ7mEKSgpmyrVXJx5sRa9Vthf1AtQLUZTZ/1000265064.jpg)
![1000265066.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUTTi8uwLc5z1B9xkJ1th1JfYnS8dyn4wxXm5JWTr3xq/1000265066.jpg)
# * #### Paso nro 6 **

>Con los retazos de color blanco,recorte la parte de la nariz y ojos,luego marque en dónde iban a estar ubicados,y empecé a coserlos a mano también. Y quedó la carita del osito.** > * #### Step 6 > Using the white scraps, I cut out the nose and eyes, then marked where they would go, and started sewing them on by hand. And that's how the little bear's face turned out. ---
![1000265067.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmXfNWYPGAvXJyQgxxWb4SU8zC5bow9SDQ2w8F2HS9n7/1000265067.jpg)
![1000265068.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU2JcHMjkkcQkvZkBgSNirYgbxYy7aFbdxXTF9ycE5en9/1000265068.jpg)
# * #### Paso 7 **

>Y como último detalle,le cosi las cuentas de color negro en los ojos para simular las pupilas,y en la nariz también cosi una cuenta.** > * #### Step 7 > And as a final detail, I sewed black beads onto the eyes to simulate pupils, and I also sewed a bead onto the nose. --- #
Resultado||Result
 #
![1000265117.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSvVMYMg8fEFJ7HDP7d1Xdyt6hnPKPX2VSZz622akGdA1/1000265117.jpg) ![1000264944.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXj7UkWTjYQXHaVmhWZfcAZ28Getj7nJxYU7yyDpfm9J2/1000264944.jpg)
# *

>Me encanta cómo quedó,es pequeño, práctico y único además me da mucha satisfacción saber que ayudé al planeta usando retazos que normalmente terminarían en la basura. Gracias a todos por haberme acompañado hoy 👋* # > I love how it turned out! It's small, practical, and unique, plus it gives me so much satisfaction to know I helped the planet by using scraps that would normally end up in the trash. Thanks to everyone for joining me today 👋 --- # *

body.title: Creciendo en Hive /ESP-ENG
body.body: Me ha gustado bastante ser parte de la Web3, especialmente aquí creando blogs. Les cuento: antes tenía un Facebook y solía compartir mis imágenes ahí en esa red social, pero luego dejé de publicar. En Instagram subo pocas imágenes, entonces la red donde estoy más activo, compartiendo más de mis fotos y blogs, es aquí en Hive.

> Foto realizada con flow Quería contarles con este párrafo mi participación en la Web2. También publico en LinkedIn, pero ahí son más temas profesionales. Ahora, aquí en Hive siento que puedo explorar mi pasión por los deportes. He venido escribiendo en Fulldeportes sobre el Real Madrid, un equipo que sigo desde pequeño y que conecta con mi pasión de la infancia; por eso me gusta escribir sobre ellos.

> Foto creada con flow Otra comunidad donde publico es Holos & Lotus; ahí los temas están relacionados al ser humano. Son temas muy diversos y me gusta esa comunidad porque me siento identificado con su contenido. Muy pronto escribiré sobre emprendimiento o mi experiencia que he tenido; esperen más posts míos en otras comunidades nuevas. Decidí escribir aquí para que conozcan más quién soy, ya que si me han leído participando en dinámicas, me ha gustado Hive y sigo publicando contenido en las comunidades que les mencioné, para que en alguna ocasión, si quieren saber qué escribo y dónde me pueden encontrar, ya lo tengan claro. Me invitó @elizabeths14 a Hive. Fue porque participé en una charla en la comunidad de la Cryptomanada de Yis, y como me gustaba crear blogs y también quería encontrar una manera de crear contenido donde pudiera recibir recompensa por lo que creaba, dije: aquí es el lugar. Empecé a crear contenido más enfocado en lo que me gusta y, claro decidí seguir escribiendo y creciendo. También se unió prácticamente al mismo tiempo que yo @waralotito, y me ha gustado ver todo el contenido que crea. Me gusta apoyarla comentando sus posts porque escribe muy bien. También me gusta buscar nuevas maneras de actualizarme al crear contenido. Me ha tocado explorar diversas herramientas para crear imágenes; ahora mi favorita es Flow. Antes usaba mucho Sora, pero como desaparecerá, me toca encontrar nuevas aplicaciones. Si conocen alguna interesante, me gustaría que me la compartieran en los comentarios. Ahora les cuento: empecé a publicar, como les mencioné, en Fulldeportes contenido de actualidad del Real Madrid. Aquí siempre me toca analizar sus juegos, leer lo que dicen los comentaristas e investigar para crear un buen blog de calidad. También, en esa misma comunidad, he escrito sobre los Yankees, sobre mi experiencia en el gym o también mi experiencia en el ciclismo. Ahora también he escrito en Holos & Lotus. Aquí el contenido es muy diverso: temas de salud, pensamientos sobre distintos temas; por ejemplo, mi último post fue sobre la salud. Me ha encantado recibir los comentarios de los hivers. En ocasiones he recibido feedback sobre mis posts, lo cual me agrada porque sé que si otras personas me dan consejos para mejorar, es una buena señal. Claro, tomo esos consejos y los aplico en el siguiente post para escribir mejor. Si tienen algún comentario sobre mis posts, estaré encantado de leerlos. Sí he tenido algunos desafíos al comienzo, porque escribir en otras comunidades me ha obligado a leer sus reglas: qué se debe hacer y qué no. Como hay muchas comunidades, me toca analizar dónde debo poner mi mayor esfuerzo o saber encontrar aquellas donde me sienta identificado para escribir mis pensamientos. Pude superar estos desafíos enfocándome en las comunidades que me gustan y haciendo lo siguiente: apoyar a otros hivers con mi voto, comentar sus publicaciones y leer sus posts. Para mí, son acciones que aportan y ayudan a la comunidad a crecer. Uno de los hábitos que tengo para escribir es que, si siento que estoy bloqueado creativamente, escribo sobre algo que me apasiona. Por ejemplo, voy a la comunidad de Fulldeportes y escribo sobre el Real Madrid o sobre el gym; luego, cuando siento que superé ese bloqueo, continúo con otros contenidos.

> Foto realizada con flow Algo que ha cambiado en mí al estar en Hive es mi confianza al escribir temas no técnicos, explorar ideas y expresarme mejor. También he vivido muchas experiencias que pueden ser traducidas en blogs dentro de Hive. Esperen muy pronto nuevo contenido.

> Foto realizada con flow Gracias por leer.
Read the English version here

This is the spoiler content. Optionally with more lines I have really enjoyed being part of Web3, especially here creating blogs. Let me tell you: before, I had a Facebook account and I used to share my images there on that social network, but later I stopped posting. On Instagram I upload few images, so the network where I am most active, sharing more of my photos and blogs, is here on Hive.

> Photo created with flow I wanted to share with you in this paragraph my participation in Web2. I also post on LinkedIn, but there it is more about professional topics. Now, here on Hive I feel that I can explore my passion for sports. I have been writing in Fulldeportes about Real Madrid, a team that I have followed since I was a child and that connects with my childhood passion; that is why I enjoy writing about them.

> Photo created with flow Another community where I post is Holos & Lotus; there the topics are related to the human being. The topics are very diverse and I like that community because I feel identified with its content. Very soon I will write about entrepreneurship or my experience; expect more posts from me in other new communities. I decided to write this so you can know more about who I am, since if you have read me participating in dynamics, I have liked Hive and I continue posting content in the communities I mentioned, so that if at some point you want to know what I write and where you can find me, you already have it clear. @elizabeths14 invited me to Hive. It was because I participated in a talk in the Cryptomanada de Yis community, and since I liked creating blogs and also wanted to find a way to create content where I could receive rewards for what I created, I said: this is the place. I started creating content more focused on what I like and, of course, I decided to continue writing and growing. @waralotito also joined practically at the same time as me, and I have liked seeing all the content she creates. I like supporting her by commenting on her posts because she writes very well. I also like to look for new ways to update myself when creating content. I have had to explore various tools to create images; now my favorite is Flow. Before I used Sora a lot, but since it will disappear, I need to find new applications. If you know any interesting ones, I would like you to share them in the comments. Now let me tell you: I started posting, as I mentioned, in Fulldeportes content about Real Madrid news. Here I always have to analyze their matches, read what commentators say and research to create a good quality blog. Also, in that same community, I have written about the Yankees, about my gym experience, and also my experience in cycling. I have also written in Holos & Lotus. Here the content is very diverse: health topics, thoughts about different topics; for example, my last post was about health. I have loved receiving comments from hivers. Sometimes I have received feedback on my posts, which I like because I know that if other people give me advice on how to improve, it is a good sign. Of course, I take that advice and apply it in the next post to write better. If you have any comments about my posts, I will be happy to read them. Yes, I have had some challenges at the beginning, because writing in other communities has forced me to read their rules: what should be done and what should not. Since there are many communities, I have to analyze where I should put my greatest effort or know how to find those where I feel identified to write my thoughts. I was able to overcome these challenges by focusing on the communities I like and doing the following: supporting other hivers with my vote, commenting on their posts, and reading their content. For me, these are actions that contribute and help the community grow. One of the habits I have for writing is that if I feel creatively blocked, I write about something I am passionate about. For example, I go to the Fulldeportes community and write about Real Madrid or about the gym; then, when I feel I have overcome that block, I continue with other content.

> Photo created with flow Something that has changed in me by being on Hive is my confidence in writing non-technical topics, exploring ideas and expressing myself better. I have also lived many experiences that can be translated into blogs within Hive. Expect new content very soon.
