body.title: 🌹 Not everything needs a reason
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVksgdvCwSjQcGzJBsBdp5s52xJ18uLchy7nqBgvhu17/IMG_3947.jpg 


Today I just felt like holding a flower…  
no special occasion, no big meaning behind it.

Sometimes I do things like that.  
Little random moments that don’t make much sense to anyone else… but they feel right to me.

Maybe it’s like when I read manga and a scene just *hits* you, even if it’s simple.  
No big action, no drama… just a quiet feeling you can’t explain.

That’s how today felt.

A red top, a simple rose, and a moment where I just existed without overthinking everything.

I’m learning that not everything needs a reason.  
Some things are just meant to be felt.

And honestly… I like that.

Just Lynda, finding beauty in small, random moments 🌹

body.title: [Es-En]
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTmwNwVJtJEgBbDgFvFCLBzKS9QEGouPfoCs82N5X2sC/1777328290539.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/animales-caballos-mam%C3%ADfero-especies-8080446/)

Queridos amigos de Ecency, hoy quiero hablarles de esos seres que han acompañado a la humanidad desde tiempos remotos: los caballos. No pretendo ordenar demasiado mis ideas, porque el amor y la gratitud rara vez se expresan en líneas rectas; más bien se derraman como recuerdos, emociones y anécdotas que se entrelazan.

Pienso en la historia y me maravilla cómo los caballos han sido compañeros inseparables de nuestra evolución. Desde las antiguas civilizaciones que los veneraban como símbolos de fuerza y nobleza, hasta los campos de batalla donde fueron aliados silenciosos, y los caminos rurales donde ayudaron a transportar sueños y cosechas. En cada época, el caballo ha sido más que un animal: ha sido un puente entre lo humano y lo natural, entre la tierra y la libertad.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ2Fq3seFVmoE9KUEBJjnYdXztyTjxAKD99v8vBG6dsT/1777328426430.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/monta%C3%B1a-caballos-naturaleza-paisaje-5092625/)

Recuerdo la primera vez que monté uno. Era un caballo mestizo, de mirada tranquila, y aunque yo estaba nervioso, él parecía saber exactamente cómo transmitirme calma. Esa sensación de confianza, de que alguien más grande y fuerte te sostiene, es algo que nunca se olvida. Y pienso que muchos de ustedes también tendrán historias similares: un paseo al atardecer, un trote en la playa, o simplemente la contemplación de su elegancia al correr.

Lo curioso es que, aunque hoy vivimos rodeados de tecnología, los caballos siguen teniendo un lugar especial en nuestro imaginario. ¿Quién no ha sentido un estremecimiento al ver una película donde el héroe cabalga hacia el horizonte? O al leer un poema que describe la crin al viento, la potencia de sus músculos, la mirada que parece contener siglos de sabiduría. Los caballos son memoria viva, y al mismo tiempo, inspiración para el futuro.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhGGzujnnPaMo9mP8t3NEYZbeNcABiHnBBRPZsgQ8msh/1777328536681.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-granja-caballo-blanco-8026521/)

En mi vida cotidiana, aunque no convivo con caballos, me gusta pensar que su espíritu está presente en la manera en que buscamos avanzar, superar obstáculos y mantener la dignidad. Ellos nos enseñan que la fuerza no está reñida con la ternura, que se puede ser poderoso y a la vez sensible. Esa dualidad es la que me hace sentir tanta gratitud: porque los caballos nos recuerdan que la belleza y la resistencia pueden ir de la mano.

A lo largo de la historia, han sido motores invisibles de progreso. Sin ellos, muchas rutas comerciales no habrían existido, muchas culturas no se habrían conectado, y muchas historias no se habrían contado. Y sin embargo, pocas veces les damos el reconocimiento que merecen. Por eso este post es también un acto de justicia poética: decirles gracias, aunque ellos no lean estas palabras, aunque su lenguaje sea otro, más puro y más instintivo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5K2krw3F8otQBvhrXoKm4RN6tgSNLP73JqZy6bPKzAb/1777328616437.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-animal-semental-mam%C3%ADfero-9057949/)

Amigos de Ecency, comparto esto con ustedes porque sé que aquí valoramos la autenticidad, el afecto y la conexión con lo esencial. Los caballos son parte de nuestra memoria colectiva, y hablar de ellos es hablar de nosotros mismos. Quizás alguno de ustedes tenga un recuerdo de infancia con un caballo que le enseñó a confiar, o una experiencia reciente que le devolvió la paz. Me encantaría que lo compartieran, porque cada historia suma a este homenaje.

En fin, este texto desordenado es solo un intento de abrazar con palabras a esos seres que nos han dado tanto. Los caballos son fuerza, son ternura, son historia y son presente. Y nosotros, como comunidad, podemos seguir honrándolos con gratitud y amor. Porque al final, lo que nos une no es solo la tecnología ni las plataformas, sino la capacidad de reconocer la belleza en lo que nos rodea y agradecerla juntos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8HaVd4CLmRv5VmP9AwW43HfAELf93v2wbfseTLYMX7H/1777328715214.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballo-casta%C3%B1a-semental-4301078/)

Gracias, caballos, por ser parte de nuestra vida. Y gracias, amigos de Ecency, por ser parte de este viaje compartido.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvKjJzCXpFDCsZeWJf5ja33WDdmcYkXYJR6EaPL5e2qQ/1777328780103.jpg)

[Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-animales-caballos-salvajes-1759214/)

***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS8NxVgy4gwzyp6DQhH5bFiDnCC7e3UoZD2sHdkm8NfM4/1777329491074.jpg)

***

Horses: Strength, Tenderness, and Living Memory

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTmwNwVJtJEgBbDgFvFCLBzKS9QEGouPfoCs82N5X2sC/1777328290539.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/animales-caballos-mam%C3%ADfero-especies-8080446/)

Dear friends of Ecency, today I want to talk about those beings who have accompanied humanity since ancient times: horses. I don’t intend to arrange my thoughts too neatly, because love and gratitude rarely flow in straight lines; they spill out as memories, emotions, and anecdotes that intertwine.

I think about history and marvel at how horses have been inseparable companions in our evolution. From ancient civilizations that revered them as symbols of strength and nobility, to battlefields where they were silent allies, and rural paths where they helped carry dreams and harvests. In every era, the horse has been more than an animal: it has been a bridge between the human and the natural, between the earth and freedom.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZZ2Fq3seFVmoE9KUEBJjnYdXztyTjxAKD99v8vBG6dsT/1777328426430.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/monta%C3%B1a-caballos-naturaleza-paisaje-5092625/)

I remember the first time I rode one. It was a mixed-breed horse, with a calm gaze, and although I was nervous, he seemed to know exactly how to transmit serenity to me. That feeling of trust—that someone bigger and stronger is holding you—is something you never forget. And I imagine many of you have similar stories: a sunset ride, a trot along the beach, or simply the contemplation of their elegance in motion.

What’s curious is that, even though we live surrounded by technology today, horses still hold a special place in our imagination. Who hasn’t felt a shiver watching a movie where the hero rides into the horizon? Or reading a poem that describes the mane in the wind, the power of their muscles, the gaze that seems to contain centuries of wisdom. Horses are living memory, and at the same time, inspiration for the future.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUhGGzujnnPaMo9mP8t3NEYZbeNcABiHnBBRPZsgQ8msh/1777328536681.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-granja-caballo-blanco-8026521/)

In my daily life, even though I don’t live with horses, I like to think their spirit is present in the way we strive to move forward, overcome obstacles, and maintain dignity. They teach us that strength is not at odds with tenderness, that one can be powerful and sensitive at the same time. That duality is what makes me feel so grateful: because horses remind us that beauty and resilience can walk hand in hand.

Throughout history, they have been invisible engines of progress. Without them, many trade routes would not have existed, many cultures would not have connected, and many stories would not have been told. And yet, we rarely give them the recognition they deserve. That’s why this post is also an act of poetic justice: to say thank you, even if they don’t read these words, even if their language is another—purer, more instinctive.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma5K2krw3F8otQBvhrXoKm4RN6tgSNLP73JqZy6bPKzAb/1777328616437.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-animal-semental-mam%C3%ADfero-9057949/)

Friends of Ecency, I share this with you because I know we value authenticity, affection, and connection with what is essential. Horses are part of our collective memory, and speaking of them is speaking of ourselves. Perhaps some of you have a childhood memory of a horse that taught you trust, or a recent experience that brought you peace. I would love for you to share it, because each story adds to this tribute.

In the end, this disordered text is just an attempt to embrace with words those beings who have given us so much. Horses are strength, they are tenderness, they are history and they are present. And we, as a community, can continue honoring them with gratitude and love. Because in the end, what unites us is not only technology or platforms, but the ability to recognize beauty in what surrounds us and to thank it together.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8HaVd4CLmRv5VmP9AwW43HfAELf93v2wbfseTLYMX7H/1777328715214.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballo-casta%C3%B1a-semental-4301078/)

Thank you, horses, for being part of our lives. And thank you, friends of Ecency, for being part of this shared journey.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWvKjJzCXpFDCsZeWJf5ja33WDdmcYkXYJR6EaPL5e2qQ/1777328780103.jpg)

[Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/caballos-animales-caballos-salvajes-1759214/)

body.title: Juicy Sirloin Steak with Pork Rind / Jugoso Bistec Solomo De Cuerito
body.body: > ![Historia de Instagram Collage Cumpleaños Polaroid (1).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23yJSr5cGFxi1VZD9onSC7Ges92UrhPPBgVPyapFDpj6tLkQdjR9cVB7e4q8s81cuoBJf.png) **English** ### **Juicy Sirloin Steak with Pork Rind** Warm greetings, I hope you are all well, fellow Creative Cuisine enthusiasts. I'm sharing a mouthwatering dish with you; I had most of the ingredients on hand and took extra care to make it delicious. I love this meat because it's so tender, and when I eat it, I serve it with plenty of onions and some seasonings. >***Español*** > >### **Jugoso Bistec Solomo De Cuerito** >Un saludo cordial, espero que se encuentren bien, amigos amantes de Creative Cuisine. Les presento una comida que abre el apetito; tenía la mayoría de los ingredientes y me esmeré para que me quedara apetitosa. Esta carne me encanta porque es muy blandita, y cuando la como, la acompaño con bastante cebolla y algunos aliños. ![IMG_20260423_131956.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/2423yrWnV5Qk53HtHzgxbcheSsYyXfEhQ9gvehuk68joN1RSR5nqzDffaWqrhnwrbZX2r.jpg) The accompaniment to this meal was green plantains, but when I looked for them in the pantry, they were a little yellowish; however, the flesh inside remained firm, still more green than yellow. When they're like this, I prepare them the same way I would for tostones. After they're cooked, I add a pinch of salt, which gives them a delicious touch, because the sweet and salty flavors come together. >El acompañamiento para esta comida era plátano verde, pero cuando lo busqué en la despensa, estaba un poco amarillento; sin embargo, por dentro su pulpa se mantenía dura, seguía más verde que amarillo. Cuando está así, lo preparo de igual forma que el tostón. Al terminar de cocinarlos, le agrego una pizca de sal que le da un toque delicioso, porque se unen esos sabores dulces con salado. ![IMG_20260423_125110.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wCDgmDU234KCmWNTUMcVnnXewgLxcpoib5S86C1VTnhccVvtf1XVDnTXmd45R2SAXRe.jpg) Another thing I do when it comes to meat: I use a whole onion and cook it with a special touch. I sauté it until it's toasted and crispy with a slight sweetness, which, when mixed with the meat, blends those flavors and makes it truly delicious. It's a meal that leaves us wanting more, especially considering it also provides energy and helps build muscle mass. >Otra cosa que hago cuando se trata de carne: utilizo una cebolla completa, la cocino dándole un toque especial. Las sofrió y las dejó tostadas y crujientes con un leve sabor a dulzor, que, al mezclarla con la carne, se fusionan esos sabores y realmente queda exquisita. Una comida que nos deja con ganas de repetir, tomando en cuenta también que nos suministra energías y aumenta nuestra masa muscular. ![IMG_20260423_131808.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23zbTcikQfJe5548udraDSBDTPxbW6yALEqMsRM4PoQPaD5FEErPhDabHrfoVTiUkRvAi.jpg) The ingredients we'll use for this meal are easy to find in our rich culinary tradition. This always gives us the opportunity to improvise and create new, original dishes that encourage us to spend more time in the kitchen with greater pleasure. >Los ingredientes que vamos a utilizar para esta comida son fáciles de encontrar en nuestra vasta gastronomía. Que nos da la oportunidad siempre de improvisar y presentar nuevos platos originales que nos animan a permanecer en la cocina con más placer. --- #### **Ingredients:** - 150 grams of beef tenderloin with skin on - 1 onion - 3 sweet peppers - 1 sprig of cilantro - Adobo seasoning - 1 tablespoon of Worcestershire sauce - Oil - 1 semi-ripe plantain - Salt --- > #### **Ingredientes:** >- 150 gramos de solomo de cuerito >- 1 cebolla >- 3 ajíes dulce >- 1 rama de cilantro >- Adobo para sazonar >- 1 cucharada de salsa inglesa >- Aceite >- 1 plátano pintón (más verde que maduro) >- Sal #### **Preparation:** **1)** Wash the steak thoroughly and season it with adobo (a mixture of oregano, pepper, thyme, and cumin). Add a pinch of salt and Worcestershire sauce, and let it marinate while you prepare the rest of the ingredients. > #### **Preparación:** > **1)** El bistec previamente bien lavado, lo sazonamos con adobo (esta mezclado con orégano, pimienta, tomillo y comino), le agregamos pizca de sal, salsa inglesa y dejamos macerar mientras ganamos tiempo. Picamos los demás ingredientes. ![IMG_20260423_122416-COLLAGE.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EokfVTDHaQmjsPUd6AD3JKfDPGzEr7PDnZuNZSTZ4scrKJELdnFMdpU3X2Pm5ovx51i.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_122458.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EpEKhpVwUsQrnSUqNLHV7Dmo3wygqZc3aUxDUc7F6A1K3S9LPa8H74cD5PExgkhzr5H.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_122708.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/EqBd7Jpy3Hr8BkVyTjL9iZPMW3b8s1gEBekPDk4jsKfWvNiXNZ9Ece1LH6ssT6wcxF2.jpg) **2)** We wash and chop the seasonings, then add them to the meat. > **2)** Lavamos los aliños y cortamos, para luego añadirlos a la carne. ![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-24 at 11.31.36 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AJmsz8wxnZoMCAztjtEiwFCg1dLspApg6Dbsjndk6GShL7N9SCRUwD4Wa6Ez8WK.jpeg) ![IMG_20260423_121902.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eoc81fP8wuyCkN3D2e55UagTp5wCMpXbF3LEd5WCcrgU1TNQtD7fjsRLED6eNUMKRUt.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_122812.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23wgQ5YwhEMJVFV6M5JUToTLqTCMB6ozYh81QnGMSEDGPT8wGVzMNCpH6WvBWhtwShsY8.jpg) ![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-24 at 11.56.58 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/AJoKGxv7St2kxNCej59UbEtuPtXBDapJMo6ykegweFx4UBoC6RQ5JzgyvRVMS3T.jpeg) ![IMG_20260423_123402.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/Eonn1sPqvvroDSt2UwzqCh4vQQLVYo45n9pmXSnFfePxfaFizxRewQfmDpguTYRGRYK.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_123421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lanoican/23ynYfi9APY9TQbhRrHUG8YuwjZoEjYK1awDXzDDHCvMyV1rSHMxQeVaxzw69qafj3r74.jpg) **3)** Peel and slice the plantain into thick slices. Then fry it briefly on both sides. Transfer it to a board and mash it with a stone, return it to the pan, wait until it browns, and remove from the heat. body.title: Las burbujas del estres / The bubbles of stress
body.body:
> ## Spanish Hola a todos, hace unos días comencé a notar una conocida comezón en las palmas de las manos, cosa que hace muchísimo no pasaba y, al mirar, sabiendo aun así a qué se debía, no pude evitar sentir un poco de ansiedad, pues no era otra cosa más que las burbujas o pequeñas ampollas que aparecen por el estrés como medio de señal de que el cuerpo está pasando por tensiones y sensaciones varias. Y si en años anteriores solían aparecerme muy seguido y aun así me tomaban por sorpresa, más que todo porque en sí estas suelen causar un ardor muy insoportable y, más allá de ser solo una alerta, terminaban haciéndome entrar en un estado de ansiedad. Y, pues, más allá de ser señales del cuerpo de un llamado de atención, el hecho de volver a tener esto en mis manos (aunque también salen en otras áreas) me hace sobrepensar mucho en que quizás me he carcomido la mente y he dejado llevar por el estrés y la angustia sin darme cuenta, o quizás sí, pero no lo he tomado con la importancia que es, y es justamente donde a veces el no fijarnos detalladamente en cómo estamos actuando o minimizarnos puede jugarnos en contra, ya que, pues, podría decirse que estos días sí he sentido ese estrés o esos enojos por cosas variadas, pero mi visión era que se pasaban al rato y, por lo visto, no era así. Y en retrospectiva, las señales han estado claras, con migrañas fuertes y dolores de cuerpo, una que otra rabieta hacia mí misma, pero solo encajo todo cuando vi estas burbujas de nuevo. Verán, a nivel visual, se puede decir que es de lo poco que me llega a hacer sentir impactada, ya que mis manos se ponen rojas y la comezón de estas ampollas pequeñas me hace temblar, y me da esa desesperación por querer quitarlas, cosa que no se debe, sino que lo ideal es buscar un medio como algo frío que disminuya la sensación. Y en momentos donde la mente está nublada y esto hace acto de presencia, la coordinación se va y simplemente está esa respiración de sentirse atrapado.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2VVPMBQw1vdD8HhpBTXBRkEAiueUVpDZEfyPT17HQG4/1777329230863.jpg
Sé que todo esto que escribo podría verse como un reproche o una queja y en parte no niego que me siento algo enojada conmigo misma porque, a pesar de todo, he estado haciendo mis días normales sin darme cuenta de que había más allá de un bajón emocional un estrés madurando y agrupándose de manera constante; sino más bien es una forma de ver y expresar un poco de esos pensamientos y así ordenarlos un poco, lo cual siempre me ayuda a ver incluso un poco más. Y si se preguntan la causa de tanto estrés o tensión en estos días, pues muchos son los factores que he podido desatar y sacar de esa maraña de cosas que generan estrés y llegar al núcleo, pero dentro de todo no es malo, pues a medida que doy una causa, trato de pensar y verla de una manera que genere calma porque sonará algo infantil, pero la verdad, cuando veo esas burbujas y siento ese ador, me vuelvo la persona más sentimental y con la sensación de fragilidad que no me gusta, pero siento que me atrapa. Bueno, más que todo podría decirse que este post es parte de los muchos que van hacia lo que llego a pensar en el momento, que escribo y así mismo lo plasmo sin alterar ni maquillar, solo suelto y que salga todo. Sé que no soy la única que ha sentido estas burbujas o ampollas de estrés único, por lo que sé que posiblemente puedan entender lo frustrante que puedo estar sintiéndome ahorita, y el tema de cómo hay que actuar día a día sin importar y solo avanzar, por lo que este pequeño momento de escritura puede ser una forma de respirar un poco. Así que, sin más y esperando sea de su agrado y haberme podido dar a entender, muchas gracias por leer.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZqfjwxu5KNCv4ZWQb4CNgvciVFPzx3m9gocYjQRLeBKm/1722384966059.jpg)
## English Hi everyone, a few days ago I started noticing a familiar itching in the palms of my hands, something that hadn't happened in ages. Even though I knew what it was, I couldn't help but feel a little anxious. It was nothing more than those little blisters or blisters that appear due to stress, a way of signaling that the body is experiencing tension and various sensations. In previous years, they used to appear quite frequently and still took me by surprise, mainly because they usually cause an unbearable burning sensation and, beyond being just a warning sign, they ended up making me anxious. And so, beyond these being my body's way of asking for help, the fact that I'm seeing this again (even though it's appearing in other areas too) makes me think a lot about how I might have been letting stress and anxiety consume me without realizing it, or perhaps I have, but I haven't taken it seriously enough. And that's precisely where sometimes not paying close attention to how we're acting or minimizing our own feelings can backfire. Because, well, I could say that these past few days I have felt that stress or anger over various things, but I thought it would pass quickly, and apparently, that wasn't the case. And in retrospect, the signs have been clear: severe migraines and body aches, the occasional outburst of anger directed at myself, but it all only made sense when I saw these bubbles again. You see, visually, it's one of the few things that really bothers me, since my hands turn red and the itching from these little blisters makes me tremble, and I get this desperate urge to pick at them, which I shouldn't do. Ideally, I should find something cold to lessen the sensation. And when my mind is foggy and this happens, my coordination goes out and all that's left is that feeling of being trapped.
https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2VVPMBQw1vdD8HhpBTXBRkEAiueUVpDZEfyPT17HQG4/1777329271786.jpg
I know that everything I'm writing could be seen as a reproach or a complaint, and I won't deny that I feel a little angry with myself because, despite everything, I've been going about my normal days without realizing that there was more to it than just an emotional low; there was stress constantly building up and accumulating. Rather, it's a way of seeing and expressing some of these thoughts and organizing them a bit, which always helps me see things a little more clearly. And if you're wondering about the cause of so much stress or tension these days, well, there are many factors I've been able to unravel and pull out of that tangle of things that generate stress, getting to the root of it. But all in all, it's not a bad thing, because as I identify a cause, I try to think about it and see it in a way that brings calm. It might sound childish, but the truth is, when I see those bubbles and feel that adoration, I become the most sentimental person, with a feeling of fragility that I don't like, but I feel it gripping me. Well, more than anything, you could say that this post is one of many that reflect what I'm thinking in the moment, what I write down, and what I put down without altering or embellishing it. I just let it all out. I know I'm not the only one who's felt these bubbles or blisters of unique stress, so I know you can probably understand how frustrating I might be feeling right now, and the idea of having to act day by day no matter what, just keep moving forward. This little moment of writing can be a way for me to breathe a little. So, without further ado, and hoping you enjoy it and that I've been able to explain myself, thank you so much for reading.

body.title: How do demons exist and how do they multiply?//Mcgi Topic Review
body.body:
https://youtu.be/ILlEsshEbc0?si=1Yuy1lliU3BG0HcT

Are demons truly present in our world? Many people believe they are. According to this belief, demons are spiritual beings that exist beyond what our physical eyes can see. Though invisible, they are thought to be active across the earth. The Bible gives insight into this idea, especially in the book of Job, where Satan tells God that he has been moving to and fro throughout the world. This suggests that Satan and his forces are not confined but operate freely, influencing events and people in unseen ways.

As spiritual beings, demons are believed to affect the physical world even though they remain hidden. While humans cannot see them, it is often said that they can see us. This highlights the belief that the spiritual realm has a strong influence over the physical realm. Many people point to the growing level of wickedness, violence, and moral decline in society as evidence of this unseen activity.

In today’s world, we see a lack of respect for human life, increasing disobedience, and actions driven by selfish or harmful desires. Some attribute these behaviors to negative spiritual influence. Even the rejection of the message of Jesus Christ is, by some, seen as a result of spiritual blindness caused by these forces.

Despite all this, there is hope. Believers are encouraged to remain grounded in the word of God and to live according to His teachings. By doing so, they believe they can resist evil influences and overcome spiritual oppression. Holding firmly to faith is seen as a way to experience freedom, peace, and protection, even in a world where darkness may seem present.

**Thanks for reading.**

body.title: A mother and father are essential to a whole child as each as unique traits mirrored in their baby.
body.body:
/>

body.title: Good day and good news…. Plus some shiny….
body.body:
Afternoon everyone ….

What an absolutely gorgeous day out here in the northeast. Today was mid seventies with a very slight breeze, complete sunshine.

You couldn’t have guessed that it would’ve been so nice if you were outside at five in the morning like me. It was only forty one degrees at that time.

Great day to work with the shop door open. I also got a call from my supplier, telling me that my stain is finally in after over three weeks from when I ordered it.

Today I am going to share a coin from my collection that is a favorite design of mine. It’s the Peace silver dollar. These are really tougher to find in high grade because the fact that Lady Liberty’s hair relief is higher than the rim of the coin. So any circulation at all will wear the lines of the hair.

While this is not an extremely high grade as an MS65, it is as low as I’d go on this particular coin because of the lack of detail in grades lower.

**_Here is some information on the series and the specs of the coin:_** The Peace dollar is a United States dollar coin minted for circulation from 1921 to 1928 and 1934 to 1935, and beginning again for collectors in 2021. Designed by Anthony de Francisci, the coin was the result of a competition to find designs emblematic of peace. Its obverse represents the head and neck of the Goddess of Liberty in profile, and the reverse depicts a bald eagle at rest clutching an olive branch, with the legend \

. It was the last United States dollar coin to be struck for circulation in silver. Peace dollar United States Value 1.00 United States dollar Mass 26.73 g (412.5 gr) Diameter 38.1 mm (1.5 in) Thickness 2.4 (1921-1935) mm Edge Reeded Composition 1921–1935: .900 silver .100 copper 2021–present: .999 silver Silver 0.77344 troy oz. (1921–1935); 0.858 (2021–present) troy oz Years of minting 1921–1928; 1934–1935; 2021–present Mint marks D, S. Located above tip of eagle's wings on reverse. Philadelphia Mint specimens lack mint mark. Obverse NNC-US-1921-1$-Peace dollar.jpg Design Liberty Designer Anthony de Francisci Design date 1921 Reverse NNC-US-1921-1$-Peace dollar.jpg Design A perched bald eagle Designer Anthony de Francisci Design date 1921 With the passage of the Pittman Act in 1918, the United States Mint was required to strike millions of silver dollars, and began to do so in 1921, using the Morgan dollar design. Numismatists began to lobby the Mint to issue a coin that memorialized the peace following World War I; although they failed to get Congress to pass a bill requiring the redesign, they were able to persuade government officials to take action. The Peace dollar was approved by Treasury Secretary Andrew Mellon in December 1921, completing the redesign of United States coinage that had begun in 1907. The public believed the announced design, which included a broken sword, was illustrative of defeat, and the Mint hastily acted to remove the sword. The Peace dollar was first struck on December 28, 1921; just over a million were coined bearing a 1921 date. When the Pittman Act requirements were met in 1928, the mint ceased production of the coins, but more were struck during 1934 and 1935 as a result of further legislation. In 1965, amid much controversy, the Denver mint struck over 316,000 Peace dollars dated 1964, but these were never issued, and all are believed to have been melted. In 2021, the U.S. Mint produced a special 2021 issue Peace Dollar to celebrate the design’s 100th anniversary, with minting of the coins to continue from 2023 onwards. **_The coin…._**
/> Here is a screenshot from the PCGS website on this Peace dollar. As you can see with over thirty million struck there are not many that are this grade or higher around.

body.title: Foto Rozkminy  #1 - Do czego to wszystko zmierza?
body.body: > ![IMG_8939.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/243zZnwJkikiMb4rsRdtL94SF8NnwqUxieFn4GZ14FxBLvKoWkvXtGDhjceRhbP2K1LdX.JPG) Dzisiaj, kiedy przemierzałem z aparatem okolice mojego domu, naszło mnie sporo przemyśleń co do tego, gdzie zmierza moje fotograficzne hobby — i nie tylko o tym. Naprawdę sporo tych przemyśleń się pojawiło. Przede wszystkim zastanawiałem się, czy to, co robię, jest tym, czym faktycznie chcę, aby było. Mowa tu szczególnie o fotografii krajobrazowej, którą — jak teraz już wiem — bardzo zaniedbałem i nie poświęcam jej należytej uwagi. Jednym z czynników, który w ostatnim czasie przynosił mi niezadowolenie z tego, co robię, jest brak odpowiedniej selekcji i skupienia się na wyborze najlepszych zdjęć. Poświęcenia im uwagi przy postprodukcji. Mówiąc prościej — idę w ilość, a nie jakość. ![IMG_8936.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23ujdy3976P6in3N2czF16VYUmtLbZpYbRGhUxACMVo1Nms3VwkwyfM9BiP4hEYpuqqUf.JPG) Fakt ten szczególnie mi doskwiera, kiedy, siedząc w programach do obróbki zdjęć, brakuje mi pomysłu na ich „wykończenie”. Myślałem, dlaczego tak się dzieje, i właściwie chyba już wiem. Przed napisaniem tego wpisu przez prawie dwie godziny edytowałem zdjęcia z dzisiejszego pleneru. I wyglądało to zupełnie inaczej niż w ostatnich miesiącach. Najpierw zająłem się selekcją. Prawie 70% zdjęć wylądowało w koszu bez zastanowienia, a kolejne 10% odpadło przy edycji. Poskutkowało to tym, że zdjęciom, które pozostały, poświęciłem maksymalną ilość czasu — aż każde z nich wyglądało tak, jak powinno. Do momentu, w którym poczułem: tak, to jest to! I nie chciałem robić już nic więcej. ![IMG_8934.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/244Ujmy84W7xRpvDkbi2fF2jz1J7N2B4pyL4cvnejYTiANVZYyV2VQvhyAjweVoGwAZvy.JPG) Kolejnym problemem jest prawdopodobnie fakt, że przestałem myśleć w trakcie fotografowania. Wiele ostatnich plenerów wyglądało bardziej jak gonitwa i wyścig o to, aby wszystko sfotografować. Jakby świat, jaki znam, miał się za chwilę skończyć, a jedyną szansą na jego zachowanie było zapisanie go na cyfrowej „kliszy”. Dotarło to do mnie w połowie dzisiejszego pleneru. Albo może inaczej — przypomniałem sobie dawne zasady, którymi się kierowałem, a najważniejsza brzmi: lepsze jedno idealne zdjęcie niż 1500 przeciętnych. ![IMG_8935.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/243fdjYEEeR56BvfSFyhwBSjMTrfUf8DpcHFg6ADLccdLiwC56M1PzJdf9QaBbam65qNr.JPG) Duży wpływ na to ma zapewne fotografowanie w podróży. Kiedy zwiedzam różne miejsca z żoną, nie mam czasu na dokładne planowanie kadrów. Tam potrzebne jest szybkie myślenie i w tym przypadku „strzelanie” dziesiątek zdjęć ma sens — i tego zmieniać nie chcę. Tutaj po prostu konieczne jest odmienne podejście do każdego z tych tematów. U mnie jednak ta granica się zatarła. ![IMG_8940.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/243M71jnfovpgXhBLGC7fxp4s89cwmYetXfsBhK1DvYJrqeRGKSZNy5xGbNomUfmMD9Bq.JPG) Dzisiaj odzyskałem ten luz i w pewnym momencie porzuciłem pogoń za każdym możliwym kadrem. Po prostu zatrzymałem się na chwilę i skupiłem najpierw na tym, co widzą moje oczy. Co mnie otacza? Jak to się ze sobą łączy? Jak pokazać to w odpowiedni sposób? Może szerzej albo z niskiej perspektywy? I to zaczęło działać. Przez pierwsze 2–3 lata fotografowania krajobrazów te pytania brzmiały w mojej głowie przy każdym plenerze. Później jednak zaczęły milknąć. Czas je przywrócić. ![IMG_8937.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23tmHsDTCHNg8knmFjZQeLNoECtYDR7HN5stFe5SJLmyf3PUqDRHVRJ4ES3ps1s33yRUQ.JPG) Tych przemyśleń było znacznie więcej, ale na dzisiaj wystarczy. Piszę te refleksje, bo chcę je zachować dla siebie — jako przypomnienie, do którego chcę wracać w chwilach zwątpienia czy zapomnienia. Mam też nadzieję, że komuś innemu również się przydadzą. Pamiętajcie, że wiele odpowiedzi — i nie mówię tu jedynie o robieniu zdjęć — tkwi w naszych głowach. Trzeba tylko o tę wiedzę poprosić, zapytać samego siebie i zagłębić się we własne doświadczenia. To prawdziwy skarb. ![IMG_8938.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23wqiCerUadiZjk4BXBpff9sy9FdHGrnMZJYRzFUJva5Z4pHrvLfXdYKTodTTgyLJfx5n.JPG) PS. na koniec mały spojler wyjęty prosto z post-produkcji równolegle w Lightroomie i Photoshopie. Brakowało mi zabawy z maskami świetlnymi. Ktoś wie co to? ![Bez nazwy-2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kadr-pokaze/23uFKEvW9LpJjQrXqNwNcsAc3i9FoWYjEp6s2JpesAyX2aY7D1stQhZEfvX4Pg8QMHP4C.jpg)

description.title: CHAPARRO PLANT (En - Es)
description.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPJeDiu97PDwroBvEzn9cmws8TaGmtDqouqWzSroQqZMj/c9cff5ab_4aa3_44a3_8d0a_6b329d544148.jpg)
---
**ENGLISH** --- #

> Hello everyone, good morning. I hope you're enjoying this day in any beautiful place in the world, surrounded by nature. To our relief, the heat wave is finally coming to an end in Venezuela, and although high temperatures are still being recorded, it's no longer a daily occurrence because the rainy season, albeit more than a month late, is finally arriving. A few days ago, even amidst the severe drought, I went out to take photos in an area I rarely walk through, as it's a section of one of the roads connecting the two cities. I wanted to track down one of the most common plant species of the savanna, which is generally found in open, desolate spaces, not in populated areas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKFUKgfiPpjosb9nxeNDj4cM1e3MnqtDPQZZLy8CNpNF/93cc3267_e922_4818_914a_4b6357b2cbef.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcgow1VsPR1zW5Fpq35fPzi1moe8pnPNHxQyZQz9mByvJ/6469ebfb_b32c_4c69_948e_586c5f852e9c.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS49f41RrZpQAfMFcW3Jv5maYZivRmFsAAfx42JjEyb1d/febbe324_758a_417a_8b1d_28327d5c137d.jpg)

> I didn't delve too deeply because I'm always afraid of encountering one of those creeping creatures I don't like, but I did manage to photograph several plants of this species… it's the chaparro, which is typical of the plains, and it's very abundant here, but towards the open savanna. This stretch of road passes through farms and abandoned land, so the vegetation is very tall but dry. In the photos, you can also see coconut palms, some already withered from the high temperatures, and the only plants that have survived the climate are the chaparral. I want to tell you about it next:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Chaparro Plant]()** --- # The chaparro tree, whose scientific name is Curatella americana, is native to the Americas. It is also known as vacabuey, curata, chaparro, parica, peralejo macho, or carne de fiambre. It is commonly found in the tropical savannas of Central America and northern South America. It could be said that this tree best typifies the landscape of the Llanos savannas.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Description]()** --- # Chaparro plants can be found as trees or shrubs and can reach a height of 2–15 m. The bark is light brown, and the wood is cream-colored and very hard. This plant is highly resistant to fire.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQP29ZvSFpX2X4qwxuaiyM3Lyq9K8zQyAg5EdKoBcW3in/39a60132_7bb9_4883_877b_ffcd8ae3a8dd.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEYNvMXzCxzDL4XNR1eru4zRC8LrjPsKysnSMC7URH9A/e125badb_50fb_4101_a1b2_2630a8b153fd.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVqFqrTcFDb13SpEdhSPAJu8e6PYZtovTMbLLQ2LDBPd/a8055b13_f5e3_4c82_8a2f_e4050767378b.jpg)

> Its leaves are ovate to elliptical, approximately 8–20 cm long and 5–10 cm wide, more or less rounded, and slightly wavy at the edge, with a rough, wrinkled texture. The flowers have four recurved white petals, numerous stamens, and light green pistils. They have a sweet scent and attract bees. The fruits are green and hairy, measuring 4–8 mm. This species is common in secondary forests and savannas.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Uses]()** --- # It is commonly used as firewood and fence posts. It is said that in ancient times, saddles were made from chaparro wood. Indigenous people used the fresh leaves to scrape the fruits of the calabash tree and then paint them, creating containers. It is also used as a sponge for washing pots. For medicinal purposes, water is left in hollowed-out chaparro logs, and one or two small glasses are drunk daily to treat diabetes. The most common use is for gastrointestinal problems, stomach aches, and to relieve diarrhea. An infusion is prepared with the fruit peel and other plants and drunk like tea three times a day. It is also used to reduce kidney inflammation by soaking the stem and then drinking the liquid like tea. This treatment is also used for jaundice and hepatitis.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

Thank you all for visiting my blog… have a wonderful day!
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfD8SvjszdzfVopAHoQmYaA28h4EV55pqjui2xkDTdry2/9666de74_5886_4515_82e0_48848e1ab488.jpg)
---
**ESPAÑOL** --- #

> Hola a todos, muy buenos días. Espero que estén disfrutando este día en cualquier lugar bonito del mundo en contacto con la naturaleza. Para nuestro alivio, la ola de calor ya está llegando a su fin en Venezuela, y aunque todavía se registran altas temperaturas, ya no es a diario porque la temporada lluviosa, aunque con un atraso de más de un mes, por fin está haciendo acto de presencia. Días atrás, aun en medio de la sequía tan fuerte, salí a tomar fotos por un sector que pocas veces transito a pie, ya que es un tramo de una de las carreteras que intercomunican a las dos ciudades, pero quería rastrear una de las especies vegetales más comunes de la sabana, y que por lo general se encuentra en espacios abiertos y desolados, no en las áreas pobladas.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWV5pm5DQHM1UDeyJyLdScMWiRyLkxS4aFYCvcKiJm5xb/01e76887_cf02_4ea3_b031_13ea8f61f41d.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRHc6dv4bKREBppANvFsCBnM4hAgStZZYyDqsARx1F1oR/1a2031ad_5561_4b5b_92fa_b8b6af16900e.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTWrCbXfpdaT2FiEvcAjRe4HWDMjNXUjoMhRVGjaBXvYb/7c7accaf_8c56_4634_82c2_63ef82e69d10.jpg)

> No me internalicé mucho porque siempre tengo el temor de encontrarme con una de esas habitantes rastreras que no me gustan, pero capturé varias plantas de esta especie… se trata del chaparro, que es típica de la llanura, y aquí abundan muchísimo pero hacia la sabana abierta. Este tramo de la carretera es de fincas y terrenos abandonados, por lo que el monte está muy alto, pero seco. En las fotos también se pueden divisar palmas de coco, algunas ya secas por la temperatura tan alta, y las únicas plantas que han sobrevivido al clima, han sido las de chaparro. De ella quiero hablarles a continuación:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Planta de Chaparro]()** --- # El chaparro, cuyo nombre científico es Curatella Americana, es originaria de América. También se le conoce como vacabuey, curata, chaparro, parica, peralejo macho, o carne de fiambre. Es común verla en las sabanas tropicales de América Central y en el norte de América del Sur. Se podría decir que este árbol es el que mejor tipifica el paisaje de las sabanas llaneras.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Descripción]()** --- # Las plantas de chaparro se pueden encontrar en árboles o arbustos y pueden alcanzar un tamaño de 2–15 m de alto. La corteza es de color marrón claro, y la madera es de color crema, y de consistencia muy dura. Esta planta tiene mucha resistencia a los incendios.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPEK44JgJ5KfZs1SrXbV2W4kH2UfFrq74EAmu34xaBrw1/8a02aa5c_1b1c_4c2a_bcbe_5d9d6a0eb03c.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWbJQTnznLuqe2kTyZgA3BhbXUrnGfBhTgvsWj97LxFP5/19cdc841_acef_4ebd_9337_5b3b8d565d00.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhnvVMB4zZiimQgqSAf2AuVe4QykWF5wcAShUNvGL6zt/fd218192_a8a7_4256_8cda_0a15c073f43f.jpg)

> Sus hojas son de ovadas a elípticas, de 8 a 20 cm de largo y 5 a 10 cm de ancho aproximadamente, más o menos redondeadas, y ligeramente onduladas en el borde, con una textura áspera y rugosa. Las flores tienen cuatro pétalos blancos recurvados, muchos estambres y pistilos de color verde claro. Tienen un olor dulce y les atraen a las abejas. Los frutos son verdes y peludos con un tamaño de 4 a 8 mm. Esta especie es común en bosques secundarios y sabanas.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

**[Usos]()** --- # Suele utilizarse como leña y como postes en cercados. Se dice que antiguamente, los fustes o sillas de montar se hacían con la madera de chaparro. Los indígenas usaban las hojas frescas para raspar los frutos de tapara y luego pintarlos creando recipientes con ellas, y también se utiliza como esponjilla para lavar ollas. En uso medicinal, se deja agua en tronquitos ahuecados de chaparro y diariamente se beben una o dos copitas para tratar problemas de diabetes. El uso más común es en problemas gastrointestinales, el dolor de estómago, y para aliviar la diarrea, preparando una infusión con la cáscara del fruto y otras plantas y se toma como té, tres veces al día. También se usa para mitigar la inflamación del riñón, remojando el tallo y luego tomando el líquido como té. Este tratamiento también se utiliza para la tiricia y la hepatitis.
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eve66/Eo6D7FK774sCW7xULt9HDqyG6nHWUtvKZN59nXi1PsxxaZwgjYuPZS9oCtuuSkH5eZ1.png

Gracias por visitar mi blog… feliz día para todos.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaVoUwRh4NGFWZXmPzD8HWFxEG83qUChVLXBt4KJddiHr/annafenix.png)

description.body:
https://youtu.be/ILlEsshEbc0?si=1Yuy1lliU3BG0HcT

Are demons present in our world? Many believe they are. They are understood as spiritual beings—real, yet invisible to the human eye. According to the Bible, Satan himself told God in the book of Job that he had been roaming across the earth. This suggests that Satan and his forces move freely throughout the world. Though unseen, they are believed to influence events, spreading chaos and wickedness. While we cannot see them, they are thought to observe us, because physical eyes cannot perceive spiritual realities. In this view, the spiritual realm has power over the physical.

The presence of darkness can be seen in the many forms of evil in the world today. Violence, lack of respect for human life, and harmful behaviors are often seen as evidence of this influence. Some people engage in destructive acts to fulfill evil intentions, while others reject authority, which is sometimes attributed to negative spiritual influence. Many also turn away from the message of Jesus Christ, which believers may interpret as spiritual blindness.

For those who hold this belief, the existence of demons is real, and the solution is to remain grounded in the word of God. By doing so, they believe they can overcome spiritual oppression and live in freedom.

**Thanks for reading.**

description.title: Thought and it’s power
description.body:
![D4EA3EA5-FB12-4FE6-8E34-813476431B57.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dwayne16/23ynWfYxXKYS6LiWErx1dYcEVFAR2mGeq162MsdrGAjyeY8TMfmBkZNK7u7QeFEvJJDwr.jpeg)
***

The power dynamic of thought and consciousness is underestimated. For a long time modern media has diluted this secret into a regurgitation of self improvement  and mass media appeal. When in fact it’s much more of a superpower then a simple pattern of thinking for improving your self.Let me break it down for you.

External factors that affect our lives drastically one way or the other are inevitable. But I believe one way or the other, and a dare to say to varying degrees, these events that occur and affect such a person because such an individual gave a part, even if it’s as small as quarter, of his mental energy and thought capacity to such a thing’s overall manifestation. 

I’m not saying thought patterns contradict physics or biology. But for an earthquake to hit you, there must of been a sought of negative energy you had been projecting prior to that event, regardless of the timMe you had thought it.because that’s how such phenomena manifest. Even if it happens that your city is prone to natural disasters, the very fact that it hit you must have meant your negative energy had bought up its physical manifestation that headed towards you. That’s not to say you deserved to die. But shows how subconscious thinking concentrates external dynamic forces. That’s why negative thinking also brings out the worst of us. We become murderers. Rapists. It quite literally brings out the worst of our physical environment as it does for us. It’s true collective and systemic forces are too complex to control individually. But the fundamentals of subconscious/conscious thought stand nevertheless. Because markets, governments,economies erupted from thought. Thought also influences these things. And that thought can come in the form of decisions, actions and eventually complexity as we see it. 

Thought is the ultimate determinant. And thought is the predecessor of literally all man made phenomenon and manifestations. People with identical habits, disciple and mindset will experience different outcomes because their thinking pattern was never align with the fundamental thought processes that align with the equation for success. If you pour you mind and your life into something and you still don’t get it, it’s either a matter of time or your missing something in what your thinking or doing. It’s just not possible for you to not get your desired outcome once these things are aligned. patience is key.thought

description.title: Develando la caja negra de términos televisivos / Uncovering the Black Box of TV Terms
description.body: Hace algunos días estuve recordando de mis días trabajando en televisión, cuando de manera inconsciente le dije a una compañera de mi trabajo en el supermercado que estaba \

, término que le causó entre asco y risa, pues aunque parezca algo asqueroso, usualmente decíamos así cuando estábamos sobrecargados de actividades que debían ser resueltas en poco tiempo.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZhBKfjShJUEHUYxhqKFBy9FLseEDyUA9JktYRXTUVHw/estoy_encochinada_.png</center>

Y aunque muchos de ellos entraron en desuso, como el \

, cuando se lograba emitir una noticia con carácter de primicia, en algunos casos los de la vieja escuela lo usamos como recordatorio cuando vemos algo en redes sociales que no ha sido publicado por otros, o quizás un punto de vista diferente de un hecho que ya ha sido notorio.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUW99Xx3DSJ9LcujAtS8wCbiBXST4rzNLEMTHzXtPmYVB/estoy_encochinada_2_.png</center>

Ni hablar de la frase que se usaba en la prensa escrita, cuando un suceso reciente debía salir impreso al día siguiente, pero ya se estaban imprimiendo los ejemplares. Quizás para los trabajadores de la imprenta, el mayor temor era escuchar que dijeran \

para deshacer todo el trabajo previo y agregar un titular nuevo o una noticia de tal relevancia, que importaba mucho más que los ejemplares ya listos.

El nervio venía porque ese proceso era todo manual, y la imprenta trabajaba de madrugada, por lo que al paralizar el proceso, todo se retrasaría de más, afectando el envío al interior del país para la entrega en tiempo y forma.

Trabajar en una pauta, que era la planificación de una actividad, tanto dentro como fuera de la planta, y aunque eso daba cierto orden de trabajo, no era de hierro, por lo que el \

nos hacía movernos como locos, similar a cuando algún niño travieso llena de agua un hormiguero y salen del agujero todas despavoridas.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKyd9uzBZm4dAv9GxTSY8ukhnwAS5Mx1XT2hFvS6hxAx/estoy_encochinada_1_.png</center>

Y una última, que era más de una jerga interna entre mis compañeras de trabajo en Telesur, era el estar \

, que aunque suene un poco morboso, venía era por cómo crece este alimento, que es debajo de la tierra, justo donde no ven luz, tal cual lo hacen las papas y demás tubérculos. Y es que el trabajar en un departamento adjunto a la presidencia del canal hacía que trabajáramos desde muy temprano, a veces hasta la madrugada, por lo que al no ve la luz del ´día, éramos 4 \

en la oficina.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVxH4noRVo5nhrkSDZyrLBob2EC7mVsVpc4RoidkyAA3/estoy_encochinada_3_.png</center>

Así que entre estar \
y \

, se pasaban mis días en las plantas televisivas donde trabajé, y quizás por eso desistí de seguir activa en los medios tradicionales, aunque a veces me siento de la misma forma en la versión digital en la que me desenvuelvo actualmente.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMNxZLX3nyQd4z3z36B8GmMQ8e8PN44qLnocC8hsWu8u/separador_ingles.png</center>

A few days ago, I was reminiscing about my days working in television when, without thinking, I told a coworker at the supermarket that I was “swamped”—a term that made her feel somewhere between disgust and amusement. Even though it might sound a bit gross, we usually used that phrase when we were overwhelmed with tasks that had to be completed in a short amount of time.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmefuVZTHSHUyNJJ3oUx9hRQsBkYWAmGQzuRaE6A3AYpuo/estoy_encochinada_4_.png</center>

And although many of these terms have fallen out of use—like “tubazo,” which was used when a news story broke as a scoop—in some cases, those of us from the old school still use them as a reminder when we see something on social media that hasn’t been posted by others, or perhaps a different perspective on an event that’s already been widely reported.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmUW99Xx3DSJ9LcujAtS8wCbiBXST4rzNLEMTHzXtPmYVB/estoy_encochinada_2_.png</center>

Not to mention the phrase used in the print media, when a recent event had to be printed the next day, but the copies were already being printed. Perhaps for the printing press workers, the greatest fear was hearing someone say “stop the presses” to undo all the previous work and add a new headline or a story of such importance that it mattered far more than the copies already ready.

The problem was that the process was entirely manual, and the printing press operated in the early morning hours; so if the process were to come to a standstill, everything would be severely delayed, affecting the timely delivery of shipments to the rest of the country.

Working on a schedule—which was the planning of an activity, both inside and outside the plant—and although that provided some order to the work, it wasn’t set in stone, so a “schedule change” would have us scrambling like crazy, similar to when a mischievous child fills an anthill with water and they all come out of the hole in a panic.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKyd9uzBZm4dAv9GxTSY8ukhnwAS5Mx1XT2hFvS6hxAx/estoy_encochinada_1_.png</center>

And one last thing, which was more of an internal slang term among my coworkers at Telesur, was being “enyucadas,” which, although it sounds a bit morbid, came from how this food grows—underground, right where it doesn’t see light, just like potatoes and other tubers do. The thing is, working in a department attached to the channel’s presidency meant we worked from very early in the morning, sometimes until the wee hours of the night, so since we didn’t see the light of day, we were four “tubers” in the office.

<center>https://images.ecency.com/DQmdVxH4noRVo5nhrkSDZyrLBob2EC7mVsVpc4RoidkyAA3/estoy_encochinada_3_.png</center>

So, between being “tired out” and “worn out,” my days were spent at the TV stations where I worked, and perhaps that’s why I gave up on staying active in traditional media, although sometimes I feel the same way in the digital realm where I currently work.

***

description.title: Unraveling My Mind in Quiet Moments
description.body: Today, I felt like sharing about my personal experience about reflection and meditation. To be honest, I can't recall when was the last time I truly sat and have thought about it. But I do remember that at first, when I tried to think about it how it felt like as if it was something unfamiliar and almost uncomfortable. As we all realize that we live in a world which constantly pulls our attention in various directions. ![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zoe01/4171.png) As for now we all are living in a modern world. So, our days never goes blank without any kind of activity. We always focus ourselves with chats and reels. We have been living like this everyday and this helps us to complete our whole day. But if we stop suddenly then we get back to our reality which we don't wanna face, we often avoid it due to the lack of confrontation. If you ask me then I would say my personal experience which has helped me to figure out that reflection does not come in a structured way. Like I do not sit alone every day and meditate with perfect focus. I've never done it with plannings, I only do it at late night, when I feel like it, when everything is quiet. Usually at night people sleep so there's no one in my list to distract me, it's just stillness. I sometime regret moments like this, because my mind begins to replay the old memories, like conversations which I could have done better, wrong decisions that I took, and regrets for letting others interfere in my life, but not only that I also recall the small victories which I didn’t notice in the past. The regret is that, I didn't cherish these great small moments at all. In the beginning, thinking too much felt overwhelming. It’s easier to distract myself with other things but over time, I realized that constantly running away from reflection leaves a feeling of void inside. Like even if I have forgotten the past and moved forward in life, it still catches up with me because I didn’t confront myself properly. Well, in the back of my mind I know that I won't be able to do it properly but still I try to meditate as often as I can. And instead thinking of the things that can't be changed anymore, I try convince myself. So, the thing I'm following is exactly not meditation as in the traditional sense. It’s more like I decided to choose peace and sat alone beside the window without my phone, or sometimes I lie down and try to forgive myself for the past. Without any interruption it slowly works. Also, I don’t force myself at all because if I do that then I'll lose interest. I feel that I should also listen to my own thoughts. Also, I realized that my thoughts are not always positive. But when I allow myself to sit with them these things slowly lose their weight. Like they do not feel that bad anymore and start becoming something I can understand. But without reflection everything blends together. After practicing these habits it helped me to understand my emotions more. Before, I would feel irritaated, get stressed, even my anxiety got worse and only later realize what had actually bothered me. But when I take time to reflect, I can trace those feelings and find the cause. This helps me to gain control over my sense but not over everything, though it changes the way I respond. The challenges I have faced is consistency. I can’t say I do this every day. Like when I have my phone in my hand, hours will pass without realizing it. To be honest when I do these kind of ignorance, I start to feel like everything is piling up inside me without being sorted. That’s when I get a reminder to pause again. Anyway, it doesn’t take much effort to have a quite mind and think of everything quietly. So, it's not a bothersome for me. I do hope to continue this habit of mine. I know that out of nowhere in one night I won't become someone who meditates for every day. Because I know myself. But I'll try to be more aware, become a better person and choose silence every once in a while. ____ The images are created with Gemini and edited with [Canva](www.canva.con) ____

body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNX3MTmosV9QW26Ni2FhfCzSdvL3GSe2h9mR4z7Zf7gsN/1777327945870.jpg)
[Picture Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-sitting-on-a-train-station-platform-at-sunrise-VecFR3sZojM)

Elena woke up as early as possible to prepare for the job interview. She checked her blouse again - that was the third time she had done that since she woke up, it was perfect. She had ironed it three times within the week just to make sure it looks sharp and smart. This job matters to me, she said. I'll do all I can to land it. **First impression** matters in job hunt. 

Before her siblings could make up in the morning - they usually wake up by 6:00am, Elena had gone to the city metro station to board the train. In the next thirty minutes the train had taken off to the city centre, venue of the job interview. 

It took then barely forty-five minutes to get to the city centre. Elena had no difficulty locating the venue for the interview. On getting there the gate was still locked 🔐. Elena banged at the gate and a middle-aged man came out. Elena introduced herself and the man simply nodded. 

As Elena finished the man pointed at the other side of the gate and asked Elena to go there and read a notice pasted there. Curiously Elena went there. It was a notice informing all job applicants that the scheduled interview had been shifted because of the two days national holidays declared by the federal government. Elena was stunned. She didn't even bother to check her weekly planner or even listened to tht radio, otherwise she would have heard about the holidays. 

Slowly she retraced hers steps to the place she will board another carb to the metro station where she will board the train and go home. Throughout that day Elena felt bad. Wanted journey she kept telling herself.

body.title: The Ways of the Future, and How It Affects Money
body.body: ![FutureChanges.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8GNejtM8umNkHRS1B7J66G7jzV1Eaw5567LsPFuWVb8/FutureChanges.png) One of the things mankind thinks they have worked out is cause and effect. However, so many thing have the cause in the future, and the effects in the past. And, even if it doesn't seemingly involve time travel, we often mistake which is the cause, and which is the effect. Modern Materialistic Scientists are VERY certain that all this matter is real, and those interactions, every step, is what causes the future outcome. And that if they could measure all the atom's movements, then they could perfectly predict the future. This isn't true at all. And Quantum Physics has proved it. The atoms don't really exist, unless someone is looking at them. There interactions are a probability, not a linear physics problem. And consciousness causes changes in matter. So, you cannot compute the future based on the trajectory of atoms, at the best you can get is a probability. But, what does this have to do with money?

></center>
## The future pulls into existence the cause

The future paints the present on the back drop of the past.

Lets say we have a future that we want to bring into being.  It is our dream, or a group of people's dream, or the planet's dream.  Lets say that it is the highest desired future, then what happens is that it becomes a/the future.  And then everything gets solved from now to the future manifestation.  It gets solved, both forward and backwards.

At this point, many people will say, \
(Where is free will? It was the choice to bring this future into being.)\n\n

></center>
## What does this have to do with money?

I am writing this because i have seen many analysts guessing at the future based on the past.  When we are in a time of immense change, when it is more likely that the unusual will show up instead of the same-ole.

An example will be gold bugz.  \
Which is quite wrong, and we will recognize that soon.  But, right now, many people are calling it God's Money.\n\nAnother example is that \

If we just took expectations as thing going linearly, then this is the obvious outcome.  But, it is not in our future at all, and you won't find a hint of its wrongness in the past.\n\nStill another is that we assume the stock market exists, and then it will go up slowly and crash every once in a while.  It is what it has done for over 100 years.  However, it will not continue.  It will not change a little, it will not get a little more regulation, it will go away.  \

Well, they are there, but no one connects them with the future of the stock market. You see the pundits saying that stocks will continue to go up (forever) or they say we are going to have a crash (because that has happened before) We are heading for a VERY different future. And after that, even more different.

></center>
## Wall Street is abandoned

What in our past would suggest a future where Wall Street is gone, abandoned, verboten?  Having that place burnt to the ground and the earth salted is a future option.  But Wall Street continuing to exist is not.

But why?  This is not linear.  Some similar examples is cars replacing horse and buggies or cell phones replacing land lines.  Unfortunately, those are not very good examples.  They are examples of expanding technology and adoption.

A better example might be slavery and the Civil War.  Before Civil War, people in America were becoming against slavery.  Then after the Civil War the slaves were freed.  The end or Wall Street is something more like that.

You could make a statement that everything Wall Street does is theft.  A better statement would be that Wall Street businesses are just different levels of evil.  And when that evil is called out for it what it is. When the people see clearly all the levels of evil, they will abandon it, they will turn their backs on it.  Banksters will be hunted down and hung from lampposts.

Imagine an advertisemnt: \

. Now, imagine that being actual, factual, real! Yes, horrifying, gruesome, all nine planes of hell manifest! The start will be bank closures. Bankster holidays. Where you won't have access to your money. And later have it openly stolen. The next step is that we find out that the banks have been continuously stealing from us. Mortgages are designed to kill you. Bankruptcy is inevitable, not just bad planning. And it goes downhill from there. Wall Street will be a bunch of empty buildings, and no one will move into them because of the social stigma.

are not figurative, they are what is done, with young children, to keep the banking system running.

T.H.E.Y. are not bad.  T.H.E.Y. are not misunderstood. T.H.E.Y. are not trying to help the planet by reducing the population.  T.H.E.Y. are evil.  T.H.E.Y.  want you controlled, and if you are not controllable, T.H.E.Y. want you dead.

When we come to see this, we will wipe them from our earth.  We will not tolerate their existence.

And so, our monetary future will be very different.  There will only be a few cryptos left, but those will be the rails all money passes through.  And sometime in there, many people switch to barter.  Computer aided, AI integrated, barter.

Corporations will no longer exist.  Banks will be gone.  We may, or may not have paper \

, but what we will have is several ways to make payment/barter. Investments will become a weird word. Tainted, and no longer anything like what is just accepted today. Investment in the future, yes. Investment in your business, yes. Investment in your community yes. Investment into stocks, no, doesn't exist. Investment in bonds, no, been abolished. Putting money in the bank? none of the words in that sentence continue to exist/have meaning.

>\n

body.title: Descanso / Rest ( esp / eng )
body.body:
¿Qué es descanso?Eso me pregunto… ¿no?
¿Descansar es estar viendo una película y ya?¿O descansar es dormir, cuando podrías estar haciendo algo más?
Hay muchas formas, muchas opciones…y aun así, no sé.
Hoy fue uno de esos días en los que no puse alarma.Aunque, siendo sincero, no la necesito.
Tengo a mi niño, Lukas, que es mi alarma natural.Él se acuesta todos los días a las 8 o 9 de la noche…pero a las 6 o 7 de la mañana ya está de pie,como diciendo: “ya empezó el día”.
Y así empieza el mío.
Hoy, en teoría, no tenía compromisos reales.Solo levantarme, desayunar, prepararme…y venir para el trabajo.
Pero ni siquiera a trabajar.
Vine el día antes, como siempre,a esperar.
A estar aquí.
Mañana sí… mañana toca.Turno de 24 horas.Guardia.
Pero hoy no.
Hoy nadie espera nada de mí.
Estoy en una habitación,tranquilo, en silencio,viendo una película tras otra,intentando llenar el tiempo.
Extrañando a mi familia.
Contando las horas.
Pensando: “ya, ahorita me acuesto, duermo, me levanto, hago la guardia… y me voy”.Contando cada minuto, cada segundo.
Y aun así…
no descanso.
Uno cree que está descansando,pero no.
Eso es mentira.Una especie de falacia.
Sí, puedes ver películas,series, cualquier cosa que te distraiga…algo que te ayude a pasar el tiempo.
Pero no es descanso.
Es solo espera.
Porque no estoy aquí disfrutando.No estoy en un paraíso.
El paraíso, para mí,es estar con mi familia.
Con mi esposa.Con mi niño.
Eso sí lo agradezco.
Extraño hasta lo más simple.
Ver a Lukas bajarse solo de la cama,ponerse a jugar como si el mundo fuera suyo.Ese desorden que hace…que en realidad no es desorden.
Es como si te organizará la vida,la casa, el cuarto… todo.
Tú ordenas,y él en dos segundos lo cambia todo.
Qué magia 
Y aquí estoy yo,acostado, mirando el techo,escribiendo esto para ustedes.
Porque al final…¿qué tal si dejo aquí un pedacito de mí?
Mañana quizás hable de un anime,de una película,de una serie…
No sé.
La verdad es que nunca sé de qué voy a hablar.
Solo sé que voy a escribir.
Todos los días es igual:quiero decir algo…pero no siempre sé qué.
Y aun así, aquí estoy.
Compartiendo.
Intentando hablar de algo.
Extraño mucho a mi esposa.
Aunque a veces ella me diga:“mira lo que tienes en casa”…y tenga razón.
A veces discutimos,no porque quiera,sino por costumbre.
Pero la extraño.La amo.
Y ahora mismo…
lo único que me queda es contar los minutos y las horas para regresar a casa.
 
![IMG_20260427_174942.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valderalazaro/23yJJuGvCQMcVMQFGEaTEXQtu6cBAwJ13uxYg1JA6Npq8mscRCet3gXMfp21H8xLQv2wn.jpg)
 Agradezco a mi esposa @diazktty que siempre está a mí lado 
Gracias a la fundación BBH 
A @cathyarrow a su esposo @bradleyarrow gracias a ellos estamos hoy aquí 
Que nunca les falte el amor 😍 
Dios los bendiga 🙏 
  Google translate
What is rest? That’s what I keep asking myself… right?
Is resting just watching a movie and that’s it? Or is resting sleeping, when you could actually be doing something else?
There are so many ways, so many options… and still, I don’t know.
Today was one of those days where I didn’t set an alarm. Though, to be honest, I don’t really need one.
I have my little boy, Lukas, who is my natural alarm. He goes to bed every day at 8 or 9 at night… but by 6 or 7 in the morning he’s already up, like he’s saying: “the day has started.”
And that’s how mine begins.
Today, in theory, I didn’t have real commitments. Just wake up, have breakfast, get ready… and come to work.
But not even to work.
I came the day before, as always, to wait.
To be here.
Tomorrow, yes… tomorrow it’s time. A 24-hour shift. Duty.
But not today.
Today, nobody expects anything from me.
I’m in a room, calm, in silence, watching movie after movie, trying to fill the time.
Missing my family.
Counting the hours.
Thinking: “okay, in a bit I’ll go to sleep, wake up, do the shift… and leave.” Counting every minute, every second.
And still…
I don’t rest.
You think you’re resting, but no.
That’s a lie. A kind of fallacy.
Yes, you can watch movies, series, anything that distracts you… something to help the time pass.
But it’s not rest.
It’s just waiting.
Because I’m not here enjoying anything. I’m not in a paradise.
Paradise, for me, is being with my family.
With my wife. With my child.
That, I am grateful for.
I even miss the simplest things.
Watching Lukas get out of bed on his own, starting to play like the world belongs to him. That mess he makes… which isn’t really mess.
It’s like he reorganizes your life, the house, the room… everything.
You clean it, and in two seconds he changes it all.
What magic.
And here I am, lying down, staring at the ceiling, writing this for you.
Because in the end… what if I leave a small piece of myself here?
Tomorrow maybe I’ll talk about an anime, a movie, a series…
I don’t know.
The truth is I never really know what I’m going to talk about.
I just know I’m going to write.
Every day is the same: I want to say something… but I don’t always know what.
And still, here I am.
Sharing.
Trying to talk about something.
I miss my wife a lot.
Even though sometimes she tells me: “look at what you have at home”… and she’s right.
Sometimes we argue, not because I want to, but out of habit.
But I miss her. I love her.
And right now…
all I have left is to count the minutes and hours until I return home.
I thank my wife @diazktty who is always by my side.
Thanks to the BBH Foundation.
And to @cathyarrow and her husband @bradleyarrow, thanks to them we are here today.
May they never lack love 😍
God bless them 🙏

body.title: Equipa a Otros y Deja de Controlarlos
body.body:
>

Equipar a otros en el liderazgo consiste en servir, preparar y capacitar a los miembros del equipo con las herramientas necesarias para vivir con significado. Este proceso implica eliminar obstáculos, anticipar necesidades futuras de aprendizaje y ofrecer retroalimentación constante para asegurar que el equipo prospere incluso sin la presencia directa del líder.

>Equipping others in leadership consists of serving, preparing, and empowering team members with the necessary tools to live with meaning. This process involves removing obstacles, anticipating future learning needs, and offering constant feedback to ensure that the team thrives even without the direct presence of the leader.
https://youtu.be/W6Hemztgn0g

Nadie alcanza la grandeza solo. El Liderazgo Multigeneracional es el puente que transforma la diversidad generacional de un reto en una fortaleza, aprovechando las diferencias entre generaciones como Baby Boomers y Generación Z como sinergia colaborativa. La clave está en enfocarse en el qué queremos lograr y no en el cómo, permitiendo que cada miembro encuentre su propio camino hacia el objetivo común.

>No one reaches greatness alone. Multigenerational Leadership is the bridge that transforms generational diversity from a challenge into a strength, leveraging the differences between generations like Baby Boomers and Generation Z as collaborative synergy. The key lies in focusing on what we want to achieve and not on the how, allowing each member to find their own path toward the common goal.

You don't find places like this, you know, like it's not so common, you know, having people speak with so much value and being present. It's just beautiful. Yeah, I'll tell you, these geniuses are pretty incredible.

Hi, MK. Hi. Hi, everyone.

Nice to be here. So exciting, man. All those amazing geniuses and the concept projects you are building, amazing.

I mean, thank you. Thank you, because it's like transfusion of excitement, passion, and it's 1245 a.m. at my end, so I will sleep well after that. Yeah, I don't know if I – I don't like to feel myself, but let me try.

You know, I'm a father, built a few businesses in my life, made not profit, but income, quite substantial. I gave most of it away, spend on my kids, my friends, a little bit on myself. And, you know, in 2019, I closed my last business.

I ran jewelry stores in China from 2011 until 2019. It was a blessing, actually, from God, you know. I'm bipolar, so I had a so-called upper episode.

I was volunteering in my friend's, like, amazing place. She's a Dakini. She's a friend of mine.

And somehow, you know, I heard two things from my partners, which were quite not aligned with their personality. I know them for many years, and I shut down. And it was 2019, and in 2020, COVID came.

So, you know, if I wouldn't close it in September 2019, then in 2020, you know, we would be in trouble. Anyway, I struggled a little bit from that time financially, and I launched the coin. I didn't do my research very deep about bags.

body.body:
![O4H60woBJK1bPlek_P_20260311_113615.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/O4H60woBJK1bPlek_P_20260311_113615/O4H60woBJK1bPlek_P_20260311_113615.webp) ![Jb0QHFR502tSN4TT_P_20260311_113803.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/Jb0QHFR502tSN4TT_P_20260311_113803/Jb0QHFR502tSN4TT_P_20260311_113803.webp) ![78lBDoFMbUQehc6j_P_20260311_113847.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/78lBDoFMbUQehc6j_P_20260311_113847/78lBDoFMbUQehc6j_P_20260311_113847.webp) ![thRIkPFGnxApHWuH_P_20260311_113837.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/thRIkPFGnxApHWuH_P_20260311_113837/thRIkPFGnxApHWuH_P_20260311_113837.webp) ![5bwxyOSDW00diUIV_P_20260311_111740.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/5bwxyOSDW00diUIV_P_20260311_111740/5bwxyOSDW00diUIV_P_20260311_111740.webp) ![pDjLBGDu3LQkq5KR_P_20260311_112453.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/pDjLBGDu3LQkq5KR_P_20260311_112453/pDjLBGDu3LQkq5KR_P_20260311_112453.webp) ![T4gnHdqmwfkJWxvK_P_20260311_112324.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/T4gnHdqmwfkJWxvK_P_20260311_112324/T4gnHdqmwfkJWxvK_P_20260311_112324.webp) ![RRb7BZPuZVHs3Wuu_P_20260311_112737.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/diochen/images/RRb7BZPuZVHs3Wuu_P_20260311_112737/RRb7BZPuZVHs3Wuu_P_20260311_112737.webp)
我身邊的很多人都喜歡吃麻辣鍋，當那一鍋色澤鮮紅、香氣四溢的麻辣鍋端上桌，再看到滾燙的鍋內的牛肉、羊肉、丸子、豆腐、鴨血及新鮮蔬菜後，立刻讓人開始動筷，即使吃得滿頭大汗，甚至鼻尖微紅，不過，人們還是忍不住一口接一口，享受又麻又辣的口感，關於吃辣的能力上，我沒辦法吃太辣的，小辣是我可以接受的辣度，我可不想辣屁股啊！ 這家以麻辣食堂為名的店家，主打的是四川風味的餐點，主要分成煲類跟鍋類兩系列的餐點，煲類算是個人鍋，而鍋類則是適合多人分食的，我就點份小辣的肥腸臭豆腐煲，來試試風味，臭豆腐還蠻大塊的，而且滷得蠻透的，湯汁吸得滿滿的，好吃，肥腸也很好吃，軟軟嫩嫩的口感，也滷得很入味，鴨血孔隙細幼，光滑嫩口，但是咬下也是會爆出麻辣湯汁，總之，算是好吃的煲。 話說，店內座位區都用隔板與對面座位的隔開，我不確定是不是疫情後，才這樣的，在疫情過後的現在，小吃店幾乎都把隔板拿掉，回復為以往的開放空間，居然這家店還保留隔板，真是奇怪。 事後，和朋友閒聊時，他提到，這家店的麻辣滷肉拌飯是他的最愛，滷肉的肥瘦比例剛剛好，吃起來膠質感很重，嘴唇會感到黏黏的，香麻且帶點辣的口感，拌著飯一起吃真的好香，聽他這樣介紹，下次有機會再拜訪時，我也要試試看麻辣滷肉拌飯。
---
A lot of people around me really love eating spicy hot pot. When that pot of bright red, super fragrant broth gets placed on the table, and you see all the beef, lamb, meatballs, tofu, duck blood, and fresh veggies boiling inside, you just can’t wait to start eating. Even if you end up sweating like crazy and your nose turns red, you still can’t stop and you just keep going, enjoying that numbing, spicy kick. As for me, I’m not great with spicy food. Mild spice is about my limit. I definitely don’t want to deal with the after-effects later, if you know what I mean. This place I went to is called a “mala canteen”, and it mainly serves Sichuan-style dishes. Their menu is split into two types: clay pot dishes and hot pot dishes. The clay pots are more like individual portions, while the hot pots are meant for sharing. I ordered a mildly spicy pork intestine and stinky tofu clay pot to try it out. The stinky tofu pieces were pretty big and really well-braised. They soaked up all the broth and tasted great. The pork intestine was also delicious, super soft and tender, and full of flavor. The duck blood had a smooth, delicate texture, and when you bite into it, it kind of bursts with spicy broth. Overall, it was a really tasty dish. One thing I noticed, though, was that the seating area still had partitions between tables. I’m not sure if they added those because of the pandemic, but most small restaurants have already removed them and gone back to an open layout. It felt kind of strange that this place still keeps them. Later, while chatting with a friend, he told me that their spicy braised pork rice is his favorite. He said the fat-to-lean ratio is just right, and it has this rich, gelatinous texture that kind of makes your lips feel sticky. It’s savory, a little spicy, and super fragrant when mixed with rice. After hearing him describe it like that, I definitely want to try the spicy braised pork rice next time I visit. --- For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@diochen/first-time-trying-a-mala-eatery)
