body.title: EBONY HERITAGE: THE POETICS OF RESISTANCE AND ANCESTRAL SPLENDOR - HERENCIA DE ÉBANO: LA POÉTICA DE LA RESISTENCIA Y EL BRILLO ANCESTRAL #monomad [Eng/Esp]
body.body:
En la intersección entre el misticismo africano y la elegancia editorial contemporánea, surge una serie que rinde tributo a la identidad, el linaje y la belleza soberana.
At the intersection of African mysticism and contemporary editorial elegance, a series emerges that pays tribute to identity, heritage, and sovereign beauty.

> Esta serie fotográfica, capturada con una sensibilidad técnica excepcional, es un estudio profundo sobre la textura, el contraste y el simbolismo. A través de una estética en blanco y negro que evoca la maestría del chiaroscuro, cada imagen transforma el retrato en una pieza de arte escultórico. La piel, tratada como un lienzo de ébano, refleja una luz que no solo ilumina, sino que revela la profundidad de una historia que se niega a ser olvidada.
This photographic series, captured with exceptional technical skill, is an in-depth exploration of texture, contrast, and symbolism. Through a black-and-white aesthetic that evokes the mastery of chiaroscuro, each image transforms the portrait into a sculptural work of art. The skin, treated as an ebony canvas, reflects a light that not only illuminates but also reveals the depth of a story that refuses to be forgotten.

> La composición se apoya en elementos de una opulencia etnográfica: el turbante, símbolo de dignidad y protección, dialoga con una joyería arquitectónica que parece fusionar la armadura con el ornamento. Las marcas tribales sobre el rostro, puntos de luz blanca que actúan como una cartografía espiritual, conectan a la modelo con sus raíces, mientras que las poses, de una serenidad regia, proyectan una masculinidad y feminidad poderosas y conscientes.
The composition draws on elements of ethnographic opulence: the turban, a symbol of dignity and protection, interacts with architectural jewelry that seems to blend armor with ornamentation. The tribal markings on the face—white dots of light that function as a spiritual map—connect the model to her roots, while the poses, with their regal serenity, project a powerful and self-assured masculinity and femininity.

> Ambientada contra paredes de textura cruda y ancestral, la serie explora la dualidad entre lo terrenal y lo divino. El uso de planos cerrados para captar la mirada profunda y planos abiertos que muestran la fluidez de las telas, crea un ritmo visual que invita a la comunidad de Hive a sumergirse en una experiencia estética donde la moda es solo el vehículo para hablar de algo mucho más grande: la eterna vigencia de la ancestralidad.
Set against walls with a raw, ancient texture, the series explores the duality between the earthly and the divine. The use of close-ups to capture the deep gaze and wide shots that showcase the fluidity of the fabrics creates a visual rhythm that invites the Hive community to immerse themselves in an aesthetic experience where fashion is merely the vehicle for discussing something much greater: the eternal relevance of our ancestral heritage.

body.title: Say No To Bullying And Say Yes To Healthy Growth// LOH Contest #286.
body.body: > Good day my lovely people, it's fair to say that exams week has been hectic which has made my work here on Hive really slow but I saw this contest topic which was very tempting to me that I couldn't let it pass which is why I didn't to join the trend. ![IMG_20260425_114144_644.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/graceze/23xVcLeHTRb82dMvvYzTfXM5g7t5u22mNxChBn3GtpPDvxFvsEyampFFgZumGsxeaSn17.jpg) Anytime I watch a kid, pupil or student bullying their fellow mate either in the movies or real life what first of all usually comes to my mind is that there is problem at home, and by me saying there's problem at home I mean maybe at home the father maltreat the mother or the child is neglected at home and he seeks validation or attention from outsider, or he or she is a spoilt brat at home who thinks that the world revolves around them so the world should actually pause for them or there's just problem at home that affects them psychological which makes them take it out on others. How I would address bullying should be dependent on the situation from where I am addressing it, if I am in that scenario or place where the bullying is taking place or if I am to discourage someone from bullying like taking a talk on it, then addressing them would deserve different approach to it. Addressing it from the perspective of being in the situation itself would be me standing up for myself and making sure to point out to the bully that bullying only makes you Inferior and lesser of a human. Before even answering for if my children where to be victims of bullying, I would love to note that the kind of confidence, self worth and self value I would teach my child would be a kind that makes that child know his or her right and worth anywhere they find themselves and this would avoid the case of been a victim, but if anyone's child become a victim of bullying I would recommend therapy to them and also to report the case to the school authority so that immediate effect and changes would be made or else I change the school of that child, what I might also do is suggest help for both the bully and his or her family so as to amend what ever is happening at home. Bullying is one thing that I dreaded so much that I always make people think I am that strong and smart kid which can't be messed around with, and this approach has helped me out in school and it's even helping me out up till now, say no to bullying and encourage healthy growth. Peace out my lovely people, have a wonderful day ahead. All images used here belongs to me.

body.title: My Daily Blog 2026#116
body.body: > ![MDB.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/48mdZ9LtJFi9khbC6TsZUdMbt3CXN8oPYyMAAhUNVYJyq3VHCRQwZW9L4ig8pyFnaM.jpg) Kolejny dzień w pracy. Wiedziałem, że będę chciał wykorzystać dobrą pogodę, dlatego przeniosłem trening zaplanowany na sobotę na dziś. To podwójna korzyść: w sobotę i tak nie będę miał czasu na normalny trening, a dziś szkoda byłoby męczyć się w zamkniętym pomieszczeniu. Ładna pogoda wyciągnęła na zewnątrz wielu biegaczy – mijałem ich dziś wyjątkowo dużo. Nie oznacza to jednak, że ich wyprzedzałem; wręcz przeciwnie, to ja byłem dziś wyprzedzany, choć zdarzyło się to tylko raz. > ***[ENG] Another day at work. I knew I’d want to make the most of the good weather, so I moved the workout scheduled for Saturday to today. It's a double win: I won't have time for a proper session on Saturday anyway, and it would have been a shame to be stuck indoors today. The nice weather brought out plenty of runners—I passed quite a lot of them. That doesn't mean I was overtaking them, though; in fact, I was the one being overtaken, although it only happened once.*** ![IMG_4090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243Lvqe72jafHbPjYSwYYaGq7QcQXre8FFa5mcgMGThzswCssRaDna9Guwb8U26WfX5fU.jpg) ![IMG_4091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/244xpv8XzYUYuuiU5GbaVqj5SjrSMCZGi1krZG8S8zo2qqLj5H7TP1ZeMy2kBPGZwpYwd.jpg) ![IMG_4094.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/2449xTHoeiULtaJ8SgiABqMGLtdXjXRG4ugyqVMoF7UimhvVT175XsrCMoBynzbYHx7VG.jpg) W ocenie wirtualnego trenera dzisiejszy bieg to solidne wybieganie bazowe, ale dane wskazują dwa obszary, nad którymi muszę popracować w kontekście mojego celu (10 km poniżej 55 min). Pierwszy z nich to tętno, a drugi to kadencja. W przypadku tętna i tak zrobiłem już duży postęp, osiągając średnią 152 bpm; nie wiem, czy będę w stanie jeszcze bardziej poprawić ten wynik. Co do kadencji – sprawa jest otwarta. Przy mojej masie powinna być ona wyższa (około 170 spm), co pomogłoby zmniejszyć obciążenie stawów i poprawić ekonomię biegu. Krótszy krok oznacza mniejszą siłę uderzenia o podłoże. Przy następnej okazji spróbuję krótkich interwałów w tempie 5:20–5:30 min/km, żeby oswoić organizm z prędkością docelową. > ***[ENG] According to my virtual coach, today's run was a solid base workout, but the data highlights two areas I need to work on for my goal (10k under 55 min). The first is heart rate, and the second is cadence. Regarding heart rate, I’ve already made significant progress by reaching an average of 152 bpm; I’m not sure if I can improve much more in that area. As for cadence, there’s definitely room for improvement. Given my build, my cadence should be higher (around 170 spm), which would help reduce joint impact and improve running economy. A shorter stride means lower impact forces. Next time, I’ll try short intervals at a 5:20–5:30 min/km pace to get my body used to the target speed.*** ![IMG_4095.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/243zVCmPe8aANNDQNZXJtoSF28QHAaRhUjhtHHK5UmBuws24rC4DuRLmk7T5zpZZ8o9qJ.jpg) ![IMG_4097.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23xATu52se4ueaXCiUSjMTk4TDZLyubGYthcMfaaiBTRtcqUFczesRLJhtZUACLPs5MH5.jpg) ![IMG_4098.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23sU43rkCbKFcZbmPxhMb6g6AVVE7bHx4sStZctp5vPwSrGfTXCSP5gpzfvDqTGVBbWJN.jpg) ![screenshot-connect.garmin.com-2026.04.27-23_15_25.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/browery/23zGuLingTsSFQMEp7R8dS5KAdioSBJwtDSKkc4nJG3xyBjSxTgkeiKicSKKgKioj1JKX.png) ---

George Pólya

Saludos a toda la comunidad de HIVE, con el fin de promocionar el contenido matemático dentro de nuestra querida red social, a continuación les presento la siguiente sección en la cual se estará publicando un problema matemático a ser resuelto, los problemas abordarán diversas áreas de la Matemática (Aritmética, Álgebra, Geometría, Análisis, entre otros).

Los invito a compartir sus soluciones, sin más preámbulo les presento el problema

¿Cuántos números enteros positivos de tres cifras existen cuya suma de cifras es un número de una sola cifra?


La matemática es la ciencia de la abstracciones, que presenta cierta belleza austera para todo aquel que decide dedicarse a su estudio.

Me despido deseándoles feliz blogging.

links.body:
![Book Cover.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amirtheawesome1/23tSKs1vTAYm4LWkFXUw5QAwdGyj4QE3qaKbDZuyibyFD6yA1ugv4w4mv3bESpJaxK2jS.jpeg)

League top scorer. Champions League top scorer. 46 goal contributions in 39 matches this season. 95 goal contributions in 98 matches for Real Madrid overall. These are not “good season” numbers. These are the kind of numbers people usually throw at you to end an argument before it even starts. You see them and instinctively go, alright, please tell me we are not about to blame this guy for anything. Please tell me we are not that fucking stupid.

And yet, somehow, we are here. Again. Asking the question that sounds like bait until you actually look at Madrid properly:

# Is Kylian MbappeReal Madrid’s problem?

The funny thing is that this whole debate already had a test run in Paris. When Luis Enrique said PSG had become better defensively and offensively without Mbappe, people laughed. Of course they laughed. The normal reaction was to open Transfermarkt, pull out Mbappe’s numbers at PSG, and slam them on the table like a lawyer in a bad courtroom drama. Club legend, record-breaker, ridicolous output, face of the project, scorer of goals nobody else could score. If that was the problem, then what exactly does a solution look like?

Then PSG went and answered in the most annoying way possible: by winning. Not just winning a few games and pretending everything was fine, but actually looking like a serious football team. Balanced, aggressive, structured, talented. A team with artists, yes, but artists who actually ran. Which, for PSG, is basically a cultural revolution.

But even that did not really end the argument, because the argument was already built on a weak foundation. Results. Just results. People love results because they are easy. You win, you were right. You lose, you were wrong. Nice and clean. Football is not nice and clean. Football is ninety minutes of plans being ruined by deflections, referees, nerves, goalkeepers turning into monsters, and one fullback forgetting where he works.

If PSG had played exactly the same way and lost a final because of one stupid moment, would people still say Enrique was right? Probably not. They would call him a bottler, dig up old tournament failures, and pretend the whole performance never happened. So if PSG’s trophies alone prove Mbappe was the problem, then Mbappe’s numbers alone prove he was never the problem. And now we are stuck, because both sides are using the same lazy logic and acting like the other side is the idiot.

That is why the debate keeps going in circles. On one side, Mbappe is individually obscene. Pick whatever attacking metric makes you feel clever: goals, expected goals, shots, carries, dribbles, chance creation, final-third touches, whatever. He is there. Usually near the top. Sometimes standing alone in that stupid top-right corner of a graph where Messi and Ronaldo used to live while everyone else looked like they had entered the wrong sport.

On the other side, PSG became more coherent without him, and Real Madrid looked less coherent with him. That is the part people try to skip because it ruins the easy version of the story. PSG did not just lose a superstar and survive. They looked more like a team. They found the thing every great team eventually needs: structure without killing talent, talent without killing structure. For years, football people acted like you had to choose. Either you build a machine where everyone obeys the system, or you collect superstars and pray one of them does something illegal with a football. Enrique’s PSG said, actually, you can have both, but only if nobody is bigger than the job.

Madrid, meanwhile, did the most Madrid thing possible. They had a squad with Vinícius, Bellingham, Rodrygo, Valverde, and a bunch of unresolved structural issues, then decided the missing piece was the most famous forward on earth who also wants to live in the same attacking zones as their best attacker. Of course Mbappe scored. He is Mbappe. He would score goals in a parking lot with three defenders and a shopping cart in front of him. That was never the question.

The question is whether he solved what Madrid actually needed solved. Because adding brilliance is not the same as adding balance. Sometimes it is just turning the volume up in a room that already had a speaker problem.

# In Conclusion

Mbappe is not the problem in the lazy Twitter-tactico sense. His goals are not fake, his numbers are not empty, and pretending he is just some luxury passenger is stupid. The problem is that brilliance does not automatically answer the question a team is actually asking. Madrid did not need someone to make their strongest area louder. They needed something to make the whole thing make sense.

links.title: The Silverbloggers Chronicles - Prompt #44  Did you ever try to run away from home?
links.body:
![sb 44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23vsG6HCAfyABKLZZXDSsX4W7wK1oebbDBPWyFBC49uEX9PJD8jMd6pDmpWJkuH9q4FJU.jpg)


***
# The SB-Chronicle Prompt #44
With #sb-chronicles... we are posting a question on Mondays, prompting anyone who wants to join in to write their own \
Chronicle for future generations to read! *If you feel like suggesting a next prompt yourself... please feel welcome to contact one of the \

!*

###  Did you ever try to run away from home? What made you want to leave? What did you pack to bring and how far did you go? 
> Whenever my parents scold me back then I always think of leaving the house and swearing never to come back😆. Though it never happened. After a few minutes I would forget my plan and resume to playing🤷.
######

***

# The How-2 join the Silverbloggers Chronicles

- Just take the prompt question and answer it in your own Hive post. 
- **Post in our Silver Bloggers Community**.
- Be sure to **use [#sb-chronicles](https://peakd.com/created/sb-chronicles) as your first tag**, to get them all listed at the same place. 
- Write 100% original content of **around 300 words in English**.
- **Put the link to your post into the comment section of your chosen prompt.**
- Have fun.
- 

And soon enough, we’ll have a \

for future generations. **There is no time limit for all this...** Write whenever you like and whatever prompt suits you. Just make sure you use the proper tag and put a link to your post in the comment section of the chosen prompt, so we can curate your story.

[You can check here on all our prompts - always updated with what's to come!](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-silverbloggers-writers-block-terminator)
***
![SB_Chronicles_Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/Eo8UoVbkMbQLQ4Mv34M33H1DPziCRD6Kc9fanV7reiyH3hHt5kXjpLpTNKR54CnoZnL.png)
***

# The Idea of the Chronicles
...kinda started when our community advisor [SilverScribe](https://peakd.com/@ericvancewalton) came up with the Memoir Mondays. A new topic/question every Monday for a whole year, and we all loved it so much that we've fallen into a kind of writer's block since the \

of it.  <sup><sup> *Not really, but still...* </sup></sup>

So what could be more obvious than to continue somehow? Something has to be done to tackle writer's block, or even the ‘all-time low’ at Hive...
***
The Silverators started brainstorming the hows and the whens to get an idea of what we could all share for the best of our community. To have a sort of \

that never gets old.

In the synonyms for the word memoir, we can find - chronicle. Now, that was it.... our own chronicles!  **The Silverbloggers Chronicles**! The place where we all keep our memories to share with the future. The library of a silly, wild bunch of Silvers. **The Silvery Book of the Wise**! Hehehe


***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***
### On Winning the Prize ?!
We are all winners in this by supporting each other in the community, be it with an upvote, a tip, and/or a kind comment... 

> Since we \
know that many are just chasing big votes, with not doing much at all, running behind the whales to get them to pay attention, craving for a vote of lots of dollar$. Or the ones being \

and trying to benefit from the Vitamin R<sup>elation</sup> until there's a Lambo in sight...!

We feel this is the wrong way. A community should be there for each other, even if many humans are conditioned differently. It's more about putting the ego-selfish-ego aside, because life is not about money, it's about joy/happiness. That everyone gets support for their best they give to the community. 

> You may say it's good to have dreams? Yes, we live these dreams to achieve the best for everyone. Remember - joy/happiness?!

Why are we even writing about this while promoting the Chronicles for our community? It's to make us all realise that many members don't get high-profile support, but we can \

ourselves. Also, to understand that the idea of a memoir library for future generations is probably not the way to get rich, to finally get that Lambo. It's about sharing viewpoints, knowledge, and the occasional good laugh. It's about individuals, nature, and happiness. And be sure, we continue to curate the pearls in our midst!
***
![silver_divider_black.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/23tm7UaLc76pYmSHzjvoxFkPkfZzAiHisjLZwAUTQxGnKDSXL96oVGDuZfXYU9Rdd7YwX.png)
***

## Last words...
***
We would love to get more eyes on this post *and* all community posts from - [@hive-106316](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316) - our Silver Bloggers Mother Account.  This is why we make a point of reblogging your posts.  Please do the same?!  

<center>

### Come and join our [Silver Bloggers community![Silver Bloggers footer banner 600 x 300.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/48WD1eopcAX4rSS8vpYrV1FgBxPT9MQgSPaM2ToKczuqCr1Z41rVsFP8GHaoMoe4MT.jpg)](https://peakd.com/c/hive-106316)

### And a big THANK YOU for your support
</center>
***
[![SB_NoAI.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-106316/Eo6MQJHtPDETiEe2BCnwng3GefzS4S4q8jQBKEUpMgCrLp97LstcvcZJNS8rwT7D567.png)](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-menu-a-silver-bloggers-guide-to-the-hive-iverse)
***
[![SB_theMenu_Banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mondoshawan/EoEs3Nt6MvHXUTEeurge3264ftcpenP1XgLMBvt65mRJ6iwQ9tYKYdjraavD5hMWcjk.png)](https://peakd.com/hive-106316/@hive-106316/the-menu-a-silver-bloggers-guide-to-the-hive-iverse)

<table class=\

>1,000
Your ‘tips’ and ‘delegations’ help to support the community! Thank you ! The “true” way of a community is to support each other, also on Hive. Since it doesn't make sense to wait for the mercy of a millionaire to send us $$$ - we support each other with the best we can.
>Tipping or delegating is a way to show that you appreciate the work. It works even after a contribution has gone through the seven days of voting, and thus the opportunity for gracious \

is over. Another plus - that way no one can ‘steal’ your given support, not even the often ego-selfish, pointless Down-Voters. We thank you for all the support you give, anywhere!
</details>

links.title: Pulsera de nudos planos con la inicial del personaje Zappit [Esp-Eng]
links.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Hola, comunidad #holozing Es un placer saludaros a todos y desearos un feliz y bendecido inicio de semana. Hoy voy a compartir un fan art inspirado en un personaje conocido como Zappit. Mi fan art es una pulsera de nudo plano hecha con hilos cola de ratón, balines y la inicial (Z) del nombre del personaje. Sin más preámbulos, les invito a que me acompañéis en esta fascinante creación y pongáis manos a la obra con el hilo.

> **
ENGLISH
** Hello, #holozing community! It’s a pleasure to greet you all and wish you a happy and blessed start to the week. Today I’m going to share some fan art inspired by a character known as Zappit. My fan art is a flat knot bracelet made with rattail cord, beads, and the initial (Z) of the character’s name. Without further ado, I invite you to join me in this fascinating creation and get started with the cord. ![1000404768.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoiVGZHNaq5XKyk2akBZrmDaeiXv47mAJ94AtZxGofVPig1PMjeyLiEkzKVAiNWfnLZ.jpg) ![1000404738.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/AK2DLeiV3nDcEFAEhPsxdY45AkkcgLY4HRyxouzj9Kwc8dn3TgfYhzpre7CvNSb.png) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Los materiales que utilicé para realizar esta hermosa pulsera son los siguientes, a saber: Hilo Tijera Encendedor Cinta métrica Cinta adhesiva

> The materials I used to make this beautiful bracelet are as follows, namely: Thread Scissors Lighter Measuring tape Adhesive tape ![1000404861.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eo6MNYisi8btYHQ1uonhPJrHPrWZereV4t8EGUqb5oQ7kpQjkxRyyutfVdkJijiLi5q.jpg)
> Para empezar esta preciosa joya empecé cortando dos hebras de hilo de 40 cm que utilizaré como base para nuestra pulsera

> To begin this beautiful jewelry I started by cutting two 40cm strands of thread which I will use as the base for our bracelet. ![1000404860.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpA3yBJae5HzbRjTLyW3Rz4N3n3LpvpymVpiva881P5C4SYbRFSFBL5NK9rBWLASHVv.jpg)
> Después corté una hebra de hilo de 130cm para realizar el tejido plano de la pulsera.

> Then I cut a 130cm strand of thread to make the flat weave of the bracelet. ![1000404859.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep3fmb8o7uMD9UeUaUv6djMuMtDNQkxMnSvK1C7ghveFYt25JiutQSeboYkHJyf2cS9.jpg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

> Inicié la pulsera realizando nudos planos de la siguiente manera: Primero tomé el hilo derecho, lo pasé por encima de la base , hice una forna de P, luego tomé el hilo izquierdo, lo pase por encima del hilo derecho (que estaba del lado izquierdo) , seguidamente lo pasé por dejado de la base y lo saqué por dentro del hilo derecho (la forma de P). Después estiré el hilo de cada lado uniformemente para hacer el nudo. Con los dedos se presiona para que quede igual de ambos lados Así comenzamos nuestro tejido.

> Started the bracelet by making flat knots in the following way: First I took the right strand, passed it over the base, made a P shape, then took the left strand, passed it over the right strand (which was on the left side), then passed it over the base and pulled it through the inside of the right strand (the P shape). Then I stretched the thread on each side evenly to make the knot. With your fingers you press it so that it is even on both sides and so we begin our weaving ![1000404835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wMekYbbbGdwG6ZJgzRzot5aMCVjmoHvV7MJwDBcRBLSU4AsQ5T5PA29JH5Y5tTTAUxS.jpg)

> Ahora tomé el hilo del lado izquierdo y lo pasé por encima del hilo base, formé una especie de cuatro, luego pasé el hilo del lado derecho por encima del hilo izquierdo que tenemos en el lado derecho, después lo pasé por debajo del hilo base y lo saqué por el interior o argolla del hilo izquierdo como nos lo señala la imagen. Seguidamente con los dedos presioné para que de ambos lados tengan similitud.

> Now I took the thread on the left side and passed it over the base thread, I formed a kind of four, then I passed the thread on the right side over the left thread that we have on the right side, then I passed it under the base thread and took it out through the inside or ring of the left thread as shown in the image. Then I pressed with my fingers so that both sides have similarity ![1000404836.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23wgRzqzpBXfASCpDeudbnL1cR3gbLpaLN4YDizYcpbmsEMbuUeM73SLFy62U1q8uZeaN.jpg)
> Seguí realizando siete nudos planos completos hasta llegar a 7cm

> I continued making seven complete flat knots until I reached 7 cm. ![1000404858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eos3FuLQQug6Yk2UvgQFYVojWZFjjEME3Mdih3mYcCrm8KNobogNgytA49LDZpCkYPM.jpg)
> Luego introduje dos mostacillas por los hilos anudadores y la letra inicial del nombre Zappit.

> Then I threaded two beads onto the knotting threads and the initial letter of the name Zappit. ![1000404837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23tmNJa5ghQtcCMWaQV3PGdYdqGPFC9wF6328cGvXvn3qVak4LV1KBVqL5NcQrrEuoft1.jpg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)
> Seguí realizando el mismo procedimiento hasta llegar a la medida deseada.

> Continue following the same procedure until you reach the desired size. ![1000404857.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EoGzrogYQTv3mxwx3jLw2bpinTco2h91kPWFsDycVyW9ZrzfVu8HjXP2XGbwMdk7Uip.jpg)
> Después de llegar a la medida deseada corté los hilos sobrantes y sellé

links.title: Strategy vs. Preaching: The Great Dilemma of the Brazilian Right
links.body: \n\nThe Brazilian political landscape has been the stage for intense polarization, but beyond the surface of the speeches, there is a strategic mechanism that often goes unnoticed by the general public. However, for those in the \

as the **Jaguardopote** channel.

https://play.3speak.tv/embed?v=dreloop07/gbgyoj0k
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWBNqdWmGmX3Wt3y3z8x1FV6xJXq7SgUWZubSft4h3Du4/captura_de_tela_2026_04_27_183548.png)

 Rightly observed in its recent analysis, the difference in approach between the right and the left (specifically the PT) can be the determining factor for success or failure at the polls.

### The Phenomenon of \
\n\nOne of the most critical points raised is the tendency of conservative congresses and events to transform into sessions of \

But what does this mean in practice? It means that the right often spends energy and resources reaffirming values ​​and criticisms that its own audience already accepts as absolute truth. By focusing on \

or repetitive moralistic speeches, there is a risk of speaking only to a bubble, without advancing in the necessary ground to win over the undecided or pragmatic voter.

This approach creates a comfortable but politically sterile environment. While the activists feel energized, the real strategy of base expansion takes a back seat.

### The Pragmatic Game of the Left

In contrast, the analysis points out that the PT has demonstrated a strategic maturity that the right still seems reluctant to adopt. Instead of focusing only on inflammatory ideological speeches, progressive congresses have increasingly turned to **pure electoral tactics**. They are discussing how to fill the opponent's \
with negative narratives—what we call deconstruction—while structuring their own image for the future.\n\nThe left understands that politics is not just about being right, but about how that \

is perceived by those who have not yet made a decision. They play the game of meticulous deconstruction, pointing out flaws and building barriers to the opponent's growth.

### The Challenge of Deconstruction

As mentioned in the **Jaguardopote** video, the task of the right today should be intelligent deconstruction. It's not enough to say the opponent is bad; it's necessary to show, strategically, why their proposals and history are harmful to the average voter. The opponent's \

of voting intention will naturally fill up if there isn't a coordinated effort to put inconvenient truths and management errors there.

### Conclusion: It's time to professionalize the strategy

For the Brazilian right to convert its digital strength into lasting political results, it needs to overcome the vice of preaching. The enthusiasm of the masses is important, but without a professional electoral strategy focused on deconstruction and expansion, the conservative field will continue to gain applause at congresses, but will lose ground in the real game of power. The great lesson is clear: less preaching, more strategy.

links.title: Ya no soy la buena del cuento || I'm no longer the good girl in the story
links.body:
>

¡Hola gente bonita!

Hace poco leía una [reflexión](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/con-limites-y-con-las-cosas-claras-relacionarse-en-forma-armoniosa-y-responsable-reflexiones-desde-el-respeto-esen) de @emiliorios sobre los límites y las relaciones armoniosas, y no pude evitar detenerme a mirar el camino que yo misma he recorrido en este sentido. 

Durante gran parte de mi vida, viví bajo la dictadura de una frase que hoy, con la perspectiva que dan los años, me parece una de las trampas más peligrosas para la salud mental: \

. Para mí, esa paz consistía en ser el amortiguador de los conflictos ajenos, en disculpar lo imperdonable y en buscar una justificación lógica para cada desplante o falta de respeto que recibía. Creía, erróneamente, que mi valor como persona estaba directamente ligado a mi capacidad de sacrificio y a mi habilidad para que nadie a mi alrededor se sintiera incómodo, incluso si eso significaba que la incomodidad se mudara a vivir permanentemente dentro de mi pecho. Asumí responsabilidades que nunca me pertenecieron. Me convertí en una experta en cargar cruces ajenas, pidiendo perdón por errores que no cometí y tratando de arreglar situaciones que otros habían roto por puro descuido.

>

Hello, beautiful people!

I recently read a [reflection](https://hive.blog/hive-131951/@emiliorios/con-limites-y-con-las-cosas-claras-relacionarse-en-forma-armoniosa-y-responsable-reflexiones-desde-el-respeto-esen) by @emiliorios about boundaries and harmonious relationships, and I couldn't help but stop and look back at the path I have traveled in this regard.

For much of my life, I lived under the dictatorship of a phrase that today, with the perspective that years provide, seems to me one of the most dangerous traps for mental health: \

For me, that peace consisted of being the shock absorber for other people's conflicts, of excusing the inexcusable, and of seeking a logical justification for every slight or lack of respect I received. I mistakenly believed that my value as a person was directly linked to my capacity for sacrifice and my ability to ensure that no one around me felt uncomfortable, even if it meant that discomfort moved in permanently within my own chest. I took on responsibilities that never belonged to me. I became an expert at carrying other people's crosses, apologizing for mistakes I didn't commit and trying to fix situations that others had broken out of sheer neglect.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbwvCkZsu6act6AJCs9HfL2okjcLhk4gzbjS6CjcRz8E1/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-candle-lantern-light-9418509/)
>\n\nEn aquel entonces, no me daba cuenta de que cada vez que yo asumía una culpa que no era mía para evitar una discusión, estaba entregando un pedazo de mi dignidad. El resultado de esa supuesta \

exterior era un caos interno devastador. Terminaba mis días agotada, con una sensación de pesadez que no se quitaba con el sueño, sumida en episodios de profunda tristeza y, sobre todo, sintiendo que mi voz y mi presencia no tenían un valor real en el mundo. Me sentía invisible ante mis propios ojos, un simple recurso para que los demás transitaran su vida sin contratiempos.\n\nSin embargo, de un tiempo para acá, algo cambió. No fue un rayo que me partió en dos, sino más bien el goteo constante de una realidad que ya no podía sostener. Empecé a entender que la paz que se logra a costa de la propia anulación no es paz, es sumisión. Comencé a practicar una de las palabras más cortas y, a la vez, más poderosas del idioma: \
. \n\nAl principio, pronunciarla me provocaba taquicardia. Sentía una culpa inmediata, como si estuviera traicionando un código sagrado de bondad. Pero con la práctica, ese \
empezó a sentirse como un escudo, como una declaración de soberanía sobre mi propia energía. Aprendí que decir \
cuando no quiero hacer algo, o cuando algo me lástima, no me convierte en una persona egoísta o conflictiva; me convierte en una mujer responsable de su propio bienestar.
>\n\nBack then, I didn't realize that every time I took on a guilt that wasn't mine just to avoid an argument, I was handing over a piece of my dignity. The result of that supposed external \

was a devastating internal chaos. I ended my days exhausted, with a sense of heaviness that sleep couldn't wash away, immersed in episodes of deep sadness and, above all, feeling that my voice and my presence had no real value in the world. I felt invisible to my own eyes, a mere resource for others to go through their lives without any setbacks.\n\nHowever, for some time now, something has changed. It wasn't a lightning bolt that split me in two, but rather the constant drip of a reality I could no longer sustain. I began to understand that the peace achieved at the cost of one's own self-nullification is not peace; it is submission. I began to practice one of the shortest and, at the same time, most powerful words in the language: \
\n\nAt first, saying it gave me palpitations. I felt an immediate guilt, as if I were betraying a sacred code of kindness. But with practice, that \
began to feel like a shield, like a declaration of sovereignty over my own energy. I learned that saying \

when I don't want to do something, or when something hurts me, doesn't make me a selfish or confrontational person; it makes me a woman responsible for her own well-being.
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdthYSfs32yVuDcbA8FBMbcDgNCHVMjyujqr8wYeXTJDP/image.png)[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/ai-generated-woman-fantasy-piano-9131174/)

> Poner límites ha sido el descubrimiento más liberador en mucho tiempo. Es entender que no soy el depósito de las frustraciones de nadie ni el mapa que debe guiar a otros a través de sus propias tormentas. He aprendido a soltar las cruces que no me corresponden y a devolverle a cada quien la responsabilidad de sus actos. Es curioso, pero cuando dejas de justificar lo injustificable, la realidad se vuelve mucho más nítida. Dejas de cargar con esa molesta sensación de insuficiencia porque comprendes que el malestar del otro no siempre es un reflejo de algo que hiciste mal, sino de sus propios límites no resueltos. Hoy, mi prioridad es mi paz emocional. No esa paz de superficie que se rompe con el primer viento, sino una estabilidad interna que nace del autorrespeto. Ya no tengo miedo a las discusiones si estas son necesarias para marcar una frontera, ni me aterra que alguien se aleje porque ya no puede caminar sobre mí. He comprendido que quien se molesta cuando pones un límite es, precisamente, quien más se beneficiaba de que no lo tuvieras. Al final del día, lo que queda es la satisfacción de no sentirme cargada de culpas innecesarias. Me siento mejor, más ligera y, sobre todo, dueña de mi narrativa. He dejado de ser el personaje secundario que limpia el escenario para que otros brillen, para convertirme en la protagonista de una vida que, por fin, tiene sentido y dirección propia. La verdadera armonía no es la ausencia de conflictos, sino la presencia de respeto, empezando por el que nos debemos a nosotros mismos.

> Setting boundaries has been the most liberating discovery in a long time. It is understanding that I am not the storehouse for anyone's frustrations, nor the map that must guide others through their own storms. I have learned to let go of the crosses that do not belong to me and to return the responsibility for their actions to each person. It’s curious, but when you stop justifying the unjustifiable, reality becomes much clearer. You stop carrying that nagging sense of inadequacy because you realize that the other person's discomfort is not always a reflection of something you did wrong, but of their own unresolved boundaries. Today, my priority is my emotional peace. Not that surface-level peace that breaks with the first breeze, but an internal stability born from self-respect. I am no longer afraid of arguments if they are necessary to mark a boundary, nor am I terrified that someone will walk away because they can no longer walk all over me. I have come to understand that the person who gets upset when you set a boundary is, precisely, the one who benefited the most from you not having one. At the end of the day, what remains is the satisfaction of not feeling burdened by unnecessary guilt. I feel better, lighter and, above all, the owner of my own narrative. I have stopped being the secondary character who cleans the stage so that others can shine, to become the protagonist of a life that, finally, has its own meaning and direction. True harmony is not the absence of conflict, but the presence of respect, starting with the respect we owe to ourselves.
![Portada de facebook ropa minimalista.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmafmLSTge5P1WuKg3o2tS5L8NKcq1tW4oNC6P8yHEUK7c/Portada%20de%20facebook%20ropa%20minimalista.gif)

> Hola, buenos días, tardes o noches, comunidad de #shadowhunters. Una nueva publicación para esta casería de sombras en #hive, versión #423 del #contest #SMASH. --- Llevaba unas semanas sin compartirles alguna fotografía de sombras. El fin de semana estuve por una vereda en el Valle del Cauca; fue un recorrido interesante para conocer otros pueblos. Estuve prácticamente todo el día en una finca; habían cortado los árboles de café y tenían la madera amontonada al lado de la carretera. Al amontonar la leña en ese lugar, evitaban que algún vehículo se pasara del límite y dañara las nuevas plantas de café que estaban sembrando. Las sombras de las fotografías son principalmente de las plantas de plátano y un poco de los árboles que están al borde de la carretera. ---- Gracias por leerme y muchas gracias a los que votan o comentan. Están invitados a participar en este challenge [Shadow Hunters Community SMASh Contest- Round 423](https://ecency.com/hive-179017/@melinda010100/shadow-hunters-community-smash-contest-ede6fa6fa9acc). --- ---

Over the weekend, I was in a small town in Valle del Cauca; it was an interesting trip to explore other villages. I spent practically the whole day on a farm; they had cut down the coffee trees and piled the wood alongside the road. By stacking the firewood there, they prevented vehicles from veering off the road and damaging the new coffee plants they were planting. links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZQTXitZnwsjBJEhD68krQ2j2UUXfKq36oMBC1kmR78kj/1776389424665.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYN3eZCRwGW9QUBZUYzx69UHctBtxZFpAwGhzPTLxnR6u/1776389424744.jpg)

# SPOILERS AHEAD!!!

### Chapters Read: 11-15

After watching the *Blade* trilogy it's really nice to get back to *Cirque Du Freak*. Another of the many reasons I believe books are the ultimate form of entertainment, better than most movies, is because books don't require any reliance on graphics or CGI or anything like that. The graphics in my mind are top notch, LOL. 

Each trilogy of the four trilogies in this series have their own flavor and it's so awesome. Each series Darren slowly grows up more and more of course. 

The first trilogy was just Darren coping with his new life and learning the 101 of being a half-vampire. 

The second trilogy was a much deeper dive into what it's really like to be a vampire. Learning their lifestyle, history, experiencing their politics. It's grittier for sure. 

This trilogy is beginning to feel straight up mystical, magical. 

Vancha March might be the coolest character in this whole series. Well, that may be a strong statement but he has made a cool first impression. He's one of the coolest characters for sure. I certainly liked him in my first reads of this series but this time I like him a lot more. He's a bit gross but otherwise he's pretty awesome. Funny, tough, and wise. Just a strong individual. 

Vancha tries to battle the sun as a vampire, and he often tests his skin against the sun, in a vague effort to beat the vampires' weakness and/or learn of a solution. He's tried for 100 years with no success. The first time I read this I thought he was a tough brute for this. I respected it but found it a bit silly. But now I see how he probably influences Darren in thinking that Darren can and should try to defy destiny and create his own future. Vancha straight up dislikes Mr. Tiny greatly. 

I'm starting to see how he's a much more important character than I realized initially as well. I sorta thought that he was a third hunter just to make the series and quest more interesting. Well, I guess there's truth to that but that's not at all what his purpose is. He brings a whole new perspective and he's very important to the plot. He reveals he actually liked Kurda *and* voted for him to be a Prince. I didn't remember he liked Kurda. In addition he straight up likes the vampaneze other than their deadly method of how they feed on humans. 

I know more things about Vancha but if I broke down each reason why his significance to the story is dawning on me, I'd be writing all day. There will be a time and place for that as the series progresses. 

Vancha's significance is giving me similar feelings as I did about Kurda as in, there really seems to be several main characters in this series. Especially when it comes to the people who can prevent the rise of the Vampaneze Lord. I guess it's easy to fall into the feeling of Darren being the main character as the story is told in first person. I'm *a bit* wiser now and I've read the story before. Darren is a major character, but it seems there's equivalent characters to him at the very least. Humbling stuff. 

It was interesting to hear that when Vancha said he liked Kurda, Harkat also spoke up and said he also liked Kurda and thought he was treated poorly. Hmmm. It's a bit interesting to me that Harkat would say such a thing. He's unaware that he was Kurda so there is that maybe when he realizes he was Kurda he will do more soul searching. Harkat does say that he thinks Kurda's punishment of death was sound but he thinks that he shouldn't be seen as a villain. Maybe that's the best way to see him at the end of the day. Kurda was basically a decent person that became overly passionate and fumbled the execution. But man, he was ultimately led by fear of Mr. Tiny too though and this Vampaneze Lord prophecy. I know Mr. Tiny is like the most powerful dude ever but I feel as though the vampires shouldn't be as controlled by Mr. Tiny's words. I don't know that's easy for me to say. Kurda may always be a neverending thought provoking subject. I personally can't get over that he was willing to let the vampires become vampaneze and that he betrayed Gavner. Those points are rough when it comes to Kurda. 

Further expanding how this series is mystical and magical, this series dropped CRAZY lore and we learn about another magical being in Evanna. 

Evanna is immensely important to the series and I realize this more now, similarly to how I realized Vancha's importance. I sort of simply remembered her as another magical being to keep the series interesting, but she's more than that. 

Evanna is magically powerful, and she can have KIDS with vampires. She exists thanks to vampire from long ago named Corza Jarn who pleaded with Mr. Tiny for vampires to be able to have kids. Mr. Tiny eventually relented and created Evanna. So Evanna is the only woman on earth that can have children with vampires. She's basically Mr. Tiny's daughter. She has similar abilities as Mr. Tiny in general but is overall much kinder than him although she isn't always very sweet. 

But what's wild for me is, I TOTALLY forgot she could have children with vampires. This seems like a pretty substantial, downright massive, part of the plot of this series now that my memory is jogged. How could I possibly have forgotten that? 

As I was digesting all of this lore that was sort of dropped out of nowhere, I realized once again how high level this series really is. I swear re-reading this was a great idea now that I'm older. I'm an idiot now yes, but I was SUCH an idiot back then. Well, I do have the advantage of hindsight now but still. I guess I shouldn't say I'm necessarily dumb but I sort of overlooked important plot lines or lessons before in this story that I'm catching now. 

But honestly it's so fun!

The amount of involvement of magic is stunning in this series really. *Hunters of the Dusk* is feeling like a total pure fantasy book more than ever. There's levels to this series man, LEVELS! 

Ugh, I wanna rant longer but that's why I'm blogging about this series in sections. I might be doing the deepest blog reaction to this series ever LOL. Who knows. 

This section ends with Darren and Larten deciding to follow their hearts as Mr. Tiny suggested. They're returning to the Cirque Du Freak! Let's go!

>Expansiva semana llena de salud, energía, ideas maravillosas, magia. Encuentros con tu propio ser y mucho entusiasmo en cada actividad que realicen.

¿Eres fanático de las películas de terror, de acción o te gusta más el romance? Cuéntame sobre una película que te haya enseñado una lección importante.

>Ver películas por lo general es el pasatiempos de muchos, desde hace tiempo me entretenía mucho con las series televisivas o películas, me agradaban aquellas películas que llevaban o llevan algo de misterio, pero misterio profundo, donde ocurren cosas que no hay explicación alguna para que sucedan.

\n\n

>Son diferentes etapas por las que nos vamos paseando, a veces dejamos pasar películas porque las consideraos aburridas, luego vemos algo en ellas que nos detiene y nos atrapa, entonces allí nos quedamos a ver y escuchar con detenimiento, a entrelazar escenas con la vida cotidiana, hasta llegar a comprender ciertas cosas.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2021/2021301z4drd30ypb.webp

>Cuando nos enfocamos en determinados temas, en este caso llevo un tiempo que mi interés por la parte espiritual ha estado marcado, en el sentido de comprender cosas mágicas que ocurren y nos preguntamos, ¿para qué ocurrió esto?, ¿en qué momento? No me di cuenta, nos adentramos en ese mundo de búsquedas de respuestas y por medio de las películas nos llegan esos mensajes.

\n\n

>Es el caso de una película de nombre Los Agentes del Destino, quizás no es comprendida por quienes no se detienen en entender el mensaje de la misma, todo lo que ocurre en la vida de los humanos y desde lo invisible hay movimientos invisibles que nos detienen, nos adelantan, nos alejan de personas que nos convienen o no en nuestro camino.

https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2025/09/25/19/23/mohamed_hassan-travel-9855574_1280.png
[Fuente de la imagen](https://pixabay.com/es/vectors/viaje-aeropuerto-vuelo-silueta-9855574/)

>Los Agentes del Destino, tiene mucho para entablar una buena conversación, es impresionante. Ahora hay unas películas que me llaman la atención y no he llegado a ellas por diferentes razones, estas que hablan de energía, células, recuperación, diatribas entre lo científico que no acepta lo espiritual, este tipo de cine son lo máximo, bueno para mí, son un acercamiento a como se va moviendo la sociedad y aún muchos no lo han visto.

https://www.glitter-graphics.com/images/t/b/480x60/2021/2021301z4drd30ypb.webp

>
english version (click here)

Greetings, Community!

Have a wonderful week filled with health, energy, amazing ideas, and magic. May it be a week of connection with your inner self and full of enthusiasm in every activity you undertake.

>Are you a fan of horror movies, action movies, or do you prefer romance? Tell me about a movie that taught you an important lesson.

\n\n

>Watching movies is a common pastime for many. For a long time, I've been very entertained by TV series and movies. I especially enjoyed those films that contained a sense of mystery—a deep mystery, where things happen that defy explanation.

\n\n

>We go through different stages. Sometimes we skip movies because we find them boring, then we see something in them that stops us in our tracks and captivates us. Then we stay, watching and listening attentively, connecting scenes with everyday life, until we come to understand certain things.

\n\n
>When we focus on certain topics, in this case, my interest in the spiritual realm has been strong for some time now, in the sense of understanding magical things that happen and asking ourselves, \

Without realizing it, we delve into that world of searching for answers, and through films, these messages reach us.

\n\n

>This is the case with a film called The Adjustment Bureau. Perhaps it's not understood by those who don't stop to grasp its message: everything that happens in human life, and from the unseen realm, there are invisible movements that stop us, propel us forward, or distance us from people who are good or bad for us on our path.

\n\n

>The Adjustment Bureau offers much to spark a good conversation; it's impressive. There are some movies that catch my attention, but I haven't gotten around to them for various reasons. These are the ones that talk about energy, cells, recovery, and the debates between science and spirituality. This type of cinema is the best, at least for me. It's an approach to how society is moving, and many people haven't seen it yet.

links.title: My weekend away!
links.body:
I didn't blog about my weekend away last night because in my heart I wasn't feeling it.
I wanted to get the word out there that there are still lots of people that need our help.

@Bradleyarrow and I can't fund it ourselves, if we could, we would!
I am not the kind of person to ask for help, I am a giver.
The BBH foundation is dear to our hearts.
Please, help us to help others.


Fast forward to my weekend!

I was invited to a *40th* wedding Anniversary party!
It was in a town called Port aux Basques.
A 3 hour drive from Deer Lake.
I had to go to Deer lake to pick up an ex client, it was her sisters Anniversary party.

So, I worked on Friday, got off around 3pm, drove home, packed my bag, then off to Deer Lake to pick up Thelma.

We checked in to the air b&b.
Changed our clothes and off we went to the party.

Here are a couple pictures of the b&b.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23w2mG5q7aZhvpupcKegQCM1iatXgxfcJE1m9PivCnm5CBwH4hBbhYX3A2SVGtGbL1RwQ.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23tvnugbqDvuUHLTFuF3S3PEFuW5wRaLW9AR47CFfkDnd6reSdbUNPyig4CcbGZG4iXj2.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23vi1oNaDdXQ43ZTGELa8YGMpygTbh9NJszMcbsJuRQqrU7tm3TPT2wzbgK4Qw26e8eKd.png)



There were around 78 guest attending.
They had a cold plate pot luck.
You picked up your own meal.
Then out came the desserts, tons of cookies and a beautiful cake.

Afterwards, there was a dance, byob, bring your own booze!
I sipped on a small bottle of wine.
I had a few dances, got back to the b&b around 1:30am. LOL

There are only 2 ways to get of our island that we live on.
We are completely surrounded by water.
By plane, there are 4 airports, St. John's {the capital city of NL}, Gander, Deer Lake, and Stephenville. 
The other way is by ferry, yes you read that right, ferry.
The ferry terminal in located in Port aux Basques!
You check in, wait your turn to drive onto the ferry, go find somewhere to sit or you can rent a cabin.
There are 4 primary vessels, Atlantic Vision, Blue Puttees, Highlanders and the Leif Ericson which is mainly used to ship cargo.
It takes roughly 6 to 8 hours to get to North Sydney-Nova Scotia, and vice versa.
There are cabins to rent, restaurants, a gift shop, and lounges.
That is how we get everything we need to survive. 
I went to a local grocery store yesterday, there were signs posted everywhere, *Short on supplies due to the ferry not sailing*.
There were REALLY high winds for a couple of days out in the  Atlantic Ocean which connects to the Golf of St. Lawrence.
We are surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean 
High winds, no sailing!


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23zGcMX6aegnVQ1ZYT7GYEsNPeMFWqf4XKbfsVNAKT5g559hhXqBLimyCUbEv75DtE5JF.png)

This vessel is the Blue Puttees.
It was docked for 2 days.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cathyarrow/23yJCFAq4avisQFPSm8LufsPQufUddVvWcK75W4ujrexrJjvXAuLF73vCGBsV8Q3qdFZF.png)

This is the ferry terminal.

I love it by the ocean, the smell of the sea is Heavenly!

I had a lovely weekend!

Please don't forget to support the BBH Project!

Well, it's time to go.
Good night, God Bless!🙏
Life is good!💖

> Greetings, community! Wishing you a happy start to the week, I'm sharing my usual weekly #MyHiveGoals report! These are the last days of April, and we're back on Hive, sharing my daily activities. This second quarter of the year, I'd like to focus on my research and teaching at the university. I'm closing an important chapter and would like to document it on the blockchain. Of course, I won't stop sharing my progress on the main play-to-learn projects I enjoy: Rising Star and Splinterlands, so I'll be balancing my content between gamefi and daily blogging. For example, in this photo, you can see me having breakfast in the lab before starting to organize all the materials, reagents, and equipment to begin lab sessions. I think I'll soon have to teach in other settings beyond academia, so I'm preparing for this new stage of my professional life. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo44MwJg55NETFcNgLbtjtFq5qEwhNRXQugqWSFxNA92mx8WFSKXRkaGs4NFpGdwZK1.png) Link: [livecoinwatch](https://www.livecoinwatch.com/price/Hive-HIVE)

> But let's not forget the focus of our efforts, which is to grow within Hive. This stage, as I've mentioned in previous reports, is a great opportunity to accumulate or buy shares to establish a presence on the blockchain. Hive is still at a very attractive price for buying; it only started Wednesday night with a rebound that gave me hope of seeing our cryptocurrency back above $0.10! But on Sunday night, all that hope vanished, and we fell back to around $0.06. In short, the best thing is not to worry about the price every minute and simply focus on growing within the network, making new friends, and discovering new communities.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo4Ab6YHDAqaRVh7pHakA5AGvkNLYU7VLBS8c1rk9qDwzndFTYaNHBV8B4vRG9gDDam.png)
# Hive/HP

> The first thing I wanted to share is that I've increased my reputation! I'm now at level 75. It seemed like a very distant goal, but seeing it achieved today fills me with great satisfaction. Let's start by comparing our wallet balance this week to last week. We had 2771.5 liquid Hive, and a week later, after daily power-ups, it barely dropped to 2770.76 Hive. We've hardly consumed any of our liquid Hive balance thanks to delegations and projects with second-layer tokens that return those precious Hives to us every 7 days. When you add it all up, you realize the momentum you have to replenish your account and make it grow. ---
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo44sKseuHVHRVtrZ1mgyXCyqJ3eDKeSp9WgXBdHkNo3P5rRf99qDBE6kAC4CBPXdMB.png)

> Now let's see how we did with HP. This week we earned 118 HP through posts, curation, and comments. Last week, we generated a more or less consistent 125 HP. I don't know if I'll be able to maintain consistency when the lab classes start, but in any case, I'll do my best to try to reach 9500 HP before the beginning of May.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23t76pRBXcwsYSvYxFkQdAvyV44PE1p3Xf2Y2btC1tAbwhLcnm2XWr2zHumBUpwxtFaSi.png)|![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/Eo1wMUzbx5NonA3PQVgcSeXXtMczJfuhjn4HTZy3AEws6LSjzfaNyn6VCLA8JH4cBVC.png) --|-- Link: [hivestats](https://hivestats.io/)
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulkathos/23tbkj8mbMn9CYGJL7qVH3Zzq9mBSpZMLFAwUuy9ggaZ1KBkyRJwKGLVu3gb6pfH3bZUd.png)
# HBD Savings

> The good thing about the Hive rally over the weekend was that my Hives appreciated, so when I exchanged them for stablecoin, I got 6.42 HBD for a total of 1957 HBD. As with HP, we've maintained a consistent amount of HBD generated weekly, and I think we'll repeat that production this week. ---

links.title: Un día con mi hija: Más que una visita a odontología. // A Day with My Daughter: More Than Just a Trip to the Dentist.
links.body:
https://images.ecency.com/DQmS1UtXX6QAsUWRM76jZXQz1LE2ZCFmmMAcA5xuzfmZEee/miniatura_de_youtube_vlog_diario_sencillo_azul.png




¡Hola, amigos de Hive! Espero que se encuentren muy bien...
 
Hoy nuevamente, después de unos días de ausencia, quiero compartir un momento muy especial que he compartido con mi hija; para mí cada ocasión es especial aunque no sea de gran trascendencia.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvoPHEUWby2DJvpnRFPTzdX86LrjDCSY2YXGepVFyyP4/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVVtTAyUuMaCtdE7Q29sj7erbWXiPXDGMQFmBsNHFteC/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7BD5FDuhEPbNcMuLSRppmgefSKAq2gqk8DXkDe12moG/image.png)





 En esta semana fui con ella a consulta de control odontológico de ortodoncia. Les cuento que para mí el solo hecho de oír la palabra \

es algo que me causa mucho temor, ya que tengo mis traumas con ese tema, pero gracias a Dios mi hija hasta los momentos no sufre con eso. Desde el año pasado ella está en tratamiento de ortodoncia y todo bien; algunos dientes que estaban fuera de lugar se han acomodado.

Pero ustedes se preguntarán qué tiene de especial esto de ir al odontólogo; para mí ir al odontólogo o a cualquier otro lugar con mi hija siempre es especial, y sobre todo porque en el pasado casi no podíamos compartir tiempo juntas por mi antiguo trabajo y siento que me perdí tantas cosas hermosas junto a ella. En esta visita al odontólogo, aprovechamos para compartir ideas, dudas y conversaciones interesantes que siempre los adolescentes tienen sobre sus curiosidades y expectativas de vida.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDnMB1eJsMq9DAAmbpBtFfmBTKgrrTqWuKVfGcvLR1nK/img_20260312_wa0036_collage.jpg)



Luego de salir del odontólogo, encontramos un lugar muy tranquilo y acogedor, un lugar pequeño pero muy agradable donde venden pizzas muy ricas y allí, aparte de disfrutar de ese rico almuerzo, también disfrutamos del tema de conversación y reímos mucho, sacamos fotos; la verdad, la pasamos muy bien.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXf2faB1JeFfutb4PnERabX1MYkdTr1P29SZmSW2jqKFo/img_20260312_wa0027.jpg)



Luego, ya de regreso a casa, también sacamos fotos a nuestra Parroquia de Estanques, un pueblo pequeño y muy agradable, la fachada de su iglesia, la pequeña plaza y a la estatua de Simón Bolívar, que es nueva, ya que no tenían, al portal de los pueblos del sur.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjb37TDvsbx9m28Yo5dNjAqd79oaRNo5vJw9jhTS3Vae/img_20260312_wa0026_collage.jpg)




Bueno, amigos, quise compartir con ustedes ese pequeño momento; espero les guste y deseo poder volver pronto con una nueva publicación.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZMxb9NibcW9ttNnPJjN5ozDveCHVM2j1ebRWLniwHsj/img_20260312_wa0028.jpg)

------

## English

Hello, Hive friends! I hope you’re all doing great...
 
Today, after a few days away, I’d like to share a very special moment I had with my daughter; for me, every occasion is special, even if it’s not a big deal.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNvoPHEUWby2DJvpnRFPTzdX86LrjDCSY2YXGepVFyyP4/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcVVtTAyUuMaCtdE7Q29sj7erbWXiPXDGMQFmBsNHFteC/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7BD5FDuhEPbNcMuLSRppmgefSKAq2gqk8DXkDe12moG/image.png)





 This week I took her to her orthodontic checkup. I have to tell you that just hearing the word “dentist” fills me with dread, since I have my own issues with that, but thank God my daughter hasn’t had any trouble with it so far. She’s been undergoing orthodontic treatment since last year, and everything’s going well; some of her teeth that were out of place have moved into position.

But you might be wondering what’s so special about going to the dentist; for me, going to the dentist or anywhere else with my daughter is always special, especially because in the past we could hardly spend any time together due to my old job, and I feel like I missed out on so many beautiful moments with her. During this visit to the dentist, we took the opportunity to share ideas, questions, and the interesting conversations that teenagers always have about their curiosities and expectations for life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDnMB1eJsMq9DAAmbpBtFfmBTKgrrTqWuKVfGcvLR1nK/img_20260312_wa0036_collage.jpg)



After leaving the dentist's office, we found a very quiet and cozy spot—a small but very pleasant place that serves delicious pizza. There, in addition to enjoying that delicious lunch, we also had a great conversation, laughed a lot, and took some photos; honestly, we had a really good time.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXf2faB1JeFfutb4PnERabX1MYkdTr1P29SZmSW2jqKFo/img_20260312_wa0027.jpg)



Then, on our way back home, we also took photos of our parish church in Estanques, a small and very pleasant town—the church’s façade, the small plaza, and the statue of Simón Bolívar, which is new, since they didn’t have one before—as well as the gateway to the southern towns.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVjb37TDvsbx9m28Yo5dNjAqd79oaRNo5vJw9jhTS3Vae/img_20260312_wa0026_collage.jpg)




Well, friends, I wanted to share that little moment with you; I hope you like it, and I hope to be back soon with a new post.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbZMxb9NibcW9ttNnPJjN5ozDveCHVM2j1ebRWLniwHsj/img_20260312_wa0028.jpg)


-----

body.title: MCGI Topic Review | KNOWING THE FUTURE
body.body: > https://youtu.be/Xto8QfUW0xE?si=rp7lP94bzsip_ySY A lot of people are actually so curious about their future and I actually understand what caused it. A lot of uncertainty is happening and making it quite so difficult for even people to understand the next step to take. It is actually such a very beautiful thing if you are able to know about the future. There were times I myself have been so worried about tomorrow, the next day, the next year and generally about my life. Some comes from fear and others come from hope. But I have actually come to understand that the the word of God as I study it has helped me to calm down the anxiety in knowing the future because I have come to discover that knowing the future is not as important as trusting in God who holds the future. There is a Bible verse that I really love so much whenever I am feeling anxious about the future. In Isaiah 46:10, it says, “Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done. I have come to understand that there is nothing that really confused God and surprised God. God sees everything and knows everything. This always give me peace about my future. I know my life is not in the hands of chance but it is actually in the hands of God who owns my future. Whenever it comes to knowing the future, there are actually some warnings that the bible have helped us to understand about the future. There are people that at all cost have seeked the future but in a very wrong way. Some used divination, some used fortune telling and many more. In Deuteronomy 18:10-12, God warns His people not to follow such practices. I understand from this that seeking the future outside of God can lead me away from Him. Instead of looking for answers in the wrong places, I should seek God’s guidance through prayer and His word.

body.title: The Mercy of a Distance
body.body:
There is a bittersweet ache in finding something beautiful and realizing you are too afraid to hold it. When a light finally enters a life that has been defined by shadows, the first instinct isn't always joy. Sometimes, it is a paralyzing fear. You worry that your own brokenness will dim its glow, or that the weight of your past will eventually tarnish its perfection. Out of a strange kind of love, you choose to walk away, convinced that letting go is the only way to keep that light pure, even while your heart quietly refuses to leave.
***

The Mercy of a Distance

I found a diamond in a field of glass,
And watched the light within it softly pass.
It reached for me with fingers warm and bright,
The first true morning after years of night.

My soul is bound by debts I cannot pay,
By ghosts of who I was just yesterday.
I fear my heavy heart and troubled past,
Will break the peace that you have finally cast.

I love you with a courage born of grief,
A desperate soul in search of some relief.
But I would rather lose you to the sky,
Than watch your inner sparkle fade and die.

So I retreat, I fold, I turn away,
To keep your golden spirit from the gray.
I tell the world I’m better off alone,
While keeping every memory I’ve known.

My hands are empty, but my heart is full,
Still reeling from that soft, magnetic pull.
I’ve let you go to keep your spirit bright,
While holding you in secret every night. *** It is a lonely sacrifice to protect something by leaving it behind. I hope that by choosing this distance, I am giving that happiness the chance to remain untainted by the ghosts I still carry. Even if I am the only one who knows the truth, I will continue to love it from afar, finding a quiet peace in knowing that its shine remains perfect, even if it is no longer mine to touch.

body.title: #Monomad Challenge - The City’s Sweet Lullaby
body.body:
### Good evening, #Monomad friends Here is my entry for the #monomad contest by @brumest and @monochromes. Anyone who enjoys strolling through the city without a set destination knows the immense pleasure it brings when, with every step we take, we spot three or four more points of interest. The places may even be ordinary, or we may have passed by them hundreds and hundreds of times; and the day may not even be particularly beautiful, but there will always be something that catches our attention. A certain shadow, a certain outline, a certain gaze, or the interest evoked by the subject of the photograph. Glances that cross paths in a city that rarely leaves behind those who love to embrace it, who love to appreciate it, who love to walk through it and look around. Looking around. That’s it. That’s always what I try to do. And no matter how many times I’ve been there, it seems that the desire to visit these places only grows the more I learn and discover about them. It’s like a romantic relationship. Everything ends up feeling new, even if I’ve been with this “girlfriend” forever. Everything is new, and it fuels the desire to discover more and more. Because there’s always more to discover. All around us. Ahead of us, and in the memories we hold inside, which insist on surfacing whenever a song, a scent, a building’s facade, or a simple smile from a stranger awakens us from within and makes us seek more and more!

body.title: The Hidden  Price tag
body.body:
>***There is a way that seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.Proverbs 14:12***


I've   given this  a lot of deep thought  lately,  I'm  someone who is given to curiosity,  I like to know things beyond their normal form, beyond what the eyes can see or what we can feel, I want to understand  the science behind a thing, and what causes it..

so I'm  asking why was the way right  in the first place what were the signs and things that made it right or was it a lie?, something  wasn't good abouts  it?, if so why did the  Bible say it's  right,  alright before then it says, *\

* that  maans a careful examination  tells you there's  something  false about it..... 

that's  also telling  you  we need to pay attention  to details to differentiate what's  good and false, cause in this current era one can hardly tell, there's  a lot of mix up  between good and evil,  what's  good no longer the way it was, now what's  evil is coated good disguising to lure potential victim.


while I ponder I discover that they could be some  hidden price  tags to these things, in normal settings  you would hear ads say \

that's  like you paying an amount you weren't  suppose to because you didn't  know about it.


you understand that life is very dynamic and transcending,  a lot of things happening  so fast we barely could take a hold on it,  in the midst of our desperation we are bound to jump on opportunities, offers that  look so real,  we couldn't  doubt it in anyway but deep down there's some hidden price tags. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXkDjMEYywKGyMSgXC5kavcnrU56tzvsqKUZrV911Bcos/20250703_201127.jpg 

this is where you understand  that people do have ulterior motives to whatever they are doing,  to better understand  this let's  say a young lady desperately searching  for a job finally found one, without her knowledge  the interviewer asked for a private session without her knowledge  she is taken advantage of,  just to get the job  she so needed, she had to oblige only to discover that she's  been infected and would have to pay the price with her dear life.



this is where we need decernment, the reason why a lot of people get in trouble is because  the lack discernment  in what they do, I have fallen victim of this before and I've  learned my lessons, very rare will you encounter genuine  people with genuine intention in their heart without having some ulterior motives for their actions, we must be very careful  as not to fall victim of man's  Cunningly devices words  to lure us into their trap with what looks like good and perfect offer  because there could be hidden price  tags behind it.



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@hiventhusiast/the-hidden-price-tag-gwa)

**Уряд Ірландії оголосив про поступове згортання ключових програм підтримки для українських біженців.**

🔹З серпня держава почне припиняти надання житла для ~16 000 українців, які прибули до березня 2024 року  
🔹Виняток — лише для вразливих осіб або тих, хто не може жити самостійно

🔹Людей попереджатимуть мінімум за 3 місяці

🔹Щоб залишитися в державному житлі, потрібно буде:  
— подати заявку  
— підтвердити потребу документами  
(прийом заявок стартує в липні)

**Нові правила:**  
— виплати залишаться (€38.80 дорослим / €29.80 дітям), але з перевіркою доходів  
— житло буде у форматі спеціальних центрів

**Також новий пакет змін торкнувся виплат ARP**

🔸Програму виплат за розміщення українців (ARP) скорочують:  
— з вересня: €600 → €400/міс  
🔸повне скасування — березень 2027  
(це вплине на ~42 000 людей)

▪️Ірландія готується долучитися до програми добровільного повернення в Україну на рівні ЄС  
— орієнтовний старт: березень 2027

Програма передбачає фінансову підтримку для повернення та відбудови України.
