Buenas tardes queridos amigos de Hive y DIYHub cómo están?, en esta tarde tan hermosa les quiero compartir como he hecho esta nueva cadena para lentes hecha con mostacillas, rosas y perlas de dos tonos de rosado. Es muy fácil de hacer porque los pasos son repetitivos y sencillos de hacer, debo decir de que necesita bastante tiempo para terminarla, a mi en lo personal me ha encantado sus colores y por su sencillez, esta cadena la podemos usar cuando queramos y por sus colores blanco y rosa es fácil de combinar, espero les guste a ustedes también.

# ***<center>Los Materiales que vamos a necesitar son:</center>***

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNFvuJtJZCVHdA9icpUg29vr4vzJwnJYo28FToWr7kJG/1777320459158.jpg)</center>

<center> 20 Perlas de color rosado claro 
16 Perlas de color rosado oscuro
 10 Cuentas en forma de rosa de color rosado 
Mostacillas de color blanco
Mostacillones transparentes 
2 Argollas
2 ligas para lentes 
2 mt de nylon 0,40</center>

# ***<center>Procedimiento</center>*** 

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 1er Paso </center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVxMwGVpxBnnmubqCW2HYpA7Ej5jWpGyJjuo2W1BkqJa/1777320523745.jpg)</center> 

Insertamos en el nylon 8 mostacillas blancas, una argolla en la que insertamos una de las ligas para lentes, añadimos 8 mostacillas blancas más y cruzamos los nylon con una nueva mostacilla blanca. Llevamos este aro de mostacillas al centro para aprovechar el nylon al máximo.
____________________________________________
**<center>🩷 2do Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPxYJi3is2ZW2WYyphTD1YcXd8PQbWdkPr8rAZkXbu9Wr/1777320542997.jpg)</center> 

En cada nylon añadimos 15 mostacillas blancas, cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa, agregamos en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas, un mostacillón transparente, cruzamos por una perla de color rosado claro, en cada nylon añadimos una nueva perla de color rosado claro y volvemos a cruzar los nylon por una perla de color rosado claro, volvemos a añadir en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa.

____________________________________________
**<center>  🩷 3er Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYs743p8ycBbkEK2kazEqg8wimWe2rFQRhprtE7d5S4Pu/1777320589149.jpg)</center> 
 
En cada nylon añadimos 15 mostacillas blancas, cruzamos por una perla de color rosado oscuro, en cada nylon añadimos una nueva perla de color rosado oscuro y volvemos a cruzar los nylon por una perla de color rosado oscuro, volvemos a añadir en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 4to Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8HeNUkfs9YjYnNAVLVVqVc58mdyxtfHwzsBahkWpJ74/1777320611005.jpg)</center>

En cada nylon añadimos 15 mostacillas blancas, cruzamos por una perla de color rosado claro, en cada nylon añadimos una nueva perla de color rosado claro y volvemos a cruzar los nylon por una perla de color rosado claro, volvemos a añadir en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa.
____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 5to Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSdrzK6zF6YEZiocePn8vdVkKuqmYoXWfjvFwk9zVjTi/1777320648139.jpg)</center>
Volvemos a insertar en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas, cruzamos por una perla de color rosado oscuro, en cada nylon añadimos una nueva perla de color rosado oscuro y volvemos a cruzar los nylon por una perla de color rosado oscuro, volvemos a añadir en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa. Volvemos a insertar en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas, cruzamos por una perla de color rosado claro, en cada nylon añadimos una nueva perla de color rosado claro y volvemos a cruzar los nylon por una perla de color rosado claro, volvemos a añadir en cada nylon 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una cuenta en forma de rosa. Seguimos repartiendo este paso hasta completar el largo que deseamos sea la cadena.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 6to Paso</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadiJQAEaf2Cgm8gMh3G1sZKPfhHnrN4ERLmCcPiZTqeJ/1777320684200.jpg)</center>

En cada nylon añadimos 15 mostacillas blancas y cruzamos por una nueva mostacilla blanca, en uno de los nylon añadimos 8 mostacillas blancas, la segunda argolla en la que insertamos la segunda liga para lentes, agregamos 8 mostacillas blancas más, cruzamos por la mostacilla del cruce en este paso, repasamos las mostacillas siguientes hasta hacer un nudo doble en la siguiente cuenta en forma de rosa de color rosado. Cortamos el hilo que ha sobrado y listo, terminamos nuestra nueva cadena para lentes.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYJVD4MS8k3vnZA8thifY5ff4Fxwvm8cegwtMNwxVDyc/1777320700317.jpg)</center> 

*<center>Espero que les haya gustado
Hasta la próxima 👋
Que tengan una bendecida noche</center>*

# ***<center>Créditos</center>***

<center>Fotos de mi autoría, tomadas con un celular Samsung Galaxy A12
Traductor: App DeepL
Editores de fotos usado: editor de fotos Canva y FotoCollage</center>

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQCJhj2RSUaQuyhW7Tocn5v21njNQ74MbU7Aj28aKhkUZ/english_jewelry_dafne25.gif)</center>

Good afternoon, dear friends at Hive and DIYHub! How are you? On this beautiful afternoon, I’d like to share with you how I made this new eyeglass chain using beads, roses, and two-tone pink pearls. It’s very easy to make because the steps are repetitive and simple. I should mention that it takes quite a bit of time to finish. Personally, I love its colors and simplicity. We can wear this chain whenever we want, and thanks to its white and pink colors, it’s easy to match. I hope you like it too.

# ***<center>The materials we’ll need are:</center>***

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZNFvuJtJZCVHdA9icpUg29vr4vzJwnJYo28FToWr7kJG/1777320459158.jpg)</center>

<center> 20 light pink beads 
16 dark pink beads
 10 pink rose-shaped beads 
White seed beads
Clear large beads 
2 jump rings
2 eyeglass chains
2 meters of 0.40 mm nylon</center>

# ***<center>Instructions</center>*** 

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 1 </center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVVxMwGVpxBnnmubqCW2HYpA7Ej5jWpGyJjuo2W1BkqJa/1777320523745.jpg)</center> 

Thread 8 white beads onto the nylon cord, followed by a jump ring onto which you attach one of the eyeglass straps. Add 8 more white beads and cross the nylon cord with another white bead. Bring this beaded loop to the center to make the most of the nylon cord.
____________________________________________
**<center>🩷 Step 2</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPxYJi3is2ZW2WYyphTD1YcXd8PQbWdkPr8rAZkXbu9Wr/1777320542997.jpg)</center> 

On each nylon strand, add 15 white seed beads, thread through a rose-shaped bead, add 15 white seed beads to each nylon strand, a large clear seed bead, thread through a light pink bead, on each nylon thread, add another light pink bead and cross the nylon threads through a light pink bead again, add 15 white seed beads to each nylon thread again, and cross through a rose-shaped bead.

____________________________________________
**<center>  🩷 Step 3</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYs743p8ycBbkEK2kazEqg8wimWe2rFQRhprtE7d5S4Pu/1777320589149.jpg)</center> 
 
On each strand, add 15 white seed beads, thread through a dark pink bead, add another dark pink bead to each strand, and thread through another dark pink bead. Then add 15 white seed beads to each strand again and thread through a rose-shaped bead.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 4</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR8HeNUkfs9YjYnNAVLVVqVc58mdyxtfHwzsBahkWpJ74/1777320611005.jpg)</center>

On each strand, add 15 white seed beads, thread through a light pink bead, add another light pink bead to each strand, and thread through another light pink bead. Then add 15 white seed beads to each strand and thread through a rose-shaped bead.
____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 5</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPSdrzK6zF6YEZiocePn8vdVkKuqmYoXWfjvFwk9zVjTi/1777320648139.jpg)</center>
We insert 15 white seed beads onto each nylon thread again, cross through a dark pink bead, add a new dark pink bead to each nylon thread, and cross the nylon threads through a dark pink bead again. We add 15 white seed beads to each nylon thread again and cross through a rose-shaped bead. We insert 15 white seed beads onto each nylon thread again, cross through a light pink bead, add a new light pink bead to each nylon thread, and cross the nylon threads through a light pink bead again. We add 15 white seed beads to each nylon thread again and cross through a rose-shaped bead. Continue repeating this step until the chain reaches the desired length.

____________________________________________
**<center> 🩷 Step 6</center>**
____________________________________________
<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadiJQAEaf2Cgm8gMh3G1sZKPfhHnrN4ERLmCcPiZTqeJ/1777320684200.jpg)</center>

On each nylon cord, add 15 white beads and thread through a new white bead, on one of the nylon strands, add 8 white beads; on the second ring, where we insert the second eyeglass chain, add 8 more white beads; thread through the bead at the crossing point in this step; continue threading the following beads until you tie a double knot on the next pink rose-shaped bead. Cut off the excess thread, and that’s it—we’ve finished our new eyeglass chain.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaYJVD4MS8k3vnZA8thifY5ff4Fxwvm8cegwtMNwxVDyc/1777320700317.jpg)</center> 

*<center>I hope you liked it
See you next time 👋
Have a blessed evening</center>*

body.title: there is no need for poetry 💥💣🚀
body.body:
there is no need for poetry
when life is this easy—
this morning
a kangaroo ripped at wet grass
as I rode through cold light

magpies tearing at each other
black and white wings striking air
beaks knocking hard
feathers falling

there is no need for politics
under a sky this wide
lorikeets screaming through blossom
wattlebirds knocking through banksia

(jets are built
paid for
sent

even from here)

no need to feel it
with the ocean hammering
drowning the wailing in a mosque
when the news comes from Lebanon
voices breaking, then gone

here
hands are shaken
statements made
some grief named
and answered

while other grief
sits quiet in chests
learning not to speak

under the fat Easter moon
we are all meant to pray to
in a place this safe

there is no need for poetry
when you are not the one
being silenced

body.title: Changing of the Guard at the Shore and Eye Exercises - My Actifit Report Card: April 27th, 2026
body.body:
<center>

### Welcome to  
## ***Liquid Eye’s*** Actifit Blog

# Monday ☀️ 10326

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931777323458.645681) 

A beautiful, sunny Monday morning for a refreshing morning walk with interval walking through the palace park and breathing and meditation exercises by the water near the old alder tree on Luiseninsel. Wonderful air, greenery, the gentle lapping of the water, peace and quiet, and a bit of eye exercises thrown in. I’ve brought you two photos today that illustrate the focusing part of my eye exercises. At first glance, the pictures look the same, but if you look more closely, you’ll notice that in one, the focus is on the alder branch in the foreground, and in the other, on the trees in the background. I do this during the breathing exercises: when inhaling, I focus on the foreground, and when exhaling, on the background. I also spent some time watching the gray geese and the changing of the guard among the ducks on the shore of the carp pond, but see for yourselves in the photos.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931777323472.7753758) 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931777323470.426199) 

Ein wunderschöner sonniger Montagmorgen für einen erfrischenden Morningwalk mit Intervall-Walking durch den Schlosspark und Atem- und Meditationsübungen am Wasser bei der alten Erle auf der Luiseninsel. Herrliche Luft, Grün, leise plätscherndes Wasser, Ruhe und ein bisschen Augentraining dabei. Ich habe euch heute zwei Fotos mitgebracht, die den Fokusteil meines Augentrainings illustrieren. Auf den ersten Blick sehen die Bilder gleich aus, aber bei genauerem Hinsehen werdet ihr feststellen, dass auf einem der Ast der Erle im Vordergrund fokussiert ist und auf dem anderen die Bäume im Hintergrund. Das mache ich während der Atemübungen, beim Einatmen Fokus auf Vordergrund und beim Ausatmen Fokus auf Hintergrund. Außerdem habe ich noch ein wenig die Graugänse beobachtet und die Wachablösung der Enten am Ufer des Karpfenteiches, aber seht selber auf den Fotos.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/F527D1B2-65AF-4D80-96E7-EEB7FA2B47931777323475.046846)

body.title: Film Review: They Were Expendable (1945)
body.body:
![(source:tmdb.org)](https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/original/x5rtqVTrpzFq3Ve55QEqHXJeojd.jpg)



In an era when Hollywood and much of Western media relentlessly project an image of American military omnipotence and invincibility, it is worth recalling that the United States has suffered some of the most significant conventional military setbacks in modern history. Arguably the greatest, in conventional terms, was the loss of the Philippines to the Japanese during the opening phases of the Pacific War. What makes this catastrophe especially curious is that, even as the disaster unfolded, American propagandists and filmmakers were already spinning the defeat into a tale of heroic sacrifice. Among the most celebrated of these efforts is *They Were Expendable*, a 1945 film directed by the legendary John Ford. Though it remains one of the more obscure entries in Ford’s long and distinguished filmography, it is also widely regarded as one of the more realistic and authentic Hollywood depictions of the Second World War. It is a film that asks its audience to accept that sometimes the best a soldier can do is die—or, if lucky, escape—while those left behind are simply written off as expendable.

The film is based on William Lindsay White’s best-selling 1942 novel of the same name, itself inspired by the real exploits of US Navy Motor Torpedo Boat Squadron 3, commanded by Lieutenant John D. Bulkeley, who received the Medal of Honor for his actions in the Philippines. In the film, Bulkeley is fictionalised as Lieutenant John “Brick” Brickley, played by Robert Montgomery—himself a US Navy PT boat veteran who had served under the real Bulkeley during the D-Day landings. Montgomery’s performance carries the weary, professional calm of a man who has seen war first-hand, and it provides the emotional anchor for the film’s grim narrative.

The plot opens at Cavite Naval Base in the Philippines in November 1941, just weeks before the outbreak of hostilities. Brickley’s executive officer, Lieutenant “Rusty” Ryan (John Wayne, in a role that allows him to be fallible and vulnerable rather than the usual swaggering hero), is frustrated by the scepticism of the top naval brass regarding the usefulness of PT boats. Convinced that his career in the squadron is a dead end, Ryan prepares a letter requesting a transfer to a destroyer—a move that would have seemed sensible in any peacetime navy. The letter is never sent, for the news of the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor changes everything.

Brickley scrambles his boats out of harbour, engaging Japanese aircraft at sea. They escape unscathed, but upon returning to Cavite they find the base in ruins. The film wastes no time in establishing that the war is going to start very badly for the Americans. With much of the Pacific Fleet crippled at Pearl Harbor, the Japanese invasion of the islands is unstoppable. The small force of PT boats is left to delay the inevitable, using their speed for messenger duties or launching hit-and-run attacks on Japanese shipping. The squadron scores some successes—sinking a Japanese cruiser and several smaller vessels—but the cost in lives and boats is high. Ryan is wounded and nearly loses an arm; he is treated in a military hospital, where he falls in love with Navy nurse Lieutenant Sandy Davyss (Donna Reed).

As the American positions become untenable, orders are given to evacuate the top commanders, including General Douglas MacArthur (Robert Barrat), along with their families. Brickley’s squadron is given this task. Upon reaching its destination, the squadron continues a last-ditch campaign of resistance in Mindanao, but loses all three remaining boats—one to accident, one to Japanese bombers, and one commandeered by the Army. By the end, Brickley and Ryan have proven the effectiveness of PT boats and are summoned to Washington to provide advice. They earn the last seats on the final plane out of the Philippines, leaving their comrades to capture or death. The film closes on a note of bitter relief, not triumph.

What distinguishes *They Were Expendable* from many wartime propaganda films is its startling authenticity. The production was steeped in real naval experience. Ford himself, a captain in the US Navy Reserve, had famously filmed the Battle of Midway for his Oscar-winning documentary. The script was written by Frank “Spig” Wead, Ford’s friend and a pioneering naval aviator, who died two years after the film’s release and whose own life Ford would later chronicle in *The Wings of Eagles* (1957), again starring John Wayne. The film was made with the full co-operation of the US Navy, which provided equipment including several genuine Higgins PT boats. The Florida locations near Pensacola stood in convincingly for the Philippines, and the sense of place—sweltering heat, narrow harbours, the omnipresent threat of air attack—is conveyed with documentary precision.

Although originally conceived as a wartime morale booster, *They Were Expendable* is far more honest and realistic than one might expect. It shows the American side in a position of inferiority, suffering defeat after defeat, despite the heroism and occasional minor success of its protagonists. As the film progresses, things only get worse. Of all the main characters, only two manage to fly to safety; the rest are dead, captured, or left to an uncertain fate—including even Reed’s character, whose last scene is a poignant good-bye to Ryan, with no guarantee she will survive the fall of the islands.

The use of authentic PT boats helps Ford reconstruct naval action in a convincingly gritty manner, with minimal special effects. The combat sequences have a sense of cramped, chaotic urgency that larger-budget films often miss. That said, some of the action scenes rely on a slightly repetitive use of stock shots and an overabundance of pyrotechnics. It is also worth noting that post-war analysis of Japanese archives revealed that many of Bulkeley’s claims about the damage his squadron inflicted were exaggerated. Ford’s film, however, takes the claims at face value, which is a minor historical compromise.

Nevertheless, the film holds together quite solidly. It starts slowly, and viewers accustomed to modern pacing may find the opening hour a little languorous. The running time of just over two hours feels long, and the music by Herbert Stothart is unremarkable, leaning heavily on familiar patriotic tunes rather than a distinctive original score.

But the performances are uniformly strong. Montgomery brings a quiet authority to Brickley, while Wayne, often subjected to Ford’s notoriously abusive treatment on set—the director considered Wayne a coward for not enlisting in the war—delivers a surprisingly nuanced portrayal of a man forced to confront his own impotence. Montgomery, by contrast, received favourable treatment from Ford and even stepped in to direct some scenes when the director suffered a minor injury; this experience helped Montgomery launch his own directing career with *[Lady in the Lake](https://peakd.com/hive-166847/@drax/film-review-lady-in-the-lake-1946-5np)* two years later.

*They Were Expendable* had the misfortune of being completed shortly after the war ended. Contemporary critics praised it, but the public was more focused on peace and wanted to forget the war—especially its most traumatic episodes of military defeat. The film was a box-office failure and has since slipped into relative obscurity, known mainly to Ford completists and students of war cinema. That obscurity is undeserved. It remains one of the most unflinching Hollywood portrayals of defeat, and a powerful reminder that, for all the cinematic mythology of American invincibility, the road to victory often began with a long, bitter retreat.


RATING: 6/10 (++)

body.title: The Mound of Glory
body.body:
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhzP3pSKu3t429MMwC4rjKeqUwutAru4WBUzm5zb1MDz/photo_2026_04_27_21_06_18_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdhzP3pSKu3t429MMwC4rjKeqUwutAru4WBUzm5zb1MDz/photo_2026_04_27_21_06_18_2.jpg) ***Greetings, friends.*** In Belarus, the memory of the Great Patriotic War is a fundamental part of the national identity, state ideology and personal memory of the majority of citizens. The Belarusian Soviet Socialist Republic took one of the heaviest blows. According to various sources, the war claimed the life of one in three residents of the republic. This tragedy has left a deep mark on every Belarusian family, making the memory of the war sacred. Belarus is the most important partisan republic. Hundreds of thousands of partisans operated on its territory during the occupation, which pulled significant Wehrmacht forces from the Eastern Front to the internal partisan front.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRojkjMsebSp2zoM2RQ4HjWa6M5wDGGdBnhfYoq856ZBQ/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_50_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRojkjMsebSp2zoM2RQ4HjWa6M5wDGGdBnhfYoq856ZBQ/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_50_2.jpg) There are many monuments dedicated to the period of the Great Patriotic War on the territory of Belarus. The Brest Fortress, which is located on the border with Poland and fought the German Wehrmacht on June 22, 1941, and resisted in complete isolation and encirclement, has always been considered one of the most significant. Since childhood, I have known about the village of Khatyn, which the punishers burned down along with the inhabitants, and there were many such villages on the territory of Belarus. There is also a very sad memorial there. But I only found out about the Mound of Glory now, to my great shame. The decision to erect the Kurgan of Glory memorial was made in 1966. According to the idea, it was supposed to mark the victorious end of the Belarusian offensive operation Bagration in 1944, which led to the destruction of the German Army Group Center. This Mound is the epitome of the military and economic might of the Soviet Union.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2hxKSqPHpd9bvdmSrvZzvPZ4vKVZSPBMkVTMN5WxTKy/photo_2026_04_27_21_06_39_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2hxKSqPHpd9bvdmSrvZzvPZ4vKVZSPBMkVTMN5WxTKy/photo_2026_04_27_21_06_39_2.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsS6aMLWmQQzHv3LPNGk2VrPRsPtdVfFswzzxiMFTVtb/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_43_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXsS6aMLWmQQzHv3LPNGk2VrPRsPtdVfFswzzxiMFTVtb/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_43_2.jpg) By the will of fate, I found myself this year in the jubilee year of the Great Victory. A place like this has its own special aura. Thoughts of the past, of joy and sorrow, are born in my head.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMbjS2upCvt8rNEAb7Zu1t99DYP8ZfGFN6MLessYqiVK/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_43_2_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMbjS2upCvt8rNEAb7Zu1t99DYP8ZfGFN6MLessYqiVK/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_43_2_2.jpg) The so-called victory symbols and victory weapons are collected on the site in front of the mound. It is customary to apply the word \

to each such weapon - the famous Katyusha rocket launcher, the famous IL-2 attack aircraft, the famous T-34 tank, and even the diesel locomotive, which transported a lot of goods in wartime, is also famous.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfQA8j4aWoyr6nNXQD2wHt15JosnjyHrMgZwCQubGRKe/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_45_2_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXfQA8j4aWoyr6nNXQD2wHt15JosnjyHrMgZwCQubGRKe/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_45_2_2.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYGiPXqgTzoLcwK7CymGA3pBbcD5BiJpePEwdy5ZtiGKr/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_45_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYGiPXqgTzoLcwK7CymGA3pBbcD5BiJpePEwdy5ZtiGKr/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_45_2.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsygzGR2gnMAKqwYuX35Rp2QnxWtZHt8feLmA5rSMbcq/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_46_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWsygzGR2gnMAKqwYuX35Rp2QnxWtZHt8feLmA5rSMbcq/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_46_2.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPs1scC5xRRGMagGiAZjPgwKU5TJtVcT9EKAGgCPGGFgV/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_55_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPs1scC5xRRGMagGiAZjPgwKU5TJtVcT9EKAGgCPGGFgV/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_55_2.jpg) Time goes on, it doesn't stop, people, everyday life, life itself, the appearance of cities, communications are changing. There are generations who know about the World War only from the stories of people who did not live at that time, from films created by directors who did not know that war. And suddenly, somewhere, there is an exclamation: \

.. And once again, the sounds of saber rattling become audible, lazy old men begin to make speeches that excite young blood, which makes one lose one's mind and the story unfolds into another round of a major global war.... It seems to me that such Mounds of Glory do not remind of the horrors of war, but are carriers of the contagion of greatness, like military parades, especially with demonstrations of military equipment. Yes, it's beautiful, but it's scary.
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeAcVjnEpV8mUMdMSV3jMqXdhESom5jZSqwRQvXtkrgq2/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_50_2_2.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeAcVjnEpV8mUMdMSV3jMqXdhESom5jZSqwRQvXtkrgq2/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_50_2_2.jpg)
[![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7DdNkBUaF18f7GBFc4RbfAM4cH7bH5afrAbC7hLFNKB/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_56.jpg)](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7DdNkBUaF18f7GBFc4RbfAM4cH7bH5afrAbC7hLFNKB/photo_2026_04_27_21_05_56.jpg) The view from the top of the Mound is magnificent. It's the highest point on this plain.
I plan to visit Belarus in September to capture the beauty of the color palette of the local nature.
![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png) ***By the way, the location of the City can be seen by clicking on the link to the map in the comments to the article by @travelfeed and @worldmappin*** ![imagehive1.png](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYbD5H7vX4jU6TiFbUKDRt1VvurE3tmJNBgpmF4jxEYkW/imagehive1.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdnr6CyN4mtmwyYLY8pARGkVVgkXFcvLZv62JTVLhKesF/image.png)
***Don’t Worry, Be Happy*** (C) Bobby McFerrin
Text & Photography by @apnigrich With love @apnigrich
Good luck and have fun
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdNkuUGwFFCjDbTagfBfakLRE8shLea64nDEXNMZbnoF7/image.png) [//]:# (!worldmappin 54.01897 lat 27.89821 long The Mound of Glory d3scr) [//]:# (!pinmapple 54.01882 lat 27.89807 long d3scr)

body.title: Hot Water VS Cold Water Black Coffee
body.body: Hi Hiveans, this is my first post for this new week and, I love to be here. I am a lover of this black stimulant, this is basically my day starter for without one cup each morning my day has not started. However, I have observed that the appearance, solubility and taste differs depending on the temperature of the water being used. This is basically my personal opinion and things that I have seen during the process of making my coffee. I have decided to share so that others can see and, have a view.\n\nI have been a true lover of black coffee and I have been consistently been taking my black coffee with boiled water. In fact with 100 degrees boiled water. Just recently we had an unstable supply of electricity and, I decided to try out black coffee, at the very beginning, I did not observe any difference. Trust me this is exactly what true love does to a person. That is why the popular sentence \

is still very valid. Then came few days back and, I still made my black coffee with room temperature water, only to discover that there is a clear and obvious difference that the part of my love for black coffee has been overlooked. 


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHpwcJ7Vcrd1qnSV5bMus3XyHBbaGp5xNvCGdBM7hRRB/1777269673681.jpg)***Coffee made with Room Temperature water***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZKCQQQ9YyLN8PvscXovF2edm5p3ETXd4TwXGJaohidcn/1777269673605.jpg)***Coffee made with Room Temperature water***

One thing that really caught my attention was that the Mug that I do use to make my coffee does not get stained whenever I make my coffee with Room Temperature water or cold water. This also made me to observe that taste of it to notice that the blending was not uniform. To top it all this simple means that my black coffee is not completely dissolved. Though when I made my research, it revealed that it does not pose any health threat. This means that I can continue with either cold or hot water, depending on my preference.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVdEM65XLU3Y4LjhNuQZkhvayfooYuPSNZE5kA4d1RxH7/1777269700587.jpg)***Coffee made with hot water***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNdifMVvHxTcxnm4WZ7XqwJVfn5TpxqrmRTqYxvpMn9U3/1777269700498.jpg)***Coffee made with hot water***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAbwbFu1T38qyDoSfpaztunF5AbbP8YKtqGhWq8gn3eD/1777269700423.jpg)***Coffee made with hot water***

From the three photographs above, you will see clearly that the hot water dissolved the coffee completely and the blend of the taste is heavenly. Another advantage is that coffee with hot water has the black coffee aroma. This is the very first invitation code, if you know what I mean. Then comes the total dissolving and the wonderful taste. Makes it very perfect. As for me I will pick the hot water anytime anyday.


CHEERS

body.title: Trust the System
body.body:
>

> #  I trust you.

*What does that really mean?*

From my perspective, it is about *my* opinion of *you,* which is a series of judgements based on assumptions that culminate in me making a decision; that my conclusions are correct and *I* can accurately predict your behaviour. Therefore, if *you* do something that lays outside of my expectations of how *I think* you will react, it breaks my trust. *You* didn't break my trust, rather my predictive model of your behaviour was flawed and incorrect, so it broke. You are not to blame, I am.

> Trust no one?

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23xpAVKwYwWBig53ULarkapshNrjLRTxgS6sy5N2ib2xiWe7n4t6rRp62ywMaoEeMpHqU.png)


---

> None of us trust anyone else, but ourselves.

We might think that we trust others, but it all invariably comes down to us trusting that our predictive model is correct. We trust ourselves, even when we have had it proven to us time and again that we aren't very good at judging the behaviours of others. But, what else can we do? 

Trust is sometimes confused with hope, because often enough we *have no choice* but to \

that some person or group is going to do right by us. This is essentially where we are with politicians and governments, because we all know that none of them can truly be trusted, but we *hope* that whoever is there making decisions is going to support good outcomes for us. Yet, how often have our hopes been met, and how often have they been dashed on the rocks and carried lifeless out to sea? 

> Do you trust your government?

I don't just mean the one that is in power now, I mean *the government.* A lot of energy is spent arguing over which party or coalition is in power, but ultimately it doesn't matter, because the system itself *can't be trusted.* Some are less corrupt than others, but they are *all corrupt* because none of them put 100% of their effort into doing what is best for citizens. None of them. It doesn't matter who is Prime Minister or President, who is taking care of foreign affairs, or healthcare, no matter how \

someone is, the system is inherently corrupt.

> Which cancer do you want to die from?

It is interesting that so much energy is put into fighting over which party is better or worse, with essentially no discussion about the system itself. The system therefore is governed by those in power who benefit from the system working for them and keeping them in power. Not just in power as a particular person in a particular position like President, but in power as a system. 

The government is essentially the OS of our lives and dictates what we are able to do, how easily we can do it, and whether we benefit or not. And most of the time, it is dysfunctional and crashing, because that is how it has been designed. It is a system where all the hardware and the software it runs is in constant conflict, stealing resources in the background, and shutting down processes we need to run our lives. 

> Constant blue screens.

*Do you trust in the system?*

It is pretty obvious I don't, but the thing is that it doesn't matter what I believe, because even though democracy is fundamentally broken, it still benefits from as long as enough support it, it will keep on being the broken system of choice. It is the same with \

right? The value is in the belief it can be used to trade with, so people keep on using it. With a government, the belief is that there is no other way to govern a large group of unknown people in any other way than how it is now. Is that really the case? # No. But we believe it to be. If we survive the cataclysmic event that is likely due to our inability to work together on betterment instead of competing for control, then perhaps we will look back at this period of time and laugh at how ridiculous and how stupid we were to believe in the systems we trust today. And that is a big if, because with the momentum we have and the trajectory we are heading, we are unlikely to ever get to a point to look back, because there will be no one left to reflect. > Do you trust that tomorrow will be better than today? Will you be better tomorrow? body.title: Relationships Break When Truth Starts Hiding
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTpoWahZHwapPDTw9pavBhYb6xZAUfzEu1tERHF51vDcp/1777322949948.png)
R
Sometimes a relationship doesn’t end all at once… it fades slowly. Like something that keeps decreasing little by little, and in the beginning, you don’t even notice it. And honestly, most relationships don’t break because of big fights — they break because of silence… especially the kind of silence that hides the truth.
I used to think betrayal was always something big. Like someone clearly cheating, getting caught, or a huge lie coming out. But now it feels different. The real problem isn’t always the big thing… it’s the small things we hide. The truths we could say, but we choose not to.
There comes a point when you start feeling that the other person is changing. They’re not the same anymore. The interest feels different. Conversations become shorter, or even when they happen, they feel surface-level. And the strange part is — the person doesn’t say anything… they just change their behavior. And you’re left wondering what exactly went wrong.
That’s where the relationship quietly starts to crack.
Because when truth is hidden… it’s not just one thing that disappears. Trust slowly starts to fade too. You look into their eyes and feel like something is being held back. But since you don’t have proof, you start doubting yourself instead.
I’ve noticed something — betrayal isn’t always about a third person. Sometimes, lack of honesty itself becomes betrayal. Even if someone isn’t physically involved elsewhere, if they’re creating emotional distance and not sharing the truth… that itself becomes a kind of dishonesty.
And maybe the hardest part is this —
figuring out whether something is actually wrong, or if you’re just overthinking.
Because people who hide the truth often act very normal. They don’t fight, they don’t argue, they don’t explain anything clearly. They just slowly pull away. And that’s what breaks the other person from the inside… because there’s no closure.
Sometimes you just wish they would say it clearly once —
“Yes, I’ve changed” or “I’m not the same anymore.”
Maybe it wouldn’t reduce the pain, but at least the confusion would end.
But the reality is, people find it easier to hide the truth than to speak it.
And that’s where relationships lose.
In the end, I’d just say this — if you’re in a relationship, you don’t have to be perfect, but you do have to be honest. Because small truths can save a relationship before they turn into big lies.
And if you ever feel like someone is hiding something from you… don’t keep convincing yourself that everything is fine. Sometimes your heart sees what your mind tries to ignore.
Because relationships don’t break with noise…
they break the day honesty disappears.

body.title: Say no to bullying;#286
body.body:
![IMG_4804.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdGUjej1yiJz3vqGSnXh6kH6DyhJZaQfSWyHAKAtFtcZR/IMG_4804.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/bully-stop-bullying-no-to-bullying-1061363/)

Bullying is a very serious thing and no child should go through it. The type of emotional and mental impact it has is not good and should not be treated lightly at all. I watch a lot of movies that has to do with bullying and the scenes are nothing to write home about.

One may think that it’s only in movies that bullying happens but it’s actually an experience of some children especially in school. I for one have been a victim of bullying during my secondary school days and it wasn’t a funny experience.

I have always been small in stature and was almost the smallest in class during my secondary school days and I went to a boarding house where there’s no parental protection. 

There was just this girl in my class that just didn’t like me for no reason. She couldn’t just wait to snap at me at every given opportunity. She didn’t beat me as that’s not allowed in the school but she was verbally bullying me.

![IMG_4805.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQHkJitCpA9P1xLA8AX16NDsFD5MWycXJekXFdDfWKcUj/IMG_4805.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/vectors/ai-generated-bully-bullying-boy-8973952/)

She made me uncomfortable that I couldn’t stay where she was and always avoided our paths crossing. She was just a pain in my buttocks. Up till today I still remember her full names because of the mark she left. A mark that’s remembered but not for good. 

I keep wondering where she is now or what has become of her. She was nothing but a big bully. I would advise that parents and teachers not take bullying for granted. There should be a section of the school time table where it’s solely addressed and some consequences or punishment should be attached to those who bully others.

These bullies strive in the fact that their victim is calm or quiet most times and shys away from confrontation. The truth is that they try to cover up their inadequacies and emptiness by making others feel bad.

Left for me, these bulllies should be give the same aura they give. By experience I’ve learnt that they aren’t actually so strong and feed on the cowardness  of their victim. If they can be matched face to face or give the same medicine they give others, you would see that they always retreat.

![IMG_4806.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfA5eDJ7hMzkZyUCATiUSyC3hgaTtGDNq3Qq4ZDJg9mL8/IMG_4806.jpeg)[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/bullying-stop-hurt-feelings-sad-959433/)

If I had had a child who is a victim of bullying, I would first advise him to seek peace and verbal negotiation with any one trying to bully him. If it doesn’t work, he should not hesitate to stand up and fight for himself. Most times the bullies always back down when they are challenged or confronted by their victim.

On the other hand I would contact the school management to look into the situation and put the bully in place because no child deserves to pass through the mental, emotional and psychological trauma these bullies put people through. 

Bullying should not be tolerated no matter what and should be addressed with immediate effect in situations where it’s evident. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@babygirl888/say-no-to-bullying286-9wu)

body.title: Alone Time, Heavy Thoughts, and Survival
body.body:
> *Aquarians are known for their independence and their need for quiet time.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWeucJytkKYaC1mGhi97YnEVxtGtH3KqT9fa1LEZRifFz/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-sitting-bench-sit-alone-1853545/) *There are moments when we can be social and fully present with everyone, and then suddenly we disappear to be alone. Most times, this doesn’t happen just because we feel like it; it often happens when we are trying to heal from something. It could be anything.* *The truth is, we don’t like burdening others with our problems, so we withdraw. And when we are done healing, we come back like nothing ever happened*. *During these moments alone, we reflect on our past, present, and future. We think about many things, even unnecessary ones.* *Two days ago, my son had a high fever. We weren’t sure if it was teething or something more serious, but his body and head kept getting hot. Not wanting to take any chances, I told his mum to take him to the hospital. Minutes later, I got a call that the doctor said he would need to be admitted.* *The mention of admission disrupted my plans for the month because I knew how expensive hospital bills could be. I am on a tight budget, but his life comes first, so there was no other option. I had to let them admit him. He was tested and diagnosed with malaria and sepsis. They requested a deposit of ₦40,000, which I paid, but that completely ruined my monthly plan. I also had to stay with them at the hospital.* *I slept for only two hours, and by midnight I was awake. Both Ryan and his mum were asleep, and that was the perfect moment for my quiet time and new planning.*
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbDXMSQED9rKano46oBLwfLgpWAxhP8u428s2C8ziGasK/image.png)
[source](https://pixabay.com/photos/man-bench-sunset-silhouette-alone-1866514/) *My original plan for the month was already ruined by his illness, so I had to start rethinking how we would survive the next month. I also had some ideas, some I noted down, others I discarded.* *Alone time is something everyone experiences, whether they like it or not. It can happen when you are about to sleep, and random thoughts start flooding your mind. It can happen at work when you get lost in thought for a few seconds. It can happen anywhere.* *People are going through a lot this year, and it is not funny. You will be thinking about how to solve one problem, then another will surface, it gets tiring, but we can't give up, it is now I understand why our fathers sit alone and are moody, at that moment, a lot is going on in their minds...* *I just believe whatever everyone is going through right now is going to pass. Tough times don’t last, but tough people do. And always remember, no matter what you lose, you can always start again.*

body.title: Una noche en la sala de Videojuegos
body.body:
![1000933511.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23z7HyuqM1U7Zi4EsWNsfTd6jdLU21AsMb1RDZyEjFNTtBLN7jD44L2sYH2uoxbZ9hZup.png)
---
Dicen que las mejores cosas, salen sin mucha planificación. Yo discrepo un poco de ello, pero ayer sin tenerlo planeado realmente la pasamos genial en familia. Teníamos literalmente unos años sin ir a un lugar de estos, una sala donde hay maquinas de juegos. Los niños al estar más grandes pudieron disfrutar muchísimo más de los juegos. Jugaron Pacman, bolos, y otros juegos, pero los favorito de ellos fueron: Los carritos de carrera y uno de dinosaurios donde disparaban para sobrevivir. |![1000933553.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23uFMPHW69rPsk6EkVL3RiBLWU93LvYT1A8JTt7qcZ6iwgZgZeKnwJf3gN13LeNRoCttd.png)|![1000931517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23xVCqssueUVS2fnkhEfD8uokmTGfKcuDYVtJTHxShCNEtz9YWuSbAQE2stoExZ7U7CbM.jpg)|![1000933554.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23w2iffSUUBtWDXTJhkRDrmnWWEYF68JBycbQDFDxmXtgoReuXnmMNDuHGcUQtBZZzYTG.png)| |-|-|-| Más que mis hijos, quien realmente estaba feliz y emocionado, era mi esposo y es que nos remontamos a nuestras épocas y las salas de maquinitas. Además ¡¿qué adulto no se siente como un niño en una sala de estas?! Me dió mucha alegria ver sus ojos brillantes y su sonrisa, aun cuando jugó muy poco. Porque seguimos siendo adultos y hay niños que quieren jugar más que uno jajaja. En esta oportunidad, nos invitaron mi hermana y su novio. A ellos les gusta mucho complacer a los niños con helados, parques, juegos y comida. |![1000931549.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23tmDmYHaWXYUm8UicV6M84q6qDPKhJS6p6NdBmLcNC5zDwrfjEdGmyFEUTuE5EJgjQzt.jpg)|![1000931519.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elizabeths14/23ywkj1NH5iFgXjQ3YYsNEoBE2btUxvbYxHhnJ7Gi1izor8GWDQT92C6hgviEVGXDHtiq.jpg) |-|-| En la carrera de autos, fue muy divertido, ya que el juego les toma una foto y ellos pueden verse en la pantalla mientras juegan y al finalizar la partida. Ambos jugaron en tiempos diferentes y quedaron en 2do Lugar, aún cuando iban llevándose todo lo que veían en el camino y se salían de la pista de carrera jajaja. Y aunque ninguno quedó en primer lugar, ellos estaban felices. Estos son momentos que ellos atesoran en sus memorias y que además los hace ir más alla que solo las pantallas de hoy en día, haciendo así la experiencia más real y divertida.

body.title: Pan de plátano verde y mi spam de caballa [ESP-ENG]
body.body:
![1000312082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/AKPm9veZ7aR2oASb7kuc4STnpruwgym8YcuQCMN1gsWYe2WKZUkU1FGrbMygD7L.jpg)

A veces las mejores recetas no salen de un libro… salen de la necesidad, del momento, y de lo que hay en casa.

Mi padre había traído a casa una buena cantidad de plátanos verdes, y como buena cubana, eso en mi casa es casi un tesoro. Aquí el plátano verde se respeta: en tostones, en fufú, en mariquitas… siempre hay una forma de hacerlo feliz.

Pero esta vez yo quería algo diferente.

Estoy tomando antiinflamatorios por la rodilla y tengo que estar merendando con frecuencia, pero tampoco quería caer en cosas que me hicieran ganar peso. Así que se me metió una idea en la cabeza: hacer algo saludable, proteico… y con lo que tenía.

Llevaba tiempo viendo recetas de pan de plátano, y también ese famoso “pan de caballa”. Así que dije: hoy es el día.

Spoiler: uno salió pan… el otro terminó siendo un spam.


---

## Ingredientes

# Para el pan de plátano:

1 plátano (verde o maduro)

1 huevo

Sal al gusto

1 cucharada de aceite (de oliva o el que tengas)

![1000308477.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23vi5tV714Z9sEUrzPGRogHC4mHQRfgDQZQMNu9NFfD2LbnucBRmDGKGDf9hieb1UKCZN.jpg)


# Para el spam de caballa:

½ lata de caballa o atún

1 huevo

Sal al gusto

1 cucharada de aceite (opcional)

![1000308514.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23wWvtzciCzCip4cpMydxd5R4ctqxAhXnzA3GoqSy49RVpFVN5fMRQWzEm8QXNobEac28.jpg)



---

## Preparación

1. Pela el plátano, córtalo en trozos pequeños y colócalo en la licuadora.

![1000308481.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23zkpZkx7pGbW9WPfGGkUQEQ4qPr18sKGCvvVfxW1D3HXZkLjN6f5tEQkKUYKVwyoBHrT.jpg)


2. Añade el huevo, la sal y el aceite, y licúa hasta obtener una mezcla homogénea.

![1000308482.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23xVHHgi6o5uZLSqrY6Ljg3R5d89WtiAWpEk6KKZLx8KaJfws3gij1e1DqahUYUozour8.jpg)

![1000308483.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/2432Hq6ECWj1SkZh97etVPFajUrvLVum28G4RnSY31EGFYDGqKiyNPc4GwL5Nn7wUoEtv.jpg)


3. Engrasa un molde apto para airfryer y vierte la mezcla del plátano.

![1000308495.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23u67GR2CmKpAsCDMTs1D2jYgzKiyA9PMPXhKMTWeTtujgwsoZu6Su8tZgTHyq9PdbxBJ.jpg)


4. Cocina a 160 °C durante 15 minutos.


5. Retira, deja reposar unos minutos y desmolda.

![1000308603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23x1DBSjTQCWgGmdhN3RRGawSWbwfU6Fd9VgzMbZz6gjmZwfk13W45jLEoq6zkNmkmc3w.jpg)

![1000308602.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23wX7RFiCYrSBGfbb2CcyfRhQcXnqCo9mTMYSXH4o1apqK3uVHBQnqtwRjUGWXg8cCkzz.jpg)



Resultado: obtuve un pan diferente, con un ligero sabor a plátano pero con textura de pan, firme y bastante saciante.

6. En la misma licuadora, añade la media lata de caballa.

![1000308515.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/243BgVpTrzxnkx8jWCdgosXUKikFstFXN88uZi1idfkis54oj4gWbjs38xtEBQLK7HH3a.jpg)


7. Incorpora el huevo y la sal, y licúa hasta lograr una mezcla lo más homogénea posible.

![1000308516.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/2432FkafJGLovC5fLmCqYXVfQhiG5VnMvqggxfVgLAcspfCzAaHT8N6kGZxnEgBAGPfcW.jpg)

![1000308517.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/243frUvsB62nqFXViEffyrRoTpQvLUj5S9y68cqa6h41Yy4TA32ww5Mg1AmUaEGqMp8Zc.jpg)


8. Engrasa nuevamente un molde y vierte la mezcla.

![1000308527.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/242Y7ygcdaFRoeqJNi7oWCYNSPLeEb6gWH7Dqkm7iCQEszPb2AHuERmWRWdqpmahkMr6a.jpg)

![1000308604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23vsUmQnooAEBL92RmrAAB3m8jL2r82vzRVvoHk8gv7xVra4vnWrirQhY2uweg6eYKWWX.jpg)


9. Lleva al airfryer a 160 °C durante 15 minutos.


10. Retira, deja enfriar ligeramente y desmolda.



Resultado: en lugar de pan, salió una especie de spam de caballa casero, compacto, con un sabor intenso y muy rico.


---

Lo interesante de esta receta es que, sin proponérmelo demasiado, terminé haciendo una merienda bastante completa. El pan de plátano verde aporta fibra, energía sostenida y ayuda a mantener la saciedad, mientras que la caballa suma proteínas de calidad y grasas saludables como los omega-3.


---

### El resultado

Al final hice lo que cualquier persona haría en ese momento…

Corté el pan de plátano, le puse el “spam” de caballa arriba… y me lo comí completo.

Sin culpa.

Sin complicaciones.

Solo yo, mi invento… y el airfryer haciendo magia.

![1000308607.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23wCC4jpPhKpw4kzEsbMjBH9eK8RcMZwS7cgVrDHHN5q9LxvDuizaRgxMP4BrQmj3Tt1N.jpg)

![1000308606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23wX1R6RgVCKZpwHZTj12FiXEScxGbLSycpHG4t29aRb7SmanEZvkKhPNuZnKdHnjzxkJ.jpg)

![1000308608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/im-yanizet/23vsSc4RBkyxxBWQieELhksoBFnwAvvYJB7GZKdMwogLRa32rkVoFGB3tC5NbWb8jQnsb.jpg)


---

### Final

A veces creemos que comer saludable es complicado, caro o aburrido… pero días como este me recuerdan que no.

Que con lo que hay en casa, con un poco de curiosidad y sin miedo a equivocarse, pueden salir cosas buenas. Cosas reales.

Tal vez no fue el pan perfecto… ni el spam más bonito.

Pero fue mío.

Y eso, al final, también alimenta




# English Version 



Sometimes the best recipes don’t come from a book… they come from necessity, from the moment, and from whatever you have at home.

When green plantain turned into bread… and mackerel turned into spam

My father had brought home a good amount of green plantains, and as a good Cuban, that’s almost a treasure in my house. Here, green plantains are a big deal: tostones, fufú, mariquitas… there’s always a way to enjoy them.

But this time I wanted something different.

I’m currently taking anti-inflammatory medication for my knee and I need to snack regularly, but I didn’t want to eat things that would make me gain weight. So I got this idea: make something healthy, high in protein… with what I had.

I had been wanting to try plantain bread for a while, and also that famous “mackerel bread.” So I said, today is the day.

Spoiler: one turned into bread… the other became spam.

## Ingredients

# For the plantain bread:

1 plantain (green or ripe)

1 egg

Salt to taste

1 tablespoon of oil (olive oil or whatever you have)


For the mackerel spam:

½ can of mackerel or tuna

1 egg

Salt to taste

1 tablespoon of oil (optional)


# Preparation

1. Peel the plantain, cut it into small pieces, and place it in a blender.


2. Add the egg, salt, and oil, and blend until you get a smooth, uniform mixture.


3. Grease a mold suitable for the air fryer and pour in the plantain mixture.


4. Cook at 160 °C for 15 minutes.


5. Remove, let it rest for a few minutes, and unmold.



Result: I got a different kind of bread, with a light plantain flavor but a bread-like texture, firm and very filling.

6. In the same blender, add the half can of mackerel.


7. Add the egg and salt, and blend until the mixture is as smooth as possible.


8. Grease the mold again and pour in the mixture.


9. Cook in the air fryer at 160 °C for 15 minutes.


10. Remove, let it cool slightly, and unmold.



Result: instead of bread, it turned into a kind of homemade mackerel spam, compact, with a strong but really delicious flavor.

What’s interesting about this recipe is that, without planning it too much, I ended up making a pretty complete snack. The green plantain bread provides fiber and steady energy, helping you feel full, while the mackerel adds high-quality protein and healthy fats like omega-3.

### The result

In the end, I did what anyone would do in that moment…

I sliced the plantain bread, added the mackerel spam on top… and ate the whole thing.

No guilt.

No complications.

Just me, my little invention… and the air fryer doing its magic.

### Final

Sometimes we think eating healthy is complicated, expensive, or boring… but days like this remind me that it doesn’t have to be.

With what you have at home, a bit of curiosity, and no fear of getting it wrong, you can create good things. Real things.

Maybe it wasn’t the perfect bread… or the prettiest spam.

But it was mine.

And in the end, that nourishes too

body.title: Sunday adventure 🌞
body.body: These are some clips from the video I filmed yesterday during our Sunday adventure to El Salado Beach. Let me explain what you’re going to see in the video. 🤣 The first thing you see is the road in the locality of Santa Fe, which connects to the Pan-American highway. That’s us leaving Santa Fe… and that’s when I felt like joking around with the unknown cyclist. I told him he was slacking. We overtook him, and then, when you hear the whistle, that’s him right beside us. He caught up. We started chatting, and he thought we were riding with a group called Fastéate, who go on routes from time to time. This time they were heading to Playa Banes, a bit further than where Azrael and I planned to go. We exchanged phone numbers and told him we might spend some time there with them. Then you see Azrael and me fooling around, and me filming the Santa Ana River, near the Latin American School of Medicine. A bit further on we met up with @muhammadhalim, whom I called when we passed the school and told him to wait for us around the Los Cocos area in Baracoa Beach. 😁
> Muhammad showed us where they were selling cold guarapo (sugarcane juice). We love that!

>
</center>


Later we saw some of the cyclists from the group at a cafeteria, including the one we had first met. After passing El Salado I caught up with them, filmed them, and then turned back. From there we stuck to our original plan, although a few more things happened afterwards…

<center>
https://youtube.com/shorts/y-vlW-19xEo
<sub><a href=\
>YouTube I was really happy for my friend Muhammad, who was able to take lots of photos, and I’m sure they’re all as great as the ones he shared in

>his post today. My stats? Yes, just a moment. You can see that those stats were uploaded through my alternative account for the Strava2Hive service, @traininglog. So, here they come… And the good news I have for you is that I’m improving every day, because I can feel it in my body and in how it responds the day after.

> https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23swsB5Ru5B7QMYCEvVjM1egJDhfEQMKeULT5DaX68BtYLbgdHwdp7u4429NnB85P1Sw6.png Even though I’m completely sunburnt because the sunscreen didn’t even realise it was supposed to do its job. Yesterday I recorded the route in two sections, the outward ride and the return. Although on the way back we added that brief visit to Playa Banes.

> Metric Outbound (to Playa El Salado) Return (to home) Distance 26.41 km 31.12 km Elevation gain 54 m 64 m Moving time 1:19:01 1:41:17 Average power 68 W 59 W Calories 400 511 Heart rate 134–170 bpm 137–156 bpm Average speed 20.1 km/h 18.4 km/h Max speed 49.7 km/h 38.9 km/h
![El Salado](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nanixxx/EpGQdCJavS4JL3WP1d1bVJYm7iFpVBWze247JePG98pb4xN5WEYzGLFadt7Mm2b3xe7.jpg)
> Don’t get the wrong idea that we went to the beach to get drunk… we only had one beer each there at El Salado. Honestly, it’s perfect for cooling off…
> Near that dock we swam a little, laughed, and also pulled out a few beer cans from the water that careless people had left behind… We did a bit of volunteer work.
> The beach looked quite clean, and since there weren’t many people, it still kept that virginal air that all beaches have early in the morning hahaha… this turned out rather poetic.

> The water was very clear and you could see small fish swimming there. The beaches along the coast of Artemisa Province are very interesting, but if they have their charm, even more so does cycling through those remote places where you hardly see a soul—only nature on both sides of the road, with birds providing the perfect background. In fact, since Muhammad and I share the same passion for birdwatching, many of our conversations revolved around that topic. And also around the fact that the people living there must rely on alternative means of transport, because public transport simply doesn’t exist in those areas. And if it does, it’s so sporadic that we didn’t see a single one pass by.

> After swimming and hanging out there for a while, we decided to go to Playa Banes where the other cyclists were. It’s really close, about 5 km or so. On the way we saw some vendors selling a rather unusual fruit. Haha… it’s called caimito. They told us it was very, very sweet. So we went and bought two to try. Later I was laughing with Muhammad in Banes when he decided to eat his, because it looked so strange. And he was being really funny filming how to open it. It was also funny that we were buying a caimito in Caimito, since we were already in that town with the same name. The fruit didn’t taste like anything, but let me explain… when we left Havana, the last town in the capital is Santa Fe. Then we entered Artemisa Province in the municipality of Bauta, and both El Salado and Banes belong to the municipality of Caimito. 😆
> I really wanted another beer, but they convinced me to have it at the other beach. So you could say that on our route we tasted different beer brands in three different places…

> 😆 ... And it will continue, because this is already getting long and I have other videos I want to show you. ---

body.title: A Random Set of Urban Tails and Tales
body.body:
Acting as a layover destination for migrating birds, the lower mainland sees a variety of feathered travelers who stop by to replenish their supplies in the abundant natural spaces in and around the city, as well as co-mingle with the residents who spend all year in the vicinity. It's hard to keep track of who's who. 

I came across a protected parcel of land near a stream, where there was a board illustrating different species, and the specimens seen in that particular conservation area. 

<center>![Bird Sanctuary Board01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EowFDWEJZaQJWnoBHbmniK69ZXyb5ZrZxPD91TDyNSd6qmQrcZp6HRPWY1AvwafEbwj.jpg)</center>

<center>![Bird Sanctuary Board02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23wWvt4eqEEKSoX96bcM2yQvaJH6YreGwLzhz1UbnWsfh9vJ6Pz7V5p22bY13KpFG2RYz.jpg)</center>

There was a bag with paper and pencil, so I think that people are encouraged to report sightings. What a great idea, I thought. Involving the visitor is a great way to create a more personal rapport with the environment and its protection. 

<center>![Bird Sanctuary Board03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EnqSaemPFJraNPc33jRu2atXBpgf7nPUwTEx4VJiWDfneMH9oKWiBsaHgUn8G4nqCF9.jpg)
*Very useful!*</center>

Closer to home, I was recently surprised to see a type of goose that I had never seen before. It was hanging out with a group of cobra chickens, also known as Canada geese. 

<center>![Geese in Park01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23w2guTeErmHWrBsYD8gv9xupXqw1FNJtU9w9nvCwHPSqVFxvUhdeyjLnKgGkxQK79Ssz.jpg)</center>

There are resident Canada geese, who remain in the city all year, but others take off for warmer climes when winter arrives then return to munch on grass when the weather warms up.

<center>![Geese in Park04.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23uQn8E1BeNZG4DCwETMTfF9FiNVCgP9GvfSAoCDkTDQHaE2sya9GRfhoTxaNCyFiA9kc.jpg)</center>

I didn’t have my camera with me, so I used my Pixel 7. I really need a reminder: *do not leave home without camera*. 😌

<center>![Geese in Park02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Ep3dpZj2McVPvbKGHUmjgkFFnXhK4hQhxsKtdntjnpUWQipB4cLtupHKBqby34Tr4Fa.jpg)</center>

It turned out that this particular bird was a Greater White-Fronted goose. It had a white underside and pinkish bill with a white base. I believe this is the “Tundra” variety, but I’m not familiar with this species. As its name implies, it enjoys Tundra environs, but it passes through here during its migratory period.

The curious thing is that it was all by itself, so maybe it got separated from its flock (or perhaps it had enough of their shenanigans and preferred the company of the ever-amiable Canada goose).

<center>![Geese in Park03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EorzqhGw3Rk6Yg3Q2gw41BgkhR2iC8nXULJwDRTuJNEPs3cWZ2M5DAoF6LZAJ6CtVfa.jpg)
*One is not like the others*</center>

Across the city, in a seaside urban slough, an unfamiliar species of ducks hung out among the reeds. This particular place used to be an industrial zone that was developed into a residential neighbourhood and has now turned into a vibrant community. I came across a few nice ecosystems in that area, and I was glad to see that they took care of their natural spaces. It's expensive keeping things tidy and clean.

<center>![pond ducks.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23wgHpykicLZ6Ssg3K7E33k4G5jDArB9s5Zg1eaiAitGbH5L1b1z9BaBJzkv8ysYC6zSr.jpg)</center>

As it turned out, the ducks were American Wigeons, and they were having a pleasant time there.

On one occasion, I went out with the explicit intent of NOT taking photographs of *seagulls* because they are common birds and not so exciting for me. So, I wanted to capture new amazing avian sights. I was crossing a bridge, when lo and behold, I saw one surprising sight that I had never observed before: *seagulls taking a river bath*. Fascinating!

<center>![Seagulls in the Stream03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eoc7wxok61UEXBvNrzR3DZdiRV22HydeCUcFfzpxr3qHrCh2bafobBQMLGdwQ55jNwe.jpg)</center>

<center>![Seagulls in the Stream02.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EqL9Bqn33EZTdj4XKuoG7FaN4JiJV9k5vGs9H7zEbEnrAeQeCJJJkGjGykYJM6iDfHn.jpg)</center>

I couldn’t believe it. I thought I knew every thing there was to know about seagull behaviour, which usually consists of pestering tourists for food and harassing crows. Now, here they were having a communal bath in the fresh cold waters of the Capilano river under a brilliant sun.

<center>![Seagulls in the Stream01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/EoiTGfyF5oKFphaiJKL18G3tciVVeJnbM5sqkT7awPrCVaJSfADkoZEDKDAomHSwTjx.jpg)</center>

There are birds that are a little more urban, like this house finch perched on a sign and singing his heart out. Don’t let his diminutive size fool you, that song packs a punch. I know he’s a male because it had a brilliant iridescent orange head. I heard or read somewhere that birds in the city chirp louder in urban environments to be heard above the sound of traffic. This one was belting out the tunes.

<center>![Finch on sign.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/23yJ8EKBUWg5SuUE64SPqnu8TLjX3yqGhwvEEv7wwDeqQTm6sGRBMAf6fV6SfznWe1FKg.jpg)</center>

Wood ducks are year-round residents of the lower mainland. I usually see them in pairs that consist of a flashy colourful male, and a dainty smooth female. Here's a pair who appear to be on their way to some serious business.

<center>![Wood Ducks.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/Eo6HvHALJJ7qmDmnXTpSgiNZqfLqGht57CgzK8iiSnLoFnXGLDP56r8hxWtdLwaawzg.jpg)</center>

On the ocean, this cormorant must’ve had a lot on its mind because it stood there for over an hour watching the sunset. Possibly, it was drying up after its aquatic hunt. I have a lot of respect for this bird whose life appears to consist of hunting and suntanning.

<center>![Cormorant in the sea.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/244xqTWAHsDXN3zNs2bsVVuqyDEuj81y9UcTVLni5VgKmdMV3XFshf6SS7BadmYz5G12r.jpg)</center>

Circling overhead in broad looping circles was a larger menace. It could’ve been an eagle or another big raptor looking for a snack. Later, I saw it being attacked by a flock of seagulls, who did not like the looks of this stranger.

<center>![Eagle in the sky.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/litguru/246ap1iHVXPksSZA5YUtjvtWhvrJgyM99KUnWr8qFpZoEodaQY5XtrHqZWAq55MrGFS9Y.jpg)</center>

Thank you for visiting these great heights.

body.title: The Rainy Season.
body.body:
![Green and White Minimalist Nature Travel Vlog Youtube Thumbnail (53).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/242hivsWYCSePLosDPjYApUmeZeBr3b5LfZSs7jkM4jdsDqcHhzRvAdDjeFHp1w1xCDJp.png) ***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAyTtPNZ193z3v9HzUXNRYfNBKpop4B452wXWGAr95ns7Froa3QYr2tHe7aDsDXTJuz6E8PeAV3edWS3NGxHQJHC9xJn9eUpGW.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uEz3qUu1cpWPYjmp2LnK1i4RcXoAhocX2Rzpq9uYyMScovNm77MZBozX7i1NM59BnSf.png) On a good day, the rainy seasons are easily one of the most difficult that the average Nigerian would have to deal with in the calendar year. Not expressly because of the rain itself or the weather, but because of everything that it causes. Many people abhor going out in the rain, not because they don’t want to get wet, but because it’s just too damn stressful for anyone who tries to attempt it. And there are many factors that are contributing to this fact. One of them is our roads. A lot of our roads are unpaved, during the dry season, they’re good and fine. The only problem they pose is the amount of dust that gets raised when a strong wind blows. But other than that, it’s really not something that will be an issue. But during the rain, it all changes. The road becomes wet, and since it’s untarred, it becomes muddy and dangerously slippery. So, a bad step could mean that you fall on your face. ![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VAxm3nacdB7gLmLiZLuYVhHeNsRgxL6WKJoam3hs2B7ZLAp2jwaLFEwoAbLKzAfpv2DhtyvHbJunTbU58RMbxtkvefNK4qj8EA.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23uQkLUmr2XGp8UpLcdtKeQrWDNnK5jemLpyFynqgRKtzZaqtByEwcX3DoUEyB8Pwi9DN.png) But that isn’t the only issue we face. We also have a poor drainage system. The rain that falls doesn’t go anywhere; our gutters and ditches don’t lead anywhere either. So, when it falls, it simply stays right there on the road, turning into muddy pools of water. The gutters fill up quickly and overflow into the road. And this is how floods happen. So, if you decide to step out in the rain, besides having to deal with the slippery and muddy road, you’ll also have to wade through floods, putting your feet on places you’re unsure of. So, you just might leave solid ground and put your feet into a gutter. You won’t know which is which underneath all that muddy water. So, what if you manage to get through all this, then you pray you have a car, because if for any reason you have to rely on public transport, know that these guys will build houses and refineries on your wallet! Just the mere sight of dark clouds in the sky is enough to trigger a hike in the cost of transportation, chilly wind, and the mere promise of rain is enough to double the fare. And when it’s raining indeed? You might not even see them to begin with, and if you do, be ready to pay at least 4X what you normally would pay. Yeah, it’s cruel, I know. ![IMG_20230601_151955~2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23u5vyA77YHf5RBKE928nSnMDaruysviNmGZoQjwjqKXRBP5GJwp2xoKeC7X9cwsQvXhc.jpg) So, you see why many people prefer to be indoors when it rains? Not necessarily because it’s usually cozy weather to curl up in your soft blanket and watch your favorite movie, but also because it banishes all ideas of heat and sweat. Okay, not only because… but also these reasons I stated as well. And now, as we’re slowly getting into the thick of the rainy season, it’s going to get very wet. We’ll experience floods, transport hikes, and more cozy weather. This post is just to serve as a notice to be prepared. If you’ll be going out in the rain, take extra cash and protection, and if you’ll be home, have your movie and popcorn ready. But whatever you do, have a fruitful rainy season! ![IMG_20240503_0821302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/23wfhuyBnKkgQ77e2ah2LYpumcwVBRQBN66XFddxwZ4AjoZfAK1WUWRoBHHECKAyxgNLn.jpg) ***
Thank you for reading. Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments below, I would love to know what you’re thinking. Till we meet in the next post.
***
Watch My Engaging Stories on: [Facebook](https://web.facebook.com/brunokemaofficial), [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@bruno_kema), and [TikTok]( https://www.tiktok.com/@bruno_kema?_r=1&_t=ZN-91fKKHrMpuw).
***
N.B: All images used in this post are mine. The thumbnail was designed using Canva.
***
![2dk2RRM2dZ8gKjXsrozapsD83FxL3Xbyyi5LFttAhrXxr16mCe4arfLHA37mQtCuynkak9C9VoqEia8jgQG2PbwFzNsktXz6Hfoe4KSQsNnmd2u5Ymq52vnQFR4CHwS2v8AuqSugp7iQ5NJr9YdH7dWYndNDhdfMi9xZHQPBjU.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bruno-kema/243Bw5uTgqkghv5QdihXJGXjoqxCh1ieyLTT9CxWo3GZC5j8cgGEcx8D8WTWHuyF1BRCu.png)
