body.title: Splinterlands Economy - SPS close to ATLow!
body.body:
> ![SPS Close to All Time Low.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23vhWMzEoSWnJZdiui86ba2zi7S66i3vFBS5b7FpntqEyei4wEWnQPWsbhMFNJqKnSB6w.jpg) For any user within the ecosystem of the web3 card game known as Splinterlands, the current situation is quite complicated and must be addressed seriously, as the situation demands. Just as it's important to highlight the positive aspects, the overall scenario must be considered in the analysis to understand what might be negatively impacting the Splinterlands game economy. First, it's worth contextualizing the current situation of Splinterlands and a bit of its history. Splinterlands is a game that had its peak in terms of player numbers, transactions, and item trading a few years ago. With the arrival of Bearmarket, the game steadily lost players, and as more decisions were made, the feeling was that the community was becoming increasingly divided. Some were in favor and others against, and over time, without the arrival of new players, the community began to think almost as a unified whole, since the vast majority of proposals that arrive for analysis in the game's DAO system end up passing through without many problems.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXJ8LnhaRGb2ygovCtukzHmkxVxXSLSYdDWTvZnDKydpC/image.png
[Coingecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/splintershards)
Just as in life it's good to have an opinion contrary to your own so that the group can find the best path through debate, in a DAO that controls what happens or doesn't happen in Splinterlands, it wouldn't be any different. When most users think the same way, the collective can move towards success, always making the best decisions that greatly increase the project's value, since everyone always chooses the best option, or contrary opinions may end up being forgotten. There's a story that I don't remember exactly how it went, but it was about the tenth participant. In a group of 10 people, there's always a tenth person who disagrees with the majority. This person is crucial because they make the other 9 re-evaluate their decisions; even if the other 9 are right, the tenth participant will make them think again. With the SPS token reaching All Time Low once more, might it be the right time to reassess the route and call on this tenth participant with differing opinions? I'll be much appreaciated if you **Votes**, **Reblogs** or give any **Tips**. Thanks and have good reading! 🍀 ---

> ## The State of the Splinterlands Economy The DAO and the players will need to make a major decision about the future of Splinterlands, regarding the game's development. In a recent proposal, the team responsible for the game's development asked the DAO for millions, which is about $5,500 per day, so that they can continue updating and maintaining the game, and transfer the rights to the Splinterlands brand to the DAO.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdYdKQU1TRKXYgZxYizeWSJDJCBqD35UpkmZDM48wdWcH/image.png
[Coingecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/splintershards)
I have no idea if these figures are correct or not, but I would like to mention the state of the game's economy. For these amounts to be paid, it's very likely that the DAO will have to divest its most liquid assets, such as the cryptocurrencies with the highest market cap, leaving them with only Splinterlands' assets. If the game doesn't recoup the investment in 1-2 years, they will be left without capital, unless they use Splinterlands' assets, which are currently approaching their All Time Low, in the case of SPS which is trading at $0.004. In any case, it seems like a situation that will either work out very well or could lead to complications in the future. I think that regardless of the proposal that will be debated, and the new developments that will arrive, this issue should be analyzed with greater urgency. Tokenomics is one of the pillars of a web 3 game; without it, the game will be like any other web 2 game that has much more investment, without the differentiating factor of tokenization, monetizing time and item ownership with NFTs. What will make the game unique?
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQrGwkdLjCvW49Hb33jPqjGMELKPW3CqngKvinA6RemsP/image.png
[Peakmonsters](https://peakmonsters.com/dashboard)
It's a very complicated situation, I'd love to have a solution, but I don't. It's easy to complain without having another option, but I think it's important to pay attention to the game's economy before there's nothing left to decide. In that sense, some interesting data is that in Coingecko, the trading volume of SPS on Pancakeswap is less than $4000 and the trading volume of cards in the game is between $2000 and $4000. --- https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVA8nYfdsJtPHvQ22mgMdhDhpJEiYmuLkjyQFGFtDHnFB/Divider.png ---

> ![SPS Close to All Time Low.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/rimurutempest/23vhWMzEoSWnJZdiui86ba2zi7S66i3vFBS5b7FpntqEyei4wEWnQPWsbhMFNJqKnSB6w.jpg) Para qualquer usuário que está dentro do ecossistema do jogo de cartas web3, conhecido como Splinterlands, o momento atual é bem complicado e isso deve ser abordado de forma série, que a situação pede. Do mesmo jeito que é importante ressaltar os pontos positivos, o cenário deve ser levado em consideração para a análise e entender um pouco do que pode estar impactando negativamente a economia do jogo Splinterlands. Primeiro vale contextualizar do cenário em que o Splinterlands se encontra e um pouco da história. O Splinterlands é um jogo que já teve seu auge em relação à número de jogadores, transações, negociações de items há alguns anos atrás. Com a chegada do Bearmarket, o jogo foi perdendo jogadores constantemente e conforme mais decisões eram tomadas, o feeling era de que a comunidade se dividia cada vez mais. Alguns eram a favor e outros contra, e com o tempo, sem a chegada de novos jogadores, o que faz com que a comunidade comece a pensar quase como uma unidade, já que a grande maioria das proposals que chegam para serem analisadas no sistema de DAO do jogo acabam passando sem muitos problemas.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXJ8LnhaRGb2ygovCtukzHmkxVxXSLSYdDWTvZnDKydpC/image.png
[Coingecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/splintershards)
Do mesmo jeito que na vida é bom ter uma opinião contrária a sua para que o grupo possa encontrar o melhor caminho através do debate, em uma DAO que controla o que passa ou não no Splinterlands, não seria diferente. No momento em que a maior parte dos usuários pensam da mesma forma, o coletivo pode ir rumo ao sucesso, sempre tomando as melhores decisões que fazem com que o projeto tenha uma grande valorização, já que todos sempre escolhem a melhor opção, ou opiniões contrárias podem acabar sendo esquecidas. Existe uma história que eu não lembro exatamente como era, mas falava sobre o décimo participante. Em um grupo de 10 pessoas, existe sempre a décima que é contrária à maioria. Essa pessoa é fundamental porque ela que faz as outras 9 re-avaliarem as suas decisões, sendo que mesmo que as 9 estejam certas, o décimo participante vai fazer com que elas pensem mais uma vez. Com o token SPS chegando mais uma vez no All Time Low pode ser o momento para re-avaliar a rota e chamar esse 10 participante, com opiniões diferentes? Fico agradecido se você puder dar um **Voto**, **Reblogs** ou algum **Tips**. Obrigado e boa leitura! 🍀 ---

> ## Situação da Economia do Splinterlands A DAO e os jogadores vão precisar tomar uma grande decisão sobre o futuro do Splinterlands, com relação ao desenvolvimento do jogo. Em uma proposta recente, o time que é responsável pelo desenvolvimento do jogo pediu para a DAO um valor de Milhões, que dá uns $5500 dólares por dia, para que eles continuem atualizando e mantendo o jogo, e passem para a DAO os direitos sobre a marca Splinterlands.
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdYdKQU1TRKXYgZxYizeWSJDJCBqD35UpkmZDM48wdWcH/image.png
[Coingecko](https://www.coingecko.com/en/coins/splintershards)
Eu não tenho noção para falar se esses valores são corretos ou não, mas gostaria de mencionar a situação da economia do jogo. Para que esses valores fossem pagos, é bem provável que a DAO tenha que se desfazer dos seus ativos mais líquidos, como as cryptos de maior marketcap, restando à elas os ativos do Splinterlands e se o jogo não retornar o investimento em 1-2 anos ela ficará sem capital, a menos que use os ativos do Splinterlands, que atualmente estão se aproximando do All Time Low, no caso do SPS que está sendo negociado à $0,004. De qualquer forma parece uma situação que vai fazer com que ou dá muito certo, ou poderá ter uma complicação futuramente. Acho que independente da proposta que vai ser debatida, das novidades que vão chegar, deve ser analisado essa questão com uma urgência maior. O tokenomics é um dos pilares de um jogo web3, sem isso o jogo será como qualquer outro da web2 que tem muito mais investimento, sem o diferencial que é a tokenização, monetizando o tempo e a posse dos items com os NFTs, o que fará o jogo ser único?
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQrGwkdLjCvW49Hb33jPqjGMELKPW3CqngKvinA6RemsP/image.png
[Peakmonsters](https://peakmonsters.com/dashboard)
É uma situação bem complicada, adoraria ter uma solução, mas não tenho. É fácil reclamar sem ter uma outra opção, mas acho que é importante dar atenção à economia do jogo, antes que não tenha mais o que decidir. Nesse sentido, alguns dados interessantes é que no Coingecko temos que o volume de trading de SPS na Pancakeswap é menos que $4000 e o volume de transação de cartas no jogo fica entre $2000 à $4000. ---

body.title: Is stablecoin issuers becoming T-bill buyers good or bad for crypto?
body.body:
![f597644aa8e54bde8bc92e88fc6aa6135b591ea8.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23uQhhACw9Xi9eCTBpg3j5nQs8FYzmfGeFZorJrPnUXrXCb8s2Vexti4qJYfkxAYpVSrg.webp)

Stablecoin issuers investing reserves in treasure bills is a self-serving move because it strengthens the market upon which their products are directly built on.

But what are the secondary impacts? To the broader crypto industry directly?

In January 2020, the USD-stablecoin market was valued $5 billion, today the same market is worth approximately $322 billion.

That's a 64.4x growth in 6 years.

Over this period, stablecoin issuers have turned to T-bills for their reserves where Tether alone holds over $122 billion in treasury bills, representing more than 83% of its total reserves. 

Tether is currently a top 20 global holder of U.S. government debt, surpassing countries like Germany and the UAE.

Buy why T-bills?

There's a very simple answer here and that's the often cited \

argument and in the case of Tether's position, that's billions is yield yearly, how can they look away?

But let's discuss the risks.

### Sanctions

Stablecoins [reportedly](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/trm-labs-stablecoin-transaction-volume-143950799.html) make up approximately 30% of all crypto on-chain transactions. This percentage grows larger when Bitcoin is removed from the count.

Clearly, this is a critical crypto infrastructure of today.

The problem however is that most of these volumes go through centralized issuers with significant exposure to centralized markets.

This effectively means that a significant number of crypto users (Tether reportedly has 500 million users) are exposed to potential sanctions by simply using a stablecoin.

Coming to this conclusion is simple.

Stablecoins expand exposure to the USD, and when issuers are significant tied to the system, everyone it serves is exposed to the control of the United States government.

The global appetite for USD-backed stablecoins growing, expands the total addressable market for the crypto ecosystem that is built on top of them, which helps the US government attain broader global control and effective room for sanctions enforcement.

Think about what it means for the whole world to run on a one currency system.

These stablecoins are already designed for maximum compliance so the argument is defendable by simply looking on-chain and recent reports.

### But, T-bills are not the problem

There are other risks to cite, including the fact that the US holds a pretty bad debt, so much that it is reportedly asking for donations (unverified — seen a Facebook post today), but all investment has base risks and this is just one.

So it is clear, the product itself isn't the problem, it is the system around it so then the real area of focus should be \

Centralized businesses should not be allowed the room to have such significant market share within crypto.

Decentralized stablecoins need to step up to mitigate the growing risks of stablecoins to the sovereignty of the cryptocurrency market.

A lot of people do not realize that if the stablecoin market collapses, the crypto industry takes a big hit, despite having the not so distant history of just this happening.

More attention needs to be given to stablecoins more than ever.

body.body:
> El miedo es una de las fuerzas más antiguas y persistentes de la existencia humana. Nos acompaña desde los primeros pasos de la infancia hasta los desafíos de la madurez, recordándonos que la vida está hecha de incertidumbre. Sin embargo, lejos de ser un enemigo absoluto, el miedo puede convertirse en un maestro: nos alerta, nos obliga a reflexionar y, si lo asumimos con valentía, nos impulsa hacia una vida más plena.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZNHDCAy9HX9oQFyPx5S8gTkSkruKaP1SjM9vY3AjMmd/monster_8810924_1280.png)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/06/05/17/31/monster-8810924_1280.png) Asumir los miedos significa reconocerlos sin disfraz. No se trata de negarlos ni de fingir que no existen, sino de mirarlos de frente y aceptar que forman parte de nuestra condición. El miedo nos habla de lo que valoramos: tememos perder lo que amamos, fracasar en lo que nos importa, o no estar a la altura de lo que soñamos. En ese sentido, el miedo revela nuestras prioridades y nos invita a cuidar lo esencial. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRyCoqiFncvTvW9PD4nkpgv5R6zEEePte1SWsx8VLKmFX/silhouette_3777403_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/10/27/20/18/silhouette-3777403_1280.jpg) Vivir con los miedos implica aprender a convivir con ellos sin que nos paralicen. Es como caminar con una sombra: sabemos que está ahí, pero no dejamos que nos impida avanzar. La clave está en transformar el miedo en energía de movimiento. Cuando aceptamos que nunca habrá certezas absolutas, descubrimos que la vida es un viaje en el que cada paso, aun tembloroso, nos acerca a la libertad. Vencer los miedos no significa eliminarlos por completo, sino aprender a atravesarlos. El verdadero coraje no es la ausencia de temor, sino la decisión de actuar a pesar de él. Cada vez que damos un paso hacia adelante en medio de la duda, estamos afirmando nuestra confianza en la vida y en nuestras capacidades. El miedo se disuelve cuando lo enfrentamos con acción: hablar cuando preferiríamos callar, intentar cuando quisiéramos desistir, amar cuando tememos ser heridos. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQS6Goamh1DckBKCgiUDzUHQo81Z815q2YT4N79T4bqN/horror_5233620_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/05/29/04/53/horror-5233620_1280.jpg) Existen caminos concretos para vivir y vencer los miedos: Nombrarlos: poner palabras al miedo lo hace menos difuso y más manejable. Muchas veces esta acción nos permite asimilarlo, tolerarlo y hasta vencerlo. Compartirlos: al expresarlos con alguien de confianza, descubrimos que no estamos solos. Muchas veces nos percatamos que hay personas en nuestro entorno que tienen nuestros mismos miedos e intercambiar maneras de afrontarlo nos ayuda a convivir con ello. Actuar en pequeño: dar pasos modestos nos permite acumular confianza y demostrar que el miedo no es invencible. No debemos pretender que vamos a vencer algo a lo que le tememos de una vez. Pero, enfrentarlo con pequeñas acciones nos permite superarlo. Cultivar la esperanza: recordar que el futuro puede traer sorpresas luminosas nos da fuerzas para seguir. Aceptar la vulnerabilidad: reconocer que no somos invulnerables nos humaniza y nos conecta con los demás. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2ZrnJyKpVAUaHiVttpWvYanhXxiS6hJ7iyHqZuSDzug/woman_2725337_1280.jpg)[fuente](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/09/07/13/58/woman-2725337_1280.jpg) La metáfora del río puede ayudarnos a comprenderlo: el miedo es una corriente que parece arrastrarnos hacia atrás, pero si aprendemos a nadar con ella, a usar su fuerza, descubrimos que también puede impulsarnos hacia adelante. El miedo, entonces, deja de ser un obstáculo y se convierte en un motor. Un comentario final En última instancia, asumir y vencer los miedos es un acto de libertad. Nos liberamos de la prisión de lo imaginado y nos abrimos a lo posible. Avanzar, aun con temblor en las manos, es la manera más auténtica de honrar nuestra propia vida. Porque cada vez que elegimos caminar con el miedo y no contra él, estamos eligiendo vivir con plenitud, con coraje y con esperanza. Nota: Utilicé el traductor DeepL Translate. Las imágenes las tomé de Pixabay. ENGLISH Fear is one of the oldest and most persistent forces in human existence. It accompanies us from our first steps in childhood to the challenges of adulthood, reminding us that life is made of uncertainty. However, far from being an absolute enemy, fear can become a teacher: it alerts us, forces us to reflect, and, if we face it bravely, propels us toward a fuller life. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcZNHDCAy9HX9oQFyPx5S8gTkSkruKaP1SjM9vY3AjMmd/monster_8810924_1280.png)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2024/06/05/17/31/monster-8810924_1280.png) Embracing our fears means acknowledging them without disguise. It's not about denying them or pretending they don't exist, but about facing them head-on and accepting that they are part of our nature. Fear tells us what we value: we fear losing what we love, failing at what matters to us, or not living up to our dreams. In that sense, fear reveals our priorities and invites us to take care of what is essential. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRyCoqiFncvTvW9PD4nkpgv5R6zEEePte1SWsx8VLKmFX/silhouette_3777403_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2018/10/27/20/18/silhouette-3777403_1280.jpg) Living with fear means learning to coexist with it without letting it paralyze us. It's like walking with a shadow: we know it's there, but we don't let it stop us moving forward. The key is to transform fear into the energy of movement. When we accept that there will never be absolute certainty, we discover that life is a journey in which every step, even a shaky one, brings us closer to freedom. Overcoming fears doesn't mean eliminating them completely, but learning to navigate them. True courage isn't the absence of fear, but the decision to act despite it. Every time we take a step forward in the midst of doubt, we are affirming our trust in life and in our abilities. Fear dissolves when we confront it with action: speaking when we'd rather remain silent, trying when we'd like to give up, loving when we fear being hurt. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQS6Goamh1DckBKCgiUDzUHQo81Z815q2YT4N79T4bqN/horror_5233620_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2020/05/29/04/53/horror-5233620_1280.jpg) There are concrete ways to live with and overcome fears: Name them: putting words to fear makes it less vague and more manageable. Often, this action allows us to assimilate it, tolerate it, and even overcome it. Share them: by expressing them with someone we trust, we discover that we are not alone. We often realize that there are people in our lives who share our fears, and exchanging ways of coping helps us live with them. Acting small: Taking modest steps allows us to build confidence and demonstrate that fear is not invincible. We shouldn't expect to conquer something we fear all at once. But facing it with small actions allows us to overcome it. Cultivating hope: Remembering that the future can bring bright surprises gives us the strength to keep going. Accepting vulnerability: Recognizing that we are not invulnerable humanizes us and connects us with others. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2ZrnJyKpVAUaHiVttpWvYanhXxiS6hJ7iyHqZuSDzug/woman_2725337_1280.jpg)[source](https://cdn.pixabay.com/photo/2017/09/07/13/58/woman-2725337_1280.jpg) The river metaphor can help us understand this: fear is a current that seems to pull us backward, but if we learn to swim with it, to use its force, we discover that it can also propel us forward. Fear, then, ceases to be an obstacle and becomes an engine. A final comment Ultimately, embracing and overcoming our fears is an act of freedom. We free ourselves from the prison of the imagined and open ourselves to the possible. Moving forward, even with trembling hands, is the most authentic way to honor our own lives. Because every time we choose to walk with fear instead of against it, we are choosing to live fully, with courage, and with hope. Note: I used DeepL Translate. The images are from Pixabay.

body.body: Ірландія створена для road trip’ів — звивисті прибережні дороги, гірські перевали та краєвиди, ніби з листівок. Ці п’ять маршрутів покажуть найкрасивіші куточки острова 💚\n\n

/>

**🌄 Ring of Kerry**  
Найвідоміший маршрут Ірландії — і не дарма. Озера, пляжі, гірські перевали, яскраві села та культові панорами.  
👉 Насолоджуйтесь кожною зупинкою.

**🌊 Wild Atlantic Way (Donegal)**  
Найбільш дика частина узбережжя. Величезні скелі, безлюдні пляжі та мінлива атлантична погода — суворо, потужно й незабутньо.

**🏰 Causeway Coastal Route**  
Вражаючий маршрут уздовж узбережжя від Белфаста до Деррі.  
👉 Скелясті дороги, замки, морські пейзажі та знаменитий Giant’s Causeway.

**🌅 Sky Road**  
Коротке, але дуже мальовниче кільце біля Кліфдена.  
👉 Панорами островів, гір і Атлантики — особливо магічно на заході сонця.

**⛰️ Gap of Dunloe**  
Вузький гірський перевал з озерами, кам’яними мостами та величними вершинами.  
👉 Їдьте обережно або пройдіться пішки, щоб відчути атмосферу повністю.

👉 Який маршрут ви оберете для своєї подорожі?

body.title: The Sleeping Dictionary (2003) || A Questionable Title for a Heavy Story
body.body:
<div class=text-justify>



![IMG_5128.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23uFKd2rNiDSu8Rw6DxMcJdzE7ajnwEikH2gSKsBrmzpdSBv3gUFgc3cVVgRv2EgfXu9K.jpeg)

There’s an irresistible quality to period dramas, especially the ones set in old colonial times, that always pulls me in. Funny how after a long day, I chose to watch this film, expecting it to bore me to sleep but I ended up not blinking till the credits rolled. Before I say anything more, who on God’s green earth approved this ridiculous title for this film? 

**Synopsis**

![IMG_5130.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EoEiinBu518gHmiWg3C5kip2HtrjE9fi21vrqgyrqkzFnzh4usa8Dob1ajLh2tYe77g.jpeg)

Set in 1930s British colonial Sarawak, the film follows Truscott (Hugh Dancy), a young English officer sent to govern a remote Iban community. Idealistic and determined to do things differently, he’s introduced to the local practice of being assigned a *sleeping dictionary*, a native woman who lives with colonial officers to teach them the language and customs, often through intimacy. That’s how he meets Selima (Jessica Alba). Therefore, what begins as an arrangement meant to help him adapt slowly evolves into something something neither of them fully planned for.

![IMG_5132.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tGc5VUyL76peYCGGxrXXLTMwTAZ26su1A87gWv6VUX2VgoYTVivQokY1Ge2JHUvRyJ8.jpeg)

But in a world built on hierarchy, race, and control, their relationship is defined as dangerous. As feelings grow, so do the consequences, especially when John’s duty to the British Empire clashes with his connection to Selima and the community he’s meant to rule.

**My Thoughts and Rating** 

John and Selima’s relationship is complicated. There’s tenderness there and genuinity where they’re not just playing roles assigned to them by society. But at the same time, you can’t ignore the imbalance. Because if we’re being objective, this is a relationship that begins with power already skewed. He’s the colonizer and she’s part of the colonized community. Even when he tries to be different, that structure doesn’t just disappear.

![IMG_5129.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23tbRYzTDxfUsiPdXAPmbLaeYRFoCUF89iBPpcTHha14Sw8izDxKmc9xReGCsYD4AboMd.jpeg)

So while I found their connection emotional at times, there was always this underlying discomfort like something wasn’t entirely right, no matter how soft the moments seemed.

Now onto the bigger picture. 

![IMG_5131.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23t7DLKKCHPin1Fs58jMKNR4w8bry2fR839tJY1VCHy8VvJvL6xtAZuYxYjtpxhG498Nd.jpeg)

What I appreciated the most here is how the film doesn’t completely romanticize everything.
It shows clearly, the tension between cultures, the impact of colonial rule and the way people, especially women like Selima, are used as tools within that system. The idea of a *sleeping dictionary* itself is already loaded. It’s not just about language, but access, control, and the way intimacy can be turned into something transactional.

Selima is honestly the heart of this film. There’s a strength about her even in situations where she has very little control. You can feel her emotions even when she’s not saying much and that’s what made her character so compelling to me. But at the same time, I couldn’t help but feel frustrated for her. The circumstances she’s placed in, the choices she’s forced to make were too heavy.

![IMG_5127.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/23w2cX1BtmGdPr54DDtAbvxkdj4bdWsccrWLZeukHWRw5rVA29MJwih7vNGyK5kqvAizF.jpeg)

Now, not to be a party popper but this film leans into romance in a way that softens the harsh realities it introduces. I genuinely felt like it could have gone deeper into the political and cultural tension instead of circling back to the love story. Because honestly, that aspect of the film was just as, if not more, interesting.

Finally, this is a film that is beautiful to look at, emotional in parts but also quite unsettling.

Rating: 7.5/10

![IMG_5126.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/teknon/EonjYudLf1dwgSUFuh5AGzuCDKNuRDqCiGJ5i4nCG16PLwKzr6pHspEkn5u9zwYgiW5.jpeg)

I recommend it for viewers interested in stories about colonial history and cultural tension. 

Oh and it’s got lovely scenery. They don’t make films like that, with such lush vegetation and greenery, these days.



</diva>

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@teknon/the-sleeping-dictionary-2003-a-questionable-title-for-a-heavy-story-8uv)

body.title: The group above all - The Tale of Birdie - ENG- SPA
body.body: > When would the day come? When? They wished they could speed up time to get there faster. They were just kids, and they already thought like this. There were four of them: Claudia, Miguel, Erick, and Anner. They were neighbors in the same apartment building. They didn't have a yard to play in, nor many friends; it was just them. They longed to grow up quickly so the day would come when they could form their own band. They had these ideas as children because they watched a lot of television while their parents were out. They watched mostly music, so they loved the idea of ​​being musicians themselves someday. But since they were just kids, they only lived wishing for that day to arrive. You could say that at that moment it was just a game. But when they were old enough, some of them started studying music at a school, so things were getting serious. Claudia and Anner studied at a school, while Erick and Miguel studied on their own at home after school. After they all got home from school, they would get together to tell each other about their progress. And little by little, their friendship grew stronger, fueled by music. What began as a game started to take shape, and each of them was already thinking about forming a band together once they finished their studies. It seemed their dream would soon come true, but some things changed drastically. Their parents could no longer live in the apartment building. Some had to move for work, as it was too far away, and others because they wanted more space as their families grew. So, from one day to the next, they went their separate ways. And with that separation went their friendship, their hopes, and, of course, their dreams of forming a band together. Anyone would have said that fate wanted to tear them apart.

> Cuando llegaría el día, cuando. Ojalá y se pudiera acelerar el tiempo para llegar más rápido. Eran solo unos niños y ya pensaban así. Ellos eran 4, Claudia, Miguel, Erick y Anner. Eran vecinos en un mismo bloque de apartamentos. No tenían patio para jugar ni tampoco muchos amigos, solo eran ellos. Ellos estaban deseando crecer rápido para que llegara el día en que pudieran formar su propia banda. Tenían esas ideas siendo niños porque veían mucha televisión mientras sus padres no estaban en casa. Veían sobre todo música, así que les encantaba la idea de ellos poder ser músicos también en el futuro. Pero como eran solo niños solo vivían deseando que llegara ese día. Se puede decir que en ese momento solo era un juego. Pero cuando tuvieron edad suficiente algunos de ellos comenzaron a estudiar música en una escuela, así que la cosa iba en serio. Claudia y Anner estudiaron en una escuela mientras Erick y Miguel estudiaban de forma autodidacta en la casa luego de las clases. Luego de todos llegar de la escuela se juntaban para contar sus progresos a los demás. Y poco a poco su amistad se fue fortaleciendo con la música como motor principal. Lo que comenzó como un juego empezaba a tomar forma y cada uno ya pensaba en ser parte de una misma banda cuando terminaran de prepararse en los estudios. Parecía que su sueño se cumpliría pronto, pero algunas cosas cambiaron radicalmente. Los padres de cada uno no podían seguir viviendo en el bloque de apartamentos. Algunos debían mudarse por trabajo, ya que les quedaba muy lejos y otros porque querían más espacio ya que la familia crecía. Así que de un día para otro cada uno se separó. Y con esa separación se fue su amistad, sus ilusiones y claro los sueños de formar una banda juntos. Cualquiera hubiera dicho que el destino quería separarlos.
![pexels-cottonbro-9644673.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23xp6cGMqUokJ7kXNnuwqgpqRdmCt77aZjFSa2RVGEsFnCs6R8Rd6Vk6TiWskUx29NrHD.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> Once they separated, each went their separate ways. Their parents moved far away, so they were all separated. They all continued in music, but had to accept reality and look for other bands and groups. They were never able to stay in touch again. Each went their own way; Claudia continued as a singer and guitarist, and the others as a drummer, bassist, and pianist. They were able to advance quite a bit in their careers and it can be said that they had moderate success. Although they were happy with what each of them achieved, none of them were truly happy after the separation. They suffered greatly from the absence of each other, and it greatly diminished their motivation to continue. Some of them even came close to quitting music. But they fought and were able to continue, even though they weren't very happy. They were able to tolerate that situation for a while, but little by little it became unbearable. From afar, they all wondered what their lives would be like if they were together again. They longed for it more than anything in the world. But the moment came when longing was no longer enough; it was time to take action. Claudia was the first to take action to reunite the group. She left her band and began the search. After searching extensively on social media, she discovered that Erick was living in another country. She used her contacts to find his phone number and was finally able to locate him after so long. Erick was overjoyed and agreed with her that it was time to start over and pursue their dream. He returned to his former country to see Claudia. Once together, they began searching for the other members. The others were more difficult to find since they weren't as visible. But after months of searching, they were able to locate everyone.

> Una vez que se separaron cada uno tomó caminos distintos. Sus padres se mudaron muy lejos, así cada uno quedó separado. Todos continuaron en la música, pero tuvieron que aceptar la realidad y buscar otras bandas y grupos. No pudieron mantenerse en contacto nunca más. Cada uno seguió por su lado, Claudia siguió como cantante y guitarrista y lo demás fueron baterista, bajista y pianista. Pudieron avanzar bastante en sus carreras y se puede decir que tuvieron un éxito moderado. Aunque estaban contentos con lo que cada uno consiguió ninguno de ellos fue feliz después de la separación. Sufrieron mucho la ausencia de cada amigo y les quitó mucho la motivación para continuar. Incluso algunos de ellos estuvieron a punto de abandonar la música. Pero lucharon y pudieron continuar a pesar de que no era muy felices. Pudieron tolerar esa situación por un tiempo pero poco a poco se hizo inaguantable. Todos en la distancia se preguntaban como sería sus vidas si estuvieran juntos de nuevo. Lo añoraban más que nada en el mundo. Pero llegó el momento en que añorar ya no era suficiente, era momento de pasar manos a la acción. Claudia fue la primera en poner manos a la obra para reunir al grupo de nuevo. Dejó su banda y comenzó la búsqueda. Luego de buscar mucho en redes sociales descubrió que Erick vivía en otro país. Buscó su numero de teléfono gracias a sus contactos y pudo dar con el luego de tanto tiempo. Para Erick fue una gran alegría y concordó con ella que era el momento de recomenzar y seguir su sueño. Erick regresó al país donde antes vivía para verse con Claudia. Una vez juntos empezaron al búsqueda de los demás miembros. Los demás fueron más difíciles de encontrar ya que no eran tan visibles. Pero luego de meses de búsqueda pudieron dar con todos.
![pexels-helenalopes-1139370.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nelsoncu/23r1woig95ur1LRQjsBQjYP98ucfVuAuQCAPf64wArpUVoCXvnhtC18bsgVnsvCidmqMU.jpg) ...Free image from Pixabay...

> When they were all finally together, they felt happy; they had defied the fate that had separated them. Through tears, they formed the band AVE and swore they would never be apart again. After reuniting, they began making music on a grand scale and became very successful. No one knows their story, no one knows what they went through; they are only known as they are now. But now you know too: fate can be overcome, or perhaps it can even be proven that such a thing doesn't exist. You are the only one who sets your limits. AVE came far because of their passion, and now they will go even further, but this time because of their love for music. Friends united will never be defeated.

> Cuando todos pudieron estar juntos por fin se sintieron felices, le habían dado una cachetada al destino que los había separado. Llorando crearon la banda AVE, y juraron que jamás se separarían de nuevo. Después de la unión comenzaron a hacer música a lo grande y fueron muy exitosos. Nadie conoce su historia, nadie sabe por lo que pasaron, solo los conocen tal y como son ahora. Pero ahora ustedes también los saben, el destino puede ser vencido, o quizás hasta se puede demostrar que tal cosa no existe. Solo tu te pones los limites. AVE llegó lejos por su pasión y ahora llegará aún más lejos pero por su amor por la música. Amigos unidos jamás serán vencidos.

body.title: LOH186 //  A Movie That Taught Me an Important Lesson
body.body:
When it comes to movies, everyone has their favorite genre. Some of us crave the excitement of action-packed thrillers, others love the spine-chilling suspense of horror, and some are drawn to the emotional rollercoasters of romance. As for me, I enjoy all of these genres and I always go for what genre I crave for, but the movie Secret Superstar, a 2017 Bollywood drama, left an indelible mark on my heart and taught me an important lesson that transcends the boundaries of movie.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcayVmtgBj5cLgzkVPxm4wXVvCb65YsQRg8DCLCeRb2Mc/1000208920.jpg 


Secret Superstar tells the story of Insiya, a teenage girl from a small town in India who dreams of becoming a famous singer. However, she faces opposition from her conservative, controlling father, who discourages her aspirations and forces her into a life of silence and subjugation, her mother even suffered for it. Despite the hardships, Insiya secretly uploads a video of herself singing on YouTube, under the alias \

and her journey toward self-expression and empowerment begins.

What struck me most about Secret Superstar was the theme of following your dreams despite the obstacles in your way, and finding your voice even when the world, especially those closest to you wants to silence you. The film is not just about pursuing a passion but also about finding the courage to stand up for yourself and for what you believe in. It’s a powerful message about self-empowerment and the importance of independence.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQmHqoiTnq7JfgQWvkEBCqai9q7zLzDpziCNq4LNxECZv/1000208918.jpg 


The lesson I took away from Secret Superstar was that no dream is too big to pursue, and no one should ever let fear or external pressure stop them from reaching for it. Insiya’s journey is a reminder that your passion and your voice matter, even if society or your own family may not understand or support it. She didn’t let her father’s abuse or societal expectations crush her dream of becoming a singer. She used her talent and her courage to carve out her own path, showing that sometimes, the most powerful thing we can do is simply believe in ourselves.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmSrXAPbebfuygoLBuL2DoCMPcWkN42CRspZQgkx5uhQXV/1000208919.jpg 


 Secret Superstar speaks to broader themes of personal freedom, resilience, and self-discovery, especially for young women who often find themselves caught between tradition and ambition. Watching Insiya’s transformation from a girl who is too scared to even sing in front of her family to a confident artist who embraces her talent and speaks up for herself was nothing short of inspiring.

Though I’ve enjoyed many films in different genres, it’s stories like Secret Superstar that remind me of the power of perseverance and the importance of staying true to yourself. While action films can excite and horror films can thrill, movies that tap into the emotional fabric of human experiences, like this one, have a lasting impact.

Seriously, Secret Superstar taught me a valuable lesson that no matter how many obstacles stand in our way, our dreams are worth fighting for, and we all have the power to change our own narrative. And sometimes, it just takes one act of courage, like singing your heart out in a YouTube video, to begin that transformation.

*All image are screenshot from the movie*



**Thanks for checking on my blog and have a wonderful day**

Something that sounds easy but is not is planting vegetables in the garden.
It is a very pleasant thing to do: place seeds in a seedbed and then keep an eye on them so that they are not damaged in the germination process.
Then, constant surveillance so that common pests do not reach it and if they do, which at some point they do, remove them. 
Do not place chemicals on the plants but everything organic, prepared at home. 
Wait until they bloom, the flowers are pollinated, and if they do not achieve pollination, do it ourselves manually; waiting for it to be loaded with fruit, and then harvesting it. It's not easy, but it's something exciting to do. 
Long live the garden at home!

body.title: Yubarlákia: albóndigas de carne y arroz / Youvarlakia: Meatballs with rice
body.body:
¡Hola a todos los amigos que leen mis recetas! Hoy preparé unas albóndigas de carne y arroz, un plato muy popular de mi país, Grecia. Son muy sabrosas, y su preparación es rápida y económica. >Hello to all my friends who read my recipes! Today I prepared some meat and rice meatballs, a very popular dish from my country, Greece. They are very tasty, and they are quick and inexpensive to prepare.
![IMG_20260426_142206.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23xVKNDb8bcLFUTTCnnVBx7yMYSADvEuVRdea3zTKQEiLTXSvevwYnPR9nnPx3XuCmYhw.jpg)
Este platillo también se encuentra en la gastronomía de Turquía y de Chipre, países que histórica y culturalmente han tenido vínculos con Grecia. En cada país la receta puede tener alguna que otra variación. Veamos los ingredientes a continuación para una persona: * 200 gr de carne molida de res * 1 taza pequeña de arroz * 1 cebolla rallada * 1 cucharada de perejil picado * 1 limón * 2 ramas de yerbabuena * 1 huevo * 1/2 taza de aceite * 2 cucharaditas de maicena * Un toque de paprika * Sal al gusto >This dish is also found in the cuisines of Turkey and Cyprus, countries that have historical and cultural ties with Greece. The recipe may have some variations in each country. Let's look at the ingredients below for one person: >* 200g ground beef >* 1 small cup of rice >* 1 grated onion >* 1 tablespoon chopped parsley >* 1 lemon >* 2 sprigs of spearmint >* 1 egg >* 1/2 cup oil >* 2 teaspoons cornstarch >* A touch of paprika >* Salt to taste
![IMG_20260426_101733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/EpC9vb1SzyxZifEeoABqdx8xb58Phe2riXU6shoHhq2sCBBQeQoQc7KekYS38Ac6Uzf.jpg)

**Preparación / Preparation** En un plato hondo poner la carne molida, el arroz lavado, la cebolla rallada, el perejil, la clara del huevo, la yerbabuena, sal y paprika. >In a deep dish, put the ground meat, the washed rice, the grated onion, the parsley, the egg white, the spearmint, salt and paprika.
![IMG_20260426_102843_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23yd7eVbnSF4L9te4tRcYLBZ6nE5J3VrrStwAxEQ91cLT4y8PS34vBU5mqvGxJpzCwuq5.jpg)
Amasar bien estos ingredientes, formar bolitas y colocarlas en la olla una al lado de la otra. Encima añadir el aceite, otro toque de sal y paprika, y agua hasta cubrir las albóndigas. >Knead these ingredients well, form into small balls, and place them side by side in the pot. Add the oil, another touch of salt and paprika, and enough water to cover the meatballs.
![IMG_20260426_103531_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23xemgFpRQYs3L61F4V5otnXBcfYcYHAhyp4A2hpGLnqng5D5NNWmdvVB93x6MG3xeGpw.jpg)
![IMG_20260426_131341_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23xempXKub4iwRf1e87JWUzNWppNNfwKvTDgKPP9Yx8LmQiZ9xUfpxNcHFPCo6yQhNM8i.jpg)
![IMG_20260426_132055_HDR.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23xenF4uwyBQLQJTPBcjrgUiP1jk5pSUoR8Hxpu3Vk9wXstw5iMXhi9rQ6mM45eJeLz17.jpg)
Tapamos y cocinamos a fuego lento hasta que el agua se absorba. >Cover and cook over low heat until the water is absorbed.
![IMG_20260426_134317.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23yThVK1cTRRUqfMFmxLxPN4quas646VpkodVBUvf7qPtUo4WSPxM9kvZ1GfdUPhqTDag.jpg)
Luego, en un bol batimos bien la yema del huevo, incorporamos el jugo del limón y la maicena, y echamos esta mezcla encima de las albóndigas. Dejamos unos minutos en el fuego hasta que espese la salsa y listo. >Next, in a bowl, whisk the egg yolk well, add the lemon juice and cornstarch, and pour this mixture over the meatballs. Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens, and it's ready.
![IMG_20260426_141146.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23xp8qMHoV2GbLvsZKx9GQHUgMMixf5UfrnyoUuf2awvcrrCuvzkvuJGg5iHpAwUfsfkK.jpg)
![IMG_20260426_140741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23vsNESAUdQtRcMDTvkwhFwfa82gRM85eihR8YsYM32jcMpXXJT6NWgMXwZr6HiuTWvY2.jpg)
Servir calientito y ¡buen provecho! Espero que este plato les guste. Hasta la próxima amigos 😉. >Serve piping hot and enjoy! I hope you like this dish. Until next time, friends 😉.
![IMG_20260426_142148.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/23w2q1u1UyDyd8X5JQ2yH5tcw5WJXXL6hcYyTjBJNzvx7FFCaNX382zVFVLan7aDqCd4m.jpg)
![IMG_20260426_142213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ioanna-m/EpnDJvXjfxqt3LqT1sYtrcQ24gg4SXpazArmAJs6ZdNyBAcGStPwcuGU92EXGnyHJU3.jpg)

**¡GRACIAS POR LEER! / THANKS FOR READING!**

body.title: [ENG|ESP]  A birthday cake with almonds, chocolate, peanuts, and raisins for my husband    (Recipe)
body.body:
***


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/23wqsAJ8S2HFG7UdLyGyBP9jJc5NqhtEbqZZFTDNehVr7Ph4W5LzJDvXVrgVNvTDfnyVJ.png)


***


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EopsWCK8qRspdB4ttJfzZd2uapWX2Sdo9mHSxnqnaYbM4wkPuASNyTNJ8cLh7ETwzLo.png)


***

Hello, friends! I hope you are having a wonderful day.
¡Hola, amigos! Espero que estén teniendo un día maravilloso!.*

♡ﾟWelcome to my blog:♡ﾟ･Friends ♡ﾟ HIVE//Bienvenido a mi blog:♡ﾟ･Amigos ♡ﾟ HIVE ｡


***
***

*Today I want to share a special recipe with you to celebrate the occasion; it’s a birthday cake I made for my husband. April 16 was his 53rd birthday, and I decided to make him an almond cake with chocolate, peanuts, and raisins. Although I couldn’t make it on the actual day because I was missing a few ingredients, I finally got everything I needed and made it on April 19 so we wouldn’t miss the occasion. I hope you enjoy it as much as we did. Happy birthday, César!.
I wish you a thousand blessings today and always, and many more years to come so we can continue to enjoy your company.*
> Hoy quiero compartir con ustedes una receta especial por el día; se trata de una torta de cumpleaños que preparé para mi marido. El pasado 16 de abril fue su cumpleaños número 53 y decidí hacerle una torta de almendras, chocolatada, con maní y uvas pasas. Aunque no pude hacerla el mismo día por falta de algunos ingredientes, finalmente obtuve todos los ingredientes y la preparé el 19 de abril para no dejar pasar por alto la ocasión. Espero que la disfruten tanto como nosotros. ¡Feliz cumpleaños, César!
Te deseo mil bendiciones hoy y para siempre y que cumplas muchísimos años más para seguir disfrutando de tu presencia.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoiUg8BnWPwpdeX4egyEGqKEq2e2ynMJRg9NBmgAJb1XACLZvZVZAsAEvkkCsRJdSm9.png)


***

Now I show you the ingredients and the step by step//Ahora les muestro los ingredientes y el paso a paso:

### INGREDIENTS||INGREDIENTES:


*-50 grams of almonds.*
*-50 grams of raisins.*
*-4 eggs.*
*-100 grams of filtered water.*
*-3 tablespoons of powdered milk.*
*-400 grams of wheat flour.*
*-4 tablespoons of butter.*
*-30 grams of cocoa powder.*
*-1 tablespoon of vanilla extract.*
*-100 grams of sugar.*
*-1 tablespoon of ground cinnamon.*
*-1 tablespoon of baking powder.*



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpLh2qtipJ7kagYgXcNjaKconXgN3zURsqTvcP85S7mYcybSvAFhYu2zttZZiFMPuQk.png)


>-50 gramos de almendras.
>-50 gramos de uvas pasas.
>-4 huevos.
>-100 gramos de agua filtrada.
>-3 cucharadas de leche en polvo.
>-400 gramos de harina de trigo.
>-4 cucharadas de mantequilla.
>-30 gramos de cacao en polvo.
>-1 cucharada de esencia de vainilla.
>-100 gramos de azúcar.
>-1 cucharada de canela en polvo.
>-1 cucharada de polvo de hornear.

***

***

### Preparation||Preparación: Step by step-Paso a paso:
 
*Start with the butter; beat it in a mixing bowl until it turns pale.*
> Comenzamos con la mantequilla; la llevamos a un envase para cremar hasta conseguir que cambie su color a blanquecino.
  

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoEsWL7ozgAqMvsxeHoFQX3bsaoVzAjwVYsSGouhTJEr2Jej7P2rdDfSKbf7rWySwSj.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpLhtYiNHQvVsDdxFUkiW2rHZrNt5qgGPG97KZ19CgWYiauZEcDQ8HxpeaETuHgK8E8.png)


***
 
*Next, after a few minutes have passed, add all the sugar to the mixture and continue beating until the mixture is smooth.*
> Seguidamente, pasados los minutos, agregamos toda la azúcar a la mezcla y continuamos batiendo hasta obtener una mezcla sin grumos.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpNpkiEoCgVWNXVLUrkxCD5B8juZh39bSButRxvo5feyoD6jpH9Dv71bBoPwhBrK4MV.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep5o4zrqsXtysmEaGmUPrVPQWSVhF8J9vRowT8evpwWvURXs9QFFG1SHyNJNNxjy5hK.png)

***

*Once the mixture is smooth, add the eggs one at a time to avoid breaking them.*
> Después de dejar la mezcla sin grumos añadimos los huevos por separados para evitar dañarla, 


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoeGJdHf2abMPwVBBZMxTKsRAWDvECJaB7JWRSchvWVhhGYhNngCS5MZsx2dhL7ibyQ.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Eou8mo346tPR6gHin7VvSdgg5PiLFo7KUhuFQ9jc7S2poqkYXav81WcvT1EeTSG28xB.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep3gJcwF4BiP4w1XZeJifwsBnhacoTUgxdXYyc2psosPMyGTjxVnHrZjixWHKQmN7x3.png)

***

*Once the mixture is smooth, add the eggs one at a time to avoid breaking them.*
> Después de batir muy bien los cuatro huevos y formar una mezcla totalmente homogénea, agregamos la esencia de vainilla.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep5ncfQF2DyJ93GhjojPUbTzhZAiA8ujRrdWRaQdp8HsoYxEygS3AM9v8fL8P3wijeK.png)

***

*Now add the dry ingredients, starting with the flour a little at a time (sifted beforehand), and beat until fully incorporated.*
>Ahora agregamos los polvos, empezamos con la harina de a poco, previamente tamizada, y vamos batiendo hasta integrar por completo.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EokedjkPWvyeDoPrKbMKKneuwBCvBtbBGi1iGm2DfuehPvZzeKg61RC551nbxc6jhh8.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep7w5uZdYZSGUBAiAxyAm4nZkCvFSPSLF7fAFci2f5yghbMPijYU8yWDFVTmu5SXVjs.png)


***

*Next, add the powdered milk to the water and whisk until it becomes liquid; add the flour, alternating with the milk, until both ingredients are used up. Mix well, stirring with a wooden spoon.*
> Después vamos a agregar la leche en polvo en el agua y batimos hasta obtener la leche líquida; vamos a agregar la harina alternando con la leche, hasta culminar con los dos ingredientes. Integramos, removemos con una paleta de madera.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoCjdq62vGAvJZ5XFzxsxqDyYNcjyMmRQ4qRtCBMs9iG5vz99tQryk7y2pKcjM4YRRE.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoEsPh6H4DB7LEebG9juDpqeDdzrrnyvUviTgCw1iZT3gWVX5tr5dJJaUTRzvXBbUzH.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep1YSM8MXEG5RqZMWiHgzCPgpLUGDtmCSLQrBE9T1a11FYDTq2hEC1zdrjUiYb1ZkWN.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpA4rpkuSTTxfmNzPjNmC5GAfmMrHj1GEj4gRQsqjqQM9RysZu5Rrkhyvs6KmfkWziU.png)

***

*We add the baking powder, which has been sifted beforehand.*
> Agregamos previamente tamizado el polvo de hornear.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoK8EvX1KFiVTMEkv9hbiBgyUp6QdREW5AP8RwCMkKSyQGzVBKFFxZdJPMsyxQWmFQy.png)

***


*Now add the cocoa powder, which has also been sifted.*
> Ahora agregamos el cacao en polvo, también tamizado.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpGRkCABYHuy7j45yFuHEfDrN3mGSxeD42Dw9MPZa4xRjXHReMPMRtG8T1Fzwn6YaZ5.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep7uAvy2BJekcykWR4YT7TXJf617EXJKMeNzYN8kKQHS8w5RznkbyLB8yeYTtkggji8.png)

***


*And finally, we select the nuts and crush them so you can feel the little pieces of each one inside the cake; I’ll set some aside to use as a garnish once it comes out of the oven.*
> Y para finalizar, seleccionamos los frutos secos, y también los vamos a machacar para sentir dentro de la torta los trocitos de cada uno; dejo un poco para decorar al salir del horno.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EokdbVD1xMuaei29BJKgJW2KGuMaxgE75FqSikinUrTyuwDrXh4ycmCZXQNF7sCWUov.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpvjJHsLak6ihgJbFzc8L5g3L5CaiJEQDyjLcwZNqtHivtCMbX9woMK54wB9b6CY7Ke.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep3foKs1aJ8h2AGmihxmEToLJbKbj7CLfdf8ZQdDiz2jypNovEBT9vB2DdSb2LMjsQ6.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EowHWr28fYaTfB2TSA8NCfyyXhgHZ4eWs3EtD7GMMXN2nyqenXEw4s7wpwvDZgf7FGh.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Ep5ob3dDb8dUideyXGeQEtZheMrUgmN6czCm5TEaGfaHL3ed63ieyw7Gg7C5rygKwUp.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EowJ3Cdc4idw74ZJtwdG6NCcVWeooKGVScVCUfujYVDLaGyvWjfCeyvYFt2QiSErgyr.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpT59criMJXQJUS8a4yusaFgnK3QSwDMBhJjnRJy9nai96Kxi2BbSyiiCM26UYYjKMA.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpEJqHTBU1XLFLx66WoH8cHMXPoDKDXwQ35suTmRPhSk1jT5mi2Z7w6hMKBxcgbeX2z.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoptQrEQr9k6qSoJiWvtznYTBKfEKihmbmAURGfWFzm63ifahVZqocjwQYGoFyWWpNq.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EpJZ3bRxucwnxr63osv14FmycMSwReswFoygMfFBRXbKtw8Bfh2Uoo7HtBbtiBkTNHK.png)


***

*Place the cake batter in the oven and bake for about 35 minutes at 180°C.*
> Trasladamos al horno la mezcla de la torta, dejamos hornear por aproximadamente 35 minutos a 180º. centígrados.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/Eos2ho2crFVcDv1P1e3X1UM9bAzSCU8ixAnEZ42M13Z1BKdK6yw4rfQjQikY3ZRnagv.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dlizara/EoryPoc2ZuByodi5mo7WSixoCsJ1jFY1zDgb5XeFnPgL2JLet8rxtfhhKPAkNwpHmB2.png)


***

*After some time, insert a toothpick into the center of the cake to check; if it comes out clean, it’s done; remove it from the oven and let it cool.*
> Pasado el tiempo, introducimos un palillo al centro de la torta y verificamos; si sale seco, estará listo; retiramos y dejamos reposar.

body.title: Nature's Therapy 14k Steps in Richmond Park.
body.body:
​Hello Actifit family! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/70541aa4-bf2a-4388-8e04-f2f659169d93.jpg) ​There’s a specific kind of magic that happens when you mix fitness with the great outdoors. Today, Monday, April 27, was a testament to that. While many people find Mondays heavy or draining, I decided to turn mine into a marathon of movement and mindfulness. ​ Exploring Richmond Park ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7933f063-554e-434b-af5b-0d9b87e7e395.jpg) ​My journey today took me through the historic and serene Richmond Park. As a National Nature Reserve, it’s one of the most beautiful places to get your steps in. Walking past the Welcome to Richmond Park signs and seeing the majestic deer imagery everywhere reminds you that we share this space with incredible wildlife. ​The highlight of my walk was undoubtedly the sunset. I managed to capture a shot where the sunbeams were breaking through the clouds, casting a golden glow over the hills and trees. It’s moments like these where you forget you're working out and simply feel grateful for the ability to move. ​ Crushing the Goals 14,409 Steps ​By the time I checked my Actifit dashboard this evening, I was thrilled to see a total of 14,409 steps! ​The Morning Push I started early, building momentum with small walks. ​The Afternoon Peak You can see on my activity chart that the biggest spike happened late in the afternoon that was my long trek through the park. ​The Rewards My balance is growing, and my activity rank is looking solid at 99.74%. It feels great to see consistency paying off. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a168ab4f-6bec-4b7a-a7c2-0620e2d9dcdd.jpg) ​ Gear and Consistency ​Today I made sure to utilize my in app items my water bottles and sports shoes are active, helping me maximize my earnings. It’s a fun layer of strategy that Actifit adds to our daily lives. Looking at the Manage Workouts section, I’m already planning how to keep this streak alive for the rest of the week. ​ Final Thoughts ​If today taught me anything, it’s that nature is the best gym. There’s no membership fee for a sunset, and the fresh air in Richmond Park is the best pre workout supplement you can find. ​Whatever your goal is be it 5,000 or 20,000 steps just keep moving. Every step is a victory for your health and your mindset. Before I wrap up this post, I would like to give a huge thank you to @terganftp. By following his advice, my posts are truly receiving much more appreciation and higher rewards. ​Stay active, stay happy!

body.title: Iain Davis Interview – The Technocratic Dark State & The Network State Agenda
body.body:

body.title: The Importance Of Stillness
body.body:
>We live in a world full of distractions; our mind itself is a noisy place. If it's not one thing we are thinking about, it's another. Lately, I have been trying something crazy. Sometimes during the day, I withdraw and try to check inward to see what's going on in my mind, and I am surprised by how busy and unsettled my mind is. One moment, I am thinking about one thing, the next moment I am carried away by another. I barely sit on one thought for long. One of the hardest things for us to do is to still our minds. I have tried it many times and failed. I know you will think I am not serious until you try it too. Most people run away from quiet time, not because they do not want it. There are many who desire it, but their strength often fails them after a little trial because we are used to noise. We have made our minds so familiar with chasing different things that it makes noise look normal. We are either listening to music, singing, talking, or watching something. If the place becomes quiet, we suddenly become uncomfortable and call it “boredom.” It is as if we are scared to be silent. I don't know why it is that way, but I think that's a problem we all need to start tackling. When did you last sit quietly without doing anything, just you and your thoughts, for at least 30 minutes? If you throw that question at me, my answer is short: I don't know. I have been trying to do it, but most times, I get carried away before it even reaches three minutes. This has made me curious, is it that our minds are wired to be so unstable, or are we the very cause of the states our minds have become? Well, whatever the case may be, I still believe that there is nothing we can not undo or do if we put our hearts into it. I often stay alone, I often withdraw from people, and spend my time all by myself. Sometimes taking a long walk, or listen to motivational talks on my phone. The last time I was all by myself alone without any distractions was about three weeks ago, when I took a long walk for about two hours. There was noise from vehicles moving because it was a busy road, but I was able to interact with myself because I didn't carry my phone. Apart from walking alone, it's been quite a while since I last sat alone in a quiet environment to meditate. As I said earlier, I have been trying to cultivate the habit again, but my effort proved abortive, so I stopped. However, one thing I can tell from walking alone with no music is that I get to understand myself better. I get the opportunity to reflect on my thoughts, my plans, and come up with amazing strategies. Sometimes on my way, as I begin to ponder certain things, ideas begin to come, the eyes of my understanding open, and I begin to see things differently. The truth is, if we can master the act of silence, we will be best at making decisions even if we are not too smart. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTFHLkdQpwvYLQF7Ap1p65FFCfW4pwduZcKrvPWmBpEDZ/1777320457301.jpg) Stillness freshens our minds and understanding. I have enjoyed this many times. Each time I am faced with an issue, and I find it difficult to solve it at the moment, I go into my room and allow myself to relax, as I try to solve the case, and when I am out, I come up with good results. I use this method often when I am upset, and it has given me good outcomes countless times. ------ N.B: All Images Were Generated By Gemini AI -------

Thanks For Reading

body.title: Don't you just \
in love with this cutie?!?!
body.body:
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wWvtzwLtzFhZvk3oiis33GD5N7zKEWJuMgfgs9ED9C54wgUiVV2dpZpUTNySJL8CKcg.png


In my ever increasing list of hobbies that I think by some miracle I will magically have time for all of them... I have picked back up 3D printing and 3D modelling. And to celebrate that I decided to take another stab at using Local AI to take a png image file and converting it into a glb file which I can then convert to a stl and then 3D print it.

But before we dive into this specific post and the outcome... Let's take a look at all my previous Hive/Holozing/Splinterlands 3D prints...

|<center>Holozing = Glimmo</center> | <center>Holozing = Glimmo</center> |
|-|-|
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/ALD8aV64ZdT75kCk2hTSLyE1aUWrPVbgERtSipRq6gu1ZKtig8yj7PCsLZnESAF.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/242ruTWph75EF6byJfYaSSjBog8S9bp94WjjbjxcBXfLt72H6jqVFv1UiG1oEfYNjn796.jpg|
| <center>Holozing = Gemino</center> | <center>Holozing = Wrackdoom</center> |
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/243WcZHN2xYt8wqTPaAGGq4UmVVSMRSv1chzUxkhFMmzqpkyqCDndijuKpPcfpG9HJeEd.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23z7GDd6FMF6WK8FFeX5qcJk1TiHv5SxPcPKEDWP4giKabPa8QRndJkGcqAxtWT8kr8ta.jpg|
| <center>Unfinished painted Yabba's Pickle</center> | <center>Yabba's Pickle</center> |
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23ynUSsyk2eScW96R7u8K2mGoZaJ7zuYsCtAQLSVce3aR9oUAbJ8UDDdCn53KbEdXBKx7.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/244UxEcLNHpbSXzLbZTQHDcNgtPQxhxB8BrXXtm1zdP8V3ihBHQ5pfToBks3JB6M1djDr.jpg|
| <center>Splinterlands = Brewmaster Abraxas</center> | <center>Just look at those teeny layer lines!</center> |
|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/2432Pup934jbKqQik7N8Y6pgsoSUV6CYcgxBCosN4a1Zhb8VH1S8uGK6vds1Vj6Txz9nE.jpg|https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wX33b343TRLJ5SDM3hv9sqYt7crnLngUWbWuoc9jWQfGAvw7GwhuEtU8jFwuX42VL9T.jpg|


Okay enough down memory lane! Now onto the main event!






---

# Generating the GLB file

Once again I use ComfyUI and a pretty simple workflow to take a image and make it into a 3D model.

I decided on Fal because (s)he is just so cute! This is the image I uploaded to generate the glb file from

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Ep3drWFcrPijsmymKQhagZFZAoXrPBotUYSj8AyFUuRv9HWH7NkbCH48iz3NyhnmBMM.png

Here is the entire process in ComfyUI to generate the glb file.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tRvMuL7yewiaKjecU8tgjULYxHuv7WSoYgBpCGHD4iNeouHipBteC1MmVLLMnAz5ugm.png

It took 41 seconds from when I hit \

until it displayed the 3D model.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wgKmmyxUi2MTghjQcV4KB7C2Fg6tWqLfCijpkTZrbkQaEz9NCdFgW8hd3Jj9WCCMUGH.png

And that is all it takes to Generate a 3D model from a 2D image!



---

# Converting the GLB into a STL

In order to 3D print this cute little birdy, we need to take the .glb file and convert it into a .stl file. And to do that I use Blender. You just import the glb file and then export it as a stl. You can make changes to it while you are in Blender if you want but honeslty he was pretty good so I am going to leave it as is and see how it prints!


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tbR7TgjZmBU1WCEFnYmDKVn6dvSi5i53DNWKeLAk2tUNFiHtGLLsNhkFjDki1fzWRji.png

And I was also pleasently surprised at how clean the backside of the bird was. It usually takes way more fine tuning to get the backside to be clean looking.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Eo8QufKS9XZaXxRpp8iGpFChhvayUn4LVNapLyfFqPsARWLiTgajW9FAe4ZHrwwvLg7.png

Perfect Example is Miu....

Here is what my AI generated for the front...

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoAUVbjTrLcQUEQHKq2VPyNFH57dnhoPVSwBA35e7nsFrS2TyJaZuJTQX2rELMXp3mj.png

And this is the backside....

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/EoCbmE2giLyAZwfK9sq5BUeNz6EHEXfNHvHb4FgJ39XnUaec9xW56JzpWKy55HxupET.png

Yeah, not great haha.

But now we just need to export this bad boy as a .stl file which is easy enough!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23vhViJCQYCmcu5RmadLCDgYohhrgdA34kam96paWUwGNR4xfxjhTdR4ZcUyFQKGPxSoW.png


---

# Now to 3D Print!

I open up Creality Print (because I want to use my Creality K2 Plus for this print even though I am going to print it in 1 color).

Import the stl file we created in the last step and it will look something like this:

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23u5WvAwB4rXH4yvznEDn2W1ePpUuNTD6dNhgBC6yssdsNMLKvWMp6EPk1P9j5yqvbBrK.png

Now we could just slice this plate and print it, but I wanted to try to see how well I could paint the surfaces to see if it is even worth the effort to multi color print this one.

(and yes... there are a ton of manifold edges... you can fix that in Blender but the Slicer software does a great job of it and so I leave it to the Slicer to fix those)


... yeah I say we just stick to 1 color and then paint it by hand after the fact haha

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tkpRvftVoebNhpj4B4HjvbP3Loc9n9ncovtKqiD6MVVwK8LppgEs3uC64LWWKixZAgG.png

After slicing the plate....

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tS2gBRcFjSKRmkPbgXM8ZQBLQthtQYw8aA65svpEPQvvm2nMS858GjETzRnmu1M9Pew.png

It is estimated to take 3 hours and 42 minutes to print it.
It will take 96.94 grams of filamanet (which includes the 21.57 grams used just for supports).

Based on what I put in for the cost of 1kg of PLA, it will cost $1.94 to print this Fal 3D model.

You can even view the print job layer by layer to see the insides of it 😀

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23tbiDxf5teFZN39Z6Xej8G4GgeugNLZ4M3fY2iEZvbyPWhbG2Lhnx5XsfP7hhELc5tzp.png

Now we wait 3 hours and 42 minutes!



Here is the timelapse of FAL being printed!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23xV64wwTBzxh6uesQ8XzEPx92NTBU1shbirgHoFdx6AgYpizqFn2f9NPeHtSnqfjsSPu.gif



----

# The Finished Product

Fresh off the presses here is FAL!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23w2jGRuKBZLcENm5seMNennxDZSrSJ3CQG8jjvar8hBF5GDxiDTN6rA29aV7Qah37pDL.jpg

Cleaned up the supports and here he is.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wMaXc81ThuKHJE8sf8k3DFaLdPyPMByY5FkFdisWUEYiGkCQtRgu9ErQ4sGJDHJwWhF.jpg

His underside could use some work though 😬

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23x18qqJaiNRWq4LjRVn1dwFyzQqkNyuXd5eyK4yEWETUqRSsQF4m32eeZjCAYL4FE9cc.jpg










---

# Post Processing

Let's remind you all what FAL is supposed to look like though

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/Ep3drWFcrPijsmymKQhagZFZAoXrPBotUYSj8AyFUuRv9HWH7NkbCH48iz3NyhnmBMM.png

So I decided to start painting! And I am not a artist by any stretch of the imagination!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AKApU8tTsvKYHCzvpKbNyohn7yN4MrbtnMSYLwm3fzq8NTyEM8ptr3Ppsm9QoYc.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23xKxMJRqZFJAQcHPuVz5AKiq7DrLxLW4xDYwnMxfJrGRCiesY5rk3zVeDuuiTsa6CsAk.jpg

And here he is in all his glory!

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wC5ZtAppvxtFSUkj7Yx7ph3TSs3UNsWHMHArh7qKhQqJ9iVaahmaJD786yTiojh9Cbc.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK7x3aKcQT2z4RqxeoBTu7JYngFm5mweYGtefdCbXLYiLQveCJGERMvhqQy6vhz.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK7x3aKcQT2z4RqxeoBTu7JYngFm5mweYGtefdCbXLYiLQveCJGERMvhqQy6vhz.jpg

His chest could use some work... but it is what it is.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/AK7x3aKcQT2z4RqxeoBTu7JYngFm5mweYGtefdCbXLYiLQveCJGERMvhqQy6vhz.jpg

And look, the paint and brushes I used are all from a Dollar Store... so that is why my painting sucks and not because I just suck at painting... 😉


This was a spur of the moment idea and thus article about Holozing and me 3D printing. I hope you like my little cute Fal guy.


---

# The 3D Model Files + Legal

Look, I am not sure how all this legal shit works. I didn't create the FAL character/creature. So I am \

the starter image and using AI to generate a 3D model from that. I do know that under USA law, I am allowed to do that and print my own 3D Model of the character and share images of what I made (I think this goes under the \

policy).

But what I don't know is if I am allowed to share the files with you all. So I put a request out to my good old friend @acidyo to see if he is okay with me sharing the stl and Blend files with you all so that you can 3D print your own FAL guy. I haven't heard back yet (hence why I am pining him here too, sorry bud), so I am going to assume the answer is NO just in case. If he does respond and tell me that it is okay to share the files with people and/or upload them to like MakerWorld, CrealityCloud, Printables, then I will do that.

If you want the files though, just leave a comment stating that and if I hear back and am allowed to share them I will send you a Google Drive link to download them. No promises though since this is not my original work





---


Hey if you are still reading then I want to tell you that I run a Hive Witness Node. I run it because I want a decentralized blockchain and that means even the little guys can contribute to the blockchain and it's not all controlled by a few accounts. 

If you want to vote for me I would appreciate it.

If you don't want to vote for me... that's cool to!

|[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23wM2s18nnjEVEKsZbH8MSdTUxSq8PnAWnGiSxLNgd3v5zcJn4FtcerTYqmZDSPNYRMN3.jpg)](https://vote.hive.uno/@witness4all)|[![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/cherokee4life/23uQvauCkxRkAp6TE5itJLaRpiQ2wuszUTBp2bdaKSJvS2KP4fpnPDrvaDFWqj2y65vk5.jpg)](https://discord.gg/ujBXNA6S6Y)|

body.body: > Before I talk about the stories I loved as a child, I should mention two things: my grandmother, who looked after us because my parents worked, was illiterate and couldn’t read, and the other thing is that my parents never read us bedtime stories. When it was time for bed, they would simply turn off the light, say goodnight, and that was it. But they did tell us stories orally—folk tales or ones made up from their imagination. There was no set time for storytelling; all we had to do was ask: “Dad, tell us the story of the savage!”—we’d beg him to tell us that story again, even though we’d heard it a thousand times. The advantage—or disadvantage—of this way of telling stories was that they never told them the same way twice: sometimes they made them more exciting, other times not quite as interesting. Sometimes they’d forget a part, and we, as loyal listeners, would point out what they’d left out. We knew many of those stories by heart, as if they were written in our minds.

> For example, one of the stories I loved hearing the most was about the time the river in the town where my dad lived swelled, and some ghosts helped him cross it. According to my father, when he was very young, my grandfather sent him on an errand to town, and since their house was quite far out, my dad rode there on a donkey. My grandfather told him not to get distracted and to come back soon because rain was coming. However, my dad didn’t listen and stayed behind playing with some friends. The problem was that it started to rain, and in order for my dad to get home, he had to cross the river, which had already swollen. When he saw this, my dad started crying because night was falling and the river wasn’t receding. Suddenly, my dad saw a light appear, and the donkey began to follow it. Inexplicably, the donkey managed to cross the river, and my father arrived home safe and sound. The next day, they woke up to the news that the river had risen so high that it had swept away some animals, and that the spirit of my father’s grandmother had been seen wandering among the rocks.

></center>

Just like this story, I remember many others, but among the written ones, there’s one I remember with real fondness—and that’s because my grandmother, even more than I did, always loved it when I read it to her. When I turned 10, I asked my parents to give me a storybook, and in that book was the story of a man who complained about the existence of certain species:  
“Why do cockroaches, mosquitoes, and worms exist? God isn’t smart,” he kept saying.

But one time war broke out and the man had to flee from the enemy. One night, after walking, he lay down to rest and fell asleep. Suddenly, a mosquito bit him and woke him up. Just as he was about to curse, he heard the enemy approaching and he was able to hide in a cave. He stayed there all night, waiting. In the morning, he heard that the enemy was outside. Fearfully, he listened as they were about to enter the cave, but suddenly one of the men said to the others:  
\
With this argument, the enemy continued on their way, and the man who had disparaged the other species, in a single night, was saved by a mosquito and a spider. And that is the end of this story.
>The first image was made in Canva and the others are from my personal gallery. The text was translated with Deepl
>Thank you for your support, reading, and comment. Until next time, friend. Regards\n\n

body.title: Back in Business - Another Month with Claude - Improving the Security accross the Hive Ecosystem
body.body:
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23zGqAKwqm3DVvJN9hQmAYvXLK1tdWmL8EbmBy4ouNA2a79AHYJjHnktXcSL6ENodkyg6.png)


Yesterday I got another month of Claude Max! Yieahhha! But this time it’s the 5x version for a month, since that’s what I asked for. The previous 20x version was already really great, but somehow I felt like I hadn’t fully tapped into the 20x’s potential—even though I was able to help quite a few Hive projects. Anyway… Now I have the 5x model (and yes, I’ve actually already hit its limits) and am making the most of it for now, and was able to help more projects yesterday and today <3.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/louis88/23tv6LvvghiufWxT4uHZZQYTbkZnagqVxt64g55XyYxLvDb8focyyF3St4c2UAVLudMvf.png)


Since I’m sometimes reaching my limits, I have to put requests from the community on hold for now—but that’s not a problem, because the audits Claude spits out need to be double-checked first, and that takes time too—time that’s easy to bridge. The great @acidyo also asked me if I could review a project. That’s planned for tonight—at least part of it. 

Furthermore, I’ve continued working on projects that I know will be released soon—specifically the new frontend for @worldmappin with @detlev and @lizanomadsoul, where I’m also part of the team. But other projects are also getting my attention, and I was at least able to continue testing them on my own. Among other things, the @ecency frontend by @good-karma received at least one critical issue from me today :)

To do this, I pulled some projects again to get the latest source code and checked the security vulnerabilities I’d reported to see if they’d actually been pushed to the source code and thus fixed. 

And here’s something interesting that came in today—a request for the Hive Discord server asking me to be available for an hour of Q&A on the Hive Thrive Show. I’m happy that I’ll be able to entertain you for at least an hour next month—you’ll surely hear more about this from Hive Thrive.

That’s it for today—I’ll check in a moment to see what the agents are up to, and I’d say—tomorrow we’ll keep going strong, making the Hive blockchain more secure!

Cya

This is the bottom part of a paper egg that I painted on Easter Eve.
This is not some great work of art.
This is a small wark for a self-help house for people with various disabilities.

The idea was to draw three similar eggs. I cut them out of large pieces of paper.
I can't say I like the color green, but that's the paper they gave me.
This may seem primitive to some, but I only had an hour to do it.
