body.title: Mi versión del Arroz chino venezolano clásico [ES][EN]
body.body:
> Hablar del arroz chino en Venezuela, es hablar ya de una comida tradicional y que se consigue a lo largo y ancho del país. Para que una comida sea tradicional en un país o región, debe prepararse y consumirse por lo menos por 60 años, o eso dicen los expertos. Con la llegada de los inmigrantes chinos a Venezuela, el arroz chino venezolano se comenzó a preparar desde hace más de 60 años y se consigue en todas las ciudades o pueblos del país. Es increíble cómo la comida china forma parte también de la gastronomía que consumen los venezolanos día a día. > When we talk about Chinese rice in Venezuela, we’re talking about a traditional dish that can be found throughout the country. For a dish to be considered traditional in a country or region, it must have been prepared and eaten for at least 60 years—or so the experts say. With the arrival of Chinese immigrants in Venezuela, Venezuelan Chinese rice began to be prepared over 60 years ago and can be found in every city and town across the country. It’s amazing how Chinese food has also become part of the cuisine that Venezuelans enjoy on a daily basis. ![IMG20260423160727-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/Eq38aujJt9mKucHrg5dB9hP11sQtGaW3betFvSRmu8Mzh3MBiRWBT8erKcPUnYfvtLc.jpeg) Hay diferentes variaciones de este arroz y diferentes técnicas para prepararlos. Hoy te comparto una, que es la manera en que yo lo suelo preparar en casa y que aprendí en parte gracias a los consejos de un amigo chino que trabajó bastante tiempo en un restaurante. Esta versión no tiene cerdo, ni pollo, ni camarones, que son ingredientes que puedes agregar. Si me lees de otro país, de seguro vas a encontrar versiones que se parecen mucho a este arroz y que no hace falta llamarlo arroz chino venezolano, pero lo cierto es que he tenido la oportunidad de probar diferentes arroces chinos de otros lados y sí que es diferente y quizás es por eso que los propios creadores de este arroz definen que es venezolano. > There are different variations of this rice dish and different ways to prepare it. Today I’m sharing one with you—the way I usually make it at home—which I learned in part thanks to tips from a Chinese friend who worked in a restaurant for quite some time. This version doesn’t include pork, chicken, or shrimp, though you can add those ingredients if you like. If you’re reading this from another country, you’ll surely find versions that are very similar to this rice, and there’s no need to call it Venezuelan Chinese rice. But the truth is, I’ve had the chance to try different Chinese rice dishes from other places, and this one really is different—and perhaps that’s why the creators of this dish themselves define it as Venezuelan. ![IMG20260423160714-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EouA8dXY9Hu4qR6JY4Ym8P4LZTsWtp4ePW2AHz3z8LvnPamCwJEMbf6t2bGSPrijYme.jpeg) Un punto importante a mencionar es el arroz blanco. Me gusta utilizar un arroz premium o perlado, que no tenga % de granos partidos. Esto me permite tener un arroz más suelto. El arroz se prepara con tiempo y se debe enfriar en la nevera unas 6-8 horas. Esto es fundamental, ya que, gracias a los procesos químicos que ocurren, ayudará a tener un arroz con mejor textura. El arroz se debe lavar muchas veces para quitarle todo el almidón y cocinar con poca agua y sin sal. Una vez que el agua se evapore, se tapa el arroz y se apaga el fuego para que se termine de coser con el calor que tiene. Ten presente eso a la hora de preparar tu arroz base. > One important point to mention is white rice. I like to use premium or pearl rice that contains no broken grains. This gives me a fluffier texture. The rice should be prepared in advance and chilled in the refrigerator for about 6–8 hours. This is essential because the chemical processes that occur during this time help the rice develop a better texture. The rice should be rinsed several times to remove all the starch and cooked with just a little water and no salt. Once the water has evaporated, cover the rice and turn off the heat so it finishes cooking with the residual heat. Keep that in mind when preparing your base rice. ![IMG20260423160853-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EoiWCAJaVWQLGX4pEepA5C9TPwSHRsrmDxVbkZqoeps2kVHugqeskSQGwUf3UtiPYKZ.jpeg) Si quieres aprender a preparar esta versión del arroz chino venezolano, estos son los ingredientes que yo utilicé: > If you want to learn how to make this version of Venezuelan Chinese rice, here are the ingredients I used: ![1742532234709488918213132318348.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/242P1r2RrVCQuCaZmknu2vMctReqJiMZvNEAdMGKxUFUynUnstLojSC8Qug5S4CRpp5Tu.png)

Ingredientes || Ingredients

- 1/2kg de arroz blanco cocido refrigerado - 200gr de tocineta - 3 dientes de ajo - 1/4 de cucharadita de jenjibre en polvo - 4 ramas de cebollín - 1 zanahoria mediana - 3 huevos - 6 cucharadas de aceite de sésamo - 4-5 cucharadas de salsa de soya clara - 1-2 cucharadas de salsa de soya oscura - 2 cuchradas de ajinomoto - 1 cucharada de azúcar - Sal y pimienta negra al gusto - 1/2 kg of cooked white rice, chilled - 200 g of bacon - 3 cloves of garlic - 1/4 teaspoon of ground ginger - 4 scallions - 1 medium carrot - 3 eggs - 6 tablespoons sesame oil - 4–5 tablespoons light soy sauce - 1–2 tablespoons dark soy sauce - 2 tablespoons ajinomoto - 1 tablespoon sugar - Salt and black pepper to taste
![1742532234709488918213132318348.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/242P1r2RrVCQuCaZmknu2vMctReqJiMZvNEAdMGKxUFUynUnstLojSC8Qug5S4CRpp5Tu.png) ![1742532234709488918213132318348.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/242P1r2RrVCQuCaZmknu2vMctReqJiMZvNEAdMGKxUFUynUnstLojSC8Qug5S4CRpp5Tu.png)

Preparación || Preparation

- En una paila, preferiblemente un wok, colocar el aceite de sésamo y agregar la tocineta picadita. Comenzar a saltear la tocineta un par de minutos y agregar el ajo picadito. Saltear 1 minuto más y agregar la parte blanca del cebollín cortada en ruedas. Saltear menos de 1 minuto. > - In a pan, preferably a wok, heat the sesame oil and add the chopped bacon. Sauté the bacon for a couple of minutes, then add the minced garlic. Sauté for another minute, then add the white part of the scallion, sliced into rings. Sauté for less than a minute. ![20260427_122318.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23vsLd4Ds2WdBYC5Z5Yvj51pwhn6tN48utGZD7xvcawtPvAtQfsi3t1Vk7Wy8QG8Wg7yd.jpg) - Seguido de eso, agregar el arroz. Me gusta soltar un poco el arroz antes de agregarlo, para facilitar el proceso de mezclado. Agregar las salsas de soya. El color va a depender de la cantidad de salsa de soya oscura y de sabor de la salsa de soya clara. Puedes agregar más o menos cantidad; eso depende de tus gustos. > - Next, add the rice. I like to fluff the rice a little before adding it, to make it easier to mix. Add the soy sauces. The color will depend on the amount of dark soy sauce and the flavor of the light soy sauce. You can add more or less; it depends on your taste. ![20260427_122418.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23wCDgoPD7G6Bvr8rCsYeAu4eqtJcKYQH7kABxFka7tAbhJg8XkoP5sKwprsVeYLaqpNg.jpg) - Agregar el ajinomoto, el azúcar, la zanahoria rayada y la parte verde del cebollín. Mezclar todo, sin haber apagado el fuego, para evitar exceso de humedad. Una vez que todo esté mezclado, se agrega el huevo que previamente se cocinó como una tortilla básica con su sal moderada. Se integra todo muy bien, se ajusta sal y pimienta, teniendo presente que las salsas de soya son saladas. Una vez todo integrado, me gusta remover todo un par de minutos y apagar. > - Add the MSG, sugar, grated carrot, and the green part of the scallions. Mix everything together without turning off the heat to prevent excess moisture. Once everything is mixed, add the egg that was previously cooked as a basic omelet with a moderate amount of salt. Mix everything together thoroughly, then season with salt and pepper, keeping in mind that soy sauces are salty. Once everything is combined, I like to stir for a couple of minutes and then turn off the heat. ![20260427_122531.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23uQtagXRCYJiMRn28x1zZW8zRcygSgQp696MNnYEKeE4gFVV4WUksaiGzzFBzsxr8Rsg.jpg) Ya el arroz está listo. Si se hace en un wok, el proceso es muy rápido por la forma en que se concentra el calor. Este arroz suele ser más frito, pero me gusta cómo queda con esta cantidad de aceite, que a veces suelo colocarle menos, aunque se pegue un poco en el fondo. A este arroz se le suele colocar cerdo char siu, pollo, jamón o camarones, pero la base suele ser así con tocineta y se le agregan una o todas las proteínas mencionadas. Yo suelo prepararlo así, muy clásico, para que sea el acompañante de vegetales y/o proteínas. > The rice is ready. If you cook it in a wok, the process is very quick because of how the heat is concentrated. This rice is usually fried more thoroughly, but I like how it turns out with this amount of oil—I sometimes use less, even if it sticks a little to the bottom. This rice is usually served with char siu pork, chicken, ham, or shrimp, but the base is typically made this way with bacon, and one or all of the mentioned proteins are added. I usually prepare it this way, very classically, to serve as a side dish with vegetables and/or proteins. ![IMG20260423160703-01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/EopvqbqYWReeXNSGja6Gd1wf6d3ktEakNUWrTKJk8CMwRL58D95ZawaCHEwdHvJBq8X.jpeg) Déjame saber en los comentarios qué tan fan eres del arroz chino en general. ¡Hasta una próxima receta! > Let me know in the comments how much of a fan you are of Chinese rice in general. See you in the next recipe! --- ---
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josecarrerag/23w2oCU1jrMQb87xKWpLidyqDisfwQEZG5j58s8WspTg4md9pgUiYR7uBSLzFaqhMa5c1.png
Todas las fotografías fueron tomadas por mí con un Realme 7 pro. No autorizo a nadie reutilizarlas. Esta publicación fue escrita en español y luego traducida al inglés. > All photographs were taken by me with a Realme 7 pro. I do not authorize anyone to reuse them. This publication was written in Spanish and then translated into English.

body.title: Belcekız Beach - Belcekız Plajı ( EN-TR)
body.body:
](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeejHiwLSPXxw5YJwajP1xwDRq6Jx6udn2zbFCJpBBfbQ/IMG20260323184334.jpg)

You probably noticed it at first glance, didn't you? I couldn't ignore the turquoise color of the clear sea, the waves gently lapping against the shore, and the mixture of pebbles and sand that gives the beach its natural texture. One of the biggest factors contributing to this beautiful natural view is that the beach consists of pebbles instead of sand. The mountains in the background seem to be an integral part of this beauty. The way the sun's rays hit the mountains reveals all the beauty of nature. And those shy clouds trying to hide behind the mountains also highlight the beauty of the scenery. The name of the beach that brings all these beauties together is Belcekız Beach.

>İlk bakışta sizde hemen fark ettiniz değil mi? Berrak denizin turkuaz rengiyle kıyıya nazikçe vuran dalgalarını ve sahile doğal bir yapı kazandıran çakıl ve kumun karışımını görmezden gelemezdim. Bu güzel doğal görünümü sağlayan en büyük etkenlerden biri de sahilin kum yerine çakıldan oluşmasıdır. Arka plandaki dağlar ise bu güzelliğin birer parçası olmuş gibi duruyorlar. Güneş ışınlarının dağlara vurma şekli, doğanın tüm güzelliğini bize gösteriyor. Birde dağların arkasında kendini saklama çalışan o çekingen bulutlar manzaranın güzelliğini ortaya çıkarıyor. Tüm bu güzellikleri bir arada toplayan plajın adı Belcekız Plajıdır.

[//]:# (!worldmappin 36.54463 lat 29.12409 long  d3scr)

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbHYgCH4H8gvUnghtGFBhdcnJ7fgzJQnnWs7WNJQ3ww8P/IMG20260323184413.jpg)

This beautiful and charming beach is located in the Ölüdeniz resort town of Fethiye district in Muğla province, Türkiye. Ranked among Türkiye's most beautiful beaches, it is surrounded by several shallow areas partially separated from the sea by thin strips of land, a phenomenon also known worldwide. To get there, we set off from Antalya city center one weekend. The journey from Antalya to Ölüdeniz takes approximately 3 to 3.5 hours. There are two different routes from Antalya to Ölüdeniz. One is the completely coastal route from Antalya to Kumluca, Kaş, and Fethiye, and the other is the Antalya-Korkuteli-Elmalı and Fethiye route. I chose the shorter Antalya-Korkuteli route.

>Bu güzel ve şirin plaj, Türkiye'nin Muğla iline bağlı, Fethiye ilçesindeki Ölüdeniz tatil kasabasında yer alıyor. Türkiye'nin bilinen en güzel plajları arasında yer alan plajın hemen yanında dünyada da ün yapmış ince kara parçalarıyla denizden kısmen ayrılmış olan bir kaç sığ su alanları vardır. Buraya gelmek için, bir hafta sonu Antalya merkezden yola çıktık. Antalya'dan Ölüdeniz yaklaşık 3 veya 3,5 saat sürüyor. Antalya'dan Ölüdeniz'e iki farklı rota var. Biri tamamen sahil kenarından oluşan Antalya- Kumluca Kaş ve Fethiye güzergahı, diğeri ise, Antalya Korkuteli- Elmalı ve Fethiye yol güzergahı. Ben kısa olan Antalya Korkuteli yol güzergahını seçtik.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUQ6B6gX8iyBjqGuugziGW3Eafccgsb4CKSdryp4a9Uyz/IMG20260323161017.jpg)

It was early morning when we arrived at the beach. We had specifically timed it for this time because we wanted to see the sun rising behind the mountains and the resulting view. We would wait until evening to watch the sunset. The sea was so calm that there were only a few other people there who had come to enjoy its tranquility. The pebbles on the beach gleamed in the sunlight. As soon as we stepped onto the shore, we were greeted by the sound of the pebbles crunching. We also felt the gentle, refreshing breeze trying to blow.

>Plaja vardığımızda sabahın erken saatleriydi. Özellikle bu zamana denk getirmiştik. Çünkü güneşin dağların arasından yükselişini ve oluşan manzarayı görmek istedik. Aynı şekilde batışı için akşam saatlerini bekleyecektik. Deniz öyle sakin ki, bizim gibi bu sakin denizi görmeye gelen birkaç kişi daha vardı. Sahildeki çakıl taşları güneşin ışınlarıyla parlıyordu. Sahile ilk adımımızı attığımızda çakıl taşlarının sesiyle karşılaştık. Birde hafif hafif esmeye çalışan o serinleten rüzgarın hışmını hissettik.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb4oGpK3Sbwg1MiiNf8qUuVxNtbK31sLbgk7FGCLqckN6/IMG20260323184314.jpg)

Along the approximately 1 km stretch of beach, there were businesses that hadn't yet opened for the season. Some were even preparing, arranging sun loungers and umbrellas. Shower areas, shower cabins, and toilets and sinks were available along the beach. Behind the beach, souvenir shops, fish restaurants, and guesthouses, while not fully operational, were in a state of readiness for the season. There's a large open grassy area behind the beach where nature lovers gather. They prepare for paragliding. Paragliders take off from the Ölüdeniz hill and land here, supporting each other. While we were walking around, we also saw people packing up their parachutes and practicing. This beach is also one of the few beaches in Turkey to have received the Blue Flag award. This achievement is proudly displayed on a sign in a section of the beach.

>Yaklaşık 1 km bulan sahilin kenarlarında henüz sezonu açmamış işletmeler vardı. Hatta bazı işletmeler hazırlık yaparak şezlong ve şemsiyelerini düzenlemeye çalışıyorlardı. Sahil boyunca duş için alanlar duşa kabinler ve ihtiyaçlar için WC ve lavabolar mevcuttu. Sahilin gerisinde hediyelik eşya satan dükkanlar, balık restoranları ve pansiyonlar tam anlamıyla faaliyette olmasalar da sezon hazırlığı için bekleme konumunda yer alıyorlardı. Sahilin gerisinde çimenlik bir alanda geniş bir boşluk var. Burada doğasever bir araya gelerek toplanıyor. Burada yamaç paraşütü için hazırlık yapıyorlar. Ölüdeniz tepesinden yamaç paraşütüyle havalanan doğaseverler buraya iniş yaparak birbirlerine destek oluyorlar. Biz etrafı gezerken paraşütünü toplayan ve antrenman yapan kişilerde vardı. Bu plaj aynı zamanda Mavi Bayrak ödülünü almış sayılı plajlarımız arasındadır. Bu gururu plajın bir bölümünde tanıtım panosunda göstermişler.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmefZH2ifeLE1xxHX8uctvF3Nt9Ur43S5ZT3RakWCp7ZdA/IMG20260323184413-EFFECTS.jpg)

The beach is called Belcekız Beach. I learned about the story behind this name from a sailor working on his boat on the shore. According to him, there was a very beautiful girl living in this area. Her name was Belce, or as some called her, Belcekız. A fisherman living in the same coastal village fell in love with her. This fisherman often went out to sea and would meet Belcekız upon his return. One time, a great storm broke out. Instead of seeking refuge on the safe island of Ölüdeniz, the fisherman wanted to approach the shore where Belcekız lived, just to see his beloved. Because the storm was so strong, the fisherman's boat capsized. The young fisherman lost his life in the overturned boat. Upon hearing this news, Belcekız, unable to bear her grief, threw herself into the sea from the edge of the cliff. Based on this sad love story, they named this beach Belcekız Beach. I would like to add a love story to this sad tale.

>Plajın adı Belcekız Plajı olarak geçiyor. Bu ismin bir hikayesi olduğunu sahilde teknesiyle uğraşan bir gemiciden öğreniyorum. Anlattığına göre, bu bölgede yaşayan çok güzel bir kız varmış. Bu kızın adı da Belce ya da bazı kişilerde Belcekız dermiş. Aynı sahil köyünde yaşayan bir balıkçı bu kıza aşık olmuş. Bu balıkçı sık sık denize açılıp, dönüşte de Belcekız ile buluşurmuş. Bir balıkçı denize açıldığında büyük bir fırtına çıkmış. Balıkçının güvenli olan Ölüdeniz adasına sığınması gerekirken, aşkını görebilmek uğruna Belcekızın bulunduğu kıyıya yanaşmak istemiş. Fırtına çok kuvvetli olduğunu için kıyıya yanaşmak isteyen balıkçının teknesi devrilmiş. Genç balıkçı devrilen teknede hayatını kaybetmiş. Bu haberi duyan Belcekız acısına dayanamayarak kendini uçurumun kenarından denize atmış. Bu hüzünlü aşk hikayesinden yola çıkarak bu plaja Belcekız plajı adını vermişler. Bu hüzünlü hikayeye aşk dolu bir sahne eklemek isterim.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAS2faG9sLn5SRPvEWJ9Mz7zUDYsMAdoPowxJsUvwKSx/IMG20260323172133.jpg)

The fact that the season hasn't officially started yet makes this place even more beautiful. As we walked along the shore, we savored the moment and the tranquility, listening to the sound of the waves and the strong wind that was whipping our hair. When we looked up, we saw paragliders suddenly emerging from the clouds. They were all heading towards the grassy area of ​​the beach. The mountains surrounding the beach, and Ölüdeniz and Belcekız beaches opposite, seemed to have taken refuge. The turquoise color of the sea was reflected in the surrounding beauty. The bright face of the sun, the extension of the mountains, the vibrant and shiny appearance of the pebbles—they all seemed to influence each other. It was as if the seeds of beauty of Belcekız Beach had been scattered all around.

>Sezonun daha açılmamış olması burayı daha güzel hala getirmiş. Kıyıdan yürürken bir yandan dalga sesleri, bir yandan da saçlarımızı savurmaya çalışan o şiddetli rüzgarla anın tadını ve sessizliğini yaşıyorduk. Kafamızı yukarıya kaldırdığımızda bulutların arasından bira anda çıkan paraşütçüleri görüyoruz. Hepsi rotalarını sahilin çimenlik alana doğru sürüyorlar. Sahilin etrafını saran dağlar ve karşısındaki Ölüdeniz'le Belcekız plajı kendini koruma altına almış görünüyor. Denizin o turkuaz rengi etrafındaki güzelliklere de yansımış. Güneşin parlak yüzü, dağların uzantısı , çakıl taşlarının canlı ve parlak görünüşü hepsi birbirinden etkilenmiş görünüyor. Belcekız Plajının güzellik tohumları adeta etrafa serpilmiş.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUrwPCq9skFZqpYjHn87x1mbVR9LcKc32fWNwgy1eYhM4/IMG20260323160242.jpg)

It was getting dark when we left Belcekız Beach. We wanted to take one last look at the beach from Ölüdeniz hill before nightfall, because we rarely forget places like this that have a story behind them. I wish you all a wonderful week.

>Belcekız Plajından ayrıldığımızda hava kararmak üzereydi. Biz de karanlık olmadan Ölüdeniz tepesinden son kez plaja bakmak istedik. Çünkü buna benzer ve hikayesi olan noktaları kolay kolay unutamıyoruz. Hepinize güzel bir hafta diliyorum.

body.title: Rainbow at the Intersection
body.body:
When I was waiting on a red light at an intersection in Linz I took this picture of a rainbow that was visible that day. I am always amazed how beautiful such a rainbow can be. So many different colors just from different wavelenghts of the light. 
But the order of the colors that are visible is always the same. 

Composition of sunlight: White sunlight contains all the colors of the visible spectrum.
Physical laws: When light enters a water droplet, it is refracted, reflected, and refracted again upon exiting.  Different wavelengths: Different colors have different wavelengths. Red light is refracted less than blue or violet light.

Constant angles of refraction: Because light is refracted in every water droplet according to the same physical laws, the resulting order is always the same: red on the outside (long wavelength) and violet on the inside (short wavelength).



![IMG_20251024_173730.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/florian-glechner/EpCAohMLC2z1A8PTGCfoxWUoXMKWPNZXC8g8DWis6PjaP7B8bZ3RBJA3SJGZQJdWEKa.jpg)

body.title: Milk cartón design [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
> Comenzando la semana con un poco de creatividad, como bien ya les he comentado y compartido, ando aprendiendo a crear estas plantillas, la verdad, se ven fáciles de hacer, pero toma tiempo, cuadrar las medidas, y encontrar las imágenes para el diseño.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T133506.534.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vsUmTUz5sZ5xzFSsQNmcGv8VvgnRVo6CEbhFBUQetDgDqmGGnK5wbazZDv6YDB6LziD.png)
--- Como dicen por allí, todo trabajo requiere tiempo, y esto sin duda es un trabajo de arte y diseño, entonces por supuesto, debe tener su valor, yo estoy en fase de aprendizaje, y me gusta mucho, ojala tuviera mi impresora, podría imprimirlas y vender mis cajas, pero bueno, todo a su tiempo.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T142304.569.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xAg2j51Xdpx7yJWk3f8KfHjajDotYrmAUEaHrQYTAW15UBvxDwXsxtQo3ECz3wLLsUc.png)
Se que aun falta para el día del niño, igual hay que irse preparando, es por ello que en esta oportunidad, les traigo un nuevo modelo de caja, estilo milk, en forma de leche, una caja dulcera, decidí hacerlo con el diseño de **MARIO BROSS**. Para crear mi plantilla, use **CANVA free** ,en un formato de tamaño **21 x 29.77**, aquí iniciamos, diseñando el molde de lo que será nuestra plantilla para la caja en forma de leche.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T143306.847.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tmjWF2geG2N8zzsbU4fzQaZQJtupGKH4EA2VtjXhSC1uEESa3QQqJEPuTyB1cekLhmS.png)
Para este tipo de diseño se trabaja mucho con los marcos, sobre todo el de forma rectangular, al cual se le modifica las medidas, en esta ocasión, tenemos de varios tamaños, grande, mediano y pequeño. Una vez hecho esto, vamos añadirle lo que será las pestañas, que permitirá el ajuste para doblar y pegar nuestra caja.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T143910.589.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xAqBZGXB4gAEgQMnfEwnUY24Ls1NFddHjpYVXkPjfo7cZNRfoKzGkF2Zq5WG8kaPsRY.png)
Ya con nuestro molde listo, ahora solo queda crear el diseño, en mi opinión, siento que esta es la parte mas trabajada, al momento de diseñar y crear estas cajas, debemos buscar modelos de imágenes, fondo de textura de buena calidad, claro todo esto dependerá también, del personaje, al cual queremos basarnos para dicho diseño. Como mencione, yo decidí hacerlo de **MARIO BROss**, ya que no he hecho así para niños, siempre elijo diseño para las niñas jeje.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T145425.014.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vsd5ViRs6NzQ2EY7H7QEVWYxAJ2JpmdK1XBfkHeett8iSQFwb4aW63EjaiqMkbzBw41.png)
Y como les mencione, no tengo para imprimir, le pedí a **GEMINIS IA**, que me recreara la imagen, y miren como queda.😍
![post hive - 2026-04-27T150010.625.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/241tfnhxFqUGggX6PCQQ49Xuo7T9BDmdsFAavXK1VnjLmW5MYfougQS8FQvEvpthYifdW.png)
Esto es lo bueno de las nuevas tecnologías, trabajando con la Inteligencia Artificial, podemos recrear nuestras imágenes, y así tener una idea de como quedaría nuestro diseño.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T150200.363.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23uQkGhMmSsnw26KoNCKXokm2NbYG1oZ2xL2bkxhtxfzQkZ47eLRUmrc9CBsazGFyaYZY.png)
Que les parece, verdad que quedan muy bonitas, espero les guste, y si desean la plantilla, editable en CANVA, no duden en escribirme, pueden donarme la cantidad que quieran. 😉 ---
ENGLISH VERSION

Starting the week with a little creativity—as I’ve already mentioned and shared with you—I’m learning how to create these templates. To be honest, they look easy to make, but it takes time to get the measurements right and find the right images for the design.

![post hive - 2026-04-27T133506.534.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23vsUmTUz5sZ5xzFSsQNmcGv8VvgnRVo6CEbhFBUQetDgDqmGGnK5wbazZDv6YDB6LziD.png)
--- As they say, all work takes time, and this is undoubtedly a work of art and design, so of course, it must have its value. I’m still learning, and I really like it. I wish I had my own printer; I could print them and sell my boxes, but well, everything in its own time.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T142304.569.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xAg2j51Xdpx7yJWk3f8KfHjajDotYrmAUEaHrQYTAW15UBvxDwXsxtQo3ECz3wLLsUc.png)
I know Children’s Day is still a ways off, but we should start getting ready anyway. That’s why, this time, I’m bringing you a new milk-shaped candy box template. I decided to design it with a **MARIO BROSS** theme. To create my template, I used **CANVA free** in a **21 x 29.77** format. Here we go, designing the template for our milk-shaped box.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T143306.847.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23tmjWF2geG2N8zzsbU4fzQaZQJtupGKH4EA2VtjXhSC1uEESa3QQqJEPuTyB1cekLhmS.png)
For this type of design, we work extensively with frames, particularly rectangular ones, whose dimensions are modified. In this case, we have several sizes: large, medium, and small. Once this is done, we’ll add the tabs, which will allow us to fold and glue our box together.
![post hive - 2026-04-27T143910.589.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ikigaidesign/23xAqBZGXB4gAEgQMnfEwnUY24Ls1NFddHjpYVXkPjfo7cZNRfoKzGkF2Zq5WG8kaPsRY.png)
Now that our mold is ready, all that’s left is to create the design. In my opinion, I feel this is the most labor-intensive part. When designing and creating these boxes, we need to look for image templates and high-quality textured backgrounds—though, of course, all of this will also depend on the character we want to base the design on. > <u>Mandatory Professional Training:</u> Unlike some countries, you cannot practice with parents. You must pay a professional driving school (Fahrschule) for all training, which includes mandatory special lessons (Sonderfahrten).
<u>High Mandatory Hour Requirements: </u>Learners must complete specific, mandatory, and expensive training hours, including highway (Autobahn), country road, and night driving, along with a high number of standard training hours.
<u>Strict Exams & High Failure Rates:</u> The practical and theoretical tests are rigorous. Failing the practical test often costs over €300+ to retake, as you must pay for both the test and your instructor's time again.
<u>Operating Costs and Inflation:</u> Rising costs for fuel, insurance, maintenance of driving school cars, and an shortage of driving instructors increase overall fees.
<u>No Shortcuts:</u> The system is highly regulated with no legal way to bypass commercial lessons, ensuring high safety standards but removing low-cost alternatives.

It could be even higher if you fail your tests!!

Getting a driver's license in Germany is expensive (often €2,500–€5,000+)

PS: In Texas, there is no cost in failing a test. You can fail as many times as you want. Other than your time, there is no cost.

description.title: Book Review: Rich Dad, Poor Dad by Robert Kiyosaki
description.body:
![116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/Ep1V4WbQBwMS8v8Eim2EvaQp6RMj8J2PFqdfW3x9qXHif8dKfVp6pEtEb8LkcSMsRDk.jpg)
Hello everyone, Welcome to another book review from me based on a quote from a book. Today's writing will be from the book Rich Dad, Poor Dad by Robert Kiyosaki, and the quote says: *“It’s not how much money you make. It’s how much money you keep, and how hard it works for you.”* To me, this book is one of the oldest I have ever read, and I remember reading it again during the pandemic. The concept of money and what is yours triggered my memory to remember this quote. Although I did not get it all clearly, word for word, I checked it out once again. The quote is simple to understand. Unlike the previous quote I spoke about in my last book review on Carol Dweck's book Mindset, where you had to read the book to get a better understanding of it. In the quote above from Robert Kiyosaki, it simply says that the money you make is not how much you have, but what you keep or what works for you is your money. This means Robert Kiyosaki is talking about saving and investment. Savings are what you keep, and investments are what work for you. It is very easy to complicate what you are working for as the amount you have. But here is the thing: there are bills, expenses, upkeeps, and more that have to be factored in. Once these things are paid for, you come to realize that what you have as yours is not as much as you thought. It also reminds me of the lesson from The Richest Man in Babylon, one of the oldest classics when it comes to finance. In the book, George Clason also spoke about keeping a portion of your money so that it is yours to keep. Basically, talking about saving something as well. Now, Robert Kiyosaki says the same thing as well, but then he goes the extra mile by suggesting that you should have something that works for you as well. Money working for you comes through the process of investment because of what is considered to be the 7th wonder of the world, and that is compound interest. It is easy to get carried away by a nice salary figure in this economy, but what one fails to remember is that inflation has a strong grip on the economy, which means the price of goods and services is increasing over time. Currently, you cannot compare the cost of buying a house now to the time of the early 1980s. There is a big difference. It was less expensive back then, and money had more value compared to now. Inflation has grown muscles over time, which is making the payment for jobs small; people have to look for other sources or side hustles. In this current economy, there are many people working more than one job just to meetup with end's means. This speaks a lot to the fact that time has changed, and it is still changing. I remember a conversation I had with an elderly person who was talking to me about grabbing property as early as possible, and that his house is a major investment he made back then when he was earning #150,000 monthly. Currently, that house serves as his source of income, and I was amazed that back then one was able to build a house on a #150,000 salary, which is not up to a $120 in today's economy. Time flies, and we have to pay attention to what we keep, for that is what is ours.
___ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

I am @samostically, a chess player and writer. I love to share the experience I have gained from different battles over the 64 squares and the knowledgeable insights from books I have read. But most importantly, [I am a Midnight Owl and I founded the community Midnight Letters.](https://peakd.com/c/hive-186424/about) ♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟♟ ![samosti 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/samostically/23t7DhyLBcxoXuUmgwLnZvioQ3v5QnMB9qFkMvfhpceXCucVBy9yV435N3hgNLQdeLYpm.png)

description.title: I Chose Peace And Dialogue Over War
description.body:
Emergencies - Are you prepared for a global collapse or World War III? Does your country have a protocol or plan in case of a World War III or a global collapse? Do you have an emergency kit, a bunker, canned food, water, batteries, etc.? Do you think we will experience a World War III or any other type of global collapse?
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWV4hzupTGbRuYWZ7dWDBx5qxQ8c6yGbQrcB6T69TpAq4/image.png) [ThePixelman](https://pixabay.com/images/download/thepixelman-war-469503_1920.jpg) Hello #qccommunity, happy new week. I welcome you all to my blog for this interesting prompt. Emergencies are defined as sudden incidents that require urgent attention to prevent escalation or to contain the issue to prevent loss or further damage. This emergency can come in the form of a man-made or natural disaster. Nobody likes emergencies; however, we do have some safety gadgets around that are made to contain such situations when they occur. For example, we have fire extinguishers and anti-flame liquids to quench fire at the lowest level. There are also fire vehicles that fight large-scale outbreaks. On the prompt for this week, asking “if I am prepared for a global collapse or World War III”. Honestly, I am not prepared for such a situation because I think the superpowers would not want such escalation. In such situations, there will be loss of life, both human and animal, and massive destruction of property. There would be a serious famine and scarcity. Inflation will triple. How much food would one need to stock in such a situation? I also do not have the kind of resources and permission to acquire war weapons for personal use. However, if such a situation arose, my country is capable of containing it. They have played big brother and giant of Africa to neighbouring countries during such escalations. In my country of origin, the military always celebrates its day on January 15. There they show the strength of their weapons and what their knowledge, skills, tactics, and wits. Though I know that they do not always display everything. Furthermore, I have my Personal protective equipment (PPE) and some home safety tools that I use at home and at the office. Finally, with tensions rising around the world. I do pray for world peace and love. I also pray for the leaders to be filled with brilliant ideas that will reduce rancour and hate in society and devise better ways to dialogue rather than threats and rumours of war. title.title: Intel 24% Comeback
title.body:
Eighteen months ago, Intel had lost 60% of its value in a single year. Its CEO, Pat Gelsinger, had been pushed out. Everyone was talking about a company that had “missed the AI train.” Everyone had written it off.

And on Friday? Intel’s stock surged 24% in a single day. Its best day since October 1987. Yes, you read that correctly. Since 1987.

And it did not rise alone. It pulled AMD, Nvidia, Qualcomm, and ARM along with it. The entire chip sector caught fire. Nvidia closed at a record high and once again surpassed a market capitalization of $5 trillion.


## The rally no one expected

Intel announced its first-quarter results and absolutely crushed expectations. Revenue rose 7.2% to $13.58 billion, up from $12.67 billion a year earlier. And pay attention to this: over the previous seven quarters, Intel had posted five year-over-year revenue declines.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUxTdkfkLw4or1xLJLFqawv7WPvxDzchhKo3Vb4jxM8qc/image.png)


Then suddenly, its data center business jumped 22% year over year to $5.1 billion. Guidance for the second quarter also came in above analysts’ expectations.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRruzsiX2yFPv4UfEYWLM2qp4S7FVgeA9R8XECfKrSJhN/image.png)


The stock closed at $82.57. To understand how big this is, Intel is now up 124% year to date, after gaining 84% throughout all of 2025.

Wall Street analysts rushed to upgrade the stock. Evercore ISI, Citi, and Roth Capital all raised their ratings to Buy. “The new CEO fixed the balance sheet and put Intel back on a competitive path,” Evercore analysts wrote.

The new CEO, Lip-Bu Tan, took over in early 2025. And within just a few months, he managed to secure a $5 billion investment from Nvidia, close a deal with Google for Xeon chips in its data centers, enter Elon Musk’s Terafab project, and convince Tesla to use 14A technology. All of this came on top of the $8.9 billion stake the U.S. government took in the company.

## The whole sector caught fire

And this is where things get even more interesting.

It was not just Intel that rose. AMD jumped 12% to 14% without any news of its own. No earnings, no announcements, nothing. It simply rose because Intel showed that CPU demand is real.

“We understood that CPUs were the next major bottleneck, but Intel’s results show that this is already translating into massive upside,” wrote an analyst at D.A. Davidson. The firm upgraded AMD to Buy and raised its price target to $375.

Nvidia, on the other hand, closed at a record high for the first time since October. It ended the day at $208.27, up 4.3%. Its market capitalization once again exceeded $5 trillion. Since the end of 2022, Nvidia’s stock has risen almost fourteenfold. Fourteen times higher.

And as if that were not enough, Qualcomm rose 11% and ARM gained 10%.

So what does this mean? It means the entire semiconductor sector caught fire within a few hours because of a single earnings report. But it also seems that the semiconductor rally had started earlier. Just look at the iShares MSCI Global Semiconductors ETF, which has risen nearly 29% in just one month.

## The new AI bottleneck

And now comes the most important part. Why did all of this happen?

Until now, when people talked about AI, they talked about GPUs. Nvidia, Nvidia, Nvidia. Everyone was focused on graphics cards. CPUs had been pushed to the sidelines, almost treated like old technology.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQczF3qDWoPbD621CEW14eikpfasT5zb5Bzjn7CPFRWP6/image.png)


But something is changing. With the arrival of AI agents, meaning AI systems that can perform tasks on their own, the so-called agentic workloads, CPUs are coming back into focus. And they are doing so with such force that analysts are now talking about a CPU shortage.

“CPUs are once again emerging as the essential foundation of the AI era,” Intel’s CEO said. And the numbers support him.

Intel now expects double-digit server CPU unit growth for 2026. Six months ago, it was talking about minimal growth. Wedbush analysts said something even more striking: demand for compute was “underserved by a number ending in B.” In other words, by billions.

You may now be wondering: how long will this shortage last? Morgan Stanley’s answer is: probably for quite some time. And that benefits all CPU manufacturers: Intel, AMD, ARM, everyone.

In other words, the story is changing. It is no longer “GPUs versus everything else.” It is “GPUs and CPUs together.” And that completely changes the investment landscape for the semiconductor sector.

I think to say that US is facing a loss in Iran would be inaccurate. Even Trump administration is correct that US has a complete air superiority and can hit anything they want in Iran. Iran is contained and blockaded. What US is facing is the limits of air war. No regime has been changed in the history of the world via aerial bombardment. 

In order to change the regime it would require a ground operation like in Iraq. Iran is a larger country with a larger population so it will be a little bit more effort to completely occupy than Iraq was, but make no mistake that is completely in the realm of US capability even without a coalition like was used in Iraq. 

There are a few big downsides to the ground operation and occupying the Iran:
1. Cost
2. Time
3. More casualties on US side

None of the above would play well in the elections this November as it is simply impossible to pull the preparation and execution of a major ground operation in that time period. Also the financial and life costs would play really bad into not only mid terms, but even into 2028 Presidential elections... That is why we don't see a ground operation yet...

View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/manuel78 [![Chains-Off-My-Soul](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/89bf1e4a-cfd9-4748-b6b5-a9e2d6226eb1.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/7P14CwgvXhePxLSnqGBC2r) 
 
 - Choosing Myself

Hey there . Pull up a chair and let us just sit with this for a moment . I want to walk you through a season of life that so many of us know intimately . It is the season where you finally look in the mirror and realize the person staring back has been shrinking for years . You tell me i dont want you i should have never changed . Those words used to echo in my head like a broken record . They were spoken in a tone that sounded like care but felt like control . And well honey remind you its the way you treated me yesterday . That was the quiet truth I kept swallowing . It was never about who I was becoming . It was always about how you needed me to stay small so you could feel big .
I remember the exact morning everything shifted . The sunlight was cutting through the blinds in thin golden lines . The coffee was brewing . The house was quiet . And for the first time in a long time . I was not tiptoeing . I was not bracing for the next criticism . I was just breathing . And in that stillness . I realized im no longer the person that you pushed around . It was not a loud declaration . It was a quiet settling in my bones . Like a heavy coat I had been wearing for years finally slipping off my shoulders . I looked at the keys on the counter . I looked at the half packed bag by the door . And I knew im claiming my freedom my sanity theres no stopping me now . That sentence did not feel reckless . It felt like oxygen .
For so long . I had mistaken endurance for loyalty . I had confused silence with peace . But peace does not ask you to erase yourself . Peace does not demand you shrink your voice to fit into someone else's comfort zone . I was so done im so free your chains cant keep me down . Those chains were never made of iron . They were made of expectations . Of guilt . Of the quiet belief that if I just tried harder . If I just loved louder . If I just bent a little further . Things would finally be okay . But they never were . Because the goalposts kept moving . And I was running on a track that led nowhere .
any longer i will not stay i will not beg . That was the boundary I drew in the quiet of my own mind before I ever spoke it out loud . It was the moment I stopped negotiating for my own worth . I will not be your slave day after day . Not emotionally . Not mentally . Not in the way I dimmed my light to keep you comfortable . today i rise from my fall broke the chains lifted off the ground . And rising did not look like a movie scene . It looked like folding laundry with steady hands . It looked like making a cup of tea and actually tasting it . It looked like texting my sister and saying I am coming over . It looked like choosing myself without apology .
the pieces you broke are mending today . That is what healing actually looks like . It is not a sudden transformation . It is a daily practice . It is waking up and choosing to speak kindly to yourself . It is noticing when the old guilt tries to creep back in and gently setting it down . putting my self first no longer you just me and my family . That was the realignment . My energy was no longer a public utility . It was a private garden . And I was finally the one holding the watering can . pieces returning back into their place . The hobbies I abandoned . The laughter I suppressed . The boundaries I forgot how to draw . They were all slowly clicking back into position . Like a mosaic that had been scattered across the floor . Finally being gathered . Finally being seen .
peace within my heart my resting place . That phrase became my anchor . When the old voices tried to whisper that I was being selfish . I would place a hand over my chest and feel the steady rhythm of my own breath . That was enough . That was everything . I did not need external validation to prove I was worthy of calm . I just needed to stop mistaking chaos for connection . the pieces i lost while i was with you why did you tear them out . I asked myself that question so many times . Not with bitterness . But with honest curiosity . Why had I allowed my edges to be sanded down? Why had I handed over the keys to my own emotional house? The answer was simple . I had loved you once but you failed to see . And that failure was never mine to carry .
glad im no longer with you from this day forward ill love my self . That was the vow I made to the mirror . Not a dramatic oath . Just a quiet promise . take care of me no one like you will ever take hold . Because no one else would ever be allowed to grip my joy that tightly again . I was learning to hold my own hand through the hard days . I was learning to celebrate the small wins . I was learning that self love is not a destination . It is a daily practice of showing up for yourself even when it feels unfamiliar . i loved you once but you failed to see the love that i gave every single day . I gave it freely . I gave it patiently . I gave it even when it was not returned in kind . And that says everything about my capacity to care . And absolutely nothing about my obligation to stay .
you treated me like nothing tore my heart away . That was the hardest truth to sit with . Not because it was complicated . But because it was so simple . When someone shows you who they are through consistent actions . You do not need to decipher hidden meanings . You just need to believe them . so today i chose me every single day . Not as a punishment to you . But as a promise to myself . good bye to my past good riddence to you . Those words were not spoken in anger . They were spoken in release . Like exhaling a breath I had been holding for years . The past does not get to dictate my future . Not anymore .
i hope you learn but we know you wont . That was the quiet acceptance that freed me the most . I stopped waiting for an apology that would never come . I stopped rehearsing conversations that would never happen . dont try to beg dont cry at my feet . Because the dynamic had already shifted . I was no longer standing in the shadows waiting for scraps of attention . I was standing in my own light . your hollow words cannot reach me . Not because I had built walls . But because I had built boundaries . And boundaries are not about keeping people out . They are about keeping yourself safe .
i gave you the chances but you failed to change . That was the final ledger entry . The accounting was complete . There were no more extensions . No more second chances disguised as patience . so i took my heart put it back in place . I literally imagined it . I imagined gathering all the scattered fragments . The trust . The hope . The quiet dreams I had tucked away . And I placed them gently back into my chest . They fit differently now . Not because they were broken . But because they were mine again . your no longer my one you failed to be my only . That realization did not feel like loss . It felt like clarity . I was no longer waiting for you to become someone you never intended to be . I was finally allowing myself to want what I actually deserved .
so im out of here to a better place . That better place was not a geographic location . It was a state of being . It was mornings without dread . It was evenings without walking on eggshells . It was conversations that did not require translation . It was silence that did not feel heavy . i wish you the best but far away from me . That was not cruelty . That was self preservation . I could genuinely hope you found peace . Growth . Clarity . I just knew it could not happen in my living room . It could not happen in my emotional space . good bye my horrid past may you rest in peace . I meant that sincerely . The past served its purpose . It taught me what I would no longer tolerate . It showed me where my boundaries had been crossed . It prepared me for the life I was finally stepping into .
excuse me now im free to be my self again . Those were the words I whispered as I closed the door behind me . Not with a slam . Not with drama . Just with quiet certainty . The air outside felt different . Lighter . Cooler . Real . I walked down the steps . I felt the pavement under my shoes . I heard the distant sound of traffic . I saw the sky stretching out in every direction . And for the first time in a very long time . I was not thinking about what I needed to fix . I was not thinking about what I needed to say . I was just existing . Fully . Completely . Without apology .
If you are reading this and you are standing in that same quiet moment . Where the old patterns are cracking . Where the weight is finally becoming too heavy to carry . I want you to know something . You are not broken for wanting out . You are not selfish for choosing peace . You are not failing by walking away . You are succeeding at the most important task of all . Preserving yourself . The road ahead will have its own challenges . Healing is not linear . Some days will feel light . Some days will feel heavy . And that is okay . What matters is that you keep choosing yourself . What matters is that you keep returning to your own center . What matters is that you remember your worth is not negotiable . It is not something you earn through endurance . It is something you claim through presence .
So breathe . Step forward . Trust the quiet voice that has been whispering the truth all along . You deserve a life that feels like home . You deserve relationships that feel like shelter . You deserve to wake up and recognize yourself in the mirror . Not as a reflection of someone else's expectations . But as the author of your own story . The chains are already broken . The pieces are already mending . The light is already waiting . You just have to keep walking toward it . One steady step at a time . You have got this . And I am cheering you on . Always . 
 ***

title.title: WALKING BETWEEN COUNTRIES
title.body:
![Kopia – Whispers.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wMqZbWZRUkmPd2tH8HkQWzVaxxrRJfMMEW3tEVJ64h92XmP8JvhZ4yC6jk67A6UE6Qr.jpg)

I recently had the opportunity to visit the German–Danish border. (SCHUSTERKATE) It might not sound like anything extraordinary, but this time it was a crossing worth paying attention to. It is most likely the smallest border crossing in all of Europe. Closed to transit, closed to cars and accessible only to pedestrians. I had found this place earlier on Google Maps and knowing I would have some time during my daily break, I decided to go a bit off my route to see this smallest border with my own eyes.

>Stosunkowo niedawno miałam okazję być na granicy niemiecko-duńskiej (SCHUSTERKATE). Mogłoby się wydawać, że nie jest to nic nadzwyczajnego, jednak tym razem było to przejście godne uwagi. Najprawdopodobniej jest to najmniejsze przejście graniczne w całej Europie. Zamknięte dla tranzytu, zamknięte dla samochodów, dostępne jest tylko i wyłącznie dla pieszych. Wyszukałam wcześniej sobie to miejsce na mapach Google, wiedziałam, że będę miała trochę czasu na swojej dziennej pauzie i zboczyłam trochę ze swojej trasy, aby móc zobaczyć tą najmniejszą granicę na własne oczy.


![20260408_181944.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243M7K5BKM7CsuZZeXbWG2798bWLHscP1LHb1B3ev1PTC8j5cYAgL4y5hPSL2gZfKQQPA.jpg)

![20260408_181934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/244KP4UiNwcVUJ2Pn4xdk8WeHKLF8MYo6DtGWiEPpXee7Mk7n7toV9e34GdLmaTBgRsk2.jpg)

Interestingly, I didn’t find a typical border sign at this crossing anymore, but I suspect that it may have been there until recently, as it was still visible on Google Street View. The only indication that this was a national border was a stone marker with the letter “D” engraved on it, standing for Deutschland, along with the date when this border was established.

>Co ciekawe, nie znalazłam już na tym przejściu typowego znaku granicznego, ale mam przypuszczenia, że jeszcze do niedawna mógł tam stać, gdyż znak ten był widoczny na Google Street View. Jedyny sygnał, który sugerował, że jest tam granica państw, to ten słupek z wyrytą literą D, jak Deutschland, i datą powstania tej granicy.


![20260408_180625.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23x19F3DaboZEprjiMApKMw7xRZgqK1qjizmSSpgjjN6UW3Sg4wh7n59xZNGyKAU2VpTc.jpg)

The border crossing itself, as I mentioned earlier, is very small and is located directly on a wooden bridge. This is what the border looks like from the German side:

>Samo przejście graniczne, jak już wcześniej wspomniałam, jest bardzo malutkie i znajduje się bezpośrednio na drewnianym moście. Tak oto prezentuje się granica od strony niemieckiej:


![20260408_180741.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243M19NC149u5S4SKKnCoiRT7ZmsUS8Bb7gwjHsf6yMUsHKVnWwH7ZzestteU7NCatdgf.jpg)

And this is what it looks like from the Danish side:

>A tak od strony duńskiej:


![20260408_180701.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23wCBrrNzyU3ebbVvu34i8fRhwGhHLwZCrpW6bxvqfkkdgsC7fc8cEnLsjo6WmJ5PYfJC.jpg)

On both sides there are still small border houses, which were most likely once used as control buildings.

>Po obu stronach stoją jeszcze przygraniczne domki, które najprawdopodobniej kiedyś były budynkami kontrolnymi.


![20260408_174139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242rpsQU8SwKUmsJGkQygavdzg7aBTa9cJ8mLnKEb1b4pJeput15LjkR3Zca6M64Xu5Vj.jpg)

We can learn about the history of the Schusterkate border from the information boards located at this crossing. They tell us that the crossing was established after 1922, following the change of the German–Danish border and functioned as a so-called reporting crossing. During World War II the border was closed and strictly guarded by services. After the war the border was gradually reopened and controls became less strict over time. Of course, since 2001, with the introduction of the Schengen Area, there have been no border controls here and today we can simply walk back and forth, almost unnoticed, sometimes not even fully realizing that we have just crossed a national border.

>O historii granicy Szusterkate możemy przeczytać na tablicach informacyjnych, które są zlokalizowane przy tym przejściu granicznym. Możemy się z nich dowiedzieć, iż przejście to powstało po 1922 roku, czyli po zmianie granicy niemiecko-duńskiej i było tak zwanym przejściem zgłoszeniowym. Podczas drugiej wojny światowej granica była zamknięta i pilnie strzeżona przez służby. Po wojnie następowało stopniowe otwieranie granicy i kontrole bywały coraz mniejsze. Oczywiście od 2001 roku, od wprowadzenia strefy Schengen nie ma już tutaj żadnych kontroli granicznych i możemy dzisiaj przechodzić sobie wte i wewte, niepostrzeżenie i nie będąc nawet do końca świadomym, że właśnie przekroczyliśmy granicę.

![20260408_180539.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23uFXzt7ZJq1FvbM5mQ1tr5DY22YqKWNR18K1bvY8jj8J6bzRo7eBB8L95y2dsGwvSTP9.jpg)


![20260408_180522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23tmQFMtByW6fMpdx51CwECBqD8CEeiWYpQoTPj6BL71ntg57vVCxvgGwpXxR6T1SPFUX.jpg)

Of course, it wouldn’t be me if I didn’t pay attention to the landscape surrounding this border. The crossing is located just outside Flensburg and has direct access to the sea. Since I was there in early spring, more precisely at the beginning of April, the scenery still felt quite raw and winter-like.

>Oczywiście nie byłabym sobą, gdybym nie zwróciła uwagi na krajobraz, który rozpościerał się wokół tej granicy. Granica ta bowiem zlokalizowana jest tuż za Flensburgiem i posiada bezpośredni dostęp do morza. Jako że byłam tam na początku wiosny, a dokładniej z początkiem kwietnia, krajobraz był jeszcze bardzo surowy i zimowy.


![20260408_174225.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/243frc97aSm59ZSCodsMQ9KwAddBh6XCsH77D26WyCciVeqgB2Tj8bq6bq26bmroZ3oMP.jpg)

![20260408_174918.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242Y5pnUCYsgkx9s2iToG5goGusvJQMdRywMWhrfZmoVxhECmev4uaUvffbS8xGQhM4CF.jpg)

![20260408_174239.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/242DETEvhb4Eyu35sx8WFpvnk7HjuNakvB4LLVFvbXaRKmVed3JWJdpACEfFDaoonL2Cy.jpg)

However, the first signs of spring were slowly beginning to appear.

>Aczkolwiek powoli pojawiały się również pierwsze oznaki wiosny.

![20260408_175336.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23yd1GqGD2u83ACDgFKRyurK7nSay6N77XxR224V6ixpztQ2UH9x6ibSx9oFQwg6NaLF9.jpg)

![20260408_175528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23vi1t5ii6VXuGhjVXxXvokqTeq8bkYpp4ePUVfcfuoj7Z9XrxE1P8TEjpeFe2WgM1f8Q.jpg)


I also noticed an abandoned boat lying by the shore, clearly worn down by the passage of time. Whenever I see places like this, I immediately start wondering what story it carries and how long it has been left there.

>Zwróciłam również uwagę na opuszczoną łódkę, która leżała sobie przy brzegu, porządnie natrzasknięta zębem czasu. Kiedy widzę takie miejsca, od razu zaczynam się zastanawiać, jaką historię niesie ze sobą i jak długo leży ta łódź już tam opuszczona.


![20260408_174513.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ladytruckview/23yJEKF5wPobzNBG9BoAv9w7Ruybb8b2n2EjkWnwo7nqpiNrrEttYaphRBnPneFnLrs1q.jpg)

title.title: [EN/CZ] My Actifit Report Card: April 27 2026
title.body:
Hi there!\
I enjoyed the weekend to the fullest, and now it's time to head back to work.\
Luckily, I’m working a twelve-hour night shift, so there’s still some time to get some activity in. In the morning, I took the dogs to the training ground, and after lunch, I went for a run.\
Before heading to work, we took all the dogs for a proper walk.

**

*Ahoj!\
Víkend jsem si užil naplno a dnes je načase zase vyrazit do práce.\
Naštěstí mám noční dvanáctku, a tak zbývá ještě trochu času na nějakou tu aktivitu. Dopoledne jsem zajel se psy na cvičák a po obědě jsem si šel zaběhat.\
Před odchodem do práce jsme šli ještě všechny psy pořádně vyvenčit.*

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/bd73af2e-8830-4d9e-acb1-900b9dc83800.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/9309e8ae-03de-4854-a85a-e79fc7e465ec.jpg)

At the training ground, we are still practicing the slalom with four poles. The dogs also tackled the \

obstacle several times. It's relatively new, especially for Oggy, but he has no problem with it.

**

*Na cvičáku pořád pilujeme nácvik slalomu se čtyřmi tyčkami. Několikrát psi zdolali i překážku „áčko“. Hlavně pro Oggyho je to relativně nové, ale nemá s překážkou žádný problém.*

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/02b5bbf1-271b-425e-97ef-dd7c8b8b71ba.jpg)

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d76c4b3e-6963-4e23-888a-9bff7dad44d9.jpg)

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0f093f04-1f73-4204-be3f-f68f5ea5a949.jpg)

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/60f558d8-ceec-46b3-92d2-4e79ec18b16f.jpg)
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7c2e0eac-444b-4ce0-9f3f-8fab622e807e.jpg)

Today’s slightly longer run on the bike path was done at a relaxed pace.

**

title.title: My Best Time: Quiet Time
title.body:
Hello, beautiful and handsome men and women in the house. 

Happy new week, I am glad we are starting this week with beautiful thoughts and plans, which are an essential part of human beings on earth to think and take a step or action. 


![IMG_20260427_001044_012.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/peckypeace/23xVMX8ND96JWW8Hpd4bqXL57JkQxuL9bNGuJ1DYTPak1SaRcAxMVDrrGVuFcvY7GSRd5.jpg)


This week's featured contest piqued my interest so much that I have to create time to write because this is the most important part of my life and I'm not just doing it to take shape or for my physical benefits only, it is also for my spiritual well-being which is the most important thing in my life. 

# When was the last time I reflected 

Alright, I just finished mine this morning, and it was a wonderful time to meditate on the word of the Lord, because with this, every other thing will be in place as I prioritize. It's good to sit down and reflect on life, but the most beautiful part is meditating on the word of God, which is the solid foundation for solving your life problems and more.

This is the best time to think about the heart of God, dictate what God wants for me and my future, and sit back to receive answers from Him or listen to His thoughts towards the direction you were asking God for. 


In fact, I do my quiet time every day, where I'm staying currently there is no noise, I can decide to lock myself inside my room and ask God questions about my life using the scripture to do that, and it will be the best ever to reflect and meditate with tangible results.

# How often do I do this

I do it all the time, because I'm alone in my house, when I don't have anybody around me to disturb or distract me, at times, if I don't feel like reading, I will switch to lying down on my bed glorifying God and worshipping Him without a shout but in my mind, and thanking Him for the things He has done for me and the things He is going to do, while doing this ideas drop, direction came and instructions came as well.


At times, when the burden comes I will just push some things aside and observe my quiet time till my head is cleared. My quiet time revolves around God and me praying to him, communing, and having intimacy with Him. 

# How has this habit helped my life?

I have been taught through the scripture to always run to God for help when I am helpless. Irrespective of the situation I am in, when I run to Him in prayer, He answers me. When I go to Him with my burden, He will lift it up and give me peace of mind and rest.  God is interested in every area of my life, so I report it to Him, He attends to me with immediate effect, because He is my Father who cares for me without hesitation. This habit made me understand that there is God. 

# Is it something I hope to continue 

Of course, it's a habit that I will continue to build and to share with others to prioritize their quiet time with God. Not with vain thought.

In all, let your thoughts, your uncertainty, and issues of life be poured out to God in the place of prayer, this is where you can get results and answers.

_**This is my response to the Hivelearners featured contest week 215 episode 1**_

_**Thank you very much**_



Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@peckypeace/my-best-time-quiet-time--83u)

title.title: Turning an Old Cooker Into an Outdoor Fire Stove and Cooking Fried Rice the Old Way
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTAjnH2geUA3dpNUD7HpncVeHHA9ViwxXK3p7Tf5U3a7/9dadc588_542a_4cca_a135_a903b05dfc0b.jpg)

I'd been working a bit too hard these past few days, so I decided to give myself a simple treat, nothing fancy, just something to bring back a bit of nostalgia from the old days.

It reminded me of when my mum used to cook over a wood fire, the smell of the flames, the warmth, the atmosphere… and of course, the food. There’s just something special about it.

So I thought, why not try cooking on fire again? It’s something I haven’t done in a long time, but growing up in the Philippines, cooking outdoors over fire was just part of everyday life.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdDTsqvmEAYNx6bNBpTcy5SeyYJ9fMN21MEufS7trSDw4/img_20260426_wa0031.jpg)


I had this old rusty cooker that I just pulled out of the shed, and I was actually about to get rid of it to free up some space. But then I changed my mind. What if I could turn it into an outdoor cooker? 

It might not be the most conventional idea, but I liked the height of it, and it saved me from building a structure from scratch, and I could have my outdoor fire cooker ready straight away.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPm416TmbTxqNSSzCJdnFXP4YCsfdpkhrS2we2jaS5MXg/0.jpg)

Luckily, the nearby garden centre had a heavy slab that fit perfectly on top, dense, sturdy, and heat-resistant, and I managed to get it for just a tenner. I placed that on top. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqupedaTvBzJx4SJw5ULXDaNXQ9pU63bmH3PL5j9qxvR/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwwvfykkyo67f2vvok6nxyy7ae67checm2hk4zyatvd7otbdsrqhxyz6j1xvwpfimsngdpa.png)

Then added a few bricks… and there it was: my little outdoor cooker (yes, I know, a bit crazy 😄).


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2cfr1eHirctatsr8cRZbF4Fn2upncapn5Uq7GUjaP9C/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwx3ptzrqcqqnbu5nyl4t3nf5q8bbbo4v8ca5dem3lnzwn2mqwakavgzsdxweiohgftdduz.png)


Next step: firewood. Around here, there’s no shortage As lots of fallen and cut ash from diseased trees, just waiting to be used.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmP3DcfQxUCAVAdYeTpTbiC4uAXfCp99cEgZATLBKGJB9T/vm1pghgncycbee5hzzj19jzfufzceuv7mvfkdbzhzuaveyrkeoq2mprzrtawswvzgwtjdgfdwkl6bmsr96skf3dvop86n7sg1cv5fv5qboqr5teoyi7wxjgcnqz6upiqlhjqocr.png)

I got home, excited to try it out. I placed the woods in the lower oven compartment to keep them dry.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfCZoZ7yy9qbsmxsYjtPyiBCJLMham36thQrtP3txMX78/2gsjgna1uruvgbhdnraj2z6fsl6xeqr3pnqa26gnvdz96tbrkxwaisnzydwdne3u5ywmcz6qydcksgkgexhf8dztrjpnnjwrvz61aslmyfsusatfvx.png)


And I placed the outdoor pans in the top compartment.

Then I decided to cook something simple: fried rice.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQ6wi5Mwva5vrSS1MPutPU3cXiwrGG2ChtmRNg958mD8/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwwptynksbylunoppc2r5qyfk4mqrnrxhsb9cp5xstq5x6xfklrq6dqjmnyt8lf8dse73tj.png)



I arranged the wood in between the bricks. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQz8Fe4gKVGMFcpNu1brAyfBgXUN4HFHrHeWu35bqWadS/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwx42ssqfnbvycavjt3ktgrwxmxjgab4cpmuxcvmqbxyw7fr28h7nnggls5peadarwy25l2.png)

Lighting the fire was surprisingly easy,  the logs were dry from the sunny weather, so it got going in just a couple of minutes. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRGgeyuTrh3dTVJuzSY9dg2zwTJybWpv3WRyJdECH2wWT/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwwrdhkadkzfdtqp5e9wczqspppdasu48vp8aejidww4wtkpzmopca2ktxp5dt9x2vkyinr.png)


I started by cooking the rice.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWxGrPodecjD6aPuYTrbKEebMHXLRxGLJqio7n9Q7dirv/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwx4kkukhxxmphb59xsnw8wfd1ucksmxc2kwo111yffj78cr8jz41y24nsgzhazeu69jqqq.png)


What I love about this setup is how easy it is to manage the heat, you can move the wood around, build the fire where you need it, and adjust as you go. It felt so natural.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcriV4PBvaXJFsNSQxygGvG9yn8MS9eAhCqA1WQD4y5az/0.jpg)

The rice cooked in no time at all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWRsW7nH97o9RAE95EjAfqAWdrgz28winPqG4t7DqLbRA/0.jpg)


Then moved on to frying, lots of garlic (of course!)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVhKhBzysmvb7VaRZLjcLgorw3YSJJmPdTgp3pTPRuUd3/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwwt9nvj92excgdbfiglbkeaejgruyfyqhjkfvmcr2afcvjgcqnceadnuwzjqmybjzh6q4r.png)


Vegetables, then the ham.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeGUCz81Ppvs8c13ostGLuLyiS2G9W9ciakL5SJ8W8Xg5/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwx2dgfhe4vlsubusmnyvppcvl8gfrwwuqarcl3ymfcjjjaw18wzqqctstntvwyyxknunjr.png)


Once everything was ready, I added the rice back in, fry for few minutes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc7pd1y3MfpwnspPYcNaSTHnZsdnur3oWKryd7NdQEgUJ/fxx5caie56yoxogccgzvnxnnwemssycuackxuxwwqxvtkaj4csgzmjgzqo6ysnchqyngfnecqgwq2ghc2m1wbr1cx1g3lontqeeyuhn5a3cs.png)

and mixed it all together over the fire.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQwPyvNEiWojTeddAm4g9dUcvvFsb2Z6sbBjLqHW8jcJ8/ae9a9ea2_1574_4bfc_9e27_f57e680e50a0.png)

I can’t even explain how much I enjoyed the whole process.



Cooking this way just has a depth to it; the food tastes better. It brought back memories of when everything we ate was cooked over fire. Then we switched to gas, and the food suddenly felt… a bit bland in comparison. It lost that nice charred taste.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmefN7WZw4prdBwtWwTjZHuzPdFxzPDXbbsnHHqq8ftVvZ/0.jpg)


Once everything was done, I simply sprinkled some water over the fire to calm it down and safely bring the heat down.

This may not last long, and I’ll need to build a proper brick one someday… but for now, this little creation really made my day!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbftq79osBbc5goN41bLrGWYZMRhSUUY5bNwK1bhHwF1w/df1929f9_8b92_41ee_8ad9_c2a8ff995da2.jpg)

And we all enjoyed this delicious fried rice!

Mariah 🌿🔥

title.title: The Power of Quiet Time in a Busy Life .
title.body:
In today's world, we are all running on an invisible line. From morning to night, work, responsibilities, social media, communication with people, everything, our lives are filled with a kind of endless noise. So much noise, so busy that we forget to take some time for ourselves. I sometimes wonder when was the last time I sat down completely quietly and talked to myself? Without a mobile phone, without any work pressure, just spent some time with my own thoughts? Honestly, this time has become very rare now.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mrarhat/245n3ADsj7THDxV3qEoNnXArPWGrGSujF29xkYtsbftcCCuPKyeU6Mgo3sEAvXfPHSqQL.png)

[Image Source](https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/estuary/content?id=file_00000000e36c71f69cceae3fdc9e3fc3&ts=493698&p=fs&cid=1&sig=e33d50db0c040bbc33ccdf9c55640cc5d885f780a558ad05554f319b664997a2&v=0)

I think we are distancing ourselves from ourselves. We are so connected to others but not so much with ourselves. With so much talk, so much pressure every day, a noise is created in our heads and within this noise, we slowly lose our true feelings.

I myself was in this situation once. Always busy, always thinking about something or the other. It felt like if I stopped, I would fall behind, but at one point I realized that if I continued like this, I would lose touch with myself. That's when I tried to find some time, a little quiet time, where it was just me and my thoughts.

One of the main reasons why we don't have time for ourselves these days is that we want to be constantly connected, with phones, notifications, messages, and everything keeping us busy. But this constant connection weakens our inner connection.

I think that taking some time for ourselves every now and then is not a luxury, but a necessity. Just as we rest our bodies, our minds also need rest. And that rest comes in silence.

title.title: Reviving SIM from all my dCity cards and burning them for rewards
title.body:
Gerber, who was the developer of dCities, announced that the game is going to be shut down. This happened a couple of months back. Today I came across an interesting article where there was some good news that we get something from our dCity game assets. Looks like @ecoinstant had posted it about a month back, and apparently, I had missed it. Today, thanks to @gungunkrishu, I woke up from my sleep and got the chance to explore what this is all about. The first information that I got was about this amazing portal that lists out all our dCity assets. 

https://alextrapp.github.io/burnDcity/

I used to be one of the early members of this game, and I was playing this for a decent amount of time. I then got busy with other stuff and lost track of what was happening in the game. More features were introduced, and more maths and calculations were involved. I don't remember this game giving any big revenue for the investors or players, but it initially gave some fun for the players. As this was one of the early games on Hive, it did bag a lot of revenue from the investors who bought the NFT cards. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW91V884mYHUiLt1NVXCy9NmFTzFFpVX74dkwfFBbxvnX/image.png)

Whoever built this website has done a decent job in displaying all the NFT information. I was glad to see that my cards were worth 12k SIM tokens, which was not very bad. The first thing was to burn all my NFT tokens and claim SIM from that. The second part of the deal was to burn SIM to receive some rewards in the form of Hive. Looks like there is a fund amount of 70k Hive that is going to be distributed among people who are going to burn their SIM tokens. The burning number has to be a million. I was curious to go and find out what my balance was. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzSpvMDe7zj6ydEAHVTeDQb2fFNUuLhxBcHqKqX9giTu/image.png)

Apparently, I had so much of SIM locked in the liquidity pool. I removed my liquidity and got all the SIMs back to my account. The next step would be to burn all the SIMs by sending them to null. That's how I can participate in this reward. I don't know how many Hive I might get from the 70k Hive share, though. Looks like I have close to 6,784,051.49 SIM currently in my account. I'm ready to send that to @null. I would like to do that in a couple of days.
