body.body:
Good luck with the lessons.  I've been through this now a few times. First of all, I was a reluctant driver myself and refused to get a license until the suburbs, with an infant, forced me.  Then as my children grew, I had two children to teach. Both of these depended on driver's ed and professional teachers rather than their parents. Thank heavens. 

However, when it came to my granddaughter, we met an impasse. She also had no interest in driving (must be the genes), but eventually grew weary of asking friends and us for rides, so she relented. Turned out, personality clash with her mother made that avenue unworkable.  Her grandfather was too nervous.  Her uncle too bossy. Guess who taught her to drive?  Me!

It was a glorious experience. She was very patient with me (role reversal) because I was a bit timid.  But she listened. We found at first parking lots. Then we found a nearby college campus (after hours). Then we went on quiet neighborhood streets. Eventually, my skill limit was reached because I would not go on major thoroughfares with her. So we hired a driving instructor.  By that time, she was quite comfortable behind the wheel (thanks grandma).  

In New York it's 50 hours of supervised instruction and 15 after sunset.  She was 19 so there was no age limitation.  She is a good driver, I think.  It takes years to be a really good driver, but she's getting there.

My recommendation to every parent is, let that first car be a tank.  Then you won't worry so much  :))

body.title: 🔧 TerraCore Dev Update — API Versioning for Bots & Builders
body.body:
![cover](https://i.imgur.com/OC0eiSl.png) Hello, Fellow Citizens! We have been heads-down on the quest revamp, but in between the big feature work we are always looking for ways to make the TerraCore ecosystem more reliable for everyone building on it. Today's update is aimed squarely at our **developers, bot operators, and third-party builders** — the people running scripts, dashboards, and automation tools on top of [TerraCore](https://terracoregame.com). If that is you, read on. If it is not — stick around anyway, because this update is part of how we keep the game healthy for everyone.
## **The Problem We Solved** TerraCore has 2,701 registered players and a growing number of third-party bots and tools running against our public API. Claim bots, battle bots, price monitors, stat dashboards — there are more of them every month, which is awesome. The problem is that up until today, there was no reliable way for those tools to know when something changed. If we updated the crate price formula, adjusted an upgrade cost, or added a new endpoint — a bot would just keep running against the old assumptions until something broke. The only signal was silence, followed by unexpected behavior. That is not good enough. So we fixed it.
## **Introducing: `GET /version`** We have added a dedicated version endpoint to the TerraCore API. Any bot, script, or integration can call it at startup to get a snapshot of the current API state: ``` GET https://api.terracoregame.com/version ``` The response looks like this: ```javascript { \

} ``` The version string follows **calendar versioning** — the same format we use on the frontend. Year, month, and a patch number that increments any time something observable changes. When you see the version tick from `2026.04.1` to `2026.04.2`, you know something changed and exactly where to find out what.
## **The Response Header — No Extra Call Needed** We also added a version header to **every single API response**. Every endpoint — player data, battles, leaderboard, crate prices, all of them — now returns: ``` X-TerraCore-API-Version: 2026.04.1 ``` This means your bot does not even need to call `/version` on every cycle. Just check the header on any response you are already receiving. If it changes, pause and check the changelog before continuing. Here is a minimal Python example: ```python import requests resp = requests.get(\

)
    # fetch https://api.terracoregame.com/version for links
```

And a JavaScript / Node example:

```javascript
const res = await fetch(\

); if (apiVersion !== lastKnownVersion) { console.log(`API version changed to ${apiVersion} — review changelog`); } ``` Simple. No polling overhead. Works on any existing request you are already making.
## **What Triggers a Version Bump** We have documented exactly what warrants a version bump so you can rely on the signal: - **Any cost or burn rate changes** — crate prices, upgrade costs, quest fees, boss fight costs - **Any endpoint added, removed, or renamed** - **Any response field added, removed, or renamed** - **Rate limit changes** - **Any behavioral fix that changes what a bot would observe** This rule is now baked into all three of our module development guides (API, Smart Contract, and Frontend). When a cost changes in the Smart Contract, the API version bumps in the same commit. When a new endpoint is added, the version bumps. No more silent changes.
## **The `llms.txt` File** While we were at it, we updated our machine-readable API summary at `https://www.terracoregame.com/llms.txt`. This file is designed for AI tools, LLMs, and bots that need a structured overview of TerraCore's API and blockchain operations. It now includes a full versioning section at the top: - Current version string - The `/version` endpoint URL - The header name to watch - What a version change means and where to look If you are building a TerraCore integration and want a single document that covers all the endpoints, operation IDs, token formats, and authority levels — that file is it.
## **By the Numbers** TerraCore continues to grow. As of today: - **2,701 total players** registered on the battlefield - **646.9 million $SCRAP** permanently burned since launch - **170.8 million $SCRAP** currently in circulation - **78.2 million $SCRAP** sitting in the treasury, fueling daily leaderboard rewards Every integration that runs cleanly against the API is another player who can trust that their bot is not going to do something unexpected. This update is for them.
## **Wrapping Up** This is a small change on the surface — a new endpoint, a response header, some documentation. But for the people building on TerraCore it is a meaningful upgrade to the reliability contract between us and the ecosystem. You should never have to guess whether something changed. Now you will not have to. We are still deep in the Quest Revamp work and have a lot to show you soon. If you are a bot operator or developer and have questions about the new versioning system — or suggestions for what else would make your life easier — jump into our Discord and let us know. We read everything. See you on the battlefield.
--- *That's it for today, all the links are below be sure to follow us to hear what we are working on and follow the progress!* [Play Terracore](https://terracoregame.com) | [Check Out our Wiki](https://wiki.terracoregame.com) | [Follow us on Twitter](https://twitter.com/terracoregame) | [Follow us on PeakD](https://peakd.com/@terracore) | [Come join the Discord](https://discord.gg/terracore)

body.title: Not all forgiveness is forgotten.
body.body:
by Jamal70 on Jamal70 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/jamal70 [![Not all forgiveness is forgotten.](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/d151618f-cacd-4b37-8982-981be0cfe77c.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/bJiQ1MKJt5dqU4LHWXDiem) 
 
 One day in class, the teacher asked the students, “What happens to a person after studying?” Everyone was silent, but one student jokingly said, “Sir, people make mistakes after studying!” The teacher was surprised and asked, “What kind of thing is that?” The student laughed and said, “Because we make mistakes while studying, and we learn from those mistakes.” The whole class laughed. The teacher also smiled and said, “There is logic in what you say.” There is a big lesson hidden in this incident—making mistakes is not bad, but rather people learn and improve from mistakes. Therefore, the real purpose of studying is not just knowing the right answer, but learning from mistakes.

body.title: What to do when you are maried for 35 years ...
body.body:
As the title says we are maried for 35 years last Sunday was our anniversary, for more info about that see my post from last Saturday :
https://ecency.com/hive-124452/@stresskiller/my-35th-anniversary
 

Well we both don't really like to party or celebrate birthdays, so we went to a museum instead just the two of us .

We purchased a Museum card , that gives you acces to almost every museum in my country for a whole year , so we will be visiting more musea soon . 

But we started with a museum nearby in an area where we also surched for housing 2 years ago before we moved here .


It's an area next to one of our old airforce bases Soesterberg.

They turned the old airforce base in a nature reserve as you can see here : 
https://www.utrechtslandschap.nl/gebied/natuur/park-vliegbasis-soesterberg

On that old air force base they have build a new museum called \

one of our National Military Museum . 

1 ) 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcAnDFv3zgvwSNwdJPDuNqYM6tD2dZDQEmR3Y4puCtDux/a7403764.jpg)







**Why a visit military museum ?**
Well we both have never served in the army and with all the news about war in the world , where better to go to learn and understand some more about the materials being used then a museum.

2 ) Leopard 1V tank at the front door

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNxhp9VzpvkKW1NhopKpxpaBKPohRxmBK9K1uMZqciaC3/a7403763.jpg)

It's the first time since a very long time that i've visited a museum , and was wondering what condition i would come across when taking photos, so to play things a little bit safe i used the automatic mode and let the camera do the thinking so that i can go home and look at the images to see if and how i would change things . 

3 ) An impression of the light conditions ..

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYhA1Kg9Rt5zx2To382ghAtn8z1VxjwopNWnRLDGg25PM/a7403765.jpg)

So these are not perfect images but a learning curve for me , things that troubled the moste are : 
- **Backlights** As you can see the museum is one big box made out of glass letting in sunlight from every corner , causing either underexposed or over exposed images , but nothing you can't correct in your digital darkroom . 

- **Reflections** so many shiny surfaces reflecting light that has convinced me that i need to purchase a polarisation filter ASAP .
it will make it a lot easier to take photos of shiny objects but also from items behind glass.
 
- **People** getting in the way i do remeber a period when people would wait to move when you held a camera in those kind of places , but these days they really don't give a fuck anymore and just walk in front of the camera

- **Control of light**  Unlike my Macro photography these are objects you can't just light up the way you would like the subjects are to big for using flash lights and you don't have an army of people with you to hold light reflectors to light up dark spaces. And the museum is also using their own way of lighting up the subjects.



4 ) F16 side view

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXA9kdAgZY7MYAmrn3DPRn1vyEdRw68s5r7AxEwQ2kTVv/a7403766_01.jpg)

5 ) F16 rear view

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXuua3tsssjP5VP1F9Z5sdxEwRHapPmoZSYt59jdka6b/a7403771_01.jpg)

6 ) F16 front view . It's impossible to get the subject isolated in the photo , unless you are going to spend either ours in photoshop , or as some people do these days ask an AI to isolate it for you in the photo .

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTVqhqxznCMDXTUe8qhJpPoASiyRAHHy1mPRmrh69JQbD/a7403783_01.jpg)


7 ) Multiple jetfighters hanging from the ceiling

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZRxSdooEjhmJBXDxFCcf7qLxYteZdrJzPHnT95UBaHAe/a7403768.jpg)

8 ) They were hanging on multiple steel cables , this one is on the F15 that was hanging behinf the F16 .

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEfzGtqmFFcAWovRtJjQher7pFJVQWthJz314i6nue4s/a7403769_01.jpg)

9 ) The cockpit of the F15

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYvvwA5NgXTjJ1tuyGsigQV2Uk9hrmSHV4bzTnJY2D7Wn/a7403770_01.jpg)

10 ) Some Anti aircraft guns displayed behind the F16 on the groundlevel.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNerFo6hUirYDgoz4RPsj1uMjxujEcj2K6Y4RK15Xb8TL/a7403776_01.jpg)

11 ) But there is more here then just modern military tools , they have a nice collection of Uniforms from the past and matching weapons.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbESn8MStcLFTNG62kKHsfiR53f2NFgS2DygtH4yrukqi/a7403781.jpg)

12 ) The old unforms behind glass from a period 1795 - 1839
This is typical a photo that could have been much better with the use of a Polarizer filter . 
For more info about polarizer : https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polarizer

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma4jMzCkqfFekrRNCWDwW3AMvWzJUz3Zu6xobueAwoQS2/a7403957.jpg)

13 ) The polarizer filter would have reduced the reflections in the glass a lot .
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJkkYJayJzn25HQ23xVY383wAgoa8SArxcRy1kYtd1ej/a7403958_01.jpg)

14 ) It's hard to imagine that people would feel protective with this kind of armor , the weight will slow you down. 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNm5XKiFpisAmE6VBjK5S6ngKmQq5za2gs1W3xgSQAWui/a7403959_01.jpg)

body.title: Bitcoin at 78K and SPS is Almost at an All Time Low
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVKnRZXFf5oHci75KNJFFLfq7VLiTSzd8V2sPsQtpCyun/image.png)

Above is a Bitcoin vs SPS chart for the last three months and no matter how we love Splinterlands, the picture for the SPS token is quite disappointing. You could argue that Bitcoin is in its own pump while altcoins are really suffering and that is true to some extent, but if we compare the last three months of SPS and Ethereum you will see a similar picture, just not as drastic as with BTC:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmezs2mfpiEmyCVTUfYe2gmPkHbhgBqkNpABK13ApZNuUh/image.png)

If we take a look at the SPS chart for the last year we will see that despite at least three SPS pumps in the last year we still see a pattern of lower highs and lower lows and we are at the lowest point in the last year right now. 

This is a bearish chart and it is strongly bearish. This means that SPS throughout the last year has remained in a downtrend despite temporary rallies. When we apply technical analysis to the SPS chart it has to be said that SPS is a small market capitalization token with a thin trading volume which tends to amplify downside moves during the weak market sentiment periods.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeCfik5Vtpe1LQ3cBJGb2J7cPbBMGjzemd2sumQH94Ggq/image.png)

Based on this one year chart above I can clearly see a long-term descending channel with upper trendline consistently rejecting rallies and lower boundary of this channel slowly grinding lower.

This is a classic trend exhaustion behavior, where sellers remain in control, but momentum weakens over time. Perhaps we can hold the all time low of $0.004147 that also happens to fall into a major technical support zone of $0.0040 – $0.0042 based on this one year chart.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPPSVSRjQJfRVZsQLheSrSZhRNDjHtELtKSCHPpTgXHcJ/image.png)

This zone matters because SPS is near its all time low and selling pressure appears to be slowing while price volatility is declining. But if SPS breaks this support zone in a decisive fashion then downside will open quickly and we can head into a major breakdown zone of: $0.0032 – $0.0035

Setting an all time low and heading decisively lower would also have a very negative psychological effect where it shows that SPS is heading even lower and the price is lower than it has ever been. It would not be a pretty picture if we break the all time low from about two years ago. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRz89QbqCJeAYJMEWAoGRbgjFzXF3rGqmHQcoew3pHzik/image.png)

We all know that in the hay day of Splinterlands the price was around a dollar and we were in the middle of the crypto-gaming narrative that has not came back since 2021/22. So looking at that time is almost meaningless.

The chart above is what I would call the modern period for Splinterlands and SPS. This represents the last three years. And in these last three years SPS has gone from the peak zone of $0.035 – 0.038 to the current zone of $0.0042 – 0.0045.

This represents an 85 to 90% decline from the local cycle highs and we are more than 99% below the historical all time highs of $1. Even without looking at the historical highs the last three years looks like a classic altcoin bear market.

## Technical Pattern
It is not all doom and gloom even on the technical analysis side. Based on the last three years this chart resembles a Descending  Accumulation Base technical pattern. This pattern is bullish and showing slowing selling and clearly everyone is loosing interest, but smart money is accumulating here, though this pattern takes time, sometimes years...

Yes SPS chart looks like a forgotten asset with a very long bleed, reduced speculation and community fatigue, but it also represents an accumulation possibility. Short term SPS charts look bearish to neutral, medium term it looks like we have a base building and long term SPS might actually represent a very high risk but also a potentially very high reward opportunity. 

## Conclusion
Seeing SPS hover at an all time low is not a pretty picture, it doesn't feel good. I don't know if this price or even the all time low that we might see here soon will represent a good buying opportunity, but to me this chart doesn't look like a dead token chart.

Dead token charts usually have a vertical collapse with no bounce attempts and volume and trading going away. SPS chart still shows repeated rebounds, active liquidity, lows that look like support levels and periodic speculation around card set releases. 

This suggests that SPS is in a survival mode and we will see in the next six to twelve months if this pattern continues. 

I am sticking with Splinterlands and SPS token. I realize that the risk is very high of SPS price going lower in the next three years just like we saw in the last three years, but we know that the Splinterlands team is funded for the next two years, and all it takes is for crypto gaming or play to earn narrative to come back as these narratives in crypto tend to for SPS to become one of the top remaining gaming projects that could see a major pump. So I am betting on SPS and Splinterlands to keep delivering in the next two years and catching another wave.

body.title: Newborn photoshoot in a different way - Monomad Challenge.
body.body:
![cover.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xyXNVUanYt2uQAEe4jLJFg5t4v5jUscHm2UfWTF811g359iQNLCR1YwXLVv2VGARTxN.jpg)
Greetings to all my friends in this beautiful community, today I am back with a new photo session that I did in my new photo studio, this time for a family and their newborn baby. Lately I have taken many photos of pregnant women and the most frequent question is if I also take photos of newborns and of the baby's months and the truth is that I always tell them no because I don't have the accessories or the set for babies, however I always offer them the possibility of doing a different type of photo, in which the parents are always holding and handling the baby themselves.
  Un saludo a todos mis amigos en esta hermosa comunidad, hoy estoy de vuelta con una nueva sesion de fotos que hice en mi nuevo estudio de fotografia, en esta ocasion para una familia y su bebé recien nacido. Ultimamente hice muchas fotos de embarazadas y la pregunta mas frecuente es que si tambien hago fotos de recien nacidos y de los meses del bebé y la verdad es que siempre les digo que nó porque no tengo los accesorios ni el set para bebes, sin embargo siempre les ofrezco la posibilidad de hacer un tipo de foto diferente, en la que los papás siempre esten sosteniendo y manipulando al bebé ellos.  
![IMG_5885.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EpXMPsgHnQtzybHAv7BibkRodpWy1unEf9J4vn6xsfCvkenFdwxgrmF71U2Qy8x3TNn.jpg)
This adorable couple loved the idea and wanted to schedule a photo session with me when their baby was only 2 weeks old, they told me it was literally the 3rd time they had taken him out of the house so for me it was an honor to have done this photo session for them.
  A esta adorable pareja les encantó la idea y quisieron agendar una sesion de fotos conmigo cuando su bebé tenia apenas 2 semanas de nacido, me dijeron que fue literalmente la 3era vez que lo sacaban de casa asi que para mi fue todo un honor haber hecho esta sesion de fotos para ellos.  
![IMG_5863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EpCCFbfcnerWjrM48wVgbdQfrvBjythigYHyiUd3eJicf6HXrRALuWM5FvcWx8v7GFB.jpg) ![IMG_5870.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EprVbFTYAHHrWnNLWwXSASrBrmbVmgQk64yuRw8gw1YzoPFBKKQQ3cBAxQM8aqnGfgV.jpg)
We took both couple and individual photos, and the truth is that they all turned out beautiful!
  Hicimos fotos tanto en pareja como individuales, y la verdad es que tooodas quedaron hermosas!  
![IMG_5969.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EouBZXwV1jSWPYWB2vv3QvGr7NFfApzyWXCAZzbQBWH7ckLTTd2Koji7yDZZapwHfsD.jpg)
Unlike the typical newborn photo session where the baby is usually sleeping, here the baby was awake during the whole photo session and that allowed us to take photos where it seems like he was looking at the camera.
  A diferencia de la tipica sesion de fotos de recien nacidos donde el bebé para estar durmiendo, aquí el bebé estuvo despierto toda la sesion de fotos y eso nos permitió hacer fotos en donde parece que mirara a la camara.  
![IMG_5962.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23xybeiXhykecS1xby2igdB7t6LVJr3kWs2zi65BWLfeHxadrCcmxJcwPStCceNstDvHN.jpg)
This photo session was different and that is exactly what makes it unique and special.
  Esta sesion de fotos fue diferente y justamente eso lo hace unica y especial.  
![IMG_6013.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/EogMNRYEWMhAoGkdVDXrpAgwb9HhmQ9dMHwahF52nf4xgaDtY88J7cbzWfEeUnS1D3Y.jpg) ![IMG_5934.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23zGeWQ2Vkq2Xqv2rWp8GupRq5FL9BxecxkPdij8i37hMV2u31mXxP2KrmGAsrmz6NBmU.jpg) ![IMG_6204.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23wgUE84J696h4ggZFnja4y2jR9TrEKC2GM1abH8WWb92vVupjYfSAaccnn92D6XoEV7o.jpg)
The parents asked me to also take photos of the baby's little hands and feet because in their own words: \

.
  Los padres me pidieron que tambien le hiciera fotos a las manitas y pies del bebé porque en sus propias palabras: \

![IMG_6085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23w31xF2iF3wuBgftq8diNcah43uA3y92RDzMcrs6CP1hrJTfiY3wMf35Bqq4k3dKLeZf.jpg) ![IMG_6126.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23y8xQhEueUdfMxadEpv9EoE3x1r3ZGry9S8FgfW8KuxJSodEPgb7P1SPbfqMN6XsfPaK.jpg) ![IMG_6091.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/malos10/23zkyJwDEHF9JZjZqtthbaLqTmjAYTcpMSQg8ct41vwaMV6BBEU3SPrvLA61xRHi612mf.jpg)
I took all the photos with my Canon R8 camera, a 50mm lens at 4/f and two light points. At the end of this photo session we were all super happy with the results and I hope you like them as much as we do!!
  Todas las fotos las tomé con mi camara Canon R8, un lente 50mm a 4/f y dos puntos de luces. Al final de esta sesion de fotos todos quedamos super contentos con los resultados y espero que a ustedes les gusten tanto como a nosotros!!

At the present time inflation is striking badly and because of inflation the price of all necessary products has increased multiple X, and it is natural that general people are facing difficulties coping with the situation. We are in such a situation that a middle-class family find it struggling to save some money. In such a situation thinking about giving money to others is quite difficult as we don’t have money for ourselves let alone giving money to others. Do you think that now people have the mindset for charity? ![Inline Image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmeVcGnMh337Do5aGB7MHrvLW9b7mgzfZVrCfFbsQtwNzu/ai-image-1777310732731.jpeg) picture generated by rafiki In past times people could save money and they had some spare money through which they could provide help, especially financial help to others. They were allowed to have enough money for charity but now the situation is totally different because those people are already struggling with their own life to cope with the increasing inflation. Right at the moment they don’t have spare money to provide others with help or do charity. Does it mean we should stop helping others or doing charity when we are indeed in tough situation. At the present time trusting anyone in case of lending them money is quite difficult. At least for me I don’t have no more than 3/4 people whom I can trust fully in case of finance. In fact, I don’t trust them blindly. I just feel those people are worthy enough for me to take the risk and if they don’t return my money, it will be the end for them for my trust as I won’t give anyone the second chance. If they do, in long term I will pull off my supporting hand and I will take back my money whatever it cost as I won’t give anyone my money whom I can’t trace. I will allow them to give them a helping hand as long as they won’t betray by trust and if they do so they will hit the rock bottom for sure as I will make it happen for them. I believe that as long as we can track those people, we should offer a helping hand, but we also need to be careful we won’t suffer badly for it. It’s true that we can’t help everyone as we have limited capabilities, but we should not change our mentality to help others. As long as we can go on, we should try to offer a helping hand because it’s the thing that makes us truly human. In one case I will make an exception and it’s the time of emergency hospital treatment. I think I will try my best to give as much as possible if anyone asks me for financial help during the time of emergency because I think that life is very important and even more important than my money. There may be a chance of not getting the money anytime, but I feel it’s worth it. At least I feel that I should do it as a human and I should not forget that I am human and humans need help during the time of emergency. Charity is not dependent on the balance of the account. It depends on the mentality of people. If I have the mentality, I will try to help even if I am facing a difficult situation depending on the need of the situation.

links.title: From Your Hands to the World: Simple Photography After a Natural Disaster // photography lovers
links.body:
----
In this digital era, mobile phones have become more than just a communication tool, their presence has changed the way we interact with the world and each other, one of which is the simple photography that we can produce through mobile phones.
----

![IMG-20260427-WA0016.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNbnSUL6Y2mpeYRK3ZxY9nmCwdq2SqowrYfUBhb7SP8fT/IMG-20260427-WA0016.jpg)

<div class=\

>

Good evening, my friends, wherever you are. I hope you are all healthy and happy, allowing you to go about your daily activities as usual. I hope you all have a pleasant day.

In this blog, I want to share some simple photographs I captured during my trip to Bener Meriah, which show the impact of the natural disasters that have struck my area in recent months.

So, please continue to follow my blog to see some of these simple photographs, along with short articles from me.

![IMG-20260427-WA0003.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdvkumZuBPijG5hY9i9sp3gERAzPTvXPQ8YTf6KD4isx7/IMG-20260427-WA0003.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0002.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcVxtBfmYNjcuDvs7bZPRZLJ1JmWr9axreSXGdxVfFydC/IMG-20260427-WA0002.jpg)

In the past few months, I've traveled to Bener Meriah, and I've shared my experiences in several recent blogs.

But in this blog, I'm back again to share some of the remaining images from my trip to Bener Meriah with friends, stopping briefly in one of the landslide-affected areas. Banners were even installed along the road indicating that the area is prone to landslides.

![IMG-20260427-WA0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYaKAKWvvtBNGvUD64iC38zabXFfzvP2qA3UmkiTRiteS/IMG-20260427-WA0000.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0001.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmb6Xe5ZYaT25cLKcfvxCGwqu5NEu5pZEEca9hkRYbmWHh/IMG-20260427-WA0001.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0010.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVE5dACLrA8dKjBDpNoT2gi4E7JdTbV6Ub7wYPfCsWZBv/IMG-20260427-WA0010.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0011.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQx65mYpRY6oAnwRYwTPDg39wv2sjZtvaCWMkiTfgJD41/IMG-20260427-WA0011.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0005.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbTCdvsc96CnD5VM33gwUUXfsfmWgTU1VU2gFU1uNmuuT/IMG-20260427-WA0005.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0004.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXS5z5BbrgxcB9oVLEnWHfxfh5MakeR7iNoA1jwgzpLE3/IMG-20260427-WA0004.jpg)

If you've been following my blog recently, I've shared some of the damage caused by a natural disaster that struck my region in late 2025. This resulted in extreme flash floods and landslides, claiming over a thousand lives and severely impacting millions of residents. Furthermore, the environmental damage was also a serious concern.

One of the worst natural disasters occurred in the Bener Meriah area, a regency located at a high altitude with stunning views. Now, all that remains is rubble and the remains of a landslide, as I've shared some images of in this blog.

![IMG-20260427-WA0007.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfZs3XMTfULjc42b8gJkb3Hf6Ye7r6iMkb36zo93g5fF8/IMG-20260427-WA0007.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0006.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQZDhda7bR1qrB3xEit2XUiwUUJ86xM6Cr7LWF8NnC7e/IMG-20260427-WA0006.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0009.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXmgMWoADyuprgiuzXF7vonbsWt3XpfBbYxM6PgujD3Nk/IMG-20260427-WA0009.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0008.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQhRPXqakfG84dFgynYB5Q3P9sKY5pUALC1xjhkY5QKbs/IMG-20260427-WA0008.jpg)

This area used to be a favorite spot for travelers who took a moment to enjoy the scenery and take some nature photos.

But now, as far as the eye can see, the scars of natural disasters, such as flash floods and landslides, dot the landscape.

My friend...
Therefore, I personally learned a profound moral lesson from this disaster: that nature is a trust, not a community. I believe the current disaster is a brutal feedback loop from nature resulting from excessive forest exploitation and land use change. I witnessed this throughout my trip to Bener Meriah, and we need to remember that nature is a trust that we must protect, not just a source of economic profit.

![IMG-20260427-WA0015.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZBAo99YJhbakgzXyuPwvCay6FMTGeDyjbQcfSM9i9V31/IMG-20260427-WA0015.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0013.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmP8ip153eG8AALZys2NKrNt4wARntWhC6UQcvLKzcuLY3/IMG-20260427-WA0013.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0014.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmS9ZgzV3GjnEXiRTuYE8FsiFf2eNQ2Yg3wtGzBymq3ui2/IMG-20260427-WA0014.jpg)

![IMG-20260427-WA0012.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSTFUPZqKiQwQc3Xx7Xtz9vdR7e373cEyQGGArd26Hx9X/IMG-20260427-WA0012.jpg)

Despite this, the atmosphere in this area remains cool, typical of the highlands, and a thin mist occasionally covers the road. I personally felt this while traveling to Bener Meriah.

My friends...
Although some areas were severely affected by the natural disaster, I was still able to enjoy the open landscape, with views of valleys, lakes, craters, and even vast expanses of community gardens along the roadside.

Well, my friends, those are some of my simple photographs that I'm sharing in this post. I hope you all enjoy and are entertained by what I've shared. I also extend my heartfelt thanks to all of you who have taken the time to view and read my blog to the end.

Please leave your comments, support, and input, which means a lot to me so I can make this blog even better in the future.
That's all for now.
Greetings, everyone.
See you in my next blog.

links.title: Gold Can Be Free if You Know Where to Look
links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbmyQ4Ucc6Da3fZ2D2Pbz3vpHS2FWeua3oqc4quSsemon/image.png 
eBay.com


I have a friend who once told me he would never buy gold. When I asked him why his answer was simple. I can just go out and pick it up off the ground for free. It's a very true statement, gold can be literally found just laying on the ground or very shallowly buried if you happen to know where to look.

Over the years I have gone on many prospecting adventures and they are always very enjoyable. You don't always find gold or treasure, but spending time outdoors or even diving beneath the waves is it's own reward! Of course, when you do find some gold it's a lot more exciting. And if you know where to look more times than not you will walk away with some shiny treasure in your pocket.

No one really understands for certain how gold nuggets and deposits form, but there are many theories. Most have to do with hot ground water dissolving gold and then flowing into cooler rocks or crystals (like quartz) where they deposit the dissolved gold. I included a link in my references to an article that discusses the theories in detail. I found it fascinating, but for the majority of you I'm sure it's might not be. But it's there if you want to learn more.

So where does gold come from?





 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmNnMzz8ZkvJCnCT2gZr4WBDqUMm6eRDVsjwsExffGc8Lz/image.png 
garfieldrefining.com

This is a typical quartz gold vein that holds deposits and nuggets of the yellow metal. Notice the yellowish tinge in the crystals themselves, a pretty good sign there is gold to be found. While quartz is the most common rock to hold gold concentrations it can happen in other rocks as well, but miners typically look for quartz because it's easy to spot since it's white. Not all quart has gold hidden inside, but when you run into many old gold mine tailings you tend to find a lot of quartz in the piles of discarded rocks.



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmaCf2u2zHQh8SyfMFCaEReF5pox4BJeyYCEizFHPKJVxp/Screenshot%204980.png 

This gold nugget weighed in at just under 2 grams, a respectable size for any gold find. This I found in Arizona in an old wash that was pretty much right on top of the bedrock using my metal detector. You can see how smooth the edges of the gold are indicating that it has been weathered down over thousands of years. It was initially washed free form a quartz vein in antiquity by an ancient river that no longer exists. However, it did deposit many gold nuggets along the bedrock in it's path.  The site it came from has a lot of gold, however, I am sworn to secrecy  on it's location by the original finder. He invited me along to the site and it is loaded with gold! Sadly, I haven't been out there in years now as it's a very, very long drive from here!



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmUgMpi9ViNM76ftbvEq9BtkDM1cvPgYkLnPnLpEviHqMR/image.png 
eBay.com

Now have a look at this gold nugget found in California, unfortunately, I wasn't the lucky finder! It's the same nugget as seen in the header but you can see it's size better sitting in the palm of a hand. It weighs 4.5 Troy ounces and is an absolute beauty. When you look at this gold it's very sharp looking and rough around the edges. There is a reason for that, it only very recently was washed free of it's vein and hasn't had thousands of years to be eroded and beaten smooth like the one I found.

So what does that mean to a gold prospector like myself (or potentially you?) It means that the gold vein it was washed out of is most likely not too far upstream from where this was found. The first thing I would do after finding this is call it a day and head down to lock it up in secure storage. The very next day I would return to the spot and start heading up the river in an earnest search to find the source. If you are able to find it, it could have more nuggets just like it still waiting to be claimed! Or even a potentially workable gold mine, although that is very unlikely. Most veins aren't huge, but they are out there!

I have found several gold veins over the years all in quartz crystals, but they have all been small. Most to the time they have been eroded down to little remaining. However, where there is one gold bearing vein there are likely others so keep your eyes peeled. You might have found a motherlode!

I'm sure this prospector went back and looked for the vein, but I've never heard anything else about the story since. He still may be looking...


If you are interested in prospecting for gold yourself, one of the best ways to get started is to contact a local prospecting community. You can find them online easily and many locally will meet up from time to time. They are a great resource to help you understand what you will need to start out and the best places to search in your local area. Many you invite you to tag along to some promising areas, although it won't likely be to their secret spots that hold lots of gold. Those secrets are carefully guarded among prospectors for very good reason!



















 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmay1VYGkPJEY33bsAi1nuUzULQm6S8t8TyP1hRRzVVmaX/image.png 

That will wrap up my post for this Monday, I do hope you enjoyed it. It's been awhile since I've done a post on gold prospecting or treasure hunting. Both are both hobbies I love and have enjoyed over the years. There is gold and lost treasures to be found all around the world, all you have to do is be willing to research and go out and look. A little luck never hurt either! Please feel free to ask any questions or leave any comments below, and as always thank you for all of your support. It really is deeply appreciated! Have a great week everyone!








![GIF_20250818_160944_821.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thebighigg/23tRxfsSYAsdjhiguQKAsHWYXiuWTpEqzAgEPCSn3k9FDCsmviaF4RPWwunT73gFqjEL8.gif)



 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRPuiouLNueU3DyvnS3zhqV1tQdFA1bjxAe7AzDd8aFPD/image.png

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gold

https://www.geologyin.com/2015/09/how-do-gold-nugget-form.html







 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRPuiouLNueU3DyvnS3zhqV1tQdFA1bjxAe7AzDd8aFPD/image.png 



















**Disclaimer**

I am not a financial planner and this isn't financial advice. Please always do your own research before investing your money. You worked hard enough to earn it!

Gold prospecting and treasure hunting can be dangerous. Never put yourself in a situation that is risky to life or limb, you can't spend the treasure if you're dead.

All pictures are mine unless otherwise indicated.

The Pokémon community is buzzing, but perhaps not for the reasons fans hoped. Renowned leaker Riddler Khu has once again stirred the pot regarding the upcoming Generation 10 titles, Pokémon Wind and Pokémon Surge. According to recent social media posts, the wait for the next era of Pokémon is going to be significantly longer than anticipated.

Khu claims that these titles are slated for a late 2027 release on the Nintendo Switch 2. Even more disappointing for those eager for updates: no official news is expected for the remainder of 2026.

Riddler Khu, who gained credibility by correctly predicting the names of both games before their official announcement at the 30th Anniversary Pokémon Presents, highlighted several critical points:

*   Late 2027 Release: This effectively deconstructs rumors of a mid-year launch, pushing the debut to the holiday season of 2027.

2026: If true, there will be no official marketing or trailers throughout 2026, breaking The Pokémon Company’s traditional hype cycle.

*   Platform Exclusive: The games are expected to be exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2, taking full advantage of the next-gen hardware.

*   Insider Consensus: These claims align with \

another insider who previously suggested a total information blackout for the current year.

links.title: Police Simulator : Car Patrol Review
links.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcxSKSHKtjM817Peapu8d8AtckRWNLa14nQZ6Q2RY5c67/265dc89437a55df99cf50a1fb7677cf5)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/51dc6aaf)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/51dc6aaf)


---

I tried Police Simulator: Car Patrol and honestly the first impression was that it is a very simple and light type of game.

It is not something that gives a super realistic police experience. It feels more like casual driving and basic patrol missions. You just drive around, respond to small calls, and complete simple tasks.

The graphics are okay. Not amazing, but not bad either. It does the job for this type of game.

One thing I noticed is that the game does not really give that serious police vibe. Everything feels a bit too easy and relaxed. There is not much tension or depth in the gameplay.

The controls are simple and easy to understand. That is good for casual players. But if someone is expecting a detailed simulation experience, they might find it a bit boring after some time.

Overall, it feels like a light time-pass game. Something you can play without stress, just to pass a bit of time. It is not great, but not completely useless either.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=inkbyte/51dc6aaf)

I tried Police Simulator: Car Patrol and honestly the first impression was that it is a very simple and light type of game.

It is not something that gives a super realistic police experience. It feels more like casual driving and basic patrol missions. You just drive around, respond to small calls, and complete simple tasks.

The graphics are okay. Not amazing, but not bad either. It does the job for this type of game.

One thing I noticed is that the game does not really give that serious police vibe. Everything feels a bit too easy and relaxed. There is not much tension or depth in the gameplay.

The controls are simple and easy to understand. That is good for casual players. But if someone is expecting a detailed simulation experience, they might find it a bit boring after some time.

Overall, it feels like a light time-pass game. Something you can play without stress, just to pass a bit of time. It is not great, but not completely useless either.

links.title: What is the purpose of our existence// My review on Mcgi
links.body:
God is the main purpose why we actually exist in this life. God intentionally created us so that we can worship him, and obey his words. In Genesis, humanity is made in the image of God, which means our lives are meant to mirror His character showing love, justice, mercy, and truth in the world. Our existence finds its deepest meaning when we live in relationship with our Creator.
https://youtu.be/--URoQAbHR8?si=1lHo8J1SrfyPHuXV
God created us for us to glorify his holy name at all time. The Scriptures repeatedly emphasize that human life is designed to bring glory to God through our actions, words, and choices. This includes living in obedience to His will and trusting Him in every season. When we align our lives with God’s ways, we fulfill the intention for which we were created.

God wants us to serve other people who are human like us with love and humility. Jesus taught that loving God and loving our neighbor are the greatest commandments. This shows that our existence is not self-centered but relational. By caring for others, helping those in need, and living with compassion, we reflect God’s heart and carry out His purpose on earth.

links.title: The Hidden Cost of Constant Comparison
links.body:
![sevenheads-fear-299679 (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdYt9z4ucLiHLLnvdp9LFLm4AT12Chmo8GDXjMobFgF16/sevenheads-fear-299679%20(1).jpg)



i dont even know when it started honestly but this thing of constantly comparing yourself with others it just becomes like background noise in your head.

like youre scrolling something or even just walking outside and your brain is just doing it without asking you.

he got that job she bought that phone this guy already traveling and me just sitting there like ok what am i even doing.

not sure why i thought that but it happens so fast you dont even catch it properly.

i remember one small thing like i was in a shop buying something simple just normal day and there was this guy in front of me paying and he had this confidence like he knew exactly what he is doing in life or maybe i just assumed that i dont know.

and i walked out thinking why i dont feel like that sometimes.

then later i was just sitting on my phone again and seeing random posts people celebrating small wins big wins vacations food everything looking perfect or maybe just framed perfect.

and it starts feeling like you are always behind even when nothing is actually wrong in your life.

weird thing is most of the time i am just fine like normal life is ok but comparison just makes it feel not enough.

and the hidden cost of it i think is not even sadness directly its more like you start losing focus on your own stuff slowly.

like you sit to do something important but your mind keeps pulling you somewhere else someone else life someone else progress.

and then you feel tired without even doing much.

dont know if that makes sense but it feels like mental noise that never switches off.

even small things like someone talking about their achievement in a casual way and suddenly you are measuring yourself without even wanting to.

i was talking to a friend few days back and he mentioned he is planning something big for next year and i just said yeah nice good for you but inside i was not even part of that conversation anymore i was somewhere else thinking about my own timeline or whatever that is supposed to be.

anyway later i felt stupid for even thinking like that because why am i turning every normal conversation into comparison.

and social media makes it worse obviously but also even offline life does it quietly.

its like you dont need apps for it your brain is already trained.

sometimes i think maybe everyone is also doing the same thing and nobody is actually as ahead or behind as it looks but still that feeling does not stop.

it just sits there.

and the worst part is you start enjoying your own moments less because they dont feel big enough or visible enough.

like eating something good or having a chill day it feels normal not worth anything because somewhere someone is doing something more exciting.

dont know if this is just how mind works or we learned it somewhere.

but yeah it drains something small from you every time.

and then you forget what you actually wanted in the first place because you are too busy checking where others are at.

i was thinking maybe just one day without looking at anything would feel different but then again i dont even know if that would fix anything or just make me think more.

anyway it just keeps going in circles in my head sometimes like now even while writing this.


![image source ](https://pixabay.com/photos/fear-terror-hidden-hands-shame-299679/)

links.title: Échame el Cuento: Así me gusta
links.body:
> Como soy un tipo tocado, o con un defecto de fábrica, relacionarme con los demás no es mi mayor virtud. Estoy aquí gracias a la invitación de la maravillosa @popurri. Desde niño, tener amigos o estar en grupos fue una tortura. No sirvo para eso. Disfruto la soledad, sumergirme en mis pensamientos, mis complicaciones, mis sueños. Recuerdo que mis hermanos menores se quejaban de que no jugaba con ellos, y los maestros siempre les decían a mis padres que yo no me animaba en los grupos para tareas escolares o iniciativas. Todo esto llevó a que me etiquetaran como introvertido. Así fue durante mucho tiempo, la mitad de mi vida. Hasta que llegó el término Asperger y la ciencia avanzó mucho más con respecto al autismo. Soy un amante de las películas. Me las devoro en el cine (cuando no hay muchas personas), en la TV o en algún dispositivo electrónico. Además, me atrae todo aquello que tenga que ver con la tecnología, pero donde no tenga que relacionarme con otros, al menos mientras lo trabajo o lo disfruto. Recuerdo que tenía una linda suegra que se ponía fea cuando me veía viendo alguna película. Al ver mis películas, me integro a la trama, vivo con los personajes y, en ese momento, soy parte del elenco. Pero esa suegrita mía no sé cómo lo hacía: se le ocurría hablarme justo cuando yo estaba en el film. Eso lo odiaba. Sí, ya sé que el tema es lo que me gusta de las personas, no al revés. Solo hago la mención de lo que no me gusta para llegar al punto. Así como mi suegrita linda me echaba a perder mis ratos, se presentaban otras personas en distintos momentos de mi vida. Esos momentos eran, o son, cuando me concentro en la solución de un problema, cuando debo entregar un proyecto o cuando sencillamente estoy disfrutando de mi soledad. Odio que la gente sea metida, que dé opiniones cuando nadie se las pide y que se meta en lo que no le incumbe. Entonces, teniendo en cuenta lo que no me gusta de las personas, puedo decir que, aun cuando tengo algo echado a perder en mi coco (según algunos), sí hay cosas que valoro de las pocas personas con las que interactúo o me relaciono, incluso de aquellas que no sé de dónde salen. Nada mejor, como menciona el texto de la iniciativa, que, al llegar a un ascensor, transporte público o salón, dar los buenos días, tardes o noches. Y son muchos los que no lo hacen. En esos momentos pienso que es posible que la persona sea introvertida o temerosa, pero jamás lo excusaría diciendo que tiene los cables cambiados como yo, porque yo, que no disfruto relacionarme con los demás, puedo saludar amablemente cuando llego a algún lugar. Eso sucede porque tuve una buena educación, y eso está por encima de cualquier condición. Lo mejor que me ha pasado es que llegaran a mi vida las redes sociales. El mundo virtual, para mí, es fascinante. No lo voy a negar: hay mucha mentira, gente mala y engaño, pero he tenido la dicha de conocer personas maravillosas. Incluso he tenido novias y una esposa. Sí, una esposa salió de una red social. Con la mayoría de las personas que he conocido en las RR. SS. he tenido buenas experiencias. No preguntan de más, no se meten en lo que no les importa o, si lo hacen, es porque yo les he abierto la puerta. En Hive, como red social que también es, me he encontrado con gente que quiero mucho. Varias de esas personas han pasado a mi entorno presencial, siendo un verdadero tesoro en mi vida. Lo que valoro en una persona es la discreción, la solidaridad y el saber escuchar sin dar opinión si no se le solicita. Eso es lo que realmente aprecio. No creas, es difícil ser yo, pero lo disfruto. Soy feliz.

links.title: IS PRAYING ENOUGH TO GET CLOSER TO GOD|| THE OLD PATH
links.body:
Prayer is a good means which we can come closer to God because that's the only way which we can communicate with God perfectly and he will listen to us. Through prayer, we express our hearts, seek guidance, and grow in trust. The Bible encourages consistent prayer as a means of building a relationship with God, as seen in 

>“Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you” (James 4:8). 

But we should have in mind that prayer doesn't go alone, for God to listen to us we must be obedient and have faith that our prayers will be answered.
https://youtu.be/vSX-kqrVyf4?si=hREsxCIqZkwBRDbO
While prayer connects us to God, a closer walk with Him also requires listening to His Word and putting it into practice. Jesus taught that relationship with God involves more than speaking it includes obedience and abiding in Him: 

>“If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, you will ask what you desire, and it shall be done for you” (John 15:7).

links.title: MLB: Recordman criollo  [ESP/ENG]  ||  OPINION
links.body: jugada en Ciudad de México dentro del coso \

, sede del equipo Diablos Rojos de la Liga Mexicana de Béisbol (LMB), sirvió como telón de fondo para la exhibición del poder al bate de los venezolanos. Favorecidos por la altura de la ciudad, los toleteros hicieron desastres el día de ayer, contrariamente al discreto marcador del sábado (6-4). Y en ésta oportunidad, un domingo en la tarde fue la motivación, para una remontada de película tal como lo habían hecho los Padres en el partido previo. Sólo que fueron los Diamondbacks quienes perdiendo 6-0 a la altura del quinto episodio, encendieron los motores por medio del bate de José Fernández (jugando el campo corto), al devolver una \

de 82 MPH a las gradas del jardín izquierdo. El venezolano tiene tal talento para batear, que no le importó la pronunciada desviación que hizo la pelota, favorecida por el aire enrarecido de la altura. La pelota viajó a 409 pies del plato y con ello, el cumanés rompía el maleficio en el marcador para los ofidios, para colocar el marcador en 6-1. En el siguiente episodio, fue segunda base Ildemaro Vargas quien removió el orgullo del desierto. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

     The Mexico City Series at 'The Vault' (Alfredo Harp Helú Stadium), home of the LMB’s Diablos Rojos, turned into a total launch pad for the Venezuelan bats. Taking full advantage of the thin air at high altitude, the hitters went absolutely ham yesterday, a far cry from Saturday’s modest 6-4 line. Sunday afternoon provided the perfect script for another comeback for the ages, mirroring the Padres' heroics from the night before. This time it was the D-backs who, trailing 6-0 in the fifth, finally found their stroke. Shortstop José Fernández sparked the rally, taking an 82 MPH sweeper deep to the left-field bleachers. The Cumaná native showed off his pure bat-to-ball skills, staying back on a pitch that had some serious bite before the altitude took over. That no-doubter traveled 409 feet, finally getting the Snakes on the board at 6-1. An inning later, it was Ildemaro Vargas’ turn to keep the desert heat coming.

# ---

![Vargas.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/242NghQBwMyvx7PL8iVAQwxh1QYcD2varb8BWYi2dhS41ne1oPg5BKGSPFN6HW66jedzb.jpg) Screenshot from [video](https://www.mlb.com/es/gameday/padres-vs-d-backs/2026/04/26/825094/final/video) --- # ![Firma Fermionico_Mesa de trabajo 1616.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fermionico/QnCF6Qc3-Firma20Fermionico_Mesa20de20trabajo2016-16.png)
#
     No sabemos si fueron los tacos o los tamales, pero el natural de Caripito estuvo a solo un sencillo de batear el ciclo, comenzando su aporte con un cuadrangular en el sexto episodio colocando las cosas 7 carreras a 2 (todavía a favor de los Padres). Más tarde, anotó la de irse arriba luego de arribar a segunda con un doble, lo cual le serviría para consolidar la ventaja ofidia en su siguiente turno. Con las bases llenas cerrando el octavo, largó un largó piconazo por encima de la raya de cal de primera, para barrer las bases. Entre ambos (Vargas y Fernández), batearon de 9-6 con 6 anotadas y 5 impulsadas, para un marcador final de 12 a 7 a favor de los Backs. Ildemaro iguala el registro de partidos consecutivos bateando de hit en inicio de temporada, que estaba en manos solitarias de Pablo \

Sandoval, estacionado en 20 juegos desde 2012. Ambos equipos dividieron honores en la serie y siguen muy de cerca a los Dodgers en la división oeste de la liga Nacional. #
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

      We’re not sure if it was the tacos or the tamales, but the Caripito native was just a knock away from hitting for the cycle. He started his tear with a solo shot in the sixth to make it 7-2. Later, after swiping second on a double, he came around to score the go-ahead run, setting the stage to put the game on ice. With the bases juiced in the bottom of the eighth, he ripped a screamer just over the first-base bag to clear the bases. Between Vargas and Fernández, they went 6-for-9 with 6 runs scored and 5 RBIs, leading the D-backs to a 12-7 victory. With that performance, Ildemaro ties the record for the longest hitting streak to start a season, a mark held since 2012 by 'Kung Fu Panda' Pablo Sandoval at 20 games. Both squads earned a split in the series and remain within striking distance of the Dodgers in the NL West.\

Tell me, have you also worked with your sister on her projects?

links.title: Why We Don’t Have Time for Ourselves Anymore
links.body:
Nowadays we all are surrounded by a lot of things and in such a situation it has become very difficult to find time for ourselves and there are very few people who can sit peacefully and think about themselves, those people who can do this, I consider them very lucky. Because nowadays life has become very hectic and in such a situation it is not possible for everyone to take care of themselves, some people are very health conscious or should I say very much concerned about themselves, so they take out time for themselves no matter what the circumstances are. Yes, everyone's circumstances are not the same but we have to work according to the circumstances and sometimes things are in our favor and sometimes they are not, we have to make them favorable to us.


![lost 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/23tv8HKFVqYz2b4CMLGwitwU6jFmfcfiBZJzxS4t33YWrhTaG33x3D1yEzhHcZFQuwmH6.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)


Nowadays it has become very difficult to find time for oneself and to think about oneself because we are surrounded by entertainment in some form or the other. Whatever you look at, you find such content in every social media that you cannot go away from it. Whether you talk about Facebook, talk about Instagram, Twitter credit YouTube, you can name anything, but if you once enter there, then it becomes a little difficult for you to get out. I also used Instagram for some time but I felt that it was taking up too much of my time and I had become too addicted to reels and I was also doing too much scrolling.


Nowadays it has become very difficult to find time for oneself and to think about oneself because we are surrounded by entertainment in some form or the other. Whatever you look at, you find such content in every social media that you cannot go away from it. Whether you talk about Facebook, talk about Instagram, Twitter credit YouTube, you can name anything, but if you once enter there, then it becomes a little difficult for you to get out. I also used Instagram for some time but I felt that it was taking up too much of my time and I had become too addicted to reels and I was also doing too much scrolling.




![lost 2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bhattg/241Qbst1aGFa7PkigmcDCEdXXh7AqZ6WfAkhhTJgj5m52UWVUXzahcdSUENudFBvVFetH.png)



[ImgSrc](ChatGpt.com)



First of all, you should consume minimum entertainment. Nowadays many people consume a lot of information unnecessarily because nowadays internet facility is available to everyone and Wi-Fi is installed everywhere due to which consuming information has become even easier. First of all, I would say to you that you should consume minimum content, consume only that which is useful to you, it is not that if you have internet then you are consuming anything, watching movies, watching web series and who knows what else.



Keep yourself alone and be united. Spend less time in the crowd and make time for yourself because when you are in the crowd you don't get as much time to think about yourself. When you are alone you get time to think about yourself and you reflect, which starts to show changes in your life. And this is also necessary if you want to achieve something different in your life, so I think that you should spend a lot of time with others and learn to be alone. This is also extremely important for everyone.

links.title: CALMING THE MIND
links.body:
<div class=text-justify>

Now I know the value of a quiet time, these days things get so busy that before I know it, I am already sleepy and looking to just eat and rest only to resume the next day and continue. Life ain’t easy you know, especially when things are happening so fast that you can hardly create time to really breathe and enjoy a few hours with yourself and your thoughts. Those who have this luxury do not know how lucky they are. There was a time I had the luxury of time and would always reflect on a lot of things. I never knew how important it was then until recently when all I want to do is reflect but will often find myself dozing off in the process due to exhaustion. In recent times I can only do 30 minutes or at most one hour a day which is very small compared to all the things I have to ponder about in a day. I have always had to snap out of the trance because I need to prepare for work, or doze off in the middle of reflection only to end up dreaming about it and waking up tired because my mind worked overnight.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmXqZZVJkxXrQ4TTVpqsxd5jNuc4knw5DS43SFR1TBy8Ch/2149291831.jpg 

<a href=\

>Image by freepik Today for example I did not want to get out of bed, but had to force myself no matter how tired I was. There were a lot of things to ponder about, and a lot of things to address, but very little to reflect on because I do not have that luxury of time, not even on weekends. These days all I am craving is a full 24 hours to myself not thinking of food or what to wear because I am fully invested in looking within myself to evaluate my actions. Although I have grown in a few areas of my life recently, I can not say my foundation is stable. I believe every growth phase in a person's life requires consolidation of their foundation. This simply means looking within themselves, back to their roots to remember why they started the growth journey in the first place, and evaluate if they are moving in the direction they hoped to reach at the beginning of their journey. After this evaluation, a person’s resolve is strengthened to attain new heights, try out new strategies to better increase progress. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRDUCxsFHMDkYoRaNXkMUUuv9AgBHWz6BTZcGNSYN6ApX/rnfetchblobtmp_fgtcef2qubuke3qlh9re6s.jpg) I strongly believe that every sane person should be doing this as often as possible, it helps reduce mistakes, it helps to evaluate one’s progress, but most of all, it helps to make a better person. When they say a lot of people do not think, this is what they mean. I know a few who would prefer sleeping or doing other things to thinking, and oftentimes these people tend to only end up thinking about problems when they start thinking instead of solutions and when you talk with them, they are usually rotating around their problems with little or no headway to the solution they need. They do not find solutions because they have not trained their minds to look for solutions which is one of the major things reflection helps people do. It helps in sharpening the mind to evaluate and it is until a person can successfully evaluate themselves, that is when they can find their flaws and think about solutions. So no evaluation, no solution and you just end up running around cycles of problems. >THIS IS MY RESPONSE TO HIVE LEARNER'S [PROMPT](https://discord.com/channels/928986840747372636/929001473231183873/1498245096640872568) FOR WEEK 215 EPISODE 1 ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYqbQGFerHXinrqqmfCGrRHtwdZRhqAtCVWMna3geK2vc/20230716_224852_0000.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@kilvnrex/calming-the-mind-ja)

>

I've resided in both rural and urban environments. As a child, I believed that life would be better if my parents would only move to the city where all the fun and action was located. Once we moved to a larger town, I came to realize that the same problems I encountered in the country was more prevalent in the city. It doesn't matter your location, it's your attitude and circumstances. That's not to say that all things will change for the better or worse. They depend on the situation one is facing and the opportunities and resources available to handle them. 

For this week's ZAPFIC Monday challenge, the prompt \

presented the opportunity for me to explore my own attitude and preference for one or the other. I share a flash fiction story along those lines. He vivido tanto en entornos rurales como urbanos. De niño, creía que la vida sería mejor si mis padres se mudaran a la ciudad, donde se concentraba toda la diversión y la actividad. Dumbo es un largometraje animado de Walt Disney. Está basado en el libro para niños homónimo de Helen Aberson e ilustrado por Harold Pearl.
El personaje principal es Jumbo Jr., un elefante pequeño que es cruelmente apodado Dumbo (en inglés, dumb significa tanto «mudo» como, despectivamente, «tonto»), y que es ridiculizado por sus grandes orejas, aunque descubre que puede volar usándolas como alas. Su único amigo es el ratón Timothy.
___

body.title: Regaining my star with Vexana (quick win) after a losing streak - Mobile Legends Bang Bang
body.body:
>


Good day, #HiveGaming community. I've been going through a rough patch in Mobile Legends Bang Bang, so the victory I'm sharing with you today is one of the best I've played with my usual team.

>Muy buen día, comunidad de #HiveGaming. Estuve pasando por una mala racha en Mobile Legends Bang Bang, por lo que la victoria que les comparto el día de hoy es una de las mejores que he jugado con mi equipo de costumbre.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![2.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/Eou6NY4BRAiqJw4Hu6a3y9LmURkhRo5XrHGBo7ja42z9HTWGDnyPeXH1MMZHC4i4Pii.png)</centeR>

<div class=\

>

We started by supporting our jungler teammate to give him an advantage over the enemy teammate. Then we moved to the center since they were trying to attack us with three players, and we needed some extra help.

Once that problem was solved, we moved as a whole team to attack the bottom turret. The enemy team was intense, trying to attack us all as a group, so as a game strategy, we stayed together most of the time.

> Iniciamos apoyando a todos al compañero de Jungla para que le llevara ventaja al del equipo contrario, luego nos fuimos por el centro ya que nos querían atacar entre tres jugadores y por lo que era necesario un poco de ayuda extra.
>
> Resuelto el problema, nos movimos como equipo completo a atacar la torreta inferior. Y es que el equipo enemigo estaba intenso queriendo atacar grupalmente a todos nosotros y fue por eso que como estrategia del juego nos mantuvimos unidos la mayor parte del tiempo.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EAVKd5XUizs


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)



<div class=\

>

I couldn't resist the urge to get some kills, and when I saw the top turret being defended by three enemy champions with very little health, I decided to do my part and take them all down. I didn't care that the enemy turret would reduce my health in the process, so I moved as fast as possible to avoid being killed by the turret.

Finally, we secured the victory after so many losing streaks, with a significant lead over the opposing team. We captured the Lord, and with him, we were able to conquer the enemy base.

> Yo no pude evitar querer obtener algunas muertes y cuando vi que la torreta superior estaba siendo defendida por tres campeones enemigos con muy poca vida, decidí aportar mi granito de arena y masacrarlos a todos, no me importaba que al hacerlo la torreta enemiga me bajara la vida, así que fui lo más veloz posible para que no me automatara.
>
> Finalmente ganamos la victoria, después de tantas rachas perdiendo, con mucha ventaja ante el equipo contrario. Capturamos al Lord y junto a él fue que logramos vencer la base enemiga.

<center>![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tmBR97B1jq2hCFXYdNMcCbR7tt2PQH3pz4Bwdv1ba42dDAPsECGacWEChaWVH89wQpp.png)</center>

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)


<center>![7.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23uExGHbbNzYxXRXALqaj2M7xCkLDiMQFymEonfHhCQnKwa2EsqriWHL8GYsqdZA1Auyn.png)</center>


<div class=\

>


On the other hand, I must highlight that I did an excellent job as a mid laner, since I was the first to clear the enemy turrets between kills. The enemy team clearly lacked performance and organization. This makes me realize that not everyone is born to play MLBB.


> Por otro lado, debo resaltar que como carril central hice un trabajo excelente ya que fui el primero en despejar las torretas enemigas entre asesinato y asesinato. El equipo enemigo claramente le faltó desempeño y organización. Con esto me doy cuenta de que no todos nacen para jugar MLBB

<center>![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tGZcJ9SwNjFaZCWY8pBFYLAUMFp4KYPSiJQnGwR4jM8ZekEKkDzdSzGYQBo6dfvVpfE.png)</center>


<div class=\

>

In the end, I managed to get back on track, racked up a few multi-kills, and outperformed everyone on my team. My team for their part, did a fantastic job, supporting everyone every step of the way.


> Al final, logré recuperar mi racha de victorias, hice unos cuantos asesinatos múltiples y destaqué más que todos los de mi equipo. Por su parte, el equipo hizo un trabajo estupendo, apoyando a todos también en cada momento.

<center>![9.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tRxG8QoogDtHDR51bmoQkNhW8hRsP4Pz4ZMGD9q5bE4qoNEvVX4emN4DY54B8tR7ByG.png)</center>

<div class=\

>

As usual, here are the final results, with which, once again, I am proud of my team and their work throughout the game.

> Como es costumbre, aquí les muestro los resultados finales, con los cuales, de nuevo, me siento orgulloso con mi equipo y por su trabajo a lo largo de la partida.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)

<center>![8.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23uEuq2DvUB6GGP4YK4ZD8MnJPi7g8adnJ18S2SJgNs6Qvw7PnM7SJSJmWfSdGG9v23Af.png)</center>

<div class=\

> Before I go, I'm sharing my profile picture so you can invite me to play over there. If you play with me, I guarantee a win. That's all for now, but not before thanking everyone who took a few minutes to read this. Until next time, cheers! > Antes de irme, les comparto mi foto de perfil para que me inviten a jugar por allá. Si juegas conmigo, te aseguro una victoria. Hasta aquí les dejo mi publicación, no sin antes darles las gracias a los que se tomaron unos minutos de su tiempo para leerme. ¡Hasta la próxima, saludos! ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)
**Las fotos usadas en este post son de mi galería y fueron tomadas como captura de pantalla de mi video de YouTube.** *The photos used in this post are from my gallery and were taken as a screenshot of my YouTube video.*

***Consider following our trail on HIVEVOTE, click on the image below. We thank all the supporters.***

body.body:
Hello to all black and white photography lovers. Today I’m sharing a criterium race held in a coastal area called Mar Azul.
I headed out with my entire arsenal (every lens I own) but in the end, I only used the Canon 24-105mm, the 70-300mm, and the Carl Zeiss 80mm. It’s funny... you never truly know what you’re going to find out there, so I carry it all just in case.
The event was divided into three categories: Women’s, Men’s U23, and Elite, but I’ve decided to mix them all together here. I chose to present these photos in black and white to create a cleaner visual line; cycling kits and bikes are often so colorful that they can distract the eye. By removing the color, I wanted to make sure you see nothing but the pure action.
I hope you enjoy the series. Best regards!

body.title: Why is it always missing? | ¿Por qué siempre falta?... Mi informe de Actifit: abril 27 2026
body.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/a28fd376-106f-4184-8cf4-460ddb292e36.jpg) Most of us have this bad habit, as far as I can tell, of always focusing on what’s missing. On one hand, it’s good to make sure we have everything we need so nothing is missing when we need it—especially during a race. But I get frustrated with myself when I don’t appreciate and recognize everything I already have. My bike is practically brand new. New aluminum frame, new carbon fork, new competition-grade drivetrain, new handlebars. But there’s always something missing 🤔. I would have liked to swap out the saddle for a carbon one and the seat as well. Carbon handlebars would also be ideal, and of course a suspension fork would be perfect. But honestly, right now I’m realizing everything I’ve achieved with my two-wheeled ride, and I’m very proud of it. And it’s with this bike that I’ll be attending ___ La mayoría tenemos esa mala costumbre según mi entender, de estar pendiente siempre de lo que falta. Por un lado está bien, de maneras de suplir todos los aspectos necesarios y que nada haga falta al momento de requerir y más aún en una competencia. Pero me enojo conmigo mismo, cuando no agradezco y me doy cuenta de todo lo que tengo. Mi bicicleta está prácticamente nueva. Cuadro de aluminio nuevo, horquilla de carbono nuevo, transmisión acorde a la competencia nuevo, forma o manubrio nuevo. Pero siempre falta algo 🤔. Hubiese querido cambiarle el porte a sillín por uno de carbono y también el asiento. También el manubrio de carbono sería ideal y por supuesto una horquilla con amortiguación sería perfecto. Pero la verdad en este momento me hago consciente de todo lo logrado en lo que hace a mi transporte de dos ruedas y estoy muy orgulloso de la misma. Y es con esa con la cual asistiré a la carrera. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/630bc143-fdd4-4c7e-984a-6598a3ddbf99.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/11a0ae4b-2ca5-401c-a2c2-45c8972b813c.jpg) Riding in the mountains, and especially in Río Pinto, has certain quirks that you need to keep in mind. Loose rocks on the trail or flat stones can cut or puncture your tires and, of course, cause you to lose time changing them. The ideal solution is always to use tubeless tires. These tires have special rims with tires designed for this purpose and contain a liquid inside that automatically seals the puncture if you get a flat. One of the best features of this setup is that you can run your tires at lower pressure, which gives you better traction on climbs and, especially, in corners. And, of course, the key advantage is that if you get a tiny puncture, you won’t even feel it. But there’s a more budget-friendly alternative, and that’s the one I’m going to use. It involves putting a self-sealing liquid inside the inner tube. Generally speaking, it serves the same purpose and is more economical. The only catch is that I can’t deflate the tires as much, so the grip is reduced. Since this is my first time on this type of track, I hope I don’t regret it. ___ Convertir en la montaña y sobre todo en Río pinto, tiene ciertas peculiaridades que hay que tomarlo en cuenta. Las piedras sueltas en el camino o lajas, pueden hacer que corte o pinche tus cubiertas y por supuesto te hagan perder tiempo haciéndole cambio pertinente. Lo ideal siempre es tubelizar las ruedas. Dichas ruedas tienen unas llantas especiales con cubiertas ideales para eso y en su interior un líquido que hace que si pinchás se auto selle automáticamente. Una de las mejores opciones o ventajas que tiene este estilo, es que puedes desinflar más los neumáticos y por supuesto tiene mejor agarre en las trepadas y en la curvas sobre todo. Y por supuesto el factor importante es que en el caso de que la pinchadura sea ínfima, ni lo sentís. Pero hay una alternativa base económica y es la que yo voy a utilizar. Se trata de colocar un líquido auto sellante en el interior de la cámara. En líneas generales cumple la misma función, es más económico. El único detalle es que no puedo desinflar tanta las cubiertas y por lo tanto el agarre es menor. Cómo es mi primera experiencia en este tipo de circuitos, espero que no me arrepienta de esta decisión. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7fc8abb4-a92a-4f9e-9a97-24e45d021368.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5464690e-6e6b-4eea-9cdc-9e85b081d80e.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e6de4e97-c765-4833-ba77-8cf29ce838c9.jpg) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/df2f1dc1-3dbb-4624-9f00-78f039c7dac1.jpg) The other day I mentioned the health benefits of beets, and I have to say we’re really seeing the benefits. If you’ve been following along, I’ve been doing very light workouts lately because of the injury I’ve mentioned in other posts, but I feel that adding beets to my diet has been very positive. If you have the chance to incorporate them into your diet, in whatever way you can, I highly recommend it. As for the fall the other day and the resulting pain I mentioned earlier, I’m really happy to report that the pain is gradually subsiding and showing signs of improvement, which makes me very happy. I only ride my bike when I go to Don Juan’s school—nothing else. Maybe before the weekend I’ll put on my cycling shorts and jersey and go out for a short ride just to get a feel for it. Next weekend is the big event, and of course we’ll be there, whether my lower back hurts or not. I hope everyone has a great day 🫂. ___ El otro día comenté de las bondades de la remolacha y debo decir que estamos obteniendo los beneficios de la misma. Si vienen estos días estoy haciendo trabajitos muy livianitos debido a la lesión contada en otras publicaciones, pero la incorporación de la remolacha en mi nutrición siento que es muy positivo. Si tienes la posibilidad de incorporar a tu nutrición, de la forma que sea, o se recomienda en demasía. Con respecto a la caída del otro día y los dolores pertinentes contados oportunamente, debo decir que vengo muy contento porque los dolores se están yendo paulatinamente pero dando síntomas de mejoras y eso me pone muy contento. Solo realizo ciclismo cuando llego a Don Juan al colegio y nada más. Quizás antes del fin de semana me ponga la calza y el jersey y salga a rodar un poquito para sentir sensaciones. El fin de semana que viene es el gran evento y por supuesto ahí estaremos, duela o no duela la cintura. Espero que todos tengan un excelente día 🫂. ___ ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/408c7ee9-81f3-4c58-8108-1cd6b1bfd17a.jpg) Photos taken with my Samsung S22.
