body.title: Airport City transport manager By Game Insight
body.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcmZsTjhuuBCJj6N7kShVZbYSEKpvpZdKtjs6nLy2Mxq/110cde7b1f103815af5f3ed336bd50e6)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/811f1f7f)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/811f1f7f)


---

so i downloaded this game airport city transport manager a few days ago. not even planned honestly. was just scrolling and saw it somewhere maybe an ad or something and i was like okay why not.

first thing i noticed was it kinda looks simple but then it isnt really. like you think oh its just planes landing and taking off but then suddenly there is buses cargo fuel timing routes everything. got a bit confusing at first. not gonna lie i just kept tapping stuff without knowing what im doing.

yesterday i was playing while sitting with chai. like actual real moment. my tea got cold because i was trying to figure out why my planes were not taking off. turns out i forgot to send passengers or something. not sure why i thought planes just go automatically.

the game feels slow sometimes. like you have to wait a lot. at first it annoyed me. then i kinda got used to it. like checking it again and again after few minutes. its weird.

also the whole transport manager thing is more than just airport. like you have to manage roads and buildings and stuff. which i didnt expect. i thought only planes but nope. its like a small city thing going on.

sometimes it feels satisfying when everything lines up. like planes landing one after another. passengers moving smoothly. and then suddenly something breaks and you are like what just happened.

graphics are okay. not bad not amazing. just fine. like you wont play it for visuals. its more like that background game you open when bored.

i did notice one thing though. it kinda makes you think about timing. like real life also. waiting for things. planning stuff. or maybe im overthinking. dont know if that makes sense.

anyway sometimes i open it just for a minute and then end up playing longer than i planned. like today i said just 5 minutes and then it was almost 20.

not sure if i will play it for long term or just get bored after some days. happens with most games. but right now its okay. like not amazing but not useless either. just somewhere in between

and yeah i still forget to send passengers sometimes. which is kinda funny because thats literally the main thing in an airport but still i mess it up. anyway.

---

▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=fearline/811f1f7f)

![header](https://media.sdafintech.com/sda-repost-aave-solana-golden-connection-landscape-wide-20260427.png)

Solana Foundation is lending USDT into Aave and bringing the AAVE token to Solana — the first time a major L1 foundation has used its treasury to back another protocol's recovery directly.

Strong signal for DeFi maturity. The unanswered questions are where the more interesting story sits:

- The loan size and terms are not public.
- The bridge mechanism isn't specified — Wormhole NTT, LayerZero OFT, or native SPL mint.
- It's unclear whether this is the AAVE token only, or a stepping stone toward Aave V3 lending markets on Solana.
- Repayment, interest, and collateral terms are undisclosed.
- It is the Solana Foundation's first-ever USDT deployment — pattern, or precedent?

What's clear either way: L1 foundations are starting to act as balance-sheet operators, not just grant-makers, and cross-ecosystem capital is moving toward where the brand value is. That's a healthy direction for the category.

Watching the details.

body.title: Education Is Not Just About Books Is About Understanding Life
body.body:
/>

Image soruce : [https://pixabay.com/](https://pixabay.com/)

  
Education is not just about books. I keep hearing this line everywhere. And honestly I used to ignore it. Like yeah yeah another deep quote kind of thing. But recently it just started making a bit more sense. Not fully but a little.

Like I remember one day in the shop. A customer came and he couldnt read properly. He was asking about a product and kept looking at the label like it would magically explain itself to him. But it didnt. And I had to explain everything slowly. And he just nodded like okay got it. But I could tell he didnt really get it fully. And it felt weird. Because in school we always think reading writing thats education thats it. But that moment felt different. Like he probably knows things I dont. Like real life things. How to deal with people. How to survive stuff I never had to think about.

And then theres the opposite too. I know people who studied a lot. Like degrees and all. But when it comes to simple situations they just freeze. Like talking to someone new. Or handling a small problem. They overthink everything. I do that too sometimes. Not gonna lie.

School never really taught us how to deal with awkward silence. Or how to say no without feeling guilty. Or how to understand what someone actually means when they say Im fine but they are clearly not fine. Like no book had that chapter I think. Or maybe I just skipped it. Who knows.

Even small things like dealing with money. Like real money. Not maths problems about trains and apples. But actual bills and random expenses that just show up out of nowhere. That feels more like education now than anything I studied before.

Anyway I was thinking about this yesterday. When I saw a kid doing homework outside my shop. He looked so stressed over something so small. And I almost wanted to tell him relax this wont even matter later. But then again maybe it does in some way. Not sure why I thought that.

I guess books give you knowledge. But life kind of forces understanding on you. Whether you want it or not. And sometimes it hits at the most random times. Like while sitting doing nothing. Or just watching people pass by.

Dont know if that makes sense. But yeah its just something thats been in my head lately. Like maybe education is happening all the time. Not just in classrooms. And we dont even notice it most of the time.

Anyway I need to open the shop again. Customers might come. And Ill probably forget about this whole thought again. Until something random reminds me again. Or maybe not. Who knows.

body.title: 6 Surprising Realities Climate Science
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNcQg1ax9LHCMrfrYbvJSUk5XEkuL8C1CAoZQPPFSMQAu/img_5503.png)


As we observe Earth Day in 2026, the global conversation has shifted from symbolic gestures to a stark reckoning with data. For decades, the environmental movement has relied on hope; today, we rely on the \

report—a synthesis of the most pressing research from the 2025/2026 cycle. The headline remains sobering: 2024 was officially the warmest year on record at 1.55°C above pre-industrial levels.

While this single-year spike does not yet represent a permanent breach of the Paris Agreement’s 1.5°C threshold, it signals that we are operating at the very edge of our planetary limits. As a strategist looking at the road to COP30 in Belém, it is clear that we are no longer predicting a crisis; we are managing an acceleration. To bridge the gap between what the science knows and how we actually live, we must confront six surprising realities that redefine our environmental strategy for the years ahead.

1. The \

Paradox: The Cost of Reflective Clouds\n\nIt is a cruel irony of climate physics that cleaning up our air is currently turning up the heat. For years, industrial sulphate aerosols—particles that reflect sunlight back into space—have acted as a temporary \

dampening the full impact of greenhouse gas warming. As we have successfully slashed these pollutants, particularly through an 80% reduction in international shipping emissions since 2020, we have unintentionally triggered a shift in Planetary Albedo.

By reducing these aerosols, we have seen fewer and less reflective clouds over the oceans. This has sent the Earth Energy Imbalance (EEI) soaring, as the planet absorbs significantly more solar radiation than it radiates back into space.

\

warming—a gap that remains even after accounting for the transition from La Niña to El Niño and the reduction in aerosols. This suggests that our current climate models may be underestimating the actual pace of warming, a reality that demands we move beyond \

mitigation.

2. The Ocean’s 13-Month Winning Streak (And Why We’re Losing)

The ocean is the planet's primary thermal buffer, but that buffer is fraying. From April 2023 to June 2024, global sea surface temperature records were shattered for 13 consecutive months. This isn't just a statistical anomaly; it is a fundamental shift in marine stability.

We are now seeing the rise of \
(MHWs) that are more frequent, intense, and persistent. On average, these events now last a full week longer than they did just forty years ago. The economic fallout for \

is staggering. For example, the Peruvian anchovy fishery—the world’s largest by volume—suffered a USD 1.4 billion loss as species were forced to migrate or face mass mortality. This is no longer an ecological niche concern; it is a systemic threat to global food security and coastal livelihoods.

3. The Carbon Credit Mirage: The 84% Failure Rate

For years, the voluntary carbon market (VCM) has been sold as a frictionless way for corporations to achieve net-zero. The 2026 data exposes this as a dangerous mirage. An exhaustive analysis of nearly one billion tons of issued credits found that only 16% represented actual, verifiable emission reductions. In other words, 84% of these credits failed to deliver on their climate promise.

This integrity crisis has created a \

allowing corporations to use low-cost, low-quality credits to postpone the hard work of direct decarbonization. The failure is not limited to developing regions; it is systemic across the globe. Project types that have consistently under-achieved or lacked \

include:

* Improved forest management in the USA
* Grid-connected wind power in China
* Cookstove distribution programs
* Avoided deforestation (REDD+) initiatives

To maintain any shred of credibility, we must shift from viewing credits as a substitute for emissions cuts to treating them as a secondary contribution to global mitigation.

4. A 50% \
on the Global Workforce\n\nWe are effectively sleepwalking into a global \

that will redefine the cost of every item in our supply chain. The data shows that 1°C of additional warming could reduce working hours by as much as 50% in tropical regions due to unsafe heat stress levels.\n\nThe \

perspective requires us to look beyond the direct labor loss in the South. While the most severe impacts are felt in developing nations, the economic shocks are amplified globally through trade. The 2026 report highlights a critical shift in \

modeling: as we move from simple historical trends to more complex structural models that account for supply chain persistence, our estimates of GDP loss are doubling.

Under a high-emissions scenario, global annual GDP losses are projected at 1.4%–4.5%. The economic justification for mitigation is now undeniable: a low-emissions pathway limits these losses to 0.1%–0.8%. Protecting the tropical workforce is not just a matter of equity; it is a necessity for the stability of Northern economies.

5. When the \

: The Boreal Warning

One of the most terrifying shifts in Earth system science is the weakening of our natural carbon sinks. In 2023, the global land carbon sink dropped sharply, largely driven by catastrophic wildfires in the Canadian boreal forest. These fires alone released carbon comparable to the entire annual fossil fuel emissions of the European Union.

The \

has also moved from a future risk to a current reality. Approximately one-third of the Arctic-boreal land area has now transitioned from a net sink to a net source of CO2, methane (CH4), and nitrous oxide (N2O). As the Northern Hemisphere—long considered a stable carbon stronghold—begins to exhale more carbon than it absorbs, the \

available to humanity shrinks even further.

6. The Silent Expansion: A Temperate Zone Health Crisis

Climate change is redrawing the map of human health, and the 2026 numbers are historic. Dengue fever surged to a record 14.2 million cases in 2024, driven by expanding mosquito habitats and lengthened transmission seasons.

The \
element for Western policymakers is the expansion into temperate zones. We are no longer talking about a \

Hotspots are now appearing in urban settings in Italy and France, and at altitudes in Nepal that were previously too cold for mosquito survival. This is a health system crisis that threatens to overwhelm infrastructure in the Global North, proving that no altitude or latitude is immune to the biological shifts of a warming world.

Conclusion: From Knowledge to Global Citizenry

The 2026 state of climate science reveals that we are caught in an accelerating feedback loop. We can no longer treat biodiversity loss and climate change as separate issues; the loss of species diversity directly weakens the land's ability to store carbon, which in turn accelerates warming and further destroys biodiversity.

As EARTHDAY.ORG President Kathleen Rogers emphasizes, “We need to build a global citizenry fluent in the concept of climate change and inspired by environmental education to act in defense of the planet.”

The data is clear: our natural buffers—the oceans, the forests, and the very soil beneath us—are reaching their limits. As we look toward the \

in Belém, we must ask ourselves the most urgent question of the decade: If our planet’s natural systems are reaching their breaking point, are we prepared to accelerate our own transformation to match the pace of the warming world?\n

>\nSeagulls, fishermen, restaurants, and some of the best views over the <a href=\
>Golden Horn — all in one place. Some are fishing, some are dining, and some are simply watching it all unfold, trying to capture it all.

> On the upper deck — cars, trams, and pedestrians. The fishermen here are almost a local tradition. Sometimes they catch something, sometimes they don’t, but you’d never know from their faces whether it even matters.

> People step out to the water, light a cigarette, lost in their own thoughts. Some do it as if they’ve been rehearsing the scene all evening.
>\nLook one way — a dense cityscape, with the <a href=\
>Galata Tower rising above it all, a reference point around which the city seems to arrange itself. In photos, everything looks a bit more composed than it really is.
> Turn your head the other way — the historic district. Mosques and minarets line the waterfront, forming a skyline that’s instantly recognisable.

> And all of this together — not just a bridge. More like an observation deck, a fishermen’s club, and a culinary corner all rolled into one. You come here to cross to the other side — and you stay. Until sunset.

>

body.title: What Is Off-Page SEO? Meaning & Link Building Guide
body.body:
></center>

What Is Off-Page SEO? Meaning, How To Do It & Strategies That Work  
If you want to grow your website traffic and rank higher on Google, understanding Off page seo is essential. It helps search engines evaluate your website’s credibility and plays a major role in improving your seo rankings.  
Before we go deeper, let’s first understand what is seo. Search engine optimization is the process of optimizing your website to increase its visibility on search engines and attract organic traffic.

What Is Off Page SEO?  
Many beginners ask, what is off page seo?  
It refers to all activities done outside your website to improve its ranking. The off page seo meaning focuses on building authority through backlinks, social signals, and brand mentions.  
In simple terms, off page optimization helps search engines trust your website and consider it valuable.

SEO Basics You Must Know  
To understand off-page SEO, you need to know:

What does seo stand for – It stands for search engine optimization

What is search engine optimization – A process to improve visibility

What does seo mean – It means optimizing your website

The seo meaning and seo definition are all about improving search performance.  
Many businesses hire a seo company or experienced seo firms to manage their SEO campaigns.

Why Off Page SEO Is Important  
Search engines consider many [off page seo factors](https://www.ravi-gupta.com/what-is-off-page-seo/) when ranking websites.  
Here’s why off page seo matters:

Builds trust and authority

Increases domain strength

Drives referral traffic

Improves seo rankings

Without proper off page optimization, it is difficult to compete in search results.

Top Off Page SEO Techniques  
Here are the most effective off page seo techniques:

1.  Link Building  
    Backlinks are the backbone of seo off page activities. They act as signals of trust.
    
2.  Guest Posting  
    Writing articles on other websites helps you gain backlinks and exposure.
    
3.  Social Media Promotion  
    Sharing content increases reach and engagement.
    
4.  Influencer Outreach  
    Working with influencers helps build authority.
    
5.  Directory Submissions  
    Submitting your site to directories is a reliable off page seo techniques strategy.
    

Key Off Page SEO Factors  
Focus on these important off page seo factors:

Quality backlinks

Domain authority

Relevant linking websites

Natural anchor text

These factors directly affect your seo optimization performance.

How To Do Off Page SEO  
Follow these steps:  
Step 1: Create High-Quality Content  
Content is the foundation of seo copywriting. It helps attract backlinks naturally.  
Step 2: Build Backlinks  
Focus on relevant and high-quality links.  
Step 3: Promote Content  
Use social media and online communities.  
Step 4: Monitor Results  
Regularly perform an audit seo to improve your strategy.

Off Page SEO and SEO Strategies  
Effective seo strategies include both on-page and off-page SEO. On-page improves your website, while off-page builds its authority.  
Together, they strengthen your [search and engine](https://www.ravi-gupta.com/what-is-seo/) presence.

SEO Best Practices  
Follow these seo best practices:

Focus on quality over quantity

Avoid spammy backlinks

Stay consistent

Build relationships

These practices help improve your seo rankings over time.

Common Mistakes to Avoid  
Avoid these mistakes in off page optimization:

Buying low-quality backlinks

Ignoring relevance

Keyword stuffing

Not tracking performance

Avoiding these mistakes improves your seo optimization results.

Final Thoughts  
Understanding what is seo and applying the right off page seo techniques is essential for long-term success. It helps build authority, trust, and visibility.  
Focus on quality backlinks and smart seo strategies to succeed in search engine optimisation.

FAQs

1.  What is Off Page SEO?  
    What is off page seo refers to actions taken outside your website to improve rankings and authority.
    
2.  Why is Off Page SEO important?  
    It helps build trust, authority, and improve seo rankings.
    
3.  What are the best Off Page SEO techniques?  
    Top off page seo techniques include link building, guest posting, and social sharing.
    
4.  How long does Off Page SEO take?  
    It usually takes a few months to see results.
    
5.  What is the difference between SEO and Off Page SEO?  
    What is seo is the complete process, while off-page SEO focuses on external activities.

Saludos, gamers que dan vida a #Splinterlands. El post anterior les mencioné que la suerte está siempre a mi favor y en esta ocasión, la perseverancia y las ganas de jugar a diario lo demuestran ya que hoy me llevé la gran sorpresa con una carta invocadora en su versión más bonita y poderosa, la negra.

> Greetings, gamers who bring #Splinterlands to life. In my last post, I mentioned that luck is always on my side, and this time, my perseverance and desire to play daily proved it, as today I got a great surprise with a summoner card in its most beautiful and powerful version: the black one.

<center>![sep.2026.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tbPXTf1bvy4jaGNjptgQFy5gWYhWKJKS8g2jUuibSPhe56BuNS1C7amKtxLNKAEqeKn.png)</center>

Y es que con esto Splinterland me demuestra que me quiere mucho y que además *la suerte está siempre a mi favor*. Nunca pensé que me saldría tan pronto mi primera carta negra y menos de un invocador. Las probabilidades de que eso suceda son ¿100 a 1? La verdad no tengo idea, pero sé que es poco probable.

>
> Splinterland is showing me how much it loves me, and that luck is always on my side. I never thought I'd get my first black card so soon, let alone a summoner card. The odds of that happening are 100 to 1? I honestly have no idea, but I know it's highly unlikely.


<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 12.27.56 PM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23u5ZEDgdERFeWXCZoEUH4qJaXZiQT95G7baAPYdrJ7GMEuPM8PoBRd5cW69cwHJtanT9.jpeg)</center>




<div class\

>

Aquí les muestro el momento exacto en el que me salió, de la emoción no lo podía creer hasta que le tomé la foto y obtuve pruebas tangibles y verifiqué que estuviera en mi cuenta luego de aceptarla. Es lo más increíble que me ha pasado en Splinterlands hasta el momento.

No saben lo mucho que me he divertido jugando y sobre todo comprando cartas lindas para venirlas a compartir con ustedes y mostrarles cómo mi colección va creciendo poco a poco.

> Here's the exact moment I got it! I was so excited I couldn't believe it until I took the picture and had tangible proof, and I verified it was in my account after accepting it. It's the most incredible thing that's happened to me in Splinterlands so far.
>
> You have no idea how much fun I've had playing and especially buying beautiful cards to share with you all and show you how my collection is growing little by little.


<center>![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 12.27.56 PM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/EoEhpTiSjgtpNeV19sYPNZjyQXKbN4ha94zHrDCqAp8qAtCD3zgG65g27AfmcdkKwNR.jpeg)</center>

Otra carta que me gané en el programa de *La Taberna de @bulkathos* es la del elemental de agua llamado **Coralforged**. Un tanque nivel 1 que aunque tiene poca defensa tiene suficiente vida como para dar batalla, además, hace buen daño cuerpo a cuerpo. Sin duda esta carta valdrá la pena subirla de nivel en su momento.

> Another card I won on the show *La Taberna de @bulkathos* is the water elemental called **Coralforged**. A level 1 tank that, although it has low defense, has enough health to put up a fight, and it also deals good melee damage. This card will definitely be worth leveling up eventually.


<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pannavi/23tRxJ4DdT4UYWJ97sSEd34MavQNENX1X63d9qd2zTJ2Q4dfpwEjCcDL2S89rTG1u3mNc.png)</center>

> I also can't help but share the moment I got the message that I reached Gold Level I. This day really couldn't have been better, and I don't even like Mondays that much, but if this is how I started the week, full of pure success, I can't imagine what other surprises await me in the coming days.

links.title: [EN/Spn] just me and my small hometown shop.
links.body: /> so yeah this is kinda random but i thought maybe i should just write something about myself and what i do. not like a proper intro or anything just typing whatever comes in mind. i run a small shop in my hometown. its not something big or fancy just a normal shop like the ones you see in every street. sometimes i still think how i ended up doing this. like i studied something else and life just went in a different direction. not complaining tho. just saying. morning usually starts slow. i open the shop shutters and that sound. idk why but it feels like the real start of the day. sometimes there is already one customer waiting. which honestly feels weird and nice at the same time. like bro give me 2 minutes at least. i sell basic stuff daily use things snacks small items. nothing special but people come regularly. same faces everyday. some dont even say much just come take what they need and leave. some talk too much. like way too much. and i just stand there listening thinking about something else. one small moment i remember from last week. a kid came with coins in his hand. like proper counting each one before giving me. he wanted a small chocolate and he was short by like 5 rupees. i just gave it to him anyway. he smiled and ran away. idk why but that moment stayed in my head for a while. maybe because things are simple for kids. or maybe i just overthink small stuff. sometimes shop gets really quiet. like hours go by and nothing happens. i just sit there scrolling my phone or staring outside. watching people pass by. thinking random things. like what they do where they going. not sure why i think that. and then suddenly rush comes and i dont even get time to sit. its funny how that works. all empty then all busy. no balance at all. people think running a small shop is easy. maybe it is in some way. but doing same thing everyday. it does something to your mind. not bad just repetitive. like you are there but also not fully there. anyway i dont even know why im writing all this. maybe just felt like putting it out somewhere. or maybe just bored right now sitting in the shop waiting for next customer. someone just walked in so yeah. gonna stop here i guess. \==========================================

/>

  

Bueno, esto es un poco aleatorio, pero pensé que tal vez debería escribir algo sobre mí y lo que hago. No es una presentación formal ni nada, solo lo que se me ocurra.

Tengo una pequeña tienda en mi ciudad. No es grande ni elegante, solo una tienda normal como las que ves en cada calle. A veces todavía me pregunto cómo terminé haciendo esto. Como si hubiera estudiado otra cosa y la vida simplemente hubiera tomado un rumbo diferente. No me quejo, solo lo digo.

La mañana suele empezar despacio. Abro las persianas de la tienda y ese sonido... No sé por qué, pero se siente como el verdadero comienzo del día. A veces ya hay un cliente esperando. Lo cual, sinceramente, se siente raro y agradable a la vez. O sea, dame al menos dos minutos.

Vendo cosas básicas, artículos de uso diario, snacks, cosas pequeñas. Nada especial, pero la gente viene con regularidad. Las mismas caras todos los días. Algunos ni siquiera dicen mucho, solo entran, toman lo que necesitan y se van. Otros hablan demasiado. Muchísimo. Y yo me quedo ahí parado escuchando, pensando en otra cosa.

Un pequeño momento que recuerdo de la semana pasada. Un niño vino con monedas en la mano, contándolas una por una antes de dármelas. Quería un chocolate pequeño y le faltaban como 5 rupias. Se lo di igual. Sonrió y salió corriendo. No sé por qué, pero ese momento se me quedó grabado. Quizás porque para los niños las cosas son sencillas. O quizás le doy demasiadas vueltas a las cosas.

A veces la tienda se queda muy tranquila. Pasan horas y no pasa nada. Me quedo sentada mirando el móvil o mirando por la ventana, viendo pasar a la gente, pensando en cosas al azar, como qué hacen o adónde van. No sé por qué pienso eso.

Y de repente llega la hora punta y ni siquiera tengo tiempo para sentarme. Es curioso cómo funciona. Todo vacío, luego todo lleno. Sin ningún equilibrio.

La gente piensa que llevar una tienda pequeña es fácil. Quizás lo sea en cierto modo. Pero hacer lo mismo todos los días te afecta mentalmente. No es malo, solo repetitivo. Es como si estuvieras ahí, pero a la vez no del todo.

En fin, ni siquiera sé por qué estoy escribiendo todo esto. Quizás solo sentí la necesidad de desahogarme. O tal vez simplemente estoy aburrido ahora mismo sentado en la tienda esperando al próximo cliente.

Acaba de entrar alguien, así que sí. Creo que me voy a quedar aquí.

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

links.title: Relato: Las reflexiones de Ileana
links.body: https://64.media.tumblr.com/cc704173b5cba870764df8db604e0625/eadea922dbaebaf2-2d/s1280x1920/b9571b2f71286c2597bcf98d72e63c2d634a638a.png **Imagen editada con Canva. Fuente de la imagen: [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/es-es/foto/cafeina-cafe-beber-bebida-18330454/)**

> Mientras degustaba el té de jazmín con maracuyá, Ileana se sentó en uno de los banquillos de la plaza, con la mente hundida en una serie de pensamientos sobre su vida, su futuro y sus esperanzas. Se sentía estancada, desanimada, y decepcionada de la vida misma. Sentía que ya no podía más con el ritmo de vida que tenía hasta ese momento.

A sus 39 años, muchas personas de su círculo se habían casado o ya tenían pareja; tenían uno, dos, hasta tres empleos cuyos salarios les permitía llevar, si bien no muchos lujos, pero sí una vida digna dentro de lo que cabía en una economía donde todo se iba por las nubes.

Ileana estuvo en ambos lados de la moneda, entre la formalidad y la informalidad, pero el dinero que ganaba se iba a las deudas, a los gastos de la casa y a alguno que otro gustito.

Meses atrás intentó poner un pequeño negocio de papelería; no duró más que seis meses, por no decir un suspiro. Esa experiencia le hizo comprender que ella necesitaba herramientas necesarias para navegar por el mundo del emprendimiento.

De hecho, consideró cambiarse de giro, ¿pero cuál podría generarle ganancias recurrentes? Todo estaba saturado, desde la cosmética hasta la comida; en este último rubro hay una competencia feroz en los cuales la mitad sobrevive y la mitad perece. Algunos lo emparejaban con la creación de contenido y la IA, y otros más con empleos de oficina.

¿Qué más podía hacer?

Tenía que sentarse a pensar bien qué, cómo y por dónde empezar.

Quizás por eso no desesperaba; más bien le alimentaba la esperanza de que algún día pudiera ganarse algún premio gordo de lotería o la rifa de alguna casa, que era uno de sus sueños.

Sueños guajiros, se decía a sí misma mientras se levantaba. Pero eran sueños que se permitía tener.

links.body: Mike was a global popstar and a music phenomenon that broke many barriers and set unbreakable records ever known in the music industry. He was once just a little boy from the state of Gary, Indiana.\n\n       He was pushed into the music business  by his father joe who was very harsh and non empathetic,he usually teased his son for his big nose even if he inherited it from him,he would  say to his son \

.Mike held a lot of resentment against his father who made him hate his features .
      In the summer of 1970,he had broken off from   his band mates (who were also his brothers)to pursue a solo career in music,this was a great move ,he became  a music sensation.


     Fastworward to December 1983,mike as a  solo artist, put out album named \
it was a success, he was named \
was released and became and instant hit,Thriller has the Guinness world book of records for the \

.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdHa7PxkfTHbMvP9JtANMdo7eHv5TAzykVR2TLSbMUgMV/1776956555604.jpg)
Image source: https://unsplash.com/photos/a-man-standing-on-a-sidewalk-in-front-of-a-store-jWJn5vG4tns



       In everyones house ,you'd see  a big poster of  Mike's \
album cover either in the living room or bedroom.everybodys favourite artist was Mike,every one wanted to learn how to do the moonwalk.\n\n   \

,Oprah Winfrey,a high class tv host asks Mike during an interview.\nWhile walking through the streets of any country,you would see people dressed up as Mike,wearing a fedora hat,a jacket with an arm band,one white glove covered in rhinestones, grabbing their crotch as trying to imitate Mike's \

,Mike was a worldwide phenomenon,a unique phenomenon who was never surpassed in success.
 This success came with a lot of problems,the bigger the star,the bigger the target.

Many journalists sought out big stars,to pull down and gain monetary benefits off of.the bigger the downfall,the bigger the pay.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfC3dUvMXfNy5Cmtn2Fym14yKqRxjCZsoGp95p13eCwuz/1776957202706.jpg)
Image source: https://www.pexels.com/photo/silver-handcuffs-on-top-of-bundled-paper-money-6266771/
Mike created a sort of wonderland to make up for his lost childhood,it resembled a children's playground you would see at a carnival or at Disney land,there were roller coasters,swing sets,bouncy castles,slides ,a large house that contained stories of bed rooms for children to play in.Mike created this happy place for children who couldn't afford the luxury to have fun,he was a child at heart too and loved playing even at his big age,he loved being around children because they were pure and not judgemental.The media didn't take this very well,his intentions were misinterpreted.It was summer 2005,and the very first allegations on sexual molestation by a child came out,even after Mike was proven innocent,the media and Hollywood still sought to tear him down.
    
    They falsely misinterpreted stories usually got sold in Hollywood rather than the truthul ones,They called him names like \
, and with his middle name being \

,every journalist wanted money,whether the story was true or not,that was Hollywood for you.

       Being the year 2005,where there was no social media, celebrities relied on journalists,talk shows to promote their movies ,albums and to show the public and their fans their different personalities.In Mike's case he wanted to clear his name even if he had been proven innocent,he couldn't believe that the world and different articles and magazines thought such of him,it made him sad how some of his fans thought of him, especially the kids.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjk1EikdUMAcXRENJpT7tfUAsjg5iWMHpwV7e5z3utaS/1776956910160.jpg)
ImageSource:  https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-reporter-holding-a-microphone-near-a-red-van-10464798/
In October of that year he contacted Amy Sonia,a female journalist for a sit down and talk interview called \

, she stooped low and falsely altered the tapes to make it seems like he was a weird guy who loved the presence of children .she generated a huge sum of money from this interview. 

Mike would release home videos and tapes of his childhood,and other self recorded tapes to show  how he was like indoors, people saw he was truly a sweet soul,they found out how charismatic he was, people who thought he was always a workaholic saw the version of Mike who loved to play hide and go seek games,he didn't even like dancing although being one of the greatest dancers and entertainers if all time.
Martin Bashir,(a trusted friend of his and a well known journalist) was one of the people who tried to destroy Mike's image,he even conducted a sit down interview with the children who accused mike, These false stories triggered a lot of people and vastly damned his reputation.
    
               On June 2009 after Mike had passed away,footages which he authorized to be released after he passed were eventually Shown to the world,these including day to day footage of kids in the fantasy land,investigators went through them,no clip in the king sized bedroom showed Mike touching the children,the child,dainty who had previously accused Mike in 2005 later admitted his parents forced him to lie about Mike in 2005 for money,he later committed suicide in November of 2009.
      
     During a podcast with a popular talkshow host,Howard Stern.Amysonia came forward and apologized for purposely releasing false stories and later admitted on live television that she had lied for money due to her financial situation at the time.

     She mostly apologized to maintain her reputation .
 Other journalists soon discovered that the man who had been famous since he was a child  was making up for his loss of childhood and helping underprivileged  children and their dreams come true.

宫保鸡丁是一道让我无比喜爱的经典川菜。每当我品尝到那口感鲜嫩的鸡肉、香脆的花生和清脆的青椒时，总能感受到味蕾的刺激与满足。那浓郁的酱汁，搭配独特的辣味，让人忍不住多吃几口。无论是作为主菜还是配米饭，宫保鸡丁总能带给我温暖与幸福的滋味，是我心中的“ comfort food”。

links.title: Testing Filters in the Wilderness.
links.body:
>

I discovered Eivor's skeleton before taking a break from the Animus to explore the surrounding woods. After witnessing a falling satellite and finding an old invitation in a mailbox, I browsed Layla's personal photos for inspiration. Following a brief photography session of my own, I returned to the cabin to dive back into the past.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaMMmQn6bW6NtTFmGvFH67UeB9DKKC652qHzcRTntB5qp/screenshot_1_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVGKPifiqN2tn8C1RL4TZLaQJZKGob4ryWjm5i67zH8D6/screenshot_2_.png)

I got surprised to know it was actually the skeleton of Eivor buried right there in the America soil, thousands of miles from Norway. It was a haunting discovery that connected the ancient past to our current struggle in a way I didn't expect when I first discovered this remote location.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT9YgfCq7VgfsSR19DFf2wi8tVwL6yva7rhodq9wTaxSd/screenshot_3_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYEWt8o4Pj5ff4JfeeL8XmZ4vTJ4Lz6ZBqQChnTSymnJd/screenshot_4_.png)

Before getting back into that shed to interact with Shaun and the rest of the team, I wanted to check around the immediate area. The air seemed cold, and the history of the land felt heavy beneath my feet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYMgbzJ5RraWPHE9vKBG5PCZ5L4DBKB5Vw7oFUzXmMdx/screenshot_6_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd95kkqNKu5XxQ1sJeUM1VxGM7rzEitd57GEYF7sJMAuD/screenshot_5_.png)

I went back into the house, where I found Shaun and Rebecca busy monitoring the equipment. Rebecca said sorry about pulling Layla out of the Animus so abruptly because the generator was sputtering and losing power.

She mentioned she should need a second to stabilize the connection before I could safely jump back into the animus.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf2rR4LEKu84kdnvcB1JVXV2nGYfgUqHomyde5c7r6kXK/screenshot_7_.png)

Rebecca then said the Animus was ready for me to jump back in, but I decided to check around the yard a bit more while I had the chance to breathe.

Right after getting outside, I noticed there was a satellite falling across the earth like a massive missile.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcMGNCMFpwkjvh7pK3nJsZWbxCUu8fHec1g7p8AU83siz/screenshot_8_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPhxyzczyvYNwx9hc75X9RvWKmJxvvJBMFWq6LGZfnvh8/screenshot_9_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTqonNz9k9a6eVQgxaVpECGmmndk26MXP3g7oDMPgCGTp/screenshot_10_.png)

I decided to check if there was a way out of this isolated place.. I found this old mailbox with a mail of an invitation to a fair in Concord tucked inside.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAFvDBKnQLL19uPmjikkeUV8nMkGMQeuBXDDgsoFfP18/screenshot_11_.png)

I found a route that looked like it should take me out of this place. But as I tried, Layla mentioned we can't run away from this, so I had to come back. The invisible walls of our mission felt just as real as the wooden walls of the house.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZkTQisBoQAddqLQEFgsBZorLgEZfVFCo1qv1CqZRYzvP/screenshot_12_.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVHxppLdJPGkJy68UqTe79WWKjDokPytzkDd5AiRxFZ5x/screenshot_13_.png)

After coming back to the house, I checked on this laptop where I found a folder named \

. There were some cool photographs that Layla captured from around this place, and the images inspired me to go out and try some of my own photography before heading back into the past. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaeBQZkB65JndkRoPFnuvaNV7Axd5PmHP4HF9v7nTukAU/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYHYaqcBkcuyrq59dncWRGzQtWW1Z5AUKQ4bov2oSJ2oi/screenshot_15_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUjtJ32nPB9egiSJyjHSNXUde3RX9ube9PPbPmYmivo5Z/screenshot_16_.png) This time I tried some special filters along with some good angles for the photos shown above. I spent some time framing the trees and the cabin, trying to capture the beauty of this site. It was a brief moment of creative distraction that should help clear Layla's mind before the next long session in the simulation. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT4ZuNFbSibrCqf49Kxe2T8Fuu13eQhG5WkJzm2zhUwdx/screenshot_17_.png) And look what I found while exploring the back of the property. A small toilet that had a hole of a heart shape on the door. I took a quick photo of it, finding a bit of humor in the small things that survived the passage of time. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcFtGDee2zR1XeQrNtc8HxouezwzvMHmzznjiguhJ6Fy5/screenshot_18_.png) I went back inside the house as I finally decided to jump back in the Animus and continue Eivor's story. Just before going back in, I found this floral plant that looked beautiful in the soft light of the cabin. That's all for now. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=coooldude/f2ba9026)

The call for R&D support was answered faster than a 7 speed Sneak attack. I am incredibly hyped to announce that **iblast arcade** has officially acquired its first plot of land to begin deep-dive research into our upcoming game modes. A massive shout-out and a huge thank you to **@warrentrx** for kicking off this adventure. Thanks to his generous donation, the **iblast** research team (that's me) is moving into: 📍 **Region:** Shimmering Coast 📍 **Plot:** Doom Eden #140 📍 **Type:** Common Occupied If you find yourself wandering around the Shimmering Coast in Praetoria, stop by and say hi! Just watch out for the construction zones—we’re moving in fast. ![Screenshot 2026-04-24 105546.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23tbRLcd8sw1dqk16GwanozQ11ndCmMDiFE8phwzVzgUPCTsN94ZrTWE3NZhQGnyw1pRA.png) ### 🎥 The Maiden Voyage: Co-Hosted Stream To christen this new voyage into the Land mechanics, we are planning a special \

stream. I’ll be joined by the legendary **Level Up Life** to load up the plot with its first power core and get some workers on the ground.

We are currently syncing our watches (which is a challenge when the community is spread across every time zone on the planet!) to finalize a time and date. Stay tuned—I’ll be posting the official schedule very soon.

---

### 📦 Expanding the R&D Kit

![mission.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/iblast/23wqiHb1MX6jHXDdoT96778YZCjDuwJKpJisvqqynZB9QUkFEHLpQ8GdUc5V8NhS6Wh86.jpg)
While the land is secured, the research is just beginning. To truly stress-test the \
concepts and build better UI tools, we are still looking for \
Note: We do have a rare totem donated to the stream by Matt\

Clarke! @MattClarke! 
assets:

* **Worker Cards** (To get the gears turning)
* **DEC** (For energy and infrastructure)


On a recent stream, we joked about needing **lawn mowers, curtains, garbage cans, and lawn accessories.** While I’m *fairly* sure those aren't standard Splinterlands items yet, if you’ve got 'em, send 'em! 

**Note:** We are gladly accepting anything that helps the cause. Just know that in the name of science, we might break some stuff in the process. Sorry in advance!

---

### 📝 Transparency & Appreciation
Every single item sent to the **iblast** wallet is documented. These aren't just assets; they are tools that allow me to build better experiences for this entire community. 

It truly is amazing how this game brings people together from all corners of the globe. Whether you're donating a plot or just hanging out in the chat, I appreciate your time and support more than I can say.

See you on the Shimmering Coast!

**- iblast**

links.title: 🎵Music Community. Vuelo 090 - Sir Augusto Ramírez. Orquesta Regional Alma Llanera de Apure.
links.body: > ## Uno de mis arreglos musicales más icónicos Me gusta mucho hacer arreglos para formato alma llanera, pero escribirle a instrumentos tradicionales no es nada fácil, sin mentirles, es más difícil escribirle a un conjunto folclórico que ha cualquier otro formato musical, esto se debe a que este tipo de Orquestas son relativamente nuevas, no existen manuales de Orquestación para Orquesta Alma llanera, y creo que para ningún tipo de Orquesta Tradicional en el mundo. Los instrumentos tradicionales o populares no estan ideados para leer partitura, están pensados para hacer música en el momento, la guitarra clásica es un instrumento relativamente nuevo en el mundo académico, ya que ella siempre ha sido un artilugio de expresión popular, su ingreso a las salas de concierto fue algo que se logro con mucho trabajo y dedicación. Yo estoy en un momento histórico donde la música Venezolana esta viviendo una transformación que en mi criterio nunca había pasado con ninguna expresión sonora en el mundo, el Sistema ha dado la posibilidad de profesionalizar la música tradicional del pueblo venezolano, Bandolistas, Arpistas llaneros, Maraqueros y Cuatristas de todas partes del país estudiando Solfeo, descifrando notaciones musicales para ser interpretadas por sus instrumentos, es algo surrealista, estoy en el Génesis de un suceso que sobrepasa mi comprensión. Por ende, hacer un arreglo para este tipo de agrupaciones es dar un salto al vacío, es incursionar en un mundo sonoro nunca antes explorado, tengo la oportunidad de crear colores que ni Beethoven, ni Bach, ni Debussy, ni ninguno de los grandes iconos de la música occidental europea pudieron siquiera soñar. Este arreglo es producto de esa búsqueda por lograr una estética personal con instrumentos tradicionales venezolanos.

> ## One of my most iconic musical arrangements I truly enjoy arranging for the **Alma Llanera** format, but writing for traditional instruments is no easy task. Truth be told, it is harder to write for a folk ensemble than for any other musical format. This is because these types of orchestras are relatively new; there are no orchestration manuals for an **Alma Llanera Orchestra**, and I believe that holds true for any type of traditional orchestra in the world. Traditional or folk instruments are not designed for reading sheet music; they are meant for making music in the moment. Even the **classical guitar** is a relatively new instrument in the academic world, as it has always been a tool for popular expression; its entry into concert halls was an achievement reached through immense work and dedication. I find myself in a historical moment where **Venezuelan music** is undergoing a transformation that, in my opinion, has never happened with any other sonic expression in the world. *El Sistema* has provided the opportunity to professionalize the traditional music of the Venezuelan people. **Bandolistas, llanero harpists, maraqueros, and cuatristas** from all over the country are studying solfège, deciphering musical notations to be interpreted by their instruments. It is something surreal; I am at the genesis of an event that surpasses my understanding. Therefore, creating an arrangement for these types of groups is a **leap of faith**; it is venturing into a sonic world never before explored. I have the opportunity to create colors that neither Beethoven, nor Bach, nor Debussy, nor any of the great icons of Western European music could have even dreamed of. This arrangement is the product of that search to achieve a **personal aesthetic** with traditional Venezuelan instruments. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=guitarmcy/f3a0405e)

links.title: [EN/PT-BR] New version of Horizon Forge with improvements and fixes.
links.body:
>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23u65CPHrKoqL7FqkHAeYg7URmMkZRbFeXzVwmeAZ6L2SxecgAuYA7x9SWKEhWnsJHgdr.png)[ Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/atualizacao-do-projeto-de-ortografia-de-dois-blocos-scrabble-em-uma-tabela-21mUU21Z20Q)</center>

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tRsvbYmyaKs1XCHuRu9EuFPE7RuSULkjPhMoGtejjyqQTZ9vqLaDsDigKyK3dFFUrR8.png)</center>

<center>New version in production folks!</center>

* I applied some internal improvements, separated some information into smaller files, so that the HTML is smaller and less polluted, leaving all the .css in respective files.


* There was an error/bug when using Silas, the assassin class. At the beginning of the match in the preparation phase, when his skill was activated \

, the skill's damage was applied, but his attack was skipping, so I managed to find the problem and fix it.


* When you finish a round of a duel, you no longer need to click on the blue button to start the next match, this will be done automatically! This guarantees more agility for players, more time and more battles!


* The paladin in the preparation phase has the ability to grant a bonus to the maximum life of his allies, there was already a green glow effect and now I added the \

indicating how much life was added. I think I can change this color to green and also see a way to add indication of buffs and debuffs. I think of some icons or something above the cards on the battlefield.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tH1HMaLffcryD4dk8e34RvKGVWqDvZ15jfoUxHsitYuuPYbufhwJfWcL2R12Ddh83iD.png)</center>


* The time between the end of the preparation phase and the beginning of the combat phase was taking a long time (a few milliseconds haha), but it was not pleasant, so this time window was reduced, when the \

ended a little later, the combat began.



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/EnynWRP158rLbzjbazq9bXPbB9LDTQDcfUvisb5myL8tXNzkLzU8jtmE2EuNW6Yxetz.png)</center>


* I made some corrections to the grimoire, our \

, later I will review it because I need to add a few more things to make it more complete, with some information that is missing.

___
___

The battlefield awaits you! Call your friends, create the best strategy and shake up the battlefield! Come to the glory and honor of duels!

Play now: [Horizon Forge](https://horizonforge-production.up.railway.app/)

![sun_divisor.webp](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXEDLx7R7Jy8fHF1tA7sPyb4A9QBvmj3y4FjFhephcPCS/sun_divisor.webp)

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23u65CPHrKoqL7FqkHAeYg7URmMkZRbFeXzVwmeAZ6L2SxecgAuYA7x9SWKEhWnsJHgdr.png)[Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/pt-br/fotografias/atualizacao-do-projeto-de-ortografia-de-dois-blocos-scrabble-em-uma-tabela-21mUU21Z20Q)</center>

![divisor.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23x1ckYW5T1yBx8C6Rd18NYtNsYsNdTGDvWitn6Bsn1q5DyNyNy6dyVhLcGh4zUN1vwui.jpeg)



<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tRsvbYmyaKs1XCHuRu9EuFPE7RuSULkjPhMoGtejjyqQTZ9vqLaDsDigKyK3dFFUrR8.png)</center>

<center>Nova versão em produção pessoal!</center>

* Apliquei algumas melhorias internas, separei algumas informações em arquivos menores, para que o HTML fique menor e menos poluído, deixando todo o .css em arquivos respectivos.


* Havia um erro/bug quando utilizamos Silas, a classe assassino. No começo da partida na fase de preparação, quando sua habilidade era ativada \

, era aplicado o dano da habilidade, mas estava pulando o seu ataque, então consegui encontrar o problema e corrigir.


* Ao terminar uma rodada de um duelo, agora não precisa mais clicar no botão azul para começar a próxima partida, isso será feito de forma automática! Isso garante mais agilidade para os jogadores, mais tempo mais batalhas!


* O paladino na fase de preparação tem a habilidade de conceder um bônus na vida máxima dos seus aliados, já havia um efeito de brilho verde e agora adicionei o \

indicando quanto de vida foi adicionado. Acho que posso trocar essa cor para verde e também ver uma forma de adicionar a indicação dos buffs e debuffs. Penso em alguns ícones ou algo assim acima dos cards no campo de batalha.


<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/shiftrox/23tH1HMaLffcryD4dk8e34RvKGVWqDvZ15jfoUxHsitYuuPYbufhwJfWcL2R12Ddh83iD.png)</center>


* O tempo entre o fim da fase de preparação e o inicio da fase de combate estava demorando muito (Alguns milissegundos haha), mas não estava agradável, então diminui essa janela de tempo, ao acabar a \

um pouco depois já começa o combate.

links.title: Critics Hated It. Audiences Are Obsessed. I'm Team Audience.
links.body: So I finally caught Michael  this weekend and I have THOUGHTS.\nThe critics are dragging it — 38% on Rotten Tomatoes, calling it \

And yeah, I get it. The movie doesn't dive deep into the controversies, the legal battles, the darker chapters. It plays it safe in a lot of ways.
But here's the thing: when Jaafar Jackson hits that stage as his uncle? Time stops. The way he moves, the voice, the presence  — it's not imitation, it's channeling something real. I literally got goosebumps during the Billie Jean sequence. The man was born to do this.
The film covers Michael's journey from a tiny house in Gary, Indiana with the Jackson 5, all the way to the Bad tour era. You feel the pressure of being the biggest star on the planet, the loneliness that came with it, the relentless media circus. It's not a perfect movie by any means — some scenes feel rushed, others too polished — but the heart is there.
And the numbers don't lie: $97 million opening weekend, biggest biopic debut ever. 97% audience score. People are going back for second and third viewings. That says something.
Maybe it's nostalgia. Maybe it's the music. Maybe it's watching a nephew honor his uncle in the most personal way possible. Whatever it is, it worked on me.
Have you seen it? Did it hit you the same way, or were you left wanting more? Drop your honest take below — I'm genuinely curious.

links.title: (EN-PT) How to make money recycling (upcycling) cans-Como ganhar dinheiro reciclando (reutilizando) latas
links.body:
(English version)

Make recycling a habit by upcycling cans profitably and also saving the environment

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JLUApVDGOM4

When you empty a can, just remove both ends with a can opener. After that, wash the can thoroughly by using your regular washing-up liquid, remove the label, and let the can dry, or use a towel to dry it off.

Then, what you need is an anti-rust primer spray to apply to the inside and outside surface of the can, so that you can prevent oxidation of the metal. Use the instructions and apply as many layers as needed (probably one or two layers will suffice).

Now, this is the trickiest bit. You should visit YouTube and search for “geometric drawing tutorial”. There are plenty of videos to choose from, and I would personally select the following video tutorial:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sYTyckH7ptU

Cut a piece of white paper that has the same dimensions with the cylindrical outer surface of the can (once spread out, it will have a rectangle shape), so you can wrap it perfectly around it.

Although you may find the whole thing of drawing a geometric diamond by hand a bit difficult to do, especially if you are not good at drawing, it is actually not that difficult, once you have watched carefully this excellent video tutorial. It is like going back to school again! You’ll need the piece of white paper you have cut, a pair of compasses, a ruler, a pencil, an eraser, and of course, plenty of patience. Take your time, and try to make the drawing as nice as you can. The better the result of your drawing, the higher the chances of selling your upcycled cans fast and at a good price, e.g. on Etsy.com.

Once you have finished your masterpiece drawing (don’t worry if you make made any mistakes, since you can always start the whole thing again; just have fun!), it is time to cut along the perimeter and throw away any unwanted paper.

After that, cut through the whole drawing by using a precision knife; you can get one of them on Amazon.com for less than 10 dollars. Remove the black segments and leave the white ones.

What you need next is a set of acrylic paints and brushes (you can get them cheap online from retailers like Amazon.com). After you have wrapped and fixed the diamond drawing around your can, you can start filling the gaps that you have made with the precision knife, with any color you like. The result will be a unique upcycled tin can that is painted with marvelous colors!

The next step is to use a pair of metal cutting scissors to cut the tin surface from top to bottom, so that you don’t have an empty cylinder, but a curvy rectangle surface. Bend the sharp edges inwards after you have cut the tin, in order to make the tin safer, and give it some “volume”, as well. Another reason why you should do this is in order to make as much surface of the can as flat as possible, so that you can send it to a potential buyer by using a plain envelope for sending a letter (and thus pay the cost of a letter) rather than sending it in a box as a cylinder (as it was initially), which would increase mailing costs dramatically. Of course, you shouldn’t make the tin completely flat because you want it to keep some of its curvy volume, so it can stand upright on its own without needing any support.

That’s it then!

Now you need to take a photo of your upcycled can, upload it to your Etsy store, and send it to your social media friends.

This will be a great decorative item that can be used to add color on any desk, and serve the purpose of saving the environment from more metal waste thrown away, and of course give you some extra money to sweeten your creative experience even more. I bet you can hardly wait for your next condensed milk can to empty, so you can use it for your next can upcycling project!

I would also like to thank Sarah Moore, a UK-based expert who can upcycle literally anything you can imagine, for introducing me to upcycling and being a great inspiration by watching her videos on YouTube. It’s definitely worth watching these videos, if you want to get ideas on how to make money upcycling various objects and saving them from landfill.

(Versão portuguesa)

Faça da reciclagem um hábito, reutilizando latas de forma lucrativa e, ao mesmo tempo, ajudando a preservar o meio ambiente

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JLUApVDGOM4

Ao esvaziar uma lata, basta remover as duas extremidades com um abridor de latas. Em seguida, lave bem a lata com detergente de louça comum, retire o rótulo e deixe-a secar ou seque-a com uma toalha.

Depois, você precisará de um spray de primer antiferrugem para aplicar nas superfícies interna e externa da lata, a fim de evitar a oxidação do metal. Siga as instruções e aplique quantas camadas forem necessárias (provavelmente uma ou duas camadas serão suficientes).

Agora, esta é a parte mais complicada. Você deve acessar o YouTube e pesquisar por \

. Há muitos vídeos para escolher, e eu pessoalmente recomendaria o seguinte tutorial em vídeo:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sYTyckH7ptU

Corte um pedaço de papel branco com as mesmas dimensões da superfície cilíndrica externa da lata (depois de aberta, ela ficará retangular), para que você possa envolvê-la perfeitamente.

Embora desenhar um losango geométrico à mão possa parecer um pouco difícil, principalmente se você não tem muita prática em desenho, na verdade não é tão complicado assim, depois de assistir atentamente a este excelente tutorial em vídeo. É como voltar à escola! Você vai precisar do pedaço de papel branco que cortou, um compasso, uma régua, um lápis, uma borracha e, claro, muita paciência. Dedique um tempo e tente fazer um desenho o mais bonito possível. Quanto melhor o resultado do seu desenho, maiores as chances de vender suas latas recicladas rapidamente e por um bom preço, por exemplo, no Etsy.com.

Depois de terminar seu desenho (não se preocupe se cometer algum erro, pois você sempre pode começar tudo de novo; apenas divirta-se!), é hora de recortar ao longo do perímetro e jogar fora o papel indesejado.

Depois disso, recorte todo o desenho usando um estilete de precisão; você pode encontrar um desses na Amazon.com por menos de 10 dólares. Remova os segmentos pretos e deixe os brancos.

Em seguida, você precisará de um conjunto de tintas acrílicas e pincéis (você pode encontrá-los baratos online em lojas como a Amazon.com). Depois de envolver e fixar o desenho de diamante ao redor da lata, você pode começar a preencher os espaços que fez com o estilete de precisão com a cor que preferir. O resultado será uma lata reciclada exclusiva, pintada com cores maravilhosas!

O próximo passo é usar uma tesoura para cortar metal para cortar a superfície da lata de cima para baixo, de modo que você não tenha um cilindro vazio, mas uma superfície retangular curva. Dobre as bordas afiadas para dentro depois de cortar a lata, para torná-la mais segura e também para dar um pouco de volume. Outro motivo para fazer isso é deixar a maior superfície da lata o mais plana possível, para que você possa enviá-la a um potencial comprador em um envelope comum (e, assim, pagar o custo de uma carta), em vez de enviá-la em uma caixa como um cilindro (como era originalmente), o que aumentaria drasticamente os custos de envio. Claro, você não deve deixar a lata completamente plana, pois é importante que ela mantenha parte de seu volume curvo, para que possa ficar em pé sozinha sem precisar de suporte.

É isso aí!

Agora você precisa tirar uma foto da sua lata reciclada, carregá-la na sua loja do Etsy e compartilhá-la com seus amigos nas redes sociais.

Essa será uma ótima peça decorativa que pode ser usada para dar cor a qualquer mesa, além de contribuir para a preservação do meio ambiente, evitando o descarte de mais metal e, claro, te render um dinheiro extra para tornar sua experiência criativa ainda mais prazerosa. Aposto que você mal pode esperar para que sua próxima lata de leite condensado fique vazia, para que você possa usá-la em seu próximo projeto de reciclagem!

Gostaria também de agradecer a Sarah Moore, uma especialista do Reino Unido que recicla praticamente qualquer coisa que você possa imaginar, por me apresentar ao mundo da reciclagem criativa e por ser uma grande inspiração através de seus vídeos no YouTube. Vale muito a pena assistir a esses vídeos se você quiser ideias de como ganhar dinheiro reciclando diversos objetos e evitando que eles acabem em aterros sanitários.

(Este post foi traduzido do inglês para o português com o Google Translate)

links.title: Quiet Moments, Lasting Peace.
links.body:
>
![6A9351A7-2921-46E6-8957-26B5FFDD4882.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/princessbusayo/48Vjbs72tmRFSxEAspfYNPmD3m7QtSYwE9pEuK7bxTNn3Xgh4CRNpFXRjFBmmGr7Uk.png)
When was the last time I actually paused from the noise, distractions, and even the constant rush of life, to sit with my thoughts? I still did that last night. It’s literally an everyday thing for me. It’s one way to track the words I speak every day, my actions and even my thoughts, making me make corrections where needed and ensuring I do better the next day. For me, my quiet time isn’t occasional but a daily routine. It's a consistent thing. It’s a moment I deliberately and intentionally set aside to study and meditate on something important and necessary for me - the Word of God. Doing this has become a rhythm in my life, something I always love to return to, no matter how busy life gets. There is a book I am currently reading and a phrase has stayed with me ever since then: “Thinking about a problem over and over again in your mind is called worry. But thinking about God’s words over and over again in your mind is called meditation.” That changed my perspective greatly! It made me more aware of what I allow to sit in my thoughts and how powerful those thoughts can be. In my own way, meditation isn’t just about sitting still in the quiet and allowing yourself to be fully away from the noise and letting your thoughts flow. It is reflecting deeply on what I allow in my heart - this, I do by being conscious in the present. I intentionally guard my mind while choosing not to let just any thought settle there. What I do instead is allow what is good, what is true and what aligns with God’s promises to occupy my thoughts. Recently, I was just reflecting and it occurred to me how, when someone decides to look into my heart, they would find beauty in there. This isn’t because life is perfect but because I have been careful about what I allow to stay and not to stay. I hold on to the instruction to think on good things, and over time, it has shaped me. My heart is filled with God’s Word because that is what I meditate on daily, whether I am sitting quietly, walking, or even washing dishes. I don’t have an empty quiet time - it’s always full. It’s full of God’s promises over my life. It’s a space where I listen closely, where I am sensitive to the gentle nudges, ideas and encouragement from the Holy Spirit. It is also a moment for reflection, where I look back and see growth, lessons learned and how the journey has been. Of course, there are times negative thoughts try to find their way in sometimes. But one thing I have learned is one powerful fact that I have a choice. I can either allow them to stay or gently push them out - telling them they aren’t welcome. And every day, I choose what feeds my heart. For me, quiet time has become more than a habit but a lifeline. It’s a place of alignment, clarity and peace. To be honest, this isn’t something I ever want to live without because it’s part of me.
*Image is mine, designed by ChatGPT*

links.title: Journey to the Mysterious History of Istanbul: Our Visit to the Basilica Cistern
links.body:
A week ago, my brothers and cousins and I visited the Basilica Cistern, one of the most impressive historical buildings of Istanbul. This historical place, which many people who live in Istanbul or come here want to see, is really as impressive as it is described. I had seen it in photos before, but when I entered it, the atmosphere felt completely different. We had an unforgettable experience with both its historical texture and mystical atmosphere.


![dbfccc51-c3fe-45bd-a0de-6ab7e4277063.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpvjM8f92B9BbuFMTN2QPGse8cnXJw48DweqNWug6KEtZs2a5mr99ogNZ4j6oHdweL4.jpeg)



![IMG_1105.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoc58ADmCFTiqPqd9CSA859ii3UXSbx6kshTw2HLQLGmpcjdW2FD7QS7U3zhMhZoT3R.jpeg)


The Basilica Cistern is located very close to Sultanahmet Square. It is a few minutes' walk to historical places such as Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. For this reason, it has become one of the most visited points by tourists coming to Istanbul. We decided to visit the Basilica Cistern while visiting this historical region. The boy was so happy :)


![IMG_1094.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/23xydt17jTfcoBWdHv41pvPS8xqq1i5HoupGbaNXWxcUTuw8MvVH1bcUTo8PQ1BjCY6nC.jpeg)

![IMG_1100.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eo8LaNg63haQCDLCWDpw89NDbtMjhSS3Npc3KW8GSfTniNggY1M9p3VFfYxueCon1Yf.jpeg)

![IMG_1099.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep3dLAcb9zJL7dmwgVrjEkZqa7jqZJ3iw9ioEcSBLTvhZJB9xpSfs8gqFVMdVW6VudV.jpeg)

![IMG_1092.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EqL6qRgaGSS6fku5K7ucy96QPBvnhvadq96qXqmuZgkB3Mnv6YQ5xL7kKCdDoTTWH9z.jpeg)


A certain fee is paid at the entrance. When we went, the student ticket was 200 TL and the full ticket was 400 TL. The fare was higher for foreign tourists and was determined in dollars. Although the price seems a little high, I can say that the atmosphere we saw when we entered was worth it. Because this is not only a historical building, but also a fascinating place that takes people to the past.


![IMG_1102.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoniaEn9LV3w1bP57FokNn7agYmS5LARb8o1ZgpFvWEXbQ6ZdSH46HmZbjG8hVbKobW.jpeg)

![IMG_1104.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoEin4jZvdQxcXFj3buGUDYSHYRotb9VcoSUK667M9GqoMABojdRoz8pb4qGmuvBgcR.jpeg)


Basilica Cistern, Byzantine Emperor I. It was built by Justinianus in the 6th century. At that time, it was used as a large water tank built to meet the water needs of Istanbul. This giant structure, hidden under the city, served for water storage for many years. It was also used for a while in the Ottoman period, but it lost its importance over time. Later, it was restored and opened to tourism.
[Source](https://yerebatan.com/en/basilica-cistern/about-us/)

![IMG_1109.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoe8i5WNjf2GF4ha4BhiKgSbmpfEvBAdoLusTKEFDu1gwAHwTZ198pRzmBDqJW5dEr4.jpeg)

![IMG_1111.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpC9SDpsJJUY7bUK1EUx7HiJoDZeKaFTzaChdovXxh11nd7fBJ2UMf4MuuQkS31LJkU.jpeg)


One of the most impressive features of the cistern is its huge columns. Hundreds of columns rising under the dim lights as soon as they enter fascinate people. There are 336 columns in total, and these columns make the size of the cistern even more impressive. Thanks to the platforms that give you the feeling of walking on the water, you can walk comfortably inside. Dim lights, images reflected from the ceiling and the light sound of water add a mysterious atmosphere to the place.


![IMG_1113.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoJyXAwpg9UFjix2iXtWEM8MFEkwpxA3QN3yewq7gLFdJJjSNUgRZVAueUKZLNSgBnN.jpeg)

![IMG_1112.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EowDifAMHxf6KoBj8UtnAds7sTt9MA3MDp35SPHv6PebM8oqvdisFPsRXVrafRxQnps.jpeg)


The moment we entered, we were all silent for a short time. Because the atmosphere was really impressive. Entering such a cool, dark and historical environment after the crowd and noise outside takes you to another time. It was a very different feeling to feel the traces of the past while walking through the columns. Every column, every stone seemed to tell a different story.


![IMG_1114.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoniaKNyGkpyJWBy6fsjaFBeeCWvGc9iLjUB65mJZTX4Zez7TDGnWBC8RAkBQkS5GR7.jpeg)

![IMG_1115.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EpLf2y3UJV9Y8nHmcVdcX5f4oAHuP9cNsUCmvmrcUTjAWbmRnsTNMEmzswvZLRJRuwU.jpeg)


One of the most remarkable points of the cistern is the Medusa heads. The two Medusa heads under the columns are one of the details that everyone who visits here wants to see. One of these heads stands on the side and the other is placed upside down. There are different narrations about why this is done this way. Some say it was done just to be suitable for the column length, while others say it was reversed to neutralize the power of Medusa. Although the exact reason is not known, this mystery increases the impressiveness of the cistern.


![IMG_1116.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAUSkstddgvLvYPiJJa8vPf5znYetXGPD4EkRL296pPv7bh8mVSANBYT5kQvMN1cb2.jpeg)

![IMG_1117.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoK3uWirnqurUJ2wE4VBJMeSJx1TU58aKu9wXY9MoSRfRY7KFeaWWcJBKyeVaN1CFmh.jpeg)


We were really impressed when we saw Medusa's heads. Seeing the details seen in historical films or documentaries in real life gives a different excitement. It was very impressive to see those stone carvings, especially in the dim light. Everyone who visited was standing there to take pictures.


![IMG_1119.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoGrcUYgE7VP9GF2iytD2ZErn9mokmiiFoqUpPXnm5KnUopTMkQQZzfjbw4usSSAdmK.jpeg)

![IMG_1123.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAUWa2XZGFN3qBq4GjF81KqgeLXb5S8WdyzwdLFBD9e5f5TD3we765xV4skRUZZYoC.jpeg)


The interior of the Basilica Cistern is not only historical, but also has an artistic atmosphere. The lighting is very well prepared. The colors reflected on the columns and the reflections in the water give a fascinating look to the environment. For this reason, while walking inside, you experience not only a historical building, but also a visual feast.


![IMG_1125.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eo45jutB8Bs7dfpKKRxXDWJKQGXEwCJPnjTzidayrWfB87g6zcn7qdk95462Ns394tA.jpeg)

![IMG_1128.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoc61peDyouvwoSRR2s62nV9gELg2oUhWnMhDHtLV7o6tSJUC1LYa1qPpxd7DFnE8ft.jpeg)


While we were traveling as a family, we stood on every corner and took pictures. Especially the reflections between the columns created very beautiful images. It looked good in the photos, but the real version was much more impressive. Sometimes it was enough to just stop and watch around. Quiet and cool environment calms people.


![IMG_1134.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAU3ah1iGhPaLHFKXxPZ4BbJgS63jvL1E9KKXFJrrQ7vah3C1kCjgGmYWA42UMT3d4.jpeg)

![IMG_1135.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoEihzw5airknP8DZRejoqawFoibmKEwFewtw7JyQfu9giQ6g8bMQT3znGPEi1PAN9R.jpeg)


It is not really surprising that the Basilica Cistern welcomes hundreds of thousands of tourists every year. Because it fascinates people to see such a mysterious and historical place in the heart of Istanbul. It is admirable to have such a structure underground in a crowded city like Istanbul. The fact that this structure, which was built centuries ago, is still standing today also affects people.


![IMG_1136.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoGrfRhAYCvgfKDQCX2crpwbEsjvtj6ugLKb4gQngedBxCiPBa7UedPfUjR9q63JJYH.jpeg)

![IMG_1137.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoc54E6CjV9wV8eQdN8q7yF1EMyN2ESiFSpmZ8naHTqdYrGArmpYf3i5Y1o4tnRTVoQ.jpeg)


This visit reminded us once again how deep Istanbul has a history. While walking on the streets of the city, there is a different history on every corner, but the Basilica Cistern gives this feeling much stronger. Because this place is like a great history hidden under the ground.

![IMG_1138.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/EoAUVaejbJLcqFH4USHsPqtcTKqFWfg1W9ZztSGLs7eS3uJWHTBoCZLVS4bDVnroBwr.jpeg)

![IMG_1139.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep1VShWyW2mBg6PpcQVYAtwtVunkBHNyGLX1NmaPxy8XD6WjTaiF2rECPtZ9SATgYho.jpeg)


It was very pleasant to visit such a place with my siblings and cousins. We visited a historical place together and accumulated good memories. Sometimes it is very valuable not only to see a place, but also to share that moment with your loved ones. This visit was both an instructive and unforgettable experience for us.


![IMG_1139.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Ep1VShWyW2mBg6PpcQVYAtwtVunkBHNyGLX1NmaPxy8XD6WjTaiF2rECPtZ9SATgYho.jpeg)

![IMG_1140.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eoc1GAG4mAy6snaHS587XUPPENUALu5nV56VwHMZSCV2Tdn8Jw37X2vG5w2DoRL7Jhb.jpeg)


If you come to Istanbul one day, I definitely recommend you to visit the Basilica Cistern. It is a place that anyone who loves history, architecture and mysterious atmosphere can be impressed. It would be a very nice experience to visit here, especially while walking around Sultanahmet. The Basilica Cistern is one of the most impressive heritages that Istanbul has carried from the past to the present.


![IMG_1141.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eo45KSC1XkMf3Qmk3MNkrsRKzvMnUx7S7UjXycdBu1afMCMc7781HMSa4ew84H2GHZJ.jpeg)

![IMG_1142.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oneplanet/Eo45qnu1aGBFs4ySbkjeiwBKC5zQToJeH9SMAjRBDNuVFSo64WTt6QsfLaQVzX7NDHz.jpeg)


This trip reminded me again how valuable it is to visit historical places. It's a completely different feeling to see the places we read in books or see in photos in real life. The Basilica Cistern has also become one of the places that give this feeling the strongest. It is a truly special place for anyone who wants to feel the historical spirit of Istanbul.

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/DF3CBC73-2A1A-4DD6-B3D7-97AA797CFB2F1777306064.214833) Today I walked through parts of town I hadn’t really noticed before. New housing areas, still in development, quietly expanding into places that used to be empty. The houses looked different. Cleaner lines, more thought in how they use energy. A resident I spoke to called them low-energy houses. It made sense, even without knowing the details. I had left my phone at home, so no photo this time. Maybe another day. For a moment I wondered how I would decide today, starting from zero. It’s tempting. A different approach, more efficient, more aligned with how things are built now. But then again, what I have has grown over time. It fits. Not perfect, but adjusted. It works without draining me. Strange how priorities shift. Not everything new needs to replace what already works. Observed while moving. Left unfinished.

.

It's yet another weekly contest for us all to deal with. Thank you so much our Judge for this week, @marivic10, for these thought provoking questions for us ladies this week.

 Many people just give out their times watching movies of all kinds, without intentionally making choices. But for me, mild and educative movies are my choices at all times because I wouldn't want to get frightened during movie watching, or after watching to be so scared because I will definitely remember parts of the movies, I know I might not remember every juncture or all the actors, but I will certainly remember some parts, I would love to remember them and smile. Not to be scared or feel bad about some maltreatments or how some died who supposed not to have died in the movies...!
