 I think watching impactful movies is recommended because of the quality impacts it teaches. Apart from that, count me out of excessive movie watching. I have seen some moms at home after dropping their kids to school will just come home, abandoning every other house chores or activities undone but focused on this Indian movie series known as or being on their watching list, the popular **\
** They are Indian movie series very long and are made very hooking if you start.\n\n**My favorite has been the impactful movie known as \

** It was produced and written by John Hughes, in December, 2020. This movie to me is very important and impactful for parents to watch and know how to treat, refer and nurture the relationships within the family and share their love with their children. The main actor was a ten years old Kevin.

A family had so many kids all growing up in the same house. But there were disparities in the ways the parents treat them or showed capabilities in caring for the kids. Sometimes, the bigger ones were bullying the younger ones and their parents  over looked those loopholes in raising those kids.

A day came, the whole family decided to go for a vacation in **PARIS**. Everyone began arranging their belongings for their travel, they all got to airport to board for paris, their parents carelessly forgot Kevin in the air port and boarded. On the mid air, their mother began to search for Kevin, everybody started calling his name, \

.

There was no response and that was how all of them knew that Kevin was not among them, he had been left behind, and there was nothing anyone could do about it. The air plane is already cruising on the highest altitude you can think of, it could not stop, or reverse to land again to pick up Kevin. Meanwhile, Kevin was running all over the Air port searching and looking for his own family. **Can you imagine that?**.

After a very long search without results, Kevin had to go back home. That was how he stayed Home Alone. He became very matured on his own immediately. He goes for shopping all alone, he cooked his meals, he cleaned the whole house all alone. Sometimes, he will try shaving like his daddy used to do, but he was never scared or afraid.

 Even when some huligans like thieves came trying to sneak into their house to steal, he disallowed them, developed some strategies that only adults or security operatives could have applied, he behaved so maturedly that his parents never knew he could have.

**LESSONS FOR PARENTS...!**
Always try to know the characters of your kids one after the other. They're not the same in character building, abilities and capabilities. Every child is different.

2. Always know where your kids are per time. Try solving their needs, paying attention to their individualistic characters and needs, parents should be a bridge, showing them how to be kind and also relate kindly with one another, correct and teach them at all times. Take careful care of your kids!.

Kevin proved that our kids are both learning fast and understanding all that we as their parents are doing at all the time, know what you do while they are watching you. Kevin, did everything perfectly like if his parents were doing those.

For me, the purpose of this film...is that families must make it a duty to stay together at one time or the other, not withstanding how busy the parents are trying to make ends meet.

links.title: FOMO: cuando siempre sientes que hay algo mejor esperándote. / FOMO: when you always feel like there’s something better waiting for you.
links.body: Durante años pensé que mi problema era la falta de disciplina. Empezaba proyectos pero no los terminaba. No porque no quisiera, sino porque tenía miedo de quedarme atrás respecto a lo que a otros les estaba funcionando. Cambiaba de idea constantemente porque sentía que no estaba en el camino correcto. Me comparaba todo el tiempo y me decía: “_Si ellos pudieron, ¿por qué yo no? Si están dando los pasos, ¿por qué no probar lo mismo?”_ Hasta que, después de muchas conversaciones con dos personas muy importantes para mí —una de ellas psicóloga— entendí algo que me cambió la perspectiva. No me faltaban ganas, era FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out). **¿Qué es realmente el FOMO?** El FOMO [es un patrón psicológico que te hace sentir que siempre te estás perdiendo “algo mejor”. Te mantiene en constante alerta, mirando hacia afuera, sin poder conectar con lo que ya tienes enfrente.](https://www.psicologia-online.com/fomo-miedo-a-perderse-algo-que-es-causas-sintomas-y-tratamiento-6586.html) En mi caso, se veía así: Probaba caminos distintos, pero nunca me quedaba en ninguno, consumía contenido constantemente en lugar de ejecutar, sentía que siempre había una mejor opción si seguía buscando. Desde fuera puede parecer curiosidad o ambición. Pero por dentro era ansiedad. **El origen psicológico del FOMO** El FOMO no aparece de la nada. Muchas veces está relacionado [con experiencias pasadas, como:](https://www.psicologia-online.com/fomo-miedo-a-perderse-algo-que-es-causas-sintomas-y-tratamiento-6586.html) * Pérdidas significativas durante la infancia (personas, momentos, seguridad). * Situaciones donde no te sentiste aceptada o suficiente. * Inseguridades que te llevan a querer “estar en todo” para no perder oportunidades. También hay un componente biológico. Nuestro cerebro está diseñado para buscar recompensas rápidas. Cada vez que vemos algo nuevo, algo que “funciona” para otros, se activa ese impulso de querer probarlo. El problema es que ese ciclo te engancha… pero no te construye. **La trampa en la que caí:** Cuando entendí el FOMO, me di cuenta de algo, me mantenía ocupada para sentirme productiva. Pero no estaba enfocada, estaba aprendiendo, pero no aplicando. Buscando, pero no construyendo. Pensando, pero no decidiendo. Y mientras tanto el tiempo pasaba. No se trata de eliminar el FOMO por completo. Se trata de aprender a gestionarlo. Porque sí, el FOMO va a aparecer. La diferencia está en cómo respondes. Esto es lo que estoy aplicando: 1. Medir mi avance sin compararme. Cada semana me hago una sola pregunta: _¿Estoy más cerca de donde quiero estar que hace 7 días?_ No me comparo con nadie. Solo conmigo misma. 2. Poner límites al consumo. Menos contenido, más acción. Si no aplico, no estoy aprendiendo. 3. Comprometerme con un proceso. Elegí una dirección y decidí no cuestionarla constantemente. Voy a probarla de verdad, con compromiso. Si en el futuro cambio, será después de haberlo intentado en serio. 4. Dejar de buscar resultados inmediatos. El FOMO quiere rapidez. El crecimiento real necesita tiempo. 5. Detectar cuándo estoy evitando actuar. Si estoy investigando demasiado… probablemente estoy posponiendo. **Al final entendí algo clave:** El problema no es que no sepa qué hacer. Es que no me estaba dando el tiempo suficiente para que algo funcione. A veces no necesitas más información. Necesitas quedarte donde estás y construir.

/> * * * For years I thought my problem was a lack of discipline. I would start projects but never finish them. Not because I didn’t want to, but because I was afraid of falling behind compared to what was working for others. I constantly changed ideas because I felt like I wasn’t on the right path. I compared myself all the time and told myself: “If they could do it, why can’t I? If they’re taking those steps, why not try the same?” Until, after many conversations with two very important people in my life — one of them a psychologist — I understood something that changed my perspective. I didn’t lack motivation, it was FOMO (Fear Of Missing Out). What is FOMO really? FOMO is a psychological pattern that makes you feel like you’re always missing out on “something better.” It keeps you in a constant state of alert, looking outward, unable to connect with what you already have in front of you. In my case, it looked like this: I tried different paths but never stuck to any of them, I constantly consumed content instead of executing, I felt like there was always a better option if I kept searching. From the outside it might look like curiosity or ambition. But on the inside, it was anxiety. The psychological origin of FOMO FOMO doesn’t appear out of nowhere. Many times it’s related to past experiences, such as: Significant losses during childhood (people, moments, security). Situations where you didn’t feel accepted or enough. Insecurities that lead you to want to “be everywhere” so you don’t miss opportunities. There is also a biological component. Our brain is designed to seek quick rewards. Every time we see something new, something that “works” for others, that impulse to try it gets activated. The problem is that this cycle hooks you… but it doesn’t build you. The trap I fell into: When I understood FOMO, I realized something, I kept myself busy to feel productive. But I wasn’t focused, I was learning, but not applying. Searching, but not building. Thinking, but not deciding. And meanwhile, time was passing. It’s not about eliminating FOMO completely. It’s about learning how to manage it. Because yes, FOMO will show up. The difference is in how you respond. This is what I’m applying: Measuring my progress without comparing myself. Every week I ask myself one question: Am I closer to where I want to be than I was 7 days ago? I don’t compare myself to anyone. Only to myself. Setting limits on consumption. Less content, more action. If I don’t apply, I’m not learning. Committing to a process. I chose a direction and decided not to question it constantly. I’m going to truly try it, with commitment. If I change in the future, it will be after having seriously tried. Letting go of immediate results. FOMO wants speed. Real growth needs time. Detecting when I’m avoiding action. If I’m researching too much… I’m probably procrastinating. In the end, I understood something key: The problem is not that I don’t know what to do. It’s that I wasn’t giving myself enough time for something to work. Sometimes you don’t need more information. You need to stay where you are and build.

links.title: 27 April 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Day 3086: first impression
links.body:
/>  
[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/search/impression/)

First impression is a silent greeting that talks ahead of you. It comes in your posture, your timing, your eyes, and the little choices you make in the first few seconds. People love to claim it should not matter, that depth takes time, yet the reality is that first impressions frequently establish the tenor for all that follows. It is not always just, yet it is actual.

Knowing that moment without turning false is very potent. A great first impression has nothing to do with pretending to be ideal. Being present, purposeful, and reverent of the area you are entering helps. Your reaction, the way you listen, even the way you handle silence, all of it leaves a legacy.

Sometimes one excellent first impression unlocks doors you never even knocked on. Other occasions a careless one shuts doors before you have the chance to clarify yourself. This is the reason it is important to treat every fresh meeting with a degree of awareness. Not tension, not dread, but purpose.

Therefore walk into a room, into a talk, or into a fresh chapter carrying yourself in a way that shows who you really are at your finest. Sometimes that first moment is all people get before they choose what to anticipate from you.

links.title: Sobre en tela para guardar papeles o documentos￼ 🪡🧵💖 [esp/eng]
links.body:
>

___Feliz lunes y feliz comienzo de semana queridos amigos de NEEDLEWORKMONDAY!___ 🥰❤️

Aprovechando los recursos que me quedan de mis costuras, hoy quiero compartir con ustedes la idea para hacer un sobre multiusos en Tila, en mi caso lo quiero para guardar esos documentos que no son tan importantes, pero que para nosotros si tienen valor sentimental, como por ejemplo los boletines de mis hijos, facturas de electrodomésticos, entre otros, así que acompáñame y te comparto el paso a paso:

> Happy Monday and happy start to the week, dear friends of NEEDLEWORKMONDAY! 🥰❤️
>
> Making use of my leftover sewing supplies, today I want to share with you an idea for making a multipurpose fabric envelope. I want to use it to store documents that aren't essential, but that have sentimental value, like my children's report cards, appliance receipts, and other things. So join me and I'll share the step-by-step instructions:

<div class=\

>

![Logo para negocio de uñas moderno simple lindo rosa - 1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeEWBgANFGeF44yo3XkEBF1WEPNQvdFcpEbFfNKux6vCn/Logo%20para%20negocio%20de%20u%C3%B1as%20moderno%20simple%20lindo%20rosa%20-%201.png)

<hr>

<div class=\

> ___MATERIALES___ > MATERIALS Los boletines escolares son ese tipo de documentos que en lo personal me da mucho sentimiento tirarlos a la basura, así que prefiero guardarlos, ya que cuando pasa el tiempo y los reviso me da mucha alegría saber que mis hijos han avanzado bastante, en los boletines siempre guardan esas cosas que los maestros opinan sobre nuestros hijos, y que a veces olvidamos, también me gusta guardar las facturas de los electrodomésticos mientras los tenga activos en mi hogar, así como otros documentos que no son tan importantes, pero que si deseamos tenerlos a la mano, es por esto que quise idearme un sobre en tela para que estén organizados, y que al mismo tiempo no me ocupen tanto espacio, entonces manos a la obra, aquí les dejo la lista de materiales a utilizar : - Telas de su preferencia, en mi caso, voy a usar Dacron Unicolor y una tela estampada que tenía guardada - Entre- tela o perlon - Tijeras - Cinta métrica - Plancha - Máquina de coser, este tipo de manualidad se puede coser también a mano, ya que es bastante sencilla > School report cards are the kind of documents that I personally find hard to throw away, so I prefer to keep them. When time passes and I look through them, it brings me so much joy to see how much my children have progressed. Report cards always contain those comments the teachers make about our children, which we sometimes forget. I also like to keep receipts for appliances while I still have them at home, as well as other documents that aren't as important but that we want to have on hand. That's why I wanted to design a fabric envelope to keep them organized and not take up too much space. So, let's get started! Here's the list of materials you'll need: > > - Fabrics of your choice. In my case, I'm going to use solid-color Dacron and a patterned fabric I had on hand. > - Interfacing or perlon > - Scissors > - Measuring tape > - Iron > - Sewing machine. This type of craft can also be sewn by hand, as it's quite simple.

> ___PASO A PASO___ > STEP BY STEP Para las medidas, voy a guiarme con uno de los boletines de uno de mis hijos, lo colocaré sobre mi tela y esta la doblaré a la mitad para saber el ancho del que haré mi sobre, me quedó un aproximado de 60 cm de largo esto lo dividiremos a la mitad y la mitad la cortaremos de 30 cm de alto y la otra de 22 cm, este sobresaliente es para hacerle la pestaña al sobre. Luego cortaremos el entretela, esto es para que el sobre quede más firme y no se doble con facilidad, me gusta mucho usar este material para colocarlo entre las telas cuando quiero que estas me queden más rígidas, el entretela que tengo en casa tiene pega, así que puedes plancharlo sobre tu tela y éste se adherirá fácilmente, cortamos la segunda tela y así tendremos las tres piezas, una tela para el forro una para el exterior y él entretela > For the measurements, I'm going to use one of my children's report cards as a guide. I'll place it on my fabric and fold it in half to determine the width of my envelope. It came out to approximately 60 cm long. I'll divide this in half, cutting one half to 30 cm high and the other to 22 cm. This extra fabric is for the envelope's flap. > > Next, we'll cut the interfacing. This is to make the envelope sturdier and prevent it from bending easily. I really like using this material between fabrics when I want them to be more rigid. The interfacing I have at home is self-adhesive, so you can iron it onto your fabric and it will adhere easily. We'll cut the second piece of fabric, and now we have three pieces: one for the lining, one for the exterior, and the interfacing.

> |![IMG_9490.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmR9WR8D3YzZ1DAtPTRasAukoLYjwwdAkFPCQQsoTShNHj/IMG_9490.jpeg)|![IMG_9494.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ3Qb8P5nSnurLqmWERmew3cQ1mzdsUfCSpYeFLJGSV9n/IMG_9494.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9495.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdEARUinRKtHj48AzNyoqp3yM8AWzu1KLCMzQi743qT8h/IMG_9495.jpeg)|![IMG_9496.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmba45jxEiVbrKP5erqmmPPrGtR9JrVV2FuvTNeGEioexV/IMG_9496.jpeg)| Para el siguiente paso vamos con las costuras, lo principal que haremos es planchar el entretela a la tela que va por el lado exterior, luego vamos a unir por toda la orilla superior con costura, en la pestaña calculemos que nos quede igual de ambos extremos, a ésta le hice costura diagonal en las esquinas, luego cortamos todos los excedentes, luego vamos a unir con costura por los lados, aquí vamos a tener cuidado de no cocer la pestaña, pasamos una costura uniendo la tela del forro seguida de la tela exterior > For the next step, we'll work on the seams. First, we'll iron the interfacing onto the outer fabric. Then, we'll sew along the entire top edge, making sure the seam allowance is even on both sides. I added diagonal stitching at the corners. Next, we'll trim off any excess fabric. Then, we'll sew along the sides, being careful not to sew the seam allowance itself. We'll sew a seam joining the lining fabric followed by the outer fabric.

> |![IMG_9498.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYcYEFtkpp93FRLx7Rcpnmg9wSYtWzvn6ii5NpioKAHqW/IMG_9498.jpeg)|![IMG_9500.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSki8tiGGyrjLY6pHKG928dGFmUaLaHa1GkLbs8B4VhEp/IMG_9500.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9504.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNkJPwgGgy9zuY9ivAT3zpe8UfUXZiZVWDijFRY52j3zM/IMG_9504.jpeg)|![IMG_9508.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevwTUSocVcjgkVfjSce9hG2fKmPGJxHMZgGZxX7KmnUu/IMG_9508.jpeg)| Cortamos todos los excedentes y luego volteamos la tela para luego pasar costura en la parte inferior por el lado de adentro, aseguramos bien la costura y luego volteamos por el lado derecho y así ya está listo este fácil y práctico sobre para guardar documentos o lo que desees, espero les haya gustado esta idea > We cut off all the excess fabric and then turn it inside out. Next, we sew along the bottom edge on the inside, securing the seam well. Then we turn it right side out, and there you have it—this easy and practical envelope for storing documents or whatever you like. I hope you enjoyed this idea!

> |![IMG_9508.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmevwTUSocVcjgkVfjSce9hG2fKmPGJxHMZgGZxX7KmnUu/IMG_9508.jpeg)|![IMG_9509.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXXNFhSuN2bnSD92amoVmgGikpDuRE2t9Av28NM1M4PZm/IMG_9509.jpeg)| |---|---| |![IMG_9510.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmduVxigkAx5UrKc6Bt4MVEmN8XfTJ4Yb2HtckHXgzD6L1/IMG_9510.jpeg)|![IMG_9511.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSQxLy7cVEKF9igSy5chGeEgDG98nZSgbwKzm6QPvv4fY/IMG_9511.jpeg)| Me ha encantado mucho esta idea para organizar mis documentos o papeles que crea que es necesario guardar, de verdad que es una idea práctica y bastante sencilla, y así aprovechamos todos esos retazos de tela que nos van quedando de las costuras, eso es todo por hoy Amigo, me despido deseándoles una semana llena de bendiciones, hasta otra oportunidad > I really loved this idea for organizing my documents or papers that I think need to be kept. It's truly a practical and quite simple idea, and it's a great way to use up all those fabric scraps we have left over from sewing. That's all for today, my friend. I'm signing off wishing you a blessed week. Until next time!

# Sustainable Fashion: The Future of Style

As the world becomes increasingly aware of environmental issues, sustainable fashion is no longer just a trend; it's a movement that is reshaping the industry. In this post, we will explore what sustainable fashion means, its importance, and how it's paving the way for a more responsible future in style.

## What is Sustainable Fashion?

Sustainable fashion refers to clothing, shoes, and accessories that are designed, manufactured, and marketed in a way that is environmentally friendly and socially responsible. This includes using eco-friendly materials, ethical labor practices, and reducing waste throughout the production process.

### Key Principles of Sustainable Fashion:

1. **Eco-friendly Materials**: Utilizing organic cotton, hemp, Tencel, and recycled fabrics to minimize the environmental impact.
  
2. **Ethical Production**: Ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions for all workers involved in the manufacturing process.

3. **Minimal Waste**: Implementing practices like zero-waste design, upcycling, and recycling to reduce textile waste.

4. **Slow Fashion**: Emphasizing quality over quantity, encouraging consumers to invest in timeless pieces rather than fast fashion trends.

## Why is Sustainable Fashion Important?

### Environmental Impact

The fashion industry is one of the largest polluters in the world, contributing to water pollution, excessive waste, and carbon emissions. By adopting sustainable practices, we can significantly reduce the industry's carbon footprint and protect our planet for future generations.

### Social Responsibility

Sustainable fashion also addresses social issues, such as labor rights and fair wages. By supporting brands that prioritize ethical practices, consumers can help improve the lives of workers globally.

### Consumer Awareness

As consumers become more conscious of their purchasing decisions, they are increasingly seeking brands that align with their values. Sustainable fashion not only meets this demand but also fosters a community of like-minded individuals who prioritize ethical living.

## How to Embrace Sustainable Fashion

1. **Shop Mindfully**: Choose quality over quantity. Invest in pieces that are versatile, durable, and timeless.

2. **Support Ethical Brands**: Research brands that prioritize sustainable practices and ethical labor. Look for certifications like Fair Trade or GOTS (Global Organic Textile Standard).

3. **Thrift and Upcycle**: Give pre-loved clothing a new life by shopping at thrift stores or participating in clothing swaps. Consider upcycling items to create something unique.

4. **Educate Yourself**: Stay informed about the impact of fashion on the environment and society. Knowledge is power, and understanding these issues can help you make better choices.

## The Future of Style

The future of fashion lies in our hands. By embracing sustainable practices, we can create a more ethical, environmentally-friendly industry that prioritizes people and the planet. As designers, brands, and consumers unite in this mission, we can redefine what style means in a world that values sustainability.

Join the movement and be part of the change. Together, we can make fashion a force for good.

---

### Let’s Talk!

What are your thoughts on sustainable fashion? Have you made any changes to your wardrobe to embrace this movement? Share your experiences in the comments below! 🌱✨

links.title: La mayor comelona de  hongos [Spanish-English]
links.body:
¡Hola y buenos días, amigos y amigas de Fungi 🍄 Friday! En un recorrido por el ecosistema de Hive 🐝, descubrí esta interesante comunidad que se relaciona bastante con mi carrera de Geografía, aunque también toca la parte botánica 🌸. Pero lo que realmente me motivó fue una historia curiosa que descubrí hace poco, no solo leyendo en internet, sino viviéndola en carne propia. Hoy quería compartirla con ustedes.

Vivo en las afueras de La Habana, en el municipio de San Miguel del Padrón, Cuba. En una casa de bajos con terreno abundante y muy húmedo —casi inapto para la cría de aves de corral—, pero propicio para el florecimiento de varias especies de hongos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWiQ7D1ZYAe9miQvbtDUi4ikeGqpVCMpXxvK7qpuvHahZ/1777304995866.jpg)

[pin.it](https://pin.it/5PgHhlvft)

Los más comunes son los llamados **hongos xilófagos**. Estos se manifiestan como setas o repisas en la base o corteza de los árboles, provocando pudrición parda, blanca o blanda. Su presencia indica estrés (humedad, heridas) y representa un alto riesgo de caída.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUr4c7RnbcuXh7juNMBFGpPYYQz4jXwYpVf2N4aBqJGK3/1777305200932.jpg)

Sin embargo, al buscar al menos uno para mostrarles, descubrí que ya casi no existen en mi patio, aunque llevo más de 30 años viviendo aquí. Tras investigar, encontré al culpable: mi tortuga de tierra 🐢, llamada **Coka**. Al vivir suelta por el terreno, estos hongos forman parte de su cadena alimenticia. Aunque estos animales comen de todo, este tipo de hongo es su favorito.

Como no encontré hongos en todo mi patio, les comparto algunas imágenes de fuentes reconocidas como Pinterest para que sepan identificarlos.

Bueno, amigos, este fue mi contenido de hoy. Espero que les haya gustado y que la historia compartida les haya parecido interesante y curiosa.
___

___
___

English version content 

Hello and good morning, friends of Fungi 🍄 Friday! While exploring the Hive 🐝 ecosystem, I discovered this interesting community, which ties in quite nicely with my background in Geography—though it touches upon the botanical side of things 🌸 as well. But what really motivated me was a curious story I stumbled upon recently—one I didn't just read about online, but experienced firsthand. Today, I wanted to share it with you all.

I live on the outskirts of Havana, in the municipality of San Miguel del Padrón, Cuba. I reside in a single-story house with a spacious, very damp yard—terrain that is almost unsuitable for raising poultry, yet highly conducive to the flourishing of various mushroom species.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWiQ7D1ZYAe9miQvbtDUi4ikeGqpVCMpXxvK7qpuvHahZ/1777304995866.jpg)

[pin.it](https://pin.it/5PgHhlvft)

The most common among them are the so-called **xylophagous fungi** (wood-eating fungi). These manifest as mushrooms or shelf-like growths at the base or on the bark of trees, causing brown, white, or soft rot. Their presence indicates tree stress (often due to excess moisture or physical wounds) and poses a high risk of the tree eventually toppling over.

https://images.ecency.com/DQmUr4c7RnbcuXh7juNMBFGpPYYQz4jXwYpVf2N4aBqJGK3/1777305200932.jpg

However, when I went looking for at least one specimen to show you, I discovered that they have all but vanished from my yard—despite the fact that I’ve lived here for over 30 years. After doing some investigating, I found the culprit: my tortoise 🐢, named **Coka**. Since she roams freely throughout the yard, these fungi have become part of her food chain. Although these animals are omnivorous and will eat just about anything, this particular type of fungus happens to be her absolute favorite.

Since I couldn't find any fungi left in my own yard, I’m sharing a few images from reputable sources—such as Pinterest—to help you learn how to identify them.

Well, friends, that wraps up my content for today. I hope you enjoyed it and found the story I shared to be both interesting and intriguing.

links.body: Hi there. There is a set reveal in the Pokemon TCG Pocket mobile game. Pulsing Aura (B3) is set to release on April 28, 2026. The featured Pokemon is Mega Lucario ex. I cover some of the [initial revealed cards from Pokebeach](https://www.pokebeach.com/2026/04/pulsing-aura-set-revealed-for-pocket-featuring-mega-lucario). There is also a trailer. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GUhps8waX3o   ## Budew ---

>Image Source Budew with 30 HP has also made its way to the Pocket game. Instead of item locking like in the physical card game, this Budew attack makes the Defending Pokemon lose all Abilities. The abilities come back when the Defending Pokemon leaves the Active Spot.   ## Treecko & Mega Sceptile ex --- | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/Pulsing-Aura-Treecko.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/Pokemon_TCG_Pocket_Pulsing_Aura_Mega_Sceptile_ex.png |   Treecko is a good Grass Basic Pokemon. For one Grass Energy, Pound does 20 damage. Grovyle is unknown. Mega Sceptile ex is the Stage 2 evolution of Grovyle. This has 210 HP, one retreat cost and Fire weakness. Terminating Tail requires 2 Grass Energy to deal 130 damage. You discard 1 Grass Energy and then your opponent's Active Pokemon is Poisoned.   ## Vaporeon ex ---

>Image Source   I think Vaporeon ex is the last Eeveelution to get a Pokemon ex version. Here it is. This one has 160 HP, a three retreat cost, Lightning weakness, one ability and one attack. Wave Splash requires 2 Water Energy to deal 80 damage. Frozen Flow can be used once during your turn if Vaporeon ex is in the Active Spot. You may choose to switch out the opponent's Active Pokemon to the Bench. The opponent chooses a new Active Pokemon. This ability is pretty much like Sabrina.   ## Riolu & Mega Lucario ex --- | | | |---|---| | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/Pulsing-Aura-Riolu_q2itLYT.jpg | https://www.pokebeach.com/news/2026/04/Pokemon_TCG_Pocket_Pulsing_Aura_Mega_Lucario_ex.png | Here is a new version of Riolu. This one has 60 HP and one attack. For one Fighting energy, Fighting Fist does 10 base damage. If the opponent's Active Pokemon is a Pokemon ex then this attack does 30 more damage. For a Basic Pokemon, this Riolu is kind of dangerous. Mega Lucario ex is the evolved version of Riolu. This Stage 1 Mega Pokemon ex has 190 HP, a one retreat cost and Psychic weakness. Fighting Pulse requires 2 Fighting Energy to deal 90 base damage. If there is at least 1 extra Fighting Energy on it, then this attack does 50 more damage (140 damage). For a beatstick attacker, Mega Lucario ex looks pretty strong. Lucario based decks may consider running one of this Mega and the one of the attack boosting Lucario.   ## Bisharp Art Card ---

>Image Source Bisharp is the Stage 1 Metal evolution of Pawniard. Night Slash does not require Metal Energy. It can take 2 of any Energy type to deal 60 damage and then run away to the Bench.   ## Field Blower ---

>Image Source Field Blower is an Item card that lets you discard a Pokemon Tool card from a Pokemon or discard a Stadium in play. This looks like a good removal Item card. The major disadvantages with cards like this is that the opponent may not play any Tools or any Stadium cards in their deck. Some decks may put one copy of this and some deck may find other cards more useful than this.   ## Arena of Antiquity ---
>Image Source Arena of Antiquity is a dedicated Stadium card for Fighting Pokemon. Attacks used by each Fighting Pokemon do 20 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokemon ex.   ## Korrina ---

>Image Source Korrina is a niche Supporter card that goes really well with Fighting Pokemon. During this turn, attacks used by your Fighting Pokemon do 30 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokemon ex.   ## Kubfu ---

>Image Source Kubfu does not deal damage but it is needed for either Single Strike Urshifu or Rapid Strike Urshifu. This art looks nice. If this was printed physically, this card would sell really well.   ## Rapid Strike Urshifu ---

>Image Source Rapid Strike Urshifu is one evolution version for Kubfu. This one has a 3 retreat cost, Lightning weakness and 120 HP. The Double Type ability makes Rapid Strike Urshifu both a Water type and a Fighting type. Double typing is really good as it would make this compatible with Misty, Korrina and other Fighting boosting cards. | | | | |---|---|---| | https://img.game8.co/4174584/67a5bdd899e0be1ca02936613508317a.png/show | https://img.game8.co/4477422/9f85e081c6e0c1b5997cb5fcd92aa9b7.png/show | https://img.game8.co/4093178/695fd51ae5d7d852cc496ec7caf97bf9.png/show | Tornado Shot requires one Water Energy and one Colourless Energy to deal 40 damage to the Active Pokemon. You discard one Water Energy to deal 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon.   ## Single Strike Urshifu ---

>Image Source Single Strike Urshifu is the Dark evolution of Kubfu. This Double Type ability makes this one both a Dark type and a Fighting type. Power Blast requires 2 Dark Energy and one Colourless Energy to deal 110 damage with the drawback of discarding 1 Dark Energy from Single Strike Urshifu.   ## Closing Notes --- Fighting Pokemon get a huge boost from this Pulsing Aura set. Lucario based decks will definitely see play. It is unknown if non-Fighting decks get a boost. Field Blower looks good in some decks. More cards to be revealed as the release date of April 28, 2026 comes soon.  
Thank you for reading.

links.title: “He Brought Me Tea Without Asking 🥺”
links.body:
Okay so it’s Monday evening and I’m still in bed.
Not because I’m sick. Not because I’m tired. Just because I genuinely cannot motivate myself to be a functioning human being today and honestly I don’t feel bad about it at all.
My husband has been at his work station since morning. First day of the week, busiest day, very serious, very focused and so many meetings. I respect it. I really do.
why today of all days did I wake up wanting to go out, eat something nice, have a long pointless conversation, be a little flirty and just exist together doing nothing?
Every single Monday this happens with me i don’t know why! It can happen on saturday or sunday on his weekend but no. Lol

And then today’s weather ah.. can we talk about how unfair today’s weather is?
I stepped onto the balcony for literally two minutes and it was just perfect. That kind of cool fresh air that hits my face and makes close my eyes for a second. Wow! It feels so cool. The kind of evening where everything smells clean and the sky looks soft and your whole body just goes “please do not waste this.”
This weather deserves a walk. It deserves street food eaten outside. It deserves two people sitting somewhere doing absolutely nothing. You and me together.
Instead I came back inside and looked at my husband still typing at his work and i feel so done with life honestly lol.
The balcony is right there. The weather is right there. I am right here and he is replying to emails.

His work station room just six or seven steps away from bed room. I sent him a voice note. I am lying here. He is there. I sent a voice note because getting up felt like too much effort but also I had something important to say which was basically nothing just I missed him. He has not opened it yet.

want to go out. Somewhere small, doesn’t matter where. Just outside in that air. It can be some street food, walking slowly with nowhere to go. Or even just sit on the balcony together hand in hand. Gossip a little with a cup of tea. Laugh about something stupid. Watch the sky go dark. You know the good stuff.
Instead I am lying here sometimes checking to go his work place and watching him type and keep peeking over there hoping he will suddenly decide work is over.
He has not decided work is over yet.

Anyway
The weather outside is doing the most right now and nobody in this house is enjoying it except the curtains blowing in the balcony breeze.
If you also turn into your most romantic, laziest, most let’s-go-somewhere version of yourself specifically on Monday evenings when your husband is at his busy work mode — please comment below because I need to know I’m not the only one living this now.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZEZwHHXiQggwPwHbHCJ2xhog269rUZhTX14eCXfREXQc/img_5973.jpg)

Now I’m in the belcony and here is the chair with me we both trying to be a good company Lol.
Waiting.
He’ll finish work eventually.
Probably.
He just brought me tea without asking. Maybe he did open that voice note after all. 🥺 Oh my God I feels so shy now🫣😍
Happy Monday everyone!

links.title: HEART TO HEART SESSION | MONDAY LIVE | EPISODE 158 | @daverick as host
links.body:
Hello there! It is great to see you again. For now, we have a nice group of hosts, so no need of any new application. For the next hangout, we will @daverick invited host. Also, don't forget that 3 posts from our members who participate in the new hangout will be considered for curations Last session, we discussed the topic: --- ### **Is a Degree Still Worth It** --- Controversial topic since many of us got a university degree and in the end, employment wasn't guaranteed. We discussed how a degree doesn't guarantee you will be rich, and even a job sometimes. The community members brought their experience about the topic. To be rich most of the time is achieved through jobs that don't require a degree, but many times happiness can be found while working in something that we were trained for. Society still need people working in jobs that require degrees, but it doesn't mean that it will pay good enough for a comfortable life. --- **THIS WEEK'S TOPIC:** --- ##
BEAUTY OF LIFE
--- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gwajnberg/23xyteUzrnFQV3o3XWSH2VM5kksrTZyR4VHkYof4ixuoFy1c1L4UJoKr8zoMu4ZU9in3h.png) Life is beautiful, one of the statements we must have heard. But the things happening in the world; wars, diseases, disasters, insecurity, economic hardship, violence, social vices and the like, can make one doubt that reality. Yet, when we look at our lives and the world as well, we can point to some beautiful elements in life. Those things that can put a smile on our faces and make us really say, life is beautiful. **Discussion Questions:** - Is life really beautiful or is it just a chaotic world we're in? - Have you ever doubted the beauty of life? Why, if you did? - What do you look at or consider and you see the beauty of life? - Do you think the chaos in life is necessary to make us realise or recognise its beauty? - Have you learned to appreciate the beauty of life? How do you do that? links.title: Sniper Elite V2 [Let's Play] - 02 - Facility
links.body:
***There's something satisfying about watching the bullets travel across the space and hitting the target's skull!***

----

**Sniper Elite V2** is a Stealth Third-Person Shooter that follows a sniper's mission to stop a German mass destruction weaponry from going off during WWII. **This game is Fun!** The most standout feature is the Bullet-time moments when you snipe a critical hit on enemies.

  https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTPsLTXJajbkz89a6ZS1g5oWMaFKaFjDisG93CbLyBwWz/Sniper_Elite_V2_cover_D.webp 

I had *Sniper Elite V2* in my backlog for a long time, and I wish I played it sooner.

The game is different from the usual World War II game in that the main character is a sniper, and most of the game is about stealth and/or shooting from distance. There's enough variety in gameplay to not feel stale. I played on Easy Mode, yet I still found it somewhat challenging. Though I managed to beat the whole game without a guide.

The game has you fight both Germans and Russians, while gathering information or inflitrating enemy bases. The V2 in the title refers to the German weapon that the Sniper Elite must stop.

Watch my playthrough below:

links.title: HSCP—WK40 NEW PROMPT: MY SCHOOL-GIVEN FRIEND.
links.body:
<center>**Hello Hive Students and Alumni👋!** </center>


We welcome y'all to Hivestudents prompt, Week 40.




![1000707281.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23u5VDsVgSamDkYXLdsE9mcYn88Jh7iEJDtMjXqncRwRbaCtuPbU5T67JBQ5KuxYpxvhE.png)





<hr style=\

>

It's another amazing week, and you know what that means - it's the 40th edition of the weekly prompt to spark your creativity and get those ideas flowing in. Hive Student Connect is a community where students on Hive share their blogs. It is a vibrant space for Hive students to engage, learn, connect, and collaborate, fostering growth and development.

Whether you are currently a student or have already finished school, you are welcome to share your perspective.

This is your chance to express yourself and connect with others in the community.

Each week, we bring a unique theme or idea, something that challenges your mind, invites you, and simply pushes you to have fun while playing with words.

So ready to dive in? Below is the week's prompt and guidelines. Please ensure you read them in order not to make any mistakes.

Don't forget to tag the post correctly and share your entries in the Discord channel and not in the comment section. - Very compulsory!



<hr style=\

>



Title: That One Friend School Gave Me.


As students in school or as alumni, we all know that school comes with and gives us many things, talk of stress, memories, and such, but whether planned or unplanned, it tends to bring people our way too, people who later turn into very close friends.



So, this week, we want to know about that friend school gave you. Amongst the many friends, we are sure one will stand out. It might be your roommate, your coursemate, a seat partner, or a neighbor...



It can even be someone you knew from afar and never knew you would end up being that close to.



We want to know how you met, if it was accidental or not, what brought you both together, if you started out as fight buddies or enemies, or if it just happened... and as well, include one of the many things they did that would make you forever cherish them.


**If you also have a picture of you both together, share it and let us see that amazing human.**





<hr style=\

>


- Be original, post a minimum of 300 words.

- Everyone is welcome to join this contest.

- Subscribe to the Hive Student Connect community.

- Engage with others.

- Share your entry link in our [Discord channel](https://discord.com/invite/QktrhgRNjG), mention three people you supported as you share your link in Discord (This is compulsory).

- Post in English. If you must post in languages other than English, ensure that you include an English translation.

- Invite 3 people to join this prompt.

- No plagiarism (direct, self, monsaic or accidental), AI content or post recycling.

- Cite the image or text source that does not belong to you.

- Use the tag; #hivestudents, #students, #hscp-wk40, and #neoxian as your first four tags.


<hr style=\

>




All entrants must be active members in the Discord server to be eligible for curation (not guaranteed, though).

There will be three winners, 1st to 3rd place and 2 special mentions.

Rewards will be distributed like this:

- 1st will receive 3 Hive & 300 neoxag 
- 2nd will receive 2 Hive & 300 neoxag 
- 3rd will receive 1 Hive & 300 neoxag 
- Two special mentions will 300 neoxag receive  each.

<hr style=\

links.title: The Game They Need You To Keep Playing
links.body:
![HG2BbVhaoAA0ejS.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/pivx/23u5b6EeUJhMbSkwmL3r3MqbfHSoHj6dkoWuPYuzBYuRUA9XHCD61irb6xQtVxhBWkr6L.jpeg)

The room is warm. The light is low. Someone dealt the cards a long time ago, before you arrived, and the rules were explained just clearly enough for you to feel like a participant.

You played. Most people do. It seemed the reasonable thing — the only thing, really. Everyone else was at the table. The stakes felt manageable. And the dealer had a reassuring face, a practiced manner, a way of making the whole arrangement feel not just normal but necessary. Democratic, even.

It took a long time to notice that the other players always seemed to know something you didn’t. That the house never lost. That the rules, read carefully, had been written by people who were not sitting at your end of the table.

And that the door, the whole time, had been right behind you.

* * *

Some people thought they had found a way to change the game from within.

Not so long ago, they were promised disruption. An outsider. Someone who had nothing to owe the machine, because he had never needed it — or so the story went. The swamp would be drained. The people who had been dealt the worst hands, year after year, would finally have their turn.

They were not stupid for wanting this. They were human. When the table has been rigged long enough, the promise of a new dealer feels like salvation.

But disruption, it turned out, has its own donors. Its own revolving doors. Its own preferred industries, preferred policies, preferred exemptions. The faces around the table shifted. The table did not.

This belief — that the right person, the right movement, the right wave of anger could finally overturn the house — is not stupidity. It is loyalty. And loyalty, once extended, is astonishingly difficult to withdraw — because withdrawing it means admitting something painful: that the years of compliance, the forms filled out, the taxes paid, the faith extended, the ballots cast, were not investments in a shared future. They were contributions to someone else’s private one.

Some people are only now beginning to admit this.

But they are.

* * *

Watch the dealer carefully, and the technique becomes visible.

A politician takes the stage. The lighting is warm. The words are practiced. There is talk of ordinary people, of shared sacrifice, of the hard work ahead. There is a flag somewhere, applause at the right moments. The cameras find faces in the crowd — worried faces, hopeful faces, faces that want to believe they are watching something real.

And then the cameras stop rolling.

The calls begin. Not to constituents, but to donors. The legislation takes shape in rooms that smell like money rather than democracy. The final text — thousands of pages, released hours before the vote — was not written by the people who will vote on it. It was written by the people who paid for the people who will vote on it.

This is not cynicism dressed up as insight. It is the operational reality of modern governance in most of the world’s wealthiest democracies. Lobbyists don’t influence legislation. In many cases, they author it.

But the deepest trick happens before any of this — before the cameras, before the speeches, before the vote. It happens in the hand selection. Candidates who might genuinely threaten the donor class find their funding dry up, their media coverage thin, their party support quietly withdrawn. By the time a name appears on a ballot, the serious vetting has already occurred. Not by voters. By money. The players at your end of the table get to choose between the cards the house has already approved.

Democracy, in this reading, doesn’t begin at the ballot box.

It ends there.

* * *

People know this. They have known it for a long time, in the way you know, somewhere in the back of your mind, that the odds in a casino are not in your favour — and keep playing anyway, because what else would you do?

Opinion surveys in country after country show the same result: collapsing trust in governments, in institutions, in the premise that those in power answer to those who placed them there. But the surveys measure a feeling. What they do not capture is the mechanism. It is not simply that politicians stop listening after they are elected. It is that the politicians who would have listened were never permitted to get that far. The selection happens upstream, in the funding rounds, the endorsement calls, the quiet conversations about viability that precede any public process entirely.

The filter is invisible. That is the point of it.

If the game is fixed at the point of selection, what do you do? You cannot simply vote harder — the cards available to you were chosen by someone else. You cannot protest your way to the table where decisions are actually made. You cannot opt out of the economy — you still need to eat, to pay rent, to move through a world that requires participation at every turn.

So most people do the only thing that seems available: they carry on. They absorb the dissonance. They reserve their outrage for the dinner table, the comment section, the private conversation. And they continue, dutifully, to lay down their cards.

And to fill out the forms.

* * *

Here is where the arrangement reveals its sharpest edge.

You will provide your name. Your address. Your date of birth. Your government-issued identification. Proof of your source of funds. Explanation of the purpose of your transaction. Not because you are suspected of wrongdoing, but because the system has decided that your continued participation requires justification.

Know Your Customer. The phrase has the texture of care — as though the institution asking is motivated by concern for you, for your protection, your best interests.

But consider what is not asked in return.

Does the customer know the institution? Does the customer know how the bank’s balance sheet is structured, which risks it carries, which political campaigns its executives quietly fund, which industries its investment arm finances in your name? Does the customer know which lobbyist wrote the regulation that defines what the institution may do — and what it need not disclose?

The answer, of course, is no.

And yet this same system — the one that requires your complete financial transparency — has a long and documented record of looking the other way when the person in question is wealthy enough, connected enough, or useful enough to the right people. Files have surfaced over the years. Names attached to extraordinary behaviour in extraordinary places — behaviour that would have ended ordinary lives. The consequences for those concerned remained largely theoretical. But what those files also revealed, to those paying attention, is that the names within them were not the architects of the arrangement. They were guests. The people who truly control such situations are rarely found in the documents at all. They are the ones who decide what gets released, and when, and to whom.

The information flows in one direction only: toward them, about you. Analysed, cross-referenced, sold, leaked, stolen — fed into systems that will judge your future based on choices you made with no idea they were being permanently recorded.

This is what they call safety. What they call the price of participation.

They did not ask if you agreed to these terms. They simply changed them. And the cards kept coming.

* * *

Now, in the background, the house is introducing a new kind of chip.

It goes by several names. In some places, a Central Bank Digital Currency. In others it arrives more quietly, dressed as a stablecoin — neutral, efficient, modern. Progress. The natural next step in a journey toward frictionless payment that has only ever moved in one direction.

What it actually is, is the logical conclusion of everything that came before. The final card in a hand that has been building for decades.

Physical cash has always been the problem, from the house’s perspective. Cash is anonymous. It cannot be frozen by an algorithm, redirected by a policy update, or expired on a schedule designed to encourage spending at politically convenient moments. A centrally-issued digital currency solves all of these inconveniences — not from your perspective, of course, but from theirs.

Money has always been, at its core, a tool of individual agency — the ability to exchange value without permission, to save without approval, to move resources without explaining yourself to anyone. A programmable currency issued by a central authority is the opposite of that. It is money with conditions attached — updated silently, applied selectively, enforced automatically. Spend it here, not there. Before this date, not after. On these goods, not those.

The technology is neutral. The intentions behind it are not.

A leash. Made of code. Attached, gently and for your own good, to everything you own.

* * *

The natural response, still, is to look for a reformer. A new dealer. Someone honest enough to change the rules from within.

But the rules were not written by the dealer. The dealer is an employee. And the people who own the house have spent decades purchasing not just politicians but the entire machinery through which politicians might be held to account — the regulators who return to the industries they once oversaw, the legislation drafted before the public vote, the campaign structures that determine which reformers are viable before a single ballot is cast.

To believe that the next election, the next administration, the next wave of righteous anger will alter this architecture is not hope.

It is the house’s most valuable asset.

There is an old idea that has grown newly urgent. When an institution fails you, the theory goes, you have a choice between voice and exit. For generations, exit was treated as surrender — the responsible citizen raised their voice, organised, demanded to be heard.

But that framing assumed the microphone was real. That the feedback loop between citizens and those who govern them remained intact.

When that loop is severed — not just at the point of governance but earlier, at the point of selection, where money has already determined which voices will ever reach the room — exit changes its character entirely.

Pushing back your chair and walking away from a rigged table is not defeat.

It is the only move that cannot be countered.

* * *

What does walking away actually look like?

Not the fantasy of the hermit — disconnected, self-sufficient, responsible to no one. That is simply a different kind of illusion. You still live in the world. You still need to move through it.

It looks, instead, like a steady and deliberate migration of your financial life away from systems that require your total legibility as the price of participation. A quiet reduction of surface area. Not a protest anyone needs to witness. A personal decision, made in private, for reasons that are nobody else’s business.

It looks like understanding that the money in your bank account is a liability on someone else’s balance sheet — subject to their policies, their freezing mechanisms, their reporting requirements. The account number is yours. The money, increasingly, is conditional.

It looks like recognising that continuing to fund decisions you were never asked about — made in rooms you will never enter, for reasons explained to you only afterward, if at all — is not citizenship. It is subsidy.

And it looks like asking, calmly and without drama, what an alternative architecture for your financial life might actually look like. Not as a political statement. Not as a form of protest that anyone needs to notice.

As a personal decision. Private. Practical. Self-respecting.

* * *

This is where something built without venture capital timelines, without the approval of institutions, and without any particular interest in being respectable, begins to matter.

PIVX does not promise to fix the table. It offers something more modest and more useful: a way to leave it.

You can hold wealth in a form that no government can freeze, no institution can seize, no algorithm can expire. You can stake that wealth — participate in the network’s operation — and receive quiet, compounding rewards that require neither employer nor bank account nor form to access. You can operate a masternode and participate in a system that functions identically for everyone, regardless of jurisdiction, identity, or political inconvenience.

But PIVX offers something beyond the financial — something the current system has not managed in a generation: a community where voice is not for sale.

Development decisions are not handed down from a boardroom or shaped by the preferences of venture capital. They emerge from open discussion among people who understand what they are building and why — a meritocracy in the original sense, where the quality of an argument matters more than the status of the person making it. This is how PIVX has, more than once, arrived at the frontier of privacy technology before larger, better-funded projects found their way there. Not despite its structure, but because of it.

Masternode owners do not merely earn rewards. They vote. On the treasury. On proposals. On the direction the project takes next. Real votes, on real decisions, that move real resources. The outcome is not predetermined by whoever wrote the largest cheque. It is determined by the people who chose to show up.

This is what representative democracy was supposed to look like. The fact that it is functioning here — in a privacy network, governed by pseudonymous participants across dozens of countries — while failing so visibly in the institutions that claim to embody it, is not a coincidence. It is a consequence of design. Systems that cannot be bought tend to behave differently from systems that can.

And when you need to re-enter the world you still live in — because you do still live in it — the paths exist. Into Bitcoin, something close to digital gold after more than seventeen years: a store of value outside the reach of monetary policy, resistant to dilution by decree. Or directly into daily life — through gift cards, through merchants, through the growing network of places where value held outside the system can be spent inside it, on your terms, without leaving the trail that someone else will use to build their model of who you are.

This is not escape.

It is the freedom to move through the world without the house watching every hand you play.

* * *

The objection will come — it always does — that this is only for those with something to hide.

That phrase has done extraordinary work for the people it protects, and it deserves examination.

Everyone has something to hide, in the precise sense that everyone has things they consider private. Medical choices. Religious convictions. Political donations. The contents of their conscience. These are not shameful things. They are human things. The right to hold them without narrating them to an institution is not a privilege for the suspicious. It is a basic condition of dignity.

The people demanding your total financial transparency are, themselves, comprehensively opaque. The donor relationships, the backroom arrangements, the regulatory decisions made over private dinners — none of this is visible to you. It is visible to the participants, who are careful about what they commit to paper.

They have chosen their privacy carefully, and defended it at every turn.

They would simply prefer that the option not be available to you.

* * *

The room is still there. The table is still set. The dealer still has that practiced manner, that reassuring face.

But something has changed.

You can see the door now.

Not the dramatic exit of the revolutionary — coat thrown on, bridges burning behind them. The quieter exit of someone who has simply looked clearly at what is being asked: total financial legibility, permanent behavioral records, participation in a monetary system whose direction has been consistent for decades. And decided, without anger, without theater, that this particular arrangement no longer requires their cooperation.

Becoming ungovernable is not a statement. It is a posture. Maintained privately. Practiced daily. Invisible to the people it no longer serves.

It does not fix the room. Nothing so modest could claim that.

But it does something the house cannot easily counter: it reduces your dependence on it. Quietly. One decision at a time. Building, in the unhurried way of someone who has stopped rushing toward a finish line that was never theirs, a financial life that does not require total submission as the price of admission.

And in that reduction, something returns that is difficult to name but immediately recognizable once felt.

Not the performed agency of the voter who believes their ballot reaches the rooms where things are actually decided. Not the exhausted agency of the protester who shouts at a wall. The real kind. The private kind. The kind that requires no audience, no validation, no permission.

*The kind that was always yours.*

*The door was always there.*

*It is remarkably easy to walk through.*

links.title: Proteína Completa
links.body:
by Hilaricita on Hilaricita 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/hilaricita [![Proteína Completa](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/33f2b5c5-9c03-48bc-879f-8244bb005e66.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/84zW86Dr8U7mwZN3ZPSe36) 
 
 ![Versión español.png](https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/hilaricita/0c2eef4b843038ffa91c5c76126870fbaa369559.png)

Lunes 27 de abril, 2026

Al sostener un huevo en la mano, uno no solo percibe el peso de un alimento, sino la complejidad de una estructura biológica diseñada para proteger la vida. Desde fuera, la cáscara parece una barrera simple, pero bajo la lupa se revela como una maravilla de la ingeniería natural: porosa, resistente y compuesta principalmente por carbonato de calcio. Esta porosidad es vital, pues permite el intercambio gaseoso necesario para que el embrión respire, aunque también convierte al huevo en un elemento sensible a los olores y a la humedad del entorno. No es casualidad que las gallinas pongan huevos de tonalidades distintas; el color, ya sea blanco, marrón o incluso azul verdoso en ciertas razas, depende exclusivamente de la genética de la ave y no influye en absoluto en su valor nutricional o sabor, aunque el mercado suele tener sus propias preferencias culturales.

Dentro de esa frágil fortaleza, la clara y la yema cumplen roles perfectamente diferenciados. La clara, formada mayoritariamente por agua y proteínas como la ovoalbúmina, actúa como amortiguador y fuente de hidratación, mientras que la yema concentra la densidad nutricional: grasas, vitaminas liposolubles y minerales. En un huevo recién puesto, la cámara de aire es minúscula y la yema se mantiene centrada, sostenida por esos cordones blancos y espirales llamados chalazas, que muchos confunden erróneamente con defectos o principios de incubación, cuando en realidad son anclajes esenciales. 

Más allá de la cocina, el mundo avícola presenta curiosidades que desafían la percepción común. Por ejemplo, la formación de la cáscara es un proceso metabólico intensivo para la gallina, que requiere grandes cantidades de calcio; si la dieta no está equilibrada, la calidad de la cáscara se resiente, apareciendo huevos rugosos o demasiado finos. También existe el mito de que los huevos morenos son más \

o naturales; la realidad es que una gallina de raza Leghorn pondrá huevos blancos incluso en libertad, mientras que una Rhode Island Red los pondrá marrones en una jaula. 

Finalmente, hay un detalle técnico que a menudo pasa desapercibido: la cutícula. Esa capa invisible que recubre la cáscara justo después de la puesta sirve como sello antibacteriano natural. En muchos países, lavar los huevos antes de venderlos elimina esta protección, obligando a mantenerlos refrigerados para evitar que las bacterias penetren por los poros. En otros lugares, se prefiere no lavarlos para preservar la cutícula, permitiendo su almacenamiento a temperatura ambiente durante periodos limitados. 

El huevo es, sin duda, el ingrediente más democrático y versátil de la despensa, capaz de transformarse por completo con apenas un cambio de temperatura o una variación en la técnica. No se trata solo de romper la cáscara y lanzar el contenido a la sartén; hay toda una filosofía detrás de cómo tratar esta proteína para extraer su máximo potencial. Empezando por lo básico, unos huevos revueltos bien hechos requieren paciencia y fuego bajo. 

Cuando se busca elegancia francesa, la tortilla o *omelette* es la prueba definitiva de destreza. No debe tener color dorado ni manchas marrones; su exterior ha de ser pálido, liso y sedoso, mientras que el interior permanece ligeramente baveux, jugoso. El movimiento de la muñeca al golpear el mango de la sartén para enrollarla es un gesto que se aprende con años de práctica, buscando esa forma almendrada perfecta. Por otro lado, si se prefiere la textura crujiente, los huevos fritos ofrecen un contraste maravilloso. 

En el ámbito de la repostería y las preparaciones frías, el huevo actúa como emulsionante y aireador. Una mayonesa casera no tiene comparación con la industrial porque la lecitina de la yema crea una estabilidad única cuando se integra lentamente con el aceite. Del mismo modo, al hacer una holandesa, el equilibrio entre la mantequilla clarificada tibia y las yemas batidas al baño María exige una atención constante para evitar que se corte, resultando en una salsa aterciopelada ideal para espárragos o huevos benedictinos. 

Incluso en preparaciones más rústicas, como un shakshuka o unos huevos rancheros, el huevo cumple la función de unir sabores dispares. El calor residual de una salsa de tomate especiada o de unos frijoles refritos termina de cocinar la clara mientras mantiene la yema intacta, actuando como un elemento de unión que suaviza la acidez o el picante. Al final, cocinar con huevo es un ejercicio de respeto hacia el tiempo y la temperatura. No admite prisas ni distracciones, pues pasa de crudo a gomoso en cuestión de segundos. Dominar sus texturas permite entender mejor la cocina en general, ya que pocas proteínas responden con tanta sensibilidad al tacto del cocinero.

Durante décadas, el huevo ha sido objeto de un intenso escrutinio, pasando de ser vilipendiado por su contenido en colesterol a ser reivindicado como uno de los alimentos más completos disponibles. Al analizar su impacto en la salud desde una perspectiva actualizada, queda claro que sus beneficios superan ampliamente los riesgos para la gran mayoría de la población, siempre que se consuma dentro de un contexto dietético equilibrado. La principal ventaja radica en su excepcional calidad proteica; el huevo posee el patrón de aminoácidos esenciales más cercano al que el cuerpo humano necesita para reparar tejidos, mantener la masa muscular y sintetizar enzimas, lo que lo convierte en una fuente de proteína de altísimo valor biológico, especialmente valiosa para niños, ancianos o personas en proceso de recuperación.

Más allá de las proteínas, la yema es un reservorio de nutrientes críticos que a menudo faltan en la dieta moderna. Es una de las pocas fuentes naturales de colina, un nutriente esencial para la salud cerebral, la memoria y el desarrollo del sistema nervioso, así como de luteína y zeaxantina, antioxidantes potentes que se acumulan en la retina y ayudan a proteger la vista frente a la degeneración macular asociada a la edad. Además, aporta vitaminas del grupo B, como la B12, fundamental para la energía y la función neurológica, junto con vitaminas liposolubles como la A, D y E. Esta densidad nutricional hace que sea un alimento extremadamente eficiente: pocas calorías para una cantidad tan concentrada de micronutrientes.

Sin embargo, la controversia histórica sobre el colesterol no puede ignorarse por completo, aunque la ciencia ha matizado mucho su relevancia. Para la mayoría de las personas, el colesterol dietary presente en los huevos tiene un impacto mínimo en los niveles de colesterol en sangre, ya que el hígado regula su propia producción reduciéndola cuando la ingesta aumenta. No obstante, existe un subgrupo de población, conocidos como \

o personas con hipercolesterolemia familiar, que sí pueden experimentar un aumento más notable en sus lípidos sanguíneos ante un consumo elevado. En estos casos, así como en individuos con diabetes tipo 2 mal controlada, se suele recomendar moderación, limitando el consumo a unas tres o cuatro unidades por semana o priorizando las claras, que contienen toda la proteína sin la grasa ni el colesterol.

Otro aspecto a considerar es la forma de preparación, que puede transformar un alimento saludable en una opción menos conveniente. Freír el huevo en aceites abundantes o acompañarlo habitualmente de embutidos procesados añade grasas saturadas, sodio y calorías vacías que contrarrestan sus beneficios intrínsecos. La cocción también influye en la biodisponibilidad de sus nutrientes; cocinar el huevo mejora la absorción de la proteína y destruye la avidina, una proteína de la clara cruda que puede interferir con la absorción de la biotina (vitamina B7). Por ello, consumirlos crudos no solo plantea riesgos microbiológicos como la salmonela, sino que también es nutricionalmente menos eficiente.

En definitiva, incorporar huevos a la dieta regular es una estrategia inteligente para mejorar la saciedad, controlar el peso y asegurar un aporte nutricional robusto. Su capacidad para proporcionar sensación de plenitud ayuda a reducir el picoteo entre horas, lo que indirectamente favorece el manejo calórico. La clave no está en demonizar ni en exaltar el alimento de forma aislada, sino en entenderlo como parte de un patrón alimentario variado. Para la persona sana, un huevo al día es perfectamente seguro y beneficioso; para aquellos con condiciones metabólicas específicas, la personalización y la moderación son las herramientas adecuadas para seguir disfrutando de este alimento sin comprometer la salud cardiovascular.

Como ya casi se acaba el número de caracteres de la caja de información, les dejo con la canción que le pedí a SUNO, esperando que esta publicación les haya servido, no solo como entretenimiento, sino que les haya aportado un poco, una chispa de contenido que genera valor.

🎵 🎶 🎶 🎶 🎵 🎼 🎼 ♬ ♫ ♪ ♩

Esta fue una canción e información útil de lunes.

Gracias por pasarse a leer y escuchar un rato, amigas, amigos, amigues de BlurtMedia.

Que tengan un excelente día y que Dios los bendiga grandemente.

Saludines, camaradas \

links.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdUYtXm1BzAzx2BrmPY3ce2wi8UQhtixC1tqnmVbAAGDa/e21601a11152788fdd25601ad806240c)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/846513b2)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=likhon420/846513b2)


---

DEAD TARGET is a popular first-person shooter (FPS) mobile game that immerses players in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies.Developed by VNG Game Studios, the game combines intense action, survival elements, and strategic gameplay to create an engaging experience for fans of shooting and horror genres.

Set in the year 2040, the storyline revolves around a devastating global war between major nations. During this conflict, a powerful corporation secretly conducts illegal experiments to create super-soldiers. However, these experiments go horribly wrong, resulting in a deadly virus outbreak that turns humans into flesh-eating zombies. 

As society collapses, chaos spreads across cities, and humanity is pushed to the brink of extinction. The player takes on the role of a skilled sniper and survivor who must fight against endless waves of zombies while uncovering the truth behind the outbreak.

One of the most striking features of DEAD TARGET is its immersive gameplay. The game adopts a first-person perspective, allowing players to feel directly involved in the action. Players are positioned in fixed locations and must aim and shoot incoming zombies before they reach them.

The controls are simple and intuitive, making it easy for beginners to pick up while still offering enough challenge for experienced players. Precision, timing, and quick reflexes are essential for survival, as zombies attack in increasing numbers and with greater speed.

The game offers a wide variety of weapons, ranging from basic pistols to powerful sniper rifles, shotguns, and machine guns. Each weapon can be upgraded using in-game currency, improving attributes such as damage, reload speed, and accuracy. This progression system adds depth to the gameplay, encouraging players to continue playing and improving their arsenal. Special weapons like rocket launchers and grenades also become available, providing additional strategies to handle tougher enemies.

DEAD TARGET features multiple types of zombies, each with unique abilities and behaviors. Some zombies are slow and easy to defeat, while others are fast, heavily armored, or capable of dealing massive damage. Boss zombies present an even greater challenge, requiring players to use all their skills and resources to defeat them. This variety keeps the gameplay fresh and prevents it from becoming repetitive.

Boss zombies present an even greater challenge, requiring players to use all their skills and resources to defeat them. This variety keeps the gameplay fresh and prevents it from becoming repetitive.

The game is divided into different missions and chapters, each set in various locations such as abandoned cities, military bases, and dark underground facilities. As players progress, they unlock new areas and face increasingly difficult challenges. The mission-based structure provides a clear sense of progression and achievement, motivating players to continue advancing through the story.

Visually, DEAD TARGET delivers impressive graphics for a mobile game. The environments are detailed and atmospheric, with dark lighting and eerie sound effects that enhance the horror experience. The design of the zombies is particularly noteworthy, featuring realistic and sometimes terrifying appearances that add to the tension and excitement.

In addition to its offline campaign mode, DEAD TARGET also includes online features such as events and challenges. Players can participate in limited-time missions to earn extra rewards and compete with others on global leaderboards. These features add a competitive element to the game and increase its replay value.

Another important aspect of the game is its accessibility. DEAD TARGET is free to play and available on both Android and iOS platforms. While it includes optional in-app purchases, players can still enjoy the full experience without spending money by gradually earning rewards through gameplay.

Overall, DEAD TARGET stands out as a highly entertaining zombie shooting game that combines action, strategy, and storytelling. Its engaging gameplay, diverse weapons, challenging enemies, and immersive atmosphere make it a favorite among mobile gamers. Whether you are a casual player looking for quick action or a dedicated gamer seeking a thrilling survival experience, DEAD TARGET offers something for everyone.

links.title: A JOURNEY THROUGH... (PHOTOGRAPHY STORIES)
links.body:
![Tcats.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/AK55BpuUxZZfBqXuBG9gumXjyi8gyj6eGGTe9ojC9D3hCR62szMEA2tK6rjtbEr.jpg)

----

**Y**es, every time I observe myself wandering the streets and taking photographs, it becomes clearer and clearer that all of this has been a journey through my own life. And I know that some of you who follow my photography blog on #Hive already know quite a bit about how I ended up documenting the streets almost daily and about my relationship with the people, animals, things, places, and even memories of my town. But today I want to tell you, even just a little, about how every hour I've spent wandering the streets with my camera in hand has ended up becoming an exercise in acute and, at times, painful introspection... I started taking photos as therapy... But it all began, I think, after I finished high school at 15 (the youngest in my class). By 21, I had already graduated from university, was working at a company, happily married, and had a two-year-old son. So, with everything in my life moving so fast, it wasn't surprising that at 34 I was already the brand-new national IT manager of a local corporation and that I was also spending some of my afternoons on a psychologist's couch telling him how work stress was slowly killing me 🙃🤷‍♂... And well, the truth is that things happen as they're meant to, because it was precisely all of that that led me to photography as part of a more comprehensive therapy which, by the way, included antidepressant medication, something which, fortunately, I no longer need... And well, what I wanted to say was that, in a way, photography, my passion for it I mean, is one of the main factors that helped me \
... And wow, now looking back, seeing \

as I started thinking earlier today; I've concluded that everything is better now and that my mind is much lighter; it's a very light space. And I think I observed myself so much that I ended up throwing overboard a lot of what was weighing me down... And I know there's still a way to go, that the journey is even longer, but I also know that I'm doing more or less okay...\n\n>**S**í, cada vez que me observo a mi mismo recorriendo las calles y haciendo fotografías, tengo más y más claro que todo esto ha sido recorrido a lo largo de mi mismo. Y sé que algunos de ustedes que siguen mi blog de contenido fotográfico en #Hive ya sabrán bastante a cerca de como terminé registrando las calles casi a diario y de como es mi relación con las personas, animales, cosas, lugares e incluso recuerdos de mi pueblo. Pero hoy quiero contarles, siquiera un poco, de como cada hora invertida por mi deambulando por las calles con mi cámara en la mano; ha terminado por convertirse en un ejercicio de introspección aguda y, en algunas ocasiones, doloroso... Comencé a hacer fotos como terapía. Pero creo que todo esto realmente empezó luego de haber concluido la secundaria a los 15 años (el más joven de mi clase), a mis 21 años ya estaba graduado en la universidad, trabajando en una empresa, felizmente casado y con un hijo de dos años de edad. Así que, yendo todo en mi vida tan rápido, no era de extrañarse que a los 34 ya fuese el flamante gerente nacional de IT de una corporación local y que también pasara algunas horas de mis tardes en el diván de un psicólogo contándole como el stress laboral estaba matándome lentamente 🙃🤷‍♂... Y bueno, la verdad es que las cosas suceden como tienen que suceder, porque fue precisamente todo eso lo que me llevó a hacer fotografías como parte de una terapia más completa la cual por cierto, incluía fármacos antidepresivos, cosa la cual hoy por hoy, afortunadamente ya no me es necesario... Y bien, lo que quería decir fue que, de cierta manera, la fotografía, mi afición por ella quiero decir, es uno de los principales factores que me sirvieron para \
... Y caray, ahora viendo en retrospectiva, viendo \

como se me ocurrió pensar hoy temprano; concluyo que todo está mejor ahora y que en mi mente hay poca carga, es un espacio muy ligero. Y creo que me observé tanto mi mismo que, terminé tirando por la borda mucho de aquello que me lastraba... Y sé que aún falta, que el viaje es aún más largo, pero también sé que voy más o menos bien... 

----

![T01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23z7JHfnpCHyfEbo56VrFxnucwDGzVnoJas5evnLNXuQdHzM9TmTVKz1pAxCCbBkJ7upH.jpg)
**📷 01 - Antonio stops and says, \

... </sub>**

----

![T03.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jlinaresp/23tSS27Hxa74JzkqnKVV249ig6Qcrfn99MhjhaJNBbB5CzECjyx98X9qYJov3AeMqKJD6.jpg)
