links.title: The Secret to Mastering Your Life: It All Starts with the \
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTPvAHcAzV23wKpSMGqUSjrz9SFijRhR8sgACkPYwhRxJ/1777304177672.jpg)
We all have those days where it feels like life is just happening to us. We wake up late, eat whatever is convenient, stress about money, and let a bad mood ruin our entire evening. It’s exhausting, right?
But if you look at the greatest leaders, athletes, or even just that one person you know who always seems to have their life together, they all have one thing in common: Self-Discipline. The image of the samurai standing before the mountain says it all. To conquer the mountains in our lives, we first have to conquer ourselves. Here is how you can start mastering the \

today.
1. Mind
Your mind is like a garden. If you don’t plant flowers, weeds will grow automatically. Control your self-talk. Instead of focusing on why things are going wrong, train your brain to look for solutions.
2. Mouth
This is twofold: what goes out and what comes in. Be careful with your words—they can build bridges or burn them. At the same time, watch what you consume. Gossip and negativity are just as toxic as bad food.
3. Moves
Stop \

Your moves are your actions. Whether it’s starting a project or hitting the gym, consistent, intentional movement is what creates momentum.
4. Morning
How you spend your first hour defines your next fifteen. If you start your day scrolling through social media, you’re playing defense. Win your morning with a routine, and you’ll win the day.
5. Meal
Food is fuel, not just a reward. When you eat poorly, you feel sluggish and lose focus. Taking control of your nutrition is the fastest way to upgrade your energy levels.
6. Money
Financial stress is one of the biggest killers of peace. Controlling your money doesn’t mean being rich; it means knowing where your dollars are going instead of wondering where they went.
7. Mood
You can’t control the weather or traffic, but you can control how you react. Emotional intelligence is the ultimate power move. Don't let a 10-second bad moment ruin a 24-hour day.
The Bottom Line
Mastering these seven areas isn't about being perfect; it's about being intentional. You don't need to change everything overnight. Pick one \
to focus on this week. Once you control the internal, the external world starts to fall into place.\n\nWhich one are you going to focus on first? Let’s talk about it in the comments!

links.title: Hive Reach-out Week 97 - Charity even when it feels like a hard nut
links.body:
Charity as the word look so simple is a big one for me if we look into it deeper and carefully, one will know that there is more to just that word and all thanks to the weekly prompt talking about the test of charity, i will just jump into directly into the topic without going helter skelter . Defining the term itself and making people know more about the word charity itself before we now move to the test.


![IMG_4058.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mayorkeys/23wgmGgszEK9s2sT6Zq3e5eQtoqrj6kW327w9P2uAsmXXVjJMG2qofc72gGEzi8ytaMu5.jpeg)


CHARITY is the act of voluntarily giving out to people without expecting anything in return as a favor. It actually involves giving and not just giving but in love and not doing it for appraisals. Now we tend to see many people form organizations saying charity club and trying to put smile on people’s face. I could relate because currently i am serving and my cds is under charity group so i know how things are been organized within. That is a voluntary giving which is not a test of charity. When talking about test, it is like saying challenge and when we say challenge it means somethings that is not easy and you do it in a tight way.

When charity start becoming like a burden or you feel it is already looking like stress that is not a voluntary giving. It is like giving help in a very tight situation which you yourself never expected before and when we are talking about charity, it does not necessarily have to be money. Let us look at this example now you have a friend and you just got a call from him in the middle of the night that his car got broken down along the street not too far from yours and the area is dangerous, stranded with no cash and the only bike he saw was calling an amount so much he put a call through to you and immediately you pick up your car key and went there to pick him up saving him the stress, that is a termed charity to me.

And i believe if the act can continue not to just people we know but mainly to those we don’t know that is the real charity we are talking about because from the example above he was already fast asleep and on a normal day he should not even respond so fast to the call and he picked up the car key immediately to save a friend which is actually cool. 

Charity does not just happen once but it is a continuous stuff to do and that is why i said once charity is already becoming a burden it is already out of it. The test of. Charity can be very challenging that sometimes you will just want to walk out of there and not do anything. If you are not in your tight schedule you cannot be able to know if you can do charity or not imagine having last card with you and you just have to give out what you have.

It's a natural tourist spot with refreshing views. This place is called Lhok Buloh, which offers natural river baths.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4hX2DsWJ7zZY9gg6ejwQF24dthEsRvnuLURERxTGVRL/1777300030681.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNQAyVe1mPQtQP1h48fLJecKiSEKTN2MSt11EJDHfu2NN/1777300030936.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmejKsAz6apyFTccEUrwF3q17rRZ2WikAiYUwPCR9cSr3w/1777300031098.jpg)

The river water comes from the mountains and is clear and clean. The water is cool, shallow, calm, and the current is gentle. Large rocks line the banks of the river, while the bottom is made of small, sandy rocks. It's perfect for bathing for children and adults alike.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSCRdH8vAHhBxYCjrYv44jeWXTJ3Vh5yHrmGmKZRjKQej/1777300031285.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJX9sFa5iKALVNgC8SZ7SYT6C5kconokRdK8xu9key8y/1777300176687.jpg)

Huts along the riverbank have been built by the local community to provide shelter for visitors. The roofs are made of palm leaves, creating a relaxing atmosphere that encourages visitors to linger. Vendors also offer a variety of drinks and ready-to-eat food at affordable prices. Visitors don't need to worry if they haven't brought supplies.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNq4h5MpTzRdidfJx9rRZfBLFze17Rj4Db2WHPSJQVwAk/1777300176941.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQetbg7pXGEejsLeVq4tx4pTSpxXcW5d3AtbgUVwNHWwq/1777300177029.jpg)

The spacious area is ready to accommodate both two-wheeled and four-wheeled vehicles. Everything was prepared by the local residents. It certainly supplemented their daily income.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZzRw7hAZvUc7ZEvWqSqceTJsJt78DyRqQ4NGF2k6rZNk/1777300177102.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVj323tAQ855Htu4WaYzLR55Ge73vqFnyoV2LyZtEzpEM/1777300177189.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVCYtJzPFVvjPkbfWL48QFioaRbur5rPNcpHk4kv6LJUc/1777300403765.jpg)

The children looked overjoyed, and upon arriving, they all ran into the river. They couldn't wait to experience the pleasure of bathing in the cool, clear water. They bathed for quite a while, approximately two hours. The tiredness was evident on their faces, but it paled in comparison to the joy and happiness they felt.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmekA6k7Sk1raX68TmrEfxTaChDikrv1C9wP67eFS6JfRE/1777300403909.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme4hX2DsWJ7zZY9gg6ejwQF24dthEsRvnuLURERxTGVRL/1777300403991.jpg)

It's rainy season, and that's great for a reflection hunter in the Reflection Hunters Contest. Do you know why? Because the puddles are back.

The raindrops on the window are no exception. I have high expectations for the upcoming captures; it's truly extraordinary: the ideal projection of affection is immense and eternal. That polished surface shows me in multiple reflections. Such a phenomenon constitutes the image of a hunter's affection.

Within our precious group, exploration goes beyond the mere act of taking photographs; it means discovering vital reasons, enduring another day until we glimpse what is hidden.

Remain extremely attentive, at least for now. Don't waste any opportunities; it's your decision what to use: stay calm, the reflection you seek is about to be revealed.

links.title: Splinterlands game:- Why did I buy Nomos Summoner?
links.body:
> Hello splinterlands family. In the world of Splinterlands, the fire element or fire team has always been known for its aggressive temperament. But recently, there have been many changes in the game, especially with the arrival of new summoners; the game strategy has become much more modern. Today, I will talk about a new fire summoner in my collection, whose name is 'Nomos'. I have been thinking about making the fire deck a little stronger for a long time, and with that goal, I bought the Nomos card today. It is basically a Rebellion edition card. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCCvjfavHT7DC5gQeaDpN1qjzUtJfF4qj3iU3gqAfzVG/1777303952159.png) There are several strong reasons behind why I bought the Nomos Summoner. First, its Mana Cost is 5. It is a great choice for medium to high-quality battles. However, its biggest attraction is its tactical or strategic ability. Unlike other general summoners, it does not have a specific ability that is effective on everyone. Rather, it allows you to understand the situation on the battlefield and make decisions. Nomos has two special abilities that you need to choose based on the strategy of the opposing team. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaE563HoxeBtEHvMv1XfnBM6LJJ1y9vseDDtW6infrWVw/1777303740555.jpg) The first ability is '-2 Magic to Two Units'. Magic attacks are very powerful in the current meta or game style. Especially when playing against water or life elements, they deal a lot of magic damage. Using Nomos, you can reduce the magic attack of two opposing units by 2 points. This is a huge advantage. Think about it, if a card has a magic attack of 3, and if it is reduced to 1, then the effectiveness of that card drops to almost zero. The survivability of your tank then increases a lot. The second ability is 'Dispel'. Nomos can give the dispel ability to two units on his team. Those who play regularly know how important dispelling is. Currently, there is a growing trend in the game to make cards extra powerful with Bloodlust, Martyr, or various types of buffs. Dispel is a weapon that removes these extra benefits from the opponent's cards. If you give this ability to two cards in your team, then whenever they hit the opponent, all the magic buffs or extra power will be removed from them. This is an unbeatable strategy to stop gladiator cards in particular. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVBzKUMWsCUseoeqEWQTdcZFRvkeb3m5Lmuk8joFK5Px/1777303751179.jpg) When I was looking at the status or statistics of the card, I saw that it is also quite balanced in terms of its circulation or the number of cards in the market. The card I have is currently at level 2, which requires 5 cards and will require more cards to go to the next level. Its estimated power and power production are also quite good, which is helping to increase the value of my account. Moreover, its design or artwork is not to be mentioned. This red-haired human summoner is as stylish as he is powerful in the game. Many may ask why Nomos is there when Tarsa or Yodin are there? The answer is variety. Tarsa only increases melee attacks, but it doesn't help with defence. On the other hand, Nomos gives you the opportunity to protect your team by reducing the opponent's magic attacks or destroying their buffs. Especially when you know that the opponent can use magic or bloodlust cards, Nomos can be your best bet. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9Wyraqim1kwagZPNbvg3Q2Bsb4Hr6cbqMRDM6Ws5w92/1777303759715.jpg) The best time to use Nomos in the game's strategy is when there is an opportunity to use magic attacks in the battle rules. Also, in rules where cards enhance each other's power, the ability to dispel can turn the tide of the battle. I played a few practice battles after buying it and found that its correct application completely disorients the opponent. It's a real treat to get such a versatile card for 5 mana. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRQD1TFN21VSStMvbibWnbp6a93d3xoc5Et1HpK1t1ikK/1777303768671.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNqDPVtLvSb74eKrh5NZZGBJ9uLEipGeWXV4WUvqg2CCf/1777303768698.jpg) In conclusion, buying cards in Splinterlands is not just about expanding your collection; it's also a long-term investment and a way to improve your gameplay. Cards like Nomos add a new dimension to your playstyle. It encourages you to play smart rather than relying solely on power. I believe this new addition of the Fire element will greatly increase my win rate in games. For those who regularly play with Fire decks and are constantly losing to Magic attacks, Nomos could be the ideal solution. I am very happy with the card and hope it will help me reach better ranks in the coming seasons. My references:-https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=mirzaiqi
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRZtMskgn8d4zcpv27xJwmGJvq247fQB6ZBKsC1JU4JT/1768123335168.png)

links.title: The Rematch.
links.body: > After the Symbiote healed Peter's broken arm, he engaged in a final, brutal rematch with the Lizard. Utilizing the Symbiote's rage and aggressive parries, I successfully pinned the beast and injected the serum. As the platform collapsed, Peter rescued Dr. Connors from drowning, ensuring his survival. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XULWdGqCUiEJnuGgpnuLbocTTB9SWBihYtL1o97z1C/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmckS6aHuJRanJHHvXQ8pbgK9aC3Crv1jcHZqBFSMdBt6p/screenshot_2_.png) Peter couldn't inject the Lizard with the serum last time. Instead, they crashed inside a building and he still had the serum clutched in one of his hands when his other hand broke badly from the force, but the Symbiote fixed it instantly in the cinematic part. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUYb6hCsD4sf7UwC2ztKovLocJxeXbgm5Uc7ZBwxeYr4T/screenshot_3_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTUB5X3m4j36uFHDn7HYBDYZHjwYcCBSWdxGTVHiXM15H/screenshot_4_.png) The Lizard suddenly jumped out of the water after recovering from the crash, looking more monstrous than ever. He grew his tail back right away on Peter's witness, showing off a terrifying level of regeneration before coming for a rematch. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjYSwQT1NCEEe2rshYhfVHwQgrXYb89yVniELWFi8Xm1/screenshot_5_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQjJVF7ySuPJeq6EVNPjcEuMCnJhb2deumV79SsQPzi5J/screenshot_6_.png) The beast started attacking me even before I could get prepared. This time I was determined that I wouldn't give him a chance to pin me down or overpower my defenses like he did before. I kept my eyes on his claws, ready to dodge his crushing weight. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSQKbthnifZfjixvVDnF4mfc74CPNQE2ATMVfmXtL3cHS/screenshot_7_.png) Fortunately, the Symbiote's rage was ready to be unleashed, so I activated it at the perfect time to give him a good thrash. It was a surge of power that turned the tide of the battle in an instant. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcn5LyA83ucDS74hcdPKFxgfdpoismfAL6JocQLBB7RrH/screenshot_8_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWqhJWiQjMonriyPMH84ZJugriDk5g1dkG9Hha177ErFr/screenshot_9_.png) But the beast got some chances to attack me back as it knew it was its last time to fight for its survival. It lashed out with its claws and teeth, desperate to shake off the pressure Peter was applying. Even with the suit's protection, the impacts felt heavy, and I had to stay focused to avoid being caught in a deadly grapple. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcUr8W9Hu9VAhbvBjmXzU2jyJWhM2bS442DjK9Bk34152/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSNTLZCJENCcF1Se8Purr3DeqT13dzoE5TrH8LyWqMNzt/screenshot_11_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQmL2MntcYmrD34XP9gMQkQa54SnQv4iEsL4LEfGRxm5d/screenshot_12_.png) Along with Peter, I was also aggressive this time, so I was giving the Lizard low chances of attacking me effectively. I was parrying and dodging most of his attacks. Every time he tried to strike, I was already moving to a counter-position, hitting him back with increased force and speed. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcv9MmJnh6HrVAfKWFQLe83tn6Uty3VXYyHRYmiQr9rmg/screenshot_14_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcn7Wdjmdfn8c8MEcoWWmmQe5z73v36fCTrPvcqctGZyT/screenshot_15_.png) At last, I pinned the beast down. Peter used the Symbiotes to hold him down with multiple tendrils while he went for him with the serum. The struggle was intense, as the creature hissed and fought against the black bonds that were pinning its massive limbs to the ground. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQY2MbrXAKpARTne6H2N8YPqvXwbLkNWd7hvrKe31UGZa/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf1uesQkJs6PSLKxXsDACNzDsxLZcjx8pEryJk6nNS9ks/screenshot_17_.png) The beast was tired this time from the struggle, so he couldn't do much while Peter forced his jaw open. Peter opened the beast's mouth and injected the serum right in the jaw. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbH7VExFpc58QMi7Um3aHxjPmNxHGdRwDKVsY83od795Y/screenshot_18_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVMfrGib1P536dG6hsL7SyzrCk3fpZmeicdcLKtgDzeBH/screenshot_19_.png) The serum was injected successfully this time, but the platform beneath them got shattered from the combat damage. > After the Symbiote healed Peter's broken arm, he engaged in a final, brutal rematch with the Lizard. links.title: Castlevania Order of Shadows Golden Belmont Remakes Java Game on Game Boy
links.body:
Castlevania Order of Shadows Golden Belmont was originally released on the mobile Java platform – pre-iPhone and Android times. Very dark times, BREW was another platform for early cell phones to “game”. It was not ideal considering you had to use the square navigation button underneath the screen plus the number pad to interact. Action games were much harder than they needed to be, and Castlevania is already hard. Order of the Shadows Golden Belmont holds that franchise moniker high.

Not Canon So Don’t Ask

Information I can find on Castlevania Order of the Shadows Golden Belmont places it outside the storyline that Konami uses for the console releases. An attempt at a fun little romp in a similar universe with familiar looks but not effecting the story fans have followed for decades, and tons of games. Sometimes non-canonical releases can be fun. They allow developers to play with familiar worlds with none of the restrictions of the main series. It seems that Golden Belmont went for all out frustration until you dial in every enemy, every level, etc. You know, just like the main franchise, at least the first one (later releases did get slightly less torturous to new players). https://youtu.be/ziLddETwCOU

Revived for a New Generation

[Over on itch.io, Elvies,]( https://elvies.itch.io/castlevania-order-of-shadows-gbc) has released a recreation of Golden Belmont for free. They state this is a fun short game so don’t expect an enthrallingly long adventure here. Drop in, dial it in, then beat and reminisce that time you spent in the world of Castelvania Order of the Shadows Golden Belmont like it was a fever dream. As far as Konami is concerned, that is all this entry is, a dream not affecting the official storyline. What was your favorite Castlevania entry? Mine was Simon’s Quest. I was just so turned off by the difficulty of the original on NES that I never really bothered with that style. I did get back into Castlevania with Symphony of the Night and the GBA releases though I still shy away from the “classic” feeling ones.

links.title: Teaching a Teenager to Drive
links.body:
# Teaching a Teenager to Drive

I am unsure where to post this particular post, so posting it in my community regardless. There is little financial aspect on this other than potential for high car insurance premium, and more importantly, price of a decent used car in near future. So, I am in that phase of life, where it is time for me to teach my teenage daughter how to drive an automobile! :) Boy, I am sure you can guess where I am going with this. I have been doing the lessons for a few weeks now and MAN, it is hilarious and facing your mortal fear both at the same time.  


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/Eos6BHu3gWP3MPEenc3emXfafX5fw2Du93HwM2ubrSK1z3TDkVVNFppgTkaKins5Dno.png)

[Texas DPS](https://www.dps.texas.gov/section/driver-license)

In Texas, everything must be different as they must have to be somewhat unique, on purpose! So here, online driver education is categorized into two main paths: Parent-Taught (PTDE) and Self-Taught (Instructor-Led). For an online course to be valid, it must be approved by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR). You you think this feels like TLDR? :) Because it is!

We are choosing the Parent-Taught, for now! 

She is currently planning on getting the learners license, as soon as she is turning 15 in July. The learner license doesn't require any driving test (you are supposed to learn to drive for 6 months to one year, or however long it takes). As per the official document:

> The Parent Taught Driver Education Program allows parents or other eligible instructors to use an approved driver education curriculum, along with their personal experience and expertise, to help students become safe and responsible drivers.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/azircon/EoKCXahFR2ozf2j8N2Wiaq3HdxNFFeCeGYmTj3obvfZ5NTRnFsi6UDrUB6mKuCx8DYR.png)

There are state-approved online providers who charges a fee (typically $55 - $100) for an online 24 total hours of instruction (video and exams). However, after they complete the first 6 hours of online instructions they can take a test. If they pass the test, then don't have to appear on the written test at the DPS. 

**Step 1:** You must order the PTDE Program Guide ($20) from the TDLR website before starting any course.

**Step 2:** Choose an online provider (like those listed above) and select the \

track.

**Step 3:** Complete the first 6 hours online to get your DE-964 certificate for the learner permit

My daughter is currently doing the online part, while typically during the weekend I have been driving her around, talking driving, and sometimes letting her drive in an empty parking lot. There are some private drives in Houston, my own community has one, where I can allow her to drive. But technically she is not supposed to drive on public roads until she gets her learners license.

After she completes those three steps above, then there is:

**STEP 4** — DPS appointment: get the Learner License
Bring to DPS:

Learner license application (DL‑14B)
PTDE Classroom Completion Certificate
VOE (Verification of Enrollment & Attendance)
Proof of identity / residency
Parent present to sign
$16 DPS fee

At this point my teen ager will receive the Learner License and may begin behind-the-wheel instruction on Texas public roads. We will need to keep a log-book of behind-the-wheel instruction in detail, as they can be audited! :)

#### Required behind‑the‑wheel hours (PTDE)
Texas requires:

7 hours behind‑the‑wheel (instruction)
7 hours in‑car observation
30 hours additional supervised practice

10 hours must be at night



Total driving exposure = 44 hours

Only after that the teen is ready for a driving test (provided 6 months have passed without any incident) and get a provisional license (at age 16+).

If you think about it, that is not a small ask. Most parent typically let the student drive the car to high school while the parent rides in the passenger seat in front. But, for our case that is 15 min of drive, through local roads. In the morning they are relatively empty, but get quite busy in the afternoon on the way back. Most teens don't want to drive on the way back from school. This is because they are tired and simply don't want to deal with the traffic. I am seeing this in real time, as some of my daughter's friends are older and already going through with this process. 

If you consider the 30+7 = 37 hours of driving, that is 2220 minutes. 15 min a day, 5 days a week, that is 30 weeks. Also please add that some days there will be:
- Dad, I am too sleepy today!
- Dad, I am not feeling like today!
- Silence!

Even if you consider that 10 hours of night driving later over the weekend, the total of 44 hours of required logged driving can easily take <u>a full calendar year</u>! At least that is the experience of a lot of my peers and her peers!

The reason, I am worrying about this are the following:

- There is virtually no public transport in Houston, and I am tired of being a Uber driver for my social butterfly!
- Both mom and dad travels a lot, and when we do, it is incredibly hard to get two kids to school at two different directions.
- I am really looking forward to a night out in town with my wife, when my daughter can drop us off, eh? Role reversal!





https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaDBldXhqODk4emZrcnNsMWFkZWhwbnc0OHI3OGxjcTdrdnJsc2hzeSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/35pTQFiy14OeA/giphy.gif

links.title: Thinking Outside The Box
links.body: /> This weekend we were invited to attend a corporate hospitality box at the Ellis Park rugby stadium for the Lions versus Connaught in the United Rugby Championship. Under normal circumstances I would say no thanks but this is a good networking opportunity and you just never know who you are going to meet during the course of the afternoon.

/></center>

I did not have high hopes due to this being a league match, but you always have to go with a positive mindset as anything is still possible. As you can see from the stadium it was only 5% full and most of the corporate hospitality boxes were not open. My son and I were armed with business cards just in case there is an opportunity of creating a contact that we could go and visit this week. 

This was not a total bust as we managed to work the corporate box we were attending and there were a couple of other boxes further away that we popped our heads in and said hello. over all it was nothing special and managed to meet 3 corporate clients who may at some point become clients in the future.

If this had been a higher profile match then this would have been a prime opportunity to network amongst the various corporate hospitality boxes. The seating area is all open in the front so it gives you the chance to go and chat with others in the various boxes.

Many years ago when I was based down in Durban we had a corporate box at Kings Park and I would guess 50% of the business was done here on a Saturday afternoon or evening as we only used to leave at about 1 or 2 in the morning. We were always the last box open and many of the other boxes ended up joining in with us much to the stadium officials horror as they wanted to close the ground down and could not whilst we were still open.

Mixing business with sport/pleasure in a relaxed atmosphere with alcohol and snacks flowing is very productive and you meet so many people from various industries and these are normally those in managerial positions. Doors that would not normally be open would now be open and this is what you are looking for having a contact name which is what networking is all about.

Many companies have a policy of not being able to receive gifts, but being invited out to attend a sporting event is not deemed a gift and is common practice. Being able to invite a buyer of a company to your box as your guest to try and land the all important deal does happen and why these hospitality boxes are a great tool when used correctly.

The bigger deals will be done when the international matches take place with the next one being South Africa versus England in June and then the All Blacks in August. The tickets are very rare so being invited to a corporate box means you are a valued customer or a customer the company would like to land. This is all part of the razzle dazzle of spending your companies entertainment allowance and they need a return on this investment. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@cryptoandcoffee/thinking-outside-the-box-jgy)

links.title: It's scorching heat.
links.body: >This is the summer season in India. April has not even ended yet, and temperatures in major Indian cities have already crossed 40°C across many parts of the northern and central states. In Akola, Maharashtra, the temperature today touched around 47°C, while in New Delhi it was about 42°C. India is reeling under immense heat and this intensity is becoming difficult to endure. The heatwave feels as if one is sitting beside a furnace. This is not normal. The reason for such extreme conditions is the rapidly changing global climate which has become increasingly uncomfortable.

>Indian cities are filled with concrete structures and have fewer trees. Heat gets trapped within these concrete surfaces. India has undergone massive urbanization in the 21st century. There are too many vehicles on the roads which emit heat. Buildings are constructed in such a way that living in them without air conditioners has become nearly impossible. Air conditioners cool the indoors but release hot air outside. Thus, contributing further to urban heat and worsening the situation.

>On the other hand, massive highways are being built across India. Large buildings are rising everywhere and forests are being cleared for mining activities. These factors are making the situation worse. We are sitting on a climate bomb that may explode in the near future and its impact will be devastating. Without stopping deforestation and controlling unrestrained construction, it will be impossible to fight against this crisis.

\n\n**Thanks!**

links.title: Where have I been?!
links.body:
Seems like time itself is running away from me again. I keep meaning to sit down and write here, but something or another always comes up to demand my attention. 

Our dishwasher died last month (right after the Washer and Dryer also died), so having already suffered the massive blow to my wallet that the washer/dryer caused, I decided I'd buy a dishwasher and install it myself. How hard could it be, right?

It's pretty easy, honestly. Not at *all* worth the $200 fee for them to install it! It took me 30 minutes from start to finish, and I saved $200.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/23wMaJaAmdeDwxxa6joz7XfxmMUxxff5UDqx342zEBVBmSXwZTfA2UGJwBrUVHoQXJVq2.png)

Here in Saskatchewan, we've had spring->dump of snow->spring->dump of snow so many times I think we're on the 5th bloody winter now.

This was April 20th - fully Spring weather. We hit 20'c for the first time this year.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/23xKtjBgHp6PFcmhhZZnNJtNBS47G1d23KctzoR5UJ2ZAHGUPSva4FJbb5LmWryuE4zuZ.png)


And THIS BULLSHIT was April 25th.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/23w2usXA7x2GESJJzsAQV4bZUYYvEpnS9Vv63LEfWKfgimTWJMhmoMLLRo8JDDoNm4gDd.png)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/oblivioncubed/244ofYZxZzCNGKW44cP1HqPCjfWnVRZTS4Uu1fEN7vNnGZs9v4XxnU2v4jGBwww5fcqac.png)

I've tried to put away my snowblower 3 times so far, and every time I do it bloody dumps a foot of snow on us! Insane weather! 

We've also run D&D twice since I last posted about it. We've completed Session 16 and are moving on to Session 17 in May. Per usual, my players are keeping me on my toes by not doing what I expect. I try not to plan what they'll do, so it's not a detriment that they keep surprising me... but they definitely are continuing to surprise me with the choices they make. I'll try to get S.15 and S.16 notes up soon.

Unfortunately, this is all the time I have today. Thanks for reading.

links.title: It was quite chaotic... but it turned out good !
links.body:
The tension in middle east has severely disturbed the LPG cylinder market in india. There is a shortage of cooking gas at many places and the oil companies are trying their best to cater the public demand. The most affected of them are the people residing in urban areas. It is strange how the life is enormously depends on cooking gasses. People in urban areas are greatly affected as they do not have any additional sources. Especially to those who has some family function likes marriages at home. The ongoing marriage season has created a chaos. Most of the family are biting the dust just because the meals are prepared on cooking gasses and in short supply they are unable to cater the chefs demand. But at the same time people living in rural areas are happily arranging grand fiesta as they have some additional source apart from the cooking cylinder.


![20260427_085034(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/23wqiMQnUZ4tcruccp66SwYMacvjufq1w5kUiFfGzaZjhAkDiSXxHW9hPuYyNcrRzNeMH.jpg)



This is first time I have seen the rural people.having an edge over the urban people. Few months ago, while I was in city, I saw a bride father literally crying as he was unable to arrange the cooking cylinders for the marriage function. Everything was arranged in advance buy on the fateful days, the short supply made it impossible for him to make all the arrangement for the marriage reception. Later, it was the friendly neighbourhood who pitched in with their spare cylinders. Today I witnessed similar situation at my village, however the bride father was not worried at all. He was at chill and made aome alternative way to cook the food for the marriage reception.

> ***Whipping up chaos in the kitchen***

A grand reception with multiple cuisine is seen as a representation of family prosperity, pride, and social status. Indian culture emphasizes hospitality and hosting large numbers of guests, including extended family, friends, and acquaintances. It is a time for community reunion and celebration. In rural areas the number of guests is much more because of the extended community and village people. So deal with the mass food preparation, the bride father has arranged for a make shift cooking stove that work on wooden logs. 


In rural settings, the chulha is built directly into the ground or on a raised platform, with the wood providing efficient heating for daily meals. In the marriage set up, a round block is made using the bricks and then it is filled up with large wooden logs. Thick logs are used for long duration cooking, smaller sticks, dry twigs, crop waste, and cow dung cakes are often used to start the fire or maintain a low, steady flame. The makeshift cooking stove helps the family from the over burden chaos of the cooking gas. Rather than getting upset of undue worry, the availability of alternative solution is a way to deal with the pressure situation. Such alternative is not feasible in urban set up. There by the Rural life is scoring an additional point above the Urban lifestyle.

It has been a general view that life in rural areas is tough, but looking at the way every problem has simple solution, it is good to give a thought once again.


**In good faith - Peace!!**



![1000037470.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/steemflow/Eo8M1obna2cYnnMAc2ZC3wWMW9ZqZHvk9StEga6aY2cTsKmweW7zFBDm7D13YHVoC5N.png)

links.title: DEALING WITH DEPRESSED TEENS// MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
links.body:
https://youtu.be/y4gKUv0znwY?si=YNfDCxTFl49CaLlA
Depression is something that happens to everyone at a given point in time, for us to protect teens who are depressed, it means we have to approach them with love and caring. The Bible encourages us to 

**“bear one another’s burdens” (Galatians 6:2)**

 We are expected to listen to them carefully with love. Most teens who are depressed usually feel they're alone in their problems, but as an adult it is our duty to let them know that God and humans care for them. Creating a safe space where they can express their struggles is a practical way to reflect Christ’s love.

It is the duty of the parents to console them at that stage of their life. Scripture shows that even faithful people experienced deep sadness, yet God remained close to them. 

**“The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit” (Psalm 34:18).**

Helping teens see that God understands their pain can make faith feel real and personal, not distant or abstract. Encouraging prayer, even simple and honest conversations with God, can help them begin to open their hearts.

# Warm greeting community and hivers 😍💕.

The most important thing I have learnt here on on Hive is Staking, which I see as a way to grow through investment for the future. And HBD is one that I know many people relied on for conversation and savings because of its value as a liquid Hive that ranges with dollars 💵 when converted to currency.

# My HBD And Its Benefits:

Am usually thrilled in the days of HBD, once my rewards start dropping as the amount of HBD shows the total earnings 💵 when calculated weekly or monthly. This is what gives me happiness and motivates me to keep going here on Hive. Although my HP is also there , piling up , but HBD is usually where I pay attention to know what to save up and what I will convert to my local currency for emergency keep in the local bank 🏦 .

HBD I could say was my saving grace, because despite I was saving part of my weekly HBD, I usually also convert some of them to help sort out my immediate needs when the situation calls for it. And the good thing with then HBD is how its equivalent to dollar 💵 when converted to Hive and selling the Hive through online exchange. 

There was also a time I saved up lots of my HBD, kept it for when Hive will go up for better investment. But the problem is how the fluctuation continues to discourage one. So I decided to just convert the HBD and save it up in the local bank where the dollar gained through HBD is more appreciated. And now that HBD earnings has been removed, its feels so bad because it was one earnings that helped elevate one’s spirits at all times here on Hive .

But staking is one thing that I love here, and not just staking Hive, but other tokens that might have value in the long run because Hive is one web 3.0 decentralized platform that has proved that every individual who thinks of the future will literally achieve something great. We are hoping that better days should commence soonest.

In all, we need to know that the future of web 3.0 is important through what we think 💭 and the impact we are making here on Hive Ecosystem . links.title: Making My Own Handmade Notebook
links.body:
![notebook handmade (1).gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoAag7WfUcX7cpzp32Bcfvgu9W4TVA2kgPjY8Dv8oQXpxx5hueevXrH4SmdXeenbFk3.gif)
Hello, how are you? It is so hot today, imagine yesterday the heat index was just 40 degrees Celsius, but today it rose to 46 degrees Celsius. It felt like I've been frying alive. LOL So yeah, back to the topic. Whenever I make a sketchbook, I always write notes or a to-do list, so it always ruins the drawing-only sketchbook LOL. So I force myself to make a notebook specific to any notes I want to write. Now my notes are all organized in one place, and I no longer stress finding where I wrote all my notes. -----
Materials I Used:

>
  • Ribbon
  • Glue
  • Thin Paper
  • Headbands
  • Cream Paper
  • Brush
  • Chipboard
  • Faux Leather
  • Garter
  • Hot Blower
  • Heavy Books
-----
Craft Time!

> ![2.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5oDcz6sHvTQv4qsqq7BSkz7KJJjXpuHmBDGnLK2ABKmKMPe5QzuBDWE5ZqLBXFPA5.JPG) I divided the 60 sheets of paper into 6, so each group contains 10 sheets, and these 6 groups of paper will be called signatures in the bookbinding world. ----

> ![4.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9273CZ6YdwvzJGH1hiW7ogRLTLfM8UXsUBbR1HMS8dyGc3S6PfRWHce5GJAU1j7K.JPG) I grab one signature and place it neatly on a flat surface. ----
> ![6.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5nBFKL5UPaSuY13m6UsyU2Nahim62VKPzqqBgQnCuTAq3EgbYP7gfXoTD6cuUxY4c.JPG) And fold the signature in half. -----

> ![8.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokd8NeGg8z8SYZBMzRmYY5Y6g7d1H5cCnzFAS3Lvhg6borSn2kRj9W4dYC8vaz8fcM.JPG) To fold it evenly, I use my bone folder to do the job. I do the same thing on the other signatures. -----

> ![11.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopsveNyhyz5FL5SPCEctMip2zjD6gMKYD7BTAzEXcxgx6f7rWtugbsJBaTr8j6JZLV.JPG) Then I am going to use this clip and a two-thick chipboard and sandwich the signature between them to flatten them up. Doing this makes the next process easier. ----

> ![15.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5niG2cxPFtXLUHjijH6FakdmJ6ArcEDzvprWBqNuUMbKnQRFUABFNKXbeN1USdeGG.JPG) In this part, I am going to make a punching hole reference. What I do is I cut a thick chiboard with the same length as the signature, and then I mark the part where I want the holes to be. ----

> ![17.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EouBA3e5GyxUjy6RP5c9EKJRjKP2umH4cdAxEyRmFsDFNDoyPwNhvGHWvYYRzDB9QoS.JPG) I grab one signature, and then I am going to use the punching hole reference I made to poke a hole. This is what it looks like. ----

> ![19.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpEHkFHsQRA2TD52UDq6PECA1FjjuaR9KP9rLQSdWXUe6sZPJKSzc3BA3V68Be9CHND.JPG) Do the same on the other signatures, and then I flatten them again using the chipboard and clips. ----
Sewing The Signatures:

> ![21.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiVo8w92HVChR6oBSwjB9q3YWp1sQhakRs35twoG5ohDhBYqkj96CQCnfRnsxWmSow.JPG) To sew the signatures, I am going to need a needle and thread. ----

> ![23.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep7u2Ry6kShZiJ6c5Z4MCYaSex9Mddf2cPpcJSGrsKE9F1y5KmWfwgxcE521iiV9i8k.JPG) After hooping in the thread into the needle, I am going to knot the end of the thread. ----

> ![26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EppM9ZBbfycgJuPfafZ9F4REC2Tf3uotrWgBBzgk92a1FDtRPkSnxjimzf1GsW1Amjg.JPG) To stop knotting when sewing the signature, I like to run the thread into beeswax three times. ----

> ![28.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpXKuJRuQm4DHjnPfdoVpvS4mv658daHrKnh1XUKkFAPQPjMMqQ3CQ2R892kdehELoe.JPG) I grab one signature, and then I poke through the first hole of the signature until the knot. ----

> ![30.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9gdKaerRdy6MzMLkEMMys6uNTFBst12uJa4mBYMbVmS7iFMVTFodqxcVKxaSer4S.JPG) And then from the inside I poke out the needle and thread to the next hole until the last. ----

> ![32.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiYeNoLr5VVDHknZqdqBuuvYB4JRYm7TA43ErBMJU2XUwP9T1bv6ZTcfTuWZF95Xfo.JPG) I tie a knot at the end, and after that, I return to sewing, going to the first hole and do the same thing, tie a knot at the end, and poke the needle out. ----

> ![34.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpLfvJsprvW59oXq3xyTCcM7gmDS26aNxM8i6LFpB8WqcNygA7dKadANe4sN4BsMT8y.JPG) After that, I grab another signature and put it above the first signature. ----
> ![36.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpXJbPkTHHqTv2g8gcVTeMN1CuZMrkdUf4ADzcX2VXUNNW7zoBsrn4LzyZubMKuqkAW.JPG) Sew from the first hole to the second hole. ----

> ![38.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpCApFFYD1gB7ug59krDU6RUcKR1sWwyNTGvrQSVtwbfkMxB65skhEoUbb4gCdHkcDS.JPG) and then sew it under the thread of the second hole of the first signature. ----

> ![40.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoEtQ8Nwv47WhmNzNbdkcB5Jt52sBEsCv5782FJobw7LHJKUGUE6fgVNDR5Jzuk3CZi.JPG) And then return that needle to the second hole and proceed to the next hole and do the same thing. ----

> ![42.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep7ucbUbpY3AV6j6y49ZUdD1Bpi6Faz5Vr7YUUx6AHYGCKqzN39K5dUqmmQu1PMPDQH.JPG) Grab another signature and then poke in the needle and thread in. ----

> ![45.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpXLrkwGCKfdysEqkQhmsnMYHaH13qwpmdKvkjpufQPVNZVa6u56z8afV3th3ahr7mR.JPG) Poke the needle out and then loop it below the second signature and do the same thing on the remaining signature. ----
> ![47.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoptPxFQZuzpwjgVk2F9UjnwHHFjtDob5NuDGaPb2WZWczGse9MWoqMCVtSQANxBkdd.JPG) Sew it until the last signature. ----

> ![49.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPJTep2uYVayeuBTTNPJNezMBUczFjHic5j5Z3zoZm66CXMVpgSU6Qp44bbNxP9Rg.JPG) This is what it looks like, and then I flatten it again using two chipboards and clips. ---- ----
Glue The Signature:

> ![51.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EonmTxCzv2PTMDjtcmeLZCqhzPH4EQ3iRwCXcPCsVqLDmhnykvxrincjd2MUASqXNmw.JPG) I pour glue into a container and dip the brush that I am going to use to coat it enough to cover the signature. ----

> ![53.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep3eNZScLMRHGqEq2JcC1FtRTV3qBJWzCSs9NLoTuNd2N3mq7GwMuvXxvGYntSoKqYG.JPG) Then apply the glue to the part where I sew the signatures. ----

> ![55.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoyPbVLWvoEKY6m1P9hXGfkVn866Bnfb6WF1pQUU9Z9Bs5p7SGM65pwZCbteji4mhq4.JPG) To make the drying time faster, I use a hot blower to do the job. ----

> ![58.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Ep5nG3WJKcYHof61nDc9uChYAkhb9yt7Ee4xPQjbgp4HCFa2JvoRGycpHzc1rBmX548.JPG) Then I am going to glue the ribbon, making sure to place it at the top part. ----
> ![61.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowGYhGFGspguQdbhkwFK6F3JJtAdkMdaVab4FnQGpkh7YxdXyJvnUa84DdgkmexbWo.JPG) Make sure to glue it upward. ----

> ![64.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopsWDj7G1EL33jPYwc3cTsn9RSJjhQyV1CLxCnaRfumaxoXabGEVS3Ydoo2oBSX7zc.JPG) Then, for the headband, I am going to glue the top and the bottom of the text block. ----
> ![66.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eou9CLs5y3FugaqBG2Ytp1DLtbjJJS352sSCEkGumppyDgKydo3drNJtkuhEKko3ePe.JPG) Carefully place it at the top and bottom. ----

> ![69.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpGRDvJa6kjfM8x2VpeCcfMtFJyz7p6jFCtFSWyVsazkTHNaXDcb5Fhat4bKsomsGnN.JPG) To secure the signature more, I am going to glue a piece of paper. ----

> ![71.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokeWDZFHUWu99vqGBpkeeGmWXYerkxk46yZB7j3jRs6FRTbPDamygzFztXP2f5q1Bq.JPG) Then I am going to glue the front cover paper. Make sure to glue just a few centimeters of the paper. ----

> ![74.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowHe3TgvKnDnnFFezLd1AbAM7mkUZjkgauJ2ser27B565FfecAas6r1QacWbJunAPG.JPG) I do the same at the back. ----
Making The Thick Cover:

> ![77.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eoc9Mf2pAuqEvfkVjSXD3AZHgmJoTQ42adNG2C6U2pCA7hMsPVvSAxMPnKSXy1uufCp.JPG) For the cover of the textblock, I am going to need faux leather, chipboards, scissors, a squeegee, and glue. ----
> ![79.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoK9CV8jPQEcm3LJv6jS1XwEAX8ETQiBSi6HPPqSkKco1NLzsyKTL4fCWReeeD3o4vw.JPG) I glue the back of the chiboard. ----
> ![80.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogRDHxiYX8krHMiDbaoLkHf7jR4Xeb32Y21R43dsEjmabaujx2F2TgvreWwgnZ3eP4.JPG) And the press into the faux leather. ----

> ![83.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiZ6ajX3yNVrupgGKwmjt3ERVqtrnMeJmYgQp9BHNTx5SvsT6G2GFMuAjiJxD7k73L.JPG) I added a paper in the middle for extra. And then I ran the bone folder around to remove any bubbles or to flatten it. ----
> ![85.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoptoniSc9vmWbJEjpgRrJ9Z7MLWJjjW1jUJVtMSr1qG2fXQvvgsmENvrfxLq4cqoWX.JPG) Then I glue the top and bottom first. ----
> ![87.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWcCsJBhkDmkzah8CnYP3Nai5YynmMVE5jTr4veo9onSobfiJaHhYEF5WteFJpvpr.JPG) Run the bone folder to flatten it evenly. ----

> ![89.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EowH1MZkyieUoCKgcotwf2AXzJMQrJuULmkdXcyiDPYQC6RfKWYMKdPgeaSBc2WNrbh.JPG) Then, to the side, I cut the excess leather to prevent the cover from bulging on the side. ----
> ![91.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoiWheAkjLA3UpcF1GPZ89EGnFPNMkuK7uySNMrDLN81sWrrAFr5yuqatfRxWqSZA92.JPG) This is what it looks like, and then glue the side. ----

> ![93.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EpGRcde8FWh389Ht6tGQxPGLqE8b3eWH6uNTTNbapJEbTmLSt5NviCe1CBvh9c44L9t.JPG) I forgot to cut the other part, so I am going to LOL. ----

> ![96.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/Eokf3EGHtZwoYACGQmEY7L9hfrpkNXFsCjCyrxdFcUNimpPvPVn2kC852XUxWLBRzLK.JPG) Flatten it with a bone folder again. ----
Gluing The Cover and Textblock:

> ![98.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EoeHNmqoEjzbbmhN4fNVHNsdibCTTitDT6vgq1sWucTjgA49hNCDbEtTxUo4su3SPHd.JPG) To glue the textblock and cover, I am going to add glue around the front and back cover of the textblock. ----

> ![100.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopupeZwKzN6vdcqmJv1qxNxq8PKvtXqPwyfxsRpQTXYdJAF8AtHJ1tYL21f46DX1vK.JPG) And carefully glue it together. ----
Adding The Garter:

> ![102.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EqdBqa7G7wmWfvLVRGBz37k3EVQAZyNUUMMeMst1pAgbeWYzk2iMUsgLtyx8gFfoGGb.JPG) To add the garter, I slit the top and bottom of the cover, then put in the garter, and then glued the garter to make it stay there. ----

> ![104.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EopvjbkvqjcqZDrYmEYBbeLJd8efHNcfa7gVqUoTuqbdfHY3MbauPuuxsFVMPTEko8H.JPG) This is what it looks like. Let the notebook dry below a heavy book for a whole day. ----

> ![106.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EogPMCeNw2WH7XC523PE6oCHYV7JMEdxge9R8h9H5podNHQs9RFRKDFW5jZmChiNv68.JPG) The notebook is ready to be used. ----- ![107.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/leannwithdoublen/EokebfedmMM5si4Zb2Lm7JQTrdev92yxd3jVESuzbS1DVytesuSQbK9zY4DSoE5DkEh.JPG) Now it doesn't have to use my sketchbooks as my note-taking book LOL. ----

links.title: 当然可以！以下是一个旅游博客的主题建议：\n\n**“隐秘的旅行：探索
links.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gdfb41c59fd5ab4a55ac9a6e3912004c94670f047d433578308031d08d8493907952ff770f5c14f9743955045a46998cd4345118ed2731baa5cadc53df98a38e7_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 隐秘的旅行：探索不为人知的目的地

旅行是打开世界的一扇窗，而有些地方则像是隐藏在角落里的宝石，等待着被发现。今天，我们将带您探索一些不为人知的旅行目的地，这些地方不仅美丽，还充满了独特的文化与故事。

## 1. **阿尔巴尼亚的锡拉库萨**

锡拉库萨，这个位于阿尔巴尼亚的海滨小镇，拥有迷人的海滩和丰富的历史。与其说它是一个旅游胜地，不如说它是一个隐秘的宝藏。这里的古老城堡和宁静的海湾，吸引着那些想要远离喧嚣的旅行者。

### 必游景点：
- **锡拉库萨古城**：漫步在古老的街道上，感受历史的厚重。
- **海滩**：享受阳光和海浪，体验真正的放松。

## 2. **斯洛文尼亚的布莱德湖**

布莱德湖被誉为“欧洲的明珠”，但却常常被游客忽视。湖中有一座小岛，岛上有一座迷人的教堂，四周环绕着壮丽的阿尔卑斯山脉。

### 推荐活动：
- **划船到小岛**：体验划船的乐趣，欣赏湖边的美景。
- **湖边徒步**：沿着湖边的小径，享受宁静的自然风光。

## 3. **摩尔多瓦的基希讷乌**

摩尔多瓦可能不是每个人的首选，但基希讷乌却是一个值得探索的城市。这里有丰富的文化、友好的当地人和美味的葡萄酒。

### 不容错过：
- **国家博物馆**：了解摩尔多瓦的历史和文化。
- **当地酒庄**：品尝世界级的摩尔多瓦葡萄酒。

## 4. **冰岛的西峡湾**

虽然冰岛的黄金圈吸引了大量游客，但西峡湾却是一个鲜为人知的地方。这里有壮观的瀑布、宁静的海湾和丰富的野生动物。

### 探索建议：
- **徒步旅行**：在壮丽的自然风光中徒步，感受大自然的力量。
- **观鸟**：在悬崖上观察成群的海鸟，体验与自然亲密接触的乐趣。

## 结语

这些隐秘的旅行目的地，不仅能让您远离人群，还能让您体验到更真实的当地文化。无论是美丽的自然风光，还是丰富的历史文化，它们都值得您去探索。下次计划旅行时，不妨考虑这些不为人知的地方，开启一段独特的旅程吧！

***

links.title: Chutney Mix
links.body:
by Siberiann on Paul Lindstrom 
View my bio on Blurt.media: https://blurt.media/c/paulindstrom [![Chutney Mix](https://blurt.media/lazy-static/previews/a7bc38cb-167a-4858-87b9-b2a007177bfc.jpg)](https://blurt.media/w/jmVDWCB8gyaUECEwhqFDc5) 
 
 Nadie sabe exactamente cuándo sonó la primera nota que definiría al chutney, pero todos coinciden en que nació del sudor y la nostalgia. No fue un género planeado en una sala de reuniones ni diseñado por ejecutivos discográficos; surgió orgánicamente, casi como un accidente necesario, en las cocinas y los patios traseros de Trinidad y Tobago y Guyana. Era finales de los años sesenta y principios de los setenta, y las comunidades indo-caribeñas buscaban una forma de mantener vivas las raíces mientras navegaban su nueva realidad en el Caribe. Al principio, no se llamaba así. Era simplemente música para bailar en las bodas, interpretada por músicos locales que tomaban los viejos cantos devocionales hindúes, los bhajans, y les inyectaban el ritmo contagioso de la isla.

Lo interesante es ver cómo la instrumentación contó esa historia de fusión. El dholak, ese tambor de doble cabeza tradicional de la India, segu siendo el corazón latiente, pero empezó a compartir espacio con el dhantal, esa vara de metal que marca el tiempo con un tintineo característico. Sin embargo, lo que realmente cambió el juego fue la introducción gradual de elementos occidentales. Los teclados electrónicos comenzaron a reemplazar o complementar al harmonium, y las guitarras eléctricas empezaron a colarse en las melodías. No era una traición a la tradición, sino una adaptación. Los músicos entendieron que para que la música respirara en el contexto caribeño, tenía que hablar también el idioma del calipso y, más tarde, del soca.

Sundar Popoo suele ser citado como la figura clave, el padre putativo del estilo, aunque él probablemente nunca quiso tal título. Cuando lanzó \

a principios de los setenta, no estaba intentando crear un nuevo género comercial; estaba tratando de conectar con su audiencia de la manera más directa posible. Su éxito abrió la puerta. De repente, cantar en hindi o en un criollo local mezclado con términos indostánicos no era algo exclusivo de las ceremonias religiosas, sino motivo de fiesta. La gente bailaba. Y eso es lo que define al chutney: es música funcional, hecha para mover el cuerpo.

A medida que avanzaban las décadas, especialmente en los ochenta y noventa, la línea entre el chutney y el soca se volvió borrosa, dando lugar al chutney-soca. Artistas como Drupatee Ramgoonai rompieron barreras al llevar estos ritmos a escenarios más amplios, incluso compitiendo en carnavales tradicionales dominados por otras narrativas. La producción se volvió más pulida, los sintetizadores más presentes, pero la esencia rítmica del dholak nunca desapareció del todo. Es esa tensión constante entre lo antiguo y lo moderno, entre la diáspora india y la identidad caribeña, lo que mantiene vivo al género.

Esa vibración que nació en los patios traseros no se quedó confinada a las pistas de baile; se filtró lentamente hacia la tinta y el papel, dando voz a una identidad que hasta entonces había sido silenciada o simplificada. En la literatura, especialmente en la obra de autores como V.S. Naipaul o, más tarde, en la narrativa contemporánea del Caribe anglófono, el chutney aparece no solo como banda sonora, sino como metáfora de la hibridación. Los personajes ya no son vistos únicamente a través del prisma de la servidumbre contractual histórica, sino como seres complejos que negocian su lugar en el mundo a través de esa fusión cultural. 

El cine, por su parte, tardó un poco más en capturar la esencia auténtica del género, pasando de representaciones caricaturescas a retratos más matizados. Películas trinitenses y producciones independientes comenzaron a utilizar el chutney no como exotismo de fondo, sino como el pulso emocional de las escenas clave. Ya no era solo música para una boda estereotipada; era el sonido de la rebeldía juvenil, de la celebración clandestina o de la afirmación cultural en espacios públicos dominados por otras narrativas. La cámara aprendió a bailar al ritmo del dholak, capturando la energía visceral de los festivales de Chutney Soca, donde la vestimenta y el movimiento cuentan tanto como los diálogos. Esto ayudó a normalizar la presencia indo-caribeña en la imaginación visual global, lejos de los clichés orientalistas.

En cuanto a la moda, la influencia es quizás la más visible y tangible durante la temporada de carnaval. Lo que comenzó como una adaptación práctica de la ropa tradicional india para climas tropicales y bailes vigorosos se transformó en una declaración estética poderosa. Las faldas lehenga y los cholis se mezclaron con lentejuelas, plumas y bikinis típicos del soca, creando un estilo híbrido que desafía las normas de modestia tradicionales sin perder su raíz cultural. Diseñadores locales empezaron a experimentar con telas más ligeras, cortes más atrevidos y colores vibrantes que reflejan la alegría ruidosa de la música. Esta evolución textil no es superficial; representa una liberación corporal, especialmente para las mujeres, que encontraron en el escenario del chutney un espacio para reclamar su autonomía y su belleza bajo sus propios términos, lejos de las expectativas conservadoras de generaciones anteriores.

Finalmente, el eco musical del chutney ha resonado mucho más allá del Caribe, actuando como un puente inesperado entre continentes. Su estructura rítmica y su capacidad de fusión han influenciado a productores de música electrónica en Europa y Asia, que ven en el dholak y las escalas indostánicas una fuente fresca de samples y texturas. Se pueden rastrear sus huellas en ciertos subgéneros del drum and bass y incluso en colaboraciones pop globales donde la línea entre el bhangra punjabí y el chutney trinitense se difumina intencionalmente para crear un sonido pan-diáspórico. Más cerca de casa, su impacto en el dancehall y el reggaetón es innegable; la forma en que estos géneros incorporan patrones rítmicos sincopados y melodías pegadizas debe mucho a la popularidad masiva que el chutney logró al demostrar que la música étnica podía ser, ante todo, música popular de fiesta. No se trata de una apropiación, sino de una conversación continua, un diálogo rítmico que sigue escribiéndose cada vez que un tamborero golpea su instrumento y alguien, en cualquier parte del mundo, siente la necesidad inevitable de mover los pies.

Mirar el chutney hoy en día es observar mucho más que una simple colección de canciones; es witnessing un acto de supervivencia cultural transformado en triunfo. Durante décadas, la comunidad indo-caribeña existió en los márgenes de la narrativa nacional en países como Trinidad y Tobago y Guyana, a menudo vista como permanente extranjera o relegada al ámbito privado de lo doméstico y lo religioso. El chutney rompió ese silencio. Al sacar los instrumentos sagrados y las lenguas ancestrales de los templos y llevarlos a las calles, a los estadios y a la radio principal, el género funcionó como un mecanismo de validación pública. Dejó de ser algo que se escondía por vergüenza o por respeto a una tradición rígida, para convertirse en un motivo de orgullo colectivo. Fue la primera vez que esa identidad híbrida, ni completamente india ni completamente caribeña, se afirmó con volumen y sin disculpas.

Este hito cultural también marcó un punto de inflexión crucial en la dinámica de género dentro de la diáspora. Tradicionalmente, las mujeres indo-caribeñas tenían roles muy restringidos en la performance pública, especialmente cuando se trataba de música y baile. El surgimiento del chutney, y posteriormente su evolución hacia el chutney-soca, creó espacios donde figuras femeninas podían no solo participar, sino liderar. Cantantes y bailarinas comenzaron a desafiar las normas de modestia y sumisión, utilizando el escenario como una plataforma de empoderamiento. Esta visibilidad tuvo efectos cascada en la sociedad, normalizando la presencia femenina en espacios públicos de entretenimiento y cuestionando estructuras patriarcales arraigadas que venían desde la tierra de origen. La mujer bailando chutney no era solo una artista; era un símbolo de cambio social.

Además, el chutney redefinió lo que significaba ser nacional en el Caribe. En una región donde la identidad a menudo se había construido en torno a la herencia africana y europea, la inclusión masiva de la estética y el sonido indio obligó a una renegociación del concepto de \

. Ya no era una suma de partes separadas, sino una mezcla inseparable. El éxito del género demostró que la cultura no es un juego de suma cero, donde ganar uno significa perder para otro, sino un tejido que se fortalece con cada hilo nuevo. Las celebraciones nacionales, antes dominadas por otras expresiones, comenzaron a integrar el chutney como elemento central, reconociendo que la experiencia indo-caribeña es fundamental para la historia completa de la nación.

Hoy, el legado del chutney como hito cultural se mide en la naturalidad con la que las nuevas generaciones navegan su identidad. Los jóvenes ya no sienten la necesidad de elegir entre sus raíces; las viven simultáneamente. La música les dio el lenguaje para hacerlo. Cuando un niño en Queens, Nueva York, o en Londres, baila al ritmo de un dholak mezclado con bajos electrónicos, no está solo consumiendo entretenimiento; está heredando una victoria. Está participando en una tradición que logró convertir la marginación en influencia, el aislamiento en conexión y la nostalgia en innovación. El chutney probó que la cultura es viva, maleable y resistente, y que la verdadera autenticidad no reside en la pureza estática, sino en la capacidad de adaptarse y florecer en suelo nuevo.

Es todo por hoy.

Disfruten del mix que les comparto, esta vez, sin voz, solo instrumental. 

Chau, BlurtMedia…

https://img.blurt.world/blurtimage/paulindstrom/a4ca48f8252d57129ab76b747cd3f5b6b6208eae.gif

links.title: LOH #286: Bullying must be fought, because we are meaningful.
links.body:
>Discussing the school environment is never-ending. Especially bullying. You know, this has been going on for a very long time, and it's like a tangled thread that's incredibly difficult to unravel, or like a never-ending chain. From mild bullying to serious ones that result in fatalities, it keeps happening year after year, with a significant increase in cases. But how come? Why doesn't it stop and instead seems to become a culture?


---

![ysji1jr8hqd2wu11.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/2432f36DW1Qw56iF8H335LjPT3QdyKYdb3WgW6AMg4PnFxTuxakVChdNBVtYx95tYhs2J.jpeg)


[Image](https://rsj.acehprov.go.id/berita/kategori/artikel/menumbuhkan-empati-untuk-mencegah-bullying)



---

When I was in my final year of elementary school, it was my hardest year because I had to endure verbal bullying from my entire class. It was a miserable year, but I got through it. I don't know why they did that to me and ostracized me. I was high-achieving, and I was never naughty. I was just deaf, and that made them abuse me. At that time, I didn't cry or whine. I just went to school every day, attended lessons, practiced for extra practice for the final exams, and that was it. I finished my final year with flying colors, got good grades, and got into the top junior high school in my district.

In junior high, I experienced similar verbal bullying, but in a smaller group. I kept asking myself: Why? Why did they have to be so harsh when this was my body? What did I do? Nothing. How did I handle it? Nothing. I just continued with my normal activities, wondering.

---
WHAT IF MY CHILD IS A BULLYING VICTIM?


---

I don't want him to be like me. I will ask who dared to do it and how many people? If the number is large, I will step forward and urge the relevant school personnel, including educators, to take this seriously. I will tell my child to stand up to the bully and not remain silent because he was born a free human being and citizen. If, after the discussion, the situation becomes increasingly uncontrollable, making my child uncomfortable and hindering his educational development, I will move him elsewhere. I will not allow my child, whom I gave birth to with all my love and all my heart, a free and independent human being, to endure trauma that will not heal for the rest of his life.

I will tell him that he has the right to control his own body, so if anyone bullies him, whether physically or verbally, it is absolutely unacceptable. It is not your fault, and it must be stopped. The wounds of bullying can linger in the victim's mind for life. Even if the victim finds a way to make peace with their wounds, the memories will still haunt them periodically. I hope bullying in any form is not allowed to continue. Thank you for reading my opinion; I hope you were impressed. See you in the next contest.

---


![FB_IMG_1775230739933.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/242Y7X8kxPFJaKTKALzDkhafBecrbsX1CzHigtVw2aEhPMHfppJxHWFdZmQWDoGfRN7Eb.jpg)

![IMG20260331104111.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/titisnariyah/242NixTeCHbDc8YGvForkzpuZBVMHFnNDvQ1m7J3P1trJ7ryDUbDLY3CZR8dhBU4Ww6CY.jpg)

links.title: 懒人做饭
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![c3yzR6Fat3zlpY1m_mmexport1777302117862.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/lenalu/images/c3yzR6Fat3zlpY1m_mmexport1777302117862/c3yzR6Fat3zlpY1m_mmexport1777302117862.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

最近开始逼自己做饭，谈不上什么美味佳肴，充其量就是生命体征维持餐，主打一个快速简单、一锅乱煮，勉强做到有荤有素、营养均衡，至于味道，主打一个难吃但能入口。
 
其实我本身挺爱吃的，唯独不爱做饭。每天下班路上，明明路过菜市场和超市，进去买菜也不算麻烦，可一想到要日复一日、天天重复这件事，就打心底里烦躁。一天就24小时，工作和睡觉已经占去了绝大部分，属于自己的时间少得可怜，真不想把仅剩的精力，耗在做饭这种琐碎又没完没了的事上。
 
思来想去，打算搞个懒人备菜计划：每周日集中买好一周的食材，肉类提前切好腌制好，素菜也洗净切分，用密封袋按一顿的量分装好，直接丢冰箱冷冻。往后下班回家，不用再买菜、不用费劲切菜，拿出来直接丢小锅里乱煮乱炒就行。
 
说实话，脑补了一下那个画面，大概率又难吃又没卖相，想想都觉得有点恶心，可随便吧，能填饱肚子、维持生活就行。至于这个计划能坚持多久，心里完全没底，走一步看一步，只求别半途而废就好🤧

---

For the best experience view this post on [Liketu](https://liketu.com/@lenalu/5dwxbe)

links.title: Tasty and nutritious banana cake.🍕🍌🍌//Sabroso y nutritivo pastel de plátano.
links.body:
<center>![sa.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vi6BQm3ovxxjgPJMEio24RWGemXQhNnT5svRCh9X7zXy5XAUt3uQ6YhLNntQCeYqgzn.jpg)</center>

Hello, my dear friends at Hive Food, I hope you're all doing well.

This recipe is super nutritious and very tasty; it's ideal for lunch, as it's a delicious cake made with yellow bananas, preferably. Take note of the ingredients and pay attention to the preparation.

>Hola, mis queridos amigos de Hive Food, espero se encuentren muy bien.
Esta receta es supernutritiva y muy sabrosa; para los almuerzos es ideal, ya que contiene, se trata de un sabroso pastel de plátano amarillo, preferiblemente. Tomen nota de los ingredientes y presten atención a su preparación.


![jn.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23sxnMbKJcKpK83rMFpemrBxrxdF1MtkFwxjG87RhYvL1w2oc3yGhXyhQgSrju7KxJfgs.png)

<center> Preparación—Preparation</center>


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23u652kA2ro7LTBsQ39k4cmC2ARvkwSz8G2KcmzmvktVtwYFiAS3iXUdz3pzsGQawxbtu.png)

In a pot we put the vegetables, plus the meat and the sauces with two tablespoons of oil and half a cup of water; we start to cook the ground meat.

>En una olla ponemos las verduras, más la carne y las salsas con dos cucharadas de aceite y media taza de agua; ponemos a guisar la carne molida.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wC7dwVwd6PdbrC8wmHSESaf4s2yVZEtMsrZjiXW3RKd34wVDKJCRX2ViuYUPdr948kJ.png)

In another pot, we boil the yellow plantains.

>En otra olla ponemos a hervir los plátanos amarillos.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23uFU4LinQ5bYToMfq1zPYW2Psu1Xoz1tUtNdwmM7mACY71g8Kva3sjB2aeVn3iuDm9XP.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wC9VKentvdiEWdahhv2HQtkPixfpbxXx7xSZ8Npw5sdfGfx3BeGBL4bgPDQQ12qw7bN.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23yJJcWR3CvNJpvuoCxA6UQZGoD2GLBawWARAwo3L4LqzujZ1exLgiS7kE5JoMZk7eNFF.png)

Once the meat is cooked through, remove it and mash the plantains.

>Cuando ya este bien guisada la carne la retiramos y trituramos los platanos


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wCBzUkf9A77whtHVGnAUkLi3HtGiDsTYnx1KPFHB3mXJtqQy9iwDWvjEGSXPe28GQ6n.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vhyMgHxQErQfrkGfR9rUo4WdRpDo6pCrLJh8uEf1yKQzGHCbwxxSWBmcZSHtiTKdtFa.png)

After thoroughly mashing the plantains, we add the cooked ground meat.

>Después de triturar bien los plátanos, le echamos la carne molida guisada.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vsFsGrkjUMaD7pb6LwAMxbcGbjVmNzNHzPXfCwq2iUjmRN9fEx1m8Qb8EgcYzspjAeB.png)


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vsNbgbQ133Ea1N3TCCxs9LRYYm1LS3dfBcf8rk5kyBPEq6DXZ5R1rLb8nXE4f5PSFLh.png)

We sprinkle the cheeses on top later.
Place in a preheated oven at 300°F and bake for about 15 minutes or until golden brown on top.

>Le echamos los quesos por encima para luego 
Llevar al horno precalentado a 300°F y hornear durante unos 15 minutos o hasta que dore bien por encima.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23wBxp3kqFRa4P4HTXiW3xUdhsMfGM1wMXTWRMfoLuDpPjwJaLesQUhNBK2dLqK2JkLoq.png)

If you prefer to serve the cake with white rice or mashed potatoes, you can do so.

>Si prefieren acompañar el pastel, lo pueden hacer con arroz blanco o puré de papas


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23uFZvj4kfd7LSjxZyH8ZLNTQUzRjKazrxBdn4BH9CLSnoPxxFbp4fa7WaNXTjrpMcmXF.png)

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/karinanunez/23vsBvESQLdjMapCbN11cr9u8Rh9eg2EV8k2MBLg6Q4xDrtqVDskrb6i4hitcpQCzkaLC.png)</center>

and My Rising Star Musical Journey
links.body: မင်္ဂလာပါရှင်။ ဒီနေ့မှာတော့ မြန်မာသီချင်းကောင်း ကြိုက်သူတိုင်းရဲ့ ရင်ထဲမှာ စွဲထင်ကျန်ရစ်နေတဲ့ အဆိုတော် အောင်ရင်ရဲ့ ထာဝရလက်ရာတစ်ခုဖြစ်တဲ့ \

သီချင်းလေးအကြောင်းကို ဝေမျှပေးချင်ပါတယ်။ ဒီသီချင်းဟာ သာမန်သီချင်းတစ်ပုဒ်ထက်ပိုပြီး ဖခင်တစ်ယောက်က သားသမီးကို ပေးခဲ့တဲ့ အဖိုးမဖြတ်နိုင်တဲ့ ဘဝလက်ဆောင်တစ်ခုလို့လည်း ဆိုနိုင်ပါတယ်။\n\nMingalaba! Today, I would like to share the story behind one of the timeless masterpieces by singer Aung Yin, titled \

(A Father’s Words), which remains deeply etched in the hearts of everyone who loves classic Myanmar songs. This song is more than just a melody; it can be described as an invaluable life gift from a father to his children.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeu1LKcdSLLpW1zW49AHMqk5kKkiC7siyma6ChqjLhCcf/1777302464743.jpg)


​နှလုံးသွေးနဲ့ ရေးဖွဲ့ခဲ့တဲ့ ဒီလောကထဲတို့ကြား
အပြစ်ကင်းတဲ့ ကလေးလေးတစ်ယောက် ခေါ်ဆောင်လာခဲ့တယ်။ အို ဖေဖေကြီးတဲ့ သူ့ခေါ်သံလေးရယ် အရင်ဦးဆုံးစကားစပြောချိန် သတိရတယ်

This song begins by reflecting on the pure moment a child is brought into this world. The father fondly remembers the very first time he heard the child call out \
a memory that remains etched in his heart.\n\n​ဖခင်တစ်ယောက်အတွက်တော့ သူ့ရဲ့ရင်သွေးလေး လောကထဲကို ရောက်လာပြီး \

လို့ စတင်ခေါ်ဝေါ်ခဲ့တဲ့ အချိန်ဟာ ဘဝမှာ အပျော်ဆုံးနဲ့ အမှတ်ရဆုံး အချိန်ပါပဲ။


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPro1rJWfgnwUpgKNPdso76qdBpUNrU2Ubm3jaeWndhpc/ai_generated.webp)

ဘဝလမ်းဟာ ဖြောင့်တစ်လှည့် ကောက်တစ်လှည့်ပါ
နီးတစ်လှည့် ဝေးတစ်လှည့်ပါ ဒီလောကထဲတို့ကြားမှာ သင်ခန်းစာတွေယူပါ

ဆိုးတစ်လှည့် ကောင်းတစ်လှည့် ဘဝ... မာယာတွေကြားထဲက

လွတ်မြောက်နိုင်အောင် ကြိုးစား ဒါအဖေ့မေတ္တာစကား

The chorus offers a profound life lesson: life is a mix of straight and winding paths, sometimes close and sometimes far. It encourages us to learn from the world's adventures and strive to overcome challenges, guided by a father's loving advice.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemzyxV8JM6D983U1ppWmghJ6nsNxgRhcxGSUdS5pz7YA/1774965657976.jpg)

​လောကကြီးမှာ အရာရာဟာ ထာဝရမဟုတ်ပါဘူး။ အဆိုးနဲ့ အကောင်း၊ အကောက်နဲ့ အဖြောင့်ဟာ အမြဲဒွန်တွဲနေတတ်တာမို့ ဘယ်လိုအခြေအနေမျိုးမှာမဆို သင်ခန်းစာယူတတ်ဖို့နဲ့ ဘဝရဲ့ မာယာတွေကို ကျော်လွှားနိုင်ဖို့ အဖေက လမ်းညွှန်ထားတာပါ။လဲနေလည်း ပြန်ထဖို့ မမေ့ပါနဲ့ သားရယ် အသက်ရှင်သမျှ တို့ကြိုးစားခွင့်ရှိတယ်
ဘဝကို ဖြစ်သလို နင်းလျှောက်မသွားပါနဲ့ သမီးငယ်
အဖေ့မျက်ကွယ်ရာမှာ စိတ်ချချင်တယ်...

​Meaning: The father reminds his children never to forget to stand back up after a fall. As long as we live, we have the chance to try again. He advises them not to wander aimlessly through life so that he can feel at peace, even when he is no longer there to watch over them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW3WT96pCZqS32XcCGAPggu5HyB4A6DWyNgNLHRs18tbH/img_0.4485858976933855.jpg)


​အမှားဆိုတာ သင်ခန်းစာဖြစ်ပြီး လဲကျတိုင်း ပြန်ထနိုင်ဖို့က အရေးကြီးပါတယ်။ ဘဝကို တန်ဖိုးရှိရှိ ရှင်သန်ဖို့နဲ့ အဖေ မရှိတော့တဲ့ တစ်နေ့မှာတောင် သားသမီးတွေကို စိတ်ချလက်ချ ထားရစ်ခဲ့ချင်တဲ့ ဖခင်တိုင်းရဲ့ ဆန္ဒကို ဒီစာသားလေးတွေက ဖော်ပြနေပါတယ်။


​
​ဒီသီချင်းကို နားထောင်ရင်း ကျွန်မတို့ရဲ့ မိဘတွေက ကျွန်မတို့ကို ဘယ်လောက်အထိ လမ်းမှန်ရောက်စေချင်လဲဆိုတာ ခံစားမိပါတယ်။ ကျွန်မတို့ တက်လှမ်းနေတဲ့ ဘဝခရီးမှာ အခက်အခဲတွေ၊ စိတ်ဓာတ်ကျစရာတွေ ကြုံလာရတိုင်း မိဘတွေရဲ့ ဆုံးမစကားဟာ အကောင်းဆုံး အားဆေးပါပဲ။ အထူးသဖြင့် အခုလို အပြောင်းအလဲများတဲ့ ခေတ်ကြီးထဲမှာ ကိုယ့်ကိုယ်ကိုယ် ယုံကြည်မှုရှိရှိနဲ့ အားမလျှော့တမ်း ကြိုးစားသွားဖို့ လိုအပ်ပါတယ်။


​Watching our parents guide us through life's ups and downs gives us immense strength. In an ever-changing world, holding onto these values helps us remain resilient and focused on our personal goals and professional growth.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUSp3bkEN4MXKfSP1QAFnA53dYCKWJAN29DVgPXH2iJMA/img_0.2951814577976987.jpg)

​
​ကျွန်မရဲ့ ဂီတခရီးလမ်းကိုလည်း Rising Star ဂိမ်းထဲမှာ တစိုက်မတ်မတ် လျှောက်လှမ်းနေပါတယ်။ လက်ရှိမှာ Level 109 ကို ရောက်ရှိနေပြီဖြစ်ပြီး ဂီတပညာရပ်တွေကို ပိုမိုနက်ရှိုင်းစွာ နားလည်နိုင်ဖို့ Production Lesson ကို အားစိုက်လုပ်ဆောင်နေပါတယ်။ ဒီသင်ခန်းစာကနေ ဂီတထုတ်လုပ်မှုအပိုင်းကို ပိုမိုသိရှိလာရသလို၊ Skill ရမှတ်တွေ တိုးပွားလာတာကလည်း ကျွန်မရဲ့ ဂိမ်းကစားမှုခရီးစဉ်အတွက် တကယ့်ကို စိတ်လှုပ်ရှားစရာပါ။

links.title: Monomad: Streets and buildings [Eng/Esp]
links.body:
>

This is my entry for the #monomad challenge.

Happy start to the week to everyone, dear friends in the community and lovers of black and white photography; I hope you’re all doing great. I want to kick off the week by sharing more street photos, so I hope you enjoy each one as much as I enjoyed taking them.

Feliz inicio de semana para todos, queridos amigos de la comunidad y amantes de la fotografía en blanco y negro; espero que todos se encuentren genial. Quiero empezar la semana sumando más fotografías callejeras, por lo que espero que disfruten de cada fotografía, al igual que yo disfruté el hacerlas.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23y8jMWMGDHyYzTRjfFfWi3gr5VJotr9mRdPi6KZSic32ZQunJwcg5Dfwy9Tn5fD6u9tK.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tvVYjMQcq7Y5ESJavg1sgW7BzRmEXe4m8W69vMNgB1DeUWSWni2FcgkRdWXsfieysge.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uFMFc2BcycCLiT8w1AEEV3qv149gQBMnF5x2qPkUSj1bUKL4sHd19rCuGCp8FWtNWsr.jpg

>

Although I try to focus heavily on people when I take street photos, there are times when certain structures catch my eye whether because of their architecture or the way the sun hits them and creates a more striking appearance which is why there’s such variety in my photos today.

A pesar de que cuando hago fotografías callejeras, intento centrarme mucho en las personas, hay ocasiones en las cuales ciertas estructuras se me hacen llamativas, ya sea por su arquitectura o por cómo el sol impacta en ellas y genera cierta apariencia más atractiva; de ahí la variedad en mis fotografías el día de hoy.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23w2gpdy7HaXjcapjNHFwNQ4dYxexPwFZvPFHXDuuiV872WyoR64TtBH4mN75P3n8gmbh.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23zkkYuuGcr8F3LukVFscnoyuzdR88LpEqvmBMYec63AoD1G27Gj3ybhSXhgDCzWRuFDA.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23zbS7wtFkEKbZaKwrNLak2ghQzTkgHPqPrxyfSigy41zERtL2rkbiRKadCPE6Uw9rmXM.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23xp4iLoZV6jfHe1jCYEYmgknn7YstjetBdSSJ3nDoG96R4r7hS95QhjcmUXiYEpeS7Tb.jpg

>

The streets always have a story to tell, and that’s what I strive to capture in my photographs; moreover, when viewed in black and white, I feel that story becomes even more compelling you appreciate the details a bit more without the distraction of color, and I find the result to be even better.

Siempre las calles tienen algo que contar y es lo que busco capturar en mis fotografías; además, al verlas en blanco y negro, considero que esa historia termina siendo más llamativa, aprecias un poco más las cosas sin tener la distracción del color y el resultado me parece incluso mejor.


https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23tbiDzCPCCiKzRbHeKxe9CyCQ21YqxJj4Q1nsqzN3xVhFGDtqMgFEt1tyu6ghyhSNQ1Z.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uFH1j45NwNH94d8pH5KEpqfy7jnoVYxewxcVLtge9mrfs44CDrQ9qqL7M2NcAUDEDPV.jpg

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/naitreart/23uQiHuay6VPYi2jckMHezBFetG6hTH1gBf75xQ4Ykwv9NKpGAPgiF4qujban911mRn77.jpg

>

That's all for today; thank you for taking the time to read my post once again and for checking out my photos. Once again, I hope you all have a great start to the week and a wonderful Monday. See you next time, dear friends in the community!

Esto es todo por el día de hoy; les agradezco por tomarse el tiempo de leerme un día más y también por ver mis fotografías. Nuevamente deseo que todos tengan un excelente inicio de semana y también un excelente lunes. ¡Hasta la próxima, queridos amigos de la comunidad!

/>

\n
