links.title: Hive Communities | Communities Created, Top Communities by Subs, Activity, HP Weight and Authors | Apr 2026
links.body:
How is Hive doing with Communities these days? Communities are an essential feature of the Hive ecosystem as they allow for easy content discovery and finding specific topics that users are accustomed to. Almost all content is posted in some community that is later used by users to filter content, or by curators to support authors and communities. 
If we combine communities with the possibility for easy tokenization, communities’ tokens, and provide tools for users to monetize, things can become very interesting. So far nobody manged to crack the code for this, but it’s never too late 😊.

 




![01.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEyz3Ked4xmZUgnrySzJfY1oNsixhh5D87bziqhx8tBbZNPonLstYqStFgKdo4vnkxj.png)





There have been some well-established communities on Hive, and some new coming in. Some of the communities already have their token on Hive Engine. 

Here we will be looking into the following things:
-	Number of communities created
-	Top communities by number of subscribers
-	Top Communities by activities
-	Top communities subscribers’ stake
-	Top communities by active authors

Communities went live officially in February 2020, but they were in a test phase before that. 

**The period that we will be looking here is from November 2019 till now.** 

## Number of Communities Created
First let’s look at the total number of communities created with time.


 


![image001.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23vhTiFEjgsbBBV1biTh42SJ4HkNdsMpUbjKDj6Fz97wVW1vTsfSYt2h2YUpxobQzkPvd.png)





We can notice the spike in the number of communities created is quite visible in 2020 when they launched. Afterwards the number dropped and lately there are few communities created per day. 
In the last period there have been a few communities created, usually it is below 5 per day.

### If we look at the monthly chart, we get this:

 






![image003.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/EoATY75Xaz9KpaScY9tL8iVUqSCp6pRwdjQdHnJPwPv5cijt8GG8WWh45M8iH4styDg.png)




More than 300 communities per month as ATH number, while in the last months there are between **20 to 30** communities created per month. 

There are now **4.5k** communities on Hive.

## Top Communities by Number of Subscribers
Who are the top communities on the blockchain?
We will be looking at this with more than one parameter, but for starters let’s take a look at the most obvious one, the number of subscribers.

Here is the chart.

 



![image005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uQNneiKLFay35GmoxirAaQWu5uG41u2SXaTviTeH3frezksPJh8GUhVJoXBYnNbAebK.png)






The LeoFinance community is now at the top with 26k subscribers, closely followed by the Photography Lovers and then the GEMS community. 
Foodies, Worldmaping and the Gaming community in the top as well.
The subscribers’ numbers to the communities keep growing.

## Top Communities by Subscribers’ Stake
Another interesting way to rank communities is the stake of their subscribers. After all we are on a DPoS chain. 
What is the stake weight of the subscribers in each community?
Here is the chart.


 



![image007.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uEzR5qWqotP8do9tBAiKhdyt2MVL6wCWuyc5sXvJ7XwXGAC9P7wshhWy9FzZemNJ3hi.png)







In this type of ranking the HiveDevs community comes on top with 63M HP. Worldmaping, OCD,  and Hive Statistics comes next.

## Top Communities by Activity
The number of subscribers in a community and their stake is important. But more important probably is how active the communities are.

Here is the chart for the top communities by the number of **posts and comments** made in the last 30 days.


 
 




![image009.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23tbKPNkBhTz4efBWG1iqcuEzgoGTrjWTKtW7YJ3F28b39MsbXnxBvT3cbf2GvKXce6u5.png)






The red is the number of posts, while the white is the number of comments. 
We can see that LeoFinance, or Inleo as the new brand stands, is at the top here, and by a lot. This is mostly because of the short form content and the blogging happening there. On the second spot is Snaps, another short for and then comes Ecency that also provides a short form content trough waves.

Some other know communities as Actifit, Worldmappin, Photography Lovers, Splinterlands in the top as well.

## Top Communities by Active Authors
What about active authors? Here is the chart for the last 30 days. The MAUs. 

 








![image011.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dalz/23uQNiD4QtLsME6XpJuBPTT1R7c46bUdRPhwvwod1P8wb9UsPNQfwYA4oB1gRyNhsnJG4.png)





These are accounts that have made posts or comments in the community.
InLeo comes on top with 900 MAUs, followed by Ecency, Actifit and Snaps. All short form communities. Overall the short contents seems to be overtaking with what’s left from the activity on chain. 




All the best

links.title: Dread Tafarian + Kicking Roc - My secret to victory.
links.body:
‎Hello everyone,
I'm @naturaluttom. I hope everyone is well, I'm fine too. Today I'm going to share my experience with my two most used cards from my favorite game Splinterlands.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSxZNVej3znVbb285rDUSBtJWTcAdgX7mTPqTruXMoX1Q/1777302151106.png)

[‎The image was created with AI.]()

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)
I honestly use the same two cards in most matches - Dread Tafarian and Kicking Roc. I don't play very well with calculations, so I like to play simply. But these two cards work for me most of the time.

First, let's talk about Dread Tafarian. I always keep this card in front. Because it can attack well from the front, so it performs well when it's in front. It has Health 6 and Armor 1, so it can take quite a lot of damage in the beginning. But what I like the most is its Heal ability. It regains 1-3 of its max health every round. That's why I often see that even when it's almost dead, it still heals. That's why I use it as my main tank.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYRpXMyEk5Kz5wtCcviVf5UzmYjsGeBUkBcURBCAtHk6t/1777302169974.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd5YQW2oDgsn7k8iof9AFBqJfppcer2KUGDHT3U5aTfV9/1777302170012.jpg)

Now, let's talk about Kicking Roc. I always keep this card in the back. Its Attack 3 (ranged), Health 5 and Speed ​​2. Since it attacks from a distance, it doesn't work well if you put it in front. But if you put it in the back, it starts dealing damage just fine. It gradually reduces the health of the opponent's cards.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPXVqUvF18h8HJwnUwQzesNutmYaZNfzeGNPDoXkds5Pq/1777302208866.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQman4nFSvobZWakDGo4M7HrTmxU7NEsoHEou1WhokwETWx/1777302208910.jpg)



My style of play is very simple - taking all the damage with Dread Tafarian in front, and attacking with Kicking Roc in the back. I have noticed many times that playing this way makes it very easy to win.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd1YxUvScaswW223WNgxAp8rsn44svAkLDVybcCYCMHQb/1777302208951.jpg)


I don't win all the matches, but these two cards have helped me win many matches. So I use them in almost all the matches.
That's it for today. 




Thank you all ❤️




![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTGdTS4iqM7QBFQiHefGE2mDcpwBepyYtiFc5e9GPrzCc/1775330832072.png)

links.body:
El cuento tiene sus situaciones menos creíbles, como esa del padre comentada por ti, porque un padre posiblemente pierda el apetito en una situación como la desaparición de su hijo.
Tampoco creo sea un caso tan común una madrastra mala como la suelen pintar en muchas historias, y menos una que asesine a un niño nada más por celos o algún motivo parecido de poco peso.
Pero se trata de un cuento de fantasía y horror y muchas situaciones pueden ser simbolismos.
La parte más realista, aunque resulte asombroso, es la de comerse a un niño.
Las hambrunas eran comunes hasta en Europa en tiempos relativamente recientes. En esas situaciones se han reportado casos de madres que se comieron a su hijo o hija.
También han habido madres reincidentes, como un caso del Volga en la hambruna soviética de 1921, cuando una madre mató y se comió a su hija después de haber devorado los restos de su hijo fallecido.
Es posible esa parte del cuento haya sido inspirada por un caso real parecido.

Dani, you have to get these [jobs](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-job) out, we need this [money](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-money). I know! I know!! But how do we do it and still remain on green light profits?. Why not [TRY](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-try-currency) an early strategy?   

Some call it MMM (Money Making Monday), well, if you are to ask me, I would personally have loved it to be a [day](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-day) I take that needed rest. You may be imagining if actually I am lazy, just give me some [time](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-time) to chop into this [article](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-article) and maybe, just maybe you will side with me. And talking of taking that needed rest, it can be dicey. There is a pending [debt](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-debt) to clear and new bills are coming in. This can be the fate I have to patiently endure until [ALL](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-all-currency) gets erased.   

I won't be going back to where the [bad debt](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-bad-debt) actually started, it better we heard [forward](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-forward-financial) so we can meet up this article. A little take [home](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-home) here; ‘monitor bad debts, they can in turn hunt you down’. Of course you know, this ‘bad debt' can also be an uncalculated [investment](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-investment).  

From quitting my job to turning into a full time entrepreneurial career, this is a [story](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-story) of a young [man](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-man) who dares the normal patterns of getting paid. That paycheck after 30 days isn't my thing so why not opt into entrepreneurship and get your [income](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-income) daily. Not bad right? But it comes at a [cost](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cost). First, you will have to solve the problem of what type of [entrepreneur](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-entrepreneur) do you want to be?   

Oh! You never saw that coming. Maybe the idea was just about [cash flow](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-cash-flow) until you realize that entrepreneurship can be about standard and expansion. From just trying to solve problems locally, you may have to turn attention to international [markets](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-market). Let me halt there; it seems my fingers are typing away from the point of conversation.   

I started calculating how to run this [week](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-week) since last Saturday; bills to clear, [expenses](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-expense) to make and well, we will have to [work](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-work) and the earlier we deliver the better. There are a [lot](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-lot-commodities) of jobs on the table currently in the office and well, this can end up not translating to [profit](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-profit) if the right tactics are not deployed.   
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmc9yaCwPQGgBuya4BRw77ED4hcWbjnwnbCweHBFyBUMv8/1000173730.jpg 
[source](https://www.freepik.com/free-vector/financial-planning-young-adults_274484074.htm#fromView=search&page=7&position=48&uuid=6f39c47c-c03b-4c8d-8547-8af45ec6e1fe&query=Expenses+AI+generated+) 
Expenses are on the high side especially in the area of [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy-industry). [gas prices](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-gas-price) have gone to the roof affecting daily living and daily businessing. Think of the cost of running a generator in an office of limited machines and limited hands and it can be a deficit unless you get that assistance from general [electricity](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-electricity); something that has been very poor for the past weeks.   

The fact is, the higher the profit we keep from these workloads, the higher the chances of [clearing](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-clearing) the entire pending debts and focusing on where to channel our resources in the [Next](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-next-2007-film) half of this [year](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-year). This has been my strategy since January but one way or the other, I keep seeing red lights. The market crumbled at first; something I was also planning to take advantage of in the long run to mitigate every debt pressure.  

The [war](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-war) that took place in the middle east escalated down here in [terms](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-term-insurance) of [energy](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-energy) and logistics and you may consider how much extra to spend in a day and what that can convert in a [month](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-month). It is more like losing 20 to 30% of expected profit courtesy of high gas [prices](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-price) plus poor general electricity circulation.   

To conclude, let me add, [business](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-business) goes beyond how much workload is coming in and even how much it translates in incoming [transactions](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-transaction). This is my workload experience; getting work out on time is good but it can also end up not being profitable when high expenses are the bench mark. 

This is where there is a need for an expansion because in a broader lens, fast and efficient [delivery](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-delivery) is key to [gain](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-gain) [customer](https://inleo.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-customer) trust and more impact and adding to that, better profit. Business can be very tactical and this is where staying in the SME section is not that much advisable.

links.title: Tres semanas para el escenario - Historia [ESP-ENG]
links.body:
Tres semanas después la Banda seguía firme, pero el estudio estaba irreconocible, papeles con letras, acordes garabateados, guitarras apoyadas en cada rincón y una energía que podía conquistar lo que sea. Además, la banda había logrado lo impensable: diez canciones completas, cada una con su alma y su verdad, donde le dio trabajo, pero noche y día para conseguirla. Toda la banda Lucas, Dani, Michelle y Stewie cargaron sus instrumentos hacia la oficina del RisingStar, donde allí recibieron un sobre brillante con el logo del concurso esperaba sobre el escritorio. Michelle lo abrió con cuidado —Este es —dijo, con la voz temblorosa—. Nuestra inscripción. Lucas sonrió. —Es oficial. Lo logramos, pero ahora toca esperar que nos aprueben. >Three weeks later, the band was still going strong, but the studio was unrecognizable: sheets of paper covered in lyrics, scribbled chords, guitars propped up in every corner, and an energy that could conquer anything. What’s more, the band had achieved the unthinkable: ten complete songs, each with its own soul and authenticity—it took a lot of hard work, but they’d poured their hearts into it day and night to make it happen. # >The whole band—Lucas, Dani, Michelle, and Stewie—carried their instruments to the RisingStar office, where a shiny envelope with the contest logo was waiting on the desk. Michelle opened it carefully. “This is it,” she said, her voice trembling. “Our entry.” Lucas smiled. “It’s official. We did it, but now we just have to wait to see if they approve us.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWgEB3ijyKtPkpVjJT2fYDDEHjGqCDZj6cXwxrTR6iw73/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/cinta-banda-grande-tambor-m%c3%basica-1582143/) La banda respiró un poco, ya que ahora no todo dependía de ellos. Sus canciones estaban listas, su pasión intacta, pero la decisión final estaba en manos del jurado encargado del concurso nacional de Banda. Días después, un correo llegó al estudio, pero era diferente, donde RisingStar los había invitado a recibir camisetas negras con detalles en dorado, chaquetas que brillaban bajo la luz y botas con un toque moderno pero profesional. Cada pieza parecía diseñada para que se sintieran invencibles. —¡Miren esto! —exclamó Dani, probándose la chaqueta—. ¡Podemos salir al escenario como verdaderos rockstars! Michelle ajustó. —Esto no es solo ropa —dijo—. Es un recordatorio de todo lo que logramos. Lucas golpeó suavemente el tambor con un ritmo seguro. —Tres semanas de locura, diez canciones y ahora ropa, no podemos fallar. Stewie asintió. —El concurso nacional nos espera. Pero aquí, con estas canciones y este uniforme, somos más que una banda. >The band breathed a sigh of relief, since now not everything depended on them. Their songs were ready, their passion undiminished, but the final decision rested with the judges of the national band competition. # >A few days later, a package arrived at the studio, but this one was different: RisingStar had invited them to receive black T-shirts with gold accents, jackets that shimmered in the light, and boots with a modern yet professional touch. Each piece seemed designed to make them feel invincible. “Look at this!” Dani exclaimed, trying on the jacket. “We can go out on stage like real rock stars!” # >Michelle adjusted her jacket. “This isn’t just clothes,” she said. “It’s a reminder of everything we’ve achieved.” Lucas tapped the drum gently with a steady rhythm. “Three weeks of madness, ten songs, and now clothes—we can’t fail.” Stewie nodded. “The national competition awaits us. But here, with these songs and this uniform, we’re more than just a band.” ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcmL1tcAM68ZnSd8grYTD9EiR2sEdEJYsD9fJxqjRGcaT/image.png) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/guitarra-m%c3%basica-instrumento-3853132/) Todos sonrieron, sabiendo que el momento de su debut oficial estaba cerca. El estudio no era solo un lugar donde creaban música: ahora era el inicio de algo más grande, donde sus sueños como Banda dejarían de ser ideas y se convertiría en sueños. La cuenta regresiva había comenzado, y ellos estaban listos para estallar sobre el escenario de ese concurso nacional de bandas. >Everyone smiled, knowing that the moment of their official debut was near. The studio wasn’t just a place where they made music: it was now the beginning of something bigger, where their dreams as a band would stop being mere ideas and become reality. The countdown had begun, and they were ready to take the stage at that national band competition.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

links.body:
![Modern Aesthetic Wedding Photo Collage Instagram Post (1100 x 1350 px)_20260427_181033_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xemptX9yV6pY7HpUXKNhYsdJh2Rte2fkGP61NMY3qBnwdc9Us1RqWppHxAz1K1dNR5M.png)
<center></center>*<sub><center>Lead image  created using [ CANVA](https://www.canva.com/design/DAG4XqLPHZk/zEFLzmmPErnISEOtfB8PGA/edit?utm_content=DAG4XqLPHZk&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link2&utm_source=sharebutton)</center></sub>*

<div class=\

>Hello daily bloggers! It is nice to be here again after a series of travel postings since I had my last trip to Bantayan Island last month, and it took me weeks to finish my whole journey. Today, it was no trip, no tickets, no accommodation. It is just a daily life of me as I continue to brighten my life and make meaning of it. Today, we had a really long, tiring day in the market, in our house, and at the beach, for we wanted to have our day filled with food and a cooking session. There were no responsibilities, duties, or classes today, hence we had plenty of time on the clock to have fun and spend time together as a couple. ![Messenger_creation_0583438A-864B-4A7D-A901-2CCDEF2DF711.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243zRN7cdM2ShCCRnPFj4ceDdM7fqahj3P9VA9V7177QL9kM1wdhhe6DZQ3eVnk9TJsCg.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_5419BE42-E817-4F77-A508-DE6A33939B83.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wqg8JNpbDZ6yJ9bHCEAX7bdby8G5ZvnBRwBbzvtdvTRPRVWUL9vcMLVsWuFhQB1Xwkm.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_B2A593FA-367D-4A8F-AD32-BB740D6C4746.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wgKUvyyMwEZVB2rHmbjHwTqPDxMN9GegGmnsZP7y8JDGYfkGkemQHEdA2QjTnnc7NXf.jpeg) First thing first in the morning was going to the public market for we had to buy seafood, specifically shrimp, sea urchins, scallops, and crabs. We had to go to the farthest market in San Remigio, namely the Tambongon Public Market, to buy these foods, since our central market in the town proper does not have that much seafood for sale. We went to the bridge near the market where the cheapest but freshest seafood are sold, and fortunately we bought them successfully. My boyfriend chose them carefully, the freshest ones, so we could eat them deliciously. We bought the shrimp for 240 Php, crabs for 400 Php, scallops for 150 Php, and sea urchins for 100 Php. We also bought some ingredients in the market for our cookies and avocado milkshake. It is plenty of food to eat but it was the whole point. ![Messenger_creation_040474D2-85EF-435A-AEC3-4F3A16596FCE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23xAY7ujvZHucCy6hDanAPpybHBAgfZKJWF4w3577PZSfj8p6Vbs7ADqW5xMjSXH5eaj8.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_6765ECAD-5EBC-4067-9DF6-6DC74901CDB1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wMaJYC4AwutK9KAVvfgtGEp5wDc1EDUcF5GmUPhKdJaryN9hGh4HfUDTYkUf3FapNWw.jpeg) When we got home, we cooked the seafood immediately so we would not have a hard time figuring out how to cook rotten seafood. We made buttered garlic shrimp since we love eating it, made grilled buttered garlic scallops, and a tinolang crabs with many malunggay leaves. We loved the process of eating, the preparation, the conversation, and the feast of eating. ![ac3dd2f7-2b6f-4c23-a874-2596b32375f6media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpnDKvha2YP6r9RUSjY1V44mi3JQ4wpMYgpF66RHnGPeNNXwUR1S1ycP6rkk3ayeDNA.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_5E90DC8E-940E-4639-B7A9-3BCAF7F6538E.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpJYfC8i1pptRPJBsMcda6FmDw7UAFarvzJ1Qd52kHe6urHfiNfmSy6SVhFJN44M67v.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_67D78664-A4B2-4153-8BE7-5AA1C3751C1F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/EpNpnnxwp16zoHXkmDETZqGJ6ryyASqvkHiCkKY4Z22n4p2QN3mPBRFgdLbnRNykp9Z.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_575846E3-9226-44E7-B0BC-FADA1175F024.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wgMWXxP4EafbSXokyCEHXwV7xNw1MkqKrPe7RCT3Uf4ASqRVeN9PrytFZhmb71WGv2G.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_A5A4BE68-E0F9-479B-B384-73B1BBBF91BC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsSXkYZtf2zLvnDX2eKXVqdBAt1BvC3Q9nqGVpGjWs2yoDeiR3aBmug252GoWrNrAvR.jpeg) Once we were so tired and our backs aching, we found ourselves so thirsty in the middle of these sensations and made our avocado shake immediately. It was just a pair of ice, a kilo of avocado, a condensed milk, and an evaporated milk. The blender was not that easy to use since it is a bit rugged but we successfully made the shake. As someone who loves avocado, drinking a milkshake from fresh avocados is a top-tier gustatory experience. Who loves avocado here? ![Messenger_creation_28934B81-E9C2-4D9D-B828-B251B9F31EFC.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wC7QQXDiXGVNKhQBtzVm6KJgUuXnHiZU8JVkpU8B4YCqQBvicXXZUMMrwsvTBySYXcg.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_9B198897-C86E-4B19-AF58-55BC4B71A37D.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23uQvaQ1u1AnD5DKwyY5EGExdu3YHb53FC6yx72Kg8fNtd9zbSXEYeFMJaTNL3q393Cew.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_BA63E733-7827-4330-8EAE-D69DE2B388FA.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/244Umvs2b5vCgJQMoUrwCAgwu2UQm7TSENpD3LfC1r9FcmW24N6nCeCQcX84qwMwh5oqi.jpeg) ![Messenger_creation_95BD63B3-DD63-449B-95E2-D16D31E225D9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/245Sy5hhPqW7CUUxuus7vtVKGhm9gZCcXKqnc5H6djh7GPgomTDV2wg4KUpAXX3mcNqEE.jpeg) After a long enjoyment of cooking food and drinking fruit shake, we headed to the beach and ate everything we cooked. We did not rent a table, a room, or any accommodations. It was just a simple sit in a seaside corner, laughing together while enjoying our cooked food made with love. I enjoyed the food but I enjoyed most the sea urchin which is my greatest food and all-time favorite. The sea was bluer than I thought and it was lovely to be there, with a beautiful company and scene. ![8a6b7714-89ea-4ab0-932e-8f9c5f18e2acmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/243zZiA8KqsTPQo6f4kWFkyN78JGMRwFZFxh4oV6ZCaXCDuQnCY5FZpRsfLapJQ8xNgM6.jpeg) At the end of the day, I realized that not all meaningful days require grand plans or far travels, sometimes it is just about the simple moments that we choose to fill with love, food, and presence. It may be tiring, messy, and ordinary, but it is in these little shared experiences that life feels the most full and genuine. ![5df5e53a-acf9-4401-895c-08f7dce37cc2media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wCC4uJ4U81MfdyGYjf6znkYwveRCj7ZQNP6SqnzWUsWr6NjE8upD8WJDE2j5MFRfQqR.jpeg) ![550f0214-384e-4874-b6dc-d9c3abab5a52media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsQpuTzGAAUxkifxfvFpzZ3Hkih7UWWg8usST45BL18cencQrzCuUjmjsoUxBa7iwFB.jpeg) ![848aa211-0c52-4e46-a749-fc763015882dmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vi1x2rychKLgBW6CWk7FywUvhSTYpjaDFpEFKUcyyQqRSpFeZwByWNjFc1wpY9e66vf.jpeg) ![430001a4-6ce3-4ee2-b126-fd9bbee2e75dmedia_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wgKh7GXF2N77drHxMNoR7e4vZNz8GfnwVs9jqBfddSaQeoZra3xad4K8KQMd7b1Hec3.jpeg) ![0714976e-6bb4-4445-9808-e56c65204259media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23vsQcNTRsqUPD4Erv76D9a43ecDDFxR4rhaEHxYizFnXrwJNdUYhNRuBzcm6z1go8kwN.jpeg) ![1e29d6db-ffd9-45e2-9e03-c69a2b082419media_editing.tmp.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/whosee/23wX12yZFh3UMiARVzqcHyTv4bdsuz52NfBjmvwpazihVnEHkc2bSJWkPRSAaNrQcT8ba.jpeg) Tonight, we baked cookies we don't know the name is and I'll be bringing it to my school tomorrow. This is a Syritta pipiens, commonly known as the thick-legged hoverfly. The eyes are what made me think this must be some kind of hoverfly, but I had to do a bit of research, as it did seem to have a larger body, and the thicker legs are sure noticeable. It is originally from Europe but can be found across Eurasia and North America. It gathers pollen and nectar and is typically spotted around flowers. They play a key role in environmental functionality, and an abundance of them is a reflection of a healthy environment around them.

links.title: The Forge: From Breaking Up Fights To Breaking My Excuses.  LOH #286
links.body:
At the moment, I'm a Corp member, and as a Corp member in my country we are being assigned to work at different organizations, be it a bank, school, companies, ministries, and the likes for the space of a year.



![1000718620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23xAXWFXXEmMeHcGMbRQpjp1pEUvwSpWKbSXAj39mcQnPbFDdjyKF2t35Dz2VdfVL2Dnk.jpg)



For me, I was posted to a school to teach, and as a corper and teacher that I am, I've witnessed this with my own very eyes countless number of times, I mean bullying. I've noticed how some of my students suddenly go withdrawn in class, I've seen some shiver at the presence of others, I've seen some refuse to go out during break time all because they've been threatened by a fellow student.








So, when I began to notice all of that, I took action. What prompted me to take action was because of a boy I noticed is always silent in class, after engaging him in a conversation I got to understand that he's being a victim of this bullying of a thing. It got to an extent that he couldn't even look at anyone face to face in the eyes, he was either looking away or looking down.



And like I was saying, I took action. I didn't let it sound like I was being told anything because this bullies can still go at the back outside of school hours to threaten their victims again. So, I started using some part of my periods in their class to talk to them about respect, kindness and the usage of words. That was how I began to take control of things and moved into talking about things like bullying either with words or physical engagements.



![1000629047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/1000629047.jpg)


And I was glad I was able to talk it out with them, even though I had planned to involve higher authorities or even the civil defense if it persist/if I'm not seeing changes. Some of them even came to me to open up about why they turned out that way, some of them were once a victim as well, and I tried my best to talk to them about it while telling them that there's no advantage or benefit in what they are doing.




Now, if I am a parent... With what I've seen and experienced, first off I would have made sure that the kind of relationship I have with my children is one where they are free to communicate whatever to me... including their fears. So, if my child comes to me to tell me about being bullied in any way, I would listen to him/her, get every details needed and take action immediately. I would let the school know about it, and if possible involve the authorities too... Because my child's safety is important and he/she can only learn in an environment where he/she feels protected.



Also, as a parent I would make sure to instill in and teach my children confidence and self worth. I would teach them to never look nor act weak. To not be a bully, to not be violent, but to speak up when needed, to seek help when needed and to not suffer in silence or keep things to themselves.


**In light of that, I would as well love to talk about this second topic,** because immediately I went through it, a movie came replaying in my head. And it will interest you to know that the movie that has this much impact in me isn't an horror movie or comedy movie. It is a Christian movie titled...*\

*





It was done by the producers of Overcomers, War Room and the likes. And they are known to deliver. I'm saying this first because I would love you to watch any of those movies. I can vouch and recommend it.




The movie happens to confront everything in me. It was about a young man who was just drifting through life and all, and along the line someone came in to confront him and his comfort with making excuses. This person who came into his life was the one that forged him like the title says, into a better individual..


![1000984238.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tvc91pg8bmbGCcCYbnSsSJuBtTe1M1usjXzu4YM4X7JZ59f5zNX4QV5YVTS7f6JLBYX.jpg)[source](https://www.theforgemovie.com/share)


We all know the process an iron goes through if it's to be mold into something, it undergoes fire, hammering and shaping. And that's it with the lessons from the movie too, that we can't get a result without going through some processes, we can't be successful and impactful by sitting down at a place and making excuses for ourselves.


So, another lesson from that movie is that, who we surround ourselves with matters, and that no one, absolutely no one will fix your life for you. You need to get up, be serious, disciplined, take correction and be guided into fixing things for yourself.


Like I said earlier, that movie confronted, challenged and made me question every single thing in me. I began to think if I was really growing/improving or I'm just here existing. And I discovered that, at a point in ones life, it's necessary to step into that fire(life), to get hammered and to be shaped/forged into something better.







🌹

**Thanks a lot for taking your time to read through, kindly do well to stop by my blog @marsdave for more exclusive and amazing content.**

links.body:
Hello everyone Good morning everyone you're welcome to my blog today.



The difference stages in life and I've been through some of these stages in life the truth is that things are not always the way the same always and things will never remain the same, one thing that is constant is change on some times life lives us feeling blank,void and empty.


 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfPZq8S3F3XN1gVTFnohXfafNZbA3SUFAvqzc2RMRJQxT/163505.png 


( WHEN NOTHING FEELS NEW )this topic hits differently for me at this particular point because I feel like nothing feels new everything is just going like we are on a repeated circle.

‎it makes me feel bad because being able to cope through last month was not an easy one for me . Although it was my birth month it was still the hardest for me trying to cope with family issues deal with myself my emotional and my mental health and every other thing and I wake up each day get up take my bath and head out to work hoping to find some new motivation but it's always the same thing and everything you feels cold and distant.



I had to find ways to deal with it the situation at hand and one thing that I've learned these days is to prioritize myself ,making myself happy my happiness matters a lot in my life right now. Happiness is the only thing that can keep me going, it keeps my fire burning even in the darkest days I've learned to pray for the best and also hope for the worst and have this strength to stand strong even in my lowest times.

Always reminding myself that I can do anything I want to do I can achieve anything I want to achieve that is what keeps me going through this times when nothing feels new. Getting to love myself more has been the best thing has ever happened to me. Waking up every morning and you're looking to the mirror and I tell myself you are your best girl and you got this. Put up good u smile on your face and face the world with your head held high and you will conquer.

Thank you for stopping by my blog

links.title: Life Will Out - Horror Short Story
links.body:
![The King of the Dead.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23tRvemkZnpgb9pcvyjb47j7gKrAyAsRYMtH5SU2TrSTbTAX1fFLn9fwWaEbGxSVDMiLq.png)

The empty eye socket casts its gaze across the grey fields. Corpses rot in place of soil, the buzz of flies toiling over their gluttony scatter the sky like ash on the breeze. Here and there the restless dead go about their tasks, moving the heaps this way and that in a constant search for a bare patch of life giving earth. 

A place to nurture a sprouting plant. A patch of loam for the sun to kiss, for rain to caress a hope of life bursting forth in orgasmic rupture. The flutter of the wind stirs a group of flies from their slumber and maggots make merry on the mountains of meat.

Arbratztan sighs a hollow rattle. No breath in that sigh, that expression of a time nearly beyond un-living memory. He pulls folds of flapping flesh around him like a cloak to ward away the cold. But there is no cold, no heat, no shiver from winter's wanton ways. Just endless gore and the mountains of the dead. 

They were his soldiers once. His path to greatness, each one loved for the role they played. General, grunt, king, pawn, it was all the same since the plague had come.

<center>![Horror Page Break_01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23x1atZJzJihAwqNCeVRphbKvKS2tjBYoEgRitYU5n53nshT1X1ZevCox6wPbFALbv3MD.jpg)</center>

The trickling stream flows through cracks and crevices like a guilty lover returning home from a tryst. Through muscle crevices and crevasses of hollow bone, marrow long eaten by the myriad of decay. Nonetheless this trickle reaches the ground, the sapient earth and lingers for a moment before sinking, gulped down by the thirsty soil. After a time, a brief season of the passing sun, a flower blooms from reaching stem. The sun blazing in sympathy with its winking eye and the rotting dead feed its roots.

<center>![Horror Page Break_01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23x1atZJzJihAwqNCeVRphbKvKS2tjBYoEgRitYU5n53nshT1X1ZevCox6wPbFALbv3MD.jpg)</center>

<center>![zombie-1399939_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23vsJAjZYoekoUbxnxzCkCi2TAFfMgpxHxLnfmDP4kpbbwyg1LWcjoUibSA6gWiDvBBy2.jpg)</center>

Arbratztan  floats over the hills of pestilence, the place where the fighting was once fiercest. He hasn't been here in over a hundred years ever since that time of great change. The memory of her singing flutters through his mind, a sirens call in the echoing halls of his soul. This is his penance, an unending remembrance of her cadence, a chatter of a spring born in the high vales of his long ago home. Asmollin singing, her hair a weave of sunburst in the corpulent green, serenading the honey bees bumbling about their business. The golden leaves of Falanmouth and Garanmouth trees listen to the sacred heart of life. The mother and father of the acorn wave their arms to the rhythm of her song. 

She had been the living embodiment of that country, the scion of magic and he had destroyed it all. Nothing left but death and the squall of bitter rain. Nothing but memories and pain. Nothing but eternal rot and decay. 

Suddenly a green flash on the horizon catches his attention. A note of hope born on the moist breeze, the start of a sonata long missed. He focuses his attention on that spot and summons all his power to move through the bodies of his dead. Feeling every fly burrowing, every maggot shriving, even the final vestiges of life in the small mammals that feed on the entrails of the newly defunct. He feels the tight pull of slack sinew in the still animated as they labor until spent in the sepulture fields.

He appears among a grove of monsterous plants. Large spade like leaves sway in time to a music he can't hear. Fear grips him for the first time in a millennia but he brushes it aside. Giant blood red stalks erupt in a fountain of pink and green flowers, garish as guts rent by the sword. The leaves are slashed with strange markings like runes dancing in the sickly glow of the flowers.

<center>![halloween-1787545_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/23ycu3GQLEugmTTLXbyetLdvi1GzKnME15Fn1FKMzct8jx1PmmJtcMAxKQyJQEK7AwzsW.jpg)</center>

\

Slowly he turns. Asmollin gazes from the hollow place among the pulsing petals. Her golden hair disperses in motes of light like pollen's flight in the summer dawn. Eyes like two green wells of deep refrain wet with the mead of poetry. Her lips sting his mind with the fullness of life as she leans forward to whisper.

\
\n\nHe starts to cry tears of blood as he melts under the pressure of unattainable life. \

She kisses him and a breath of hot, sweet life passes into him. Finally he sighs and fades away in the dying night. 

**The end.**

<center>![Copyrightbanner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/raj808/242DBfiTFtTzwpdfSk9Ym5NkuRvi2AqgVSus4SBVkypMbmvTNFLzMsfYSJChE9G5Q95T2.png)</center>

Please follow [link 1](https://pixabay.com/en/flaming-skies-ominous-fire-clouds-3255774/), [link 2](https://pixabay.com/en/portrait-halloween-zombie-face-3205417/), [link 3](https://pixabay.com/en/zombie-the-walking-dead-undead-1399939/) & [link 4](https://pixabay.com/en/halloween-girl-all-saints---day-1787545/) to credit. All other media used is my own, designed and created by me.</center>

links.title: Explosive Solutions.
links.body: > I used explosives to manipulate tar levels and reach higher ground. After ambushing two Bedlam Raiders and a droid companion, I discovered an echo near a corpse that revealed the Raiders true nature. I finally reached a meditation point near the giant creature to rest. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdvCwYGzmPqhArsE8zJfAJDzsGSKH1tstjrBwuKi7ndNb/screenshot_1_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbBRDWnjMxwBmG64H3dGXngewUnNrBRoEBkMXPNUR8nqa/screenshot_2_.png) I had to take help from a YouTube gameplay to understand actually what I had to do in this confusing section. At last, I understood I could actually throw that explosives towards the wall that was holding back the sludge. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMFjU3qLh36TTewgUmUdirWXVh4oRoKcrxJpKxiCFFej/screenshot_3_.png) Once the wall exploded, more tar fell down into the chamber, which increased the density and made us float safely above the hazard. It was a clever environmental puzzle that required precise timing to clear the path forward. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme8ddh2gSCTzoSGEUHCn76tTwaACAft93LRg2wkLu2L2j/screenshot_4_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPuJadmCfH7DLMfPeWPawpi6js7Hqw8mv75N8HSBMVVwu/screenshot_5_.png) I unlocked another shortcut nearby to make future travel easier, and then I faced this small droid that asked for my help. It wanted me to retrieve their stuck ship, which was wedged badly in the thick tar. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNhG5dCF9zsUGEi92cBQ5Niv7pkHCqUrodL5euLWZLG2Z/screenshot_6_.png) Unfortunately, despite my efforts, I couldn't help him move the massive vessel with my current abilities, so I had to leave the poor machine behind to search for another way out. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3FKAr7tTFVn8cEeXWQAyGD6ZBfZwE6sd48Db3XxKnhH/screenshot_7_.png) I continued my movement instead of lingering at the crash site. It looked like we finally saw our way out just past that big creature looming in the distance. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfZfuRnjtKUUWpjxNFSCSUCe3DMWfsCuA323DeSZb63zG/screenshot_8_.png) There was this droid on my way that was guarding an edge. I stayed low and moved quietly to find a chance to take it down in a stealth attack from behind. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcRHrVqx8c1iq2c3uKfPGrf44LeiUyF5ZN637GyBEk6Rz/screenshot_9_.png) Then I found a Bedlam Raider walking along with a droid further down the path. The Raider was talking to the machine as if it were a living companion, unaware that I was watching them from the high ground. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfHc9pp5i6TK6TsyjjGjXt5XECdoGPYMuzcEUoXqAsBqN/screenshot_10_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd93b38PQBRH2sRB4Bp2fofMp5SfBE92BBd3xSKgoEYfs/screenshot_11_.png) As they were positioned right below me, I took the opportunity to jump on the Raider and took him down real fast while the droid continued walking ahead. It hadn't yet realized its partner had been neutralized. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXLcgHwAHGnSudRXWHudc7WyANQXxQEEy8zGzcZgzPtX/screenshot_12_.png) I didn't give the droid a chance to attack me, just like the other encounters I had survived earlier. I attacked it real fast before its shields could fully deploy and took it down by slicing it into two pieces. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNzFnJnHAsT6Dyohk5A1cQPfh15avadteWs3iDeFj13Jx/screenshot_13_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQiRq973pr2EzNzq5Y2sSTZhjKogptFZxCdhoU9AtSNDv/screenshot_14_.png) Then another Bedlam Raider came forward to fight me. I didn't notice exactly where this raider was, but I had to take him down as well in a brutal battle. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYPxMdxLTWTbRsxT33jh4g4DZQ48sRvbD57RmCLHhaucM/screenshot_15_.png) I found this dead body on my way, and there I sensed a echo lingering around the remains. The vision told me that these Raiders are nothing but heartless killers who have no respect for life. It was a grim reminder of why I needed to be careful while exploring these parts. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNAzhCqz4VLr3Sj6gSmWo2ZAaadvm1FV3WHYKqyMyoaU/screenshot_16_.png) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHcVhqMt7QeHUeQrXSWoNdBnpZvHrV73tojSXut8he85/screenshot_17_.png) I went ahead and found this meditation point. I could see the giant creature was actually not so far from me anymore. I saved the game there and decided to take some rest before facing whatever challenges the beast would present next. That's all for this session. More moments coming soon and thanks for checking it out. --- ▶️ [3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=ridwanan/37d85bda)

links.title: Dos padres tengo  Yo...( es)
links.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWmGSf1Njp6EMcadMhCcQ8gERcy7Q5wpXNFb8NaKW6a5C/1777300776830.jpg)


¡Hola!

Les saludo y les pongo a escribir rapidito esta pequeña historia que prácticamente me han regalado.

Mañana, un amigo del terruño viaja hasta La Habana para llevar a su papá, ya avanzado en edad, con achaques propios de haber andado a pie por las largas rutas de la vida, hasta la capital del país.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfXrr5owsw49pd5JSD5dw2yoMPDNUPhjqcoVBZjaS2JBt/1777300895263.jpg)

El motivo del viaje es ponerlo casi en la escalerilla del avión que lo llevará hasta España, acompañado de su otro hijo que radica en la madre patria, como solemos llamar los cubanos al país que primero colonizó y eliminó en la práctica a los aborígenes que habitaban estas desconocidas tierras de ultramar, lugar donde radica desde hace poco tiempo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWe1dLVXpQCtDWymyxpmy2Jbwwd6ir3mKUChdHKAdSYMw/1777300937922.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTsdkqRftShJ2k1yJz5ybHySyCNq4p2CrjTqzGdNHMVza/1777300938422.jpg)

En esta pequeña historia, no vi ni oí a nombrar a los protagonistas ni usar motes ni seudónimos. Solo contaré la pequeña historia.  
¡Y qué es lo emocionante de este relato?  

Mi amigo, mañana temprano, toma de la mano a su papá, ya longevo, igual que aquel cuando él era pequeño, para llevarlo y despedirlo en un viaje que quizás sea el último contacto físico entre ambos. Y aunque así no sea, marcará una dolorosa separación. Pero lo interesante de la historia es que su papá, que es originario del legendario Camagüey, hace cerca de un año está aquí, en este municipio, precisamente en casa de su mamá (la del amigo) y exesposa del anciano, pues allá en su provincia ya se había quedado prácticamente solo y al cuidado de una parentela o de algún vecino muy afectuoso. No estoy seguro.

También desconozco los motivos de la reparación, hace ya bastantes años, del matrimonio del que nació mi amigo. Ella, también desde hace una buena cantidad de años, se mudó para acá con sus dos hijos y contrajo matrimonio, o entró en una unión matrimonial con su actual esposo, con quien convivía sola después de que los jóvenes tomaron cada cual el camino de hacer sus propias historias.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyp7Xq7nPQmLpQYJaWajDvvAasVbX79TFAoHsQMM5RDo/1777300993289.jpg)

Continuó.  
La decisión de que el ex recibiera asilo familiar parece haber sido de común acuerdo familiar y con el consentimiento del actual esposo, quien, aunque también ha pasado en los últimos años por algunos problemas de salud, está lo suficientemente lúcido como para entender algunas cosas: que son tabúes, complejos y pseudo reglas sociales que ponen en la picota del barrio y la censura chismográfica la acción de que uno es y el que es, conciban bajo el mismo techo o bajo el mismo árbol del que los días comieron de la fruta prohibida.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4kvGGcMLBoFhju1EvQYnTY4BRcKQBe35sJ6jVtWUTaq/1777301023882.jpg)

Y como la realidad también es una novela, en una buena novela, si no hay enredos, no es novela. Al poco tiempo, la cacatúa del barrio, a mitad de periodo de exilio, metió ruido en el sistema de conceptos morales y éticos de la ex cónyuge de uno y yacónyugue del otro, y provocó una separación en lo sutil de la señora, resultando en una separación en lo denso; es decir, que el ex tuvo que abandonar la embajada y refugiarse en un apartamento alquilado por los hijos para tal situación.

Resultado del pincha pincha vecinal: ahora, quien quedó dividido fue mi amigo, que con las circunstancias económicas actuales tenía dos problemas al mismo tiempo: el padre, solo y enfermo en un apartamento, y, por otro lado, ayudando a la madre con el esposo, quien tiene otros tantos problemas de salud, incluyendo actualmente problemas de carácter mental.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQg3Fr3kZeN5hSRbiJX6hGuixdjRC3r2LaGrbVgmDHgMh/1777301085186.jpg)

olución transitoria:
Contrato de una cuidadora para el papá. 
Saldo económico. Más gastos.

Pero hoy, mi amigo me convidó para que, también con el consenso de todas las partes —menos el de la vecina cizañera— dejara unas instantáneas para perpetuar las horas antes de la despedida a su papá.

Para llegar a este momento, hicieron que aquel volviera meses antes al lugar, tirando por la borda la filosofía vecinal, los complejos, tabúes y diretes sociales, y cuanta norma de convivencia no escrita actuó sobre decisiones que solo incumben a cada persona como parte de su libertad personal y su derecho a elegir lo que mejor crea para su bienestar en armonía con ella misma.

Ella permitió que en otro momento de su vida, ya también longeva, convergieran en un mismo tiempo y espacio dos líneas, dos cuerdas que la hicieron vibrar, y ahora ve cómo se vuelven a separar para nunca más unirse.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmePU8zVy43RTVvSgWiSErJfMKam6ggYSfkKZ4U8uMYeGg/1777301375512.jpg)

Mi función, además de ser un buen pretexto para escribir un post, era dejar constancia de aquella escena familiar donde, como cierre y para darle más veracidad a la acción, le pedí a la mujer que tocara con sus manos a los dos hombres que cubrieron dos tiempos en su vida. Ella fue más allá, poniendo las manos afectivamente en sus hombros con el gesto de atraerlos hacia ella, mientras el hijo los miraba emocionado.

Me acordé de José Martí cuando mi fraterno coterráneo, al salir de la casa de la mamá, me dijo: \

Quizás toda esta historia sirva para una reflexión cuestionadora en el ámbito de las relaciones en el área de conflictos, como este, que tuvo un final bastante romántico. Pero más allá de este caso en particular, no se sabe que no se deciden con simples decisiones, ni deseos personales y sentimentalismos novelescos.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrT13huvXLwtBYP29i2U2hRZykiZbX8GPgk5JHUoLwVc/1777301435110.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV2awJzij3jU4EyASeoyW8Y4i6gv2PkwRGz1UQfiyr9X6/1777301435568.jpg)

Pero yo tampoco asistí a esa íntima escena familiar para juzgar solo para dejar constancia literaria y fotográfica, y para ponérsela a su consideración.  
Gracias por acompañarme.

links.title: HivePulse v1.5.0: Your Hive Wallet, Now Supercharged! 💰 Hive-Engine Assets, Node Control & More
links.body:
Hey Hiveans! 🐝

We are excited to announce that **HivePulse v1.5.0** is now LIVE on the Chrome Web Store! This update brings one of our most requested features to life — a true all-in-one wallet experience that unifies your Hive and Hive-Engine assets in one beautiful view. If v1.4.0 was about social pulse, v1.5.0 is about financial pulse.

---

## 💼 The New Wallet Tab: Everything You Own, In One Place
We have completely reimagined how you view your wealth on Hive.
- **Portfolio Value in USD:** Your total holdings are now calculated and displayed in real-time US Dollar value. No more mental math — see exactly what your stack is worth at a glance.
- **Comprehensive Asset Breakdown:** Dive deep into your portfolio with a detailed breakdown of every asset you hold.
- **Hive-Engine Integration:** Hive-Engine tokens are now fully integrated into your portfolio! Your HE holdings are fetched, priced, and displayed alongside your Hive and HBD.
- **Token Sorting & Filtering:** Easily sort and filter your Hive-Engine tokens to find exactly what you're looking for.
- **Live Token Logos & Market Prices:** Hive-Engine tokens now display their official logos and accurate market prices pulled directly from Hive-Engine market data.

## 🌐 Node Selector: Take Control of Your Connection
Sometimes the default path isn't the fastest. Now, you choose the route.
- **Dual Node Selection:** A brand new node selector lets you independently configure both your **Hive** and **Hive-Engine** RPC endpoints.
- **Custom Node Options:** Not seeing your preferred node in the list? You can add your own custom RPC endpoints for both Hive and Hive-Engine.
- **Tailored to You:** Prefer a specific Hive API node for account queries, but a different Hive-Engine node for token data? No problem — you can mix and match to build the fastest, most reliable connection for your workflow.
- **Bypass Slowdowns Instantly:** If a node is lagging or temporarily down, simply switch to another with a single tap. No more waiting on unresponsive endpoints!

## 🔧 Under the Hood: Hive-Engine Polished to Perfection
We know how important Hive-Engine is to the ecosystem, so we invested heavily in making the experience rock-solid.
- **Robust Token Fetching:** Completely rewritten token fetching logic with better error handling and retry mechanisms.
- **No More Loading Hangs:** Fixed edge cases where HE token icons or data could cause the view to hang.
- **Correct API Endpoints:** Updated to use the proper Hive-Engine API endpoints for reliable data.
- **Enhanced Logging:** Added comprehensive debugging capabilities to keep things running smoothly.

## 📊 UI/UX Refinements
- **Wallet-Focused Navigation:** The Apps tab has been replaced by the new Wallet tab, putting your assets front and center.
- **Dedicated Portfolio View:** The PortfolioCard has been moved to its own dedicated view for a cleaner, more focused experience.

---

### 🚀 Other Improvements & Polish
- **12-Month Development Roadmap:** We have published our feature suggestions and a comprehensive 12-month roadmap so you can see where HivePulse is headed next. Transparency is key!
- **Documentation:** Added a comprehensive Hive-Engine debugging guide for contributors and power users.

---

## 📥 Get it Now!

If you already have HivePulse installed, your browser should update it automatically soon. If you haven't joined the pulse yet, now is the perfect time!

👉 **[Download HivePulse on the Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/hivepulse/hakcpohpejoejmlhiphpkjobpjeckdlg)**

### We Want Your Feedback!
HivePulse is built for you. If you have suggestions, find a bug, or want to see a specific feature, let us know in the comments below or join the conversation on Ecency Chat!

---

Your support helps us keep the heartbeat of Hive strong and accessible to everyone!

**Keep Hiving,**
*@hdev team*

---

links.body:
**Solid review.** The useful part isn’t just the reward snapshot — it’s that your posting mix is starting to show a pattern. Your own screenshots point to roughly **185.05 HP author rewards + 12.47 HP curation rewards over 7 days** from [HiveStats](https://hivestats.io/@aljif7), and your writeup correctly spots the bigger story: **consistency is carrying the account, while the philosophy posts are giving you upside**.

The growth chart also tells a clear story: your account HP appears to climb from about **9.7k to 12.6k HP** across the displayed week, with visible boosts from power-ups/rewards in the [HiveStats account view](https://hivestats.io/@aljif7). And that **$0.936 author total on 2026-04-27** in your chart is a nice reminder that even an average day still stacks when you keep the machine running.

Your best instinct here is separating **baseline content** from **breakout content**. The baseline is your [Daily Word in Spanish #385](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/a-daily-word-in-spanish-385-moglvrmqf5066110?referral=aljif7) and Actifit rhythm; the breakout angle is your newer philosophy line like [¿Ser, Saber y Hacer? ¿Cuál es prioridad?](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/ser-saber-y-hacer-cu-l-es-prioridad-moe6tsdv6774782d) and the follow-up reflective post visible in your recent publishing streak on [@aljif7’s recent posts](https://inleo.io/@aljif7). That’s the combo that usually works: **one format builds trust, the other builds curiosity**.

If I were being blunt, I’d say this: **don’t hide the strongest signal by excluding it from your own weekly list.** Actifit and Daily Word are your engine, yes — but the “Being and Doing” posts are probably your differentiator, and your review already hints they surprised you in a good way. That kind of surprise is gold; boring, repeatable content pays the rent, but weird thoughtful posts are what make people remember the author.

  **Capítulo 6**

**Vendiendo confianza: El arte de persuadir**

Si estás leyendo esto, es probable que ya tengas un producto maravilloso entre las manos o una idea de servicio que sabes que podría cambiarle la vida a alguien. Pero, a la hora de ponerle precio y decir: \

es la norma, pero a veces confundimos vender con \

. Nada más lejos de la realidad. Vender no es otra cosa que ayudar. Si tú tienes algo que resuelve un problema —ya sea un cake para un cumpleaños, un servicio de peluquería, o ropa artesanal—, lo que estás haciendo es ofrecer una solución.\r\nVender con confianza es un arte que se aprende, y en este capítulo vamos a desmitificar el proceso para que te sientas segura, profesional y, sobre todo, efectiva.\r\n### Cambiando el \
: De vender a servir\r\nEl primer paso para vender con confianza es cambiar tu mentalidad. Muchas emprendedoras en la isla sienten \

.
Aquí está la clave: El precio no es solo un número; es el reflejo del tiempo, el sudor, la creatividad y los recursos (que todos sabemos cuánto cuesta conseguir) que pusiste en tu negocio. Cuando vendes, estás intercambiando valor. Si tú no valoras tu trabajo primero, nadie más lo hará.
Vender es una conversación entre dos personas donde una tiene una necesidad y la otra tiene la respuesta. Cuando ves la venta como un acto de servicio, la confianza fluye sola. No estás molestando; estás informando sobre una oportunidad.
### El arte de la conversación: Guiones sencillos y humanos
En nuestro contexto, la mayoría de las ventas ocurren por WhatsApp, Instagram o en el \

del barrio. No necesitas un discurso de Wall Street; necesitas humanidad. Aquí te comparto una estructura sencilla para que tus conversaciones no parezcan un monólogo aburrido, sino una invitación irresistible.
1. El Saludo Empático (El Gancho)

### Derribando objeciones con elegancia
Es normal que el cliente tenga dudas. En Cuba, las objeciones más comunes suelen ser el precio, la logística o la desconfianza por experiencias previas. Aquí te enseño cómo manejarlas sin perder la sonrisa:
●	  **Cuando dicen: \

\r\n### El Cierre: No tengas miedo de pedir la venta\r\nMuchas ventas se pierden en el \
porque la emprendedora espera a que el cliente diga: \
. A veces, el cliente necesita un empujoncito.\r\nCerrar una venta es simplemente concretar los detalles. Usa preguntas de opción doble para facilitar la decisión:\r\n●\t\
\r\nAl dar opciones, la mente del cliente pasa de pensar \

. Es un truco psicológico sencillo que aumenta tus cierres significativamente.
### La Persistencia no es Pesadez
Un error común es pensar que si alguien no te respondió el mensaje, es porque no le interesa. ¡Falso! La vida en Cuba es caótica: se fue la luz, se acabó el paquete de datos, el niño se enfermó o simplemente se le olvidó.
Hacer un seguimiento es parte de un servicio excelente. Un mensaje tipo: *\

*, puede rescatar hasta el 50% de las ventas que creías perdidas.
### Tu confianza es tu mejor argumento de venta
Para vender en el contexto actual, necesitas creer ciegamente en lo que haces. Si tú sabes que tu producto es bueno, que tu servicio es honesto y que tu esfuerzo es real, esa energía se transmite.
Recuerda que cada \
que recibas no es un rechazo a tu persona, es simplemente un \

. No te lo tomes como algo personal. Sigue perfeccionando tu guion, sigue escuchando a tus clientas y, sobre todo, sigue presentándote con la cabeza en alto.
Vender con confianza es reconocer que tú, como mujer emprendedora, estás aportando valor a tu comunidad y a la economía de tu hogar. Persuadir no es manipular; es guiar a alguien hacia una decisión que le hará bien. ¡Sal ahí fuera y haz que suceda! Tu negocio merece ser conocido, y tú mereces el éxito que viene con cada venta cerrada.

links.title: Memory glimpes hit hard sometimes
links.body: **_Hi, Hive_** Today, I want to share the experience that I had on my last day at school. It was a very gloomy day for me, not only for me but also for my friends. As we all know, no matter how much we hate our school, it will still be in our memories. And in the same way, I also experienced the same thing🥲. 🍂 It was very difficult for me to leave the school like this. Children spend a **substantial part** of their lives in school. And they build an **emotional association** with school. Because of this, it becomes very difficult for them to leave the school. At last day of my School some of my friends became too **emotional,** but some had tears in their eyes. It is just because of their affections with school. So, at last day of my School **firstly**, my friends and I went to see every **nook** **and corner** of the school so that we could save some memories of that beautiful moment. At that moment, it became very difficult for us to separate from each other in this way🙍. After that, we went to our **Principal's office🏫** and all of our teachers were also in the office. Our principal and teachers advised us to be **honest and courteous** in our lives. It was a great **gift💝** for us from our teachers. We also get their signatures to hold their memories. 👉We all know that teachers can only open the door, but you should enter it by yourself. Our teachers gave permission to exchange gifts. So, the **gift-giving ceremony🎁** had started. Some gifts from my friends are these.

/> My friends gave me some gifts. And I also gave them. At this point, I became very emotional, some of my friends started **weeping** **bitterly**. The gifts from my friends were too **precious** for me. And at the end, I want to say that my school and its beautiful memories will always shine in my mind's eye like a **bright lonely star in the blue lake of sky**. I can never forget the familiar faces of my close friends. At the end, we were separated with the same promise that we would meet each other after some time, at the same place, but it was just a promise. The thing that surprised me at my last was the **unique and precious gifts** from my friends.

*Last week, I shared that we visited Marian Orchard chapel, now let me continue the virtual walk so I could show you what more to see.*

Remember the arches adorned with bougainvillea?

This is where my son Caleb and I are standing. It is long path to explore.

<div class=\

>https://images.ecency.com/DQmXPFFxQAypoewaPXjj6MCv5TjoP9Dfi6pufRmqSvwMBwg/47aea6f3_567e_4f87_905e_fcd618be7056.jpg) While going down, we chose to go at the right path and this is where we are led to; ![13b3ae57-7fe1-4a1f-bc2e-ea2c159dbe5c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23xehc3cTFCHF39wwKHpBxvrP8gUhunFftUBMKaxJxRQxw5wPc2aqSrxzDFAhrd5skvNh.jpg) After checking some photos we went back. We heard the church bell indicating that the mass is about to start. That made us torn, *should we go back or continue exploring?* Well, my Mother in-law was a devotee so of course we went back. ![1102516a-2456-4ded-9689-ac3031094fd0.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23wWy7F8yVuYGAVoR8Wgc5vrhGZwxarRrERYfCyQ6rtR47uwmnBNaUdupM7va8LbH8jfU.jpg) We also passed by here and maybe due to funds that the construction was stopped. ![b3bc6b56-40ae-49d0-b3c9-b29a66df3db5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23vsLKaquJasE4vFPZ7cz5f2quGABCXDbUeP8AkoufmMEyx8jYeiXAGnZjW2TTNWXukXo.jpg) At the left side, are the Jesus stations of the cross. We chose not to go down since we would be late for a mass.
![c6b38d39-6904-4daf-befa-0ea69b466ca8.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23xAVKSQxf9aCEpe9WYmZRvRNfdMj4AS1mCAPzeiyFmmuAeop4Qv2EV8k11zGw8Vipa7A.jpg)
But we dropped by here to light a candle and a short prayer. As I mentioned previously, we just stayed under the shaded canopy. While the mass is ongoing of course my son won't sit still. Good thing SIL was there to the rescue. They are helping me in taking care of him.

>https://images.ecency.com/DQmPjaM63mBU4uAAYvjGhk8AWPT76q8Lmt3jPvCh7c6Yd48/7fa75b97_6974_43ac_b0d0_25744e0c13d9.jpg) One thing you should bring going here is food just in case you would starve after walking around. ![e887103a-e0e2-44a6-882c-002cb103d092.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23wCBXuvnpr8xTVkJv5Eymd4ehEMLyNxPb47bqjqLEqULkhi3XU1kSYBr2hoYNVQKECH2.jpg) Though there is water for sale, you need an exact amount . After a while, that is when Caleb fell asleep that I needed to carry him Too bad, I got only a few photos.
![3fc8a98c-bbf2-4948-b1ad-39558e0c961c.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/lhes/23zkvrf79ww78ZS49yNwX51vdo2wwLvHq6VwYJ7JJrHUiux1sARERZMyu1if6ihEtbaid.jpg)
Thus, I managed to capture the roses that were in bloom and of course a lot of my son's smiles and laughters. Till next time. https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/sensiblecast/23wWkdhQhQVGifQgWmVNnrkoCyhHtKEdbw5B929Y9931DQx3qnZJR9nwFA5n8LS7EUdac.png *Lead image was edited using Canva*

links.title: First Impressions: The Silent Introduction That Speaks Volumes
links.body: The first impression always holds special importance because it's the moment when someone forms an initial opinion about you. Whether it's the start of a new friendship an interview opportunity or a first meeting at a gathering your style way of speaking and attitude create an image in others' minds. That image may later become stronger or weaker but its foundation is always based on the first impression.\n\n

and there's a lot of truth to it. Although people's opinions can change over time the first impression provides a strong foundation. If it's positive moving forward becomes easier and if it's negative it takes more effort to change it. That's why we should present our best side in every new meeting.

In making a first impression, it's not just appearance that matters your attitude, confidence and way of speaking also play a very important role. A smile a gentle tone and listening to others attentively all present you as a positive personality. In contrast inattentiveness or rudeness can immediately create a negative impact.

The first impression is an opportunity that can open new doors every time. If we use this opportunity wisely we can not only win the hearts of others but also create new paths to success in our own lives. So always try to make your first impression one that leaves a good mark in people's minds.

links.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVk7DVpqzy7PzcQPpD3Ngzd7hL4SHfH2PZwdw7ETJEqBd/IMG_8077.jpg 

There are moments when everything feels quiet, like tonight. Just me, the sky, and my thoughts. Sometimes I step away from everything just to breathe and remind myself that I’m still in the process of becoming who I want to be.

I recently finished high school, and even though it feels like a big achievement, it also feels like standing at the beginning of something unknown. I don’t have everything figured out yet… but I do know that I’m curious, that I want to learn, and that chemistry keeps coming back to my mind like a small spark that won’t go away.

I think about the future a lot. About being in a lab, discovering things, understanding reactions, and maybe even creating something meaningful. It sounds big… maybe even a little scary. But at the same time, it feels right.

Tonight, under the moon, I feel calm. Not because I have all the answers, but because I’m learning to trust my path, even if I’m just taking small steps.

And maybe that’s enough for now. 

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@alanacont/-between-dreams-and-who-im-becoming-6vz)

links.title: THORChain Halted for $500. Not $1.4B. And That’s Good
links.body:
![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRFb3ahd5QZj1HUH1gsrkxccBN6xDCUmDZ7CQA9KRPXFo/image.png)



Litecoin recently underwent a reorg that exposed crosschain protocols to double spends. The damage was relatively minimal as most protocols caught it quickly and Litecoin contributors managed to quickly patch the bug and move forward.

THORChain has been facing heat over \

ever since the [Bybit Hack](https://www.dlnews.com/articles/defi/thorchain-role-in-lazarus-laundering-is-big-defi-problem/) last year. The recent [Kelp DAO hack](https://unchainedcrypto.com/kelp-dao-exploiter-moves-175-million-in-stolen-eth-into-new-wallets-routing-funds-through-thorchain/) also created controversy around THORChain.\n\nOver this past weekend, the Litecoin Reorg led to an automatic insolvency halt for the THORChain protocol. This halt has added fuel to the fire as people are saying *\

*.

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmchQknipo85E26rzG3scZreyvYiD6SCCwBhRrCnbLzHRU/image.png)

As someone who builds in this space ([LeoDex](https://leodex.io)) and spends a lot of time looking at transactions onchain — as well as determining the true decentralization of protocols — I want to explore what happened with Bybit, Kelp DAO, and the recent Litecoin reorg in contrast with THORChain's varying responses to these events.

The question everyone is asking: if THORChain ***can*** halt under certain scenarios, why does it halt under some but not others?

## A Brief Litecoin Reorg Timeline

There are plenty of other articles covering what happened with Litecoin in detail. Here's a brief timeline with THORChain's response overlayed:

- **~Late March 2026** — Litecoin core developers privately patch an MWEB consensus bug. The fix is committed to GitHub between roughly March 19–26. The patch is not pushed as a mandatory upgrade, leaving unpatched mining pools vulnerable.
- **~38 hours before the attack** — The attacker pre-funds a wallet via a Binance withdrawal, with the destination address already configured to swap LTC into ETH on a DEX.
- **April 25, 2026** — A coordinated DoS hits major Litecoin mining pools running patched software. Unpatched nodes — now controlling more hashrate — accept invalid MWEB peg-out transactions. A fork begins at block 3,095,930.
- **During the ~3-hour fork window** — The attacker pushes invalid peg-outs to cross-chain DEXs and attempts double-spends against bridges and swap protocols. NEAR Intents reports ~$600k of exposure.
- **April 25, fork resolves at block 3,095,943** — The DoS subsides. Patched nodes regain hashrate majority and execute a 13-block reorg, wiping the invalid chain. The main chain settles clean.
- **Same window — THORChain side** — A Litecoin transaction THORChain had already credited gets reversed by the reorg. THORChain's Asgard Vault accounting now shows a ~$500 discrepancy between expected balance and actual on-chain LTC.
- **Automatically and without human intervention** — THORChain's [Automatic Solvency Checker](https://docs.thorchain.org/technical-documentation/technical-deep-dive/security) detects the divergence. Once >1/3 of nodes report insolvency, Litecoin trading on THORChain auto-halts. No vote, no admin action.
- **Litecoin Core v0.21.5.4 released (April 25)** — The Litecoin Foundation publishes the patch and urges all node operators to upgrade.
- **April 26** — JP Thorbjornsen publicly clarifies that the auto-pause was triggered by code, not by humans. The Litecoin Foundation declares the network stable. [GitHub commit history begins to surface](https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/04/26/litecoin-says-its-13-block-reorg-was-not-a-zero-day-but-github-commit-history-shows-otherwise), raising questions about the \

framing.
- **Once solvency restored** — Per protocol design, when 2/3+ of THORChain nodes confirm balances are reconciled, Litecoin trading auto-resumes. No manual action required.

## How THORChain's Automatic Solvency Checker Works

THORChain's protocol has the ability to automatically halt when there is a question of solvency. In this scenario, THORChain's internal accounting via Asgard vaults detected a $500 discrepancy vs. onchain balances.

This led to a code-triggered ASC (Automatic Solvency Checker).

- When 1/3 of nodes detect an insolvency onchain, the chain auto-halts.
- When 2/3 of nodes determine that solvency is restored, the chain auto-resumes.

There is no human in the loop. No multisig. No admin key. The protocol [enforces its own integrity](https://gitlab.com/thorchain/thornode/-/issues/999) — and that's exactly what happened over the weekend.

## Crypto: Code Is Law?

Satoshi built Bitcoin on a critical ideal: **Code is Law.**

In a sufficiently decentralized system, code is the law. Whatever the outcome is onchain, that outcome **should** happen based on the laws (code) written by that chain.

In systems where humans are still in control, funds can be frozen. Actions can be coordinated. This is not inherently **wrong**, but it is inherently against Satoshi's ideals.

Ask yourself this critical question: **Why do hackers move to BTC?**

Go back to the Bybit hack. The Kelp DAO hack. Look at every major DeFi exploit of the past two years.

The hackers move from ETH to BTC. Why do they do that? Why are they moving crypto from other chains to Bitcoin as fast as they possibly can?

The simple answer: Bitcoin's chain is not going to freeze funds or halt over illicit flows. Bitcoin is sufficiently decentralized to the point where miners would have to collectively decide to halt or freeze funds. The damage to the network would be too great to do this — so it never happens.

Compare that to what happened on Arbitrum during the Kelp DAO exploit: the Arbitrum Security Council [froze $71M of stolen ETH within hours](https://unchainedcrypto.com/kelp-dao-exploiter-moves-175-million-in-stolen-eth-into-new-wallets-routing-funds-through-thorchain/). [Tether froze $9M](https://www.coindesk.com/tech/2025/04/07/the-blockchain-fueling-north-korea-s-massive-crypto-laundering-operation) of Bybit-linked funds. Mantle froze $41M. These chains *can* freeze funds because they are *not* sufficiently decentralized to resist that pressure.

The hackers know this. That's why they sprint to Bitcoin.

## Is THORChain Sufficiently Decentralized?

The argument for why BTC can \
but THORChain cannot is going to be: *\

*

My counterargument is that THORChain nodes are in charge — similar to Bitcoin. It is technically *possible* to halt Bitcoin or freeze wallets. You just have to get enough of the miners to agree on it. Will that actually happen? Extremely unlikely.

The same goes for THORChain. The code is the law. If the nodes on the THORChain network feel that the code is still functioning correctly, they are unlikely to halt over certain flows. Is that right or wrong? That's a subjective question in many cases, and an objective one in others.

In the case of true decentralization and \

ideals, it is the right approach. If THORChain were to freeze funds or halt a chain, there must be sufficient coordination in a way that is decentralized. If there wasn't, THORChain's model of being a decentralized crosschain swapping protocol would be dead anyway.

It's also worth noting that THORChain's nodes [can opt out by churning out](https://dev.thorchain.org/concepts/network-halts.html) — turning themselves off — without disrupting the network. No single node can force a halt. No single node can prevent one. That is what decentralization actually looks like in practice.

## What Should Be Done

![image](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmQYV9SEgv6fHEFSzGyUApNghHgjenV17kYyn4GHHrprze/image.png)

I completely agree with this [X post](https://x.com/ErikVoorhees/status/1896926520981217361) from Erik Voorhees. Decentralized blockchains operate on a \

architecture. If a small group of human actors can intervene to halt, alter, or freeze funds, then it undermines the entire foundation of what decentralized crypto is meant to be.

I don't believe in bad actors. I don't want to see real people get hurt. I don't even want to see centralized exchanges (businesses) get hurt either. It's immoral and wrong.

That said, it is not the responsibility of decentralized protocols to intervene unless the nodes in that network decide they want that responsibility. Attacking a community and a protocol that is sufficiently decentralized for *not* taking action is the wrong approach.

This will lead to a slippery slope.

**Answer this for me in the comments: if billions of dollars per year are hacked in crypto and then moved to BTC, should the BTC miners coordinate to freeze wallets, funds, and potential bad actors? Why should THORChain act differently?**
