links.title: PEvO roadmap: the next 18 months
links.body:
It's been nearly two weeks since the launch of the [PEvO beta](https://beta.pevo.science), and it's time to lay out the current plans for its future trajectory. The core functionality is implemented, although it needs a lot more testing under real-world conditions. Content is written on-chain, but in a testing namespace - be aware of that when you use your Hive account. The platform provides free accounts to users with an institutional email address or an ORCID iD with at least 3 external publications. If you don't have either we can whitelist email addresses for testers.

When the whitepaper was written in 2016, the open science ecosystem was only just starting to sprout. Much has happened since, but the core ideas of the concept are still as valid today. The interest in post-publication reviews has even risen.

From here, the work splits into three phases:

![image](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRxyqKVb9f2LxgZsbeg88KUdyfaGGDyUs8e6aftyYPakb/image.png)


## Phase 1: Preparation for production. September 2026.
Step one is expanding the tester cohort to simulate real interactions by different users. This will surface bugs and issues that have to be fixed before we can move to a production namespace without the risk of putting incorrect data on chain. A security review of the code by independent professionals is an optional goal for this phase, dependent on cost and funding. 
It also needs content policies, a code of conduct and similar moderation guidelines. Drafting these well requires input from people experienced in moderating scholarly platforms, which is one of the things we're currently looking for in advisors and contributors.

## Phase 2: Standards and institutionalization. September 2027.
The current feature set is largely complete in regard to evaluation, but for the publishing part to be useful to researchers it requires a lot more integrations. Metadata has to be mapped to standard scholarly metadata formats including Dublin Core, JATS XML, COAR Notify, and others required for institutional and indexing integration. This work requires a more systematic approach than the quick development of the beta meant to demonstrate the concept.
To be able to issue DOI numbers and access some institutional APIs, PEvO also needs a legal umbrella. Work is underway to form a Portuguese non-profit association as an appropriate legal structure. Still looking for volunteer founding and board members.
Funding for this phase has been requested through an NLnet NGI Zero Commons application submitted for the June 2026 round.

## Phase 3: Field establishment. October 2027 onward. 
The focus will be on adoption: having a presence at conferences, contacting research groups and institutions, creating publications about PEvO's design and participating formally in standards bodies. Future sustainability becomes a real question, with European research infrastructure programs, foundation funding, and donations as likely targets. The reputation algorithm requires fine-tuning with real usage data, which only becomes meaningful at scale. Governance also matures at this point: an elected board, transparent reporting, community participation through voting.

-------

If you want to help shape the future of the project, get in touch. Be aware that plans will evolve; this is a rough roadmap, not a fixed timeline.

</center>
</liketuimages>

家人们，谁懂啊，今天我又又又被资本做局了！
作为近几年来比较火的段子，资本做局这句话似乎已经时常被挂在耳边，成为了我们身边的常态。
而普通人的生活，似乎从出生开始就已经被“资本做好了局”。
可有时候仔细想想，哪来那么多资本专门针对我们啊。
绝大多数人以为的资本做局，可能是一群大佬在某个会议上，经过彻夜长谈，最后制定了一系列的精密计划，然后就让普通人没办法逃脱了。
他们想的做局，是从上到下的，但是其实真正的做局，是自下而上的，简单来讲，就是得顺应人性。
一个推恩令，为什么被无数人当成千古第一阳谋？
因为他顺应了人性。
人性是最底层的逻辑，一旦违反人性，那别说所谓的资本，就是庞大的帝国，也会慢慢倒塌。
资本不是在做局，资本只是在找到利益更高的方式而已。
从前，这个方式往往和人的需求有关，现在，资本的运作其实更多在金融层面，和绝大多数人没有关系的。
不是有个段子说嘛：只有在股市里，才能说自己被资本做局了。
就好比这种AI的爆发，资本看到有利润了，立马就涌入了。
至于AI最后会不会替代我们，人家怎么会考虑呢？
这就是那句我消灭你，与你无关的真实写照。
人家连消灭我们都无所谓的，又哪有空去做局啊。
有的东西，也不叫做局，那叫一个愿打一个愿挨。
但凡有过社会经验的，都知道低价没好货，但是我们还是买。
说白了不就是接受了它背后的质量问题嘛。
虽然价格高的不一定是好货，但价格低的一定没好货。
就好像我们从来不骂蜜雪，因为人家价格摆在那，但其他奶茶店要是爆出点质量问题。
那我们二三十一杯买的算什么？
算冤大头嘛？
所以呀，哪那么多的资本做局啊，你觉得呢？

---

I wanted to share this new drawing I finished today with you guys . Sometimes I start with a simple idea, like a morning cup of coffee, and then the scene just starts growing on its own. This time, it turned into a very busy table with two characters who look like they haven’t quite woken up yet

I must admit, my favorite part of this doodle is the little cat peeking over the table. It’s unbelievable how much personality you can add just by having a pair of eyes watching the flowers in the vase. I really enjoyed playing with the warm, peachy tones for the background and the table; it gives the whole piece a cozy, morning feeling that reminds me of a slow weekend moment with family 

I tried to focus more on the interaction between the objects and the people this time. There is a lot to look at, from the texture on the large mug to the way the leaves are reaching out across the composition. It’s fun to take a normal daily moment and turn it into something a bit more whimsical and colorful and kid-like
What do you think is going on here? is someone about to get in trouble for touching that flower? Let me know what you see Thank you for following along with my creative practice. I’m having a blast seeing everyone else's work in the community.

links.title: A Future Where AI thinks for you.
links.body:
![252703.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josediccus/23tvgJ4bEkEZW6S9ZYdbghxCncvECynNFHmyLPtrbUcaEbFoDGY4CrNAbmnK1vLTdX4Vp.jpg)


<hr>


A lot of people understands the blueprint for success, but the biggest issues is always intentionality, discipline and seriousy.


 A few years back, I had a blueprint, a pattern I wanted to execute, executing it properly means that I can have less financial constraints, I can pay my bills properly, pay my hospital bills and raise a family on a good budget. 

I made my plans, drew the timeline, checked the timing and was sure that I would excute it probably, but I miscalculated the window and let my emotions ruin it. 

This is one thing about having plans, they look very good on the surface, but the problems is us.


 Emotions are the biggest problems with making logical and reasonable decisions, it's not like being emotional is a curse, it's actually a blessing, but sometimes we mix it up, and forget that life also requires us to make reasonable choices. 


Being emotional is what makes us humans, but imagine having to rely on AI or other some of artificial intelligence to make our decisions simply because we do not trust ourselves to do so. Will it come to this? Absolutely so. 


Machine learning and other systems that are built to mirror the human imagination are becoming smarter, and the systems are fed with algorithms and data without the human sentiment and freedom of choice and adverse reasoning. 

**One of the biggest problems we have is also trusting in our judgements.**

Someone people make decisions within having empirical data and historical research, we make deductions, based on what is we see, hear or perceive. Humans have built systems that we can easily fail to.

We understand how sentimental we are, and fellow humans take advantages of these loopholes. Most of my plans that have failed have mostly been me looking at the picture wrongly instead of trying to perceive it correctly. 

Will I ever entrust am AI with my decision making process, yes I definitely will.


 ### Why?

 Because I think our decision making can be flawed because of the possibility of being excessively sentimental, but this isn't bad if we also have a system plugged into our lives that raises a red alert whenever we become too sentimental with the situations in our life that requires proper reckoning. 

In systems, We've trusted machine to do treatments, we've entrusted AI for financial purposes like research and investment, and many others thing with proper data and built them to be flawless, and honestly people sometimes needs flawlessness in their decision making process to actually win in so many situations in life..

This isn't a tweet for PRO-AI or anything like that, I'm starting to think past myself, and even weigh in the actions of people that has had catastrophic consequences.. 


Perhaps we will have a future where we can make decisions not based on sentiment. Maybe we will..

links.title: 📷 Extreme Wide Angle Indoor Architectural Photography at the Hunterian Museum Glasgow [EN/DE]
links.body:
![_DSC9339.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23tvcRsV43aexz6q7Z8Z7U6hRUg5inLKptxCTyYAw2ihLikhmdDZv8uyqQD7HWryEkWHw.jpg)

There are situations where even a 16mm full-frame lens isn’t wide enough. Admittedly, these situations are pretty rare, but it was precisely for such occasions that I bought the 7Artisans 9mm F5.6 in Shanghai last year. Of course, it’s not the sort of lens you’d keep on all the time, walking around town and documenting pretty much everything that comes into view. No, I usually just carry it as a second or third lens in my camera bag so I can swap it on when needed.

*Es gibt Situationen in denen selbst 16mm Vollformat nicht weitwinkelig genug sind. Zugegeben, diese findet man eher selten, aber für genau diese Fälle kaufte ich mir letztes Jahr in Shanghai das 7Artisans 9mm F5.6. Natürlich ist das kein \

, mit dem durch die Stadt spaziert und so ziemlich alles dokumentieren kann, was einem vor die Linse kommt. Nein, wenn, dann habe ich es als Zweit- oder Dritt-Objektiv in meinem Fotorucksack, um es bei Bedarf aufschrauben zu können.*

![_DSC9340.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23uFM2XZMRuvVDWoW9t9YKcVqWjv5h8fXQrfgEubCtojj6SvP1qwGzYJY8NBZzzXZqHXm.jpg)

![_DSC9337.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23tbppGfT9eWK1eoYJNMdeCqwrYnGZtHHkY4C2t4WUHAtVy2p1FqHsh2eBiR1nsumqLX1.jpg)

That's how I had it with me on my third day in Glasgow, when I visited the beautiful university, which immediately brings to mind a Harry Potter film. Whilst exploring, I came across this staircase leading up to the Hunterian Museum, and it immediately struck me that this was the perfect opportunity to put the 9mm to use again. It was only thanks to this extreme focal length that I could capture this place exactly as I perceived it when walking up and down the stairs.

*So hatte ich es auch an meinem dritten Tag in Glasgow dabei, als ich die wunderschöne Universität besuchte, die sofort an einen Harry Potter Film erinnert. Bei meiner Erkundung fand ich dieses Stiegenhaus, das zum Hunterian Museum hinaufführte und sofort wurde mir klar, dass dies eine ideale Möglichkeit ist, um mal wieder die 9mm zum Einsatz zu bringen. Nur durch diese extreme Brennweite konnte ich diesen Ort so abbilden, wie er auf mich wirkte, als ich die Treppe rauf und runter ging.*

![_DSC9346.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23uFPTmyYrU1YnKotC7H3zesmsXi7L2sp1QP5BY7NqcFepVDqKFUkgKPDbBVYN6abZpTt.jpg)

![_DSC9332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelshots/23tbkLVX2C6pJkK5KACQawod8bY96HTTemduCsUZb7MWhrRfaEsUgMWM58W6cWLCtq6yn.jpg)

You may have already noticed the distinctive star-shaped lens flares in these photos. That’s a unique feature of this lens. But it does have its drawbacks as well. The lack of autofocus is easy enough to live with, but the sharpness does drop off quite significantly towards the edges. Nevertheless, I love it, because without it, photos like these would be absolutely impossible. I hope you like them and wish you a lovely day!

*Vielleicht sind euch schon die markanten Blendensterne auf diesen Aufnahmen aufgefallen. Das ist eine Besonderheit dieses Objektivs. Es hat aber auch seine Schwächen. Der fehlende Autofokus ist noch leicht zu verkraften, aber die Schärfe nimmt zum Rand hin schon sehr stark ab. Trotzdem liebe ich es, denn ohne es wären Aufnahmen wie diese absolut unmöglich. Ich hoffe sie gefallen euch euch und wünsche euch einen schönen Tag!*

See you soon!/*Bis bald!*
Stefan

**In today's battle, you can observe that magic attacks performed exceptionally well. My primary focus during the battle was directed toward my first card and my healing card; both executed their roles to perfection. Thanks to these cards, the enemy sustained significant damage—which is precisely why I emerged victorious in today's battle. I utilized a specific card that plays a unique role in combat: Djinn Muirat. The distinctive feature of this card is that whenever it is targeted by a magic attack, the attack strikes its armor first before impacting its health; this makes it a highly appealing card that delivers a strong performance in battle. If you possess a solid collection of magic-attack cards within the Water and Death Splinters, you can win a great many battles.**


![Screenshot 2026-04-27 194147.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nexo0702/23tRrJ8UbcuChMxmDtwW5eB4MQpQbvLc6napXXcNWBV5R7fqANvpoanD1KvEd5WWLbQPS.png)

Furthermore, upon reaching Level 4, this card gains a specific ability known as \

This ability functions such that whenever an enemy deals 5 or more points of damage, that damage is reduced to a fixed value of 1. In other words, even if an enemy possesses a Magic Attack power of 6, the actual damage inflicted upon this card will be reduced to just 1. However, if the incoming attack damage is 4, no reduction will occur. Consequently, this card becomes exceptionally powerful at Level 4. For this reason, I will now be aiming to upgrade this card to Level 4.**

body.title: Photography Lovers: see the view from above
body.body:
Hello photography friends!
Meet me again, @asklanbudi.

On this occasion, I want to share some of my photography.
This photo is a view of a location in my area.
This location, including a tourist attraction, has been abandoned due to neglect. It has now become a slum and dense forest.

body.title: Splinterlands - Opening 100 Common Draws
body.body:
![cs.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23xKp7jZnXfiV57EyviRRgooHgaE5s2hFZCGUAdBL9txmSuudegAuL2MgxJ9L68Xurs7R.png)

Hello everyone, have a nice day and good battles. This time I will be opening another 100 common draws from batch 1 of this season. I will not using alchemy potions, since I'm saving them for epic and legendary draws, so my chances of getting gold cards will only be 0.5%.

Unfortunately, this time I didn't get any gold cards. Well, now it's time to level up some common cards.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/Eo8QqJDstS5sv3KC2RjgzoGetMRybvhZgepxu6Dk4jzCLij2Ut5DjhiihLyRod4R3rK.png)
[Opening link](https://splinterlands.com/shop/rewards?t=8396f8cb2509169fe4a27ecbe0fe5bf6a077b780&ref=langice)</center>

---

Now, my undead Husk of the Hunter is at level 9, where she gained 1 armor stat. And when she reaches the max level, she will learn the Deflection Shroud ability, so his adjacent allies will gain the Deflect ability, so they won't be affected by thorns, magic reflect, return fire or blast.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRt5E3rxc6bU46zJ4QBRoQfTPduM3n7Lf8uUk9ku66mx8rJSLCMMdXnUNvQabWZisbb.png)

---

My elemental Coralforged only needs 39 more copies to reach the max level, where it will gain the shield ability, which allows it to take 50% less damage from physical attacks.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aubryd/23tRtDTyXJBa6NkNB5LphAwgA9RsAvH8YgqFnhCMxp12KU586PuFUThskpiJ7MkuYiSda.png)

---

Currently, all of my common conclave arcana reward cards are at level 9, except for the three that I haven't leveled up, as I already have them at the max level in gold foil. I will open many more common draws when I get more glint and hopefully get some gold cards, and I wish you the same; have fun playing.

---

Are you not playing Splinterlands yet? You can join with my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com/register?ref=langice) and I will give you 600 DEC when you buy the spellbook.

That's all for now guys, see you on the battlefield!

body.title: Un oponente que se la jugo hasta el final  || Pool modo Bola 8   (Esp / Eng )
body.body: > Buen día tarde o no noche para todos los compañeros de la comunidad @geekzone. Hoy les comparto una partida de Pool en la modalidad bola 8. Mi oponente que por casualidad me toco uno de mi mismo nivel (Nivel 3) realizo su mayor esfuerzo aunque al principio tuvo algunas imprecisiones en los tiros, en un tramo de la partida consiguió unas cuantas anotaciones seguidas, esto lo ayudo a que la partida fuese un poco mas interesante y con un toque de incertidumbre al fina. >Good morning/afternoon/evening to all my fellow members of the @geekzone community. Today I'm sharing a game of 8-ball pool. >My opponent, who by chance was at my same level (Level 3), gave it his all, although he had some inaccuracies in his shots at the beginning. At one point in the game, he managed to score a few points in a row, which made the game a bit more interesting and added a touch of suspense towards the end.

> El comenzó abriendo la partida sin conseguir un hoyo en el primer tiro, aunque en mi turno siguiente tampoco conseguí un buen tiro fui yo quien metió la primera bola para desarrollar el rumbo de la partida. Hay varias modalidades en este juego que debo ir desbloqueando, cada partida tiene su precio de entrada, por lo que es importante ganar para conseguir fichas. Con sinceridad hubo un punto clave en la partida donde mi oponente pudo tener un acierto que le dejaría es escenario listo para ganar, pero un mal tiro a la bola 7 le quito esa ilusión y me dejo el camino libre a mi, por eso cada tiro cuenta. Por cierto este a oponente tenia un seudónimo raro (Sr. Nariz) espero topármelo en otra partida online en el futuro. >He started the game by not sinking his first shot, and although I didn't get a good shot on my next turn either, I was the one who finally got the first ball in, setting the tone for the game. There are several game modes that I need to unlock, and each game has an entry fee, so winning is important to earn chips. >Honestly, there was a key moment in the game where my opponent could have made a shot that would have put him in a winning position, but a bad shot on the 7 ball dashed his hopes and cleared the way for me. That's why every shot counts. By the way, this opponent had a strange nickname (Mr. Nose). I hope to run into him in another online game in the future.

>
Gracias por su atención prestada, será hasta la próxima.
Thank you for your attention, until next time.

body.title: The Guardian - Let's Make a Collage - Round 249 [ENG/ESP]
body.body:
Hello friends and hello #lmac community, what a joy to return again to the community to share the result of this last round. I hope you are having a very nice day and that the week has been totally productive, but above all very creative. Here is my submission.
> Hola amigos y hola comunidad de #lmac, qué alegría regresar nuevamente a la comunidad para compartir el resultado de esta última ronda. Espero que estén teniendo un muy lindo día y que la semana haya sido de total provecho, pero sobre todo muy creativa. Les comparto mi participación.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVEJk31H5og2feoJnTy1yKm24Jw2JtK11C9CxsWUH54kK/6.jpg)

This week's image, from the moment I saw it, inspired a certain air of protection and care, so I came up with the idea of creating a protective guardian of nature. To do this, I used a beautiful image of a forest in shadows, to which I made some color corrections to achieve a darker atmosphere. Right in the center, I added the statue, adjusting lights and shadows to improve integration with the environment and increase the air of mystery and solemnity. Inside the guardian's layer, I placed the texture of a butterfly wing. With my brushes in Photoshop, I added a small halo over the guardian's head, as well as some stars and sparkles. I also added some small flowers with blur effects that I obtained from the community's resources. I really liked the mysticism that was emerging, but I wanted to increase the mystery by adding two textures of my own: one of chromatic aberration, typical of errors in analog cameras, and another of noise and tears. Without a doubt, the result I got was exactly what I wanted: a mysterious atmosphere where a guardian protects a secret garden in the middle of a forest. I hope you like it too.
> La imagen de esta semana, desde que la vi, me inspiró cierto aire de protección y cuidado, así que ideé realizar un guardián protector de la naturaleza. Para esto me auxilié de una bella imagen de un bosque en penumbras a la que realicé algunas correcciones de color para lograr una atmósfera más oscura. Justo en el centro agregué la estatua, a la que ajusté luces y sombras para mejorar la integración con el entorno y aumentar el aire de misterio y solemnidad. Dentro de la capa del guardián coloqué la textura de un ala de mariposa. Con mis pinceles en Photoshop agregué un pequeño halo sobre la cabeza del guardián y algunas estrellas y destellos. También agregué unas pequeñas flores con desenfoques que obtuve de los recursos de la comunidad. Me gustó mucho el misticismo con el que estaba quedando, pero quise aumentar el misterio agregando dos texturas propias: una de una aberración cromática, típica de errores en las cámaras analógicas, y otra de ruido y rasgaduras. Sin dudas, el resultado que obtuve era exactamente lo que quería: una misteriosa atmósfera donde un guardián protege un jardín secreto en medio de un bosque. Espero que les guste también.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPTiGuZrsyW5KmzcP4wC3WJSuop2wGvqZgL8rTPFahtAY/uniconverter_20260426125935.gif)

I share with you the creation process in a small GIF animation. I hope you like it; I think this way the creative process will be better understood.
> Les comparto el proceso de realización en una pequeña animación en formato GIF. Espero que les guste; creo que así se entenderá mejor el proceso de creación.


![](https://images.ecency.com/p/6VvuHGsoU2QCK6yq1XKF2z9F8sayRpwConx4qLB8opqXz4fq9nYcCp6fBHJfY5vUpQdayB4DHqbmm4kVPCYRmkRhkHfaq5918JpT2HsASXa6ufA4j5zKqLERWX5Jke?format=match&mode=fit&width=1024)
### [Let's Make a Collage - A Contest for All Creatives on Hive - Round 249 - ✨55 HIVE in the Prize Pool!](https://ecency.com/created/@lmac/lets-make-a-collage-a-contest-for-all-creatives-on-hive-round-249-55-hive-in-the-prize-pool)

### Base image of this round.

![](https://images.ecency.com/p/Zskj9C56UonZ32EJw6nMcm9UJXZFc4FvMtk6wyeA9EABoLgCVHHS1cJyEYMjJXyKYjqNffFCXkF5cFQQsrxSyu9Hi1fbHjdoA5NtvybftFYR5Bt9c29U?format=match&mode=fit&width=1024)

Well, friends, without further ado I say goodbye, wishing you, as always, a week full of joy and all the success and luck in the world. I hope you liked my collage; I really enjoyed sharing it with you. Bye bye. > Bueno, amigos, sin más me despido deseándoles, como siempre, una semana llena de alegrías y todo el éxito y suerte del mundo. body.body:

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQpP9AiFnWHFnXSW8bnnn1MNBhNY53wsdehazhH4wcaJW/image.png)

## The Fast & The Flavorful: The Ultimate Thai Comfort Duo!

### 🇬🇧 English Review by Sakol

**Welcome back, my hungry friends!** Sakol is here, and today we are stripping away the complexity and going back to the absolute basics. Sometimes, you don't need a 10-course meal to find happiness. Sometimes, happiness is served in 5 minutes! Today, we are celebrating the undisputed kings of Thai street food and the ultimate \

meal. It’s fast, it’s simple, and it is **undeniably legendary!**

Let’s talk about this dynamic duo:

* **Crispy Thai Omelet (Kai Jeow):** Listen… can you hear it? That beautiful **\

** as the egg hits the hot oil! A proper Thai omelet is a masterpiece of texture. The edges are fried to a crispy, golden-brown perfection, while the center remains fluffy and cloud-like. Drape this golden blanket over a bed of steaming hot jasmine rice, add a dash of fish sauce with chilies (Prik Nam Pla), and you have pure, unadulterated comfort in every single bite!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT8k77DzcWvkiWX3F1yk4mwV7bLt7qs63LFhVa3Cm6pVZ/image.png)


* **Deep-Fried Pork (Moo Tod):** And standing right next to our golden omelet is the savory hero! Coated in garlic, pepper, and a touch of soy sauce, this pork is fried until it reaches a glorious, caramelized chewiness. It’s crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and incredibly savory. The saltiness of the pork cuts through the rich, fluffy egg perfectly. They are the ultimate best friends on a plate!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcPWNGvSb5tEiSMwE961Wipx2VJUcM7cahWDJbQi6NksB/image.png)


**The Verdict:** Simple? Yes. Fast? Absolutely. Delicious? **1000% YES!** This combo proves that you don't need fancy ingredients to create a perfect meal. It’s quick, soul-satisfying, and hits the spot every single time!

body.title: Between distraction and reflection  [EN/PT]
body.body: > Distractions bombard us all the time and we have a tool that attracts our attention constantly in our hands or, at best, in our pocket. It is getting harder and harder to feel bored and boredom is an ally for reflecting on life, on ourselves, on who we are and what we are going to do. Good ideas arise during boredom, this has already been proven. But no one really wants to be bored, we forget to think about life and doing a personal analysis ends up being left aside, there are too many distractions. Sometimes it is necessary to step away from everything and give space for these thoughts. I was living this, not only with distractions, but with too many things to do. Many projects, many ideas, hard work being carried out from morning until night and then I couldn’t do much beyond that. I don’t know if it was burnout or something similar, but it felt like my mind was overflowing and at no moment did I actually stop to think about life, about myself or to make those necessary reflections. I was living on autopilot, dealing with daily obligations imposed by myself. Then, when everything went silent, the thoughts came. For a few months now I have been thinking too much and that is also not good in excess. Thinking too much led me to have excessive worries and along with that came anxiety. Distractions do manage to distract, but only for a short time, the mind keeps hammering on several things that leave me worried. What used to be natural, I tried to use as something that could help me with this excess of thinking, but I realized that I live on the edge of excess, excess of work, excess of worry and thoughts. Nothing in excess is good. I am trying to balance myself again between work and meditation, both are important. I think that is it, we need to find balance, because reflecting too much is not good and too many distractions are not either, but having a bit of both can be ideal so that we can get to know ourselves and work to go further. I have been doing things more consciously and planning my actions, this helps, but it is also necessary to understand my own situation. I think each person is in a different phase, in mine I was on the verge of a collapse. Many people are so distracted that they do not even realize where they are heading, they just keep going without stopping to think. After everything that has been happening, I have been taking some time to balance everything. I continue working and thinking about my projects, now without exaggeration. I am trying to have moments of controlled distraction, but the most important thing has been setting aside time to meditate and reflect on my life, on what I need to do. This more intentional self-knowledge has been beneficial. Balancing everything, without excess, is where I want to get. Usually I have been taking long walks on weekends and even though I bring headphones and my phone, I try to spend a good amount of time just thinking while I walk. This has been very good, it has helped me reflect without excess, since now I have a specific moment for that. I think this is my moment, a moment to spend more time with myself and build a habit that is still in progress, but that can help me through these challenges. I defined a time for this, just like I have a time to work, just like I have a time when I allow myself to be distracted. Sometimes thoughts can torment us, sometimes distractions only get in the way, but the conclusion I reach is that excess is dangerous. Distractions are good at the right moments, work and meditation also have their moments and our role is to adjust everything into a balance that brings benefits and does not become a problem. It took me a while to realize this, I needed to be impacted in some way to understand what was really happening. Maybe without that I would still be in a kind of limbo, thinking I was doing the right thing, without time to look at myself from the inside out. In the end, balance does not appear on its own, it is built little by little. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png) Distrações nos bombardeiam a todo instante e temos uma ferramenta que atrai nossa atenção o tempo todo em nossas mãos ou, na melhor das hipóteses, no bolso. Está cada vez mais difícil ficar entediado e o tédio é um aliado para meditar sobre a vida, sobre nós, sobre quem somos e o que vamos fazer. Boas ideias surgem durante o tédio, isso já foi comprovado. Mas ninguém quer ficar entediado de verdade, esquecemos de pensar sobre a vida e fazer uma análise pessoal acaba ficando de lado, são distrações demais. As vezes é necessário afastar de tudo e dar essa oportunidade para os pensamentos. Eu estava vivendo isso, não apenas com distrações, mas com coisas demais para fazer. Muitos projetos, muitas ideias, trabalho duro sendo executado da manhã até a noite e então eu não conseguia fazer muito além disso. Eu não sei se foi um burnout ou algo parecido, mas parecia que minha mente estava transbordando e em nenhum momento eu parava de fato para pensar sobre a vida, sobre mim ou fazer aquelas reflexões necessárias. Estava vivendo no automático, lidando com obrigações diárias impostas por mim mesmo. Então, quando tudo ficou em silêncio, os pensamentos vieram. Já fazem alguns meses que eu tenho pensado demais e isso também não é bom em excesso. Pensar demais me levou a ter preocupações excessivas e, junto com isso, veio a ansiedade. As distrações conseguem distrair de fato, mas por pouco tempo, a mente continua martelando várias coisas que me deixam preocupado. O que antes era o natural, tentei usar como algo que me pudesse ajudar com esse excesso de pensamento, mas percebi então que eu vivo à beira do excesso, excesso de trabalho, excesso de preocupação e de pensamentos. Nada em excesso é bom. Estou tentando me equilibrar novamente entre trabalho e meditação, os dois são importantes. Acho que é isso, precisamos encontrar o equilíbrio, porque refletir demais não é bom e distrações demais também não são, mas ter um pouco de cada pode ser o ideal para que possamos nos conhecer e trabalhar para ir mais longe. Tenho feito as coisas de forma mais consciente e planejado minhas ações, isso ajuda, mas também é necessário entender a própria situação. Acho que cada pessoa está em uma fase diferente, na minha eu estava à beira de um colapso. Muitas pessoas estão tão distraídas que nem percebem para onde estão caminhando, apenas seguem, sem parar para pensar. Depois de tudo que vem acontecendo, eu tenho tirado um tempo para equilibrar tudo. Continuo trabalhando e pensando nos meus projetos, agora sem exagero. Estou tentando ter momentos de distração controlada, mas o mais importante tem sido separar um tempo para meditar e refletir sobre minha vida, sobre o que tenho que fazer. Esse autoconhecimento mais intencional tem sido benéfico. Equilibrar tudo, sem exageros, é onde eu quero chegar. Normalmente eu tenho feito longas caminhadas nos finais de semana e, apesar de levar fones de ouvido e o celular, tento ficar um bom tempo apenas pensando enquanto caminho. Isso tem sido muito bom, tem me ajudado a refletir sem exageros, já que agora eu tenho um momento específico para isso. Acho que esse é o meu momento, um momento de passar mais tempo comigo e criar um hábito que ainda está em construção, mas que pode me ajudar nesses desafios. Defini o momento para isso, assim como tenho momento para trabalhar, assim como tenho o momento em que me permito ficar distraído. Às vezes os pensamentos podem nos atormentar, às vezes as distrações só atrapalham, mas a conclusão que eu chego é que o excesso é um perigo. Distrações são boas nos momentos certos, trabalho e meditação também têm seus momentos e nossa função é ajustar tudo em um equilíbrio que traga benefícios e não se torne um problema. Eu demorei para perceber isso, precisei ser impactado de alguma forma para entender o que estava acontecendo. Talvez sem isso eu continuaria em uma espécie de limbo, achando que estava fazendo o certo, sem tempo para olhar para mim de dentro para fora. No fim, o equilíbrio não aparece sozinho, ele é construído aos poucos. --- Credits: Translated: [Deepl](www.deepl.com/pt-BR/translator) Cover: created by [Canva.](www.canva.com) AI-generated image [ Flow]( www.labs.google/fx/pt/tools/flow) --- ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma2XinqppUM2Uvqbsii8ViPirxPmkbLmJ8FkfAbcj9EYN/image.png)

body.title: Pen to Paper
body.body:
As the pen gets to the paper, the weight of notions continues to dissipate. Pen to paper is not a stored recollection but a point that connects to afterthoughts. Although the initial whim is no more, further writing perceives and tends to go on. Veylin drags the pen from across the table and points with the nib to the page placed in front. His limb together with his chest resting on the table, the side of his face planted on the desk. With a loose grip of his right hand, the pen floats, almost; although it touches the sheet.

The window shines bright upon him, laying there with his eyes closed, light spread across the surrounds, mind holding and blank. A knock on the door and a woman appears, hooking it open. In one hand she holds a tray, a cup and slices of toast. He hears the sound and the footsteps approaching, yet he adheres to the space. Gentle, but enough to intrude, she says;

“Veylin, the publisher called, asking about you.”

The same stance as before, but now he blinks and sees the clock above the door frame.

“If he calls again, just tell him I’m sick.”

She sets the tray onto the table and leaves. Closing the door on her way out, she hums lightly 
“Please make sure to eat it.”

Same as before, his face undisturbed as though she is still in the room. Veylin gets up from the chair, looks outside the window. A garden around the sill, bordered by a wooden fence. An old man stands at the corner of the block, perhaps waiting to cross the road, waiting for the traffic to hold.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWAzVC5c1G13AhgEsWS68g1Th3BVfgCTvsdwZt2fW9hhF/img_0148.jpg)

*“His words and not mine. The man, old, not yet old enough
to stroll at his will, but stop, why?
Surrender, just rest a bit,
stranger to the sorrow, the misery,
graves scatter, marrow ripens,
a soul no more,
ashes.”*

Holding the pen, Veylin writes a version drafted standing up. He wrote it, but it doesn’t feel like it,
self-estrangement without fully meaning to reveal himself. He thought he was writing a philosophy, this is what I think of you, the stranger completes the very idea Veylin put on the page.

The mirror hooked to the wall opposite the desk, the light through the window alters the image it holds.
That is why it haunts people. That is why it makes a story.
The thing that sees you most clearly is the thing that doesn’t know you at all.


Standing there he sees the stranger again, a mirror,
behind him yet, despite the appearance, nothing to gather of him; the only thing he sees is himself, he feels what he attaches to the body.
The mirror holds the image, the soul to be desired by looking, velyin know he wrote beacuse he needed to, he knows  the feeling of to gaze into abyss and not quite belive it.

The mirror:

“ But what I think of you; is that you wrote this because you are afraid that even if someone looked at you clearly, it still wouldn’t make you real to yourself.”

 velyin sits down on the table holding the pen, writing but not reading, the man in the window on his way, the food still there, 

*opaque clarity, the vanity sees
a hull bloodless, grasping
the scene, whether recognizable 
the strangers I wrote about 
they are me
imparted, forced
the ideas, conventions extracted 
they are me
comprehended, so a dimension
of intellectual and secluded reverie exists
a difference, a complex arrogance 
it could never be me
never like them*

body.title: Reflecting on Life: The Importance of Quiet Time
body.body:
/>

image generated using Gemini AI

To some religions, a quiet time is a time when one sets aside to study the Bible and pray; it is a time to study the Bible and communicate with God. It is a time when individuals have a quiet and personal time with their God. Quiet time is not a break from the world; it is an atmosphere for growth. Whether it is spiritual, academic, or creative.  

In a world where noise is the order of the day, where you can find noise even in a silent environment, worrying about the unknown factors of your life, planning about a future event, or even thinking about an activity that was left unfinished. Having a time where all you do is reflect on your life in general is a necessary reality rather than a thing to deliberate on the importance of.  

Whether it is in the morning when you wake up from sleep, or during your long morning walks or even a few minutes before sleep every day, one must have time to reflect on what they did during the day, their choices, and all that involves decision-making in regards to their life for one to grow and self-develop.  

At this time of reflection, it is expected that one should suspend all forms of activities, which include keeping your phones and all devices away, ignoring all messages, emails, and social media during this period, to stay focused on reflecting. One is expected to ask themselves questions like: Is my life moving in the direction I want it to, or am I only going as far as or where I am being pushed to go?  

When preparing for an exam, one may reflect on what they have read to remember what they have understood, and sketch out their reading goals to see how much they have achieved so far. It could also be helpful for creative writers during their quiet time to write out their thoughts during a reflection as plain as it comes, so as not to forget them. 
 
I usually use my morning walk time to reflect on my life, and sometimes have a book where I jot down all of my reflections, which could be a wrong choice that I made during the during that I will love to change and one which I am happy about. This helps me improve in my decision-making process and also helps me sometimes in correcting my wrongs.  
People around me sometimes gets agree at me because I tend to have my quiet time sometimes in the minds of others, while everyone is there communicating in a room, I could be present in the room but absent-minded.  

Whenever I take a walk, I tend to leave my devices at home, which helps me stay away from my screen for the period of my walk. Sometimes when I feel like staying off from the screen, I tend to go out for a long time and will leave the phone at home for a long period of time.  

Silence is the only place where we can fully find ourselves, whether spiritually, creatively or mentally. Our quiet time is the only place where we can take control of ourselves, putting the phone away and closing the door. Only then do we open the door for ourselves to see the world even more clearly.

Thank you for reading. My name is @rishagamo, and this is my response to the Hive Learners weekly Featured Content Week 215 Episode 01: “A QUIET TIME”.

title.title: Turning Struggles into Opportunities.
title.body: Back then, when I was still an undergraduate, life seemed somehow tough as a student, and the only option you have is just to make sure that you survive no matter what happens. Before I got admitted and even after I was admitted into the university, I thought about how I was going to cope, but you know, sometimes destiny has it planned out for us. I met a friend after about a year at the university who does online remote work but more like a freelancer. He works for multiple companies and then gets paid after he has done his duty to them.\n\n

>

Normally there is no way I would have been able to know what he is doing if I did not get close to him. But then I was skeptical about finding out because I felt most people would not want to open up to people about what they are doing, so I stood back and waited for the right time. Not knowing that he wanted me to talk by myself, that I needed something I could feed on. But I tried to speak up, but I couldn't. Eventually, when I had to speak up, he told me something and gave me the basic principles that I will use to start this journey and to make some money to sponsor my education and also some part of my life. 

I was happy with what he did as a friend because if it were some other friends, they would not give ears to whatever you want to say. So I tried my best to ensure that I was able to get a client to work with. Although the money I was getting was very small, I couldn't complain because I was not getting anything before. I strived so hard to keep up with the hustle, but it was becoming so hard due to the fact that my network was a big problem for me. Most of the clients I was not getting turned down any proposal we have, and they will say they are not interested anymore. 

I was not happy because I know I am just starting, and it will be kind of hard to say that I am just starting something new and I am giving up so easily. I summoned courage, and I saved up some money to get a 5G router to help accelerate my network. Well, it did try to the best of its ability, but it was not to the fullest of its ability because the network was very poor. At some point I began to go to his place for help, and I would get a deal, but when I went back home, I had nothing to show for it. I had to give up because my friend was becoming a pain because he will never motivate you to do more but instead downgrade your efforts. But after a long period of trials, I was able to trace back my steps, and I now got it right, and he is amazed about how fast I went with learning and getting better. 
Moral lesson: Never let anyone tell you that you cannot do it when you have not tried it.

links.body:
>

Today, after doing my chores and having nowhere to go, I became bored and so, I decided to visit a friend at her home, since it's been a long time since I visited them. Fortunately, I met her crafting, since she is a lover of craft, she was doing her thing and for the first time, I found interest in what she was doing and asked her to teach me.

![IMG_20260427_144639.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23vsWatW7nba2VyhqHcgzfNGBpHLuoeQJBpBfNFbkiG12U9ivt4qnCrJQCyS8DcU8QsRJ.jpg)
___

She was crafting a bracelet using Yarn/cord rope depending on what you know it as, she said she was crafting the bracelet using the Macramé technique, which is the knotting method, rather than knitting or weaving.

She firstly tried to show me with her yarn what she was doing but we both realized that I wasn't getting, anything and it was looking so complicated, so while she used another colour of yarn to make what she was making, she decided to remove the green and red colours of yarn for me, so I could follow her every step.

https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23x19JMkWBgh9zvQ6NH1S8v9FLz76Q5Ky7k2s8dSECV4pQWcZG4RmYGYGkGr19NNeZcaY.jpg
---
---
---

# Steps

<div class=\

> ![IMG_20260427_114316.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/23tSKnDYBuS9KTkNuQsp6LqFp6M44he5VRnn1kaRM6dtuSyS7zXvEEjEXY6nbtEPSnP5V.jpg) ![IMG_20260427_115459.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nwaadiaha/Ep5mHT7MVtx1Tsycs8DEhf5rZMoQZ6jxqeB8KA4Ep2FHED5SU6th9shbG79aAUA3DP5.jpg) --- --- I made a lot of mistakes at the beginning, and such too many times I had to lose and start all over again too many times, but I was persistent in learning, so regardless of how many times I made a mistake and she told me to start all over again, I did it, until I got correctly how to do the intertwining and inter-knotting work. She took her time to teach me how to place one yarn on another, in between another yarn, and inside another yarn. While she took minutes to finish her own bracelet, I took hours to finish mine with a lot of trial and error, but finally, I made a beautiful bracelet for myself for the first time. links.title: I went for a walk in the park, and the magnolias are in bloom there.
links.body:
I went for a walk in the park, and the magnolias are in bloom there. 
The magnolias are blooming so beautifully. I really love magnolia trees. I love the big flowers on the bushes—or rather, on the tree. The flowers are so big and so beautiful. 
The flowers are a bright, deep pink, with a hint of white in the center. 
How could anyone not love such beauty? 
I love walking in the park, especially when the magnolias are in bloom. It’s wonderful here. It’s a great spot to take photos of the magnolias, or to take photos with the magnolias in the background, or just a selfie with a beautiful backdrop of blooming magnolias. It’s a great spot for a photo shoot. It’s also a nice place to sit and take in all this beauty. 
I took lots of photos of the magnolias to share with you. We also sat on a bench and admired the magnolias in bloom. 
We have many parks where magnolias bloom and grow. But you can’t find this tree everywhere. It requires good care, which is why you can’t find it everywhere. You’ll mostly find magnolia trees in parks or in someone’s yard. You won’t find this tree in plantings, forest plantations, or the woods. 
Such beauty requires good care. 
But in the end, the tree will reward you for your care and treat you to its beautiful sight—the sight of magnolia blossoms.

links.title: Grandma's Lilies.
links.body:
> Greetings, friends who love nature in all its forms—in this case, everything related to vegetation, plants, flowers, gardens, and crops. This is actually my first time in this community, which I really like because it pays such a beautiful tribute to nature—specifically, to plants.
![DSC06037.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vicent21/EoEpadc8NycX9YEi64BbQXRTBNrxB9cwvewui59PW6ZHM2zhZrY92HoqhRJUoAgZYgc.JPG)

> We don’t have a garden at my house, but that doesn’t mean we can’t visit others and admire what they have, like at the farm where my grandmother lives. In Venezuela, a “fundo” is like a countryside in other places—a place with many fruit trees and ornamental flowers, such as this beautiful lily. The lily is like an exotic flower to me because of its unique nature—it’s not like the others. It comes in various colors: white, lilac, leopard-print, Japanese, and Virgin Mary lilies—those are the ones I’ve found, and there are more.
![DSC06036.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vicent21/EopsrcC8hsNDKPqVfWj53tvfTAc37nkE6vmxaHV3fz5aLw3e4hDACgMPgdBejVLM74H.JPG)

> The one in the photos is the orange lily; they say they are native to Europe and Asia. Its petals are elongated, and its scent is most noticeable at night. The center is yellow and has six stamens, or what we also call pistils. It has a trumpet shape; the flower grows from a bulb that forms at the tip of the elongated stem. It stands out for its height among other plants; this one didn’t grow very tall, but I’ve seen other, taller lilies.
![DSC06035.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vicent21/EqWmkMc1BpD51MqYxX3WKqoKnRodkm9RVYnV9MePyDKsKw7esj1wHdDwMvq4xPqfdQo.JPG)

> It’s said to bloom in the spring—like most flowers—and in the summer. It has many meanings: rebirth, purity, motherhood, and love. Orange lilies are ideal gifts to lift the spirits of others or even yourself. There is a wealth of information about this flower—you just have to look—and you’ll be surprised to discover that it’s not just a beautiful flower, but also a source of so much knowledge and learning. Photos taken with a Sony digital camera. Content translated using the DeepL app. Cover edited in Canva.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/vicent21/243MSMTrSjZeD4TL3p8bXqFfdHwTekLQ3M9VPbtdtKVQGfhCvjhjNKYMbayM4TPaoshuo.png)

links.title: How Habits Shape Our Future.
links.body:
All of us in this world are doing something every day and we don't know that what we are doing day to day is taking shape in our life. And those habits are actually building our future without us even knowing. It's like the smallest thing but if you think about it, it's the strongest. Because whatever we do, it will happen tomorrow. Tomorrow becomes your future.

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmYjH74agVBnVvfy49D1aZGLsUNGfFaBVJqJweYjyyMevB/Screenshot%202026-04-27%20200040.png 

[Source](https://www.freepik.com/free-photo/start-diet-nutrition-eating-choice-weight-healthy-concept_17139499.htm#fromView=search&page=1&position=35&uuid=8c4b8d03-be06-418e-8d05-2a64a0dc2160&query=How+Habits+Shape+Our+Future.)

If I talk about me, I was never a habit taker. I thought I will change my life, I will start doing good things. But that one day never came because I wasn't doing anything towards it. And then I came to know that the people who are better than me, they are not smarter, more intelligent, they are just better habit builders. They wake early, they achieve their goals every day, they don't procrastinate. And that was the difference.

Because habits are not one big thing, it's a little thing every day. If you read only 15 minutes each day, after one year you will know more things than other people. If you save even a small dollar every day, after some years you will be rich. But if you do nothing for some years, you will remain at the same place. This is life and it's tough but it's true.

It's also the same with bad habits. They are difficult to get rid of. Smoking, laziness, overthinking, procrastination, these things also slowly enter your life and then they remain. And the worst of all is you don't feel them coming, you just one day wake up and they are in control of you. And then it's very difficult. But it's very difficult and it takes a lot of work.

I believe, there should be some caution in doing things. Because you are not just killing time, you are actually building your character. Your habits will determine what kind of person you will be in next 5 or 10 years. No one is perfect, it's not about being perfect. But at least you should have some good habits, some positive habits which will help you to move forward.

Finally, I will just say this, it's not by chance or luck what is happening to you. It is decided by your daily habits. The little things, done every day, will change your life. So start now, even if it's very small. Because it's better to do small things every day than to do big things once.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mimiuse/how-habits-shape-our-future-6yb)

body.body:
And whenever a student passes what they call an industry certification, whether it be from Microsoft, Cisco, a third party validated industry, the school gets about $500 for that. And then the teacher themselves, they also can receive between 25 and $50 as a bonus. And I didn't realize this until actually this week because I've done it in Florida for so long that Florida is such a unique state.

And now Texas is doing that. There's a few other states doing it, but I didn't realize how unique it was for Florida. So as our endeavor moves forward with financial literacy, it's gonna allow other states to create these programs and allow schools and districts who wanna teach financial literacy to be able to get into these column grants, for lack of a better term, so schools can continue to keep funding financial education and financial literacy.

So just really happy that this is happening. Champion this. It's gonna be a year before this gets on the state's matrix and maybe a couple of years before it gets throughout the rest of the country.

But it's an endeavor that I really wanted to do and it makes me feel like I'm helping education. It's a win-win for everybody also through the CIW company that's championing our exam, as well as the credit union. I didn't realize until our meeting just this last week with the union that by them bringing in, just call them community outreach programs to help people understand how to budget better, how to make better decisions, how to see where they need to leverage their money, they will get bigger grants from the federal government or FDIC.

So it's a win-win all around. And just wanted to give you a quick update on that. So thank you.

body.title: Special Ocassion.
body.body:
I recently visited Mt. Gambier for a special purpose. My wife's brother and sister-in-law are about to welcome their newborn. On this special occasion, our sister wished to celebrate in a traditional style, in keeping with the roots of our culture. We planned to make her dream come true. So, I became the photographer and assisted my wife with the decoration. 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmdcEaVqmYjRC1YvLRzvvKxZFUXQ4x3gfGM9hUScSAZaif/02.jpg 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfKGAK9B3xKLR8GKT66m7MPfYxJkRGjNyixwHhf34E1jv/03.jpg 

Their home was already filled with different cultural artifacts, including the statues of gods. We decided to use the window frame, which would affect a few photos, but would be worth it. Initially, we finished up with what we had and added red and white clothes from the Spotlight. 
 <div align=\

>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmT7BRt4iKp2aDrSzh8Y8dkB3YMP3tHznViLEFJHHdA1hP/o4.jpg https://img.leopedia.io/DQmZkoEGX83RBPRFiXbc8vWQtj5nz2XEtAkUQLnD3mXToaU/IMG_4697.jpg The Occasion: **Dahi-Chiura** In Nepali tradition, a baby shower is rooted in cultural heritage and is celebrated by feeding a little paste of a bit of curd and beaten rice. (Dahi: Curd, Chiura: Beaten Rice). This is not a gender reveal, but it is done around the 6th month of pregnancy, as yogurt and beaten rice have been considered a healthy diet for a long time.

>https://img.leopedia.io/DQmd4ogiFbvvqXgfezVEpAT9GUkpHd6izMNtTqGrtwQD5PA/05.jpg As per the sister's wishes, we added an essence of a cultural power surrounding you that fills your heart and brings nuances of your roots to your lifestyle. Our sister may have been looking for something similar. While we offered our gifts and blessings, she cried. It was a moment to realize how relationships and family make everything together in place filled with love, and one in this world. A beautiful share of cultural heritage in Hive. Hope you liked going through my blog. I will see you again with the next story of my life. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@suzn.poudel/special-ocassion--cel)

body.title: The Other Cheek
body.body:
.

This is what was said by the shooter in the US who tried to charge through security at the Whitehouse Correspondence dinner in Washington. And while I disagree with violence, I am just wondering who doesn't agree with that statement. Because if turning the other cheek to the violence of others is acceptable, it means that no one should do anything about child abuse or sexual abuse, or any other kind of violence. But it opens up a can of worms, doesn't it? Because while those examples are illegal, so too have been some actions of the US government, meaning that they are inflicting illegal violence on people who may not be able to defend themselves. 

---


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/23vhq7vDw5KBpGEMmHUKaU3cUp6FTKsKQKxqnk8cCgxKEghcPJ3uHuc5KzW5EdLrcLibt.png)


---

I have said for a while now that the US is heading toward a civil war, but most people will disagree, because they are imagining civil war to be like it was a hundred and seventy years ago, between the Union and the Confederates. But I don't think that kind of civil war is what would happen, because *war has changed.* Just like the war in Ukraine and Iran is being largely dominated by drones, and countries are ramping up robotic soldiers in various forms, civil war will take on a new form also. 

As I see it, instead of a concerted push by centralised forces, a new US civil war would be far more decentralised, with many groups, as well as \

performing attacks against those they believe to be the perpetrators. And belief is all that matters, since we are in the post-fact world that has had gasoline poured on it over the last decade of Trump, with \

and direct lying still garnering support. Rather than bringing people together, politics is about turning people against each other, with who ever can create the best enemy getting the backing. And the best enemy position is facilitated by wild emotions, a lack of critical thought, and the feeling of being victimised. 

The new civil wars are already raging and have been for a while, but they have been constrained to the digital platforms, which have used them as collateral to get more clicks. But inevitably, those same online arguments that shape belief systems and encourage outrage, will spill into the physical world and will encourage people to act. And we are seeing this more and more, where *civilians* are taking matters into their own hands and acting on what they believe. 

While they are likely considered \
to most of us, it is the trend that matters, because just like a fashion trend, it starts to self-propagate, pulling more people into its sphere of influence. It is like that [\

](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fW8amMCVAJQ) (short and worth the watch) concept where the first person is ridiculed, but once one follower comes along and legitimises, more will join in and pretty soon, there is a movement. And no matter what a person believes, with the internet, there is always someone willing to legitimise it. Even the most heinous and disgusting of beliefs, has groups of supporters on the internet. So increasingly the position will become that people will act on their beliefs to do something against the perpetrators they see, whether it be governments, industries, corporations, or other citizens. When people are turned against each other for political and financial gain, it can only be expected that violence will result. And because the way this has been done has been to enrich an increasingly small amount of people, it means that simultaneously a growing number are facing increasing uncertainty and hardship, with less and less to lose. The social contracts are broken, the economic stability eroded away, the reasons to turn the other cheek diminishing rapidly. Governments aren't prepared for a modern civil war, much like traditional battle tactics haven't fared well in Afghanistan or Ukraine, because the form of war had changed. Even now, with a far superior force, the US is facing a loss in Iran. The government response to a decentralised civil war would be increasing oppression through monitoring and application of force, such as what has happened in the US over the last decade or so, and the usage of military and government militia roaming civilian streets. And ultimately, this approach is going to exacerbate the problems and push more people toward what was the edge domain of crazies and extremists. But, once enough people get pushed, that edge is no longer the edge, it is approaching the norm. That means there will be *more extreme* people who will increase severity and frequency, which will speed the process up further and add velocity to the movement. Not a single, concerted movement, but a myriad of movements, all with different ideals and targets, all wanting to do what is right *in their eyes.* And the more they do, the more harm gets done to an increasing number of people, creating a larger base of those who are damaged and oppressed, and are therefore less likely to turn the other cheek to the situations that feel are not right. If someone you cared about was being attacked, would you want someone to step in and defend them? What if they were being attacked by the people who are charged with defending them, those who make the laws, and police the laws they have made? Should people defer to authority, even when they believe what the authority is doing is morally wrong? > We have seen what happens in the past, haven't we? The world is in a sorry state of affairs and people are suffering, while politicians create unnecessary violence and volatility, and corporations are hitting record valuations. The economic and political systems are not aligned with improving society and are in fact the antithesis of what humanity needs. With their greed for power and control, they are creating an ecosystem that becomes increasingly volatile and violent, until all social systems collapse - *and no one wins.* Turn the other cheek? body.title: Dailyprompt:  First impression
body.body:
The first time I saw them, something about them felt off.

I couldn’t explain it.
They looked normal… smiled normally… even spoke politely.
But there was something in their eyes.
Too still. Too empty.

I told myself I was just overthinking.
“It’s just a first impression,” I thought.
So I didn't pay much attention and ignored it.

Days passed, and I saw them again.
Same smile. Same calm voice.
But that feeling didn’t go away.
If anything… it got only stronger.

One day, I noticed something strange.
Everyone talked to them.
Everyone laughed with them.
But no one ever stayed for long.
And then… I realized something worse.
No one remembered them either.
Not clearly.

I tried to bring them up in a conversation once.
“Who?” someone asked.
I turned to point at them...
But they were already looking at me.
Smiling.

Like they knew I had finally noticed.
And that’s when it hit me…
Maybe my first impression wasn’t wrong.
Maybe it was a warning. 

Thanks for reading

body.title: Poema: La búsqueda del bienestar en tiempos de crisis|| (ESP-ENG)
body.body:
<CENTER>
#
Tormentas que azotan el alma.
Feroces tempestades de la vida.
Caos social que envuelve la nostalgia.
Abismo de años en crisis.
Emociones en grietas sin suspiros.
Nación triste que empaña la vida.
Años que transcurren en crisis.
La vida se convierte en desierto.
Y la muerte se anhela en la nada.
No hay conciencia del bienestar.
El egoísmo reina sin piedad.
La justicia del hombre se convierte en polvo.
La muerte prepara su tumba.
Y el hambre roba el bienestar de sus habitantes.
Mundo oscuro del mal.
El egoísmo reina en los palacios del hambre.
El bienestar se traduce en miseria.
No hay conciencia de la vida.
Y el sueño se hace añicos en corrupción.
La vanidad es el tesoro de los amantes.
No hay amor por la vida.
La sequía se entrelaza con el desierto.
Y el vacío ha robado la esperanza.
La patria sueña, y su sueño se desvanece. 
El bienestar está lejos de la nación.
Un país que se convierte en polvo bajo sus pies.
El orgullo crece en la arrogancia del necio.
Saquearon la esperanza de los soñadores,
y el bienestar mental se hizo añicos en el alma.
La angustia persigue a la desesperación,
y el dolor abraza la miseria.
Las colinas se agitan, buscando esperanza.

Los techos de hojalata tiemblan de hambre.
Robaron el bienestar de los soñadores.
La vida se convierte en un sueño en medio de la muerte.
La miseria clama desde las colinas,
y el dolor robó el bienestar de mi patria.
#
El bienestar es como hojas marchitas.
Ningún sueño trae paz.
El hambre sacude cada rincón de mi país.
Los suspiros de quienes sueñan se han secado.
Quienes abandonaron la patria jamás regresaron.
El bienestar se convirtió en mera fantasía, y
los niños pobres juegan con carros de polvo.
La tristeza es el luto de la nación rica.
Teje el sueño del olvido, y
mi nación sueña con la restauración.
Se aspira a un mayor bienestar en la ruina.
La miseria y la pobreza son los cimientos del futuro.
Los vientos soplan desde los extremos,
y el verano abraza el frío del invierno.
Todo es un sueño sin bienestar.
Alguien clama por los muchos engaños.
Alguien es fecundado por las muchas promesas,
y ninguna palabra se convierte en verdad.
El engaño corrió por las calles de mi patria,
y no hay amor, solo tristeza.
Un nuevo sueño se aguarda.
Se espera un rincón de esperanza.
Se espera el regreso de los niños.
Se espera una nación libre de corrupción.
Se espera un sueño que albergue bienestar
Y que haga florecer la salud y el amor.
Los pobres sueñan
Y los pocos ricos que quedan en la nación sueñan.
La vida es solo aliento
Y el suspiro se convierte en esperanza y amor.
Bienestar, bienestar es el clamor de la nación.
Un clamor de sueño y esperanza en el amor.
Bienestar para la convivencia
Y bienestar para una nueva nación.
Mi patria que sueña.
Mi nación que eres hermosa.
Sueñas en las alturas del bienestar.
Sueñas con tanta inquietud que quieres abrazar tu futuro.
#
</CENTER>
#
<CENTER>
![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmc8k1gR643rpSFbwBTPdnN1QXbgQnoHQWzMEfyjJwS4mt/image.png)
</CENTER> 
#
<CENTER>
#
### The search for well-being in times of crisis
#
Storms that lash the soul.
Fierce tempests of life.
Social chaos that envelops nostalgia.
Abyss of years in crisis.
Emotions in cracks without sighs.
Sad nation that tarnishes life.
Years that pass in crisis.
Life becomes a desert.
And death is longed for in nothingness.
There is no awareness of well-being.
Selfishness reigns without mercy.
The justice of man turns to dust.
Death prepares its grave.
And hunger steals the well-being of its inhabitants.
Dark world of evil.
Selfishness reigns in the palaces of hunger.
Well-being translates into misery.
There is no awareness of life.
And the dream shatters into corruption.
Vanity is the treasure of lovers.
There is no love for life.
Drought intertwines with the desert.
And emptiness has stolen hope. 
The homeland dreams, and its dream fades.
Well-being is far from the nation.
A country that turns to dust beneath its feet.
Pride grows in the arrogance of the fool.
They plundered the hope of the dreamers,
and mental well-being shattered in the soul.
Anguish pursues despair,
and pain embraces misery.
The hills stir, searching for hope.
The tin roofs tremble with hunger.
They stole the well-being of the dreamers.
Life becomes a dream amidst death.
Misery cries out from the hills,
and pain stole the well-being of my homeland.
#
Well-being is like withered leaves.
No dream brings peace.
Hunger shakes every corner of my country.
The sighs of those who dream have dried up.
Those who abandoned the homeland never returned.
Well-being became mere fantasy, and
poor children play with carts of dust.
Sadness is the mourning of the wealthy nation.
It weaves the dream of oblivion, and
my nation dreams of restoration.
Greater well-being is aspired to in ruin.
Misery and poverty are the foundations of the future.
The winds blow from the extremes,
and summer embraces the cold of winter.
Everything is a dream without well-being.
Someone cries out against the many deceptions.
Someone is impregnated by the many promises,
and no word becomes truth.
Deceit ran through the streets of my homeland,
and there is no love, only sadness.
A new dream is awaited.
A corner of hope is awaited.
The return of the children is awaited.
A nation free from corruption is awaited.
A dream that harbors well-being is awaited
And that makes health and love flourish.
The poor dream
And the few rich who remain in the nation dream.
Life is but breath
And the sigh becomes hope and love.
Well-being, well-being is the cry of the nation.
A cry of dream and hope in love.
Well-being for coexistence
And well-being for a new nation.
My homeland that dreams.
My nation that you are beautiful.
You dream in the heights of well-being.
You dream with such restlessness that you want to embrace your future.
#
</CENTER>
#

body.title: “Even the smallest stone has survived countless waves.”
body.body:
![1000041236.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/wheng30/AKut7s9U6c8UC6ot6Ps6qdDM71m1hfiDF8Zj8zcZWpiDHS4FYfSFepBgY6nJdZD.jpg)
The sun was just starting to come up when I walked along the shore. The sound of the waves was really nice in the morning air. I bent down. Picked up a small stone. It was smooth and cool in my hand. For some reason I did not let it go. As I kept walking I found myself picking up stones. Each stone was different. Each stone had its story that the sea had made.

When I held each stone I felt like I was getting pieces of calm. The stones were something in a world that never stops. The ocean kept coming out. It was loud and restless.. My hands were full of quiet stones that did not move.

When I finally stopped my pockets were heavy with stones.. My heart felt lighter. I smiled because I realized that sometimes simple things, like holding a stone by the beach remind you to slow down and just breathe. The stones, by the beach were really nice. Holding the stones made me feel better.

title.title: (ESP-ENG) Lesiones por todos lados... [Opinión]
title.body:
**<center>Hola amigos, buenas vibras para todos.</center>**
> Hello friends, good vibes to all.


![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQrMXaYGR2qhTjoeNBbQUDEiA3uMsjPFWGvqG6T5ezvpaS6hpi2nrhEcrf1nP2F4LMx.jpg)


[Fuente. ](https://www.elcomercio.com/deportes/futbol/jugadores-lesionados-mundial-ausentes-recuperacion/)

<div class=\

>45 días son los que faltan para que el balón comience a rodar en el mundial, más específicamente en el estadio Azteca en donde México recibirá a Sudáfrica. Creo que todos estamos emocionados por semejante cantidad de partidos que tendremos en esta edición pero, ¿podrán decir lo mismo los jugadores? - gran pregunta. El tema de las lesiones es algo de lo que se viene hablando desde hace mucho tiempo motivado por el calendario tan excesivamente cargado por el que tienen que pasar estos futbolistas. Si un año \

, es decir, sin competencias en el verano de por sí es bastante desgastante imaginen jugar un mundial después de haber corrido unos 60 partidos aproximadamente. Una locura realmente. Pero lo triste de eso es que esas consecuencias ya las están padeciendo algunos nombres.

> There are 45 days left until the ball starts rolling at the World Cup, specifically at the Azteca Stadium where Mexico will host South Africa. I think we're all excited about the sheer number of matches we'll have in this edition, but can the players say the same? – a great question. The issue of injuries has been discussed for a long time, driven by the excessively heavy schedule these footballers have to endure. If a \

year, meaning one without summer competitions, is already quite exhausting, imagine playing a World Cup after having played approximately 60 matches. It's truly insane. But the sad thing is that some players are already suffering the consequences.

>La cantidad de lesiones que se están conociendo en esta recta final de temporada es demencial, creo que siempre hay lesiones en el fútbol pero la cosa es que ahora todo se magnífica precisamente por la cercanía del mundial. Grandes nombres se van a perder la cita mundialista, nombres que creo yo son o eran importantes para sus respectivas selecciones. Ekitike es uno de ellos, el delantero francés jugador del Liverpool se rompió el tendón de Aquiles. Lo triste es que se perfilaba como el 9 de Francia ya que es un jugador espectacular pero esta rotura lo dejará fuera unos cuantos meses. A la baja de Rodrygo con rotura de ligamentos y menisco se le suma de la Militao quien otra vez se lesionó el bíceps femoral. Lo de Éder es digno de estudio, no es nada normal que un jugador se lesione tanto y tan seguido. Una lastima porque bueno y sano es de los mejores centrales del mundo.

> The number of injuries we're seeing in this final stretch of the season is insane. I think there are always injuries in football, but the thing is, now everything is magnified precisely because of the World Cup being so close. Big names are going to miss the tournament, names that I believe are or were important for their respective national teams. Ekitike is one of them; the French striker who plays for Liverpool ruptured his Achilles tendon. The sad thing is that he was shaping up to be France's number 9, as he's a spectacular player, but this rupture will keep him out for several months. Adding to Rodrygo's absence with a torn ligament and meniscus is Militao, who injured his hamstring again. Éder's situation is worthy of study; it's not normal for a player to get injured so often. It's a shame because, when healthy, he's one of the best center-backs in the world. ![2.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23tmBC4DyfCnRWf43m5jhrchKcueYs1ybLDqTEeTZfNBGB4ihpKgv5piPtjovFjzWnji7.webp) [Fuente. ](https://www.telemundo.com/deportes/copa-mundial-de-la-fifa-2026/militao-recae-de-su-lesion-y-se-perderia-el-mundial-2026-con-brasil-rcna342115) --- ![3.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23zknYgbKS7irLPDRHuuhU5kvDzttcenDpcsqcKaukFrx2w3TeVDJbyzEsEUKqv77hnZ3.webp) [Fuente. ](https://www.si.com/es-us/futbol/estevao-en-duda-para-el-mundial-2026-con-brasil-tras-lesionarse-con-el-chelsea)

>Estêvão con un desgarro en el isquiotibial es otro que casi seguro se va a perder el mundial. Este jugador es de los que más quería ver porque siento que su calidad y potencial son muy grandes, es de los mejores jugadores jóvenes del mundo, en el Chelsea es pilar en el ataque. Para ir finalizando con los que de manera segura se quedaron fuera nos queda por nombrar a Gnabry, el alemán del Bayern (rotura del abductor) y a Xavi Simons, el más reciente de todos, con la clásica rotura de ligamentos. La mayoría de estos jugadores son titulares en sus clubes y podían serlo en sus selecciones pero el destino o el calendario no quisieron que eso pasara. Pero las cosas no acaban acá y es que hay otra lista de jugadores que están lesionados pero que su presencia, en teoría, no corre peligro.

> Estêvão, with a hamstring tear, is another player who will almost certainly miss the World Cup. This is one of the players I most wanted to see because I feel his quality and potential are immense; he's one of the best young players in the world, and a key figure in Chelsea's attack. To finish up with those who are definitely out, we have to mention Gnabry, the German from Bayern Munich (adductor tear), and Xavi Simons, the most recent of all, with the classic ligament tear. Most of these players are starters for their clubs and could have been for their national teams, but fate or the schedule didn't allow it. But things don't end there, as there's another list of injured players whose participation, in theory, isn't in jeopardy.

>De hecho acá solo voy a nombrar a dos porque son los más sonados. El primero es obviamente Lamine Yamal quien sintió el pinchazo en el partido contra el Celta. La lesión entiendo es una rotura muscular, no tan grave, del isquiotibial de la pierna izquierda. Estas lesiones pueden ser bien engañosas porque si no son tratadas como debería de ser y se tiene el reposo adecuado puede convertirse en una pesadilla. Claramente queda fuera del resto de la temporada, clásico incluido, pero se espera que llegue al mundial. El tema acá es, ¿llegará en forma y ritmo? - probablemente se pierda el partido inaugural con España pero con el resto irá poco a poco. Y el segundo es la base medular de la defensa argentina, el Cuti Romero. En un partido con el Tottenham el central se retiró de la cancha llorando por una lesión en el ligamento colateral de la rodilla derecha; los jugadores conocen su cuerpo y saben cuando algo va mal.

> In fact, I'm only going to mention two here because they're the most talked about. The first is obviously Lamine Yamal, who felt the twinge in the match against Celta Vigo. I understand the injury is a muscle tear, not too serious, in his left hamstring. These injuries can be quite deceptive because if they aren't treated properly and don't get adequate rest, they can turn into a nightmare. He's clearly out for the rest of the season, including the Clásico, but he's expected to be available for the World Cup. The question here is, will he be fit and match-fit? He'll probably miss the opening match against Spain, but he'll gradually return to form for the rest of the games. And the second is the heart of Argentina's defense, Cuti Romero. In a match against Tottenham, the center-back left the field in tears due to a collateral ligament injury in his right knee; players know their bodies and know when something is wrong. ![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23wqnVYbgYyVi4n9N25XcvHxk6p2oHvY3CaBPF2NUZo1gjSXrtu1F3tzygH5XssoLJSxZ.jpg) [Fuente. ](https://www.ole.com.ar/futbol-internacional/inglaterra/cuti-romero-lesion-tottenham-seleccion-mundial-2026-video_0_eeWsrUWoIm.html) --- ![5.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/javyeslava.photo/23uQpMmn2nLr8fW2vypxSzAZZkCUzNzUHXQYyv2ae6nzJsFPkzmSR8vGR8zgfN6eJ9upB.jpg) [Fuente. ](https://www.sport.es/es/noticias/barca/ultima-hora-lesion-lamine-yamal-129427582)

>Esta baja por los argentinos significaría un duro golpe porque estamos hablando, al igual que con Militao, de uno de los mejores centrales del mundo, para muchos el mejor. Esta baja es para 5-8 semanas por lo que en los papeles llegaría al mundial. Cada vez en el fútbol hay más lesiones y esto no tendría que ser normal aunque sea algo inevitable. La exigencia física a la que estos jugadores están expuestos cada vez es más grande por lo que realmente no veo una solución posible y es que como se sabe este deporte es movido por el dinero y tener más competencias, más viajes y por ende más partidos significa más dinero en los bolsillos para todos. El gran negocio del fútbol llevado a cabo por unos tipos que en su mayoría nunca han pateado un balón en una cancha.

> This loss for Argentina would be a major blow because, like with Militao, we're talking about one of the best center-backs in the world, for many, the best. This injury is expected to keep him out for 5-8 weeks, so on paper, he should be available for the World Cup. There are more and more injuries in football, and this shouldn't be the norm, even if it's somewhat inevitable. The physical demands placed on these players are constantly increasing, so I don't really see a solution. As we know, this sport is driven by money, and more competitions, more travel, and therefore more matches mean more money in everyone's pockets. It's the big business of football, run by guys who, for the most part, have never even kicked a ball on a pitch.

***

Bueno mi gente por hoy es todo, espero que les haya gustado. ¡Un abrazo a todos, nos leemos en la próxima!
*** > Well folks, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed it. ¡Hugs to everyone, see you next time!

title.body:

Hello friends, today I would like to continue talking to you about my trip to Turin, where I discovered many new things and many new places, one of these was undoubtedly the Subalpina gallery, probably one of the most famous and covered galleries in Turin inspired by the famous galleries found in Paris.

![IMG_2540.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23y8sofiVHHT6vhB5vSjnb84Pv26VGEaJCyN31tdj2Got5tHi9QkPiMJzKKWy6WiBTa7f.JPG)
