This gallery is located between Piazza Castello and Piazza Carlo Alberto, therefore right in the central part of Turin, it was designed in 1873 by the architect Pietro Carrera and was built about a year specifically for a space conceived, ehm, for the leisure and shopping of the city's bourgeoisie. In fact, you can notice as soon as you enter that it is a very chic place. Unfortunately, during the Second World War it was severely damaged but fortunately it was rebuilt and restored as was Fedele's project.

![IMG_2541.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23wWuBA5f3auQ9xAPBNajJJnAhhsErQZJjqPWuyGwYaxHbywLPeJWS6FL5Fy82aEYYpkp.JPG)

![IMG_2544.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23yTf3hjLoSM6Nvop9T1zyeg3XmSHD7uTuDYryKRhM8beipqaeAV2gEHJejJHLPqKULBX.JPG)

it is very tall as a gallery and it is the first thing I noticed, currently inside there are still cafes and restaurants and also a bookshop but I had also noticed a cinema, and I discovered that in 2025 this place was bought by Alessandro Barbero the famous social communicator and professor, a very successful historian in short and who in fact is from Turin, who wanted to buy it a little to relaunch this place so that it could become a bit of a centre of culture for all of Turin.

![IMG_2546.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23w2m8LQn8uHeHRjUHYEs5Fa1dKCHoVNmobASwVpHJrupvDBCAC6y9oVM9jTF35WfMTT9.JPG)

![IMG_2547.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/butterfly-jt9/23vsNTxqBiXv6TUC1oq44MrawAVnDgbxTtyhNA7bSuGbQv8qLBVtr5PdLGjwCV7WsF4kX.JPG)

I would have liked to have breakfast there, or eat something good but in reality the prices are very high and it is normal that it is like that in such a beautiful and particular place. And I even discovered that some films were shot inside. Also because if you can also see the photos it really seems like you are inside a film set almost. So if you have the possibility and if you pass through Turin I would pop in here. I wish you all a good day. See you soon.

title.title: “Why Being Busy Is Not the Same as Being Productive”
title.body:
In today’s fast-paced world, being busy is often worn like a badge of honor. People proudly say, “I’ve been so busy,” as if it automatically means they are making progress. But the truth is, being busy and being productive are not the same—and confusing the two can quietly hold you back.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdmH4iWSYoeKDzURfizd1pTXV2gVdKkJxoomadMnCxziB/img_3765.png)

Being busy means your time is filled with tasks. Your schedule is packed, your phone is constantly buzzing, and you’re always moving from one thing to another. It feels like you’re doing a lot, but activity doesn’t always equal achievement. On the other hand, productivity is about doing the right things—tasks that actually move you closer to your goals.

Imagine spending hours replying to emails, attending meetings, or scrolling through work-related content. You might feel exhausted at the end of the day, but what did you really accomplish? Did you take a step forward, or were you just caught in a cycle of constant motion?

One of the biggest reasons people stay busy instead of productive is the illusion of progress. Completing small, easy tasks gives a sense of satisfaction. It feels good to check things off a to-do list. But often, the most important tasks—the ones that require deep thinking, focus, and effort—are the ones we delay. These are the tasks that truly matter, yet they are also the easiest to avoid.

Another factor is distraction. We live in a world full of notifications, social media, and endless information. It’s easy to get pulled into things that demand attention but don’t create value. You might spend hours switching between apps, messages, and minor tasks, thinking you’re working, when in reality, your focus is scattered.

True productivity requires clarity. You need to know what actually matters. Instead of asking, “What should I do next?” ask yourself, “What is the most important thing I can do right now?” This simple shift can change everything. Productive people prioritize impact over activity.

It also requires discipline. Deep, meaningful work often feels uncomfortable. It demands focus, patience, and sometimes even boredom. But this is where real progress happens. Whether it’s building a skill, working on a project, or making a long-term plan, productivity is about investing your energy where it counts.

Being productive also means knowing when to slow down. Rest is not a waste of time—it’s a part of the process. When your mind is clear and refreshed, you can think better, decide faster, and work more effectively. Constant busyness, without breaks, only leads to burnout.

At the end of the day, the goal is not to fill every minute of your time, but to use your time wisely. It’s better to complete one meaningful task than to finish ten unimportant ones. Progress is not about how much you do—it’s about how much it matters.

So the next time you feel proud of being busy, pause for a moment and ask yourself: “Am I actually moving forward, or just staying occupied?” Because real success doesn’t come from being busy—it comes from being productive.

The Miracle Bibimbap: 7 People, 7 Secret Ingredients


Today, my friends and I had a very special dinner event: \

🥣✨

The rule was simple. Seven of us had to bring one bibimbap ingredient each, but without telling anyone what we were bringing. We were a bit worried that everyone might bring the same thing (like everyone bringing just carrots! 😂).

But when we opened our containers, we were shocked! Not a single ingredient overlapped. We had everything we needed: crunchy bean sprouts, savory sautéed mushrooms, fresh seasoned spinach, carrots, zucchini, a perfectly fried egg, and even the \

– spicy gochujang and fragrant sesame oil!

We mixed it all together right on the spot. It was like a delicious harmony created by chance. Eating a meal that was completed by everyone's secret participation made it taste even better. It truly was the best random bibimbap ever! 😋🇰🇷

Happy week, friends!
It’s always a pleasure to be here, bringing new and positive vibes. The cover photo is a well‑deserved recognition of our most loyal participant in the cycling chats. Great photo, isn’t it? In the previous initiative’s post we was promoting a little photography challenge here — the Cycling‑Photography Challenge or #CPC. Come on, don’t be shy! You only need to add the tag to your post, whether it’s a one‑off entry or one generated through the automated #Strava2Hive service. This way, we’ll create a poll with the participants’ photos and spark new interactions within our community. 😀 Easy peasy — just nick the Monomad trick: 🤓 paste This is my entry for the Cycling‑Photography Challenge or drop the tag #CPC.

Ride it, snap it, share it!
A new motivation here! So many breathtaking landscapes to share and to help promote cycling as a healthy activity — and one that also rewards us with views that people rushing around in cars usually miss.

> Rank Athlete Total Kilometres 🥇 1st @preciouz-01 128.99 🥈 2nd @matisport 97.11 🥉 3rd @traininglog 64.91 We put together a compilation of everyone who shared their routes this week, and even added up the kilometres to create the podiums. What do you think?
Alright, time to give a shout‑out to the posts from these past days!

>Getting to road biking without the roads 😄 by @nozem01 - Lovely contribution to the last Cycling ChitChat, with a new motivation for the whole family, once again showing how cycling improves our lives.\n\n

>In search of my dream bike 🚲 Buscando la bicicleta de mis sueños by @santacruz.sports - Welcome to those who remember topics proposed in our initiative and bring them back to the present. That’s really great. We hope to see you back on the wheels soon, my friend.\n\n
>You’re not going to believe it! 😄 by @nanixxx - She still wants to take the Strava throne from someone she doesn’t even know, but well… everyone can be happy with their own obsessions. Haha!\n\n

>Tour, 22 Mile Ride, Garmin Varia Radar, Session and Lunch, Baby Birds, Kit Storage - Tuesday by @flemingfarm - There are cyclists here who are really deep into birdwatching. And although this post includes many other interesting things and is part of the author’s daily updates, the story of the chicks in their nest is truly charming.\n\n
>Rain, Tour, 27.6 Mile Trainer Ride, Session, Autozone, Rain, Date - Wednesday by @flemingfarm - Everyday life and its happy moments. Cheers!

>Tour, WIND, 25 Mile Ride in High Winds With Panniers, Autozone, PDC, Car Brake Repair, Soak - Thursday by @flemingfarm - Three posts in one week! We’re really happy to see your active participation in the community. We hope you’re enjoying it as much as we are enjoying your updates. Those panniers really got me thinking about getting a pair for myself.\n\n
>Cycling north of the city by @vesytz - Here we have once again a beautiful selection of photos from a bicycle ride.

>

Hey, time for a ChitChat question!

 Cycling influencers: real inspiration or just pure posing? ... Remember to use the hashtag #CyclingChitChat, and feel free to invite a friend to join in. That will help us connect with more people. You can reply in the comments on this post or even write a whole post about it… it’s your choice. We’ll be waiting for you. Catch you soon.

Watch on YouTube 

Divinity: Original Sin 2 conceptually a fantasy \

of the Divinity Series is imagined as a game that takes the success of the first two parts even further. This game presents a new more expansive and mysterious world where power, magic and destiny have reached a whole new level. This time the story is deeper and more thrilling than before where the player not only has to face enemies but also deal with the consequences of their own decisions.

In this part the world feels even more open and alive. Every city every forest and every location has its own unique story. NPC characters seem smarter and more realistic than before reacting based on your decisions. This is what turns the game into a cinematic experience where you yourself are the hero of your own story.

The combat system has also been improved. Now not just magical powers but the use of the environment has become even more important. Teamwork strategy and timely decisions are what bring you success. Every battle is like a new puzzle that you have to solve.

Open World Experience: 
A vast and completely free world where you can go anywhere you want.

Advanced Combat System: 
Improved turn based combat new spells and brilliant use of the environment.

Deep Storyline:  
More complexity in the story secrets and surprising twists.

Multiplayer Mode:  
An even better and more exciting experience playing with friends.

Character Customization: 
Design your character however you like with new abilities and styles.

Dynamic World: 
A world that changes based on your decisions along with character reactions.

If you loved Divinity Part 2, then this Part 3 will prove to be a new and even more exciting experience for you. This game isn't just meant to be played it's meant to be lived where every decision gives your own story a new direction.

title.title: Between Spectacle and Strategy: Why Does Everything Become a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC)?
title.body: />\n\nIn the current political landscape, it seems that every relevant debate in the National Congress ends up being packaged as a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC). But is this always the necessary legal tool, or are we facing a grand political theater? In our most recent video, we discuss the \

in certain agendas that, although they could be resolved through ordinary bills, are elevated to the status of PEC to serve purposes that go beyond legislation.

#### The Left's Show and the Right's Capitulation

The central point of the analysis is how the choice of PEC serves as a showcase. For left-wing parliamentarians, the more complex procedure and the gravity of a constitutional change offer the perfect stage for personal and ideological promotion. It's the necessary \

to mobilize their base and set the public opinion agenda with issues that are dear to them.\n\nOn the other hand, we observe a curious and worrying phenomenon: the capitulation of sectors of the right, specifically Bolsonarism. The video highlights that, to avoid popular rejection or immediate wear and tear, parliamentarians who claim to be in opposition end up voting with the left on controversial issues—as happened with the \
This stance generates a clear contradiction: while they surrender in the vote, they continue to use the label of \

to attack anyone who dares to criticize former President Bolsonaro independently.

#### The Politics of Fear of Losing Votes

The criticism extends to the stance of figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, who, according to the analysis, avoids direct debate and prefers not to detail proposals so as not to \

When politics becomes merely a game of maintaining popularity, the technical content and viability of projects take a back seat.\n\nThe use of the PEC (Proposed Constitutional Amendment), in this context, is pointed out as a political \

If the objective were legislative efficiency, other paths would be taken. Since the goal is to generate noise and ensure electoral survival, the chosen path is the one that generates the most engagement, even if it means compromising the integrity of the constitutional debate.

#### Conclusion

We cannot accept that our Constitution be used as an instrument of political marketing. It is necessary to question: why does this issue need to be a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC)? Who benefits from prolonging this discussion? The role of the voter is to see beyond the smokescreen and demand coherence from their representatives, so that politics ceases to be a spectacle of convenience and returns to being a space for real solutions for the country.

title.title: Every Child Deserves Safety: The Danger of Bully in Schools- LOH contest-286
title.body: A school is meant to be a very safe place for kids to learn and acquire knowledge, and not a place where parents fear the worst could happen and feel insecure/ scared leaving their kids because of other kids who are bullies. School bullying is gradually becoming a pandemic in our society today, and it really needs to be controlled at all costs, for the sake of our future. The consequences of bullying children can be really severe and harmful. It affects the child in several ways; it affects them mentally, emotionally and even destroys their self confidence and esteem. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmS4xGJUAMRGVxjb5LizvGUHX9XNos2pTkjwFEcVe9ki3E/1777295641377.png) Each time ,I hear a news about bullies, I keep wondering if kids aren't taught love , empathy and kindness enough at home. Bullying is a very cruel act and needs to be stopped, to avoid irreversible incidents like death. Constant bullying could lead to death, suicidal thoughts and severe damage that will affect the victims till they become adults. It was just yesterday, I was scrolling through Facebook and I watched a terrible video of a young college student who suffered bullying from other kids, for a long time and finally he was beaten to death by other students because he was suspected to be gay, and I watched this video in so much pain, because the society is becoming dangerous by the day. Because he was different from other male kids and behaved like a female, that made him a target amongst other male students. That young kid was a victim of constant bullying and hatred that eventually lead to his death. I was speechless , because that was cruelty and nobody deserves to be bullied because they are different from others. We all are not even created to be alike. I really hope and pray he gets the justice he deserves. This wasn't just bullying, but hatred and wickedness at the highest level. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVBH5uQiSHgSSZXjL69sizK6J7SDUzjNngi6gLvqxFZYn/1777295655377.png) We have the responsibilities as adults, teachers, parents, counselors and in any position we find ourselves teaching and educating kids to stop bullying others. It shouldn't end in teaching them, but also being good examples to these kids. Teach them practical empathy and kindness by accepting everyone, including those who are different, disabled and look weak with so much love , kindness and empathy. Especially, parents and teachers, it's important to show and practice kindness to kids and they will emulate. Also, making kids understand that there is punishment for their actions will help reduce bullies. If kids understand the correction and punishment they get for trying to bully others, I believe they won't bully themselves. Also, it's very important to teach kids to report. Victims of bullies should speak up and other kids watching or passing by should also report the bully. A strong report system should be built against bully, no matter how small the case might seem. If it's suspected to be an act of bullying, then it should be reported. The bully should be held accountable for their actions towards others, corrected and also punished appropriately. Creating a system like this will encourage everyone to speak up , not just for themselves but for the sake of others. Bully shouldn't be tolerated. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb92QSi6CrBJ9De4EfPvjc9i4zvofje5eJbGGcsNSbKsA/1777295952578.png) If my child were to be a victim of bully, first I would try as much as I can not to blame the child. I have grown to learn that blaming a kid will make the kid hesitate to speak up in the future. The first step I will take is to avoid blaming my child in situations like that, it's also not their fault. I will encourag my child to always speak up. The next step is reporting to the school authorities, calling on the parents of the kids involved to address the situation. And if I feel the situation wasn't handled the way it should be handled, like the bullies aren't held accountable, corrected or punished appropriately, my child will definitely leave such institution to an institution that controls bullies better. I'm taking my child out of such an institution because I prioritize my child's safety, mental, emotional health, and their self confidence. Most importantly, avoiding an irreversible and deadly situation. I believe bullies can be stopped and controlled with the right support and awareness . It can be controlled if the victims and bystanders speak up and report immediately. I believe it will be controlled and stopped if we teach our children to practice empathy and kindness to everyone, including those who aren't like them. The society put more efforts in spreading love and kindness to everyone, regardless of their different looks , beliefs and personalities. This is my response to this week LOH prompt: >1️⃣ What are your thoughts on school bullying? How would you address it? If you have children, what would be your best advice for your child if they were to become a victim of bullying, and what would you do? Thanks @marivic10 for this amazing prompt. Pictures are AI Generated. Thanks for reading ♥️ ### Vanilla 💗

Having a good heart of compassion towards your fellow human a good quality that classify a good christian. Helping others is seen as an expression of love and obedience to God. Scripture encourages generosity, reminding us that what we have ultimately comes from God and should be used to bless others. When we give willingly, we reflect God’s kindness and care for humanity.

But the bible did not tell us that is compulsory for us to meet everybody's need that are close to us. Each person is expected to work hard and take good care of their lives. The principle of personal responsibility is clear, as believers are encouraged to be diligent and not depend unnecessarily on others. Helping others should not enable laziness or neglect of duty.

The early church provides a balanced example of this teaching. Believers shared with one another so that no one lacked basic needs, yet this was done voluntarily and with wisdom. Giving was motivated by love, not compulsion. This shows that financial support is a moral calling guided by compassion, not an absolute obligation to solve all problems.

Channels: go to noxsoma.substack.com and subscribe. 

We have a piece in today’s Ox Drop about the growing and ugly divide between males & females. We are intentionally reducing these critters to a diminutive and vague reference because the behavior in question does not reflect that of what our Atman would recognize as “men” & “women”, let alone ladies and gentle (meaning “well-born”) men. It was commonly said in the before times, that “the cream rises to the top.” But, notes the cynic, “so does the scum.” 

In the waning days of white-supremacy-powered American hegemony, it’s not surprising that the “War between the Sexes” has escalated to a level that spotlights the word, “misandry.” This word, apologetically coined in 1881, is the welding of the Greek, “miso” meaning hate, and “andros” meaning “male human” (as opposed to women, or gods.) This time, our word does not come from the hallowed halls of psychology, but from one, Frances Power Cobbe, an Irish feminist  nigh-instantly  flipping misogyny to “misandry” to make a point. 

The word and the concept was incubated within the Womens Rights movement and wielded by both sides of the battle lines. 

(1970s-90s). Second-wave feminism & backlash.  As feminism critiqued patriarchy and male privilege, critics began to claim that some feminist rhetoric expressed hatred of all men, not just patriarchal structures. They adopted misandry as a counter-accusation to misogyny. 

(1990s-2000s). Men's rights movement. This movement made misandry a central term in its lexicon, arguing that society systematically discriminates against men (e.g., in family courts, domestic violence shelters, education). They positioned misandry as the overlooked mirror image of misogyny. 

(2000s-present).  Internet and social media  Online forums, Reddit, Twitter, and YouTube amplified the term enormously. It became a staple of \
discourse, often used to label feminist statements, dating norms, or media portrayals (e.g., \

sitcom tropes) as hateful toward men.    

Conversely, the word, “misogyny” goes back to antiquity. A deep dive into history suggests that men have always hated women. In general that is. It literally goes back to Genesis. Imagine Adam and Eve, as “1984” characters Winston and Julia. Winston gets busted, with apple in hand, still chewing, and immediately flips on Eve. 

“Twernt me Lord, spect-it was Eve.” 

It’s been downhill for women ever since. There’s not a history book ever read by your humble observer where there wasn’t some horrible fate leveled against women of any era, on either side of the common era, simply for being women. Unfaithful? Death. Barren? Death. Not pretty anymore? Death. Born female? Death. It’s a wonder there are any females left on the planet. That they exist is a testament to their resilience. 

What was that line? “Can’t live with’em, can’t live without’em.” 

But back to the scum rising to the top. The scum of maleness seems to have risen to the very top of the social media popularity pyramid. But it hasn’t stopped there. The Epstein apocalypse has confirmed what many have suspected, (and some have enjoyed, downstream) for decades.  Yours truly has been blissfully ignorant of the current wave of this phenomenon for many years. It’s only when the likes of blowhards like Voldemort, and his virulent ilk rise to the level of my awareness do I have a clue that this attitude and behavior is, or seems to be, perpetuating throughout the simulation.   
It’s never not been this way through time. (Although it has not been this way for your boy. The past was active, varied, daring and experimental at times, but deny decadence, and sexploitation.) The stories of matriarchal societies, are Utopian fantasies. But that’s a debate for another time. 

Have you ever heard of the “Witches Hammer?” Aka the “Malleus Maleficarum.” It’s this crazy treatise on the prosecution of witches, published in the German (that anti-human region) city of Speyer, in 1486. It was written by the German Catholic clergyman Heinrich Kramer. It’s been characterized the compendium of preexisting demonological literature of the 15th century. 

Here’s one of my favorite, but crude, recollections from the book.  In my own rendition. 

Heinz is coming home from wherever he was. Gertrude returning from the grocer’s with dinner. Heinz has a natural thought about Gertrude, gets a hard-on, and because he’s a 15th Century Catholic German, he doesn’t know what to do. So he runs to the church and tells the vicar. Of course the clergyman immediately diagnosis the problem. “Witchcraft!” Heinz mentions seeing Gertrude. “She’s a witch!” Gertrude is burned at the stake. Or drowned, or, what they call, “Pressed.” This is where the “melleus” kicks in, it means “to crush.”     

Anyway, all these words later, back to the word that started this whole trip, “misandry.” It seems to have flipped from a defensive term, to an offensive one. It’s not like     
It’s not like men don’t have this vitriol coming. After an entirety of institutionally, academically, theologically, politically, sexually and violently hating women, men should forever sleep with one eye open. But for real. “We” (still a man, afterall), won’t have to. The final irony, and maybe it’s a tragedy, and maybe it’s just nature – is nature her self. (If it’s not demons.) Females, of all species, (confidently speculating), have those annoying chemicals that make reproduction, an instinct, rather than a choice. Even if they manage to overcome the urge to reproduce that nature is still there. (I got stories.) 

The War Between the Sexes isn’t new, it’s perpetual. What changes is the technology and the artificial “laws” that are supposed to, but always fail to protect women from the nature of the beast.

title.body:
## What is DemoniCore?
[DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com) is a simple and fun [play-to-earn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blockchain_game) game, where you conjure demons to battle in [PvE](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Player_versus_environment) turn-based [RNG](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random_number_generation) combat, reminiscent of old-school [RPG games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Role-playing_game).

![DCORE](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/logo/dcore-logo11-trans.png)

## [Tokenomics](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics)
The sole token of DemoniCore is [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE), which can be traded on any exchange that supports Hive Engine tokens, such as [Hive Engine](https://hive-engine.com/) and [Tribaldex](https://tribaldex.com/).

**DCORE (as of 2026-04-27):**
* One DCORE is worth
    * 0.00020001 HIVE
    * $1.0e-05 USD
* Total DCORE
    * Supply: 2,292,001
    * Circulating: 2,291,991
    * Total staked: 832,407 (36.3%)

## [Philosophy](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#philosophy)
The overarching philosophy of [DemoniCore](https://www.demonicore.com/) is \

, and this mandate extends to the game's tokenomics. Instead of a complicated ecosystem with numerous different cryptocurrencies to keep track of, we opted for a single token, [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE), that is used for all in-game transactions, and which can be traded freely on [Hive Engine](https://hive-engine.com/).

## [Scarcity](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#scarcity)
Unlike many other play-to-earn games, [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) has a very limited supply, and is designed to stay that way. The total supply currently stands at 2.29 Million tokens.

[DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) is regulated by a unique emissions mechanism that only mints new tokens on an as-needed basis, with a hard cap on new token supply. If the game's reward pool decreases below a 66,000 DCORE threshold, **DemoniCore** will mint new DCORE in 10,000 token increments until the reward pool exceeds the minimum threshold.

The amount of new [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) minted can never exceed 240,000 per day. 
Keep in mind that this represents the _theoretical_ maximum allowed inflation by the system - the actual inflation is much lower.

![Demon](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/rand/demon/4.png)

## [Uses](https://www.demonicore.com/tokenomics#uses)
[DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) is the currency that [DemoniCore](https://www.demonicore.com/) rewards players with for successfully [slaying](https://www.demonicore.com/battles) and [exorcising](https://www.demonicore.com/exorcisms) demons. In turn, players can spend DCORE to upgrade their stats, purchase potions to reduce their Insanity level, and buy NFT cards on [Hive NFTs](https://hivenfts.com/demonicore/buy/) to enhance their gameplay experience.

[House Demons](https://www.demonicore.com/house_demons) is an exciting new game mode, providing yet another use case for **DCORE**! Summon your own loyal demons, powered by AI, whose looks and personas are limited only by [your imagination](https://www.demonicore.com/about_house_demons). Your house demons will generate income and communicate with you - even responding to your messages - with the personalities that you crafted for them!

![House Demon screenshot](https://d28h36qk0p1alw.cloudfront.net/images/assets/house-demon-message-frida.png)

We always strive to come up with new ways to provide [DCORE](https://hive-engine.com/trade/DCORE) sinks, and we reserve the right to iterate on balancing gameplay mechanics, rewards, and prices to keep the game economy healthy for players and investors.

## To our players
As always, thank you for your love and support - without you, there is no **DemoniCore**. For anyone who hasn't yet played, please give [DemoniCore](https://demonicore.com/) a try!

[Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/DxD2WEkZk5)

title.title: Idea: An adjustable quality monitoring dashboard for Hive accounts
title.body:
A what? Let me explain my most recent idea to you. 

Recently I've discovered the [Mantecurated tool](https://mantecurated.3speak.tv/@friendlymoose)) by the @mantequilla-soft team. With tool you can get an overview of the curation health of a user. 
It shows the diversity of authors, vote distribution and self votes. The better you score on these points, the higher your score. I find it a really cool tool to see how you are doing. And with 82/100 I'm doing quite well I think, although I could improve my distribution a bit.

![mantecurated.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23tGXv2q2pZ5gxi4opRjnyTHDbmeum6bqWGM6RPhrjUSPGzVqrHhWiLdaWBR4BQPmyKkZ.png)

This is a really cool tool that give you a really good insight of the quality of your voting or the voting of other accounts. 
But this tool also gave me the idea for another tool. What if we make a dashboard with even more statistics?

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Quality monitoring dashboard
Personally I find it quite hard to determine whether an account is adding value to Hive. Especially with the rise of AI and the high number of scammers. The only statistic that is shown on most front-ends is reputation level. And to be fair, this number doesn't tell me a lot. There are accounts with a high reputation that aren't adding much value anymore and newbies with a low rep that do. And also scammers are using accounts with quite a high rep of around 50. 
Recently PeakD introduced the KE to (check my recent [blog](/hive-148441/@friendlymoose/how-i-use-the-new-peakd-ke-feature-to-prevent-rewarding-scammers) about it). But also KE doesn't tell everything. Some people just need the rewards to pay for their bills in real life. 

So I thought; wouldn't it be cool if there was a dashboard like the Mantecurated tool, but then will all kinds of stats from an account?
With an overview of all stats from an account you will get a better view on their behaviour on Hive, 
I think such a tool would really help curators make better decisions while curating.

It might look something like this (generated by AI based on the content of this blog):

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23sweNdeyiyLKQ6FyQLHa1fBJq8pRvsDC3VcoqGCLuFjUeXFx7h49fwAm7ZmJD8mEqVkd.png)


![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Which stats?
I have created a list of stats that I think might be interesting to see on a dashboard

- Posts/Comment ratio (does the user only post or do they also comment)
- Interaction with own posts (does the user interact with its own posts)
- Unique downvotes (how many downvotes from unique accounts did this user receive)
- Number of comments per day/month
- Average post length
- Average comment length
- Autovotes received (does this account get a lot of upvotes from the same users at the same times)
- KE 
- HW Blacklist (is the account on the blacklist of Hivewatchers)
- Outgoing transactions to known exchanges
- Transfers to other Hivers
- Send out vs Received
- Average reward per post
- Self votes (how many times did the user self vote)
- Vote distribution (not always voting the same users)

These are the stats I've come up with, but maybe there are some more interesting ones to add to the dashboard. Feel free to share yours in the comments.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)


# Which timeframe
There are accounts that have been registered almost 10 years ago and a lot can happen over the years. Someone might have changed their habits over the years. It would be interesting to focus on a more recent timeframe like a year or even a month. Maybe it can even be made adjustable.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# Configurable thresholds and traffic lights
It would be cool if some of the stats could have personal configurable thresholds. For instance if a user has a KE < 50, the bar is green, but when it goes above that threshold it turns red. 

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)


# Indicator in front-ends
Ideally I would like to see the traffic light I mentioned above integrated in the front-ends. 
The idea is that the traffic light turns red if any of your configured thresholds is exceeded. 
The red light doesn't mean you shouldn't upvote, but should be seen as a warning! A sign for you to look into the stats of the author before curating.

As new accounts don't have any thresholds configured we might want to think of a default set of thresholds.

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)

# What do you think?
I realise this is quite a big project and there are probably a lot of things to say against some of the stats. But I do think it would be helpful to have a quick overview of these (and maybe even more stats). It would at least help  me make better choices when curating. 
And when we as Hivers can influence our own stats by changing our behaviour. 

I'm really curious what you think about this idea. 

I'm tagging a couple of developers to see if this idea is even feasible at all; @ecoinstant @thecrazygm @beggars @eddiespino @demotruk 

![divider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/23t7YWoNDewJkbQoM9yiSvwjFh4yHJuCWXPjgX31Eep5JGnZChA88ZNWdDr6H5FBgdVaj.png)



Please share your thought in the comments.

https://images.hive.blog/0x0/https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/friendlymoose/245n3faSf1E4HdNCPePvHHzVkaLUPjScGnEhLJdQ9YtAeD2ZUpVCBcm9i3TRJ1AHZFLr4.png
# Friendlymoose
</center>

https://images.hive.blog/DQmWTg7thc8jx6AvKq3pLu5T2RZ8GZ4L7KJn22rYGfwdXKY/5116~5.jpg

I popped down to the local nature reserve to see if there were any butterflies. Unfortunately, it was a bit overcast down there, so I hardly saw any at all. I did spot a ladybird, which was much easier to photograph. 

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRBPw45cKwgPkM7kN69tCF8VhC7sqpfjDSc1ZaBiinYA3/5121.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmRnLgZCEoCq4Dk1qzAckabweH88JkhV4NiKDw1Cf7DeCC/5117.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmPFFRePCawkAtn5nHxfAbx3a2ctN11EBSt7UCe9XM9hhS/5124%20.jpg

https://images.hive.blog/DQmd9Uhw1zCjL2MhFfPhnNFgsMJbLRFadSgjQmoyDqntX3V/5140.jpg

I carried on with a circular walk. Even though there was a lack of butterflies, the walk was still pretty, with the blossom, overhanging trees, and gorse bushes.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmQzuDt7E77xheaEwoMPsQAfiinz1zHqDwGPKKRa5z88qH/5120.jpg

It was funny that there was just one red berry on the hawthorn bush, standing out among the white blossom.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmYT4yXPdbUsPwqDYTNrSBUv3DZfhNwQFTLyRD5RTy6QKc/5146.jpg

At the very last minute, from a distance, I spotted a butterfly on a dandelion. I couldn’t get close to it, though, as it would have flown off. I will have to return another day.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmczzLdadFJSfHiaKbCQ924h9bWiX8rKPBPjo7spdxgRyM/P4271811.JPG

As I got back home, I spotted the ducks basking in the sun that had come out, while keeping one eye on me.  I did carry on walking around the park, but still no butterflies.

https://images.hive.blog/DQmTQF6wQW4xj6B6wQh99WqmNgkL1JrpKsWChsLv5k5Lq4b/PaRgthAvamAmR7uZi4RENh3BWaKjnQbhHtF9iaSV1cVaeSir8SCZYpmzMLvBrDLdiD44L3w4RUXvxqnkBg2eqoHbbUCFgVMLCokxymJ6uR...g2EUvmwMbS8rDTmwiZZiXJVfaSEG5zu7KhSz75fp2aWUpTTXMModEMjmcJDocpskjENinHpDX2Xfhqs6PzWxPZxGDEgVmqwVo162Vb1AHTA1YxrG6iGLyJ3Dqw.gif

title.title: The discovery of two unique species of beetles in the forest // Photography behind the macro lens camera - metallic blue beetle and snout beetle
title.body:
## Good night to all my beloved hive friends ♥️ ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf3CsUbNW4XemhqHw3yCo4tQzfRwzKCniXT35pq6QNo3a/1777292678619.jpg) In this post, I’ll share my experience and success in capturing the beauty of two stunning beetle species-the metallic blue beetle and the snout beetle.I managed to find these two beetles in a palm oil plantation and this was a deliberate effort to achieve the best possible results. Inside the oil palm plantation, specifically by the edge of a waterhole, I managed to spot a metallic blue beetle flitting among the leaves, this beetle has very unique characteristics, from its shape and size to its color. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdADAiZdtdZURd2fGjhDXhQ27vTQdU1wf66E5X8jbYp9R/1777292678669.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc2KVJ4uw49KZ1cJ2eFur8LM2VJd5zyeEB94ryYeM68Qy/1777292678716.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSfAQGBSjz396723rJheTz2DzJcpuy7jfuSTB3cSbjQYU/1777292678760.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRUtZeZEHXeomb3sBvMj8ZATYwWjMAnweBWPssDjvJfLk/1777292678804.jpg) I’m absolutely certain that anyone who sees this beetle will love it, especially if they see it in person. This beetle has a metallic blue color that looks absolutely stunning and shimmers in the sunlight, but it’s so small that to truly appreciate its beauty, you have to view it from quite a close distance. This beetle has a slender and elongated shape,the surface of its wings looks hard and shiny,but if we look at this beetle more closely, we’ll notice an orange hue on its neck,of course this is a truly beautiful color combination for a beetle . ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT4FzAiD5VR3Z81HfnPTLyx7VRNKVJsk4E3A6p6m56Mkk/1777292701270.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYyaukn5Rh3z9A4HL8sLrvzmahYeMycsEZg4QFxH3p92H/1777292701317.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNxikBAdcbsQXTBKx8DGKWadutPwpDQb2zjMaHkiFVKSR/1777292701366.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeS7a5BDbRJhVndP9kQmFrzwdxRUKpm7LSFQpTejLvKJ1/1777292701412.jpg) This beetle also has segmented fairly long antennae, indicating a keen sense of smell for detecting its surroundings,a mate, and food sources.I feel very happy and satisfied because I have succeeded in finding this beetle, this beetle is quite rare in my area and finding it is not an easy thing now. I photographed this beetle using a macro lens, so the results turned out so beautiful and detailed,we can see its shape and color quite clearly, and that’s incredibly satisfying. In addition, I also managed to find a weevil. This beetle also has some unique characteristics and is just as interesting as the previous one. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ9M54zD1SmE5rv9XXhqjZHQ92nszpqEoqhcBzy7jmY6a/1777294661813.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaSEnYcBZQW5BmmNShqsPo5kCSFH6QDueQYgq5h3wfhxr/1777294661866.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPHtpY9Xfga2385GDNeGbF9bU2vuweta8WWb8iNbSTzNf/1777294661922.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevnQbQmTh6PgYb1BKQJfJaMVqvmySvnzxfemWp7teK1n/1777294661974.jpg) I managed to find this beetle by the riverbank, and I think it’s one of the most unique beetles in the world.Luckily, the population of this beetle is quite stable in my area, so I can easily find it almost anywhere.This beetle has a long snout on its head called a rostrum, and at first glance its snout looks very similar to that of a yurumi animal,and this is a flying insect but it often spends its time on plants or grass, it walks slowly enough that we can easily photograph it. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDymxyWM1uR2S5uKwJ6Crqixq3HB2dVo1zo5UDyB3KCx/1777294684603.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdV9NmPGcNGfGuzH1tgyx98ktjkB2aFsKUTHvaGFhCEnX/1777294684653.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbXtMqbTcfWs4PbkKpHSgdJWVAvyWCJXGCvj4swkA8p6R/1777294684701.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNmz5d715VgpfopA5ptvSybmuQiBArHcq3hnGADEKrcwU/1777294684751.jpg) What's even more interesting is that this beetle has a fairly hard shell, and this is one of its body's defenses.Just like the previous beetle,this beetle also has long antennae but has a bent shape. Photographing this beetle is quite easy, but sometimes we often miss this brief moment, I managed to take several pictures of this beetle using the help of a macro lens and now let's see its beauty. ----

Life is a responsibility Be yourself, keep learning and don't hesitate to start😉

And you can also find me on [Ecency Discord](https://discord.com/invite/m9MyMSWx)

----

Thank you very much for reading my post till the end, I am here to say thank you very much 🙏

---- ----

All images are mine, I took the photos using the Infinix 10 pro cellphone and I edited the images using the Lightroom application. I'm @riyat. See you again in my next post ♥️

title.title: Anemic & Noxious Fumes: The Battle of Endurance
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPpAxgZCyztoYs8QKVbqQzCusi5dPgq9tTncczdF2uuQ7/thumbnail_battle_of_the_day.png)

Hello Splinterlands warriors,

This time I want to share a battle that, honestly, made my heart race a bit. The rulesets were no joke: **Anemic** and **Noxious Fumes**, with a 38 mana cap, and only **Life, Death, and Earth** elements available. Right from the start, it already felt like this wouldn’t be an ordinary fight.

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXxeWP8UkQ5kdFvvsgxKgEnPhfKqLtDvYcdUQtH4t1xWA/anemic_icon.png)</center>

For those who aren’t too familiar, **Anemic** limits all monsters to a maximum of just 4 HP. So whether it’s a legendary or a common, everything gets “flattened” like a broke college kid at the end of the month. On top of that, **Noxious Fumes** applies poison that eats away at every unit each round. What does that mean? It’s not about who’s the strongest—but who can last the longest… or who’s clever enough to find an opening.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmedX5jSPQBEV9ePmAx8bhbPg2sD9uWYDdURW5pHbUhRN1/round_1.png)


I went in with a strategy that was, honestly, a bit reckless but full of hope. My main carry was clearly **Quora Towershead**, supported by **Pelacor Mercenary** as a tank with heal. Then I added two martyrs—**Venari Marksrat** and **Fungus Flinger**—positioned around Quora. The idea was simple: if they fall, Quora would “level up” through the martyr effect.

At the start of the match, I was still fairly calm. But the moment I saw my opponent’s lineup, I immediately realized… this was going to be a long one.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEwi3mAgugjaNgd9oy1wckuSTTEVXzivWEa9gRLHXsRE/round_2.png)


My opponent brought **Xulax Nightwind** as a tank—thick void armor, basically a walking wall. From the backline, **Silent Sha-vi** was quietly stabbing with sneak attacks. And to make things even tougher, their archon was **Thaddius Brood**, reducing HP and magic attack. In a ruleset where HP is capped at 4, that HP reduction feels like cutting your lifespan in half.

Round 2 was where things started to fall apart. The poison kicked in. One by one, units began to drop. What made me even more cautious was realizing my opponent had immunity units: **Harklaw** and **Ujurak Brave**. They just stood there unfazed in the middle of the toxic storm, while my team slowly collapsed.

At that point, I could only hope for one scenario:
“Hopefully the martyr effects trigger before everything is gone.”

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVkNcetjiRSsBDEjrj3bKrk4E1BEEVX99gyGg1Ca3uVWR/quora_vs_enemy.png)


And sure enough, they did. **Venari Marksrat** and **Fungus Flinger** fell—and the effect was immediate. Quora became stronger, faster, more… alive.

But even then, it wasn’t enough yet.

Going into Round 3, I held my breath. The poison struck again. And in that moment, a bit of good news arrived—my opponent’s **Arachne Weaver** went down. I allowed myself a small smile. But it vanished instantly when I saw Quora sitting at just 1 HP.

One HP.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZnccSAhNvdPfSErVrQV6MNYmdrkWTx2srpScwoKL46d8/round_3.png)


If this were a movie, this would be the slow-motion scene.

Luckily, Quora’s heal activated. Her HP went up to 3. And that’s when everything changed. She attacked… and **Bloodlust** triggered. From that point on, like an engine finally warmed up, she went berserk.

Each kill increased her stats. Each round became more dangerous. But still, the poison didn’t care who you were. I realized I didn’t need full HP—I just needed to survive with 1 HP at the end of each round.

And somehow… that’s exactly what happened.

One by one, the enemies fell. Quora stood alone at the end—exhausted, on the brink of collapse, but still alive. And that victory… didn’t feel like it came from being the smartest player, but from making the right small decisions at the right time.

You can watch the battle here:
<center> 👉  [**LINK BATTLE**](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sm_xwZvt636jRxelzGViEgN?ref=rqr4)  👈</center>


What makes this battle interesting is how the rulesets can completely flip the value of cards. Under normal conditions, I probably wouldn’t rely so heavily on martyrs. But here? They were the key.

If you ask for my honest opinion, **Quora Towershead** in this kind of ruleset feels a bit “unfair”… but in a fun way. She’s not just strong—she has incredible comeback potential.

The lesson I took from this?
In extreme conditions, don’t look for the strongest team—look for the one that can survive the longest and keep scaling.

My short advice:
**when facing Noxious Fumes, always think long-term—immunity, healing, and scaling are far more valuable than early burst damage.**

See you in the next arena.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuXxp6GBhwB1HpXvoabLn8Dt8QaRKSe1WNYDzqX1v6Vk/chaos_logo.png)

It's free, but you'll need to invest in a beginning deck or buy gaming cards to gain real assets like cards and tokens.

title.title: Concurso de la comunidad Ladies of Hive #286\\Ladies of Hive Community Contest #286
title.body:
Saludos comunidad damas de Hive, bienvenidos a mi blog, esta semana la dama @marivic10 nos trae propuestas interesantes., yo elegí dar respuesta a la primera interrogante. >Greetings Hive ladies community, welcome to my blog. This week, lady @marivic10 brings us interesting proposals. I chose to answer the first question. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcz5sV1wKB4rxeoqPCe5wH4BG4NnssigBmdTgzsBmEs55/1777294897894.jpg) **¿Qué piensas sobre el acoso escolar? ¿Cómo lo abordarías? Si tiene hijos, ¿cuál sería su mejor consejo para su hijo si fuera víctima de acoso y qué haría?** El acoso escolar es una forma de violencia y discriminación que deja heridas profundas, afecta a niños, niñas y adolescentes, debemos distinguir lo que es broma y lo que hace daño, si nos reímos todos por un comentario que han dicho de alguien quizás sea broma pero si ese comentario avergüenza o pone triste a alguien hay que parar y pedir disculpas. >**What do you think about bullying? How would you address it? If you have children, what would be your best advice for your child if they were a victim of bullying, and what would you do?** Bullying is a form of violence and discrimination that leaves deep wounds. It affects children and teenagers. We must distinguish between what is a joke and what is harmful. If we all laugh at a comment made about someone, it might be a joke, but if that comment embarrasses or saddens someone, we must stop and apologize. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFq5FHq3Jor9LvsTZVmHXGzUbPRisPSFMSoWDqtJDLze/1777295850798.jpg) En mi época también existía mucho bullyng o acoso escolar (empujones, burlas, favoritismo por parte del profesor) solo que era normalizado por nuestros representantes y docentes como travesuras de niños, ese silencio, indiferencia y exclusión también es un acoso, los acosados nos apartabamos del grupo y éramos considerados como antisocial pero nadie intervenia para que fuéramos respetados y aceptados, actualmente el acoso escolar es más sofisticado, visible y devastador incluyendo el ciberbullying que afectan de manera significativa la salud integral de quien lo sufre. Actualmente mis hijos ya crecieron, sufrieron algo de acoso escolar, mi consejo siempre fue denunciar y apartarse, mi reacción siempre fue defenderlos, ir al colegio denunciar al acosador, antes no contaba con muchas herramientas para abordar el tema sin embargo los apoye, no me hacia la indiferente, siempre estuve presente, les hacía sentir seguros en casa para que confiara en mi y me contarán todo lo que les sucedía en el colegio, jamás los culpe por lo que hicieron otros, les creía todo lo que me decían, el silencio de un adulto ante un caso de acoso no es neutralidad es un aval y eso hace más fuerte al acosador, hablar, denunciar y apoyar hace la diferencia. **Nadie merece sentir miedo de ser quien es, todos merecemos respeto y consideración** . >In my day, there was also a lot of bullying (pushing, teasing, favoritism from the teacher), only it was normalized by our parents and teachers as children's pranks. That silence, indifference, and exclusion is also bullying. Those who were bullied were isolated from the group and considered antisocial, but no one intervened to ensure we were respected and accepted. Currently, bullying is more sophisticated, visible, and devastating, including cyberbullying, which significantly affects the overall health of those who suffer it. My children are now grown, and they experienced some bullying at school. My advice was always to report it and distance themselves. My reaction was always to defend them, to go to the school and report the bully. Before, I didn't have many tools to address the issue, but I supported them. I wasn't indifferent; I was always there for them. I made them feel safe at home so they would trust me and tell me everything that happened at school. I never blamed them for what others did; I believed everything they told me. An adult's silence in a case of bullying is not neutrality; it's complicity, and that makes the bully stronger. Speaking out, reporting, and supporting them makes all the difference. **No one deserves to be afraid of being who they are. We all deserve respect and consideration.** ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcPRrEN3gQsfPaBzqHbN3YtQPNrRxnKX6qro8nEoBmgA/1777295903832.jpg)
>

title.title: Fiction Story / Champagne Bubbles (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
>

#### <center>The bubbles in the champagne.</center>

#

<center>![1000700194.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23uQJZiz9LMujskVB47V5anyhoZBuM8HiWKWGx994R91L3nNJNBj9vWfGeos4Qf5UBKJJ.jpg)</center><center>[source](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/celebracion-champ%c3%a1n-vasos-verter-1852926/)</center>

***


The golden wedding anniversary celebration for my boyfriend José Manuel’s parents was being held at the family estate. When I arrived, I felt out of place in this luxurious setting. 

The main hall was adorned with long tables draped in linen tablecloths and crystal glassware that sparkled in the light of the large chandeliers hanging from the ceiling.  The waiters, dressed in black, carried silver trays and continuously offered  drinks to the guests. 


But what struck me most were the women’s outfits. They were excessively lavish, with gold and gemstone accessories dangling from their ears and necklaces encircling their necks. It felt like I was at an event for the British royal family. They strutted around the ballroom just to be the center of attention. How vain. My simple black, ankle-length dress and the silver choker with a small emerald that José Manuel had given me for this celebration were a far cry from this scene. 

I would have preferred to stay with my cat Carlota in my  small, cozy apartment right in the heart of the city. I didn’t like the countryside, and even less so in this cold season.  Who would have thought to hold the celebration at this house, in such a remote place, surrounded by forests. But I came only to please José Manuel. 

\

His hoarse voice snapped me out of my thoughts. 

He took my hand as if I were a little girl and led me to an indoor garden with tables and chairs around the pool, where a group of young men and women were chatting. 

“Hi, everyone! How’s it going?”

They all turned to greet him and looked at me curiously.

“Meet Rubí, my girlfriend.”

“Nice to meet you all.”  

Despite my first impression of the party guests, these people seemed friendlier to me, and although the women were dressed very elegantly, they greeted me warmly. All of them, except for one young woman with large black eyes and long black hair, who was wearing a silver dress that hugged her slender figure; her gaze gave me a strange feeling. 

She came over to greet me and, looking at José Manuel, said, 

“Your girlfriend is pretty,” and at that moment she looked at me  and smiled. But her smile was cold; there was no kindness in her tone of voice. 

\

. 

I stayed silent even though I wanted to shout at her that I wasn’t what she thought I was, but the look José Manuel gave me stopped me. I just managed a smile that made me look stupid. 

“Can I borrow your boyfriend for a moment? I’ll give him back to you right away.” 

Without waiting for my answer, she grabbed him by the arm and  they left. What upset me the most was that he didn’t put up a fight. 

I stood there, not knowing what to do; the young people had left. The cold of the landscape was visible through the large windows. I walked over to them and stood watching the snow fall. 

A waiter carrying a tray with a glass of champagne approached me. 

“Miss,” he said, “would you like a glass?” 

The golden liquid bubbled, tempting me to drink it, and even though I knew the consequences, I took the glass. 

\

I said, and he smiled as if he knew what was going to happen. 

I drank the champagne, savoring the sensation of the liquid as it went down my throat.  And that was enough for me. 

I walked with a very confident stride toward the main hall. There was José Manuel, talking animatedly with the girl. I approached him and said.

\

He stared at me with concern. He knew what I had done; he knew the effects champagne had on me. A strange trait I had inherited from the women in my family.

*I don't know when or how it started, but in a society that suppressed women's emotions, champagne helped them let loose. And over time, that character became a family tradition.* 

 
We walked to the dance floor where an orchestra was playing a tropical rhythm;  it didn’t seem to fit the party’s atmosphere, but it made my whole body move like a professional dancer. José Manuel had trouble keeping up with the beat, but he didn’t let go of me. 

People formed a circle around us and began to clap.  The faces that had been cold and haughty were now cheerful and lively. 

We danced over and over again. 

\

I felt sorry for him seeing him so sweaty, so we stopped dancing. 

The celebration continued with dinner. They seated me between José Manuel and a heavyset man who looked like a diplomat. The food was brought out on large platters that were placed in the center of the tables. 

I struck up a very funny conversation with the heavyset man and a woman sitting across from me. Our laughter was contagious, and within minutes everyone was laughing. We couldn’t stop. Only José Manuel remained very serious. And the more I saw him like that, the more I laughed.

\

he said, grabbing a piece of chicken and popping it into my mouth. 

I stopped laughing right away, and so did everyone else. Dinner went very well, and then came the toast. In front of me was a glass brimming with champagne. I watched the bubbles rise and dance playfully, urging me to drink.   

José Manuel’s parents looked happy. They said some very beautiful words about the importance of love and understanding as the foundation of their years of marriage.  

Everyone raised their glasses to toast. I knew that if I drank it, things would get out of hand. I looked at José Manuel and put the glass down. “I need to watch what I drink,” I told him. He just breathed a sigh of relief. 


\

After saying goodbye to her parents, we went to the pool area where her friends were, including the young woman with dark eyes. 

\
The young woman had come over to the edge of the pool. \n\n\

*This girl clearly didn't get it at all*, I thought, but not out of anger—it actually amused me. It seemed like the champagne bubbles wanted me to have some fun one more time. With a shove, I sent the girl tumbling into the pool. The water must have been really cold, because her scream echoed throughout the house. We all laughed a lot, and when they helped her out, she was furious. In my defense, I have to say, she had it coming. ![1000593103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23twCGEjH2xuU7mRjzfHme268u6XkieKjTRWRM9gYSEdHBwmn2Ljw4USibmjQtSGuPVx4.jpg)
Thank you for reading
*** ![1000324457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23yU4h4sgk1R5FcNZXmMuzUHvtTpLrN84AHj2ems3ckmeUJxTFe8qjwBwgggvNHnTbW3Z.jpg) *** ####
Las burbujas del Champagne.
# La celebración de las bodas de oro de los padres de mi novio José Manuel, se estaban realizando en la finca de la familia. Cuando llegué me sentí fuera de lugar  en este ambiente de lujos. El salón principal estaba adornado con largas mesas con manteles de lino y cristalería que lanzaban destellos con la luz de las grandes lámparas que colgaban del techo.  Los mesoneros vestidos de negro llevaban bandejas de plata donde ofrecían  continuamente bebidas a los invitados. Pero lo que mas me chocaba eran los trajes de las mujeres. De un lujo excesivo, con accesorios de oro y piedras preciosas que colgaban de sus orejas y collares que rodeaban sus cuellos. Parecía que estuvieran en un evento de la realeza inglesa. Se pavoneaban en el salón solo para ser objetos de admiración. Que vanas. Mi sencillo vestido negro y largo hasta los tobillos  y la gargantilla de plata con una pequeña esmeralda que José Manuel me había regalado para esta celebración, se alejaba mucho de este patrón. Hubiera preferido quedarme con mi gata Carlota, en mi  apartamento pequeño y acogedor en pleno centro de la ciudad . No me gustaba el campo y mucho menos en esta época tan fría.  A quién se le habría ocurrido hacer la celebración en este casa, en un lugar tan alejado, rodeado de bosques. Pero vine por complacer a José Manuel. —¡Vamos Rubí! te voy a presentar algunos amigos. —Su voz ronca, me sacó de mis pensamientos. Me tomó de la mano como si fuera una niña y me llevó a un  jardín interior con mesas y sillas, alrededor de la piscina, donde había un grupo de hombres y mujeres jóvenes conversando. —¡Hola amigos! ¿Cómo la están pasando? Todos voltearon a saludarlo y me miraron con curiosidad. —Les presento a Rubí, mi novia. —¡Encantado de conocerlos!  A pesar de mi primera impresión de los invitados a la fiesta, estas personas me parecieron mas cordiales y aunque las mujeres estaban vestidas muy elegantemente, me saludaron con amabilidad. Todas excepto una joven de grandes ojos negros y larga cabellera negra, que llevaba un vestido plateado ajustado a su cuerpo esbelto, cuya mirada me produjo una extraña sensación. Se acercó a saludarme y mirando a José Manuel le dijo. —Tu novia es bonita. —En ese momento me miró  y se sonrió. Pero su sonrisa era fría, no había en su tono de voz nada de amabilidad. —Pero creo que es un poco tímida. Seguro que no está acostumbrada a estar en este tipo de reuniones. Me quedé en silencio, aunque quería gritarle que yo no era como ella pensaba, pero la mirada que José Manuel me dirigió, me lo impidió. Y solo esbocé una sonrisa, que me hizo parecer estúpida. —¿Me prestas a tu novio un momento? ahora te lo devuelvo, —y sin esperar mi respuesta lo sujeto del brazo y se fueron. Lo que mas me indigno fue que el no opuso resistencia. Me quedé parada sin saber que hacer,  los jóvenes también se fueron. El frio del paisaje se veía a través de los grandes ventanales. Caminé hacia estos y me quedé observando como caía la nieve. Un mesonero con una bandeja que traía  una copa de champagne se acercó. —Señorita me dijo ¿gusta una copa? El  dorado líquido burbujeaba incitándome a beberlo y aún cuando sabía las consecuencias, tomé la copa. —¡Gracias! —le dije y el se sonrió como si supiera lo que iba a suceder. Me tomé el champagne disfrutando de la sensación del líquido, mientras bajaba por mi garganta.  Y eso fue suficiente para mi. Caminé con paso muy seguro hacia el salón principal. Allí estaba José Manuel hablando muy animadamente con la chica. Me acerque y le dije —¡Vamos a bailar mi amor! El se me quedó viendo angustiado. Sabía lo que había hecho, conocía los efectos del champagne sobre mi. Una extraña condición que había heredado de las mujeres de mi familia y que podía tener efectos desastrozos. *No sé cuando ni como se originó, pero era la manera como en una sociedad que restringia las emociones de las mujeres, el champagne las ayudaba a desinhibirse. Y con el tiempo ese carácter se fue fijando en la familia.*   Caminamos hasta la pista donde una orquesta tocaba un ritmo tropical, me pareció que no iba acorde con el ambiente de la fiesta, pero hizo que todo mi cuerpo se moviera como una bailarina profesional. A José Manuel le costaba llevar el ritmo, pero no me soltaba. Las personas hicieron una rueda alrededor y empezaron a aplaudir. Los rostros antes fríos y fatuos ahora eran alegres y vivos. Bailamos una y otra vez, hasta que me dijo. —Rubí por favor para, ya no aguanto más. —¡Te lo mereces! por lo que me hiciste. —Tu me prometiste que no beberías champagne. —Me dejaste sola. —Está bien perdóname. No lo volveré a hacer. Me dio lástima verlo tan sudado y paramos de bailar. La celebración continuo con la cena. Me sentaron entre José Manuel y un señor gordo, que parecía un diplomático. La comida fue traída en grandes fuentes que colocaron en el centro de las mesas. Entablé una conversación muy divertida con el señor gordo y con una señora que estaba enfrente. Nuestras risas eran contagiosas y en pocos minutos todos reíamos. No podíamos parar de hacerlo. Solo José Manuel mantenía una actitud muy seria. Y cuando lo veía mas risa me daba. —¡Para de reír Rubí! —Jajaja no puedo parar —Tienes que comer algo, —y agarrando un trozo de pollo me lo metió en la boca. De inmediato deje de reírme y también las otras personas. La cena termino muy bién y entonces vino el brindis. Delante de mi, estaba la copa rebosante de champagne. Miré las burbujas que ascendían y salían juguetonas incitándome a beber.   Los padres de José Manuel se veían felices. Dijeron unas palabras muy hermosas sobre la importancia del amor y la comprensión, como la base de sus años de matrimonio.  Todos alzaron las copas para brindar. Yo sabia que si me la tomaba se produciría una situación desenfrenada. Miré a José Manuel y bajé la copa. —Debo controlar mi bebida le dije. Él respiró aliviado. —Gracias... te amo. Después de despedirnos de sus padres fuimos al área de la piscina donde estaban sus amigos entre ellos la joven de ojos negros. —¡Buenas noches amigos! Nos estamos viendo. —¿Por qué te vas temprano José Manuel? La joven se había acercado al borde de la piscina. —Porque voy a llevar a Rubí a su casa. —Y por qué no la envías en un taxi y te quedas un rato mas. Evidentemente esta chica no comprendió nada, pensé, pero no con rabia, mas bién me hizo gracia. Parecía que las burbujas del champagne querían que  me divirtiera una vez más. De un empujón lancé a la chica a la piscina. El agua debió haber estado muy fría, porque su grito se escuchó en toda la casa. Todos nos reímos mucho y cuando la ayudaron a salir estaba furiosa. A mi favor debo decir que ella se lo buscó. ![1000593103.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/popurri/23twCGEjH2xuU7mRjzfHme268u6XkieKjTRWRM9gYSEdHBwmn2Ljw4USibmjQtSGuPVx4.jpg)

title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYcGsu3QZ7VKRBpR4rNUNiNFSp18Fv76DAMvpQJwXvVjs/4324.jpg)

Hello Hive Community.

I hope you all are fine. I am also fine here. This is my entry for the #monomad challenge April 26th. In my post today, I have presented to you everything that I see around me. The main ones include the pigeon and the squirrel sitting on the side of the water. Along with that, I have also presented to you some things that I see around the house.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXotY6LSrpy6GRFZ8ud6e6iqqKGyFwtxKv19dtJHGAynG/1_1.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTu8A4VQPQYKhZZKoWRAES2LXRNG8KnmJDqwLPa5bxYuS/4_4.jpg)

In the two photographs above, you can see some things lying on the desk. The first photograph above presents a calm and thoughtful scene of a desk. In the center of the desk is a delicate flower. The flower seen in the photograph is a rose. Its petals look tightly layered. As if it has just started blooming. There are a few small personal things around the flower. A little blurry in the background, a closed laptop is sitting.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV3CApga1bgreMhhp9GfqGK9cypQomKQLruQP246yE6YD/2_2.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZg1n1NWmhdJ9j25QxAJd7HPyMwke2Zu1GYzrCiSAKyho/6_6.jpg)

In the photographs above, pigeons can be seen. In the center of the photograph, a small group of pigeons is standing together near the water fountain. The bodies of these pigeons are slightly tilted towards the water. It seems that these pigeons are going to drink water or are carefully observing their surroundings. The pigeons seen in this scene appear calm and unperturbed. One pigeon in the foreground stands slightly ahead of the others. This gives a sense of depth and perspective. The birds behind it are slightly blurred. The camera's viewer naturally focuses on the pigeon closest to the scene. The water next to the group of pigeons reflects soft light. At the same time, it creates gentle ripples that spread out.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcw6VrjF5qT3HvWU1jjW6jZWjRBHMxuczzovjDgT8qU7H/3_3.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVcaSwDXXVTy7FAJtanvok93QwT9WqXyV2u6Su396capo/5_5.jpg)

If you look carefully at the photographs taken above, at first glance, the eye is drawn to the rows of metal pipes equipped with small taps. These rows of pipes stretch into the distance. These water pipes create a strong leading line. Which draws the viewer's eye into the depth of the image. A small squirrel is seen in the middle of this man-made arrangement. delicately perched on a pipe. The squirrel's small body contrasts sharply with its rugged surroundings. The squirrel seems focused and alert. It appears as if it is carefully exploring this unfamiliar terrain. The background is intentionally blurred. This adds depth to the photograph and isolates the main subject. This blurring removes distractions and focuses the attention on the squirrel and the pipes.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaBhJ8F73KhsCaqZNnf4qkh13X9wLo585fByTa71EvRPJ/7_7.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcnXdEMxmc9Mj6UCAQeYJHeKYMSXYXC19BfWjSNSP5Jyb/9_9.jpg)

This photograph presents a magnificent view of an intricately carved arched window. The light filters through its delicate pattern and glows warmly. The scene is rich in detail and has a strong sense of history, craftsmanship and artistic beauty. The most striking feature of this photograph is the beautifully designed latticework within the arch. The pattern is carefully carved. It creates an intricate network of shapes that resemble a design of interconnected branches, leaves and flowers. The sunlight shines brightly behind the carved curtain, making the patterns stand out in contrast. It illuminates the edges of the carvings and creates a soft halo around them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbFzbUoPeyhZkP1HqYhVdr1c8yxYUdrk95WHqzQRMSzxa/8_8.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb7VWrkCTbYq42b5ZPpduQmJZn3rs5kpHzxJChoLe9EvZ/10_10.jpg)

In the first photograph above, a teddy bear can be seen lying on the floor. While in the second photograph, a group of pigeons can be seen sitting near a fountain. This photograph tells a simple yet meaningful story. It shows how small moments in everyday life, such as birds gathering near water, can maintain a sense of peace and beauty.

Each photograph presented here tells a subtle yet meaningful story. All these photographs show how a small creature can bring life to an ordinary environment. With that, I will end my post here. I hope that my post will be accepted for the #monomad challenge April 26th.

I sincerely thank you for visiting and reading my post.

title.title: 近距离看到了纺织机器
title.body:
那天去参观四二七大罢工的展览馆后，导游说还有一个馆值得我们去看看，而如果她不说，我们还不知道。因为一直以为就这一个展览馆呢。 导游将我们从另一个门拉出来之后，走向了后面的一个平房区域，那里写着文化综合馆。 

从外面看这个馆真的不大，但是进到里面空间豁然开朗。墙上摆放着整齐的白纱线，入门的右手边就是一台纺织机，这台纺织机是我国上个世纪50年代自主研发的第一代国产主力棉织机，是当时全国纺织厂的标配。以坚固耐用，维护简便著称，大幅提高了国产棉布的生产效率。 
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcv48nSr7bqu3DyuJvSqrEW885PqF4hWesKfTz1ULDLz1/_.jpg)
***听一听，看一看纺织机器的诉说！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXLusFaYveRcNF6sgBCp3dDUjAt6sLfQ9ZgrUw2Thsrs/shuoming.jpg)


这台机器在大连纺织厂服役了数十年，声场了大量国产棉布，支撑了大连纺织业的辉煌，直到更先进的无梭机器普及，它才逐步退出生产线。 是大连纺织业的实物见证，也是那段反帝工人运动历史的纪念物。 

然后往里走，还有个机器织布演示，墙上也都是纺织线，这里还有个咖啡厅，然后是巨型书架，和阶梯座椅，大家可以喝着咖啡看书，也可以坐在任意一个座椅上读自己喜欢的书，所有的书都是免费阅读，但是不能借阅。 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTsduXKf1fKk6fAd766JBf9haVQLtFECFR2FDsD5VeZn3/m.jpg)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmX2fAtxBFJQzwzHy54Qsfi8o2nyzXr3WBcydSfNuHL5M2/zuowei.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmevET6S5QwywqtnZu6HTdoPrpnYq1ZEya6oVVGYLrANS5/speak.jpg)

导游简单介绍了一下这里的设施，规模，好玩的景点等等，然后就让我们自由参观了。 这里除了机器，大量的书籍之外，还有个好看的景观就是月球之眼，导游说这个地方还很出片，建议大家可以拍拍照呢！

***的确很 出片啊，你看她们拍的多好！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZPmCTwdWUsGYdVc9qQRgriowYJPnKPkzUi5ETzD1tWJQ/photo.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbZRUYeC3GGaPFEWuaBqsvu5bfu3HyLjk3V1Gg9tT5ab/take.jpg)
***我触摸一下“月球”的表面！***
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRTaQi4qurxeju4agj9osY1znCJ8sU2AMhxZHXFYAQoAB/yan.jpg)

后来又来了很多人，我发现干什么事儿真的是不能太晚，一定要赶早，否则就这个时间，人都上来了，就会感觉很热闹，不过我还是喜欢静静的看。 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYe3s6NvKKjtnQV6sbL4hZ2dhkKk2kb7ep1YBneAwjRyC/visite.jpg)

这里除了展览一些当时的机器，还有很多的手工文创作品，我也没怎么仔细看，觉得这些东西只是能有点纪念意义，但是如果不需要的话，还是别糟蹋金钱了。 

不过这里的确是一个适合休息的地方，如果大家参观完第一个馆之后，觉得有点累的话，就可以到这里喝喝咖啡，看看书，缓解一下疲劳，攒足了能量之后，就可以继续徒步旅行啦！

title.body:
# Hello hive.

Good day to you all my great people in the @needleworkmonday community, happy new week and happy needleworkmonday, hope you all are doing well today, I'm here today to share my beautiful work with you all and also the steps i carried, it about the process of how i make this beautiful and designing free kaftan bubu gown for my mother in-law.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcrrmMrNSFKQePiuirJyzhp72GSK6aNEM8Hruj3R6qd4Q/1777292507053.jpg)

title.title: ‎Choosing the Right Architect: Who Should Lead Chelsea’s Next Chapter? ‎
title.body:
‎There’s something about being a Chelsea fan that conditions you to expect change and sometimes too much of it. Managers come and go like seasons, each of them bringing their own new philosophy, a new promise, and often, a familiar ending. But it feels different this time around. This decision feels heavier. It’s not just about who can win matches next week but it’s about who can rebuild identity, restore stability, and give us something we’ve been missing for a while and which is direction.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmVfA7Km1hmAWbRerA129SVNjFx28jaxkQDdo2wEztA3yt/images%2014.jpeg 

‎[source](https://www.google.com/url?sa=t&source=web&rct=j&opi=89978449&url=https://www.facebook.com/goalrushcfc/posts/%25EF%25B8%258F-chelsea-admire-both-cesc-f%25C3%25A0bregas-and-andoni-iraola-with-xabi-alonso-and-iraol/958010753640879/&ved=2ahUKEwju58X2jY6UAxWW3gIHHbWwKmgQtaYDegQIBxAA&usg=AOvVaw2eklWTSp2dhGfI4klvfYf2)
‎
‎But while I was Looking at the names of the candidates being mentioned in the past days, each one of them carries a unique story.
‎
‎Cesc Fàbregas is the first names that comes to my mind and I believe most of the Chelsea fans including me like it because of his past history with the club as player. And also he is doing pretty good in the Italian Seria A right with Como. 
‎
‎Cesc Fàbregas is perhaps the most romantic option among the name shortlisted. He is former Blue who understands the club’s DNA, he represents continuity and emotional connection. But sentiment alone doesn’t build dynasties. His managerial experience is still developing, and Chelsea isn’t exactly the place for on-the-job learning. Though he is doing very well at Como presently just like the other managers before taken Chelsea job.
‎
‎Oliver Glasner is another name being mentioned. And for me, he brings structure and discipline because his work in European competitions has shown he can organize a team effectively, making them hard to break down while still being dangerous going forward. I believe he feels like a “system-first” coach—something Chelsea desperately needs.
‎
‎Andoni Iraola is one of the most exciting names anong them. His aggressive, high-pressing style is modern and fearless as well. You see intensity and courage, watching his teams and qualities that have been missing at Stamford Bridge. But the question lies in whether he can really handle the pressure and expectations that come with a club like Chelsea.
‎
‎Marco Silva is another name being put on the table and I think he is often underrated. In the past seasons , he's shown he can build organized, competitive teams even without superstar resources. There is also a calmness to his approach, a sense of gradual progress. But Chelsea rarely does “gradual.” and that’s both the problem and the reality as well.
‎
‎Then there’s Luis Enrique. A proven elite manager who has handled big egos, big expectations, and delivered at the highest stage. His style brings authority and a clear tactical identity. I think if Chelsea want an immediate return to competing at the top, then he his arguably the safest and strongest choice that comes to mind.
‎
‎And lastly is José Mourinho, a name that will always stir emotions among Chelsea fans. The nostalgia is powerful. He knows how to win, and he knows Chelsea really well. But football evolves, and so must clubs. A reunion would be dramatic, but would it be progressive? And I don't think his approach can go well with the new Chelsea owner.
‎
‎For me, I think this decision of selecting new manager to take the club forward comes down to one question, and which is do Chelsea want a rebuild or a rebound?
‎
‎If it’s a rebuild, then I will chose someone like Iraola or Glasner, because they are coaches who can instill a system and grow with the squad. But if it’s a rebound, then I think Luis Enrique will be perfect for the job and he is someone that can immediately command respect and deliver results as well.
‎
‎But deep down, I believe Chelsea need more than just a manager. They need an identity reset. Someone who won’t just manage the chaos but also eliminate it.
‎
‎Maybe the real answer is not just on that list. Maybe it’s “someone else”, someone aligned with a long-term vision, but not just short-term pressure.
‎
‎Because at this point, it’s not about the next manager. But it's about the next era.
‎
