title.title: Dieci anni senza banche: La filosofia e la pratica della sovranità finanziaria secondo Joel Valenzuela (DASH)
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmb5vFUW2JLPNdSqyqTG34Jcr63C8AoCFs9yNLKJZ2e3GX/HGx218XaYAAnz3v.jpeg 

✍️ Riassunto in 🇮🇹 della seguente Live realizzata da Dash Italia By AI NotebookLM Tool 🤖

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j_APSMFOKSs

Joel Valenzuela (@thedessertlinux), figura di riferimento nell'ecosistema @dashpay, ha condiviso la sua straordinaria esperienza di vita: dieci anni trascorsi completamente al di fuori del sistema bancario tradizionale. La conversazione non è stata solo una celebrazione di un traguardo personale, ma un’analisi tecnica e sociologica sul perché Dash rimanga, a distanza di anni, lo strumento d’elezione per chi cerca una vera indipendenza economica.

**Il passaggio critico, da Bitcoin a Dash:** Il viaggio di Joel è iniziato circa 13 anni fa con Bitcoin. Tuttavia, il punto di svolta è arrivato nel 2016, durante le cosiddette “guerre per la dimensione dei blocchi”. Joel ha raccontato le frustrazioni di quel periodo: attese infinite per le conferme che lo lasciavano bloccato in un centro commerciale o impossibilitato a pagare un pranzo. Quando Bitcoin ha scelto la strada del “settlement layer” (bene di riserva) sacrificando l’usabilità quotidiana, Joel ha cercato un’alternativa che fosse davvero “contante digitale”. Dash è stata l’unica a soddisfare i requisiti di velocità, costi irrisori e scalabilità on-chain.

**La Governance come anticorpo contro il dirottamento:** Uno dei temi più caldi della live è stato il confronto tra i modelli di governance. Joel ha spiegato che uno dei maggiori difetti di Bitcoin è la mancanza di un meccanismo decisionale integrato, che lo ha reso vulnerabile al controllo di piccoli gruppi di sviluppatori. Dash, al contrario, ha risolto questo problema attraverso il sistema dei MasterNode e della DAO. Questo modello ha permesso alla rete di proteggersi da pressioni esterne (come i tentativi di rimuovere le funzioni di privacy per compiacere i regolatori) e di prendere decisioni strategiche sulla scalabilità in modo democratico e vincolante. Un esempio emblematico citato è stato il 2022, quando la community ha utilizzato il voto dei MasterNode per forzare un cambio di leadership nella Dash Core Group, dimostrando che il potere risiede effettivamente nelle mani di chi detiene e supporta la rete.

**Vivere nel mondo reale, Lo stack tecnologico di Joel:** Vivere senza banche oggi non è più una sfida impossibile, ma richiede gli strumenti giusti. Joel ha descritto il suo flusso di lavoro quotidiano:

- **Pagamento delle bollette:** Utilizzo di servizi come Spritz o Zipto negli Stati Uniti, che permettono di pagare utenze e affitto scansionando semplicemente un codice QR.
- **Acquisti quotidiani:** Uso massiccio di BitRefill e altre piattaforme di gift card. Joel sottolinea come, grazie alla velocità di Dash, l’acquisto di una carta regalo avvenga istantaneamente alla cassa, permettendo di pagare l’importo esatto della spesa in pochi secondi.
- **Carte prepagate e Privacy:** L’integrazione di servizi come Zebec, che offre carte ricaricabili senza la necessità di complessi processi di identificazione (KYC), permette di gestire le piccole spese quotidiane mantenendo un alto livello di riservatezza.

**Privacy e Trasparenza, un approccio duale:** Interessante la riflessione di Joel sulla privacy. Egli sostiene che la riservatezza dovrebbe essere la scelta predefinita per la vita personale, mentre la trasparenza dovrebbe essere la norma per chi riceve fondi pubblici o della community. Joel mette in pratica questa filosofia: utilizza le funzioni di privacy di Dash per le sue spese personali, ma mantiene la massima trasparenza per i fondi che riceve dalla DAO per i suoi progetti, permettendo a chiunque di monitorare come viene speso il budget.

**Dash Evolution e l’economia del dato:** Guardando al futuro, la discussione si è spostata su Dash Evolution. Joel ha descritto Dash come un sistema duale: una rete monetaria solida (L1) affiancata da una rete di dati decentralizzata (L2). Questo permette la creazione di applicazioni Web3, come il social media decentralizzato Yapper, dove l’identità dell’utente non è legata a un server centrale ma risiede sulla blockchain. L’obiettivo è creare una “Digital Cash Economy” completa, dove le persone possano non solo spendere, ma anche guadagnare direttamente in crypto, eliminando del tutto la necessità di ponti verso il mondo fiat.

**Conclusione:** La testimonianza di Joel Valenzuela conferma che Dash non è solo un asset speculativo, ma un’infrastruttura matura per la sovranità individuale. In un mondo in cui il sistema finanziario tradizionale diventa sempre più restrittivo, Dash offre un’alternativa già pronta all’uso, capace di scalare e adattarsi grazie a una governance che mette al primo posto le esigenze degli utenti reali.

title.title: Holding On        ...The Apprenticeship of Pain
title.body:
*There are all kinds of ways for a relationship to be tested, even broken, some, irrevocably; it’s the endings we’re unprepared for. ― Katherine Owen, Not To Us*


![Untaithful.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/johnjgeddes/23tGcCgLe7wHWcf122maQ8XPrXBu1d9kcDzVnC5nKwjy8rFZeXwGAKnrerZMdKpn746Ww.png)


People want a set of rules for living—why else would self-help books, life coaches and gurus be in such demand? Don’t get me wrong—I’m not blaming anyone. It’s nobody’s fault we get into the habit of breathing and then carry on cause it’s all we know. We keep figuring we can muddle through—but, of course, we can’t. Then, one fateful day, it all comes crashing down. We’re left sifting through wreckage—dazed survivors of some capricious storm. So, I know life isn’t easy and living isn’t a science. Life is an art, and the apprenticeship by which we learn is suffering.

“So, is Matt sending out his curriculum vitae?” Jay’s asking Margot. I know she and Matt have been putting off marriage until Matt finishes his doctoral studies. Margot shifts uncomfortably in her chair. “Actually, Matt wants to take a few more courses in Mathematical Biology.” “Are you serious?” Jay sputters, “I thought he’d be lecturing this fall.” We’re in the cafeteria eating lunch together as usual. But today, Jay’s crossing an invisible line, intruding into Margot’s private life. I want to kick him in the shins—unfortunately, I’m at the long end of the table. Why can’t I be a super-hero like Plastic Man?

“He wants to take a teaching position,” Margot explains, “but figured if he didn’t take the courses now, he never would.” “That’s great for him, but where does that leave you?” I quickly intervene. “I really don’t think Matt and Margot’s plans are our concern, Jay.” Margot flushes, “It’s okay Paul—I know Jay means well. Frankly, I’m disappointed too, but it can’t be helped.”

I give Jay a smoldering look but frankly, neither of us is buying what she’s selling. Margot’s been living with Matt—helping put him through graduate school. I know what you’re thinking, but that’s her—that’s what Margot’s like. It’s all based on the understanding they’ll be married in the fall. Now, it looks like that isn’t going to happen either.

Jay throws up his hands, “I’m outa here—I’ll catch you guys later.” We watch him thread his way through the Medical Building cafeteria and head back to the old Medical Wing. Margot puts down her half-eaten sandwich, “Well, what do you think, Paul—do you agree with, Jay?” “I think Jay’s got a big mouth.” Her eyes crinkle into a smile. It doesn’t help she’s gorgeous—blue-black hair and violet eyes—a young Elizabeth Taylor. Also, I’m in love with her—something else that doesn’t help.

“How long has it been?” I ask, knowing the answer only too well. She shrugs. Maybe she doesn’t know, but I do. Three years, four months and eleven days, I muse—the length of time they began living together—and the corresponding length of my stay in Limbo. I know there’s no real place called Limbo—the Council of Utrecht didn’t get around to studying that topic. They put it in limbo—in the margin—to be considered later, but they never got back to the topic. I doubt there’s any unbaptized babies there anyway—but I’m there—in the margin. Marginalized and waiting. So, I ask you who’s dumber—her or me? Yeah. The jury’s out on that one too.

Friday night, and Matt’s working late as usual, so Jay talks us into the Brunswick Tavern. “Hemingway used to write there,” he crows. Wrong. He used to write at the Pilot Tavern and that’s been torn down for years. I grab him and pull him aside. “What gives Jay—Why the hell are you so all-fired up to get us to the Brunswick House?” He colours. Now I know he’s got an angle. “C’mon, give over—What’s up?” “Look, I just heard through a friend of a friend that Matt’s there every Friday night—with a different chick.” My blood boils. “You gotta be kidding.” “No, I’m not. And I want Margot to see.”

I raise an eyebrow, which he ignores. “C’mon Paul, she’s got a right to know. God! That low-life scumbag—stringing her along while she puts him through school.” “That’s her choice, not yours.” “Don’t be a Boy Scout, Paulie—I know you gotta thing for her.” I grab him by the collar and give him a murderous stare. “You’re not saying a damn thing—you hear me?” “Yeah—I hear you.” I let him go and watch him almost fold like an accordion, his knees buckling. I reach out and hold him up.

“C’mon buddy—nobody ever said you were a fighter.” “Yeah—I’m a lover,” he whimpers. “Nobody ever said that either,” I smile. There’s a quick change of plans and we head to The Black Hart. Jay’s pissed, but Margot’s none the wiser.

We sit in the beer pub and I buy the first round. Before long, we’re all complaining about our Profs. After a few minutes, Jay comes back from the washroom, looking ill. He tilts his head in the direction of the bar lounge. I excuse myself to use the washroom. I follow his cue and discover the reason for his deathly pallor. There, sitting in a booth, is Matt with his arm around a girl. He’s so wrapped up in her, he doesn’t see me standing in the doorway, mouth agape.

I panic. The only excuse I can think of is to say the beer’s tainted and get Margot the hell out of there. I’m just about to return to the table when I bump into Margot and as she spies Matt and the girl, they begin to kiss. Margot heads straight to the table. “What the hell is this, Matt—your version of working late?” He stands up apologetic and tries to calm Margot, but the other girl puts two and two together. “Are you his girlfriend?” She asks Margot. “We live together—I’m his fiancée,” Margot spits back.

They face each other like she-cats squaring off for territory, and then, the girl changes her mind. “You bastard,” she hisses at Matt and swipes him with her talons. She then heads for the door. Matt grabs a napkin from the table, dabs at the claw marks she’s left on his cheek, and then leaves, hurrying after the girl! Margot slumps down in the booth. Jay pokes his head in the doorway, but I wave him off. Party’s over for tonight.

I slide in beside Margot who’s strangely calm. “I know who she is,” she says softly. “You do?” “She’s one of his thesis advisors—he’s been trying to impress the Profs and figures she could help.” *I’ll bet*, I tell myself, trying hard to focus on her, instead of Matt. “It’s okay—no big deal—we can work this out,” she says dully. She’s detached—unaware she’s methodically shredding the blood-stained napkin he used to wipe his face. “It’s all right to cry, you know,” I tell her. “What makes you think I want to cry?’ She looks so beautiful and vulnerable, I melt. I want to take her in my arms, but of course, I can’t.

“I was at a funeral once for a young couple who got married in high school. Their three year old died of a congenital disease.” Margot stares at me, not sure where this is going. Tell the truth, neither am I. “The parents knew it was coming—prepared themselves—told themselves it was all right.” “What’s your point, Paul?”

“I used to play with little Sarah—pretend I was Ernie and Bert. No one cried for that little girl. Everyone was going to leave that graveyard without crying—so, you know what I did?” “No, I have no idea.” “I put on my Ernie voice and said, ‘Hey, Bert—do you think it’d be okay to say good bye to Sarah?’ and then Bert said, ‘Sure Ernie—you love her.’” Margot’s eyes filled with tears. “So, Ernie and Bert said goodbye, and then the parents said goodbye—and then, one by one, everyone said goodbye. And we all cried.”

The tears were running down my face now and they were running down Margot’s. It’s okay to cry,” I said. She reached out and held my hand tight and we both sat in the lounge of the Black Hart and cried. Margot didn’t leave Matt. He came home later that night and they made up. They got married last month and are still going strong. Margot and I are still best friends—occasionally, we go for drinks and laugh—but we do not cry.

We’re both still practicing our art—muddling through each day—sifting through the wreckage. Margot’s kind of heroic in a sad sort of way. She reminds me of the priests who sewed up the curtain when the veil of the temple was rent. They knew somehow the priesthood had changed, but they still went on, clinging to their traditions. Margot’s like that and I guess in a way so am I too—both clinging to the wreckage in our apprenticeship of pain.

To be continued…

title.title: Закордонна медицина: як це реально працює
title.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYUAMF58ZC5jpufFqratR7UyavY27x2Cw5Zp4r4i6nbAS/image)

Українці за кордоном стикаються з плутаниною: коли лікар безкоштовний, за що треба платити та що покриває страховка. Це залежить від країни, але є кілька загальних правил.
Важливо знати:

“Безкоштовна” медицина зазвичай працює через податки або страховку.
Екстрена допомога - майже завжди доступна.
Сімейний лікар часто є першим кроком до лікування.
Без страховки прийоми, аналізи й лікування можуть бути дорогими.
Страховка покриває не все: є доплати за ліки, стоматологію, приватні клініки або фахівців без направлення.

Поради:
- оформіть страховку чимшвидше;
- знайдіть сімейного лікаря;
- завжди уточнюйте, що покривається;
- зберігайте чеки й документи;
- дізнайтеся номер швидкої та правила запису до лікаря. 

Формула проста:
- екстрене звернення - допоможуть безоплатно;
- планове - через запис і систему;
- отримати допомогу без черг - здебільшого приватна медицина, тож дорого. 

Бережіть себе й розбирайтеся в місцевій системі одразу - це економить і гроші, і нерви.

[INFA UA](https://t.me/INFA_U_A)

***

title.title: 闹中取静的书站--书门书屋
title.body:
![book1.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1777295004082-m553g.jpg)
书门书屋，岳阳楼对面

叫“书门”的书店，看起来有那么点味。主人子墨是个蛮有小资情调的人，开的店和她的主人一样，别有韵味。

![book2.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1777295141392-ikyl4.jpg)
整体的装饰是利用了旧房改造，主打原味，但又有那么股新的时尚味道。

![book3.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1777295220009-7nbe2.jpg)

蛮多书架和书的，可惜现在人的心思大多不在书上啰。我也只是瞄了一眼，稍翻了下，像是回到了当年在图书馆读书的日子。

![book4.jpg](https://img.ilark.io/img/202601/1777295313898-1vqh4.jpg)

书店对面就是岳阳楼，岳阳本地最大的招牌啰。位置还不错，也算是闹中取静。我去的时候人不多，也不知经营得如何。感觉整体氛围不错，小巧而精致。只是感觉岳阳的小资情调似乎有点少，不少西式店都经营得不好。希望它能活下来。

## Little Big Town

Formed in 1998, Little Big Town is a powerhouse of modern country music, renowned for their impeccable four-part vocal harmonies and a unique blend of country, pop, and rock. The group—consisting of Karen Fairchild, Kimberly Schlapman, Jimi Westbrook, and Phillip Sweet—is distinctive because they lack a dedicated lead singer; instead, they rotate lead duties, creating a rich, collaborative sound. With massive hits like \

they have earned numerous Grammy, CMA, and ACM awards, securing their place as one of the most respected and enduring vocal groups in the industry.

---

Here's what eBay had to say about a couple of these guitar picks 

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b9fccc43-0617-4129-a152-82e2c97c63b9.jpg)

---

![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/5b2e2364-7ddf-431f-9ed0-7bf25a004548.jpg)

---

This collection is a remarkable physical record of rock history, featuring a diverse array of guitar picks gathered from some of the most legendary North American tours. Each piece represents a specific moment in time, coming directly from the hands of the most influential touring bands of the last 20 to 40 years. From the thrash metal precision of Megadeth to the grunge-era icons like Eddie Vedder, these picks are more than just gear—they are tangible artifacts from the high-energy arenas and stadiums that defined a generation of music.
The significance of these picks lies in their connection to the peak of live performance culture across the continent. Over the past four decades, touring reached a massive scale, and these picks were used by artists who headlined the most iconic festivals and venues in the world. Whether it's a specialty \

design or a classic tour-stamped plectrum, having items from bands that shaped the sound of the 80s, 90s, and 2000s makes this a curated chronicle of modern rock’s touring legac. I'm putting this guitar pic together. Alphabetical order over the next few weeks and months. ---

title.title: AI and the New Frontier of Football Match Forecasting\n
title.body: The use of artificial intelligence in football analytics has transitioned from experimental curiosity to practical necessity. With the modern game generating vast amounts of data—from player tracking metrics to tactical heat maps—traditional methods of prediction based solely on league standings or recent form have become increasingly inadequate. Machine learning offers the ability to process this complexity, identifying nonlinear relationships and subtle patterns that escape human observation. However, the growing number of AI prediction platforms also demands critical evaluation: not every model is built with the same rigor, and not every output deserves equal weight.\n\nA platform that has approached this challenge with methodological discipline is [Ai-FootballPredictions.com](https://ai-footballpredictions.com/). Rather than relying on black-box algorithms, the resource emphasizes transparency in how its models are constructed, trained, and validated. The underlying system draws from extensive historical datasets, incorporating variables such as expected goal differentials, defensive organization metrics, player availability, and even situational factors like travel distance, rest periods, and weather conditions. For tournament football—including the expanded 48-team 2026 World Cup—the platform adapts its framework to account for unique variables such as third-place qualification scenarios, venue altitude differences, and the logistical complexity of a three‑nation hosting arrangement. This contextual intelligence is what distinguishes genuine analytical tools from generic automation.

title.title: The Hive-Engine Failover Fix Is in Main
title.body:
This one feels good.

The Hive-Engine failover fix I have been testing is now merged into `main`.

- PR: **[#134](https://github.com/hive-engine/hivesmartcontracts/pull/134)**
- Merge commit: **[`f53f023`](https://github.com/hive-engine/hivesmartcontracts/commit/f53f023)**

There were a couple of follow-up commits on top of it afterward, but that is the merge point for the failover work itself.

## What The Fix Was For

The problem was straightforward from an operator point of view:

- primary Hive RPC goes bad
- node does not roll over cleanly
- streamer starts limping or falling behind

That is the kind of issue that wastes time because the process can still look alive while doing a worse job than it should.

## What Changed

I took the minimal path instead of trying to redesign the whole RPC layer.

The core changes were:

- request-level failover across the configured RPC list
- temporary scheduler-level node demotion for repeatedly failing nodes
- shutdown reliability fixes that I already had on another branch
- dependency cleanup so the branch was sane while I was testing it

The important part was the scheduler-level demotion follow-up.

Request-level failover alone helped, but it still let the streamer lean on a bad primary more than I liked. Once I added temporary cooldown behavior, the node started behaving much more like I wanted under forced RPC failure.

## The Real Test

I did not just run this for five minutes and call it fixed.

I let it run for over a week and deliberately tested it against live failover conditions.

That included firewall-blocking `api.hive.blog` and watching the streamer logs in real time.

The satisfying part was finally seeing the behavior I wanted:

- bad node starts failing
- streamer cools it down
- healthy node keeps carrying block fetches
- engine stays caught up

And to be clear, the screenshot I am using was not from my synthetic firewall test.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/thecrazygm/23tRvSdmSYBKTYj7AVR4TXrw7DnJDg9ykssjE3arGBbUYFbPtRvZ6iVbMDmLkMxBxe5tC.png)

That screenshot was from real production behavior after I forgot to restart the node after pulling the update. By the time I restarted it, the node was roughly 50,000 blocks behind and chewing through backlog. While it was catching up, I saw the streamer cool down `api.c0ff33a.uk` in real time and keep moving.

That makes the screenshot better, not worse.

It is one thing to see the fix behave during an intentional test.

It is another thing to catch it doing the right thing in actual replay under live load.

The line I wanted to see was:

```text
[Streamer] Cooling down node https://api.c0ff33a.uk for 30000 ms after repeated failures
```

That is what a failover list should do. Not cling to the bad node. Not limp forever. Just move on.

## Why I Am Happy About It

If you configure multiple RPC endpoints, the node should actually behave like it understands why they are there.

Now it is a lot closer to that.

That is a good outcome.

As always,
**Michael Garcia** a.k.a. **TheCrazyGM**

When you feel like working. Have you ever noticed that sometimes you feel like working at the wrong time? LOL, yes, it sounds like a joke, but it happens. As evening approaches, you have a little free time, which you can use to learn something new. It can be so captivating that you really want to try it, to immediately put it into practice. But instead, you realize it's time to go to bed soon, not the time for work. ![30artstorDSC04460.png](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZxcscByWrX3fcGRmWdEN6TMeRhF4MtxuDr58gcA49oZL/30artstorDSC04460.png) Since I mentioned jokes, I remembered one on this topic: If you really want to work, lie down, go to sleep, it will pass! So, let's see how mycologists grow oyster mushrooms using fallen leaves as a substrate. I'd love to try the same thing: collect the leaves, soak them in a lime solution for a couple of days to remove excess acidity, boil it, place it in a plastic bag with lime, gypsum, and oyster mushroom mycelium, and let it all ripen. But I can't do this until tomorrow, or even until next fall, because most of the fall leaves have already rotted and could become a source of pathogenic fungi, like various types of mold, infecting the mushroom block. title.title: (en.es) On guard against life ✦ A Picture is Worth a Thousand Words
title.body:
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

 
 
# <center> ✦ ***On guard against life*** ✦</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEAcSoHr1zymvnvg82eRGguYFSoVRxPY5yURwQ9zyK5b/artguru_20260427085931_artguru.png)


#### 📸https://www.artguru.ai/es/ai-text-to-image-generator/create/

The boxer prepares, red gloves shielding him from blows, eyes fixed straight ahead. There's no ring, just a mirror.

We've all heard that life deals blows, and I can assure you it's true. Some blows come into our lives announced, others hit us straight in the gut, without warning: unexpected news, a loss, a betrayal, a moment that tears our souls apart with pain and without warning. We all receive blows, and we will continue to receive them in our lives until our last breath, which is why we must be like boxers, on guard, on guard against life.

And every good fighter knows that being on guard isn't about being afraid or living in constant defensiveness; it's about being prepared, having your feet on the ground and your hands up, because protecting ourselves is as important as fighting. Violence doesn't solve as much in this life as awareness and consistency—in our actions, in our timing, in our emotions. It's knowing that blows can come any day, but you have within you the capacity to act, to move, to resist, to respond, and above all, to defend yourself.

Life tells you: prepare yourself, this isn't a game. Put on your gloves—both the ones for attacking and the ones for defending. With your fists raised, you're not always looking for fights; it's a reminder not to fall at the first blow.

Sometimes you'll be knocked down by a low blow from life, and that's not a failure, or at least not entirely. If you fall flat on your back, you know you've hit rock bottom, and from there you can only get up before the count of ten. Raise your guard again; the fight isn't over until you decide it is.

Some people get tired of always being on guard and neglect their arms, letting them drop. And right there, in that split second of carelessness, the hardest blow lands. That's why my advice today, as I write these lines, is: don't lower your guard, never do it, not even when the referee isn't looking. Stay on guard for yourself and for who you are, so that when life comes in a spiral of violence to hit you, you can dodge it and return the blow with grace.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  
![](https://images.ecency.com/p/3ossSWoLBnTDQ1TvAjS9Kmow57ZbFshVns79LnDvVUgHmyB6wd16NRx56R33JmgTV6Lbh41zkpSVr5ou4TryEoAMMYQwT66EFbNybWKw9DcxBGgtP8cEYXGoFzvLxt9bJU1exVtC7Bo4ScXWZaPEkSciz4F4Mu44m83fqhLpP5iEpQdimxeKYvy96eb2M4gQrPoPtLNAEgH2vrBtxYJQNPyGJdcvvBib4LPmU8RHM4FAqezegCkeFq9DMqAXPXWchZ4s?format=match&mode=fit)
#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>  

 
 
# <center> ✦ ***En guardia ante la vida*** ✦</center> 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUEAcSoHr1zymvnvg82eRGguYFSoVRxPY5yURwQ9zyK5b/artguru_20260427085931_artguru.png)


#### 📸https://www.artguru.ai/es/ai-text-to-image-generator/create/

El boxeador se prepara, delante de él los guantes rojos cubren los golpes, mirada fija, al frente. No hay ring, hay un espejo.

Todos hemos escuchado que la vida da golpes, y puedo asegurar que es cierto. Algunos golpes llegan a nuestra vida anunciados, otros van directo al estómago, sin verlos: una noticia inesperada, una pérdida, una traición, un momento que doble el alma en dos con dolor y sin avisos. Todos recibimos golpes, y los seguiremos recibiendo en nuestra vida hasta el último minuto, por eso hay que estar como boxeador, en guardia, en guardia con la vida.

Y es que todo buen golpeador sabe que estar en guardia no es tener miedo o vivir en defensiva constante, es estar preparados, es tener los pies en la tierra y las manos arriba, porque protegernos es tan importante como pelear. La violencia no soluciona tanto en esta vida como la conciencia y la consistencia, en las acciones, en los momentos, en las emociones. Es saber que los golpes pueden llegar cualquier día, pero tienes en ti la capacidad de la acción, de moverte, de resistir, de responder y sobre todo de defenderte.

La vida te dice: prepárate, esto no es un juego y tú empuña los guantes los de atacar pero también los de defender, con los puños arriba no siempre buscas peleas, es un recordatorio de no caer ante el primer golpe.

A veces caerás derribado por un golpe bajo de la vida y eso no es un fracaso, o no al menos del todo, si caes en la lona con la espalda pegada, sabes que estás en lo más bajo y que desde ahí solo puedes levantarte antes de que termine la cuenta de diez, sube la guardia otra vez, el combate no termina hasta que tú lo decidas

Hay quien se cansa de siempre estar en guardia y descuida sus brazos los deja caer y justo ahí, en ese segundo de descuido llega el golpe más duro, por eso mi consejo hoy, mientras escribo estas líneas es: no bajes la guardia, no lo hagas nunca, ni cuando el árbitro deja de mirar, mantente en guardia por ti y por quien eres, para cuando la vida venga en espiral de violencia a golpearte tú la esquives y le devuelvas el golpe con gracia.

#### <center>─── ❖ ── ✦ ── ❖ ───</center>

title.body: Yesterday, the people of 3Speak replied about the case, and this is the answer they gave me: \n“Hello @GER-MAN, about 6 months ago, we had a hardware failure, literally lost a hard drive. It's since been fixed, and work has continued, but while we were able to recover some older videos, not all of them made it. That part was genuinely unfortunate and not intentional. I also want to clear up a common misunderstanding: videos aren't stored on the blockchain. Hive handles text only, videos, images, and audio are referenced from posts, not stored on-chain. Looking ahead, 3Speak is moving toward a sustainable model. Without ads, there's no way to offset long-term storage costs indefinitely. SPK Network is days away from launching, which will let anyone back up and host their own videos for as long as they want. 3Speak will serve as the delivery platform and initial hosting solution. We haven't finalized the details on the freemium model yet (which we're absolutely keeping), but something like a 3-month hosting window is being discussed, after which users can self-host indefinitely. These changes aren't a reaction to the hardware failure, they're part of a necessary roadmap shift to keep the project alive long-term.”\n#waves !ALIVE

title.body:
Hello hivers, an happy Monday to you all! Another warm sunny day here and the hair smell of springtime flowers. While my older furry friend Nanny is sleeping hard on my sofa, the younger Bimba is playing outside jumping on my plum tree and hunting the flies around. Just an ordinary day in my backyard. 😊 A couple of days ago one of my friend asked me to paint some tiny artworks about the blue Nymphea because he published a small book about his journey in Sri Lanka (he's a photographer) to give them to some of his friends as a sort of bookmark for the book. Maybe you noticed I don't use to paint flowers in my artworks and when I do it I use just few strokes of colors to represent them, but he is a friend and so I'm painting 6 tiny (simple) blue Nymphea for him. This morning, as usual, I woke up soon to work on them and, after some different sketches to understand the better way to represent the flower, I painted these ones: ![DSCN0048.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silviabeneforti/EoGztZ4TfAP2GK4WhJD49LXGatqnh29n77TqV9AKwU1C6MqVKKTyDpnvTkaA3JJmAsA.JPG) I watched many pics about the nymphea flowers and they are so so beautiful, but it was not so simple for me to paint them in my own style. title.title: Calling It On the Fly: WOO Reveals Wrestling’s Hidden Language
title.body:
A Big Hello to all WOO Fans! 🥳🥳🥳 WOO! 

One of the most fascinating parts of this entire episode, at least for me, is hearing how much of the match was actually decided in the moment. There’s this assumption sometimes that everything in wrestling is carefully planned and rehearsed, but Saturn completely breaks that idea down here. Because according to him, a lot of what we saw in that match was called on the fly.

>*Watch WOO's very own Perry Saturn and his latest \
video over at [THIS LINK](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vStGgwstymQ). The theme for this latest video production is \

*

---

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/blitzzzz/23u5xWMV4MoLyN3xvPnrdNRZtyn2ggDG7yhAutZFoJ1TGjQeeCWWcLu4CjN13tFYihAgR.png)

---

### The Communication Behind the Match

* **The match wasn’t fully choreographed beforehand.**
  
Saturn explains that they worked the match in real time, which means they were constantly adjusting based on how things were going.

* **Simple cues were used to guide the action.**
  
Instead of long discussions, it was quick instructions and reactions that shaped the flow of the match.

* **Trust between the wrestlers was essential.**
  
Without trust, this kind of approach wouldn’t work. Each wrestler needs to rely on the other to respond correctly in the moment.

* **Experience played a huge role in making it work.**
  
Saturn’s ability to adapt and guide the match was clearly a key factor in its success.

* **Every moment required awareness and quick thinking.**
  
There’s no room for hesitation when you’re calling a match on the fly. You have to be fully present.

### To round up the points I've made

This is the kind of detail that makes me appreciate wrestling on a completely different level. It’s not just about physical ability. It’s about awareness, communication, and trust. And as a WOO fan, I think this is exactly why content like this matters. It gives us a deeper understanding of what we’re watching, and it makes every match feel more meaningful.

---

Well, that's it for today. We will continue again tomorrow! 😁 WOO! 🎉

title.title: Truth Revealed.
title.body:
>

After defeating the bodyguards, I engaged in a grueling duel with the Greek captain, eventually taking him down with the help of rebel archers. I recovered an insignia linking the corruption to Fort Boubastos.

Finally, I joined Hotephres and Khenut in a somber ritual for Shadya.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUViDsr5Rj9c7ypU7wook9nRX1NLW6HPK8eiX3gPhYcT/screenshot_1_.jpg)

As I was done taking care of the bodyguards, there was only the captain left to deal with at the site. I knew he was slower, so I decided to face him directly to finish the fight. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXxC45ftfMG8pfDggTN9Lpg3CqPNvv3MybVmSJ3iPxRo/screenshot_2_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma92L4SgHL7vYiCEq22sCiFW23etF6iaWjvD7paHWgMRe/screenshot_3_.jpg)

But no matter how slow he was, his attacks were really heavy and took a massive toll on my defense. I had to take time to regenerate my health after getting damaged by his crushing strikes. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTvEgx9fAHyaq612WZ1MSTHMCJtfqq5Pgyuy3xpVvJ7e/screenshot_4_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToP14V9gWDxxAEkE9Un1BD6X86QRm9pHwztGKyvPhFkS/screenshot_5_.jpg)

I kept going for him and damaged him a little while he was wandering around looking for me. However, he was a strong warrior and kept damaging me in return every time I got too close for comfort. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8W1fnfsmt4xx3GznoyGyp7Ju1yeKdzTsP5AWsgU9oVg/screenshot_6_.jpg)

I knew it was going to be a slow process to bring him down, but I was at least getting there with every successful strike. So I stuck to this strategy of patience and precision, refusing to rush into a fatal mistake.

I watched his movements carefully, learning the rhythm of his heavy swings to find the perfect opening.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNmi82Azpdx24HXa9yv2gsrehGwvzoyAmWen3VQK8FXM/screenshot_7_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRvmfapat3gapUEuiZWSpdcjfuShz7sYgwVkeTQSdbYuD/screenshot_8_.jpg)

There I used a shallow distraction to confuse him while I ran towards him and jumped on him from a nearby ledge. He survived the initial impact and climbed back to his feet. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZJmTVcKsPm6GD1UwBVWKs376Gbd12ykqDstWetuu31oB/screenshot_9_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY5hx8WHgH4VLc8i1g4YobaVG5wwAKsuipPWspkNh7vv3/screenshot_10_.jpg)

For a moment I decided to face him head-on again, so I started dodging his attacks with quick movements. I did great there, slipping under his massive axe and landing quick counter-attacks.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwJpTom4D6PQDxNX6zZbfx6peJ8DuG84UwRJqQvHLy9N/screenshot_11_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTsaHe1X4gKRLWVdrmpdZDW5EjSPLLz7ne8uxnqhtuNAp/screenshot_12_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPbXWGo23avDKyiC6qAVBsf57VU4yEYAtozVAgEU7cshS/screenshot_13_.jpg)

I had to escape again after getting damaged by a lucky swipe from his blade. When I knew the time was right, I tried a leap attack again to bring the full weight of my blade down on him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJ2qFqntGRAuddoygcsoX83j3DurR738zdk8WyDxjWad/screenshot_14_.jpg)

And I had to escape again right after the jump to avoid his desperate counter attack. I realized I would die with a single scratch next if I stayed within his reach for even a second longer. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCTUDgMMSS5E139Jq2qAibQufWUTjfMcbqV3AtqnYagp/screenshot_15_.jpg)

When I went for the enemy again, some rebels assisted me in the fight and they started shooting the enemy with arrows from their horses. The captain was overwhelmed by the rain of arrows coming from all sides.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNS5kCDEAZcyopXQvfmJrkV5Z7Py1SLnS4hxebyN7KAcf/screenshot_16_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY7aPAbx23H5TQPLXGr8Gxa5YDWXopU3UeESktz8PmX5m/screenshot_17_.jpg)

It looked like the rebels did amazing and pinned down the enemy captain with their relentless fire, but I had to confirm the kill myself. I found an important insignia on the dead body after he finally fell to the ground.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDaujo2Gc5MdL32XQLBTjvbzfKNQQxRntEFkknA571v5/screenshot_18_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrQmXEjZsKqhVBB4mjDE5N439h5yDnWbUy3Jko5tBtic/screenshot_19_.jpg)

I ran back to Hotephres and Khenut while taking the insignia to show them what I had discovered. Hotephres confirmed it was from Fort Boubastos to the east, run by another man who thought himself untouchable.

He explained that people would continue to suffer unless we acted, so Hotephres asked for Bayek's help at last.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkB5zBDgREMN15ZZ7ANras73dskUNkLRQvARrbtRoZMt/screenshot_20_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQQfBdMrf2nqW8XoCwcgNDTiULdyswzjEtKrhuv6qotQ8/screenshot_21_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFZHDsVZoPgwEJwfcMB4P3x59j85SERBTREAGTsJ9GgE/screenshot_22_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3TZNKXXsfac11CPWwNj38NK9rvN8ubXmpMoSftMN9aL/screenshot_23_.jpg)

Then Bayek decided to join Khenut for the ritual to say goodbye to Shadya. They stood together in silence, honoring the memory of the light that had been taken from them too soon.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSMhdA8w7CMxwexCBwek7GPZy6F8rYs9aAybVbuTsst8s/screenshot_24_.jpg)

The quest \

was completed and a new one came in sight as the sun began to set over the horizon. Senu came over and landed on my hand. After defeating the bodyguards, I engaged in a grueling duel with the Greek captain, eventually taking him down with the help of rebel archers. I recovered an insignia linking the corruption to Fort Boubastos.

Finally, I joined Hotephres and Khenut in a somber ritual for Shadya.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUViDsr5Rj9c7ypU7wook9nRX1NLW6HPK8eiX3gPhYcT/screenshot_1_.jpg)

As I was done taking care of the bodyguards, there was only the captain left to deal with at the site. I knew he was slower, so I decided to face him directly to finish the fight. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTXxC45ftfMG8pfDggTN9Lpg3CqPNvv3MybVmSJ3iPxRo/screenshot_2_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQma92L4SgHL7vYiCEq22sCiFW23etF6iaWjvD7paHWgMRe/screenshot_3_.jpg)

But no matter how slow he was, his attacks were really heavy and took a massive toll on my defense. I had to take time to regenerate my health after getting damaged by his crushing strikes. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeTvEgx9fAHyaq612WZ1MSTHMCJtfqq5Pgyuy3xpVvJ7e/screenshot_4_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmToP14V9gWDxxAEkE9Un1BD6X86QRm9pHwztGKyvPhFkS/screenshot_5_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb8W1fnfsmt4xx3GznoyGyp7Ju1yeKdzTsP5AWsgU9oVg/screenshot_6_.jpg)

I knew it was going to be a slow process to bring him down, but I was at least getting there with every successful strike. So I stuck to this strategy of patience and precision, refusing to rush into a fatal mistake.

I watched his movements carefully, learning the rhythm of his heavy swings to find the perfect opening.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNmi82Azpdx24HXa9yv2gsrehGwvzoyAmWen3VQK8FXM/screenshot_7_.jpg)

For a moment I decided to face him head-on again, so I started dodging his attacks with quick movements. I did great there, slipping under his massive axe and landing quick counter-attacks.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwJpTom4D6PQDxNX6zZbfx6peJ8DuG84UwRJqQvHLy9N/screenshot_11_.jpg)

I had to escape again after getting damaged by a lucky swipe from his blade. When I knew the time was right, I tried a leap attack again to bring the full weight of my blade down on him.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTJ2qFqntGRAuddoygcsoX83j3DurR738zdk8WyDxjWad/screenshot_14_.jpg)

And I had to escape again right after the jump to avoid his desperate counter attack. I realized I would die with a single scratch next if I stayed within his reach for even a second longer. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUCTUDgMMSS5E139Jq2qAibQufWUTjfMcbqV3AtqnYagp/screenshot_15_.jpg)

When I went for the enemy again, some rebels assisted me in the fight and they started shooting the enemy with arrows from their horses. The captain was overwhelmed by the rain of arrows coming from all sides.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNS5kCDEAZcyopXQvfmJrkV5Z7Py1SLnS4hxebyN7KAcf/screenshot_16_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWDaujo2Gc5MdL32XQLBTjvbzfKNQQxRntEFkknA571v5/screenshot_18_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQrQmXEjZsKqhVBB4mjDE5N439h5yDnWbUy3Jko5tBtic/screenshot_19_.jpg)

He explained that people would continue to suffer unless we acted, so Hotephres asked for Bayek's help at last.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkB5zBDgREMN15ZZ7ANras73dskUNkLRQvARrbtRoZMt/screenshot_20_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYFZHDsVZoPgwEJwfcMB4P3x59j85SERBTREAGTsJ9GgE/screenshot_22_.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR3TZNKXXsfac11CPWwNj38NK9rvN8ubXmpMoSftMN9aL/screenshot_23_.jpg)

Then Bayek decided to join Khenut for the ritual to say goodbye to Shadya. They stood together in silence, honoring the memory of the light that had been taken from them too soon.

title.title: Handling More Weeds 🌿🌱🌿  In A Better And Successful Performance At The Animal Production Without Any Set Back Or Side Effect On Them .
title.body:
![Screenshot_20260427-121852.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23zS7UuD7A2shzxsaxDYG65f91uWUx9WVU3HG2YynJFkRxRWmprxsWoJLFgQb51RqWUJ3.png)








---
---
---






Sometimes the prediction as a farmer may be wrong due to the fact that you have a lot in your head to gather up and to face privately or group. It has happened to me on several equations whereby I was not able to think straight because of so many assignments at hand. So it affected a lot of Farm activities and also animal production as it was at that point in time. After a very long period Of time I realized that being a farmer is not just collecting of seeds planting of crops and the rest. We must also be able to keep rest the brain so that it will be able to relax and process so many new updates regarding Farm agriculture as a whole. 

Which is why sometimes I also visit the nature in the wood. Meaning that when I feel more heavy I always visit the farm to relax my brain and also for me to assimilate more new ideas and information to be processed within the week or for a couple of weeks. It is never easy to be a farmer for those that actually understand what I'm talking about. So on the other hand has I also visit the farm, there are some weed that I need to give us an hint on it because it has been of help for several years to keep my animals healthy and also safe. The growth and the development of the animals were extremely rapid. So at the long run, it has been of help to me and to the farm as a whole. I'm also we give an update on the couple of improvement that will be on the farm soonest meaning that I also want to go on a project called the grasscutter farming. It has been a couple of months gathering up information and materials physically and theoretically what I can really improve on being a grasscutter farmer. So as it goes I'm going to give us the full details and updates on this as I make the grasscutter cages and also buy some few materials that is required of it. Although things are extremely expensive at the moment. 


* This type of weed can be used to feed your animal most especially the rabbit at least once in a day. Not like the grasscutter animals which can survive on grasses for a very long period Of time even without giving them the grains. Although the greens as well will go a very long too. 


![Screenshot_20260427-121940.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/Ep3giCEUpjstMCZyW3g7WLaxFjZsA35BvqeMyKpT3DVw6wzwLMYwEpEv1bHk2hvdgzV.png)

![Screenshot_20260427-121948.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23z7LE579vAYMskgdWsPiqD9qGR6TYBfgW9uYk5pLi4BdzEDs2MDTu54E5YYB1WA9UfUf.png)

![Screenshot_20260427-122005.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23wX9aWPBkiP9MttPVanqmgczCQrH3tHCDXuuq79CRmFVkUi2rgVUViMETcCQydqktfn1.png)



You can find the plant or the weed alongside the river Banks or where it is extremely moist. These are the few places that you can absolutely see this type of weed for your animals. and that is why as the Farmer you need to bring more innovative ideas such that you can be able to transplant it into your own environment and keep on applying a lot of water for it to survive and for it to get more new ones growing up. 

![Screenshot_20260427-121911.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23wX9o5u7F3dnmJyHpYFb1N1MEBu13CiGUc5JKZpyjh2nmbuAoqxGS1q5V6vC4fs8jGNK.png)

![Screenshot_20260427-121929.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xAg5EkY2e9VdYmpwEqAV6Xe8cSfvgAuHSBJ6JehmaapGXZErHfR6AmYYeGQW5QTM4hW.png)

![Screenshot_20260427-121920.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/242DNzPNsBvvdcoRmpUhv7Rd7giLxjTbH9pfgzo5qB8vJ8t1x7nidJmu9VoRcfwBqfndE.png)


I have done it on several occasion and it worked. Only that the first attempt and the second attempt was not giving a very good response. But subsequently it came out massively that are even have to cut on weekly basis for the animals to consume it. This is the essence of bringing in modernization into agriculture. You may not find this in books at all but yet it can happen. 
 


![Screenshot_20260427-121840.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23xpFJS38SwEagaE1KPwTUjS56YWj7V3jm8PThGH5ETirnXL766kQkLFoR2TT4dv2YvsJ.png)

![Screenshot_20260427-122554.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/23z7NbRkrZEyH6A3Jj53AvG9dtNFYVxcRDy8G4Xipr1HdN5JeZ8Ktct8qm3tmNzC6d6Nt.png)

This weed is very hairy. And it can also cause a lot of scratching and itching to you if care is not taking. So you need to apply a lot of wisdom while handling this type of weed even before giving it to your animals. 



![Screenshot_20260427-121903.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mattsanthonyit/EokfYjqWs7M2uGinxkKiH7SFDW18zvT2ExJGjgcQkzShEqdq4k3vwtqCfMMFNxDUttM.png)

title.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro: O Google Está em Primeiro e Agora Fala com Você
title.body:
Ser o número um num ranking de inteligência artificial é algo que muda de mãos com frequência. Modelos sobem, descem, são superados. O que chama atenção no Gemini 2.5 Pro em abril de 2026 não é apenas que ele está no topo do placar — ele a distância com que chegou lá, e as novas capacidades que acompanharam esse avanço.

## O salto no placar

O LMArena é o benchmark humano mais respeitado do setor: pessoas reais comparam respostas de modelos sem saber qual é qual, e votam na melhor. Não é sóciódigo. É escrita, raciocínio, conversa, utilidade real.

O Gemini 2.5 Pro subiu 24 pontos de Elo nessa plataforma e chegou a 1.470 — o número mais alto já registrado. No WebDevArena, focado em desenvolvimento web, o salto foi ainda maior: 35 pontos, também liderando.

Para comparação: subir 10 pontos de Elo já hé considerado significativo. Subir 24 e 35 ao mesmo tempo é um recado claro de que algo mudou na forma como o modelo processa e responde.

## Deep Think: pensando antes de responder

A novidade mais técnica está no modo **Deep Think**, que usa novas técnicas de pesquisa para fazer o modelo considerar múltiplas hipóteses antes de chegar a uma resposta. Em vez de ir direto para a conclusão mais provável, o modelo explora caminhos alternativos e avalia qual deles é mais robusto.

O resultado prático: no benchmark USAMO de 2025 — uma das provas de matemática olímpica mais difíceis do mundo — estes resultados são hoje considerados referência no setor para modelos de raciocínio matemático.

Para tarefas como análise jurídica, estratégia de negócios ou resolução de problemas com múltiplas variáveis, essa capacidade de considerar hipóteses antes de decidir faz diferença real.

## Agora ele fala — literalmente

Uma das novidades mais concretas desta atualização é a saída de áudio nativa. O Gemini 2.5 Pro agora consegue responder em voz de forma direta e natural, sem precisar de um sistema separado de conversão de texto para fala.

Isso muda a experiência de uso: em vez de ler uma resposta longa, você pode ouvir. Para situações onde as mãos estão ocupadas, ou onde o contexto é conversacional — reuniões, consultas rápidas, acessibilidade — isso é uma mudança real de interface.

## Project Mariner: usando o computador por você

O Google também integrou ao 2.5 Pro as capacidades do **Project Mariner**, que permite ao modelo interagir com o computador como um usuário humano: navegar em páginas, clicar em elementos, preencher formulários, executar tarefas em interfaces gráficas.

Isso coloca o Gemini 2.5 Pro no mesmo território que o GPT-5.4 no que diz respeito à automação agentic — a capacidade de não apenas dizer o que fazer, mas fazer.

## Controle para desenvolvedores

Para quem usa a API, o Google adicionou **thinking budgets**: uma forma de controlar quanto processamento de raciocínio o modelo usa por chamada. Mais raciocínio significa respostas mais precisas, mas também mais tempo e custo. Com os thinking budgets, o desenvolvedor define o equilíbrio.

O acesso ao modelo está disponível via Google AI Studio e Vertex AI, com suporte a contextos longos e raciocínio aprofundado.

## Liderança sustentável?

A pergunta que fica é se o Google vai conseguir manter essa posição. O histórico do setor mostra que o número um muda com frequência. O Gemini 2.5 Pro chegou ao topo com um conjunto convincente de melhorias — raciocínio mais profundo, áudio nativo, automação real, e uma pontuação humana que não mente. Agora é só questão de quanto tempo até o próximo desafiante aparecer.

Por ora, o Google está na frente. E isso, por si só, já é notícia.

title.title: The Things That Almost Broke My Prop Firm (And What I Fixed)
title.body:
/>

Are you thinking about starting a prop firm?

Then this might help you avoid some mistakes I had to learn the hard way.

I made a few bad decisions early on.

And yeah… it cost me time, money, and things got pretty stressful at one point.

Looking back, most of it could’ve been avoided.

From the outside, starting a prop firm looks easy.

But once you’re inside it, it feels very different.

In this, I’ll share what went wrong, what almost broke my prop firm, and what I had to fix so you don’t go through the same problems.  

<h2 style=\

>How I Started a Prop Firm and What I Expected When I started my prop firm, the idea in my mind was clear: find good traders, fund them, and earn from their profits. At that time, I was mainly focused on getting things running. I was thinking about how to bring in traders, how to set up basic rules, and how to make the process smooth. I believed that if traders were good and profitable, the prop firm would automatically do well. What I didn’t understand at that time was how many moving parts exist behind a prop firm. It’s not only about trading results. There is also risk management, payout handling, and making sure everything stays stable when multiple traders start performing at once. I was looking at it from a trading point of view, not a system point of view. At that stage, I hadn’t yet seen how quickly things can become connected and sensitive once a prop firm starts scaling.

>What Almost Broke Prop Firm During Early Scaling The first real shock came when my prop firm started scaling. As more traders joined the prop firm and more of them started passing evaluations, success itself started creating pressure. Risk exposure increased without me fully realizing it. Multiple traders unknowingly started taking similar positions, and suddenly, the prop firm wasn’t as diversified as it looked. On paper, everything in the prop firm looked stable. In reality, hidden correlated risk was building. Then one volatile market move exposed everything at once. It wasn’t a single failure. It was a chain reaction, risk, payouts, and exposure all hitting the prop firm at the same time. That was the moment I realized the biggest danger in a prop firm isn’t losing traders. It’s not seeing how connected everything actually is. That phase nearly broke the entire prop firm structure.

>How I Fixed Risk and Growth Issues in a Prop Firm Fixing the prop firm wasn’t about one solution. It required rebuilding how the entire system worked and implementing proper Prop Firm Trading Solutions across risk, payouts, and overall growth management. The first change was risk segmentation in the prop firm. Instead of treating all traders as one group, I started separating them based on strategy behavior and correlation patterns. That alone reduced hidden exposure significantly. Next, I reworked the prop firm payout system. Payouts were no longer reactive. They became structured, planned, and backed by reserves so that growth didn’t create cash flow stress inside the prop firm. Then I upgraded the infrastructure. Real-time monitoring replaced delayed visibility so I could track exposure inside the prop firm instantly, not after problems appeared. Finally, I slowed down expansion. This was the hardest decision for the prop firm, but also the most important one. Because in a prop firm, uncontrolled growth is more dangerous than steady, controlled progress.

>Key Lessons I Learned From Running a Prop Firm Building a prop firm taught me lessons I didn’t expect at the beginning. The first is that the structure of the prop firm is the biggest risk, not the traders. The second is that success in a prop firm can create more danger than failure if it’s not controlled properly. The third is that risk in a prop firm is never individual. It is always systemic, and it shows up when multiple small factors align. And the most important lesson: most failures in a prop firm don’t come from big mistakes. They come from small issues that compound quietly inside the system.

>Final Thoughts on Building a Prop Firm If there’s one thing I’ve learned from building a prop firm, it’s this: Prop firm fails when too many traders win in ways the system wasn’t designed to handle. What almost broke my prop firm wasn’t bad performance; it was uncontrolled success. And once you understand that, you stop thinking like someone managing traders… and start thinking like someone responsible for the entire prop firm system behind them.

title.body: > I’ve met so many people who are always yapping on and on about God knows what and it gets to that point where all they’re saying is trash and people tend to just get fed up of them. It’s in human nature to talk, but sometimes we do need to know when to be quiet. Being wise also includes knowing when to talk and when to be mute because saying something at the wrong time and in the wrong situation can do you more harm than good most times. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfTFJYnFXwLhqoPMHnCCuWrqD7bSe3zUM27j4wcuV9oFF/img_1883.jpg) It’s sad that most people are in jail today because they couldn’t keep their mouth shut and that landed them in trouble. Don’t get me wrong, it’s okay to talk. I mean, in a world where everyone loves gist and petty gossip, you’re bound to have a huge record of speech each day from all over the word. As much as we are meant to use our mouths to talk, our mouth also needs a break sometimes so our brain can process some stuff. I’ve always said that the people who are very smart and mature are people that live in silence. People living in noisy places always have their mind occupied with noise which is very bad for them but sometimes situations are very tight. Most of us Africans don’t believe in meditation and all those stuff. I remember telling a friend to reflect over his actions and you won’t believe the person laughed at the thought of it. I mean, I totally understand where they’re coming from but you’d be surprised what reflection and meditation can do for you. I’ve always been an overthinker, which means my mind is always preoccupied with something. And I’m the kind of person who reflects over every little thing. Let’s say I step out to work or an event, meet people and all and then I get back home. Once I’m home,my brain subconsciously starts to process everything thing right from when I stepped out from the house, to when I met people, what was said, facial expressions that were made and everything in between. And honestly, there’s always something to discover when you look at things from another perspective. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmco2gN6faA2KxMeK9rHoP1EaDJy7ACL6uzw6BkPDmYodA/img_2231.jpg) This has grown to become a thing for me to the extent that my mind just goes into that mode when I get home- I live in a very quiet place and that helps a lot because I get to have peace of mind for my body to relax and all. Reflection to me, has coming a second eye for me because I get to recall everything that went wrong and make sure to make things right. I might have offended people with my words or actions while I was on and about my day but only people who pay keen attention will notice little tiny details. If I’m to be honest, everyone deserves a brain like mine or the change to meditate and reflect over their day and actions. It really helps a lot especially with your personal development and your interaction with others. - - - all images belong to me. - - - ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXuSJ2V9NneWQW9Jxgobw7BtKvMb3UBPdxv3jaAhx5vpA/f40b32ec_5287_4867_ae7e_9fa77d7f679b.png)

title.title: Go ahead... Do it anyway.
title.body: <center>[House Digest](https://www.housedigest.com/976189/things-you-should-know-before-you-knock-down-a-wall/)</center>\nIn a world where people's appearance counts more than their content, where all prejudice overrides the real values that (at least according to the law of men) should ensure that each and every human being should be treated equally, where the segregation of social classes is increasingly evident... Why fear doing something because of what others will think? As long as it's not an illegal activity or behavior, do it anyway.\nThere is a worrying inversion of values here about how we should behave, because instead of pleasing ourselves (almost always first and foremost), many of us are concerned with pleasing other people. This search for validation from others has become a \

, which spreads at an alarmingly impressive speed. Living in dependence on what others think or say about us is like putting ourselves in a cage (without having the key).\nThis type of attitude is an extremely damaging choice, because when we ourselves withdraw from the position where we should always strive to be the protagonists of our own story, we are automatically giving up the autonomy of our own decisions. Once this happens, other people begin to determine what we should do, how we should think, and even how we should express ourselves... Who thinks it's good to live like that?\nUnfortunately, there are people who like to live like that (and no, I will never be able to understand that). Free will should never be taken from us, as it is something very precious and that was given to us at an extremely high price (in fact... immeasurable). Once we allow someone to do this (based on our own inertia in the face of facts), we are giving the other person the right to live a life for us that is not theirs. Think about this before living in \
.\nThere is no single right way to do what is right, but there is a right way to do what can be considered the least wrong (within a general consensus of \

involving social behavior). In the midst of this rather complex journey, each of us learns how to do what we want. In the right way, not only according to our own needs, but also meeting (though not always) external expectations.
---
<center>**Adelante... Hazlo de todos modos.**</center>
En un mundo donde la apariencia importa más que el contenido, donde todo prejuicio prevalece sobre los valores reales que (al menos según la ley humana) deberían garantizar la igualdad de trato para todos, donde la segregación social es cada vez más evidente... ¿Por qué temer hacer algo por lo que piensen los demás? Siempre que no sea una actividad o comportamiento ilegal, hazlo de todos modos.
Aquí se produce una preocupante inversión de valores sobre cómo debemos comportarnos, porque en lugar de complacernos a nosotros mismos (casi siempre ante todo), muchos nos preocupamos por complacer a los demás. Esta búsqueda de validación externa se ha convertido en un “vírus”, que se propaga a una velocidad alarmante. Vivir dependiendo de lo que otros piensen o digan de nosotros es como meternos en una jaula (sin tener la llave).
Esta actitud es sumamente perjudicial, porque al renunciar a ser protagonistas de nuestra propia historia, renunciamos automáticamente a la autonomía de nuestras decisiones. Una vez que esto sucede, otros comienzan a determinar qué debemos hacer, cómo debemos pensar e incluso cómo debemos expresarnos. ¿Quién piensa que es bueno vivir así?
Desafortunadamente, hay quienes disfrutan de vivir así (y no, jamás lo entenderé). El libre albedrío jamás debería arrebatársenos, pues es algo muy valioso que se nos otorgó a un precio altísimo (de hecho, incalculable). Al permitir que alguien haga esto (por nuestra propia inercia ante la realidad), le estamos dando a la otra persona el derecho a vivir una vida que no le pertenece. Reflexiona sobre esto antes de vivir en el “exilio”.
No existe una única manera correcta de hacer lo correcto, pero sí existe una manera correcta de hacer lo que se considera menos incorrecto (dentro de un consenso general de \

en lo que respecta al comportamiento social). En medio de este proceso complejo, cada uno aprende a hacer lo que desea. De la manera correcta, no solo según nuestras propias necesidades, sino también satisfaciendo (aunque no siempre) las expectativas externas. ---
**Vá em frente... Faça assim mesmo.**
Em um mundo onde a aparência das pessoas conta mais do que os seus conteúdos, onde todo preconceito se sobrepõe aos valores reais que (ao menos de acordo com a lei dos homens) deveriam assegurar que todo e qualquer ser humano deveria tratados igualmente, onde a segregação de classes sociais é cada vez mais evidente... Por que temer fazer algo em decorrência do que os outros irão pensar? Não sendo uma atividade ou comportamento ilícito, faça assim mesmo. Há aqui uma preocupante inversão de valores sobre como devemos nos comportar, porque ao invés de agradarmos a nós mesmos (quase sempre em primeiro lugar), muitos de nós está preocupado em agradar outras pessoas. Essa busca pela validação alheia de se tornou um “vírus”, que se espalha com uma velocidade assustadoramente impressionante. Viver na dependência do que os outros pensam ou dizem ao nosso respeito é se colocar numa jaula (sem ter a chave). Esse tipo de atitude é uma escolha extremamente danosa, porque quando nós mesmos nos retiramos da posição onde devemos sempre procurar ser os protagonistas da nossa própria história; automaticamente, nós estamos abrindo mão da autonomia das nossas próprias decisões. Uma vez que isso acontece, outras pessoas começam a determinas o que devemos fazer, como devemos pensar e até mesmo como devemos nos expressar... Quem acha bom viver desse jeito? Infelizmente, existem pessoas que gostam de viver assim (e não, isso eu nunca serei capaz de entender). O livre arbítrio nunca nos deve ser tirado, pois é algo muito precioso e que foi nos dado a um preço extremamente caro (na verdade... imensurável). Uma vez que permitimos que alguém faça isso (tendo como base a nossa própria inércia diante de fatos), estamos entregando ao outro o direito de viver por nós uma vida que não deles. Pense nisso antes de viver no “exílio”. Não existe o jeito certo e fazer o que é certo, mas existe o jeito certo de fazer o que pode ser considerado como menos errado (em um consenso geral de “normatividade” envolvendo comportamento social). No meio de toda essa jornada bastante complexa, cada um de nós vai aprendendo a como fazer o que queremos. Do jeito que é certo, mediante não apenas as nossas próprias necessidades, mas também atendendo (embora nem sempre) as expectativas mais externas. Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@wiseagent/go-ahead-do-it-anyway-xk)

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said that artificial intelligence will make us care more about people... Let's put it this way, if it were like in Japan, everything would be fine. It doesn't matter whether it's gaming or anime – you can see they're using it wisely. They're eliminating jobs that are most easily replaced; some people lose their jobs, but others change positions. This is a normal process, so you need to educate yourself, but in return, life moves incomparably faster. The problem is that most of the world behaves completely differently.

body.title: A different perspective on rain.
body.body:
A different perspective on rain.

I grabbed a large shovel and started digging a wet spot called rain.

During rain, digging isn't easy; wet soil sticks to the shovel blade, which doesn't help us at all. Therefore, as a rule, it's better to dig a garden in dry weather; I've experienced this repeatedly.

In theory, rain should always be a joy, like a traveler in the desert, but it often becomes a nuisance if you live, for example, in the tropics or in London, and prolonged rain makes you doubt sunny days even exist.

![DSC06623.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmbEtH4Ku9nFDCBvG4ERvc56SKX6Mf886QigYFgohRPs7y/DSC06623.JPG)

A couple of years ago, I would have dreamed of rain over my garden, but my knowledge of how certain crops develop allows me to look at it differently and think not about rain, but about balance, so that there isn't too much rain.

![DSC06619.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmZMdVRNkSxPmChXibLHqCpn9yFr8cND5P58HRiAv87QQZ/DSC06619.JPG)

I remember a saying: If you plant in the mud during the rain, you'll become a prince.

This is debatable, but folklore and science don't always intersect in the same longing; they move along a curve and have many points of intersection.

![DSC06620.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQma6ga1JssZ2L7sYE2EoG5yF2AfegUrUmwRA2g3jafBZMe/DSC06620.JPG)

Logic dictates that plants, let's say tomatoes, which hold a lot of moisture, should love rain and overwatering. But no, excess moisture promotes the development of late blight, which grows, infects tomatoes and other nightshade crops, destroys the tops, and promotes rot in already-developing fruits.

![DSC06621.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmetEhebzqWe25YF9SPM75azLSRfjfp9uoKsGse59Piw5W/DSC06621.JPG)

I'm a bit like the tomato lol, a kind of Senor Tomato like in \

I don't really like dampness, but I do like a warm rain in the middle of a hot summer, a short one, the kind you can forget about in five minutes. ![DSC06487.JPG](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmUvuaWTaUk8JX3fM7rGXY5Uf8uGui7zD15ve8WLDQw2xm/DSC06487.JPG) --- Below you can see my containers with data that I collect in INLEO and always have quick access to them it is very convenient. [Material thoughts about beekeeping №1](https://inleo.io/threads/view/barski/re-leothreads-drl8tnsl) When I visited dense forests, I did not see ideal conditions for bees there, but many beekeepers harvest beekeeping products in such places. body.body: 제주 생활 2년차! 현지분들이 작년에는 묻지 않던 질문을 올해 많이들 하십니다. 고사리 좀 꺽으러 다녀왔냐구요. 몇번 기회가 있었지만 비가 내리거나 몸이 아팠거나 출근능 해야해서 아직 기회를 잡진 못했습니다. 경험도 경험이지만 제가 고사리 나물을 무척 좋아해서 올해 먹을 고사리를 준비해 보고 싶었거든요. 오늘 사무실 동료분께서 점심시간에 사람들 몰래 건고사리 한봉지를 챙겨주셨습니다. ㅎ

/>바로 어제 하나로마트에서 건고사리 80g에 13,000원 하던 것을 보고 왔는데… 엄청 양이 적었었거든요. 양도 양이지만 산에 가서 쪼그려 앉아서 고사리를 꺽고, 모아서 삶고 다시 건조 시키는 수고로움을 생각하니 정말 받아도 되나 싶었습니다. 이걸 다 직접 꺽으셨어요? 라고 묻자. 무슨! 내가 꺽나! 집사람이 꺽었지! 하시네요. 몸둘바르 모를 정도로 감사했습니다. 집에 와서 지퍼백에 나눠 담았습니다. 하나라도 흘릴까 싶어 싹싹 모아 담았습니다.

/>

이렇게 두봉지나 나왔습니다. ^^

가족들에게 받아온 이야기를 하면서 너무 미안하고 감사한 마음이 들었다고 하니 둘째가 그러네요.

아마도 아빠가 만든 식혜를 엄마가 다른 사람들에게 선물로 나눠줄때 받는 사람들이 이런 마음일 거라구요. ㅎ

body.title: Last Day of Stowe Mountain Resort, Vermont, USA
body.body:
![IMG_6400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23s9Loe8jrY6GYc3QvhwNoxt7TGTWJ2Sx5mgy5LM5vU4ePdr2Sh1pSaYFhwuix13mizFZ.jpeg)*The view of Mt Mansfield and Smugglers Notch in Northern Vermont from the high speed quad lift at Stowe Mountain Resort on the last day of the ski season, 2026.*

  What a season it has been, here at the best ski and snowboard destination on the East Coast. If you have ever heard the term \

, this is where they are talking about. Stowe, Vermont has had an epic winter. The snow started to fall heavy in November, and stuck around pretty much straight through April. The entire resort was open pretty much the entire winter. This meant that there was absolutely incredible snowboarding off the trails, through the trees. I did some exploring this year, and felt like every day I was finding new, fun, challenging places to snowboard. I got some days in with friends, and managed to walk away, fully recovered, from one harrowing crash into a tree. 
  
  At the bottom is a snapshot into my season, thanks to my EPIC app, tracking all of my days and lifts and vertical distance. I got up to the mountain a total of 43 days, which means I paid about $23 a day to snowboard this season, thanks to my season pass. I boarded just under 300,000 vertical feet, although that is most likely due to me spending so much time in the trees, which is a lot slower and tougher on my legs than just going straight down. 

  Looking back over the season there are so many highlights. And I couldn't help but think about all of them as I traveled up the lift on the last day of the season. Beautiful views and blue skies greeted me, with rapidly warming temperatures and spring corn snow conditions. It was a fabulous way to end the season. Now these trails will turn into hiking trails and people will be dusting off their mountain bikes for the opening bike trails. 

  Enjoy some of the amazing views from the slopes of Mt. Mansfield from our last day of the skiing season!

![IMG_6403.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EoeFPzsqkAKS6cNiEtQGZsMpqQAvwiVU4nJfgF4p6ZrKyQRrTF8K4KqfQVqpF3TPNuh.jpeg)*Top of the quad ski lift. Still top to bottom skiing at Stowe on April 25th, 2026. What a season it has been.*

![IMG_6405.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23xATXr7wLksC3e9NAaHijwK3JP6XvdyFsp3YUDKbs3bsRobrpUNysjsj4d1yoQx4tDFD.jpeg)*A couple of times I just had to stop and soak it all in. There was hardly any crowd at all, and still so much snow to play in. Not bad for late April here at Stowe Mountain Resort.*

![IMG_6377.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EopuKU9fFr7Q4edn4y1J3Y6NKycGLEoxhTzbYy4PjnJ6HVBDxrKYACredPQLtQTF88x.jpeg)*Nicely groomed, fresh tracks, and blue skies! What more could you ask for?*

![IMG_6381.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EowFgoUoheAk5M69WH7QLRy1YLvUagfDaz6MZD913cwbK3qDQ93GJR3f1m2gKwv41pA.jpeg)*I didn't even know that the Nosedive run, a black diamond off the side of the quad, would be open. It was another nice surprise.*

![IMG_6396.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23tvgJxENM5BNLjgxqn6sHD4Qwf5RLKpbqYFxaS8rsCejx5uxPyjRYS55jQk4G9Ma8uWh.jpeg)*Cernterline, under the lift, was a bit patchy. There were still lots of open options, and everywhere you looked was just beautiful.*

![IMG_6395.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpNoupAGvpNxgM7eqZ8oUDebLzL1e4pUWtXwEvp5GvuN2cJxh33etBtM5cCdSaCVHAg.jpeg)*This is my SWAT team ski outfit, at the top of Hayride, one of the famous 'Front Four' black diamond runs off of Mt Mansfield here in Vermont.*

![IMG_6394.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EppM8gynDsS6rTtUg2e33Y5TkjJnhUhJusQJxdcVYMKs6zXejpcDpR4WpEWMK8vneNB.jpeg)*Get ready. Hayride, here I come!*

![IMG_6404.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EorzNQ3tRhLBiqW6rCbCD6XRKitcPm3JiTxua9hfUAtwYxDPhqMpU24yjSZMX7zoyQU.jpeg)*You would need your rock skis for this run!*

![IMG_6402.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EprS8YPQ8peTyF51FkXUsQE8jxtNiHwQqmRubCP36AbcczpiRCbkGX7NKjs3nQAncPQ.jpeg)*Like a painting. This is the cliff house at the top of the gondola, under the famed Mt. Mansfield peak.*

![IMG_6401.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23vhz7Y26QnjTi3jL7u6E4Y4wcUjJyNK6JhoB1ALJC8ncXC3HYiaxoStPLGKhFpMfUzs5.jpeg)*Getting higher into the alpine region of Mt Mansfield.*

![IMG_6366.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/Eos1rtaTE4bDnB8FgDpsGJSRikD4aY1GkAq9tQ7jwoh1knLwU42LiAzxtentsXEM1C4.jpeg)*Blue skies and only a few people in front of me for first tracks at the opening bell!*

![IMG_6398.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23wqik7foYrDFX9HRctQGN5cuv3tJ8Fo4xnBhKnq5pFdNTTLMwfS5uxe1CWjUDRZTGWvb.jpeg)*How much longer will these frozen waterfalls exist? Spring is rapidly approaching.*

![IMG_6383.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpxqHaue8jUADbWFw5GjJPEKG96j7n7bkXfytdiTFkQHsqUspsYRdm9hzFJWTZTEyMc.jpeg)*These radio antennas are at the chin of Mt Mansfield. This look is on the way to Nosedive.*

![IMG_6379.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EowG6BcX27Kf2jyguSJQLooGH7SryWqhDqBs1osDWumg5MHvYmFp2qY3VxetfCbmxpc.jpeg)*More frozen waterfalls!*

![IMG_6387.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/EpLg2Ksiy4Cs9G93UAKthYaEB9v5QxgixYo1dE5BgzSNNyqX3tE3CH6mFZXQXVU4nQq.jpeg)*Stowe Mountain Resort really did a great job with snowmaking and keeping the resort open until late April this year.*


![Screenshot 2026-04-27 at 8.16.37 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dtam/23wCdA55HwzzqXcViYq8LaQAm6JFJiXpoESvvK9Yw2HiDu8tQ8PBNfpfbn685xYq8GL7a.png)*Well, I didn't hit 300,000 vertical feet this year, but 43 days at the mountain...hell yeah! There was a lot of time spent in the woods, one major accident when I hit a tree and was out for 6 weeks, but a full recovery, and some of the best snowboarding of my life!*

As always, keep posting and keep traveling!
- Dai Mar
