body.title: La decisión conciente transforma. 📝
body.body: > Tomar una decisión precipitada puede tener consecuencias negativas, por lo que debemos aprender a razonar antes de actuar, ya que, sea cual sea el resultado, será nuestra responsabilidad. ![El crecimiento requiere paciencia.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTgG63L3JXYWm1dmyiqxWJKFbJYwtTAXhVdStRk8s3Jen/El%20crecimiento%20requiere%20paciencia.jpg) [Imagen creada en canva](https://www.canva.com)[Fuente del recurso](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/mujer-direcci%c3%b3n-toma-de-decisiones-5949817/) Considero que la toma de decisiones es una de las áreas más importantes para las personas. Desde pequeños, debemos aprender a discernir qué nos beneficia y que no, aunque parezca negativo, nos ofrece una lección para el futuro. Es parte de la vida y del crecimiento personal y consciente de cada individuo. A veces, incluso cuando creo que es la decisión correcta, el resultado me hace dudar porque no fue lo que esperaba, sobre todo cuando implica beneficiar a otra persona. Si todo resulta ser lo contrario de lo planeado, siento remordimiento, porque tuve la oportunidad de tomar la decisión más beneficiosa, pero al intentar hacer las cosas bien, el resultado fue completamente lo opuesto. Sin embargo, con el tiempo, puedo ver que, aunque el resultado inicial no fue el esperado, gracias a haber hecho lo correcto, ahora puedo decir que valió la pena. He aprendido que, aunque las cosas no siempre salgan según lo planeado, hacerlas bien trae satisfacción, no solo por el resultado como tal, sino también porque sabía que tenía que hacer las cosas bien. Tomar decisiones acertadas tiene muchos beneficios, empezando por nuestro bienestar emocional, tanto a corto como a largo plazo. No hay nada mejor que saber que estamos haciendo las cosas correctamente. ![geralt-planning-4897792.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQjDxbEGj19wiTFk5xPMgSE9mJdBAvQMtMJro8vkWteDk/geralt-planning-4897792.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/planificaci%c3%b3n-plan-oportunidad-4897792/) Para muchas personas, tomar decisiones suele ser muy complejo. No es un proceso sencillo, y es muy difícil hacer lo correcto sin cometer errores. Para mí, es algo que me invita a reflexionar, aunque a veces debo ser más intuitiva y seguir mis sentimientos, sobre todo cuando creo que algo es correcto aunque no me beneficie directamente. Esto también forma parte del proceso de crecimiento personal: tomar decisiones conscientes, donde podemos aprender y encontrar ejemplos para futuras situaciones en nuestras vidas. Las decisiones que tomamos en la vida, nos guste o no el resultado, nos dan la oportunidad de vivir experiencias basadas en lo que hemos elegido. Pero es muy complejo, especialmente cuando somos jóvenes. Nuestra falta de experiencia nos lleva a cometer muchos errores, que al principio pueden tener consecuencias, pero con el tiempo, al aplicar esas experiencias a nuestra vida, nos ayudan a ser más sabios en el futuro, brindándonos nuevas oportunidades para mejorar y alcanzar el bienestar. ![tumisu-project-management-2061635.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYZ5UnbhXUFCkqXbn8AUS5ggaW68bBXYSBxZdMAnecP5/tumisu-project-management-2061635.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/gesti%c3%b3n-de-proyectos-2061635/) Hoy me siento muy agradecido porque muchas cosas buenas han llegado a mi vida gracias a las decisiones que he tomado. También he vivido momentos que quizás no hubiera deseado, pero agradezco la oportunidad de haber superado todas esas etapas, donde la toma de decisiones, más allá de los beneficios materiales, me ha enseñado valiosas lecciones que me motivan a ser mejor hoy, no solo esforzándome por alcanzar grandes metas, sino también disfrutando del proceso. ![rawpixel-heart-1986105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmayHr9HhRCpgAuZJx9pBMv4qMFXxedsfEHFJ7o7RzMFw4/rawpixel-heart-1986105.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/coraz%c3%b3n-playa-calma-disfrute-1986105/) La toma de decisiones consciente implica mucho, especialmente buscar opciones que nos beneficien después de un proceso de evaluación, pero tanto si todo sale según lo planeado como si no, si sabemos que hicimos las cosas bien, tendremos la satisfacción de saber que actuamos conscientemente y eso transforma nuestra manera de pensar y apreciar todos nuestros logros. > Gracias por leer mi publicación ❤️ --- |English version . | | -------- --- Making a hasty decision can have negative consequences, so we must learn to reason before acting, because whatever the outcome, it will be our responsibility. ![El crecimiento requiere paciencia (1).jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ56qhBhHXKqKcCFFwLVATor675tpRcPpUEh8vpyesNME/El%20crecimiento%20requiere%20paciencia%20(1).jpg) I believe that decision-making is one of the most important areas for people. From a young age, we must learn to discern what benefits us and what doesn't, because even if it seems negative, it offers us a lesson for the future. It's part of life and of each individual's personal and conscious growth. Sometimes, even when I think it's the right decision, the result makes me doubt because it wasn't what I expected, especially when it involves benefiting someone else. If everything turns out to be the opposite of what I planned, I feel remorse because I had the opportunity to make the most beneficial decision, but by trying to do things right, the result was completely the opposite. However, with time, I can see that, although the initial result wasn't what I expected, thanks to having done the right thing, I can now say that it was worth it. I've learned that even when things don't go according to plan, doing them well brings satisfaction, not only because of the outcome itself, but also because I knew I had to do things right. Making sound decisions has many benefits, starting with our emotional well-being, both in the short and long term. There's nothing better than knowing we're doing things correctly. ![geralt-planning-4897792.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQjDxbEGj19wiTFk5xPMgSE9mJdBAvQMtMJro8vkWteDk/geralt-planning-4897792.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/planificaci%c3%b3n-plan-oportunidad-4897792/) For many people, making decisions is often very complex. It's not a simple process, and it's very difficult to do the right thing without making mistakes. For me, it's something that prompts reflection, although sometimes I have to be more intuitive and follow my feelings, especially when I believe something is right even if it doesn't directly benefit me. This is also part of the personal growth process: making conscious decisions, where we can learn and find examples for future situations in our lives. The decisions we make in life, whether we like the outcome or not, give us the opportunity to live experiences based on what we've chosen. But it's very complex, especially when we're young. Our lack of experience leads us to make many mistakes, which may have consequences at first, but over time, applying those experiences to our lives helps us become wiser in the future, providing us with new opportunities to improve and achieve well-being. ![tumisu-project-management-2061635.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfYZ5UnbhXUFCkqXbn8AUS5ggaW68bBXYSBxZdMAnecP5/tumisu-project-management-2061635.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/illustrations/gesti%c3%b3n-de-proyectos-2061635/) Today I feel very grateful because many good things have come into my life thanks to the decisions I've made. I've also experienced moments I might not have wanted, but I'm grateful for the opportunity to have overcome all those stages, where decision-making, beyond the material benefits, has taught me valuable lessons that motivate me to be better today, not only striving to achieve great goals, but also enjoying the process. ![rawpixel-heart-1986105.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmayHr9HhRCpgAuZJx9pBMv4qMFXxedsfEHFJ7o7RzMFw4/rawpixel-heart-1986105.jpg) [Fuente](https://pixabay.com/es/photos/coraz%c3%b3n-playa-calma-disfrute-1986105/) Conscious decision-making involves a lot, especially seeking options that benefit us after an evaluation process, but whether everything goes according to plan or not, if we know we did things right, we'll have the satisfaction of knowing we acted consciously, and that transforms the way we think and appreciate all our achievements. > Thank you for reading my post ❤️ Imágenes creadas en [canva](https://www.canva.com/es_419/) Texto traducido al inglés en [Traductor de Google](https://translate.google.com/?hl=es&sl=auto&tl=en&text=Para%20finalizar%20me%20gustar%C3%ADa%20resaltar%20que%20existe%20un%20fidelidad%20que%20es%20para%20toda%20la%20vida%2C%20sin%20dudar%20por%20un%20momento%2C%20digo%20que%20es%20la%20fidelidad%20de%20Dios%20en%20nuestras%20vidas.&op=translate) ![IMG_20231128_162542.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQFtBdh3FXgNmKcYfeJMmjCJNgMiUoHyAoXxNqM4v6a2g/IMG_20231128_162542.png)

body.title: Lise Meitner — A Quiet Force in the Heart of Berlin
body.body:
![IMG_0776.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/city-of-berlin/242YAJWNWPCFCDh9Q83iEY2xapBt43cSgs6pLa1acyZg82Rc6zPfiomhAmY98Xu1k5PDK.JPEG)

There are statues in Berlin that demand attention — and then there are those that ask you to come closer. The figure of Lise Meitner belongs to the latter. She stands there, almost fragile, hands gently folded, as if she were holding a thought rather than a discovery that would change the world.

I passed her the other morning on my way through the courtyard near the Humboldt University. It was one of those grey Berlin mornings, the kind that softens everything, even history. And yet, standing before her, I felt something very precise: clarity. Not about the past, but about the kind of silence that surrounds certain achievements.

Lise Meitner was born in Vienna in 1878, at a time when women were not expected to enter the realm of science — let alone reshape it. And yet she did. As a physicist, she became one of the central figures in the discovery of nuclear fission, working closely with Otto Hahn. But history, as it often does, chose to remember selectively. Hahn received the Nobel Prize. Meitner did not.

Berlin was not just a station in her life — it was the place where her intellectual identity took form. At the University of Berlin, today’s Humboldt University, she attended lectures by Max Planck, at first unofficially, because women were not formally admitted. Later, she became one of the first female professors of physics in Germany. It is almost impossible to imagine what that must have meant at the time: to exist in a space that was not designed for you, and yet to leave a mark so deep that it could not be erased.

But Berlin also became the place she had to leave behind.

In 1938, as a Jewish scientist, she was forced to flee Nazi Germany. She escaped to Sweden, carrying with her not only her knowledge, but also the quiet dignity that seems to echo in this statue. It was there, in exile, that she provided the theoretical explanation for nuclear fission — a breakthrough that would ultimately shape the modern world in ways both illuminating and terrifying.

And perhaps this is what moves me most when I stand before her: the ambiguity of legacy.

Meitner refused to participate in the development of nuclear weapons. She understood the implications of her work — not only scientifically, but ethically. In a century obsessed with progress, she remained anchored in responsibility. There is something deeply Berlin about that tension: between innovation and reflection, between creation and consequence.

Her statue does not celebrate loudly. It does not monumentalize power. Instead, it reminds us of something quieter, and perhaps more important — integrity.

In a city that constantly reinvents itself, Lise Meitner stands as a counterpoint. Not everything needs to be rebuilt to be remembered. Some things endure precisely because they resist noise.

Ciao Kakao, your Morticia
![IMG_0777.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/city-of-berlin/EoGzSZ9cun6e3gwB9Yaa2aeRFJYydV4bXKZN7kqFLEYu5apN7Qkp46W3eXTio9dk45N.JPEG)

- - -
# Lise Meitner — Eine stille Kraft im Herzen Berlins

![IMG_0776.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/city-of-berlin/242YAJWNWPCFCDh9Q83iEY2xapBt43cSgs6pLa1acyZg82Rc6zPfiomhAmY98Xu1k5PDK.JPEG)
Es gibt Statuen in Berlin, die Aufmerksamkeit verlangen — und dann gibt es jene, die einen näherkommen lassen. Die Figur von Lise Meitner gehört eindeutig zur zweiten Kategorie. Sie steht dort, fast zerbrechlich, die Hände sanft gefaltet, als würde sie einen Gedanken halten und nicht eine Entdeckung, die die Welt verändern sollte.

Ich bin ihr neulich am Morgen begegnet, auf dem Weg durch den Hof nahe der Humboldt-Universität. Es war einer dieser grauen Berliner Morgen, an denen alles weicher wirkt, selbst die Geschichte. Und doch empfand ich vor ihr etwas sehr Klares: eine Art von Präzision. Nicht über die Vergangenheit, sondern über die Stille, die manche Leistungen umgibt.

Lise Meitner wurde 1878 in Wien geboren, in einer Zeit, in der Frauen nicht dafür vorgesehen waren, die Welt der Wissenschaft zu betreten — geschweige denn, sie zu verändern. Und dennoch tat sie genau das. Als Physikerin war sie eine der zentralen Figuren bei der Entdeckung der Kernspaltung und arbeitete eng mit Otto Hahn zusammen. Doch die Geschichte, wie so oft, erinnerte sich selektiv. Hahn erhielt den Nobelpreis. Meitner nicht.

Berlin war für sie nicht nur eine Station — es war der Ort, an dem sich ihre intellektuelle Identität formte. An der Universität Berlin, der heutigen Humboldt-Universität, besuchte sie Vorlesungen von Max Planck, zunächst inoffiziell, da Frauen nicht zugelassen waren. Später wurde sie eine der ersten Professorinnen für Physik in Deutschland. Es ist kaum vorstellbar, was das damals bedeutete: in einem Raum zu existieren, der nicht für einen gedacht war — und dennoch Spuren zu hinterlassen, die nicht ausgelöscht werden konnten.

Doch Berlin wurde auch der Ort, den sie verlassen musste.

1938, als jüdische Wissenschaftlerin, war sie gezwungen, vor dem NS-Regime zu fliehen. Sie entkam nach Schweden und nahm nicht nur ihr Wissen mit, sondern auch jene stille Würde, die sich in dieser Statue widerspiegelt. Im Exil lieferte sie die theoretische Erklärung der Kernspaltung — ein Durchbruch, der die moderne Welt auf tiefgreifende und ambivalente Weise prägen sollte.

Und vielleicht ist es genau das, was mich an ihr am meisten bewegt: die Ambivalenz ihres Vermächtnisses.

Meitner weigerte sich, an der Entwicklung von Atomwaffen mitzuwirken. Sie verstand die Tragweite ihrer Arbeit — nicht nur wissenschaftlich, sondern auch ethisch. In einem Jahrhundert, das vom Fortschritt besessen war, blieb sie der Verantwortung verpflichtet. In dieser Spannung liegt etwas zutiefst Berlinerisches: zwischen Innovation und Reflexion, zwischen Schaffen und Konsequenz.

Ihre Statue feiert nicht laut. Sie monumentalisiert keine Macht. Stattdessen erinnert sie an etwas Leiseres — und vielleicht Wichtigeres: Integrität.

In einer Stadt, die sich ständig neu erfindet, steht Lise Meitner als Gegenpol. Nicht alles muss wieder aufgebaut werden, um erinnert zu werden. Manche Dinge bleiben gerade deshalb bestehen, weil sie sich dem Lärm entziehen.

Ciao Kakao, Eure Morticia
![IMG_0777.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/city-of-berlin/EoGzSZ9cun6e3gwB9Yaa2aeRFJYydV4bXKZN7kqFLEYu5apN7Qkp46W3eXTio9dk45N.JPEG)

body.title: 继续圆滚滚：带媳妇去吃苏氏牛肉面
body.body:
今天中午又不知道该吃些啥，喊朋友夫妇合计一起吃点大餐，结果他们倆竟然在家带娃——这还没放假呢，竟然就给娃请假，也是醉了！


![20260427_122646.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ2TsbcZxdjZBeb797hmnsF1j9EMgyTgiK2B6EwYG4o2i/20260427_122646.jpg)

朋友们不出来，就只好和媳妇两个人出去觅食啦，我们商量了一大堆各种饭店之后，决定去吃苏氏牛肉面。

话说我已经吃了N多天的各种面，实在是不想吃了，不过最近带娃吃苏氏牛肉面时没少和媳妇安利这个有多好吃，不带媳妇去吃有点过分了。

其实苏氏牛肉面早在2000年前后在沈阳就有店铺呢，那时候也没少去吃，媳妇那时候也去吃过，就是这些年各种美食层出不穷，才很少去了。

印象里那时候苏氏牛肉面粗细均匀，有些像那种机制的原挂面，吃着也没觉得多好吃。

但是这两年再吃苏氏牛肉面，发现都是工人在当场抻面，当场下锅。面条的粗细不匀，但吃起来却是口感极佳，这也是我之前强烈和媳妇安利的原因。

离我们最近的苏氏牛肉面在北行那边（碧塘公园附近）但是不好停车，所以这次我们决定去兴华街那边的苏氏牛肉面，距离星摩尔也不远，想着实在没地方停车就停到星摩尔然后步行过去。

结果我在这附近转啊转啊，竟然还真被我找到一个停车位（前一位车主刚把车开走）
![20260427_121312.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXT6d54UBqUMcobdeexp3yboT7FthKMBDeSKcUye85YuU/20260427_121312.jpg)

就是这位置超级难停，不过毕竟老司机了，搞定！
![20260427_121323.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSK3fX8aKUJtce2hNRRhGt4Q7eqVAhn5yWZJS8jQt8c5Y/20260427_121323.jpg)

对面竟然是韩都烤肉，说起来也有20来年没有吃过它家了，当年我们也是它家的常客呀
![20260427_121327.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXayFZG89FC61pM5qs6KbCSNZPKTiPhH2gDiYmwk4hN6R/20260427_121327.jpg)

旁边就是地铁站
![20260427_121336.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmT9u9KVpmNtTBHXkX9JhECMyesjxuGW8SRQAyaHoxU9e8/20260427_121336.jpg)

对面的方林装饰总部
![20260427_121421.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmd635vutxTJj6bHvQeq8sdvPkCZS6GAmwyMrHHkNrvR25/20260427_121421.jpg)

这边还有一个温泉
![20260427_121429.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYGcE1v9KjEQ7LZtvXxzRtK1jHjASheP1g2bHhAyjVrKy/20260427_121429.jpg)

步行前往苏氏牛肉面，两边的小店还很多
![20260427_121505.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSVtEFRCc7WrRuYnEK1cJdQLRgK5zWjpRy1PrRkXNrPb1/20260427_121505.jpg)

来到韩都对面，竟然是33年的经典老店啦，我和媳妇提议要不我们吃烤肉去吧？媳妇说没带儿子来怎么好意思两个人吃烤肉呢？！😳
![20260427_121514.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVA6hZXpcbv4Dpt1NfVk4YaUCSQBNDMGDgCTSXzo5oJMU/20260427_121514.jpg)

后边是红星美凯龙
![20260427_121520.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZjVnVBSqVEUN8ZBoQSpX86CnrnoLY4yEZGuAgRjYhfVf/20260427_121520.jpg)

到达苏氏牛肉面
![20260427_121906.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaFeMoRV9sTKCK28ug2KH3hGmr1CmmJCCwK5J3d6caj4T/20260427_121906.jpg)

热乎乎的苏氏牛肉面上来啦
![20260427_122646.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQ2TsbcZxdjZBeb797hmnsF1j9EMgyTgiK2B6EwYG4o2i/20260427_122646.jpg)

还有烤串
![20260427_122654.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTcsy9ZxcAkJv2voW4NCfkGdpULwxhnxCxUKY6t97HdEE/20260427_122654.jpg)

还有花生露
![20260427_122703.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdU6AMvvSnzcNAvAiFiQQySVX6nGqyXHrruCudqrwNe7y/20260427_122703.jpg)

虽然这些天连续吃面，来之前实在提不起胃口，不过一吃上，还是觉得实在是太好吃啦。

和苏氏牛肉面比起里，什么老四季抻面、兰州拉面、杭小点的葱油面、李先生的牛肉面、秦兜兜的裤带面、西安里的哨子面，还有什么礼面之类的都逊爆了。

别问我怎么了解这么多面，因为我天天吃面啊。呜呜呜！

---

Alfredo Espino (Nació en Ahuachapán, 1900-1928). Poeta salvadoreño y escritor que a partir de su único libro, \

, es uno de los líricos más leídos en Latinoamérica. Posee una una recopilación de 96 poemas.
Alfredo Espino tiene una poética delicada; buscó plasmar en su poesía, una declamación y estilo sencillo, fácil de captar, sin complicaciones, y queriendo proyectar un día en el rancho; mostrando el campo, las tardes en el pueblo, el amor, el cafetalito, los bejucos, el nido del cenzontle y lo autóctono de El Salvador.
Un día ¡primero Dios!
has de quererme un poquito.
Yo levantaré el ranchito
en que vivamos los dos.
 
Un rancho y un lucero de Alfredo Espino, es el poema de amor más dedicado para el día de las madres en El Salvador, que se celebra cada 10 de Mayo.
Espero disfrutes mi declamación que la dedico con todo mi corazón a todas las mamitas salvadoreñas y a las mamás de todo el mundo, bendiciones! 🙏😘
___

content.description: Alfredo Espino (Nació en Ahuachapán, 1900-1928). Poeta salvadoreño y escritor que a partir de su único libro, \

, es uno de los líricos más leídos en Latinoamérica. Posee una una recopilación de 96 poemas.
Alfredo Espino tiene una poética delicada; buscó plasmar en su poesía, una declamación y estilo sencillo, fácil de captar, sin complicaciones, y queriendo proyectar un día en el rancho; mostrando el campo, las tardes en el pueblo, el amor, el cafetalito, los bejucos, el nido del cenzontle y lo autóctono de El Salvador.
Un día ¡primero Dios!
has de quererme un poquito.
Yo levantaré el ranchito
en que vivamos los dos.
 
Un rancho y un lucero de Alfredo Espino, es el poema de amor más dedicado para el día de las madres en El Salvador, que se celebra cada 10 de Mayo.
Espero disfrutes mi declamación que la dedico con todo mi corazón a todas las mamitas salvadoreñas y a las mamás de todo el mundo, bendiciones! 🙏😘

body.body:
This blog will explain why digital marketing is important for modern brands and how it supports long-term success.



![digital-marketing.jpg](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/7d885305830b3836dfb5be80ac592ff82cd932007f0d668f30f76a7bfdf121e0)



In the modern dynamic world, businesses cannot afford to use only the traditional modes of marketing like newspapers, radio, or billboards. The internet has transformed the way people do their searches and purchases and their interactions with brands. This is where [Digital marketing for wedding planners in NYC](https://www.omefyi.com/digital-marketing-for-wedding-planners-in-nyc/) comes in. It assists companies to connect with the appropriate audience, gain trust, and achieve growth in a way that has never occurred before.

What Is Digital Marketing?

Digital marketing refers to marketing products or services online using websites, search engines, social networks, and email. It involves content marketing strategies, social media marketing, email campaigns, and search engine optimization. 

Digital marketing has helped businesses to reach out to people when they are online, at the point where they spend the majority of their time.

Helps Reach a Larger Audience

Digital marketing offers one of the greatest benefits: the ability to target a global market. Compared to traditional marketing, which is confined to a particular locality, digital sites enable companies to reach out to individuals anywhere in the city, country, or continent. 

Digital marketing provides equal chances of growth whether you are a small business or a large company.

Cost-Effective Marketing Strategy

Online marketing is cheaper than conventional marketing. Placing advertisements on social media or search engines is less expensive than placing flyers or TV adverts. This renders it an ideal choice for small and medium-sized enterprises. 

Professional SEO services include businesses that are able to enhance online presence without incurring excessive expenses. It has long-term benefits in that it creates organic traffic to websites.

Builds Brand Awareness

Now, citizens on the Internet engage in search activities prior to purchasing any product or service. You can miss out on potential customers if your brand is not visible on the Web. 

Digital marketing assists in establishing a formidable online presence. Businesses can narrate their stories through social media posts, blogs, and online advertisements and gain the trust of customers. This eventually creates brand awareness and recognition.

Improves Customer Engagement

Digital marketing enables brands to communicate with their customers. Communication via social media sites, emails, and live chats is simple and fast. 

Companies can answer client queries, accept feedback, and solve issues in real time. This creates a close association with customers, and loyalty is enhanced.

Supports Targeted Marketing

The other significant advantage of digital marketing is the targeting of the appropriate audience. Based on age, location, interests, and behavior, businesses have options on whom they would like to see their ads. 

To illustrate, [Local SEO for event planning businesses in Manhattan](https://www.omefyi.com/local-seo-for-event-planning-businesses-in-manhattan/) helps businesses in drawing customers within their locality. This would be particularly handy in small businesses such as restaurants, salons, and local service providers. It makes sure that your business is easily found by those who are looking to get services in your area.

Measurable Results and Performance Tracking

Digital marketing, unlike traditional marketing, provides clear, measurable results. Businesses are able to monitor the number of visitors who visited their site, those who clicked on the advertisements, or even those who bought their product. 

Such tools as Google Analytics can be used to keep track of performance and make superior decisions. This enables enterprises to improve their strategies and achieve better results in the long run.

Keeps You Competitive

Most businesses are currently employing digital marketing in the current competitive market. Unless you use it, you risk losing out to your rivals. 

Investing in digital marketing techniques like content marketing and the use of SEO will help businesses to remain ahead and reach more customers.

Final Thoughts

Online advertising is no longer a luxury; it is a necessity for brands in the new age. It assists companies in accessing a larger audience, decreasing expenses, enhancing interaction, and prospering more quickly. Using tools such as Local SEO and professional [SEO services for coffee shops in New York](https://www.omefyi.com/seo-services-for-coffee-shops-in-new-york), companies are able to increase their presence on the Internet and find the appropriate customers. At a time when the majority of the decision-making process begins on the Internet, online marketing guarantees that your brand remains prominent, competitive, and prosperous.

FAQs

1\. What is the main purpose of digital marketing?

Digital marketing primarily aims at advertising products or services over the internet and reaching out to prospective customers.

2\. What does Local SEO do to benefit small businesses?

Local SEO assists in the ranking of companies in local searches, making them easy to search for and visit by nearby customers.

3\. Are SEO services important for online growth?

The answer is yes, because the services of SEO help companies to be more visible on search engines and thus capture more organic traffic and desired sales.

4\. Is digital marketing suitable for small businesses?

Digital marketing is cheap and enables small businesses to match their bigger counterparts, yes.

5\. How long does it take to see results from digital marketing?

The outcomes may differ, and such strategies as SEO can require several months, whereas paid advertisements can bring the results within a short period of time.

body.title: Entre Vitrales y Arcángeles me Veo: Mi Travesía por Brasilia [Esp/Eng]
body.body: > Saludos cordiales, estimada comunidad de Lifestyle. >Warm regards, dear Lifestyle community. Continúo mi fantástica expedición por la ciudad de Brasilia. Corresponde seguir la planificación de esta visita, tal como la tiene programada mi amiga Damelys, por el eje cultural de la ciudad. Llego con el asombro en el pecho tras salir del Memorial de los Pueblos Indígenas, para quedar estupefacto ante esta obra arquitectónica; un regalo de la vida y de la amistad. Es una fabulosa aventura donde la realidad y las estructuras, plantadas como árboles mágicos de la Amazonía brasileña, despiertan la imaginación. > I continue my fantastic expedition through the city of Brasília. It’s time to follow the itinerary for this visit, as planned by my friend Damelys, through the city’s cultural heart. I arrive filled with wonder after leaving the Memorial to Indigenous Peoples, only to be left speechless by this architectural masterpiece; a gift of life and friendship. It is a fabulous adventure where reality and structures, planted like magical trees of the Brazilian Amazon, spark the imagination. ---

> --- Aquí estoy en la Catedral Metropolitana de Nuestra Señora Aparecida, conocida popularmente como la Catedral de Brasilia, obra emblemática del arquitecto Oscar Niemeyer. Inaugurada en 1970, posee un diseño inédito y es un referente mundial de la arquitectura moderna. La aprecio como un portal de energía cósmica, una flor de pétalos abiertos al universo que destaca por sus dieciséis columnas de hormigón, las cuales se elevan hacia el cielo simbolizando manos abiertas. > Here I am at the Metropolitan Cathedral of Our Lady of Aparecida, popularly known as the Cathedral of Brasília, an iconic work by the architect Oscar Niemeyer. Inaugurated in 1970, it boasts a unique design and is a global benchmark of modern architecture. I see it as a portal of cosmic energy, a flower with petals open to the universe, distinguished by its sixteen concrete columns, which rise towards the sky, symbolising open hands. La estructura me atrapa incluso antes de entrar al templo, gracias al cromatismo que crean sus vitrales azules, verdes y blancos, así como por la presencia de las esculturas de los cuatro evangelistas en su entrada. Esta visita es un precioso obsequio dentro de mi recorrido por la capital brasileña. > The structure captivates me even before I enter the cathedral, thanks to the play of colours created by its blue, green and white stained-glass windows, as well as the presence of the sculptures of the four evangelists at its entrance. This visit is a precious gift during my tour of the Brazilian capital. Mis sentidos están desbordados ante cada espacio de esta obra. La Catedral de Brasilia no solo es un icono estético de la ciudad y de la República del Brasil, sino una notoria ruptura con la tradición arquitectónica eclesial que predominó durante siglos. Al desprenderse de cánones conservadores —como la planta de cruz latina, las naves laterales, los arbotantes o las pesadas bóvedas de piedra—, Niemeyer transformó este proyecto en una experiencia espiritual, marcada por la exigencia de la modernidad técnica y una filosofía de apertura. > My senses are overwhelmed by every aspect of this building. Brasília Cathedral is not only an aesthetic icon of the city and of the Republic of Brazil, but also a striking break with the ecclesiastical architectural tradition that prevailed for centuries. By breaking away from conservative conventions—such as the Latin cross plan, the side aisles, the flying buttresses or the heavy stone vaults—Niemeyer transformed this project into a spiritual experience, marked by the demands of technical modernity and a philosophy of openness. Tradicionalmente, las catedrales se concebían como claustros de fe: espacios cerrados, oscuros y masivos que protegían al fiel del mundo exterior. Niemeyer hizo lo opuesto: al eliminar los muros de carga, permitió que la luz fuera la protagonista. Los vitrales de Marianne Peretti no son elementos decorativos añadidos, sino los auténticos muros. Esto me genera una sensación de suavidad al ver que el cielo de Brasilia parece habitar el templo, borrando el límite entre lo sagrado y la naturaleza. > Traditionally, cathedrals were conceived as sanctuaries of faith: enclosed, dark and massive spaces that shielded the faithful from the outside world. Niemeyer did the opposite: by removing the load-bearing walls, he allowed light to take centre stage. Marianne Peretti’s stained-glass windows are not added decorative elements, but the very walls themselves. This gives me a sense of gentleness as I see that the sky of Brasília seems to inhabit the temple, blurring the boundary between the sacred and nature. ---

>

---

Es magnífico. Al encontrarme en el centro de la Catedral, el diseño circular me sitúa frente al altar, donde todos estamos unidos sin perturbaciones. Todo fluye con la simetría de la cercanía y la comunidad; no soy un espectador de una liturgia distante, sino un integrante de un espacio envolvente. Al revisar la configuración de las catedrales góticas, que perfilaban la verticalidad a través de la piedra y el esfuerzo estructural de los arcos apuntados, noto que Niemeyer utilizó el hormigón armado para diseñar una nueva geometría. Estas piezas, como pétalos que ascienden, convierten a la catedral en una \

de luz y tensión universal. > It is magnificent. Standing in the centre of the cathedral, the circular design places me directly in front of the altar, where we are all united without distraction. Everything flows with the symmetry of closeness and community; I am not a spectator at a distant liturgy, but a participant in an immersive space. When examining the layout of Gothic cathedrals, which emphasised verticality through stone and the structural strength of pointed arches, I notice that Niemeyer used reinforced concrete to design a new geometry. These elements, like ascending petals, transform the cathedral into a ‘sculpture’ of light and universal tension. ---

> --- Al entrar, percibo una atractiva diferencia al pasar por un túnel oscuro que desemboca en el espacio amplio y luminoso de la nave: el arquitecto recrea un ritual de purificación psicológica, un paso de la penumbra hacia la luz desbordante. Como aventurero que aprecia la emancipación racional, esta obra encarna precisamente eso: la liberación de la arquitectura del peso de la tradición histórica para abrazar un futuro donde la razón, el espacio y la luz conviven sin dogmas de piedra. > Upon entering, I perceive a striking contrast as I pass through a dark tunnel that opens into the spacious, luminous nave: the architect recreates a ritual of psychological purification, a passage from shadow into overwhelming light. As an adventurer who appreciates rational emancipation, this work embodies precisely that: the liberation of architecture from the weight of historical tradition to embrace a future where reason, space and light coexist without immutable dogmas. Tengo mucho que anotar en mi blog. No puedo dejar de lado las esculturas de bronce de los cuatro evangelistas —Mateo, Marcos, Lucas y Juan—, guardianes del espacio sagrado en el exterior. Junto con otros elementos del santoral, refuerzan la naturaleza del templo. Son obra del escultor Alfredo Ceschiatti, quien colaboró estrechamente con Niemeyer para asegurar que las figuras complementaran la audacia del edificio. > I have a lot to write about on my blog. I cannot overlook the bronze sculptures of the four evangelists—Matthew, Mark, Luke and John—who stand guard over the sacred space outside. Together with other elements depicting the saints, they reinforce the character of the church. They are the work of the sculptor Alfredo Ceschiatti, who collaborated closely with Niemeyer to ensure that the figures complemented the building’s bold design. ---

> --- En esta travesía, estos detalles merecen ser fotografiados y guardados en mi memoria personal. Al llegar al centro de la nave, me encuentro con los arcángeles Miguel, Rafael y Gabriel. Elevados sobre el espacio central, su sencillez me conmueve; siento que floto con ellos por todo el portal cósmico de la catedral, reforzando la idea de Niemeyer de que la estructura no tiene peso y que el cielo está presente en su interior. > On this journey, these details deserve to be photographed and stored in my personal memory. Upon reaching the centre of the nave, I encounter the archangels Michael, Raphael and Gabriel. Soaring above the central space, their simplicity moves me; I feel as though I am floating with them through the cathedral’s cosmic portal, reinforcing Niemeyer’s idea that the structure is weightless and that the heavens are present within it. ---

> ---
La unidad entre las artes y la arquitectura
Como cronista de mi aventura, noto un detalle fascinante: tanto los ángeles como los evangelistas no fueron \

como decoración, sino concebidos como parte del ser arquitectónico. Si la catedral es un objeto que rompe el paradigma, estas esculturas actúan como el vínculo humano-divino dentro de esa geometría. No dominan el espacio, sino que se integran en la atmósfera de luz azul y blanca, como parte de una coreografía suspendida. > The unity between the arts and architecture > As I chronicle my adventure, I notice a fascinating detail: neither the angels nor the evangelists were ‘placed’ there as decoration, but conceived as part of the architectural fabric. If the cathedral is an object that breaks the mould, these sculptures act as the link between the human and the divine within that geometry. They do not dominate the space, but rather blend into the atmosphere of blue and white light, as part of a suspended choreography. Tras este breve recorrido por el espacio y las artes en Brasilia, la agenda anuncia que abordaremos el carro de Cássia para trasladarnos, junto a Damelys y Alfredo, al comedor de la Universidad de Brasilia. > Following this brief tour of the space and the arts in Brasília, the itinerary announces that we will board Cássia’s car to travel, alongside Damelys and Alfredo, to the dining hall of the University of Brasília. --- ¡Fabuloso vuelo en esta ciudad planificada sobre el trazado de un avión! > A fabulous flight in this city planned on the blueprint of an aeroplane! --- ![imagen.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hiramdo/EowFCWZ665utq8RamW9y9CL7SuChDXnwAtvaBpXvWMXJC5tb54QoTN6K7oZacPYdGVr.png) ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hiramdo/23w2zBfi3jVpJWeEZosHmTM2YnBz5GWW5QfydHsZb3n5itHWiuuMUvDkLtZoawDPuwTzu.png) ---

body.title: Liege, Planted Garden Seeds and Potatoes, Robin, 15 Mile Bike Ride, Flat, Booty - Sunday
body.body:
Got to see the last 1/3 of the Liege race yesterday morning as Pogi rode away from Seixas on the last hill to easily win the race. Just crazy how strong and the endurance of the top riders. ![IMG_20260426_052737.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2mG5AR2DmYksEyXxT3TtK45BtCt6weFFU1VFbWfJxkVB96tr76zaEUk5zyi1tfXPuM.jpg) ![IMG_20260426_064055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFTQmLKvQjwC6giWwmcFvRVnd3yvRdGNupHRAkz5nM6ArXRYcbWDfs5rFtMJvER6YHK.jpg) My morning was focused on getting the garden planted. First was the 2 rows of peas with their fences. ![IMG_20260426_095358.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23w2gq7ouP8dYaTJBGPMWak7gWUXMCxwHGJPBacjUYcgw8FA2X8ucbJNWNYL6SXNYp9au.jpg) Celery next. ![IMG_20260426_100047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wMW4kSQvd2m3jgMktmzikFfjE7wZx1Hc8i1zq2kpidsTyJA7FWCV3vRLuipkBNRQAXU.jpg) Cabbage next row. ![IMG_20260426_100935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uQp2V3AXYmyGNTUSgxVvz8dMANp2BRv8VfAGib8JEgNVXWN1o6qdqmBQyy65EMZLw52.jpg) Then a row each of kale and chard. ![IMG_20260426_102139.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23yd3v7BpB5aBFKBXCiPjJZjYKyN5RfGZsH1uA1uiM939AMC7N2fPtXjmmzZ5PpipFAxh.jpg) A row of beans. ![IMG_20260426_104522.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x17JjFvAar7L5gEY3nmMgjje4U1tUGGNkzL9u9bmoKTiDfmhtd39CxAGsF4r9zHogsH.jpg) I went to get a bag of potatoes from the studio and the robins have 4 eggs in their nest now, not hatched. She was not happy with my proximity to the nest and sat in the tree pipping and chirping at me until I walked away. ![IMG_20260426_110752.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmDZX7zYLPjPEyjTckYfTiB8ABGujLKuqBKqQo3XcaeLVorHdvK1hvDwAEe9g33MjdL.jpg) 4 rows of Red Nordland potatoes in the ground. About 200 of them and R helped me with one row. They are on the end of the garden so when it is time to harvest I can lift the plastic without having to worry about other plants. ![IMG_20260426_134421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wWttJRLDB7N5PhXUeymZ3M6STG6sdRWGZFQyW4PfXcChZFTnC8E7qEV9DdkGaeWoKyY.jpg) J had his flag football in the afternoon and I went out for a mellow-ish ride. I really was trying to keep it mellow but my legs have other ideas. ![IMG_20260426_141259.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23wCBeKazGxxEzmpcuvK3XitdyasB2LfHdcup8o615rLsT4YSMEr1VYgV4tmHKr67crYL.jpg) It was snowing on Mt. Spokane as a cell went whizzing by. It had some cool breezes with it but the sun would come back out and be warmer again. ![IMG_20260426_141518.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/245wFpds6MdCr5eykoKGXK27YGEdJzJndR7MDUmu7QVksEtYNNL3bFBBiGcoHmDA2xF5A.jpg) I chose to ride a lot of gravel on my road bike and paid the price on the steep downhill curves as I got a front tire flat. I again was able to get it fixed in about 5 minutes and be back on the gravel road only going a good bit slower so as not to explode another tube. ![bike 4-26.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tbMB4W1m9CeEMzdEp3QTxczEQRiNrgH75UfcueGF5ZeemDtEyYJAAuxzN38LDaHZnue.JPG) It's interesting how I can nail the same distance as the prior day without trying. 15 miles exactly again. Still zone 3 the bulk of the time and likely the mile+ hill climb lead to the threshold level. ![bike 4-26 zones.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tGTE7L3iMAEGjkwY4YtiHfQg2GxTNDh1uU2wuicRbCVUQ8Hce1j3tNs3cCxUoQhcvBc.JPG) Found 4 more e-cigs and a broken set of DeWalt head phones. Oh and my flat tube... ![IMG_20260426_151546.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23x15FdcHCgtXyS5Ep4wKDyHsD8zqtcbLRCpdZ98Gw9Sv4agbKEqarWmorNHLMAXqq384.jpg) Ripped the batteries out of the e-cigs right away. ![IMG_20260426_170657.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23tmFP3a9XjFeKdzDNeTtad5uphVpxGds6rgC92vvCfcZMkQimvRDGsL5BBRSsXCi4Qts.jpg) And this is my nearly 3 dozen batteries I have so far just from the e-cigs I find on my rides. ![IMG_20260426_170053.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/flemingfarm/23uFTyaCYgmAqU18owMJd8TMrsfJF2HFjY5eb7fhPFuyeh843HP9QP22PPui5jaqBFax8.jpg) Today I get the boys to school in a while, I got a few leads from Thumbtack and need to setup the one I got overnight, will return the core of the brakes to Autozone, figure out where I will plant yellow potatoes and get the space tilled and maybe planted, then have to pick J up after track practice and figure out dinner. ---

body.title: Hot Springs, AR Wedding at Garvan Woodland Gardens
body.body: A mid-week (Tuesday) wedding isn't the normal for us, but when we heard what was planned for Journie & Daniel's wedding, we were totally onboard. Yes, Journie's mother was a bit of a hippie and named her after the band Journey in case you were wondering (her story to me :D) They wanted something unique and different. Something small, intimate, and with their closest family/friends. On top of that, Journie had her heart set on one of the iconic glass chapels of Arkansas. Garvan Woodland Gardens was her location of choice and for us....it was a HELL YES! Set in the woodlands just outside Hot Springs, Arkansas, this location was amazing. A sculpted garden with glass chapel, art installations, a tree house structure, Japanese gardens, waterfalls, iconic views...this place has it all. Top that off with some perfect weather of 73 degrees and sunshine and you have the makings of a perfect outdoor wedding day. We feel truly blessed to capture this one on photo & video and can't wait to share more...but for now, here are some sneak peek photos from the day

body.title: Einführung: Die Rolle Sicherer Systeme Beim Aufbau Von Vertrauen
body.body:
In der heutigen digitalen Welt sind sichere Systeme ein entscheidender Faktor für das Entstehen von Vertrauen. Unter sicheren Systemen verstehen wir IT-Infrastrukturen, die durch technische und organisatorische Maßnahmen vor unbefugtem Zugriff und Manipulation geschützt sind.






Die Verbindung zwischen IT-Sicherheit und Vertrauen ist untrennbar, denn nur wenn Systeme verlässlich funktionieren und Datenschutz gewährleisten, entsteht beim Nutzer ein Gefühl von Sicherheit. Dieses Vertrauen bildet die Grundlage für effiziente Kommunikation und Geschäftsprozesse in der digitalen Wirtschaft.






Aktuelle Studien bestätigen, dass das Vertrauen in IT-Systeme auf konkret messbaren Sicherheitsmaßnahmen basiert und nicht allein auf vertrauensvollen Zusicherungen beruht. Dies unterstreicht die Bedeutung einer starken IT-Sicherheitskultur, die transparent kommuniziert und konsequent umgesetzt wird.






## Grundlagen: Vertrauensdefinitionen In IT-Systemen Und Deren Bedeutung






Vertrauen in IT-Systemen umfasst unterschiedliche Dimensionen, die wir in technischer und psychologischer Hinsicht betrachten müssen. Aus technischer Sicht bedeutet Vertrauen die Annahme, sich auf die korrekte Funktionsweise von IT-Lösungen verlassen zu können, wodurch Komplexität reduziert und Risiken gesteuert werden.






Auf Nutzerseite spielen psychologische Komponenten eine bedeutende Rolle: Vertrauen entsteht hier durch die Wahrnehmung von Transparenz, Verlässlichkeit und Sicherheit im Umgang mit dem System. Die Abwesenheit von Vertrauen führt nicht selten zu Misstrauen und Nutzungseinschränkungen.

Fehlendes Vertrauen kann gravierende Folgen haben, wie die Verweigerung der Nutzung wichtiger Services oder negative Auswirkungen auf die Geschäftsbeziehungen. Daher ist das Verständnis beider Perspektiven essenziell für ein ganzheitliches Vertrauensmanagement in IT-Systemen.






## Regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen Als Vertrauenstreiber






### EU-DSGVO: Schutz Als Grundpfeiler Für Nutzervertrauen






Die EU-Datenschutz-Grundverordnung (DSGVO) ist ein zentraler Bestandteil für den Schutz personenbezogener Daten. Sie stärkt das Vertrauen der Nutzer durch klare Regeln zu Datenverarbeitung, Integrität und Rechenschaftspflicht. Compliance mit der DSGVO verhindert Bußgelder und unterstützt Unternehmen beim Erhalt ihrer Glaubwürdigkeit.






### ISO 27001: Standardisierung Und Ihre Auswirkungen






Mit der ISO 27001 wurde ein international anerkannter Standard für Informationssicherheitsmanagement etabliert. Unternehmen, die diesen Standard erfüllen, signalisieren ihren Partnern und Kunden ein hohes Maß an Sicherheit und Verantwortlichkeit. Dadurch entfaltet sich ein positiver Effekt auf das generelle Vertrauen in IT-Systeme.

Multi-Faktor-Authentifizierung (MFA) ist dabei eine Schlüsseltechnologie. Sie verlangt von den Nutzern neben dem Passwort eine zusätzliche Sicherheitsstufe, etwa einen Einmalcode per SMS oder eine Authentifikator-App. Das reduziert die Gefahr unbefugten Zugriffs erheblich und stärkt das Vertrauen der Spieler in die Plattform.

body.title: A Rough End
body.body:
![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRdw5pgn9k5p4dRSmKRhgdCYYdG6xjvQQBuJdDLsBKiio/PXL_20260327_173005830.webp)

------------------------------

It wasn't the end of the season that the Radford Highlanders were hoping for, but it's where we are and I think they are still going to be in a good place to make it to the conference tournament.  They played their final series of the regular season this past weekend down in Rock Hill South Carolina about three hours away from their Virginia campus. 

Things started off pretty good on Friday with a nice 1 to 0 win over the Eagles, but unfortunately, things didn't quite go their way on Saturday during the double header.  On Saturday they ended up falling 4 to 3 and then 7 to 4 against the team that knocked them out of the conference tournament last year.  Hopefully they can get a little bit of reverse karma and do the same thing to them this year.  

I think with the way this worked out, Winthrop ended up being the top team in the Big South for the regular season.  You might remember I said last week that the top five teams get to make it to the conference tournament at the end of the season.  With Radford sitting in the number three spot right now, that means they should be pretty much guaranteed a spot in the tournament.   However, here is the kicker.  Generally, if you are the winner of your conference tournament, you automatically get a bid to play in the national tournament.  

However, if you have a losing record, you are not able to play in the national tournament.  Kind of messed up right?  So let's say Gardner Webb with a record of 8 and 10 in the regular season was somehow able to run the tournament and become the conference tournament champ.  I don't think they would be able to play in the national tournament according to the rules.

With a 10 and 8 record on the season, Radford should still be okay.  

Right now the final standings put Winthrop in the tournament followed by USC Upstate, then Radford, Presbyterian, and finally Gardner-Webb.  I just hope the ladies bats can get going for the post season.  As you have seen from a lot of their scores, pitching hasn't been an issue for them, but offense has.  They haven't been getting the run production they need or they have been leaving a lot of runners on base. 

They need to fix that.  Personally, I think it would help if they got my niece in the game more, but I am clearly biased! 

Either way, the Big South tournament starts up on May 6th and I am really looking forward to seeing how they do.  It should be double elimination format, so that gives them a little bit of wiggle room.

body.title: Hay historias que no se notan a primera vista [ Esp - Eng ] There are stories you can’t see at first glance
body.body:
>

27 de abril de 2026, Freewriters Community Daily Writing Prompt Día 3086: primera impresión.

Muy buenos días, mi gente, por acá arrancando la semana con toda la energía, escribiendo para ustedes desde Buenos Aires, #Argentina, en este lunes soleado que ya de entrada levanta el ánimo. Porque no hay mejor manera de empezar que con buena vibra, con ganas de avanzar y con esa mentalidad de que cada semana es una nueva oportunidad.

Y es curioso, porque en medio de ese ritmo con el que comenzamos, también se cruzan muchas personas, muchas historias, muchas primeras impresiones. Y ahí es donde uno empieza a darse cuenta de que no todo es lo que parece a simple vista.

Si te ha pasado alguna vez, quédate a leer, porque esto conecta más de lo que crees.
_________

<center>![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSDzRQko1RJyYoES7aureuPgU4mXsgn4g9sePTCuDU9qb/image.png)</center>

<center>*\

*</center>

_________

Hay algo que pasa mucho en el día a día, y es que uno se hace una idea rápida de las personas. Las ves una vez, cruzas dos palabras y ya crees saber cómo son. En el trabajo, en la calle, con vecinos, incluso aquí mismo en redes. Uno arma una película en segundos, sin darse cuenta, basándose en una mirada, en una forma de hablar o en una primera actitud. Y lo más curioso es que muchas veces damos por hecho que eso es suficiente para definir a alguien, cuando en realidad apenas estamos viendo una pequeña parte de todo lo que esa persona es. Vivimos tan rápido que a veces ni nos damos la oportunidad de conocer más allá de esa primera impresión.

A mí me ha pasado muchas veces. Personas que al principio se ven serias, como distantes, y uno piensa “este no es muy sociable”, y después resulta que son tremenda gente, de esas que te ayudan sin pensarlo, que están ahí cuando hace falta. Y también al revés, gente que se muestra amable de entrada, muy conversadora, con buena vibra, y con el tiempo te das cuenta de que no era como parecía. Ahí es donde uno entiende que la primera impresión muchas veces se queda corta, que no alcanza para conocer realmente a alguien. Porque todos tenemos capas, momentos, historias detrás que no se ven en un primer contacto.

También me pasó mucho al llegar a Argentina. Uno viene con su forma de ser, con esa cercanía del venezolano, de hablar con todo el mundo, de ser más abierto, más expresivo. Y claro, al principio uno percibe a la gente más reservada, más en lo suyo, y puede pensar cualquier cosa, puede incluso llegar a interpretar mal ciertas actitudes. Pero con el tiempo te das cuenta de que no es frialdad, es otra forma de ser, otra cultura, otra manera de relacionarse. Y ahí es donde uno empieza a entender, a adaptarse y a respetar esas diferencias. Te das cuenta de que no es que estén mal, simplemente son distintos, y eso también suma.

Y si lo llevo un poco más a lo personal, a mi propia historia, también pasa algo parecido. Desde afuera, muchos pueden ver solo una parte de mí, el que escribe, el que comparte, el que sigue adelante, el que siempre tiene algo que decir. Pero hay otra historia detrás, una que no siempre se ve a primera vista, una que no se nota en una primera impresión. La de un padre que ha tenido que aprender a vivir con una ausencia que no se llena, la de alguien que dejó su país buscando un mejor futuro, la de una persona que ha tenido que reconstruirse poco a poco, desde cero, con esfuerzo, con caídas y con aprendizajes. Y así como pasa con los demás, conmigo también aplica lo mismo, no todo lo que se ve al principio cuenta la historia completa. Por eso hoy más que nunca entiendo que vale la pena mirar más allá, darse el tiempo, porque muchas veces lo más valioso no se ve en la primera impresión, se siente con el tiempo.

<center>![SeparadorHive.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mballesteros/23t7YWoN53XUARh93PVvS9mqaVjjjMGSNi6uJUMjKptGwBVoiTyadsRVjRPAE27xgxsc7.png)</center>

Y al final, uno entiende que no todo se trata de lo que vemos en el primer momento. Detrás de cada persona hay una historia, hay luchas, hay aprendizajes que no se notan a simple vista. Por eso vale la pena darse el tiempo, no juzgar tan rápido y permitir que las personas muestren realmente quiénes son.

Porque así como uno también lleva su propia historia por dentro, todos los demás están cargando la suya. Y quizás, si aprendemos a mirar un poco más allá, podamos conectar de verdad, desde lo humano, desde lo real.

Quiero agradecer a la comunidad #freewriters, en especial a @daily.prompt, @mariannewest y @felt.buzz, por este espacio donde podemos compartir desde lo vivido.

Gracias por leer, te leo en la caja de comentarios. Un abrazo grande para todos y que tengan un excelente inicio de semana

Hello hive 




![Collage 2026-04-27 13-04-40.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/AK56mEuGyJUYn8vX8HiNQftsbpjMjSFZ7CGBK4bcLdwajPVthDY1yPwAzzAZ7WB.png)


Happy new week, ✂️✨
Wishing you a productive and creative Monday ahead. 💫

“Today I’ll be sharing how I made this beautiful blouse with puff sleeves ✂️✨. In my previous post, I showed you how I made a Pencil Skirt with Hip and Butt Enhancement, just with 3 yards of Ankara to achieve the dress. Stay tuned as I take you through the process step by step!”



![IMG-20260417-WA0000.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23xenQAijPPQxxRrKZ2jd3KM5THQbZjRy7ktZjWu7n9R9k2jWPwHJG1UkLkwLELVsVUvj.jpg)




This elegant princess bustier blouse, as seen in your image, features a fitted bodice with structured cups and soft puff sleeves, giving a neat and stylish look.


**Step 1: DRAFTING THE BODICE (FRONT) ON A PATTERN PAPER** 

Start by drafting the front bodice using your measurements:
Shoulder: 15 inches (7.5 on fold)
Bust: 35 ÷ 4 = 8.75 + 2 allowance 
Waist: 27 ÷ 4 = 6.75 + 2 allowance 
Half length: 16 inches
Under bust: 13 inches
Mark the neckline (3 inches width, 6 inches front depth V-shape, 1.5 inches back depth round). Connect shoulder to armhole and shape neatly.




**Step 2: Creating the Princess Line
From your nipple-to-nipple measurement** (7 inches ÷ 2 = 3.5 inches), mark the bust point. Draw a curved princess line from the armhole down through the bust point to the waist. Cut along this line to separate the side panel from the center panel.




![IMG_4661.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23tHAA4BX65t7tMP84A5em9nu85VSp4qwCxwjZFcVYtgKGX8KqfUXJnhuRRcua9NfpaAs.JPG)



Preparing the Fabric
Fold your Ankara fabric into two and place your lining beneath it. Ensure both fabrics are well aligned. Iron your astay (stiffener) onto the fabric and lining pieces to give the blouse structure, especially around the bust area.

**Step 3: Bust Cup Shaping**
Add 1inches allowance at the bust curve for fullness. This is what gives the bustier its fitted shape. Insert the bust pad between the lining and main fabric when sewing.




**Step 4: Cutting the Back Piece
Draft the back bodice using:**



![IMG_4654.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23wMap18X2PBZPK4bga5Zx2QVfueLyPAhuEhLwooZp1Bb1d67QFZedS3mqnBJynEXoTnT.JPG)




Half length back: 15 inches
Same shoulder and waist measurements
Add zipper allowance (1–1.5 inches) at the center back. Keep the neckline at 1.5 inches depth with a round shape.



![IMG_4829.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/deborahstitches/23wMWWKs3xYMhwbUdndCX3NHcbDWJfEHiH45JMpRfmt5L1t8nnXdDVEzwhyY7SUFeMSQG.JPG)




**Step 5: Cutting the Puff Sleeves
For the puff sleeves:**

Join lining and outer fabric separately, then attach together.
Insert the bust pads before closing.


**Sew shoulder seams and side seams.**

CUTTING
Fold fabric into 4
Length: Mark 42inches + 2 inches (allowance)
Hip line: Measure 9 inches down from waist
Waist: Divide 26 ÷ 4 = 6.5 + 1 inch allowance
Hip: Divide 36 ÷ 4 = 9 + 1 inch allowance
Shape from waist to hip, then slightly taper down for a fitted long skirt
Cut front and back pieces

Sew darts on front/back fabric and lining separately

body.title: To say enough and not too much
body.body:
Do you ever get this sensation like you over-talked? Like you gave someone more information than was needed or was useful to the conversation? I don't know why this happens to me. If I think about it from a rational perspective, I didn't really talk that much, but I always get this feeling that I gave myself away more than necessary. Maybe it has something to do with my upbringing as I was taught to be silent and complacent, and my opinions were often ignored.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW4jTjDMjPYdqDfV12G12YxCcb4oLkqsPAUudKsQh4ocL/1777292741675.jpg)


It could be that it actually depends on the feedback. For example, if someone replies to you with meaningful comments, then you feel it was worth it to express yourself. But you can never know what the feedback will be until you have spoken. So, really, you just have to risk it, and when you get poor answers, deal with it in the silence that comes afterward.

body.title: [Eng./Esp.]   Where the snake doesn't bite its own tail.   ||   Donde la serpiente no muerde su cola.
body.body:
*** *** #
Si eres de habla hispana, la versión en español es mejor para ti; debes hacer clic 👉 [**AQUÍ**](#english)
*** ***
# ***
Where the snake doesn't bite its own tail
***

> They say that the **‘first impression’** is everything, but the first impression I had when I saw my brother Jhonny’s leg, via the screen from Valencia, Carabobo State, Venezuela, was one of sheer horror. It wasn’t a pleasant sight. There, on his skin, was the reddish rash of shingles. Barely three days into the outbreak and the virus was already claiming its territory with that stabbing pain that only those who have experienced it can understand. I can only imagine it and hope it never happens to me...
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wMaJcL3ResZ6mKVFd4LDNMbpiV5RUqCPw87JBfa9HWX6bMbxntJd2b8zTWfH3mh1bcp.png) [Thanks to the Banana 2.0 app for illustrating my post.](https://gemini.google.com/app)
In our Venezuelan culture, shingles isn’t just herpes zoster; it’s a mythical entity. We grew up with the warning that, if the two ends of the rash join up to encircle the body, the outcome is fatal. That is why Jhonny, with the pragmatic desperation of the sick man, has decided not to take any chances. He told me he has already started medical treatment, but that he has also sought out someone to ‘pray over’ the area, as one does with the evil eye. “Here in Canada,” I asked, “people don’t know of any prayers for that illness.” It is fascinating and profoundly human to see how aciclovir and faith coexist in the same vessel of hope. Whilst the statistics suggest he has between two and six weeks left to fight, he walks that bridge between science and even the mystical. That first visual impression of his wound reminded me that, in the face of pain, we return to our roots, to our grandmother’s secrets and to the silent prayer that seeks to halt the serpent’s advance. Jhonny hopes that, during these difficult weeks of mourning, medicine will heal the body and prayer will soothe the wounded soul. Let us hope that soon it will all be nothing but a bad memory. *** ***

# ***
Donde la serpiente no muerde su cola
***

** lo es todo, pero la primera impresión que tuve al ver la pierna de mi hermano Jhonny, a través de la pantalla desde Valencia, Estado Carabobo, Venezuela, fue de puro escalofrío. No era una imagen agradable. Allí, sobre su piel, se dibujaba el mapa rojizo de la \

. Apenas tres días de brote y ya el virus reclamaba su territorio con ese dolor punzante que solo quienes lo han vivido comprenden. Yo solo lo imagino y espero nunca me de...

<center>
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/amigoponc/23wMaJcL3ResZ6mKVFd4LDNMbpiV5RUqCPw87JBfa9HWX6bMbxntJd2b8zTWfH3mh1bcp.png)
<sup>[Gracias a la app Banana 2.0 por ilustrar mi publicación.](https://gemini.google.com/app)</sup>
</center>

En nuestra cultura criolla (Venezuela), la culebrilla no es solo un herpes zóster; es una entidad mítica. Crecimos con la advertencia de que, si las dos cabezas de la erupción se unen rodeando el cuerpo, el destino es fatal. Por eso, Jhonny, con la pragmática desesperación del enfermo, ha decidido no jugársela. Me contó que ya comenzó el tratamiento médico, pero que también buscó a quien le \

la zona, como se hace con el mal de ojo. Aquí en Canadá -pregunté- y la gente no conoce de rezos a esa enfermedad. Es fascinante y profundamente humano ver cómo conviven el aciclovir y la fe en un mismo frasco de esperanza. Mientras las estadísticas dicen que le quedan entre dos y seis semanas de batalla, él transita ese puente entre la ciencia e incluso lo místico. Esa primera impresión visual de su herida me recordó que, ante el dolor, volvemos a las raíces, a los secretos de la abuela y al rezo silencioso que busca detener el avance de la serpiente. Jhonny espera que, en este duro duelo de semanas, la medicina cure el cuerpo y la oración sosiegue el alma herida. Ojalá que pronto todo sea solo un mal recuerdo.
*** ***

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPAiEN3dYcg6BHKwX9cTzBRoFUww2pNi83oBvRz4VFCw8/image.png) In this post, the subject is different—much larger—and so the light falls upon it quietly, as if it didn’t want to disturb it. But it does, because it draws so much more attention; it conveys something. Moreover, where there is light, something else is born—something you can’t touch, but which insists on staying, marking its territory, and then, when you least expect it, it’s gone. This is a small ceramic piglet in different colors, but one that has been with us at home for many years, as it is harmless; wherever it is, it remains motionless, yet with a very big smile and its perfectly drawn black spots. It sits on the floor, where at first glance it might seem alone, but it never is, for beside it, spreading like a dark whisper, lies its shadow—much larger and more powerful. >Para esta entrada el objeto es distinto, mucho más grande y por eso la luz cae sobre el objeto de forma silenciosa, como si no quisiera interrumpir. Pero lo hace, ya que llama mucho más la atención, transmite algo, además donde hay luz, también nace algo más, algo que no se puede tocar, pero que insiste en quedarse, marcar territorio y cuando uno menos lo espera se va. # >Este es un pequeño cerdito de cerámica de colores diferentes, pero que nos ha acompañado en casa durante muchos años, ya que es inofensivo, donde está vez permanece inmóvil, sin embargo, con una sonrisa muy grande y sus manchas negras perfectamente dibujadas. Está en el suelo, donde a simple vista puede parecer que está solo, pero nunca lo está, puesto que a su lado extendiéndose como un susurro oscuro, está su sombra mucho más grande y poderosa. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW58w1oUi55PFArTb3z5UNrF8cqfCKW4MrpTS6ivqmR88/image.png) ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmU39sWoitm5Z8tdBH59zmt7gD6GPhSRrj6mWpxmhaiLvM/image.png) It is not just any shadow; it is dark, more elongated, more diffuse—almost as if it had a life of its own, and only it knows when to move. While the little pig fulfills its role of standing still as an ornament, observing the world with bright blue eyes, the shadow seems to be observing something else—something deeper, quieter, known only to the shadow itself—since it has no details, no color, but it has a presence. In this case, the shadow doesn’t ask for attention, but it steals it, since it appears uninvited; simply with the presence of light, it stretches across the tiles, warps at the floor joints, adapts without complaint, says nothing, and is the first thing we notice upon closer inspection. Moreover, it is there because it must be, because it is part of the little pig even though it never quite resembles it. >No es una sombra cualquiera, ya que es oscura, más alargada, más difusa, casi como si tuviera vida propia y solo ella sabe cuando moverse. Mientras el cerdito cumple su función de estar quieto como adorno, observa el mundo con ojos azules y brillantes, la sombra parece observar otra cosa, algo más profundo, más callado, que solo la sombra conoce, puesto que no tiene detalles, no tiene color, pero tiene presencia. # >En esta caso la sombra no pide atención, pero la roba, puesto que aparece sin ser llamada, simplemente con presencia de luz, hace que se estire sobre las baldosas, se deforma en las uniones del piso, se adapta sin protestar, no dice nada y es lo primero que todo vemos al detallar. Además, está ahí porque debe estar, porque es parte del cerdito aunque nunca se parezca del todo a él. ![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdkVF346trSXdfpVUxdnude235p6X7Pqa73XWZM8AKJNK/image.png) A striking contrast emerges between the solid figure and its dark reflection, where both tell a silent story. A story told not with words, but with shapes. Because sometimes we are not just what we reveal in the light, but also what we cast when the light touches us. And so the little pig remains still, the shadow stays with it, but between the two of them, without moving, something happens. >Se crea un gran contraste entre la figura sólida y su reflejo oscuro, donde ambas cosas son una historia silenciosa. Una que no se cuenta con palabras, sino con formas. Porque a veces no somos solo lo que mostramos bajo la luz, sino también lo que proyectamos cuando ella nos toca. Por ende el cerdito sigue quieto, la sombra lo acompaña, pero entre los dos, sin moverse, ocurre algo.
![pngwing.com 3.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPvWeswjaMnCtt69QxnpZHm1una1iw2HUxZJpGBgEY2RH/pngwing.com%203.png)

body.title: Comerong Island orchid recce ride/walk : April 26 2026
body.body:
After yesterday's pickleball introduction was keen on an easy day. Turned down the chance to use the car to go look for orchids while my wife went to visit a friend for crochet/knitting/Bad Sister session ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/14844cd2-81b6-45b8-818a-102a6abde31a.jpg) Took the bike down to the river to walk across to Comerong Island - Coolangatta Mountain shot while the sun was still up high ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/da1a27c9-1a94-486b-a9b9-a2bab57c11a6.jpg) This little birdie hung around long enough for me to get camera zoomed in ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/61cfc530-d5ff-4ff3-bc3e-727d3e6d7173.jpg) Takes 10 to 15 minutes to walk here from our side - road trip plus ferry would be at least 45 minutes. With fatbike tyres could cut that down in half. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/1ba32892-de48-46c5-bf97-dcd9aa606182.jpg) A little mushroom action. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d2d7b6a4-bf51-4c7a-9ec2-cfaf122f0945.jpg) Walk is a recce walk for autumn greenhoods - first leaves shows the challenge the orchids have getting through the leaf litter. There are a lot of deciduous trees in the canopy ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/326cafe9-e0c9-476a-82d0-26d0e5f691f8.jpg) Was hoping to find one helmet orchid I flower - this is as close to a flower - too early to ID ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e00d9e98-66c9-4414-97f9-5a0f09f8f370.jpg) A different gree hood rosette - shorter pedicel ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/98d54934-6ea8-4e2f-a754-7985a480e623.jpg) The leaf litter shot ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ee88be98-634a-4c4f-9ce5-c788e779ccc8.jpg) Itching to find a spike - new leaf forming in the middle ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/65231b04-cf48-4b64-8aa4-5619aa48bbfa.jpg) Next stage along - previous shot had 4th leaf forming. This one already has five ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8a5819ae-a892-4321-88fa-7fb37228b171.jpg) Still only budding helmet orchids ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/7755e723-5ad2-436b-a8dc-c99dd38960a1.jpg) Budding acianthus orchid - leaf has left the ground suggesting plant has self-pollinated ahead of flower forming ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e090219c-3981-45ea-8386-dfaf13ab6273.jpg) Budding helmet orchid on the way back. Looks like it is going to be a good season with more clusters on both sides of the track ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/acd14c10-7608-427d-8414-9de2407667b3.jpg) Guessing a nodding greenhood ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/6ae24369-832c-4e48-90e8-dd756bc13d78.jpg) Ghost mushrooms - two clusters and some focal angles ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/17d2fcfe-5928-405d-96c0-78c58540406f.jpg) Twins in focus ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/d790e704-470d-47fa-8685-f312068e45fa.jpg) Shot of the underside ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/0485eaef-0854-4941-ad25-5c9a61ef80a8.jpg) Silver top ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/29979ac4-5040-49ff-bdca-a7cd380c5667.jpg) Also with an underside shot ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/463c7619-a256-4c41-9893-91d9b0fdf3db.jpg) Orb weaver spider - a bit different to others I have seen ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/ae6c812f-be7f-42ef-858a-ca9b32d7b2c9.jpg) View across where the Shoalhaven River would go into the sea if it went into the sea. Fatbike route would go down to the beach and along that as the grassy area in front is a shorebird nesting area - note the half moon ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/859cbae7-7c04-46b1-9748-4649614ebd70.jpg) Looking north to Gerroa - note the kite surfer action ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/33c3332f-5703-4172-9ab5-0023897847f2.jpg) Short ride - big walk - not bad for tired legs ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/633d47e4-cd78-40f8-a474-ee336da08cbb.jpg) This moth woke my wife at 3am - I set it free from the spider web ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/55501ab9-2730-4e72-8ab4-7338e3faec63.jpg) Pizza for dinner with a cycling theme - Tadej Pogecar wins Liege-Bastogne-Liege for the 4th time

body.title: Flea Market and a Birthday Par-Tea - April 26, 2026@goldenoakfarm
body.body:
![Flea Market finds crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23u652nT9CYtbMeJmucCxGn23HZFAfWLr2ErN7u4hTgughFxgTZwVU675ZDdUCBoAWvyy.jpg)

On Sunday I was up at 4:45AM and worked on my posts for a while. Then I had to get a shower and get ready to go to the flea market at 8:30AM with my #2 intern. It was a tiny one, not what I had expected, and I only found a few things. The green frog will go on the tile backsplash over the copper sink.

![Lawn chairs out crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23wBfhYmqpoJLqaxxQJM51fDDvF17xmbL8Pvj7oq2Bzy5w7xM1K5Zix5HTeJFVbFJZoCZ.jpg)

When we got back, I got changed and my #2 intern and I went to the barn in her truck and brought back the lawn chairs. I’ve missed having them to sit in to do notes or rest.

![Marianna's birthday - making festive hats collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpA5Umy9Fv9JvVvduDe1XgD89g4Bt3vdAMR8QszE8bACGWAmmQAT1khzL4y9gJmyePe.jpg)

Once that was done, my #1 intern and I selected hats from my stash in the cedar closet and got ready to create a “festive” hat for the birthday party. The first thing we did was wander the yard looking at flowers to select.

Then I got my ribbons out and she pulled the paper flowers from the arrangement on the dining room table. I made a bow and streamers and she hot glued tiny flowers from the ribbons.

I made a band to insert the flowers in, but it wasn’t strong enough, so I ended up sewing them on.

I’d forgotten to wrap the present or make a card so I rushed around to do that when I’d finished the hat. Next was to get dressed. I don’t have any fancy dresses that fit, so it was jeans and a jersey. My #1 intern wore a lovely sundress. And off we went.

![Marianna's birthday - Anne's house plants crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpxqMRUUWFeTuLTNecMKP81ZbUDi2eSwMmk1ZUke5n2BztFrhHU4Cj33ES1Ty3LPvkY.jpg)

The first thing you see when you enter the birthday venue is my friend’s goddaughter’s house plants. They were all so lovely, as was her house and garden.

![Marianna's birthday - the tea cakes and tea collage text crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23yJQfRLkPCS4QJukaP4GgzoarkGUvtPXuncjpiDG7DDGqYKFxr8hDWFC5gkh6fKY4Y1m.jpg)

It was to be a tea party sort of birthday party for my friend’s 80th. Both her goddaughters had planned it and they had done such a great job! The teacups were take home, you selected the one you liked, had your tea in it, and took it home. I selected the one on the lower left of the set on the right side. My #1 intern selected one with a saucer.

![Marianna's birthday - Pam and Marianna crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EogNE7GsU3rCYMJgMayzGpBvGMPafSMPqewukYhfytP9hoQcJo2PkjZR4NL7qPCfUgu.jpg)

*My friend and I with birthday cake*

There were about 30 people and the goddaughters were so happy it was a lovely day. It would have been a bit crowded in the house. It was a lovely time, with all her friends and neighbors.

We discussed whether we each felt like we could pick blueberries this year. We decided if we kept the amount small and asked for accommodations, we could manage it. So we need to get signed up.

She had wanted a German chocolate cake and they’d had a splendid one made.

![Marianna's birthday - Arissa reading crop April 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/EpLgxAEmzgQM2ycyFFg1kEeDjeEFJu5DuUcwLMJ8SeLpFr1FMw5NpqeSmxvQZmfuo6Q.jpg)

*#1 intern taking a quiet break*

We stayed a couple hours and then headed home. I worked on the posts for a while then sat down to watch ‘Leave It to Beaver’. Tom and my #3 intern arrived and we visited for a while.

When they left, I got the cold frame closed up and at 8PM I pulled the shades it was still really warm in the house so I asked my son to light fires later in the night.

I didn’t get to bed until after 9PM.

On Monday, I have to prep for doing the windows that have to be done from a ladder. And in the afternoon I have an event at the Senior Center. So a long busy day…

![Mini bio framed Jan 2026.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/goldenoakfarm/23xyn876JURgHHjsp757ZTvXeEEBjdDeLXWynRcLCeuqwPPsqtEtXTosSPyKZdAgWivJB.jpg)

body.title: [EN/ES] Zappity (HOLOZING ART)
body.body:
### Zappity resting on a log. > ### Zappity descansando en un tronco. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7YrQWQH4VGvkg5kYhCEXzSsCmFwY5qgV6fba2SdGKad/288_sin_t_tulo_20260425174638.jpg) Today I went back to coloring one of my drawings that I made during Zingtober some time ago. These are among my first drawings in the community, and I hold them in high regard. Back then I made all 31 drawings traditionally with pen and paper, and I got results that I really liked, shading using hatching. But now I want to make more colorful drawings. So I will import my old drawings into Ibis Paint and color them with nice, cheerful colors. Today it was the turn to color the drawing from day 25, which had the prompt 'Trunk'. For this I drew Zappity resting while sitting on top of an old tree trunk. > Hoy volví a colorear uno de mis dibujos que realicé durante el Zingtober hace ya un tiempo. Estos son de mis primeros dibujos en la comunidad y les tengo mucho aprecio. Para aquel entonces realicé los 31 dibujos de forma tradicional con bolígrafo y papel, y obtuve resultados que me gustaron mucho, sombreados utilizando hatching. Pero ahora quiero hacer dibujos más coloridos. Así que importaré mis dibujos antiguos a Ibis Paint y los colorearé con colores bonitos y alegres. Hoy fue el turno de colorear el dibujo del día 25, que el prompt era 'Trunk'. Para esto dibujé a Zappity descansando sentado encima del viejo tronco de un árbol. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeZ6gdrU4vims8ny52gD22tf9qwfqiLWqGXN7vGNcpGpN/descargar_4_1.png) The first step will be to import my drawing. So, taking a photo of the paper sheet, I bring it into Ibis Paint where I adjust the colors, lights, and shadows to obtain only the black lines, eliminating the paper texture. I try to make the lines as clean as possible, although later I can adjust details that are not quite right with the eraser and brush. > El primer paso será importar mi dibujo. Así que, tomando una foto de la hoja de papel, lo llevo a Ibis Paint donde ajusto los colores, luces y sombras para obtener solamente las líneas negras eliminando la textura del papel. Trato de que las líneas queden lo más limpias posible, aunque después podré ajustar con la goma y el pincel los detalles que no estén del todo bien. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVPBDqnXBwQWUqxwdtVnvgNLaZeGV78zmDwpXm6fr3wk5/288_sin_t_tulo_20260425120308.jpg) I will also erase with the eraser all the hatching I did for shading since I don't need it, and by using color I can do it with different layers of light and dark colors to get a more polished result. > También eliminaré con la goma todo el hatching que realicé para el sombreado, ya que no lo necesito, y al estar usando color podré hacerlo con distintas capas de colores claros y oscuros para obtener un resultado más pulido. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeARFgn2YFDsxrTvTgUjoPKgs2bdtaaWTkgHWMUTSmxu5/288_sin_t_tulo_20260425120752.jpg) To color, I will start with the trunk. I almost always begin coloring with the characters, but today I feel like starting with the trunk because I really enjoy drawing wood and the ring textures on surfaces. I will be using a lighter color for the inside of the trunk. > Para colorear comenzaré por el tronco. Casi siempre comienzo a colorear por los personajes, pero hoy me apetece empezar por el tronco, ya que me gusta mucho dibujar madera y las texturas de anillo de las superficies. Estaré usando un color más claro para el interior del tronco. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeFZNNmbVAGegi64zHZW4CpUfM17QUSQkywd6kMCURLoY/288_sin_t_tulo_20260425121956.jpg) I will also color the grass green and make small weeds with little lines as if it were a simple texture; I will alternate them between light and dark colors. > También colorearé el pasto de verde y haré pequeños hierbajos con rallitas pequeñas como si fuese una textura simple, los alternaré entre colores claros y colores oscuros. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ7YrQWQH4VGvkg5kYhCEXzSsCmFwY5qgV6fba2SdGKad/288_sin_t_tulo_20260425174638.jpg) Done with all the coloring, the only thing left is the background, which will be a flat blue with large concentric white clouds focusing on the character, and Zappity himself, who will be that characteristic electric orange. I will also make some adjustments in areas that had imperfections from the ink. This is the final result, and I hope you like it as much as I do. > Listo con todo coloreado, solo queda el fondo que será azul plano con grandes nubes blancas concéntricas enfocando al personaje, y el propio Zappity que será de ese naranja electrizante característico. Además haré algunos ajustes en algunas zonas que quedaron con imperfecciones de la tinta. Este es el resultado final y espero que les guste tanto como a mí. Thank you for accompanying me one more day of drawing. > Gracias por acompañarme un día más dibujando. --- ***About:*** ==*Sketchbook and Journal of a Learner*== **If you like my content, join my [Fanbase clicking here](https://hive.vote/dash.php?fan=nestodibuja&i=2)**
