body.title: Going to the zoo zoo zoo...
body.body:
[//]:# (!worldmappin 40.15552 lat -83.11640 long  d3scr)


<center>![PXL_20260425_134903208.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vsL2EnruoTcnw3rtSw1T3rMocwUvwoGud1SEk7sPsggSvJpSFywya7cA8uPWecFiLRo.jpg)</center>


-------------------------------


There wasn't much down time this past weekend as @mrsbozz and I headed down to Ohio to celebrate her sisters fiftieth birthday.  We had a nice walk and dinner on Friday night that I will write a post about later, but Saturday morning before the real festivities we headed to the Columbus Zoo to take a look at some of the animals with our great/grand niece.  She would be our niece's daughter, so however you want to break that down.  When our nieces were little kids they used to listen to a singer named Raffi and he has a song called \

, so that was the inspiration for the title of this post.  


<center>![PXL_20260425_131724189.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23r1gnAUuNc3ySHyGMKBpEozuVmseDsU46y9cuKZNq9NjdUn2xeC933KbcdEwWAB1cEJL.jpg)</center>

----------------------

The [Columbus Zoo](https://www.columbuszoo.org/) is pretty impressive though my brother in law was complaining about how expensive it has gotten over the years compared to when they first moved there.  Seems to be the case everywhere huh?  Luckily, they buy a season pass, so we were able to get in for free.  This wasn't the first time we have been to the zoo, but it is the first time we have been with our grand niece, so that was kind of special.  Especially since I can still remember visiting with our nieces. 


<center>![PXL_20260425_132051184.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/244xwuTRqT3aigWhPZdR1xY1VNde8nTe9rX4jBeD5nbeKRoesNu2QcAxHdoqDQx7ZefTu.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

We stopped for a quick look at the seals before we headed off to the Asia section of the zoo.


<center>![PXL_20260425_132414350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/244odG2tTf1EFN8JfjrhL3EbsNg1MYTRPXnynVkbBNivaupWkYx1zvznWJQXBrj4hdvz6.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

We thought it was kind of funny that they have a place called \

near where all the animals are.  You would think they might go for all vegan stuff given the mission of the zoo, but nope.  They also had a bunch of other food kiosks open around the zoo including Dip N Dots, which was funny because who gets Dip N Dots at 9 AM in the morning...


<center>![PXL_20260425_132430371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23qrFWyCFiDjmxWmM8KB5Tf1tZozkcNZSdXzKEs22aJy3n6saua8SeofYJMaf3Y6R67Ba.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_132433734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23uQrDKesb6SxBY1ApRM2dQbfmqkAbZusp1FfPEUVqeWXCU55VQy1F2afadq4yYjVfTq2.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_132519213.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/241tSpiAc7DiU39mCPLqiGZGfiWbNwNyiE3AfoKcon4CP1NccxVkkCo7zAi5xyJZ6sNyr.jpg)</center>

----------------------

Our first stop in \

was the elephants.  There was just a single elephant outside eating, but it drew quite a crowd of people.  


<center>![PXL_20260425_133414033.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tmJAzJsCZvATJHfPWqiUDTCJo9mt54PHJRZhyxkr6MXVq98NxKqJu2ASnEVfbbgmNPz.jpg)</center>

------------------------

Inside the enclosure the little elephants were playing with each other.  Every now and then the mom elephant would push them apart from each other like \

.  This zoo is owned and managed by Jack Hannah, so the animals have pretty free range despite them being trapped in a zoo.  They can choose to be inside or outside if they want depending on their mood.


<center>![PXL_20260425_133847786.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wzzvznMnmSp744sFtmq5yHn5SUZqtDo29uX84GCQofz9mqtCMin69hxiVZhT4GM33hp.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_133857050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x15EgTsyTZKS31nQUTwAQrBPEMwD4W2a4PdL28p1Be8CveGhbofHxhACtzKXRfVsyP8.jpg)</center>

----------------------------

From the elephants we moved on to the red panda bears because those are my favorite, but they are usually hiding, so you can't often see them that well.  Sure enough, they were tucked away in the tree on this cloudy Saturday morning. If you look really closely, you can see bits of them, but I don't blame you if you can't pick them out.

Especially the one in the top photo.


<center>![PXL_20260425_134746067.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23uQnHrCFYsjQeDmTyapfk3xiXaJZAWmv4h6sFXMHJabGDEeN7YssrgHAeun6qx22E3R6.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_134905150.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23tveag8bXx4yKmDrXSGt9mfejRhAc4pLKBs5ygGkhLCzURxdvwYSTyg9JJC5w2JSzFYG.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

From the red pandas we moved along to the tigers and we got pretty lucky that after a short wait we were able to watch them feed the tigers some raw meat.  It was pretty cute, and the crowd seemed to love it.


<center>![PXL_20260425_135611077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xeb9Wy4TNcxPDjb7xP5hFKuZWkNimJYAtpZtBYnJ393Y5iAmJfnkSZL9APYNPwCon6a.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_135735770.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/2423oTzRNcLjfoLkQP5xn6R72zP8AV1VzDbSnBVXTuqUYHgtvZ6BfDfiKm1qAj4YWRFyF.jpg)</center>

-----------------------------

We spent some time looking at and learning about the flamingos before we had to decide what our next destination would be.


<center>![PXL_20260425_140230352.NIGHT.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23wqCrgB9ApDeUeyCgTLXRQdeidS34QxxUPskwnKBEq1ctC5FB1KEcKsX9dEsLyxnA8ZG.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_140747329.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23x9wjdNeojAyxKJVkxVxuk5ZGvrwEDetoiqLeRC7KKm2FZjAcpghyMJeNgMWBxQdqVe4.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_140926447.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23xAcMCXS3ZbT6wNLa3N6Lkmbyz8FEonuNi7BPKWvjHDdkNPdJCtzQq4RL7g41YirxKxp.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

We picked Australia and the Islands, so we got to spend some time in the aquarium looking at animals from the Great Barrier Reef.  The little one is starting to walk now, so we gave her a bit more free reign than we normally would have.


<center>![PXL_20260425_141808360.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23vhwMWb8C8q2eyt4ao19PyQXX2KXR97z5CbowRqwB8dKhmMZwwfRtcziZgBA6g56ZyQB.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_141929641.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23zRtRdijj3fD2FkLG9jiJwEqyB8pkgbvUHs1k8Pb3dUUQQZJV2qpYFViRFrSx46V16od.jpg)</center>

---------------------------

Though she is still a bit slow and unsteady, so eventually she ended up on uncle bozz's shoulders!


<center>![PXL_20260425_141133124.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/241tNNmGoBtAKCmqUpxrtHnZLkeDKmDFjbapb1n3BjYx4V8gPJHDo5anNv7tB3tW53mbG.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_141353887.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/23u5xjp1Y8nRxukiDHwFykmR5cap3UMDuM8WTu5sxtbc5WMUfg5nzPJKuAAzghXWNpmb5.jpg)</center>

-----------------------

She got to see so many cool things at the zoo, including the penguins which were one of her aunts favorites when she was a kid.

It was pretty cool how the rays and the penguins would swim right up against the glass so you could get a good view of them.


<center>![PXL_20260425_142931896.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/Ep1WpkesykrB5Nmy2L1d6Q5rgVCQCkbEUEzSizMgkheZJKP2Gkkwp1knYTzWgBhVQ4R.jpg)</center>


<center>![PXL_20260425_143018336.RAW-01.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bozz/EoK4tBsbiDTb7PkXDXHYx4ghdYR9ZyMKDxHSRzgwWMV7eUH1Ub6FUoSJG7E58WXVp32.jpg)</center>

-------------------------

Finally, she capped of her trip to the zoo with a ride on the carousel.  This carousel was built in something like 1914 and though she seemed a bit unsure at first, by the end she was riding around with her hands up like she was on a roller coaster!  It was a great morning spent with our family.  We had a really great time and I imagine this will be just one of many future visits the Columbus Zoo with our great niece.

哈啰啊，朋友们，不知不觉到了四月底啦，马上就要五一假期了，时间真的飞速一般，一晃悠这2026年快已过大半年，你敢信吗~·

我们本地的公交地铁又开始放免费乘坐福利啦，4月28日-5月5日期间，大家伙来福州游玩的又可以省去一大笔出行费用，这可太OK啦，不得不收，福州政府，福州文旅还真是给力，这一次还额外送出千只代表福州本地特色的伴手礼娃娃，，需要去指定的小程序上预约，然后到指定地点领取。。

我估摸着这活动又又又是爆满了，做为本地土著，就不和来榕玩的游客们抢小礼物啦，哈哈哈哈。。你们动作得快，不然根本抢不到的。。有小粽子，小鱼丸，还有榕榕伴手礼等等。。祝你们好运哦。

我现在出行，少数情况下驾车，大部分情况下，还是乘坐地铁，主要是很方便啊，远到火车站，飞机场，福州地铁都可以直达，地铁公交线路四通八达的，关键是这时不时给你一个免费出行，还有出门在外，如果自带的水杯，哪里都有凉茶，茶饮，白开水饮用。。方便的很。。

福州地铁还推出榕榕有礼系列吉祥物文创，在地铁1号线C口附近有专门的拍照打卡点，还有参与活动送礼品以及榕榕吉祥物自助购买柜等等。。

除了可爱榕榕玩偶之外，还有手提袋，明信片，冰箱贴以及盲盒系列，目前来看，榕榕玩偶最受大家的欢迎。

OK，今天先分享到这儿哈，祝福大家周一愉快，愉快一周。。

body.title: Sublime Sunday and A Simple Apple Cake
body.body:
I had fresh apples and 30 minutes to spare, so I prepared a simple apple cake. (While the cake was baking in the oven, I did my laundry!) ![IMB_cCMuOY.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/23w2oCPe5CZXjSKwme9VfkAgYW6fe9nNE8yLJ7VNGdgt6L8K2d7HdeERqKrLTFDMRwBM3.gif)
In a bowl, mix the dry ingredients: 3 cups all-purpose flour, 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon,1 teaspoon baking soda, and 1 teaspoon salt.
In another bowl, combine thoroughly 1 and 1/2 granulated sugar, 3 eggs, 1/4 cup melted butter, 1/2 cup vegetable oil.

Then finely dice 2 fresh apples. ![IMG_0171.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Ep7v9W71xC7WHVDPsBLnaqCrn5wVLNhreVGVhbKVThimsdW7CvAy2SXDzVS4vdu3pkA.jpeg) Combine the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients in two batches and stir together until almost combined. ![IMG_0173.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Eos3Bxf41J5XH9rArwtR6ruUtqmVoHKwjuhVLpY23YGmVa4bM36B4yhSeYqLQduY6uE.jpeg) ![IMG_0174.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Eos3GZqAwaqCw1CzVsj4JLyKJHjxS1Z7bF34SPdte9sXsWkMP64LGc3Suwkfmxp4MGu.jpeg) ![IMG_0175.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoeHJy1SuCyoafU6GADFFVtd3FDhjk5D7QpwKaXbyJDuKkVV4ibAw8X6rDJWsUK7yRb.jpeg) Add 2 teaspoons of vanilla. ![IMG_0177.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EppNArJD55neXcSUK97sVPBhuh684jtZQ6f1QUgUKcKnTsXED3fonsE3mj4ez9mCPh2.jpeg) Add the diced apples. ![IMG_0178.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoH1L1zA18RH2R1e16Fp7fKUj27YoWHE1FK4ebB3DKmZVy1E1pu7Nfpa4h83uWSdAH1.jpeg) And mix. The cake batter will feel dense, unlike regular cakes that you can pour. ![IMG_0179.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EpXLyJGcxt9YJX8WoP1R4Y4nX9JbZbS2P8LTEs6TUcxWGaZdiAti4PUVKDsHU5C1AUG.jpeg) Scoop the apple cake batter into a prepared pan (greased with butter).
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EonjxqDBf4bgVHkKcrUCE6abD9Pu4dFExutd8uNGzA2Gmh8zVkYCy6cRfmokUXN15xC.jpeg
https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/Eoc8R2wk7WTHVDYybsHX2ut3uekDZRP7X84CJXGWCtBKKyivQohCuWC9i7aQA7kYADu.jpeg
![IMG_0183.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoeGGfczoKZuzweDaiYkz63W4CELdzdmeiygTAoTpEWT2dd6qSR9e2gkZdysVXyWT4P.jpeg) Then bake in a preheated 325 degree F oven for 55- 60 minutes, or or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean. Cool for 10 minutes, then turn onto a plate, and glaze the cake if preferred. ![IMG_0184.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoiWgZSX4R6op5RxEXkaFdN1ZmC5AHE4tjgNG99wPud1f185JCH2x7RPqHtHdEs2AGb.jpeg) I prepared a brown sugar glaze of 1/4 cup butter and 1 cup brown sugar which I heated until it turned caramel in color. ![IMG_0186.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/silversaver888/EoyQXedDu4Dgm1abG4syTTkAdo5USo6FfydQBnPc8UmhXREPTk9oysrX8EpdEFwpxks.jpeg) ####
We are ready to cut it, and have a taste, while it is warm!

body.body: The Satoshi wallet reassignment piece is the part that's going to make this contentious beyond the usual fork discourse.\n\nHard forks with legitimate technical arguments (like drivechain proponents have) still tend to fail because coordination costs are higher than the benefits for most node operators and miners. But reassigning dormant wallets -- even Satoshi's -- is a different category of problem. It touches the foundational property guarantees that give Bitcoin its monetary credibility. The argument \
doesn't survive first contact with the question of what makes any property right durable.\n\nThe \

framing is interesting here. If a non-trivial percentage of Bitcoin holders believe eCash will get meaningful mining support and dump BTC ahead of the fork, that's a testable hypothesis over the next few months. The last time a major Bitcoin hard fork was announced (BCH, BSV), the price action was complex -- initial speculation, then a drawn-out underperformance for the fork chain.\n\nMy expectation: the fork launches with minority hashrate, trades at a fraction of BTC's price, and the drivechain use case never materializes at scale. But the period between announcement and launch is probably noisy.

body.title: Creating Outdoor Spaces That Feel Refined and Comfortable\n
body.body:
A well-designed outdoor space should feel inviting from the moment you step into it. It should offer comfort without feeling overdone, and it should feel refined without becoming formal or difficult to use. The most successful outdoor environments often achieve this balance quietly. They combine thoughtful furniture choices, balanced layout, and durable materials to create patios and seating areas that feel natural, elegant, and easy to enjoy. Creating outdoor spaces that feel refined and comfortable begins with understanding how design and function work together.  
Comfort and refinement are not opposing qualities. In outdoor design, they often depend on one another. A space may look beautiful, but if the seating feels rigid or the layout feels awkward, it will not invite people to stay. In the same way, a patio may feel comfortable but lack visual balance if the furniture does not work well together. The goal is to create a space where comfort supports style and style reinforces comfort.  
**Comfort Begins With the Right Furniture**  
Furniture is the foundation of any outdoor setting. Outdoor chairs, seating arrangements, and tables determine how the space will be used and how enjoyable it will feel over time. If the furniture feels supportive and proportionate, the patio becomes a place where people naturally want to relax. If it feels too bulky, too sparse, or poorly arranged, the space can feel incomplete.  
[Luxury outdoor furniture](https://luxuryoutdoorfurniture.com/) often creates this sense of comfort through balanced proportions and thoughtful design. Outdoor chairs are made to feel inviting without overwhelming the layout. Seating arrangements are designed to support conversation and ease. Outdoor tables add purpose to the space, giving people a place to gather, dine, or simply enjoy time outdoors.  
When furniture is selected with both comfort and design in mind, the entire outdoor space begins to feel more composed.  
**Refinement Comes From Simplicity and Balance**  
A refined outdoor space does not need to rely on excess. It often feels more elegant because it avoids clutter and allows each element to serve a purpose. Clean lines, comfortable spacing, and cohesive furniture choices help create a setting that feels calm and intentional.  
Luxury patio furniture is often most effective when it supports this sense of simplicity. Outdoor seating arranged with care allows the space to breathe. Tables placed thoughtfully anchor the layout without dominating it. Additional elements should complement the furniture rather than compete with it.  
Refinement often comes from restraint. A patio feels more polished when it is designed with balance rather than decoration alone.  
**Layout Shapes the Outdoor Experience**  
The arrangement of furniture has a strong influence on how comfortable and welcoming an outdoor space feels. Seating should support natural interaction while leaving enough room for movement. Tables should feel accessible and useful without interrupting the flow of the space.  
A balanced layout creates a sense of ease. Outdoor chairs gathered around a table feel welcoming because they suggest conversation and connection. A seating arrangement placed with clear spacing feels more open and usable. When people can move through the patio comfortably, the entire environment feels more relaxed.  
This is one of the reasons refined outdoor spaces often feel better to use. The layout has been considered carefully rather than filled in without purpose.  
**Material Choice Supports Lasting Comfort**  
Comfort and refinement are easier to maintain when furniture is built from materials designed for outdoor use. Durable materials help outdoor furniture retain both its structure and appearance over time, which keeps the patio looking polished and feeling dependable.  
Aluminum outdoor furniture is often chosen for this reason. Its strength and resistance to corrosion make it suitable for regular outdoor use, while its clean appearance supports a refined design. Outdoor chairs and tables built with aluminum frames remain stable and visually balanced, helping the space continue to feel comfortable and intentional through changing seasons.  
Material choice contributes to the experience of the space just as much as visual style does.  
**Outdoor Tables Add Function and Structure**  
[Outdoor tables](https://luxuryoutdoorfurniture.com/collections/tables) play a central role in making a space feel complete. They provide function, but they also create a visual center that helps define how the patio is used. A dining table can support meals and gatherings, while a smaller table can make a seating area feel more practical and welcoming.  
Luxury outdoor tables help create this structure without disrupting the flow of the space. When paired with comfortable outdoor seating, they give the patio a clear sense of purpose. This combination of function and design makes the outdoor area feel easier to use and more naturally integrated into daily living.  
A refined patio often feels more complete because the furniture serves clear and useful roles.  
**Everyday Use Is the True Measure of Good Design**  
An outdoor space may look impressive, but its real success depends on whether people want to use it regularly. Comfort, balance, and durable materials all contribute to this. When furniture supports quiet mornings, evening conversations, and everyday outdoor routines, the space becomes more than just visually pleasing. It becomes part of how the home is lived in.  
[Luxury outdoor furniture](https://luxuryoutdoorfurniture.com/) supports this by combining long-term usability with thoughtful design. Outdoor spaces feel more refined when they can be used with ease and more comfortable when they support the natural rhythm of daily life.  
This connection between design and everyday use is what gives well-planned patios their lasting value.

body.title: Thinking of Taking Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate Exam? Here's How Hard It Really is
body.body:
![associate-badge-gen-ai.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/51075ec46a63cbe02f56f8f08641cb83c901e0374d8009a5a839774c0aea4f64)



I still remember sitting at my desk the night before my Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate exam, second-guessing every decision I'd made in the past three weeks of studying. Was I ready? Had I covered enough ground? Was this certification even worth the stress?

If you're asking yourself the same questions right now, this post is for you. Here's what the exam is actually like. No sugarcoating, no hype.

## What Nobody Tells You About This Exam Before You Sign Up

Most blog posts will tell you it's \

and leave it at that. That's not helpful. Here's the real picture.\n\nThe Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate exam consists of around 56 multiple-choice questions (some unscored) and you have 90 minutes to complete it. On paper, that sounds generous. In practice, many of the questions are scenario-based and require you to think like an actual engineer, not just recall a definition. You're not being asked \

. You're being asked to choose the right RAG architecture for a specific business problem or to debug why a pipeline is failing after switching to a model with a shorter context window.

Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate exam tests six broad domains: design, development, deployment, evaluation, governance, and monitoring. And it leans heavily on Databricks-specific tools such as Mosaic AI Vector Search, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Foundation Model APIs and Model Serving. If you've only studied generic GenAI concepts, you'll hit a wall fast.

## Where Most Candidates Struggle (And I Almost Did Too)

The section that tripped me up the most was the agent and tooling design questions. I knew the theory: tools, system prompts, LangChain agents. But Databricks Generative AI Engineer Associate exam presents these in messy, real-world scenarios where you have to pick the best option, not just a correct one.

Chunking strategy for RAG was another area that felt deceptively simple until I saw the questions. You need to know not just what chunking is but how chunk size affects context window limits, retrieval quality and which evaluation metrics (like recall and NDCG) tell you if your strategy is actually working.

And then there's the MLflow and deployment section. Questions about registering models to Unity Catalog, sequencing deployment steps, and deciding between provisioned throughput versus pay-per-token endpoints. These require hands-on familiarity, not just surface-level reading.

The honest truth? If you walk in having only read the official documentation, you will find this exam hard.

## How I Passed Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate Exam (What Actually Works)

**First, complete the official Databricks Academy course:** \

It's free, self-paced, and maps almost perfectly to the exam domains. Don't skip the demo notebooks if you can access them.

**Second, build something:** Even a small RAG application using LangChain and Databricks Vector Search will teach you more than three hours of reading. The exam is practical, and your hands need to know the workflow, not just your head.

**Third and this is the one I underestimated: Practice with real exam-style questions early and often.** Not to memorize answers but to train your brain to think in the scenario-based way the exam demands. You need to develop the instinct for why one architecture is better than another in a given context.

## What Helped Me Practice the Right Way

This is where I was able to get an exact idea of what to expect on the exam. [Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate practice questions by CertBoosters](https://www.certboosters.com/) are structured exactly the way the real exam thinks: scenario-driven, Databricks-specific and designed to surface the gaps in your understanding rather than just test your memory.

What I liked most was that the questions cover the full spectrum: RAG pipeline design, agent tool selection, MLflow deployment sequencing, chunking strategies, Vector Search configuration and governance with Unity Catalog. Going through them revealed blind spots I didn't even know I had and that's exactly what good practice questions should do.

If you're two or three weeks out from your exam date, regularly working through CertBoosters practice questions alongside your coursework is one of the highest-leverage things you can do.

## The Exam is Passable, But How?

Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate exam is challenging but it's absolutely passable with the right preparation. The people who struggle are the ones who rely on passive reading alone. The people who pass are the ones who practice thinking like a GenAI engineer not just studying like a student.

You've already taken the first step by doing your research. Now take the next one, start working [CertBoosters practice questions](https://www.certboosters.com/exam/databricks/databricks-generative-ai-engineer-associate), identify where your knowledge has gaps and start filling them in. Your Databricks Certified Generative AI Engineer Associate certification is closer than you think. Good Luck!

body.title: The Ethereum Foundation Just Unstaked $49M of ETH -- And the Pattern Matters More Than the Size
body.body:
The Ethereum Foundation moved 17,035 ETH -- roughly $48.9 million at current prices -- into Lido's unstaking queue on April 26. The operation ran through 271 batched transactions. That's not someone fumbling with a wallet. That's deliberate treasury management.

The question isn't whether they're allowed to do it. They are. The question is what it means when the network's primary institutional steward keeps converting its ETH holdings into liquidity.

---

## What Actually Happened

Arkham tracking data showed the EF routing a large position through Lido's withdrawal process. Batched Lido withdrawals carry a queue delay -- the ETH doesn't hit a liquid address immediately. The 271 transactions suggest this was planned in advance, not reactive.

After this move, the EF still holds more than 53,000 ETH in staked positions, plus separate liquid treasury assets. The total unstaking represents roughly 24% of their staked position, not a full exit.

No destination for the unstaked ETH was disclosed at the time of writing.

---

## The Context That Makes This Significant

This is not an isolated event. The EF sold 10,000 ETH through an OTC counterparty in the weeks before this unstaking. Two moves in quick succession -- OTC sale, then a large unstaking -- form a pattern worth reading carefully.

ETH is currently trading at $2,320, down 0.6% on the day. The ETH/BTC ratio sits at approximately 0.030 -- one of its lowest levels in years. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 33 (Fear). The EF is converting ETH to liquidity in an environment where ETH sentiment is already fragile.

---

## The Lido Question Nobody Is Asking

One Reddit comment cut to something important: why did the Ethereum Foundation stake through Lido in the first place?

The EF has spent years advocating for decentralized staking and solo validators. Lido is the dominant liquid staking protocol, consistently holding 30%+ of all staked ETH -- a concentration that the EF itself has warned about from a network security standpoint. Using Lido for their own staking position is a contradiction that has never been clearly addressed.

The unstaking through Lido doesn't create new decentralization risk. But the original staking decision did, and it's worth noting that the entity most vocal about Lido's dominance was contributing to it.

---

## What This Is Probably About

The EF runs a real organization. Grants, research salaries, Devcon logistics, ecosystem funding -- these have dollar costs. ETH is their treasury asset. Selling ETH to fund operations is structurally required if they don't want to hold and spend stablecoins or fiat.

The EF has historically been transparent about this framing: they sell to fund public goods. That's a defensible position.

The problem is that each sale transmits a signal the market reads as: *the people who built this are still reducing their exposure.* Whether that interpretation is correct is almost beside the point. In crypto, where narrative and price are tightly coupled, the signal function of a large wallet move often matters more than the underlying rationale.

---

## What to Watch

- **On-chain destination**: does the unstaked ETH move to an exchange deposit address, an OTC counterparty, or stay in a holding wallet? Exchange deposits are the clearest sell signal.
- **ETH/BTC ratio**: currently at multi-year lows. If ETH continues underperforming BTC while the EF is visibly liquidating, the ratio could push lower before any recovery.
- **EF communications**: a transparent disclosure of what the unstaked ETH is funding would materially change the sentiment read on this move.
- **Staking queue timing**: Lido withdrawals take days. The ETH becomes liquid on a timeline the market can estimate. Watch for price impact around expected delivery.

The $49 million number is not large enough to move the market by itself. The signal is the issue. And right now, the signal isn't clean.

>Saying something and then having to follow through on it ultimately becomes a commitment, since saying it just for the sake of saying it isn’t enough; you have to be consistent in what you think, do, and above all say, so that things are truly taken seriously—not as something said in the heat of the moment just for the sake of saying it— This is a way in which things make more sense, and you feel that someone is consistent with what they do—even if that sometimes means saying something that might have seemed easy to carry out at the time, but later you feel like changing your mind, and yet, for one reason or another, you can’t—not because it isn’t true, but simply because you feel that failing to follow through in some way just isn’t right. ![separadoryasma1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23tRzwswFj7sdCJKFgW2jsAWvCyEzuv6zxT8pCrVwXa8ePqRSdQWi3P6ZbtsyGmy6y4G2.png)

>In my case, I usually say what I really want or intend to do, without going back on my word later, so that what I say and do is consistent and there are no problems down the road, but it often happens that there are moments when you realize that the very thing you said you wouldn’t do or don’t do—well, it seems like in one way or another you’re going to do it, and even if you don’t want to—well, in one way or another you fall into it and try to go back to the point where you gave your word that you wouldn’t do that or that it wasn’t like that. at least that’s what happened to me—I used to say I didn’t really like going to the beach because what bothered me most was the trip back with all the sand and stuff; it really bothered me a lot. --- ![wokandapix-keywords-letters-2041816_1920.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yasmarit/23wMgkjQNKgLgob37YkiafC7rTRMUr2JPuuQwJCkn8yxvnmKhe7LJ5iQYJgZr8zeuET2k.jpg) [Source](https://pixabay.com/es/images/download/x-2041816_1920.jpg) ---

>Haha, but one day some friends invited me to hang out at the beach. body.title: Dailyprompt - First Impression
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTmhZtHfFMs6f1KndR4bgpdKezRSFGFmuPpNP2gt3G3Yb/W5LtFUPm6g73GywJLc4qya717jY4hemJ4yGThw4X26FyBW1ysEe1Co9M8JtyJuqd9Yjr5YuZo9HL7rSQK3bwSGydkytwGVzXtVECgbn4t42JJbaJSufuQ7q5VqNEXkZbnQHiEypwof9RcSWumKGbEfKFzEpzA.avif

First impressions are hard to forget.

I still remember that night. The harsh cold rain and the knock on my door that cut through the dark.

If I had known back then… how could I have known such a thing? Would any of it be any different if I had known?

I remember opening the door half asleep, only to meet a tall bald man with tattoos crawling up his face and dark circles sunk deep around his eyes. It wasn’t just his appearance that unsettled me; it was the way he stood there, too still, like he had been waiting for me longer than the knock suggested.

He didn’t say much. Just handed me a metal box and a letter. The job was simple, he said. Deliver it to a manor on a small island off the coast of Brunswick, Maine.

And then he smiled.

I still remember that smile.

It was wide. It didn’t feel like a smile at all.

Something about it was off. I knew that even then. But the letter had a cheque tucked inside, enough to cover more than just the trip. And I didn’t have the luxury of refusing work. My ex-wife had been on my back for days about the alimony. Bills don’t care if something feels wrong.

So I took it.

I slipped on my coat and wrapped a scarf around my neck. A few hours and a short boat ride out there to deliver the box and then back by supper.

Or so I thought.

body.title: HiveP2P reafirma su naturaleza descentralizada [ES-EN]
body.body:
ENGLISH VERSION (click here!)

A few days ago, @hivecuba.p2p was forced to halt its operations. Fortunately, our systems, designed from the start with on-chain security in mind, rely solely on the HIVE blockchain to operate safely and in a decentralized manner. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-p2p/23wC2xaUuSiR3HjLK8VMh5wTkbweCkpaF9V48zVMyEa3Kp8dHwsRSBncVUyV5Qpi8E1Di.png) Image generated with the HiveP2P Logo using Copilot ## Short Horror Story: OFAC vs HiveP2P It all started because our domain provider [**NameSheap**](https://www.namecheap.com), under U.S. jurisdiction, declared that the domains hivecuba.com and hive-p2p.com violated their terms of service. To recover the domains, the owners were required to go through a KYC verification process (impossible if you are Cuban and live in Cuba). NameSheap is a domain provider that initially only asks for an email to register, and only requests KYC in cases of violations (OFAC complaints). The hivecuba domain, and especially hive-p2p, as an independent, decentralized service for unregulated asset exchange with a country sanctioned by OFAC, fell victim to the fine print: NameSheap is registered with ICANN in the U.S., so it is bound by U.S. regulations and cannot process transactions (registration, renewal, transfer) with sanctioned persons/entities. ![loockNameSheap.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-p2p/23wCZSBEkY74QCyC2HthJYHBTm5FLg7d8EueLap3WqWqErnKhkwi1w5CBkuomfZzWkpag.jpeg) Upon investigating, there are other precedents, for example: > The case of Steve Marshall (2008): > A British citizen residing in Spain managed 80 websites related to travel to Cuba. His U.S. registrar (eNom) received a call from OFAC and blocked all domains, considering them \

under the Cuban sanctions. eNom refused to transfer the domains to another registrar, claiming that the transfer would also violate OFAC regulations. Therefore, if you live in Cuba or your service has anything to do with Cuba, you must keep in mind that domain providers like Namecheap, Porkbun, GoDaddy, and any registrar that applies KYC with nationality verification may declare you in violation of their terms and conditions for being a national of a sanctioned country (Iran, Cuba, Syria, North Korea, Crimea), even if you reside outside those countries. What's really curious is that this incident occurred right after HiveP2P was represented at the [VIII Crypto Summit in Moscow](https://peakd.com/hive-10053/@hive-p2p/hivep2p-en-moscu-se-abre-una-brecha-con-el-know-how-de-hivecubadev-es-en), where there were intentions and efforts from Russian entities, clearly sanctioned by OFAC. We defend the right that crypto is for everyone. ## There's no stopping you when you're decentralized The domain block forced us to halt our services, as the web links were not working. We took on the task of researching and testing several alternatives. We lost the .com and switched to .net, but along the way we established strategies in case we ever face a similar situation again. From this experience we have learned several lessons. One of them is **read the fine print** and another is that **cheap does not mean better**. From the definition of the initial architecture, all storage and operations are based on HIVE as a decentralized immutable database. This has shown us that even if our services are erased, as long as the HIVE blockchain remains functional, we can rise again like the Phoenix without any user's assets being affected—only the delay of our rebirth would impact them. That is the power of HIVE, which we will expand in our future developments. ## A pause for self-reflection We have delayed giving explanations because it is not advisable to stir up dust without a plan behind it. We have made sure to back up everything necessary, verify the security of all systems, and above all, look for new alternatives in case new malicious obstacles arise. The crypto space and the inherent freedom have enemies in all policies; escaping control is feared by those who exercise it. We have slowed our pace, but so that each step is firmer. New opportunities and alliances are coming that will make HIVE and its ecosystem an access point for everyone to the global economy. We are already part of that change, **and you too**.

Hace unos pocos días @hivecuba.p2p tuvo que detener sus operaciones de manera forzosa, por suerte nuestros sistemas diseñados desde el inicio pensados en la seguridad onchain, solo dependen de la blockchain HIVE para operar con seguridad y descentralización. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-p2p/23wC2xaUuSiR3HjLK8VMh5wTkbweCkpaF9V48zVMyEa3Kp8dHwsRSBncVUyV5Qpi8E1Di.png) ## Historia de Terror Corta: OFAC vs HiveP2P Todo surgió porque el proveedor de dominio que teníamos [**NameSheap**](https://www.namecheap.com), con juridicción en EE.UU declaró que los dominios hivecuba.com y hive-p2p.com incumplen los términos del servicio, requiriendo para valorar recuperar los dominios un proceso de verificación KYC (Imposible si eres Cubano y además vives en Cuba). NameSheap es un proveedor de dominio que en principio solo solicita para el registro un correo y solo en casos de violaciones (denuncias de la OFAC) solicitan KYC. El dominio hivecuba y sobre todo hive-p2p al ser un servicio independiente, descentralizado para el intercambio no regulado de activos con un país sancionado por la OFAC estuvo marcado por la letra pequeña: NameSheap está registrado ante la ICANN de EE.EE. UU. por lo que está obligada a sus regulaciones y no puede procesar transacciones (registro, renovación, transferencia) con personas/entidades sancionadas. ![loockNameSheap.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-p2p/23wCZSBEkY74QCyC2HthJYHBTm5FLg7d8EueLap3WqWqErnKhkwi1w5CBkuomfZzWkpag.jpeg) ![Screenshot 2026-04-26 at 16.42.34.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/hive-p2p/23tRxGFFnMnT4L7tEaVCn5kv2fcqgMnc4MwvhB1dKReA1GcvC9VpAHSqKukeLGeZyma2z.png) Por tanto, si vives en Cuba o tu servicio tiene algo que ver con Cuba debes tener en cuenta que proveedores de dominio como Namecheap, Porkbun, GoDaddy, y cualquier registrador que aplique KYC con verificación de nacionalidad, te pueden declarar como incumplidor de sus términos y condiciones al ser nacional de país sancionado (Irán, Cuba, Siria, Corea del Norte, Crimea) aunque residas fuera de esos países. Lo realmente curioso es que este incidente ocurriera justo después de que HiveP2P fuera representado en el [VIII Crypto Summit de Moscú](https://peakd.com/hive-10053/@hive-p2p/hivep2p-en-moscu-se-abre-una-brecha-con-el-know-how-de-hivecubadev-es-en) donde hubo intenciones y gestiones de entidades rusas, claramente sancionadas por la OFAC. Defendemos el derecho a que crypto es para todos. ## No hay como detenerte cuando se está descentralizado El bloqueo de dominio nos obligó a detener nuestros servicios, pues los enlaces web no funcionaban. Nos dimos a la tarea de investigar y probar varias alternativas. Perdimos el .com y pasamos a .net, pero en el camino establecimos estrategias por si alguna vez más tenemos un suceso parecido, de esta experiencia tenemos aprendidas varias lecciones. Una de ellas es **leer la letra pequeña** y la otra que **barato no significa mejor**. Desde la definición de la arquitectura inicial todo el almacenamiento y operatividad está basada en HIVE como base de datos inmutable descentralizada, eso nos ha demostrado que pueden incluso borrar nuestros servicios que mientras la blockchain HIVE sigue funcional podremos revivir como el ave Fénix sin que ningún usuario vea afectado sus valores, solo la demora de nuestro renacer lo afectaría. Es el poder de HIVE que expandiremos en nuestros desarrollos futuros. ## Una pausa de autoreflexión Nos hemos demorado en dar razones pues no es conveniente levantar el polvo si no hay un plan detrás. Nos hemos asegurado de respaldar todo lo necesario, verificar la seguridad de todos los sistemas y sobre todo buscar nuevas alternativas por si aparecen nuevos tropiezos mal intencionados. El tema crypto y la libertad inherente tienen enemigos en todas las políticas, escapar del control es temido por los que lo ejercen. Hemos disminuido el paso, pero para que cada uno sea más firme, se avecinan nuevas oportunidades y alianzas que harán de HIVE y su ecosistema un acceso para todos a la economía global, de ese cambio ya estamos formando parte **y tú también**.

body.body: \nThere's something uniquely gripping and mystery-driven horror, the kind that doesn't just try to scare you-but to trap your mind in a loop of questions. A series like \

thrives on this tension, blending fear with uncertainty in a way that keeps viewers mentally engaged long after the screen goes dark. I just finished Season four Episode two and I'm already feeling anxious for what's coming next. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJEfzu3fZwFYvJvWaG3q2UERWpPAKn8WnsiHAkdLbP2S/img_0463.jpg)

At the core of its intrigue is the unknown. Unlike straight forward horror, where the threat is visible and defined, mystery horror withholds clarity. You are not just watching events unfold, you are also trying to understand and put the puzzle together. Every scene becomes a clue, every character a possible answer or deception.  This transforms the viewer from a passive observer into active participant, constantly theorizing, predicting and second guessing. Most times I even go on YouTube to watch reviews on the movie to see what I missed along the line. 

Another reason these stories captivate is their psychological depth. Fear becomes layered, it is no longer about what is chasing the characters, but why it exists, how it operates, and whether escape is even possible. This uncertainty creates a more lasting form of tension. Your mind doesn't get relief because the rules of the world are unclear and that unpredictability keeps you hooked. 

The brain naturally seeks patterns and answers.  When a story deliberately delays those answers, it creates a kind of mental itch. You keep watching, not just out of entertainment, but out of a need to complete the puzzle. This is why on twitter there are discussions surrounding theories and debates on the movie. The story doesn't end when the episode does; it continues in the minds of its audience. 

In the end, what makes mystery horror so compelling is its ability to blur the line between fear and curiosity. It doesn't just scare you, it makes you think, question, and return for more.

Thanks for stopping by my blog, see you soon.

body.title: Identifying Mispriced Outcomes in World Cup Betting Markets
body.body: The expansion of the FIFA World Cup to 48 teams in 2026 introduces not only structural complexity but also significant inefficiencies in betting markets. Traditional bookmakers rely heavily on historical data, public sentiment, and simplified power rankings—approaches that struggle to account for new variables such as third‑place group stage advancement, cross‑continental travel fatigue, and the rotating venue conditions across three host nations. For professional bettors and trading analysts, these inefficiencies represent potential value: moments where market prices diverge from statistically derived probabilities. The challenge lies in identifying such divergences before the market corrects itself.\n\nOne resource that has gained attention for its quantitative approach to this problem is <a href=\

>fifaworldcuppredictions2026.com highlights value betting opportunities highlights value betting opportunities through its simulation‑based forecasting models. Unlike generic odds comparison sites that simply aggregate existing lines, this platform generates its own probabilistic outcomes based on tournament‑specific variables—fixture density, rest differentials, climate adaptation, and even referee tendencies. When the platform's implied probability for a given outcome exceeds the odds offered by bookmakers, a potential value situation is flagged. This methodology does not guarantee profit—football retains its fundamental unpredictability—but it provides a disciplined, repeatable framework for identifying market discrepancies that might otherwise go unnoticed.

body.title: Nouns DAO Analysis
body.body:
Nouns DAO: The Perpetual Auction Treasury Model – Generative NFTs, Community Governance, and Public Goods Funding – Technical Architecture, Governance Mechanics, Ecosystem, Goals, and a Comparative Analysis with Cardano Catalyst

https://cryptotexty.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/OIP-1569483943.jpg

Nouns DAO, launched on 17 August 2021, pioneered a radically simple yet powerful perpetual funding mechanism: one generative Noun NFT is trustlessly auctioned every 24 hours forever, with 100% of ETH proceeds deposited directly into the DAO treasury. Each Noun grants its holder one non-transferable but delegatable vote in governance, creating a self-perpetuating cultural and financial flywheel. By April 2026, the DAO has minted over 1,887 Nouns, accumulated a treasury exceeding Ξ 3,750 (~$8.8 million), funded more than 148 on-chain proposals and 350+ community initiatives (via Prop House and subsequent evolutions), and established a legally recognized Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Association (DUNA) in Wyoming. Governance has evolved from direct Compound-style proposals to Prop House competitive rounds and then to Flows.wtf — a continuous, curated streaming model described as an “onchain Y Combinator.”

This research paper analyzes Nouns DAO’s technical characteristics (daily auction contract, Compound Governance fork, and DUNA legal wrapper), voting and proposal mechanics, ecosystem scale and impact, strategic goals, and long-term vision. A detailed comparison with Cardano’s Project Catalyst highlights fundamental divergences: Nouns DAO generates and deploys treasury through perpetual cultural NFT sales and community curation, prioritizing meme-driven public goods and continuous funding, while Catalyst relies on permissionless stake-weighted voting for large-scale grant distribution. The core question—how Nouns DAO functions in practice, how it differs from Catalyst, and its resulting pros and cons—reveals a highly original, culturally resonant model that excels in sustainable treasury generation and creative public-goods allocation but introduces unique risks around concentration and meme volatility. Data is drawn from official documentation, governance records, recent proposals, and ecosystem updates as of April 2026. 

 

1 . Introduction

Few DAOs have captured the imagination of the crypto community as effectively as Nouns DAO. Its core innovation — auctioning a single, generative, public-domain NFT every 24 hours forever, with every ETH of proceeds flowing directly into a community-controlled treasury — created a self-sustaining economic and cultural engine. Each Noun functions as both a collectible artwork and an irrevocable membership token granting one vote in DAO governance. This mechanism has produced a vibrant, meme-native community while funding hundreds of public-goods initiatives, cultural projects, and builder programs across the globe.

Nouns DAO operates on Ethereum mainnet using a fork of Compound Governance. Proposals require a minimum of 4 Nouns to submit, votes are delegatable but non-transferable with the asset, and the treasury is used exclusively for long-term growth and prosperity of the Nouns project and broader public goods. To address legal and liability concerns, the DAO ratified Proposal 727 establishing a Wyoming Decentralized Unincorporated Nonprofit Association (DUNA), providing limited liability while preserving on-chain sovereignty. The Nouns Foundation retains a temporary, narrowly scoped proposal veto right to mitigate extreme risks such as 51% attacks or unaudited upgrades.

By April 2026, Nouns DAO has evolved significantly in its capital deployment strategy — transitioning from direct on-chain proposals to Prop House competitive rounds and finally to Flows.wtf, a continuous curated funding stream often characterized as an “onchain Y Combinator.” This progression reflects broader lessons in DAO capital allocation: moving from high-friction governance to lightweight, impact-focused continuous deployment. The treasury, while fluctuating with ETH price and auction dynamics, has historically supported substantial public-goods spending, with over 605 builders funded across active flows by early 2026.

This paper provides a comprehensive, research-grade analysis of Nouns DAO. It examines technical infrastructure, voting and proposal mechanics, ecosystem metrics and cultural impact, strategic goals, followed by a head-to-head comparison with Cardano’s Project Catalyst. By synthesizing primary sources — the Nouns website, governance forum, recent proposals, and 2025–2026 evolution reports — the analysis answers the core research question: How does Nouns DAO actually function as a perpetual auction treasury model, how does it differ from large-scale stake-weighted funding mechanisms like Catalyst, and what are the resulting pros and cons in terms of sustainability, cultural resonance, and capital efficiency?

Nouns DAO stands as a compelling case study in meme-driven, culturally native governance that has proven capable of generating ongoing treasury inflows while funding meaningful public goods. Its lessons are particularly relevant for DAOs seeking sustainable funding models beyond initial token sales or inflation. 

Read full research paper here: https://cryptotexty.io/nouns-dao/
More about Nouns DAO: https://nouns.wtf/
More about Project Catalyst: https://projectcatalyst.io/

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@flodner/nouns-dao-analysis-3yv)

body.title: Memories from the trunk.  | Recuerdos del baúl | Lembranças do porta-malas..
body.body: Traducido del Español a Inglés - Portugués

> I had the joy of speaking with my father and my brother, my new nephew was born just a few days ago, they named him (khain) his birth was complicated but now he is already home and the family is happy to have him.
- *My dad shared some photos from his memory box..* It's me! Without glasses, with straight hair, and with much more energy than now. 😂 ![1000224169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/EowG4Ds9K7XSdezamkDeXyR32vNkoGGbuGniGUh7v1sC7x7GzGiCSMS7j2mgSiVXgzk.jpg)
My hair is wavy, but back in high school it was always straight, constantly subjected to blow dryers and straighteners. I think it was just a way of feeling silky and long. I haven't straightened my hair in years; I don't have the time or money. - Graduation ceremony! I'm at the back of the row, just to the left you'll only see my round face. ![1000224312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23tRzfacK2h59spShi1DpXmemMef1bXZ1wTFF2SqQBL4fevU8k9TeDcq687HMNPVByo4r.jpg)
- A version of myself just beginning to discover the world. I think high school is an excellent stage of life, a stage that never returns, but that always accompanies us with its fond memories. A time full of goals and the certainty that I would build a life exactly as I planned. WELL! Now, many years later, reality has turned out to be very different from what I imagined in high school, but if there's one thing I've learned, it's to accept change and keep moving forward.
- I think I was 10 years old when I graduated from school. A little girl, newly arrived in the town where I grew up. I remember it was difficult for me to adapt to a new school, a new environment, and to make new friends. (This was during the difficult separation of my parents.) ![1000224421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23y8sojDA4Ft3sbkhHPJbfasUnh3atiungFCFPD3RFwP9o7LfL7uKVm6WPtsPKcrWoDPe.jpg)
* And as I always say ## We move forward every day, fighting day by day. *** > **The photos are my own and I took them with my Redmi 14C cell phone.** > **AI was not used to write the post; Google Translate was used to write the English and Português parts.** **

> Tuve la dicha de hablar con mi padre y mi hermano, ha nacido mi nuevo sobrino hace apenas unos días, lo llamaron (khain) su nacimiento fue complicado pero ahora ya está en casa y la familia feliz de tenerlo.
- *Mi papá compartió algunas fotos de su baúl de los recuerdos.* Soy yo.! Sin gafas, con el pelo liso y con mucha más energía que ahora. 😂 ![1000224169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/EowG4Ds9K7XSdezamkDeXyR32vNkoGGbuGniGUh7v1sC7x7GzGiCSMS7j2mgSiVXgzk.jpg)
Mi cabello es ondulado, en mis tiempos de segundaria no había un momento que mi cabello no estuviera liso, sometido siempre a los secadores y las planchas de cabello. Creo que era una mania de sentirlo sedoso y largo. No e vuelto a alisar mi cabello en años, no tengo tiempo ni dinero para hacerlo. - Acto de grado! Estoy en la parte de atrás de la fila, justo a la izquierda podrás ver solo mi cara redonda. ![1000224312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23tRzfacK2h59spShi1DpXmemMef1bXZ1wTFF2SqQBL4fevU8k9TeDcq687HMNPVByo4r.jpg)
Una versión de mí que apenas comenzaba a descubrir el mundo. Creo que la segundaria es una excelente etapa, una etapa que ya no vuelve, pero que siempre nos acompaña con sus buenos recuerdo. Tiempos llenos de metas y de esa seguridad de que construiría una vida exactamente como la planeaba. BUENO! ahora luego de muchos años atrás, la realidad resultó ser muy diferente a lo que imaginaba en la secundaria, pero si algo e aprendido es aceptar los cambios y seguir el camino.
- Promoción escolar.! creo que tenía 10 años ahí. Una pequeña niña, recién llegada al pueblo donde me crié. Recuerdo que fue difícil para mí adaptarme a una nueva escuela, un nuevo ambiente, y hacer nuevos amigos. (Aquí estaba pasando la fuerte separación de mis padres.) ![1000224421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23y8sojDA4Ft3sbkhHPJbfasUnh3atiungFCFPD3RFwP9o7LfL7uKVm6WPtsPKcrWoDPe.jpg)
* Y como siempre digo ## Avanzamos todos los días, luchando día a día. *** > **Las fotos son de mi autoría y las tomé con mi teléfono celular Redmi.** > **No se utilizó IA para escribir la publicación, se utilizó Google Translate para escribir las partes en inglés y português.** **

>
Tive a alegria de conversar com meu pai e meu irmão. Meu sobrinho nasceu há poucos dias e recebeu o nome de Khain. O parto foi complicado, mas ele já está em casa e a família está muito feliz com a sua chegada.
- *Meu pai compartilhou algumas fotos de sua caixa de recordações..* Sou eu! Sem óculos, com cabelo liso e com muito mais energia do que agora.😂 ![1000224169.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/EowG4Ds9K7XSdezamkDeXyR32vNkoGGbuGniGUh7v1sC7x7GzGiCSMS7j2mgSiVXgzk.jpg)
Meu cabelo é ondulado, mas no ensino médio ele era sempre liso, constantemente exposto a secadores e chapinhas. Acho que era só um jeito de me sentir sedosa e com o cabelo comprido. Faz anos que não aliso meu cabelo; não tenho tempo nem dinheiro para isso.. - Cerimônia de formatura! Estou no final da fileira, um pouco à esquerda, vocês só verão meu rostinho redondo. ![1000224312.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23tRzfacK2h59spShi1DpXmemMef1bXZ1wTFF2SqQBL4fevU8k9TeDcq687HMNPVByo4r.jpg)
Uma versão de mim mesma começando a descobrir o mundo. Acho que o ensino médio é uma fase excelente da vida, uma fase que nunca volta, mas que sempre nos acompanha com suas doces lembranças. Uma época cheia de objetivos e da certeza de que eu construiria uma vida exatamente como planejei. BEM! Agora, muitos anos depois, a realidade se mostrou bem diferente do que eu imaginava no ensino médio, mas se há uma coisa que aprendi, é a aceitar a mudança e seguir em frente.
- Acho que tinha 10 anos quando me formei na escola. Uma garotinha recém-chegada à cidade onde cresci. Lembro que foi difícil para mim me adaptar a uma nova escola, um novo ambiente e fazer novos amigos. (Isso aconteceu durante a difícil separação dos meus pais.) ![1000224421.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monachta/23y8sojDA4Ft3sbkhHPJbfasUnh3atiungFCFPD3RFwP9o7LfL7uKVm6WPtsPKcrWoDPe.jpg)
* E como sempre digo ## Seguimos em frente todos os dias, lutando dia após dia. *** > **As fotos são de minha autoria e foram tiradas com meu celular Redmi 14C.** > **A inteligência artificial não foi usada para escrever a postagem; o Google Tradutor foi usado para escrever as partes em inglês E português.** **

body.title: An early winter sunset.
body.body:
We are in the last part of the autumn season, but winter decided otherwise.
![082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqFuLouUbLUrz3PJCE93RrK8LgJio1A4A29NFpkFiAfrE5Cnk3mPAEx3hcXeV9FYHSJ.jpg)

Knocking on the door earlier than usual with tons of rain to announce its presence.

This is the later part of the day after yesterday's cloudy blue post, as I had an idea to go and look at the sunset. And so, my two wives and I got into our car and travelled up to a high spot to get the sunset. Two wives? Yeah, my wife says that my camera is my second wife :)
I have to admit that my camera bag stays with me wherever I go, and so does my wife, which might seem to be a bit unnatural, but to us it makes much sense, as we have an abundance of nature here and if I see something nice, or extraordinary, then I have the camera to share here on Hive. I will tell you my wife's part at the end of the post.
Come and look at the sunset.

Just in time to get the shot below as I got out of the car.
![107.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23wX1LSasRk5kdmcgUEMGZnrupHc4kyBTcnmFG9zzcemgKZTinmNrCYSJGkjKYA4SMPge.JPG)

Back to the sunset, and I am addicted to sunrays as you will see below. 
![074.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23vsSp6cUpaw88xwtJLLZYLHkZhyL8FuRGAVxUkrsJTzVzK2hhtUp1mCeBxTtnCxLR7P2.JPG)

![078.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpXL1jkMF2oXHsdKWVLBeiaY3wmHmrtgGpinWVrNWEf7VnmVYFbMLFSdGRfqpoSdJAK.JPG)

![088.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23s9ZyCu8eYY8Ng3NLLs35117WLHzUcsme2gEFQ3SKZTKYNSo51oHXVCmTf4cNTM7HL1e.JPG)

![089.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoeEsRq4ti2LEexXxUQSGffKSNMXyY7yMarB2sKYsubk7AHkSAtPY8My4RGtepmwpFS.JPG)

There was a lot of cloud about, and it was difficult to get the full sun on camera as it played a hide-and-seek game with me. But the colors made up for it and the wind was driving the clouds from the right hand (north) across the horizon to the south. I always try to understand the wind directions whenever I take shots of the sky, as then I get to fathom the way that the clouds would travel. It is also important for me because I then know how to wait for a certain cloud to arrive in order to take the shots.  
![094.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EoyPXJx71dnz4WZPjLwSYi7g6XxmPbKCa9mzqsiVnB6hYJuc9CPcZE5QAjSGey2nSzY.JPG)

Here is a closer shot of the picture above. 
![097.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EpJZWfbNDASV86kuSX2kDyBpfRNWKbYbmamf7XwrksS2E7RmX2mvHQj5381P4smCU57.JPG)

![102.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/23vsQK6SaQBgVu2JFmoZxUFjTXz96BpQBzkc9EyimwZzbGq5TLZxJmYGwiCb1GWfnUfFd.JPG)

![104.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/Eou8CgmHrJBWfMcjaAEeRUYoJ3DhEcHnpvstafkcgksALobU8WPCJWwT4hT8yU5dff5.JPG)

And finally, it was done as everything started to fade after this shot below.
![113.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/papilloncharity/EqJ2JZC7sXiHQEqCj2syZVGDeGZKKVUSissxwMVFFHvnruNGV976G3DKzzPmMqrnPzV.JPG)

Okay, as I said above my wife is also always by my side as I cannot walk alone anymore. I have had a few falls lately, due to the uneven terrain that I walk on, and I get such sharp stabs in the knee of my gammy leg that I cannot even stand or step on it. So, then it is only one way, I have to kiss Mother Earth (fall down). My wife acts as a guide and she warns me every time that she sees a sudden dip or a sudden rise in the path. The problem I have with the knee is that the cartilage is gone and so a wrong step results in the knee going bone to bone.

But that's just me and I can still cope with things. In any case, the weather is strange not only here as one can see the power of nature across the world. Thank goodness we don't have Tsunamis or Typhoons here in our country, but the wildfires and floods make up for it. The word is out that the African continent is starting to split apart, and whether this is true or not I wonder if this will ever happen. So many stories going about lately, especially with the false stories created lately with AI. 
Such is life. 

I hope you enjoyed the pictures and the story.

Photos by Zac Smith. All-Rights-Reserved.

Camera: Canon PowershotSX70HS Bridge camera.

Until next time, cheers!

body.title: Modeling Uncertainty: The Evolution of World Cup Forecasting\n
body.body: The upcoming 2026 FIFA World Cup presents a paradigm shift for tournament analysis. With an expanded 48-team field, a three-nation hosting arrangement across the United States, Canada, and Mexico, and a reimagined group stage that will see third-place teams advance, conventional forecasting methods face significant limitations. Historical data—head-to-head results, goal differentials, and legacy rankings—becomes less reliable when the tournament's core structure changes so dramatically. For sports analysts, journalists, and strategic observers, the challenge is not simply to predict winners but to identify frameworks capable of accounting for new variables such as intercontinental travel loads, climate adaptation, and uneven recovery schedules.\n\nOne resource that has emerged specifically in response to this analytical gap is Fifaworldcuppredictions2026.com. Unlike broad-spectrum statistics platforms that apply the same models across leagues and tournaments, this tool focuses exclusively on the unique parameters of the 2026 World Cup. Its approach emphasizes simulation-based forecasting, incorporating factors such as the probability of third-place group finishers advancing, the impact of venue altitude variations, and the cumulative fatigue effects of cross‑country travel across North America. What distinguishes the platform for professional use is not an assertion of accuracy but a commitment to methodological transparency—users can examine how different inputs, from injury reports to qualification form, alter probabilistic outcomes. This transforms raw predictions into testable hypotheses rather than definitive claims.

body.title: The Analytics Challenge of the 48‑Team World Cup\n
body.body:
Forecasting the FIFA World Cup has always been a test of analytical discipline. Traditional models rely on historical consistency, tournament experience, and head‑to‑head records—metrics that assume structural continuity from one edition to the next. The 2026 tournament, however, breaks that continuity in fundamental ways. With 48 teams instead of 32, a group stage that allows some third‑place finishers to advance, and a three‑nation footprint stretching from Vancouver to Mexico City to Miami, the predictive variables have multiplied. For data‑driven analysts and football journalists, the question is no longer simply which team is strongest, but which forecasting framework can adapt to unprecedented logistical and structural complexity.

One platform that has attempted to address this gap is [Fifaworldcuppredictions2026.com](https://fifaworldcuppredictions2026.com). Unlike general sports statistics aggregators that apply one‑size‑fits‑all algorithms, this resource focuses exclusively on the unique parameters of the 2026 edition. Its simulation models incorporate travel distance between group stage venues, climate variation across host cities, and the conditional probabilities of third‑place qualification. More importantly, the platform avoids deterministic claims; instead, it presents outcome ranges that shift as new data—such as injuries, squad announcements, or recent friendly results—become available. For a professional analyst, this transparency is valuable not because the predictions are infallible, but because they are testable and reproducible.


---

body.body:
<center>![IMG_8460.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23xKp2uKd1k2vCgxCt5GMFby2prBnFHnVATL4Vk9Xg8YqJcFEoSGRMhN2SYALN8gAE57K.jpg)

------

What does it take to make a bunch of new pictures?

I had light coming in from the window.

I had a camera charged and ready, with a macro lens attached.

I had an itchy feeling on the tip of my finger,
the one that goes away only when you press the shutter.

I had everything but an excuse.

What to shoot for no apparent reason?

Just for the sake of it? 


![IMG_8439.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23u64t6masCyyiZqKgzvZnqmwwYNVbwiWynzcZiS8RoFRQPCyehmRnx3VBycAQ1jVJub9.jpg)



![IMG_8445.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23u5zffmXE5Q5yXku5zFHpqnWdWH4jMSsDHHsUcAAnu1cEHRCMtNGCEbCSigmAxNbNiyg.jpg)

![IMG_8437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23yJJKAhriLdZj6n5ubR8uTLDCEWHRAfP9u9UBDA7oUnPEJ8p9b3cxCzCFFA8sJyifnvU.jpg)



![IMG_8442.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23zGciHGsdVDLhCLxCGvi9mEUP2Kz2Jt8uJLZ36mCvJrdMCCYcRbfJzut6UXerR9BMK7H.jpg)

![IMG_8444.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23xVF8U9usHes9awAjboxBozq7LaSAYu657DDSGcsbUteXJLvaT6vGbNpYsec12dWr9Th.jpg)


![IMG_8446.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23uQhpUpkJe1zvahRVoDCKNxwZp9ygkcYKEqc78XbUGpwarX7GJtfRrxHi5SvaedwuQ7E.jpg)

-------

And then I saw it!

A bouquet of dried flowers.

Not dead, just lifeless.

Still colourful, still elegant, still lovely.

And I started shooting.

Someone said that macro lenses are portals.

They must be.

How else could I have found myself
in such a delicate and elusive world?


![IMG_8447.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23uFTQEsWVDWAcBwWamKWweeeNdDDN3XxwjZMDMAZSDcPn6L2LWKN2UypD7K5Czp4FH7S.jpg)

![IMG_8449.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23xefWedLbRbKfK5eM4BvKgbExqjYFnCXyKBY8va7t4qBPaRELqHGdsPGApkjCcHevyar.jpg)

![IMG_8451.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23xp6FwU29oo7hTUPCuVohEFtiDC8dh8odRmDqkAbgBzCcyKp8aZc4vmcjMjr94AfYNas.jpg)

![IMG_8454.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23wqiRi9DKw3246LyQ2Yt29nxRueAUsrPJrpZ4S81FpHrRUNUAztdG3BGZsKApv1T6hCV.jpg)

![IMG_8456.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23tGaDRhVwPGzAkoiS2k4vGet6fpGpRzRcQ94a2J9puyTZf5zehG8PnUx8c8mrqLk8Uig.jpg)

![IMG_8457.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/fotostef/23t7DhzyQxYQ5je48jVqRLaqKGukhQSFqRLdXECFmXjywyNtT54qzcvvRTeZX2MA43sjw.jpg)

--------


I haven't been around here much lately. It has happened before. It may happen again. For now I try to keep in touch as much as I can. The truth is that hive looks a bit empty lately. I am struggling to find what to vote. Maybe I am too many years here and the people I used to follow are not active any more. I guess some new creators are coming along but I haven't had the time to connect with any of them.

I took those pictures the other day in our workshop. We have already share some of them in our [Instagram account](https://www.instagram.com/traisto_loom/) and I may also use them in my [substack](https://substack.com/@fotostef?) that I started recently.

Greetings to this wounderful Family!!!How are you all doing,I Hope you all are good and Fine,I welcome you all to my blog.

Today my Kids were Craving for pasta served with Local Native Stew and After some minutes,I made it for them which comes out very tasty and Delicious 🤤.

INGREDIENTS USED 

🌳One packet of Pasta 🍝 
🌳Half litre of Red oil
🌳One tablespoon of salt
🌳One tablespoon red chilli pepper
🌳Two sachet of Tomatoes 
🌳One tablespoon of Curry powder 
🌳Few pieces of Scent Leaves 🍃 
🌳One bulb of Onions 
🌳Eight pieces of Fresh tomatoes 🍅 
🌳Water


![1E9B94CB-0C10-49A6-81F9-640FBC2F602F.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/23zGoEYuTvuGjRKHC4LV6RnsRsxRkfEP5gQnrBh6vrDTdD36HxV6Yna6PXnFQZFGFViBA.jpeg)

- 

PROCEDURE USED
In This procedure,I will show you guys how I made this tasty Receipe which turns out very Delicious.


![86E086C2-B4D2-41B4-A04F-0267085C32E9.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/23xpHH6cZyyvSbadTuayn84LZyFuMSEJNwxdQ1HGnMaReGfutRq1CtGiWULJZKvDEhwTQ.jpeg)



Firstly I poured water inside my pot and allow it to boil a little and then pour in my pasta and allow it to perboil.


![082FC470-AF18-494B-945D-814D2094A056.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/EocBnyKWJjbexhrz4dk2cYD8XRmLpxpC9vjBewmT3S1Pjv8Drxam78UqtKhWB4tpdpT.jpeg)


After a while of perboiling my pasta,I seived it out and then I washed both my onions and fresh tomatoes and added a little water inside my pot and cooked my pasta and also added my tablespoon of salt to give it a little taste and after a while,All the water drained and I set it aside.


![B70DC77F-CC33-4A2E-A949-019E1DF665C1.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AK6ZLNq9ZBHAYm5thayWnCaLwjiQS5o5yxQVicoFmSoS586BQts48jGUokR1j1T.jpeg)

![59B290CB-0E09-44DA-8F78-870A3B696A98.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AJmuceSfEovgS7ktxXE1SjCAMoKDBhoAdDL3DMUfCoB54Bju1VWi9pmbU7UGA2t.jpeg)





I washed my scent leaves very well,set my pot on fire and added my red oil and after a while,I added my sliced onions,Fresh tomatoes,red chilli pepper,and my sachet tomatoes and stir a little,I also added my tablespoon of curry spice,salt and scent leaves and stired again.

![26DA5C10-9CF1-4BC4-86F3-18F72937CEBE.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AKGbLJNbgPsq7EHJxdNwTDxcH8SSMrmCLgeBDS2m3Dv1qZTmaxizLAvcdh1TLun.jpeg)

![FA0FFA9C-AFA0-412E-BA03-5708FA3ABD1B.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AK3grSXiaRU73CKUfW3YXtDQr4cmYc2S5CyHmCQjMbSQ5GCkDL1kyxRVwhwrtWU.jpeg)

![D443C339-0A43-4556-8A58-DF7174CE86B6.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AK3gshDFju1tkjJbyWhgs9eKgUQFUtoH4v7D7CfL8defRMHn9XnExjaFNUPYwnH.jpeg)




After a while I added a little water and after some minutes ,My Local native stew was ready.

![DFF67B71-E08A-4CCA-8DCF-A3D494612400.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/AJmuHeuJD64UvN9Jp7hT6PNqgYEWKrTSY8PYCCzEe9giEDLhNDdbRHFwoMrMULV.jpeg)



And I dished it out for my Kids to enjoy.

![08365596-318D-49E9-BAB0-4C11C1813C74.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mimigold/243fy4HqG69ZxMvNJyvT3xkijKNcGQVxf5nyBa5TwJ6zLkkuSRZWozNTGYvSAhWGv311e.jpeg)

body.title: A Cold Front | Un Frente Frío [ENG-ESP]
body.body:
![17772260020524854457421078710568.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/restcity/23uFVbSzcLpETuMnJLRtoZyM3zABiuxcw9JL8uCMebn8CYp2pjo4Gs5As9dEfmVceUcuN.png)
[Picture](https://www.pexels.com/photo/enchanting-snowfall-in-a-serene-winter-forest-30814775/)

<center>

**A Cold Front**

“How long has it been?”

“Quite a while.” her eyes thin in the wind.

“Come back frequently?”

“No. Never.” No apologies.

Troubled. She is. 

The city is drowning in piles of snow. It leaves everything in a smothering white glow. 

I don’t know what to say, so I go “I am not my father.”

She sighs. “I know which makes this that much harder.” Her eyes twinge now. 

I raise an eyebrow. 

“I’m sorry, I can’t elaborate.” 

Great. 

I nod. 

Then, her gaze turns back to me. “I’m not my father, either.” 

A small grin on her face. 

Makes me believe there’s a trace. 

That maybe, she shares a fraction

Of my ongoing attraction. </center>


***

Hey there! I’m Shila! I’ve loved books since I could read, and decided I would write books I wanted to see written for others! Check my children’s book [Imagination](https://www.amazon.com/Imagination-Shila-Williams/dp/B09YV2FR4G) on Amazon!

**Need Freelance Writing services?** Check out my page on [Fiverr](https://www.fiverr.com/s/ljDR4Dy)!

Follow me on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ShilaWrites)!

I also write on [Tumblr](https://www.tumblr.com/blog/shilawrites)!

![17772260020524854457421078710568.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/restcity/23uFVbSzcLpETuMnJLRtoZyM3zABiuxcw9JL8uCMebn8CYp2pjo4Gs5As9dEfmVceUcuN.png)
[Picture](https://www.pexels.com/photo/enchanting-snowfall-in-a-serene-winter-forest-30814775/)

# ESPAÑOL

**Un frente frío** 

«¿Cuánto tiempo ha pasado?» 

«Bastante tiempo». 

Sus ojos se entrecierran ante el viento. 

«¿Vienes a menudo?» 

«No. Nunca». Sin disculpas.
 
Está inquieta. Ella lo está. 

La ciudad se ahoga bajo montones de nieve. Todo queda envuelto en un resplandor blanco y sofocante. 

No sé qué decir, así que suelto: «No soy mi padre». 

Ella suspira. «Lo sé; y eso hace que todo sea mucho más difícil». 

Sus ojos se contraen ahora con dolor. Alzo una ceja.

«Lo siento, no puedo dar más detalles». Genial.

Asiento. 

Entonces, su mirada vuelve a posarse en mí. «Yo tampoco soy mi padre». Una leve sonrisa asoma en su rostro. 

Me hace creer que queda un rastro. 

Que tal vez ella comparte una fracción 

De mi persistente atracción. 

***
