body.title: The Juniper Tree [Analysis of the Story] ESP/ENG
body.body:
![Presentación Diapositivas Proyecto de Historia Vintage Scrapbook Marrón (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tmDZYBis5Fv6VLY97NiiN9L8uTjaEdpTWjZ9L6DKYDKRGj6tjQb95gCJSqUiyBxBJKo.jpg)
(Cover designed by me in canva editor)
>Portada diseñada por mi en el editor de Canva

Today I'm bringing you a summary and analysis of one of those dark tales by the Brothers Grimm that I love so much 🤗 they're my guilty pleasure hehe 😄 I hope you like \
\n\n>Para ele día de hoy traigo el resumen y análisis de uno de esos cuentos sombríos de los hermanos Grim que tanto me gustan 🤗 son mi gusto culposo jeje 😄 espero que les guste \

Overview/Resumen

A loving couple were happy but childless, despite the wife's constant prayers. One winter, while peeling an apple under a juniper tree, she pricked her finger. Seeing the blood fall on the snow, she wished she could have a child with those characteristics—white as snow and red as blood. She gave birth to a beautiful son, but died in childbirth and was buried under that same juniper tree. The father remarried, this time to a wicked woman. They had a daughter, but this woman detested their firstborn son.

>Una pareja de esposos que se amaban eran felices pero no tenían hijos, a pesar de que la mujer le pedía a Dios día y noche. En una ocasión durante el invierno en que pelaba una manzana bajo un árbol de enebro, ella se pinchó el dedo y cuando vio la sangre caer sobre la nieve pensó que le gustaría tener un hijo con esas características (blanco como la nieve y rojo como la sangre), y en efecto ella da a un luz un hijo hermoso pero ella muere en el parto y es enterrada bajo ese mismo enebro. El padre vuelve a casarse pero en esta ocasión con una mujer malvada, con ella tiene una hija pero esta mujer detesta al primer hijo.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EoyRxSwxt7Apbs8MeHoz31ZxtrxbBhaxZyLddxbVgvQPePeaL8QkBWL6GcbLaV27pQf.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/562950022175262347/)

One day, when the boy returned from school, the demon inspired the woman to do something horrible to him. First, she treated him with feigned sweetness and offered him an apple from a chest, but warned him that he must take it himself. The boy obeyed, and as he bent down to reach into the chest, the woman slammed the heavy lid shut, decapitating the child. Seeing this, the woman sat the body on a chair, placed the head back on its head, and tied it with a cloth like a scarf.

>En una ocasión en que el niño regresó de la escuela el demonio inspiró a la mujer a hacer algo horrible con él, primero lo trató con falsa dulzura y le ofreció una manzana de las que estaban en un arcón, pero le advirtió que debía tomarlas él mismo, el niño obedeció y cuando se inclinó hacia el interior del arcón, la mujer cerró la pesada tapa, decapitando al pequeño. Al ver esto la mujer sentó el cuerpo en una silla, puso la cabeza en su lugar y la ató con un paño a modo de bufanda
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/EowKSFagSrorL3fRpUd5TYSp5PQ12uLupQkbMziV23AqV4T9kAjPi56oXH2iBvDjp1j.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/438960294915236586/)

Marleenken, the boy's sister, asked him for the apple, but obviously the boy didn't react, so she shook him and his head fell off. Then his mother, to try to hide her daughter's \

cut the boy into pieces and threw him into the stew. But the worst part was that she gave it to her own father to eat. He, of course, asked about his son, but she told him that the boy had gone to the house of some relatives.

>Marleenken, la hermana del niño, le pidió la manzana pero obviamente el niño no reaccionaba, así que ella lo agitó y de esta manera la cabeza se le cayó, entonces su madre, para tratar de ocultar \

de su hija cortó al niño en pedazos y lo echó al guiso, pero lo peor de todo fue que se lo dio de comer a su propio padre, él por supuesto preguntó por su hijo pero ella le contestó que el niño se había marchado a la casa de unos parientes.

The father ate that stew with gusto; he even told the woman that it was delicious and that he wanted more, that it gave him the feeling of eating something of his own; he ate and threw the bones under the table

>El padre comió ese guiso con avidez incluso le dijo a la mujer que estaba delicioso y que quería más, que le daba la sensación de estar comiendo algo suyo, comía y tiraba los huesos debajo de la mesa-
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23zm1NxGYC1vdo74D5JgdiZ29hBGhdXvTXHLDRwytG5mE2osdBhGXFsNQPAjcWDmazXzT.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/503769908291435260/)

The sister then gathers the bones, puts them inside a handkerchief, and buries them under the juniper tree, the same juniper tree where the boy's mother is buried. Suddenly, a bird emerged and began to sing a story about a crime...

>La hermana entonces recoge los huesos los pone dentro de un pañuelo y los entierra bajo el enebro, el mismo enebro donde está enterrada la madre del niño, de pronto un pájaro emergió y empezó a cantar una historia sobre un crimen...
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23x1PvJDh8NoBcZ2wyyTFSyNwoVSTW8eBAMZaUFk3gRobeiFaUd3eMQNub6JuH8i8M8Bw.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/346847608803003436/)

First he went to a goldsmith's house, and after singing his song, the goldsmith gave him a gold chain. And so he obtained favors through his macabre song: My mother killed me, my father ate me, and my good little sister gathered my bones, kept them in a very pretty silk cloth, and buried them at the foot of the juniper tree. What a pretty little bird I am!

>Primero fue a la casa de un orfebre y luego de cantar su canción El orfebre le regaló una cadena de oro. Y así fue obteniendo favores por medio de su macabra canción: Mi madre me mató, mi padre me comió y mi buena hermanita mis huesitos recogió, los guardó en un pañito de seda muy bonito y al pie del enebro los enterró, ¡Qué lindo pajarito soy!
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23tkpGpLiwsoXsMGUNjgiSYaTiYoq6hqyd5LcSnvs5wW5Vt5FjinB1Fx6sNmYP8dKw6g8.png)
[Fuente](https://www.mundopandereta.com/2026/01/el-enebro-el-cuento-de-los-hermanos.html)

The fact is that the bird returns to the house, kills the stepmother, frees the child, that is, resurrects him, and the child can go back to live with his father and sister.

>El caso es que el pájaro regresa hasta la casa, mata a la madrastra, libera al niño, es decir, lo resucita y el niño puede volver a vivir con su padre y con su hermana.

My Opinion/Mi Opinión

There is no doubt that this is one of the most macabre tales in the Grimm Brothers' repertoire, with nothing less than infanticide as its central theme or axis. There is also the envy that the stepmother feels towards the child, and what strikes me most is that the apple is, in this case, the motive, or rather the means, through which the crime is committed—an apple again, just like in Snow White, remember?

>No cabe dudas de que este es uno de los cuentos más macabros que hay en el repertorio de los hermanos Grimm, con nada más y nada menos que el infanticidio como motivo central o como eje central de la historia, también está la envidia que en este caso siente la madrastra hacia el niño, y lo que me llama más la atención es que la manzana sea en este caso el motivo, o digamos el medio, a través del cual se comete el crimen, de nuevo una manzana al igual que en Blancanieves ¿recuerdan?
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23wCUmGyDd5akqm8JiFikhAB49BSPaKr1AXUJUjZuYbk4GNgZAbKi4rZbrMZdyw99Yka4.png)
[Fuente](https://www.pookpress.co.uk/the-juniper-tree/)

He revives through the bird that sings the song and then with his original body, but whatever the case, this makes us think that the tree acts as something like a channel, or as a bridge that unites life and death; that is where the child's mother is buried and that is where the child reemerges as a bird, tormenting the mother with that song and also proclaiming the crime of which he was a victim.

>El revive a través del pájaro que canta la canción y luego con su cuerpo original, pero sea como sea esto nos hace pensar que el árbol actúa algo así como un canal, o como un puente que une la vida y la muerte, allí es donde está enterrada la madre del niño y allí es donde el niño resurge como pájaro, atormentando a la madre con esa canción y además pregonando el crimen del que fue víctima.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23zGuhVpTxA9JYXtTwMGQMnFS12kdisq1AGL4eoNdnzhpK71iT7L8XokGKg4GpFZJcUuT.png)
[Fuente](https://www.pookpress.co.uk/the-juniper-tree/)

I think it's one of the most macabre stories, not only because of the explicitness of the death and the macabre fact that the stepmother fed the father his son's flesh, but because the very act of evil or crime breaks with family harmony, the harmony that is supposed to exist in a family.

>Creo que es una de las historias más macabras, no solamente por lo explícito de la muerte y por lo macabro del hecho de que la madrastra le diera de comer al padre la carne de su hijo, sino porque porque el hecho en sí de la maldad o el crimen rompe con la armonía familiar, la armonía que se supone debe existir en una familia.

Another striking thing is that at first the stepmother seems overwhelmed by the crime she committed, but far from accepting her own guilt, she hides it in a horrible way, leaving her daughter to assume that responsibility, thinking that she had killed the child when she shook him very hard and his head fell off. Then the girl in this case did not act cruelly but rather she had compassion for him, picked up his bones and went to bury him in the juniper tree.

>Otra cosa que llama la atención es que al principio la madrastra parece abrumada ante el crimen que cometió, pero lejos de aceptar su propia culpa lo que hace es ocultarla de una forma horrible, dejando que su hija asuma esa responsabilidad, pensando que ella había matado al niño cuando lo sacudió muy fuerte y se le cayó la cabeza, entonces la niña en este caso no actuó con crueldad sino que ella tuvo compasión de él, recogió sus huesos y fue a enterrarlo en el enebro.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23yTonLaCCg1eYEgPJAron92FjysHXvGwDrx1BJsBxWSme3iH4gfTAb8MEyPS9uzDyXuL.png)
[Fuente](https://www.pookpress.co.uk/the-juniper-tree/)

And I bring up the apple again because this fruit is always associated with sin. For example, even though the Bible doesn't mention it as an apple, people assume it's the fruit Adam and Eve ate. The apple also appears as a temptation in Snow White, and in this case, it also tempted the child. The story also seems to speak to us about deadly sins. For instance, we have the stepmother's envy. It seems she wasn't satisfied with the love her husband felt for her, but rather didn't want the child because she didn't see him as part of her own family. Perhaps she thought her husband loved him more than her, his wife, or their daughter, so she envied the child. On the other hand, we also have gluttony. The husband was so absorbed in the food he was eating that he didn't even care that his son had disappeared under mysterious circumstances.

>Y vuelvo a mencionar el tema de la manzana porque siempre se atribuye esta fruta al pecado, por ejemplo a pesar de que la Biblia no menciona que fuese una manzana, la gente asume que es el fruto del que comieron a Adán y Eva, también está la manzana como tentación en Blancanieves y en este caso también sirvió de tentación al niño. La historia aparece hablarnos también de pecados capitales, por ejemplo tenemos la envidia de la madrastra que parece que no se conformaba con el amor que su esposo sentía por ella, sino que no quería al niño porque no lo veía como parte de su propia familia, quizá pensaba que el marido lo quería más a él que a ella, su esposa, o a la hija que ambos tenían, entonces tenía envidia del niño, por otra parte también tenemos la gula, el esposo estaba muy absorto en la comida que se estaba comiendo, tanto que ni siquiera le importó que su hijo había desaparecido en extrañas condiciones.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mairene1/23xAqCUkcfb4goTsRsc64Zj8xkSSdxjvFhCvXaLJp3PYsYPkd4F7m92APZsMcVZfsUGUJ.png)
[Fuente](https://www.pookpress.co.uk/the-juniper-tree/)

Well friends, that's all for today. I hope you enjoyed this analysis, and I'll see you next time with another analysis, whether it's from the Brothers Grimm or another story that I also like and want to share with you 😉.

>Y bien amigos, eso ha sido todo por el día de hoy, espero que les haya gustado este análisis y nos vemos en otra ocasión con otro análisis, bien sea de los hermanos Grimm u otro cuento que también me guste y quiera compartir con ustedes 😉.

body.title: Libro Que Cambió Mi Vida (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
![Brown Beige Vintage Paper Book Blank A4 Document.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23vsf9VoT8FrpxX64T1PTLG5zYCHGxcHd1QuexUJRAThdtq5jX6ssJtL4SxXL6iV4e4aL.jpg)
(Imagen hecha con el editor de canva) >Image made with the Canva editor

Buenos días, tardes o noches, según el horario en el que están leyendo este post, hoy me dispongo formar parte de la iniciativa del mes de esta comunidad, invitando a mis hijas @bethyjade y @mairene1 a participar, ya que también les gusta la lectura tanto como a mi, y aunque no acostumbro a celebrar el día del libro como tal, tengo mi cuarto lleno de libros, algunos viejos y otros mas nuevos, pero entre todos ellos hay uno que siempre será especial para mi desde que lo leí la primera vez, se llama El Milagro Más Grande Del Mundo por Og Mandino. Este libro es importantísimo para mi por una razón importante pero antesme gustaría darles un poquito de contexto para quién no sabe de que se trata. >Good morning, afternoon, or evening, depending on when you're reading this post. Today I'm joining this community's initiative for the month by inviting my daughters, @bethyjade and @mairene1, to participate, since they love reading as much as I do. Although I don't usually celebrate Book Day, my room is full of books, some old and some newer, but among them all, there's one that will always be special to me since I first read it: The Greatest Miracle in the World by Og Mandino. This book is very important to me for a significant reason, but first, I'd like to give a little background for those who don't know what it's about.

[El libro que marcó mi vida - Iniciativa Día del Libro / The Book That Changed My Life - Book Day Initiative [Subtitled]](https://peakd.com/hive-161447/@hiveargentina/493af481)

El autor de la obra está inmerso en la misma no solo como un personaje, sino como el protagonista, allí el narra su experiencia vivida en lo que el lector intuye como su encuentro con Dios, auque este no se presenta como tal, sino más bien en la figura de un hombre anciano pero fuerte, llamado Simon Potter, con el cual entabla una amistad y a menudo se reunen en interesantes tertulias en las que hablan de libros y filosofía, mientras degustan copas de jerez, El anciano le menciona que lleva a cabo el oficio de trapero (gente que vive de compra y venta de productos usados) pero no es cualquier trapero, él se dedica a recoger y transformar almas vacías para que se vuelvan limpias, dignas y sobre todo felices, todo esto hace a través de una serie de mandamientos llamados El Memorandum de Dios.

>The author of the work is immersed in it not only as a character, but as the protagonist. There he narrates his experience in what the reader intuits as his encounter with God, although God is not presented as such, but rather in the figure of an old but strong man, named Simon Potter, with whom he forms a friendship and they often meet in interesting gatherings where they talk about books and philosophy, while enjoying glasses of sherry. The old man mentions that he carries out the trade of ragpicker (people who live by buying and selling used goods) but he is not just any ragpicker, he dedicates himself to collecting and transforming empty souls so that they become clean, dignified and above all happy, all this he does through a series of commandments called The Memorandum of God.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23zGuR4chDRgn4HSWsMu8tqgrULnnTXwq3EVE9u5km4bUZBkqy7nnn5ai5jtTcP4j8dM1.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/465700417689363660/)

Recuerdo que este “Memorandum” me llegó tanto al alma que yo lo fotocopié del libro y lo pegué en mi locker del trabajo. El memorandum contenía mensajes como : “Elije amar en lugar de odiar, elige construir en lugar de destruir” entre otras cosas importantes. Bueno, el caso es que en una ocasión yo estaba muy molesto, ya no recuerdo porqué, pero estaba furioso, así que abrí mi locker con rabia y la puerta se deslizó rapidamente, dejando expuestas las hojas que yo había pegado con todas esas palabras hermosas. Mis ojos inevitablemente se fueron allí, comencé a leer casi sin proponérmelo y de pronto sentí que toda esa rabia que sentía fue mermando de manera impresionante

>I remember that this \
touched me so deeply that I photocopied it from the book and stuck it on my locker at work. The memorandum contained messages like: \

among other important things. Well, the thing is, one time I was really upset—I don't remember why, but I was furious—so I angrily opened my locker, and the door slid open, revealing the pages I had stuck on with all those beautiful words. My eyes inevitably went there, I started reading almost without meaning to, and suddenly I felt all that anger I felt begin to subside in an impressive way.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23tvyRxP2z4FjCZcB2jJ4kzGgSGBcVrYgwdy2ZS78nwHJZSTvbFxKLgfjJpMUWe5Kf723.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/580190364516690470/)

Normalmente leo de todo pero si tuviera que inclinarme por un género en especifico creo que sería la criminalistica, libros que tienen que ver con investigaciones policiacas, por ejemplo Cuatro Crímenes, Cuatro Poderes, de Fermín Mármol León

>I usually read everything, but if I had to choose a specific genre, I think it would be criminology, books that deal with police investigations, for example, Four Crimes, Four Powers, by Fermín Mármol León
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23yd3nJwmkmAhakxd45TArMAjvvxefxV5hLCmZcUcUBKCtVNR53PsT4t1DYJPFYr232L2.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/798051996461320820/)

No acostumbro a celebrar el dia del libro, quizá tal vez leyendo, pero es porque siempre lo hago, y cuando voy a una feria de libros por lo general me gusta revisar las novedades, o que propuestas interesantes tienen ahora.

>I don't usually celebrate Book Day, maybe by reading, but that's because I always do, and when I go to a book fair I generally like to check out the new releases, or what interesting proposals they have now.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23vi1YMJ9viyTR1Rv1nwCpmvfS4ofkPqhxcEwd6WbBef6YkVWuccMSH5xMZLad6QcmnF3.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/902901425281527599/)

Tampoco he conocido a un autor famoso, pero si me hubiese gustado conocer a muchos, por ejemplo Gabriel García Márquez, a quién considero un genio de la literartura ltinoamericana, es una lastima que ya no esté entre nosotros.

>I haven't met a famous author either, but I would have liked to meet many, for example Gabriel García Márquez, whom I consider a genius of Latin American literature; it's a shame that he's no longer with us.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/victor2356/23xL2ivoNMdDjbqFuiPAc8U6xckh72VYDjKMLTPUSDLsyV2Uu7uzBzSV96kxjRdtkaj3V.png)
[Fuente](https://es.pinterest.com/pin/153826143497025756/)

Bueno, espero que les haya gustado mi participación y los invito a todos a formar parte de esta iniciativa de @Hiveargentina, nos vemos en otra oporunidad, Dios mediante.

>Well, I hope you enjoyed my participation and I invite you all to be part of this initiative by @Hiveargentina. See you next time, God willing.

body.title: My Personal Top 10 Best Villains in Film and TV [ESP/ENG]
body.body:
![Presentación Historia del Rock Collage Blanco y Negro (1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23tvu8HSKByYm7Yr26FRszqKo38vCDhef7KpMLt8Zx7g36XzDWAno3N1pNogZWjTg34pZ.jpg)
[Fuente](https://www.latercera.com/culto/2024/09/10/darth-vader-james-earl-jones-y-la-creacion-de-un-villano-inmortal-de-star-wars/)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/260434790946833219/)
[Fuente](https://nofilmschool.com/jack-nicholson-iconic-shining-line)

Hey everyone on the internet, how are you? Today I want to talk to you about something interesting: What would movies and TV be without a good villain? They help spice up the story, give it more impact, and can even help generate great character development. So today I'm going to show you my selection of what I consider to be the best villains. >¡Hola Hola gente de internet! ¿cómo están? Hoy quiero hablarles de algo interesante ¿Qué sería del cine y la televisión sin un buen villano? Estos ayudan a sazonar la historia, a darles más impacto, incluso puede ayudar a generar grandes desarrollos de personaje, así que hoy yo les voy a mostrar mi selección de los que considero Los Mejores Villanos.

Jack Torrance, The Shining (1980)

Jack Torrance, The Shining (1980)

Masterfully portrayed by Jack Nicholson in The Shining, it had a profound impact on audiences. I'll be completely honest with you, I didn't really like the film itself at all; I even think it's overrated. But Nicholson's performance is on another level. I think he masterfully handled his character's psychological decline. The deranged expression on his face when he says, \

is undeniably terrifying, and it's not a supernatural fear, it's a paralyzing fear. You know that at any moment he's going to open the door and all hell will break loose. He builds an aura of instability from the very beginning, gradually emphasizing it. It's absolutely brilliant.

>Magistralmente interpretado por Jack Nicholson en El Resplando,r generó un gran impacto en la audiencia. Voy a ser muy sincera con ustedes, la película realmente por si sola no me gustó para nada, incluso considero que está sobrevalorada, pero la actuación de Nicholson está a otro nivel, pienso que él supo manejar muy bien el descenso psicológico de su personaje. La expresión desquiciada de su rostro cuando dice “¡It´s Jhonny!” no puedo negar que da miedo, y no es un miedo sobrenatural, es un miedo paralizante, sabes que en cualquier momento terminará de abrir la puerta y se desatará el caos. Él construye un aura de inestabilidad desde el inicio pero poco a poco la va enfatizando, es absolutamente brillante.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/245HuvgMvsneow9eDKQeuVuPm75oxj9DJorbauFdazVuaUkh1radpcYknjHpinMeFagdQ.png)
[Fuente](https://nofilmschool.com/jack-nicholson-iconic-shining-line)

Darth Vader

Darth Vader is one of the most iconic villains in cinema. He's a complex character because he embodies many feelings and experiences: first, the man who loves; then, the loss of humanity and empathy, surrendering completely to the dark side; and finally, redemption. When Anakin Skywalker lost what he loved most, he also lost his own identity. That's why he no longer cared about being part of the dark side; in fact, his impassivity was his greatest weapon. He seeks control and power precisely because he can no longer bear being controlled. He thinks that in this way he will suffer no more losses. But since not all is lost for him, and a light of hope shines in his soul, redemption comes to him through his son Luke, in one of the most iconic scenes in cinema. Ahhh, I love it, I swear! 🤗

>Darth Vader es de los villanos más icónicos del cine, es un personaje complejo porque encarna muchos sentimientos y experiencias, en primer lugar, el hombre que sabe amar, luego la perdida de su humanidad y la empatía, entregándose totalmente al lado oscuro, y finalmente la redención. Cuando Anakin Skywalker perdió lo que más amaba también perdió su propia identidad, por eso ya no le importaba ser parte del lado oscuro, de hecho su impasibilidad fue su mejor arma, él busca control y poder porque precisamente ya no soporta ser controlado, piensa que de esta manera ya no sufrirá más pérdidas, pero como no todo está perdido para él y en su alma brilla una luz de esperanza, la redención llega a él a través de su hijo Luke, en una de las escenas más icónicas del cine. ¡Ahhhh me encanta, lo juro! 🤗
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23u5vsMWf3vuQyFausp16WZB4pQSMgZxAubXA1JT1C3RNqhy1YdyyYEuKG8a2aSUMDMCc.png)
[Fuente](https://www.latercera.com/culto/2024/09/10/darth-vader-james-earl-jones-y-la-creacion-de-un-villano-inmortal-de-star-wars/)

Hans Gruber Die Hard, 1988

Hans Gruber Duro de Matar, 1988

Performed in a regal, wonderful and brilliant way by the great Alan Rickman, this also being his first film role, let us remember that Alan already had a career as a theater actor, but never before Die Hard had he done anything for film.

>Interpretado de una manera regia, maravillosa y genial por el gran Alan Rickman, siendo este además su primer rol cinematográfico, (recordemos que Alan ya tenía una trayectoria como actor de teatro, pero nunca antes de Duro de Matar había hecho algo para el cine)

Hans isn't a terrorist like the others; he hardly ever uses brute force and isn't impulsive. On the contrary, he's cunning and intelligent, which makes him even more powerful. He reminds me somewhat of \
the leader of the gang in \

with the difference that The Professor wasn't a true villain. He was driven by deeper, more altruistic interests than money; he was a humanist and never intended to actually harm hostages. Alan's performance gives him a sober and elegant touch, yet he's also charismatic. He becomes unpredictable and knows how to seize opportunities, like when he pretends to be a hostage (I couldn't help but laugh at that part). And something that completely differentiates him from The Professor in Money Heist is that Gruber pretends to be driven by political interests, but in reality, his interest is superficial—just money—while The Professor sought to sabotage and expose the system to society.

>Hans no es un terrorista como los demás, casi no usa la fuerza bruta y tampoco es impulsivo, al contrario es astuto e inteligente, algo que lo vuelve aún más poderoso, me recuerda de cierta forma a “El Profesor” el líder de la banda de “La Casa de Papel” con la diferencia de que El Profesor no era un villano real, a él lo movían intereses más profundos y altruistas que el dinero, era humanista y nunca pretendió lastimar rehenes realmente. La actuación de Alan le da un toque sobrio y elegante a Hans pero al mismo tiempo carismático, se vuelve impredecible y sabe aprovechar las oportunidades que se e ofrecen, como cuando se hace pasar por un rehén (no pude evitar reírme en esa parte) y algo que lo diferencia por completo de El Profesor de la casa de papel, es que Gruber finge que lo mueve un interés político pero en realidad su interés es superficial, solo el dinero, mientras que El Profesor buscaba sabotear y exponer el sistema ante la sociedad.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/244eADbtPZpDpU1WcAHzGagB1p95dYtKGkn6Fvx6SwuVPAPWBm6kzoPKK9STqvsX3FCMD.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/260434790946833219/)

Violante Cabral Xica da Silva (1996)

And now we turn to television. For me, one of the best performances in Latin American television is that of Brazilian actress Drica Moraes as Violante Cabral. This woman, like Gruber, is cunning, intelligent, and manipulative, so much so that she went far beyond what any woman of her time could, pulling strings at will to get what she wanted: she manipulated her father, the people, the church, and even the Portuguese crown, demanding that they send nobles who could help her with her plans. However, Violante Cabral was not arrogance; quite the opposite, she was a reserved and bitter character. She uses her religious fanaticism to justify her terrible acts, reveling in cruelty and control. In fact, many characters in the telenovela claimed that if she were a man, she would be even more dangerous. She is calculating and inhumane, yet she presents the world with an image of a constant victim.

>Y ahora pasamos a la televisión. Para mi una de las mejores actuaciones de la televisión latinoamericana es la de la actriz brasileña Drica Moraes como Violante Cabral. Esta mujer, al igual que Gruber es astuta, inteligente y manipuladora, tanto que llegó muy lejos, más de lo que cualquier mujer de su época podía llegar, moviendo hilos a su antojo para conseguir lo que quería: manipuló a su padre, al pueblo, a la iglesia e incluso a la corona portuguesa, exigiendo que enviaran nobles que pudieran ayudarla con sus planes, sin embargo Violante Cabral no es carismática, sino todo lo contrario, es un personaje contenido y amargado. Ella usa su fanatismo religioso para justificar sus terribles actos, disfruta la crueldad y el control, de hecho muchos personajes dentro de la telenovela afirmaban que si ella hubiese sido hombre sería aún más peligrosa. Es calculadora e inhumana, pero vende ante el mundo una imagen de víctima constante.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23vhnuHBqJJRkWqby2LZK47hPFmHXt1T2CvboGQ6gbf25vVA96Xg1c2oeSbRc74wsrwiA.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/429179039512053325/)

Negan (The Walking Dead)

Ahhh! My favorite villain, brilliantly portrayed by Jeffrey Dean Morgan, is a charismatic villain you can both hate and love. He imposes \
through fear and submission; in fact, he's the leader of a self-proclaimed \

other communities as long as they shared fifty percent of the resources they obtained. In his community, Negan maintained a cruel system of punishment that forced his followers into obedience. He did whatever he wanted, and even had a harem. He was driven by sarcasm and sadism; in fact, his best and greatest weapon was Lucille, a barbed-wire bat which he uses to intimidate and, yes, brutally murder his victims. Although he doesn't see himself as a villain but as a \

he simply enjoys his dominance and control over others too much, and when he feels he is losing it, his cruelty intensifies. But Negan is a complex character because deep down he retains humanity, and his life experiences lead him to have one of the best and most interesting character developments I've seen in television series.

>¡Ahhhh! Mi villano preferido, muy bien interpretado por Jeffrey Dean Morgan, es un villano carismático al que puedes odiar y amar al mismo tiempo. Él impone “Orden” a través del miedo y la sumisión, de hecho es el líder de un grupo autodenominado “Los salvadores” que pretendían “proteger” a otras comunidades siempre y cuando compartieran el cincuenta por ciento de los recursos obtenidos. En su comunidad Negan mantenía un cruel sistema de castigo que forzaba la obediencia de sus seguidores, hacía lo que quería a su antojo e incluso tenía un harem. Lo movía el sarcasmo y la necesidad de controlar, de hecho su mejor y mayor arma era Lucille, un bate con púas incrustadas, el cuál usaba para amedrentar y sí, asesinar brutalmente a sus víctimas, aunque él no se vía a si mismo como un villano sino como un “salvador” es solo que disfrutaba demasiado de su dominio y control sobre los demás y cuando sentía que lo perdía se agudizaba su crueldad, pero Negan es un personaje complejo porque en el fondo guarda humanidad y las experiencias vividas lo llevan a tener uno de los mejores y más interesantes desarrollos de personajes que he visto en series de televisión.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bethyjade/23uFKSxgDeW3Jfv2vSTWQYxUfMpu2ey2CKSEZczdkdn6bHk3X4ZfLQaS4EofZ612rHGMK.png)
[Fuente](https://ar.pinterest.com/pin/730638739558980926/)

And well, people, that's all for today's post, I hope you liked it. Thank you very much as always for supporting my work, I welcome new readers, I love you all very much, I send you a hug and I'll see you in another post.

>Y bueno, gente, esto ha sido todo por el post de hoy, espero que les haya gustado. Muchas gracias como siempre por apoyar mi trabajo, le doy la bienvenida a los nuevos lectores, les quiero mucho a todos, les envío un abrazo y ya nos encontraremos en otro post

body.title: Noche de cine en mi cumpleaños #26. (ESP/ENG)
body.body:
![1000100308.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQX1QCU8EKjdgAjeZpBNuDdZqxkg2pWGQEVHPRjdtuyPX/1000100308.png)


Saludos amigos de Lifestyle un gusto saludarles, espero se encuentren bien, y que esta semana sea de muchas bendiciones y prosperidad en sus hogares, que todos sus objetivos se cumplan a cabalidad.


>Greetings, Lifestyle friends! It's a pleasure to greet you. I hope you are well, and that this week is filled with blessings and prosperity in your homes, and that all your goals are fully achieved.



![Pinzas de margaritas_20260427_064512_0000.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUzJpa76YgrdFGN3arCoYtz2VmGDrLLevmuzhfGPCWumB/Pinzas%20de%20margaritas_20260427_064512_0000.jpg)




Les cuento que ayer estuve de cumpleaños #26, un año más de vida que agradecer por lo bueno, por lo malo y por las experiencias de cada día, estuve en casa con mi familia en el día y en la noche mi esposo me llevó al cine a ver la película Michael.

>I'm telling you that yesterday was my 26th birthday, another year of life to be grateful for, for the good, the bad, and for the experiences of each day. I was at home with my family during the day, and at night my husband took me to the movies to see the film Michael.

![1001425082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EpQy9TSTKPJcTWYnkop3W8hDXzDGpaAehibpc79grBm1SsLcqbuHbeEdbnHXtWRhh5E.jpg)


![1001425083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EogNGqyTaccX37Ere2ZSTSPEuGUZZunivuXNTuCGXe42cyHEx7iFBU58xTrwyEHRe64.jpg)


![1001425084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/EoiWfZk3RiyLNxgfnH25fnjeUtVSYVcr2EQQzfP18MHbYJpKSmnZJsHP9yLvhg3JhXZ.jpg)







Y sí, fue una noche diferente ya que no había más planes, yo supe contenta de entrar y ver la peli, lo malo es que llegamos a las 6 pm y ya había comenzado la función luego pedimos la función de las 7 pero era subtitulada y no me gustó así, terminamos en la función de las 8:40 era la última pero al menos estaba en español.



>And yes, it was a different kind of night since there were no other plans. I was happy to go in and see the movie. The bad thing is that we arrived at 6 pm and the show had already started. Then we asked for the 7 pm show, but it was subtitled and I didn't like it that way. We ended up at the 8:40 pm show, it was the last one, but at least it was in Spanish.



![1001424930.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23yJBuVpbWpWFrPDCBgDjCruKiDbTaQ6aGg3LatRLWb1tPgw8A8X1fn4V9UXSr6op9jMK.jpg)


![1001424645.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23u5xNBqRMFpwYuM9U9714Uww42H3aKRfoKeFAtcuhwbprQuhRvRAAgo2Dme4Asd1aSKd.jpg)

![1001424500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23x152AgLvuCCVDj4amsLZiwuXootQLsBzwJxSanPULcGJMWyAMGGpN619adTWe9a4Zwq.jpg)




Mientras esperábamos la hora comimos una pizza y caminamos un rato, luego nos fuimos a comprar las cotufas y entramos, en cuanto a la película, fué demasiado espectacular, todo, la interpretación, las coreografías, absolutamente todo se veía bien, muy emocionante.

>While we waited for the show to start, we ate pizza and walked around for a while. Then we went to buy popcorn and went in. As for the movie, it was absolutely spectacular. Everything—the acting, the choreography—everything looked great and was very exciting.

![1001424670.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marile21/23wg91gxMboYLoNcL4YcaHKACGMRUEhBebbrh5sroi5jPm6u1sKvqEmwtvKWuaBhdeRfn.jpg)

Yo feliz de poder pasar un ratito fuera de casa en mi cumple, ya luego regresamos a casa porque al día siguiente tocaba levantarse temprano para ir a trabajar, y esto fué todo. Saludos, nos vemos en una próxima oportunidad, les dejo algunasnforos que tomé.

body.title: REGAINING THE LOVE OF PARENTS// THE OLD PATH
body.body:
The bible teaches us that peace is priceless and it tells young children to always reconcile with their parents even though the love is no longer there. Scripture teaches that love is not only a feeling but also a choice expressed through humility, patience, and forgiveness. When there has been distance or hurt, the first step toward regaining our parents’ love is often a sincere change of heart. 

>Proverbs 15:1 says, “A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.”

Another principle is seeking or repentance and asking for forgiveness from your parents for peace to reign. If past actions have caused pain or disappointment, God encourages us to acknowledge our wrongs and seek forgiveness. This reflects the heart of the prodigal son in Luke 15, who returned to his father with humility and was received with love. In the same way, when children show genuine remorse and a willingness to change, it often softens the hearts of parents and rebuilds trust over time.

body.title: 러브 스토리의 주제는 다양
body.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gbeffaa9d9477760f53b3a0fdc5c13665e8981065007fe8be585a1e26a7f272b604ce2d3af07ba2fb68fb61bbf9ebb5e9dab800a749b87dcc7001c373f5436c00_640.jpg)</center>

***

# 다양한 주제를 가진 러브 스토리

## 1. 시간 여행자의 사랑
### 줄거리
주인공은 우연히 시간 여행을 할 수 있는 능력을 가지게 된다. 과거와 미래를 넘나들며 사랑하는 사람을 찾기 위해 노력하지만, 시간의 흐름에 따라 그들의 운명은 계속 변화한다. 결국, 진정한 사랑이란 시간과 공간을 초월하는 것임을 깨닫게 된다.

## 2. 이웃의 사랑
### 줄거리
도시의 한 아파트에 사는 두 사람은 매일 엘리베이터에서 마주친다. 처음에는 서로에게 관심이 없던 두 사람은 작은 사건을 계기로 가까워지게 되고, 서로의 삶에 깊이 스며들게 된다. 일상의 소소한 순간들이 그들의 사랑을 키워나간다.

## 3. 음악의 힘
### 줄거리
주인공은 재즈 바에서 일하는 뮤지션으로, 우연히 한 손님과 눈이 마주친다. 그 손님은 유명한 음악 프로듀서로, 두 사람은 음악을 통해 서로의 마음을 열게 된다. 하지만 과거의 상처와 꿈의 경계에서 갈등을 겪으며 진정한 사랑을 찾아가는 이야기를 그린다.

## 4. 재회
### 줄거리
고등학교 시절 첫사랑과 이별한 주인공은 성인이 되어 우연히 그를 다시 만나게 된다. 시간이 지나도 변하지 않은 감정과 서로의 삶에서의 변화가 그들의 관계에 어떤 영향을 미칠지 탐구하는 이야기다. 과거의 아픔을 극복하고 새로운 시작을 할 수 있을까?

## 5. 이국적인 사랑
### 줄거리
여행 중 만난 외국인과의 사랑. 언어와 문화의 장벽을 넘으며 서로를 이해하고 사랑하게 되는 과정을 그린다. 두 사람은 서로의 나라를 방문하며 각자의 문화와 가족을 이해하고, 진정한 사랑이란 다름을 존중하는 것임을 깨닫게 된다.

## 6. 비밀스러운 연애
### 줄거리
사회적 지위가 다른 두 사람의 비밀스러운 사랑 이야기. 그들은 서로의 배경과 상황을 극복하고 사랑을 이어가려 하지만, 주변의 시선과 압박이 그들의 관계를 위협한다. 결국, 사랑의 힘이 모든 어려움을 이겨낼 수 있을지에 대한 질문을 던진다.

## 7. 고양이와의 인연
### 줄거리
주인공은 길고양이를 돌보다가 그 고양이의 주인과 만나게 된다. 고양이를 매개로 시작된 두 사람의 인연은 우정에서 사랑으로 발전하게 된다. 동물과의 관계가 사람 사이의 사랑을 어떻게 변화시킬 수 있는지를 보여주는 이야기다.

---

이와 같이 다양한 주제를 통해 사랑의 여러 형태와 복잡성을 탐구할 수 있습니다. 각 이야기에서 등장인물들은 서로 다른 배경과 상황 속에서 진정한 사랑을 찾기 위해 노력합니다.

body.title: Where the Water Softens Every Voice – Neuruppin
body.body:
![IMG_1048.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Eq5C1gVu9U5YFad6iNmY6uMpEyvr8UkZbRKZDoZ96ZoNFdSHEDPnNHUJiefRNBrrRoo.JPEG)
After Lauterbach Castle, where a building slowly finds its way back to itself, Neuruppin offers something different—not revival, but a present that simply works.

The town rests picturesquely by the lake, calm and composed, as if it has consciously stepped away from urgency. The water is not just scenery here; it sets the rhythm. It smooths thoughts, takes the edge off things.

The people are friendly, open—and yet it takes a moment to understand. The Berlin-Brandenburg dialect carries a certain sharpness, a directness often associated with the famously blunt Berlin attitude. But here, it softens. What first sounds rough reveals itself as genuine warmth.

Neuruppin is not deserted like Nauenhof, where silence almost overwhelmed, nor is it contradictory like Sachsenhausen. It is a place in balance—one that doesn’t need to prove anything.

The thermal spa fits seamlessly into this atmosphere. Especially the large lakeside sauna—a space suspended between heat and horizon, where your gaze drifts across the water while your body slowly unwinds. It is a place to switch off, but not in the sense of escape—more like a gentle return to yourself.

Perhaps that is what defines this place: it doesn’t insist, it invites.

I will gladly return.
![IMG_1047.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Ep7siCG74t6wD72CGRpUzmCjMvbx9jNVtAs7nB7YxtcSNn5G9ZkjDpPaAjpNCbYyB3d.JPEG)

- - -
### Wo das Wasser die Stimmen glättet – Neuruppin
![IMG_1048.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Eq5C1gVu9U5YFad6iNmY6uMpEyvr8UkZbRKZDoZ96ZoNFdSHEDPnNHUJiefRNBrrRoo.JPEG)

Nach Schloss Lauterbach, wo ein Haus langsam wieder zu sich selbst findet, öffnet sich in Neuruppin etwas anderes: keine Wiederbelebung, sondern Gegenwart, die einfach funktioniert.

Die Stadt liegt malerisch am See, ruhig und gesetzt, als hätte sie sich bewusst gegen jede Hast entschieden. Das Wasser ist hier nicht nur Kulisse, sondern Taktgeber – es glättet die Gedanken, nimmt den Dingen ihre Schärfe.

Die Menschen sind freundlich, zugewandt – und doch braucht es einen Moment, das einzuordnen. Der Berliner und Brandenburger Tonfall trägt eine gewisse Schärfe in sich, eine Direktheit, die leicht mit der legendären Berliner Frechheit verwechselt werden kann. Doch hier ist sie weicher, beinahe warm. Was zunächst rau klingt, entpuppt sich als ehrlich gemeinte Offenheit.

Neuruppin wirkt nicht verschlafen wie Nauenhof, wo die Stille fast überwältigend war, und auch nicht widersprüchlich wie Sachsenhausen. Es ist ein Ort in Balance. Einer, der nichts beweisen muss.

Die Therme fügt sich fast nahtlos in dieses Gefühl ein. Besonders die große Seesauna – ein Raum zwischen Hitze und Horizont, in dem der Blick über das Wasser schweift, während der Körper langsam zur Ruhe kommt. Es ist ein Ort des Abschaltens, aber nicht im Sinne von Flucht, sondern eher wie ein sanftes Ankommen bei sich selbst.

Vielleicht ist es das, was diesen Ort ausmacht: Er drängt sich nicht auf, er lädt ein.

Ich komme gern wieder.
![IMG_1047.JPEG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/travelflower/Ep7siCG74t6wD72CGRpUzmCjMvbx9jNVtAs7nB7YxtcSNn5G9ZkjDpPaAjpNCbYyB3d.JPEG)

body.title: Mensaje diario de 5 minutos-Primera impresión/ Daily 5 minute message-Pirst impression
body.body:
> Disfrutar una primera impresión, un primer lugar, la impresión de una primera persona y a veces noes equivocamos. Simplemente son momentos que nuestros sentidos simplemente captan señales y no las entendemos. pero siempre ese primer instinto nos va dando las señales adecuadas. Disfrutar hermosas imágenes que nos dan grandes sensaciones. Se acercan las tormentas, se acercan los días de lluvia, se acercan los nuevos paisajes o por lo menos esa es la primera impresión que tengo en estos momentos. Claro puedo equivocarme con solamente ver la imagen. Con las personas se vuelve complicado hay personas que se dejan observar, vemos sus actos, vemos sus antecedentes y momentos. Pero aún así nunca llegamos a conocerlos completamente. Y es que las personas no exponen su 80% en su totalidad y que también pueden cambiar un poco, aprenden, mejoran o hasta empeoran. Pero la vida sigue su camino, mi taza de café cambia un poco a veces me sabe a felicidad, a veces me sabe a recuerdos, a veces simplemente me da energía para comenzar el día con buen animo. La vida sigue paso a paso solo tiene que avanzar un poco.
***
Este texto corresponde a mi participación en el reto diario del amigo @latino.romano y @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/27-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3086-first-impression) **ENGLISH VERSION** Enjoying a first impression, a first place, the first impression of a person, and sometimes we're not wrong. They're simply moments when our senses pick up signals, and we don't understand them. But that first instinct always gives us the right clues. Enjoying beautiful images that give us great feelings. Storms are coming, rainy days are coming, new landscapes are coming, or at least that's the first impression I have right now. Of course, I could be wrong just by looking at the image. With people, it gets complicated. There are people who let themselves be observed; we see their actions, their backgrounds, and their experiences. But even so, we never truly know them completely. People don't reveal 80% of themselves, and they can also change a little, learn, improve, or even worsen. But life goes on. My cup of coffee changes a little; sometimes it tastes of happiness, sometimes it tastes of memories, sometimes it simply gives me energy to start the day in a good mood. Life goes on step by step; it just has to move forward a little.
***
This text corresponds to my participation in the daily challenge of my friend @improv, @felt.buzz, @latino.romano and @mariannewest [post](https://hive.blog/hive-161155/@daily.prompt/27-april-2026-freewriters-community-daily-writing-prompt-day-3086-first-impression)

<div class=\

> The number of cosplayers who attended the last Comic Expo was quite high. Both days were packed with cosplayers who came to have a good time, meet up with friends, and, of course, take photos—a must. Photos, videos, etc. I took tons of pictures, and even so, I know I missed many cosplayers. There was an area next to the stage set up for people to take photos. My friend Frantografias, a photographer from the city, was also there, with his lights set up, taking a lot of pictures. I spent quite a bit of time in that area; we even helped each other take photos. When other friends from digital media and low-budget content creators arrived, we organized ourselves to take photos. For a moment, I went to take a picture with Catwoman at the Batman collectors' booth. ---- > La cantidad de cosplayers que asistieron a la última Comic Expo fue bastante alta. Ambos días estuvieron repletos de cosplayers que vinieron a pasarlo bien, a reunirse con sus amigos y, por supuesto, a tomar fotos, algo imprescindible. > Fotos, vídeos, etc. Tomé muchísimas fotos, y aun así, sé que me perdí a muchos cosplayers. Había una zona junto al escenario habilitada para que la gente se hiciera fotos. Mi amigo Frantografias, un fotógrafo de la ciudad, también estaba allí, con sus luces montadas y tomando muchísimas fotos. > Pasé bastante tiempo en esa zona; incluso nos ayudamos entre nosotros para tomar fotos. Cuando llegaron otros amigos de medios digitales y creadores de contenido de bajo presupuesto, nos organizamos para tomar fotos. ----
On the terrace, I also spent some time watching which cosplayers called me over to take their picture. As always, there were many who had been cosplaying for years, but also young people who were just starting out and doing their first cosplay. Some were visitors from other states who traveled to the city to attend the convention. They all deserve praise, as they sometimes spend more than 12 hours in their costumes, including the time from when they put them on—some at home—until they finish and return home. Some costumes are very elaborate, with many layers of fabric, and the heat, combined with the hustle and bustle of taking photos and doing other things, is quite tiring. On the first day, there was a cosplay presentation. Around sixty people participated, each performing in turns for about two minutes on stage. These presentations were evaluated by the judges. That day, there were six lucky winners who stood out with their cosplays, who received gifts from the sponsors, and the first-place winner received a cash prize. On the second day, there was a cosplay parade. It was more dynamic, but many cosplayers also participated. Afterward, they went to the photo area so that photographer Fran and the media could take their pictures. I took the opportunity to photograph some cosplayers I hadn't photographed before. ---- > En la terraza, también pasé un rato observando qué cosplayers me llamaban para tomarles una foto. There are times that she ignore her babies cry, even though she's the reason they are crying, aigoooo. Batik is always that \

But even though the breeze is cold during that minutes of heavy rain, the heat after it is still so intense. It will really make you sweat. I like that I sweat coz of it, but I hate it. Mommy F hate it too, she had no choice but to wet her arms more often or else... ...and so, coz it rains, I feel like it is the best time to look around the yard. After the rain shots are always the best because for some reason, it gives a special but natural effect to the photo when captured it.

>https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ruffatotmeee/Eos1FwjgbvH6MzCXwJsWRDDW1s6jC9P6cJT5bmurdBGCADsfwrv2FQp7J3kNn1tjcXj.jpg Raw and unfiltered -but wait, some built in camera still has filter, but well, I am satisfied with this short. And look how happy the plants with this rain

body.title: Click: I Like You
body.body:
click” button. We have become distant observers of emotions. We do not consume or experience emotions anymore - we only observe it. Just like in ancient Greek arenas, where people fought with their lives, blood was shed, one succeeded, and people clapped. Another suffered, and they reacted accordingly. That’s all. And now we are spending our time in a similar manner. 

>Myself: Elite Beggar

Now look, someone who posts after achieving great success spends the evening counting likes, just like a beggar taking coins out of a bowl, counting how much he collected today. (No offense) And someone who shares sorrow looks at how many sad emojis they received, how many likes. And then there is someone with the laughing react, just for the love of the game. Now the author will keep on wondering, “Why did someone react with laughter?” 

They do not realize that the person who pressed like may have been just as disinterested as the one who used a funny emoji. Because all of us are just pressing the like button and moving on - like running on a treadmill, without thinking about what lies ahead. Because there is no “ahead” on a treadmill; it keeps you in the same place. At least, it helps to keep one in shape.  

So, we are running on this treadmill, repeatedly pressing the like button in an utterly disinterested manner. A situation where our soul is not fully present. We are not truly feeling anything. We are only observing pain from a distance, observing happiness from afar. Maybe we are doing this because we are just bored, and to entertain, we are consuming others emotions.  

And as a result, people’s biggest moments, their major experiences, and their life-changing events are increasingly becoming hollow. Earlier, when such moments were celebrated socially, in the real world, there was energy, gatherings, and presence. But now they are posted online, and the celebration has become: 300 comments and 2000 likes. 

The problem is not this attention or advancement, rather a choice by us. We have forgotten to live with a balance. In this contemporary world, no one stops to think, I did not meet anyone. No one personally patted my back. There was no real presence. No one wiped my tears. No one shared laughter with me.  

In the end, Ahmad Javed beautifully said: after removing all mistakes, shortcomings, all layers, man still remains man. But if even one layer is removed, perhaps he no longer remains human. And that layer is connection. 

Social connection, which once existed in the real world, is now dying. And we social animals need it back.  

................. 

Peace 🕊

body.title: We Are the Problem
body.body:
In this life, and from the experiences I have had, I have realized that humans are among the most terrible creatures we have ever known in the history of the universe. When I say humans, I am not trying to separate myself, we are all the same. It only depends on how things are going in our lives and how people around us respond to us.

We have a lot of bitter people around us, and most times, they fail to see anything good in what others do. The funny thing is, it doesn’t mean they are not doing well. I have seen people who are rich and still bitter about someone else’s breakthrough. What do we call that kind of attitude? Should we call it envy? Why is the human heart so full of evil, constantly devising wrongdoing?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSJqyirQ71o2ukAwfWarNX7MAAtaSrjoiQWJ2xTwuFF3a/1777286716110.jpg)

We live in a world where war is treated as peace, and the absence of it is seen as calamity and disaster. We see humans prey on other humans, the weaker ones. People flex their strength when they encounter those below them, often making them feel inferior.
To echo what the Bible says about life being a warfront or battlefield is accurate when describing what is happening among us. We are so flawed that when we benefit from evil or questionable practices, we speak less about it. Yet, we are quick to point fingers at others when they do the same or even worse, especially when we are not benefiting from it. The truth is, none of us is a saint. The idea that one must be without sin to cast the first stone still holds. We can not keep claiming holiness when our actions prove otherwise.

Some people are quick to condemn wrongdoing, which is good. But when they benefit from the same wrongdoing, they remain silent. Are they not hypocrites? Many of us are hypocritical, especially when we are not benefiting. We may know someone is a thief, yet we keep quiet because “he is our thief,” just like many of our leaders do.

Who can truly make things better in this world? Perhaps someone without ties, someone who has no family to be threatened when they choose to do the right thing. Sometimes, the world feels so broken that I wonder if it is even worth raising a child in it.

I think the family is where many of the world’s problems originate. Why do I say this? Most crimes are committed by individuals who belong to a family. Everyone is connected to a family, whether abandoned or distant from them. Before the government, we have families, friends, colleagues, and communities. You see parents who are unable to guide their children for various reasons. You see children fending for themselves. Why wouldn’t such children do whatever it takes to put food on their table?

We are all responsible for what is happening in our society today, through both our actions and our inactions. We are all culpable. It is when the smallest unit of the human race begins to change and take responsibility that we may start to see a difference. When we learn to love one another, we will not think of harming others.

Then, we may rid ourselves of evil and stop judging or mocking people. The reason many are afraid to speak up is the fear of being mocked or rejected by those they care about.

Life is what it is, and we must live with love and cherish the moments we have in this world. We can not leave this world until our time is up.

body.title: HBD: Withdrawal, Trading & Savings
body.body:
Back in the day, HBD was one of my main targets in my operations on the Hive Blockchain. It was what I used to calculate my daily, weekly, and monthly earnings, and at the end of the week, seeing the amount of HBD I realized gave me joy. I didn’t pay much attention to the other token, which is HP, because I knew that anything I earned in HBD was equivalent to HP, and that’s because I used (and still using) the 50%/50% HP & HBD posting method.

This post is done in a ***past*** format, that's because HBD earnings through posts is now in the past.


**What did I do with my HBD?**

 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWxokPkkLiswrKx1u94b5W4VxAVoh5NKbCEfMnxymWsd9/1002487543.jpg 


**I withdrew to fiat:**
Whenever I needed money to sort out some pressing issues, HBD was always there for me to withdraw to fiat and handle the situation. Sometimes the exchange rate with USD varies, but I’ve always taken it as 1 HBD = 1 USD. I usually made this withdrawal to fiat by first converting it to HIVE and then sending it to an exchange that accepts HIVE.


**I temporarily kept it for trading:**
One of the tools I used back then for trading was HBD. Since HBD doesn’t fluctuate much (the fluctuation is insignificant), I kept my earnings there. Whenever HIVE went down, I swapped from HBD to HIVE, and then waited for HIVE to go up before swapping it back to HBD. By then, I would have made a profit. I used this method a lot back then, and it fetched me money. Ever since HBD earnings through post were scrapped, I haven’t thought about trading HBD. It just feels somehow these days to convert liquid HIVE to HBD. To me, it feels like the wrong step. Don't you think so?


**Savings with APR earnings:**
Some days ago, I noticed that the APR for HBD savings has decreased from 15% to 12%. I checked again today and met 14%. Back when the percentage was more attractive, I made some good profits from saving HBD. For now, I don’t have any HBD to save, and I doubt I would go for the current 12% APR. No, it looks too low.

I hope the HBD earnings on posts return soon.

Thanks for reading.

body.body:
# Hello Hive 


![4125.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/242hYS2xyEeQ3bkBWnfK29CF2TsTnVA4WQCx6jwxnmSSRZoLUDXcQVAtpFuEVbXwEWq4p.jpg)



Happy new week to all the creative minds here, I hope that our weekend was blissful. It's a beautiful new day and I wish to share with us the creative process of how I made the beautiful new dress design.

![4116.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/243Bnnoj7okP7EHp8b2aEpB4ZYciEAtQ6oVH7CCxtvKxvCUTnxZzgXZfmiZ21QgJuHx4p.jpg)


People say that there is no end of limit to creativity and I believe that completely. Before we can come up with a new design we have to try out various strategies of cutting sewing or combination of fabrics. This is exactly what happened to this outfit


![4166.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23ycyGaiAtjx62wCVTMM8Hy4YLmW2Hqa5NipAvUi8CYkRnJTYbmkD5bAkj8Cqwn93XyR7.jpg)



I have earlier designed a dress in this manner for one of my friends who came visiting .  This was the dress I made for her in golden color and like I said earlier, my friends delight in visiting me and coming along with fabrics knowing that I can sew clothes. They will deliberately come on such visit to have their outfit sewn for free. 



![4179.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23tmUJY1WjzRQUrfyY7WseX6UK6PAS49BTUA9ms93ihtujEtg3Gmsts23RMEdG5jobBDi.jpg)

After making this dress for her I feel in love with the design and wanted to see if I can replicate something like that in another fabric.


The fabrics have different color and design hence it takes another level of creative to make this black come out nice. First I thought about adding white to the middle of the dress maybe it will give it an appealing appearance.
After doing that here, I still don't feel satisfied with the outcome.


Next I feel like adding some of the white fabric color to the hem of the sleeves, maybe that will complement the middle white to give it a better appearance. I am yet to try that though


And another thing again I feel like making some cover buttons of either black or white color but I am yet not sure of what will match this best

![4122.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zkpmpDzLU4BVx7jWQuRFpHbTKhiw98XxzVcFstqS9yxFb72FUzfRigSFJwpL4BGBroP.jpg)

All of these are the creative challenges I am currently facing with regards to completing this dress I am making. Sometimes we just do a trial and error and if they final look of the dress doesn't come out nice, we loosen the seam and try again.

# Dress making process

To make this dress

body.title: Interior vs Exterior Waterproofing
body.body:
There are two primary approaches to basement waterproofing, each designed to address specific conditions.

Interior Waterproofing

Interior systems focus on managing water that has already entered the basement. These solutions typically include drainage channels, sump pumps, and vapor barriers. Interior waterproofing is often less invasive and more cost-effective, making it ideal for addressing minor leaks or recurring moisture.

Exterior Waterproofing

Exterior waterproofing is considered the most comprehensive solution because it stops water at its source. This method involves excavating around the foundation, applying waterproof membranes, and installing drainage systems to redirect water away from the structure. Although more labor-intensive, it provides long-term protection and preserves the integrity of the foundation.

Key Waterproofing Solutions

Modern waterproofing combines multiple techniques to ensure maximum effectiveness from [wet basement repair](https://canadawaterproofers.com). Some of the most widely used solutions include:

Foundation crack repair using epoxy or polyurethane injections
Sump pump installation to remove accumulated water
French drain systems for efficient water redirection
Backwater valves to prevent sewer backup flooding
Drain cleaning and repair to maintain proper flow

By integrating these systems, homeowners can create a comprehensive defense against water intrusion.

Benefits of a Waterproofed Basement

Investing in basement waterproofing offers both immediate and long-term advantages:

Prevents flooding and water damage
Protects structural integrity of the home
Eliminates moisture-related health risks
Increases usable living space
Enhances property value

A dry basement can be transformed into a comfortable living area, home office, gym, or storage space without concerns about dampness or damage.

body.body:
# Monday Monochrome a few recent shots Good Morning, I hope you had a good weekend and wishing you a good week ahead Starting the week as I usually do with a few Monochrome shots, all taken on recent walks even a couple of shots from a spot I had not visited before Starting in the historic district here in New Bedford, I do love the cobblestome streets and find myself so tempted to edit any shot showing them into a mono edit. But I should also correct myself, I guess even though I think of them as cobblestones, there actually Belgian blocks. Cobblestones are naturally rounded, irregular river stones that create a rustic, uneven surface. Conversely, Belgian blocks are quarried, rectangular granite stones with straight lines, providing a more consistent, durable, and formal appearance. While both are highly durable, Belgian blocks offer a smoother surface than the bumpier traditional cobblestone Well thats how it was described online, but these are not the smooth and are surely bumpy to drive over
![recent mono-4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23vhwKZu8pjE2aWjePwwjG2yqF15kniZxMpgCJVQCQGPEhpCyCYd3Y76wsjNXg6x8q5DA.jpg) **Sony A7iv 24mm F4 8 Sec ISO 100** **[Click here to view larger](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tattoodjay/23vhwKZu8pjE2aWjePwwjG2yqF15kniZxMpgCJVQCQGPEhpCyCYd3Y76wsjNXg6x8q5DA.jpg)**

Next up still in New Bedford, on a visit to Buttonwood Park, luckily I had taken a longer lens with me to catch this shot of a commorant bird, I do not remember seeing them on the pond there previous years, but there's a few of them there this year. They were still at the pond yesterday when I took a walk there

I always try to get my appointments early morning, and as it was nice that day I headed to Fall river early for a photo walk, after the sunrise, I drove to check out Kennedy Park in Fall River and got a few shots there . Including inside this pavillion I Guess one would call it

body.title: Para entender a Kafka
body.body: Franz Kafka no necesita presentación alguna. No es casualidad que La Metamorfosis sea uno de los textos recomendables a leer, sí o sí, antes de morir. El ingenio de dicha obra arroja luz sobre una viñeta oscura de la naturaleza humana más necesaria de afrontar. En sí, esta era la visión que tenía su autor: mostrar lo cruel del mundo y afirmar, con ello, su belleza. Pero ¿qué hace a Franz Kafka tan universal? ¿Cómo se puede disfrutar su obra sin perder ningún matiz? ¿Por dónde comienzo? Son preguntas que año tras año afloran en mis clases de Literatura. Es por ello que aprovecharé mi experiencia como docente y mi amor por dicho escritor. Esto no es un estudio pormenorizado de sus símbolos y significados. Tampoco una guía integradora, aunque hay recomendaciones. Pretendo con esta entrada hacer una radiografía de su mundo interior para que así, a través de los indicios de su persona, podamos captar lo esencial y básico de su narrativa. **| Sus huellas dactilares** Todo escritor tiene una línea temática que lo define; algo así como las líneas de la mano o huellas del pulgar. Dicho tema representa el ADN de la creación literaria. La muerte era el hilo común en la madeja de poemas de Alejandra Pizarnik; la belleza, el tema predominante en la novelística de Thomas Mann. En el caso de Kafka, la angustia es la palabra que encierra todo su universo. No hay cuento o novela del escritor que no encierre impotencia, frustración o un sentimiento de absurdo ya sea en sus personajes o en la historia que nos cuenta. El macrocosmo kafkiano sienta sus bases en la fealdad del mundo. Toma de la arcilla de la vida, la moldea hasta devolvernos una escultura aséptica, gris, cuya dimensiones son la realidad tocante. Leer su obra es rozar lo convulso de la existencia humana. Sus ideas nos recuerdan por qué estamos vivos al tiempo que nos preguntan ¿estamos vivos? Hay que tener claro que no es un escritor de finales felices ni de tonos cálidos; no esperes toparte con una conciliadora visión de nuestros tiempos. **| El color de sus ojos** El simbolismo en sus páginas desborda múltiples interpretaciones debido a que su visión artística presenta un color universal. Él extrae los elementos que nos hacen afín a todos y los vuelve historias. Ejemplo de ell son su alegoría del hambre en “Un artista del hambre”; las metáforas sobre introspección y culpa en “Ante la Ley”o los múltiples juegos sobre descendencia y progenitura que dedica en “Once hijos”. Es como si, sentado al piano donde se conciertan las sinfonías del alma, tocara teclas específicas que resuenan familiar a todos, componiendo una sonata cuyos acordes sean entendidos más allá del lenguaje y el país. No solo los simbolismos son globales, también los hay personales. En cuentos como “La Condena” o en la propia Metamorfosis su prosa arroja luces sobre la tormentosa relación paternal del escritor. El padre dejó una estela negativa que lo marcaría de por vida. No es que fuera un oadre disfuncional (era alguien de la casa y respetado empresario) sino que el autoritariamo de este trazó una brecha entre un joven Franz y todo afecto humano. Le bastó la poca comunicación para dejar dicha marca en el hijo. Su forma de mirar el mundo era tan peculiar como lo que plasmaba en el papel. **| La textura de su piel** La personificación o prosopopeya está a la orden del día en la vida artística del escritor de Praga. No solo Gregorio Samsa, en “Informe de una Academia”, tenemos a un mono quien escribe una carta a una prestigiosa universidad explicando las razones de por qué logró aprender el habla. En “Josefina y el pueblo de los ratones” nos topamos con una incursión a la teoría de las masas bajo la forma de un puñado de ratones. Kafka usa la imagen animal como reflejo de la naturaleza humana; una especie de ironía que el escritor vio siempre etinado. **| ¿Por dónde empezar?** No existe una guía definitiva. En cuestiones de arte, el Norte toma diversos rumbos. Sin embargo, los especialistas consideran empezar primero por los cuentos del autor como un modo de ganar familiaridad. “La Metamorfosis” o “Informe para una academia” parecen ser textos más accesibles e ideales para un comienzo. Las novelas, en cambio, muestran el tormento del escritor en todo su esplendor, por lo que obras como “El Proceso” o “ El castillo” serían más adecuados para personas ya avanzadas en el viaje. Independientemente de por donde empieces ¡empieza ya! Leer a Kafka es una de las experiencias más enriquecedoras que puedas tener. En sus letras, nos asomamos al abismo de la propia existencia siempre con la esperanza de que alguien nos responda .

body.title: Guild Brawls With Pizza 2 - A Rollercoaster Brawl
body.body:
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23uFcH8GDdYWRsixYPTsvDPf9JmL6DpTYvChjYcXZmXabsdzQYzVvDcjqjtdZzdBqG3cQ.png)</center>

Time flies! Just completed the 269th brawl with my awesome guild, which is none other than Pizza 2 The Deep Dish!

***

- *Fun In The Discord Chats*

Really appreciated the interaction in the Discord chats within the Pizza guilds. During the preparation phase, there's a lot of information sharing and discussion on who to fill each fray. During the brawls, there were reminders to members to complete their brawl battles. And after the brawls, there were celebratory messages and some members (including me) would write about our experience in the brawls. Aside from brawls, I thought the donations were also very well organised and tabulated, with lucky draws to incentivise donors as well.

- *Moving Back To Bronze Fray*

Had 7 battles this time and it was not an easy round, especially when they have recently introduced 3 rulesets for each battle. Moreover, I have rented out most of my cards because I was playing lesser these days.

- We Got 7th!!!

So for the final result, we were 7th out of 9 guilds and got 300 Merits and around 8 SPS! A good bag of SPS! Who knows how much one SPS would go to in this market?
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/Eo8LeQEFuPwBMYGT4Rim6qwtFeDak22xbRiyt1KbSBYrkxib1G7NidcSa3sZHHvi841.png)</center>



Individually, I had 7 fights this time and I won 4 of them this time! Finished 4th within the guild. Due to change in format, wins are actually awarded to the players present in the fray if guilds decided to skip the fray. For this round, there was 1 additional win for me.
<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tbP7KAe8tHybRG75yzsZRFvZLPgm7TBAe3f5RYwyskv2FcpFs6uuFkQHVMBWaLt4uSa.png)</center>


***
**Battle 1 - LOSE**

*Gladius Card Used: Trapp Falloway*

My opponent had two cards with Demoralise while I only had one. That made a huge deal of difference in the Melee battle and I had to take the loss here.

**MVP: None**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/Eo45HnuHYrKkuwCGizMTqJPT6AiwEXjcCE87LLnJR2LZWzW5g7SHQrEMGzHG5t3EF4x.png)










***
**Battle 2 - LOSE**


*Gladius Card Used: None*

Ouch. I shouldn't be losing battles like this, but I underperformed. My strategy with Prophet Rosa backfired as my opponent put up a strong lineup with strong damage output.

**MVP: None**


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGZwBJeSZaZDMLwm3cSfFyZH7z2E8zrywT4MCcU626AnDkmUwgmXtYPkSQzHohbQKtQ.png)








***
**Battle 3 - LOSE**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

As usual. Shrugs. I didn't need to watch this battle to know I lost in this one. If you know, you know.

**MVP: None**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/Eo1wMUvPosM5Unq5am1ZMx2zfScxLGpf2Z3XmkLJmz7hLE4Qwr964c2vtqMgoqVKQ2s.png)

***
**Battle 4 - WIN**

Opponent fled! I had to get my first win through this circumstance. That's quite demoralising but we will take it!







***
**Battle 5 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Larissa Kerato*

Magic vs Magic battle! I have to say I had the stronger deck and was comfortable in this one! Larissa Kerato made all the difference! One more win under the belt!

**MVP: Larissa Kerato**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGbqyFHJkwcCXMm7LF8tSym5R2cd36JvQNrEV12rkYxAdTfekS9tX9TrqozjXTfHTXY.png)







***
**Battle 6 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: None*

Wow! I beat a Quora Towershead!!!  It was a tricky matchup with two strong Gladius cards, but Astral Entity did an awesome job with that Resurrection, and that kept Ancient Lich alive for longer. Close one but that was close to a miracle.

**MVP: Astral Entity**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23t76pNE6ANDKNMttNWij1YQHCYUa7HU3GegT9uyjCSrqx6Pwq1NrGLVetVtcTWBJAN2E.png)



***
**Battle 7 - WIN**

*Gladius Card Used: Marisol Contuma*

Wow. Another Quora Towershead. But yet another win! This was so so close! The battle was literally won by just 1 turn. It was so tough to handle two Gladius cards but I think my cards were more tankier that made the thin difference between a win and a loss. Hard to pick one MVP because everyone did well, so it goes to the tank.

**MVP: Iziar**



![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/relf87/23tGbvmHFdF5kQFBX9gLwWV5C8HT42LueizMQfj6qPstVnEnyAdKm99fc6xjvkBd54CVV.png)


So that sums up my 7 battles for this brawl! 57% win rate this time, but still delighted over 2 wins over Quora Towershead! Lol! Let's keep fighting PIZZA 2!
***
**Review Of Gladius Cards**

No new Gladius cards to review this time round.
