body.title: ANOTHER NIGHT OF FEAR AND TERROR WITH ... DEAD SPACE 2023
body.body: After the long night of terror described in the last Dead Space - related post published about a week ago, I continued playing that game from time to time, but in much smaller doses. Stuff I'm about to show you today wasn't \

in just one night, but I like the title ANOTHER NIGHT OF FEAR AND ... etc, so, yeah, it's slightly misleading, but who cares? I, most certainly don't.    

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPYpLrUhggwDjxmFyX4eXjmi9Lq2MPiTz6HeRhoxBR5vF/screenshot_1075_.png)

In today's post, I'm about to show you some screenshots I took along the way.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYDBSSNWoAWZ4v1WMTfGMsNPjJMWZn6aHedK7bgzq8Wfs/screenshot_1204_.png)

This time, the focus will be mainly on monsters.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc872cvEQ4hTQZCp3bDJjJQvNHr4JZUjCn5f3iNX5PX16/screenshot_1109_.png)

Partially becouse as the game progressed, the necromorph monstrosities got more varied and numerous, but the most important reason is that I realised how detrimental the motion blur option is to screenshots. Especially to screenshots of fast-paced action. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcdXHZr2QH7DZiHxfA5MY66MqQ5Zj59JFwiQDCdoKyDue/screenshot_814_.png)

When I turned the motion blur off, catching a clean shot of a monster in action got much easier.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmV9WUL4DzbmZ7uGXVHQFNBF734282cRTn6SZy4mnD3AX2/screenshot_1134_.png)

Most monsters weren't too hard to destroy, I mean there were very resilient to mindless attacks, but their weaknesses were fairly obvious, so with just a bit of tactical thinking, killing them didn't require more than a bare minimum of frustration. Most were like that, but ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXZUkXZxkZnTjCPprxcwaexAJeXRFG2txC65iFid7d8dJ/screenshot_933_.png)

... but the one shown in this picture seemed invincible for a relatively long time. Whatever weapon I used on him, no matter what part of his body I turned into bloody chunks of putrid, infected meat, he kept regenerating completely and chasing me across the room.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPGGeKmM3gV5CSaQLNEP7u3HRLiUKicYCHyEruomYb75d/screenshot_1059_.png)

The room in question was a cryogenic laboratory ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbSpA7UrFU16hwg7oNCM7CCVbtnud2N79SXziTcMZMf5S/screenshot_1056_.png)

... with some interesting specimens frozen in big tanks.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaUc7trCH4QqcQi15u9vdT35gfmxWfJWqwtWvggpFJZi4/screenshot_940_.png)

It took me quite a bit to realize that the only chance to get rid of this ugly, undead thing is to freeze it. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzZe758vtYntU8EPjmDnBwu3kr6jwdS9VN7agLxHNb4L/screenshot_811_.png)

It looks obvious in hindsight, but last night, in the fervor of the fight, I kept running around for long, tense minutes with no idea what to do. And the regenerating degeneration shown in the above picture wasn't the only thing that tried to kill me on that occasion ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdiKE1151w3XYPwZwf4Q3Rsd2zHt6rqH7reTd5TG3jStv/screenshot_954_.png)

... nope, some fairly small but dangerous bloodsuckers were there too.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRk3Qm1A6r56SBjVsBNPZk4oxy7K43LXYymr6oE77UKnW/screenshot_983_.png)

Here you can see all those enemies in one screenshot.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQzDws9Tb2QWLS4z9ZtW4LLwcaC14h9XZeynWuHVqczL5/screenshot_1147_.png)

At some point, after tons of blood, guts, and gore ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVNmkNuhqBD2qXm9hZJZmriiDEhwjnH9oKfNjhHFE4yiJ/screenshot_1014_.png)

... I reached a room in which I could make some repairs and modifications on my weapons, and there I suddenly realized, after many hours of playing, that I have some cool spacesuits I can use. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWJZ4BrqdFNdRmAsRWBCV62iVLG8UWxKTwR6uw51whiVJ/screenshot_1052_.png)

They were always avaliable in storage, but I didn't notice that option.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRxa2jWppTpPxGbEHZKZXfjdEVH8NWkZ1nbNdbqecnZk5/screenshot_1019_.png)

At that point, the game, quite unexpectedly, turned from horror to some sort of fashion event. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSXKSxjcAWE9ik3REopAfVKtaa9P7nnJKGbPNeajsdiKD/screenshot_1017_.png)

After all the shooting and running ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWn19XvMUTYDbQ2tVq4fcZhEKfVpSCvrsRfcr28mcCdaL/screenshot_1049_.png)

... trying the suits was a nice change of pace.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaN1iA14E6L7mpHjsQiGxqzcK2B3AKA2XWHsjgbU4QmpU/screenshot_1046_.png)

I'll show you all my space suits in this post.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdyQcSNwTL9ikQyFX1jV1BHUFh7PyBCeyk3vm3WGVDzTa/screenshot_1050_.png)

There is plenty of interesting design in this game. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXpoUho4WSzwmAH69YahFRtv1AYaH3wGqFqcXELcT9f9X/screenshot_1043_.png)

This is the weirdest fashion creation I can wear. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeMrkPkGfqvWZb5KREX6LZbdiG3PUvci3iNWJKygdHT4G/screenshot_1038_.png)

The suit is merged with patches of infected guts and flesh. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaWDidVNeaB93xrJj3gS9SLMMkivNYFKUxpv1wRWedRib/screenshot_1044_.png)

It's an interesting creation, probably very good for camouflage.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNkmoyUYuMmd42ZMbfdexLibjJi3baLwH9Mc7yXthMrmJ/screenshot_1008_.png)

This one looks fairly ordinary at first sight, but it is the second weirdest, actually. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmY3Feq8xunRJxP46P1wbXKi96RJRQLjJUe3crSgc5mKaj/screenshot_1010_.png)

Please take notice of the chopped hands attached to the helmet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUeMDqgRhhh995jF6qyEcbChsvigTJL7Nj1cDSGrKSTqP/screenshot_1023_.png)

This is yet another ordinary suit paired with an ordinary helmet.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXXdvyAomyUdkKr8YrsbbWak1g9w9HrC735LX4GxaK5qs/screenshot_1025_.png)

And that's it, the fashion show ends here ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYwj3hmvn5p3vXJUxusBP7Pidmk21BQ7QwSuDMSPEPBip/screenshot_756_.png)

... but the post goes on.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUT7cJ4SrkNyTZBpf1mzNAAzoHwgDpNAJP4tyncusAXPG/screenshot_1125_.png)

The thing shown in this screenshot, and quite a few others I prepared today, was once a person working on the spaceship.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXVLeGZujg3HkgaRmBy9KgWqLuPAU5DYAxeoEunXjo7NC/screenshot_1143_.png)

It was glued to the floor, and looked sad and harmless at first sight, but ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQNZhchQbtuEjiAJ6hJcGaKCtt3TvYJ6ZxVMi3pqaLuXr/screenshot_1316_.png)

... but it was releasing lethal gases that can kill you very quickly ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmd4R4t5znchRVnkDCQhtvvkzVXPLawZxbPnr3NZTNVM6B/screenshot_1095_.png)

... so it had to be eliminated.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXKLPQ2i8xmzBwTeUQgFp2aYYFoHj5HVZUX9zDHKR9bbH/screenshot_1093_.png)

I can't remember the reason right now, but I had to use a syringe filled with some chemicals to kill it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWzrNRFA9UUqvSgiemKwJfsWstNQSavMtJ983MscnesE4/screenshot_1155_.png)

You can see its carcass here.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQcCxhR26AHcKpPo7ArugnwzXrcHxpuCwHV9JhxPVoFA/screenshot_1061_.png)

In this screenshot, you can see me posing next to the vegetables in the hydroponic laboratory.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeMDkBMtYYTLUixxUWxV4aajrrkWGziHSBgqyQWYcbXtS/screenshot_1076_.png)

That place felt a bit like a relaxing green oasis in the midlle of an industrial hell.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU3HgfAyGe3kmxF1naKF1CoisuJy2ryV5AifKqAUzkRnh/screenshot_1206_.png)

The relaxation didn't last long, though ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPv8E52qcL8geDqhABYf2K4FkZ3Xsgc8jroJZaSnUEiLc/screenshot_1214_.png)

... becouse the necromorphs weren't too far away. It took them some time, but eventually, the monsters found me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYQ47cjbV3NSmPpjmaaGmtT79bJgFfm4wmKZJbj9Eg3cM/screenshot_1208_.png)

The thing shown in this screenshot resembles an alien bat or something like that. That thing ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWCGkueEiZatHzrMhtihRGLaFcWXB2iTKCi8QfdiN1uHp/screenshot_1192_.png)

... can fly and reanimate dead people.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTv1GqgBb7RR4AFyvRUB1NmDEb5UFr6hezekg8JnvNHTY/screenshot_1215_.png)

I mean ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQi6fG82zeMdTJxLzozfy8TiunBHZwsWrp555hNwqa4Fk/screenshot_1219_.png)

... it can turn them into monsters. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdjTBJ6hykQo6jU3L8MCe5MsH2VLrNExsu4fp588SndZs/screenshot_742_.png)

Yep, the game offers a nice variaty of interesting enemies with all kinds of behavior.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUKk5Q5m5f4HUGz4jsyLBjF8WRbC8gGhVDwajk6StypEp/screenshot_775_.png)

It's a great and pretty unique game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSbdHLsMGYgyXioNTgjyLwQ1zeZwFjtW6QdJGuRhnDqbk/screenshot_777_.png)

I think it's a horror masterpiece. There's nothing silly or incompetent in it that can break the immersion and the tense atmosphere. There is so much imagination put into the creatures and the futuristic, heavy, industrial design of the spaceship's interior.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMDVbywYmrbFzNKyiAdCToSa1gfQ59uXHKrgqArvdmhJ/screenshot_1356_.png)

Here you can see a really enormous necromorph monstrosity. The biggest I encountered so far in the game.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT4fzrRDeuPzrHsEYuudC9kcpsizuquskbnhqWugxS4Lh/screenshot_1352_.png)

It was an epic battle in zero-gravity ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmW3mKaKzJiUaQYeFWB1KDkNKm6vtywwgNzh6EczEpFgMb/screenshot_1365_.png)

... definitely a memorable encounter.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbGLyDjh5NnjbGuDYyxgnDGDpMvL6wqkJqCQh3b2PT9t2/screenshot_1087_.png)

By reading the log shown in this picture, you can learn a thing or two about the necromorphs, if you wish. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUn5GkVLJRgKU6mbh1s5JqgVaFUvEwRzMrnWgC3hvEWmQ/screenshot_766_.png)

This screenshot shows one of the most colorful parts of the ship.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVd7YxDgws9dD6FEFp8nSFqe49H3p3E4RensuXB7PzXhC/screenshot_762_.png)

And that's it ...

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVzu82V5UdLS2cqjMQ7UfUSJs81PdCk2EymVnv1fFKfzV/screenshot_767_.png)

... the post ends here - THE END.

This is my entry for the Gaming Photography Weekly Contest - Theme: Gaming Photographs. Here's the link to the contest announcement post by @gamingphoto

body.title: Optimism DAO Analysis
body.body:
Optimism DAO and Collective: Bicameral Governance, the OP Stack, and the Superchain Vision – Technical Architecture, Governance Mechanics, Ecosystem, Goals, and a Comparative Analysis with Cardano Catalyst

https://cryptotexty.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/OIP-3287540593.jpg

Optimism (optimism.io) is a leading Ethereum Layer 2 scaling solution built on Optimistic Rollups and the modular OP Stack. Its governance, known as the Optimism Collective, employs a unique bicameral system comprising the Token House (OP token-weighted voting and delegation) and the Citizens’ House (reputation-based, one-person-one-vote via soulbound badges). This structure separates economic and public-goods decisions, with Retroactive Public Goods Funding (RetroPGF) as a flagship mechanism for long-term ecosystem alignment. As of April 2026, the Collective has evolved significantly: Season 9 (January 2026) marked the transition “from experiment to organization,” introducing Protocol Upgrades 2.0, Capital Allocation 2.0, and a landmark OP token buyback program (approved January 2026) that allocates 50% of Superchain sequencer revenue to recurring buybacks for 12 months.

The OP Stack powers dozens of chains (including Base) in the emerging Superchain network, securing over $14 billion in total assets and processing millions of daily transactions with sub-cent fees and Ethereum-grade security. This research paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Optimism’s technical characteristics (Optimistic Rollups, Bedrock upgrade, OP Stack modularity, and Superchain interoperability), governance mechanics, ecosystem scale, and strategic vision. A detailed comparison with Cardano’s Project Catalyst highlights fundamental differences: Optimism’s bicameral, reputation-augmented model prioritizes public-goods funding and long-term alignment, while Catalyst relies on pure stake-weighted democracy for broad treasury allocation. The core question—how Optimism DAO functions in practice, how it differs from Catalyst, and its resulting pros and cons—reveals a mature, hybrid governance framework that balances token economics with reputation-based stewardship, offering valuable lessons for sustainable L2 scaling and decentralized coordination. Data is drawn from official documentation, governance proposals, Season 9 updates, and ecosystem metrics as of April 2026. 

 

1 . Introduction

Ethereum Layer 2 solutions have become essential for addressing the base layer’s scalability trilemma, but effective governance of these systems remains a critical challenge. Optimism stands out not only for its technical approach—Optimistic Rollups and the fully open-source OP Stack—but also for its innovative bicameral governance model within the Optimism Collective. By separating token-weighted economic decisions (Token House) from reputation-driven public-goods oversight (Citizens’ House), Optimism seeks to align short-term incentives with long-term ecosystem health.

The OP Stack has powered a growing Superchain of interoperable L2s (including OP Mainnet and Base), delivering sub-cent fees, 200 ms block times, 99.99% uptime, and Ethereum-level security. Recent developments, including the January 2026 approval of OP token buybacks tied to Superchain revenue and ongoing privacy enhancements to the OP Stack (April 2026), underscore the Collective’s active role in tokenomics evolution and infrastructure upgrades.

This paper delivers a rigorous, research-grade examination of Optimism DAO/Collective. It analyzes technical infrastructure, voting and proposal mechanics, ecosystem metrics and impact, strategic goals, followed by a head-to-head comparison with Cardano’s Project Catalyst. By drawing on primary sources—including the Working Constitution, governance documentation, Season 9 announcements, and recent proposals—the analysis answers the core research question: How does Optimism’s bicameral governance function in practice, how does it differ from large-scale stake-weighted models like Catalyst, and what are the resulting pros and cons for L2 protocol stewardship and public-goods funding?

Optimism’s model represents a deliberate evolution beyond simple token voting, aiming to reduce platform risk, prevent short-term extraction, and foster sustainable coordination across a multi-chain Superchain. Its lessons are highly relevant for any ecosystem seeking to scale Ethereum securely while maintaining credible neutrality and long-term alignment. 

Read full research paper here: https://cryptotexty.io/optimism/
More about Optimism: https://www.optimism.io/
More about Project Catalyst: https://projectcatalyst.io/

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 27 2026
body.body:

오늘 산책을 하면서 정말 즐거운 시간을 보냈어요. 우선, 동네 카페 앞에서 오랜만에 친구를 우연히 만났습니다. 그 친구와 함께 커피를 마시며 최근의 이야기와 계획에 대해 이야기할 수 있어서 좋았어요. 그 과정에서 공원에 있는 벚꽃이 만개해 있음을 발견했습니다. 정말 아름다웠고, 사람들 모두 벚꽃을 배경으로 사진을 찍느라 바쁘더라고요. 꽃의 향기도 좋고, 따뜻한 날씨 덕분에 많은 사람들이 나와서 행복한 시간을 보내는 모습이 인상적이었어요. 이렇게 소소한 일상이 주는 행복을 다시금 느낄 수 있었습니다. _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). body.title: The Great Central Ride: Two Motorcycles, one Endless Horizon
body.body:
It all begins in the quirky gold-mining town of Kalgoorlie. A place that feels like someone copied the Wild West into Australia, just with more flies and fewer gunfighters. The absolute highlight: the massive Super Pit. This hole is so enormous that you can’t help but think, “This isn’t a mine, this is an attempt to hollow out Australia.” We stand at the edge, staring down, and watching the giant mining haul trucks that appear like small ants - although these trucks are the biggest trucks in the world. Just imagine these tech specs: empty weight ~150–200 tonnes and ~225 tonnes per load, height ~6 - 7 meters (240 - 275 inches), tire diameter ~3 - 4 meters (120-160 inches) and ~2,500–4,000 horsepower. These vehicles are just out of this world.



<div json=\

/> With full tanks (and a fair bit of respect for what lies ahead), we leave civilization and head toward the Great Central Road. But first: a stop at Lake Ballard. Sounds peaceful, right? And it is at first glance. Scattered across the white salt lake are the haunting sculptures by Antony Gormley. They look like lost alien souls in the middle of nowhere.

/> It became late and this place looked like a great spot to pitch a tent for the night. And then come the flies. Not a few. Not many. A biblical plague. We look like two motorcyclists performing improvised ninja moves - constantly swatting, cursing, and laughing at the same time. Eating? Only in the tent. Taking photos? With one eye half closed. Meditation in the desert? Forget it. These bush flies really try to find moisture in every single body opening. Without a head net and a tent, you’d probably get drained in no time. However we had a peacful night.

/> Then the next morning it really begins: the Great Central Road. “Road” is a generous term. It’s more like a dusty suggestion of direction. Endless red tracks, relentless corrugations, and roadhouses spaced so far apart that spotting a fuel pump feels emotional. Each roadhouse is part gas station, part social hub, part survival outpost. And every time we arrive, we fill as much water and gas as possible. You definately don't want to run out of that.

/> Between stops: nothing. And everything. Endless horizons, shimmering heat and, unexpectedly, camels. Lots of camels. Seriously, a lot. They just stand there, watching us as if we’re the odd ones, then casually wander off. Apparently, they’ve decided Australia belongs to them now. We didn't even know, that there are camels in australia. Truly astonishing – what was once a leftover from the colonial era has become the world’s largest wild camel population. The motorcycles hold up bravely. So do we. Dust is no longer a condition. It’s a lifestyle. Every bottle of water is a treasure, every patch of shade a luxury.

/> And then after days of heat, dust, and mild madness it happens. The dusty dirt road turns back into perfect asphalt again and, on the horizon, a red giant appears: Uluru - or, as many still call it: Ayers Rock. Even if you’ve seen it in countless photos, nothing prepares you for it. It just stands there. Massive, silent, impressive. Almost unfairly majestic. That time there was a huge bush fire nearby which made its appearance look even more mysterious.

/> We roll closer, park the bikes, and suddenly everything goes quiet. No engines, no swatting flies, no dust in our mouths (well, almost). Just that moment. And somewhere between Kalgoorlie, the fly madness, roadhouses, and camels, it becomes clear: this is exactly why you do trips like this. Not because they’re comfortable. But because they feel real.

body.title: [ESP/ENG] substantial and rich concentrated green pea soup with smoked chicken and bones.
body.body:
> Feliz inicio de semana tengan todos mis queridos amigos, un gusto saludarle deseando desde la distancia que todos se encuentren bien y tengan en su hogar el pan de cada día, por mi parte el fin de semana tuve la oportunidad de cocinar en casa y preparar una sustanciosa sopa, algo tradicional dentro de mí familia, ya que mi mamá desde mi niñez siempre nos acostumbró que el fin de semana preparaba este tipo de comida, hoy les estaré presentando una sustanciosa sopa de arvejas verdes con pollo y hueso ahumado para disfrutar de un almuerzo en casa. > Happy start to the week to all my dear friends! It's a pleasure to greet you all, wishing you well from afar and hoping you have enough to eat at home. This past weekend, I had the opportunity to cook at home and prepare a hearty soup, a tradition in my family. My mother always made this kind of meal for us on weekends, and today I'll be sharing a recipe for a rich green pea soup with chicken and smoked bone, perfect for enjoying at home for lunch.
![GridArt_20260426_230711960.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AKF9QjB1aEn39WVNC5t75AX48pbSZb1vxstz7oLLGzvbwJFRk3wqUK2k1keKFqB.jpg)
Ingredientes: 1 kilo de pollo picado, 1/2 kilo hueso ahumado, 1/5 de verduras varias, 1 plátano, cebolla, ajo, ají, sal, cúbito, arvejas verdes. > Ingredients: 1 kilo of chopped chicken, 1/2 kilo of smoked bone, 1/5 of various vegetables, 1 plantain, onion, garlic, chili pepper, salt, bouillon cube, green peas. Colocamos una olla con agua y allí vertemos las arvejas verdes para que vayan cocinándose, por otra parte vamos a picar cebolla ají y ajo y llevarlos hasta hacer un sofrito. > We put a pot with water and pour in the green peas to cook, while we chop onion, chili pepper and garlic and sauté them.
![GridArt_20260426_230323650.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AK2E2nUyyP2dBugSSbnPgvkN6eMsdZvs6tpPUwnKg9mSiRTQWwoVSroWSU1U2Be.jpg)
Luego que nuestras arvejas este sumamente blanditas las llevo a licuar, la devuelvo la olla y agrego los huesos ahumados y el pollo agregándole un poco de sal y cubito. > Once the peas are extremely soft, I blend them, return them to the pot, and add the smoked bones and the chicken, along with a little salt and a bouillon cube. Seguidamente teniendo en cuenta que el pollo esté cocido agregamos el sofrito y las verduras mezclamos y sazonamos nuevamente dejando cocinar. > Next, taking into account that the chicken is cooked, we add the sofrito and the vegetables, mix and season again, leaving to cook.
![GridArt_20260426_230449284.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJpkQr6M9FEVD2SCHYisfdvofQiEZyQcNDehLnTKeX9jp8nTroEcfCLWTx77bTB.jpg)
De esta manera preparé esta deliciosa sopa llena de muchos nutrientes necesarios para nuestro organismo ya que brinda energía y calorías necesarios, además es recomendable consumir sopas una o dos veces por semana para mantener una mejor digestión, así que a todos nos gusta en casa. > This is how I prepared this delicious soup, full of many nutrients necessary for our body, as it provides energy and necessary calories. It is also recommended to consume soups once or twice a week to maintain better digestion, so everyone at home likes it.
![GridArt_20260426_230604837.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mariaser/AJkSUcEjDhB1dSCHXA7UxbdaPsTLCnfWB3HQ3z56edb5f9XtbTF9y7b2X2N8WK4.jpg)

body.title: 红妆
body.body:
层层叠叠的红，在枝头凝结成霞。
山茶，不似牡丹的富贵逼人，
不似桃花的轻佻易逝，
它以沉静的姿态，在春寒料峭时，
将一季的热烈，悄然铺展。

花瓣如丝绒般细腻，
边缘微微卷曲，似有若无的弧度，
藏着一份内敛的骄傲。
那红，不是单一的烈焰，
而是从深绯到粉霞的渐变，
在光线下流转，
仿佛将晚霞的余温，
都揉进了花心。

绿叶是它最忠实的衬托，
墨绿，油亮，边缘带着细密的锯齿，
如同忠诚的卫士，
守护着这抹不凋的春色。
风过时，花影摇曳，
却不见落英缤纷，
它只在枝头，
以静默的姿态，
诉说着生命的坚韧与华美。

山茶，是冬日里不肯凋零的梦，
是春日里最先醒来的魂。
它不争不抢，
却以最饱满的姿态，
在时光的画布上，
留下一笔浓墨重彩的红妆。

body.title: Back Home
body.body:
<center>![IMG_2612.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/23wC9dafbdrFecxqHhiwis5NLsFkRJykoUXxwkNi3vSCymzBH6YP7hHxH4Jzfo53Wb3CF.jpeg)</center><center><sub>My cousin and I tying one on the other evening.</sub></center>

Weather has been amazing lately. Promised myself this winter that when the temps warmed up I would start getting out and moving more.

So far so good.

Last Thursday my cousin drove 2.5 hours and picked me up. He brought me to his house in our home town for a week long visit. I'll be here until Wednesday.

Did I mention my cousin is like a brother to me? He's also a retired Marine. We were in at the same time. He was a couple years behind me, but we both served in a couple of the same places. That bond runs deep.

So far we've had a good time.

Played around with some engines. Went to the farm and tooled around. Ate breakfast with some old Marine friends. The kind of morning where the coffee keeps coming and the stories get better with each cup.

Spent some time visiting with my older brothers too. Chatting it up. Talking about old times and world problems. Solving nothing but enjoying the conversation anyway.

It's always nice to visit with one of my older brothers. He was such a mentor to me growing up. About 14 years older than me. I always looked up to him. Still do.

We plan to take a drive through our old stomping grounds in the country in a couple days. That should be enjoyable. Seeing what's changed. What hasn't. Remembering what used to be there.

Not sure what we have on the agenda for today. But surely it will be something enjoyable.

Sometimes you just need to get out. Be somewhere different. Be around people who've known you your whole life.

No schedule. No pressure. Just time with family and old friends.

This is what I promised myself when I was stuck inside all winter. This is keeping that promise.

![HiveDivider.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/coinjoe/EoGvX4Va6X4ZfjnYkvBhFi2bqZsCrwoqpWhwgmGDPKVDS9eeZ4zF8foqAfcm44mn84d.png)
Thanks for reading,
Joe

body.title: Los ataques de pánico han aumentado mis riesgos para la salud. [SPA-ENG]
body.body:
Todos queremos estar sanos. Luchamos constantemente por mantenernos sanos y a menudo tenemos que tomar medicamentos. Consideramos que la vida es valiosa cuando estamos sanos y bien. Tenemos que hacer muchas cosas para mantenernos sanos. Por ejemplo, al despertar por la mañana, nos aseamos y tomamos un desayuno saludable. Después del desayuno, realizamos nuestras actividades habituales y luego nos bañamos por la tarde. Tras bañarnos, almorzamos. Descansamos un rato y luego retomamos nuestras actividades diarias. Sin embargo, últimamente he perdido el control de mi vida y la clave para mantenerme sano. Porque actualmente sufro de ataques de pánico. Este problema me está afectando mucho y tengo diversos síntomas, como opresión en el pecho. ![20260427_154811.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23wqtwVcy3ShWfr4BLkASBBoMBpSQVQPru4M6KfGFd97pQbCnPXUwabcdwUpMb9m9RtBs.jpg) Anoche, después de cenar, me fui a dormir. Terminé de cenar a las 9 de la noche y vi una serie para entretenerme. Después de terminar, mi esposa y yo limpiamos la habitación y nos fuimos a dormir. Dormí aproximadamente una hora y de repente sentí un fuerte latido en el pecho y me asusté mucho. Tomé una medicina rápidamente. Después de tomarla, me dormí plácidamente y pensé que mi problema se había resuelto. Pero al poco rato, volvió a aparecer. El latido me golpeó con fuerza y sentí un miedo terrible a la muerte. Solo tenía un miedo: morir pronto. La habitación me parecía muy pequeña y todo se sentía alejado de mí. Por los ataques de pánico nocturnos, casi no podía dormir. Tomé la medicina y luego me fui a dormir. Pero esto se repetía y llegué a tener este problema casi tres veces en una sola noche. Cada vez que intentaba dormir, no lo conseguía. Finalmente, bebí un vaso de agua fría y luego di vueltas en la cama un rato. Luego descansé y me fui a dormir por la noche y dormí plácidamente toda la noche y no hubo ningún problema después de eso. ![20260427_154658.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/EoGxxQ9NG7zEQN688VkL73fj4KsGZ1up7XyDDMdYjaccRgFZg1FTeYyEh1PovAe1SoL.jpg) En general, no existe un medicamento específico para los ataques de pánico. Sin embargo, puedes experimentar opresión en el pecho temporalmente, para lo cual puedes tomar propanol 20 mg. Este medicamento puede brindarte alivio temporal. Sin embargo, el medicamento por sí solo nunca es suficiente. Además del medicamento, necesitas realizar otras actividades. Antes de esto, sufría de ataques de pánico. Tomé medicamentos recetados por el médico, quien también me dio algunos consejos. A continuación, se presenta un breve resumen de estos consejos: - Levántate muy temprano por la mañana. Después de despertarte, bebe un vaso de agua fría y camina durante al menos 40 minutos. Disfruta del aire fresco de la mañana. - Toma el sol durante al menos una hora al día. La vitamina D del sol fortalece el sistema inmunológico. Además, realiza ejercicio ligero. Sin ejercicio, es fundamental mantener una buena salud. - Haz deporte por la tarde. Hacer deporte te hará sudar y fortalecerá tu sistema inmunológico. Además, mediante la sudoración, se quemará el exceso de grasa corporal y mejorará la circulación sanguínea. Como resultado, tu cuerpo estará sano y se eliminarán problemas como la opresión en el pecho y la mala circulación. Eviten la comida rápida y grasosa. La comida rápida y grasosa es muy perjudicial para la salud. Por supuesto, debemos ser conscientes de lo que cenamos. Debemos cenar bien por la noche y acostarnos al menos dos horas después. El médico me dio estas sugerencias para un paciente con ataques de pánico. Al principio, las seguí y obtuve muy buenos resultados. Sin embargo, me cuesta mucho levantarme por la mañana. Cuanto más duermo, más duermo. Así que creo que si quiero estar tan sano como antes, debo volver a dormirme y levantarme rápidamente. Actualmente, sufro ataques de pánico. Si quiero estar sano, debo seguir las reglas anteriores. Además, debo tomar medicamentos del grupo del propanol. Les envío mis mejores deseos y espero mantenerme sano. Si ya sufren de opresión en el pecho y ataques de pánico, pueden seguir estas instrucciones. Espero que les ayuden a mantener una buena salud. Muchas gracias por compartir mi experiencia hoy. ![18.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/EoAUXZjGAPyY3oMMK4f3oHgNhH1gR25mTMmu7pBuiWx6a2eAfCbUiUbmkLz3qgzSuJv.png) ### **ENGLISH**
We all want to be healthy. We are constantly struggling to stay healthy and we have to take medicine constantly. Especially we consider human life worthwhile when we are healthy and well. We have to do a lot of things to stay healthy. Especially after waking up in the morning, we freshen up and have a healthy breakfast in the morning. After breakfast, we do our normal work and then take a bath in the afternoon. After taking a bath in the afternoon, we have lunch in the afternoon. We rest for some time and then in the afternoon we continue our various activities. Basically, however, I have lost all the activities of my life and have lost the key to staying healthy. Because currently I am a patient of panic attack. Its problem is constantly killing me and I am having various problems including chest tightness. ![20260427_154811.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/23wqtwVcy3ShWfr4BLkASBBoMBpSQVQPru4M6KfGFd97pQbCnPXUwabcdwUpMb9m9RtBs.jpg) Last night I was sleeping after eating. I finished dinner at 9 pm and watched some drama for entertainment at night. After finishing the drama, my wife and I cleaned the room and went to sleep. After sleeping, I slept for about an hour and then suddenly my chest started pounding and I felt very scared. I took a medicine very quickly. After taking the medicine, I fell asleep peacefully and I thought my problem was solved. But after a while, that problem attacked me again. My chest started pounding and I felt very scared of death. There was only one fear in my mind, maybe I will die after some time. The room seemed very small for me and everything seemed to be separated from me. My sleep was almost forbidden due to panic attacks at night. I took medicine at night and then went to sleep. But this kept happening to me again and I faced such problem almost three times in a night. Every time I tried to sleep, I failed. Finally I drank a glass of cold water and then I tossed and turned for a while. Then I rested and went to sleep at night and I slept peacefully the whole night and there were no problems after that. ![20260427_154658.heic](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bestrakibul2/EoGxxQ9NG7zEQN688VkL73fj4KsGZ1up7XyDDMdYjaccRgFZg1FTeYyEh1PovAe1SoL.jpg) Generally, there is no specific medicine for panic attacks. However, you can get temporary problems for chest tightness and for this you can take propanol 20 brand medicine. It can give you temporary relief. However, medicine alone can never be enough for you. Apart from medicine, you need to complete some other activities. Before this, I had a problem of panic attacks. I took medicine from the doctor and along with this the doctor also gave me some advice. Below is a brief presentation of the advice. -Wake up very early in the morning. After waking up, you should drink a glass of cold water and walk for at least 40 minutes. Enjoy the fresh air in the morning - You should enjoy sunlight for at least 1 hour throughout the day. Vitamin D in sunlight will increase your body's immunity. Along with this, you should do light exercise. Because without exercise, you can never be healthy - You must do sports in the afternoon. Doing sports will make your body sweat and increase your body's immunity. In addition, through sweating, excess fat in the body will melt and the blood circulation in the body will improve. As a result, your body will be healthy and all problems like chest tightness and blood circulation will be eliminated. - Avoid oily and fast food. Fast food and oily food are very harmful to our body. Of course, we have to be conscious about eating dinner. We have to finish dinner in the evening and go to sleep at least 2 hours after eating. The doctor gave me these suggestions for a panic attack patient. At first, I followed these suggestions and got very good results. However, waking up in the morning is a very difficult thing for me. Because the more mornings I sleep, the more I sleep. So I think that if I want to be healthy like before, I have to go to sleep and wake up very quickly again. Currently, I am a panic attack patient. If I want to be healthy, I must follow the above rules again. And along with this, I must take propanol group medicine. I wish everyone this prayer and hope that I can stay healthy. If you are already suffering from chest tightness and panic attacks, you can follow the above instructions. I hope the above instructions will help you maintain good health. Thank you very much for posting my real experience today.

body.title: My Actifit Report Card: April 27 2026
body.body:
![image](https://pixabay.com/get/gcb94d8ddc58268bf5f0aa6ceddd8e61a53cfdc76116f4ce2183f485439f2d30db761f544442cb783e493a173fded837f8d6970b02410b0fcba6a577bcb4dca0b_640.jpg)
Hoy fue un día maravilloso para caminar por la ciudad. El clima estaba perfecto, con una brisa suave y un sol radiante. Al salir, me encontré con un grupo de artistas en una plaza, pintando murales coloridos en una pared. Me detuve a admirar su trabajo y conversé con una de las artistas, que me contó que el proyecto busca embellecer el barrio y fomentar la creatividad en la comunidad. Más adelante, pasé por un parque donde vi a un grupo de personas practicando yoga al aire libre. Me uní a ellos por unos minutos y fue revitalizante. Hablé con una de las instructoras, que me dijo que hacen estas sesiones gratuitas todos los sábados para promover el bienestar y la conexión con la naturaleza. Cada caminata es una nueva aventura, y hoy fue un recordatorio de lo vibrante y lleno de vida que puede ser mi vecindario. ¡Espero que mañana sea igual de emocionante! _This report was published via Actifit app ([Android](https://bit.ly/actifit-app) | [iOS](https://bit.ly/actifit-ios)). Check out the original version [here on actifit.io](https://actifit.io/@titusfrost/actifit-titusfrost-20231229t015511428z)_

title.title: Café, una historia breve de amor [ESP]
title.body: >Qué alimento noble es el café, por el amor de Dios... Puede ser usado sin ningún tipo de horarios, es una bebida que también se puede degustar fría, caliente, tibia. Con azúcar, sin azúcar. Combinada con otros ingredientes; leche, cacao, chocolate, canela, avena, etc... Puede servir para juntar a dos personas que no se conocen, e iniciar un camino hacia el más ardido romance; o servir como un amable \

en una cita... En mi caso, durante las últimas horas de mi fin de semana, fue el acompañante de mi viernes por la noche...

*\n\n*

>Les doy un poco de contexto, ¿vale? Mi novio y yo teníamos demasiado, en serio; no exagero, muchísimo tiempo sin salir por ahí; los dos solos, sin niños no distracciones a nuestro alrededor una noche juntos. Si mi memoria no me fall, creo que desde octubre del pasado año no nos permitíamos compartir el tiempo para dedicárselo al otro. Ya saben, cuando una pareja tiene una cita, no es como cuando la mayoría de las personas salen de cita... Al menos, no con nosotros. Solemos reservar esa acción para avivar la flama de nuestra relación y demostrarnos (y este punto es clave) que todavía está intacta la disposición a querer estar el uno con el otro.

* ![IMG_20250117_223125_194.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23x16oAmQVm7cT4A6Cw4uscBFTkRXypqERqPGxhNAUb5SsXGJaZdTMwfbnyEe4NtVTn3m.jpg) ![IMG_20250118_185001_822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xKjoPy5vDJSrjoBR4BBB4FbtUE9d9An8K2yiBurEzNX2MQuZSsUAUviort6Z2PHn8Fs.jpg) ![20250117_063733.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23yTgy56ZAQyFV9g5TNJTYmE2EnYMst7gwHywWLGjcsJLzBzwf3oqvX8mkiqacZo6rtkG.jpg) *

>Entonces, ahí estaba yo... Es un hermoso bar-restaurant con nadie más que mi pareja, de noche, los dos juntos y con energías e intercambiando miradas (en serio, amo esa parte. Se enciende la electricidad. Y no, no hablo de corriente...). Los cafés se suceden el uno al otro. Algunos slices de postres acompañan la ocasión, y aún siento como mujer que 5 años han pasado pero aun deseo estar al lado del ser que ha inspirado; no sólo este post sino muchas otras cosas más... A veces, a buen entendedor, pocas son las palabras que deban ser expresadas.

*\n\n*
. Previamente habíamos cenado, pero el espacio para el \
aún estaba intacto. No me creo una gurú en absolutamente nada pero créanme cuando les digo, que siempre hay que dejar lugar para los \
. Tengo en sentido literal como figurativamente. El coffee break, en esta oportunidad fue tan solo el \

, lo que allí sucedió inspiró otras cosas, pero lo que cada vez me queda más claro, es que definitivamente nunca se ha tratado de un presupuestos o de presumir. Es absolutamente más valioso, para mí, tener la iniciativa para pasar (juntos) una noche fenomenal, que creer que no será así porque no tienes dinero...

* ![IMG_20250117_204345_947.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23vsHwm6xKy4vwuWS5QvD5RNpHKKACfuMkWQvGEKxnLmeXhLyzTP9ExxcnMvubDRgaBBX.jpg) ![IMG_20250117_205604_410.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chris-chris92/23xeZ9JPPPf9oNA13UgDDYHXP1iuEYkHLFojLEEtqKwFrg6hNwQDJZx7ZeMa4PqxvGHT9.jpg) *
>En este último punto, me refiero en líneas generales a aquéllas personas que aman las excusas. Yo no fui con la idea inequívoca de que iría a \

con mi novio. Sólo quisimos acompañan nuestra cita con la bebida que no tiene ni horarios, ni conoce de momentos malos, ni jamás molesta; el café. Si me apuran, casi todos los momentos más memorables de mi vida, en algún punto incluyen al café en alguna parte de esos días memorables. Él pasado viernes, tampoco fue la excepción. Siempre habrá excusas, estando en pareja, para posponer el romance pero como sucede con el café, decidimos dar un sorbo más y disfrutar de nuestro momento... Para mí, eso es una historia de amor.

* https://youtu.be/cHrNTR05voQ?is=OXCup2Oxq2dQQ9Sd ***

title.title: Star Trek: Discovery, Season 1, Episode 2, Review
title.body: > Hello friends, I hope everyone is well. Today I am going to share my own feelings after watching Star Trek: Discovery,y Season 1, Episode 2. The first episode ended with many questions, but the second episode increased the excitement a few more steps. I honestly could not take my eyes off this episode. Because not only the war, but also the fear, decisions and the value of mistakes inside people are shown very beautifully. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmWi2hZXqpKbDcL6EyXDjHdKVGPxEiPfp62v6vdepHEtbN/IMG_20260427_180657.png First of all, I have to talk about the character Michael Burnham. The situation went very badly because of the decision he made in the previous episode. In this episode, he is seen in captivity. There was a regret on his face, and there was also strength inside. He understands that everything is out of hand, but still, he did not give up. I found Michael very realistic as a character. Just as people break down when they make mistakes, they also try to fix themselves. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPrJecRKptjYYpsVkACVkDNk75qLzF1CCAsQK4hJ3SCz3/Screenshot_2026_0427_180253.jpg Captain Philippa Georgiou was very emotional in this episode. Although the shadow of the previous incident was present throughout the entire episode, her leadership, courage, and faith in Michael were not easily forgotten. There was a maternal tenderness in her character, but also firmness in difficult times. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmfGTLRSQRD5k4U6bXGtM7HyizDzGbtP1LtjnbZ88bRfJZ/Screenshot_2026_0427_180402.jpg Then comes the new ship USS Discovery. After seeing this ship, it seemed that the story was going in a new direction. The atmosphere inside the ship, the behaviour of the crew, the technology—everything had a different mystery. There was a lot more tension here than on the previous ship. Captain Gabriel Lorca caught the most attention. The character seemed different at first glance. He is not calm like ordinary Starfleet captains, but has the toughness of war. The way he speaks, his eyes, his decision-making style—all together, it seemed that he is a man who wants results, and will see the rules later. This type of character makes the story more interesting. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRat3VdUVYgrYEwSLS5reUQYinjj24xvnCmLEcT3jvghA/Screenshot_2026_0427_180151.jpg Another important character is Saru. Although he was not seen for long in this episode, his presence can still be felt as before. His ability to sense fear and his tendency to always anticipate danger make him stand out. The episode also features some new faces who are the Discovery crew. Some of them are curious, some are sceptical, and some do not see Burnham in a good light. This felt real. Because not everyone accepts someone who makes a mistake easily. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRD862BkxZbKhm7tAwv3R5TgwQdMsba8eVGnD1BkLobom/Screenshot_2026_0427_180226.jpg The best part of this episode was its ability to create tension. Not too much talk anywhere, not too much drama anywhere—everything progressed slowly in such a way that you are interested in watching the next scene. The aftermath of the war, life in prison, a new start on a new ship—all of it was a great balance. https://img.leopedia.io/DQmPFz9i9SZRwdi7NH9z5AcskbbrRw3uzXsjYyBxjCwdVGH/Screenshot_2026_0427_180445.jpg While watching the scenes in this episode, I repeatedly felt that the creators had created even the smallest details with importance. The lighting inside the ship, the design of the walls, the work of the control panels—everything combined made the places feel alive. The tense atmosphere that was created after the war was also well conveyed through the scenes. Many times, they conveyed the feeling just by showing the environment without any dialogue. This episode not only showed what would happen next, but also how a person tries to cope after making a bad decision. Burnham seemed to be broken inside, but he didn't want to show it on the outside. This conflict was the most real to me. The story is only interesting when the characters seem human—and that's what I got here. Overall, this episode made me want to watch the next episode even more. The new ship, the new face, the unknown plan—everything combined to give me the feeling that something big was waiting ahead. I personally wasn't disappointed by this episode, but I felt like the story was starting to get into its proper place now. Those who like series that build up slowly will enjoy this part. > IMDb Rating: 7.4/10 Rotten Tomatoes: 88% Tomatometer Release Date: 24 September 2017 Episode Title: Battle at the Binary Stars https://youtu.be/O2cSP25ye6g?si=8yUdwe5eCTcocgOv [All images screenshot by watching movie]() Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@mirzaiqi/star-trek-discovery-season-1-episode-2-review-ath)

title.title: Data-Driven Football Forecasting for the Modern Analyst
title.body: The football analytics revolution has democratized access to information that was once the exclusive domain of club insiders and professional betting syndicates. Today, anyone with an internet connection can access expected goals data, player heat maps, and predictive models. However, access alone does not guarantee insight. The proliferation of forecasting platforms has created a new challenge: separating tools that offer genuine analytical value from those that simply repackage basic statistics in attractive visual formats. For professional users—journalists covering multiple leagues, content creators seeking data-backed angles, or strategic bettors building models—the ability to identify reliable prediction sources is an essential skill.\n\nOne platform that has established a presence in this space is <a href=\

>footyprediction.com . The resource provides daily probabilistic forecasts across a broad range of domestic and international football competitions, from top-tier European leagues to secondary divisions and cup tournaments. From a professional standpoint, the platform's primary utility lies in its consistency and coverage breadth. Rather than cherry-picking high-profile matches, it applies a uniform methodology across thousands of fixtures annually, allowing users to compare predicted probabilities across different leagues and time periods. This standardization is particularly valuable for analysts who need to quickly assess a large volume of matches, whether for preview articles, betting research, or scouting reports. While the platform does not claim to be infallible—no responsible forecasting tool would—its structured outputs provide a defensible baseline for further qualitative analysis.\n\nNo predictive model, regardless of its sophistication, can fully account for football's inherent randomness. A single refereeing decision, an unexpected injury, a moment of individual brilliance, or a controversial VAR call can overturn even the most carefully calibrated probability distribution. Professional users of

>footyprediction.com therefore treat its forecasts as a starting point rather than a conclusion. The most effective analytical workflows combine automated predictions with qualitative intelligence: injury updates, tactical observations, motivational factors, and real-time market movements. As the football calendar continues to expand—with the 2026 World Cup introducing a 48-team format and unprecedented logistical variables—the demand for accessible, consistent, and methodologically transparent forecasting tools will only grow. Platforms that prioritize these qualities over promotional hype will remain valuable resources for analysts who require defensible, repeatable baselines for their work.

title.body:
A new campaign is now live on XOOB in collaboration with [Nomisma Network](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d), 90-day campaign featuring an initial $100,000 USDC reward pool designed to reward both influence and real user activity.

As participation grows the pool can scale up to $500,000, with additional rewards unlocked through key milestone achievements. The pool is shared between CPA and ImpactShare

[Nomisma Network](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) as an early-stage blockchain project building an AI-focused DeFi infrastructure layer. It aims to support decentralized applications by using a “subchain” model.

Their collaboration with [XOOB Network](https://www.xoob.link/?ref=60867e779d) signals something bigger! If they execute it well, the next few months could see a lot more visibility around this kind of modular, data-first approach.

Early architectures work fine for simple transactions, but once you start layering in advanced DeFi strategies, real-time data feeds, or anything even remotely AI-driven, cracks start to show.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmQfvYfTgor4b3tHA6PUKUpFJDzYtsHaVSZtufFk19kTFj/image.png)


Throughput becomes a bottleneck, latency creeps in, and suddenly “decentralized” apps rely on off-chain computation or patched-in solutions just to function.

And that’s where the quiet compromise happens. A lot of projects end up leaning on Web2-style infrastructure with centralized APIs to keep things running smoothly.

This is where [Nomisma Network](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) is trying to shift the conversation. The focus is on enabling data-rich DeFi at scale, with an architecture that’s designed from the ground up to handle complexity.

You will need a [Nomizen ID](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) to be eligible for the rewards in Season 3. The positive part is that this can be minted straight away. The bad part is the $7 fee needed for the mint.


![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ4bdA3wpi7dJV4BWWmM3VgAgqMJtv7CpTzQBEZH1yfKW/image.png)


The [XOOB](https://www.xoob.link/?ref=60867e779d) x [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) campaign has two pools for the participants. From the base $100,000 there is a $75,000 CPA Pool is distributed instantly upon verified user actions.

The remaining $25k in the ImpactShare Pool are distributed at the end of the campaign based on your total contribution and overall impact. The reward can go 5x based on participation.

Once you mint your [Nomizen ID](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) you can enrol for S3 quests and rewards! Mint Mystery Boxes for testnet [$USDT](https://x.com/search?q=%24USDT&src=cashtag_click) or points multipliers! Both social and onchain action matters.

Each Mystery Box gives you one chanse to earn rewards and increase your season multiplier. Multiplier rewards boost points from all Season 3 activities.

Your multiplier stacks up to ×5 max, and after that the [Nomisma](https://nomisma.network/?ref=60867e779d) Mystery Boxes drop only testnet USDT. Results are provably fair and based on a hash + server seed.

I went to check and wasn't suprised by the $2 price per box. Minted one and was lucky to hit 800 testnet USDT, which had 6% drop rate. Was lucky for my first try... so LFG!

title.body:
# “disfruta el día y no confíes en el mañana”
<sup><sup>Esta frase - del poeta romano Horacio</sup></sup>
</center>

----------


![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png)

<div class=\

> # Mi amanecer de todos los lunes # Hoy lunes 27 de abril, cuarto y último lunes del mes, y ya eso solo me da un motivo para agradecer, agradezco por eso y por mucho más, porque llegué, porque estoy aquí, porque respiro, doy gracias al universo y a mi vida cuántica por todo, por mi hogar, por mis hijas y por mi esposa, y por supuesto por mi familia y familiares y amigos. A veces las cosas no son como uno quiere que sean, a veces el cuerpo y la vida se comportan de manera diferente a lo que uno quiere que se comporten, ejemplo últimamente no me he sentido muy bien ni en el cuerpo por decirlo así, ni en la vida por decirlo así, uno está relacionado con posible sentimiento de cansancio y refleja en algunas dolencias muchas veces solomos llamarlo almanaque, y en otro en la vida a veces no es lo que uno quiere que sea y eso pasa por las deficiencias que están relacionadas en lo que nos toca vivir. Hoy desperté desde las 3 de la madrugada simplemente no podía dormir, pensando en mi cuerpo y en mi vida, y a pesar de lo mal que me pueda sentir hablo seriamente con mi mente para decirle que debo seguir adelante que no me puedo dejar vencer por mis dolencias ni mucho menos por la vida, yo decido seguir yo decido luchar contra todo mal sentimiento corporal o contra todo lo que me haga daño en la vida, suena a cliché, pero las cosas que nos pasan que no son de nuestro agrado nos hacen más fuerte. Definitivamente, me doy cuenta de que la mente positiva ayuda mucho en seguir en medio de las flaquezas que nos presenta el cuerpo y la vida, yo en medio de mi positivismo es lo que me ayuda a seguir y como no hacerlo si la misma vida que te golpea, es la que te ofrece seguir adelante desde que apenas abres los ojos para saber que estás frente a un nuevo día. Hoy es lunes y es mi lunes motivacional, lunes donde comienza una nueva oportunidad a pesar de lo mal que me pueda sentir. # Como dice el refrán… El sol no espera por nadie. Pero siempre sale para todos. Así que me levanto, tomo esta foto del cielo que no se rinde, y escribo para recordarme que aún estoy aquí. Y mientras esté aquí, hay camino. Solo dedícate a ser feliz. Encuentra tu luz, segundo a segundo. --------------- ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUxUivGR4Y3wCqxfRozB4rXNKyPyhYvrwGsP2ndueh2p6/imagen.png) # My Monday Morning Sunrise # Today, Monday, April 27th, the fourth and last Monday of the month, and that alone gives me a reason to be grateful; I am thankful for that and for so much more, because I made it, because I am here, because I breathe. I give thanks to the universe and to my quantum life for everything, for my home, for my daughters, and for my wife, and of course for my family, relatives, and friends. Sometimes things are not the way one wants them to be; sometimes the body and life behave differently than how one wants them to behave. For example, lately I haven't been feeling very well, neither in my body, so to speak, nor in life, so to speak. One is related to a possible feeling of fatigue and reflects in some ailments—we often tend to call it the 'almanac' (age)—and the other, in life, sometimes it isn't what one wants it to be, and that happens due to the deficiencies related to what we have to live through. Today I woke up at 3 in the morning; I simply couldn't sleep, thinking about my body and my life. Despite how bad I may feel, I talk seriously with my mind to tell it that I must move forward, that I cannot let myself be defeated by my ailments, much less by life. I decide to continue, I decide to fight against every bad bodily feeling or against everything that hurts me in life. It sounds like a cliché, but the things that happen to us that are not to our liking make us stronger. Definitely, I realize that a positive mind helps a lot in continuing amidst the weaknesses presented by the body and life. Within my positivism, it is what helps me go on, and how could I not, if the same life that hits you is the one that offers you to move forward from the moment you barely open your eyes to know that you are facing a new day. Today is Monday and it is my motivational Monday, a Monday where a new opportunity begins despite how bad I may feel. As the saying goes… The sun waits for no one, but it always rises for everyone. So, I get up, I take this photo of a sky that doesn't give up, and I write to remind myself that I am still here. And as long as I am here, there is a path. Just focus on being happy. Find your light, second by second. # ![imagen.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTCmV1D9ktNGQbGc68NXWqFUsJAVi4NKqwzzSUXtXEGEG/imagen.png) ---------- Todas las fotos son de mi propiedad ## Ahora te invito a visitar el proyecto [DRIP - WITNESS NODE - BPUD](https://inleo.io/@bradleyarrow/drip-witness-node-bpud-2a2)

title.body:
Hey Risingstar Lovers and Great Lions!

Two days ago, I fell while riding my motorcycle.
My body hurt.
I couldn't use my right hand.
That's why I couldn't do my regular income-generating work.
So I'm resting at home.
My income is low because I'm resting.
I need to run some kind of business that makes money without working.
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmTXFKB3aqjno6Xg3bSHNsiu3FkqaJLLkxxRQAoKrTQNvo/1000003034.jpg 

Now I am not happy.
I want to be happy but I can't.
Living in Myanmar, which is full of difficulties and troubles, I have put happiness aside.
I am only working to survive.

Today, the pain has eased a bit, so I used my phone to listen to a song on YouTube.
I'm sharing the lyrics of a song that doesn't disappoint even though it's uncomfortable at times.
Listen to the song \

sung by singer Han Htun.

https://youtu.be/2RwIgLaC7n0?si=qpttl6JVHfBNM_lv


**I am still living my life waiting for happiness.
When will happiness come to my life?
The wrong path blows are endless.
I will not give up. 
I am still living my life dreaming of something.
I have not found a partner to face?
I will not escape from the cruel twist.
I will not give up .
It is not easy.
Life is meaningless.
It is not easy.
Love is also meaningless.
I cannot be happy. 
I am always wrong.
I am not disappointed.
Even if I wait for the opportunity of fate, time passes.
It is difficult, I will never get it.
I am lost in the madness of life and love.
I will endure it, I will not be disappointed.
It is not easy, I am still very difficult.
Cruelty is also not easy.
I am not disappointed even if I am not loved.**

လွန်ခဲ့သော နှစ်ရက်က ကျွန်တော် ဆိုင်ကယ်စီရင်း ချော်လဲခဲ့သည်။
ခန္ဓာကိုယ် တစ်ခြမ်း နာကျင်ခဲ့ရသည်။
ညာဘက်လက် အသုံးပြုရ အဆင်မပြေ ဖြစ်ခဲ့သည်။
ဒါကြောင့် ကျွန်တော် ဝင်ငွေရလမ်းအလုပ်တွေ ပုံမှန် မလုပ်ဆောင်နိုင်ပါ။
ဒီတော့ အိမ်မှာ အနားယူနေရသည်။
အနားယူနေရတော့ ဝင်ငွေ လျော့နည်းရသည်။
အလုပ်မလုပ်ဘဲ ငွေဝင်နေသော စီးပွားရေးတစ်မျိုးမျိုး စီမံထားနိုင်မှ အဆင်ပြေမည်။

ခုတော့ ကျွန်တော် အဆင်မပြေသေးပါ။
ပျော်ချင်ပေမယ့်လည်း မပျော်နိုင်သေးပါ။
အခက်အခဲဒုက္ခပေါင်းများစွာ ပြည့်စုံနေသော မြန်မာနိုင်ငံအတွင်းမှာ နေထိုင်ရင်း ပျော်စရာကို ဘေးဖယ်ထားရပါတယ်။
ဘဝ ရပ်တည်ရှင်သန်နိုင်ရေးကိုသာ အဓိက လုပ်ဆောင်နေရပါတယ်။

ဒီနေ့တော့ နာကျင်မှုဝေဒနာ အနည်းငယ် သက်‌သာလာသောကြောင့် Phone ကို အသုံးပြုကာ YouTube မှာ သီချင်းနားဆင်ဖြစ်ခဲ့ပါတယ်။
အဆင်မပြေချိန်လေးမှာ အဆင်မပြေပေမယ့် စိတ်မပျက်တဲ့ သီချင်းစာသားကို မျှဝေပေးလိုက်ပါတယ်။
အဆိုတော် ဟန်ထွန်း သီဆိုထားသည့် \

အမည်ရသော သီချင်းလေး နားဆင်ကြည့်ပါလား။

အပျော်တွေကို စောင့်ရင်း ဘဝကို ဆက်လျှောက်နေဆဲ ။
အပျော်တွေ ဘယ်နေ့ ဘဝဆီ ဆိုက်ရောက်လာမလဲ။
လမ်းကြောင်းမှားယွင်းတဲ့ ထိုးနှက်ချက်တွေ မကုန်နိုင်သေးဘူး။
ငါ စိတ်မလျှော့ဘူး။
တစုံတရာကို မက်ရင်း ဘဝကို အသက်ဆက်ရှင်တုန်း။
အတူ ရင်ဆိုင်ဖော်လည်း မတွေ့ခဲ့ပါလား။
ရက်စက်တဲ့ လှည့်ကွက်ထဲက ထွက်မပြေးဘူး။
ငါ စိတ်မလျှော့ဘူး။
အဆင်မပြေဘူး။
ဘဝက အဓိပ္ပါယ်မဲ့။
အဆင်မပြေဘူး။
အချစ်လည်း အဓိပ္ပါယ်မဲ့။
မပျော်နိုင်သေးဘူး။
အမြဲလွဲနေတယ်။
ရေး စိတ်မပျက်ဘူး။
ကံကြမ္မာရဲ့ အခွင့်အရေး တို့စောင့်နေလည်း အချိန်တွေသာ ကုန်သွား။
ခက်တယ်၊ တစ်ကြိမ်မှ မရ။
ဘဝနှင့်အချစ်ရဲ့ မိုက်ပြစ် ရင်ထဲစူး။
ခံလိုက်မယ်၊ စိတ်မပျက်ဘူး။
အဆင်မပြေဘူး၊ ငါ သိပ်ခက်တုန်းဘဲ။
ရက်စက်ခြင်းများလည်း အို မကုန်နိုင်သေးဘူး။

title.title: How to Choose the Right Interior Expert for Your Dream Space?
title.body:
Creating a beautiful and functional space requires more than just good taste. It involves planning, creativity, and a clear understanding of how design impacts everyday living. Whether it is a home, office, or commercial setup, the right design can transform the way a space feels and functions. This is where hiring the [Best Interior Decorators In Chandigarh](https://www.mk-enterprises.in/best-interior-decorators-in-chandigarh/) becomes essential.

Chandigarh is known for its modern architecture and well-planned layout, making it a hub for stylish and practical interiors. With growing demand, many decorators now offer customized solutions that match both aesthetic preferences and lifestyle needs. Choosing the right professional ensures that your vision turns into reality without unnecessary stress.



![Best Interior Decorators In Chandigarh (9).png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/d17a55159fdcfd534e99b21a91f618059c5cf69065fc2cc43a026a2b2206434d)



***



### Why Interior Decoration Matters

Interior decoration is not just about making a space look attractive. It directly affects comfort, productivity, and mood. A well-designed home can create a peaceful environment, while a thoughtfully planned office can improve efficiency and creativity.

Professional decorators understand how to balance colors, lighting, furniture, and layout. They focus on both beauty and functionality, ensuring that every element serves a purpose. This approach helps in making the most of available space while maintaining a cohesive design.

In a city like Chandigarh, where modern living meets organized infrastructure, interior design plays a key role in enhancing lifestyle standards.



***



### What Services Do Interior Decorators Offer?

When you work with the Best Interior Decorators In Chandigarh, you gain access to a wide range of services tailored to your needs.

#### Space Planning

Decorators analyze your space and create layouts that maximize usability and flow. This ensures that every corner is used effectively.

#### Furniture Selection

They help you choose furniture that fits your style and space. The focus is on comfort, durability, and visual appeal.

#### Color and Material Selection

Choosing the right colors and materials can completely change the look of a space. Professionals guide you in selecting combinations that match your vision.

#### Lighting Design

Lighting plays a crucial role in setting the mood. Decorators plan lighting that enhances both functionality and aesthetics.

#### Custom Decor Solutions

From wall art to accessories, decorators add finishing touches that bring personality to your space.



***



### Why Chandigarh Is a Hub for Modern Interiors

Chandigarh stands out for its clean design and urban planning. This makes it an ideal place for innovative interior solutions. The city has a mix of traditional and modern influences, allowing decorators to experiment with different styles.

Professionals in this region stay updated with the latest trends and technologies. They understand the preferences of local clients and offer designs that reflect both global styles and cultural elements.

If you are interested in learning this creative field, you can also explore [Interior Designing in Chandigarh](https://www.mk-enterprises.in/interior-designing-in-chandigarh/), which provides the skills needed to build a career in this industry.



***



### Key Qualities to Look for in an Interior Decorator

Choosing the right decorator is an important decision. Here are some qualities that can help you identify the right professional:

#### Experience and Expertise

Experienced decorators bring practical knowledge and creative ideas to the table. They can handle challenges effectively and deliver better results.

#### Strong Portfolio

A portfolio showcases previous work and gives you an idea of the decorator’s style and capabilities.

#### Communication Skills

Clear communication ensures that your ideas are understood and implemented correctly.

#### Attention to Detail

Small details make a big difference in interior design. A good decorator focuses on every element to create a polished look.

#### Budget Management

A professional decorator helps you achieve your desired design without exceeding your budget.



***



### Benefits of Hiring a Professional

Working with the Best Interior Decorators In Chandigarh offers several advantages. First, it saves time and effort. Instead of managing everything on your own, you get expert guidance throughout the process.

Second, professionals have access to quality materials and reliable vendors. This ensures better results and long-lasting designs. They also help you avoid costly mistakes by making informed decisions.

Another major benefit is customization. Decorators create designs that reflect your personality and lifestyle, making your space truly unique.



***



### Latest Trends in Interior Decoration

Interior design trends continue to evolve, and staying updated can help you create a modern and stylish space.

#### Minimalist Design

Clean lines, neutral colors, and simple layouts are becoming increasingly popular.

#### Sustainable Materials

Eco-friendly materials are gaining attention as people become more conscious about the environment.

#### Smart Homes

Technology integration, such as automated lighting and smart appliances, is shaping modern interiors.

#### Multi-Functional Spaces

With changing lifestyles, spaces are designed to serve multiple purposes, especially in smaller homes.



***



### How to Get Started

If you are planning to redesign your space, start by defining your goals. Think about your needs, preferences, and budget. Research different decorators and review their portfolios before making a decision.

Schedule consultations to discuss your ideas and understand their approach. This will help you choose a professional who aligns with your vision.

Planning and collaboration are key to achieving the best results. With the right guidance, you can create a space that is both beautiful and functional.



***



### Conclusion

Designing a space is a personal and meaningful process. It reflects your style, personality, and way of living. By choosing the Best Interior Decorators In Chandigarh, you ensure that your space is designed with expertise, creativity, and attention to detail.

From planning to execution, professional decorators make the journey smooth and enjoyable. Whether you want a modern home or a functional workspace, the right expert can bring your ideas to life.

Investing in quality interior design not only enhances the look of your space but also improves your overall lifestyle.



***



### FAQs

1\. How do I choose the right interior decorator?
Look for experience, portfolio, client reviews, and communication skills before making a decision.

2\. What is the cost of hiring an interior decorator in Chandigarh?
The cost varies depending on the size of the project and the services required.

3\. How long does an interior design project take?
The timeline depends on the complexity of the project, but most projects take a few weeks to a few months.

4\. Can I customize my design according to my preferences?
Yes, professional decorators offer customized solutions based on your needs and style.

5\. Do interior decorators handle furniture and materials?
Yes, they assist in selecting furniture, materials, and decor elements.

6\. Is hiring a decorator worth it?
Yes, it saves time, reduces stress, and ensures a well-designed and functional space.

title.title: Digimon Survive [Let's Play] - 72 - Decision Point
title.body:
***Truthful Route: Session 19! Takuma and Miyuki find themselves in the human world. But Piedmon also follows them! The shrine keeping the master in place is in ruins too.***


-----

**Digimon Survive** is a Digimon Visual Novel with Turn-based strategy battles. It follows a group of children stranded in another world. They form bonds with the creators there called Digimon as they desperate attempts to find a way back home. I already finished one route of the game, and now I'm publishing my playthrough of the Truthful Route!

 
 https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRTpjMkA68Lf7sVJ4WUwvFGpBcUoiXDKVKqaAWqiJMYCN/1000072335.webp 

 


Digimon Survive is the darkest piece of Digimon media I ever consumed while still being PG13. What I love the most about **Digimon Survive**, is how it uniquely blends Digital Monsters with Japanese folklore. It's amazing how the idea of \

integrates seamlessly with Digimon lore. The specific Digimon they choose for this game enhance this theme.

Digimon Survive is the closest modern entry to the *old school* Digimon anime vibes. Though, more than the earlier Digimon anime series, the game reminds me more of **Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Survivor** series. In that series too, characters may die depending on your actions.

Below you can watch my playthrough of Digimon Survive, and the link to the whole playlist.

**THIS PLAYTHROUGH IS MODDED:** I installed the [Improved Translation Mod](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459533) and the [Quirky Dialogue Font Mod.](https://gamebanana.com/mods/459571) This playthrough should look a bit different from the official version.


----

### Watch on YouTube:


https://youtu.be/_1g9s7tQ_wg


**Playlist:**

```
 https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLt3R7_tP1xaH9mASCoJsRIYN96RihTAtI
```

### Truthful Route - 19: Decision Point


This is the human world section of the game, in which Takuma learns that time in the Digimon world and the Human world flows differently. For him, seven days have passed, but for the people in the human world, it's only been a few hours.

It's even worse for Miyuki... She's been missing for 50 years, so imagine how long it was for her in the digimon world? Hundreds? Even thousands of years?


----

Religion is not just an ordinary ritual or a worship it is a way which we connect with God. A good and real religion is a religion that talks about God and his love. It goes beyond external appearances and focuses on genuine devotion to God, guided by His Word and Spirit.

Religion can be fake and bad when it does not practice ways of God but following the ways of evil. People may follow rules, attend gatherings, and perform ceremonies, yet miss the deeper purpose of knowing God. True religion is shown in how a person lives demonstrating humility, righteousness, and care for others, especially the needy and vulnerable.

A true religion will always teach us to love one another no matter the condition we find ourselves. It involves living a life that reflects God’s character, not just observing traditions. Genuine religion produces good works, compassion, and a faithful walk with God, showing that it is not just about belief, but about a life changed from within.

title.title: Artemisia absinthium - Asteraceae (ENG/ITA)
title.body: > ### Artemisia absinthium - Asteraceae (ENG) Artemisia absinthium, commonly known as wormwood, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. It grows wild in Europe, Asia, and North Africa, preferring dry, sunny soils. ![assenzio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EnWKWafPrmxf9wBwQKF8hNC4mzta14pNgKcF9MCSYEJAvJsMv9EEvV96W3ZPjh1hYrk.png) image created with canva.com **The plant is characterized by silvery-gray leaves covered with fine hairs and an intense, bitter aroma, due to the high concentration of terpene compounds. It is cold-resistant and tolerates temperatures as low as -10°C, making it easy to grow even in continental climates.** The balsamic period coincides with the month of May, when the concentration of secondary metabolites is highest. The main constituents are thujones (α and β) and absinthine, responsible for the plant's bitter aroma and biological activities. Thujones, in particular, are neuroactive molecules that require caution when used. **Absinthe has moderate toxicity: high doses of thujones can cause neurotoxic effects such as hallucinations, irritability, and convulsions. The plant is also potentially abortive, which is why it should not be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Before using supplements or herbal preparations containing Artemisia absinthium, it is necessary to consult a healthcare professional.** Traditionally, wormwood is used as: a digestive aid, thanks to its bitter-tonic properties; a cholagogue and choleretic, promoting bile secretion. Among its confirmed properties, its repellent action stands out, useful against insects and parasites, used both in agriculture and in the home. **Infusion** It is prepared with 15 g of fresh leaves in 100 ml of water. Traditionally used to aid digestion due to its bitter ingredients. **Mother tincture** Obtained by macerating 15 g of chopped fresh leaves in 100 ml of a hydroalcoholic solution at 86° for 21 days. The filtrate can be kept for up to 3 years. Traditional use includes 100 drops per day, always after consulting a doctor. **Medicated wine** Prepared with 15 g of flowers and 15 g of dried leaves, macerated for 15 days in 1 liter of white wine. The filtrate can be kept for 6 months. Traditional use calls for 100 ml per day. **Absinthe is associated with one of the most famous beverages of the 19th century: the emerald green spirit created in 1798, with an alcohol content close to 70%. It became a symbol of the French bohemian era, consumed by poets, painters, and intellectuals who considered it a stimulating tonic and, according to the beliefs of the time, even an aphrodisiac.** Its controversial reputation led to restrictions and bans in several countries, primarily due to its thujone content. ![hive dividers.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/23t7BKexriBKviA9doWkBpvE3WA2yKQxfis1QCtDQU7rvAhxaNrDHcMfy5XLqadsaDEDf.png) ### Artemisia absinthium - Asteraceae (ITA) Artemisia absinthium, comunemente nota come assenzio maggiore, è un’erbacea perenne appartenente alla famiglia delle Asteraceae. Cresce spontanea in Europa, Asia e Nord Africa, prediligendo terreni aridi e soleggiati. ![fitoterapia.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/EoiW7vV1iNdbPAu48RSNX3FA44CE16HK74aEHuWEf5mZSMQWgTc91zo14mQKHWyiLLo.jpg) image created with canva.com **La pianta è caratterizzata da foglie grigio-argentee ricoperte da una fine peluria e da un aroma intenso e amaro, dovuto all’elevata concentrazione di composti terpenici. Resiste bene al freddo e tollera una temperatura minima di circa –10 °C, caratteristica che ne facilita la coltivazione anche in climi continentali.** Il periodo balsamico coincide con il mese di maggio, quando la concentrazione di metaboliti secondari è massima. I principali costituenti sono i tujoni (α e β) e l’absintina, responsabili dell’aroma amaro e delle attività biologiche della pianta. I tujoni, in particolare, sono molecole neuroattive che richiedono attenzione nell’uso. **L’assenzio presenta una tossicità media: dosi elevate di tujoni possono provocare effetti neurotossici come allucinazioni, irritabilità e convulsioni. La pianta è inoltre potenzialmente abortiva, motivo per cui non deve essere assunta in gravidanza o allattamento. Prima di utilizzare integratori o preparati fitoterapici a base di Artemisia absinthium è necessario consultare un professionista sanitario.** Tradizionalmente l’assenzio è impiegato come: digestivo, grazie all’azione amaro-tonica; colagogo e coleretico, favorendo la secrezione biliare. Tra le attività confermate, spicca quella repellente, utile contro insetti e parassiti, sfruttata sia in agricoltura sia in ambito domestico. **Infuso** Si prepara con 15 g di foglie fresche in 100 ml di acqua. Tradizionalmente utilizzato per favorire la digestione grazie al contenuto di principi amari. **Tintura madre** Ottenuta facendo macerare 15 g di foglie fresche sminuzzate in 100 ml di soluzione idroalcolica a 86° per 21 giorni. Il filtrato si conserva fino a 3 anni. L’uso tradizionale prevede 100 gocce al giorno, sempre previo parere medico. **Vino medicato** Preparato con 15 g di fiori e 15 g di foglie essiccate, macerati per 15 giorni in 1 litro di vino bianco. Il filtrato si conserva 6 mesi. L’impiego tradizionale prevede 100 ml al giorno. **L’assenzio è legato a una delle bevande più celebri dell’Ottocento: il distillato verde smeraldo creato nel 1798, con gradazione prossima ai 70°. Divenne simbolo della bohème francese, consumato da poeti, pittori e intellettuali che lo consideravano un tonico stimolante e, secondo le credenze dell’epoca, persino afrodisiaco.** La sua fama controversa portò a restrizioni e divieti in diversi Paesi, principalmente a causa del contenuto di tujoni. Sources - Fonti : https://www.my-personaltrainer.it/erboristeria/assenzio.html ![firmaGhilvar.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ghilvar/48SqxfhNw6nwwJEZACBwzAmKDssU5forXXdWSwLWVbz8NizZXvx3EVgejfYYTvq7cb.png) https://www.erbecedario.it/it/assenzio
