title.title: The Great April Finale: Trailers, Teenagers, and the \
Nettle Solution
title.body: />\n\nIs it just me, or is the Hive blockchain looking a little more shiny today? Probably because I haven’t been here to clutter it up for a while. Yes, I know, I’ve been gone. I’ve been an absentee landlord of my own blog, and frankly, my Hive wallet is starting to look like a dehydrated raisin. Every day I don’t post is a day I lose out on that sweet, sweet \

crypto, but life—as it usually does—decided to throw a wrench in my daily posting routine.

But I’m back. And I’ve brought stories. Because apparently, when I’m not typing, I’m busy trying to reverse a trailer into a hole while half of Flanders watches and judges my masculinity.

<h2 style=\

>The Final Whistle (and the Sound of Silence)\n\nCan you believe we are already at the tail end of April 2026? Time flies when you’re standing on the sidelines of a damp football pitch, smelling the distinct aroma of deep-fryer fat from the canteen while screaming at a teenager to \

This past weekend marked the end of the regular local amateur football competitions. It’s that magical time of year when the drama reaches its peak. We have the champions popping champagne, the relegated teams drowning their sorrows in cheap beer, and the \
preparing for the play-offs.\n\nIt’s the ultimate emotional rollercoaster. For some, it’s the \
a desperate, sweaty scramble for glory. For others, it’s the \

which is essentially the football equivalent of trying to fix a leak in a boat with a piece of chewing gum while the sharks circle.

But for me? The most important part is that the youth competition is over. Do you realize what this means? It means my weekends have been returned to me. I am no longer a high-speed shuttle service for muddy boots and sweaty jerseys. I am a free man. Or at least, I thought I was free until I looked at my garden.

<h2 style=\
Trauma\n\nWith my newfound weekend freedom, I decided to tackle the legendary \

(the local dump). For the uninitiated, the container park is not just a place to get rid of garden waste; it is a gladiatorial arena where your ability to reverse a trailer is tested in front of a live audience of grumpy employees and impatient neighbors.

I have an old, single-axle trailer. If you’ve ever tried to reverse one of these, you know they are the devil’s invention. Because the wheelbase is so short, the slightest flick of the steering wheel sends the trailer veering off at a 45-degree angle like a startled cat.

Adding to the stress is my Trailer PTSD. Two years ago, this very trailer decided it didn’t want to be attached to my car anymore. It unhooked itself on a slope, staged a \

and went on a solo mission until it crashed into a fence. Ever since then, every time I hitch it up, I have the recurring nightmare of it overtaking me on the highway and waving goodbye.\n\nI managed to empty the pruning waste without hitting anything this time, but the \

back into my driveway took approximately three years off my life expectancy. In Flanders, watching a man struggle with a trailer is basically a national sport, and I’m pretty sure I provided top-tier entertainment for the neighborhood.\n\n<h2 style=\

>The Lounge and the Forbidden Chemistry\n\nOnce the trailer was safely (and miraculously) parked, it was time to reclaim the outdoor lounge. After a winter of being a sanctuary for spiders and dust, it finally got its first real \

of the season. There is something deeply satisfying about scrubbing away the winter grime, even if you know the Sahara dust will probably return tomorrow to cover everything in a fine orange mist.\n\nHowever, the \

revealed a bigger problem: The Stinging Nettles. I went to the garden center to seek professional advice. I wanted something that would send these nettles to the afterlife permanently. The employee looked at me with a mixture of pity and bureaucratic frustration. \
\n\nThen, he leaned in, checked for hidden microphones, and gave me the \
\n\nSo there I was, standing in a garden center, feeling like I was in a spy movie, debating whether to go \
on a bunch of weeds. The war in the garden is real, folks.\n\n<h2 style=\

>The Grass is Always Greener (If You Drown It) While the nettles are thriving on neglect, my actual grass is acting like a spoiled celebrity. Three weeks ago, I mowed and re-seeded. The results? Mostly dirt. I think the local birds saw my grass seed as a five-star Michelin buffet. So, this Sunday, I went back at it. Mowed again, seeded again. But this time, I’m not leaving it to fate. I have become a professional irrigator. I am out there every few hours, hose in hand, whispering words of encouragement to the soil. \
I am essentially a high-end spa manager for blades of grass that clearly have no desire to exist.\n\n<h2 style=\
>The Age of Adulthood (and Hangovers)\n\nSaturday night was dedicated to the \
My oldest son is at that age where his social calendar is more packed than a Kardashian’s. When you turn 18, all your friends turn 18, which means every weekend is a marathon of \

He had two parties on Saturday. Two. I remember when a busy Saturday meant choosing between The A-Team and Knight Rider. Now, it’s about logistical coordination that would make a military general weep. He spent the night celebrating with his football teammates, and I spent the night wondering how long I could stay awake until he needed a ride.

On Sunday, I dragged my tired self to watch our second team’s final match. The stakes were high: avoid defeat or face relegation. In a display of pure grit, they pulled off a 1-0 win. The celebration in the canteen afterwards was... let's just say \

>Bizarro World: When the Sun Tries to Bankrupt You But the highlight of the weekend was the energy market. We had a perfect storm of heavy sun and high wind. In the world of green energy, this is the \

—but it comes with a twist.

The energy production was so high that prices hit a negative record. At one point, the commodity price was approximately -€0.45 per kWh. Now, in a normal world, having solar panels is like having a money printer on your roof. But in the Bizarro World of negative prices, your solar panels are actually trying to rob you.

When prices are negative, you have to pay to push electricity back into the grid. The grid is essentially saying, \

So, I had to stage a domestic intervention. To prevent my solar panels from sending power back to the grid and costing me a fortune, I had to consume every single watt they produced. It was time for a 5-hour strategic charging session for the car.

The \

Math  
Over those 5 hours, I pumped 20 kWh into the car. Here is how the math of madness works out:

*   10 kWh came from the grid: At a commodity price of $-€0.45$. Even after adding network fees ($+€0.12$) and taxes ($+€0.06$), the \

was roughly -€0.27 per kWh. So, for those 10 units, the energy company paid me €2.70 to take their electricity.\n    \n*   10 kWh came from my solar panels: By putting this directly into the car, I avoided \
it into the grid. If I had let that solar power leak out, I would have had to pay the $-€0.45$ commodity fee on it. By \

that energy in my car battery, I saved myself €4.50 in injection penalties.
    

In total, by driving a car that I \

for 5 hours, I ended up about €7.20 richer than if I had done nothing. I essentially got paid to ensure my car is ready for the next round of 18th birthday party taxi shifts.

It’s been a long, busy, and surprisingly profitable weekend. April is going out with a bang, and hopefully, my grass—and my Hive balance—will finally start to grow.

How was your weekend? Did you manage to make money by plugging things in, or were you too busy fighting a trailer like I was? Let me know in the comments!

Cheers,  
Peter

title.title: KNOWING THE FUTURE. MCGI TOPIC REVIEW
title.body:
https://youtu.be/Xto8QfUW0xE?si=eqqwvWnZRqUzkHr-
God did not give us the power to know the future is only Him that has that power over us. God knows everything that will happen in this life because He is the creator of all the universe. Human attempts to predict or control the future, especially through divination or occult practices, are discouraged in Scripture because they shift trust away from God.

The bible teaches us that we should put our hope and trust to God because he is the only one who can decide our future. God may reveal certain things through His prophets or His Word, but this revelation is always for His purpose, not human curiosity. 

>“The secret things belong unto the Lord our God,  but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever” (Deuteronomy 29:29).

The Bible also reminds us that our plans are limited, and we should depend on God’s will rather than claiming certainty about tomorrow. Life is uncertain, and humility is required when thinking about the future.

>“Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth” (Proverbs 27:1).

title.title: [EN/PT] First Impression
title.body: > That was a weird stare, he looked at him for a while. Trying to decide if the mistake was intentional. It was starting to feel uncomfortable for the kid to see his teacher looking at him like that. But, he was trying to get some information from that first impression.

> He had his laptop open on that square desk, as he was writing his notes. The kid knew that he needed to escape the situation, as it was stressful to him. The kid's face was showing no other expression but, fear of the situation. He said all that was on his mind. But, the principle did not get convinced that the kid did not know that chewing gum is not allowed. The first impression was taken already. It was even before he entered that room. The principle read his body language correctly. It was fear of consequences that drives the kid to say what he said. But, what he could not see is that, the little kid did not know how deceive and all he knew at the time was honesty. # PT

>

Aquele olhar era estranho; ele o encarou por um tempo, tentando decidir se o erro fora intencional. O garoto estava começando a se sentir desconfortável com o olhar do professor. Mas ele tentava extrair alguma informação daquela primeira impressão.

O laptop estava aberto sobre a mesa quadrada, e o garoto anotava. Ele sabia que precisava escapar da situação, pois estava estressado. O rosto do garoto não demonstrava outra expressão além de medo. Ele disse tudo o que lhe vinha à mente. Mas o diretor não se convenceu de que o garoto não sabia que mascar chiclete era proibido. A primeira impressão já havia sido formada, mesmo antes de ele entrar na sala. O diretor interpretou corretamente sua linguagem corporal. Era o medo das consequências que levava o garoto a dizer o que disse. Mas o que ele não percebeu é que o garotinho não sabia como enganar e, naquele momento, só conhecia a honestidade.

Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@ronnie10/enpt-first-impression-6kz)

links.title: What pleases God the most// The old path
links.body:
Genuine love and faith is one of the important thing which pleases God. The bible teaches us that trusting God with all our mind even when things looks rough for us, and that's what God wants from us putting our trust in him. Faith means relying on His word, believing His promises, and choosing to follow Him with a sincere heart rather than just outward actions.

God loves those who are obedient to his words and who respects others. God is not only interested in rules being followed, but in a willing heart that desires to do His will. When a person obeys God out of love, humility, and reverence, it shows a true connection with Him and a life that honors His ways.

A heart of love and righteousness greatly pleases God. Loving others, showing kindness, forgiving, and living a life of integrity reflect God’s character. The Bible makes it clear that when we walk in love and pursue what is right, we are living in a way that brings joy to God and fulfills His purpose for humanity.

links.title: Meditate really helps
links.body: /> Greetings everyone! We all are living our lives and of course most of us have some pressure for the family, work etc or any kind of pressure. We all are different we take life in different way. But any how we need to deal with the problem with the loads of work and everything. It's all about how you handle the pressure and everything. Many people make some way to realize the stress either doing meditation or something where things get distract easily. We all need some break from our constant thoughts which make us feel more pressure. We all know life is all about ups and downs, but more important is how do you heal and face the situation, let me tell you when I feel pressure or unfocus in my life. How I am treating myself in that situation. Of course meditation is the first thing it makes you really very calm. Meditation is all about a break from your thoughts weather it's a good or bad. You should give your mind some rest because it is working really 24x7 all day with load. You need to give some for yourself and take care of your health too. Staying under the pressure is all about the life, we all need to work hard. But more important it's about how better you deal it with. When I am under pressure or I am feeling headache all I do is meditate for 5 minutes every morning it keeps my mind very calm I am doing very often it helps me a lot. My brain cells get relax and I feel more fresh, last time I did was a week ago. And almost once or twice I am doing a week. Not for long time but only for 5 minutes too helps me to cure my brain. And doing meditation it feels like I am having a productive day I am feeling way more active even with the pressure, I think that good habits really attracts the good things. I am having lot of work pressure through out the day so of course I need some break for myself, I have such work that somedays it's impossible for me to have a time with myself too. So meditating helps me to sit with my own thoughts and a break from what I was thinking regularly. Controlling your own thoughts is really way more harder. I can't maintain the discipline for mediating daily. I am getting distract very easily, if you ask me that I wanna continue or not, then of course I need too. I want to develop this exercise in my day to day life. It really helps to make calm mind, blood flow, impacts on skin and many more. I want to do it daily, but still trying my best as often if I can do. I will also tell other people to develop this in your life it impacts in many ways, and more important you can increase your focus too.

/>

links.title: Running summary of the week // Résumé running de la semaine [EN/FR]
links.body:
<center>![running semaine 20 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eptb2ErhDj8krDnS5AwhRGQ7CvrggqtGKs4JyUN2CxyeSmYvPJricVSgjrWZsZEFrJg.jpg)</center>

Hello everyone! I hope you're all doing great at the start of this new week 😁

Today is Monday, and Monday means it's time for a running recap of the past week!

And, unlike last week, this running recap is very satisfying. I managed to complete all three of my running sessions!

I started the week on Tuesday with a classic run, a free run, on my usual route. The one where I usually stop at least once on the uphill sections… But this time, I didn't stop at all!

I ran 3.87 km, with an average pace of 7:34/km, which is slightly faster than my easy pace.

<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23tGwVTbyCSkzkPuiv3xKFjWWF6SEYxfVquu2pooukjCbdtU6N7AYcQsVe9sVQSCjmy6M.png)</center>

Actually, when I bought my new shoes, I kept saying, \

a bit like kids when they get new shoes and say they make them run fast. 😂

But in the end, the joke turned out to be true… I'm running a bit faster in my new running shoes, probably because they have better cushioning. But I need to find a new rhythm to get back to my easy pace of 7:50/km and be able to run for longer distances.

Anyway, Tuesday's session was a small victory for me; I managed to run uphill!

Then, I continued my running week with another session on Thursday. This time, I wanted to try an interval session (real intervals that alternate sprints and easy runs). I did it with @genesisledger.

<center>![marche dimanche.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23ynFh47Z5NowmqJCcfvi42NTe27daKWVub6Ehw8kcVyYuhmkPufw3Rfnhb8DibME4Uxp.png)</center>

We ran for 17 minutes at a normal pace (easy pace), then did 5 sets of [30 seconds of sprinting, 30 seconds of easy running], and then ran back at a normal pace for about 7 minutes.

Alternating sprints and easy runs helps work on cardio and endurance. It's pretty tough, especially when it's your first time. After the third repetition, I thought I was going to throw up and stop. 😂 But in the end, I kept going and managed to do all five repetitions!

It was difficult, but you can really feel it working, so I think we'll do this kind of workout again!

Then, I finished the week with a free run yesterday. I ran with @genesisledger, and it motivates me and helps me push myself. 😁

We ran 6.29 km without stopping! That's my new record!

<center>![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xATuyTvVStsdDXVupgkGoDBjDpskZkunJBiXJmZBjPnGqiio61fzbcb29toi91WvfKn.png)</center>

And I ran at an average pace of 7:36/km, which is still faster than my easy pace, but actually, that's pretty great! I'm quite proud of myself 😁
The end was rather complicated, mainly because my shoes are still hurting my feet a bit (it's probably just a matter of getting used to them).

Anyway, if I had to sum up this week of running, I'd say it was a good week with sessions that helped me improve! 👍

And for this coming week, I think there will only be two running sessions, but now we're supplementing with walking on the days we don't run.

Have a great week!

See you soon,
Johanna

PS: I used Google Translate to translate the English part.

__________________

<center>*Version en français*</center>
__________________

<center>![running semaine 20 avril.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/Eptb2ErhDj8krDnS5AwhRGQ7CvrggqtGKs4JyUN2CxyeSmYvPJricVSgjrWZsZEFrJg.jpg)</center>

Hello les amis ! J’espère que vous allez tous très bien en ce nouveau début de semaine 😁

Aujourd’hui, c’est lundi et qui dit lundi, dit résumé running de la semaine passée ! 

Et, contrairement à la semaine dernière, ce résumé running est très satisfaisant. J’ai réussi à tenir mes 3 séances de running ! 

J’ai commencé la semaine mardi, par une séance classique, une séance course libre, sur le chemin habituel. Celui sur lequel d’habitude, je m’arrête au moins une fois dans les montées… Mais cette fois-ci, je ne me suis pas arrêté du tout ! 

J’ai couru 3,87 km, avec une allure moyenne de 7:34/km, ce qui est légèrement plus rapide que mon EF. 

<center>![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23tGwVTbyCSkzkPuiv3xKFjWWF6SEYxfVquu2pooukjCbdtU6N7AYcQsVe9sVQSCjmy6M.png)</center>

En fait, lorsque j’ai acheté mes nouvelles chaussures, je n’arrêtais pas de dire : “avec mes nouvelles baskets, je vais courir plus vite”, un peu comme les enfants lorsqu’ils ont des nouvelles chaussures et qu’ils disent qu’elles courent vite. 😂

Mais finalement, la blague s’est avérée vraie… Je cours un poil plus vite avec mes nouvelles baskets, sûrement, car elles ont un meilleur amorti. Mais, il faut que j’arrive à trouver un nouveau rythme pour retrouver mon EF à 7:50/km et pouvoir courir longtemps.

Bref, la séance de mardi était une petite victoire pour moi, j’ai réussi à courir dans les montées ! 

Ensuite, j’ai continué la semaine de running avec une autre séance le jeudi. Cette fois-ci, j’ai voulu testé une séance de fractionnée (du vrai fractionné qui alterne sprint et course lente). Je l’ai fait avec @genesisledger. 

<center>![marche dimanche.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23ynFh47Z5NowmqJCcfvi42NTe27daKWVub6Ehw8kcVyYuhmkPufw3Rfnhb8DibME4Uxp.png)</center>

On a couru 17 minutes à allure normale (EF), puis on a fait 5 x [30 secondes de sprint, 30 secondes de course lente], puis on est revenu en courant à allure normale environ 7 minutes. 

Alterner sprint et course lente permet de travailler le cardio et l’endurance. C’est assez compliqué, surtout quand c’est la première fois qu’on en fait. Au bout de la 3 fois répétition, je me suis dit que j’allais vomir et arrêter. 😂 Mais finalement, j’ai continué et j’ai réussi à faire les 5 répétitions ! 

C’était difficile, mais on sent vraiment que cela travaille, donc je pense qu’on va refaire ce genre de séance ! 

Puis, j’ai terminé la semaine par une course libre hier. J’ai couru avec @genesisledger et cela me motive et m’aide à me dépasser. 😁

On a couru 6,29 km sans s’arrêter ! C’est mon nouveau record ! 

<center>![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/altheana/23xATuyTvVStsdDXVupgkGoDBjDpskZkunJBiXJmZBjPnGqiio61fzbcb29toi91WvfKn.png)</center>

Et j’ai couru à une allure moyenne de 7:36/km, ce qui est toujours plus rapide que mon EF, mais justement, c’est plutôt très bien ! Je suis assez fière de moi 😁
La fin était assez compliquée, notamment parce que mes chaussures me font encore un peu mal aux pieds (c’est sûrement le temps que je m’y habitue). 

Enfin bref, si je devais résumer cette semaine de running, je dirais que c’était une bonne semaine avec des séances qui me font progresser ! 👍

Et pour cette semaine à venir, je pense qu’il n’y aura que 2 séances de running, mais maintenant, on complète avec de la marche les jours où nous ne courons pas. 

Je vous souhaite une belle semaine ! 

À bientôt,
Johanna 

PS : J’ai utilisé Google Traduction pour traduire la partie en anglais.

Der Telegram-CEO Pavel Durov wirft Frankreich vor, private Daten von Krypto-Investoren an Kriminelle zu leaken, die die Krypto-Holder dann kidnappen.

Heftig, wenn das wahr ist.

Stellt euch vor, was für ein Honeypot eine Vermögenssteuer wäre, wenn der Staat ein zentrales Register über sämtliches Vermögen aller Bürger anlegen würde, um es dann jedes Jahr zu besteuern.

Hoffe, dass die Staaten Steuerdaten gut schützen.

Was sagt ihr dazu? Wie schützt ihre eure Kryptos?

Telegram CEO Pavel Durov accuses France of leaking private data on crypto investors to criminals, who then kidnap the crypto holders.

That’s pretty serious if it’s true.

Imagine what a honeypot a wealth tax would be if the government created a central registry of all citizens’ assets just to tax them every year.

I hope governments protect tax data well.

What do you think? How do you protect your crypto?

links.title: A Gift from Saria and the Dance of Death Mountain : TLOZ : Ocarina of Time #4 [ENG|ESP]
links.body: >\n\nGreetings, Hive Gaming community! I hope you are all doing excellent. Today we dive into Chapter 5 of our journey in \

After our meeting with Princess Zelda, we returned to the forest area with a clear objective: to strengthen our bond with the magic of the woods and prepare for the heat of the mountain. To be honest, navigating the Lost Woods is always a challenge for the senses, but the reward is worth every wrong turn. # Deep within the Lost Woods, we followed the echoes of a familiar melody until we found Saria at the Sacred Forest Meadow. It was a magical moment where she taught us **Saria's Song**, a tune that allows us to communicate with her at any time. While exploring these woods, we also put our skills to the test and managed to obtain a new Heart Piece by playing music with the Skull Kids, increasing our resistance for the battles ahead. It's a very didactic area that teaches you to listen to the environment to find the right path. # Our quest for power didn't stop there. We visited the Graveyard in Kakariko Village, where we faced the restless spirits of the Royal Family's tomb. By overcoming the trials within the crypt, we learned the **Sun's Song**, a powerful melody that can turn night into day and stun certain undead enemies. With our spirits high and new songs in our repertoire, we finally headed to Goron City to meet Darunia, the leader of the mountain tribe. # Darunia was in a foul mood due to the famine caused by the blockage of the Dodongo's Cavern. However, by playing Saria's Song, we managed to cheer him up so much that he broke into a legendary dance! As a sign of brotherhood and to help us on our mission, he granted us the **Goron's Bracelet**. This artifact gives us the superhuman strength needed to lift and throw Bomb Flowers, which is essential for clearing the path and entering the cavern to face the fire beast. # This chapter was full of music, exploration, and a significant increase in our power. With the Goron's Bracelet and the new melodies, we are finally ready to dive into the depths of the volcano. Thank you so much for your incredible support on this series! # Until next time, take care!
>\n\n¡Saludos, comunidad de Hive Gaming! Espero que todos se encuentren excelente. Hoy nos sumergimos en el Capítulo 5 de nuestro viaje en \

. Después de nuestro encuentro con la Princesa Zelda, regresamos a la zona del bosque con un objetivo claro: fortalecer nuestro vínculo con la magia de la naturaleza y prepararnos para el calor de la montaña. Para ser sincero, navegar por los Bosques Perdidos siempre es un desafío para los sentidos, pero la recompensa vale cada giro equivocado. # En lo profundo de los Bosques Perdidos, seguimos los ecos de una melodía familiar hasta encontrar a Saria en el Prado Sagrado del Bosque. Fue un momento mágico donde nos enseñó la **Canción de Saria**, una melodía que nos permite comunicarnos con ella en cualquier momento. Mientras explorábamos estos bosques, también pusimos a prueba nuestras habilidades y logramos obtener una nueva Pieza de Corazón al tocar música con los Skull Kids, aumentando nuestra resistencia para las batallas venideras. Es una zona muy didáctica que te enseña a escuchar el entorno para hallar el camino. # Nuestra búsqueda de poder no se detuvo ahí. Visitamos el Cementerio de la Aldea Kakariko, donde nos enfrentamos a los espíritus inquietos de la tumba de la Familia Real. Al superar las pruebas dentro de la cripta, aprendimos la **Canción del Sol**, una melodía poderosa capaz de convertir la noche en día y aturdir a ciertos enemigos no-muertos. Con el ánimo en alto y nuevas canciones en nuestro repertorio, finalmente nos dirigimos a la Ciudad Goron para conocer a Darunia, el líder de la tribu de la montaña. # Darunia estaba de muy mal humor debido a la hambruna causada por el bloqueo de la Cueva de los Dodongos. Sin embargo, al tocar la Canción de Saria, ¡logramos animarlo tanto que se lanzó a un baile legendario! Como señal de hermandad y para ayudarnos en nuestra misión, nos otorgó el **Brazalete Goron**. Este artefacto nos da la fuerza sobrehumana necesaria para levantar y lanzar Flores Bomba, lo cual es esencial para despejar el camino y entrar en la caverna para enfrentar a la bestia de fuego. # Este capítulo estuvo lleno de música, exploración y un aumento significativo en nuestro poder. Con el Brazalete Goron y las nuevas melodías, finalmente estamos listos para sumergirnos en las profundidades del volcán. ¡Muchas gracias por su increíble apoyo en esta serie! # ¡Hasta la próxima, cuídense mucho! ------ ---- |

links.title: (EN-DE) Vending machine business: What you need to know-Automatengeschäft: Was Sie wissen müssen
links.body: /> [_Wireless vending machine_](https://www.flickr.com/photos/55907694@N04/5175956518) _was originally posted by_ [_Per-Olof Forsberg_](https://www.flickr.com/photos/perolofforsberg/) _on Flickr and is reused here under the terms and conditions of the_ [_Attribution 2.0 Generic (CC BY 2.0)_](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) _Creative Commons license_ (English version) Things you should consider when running a profitable vending machine business You may have come across an ad that promotes a great money-making vending machine business opportunity. According to claims by those who advertise this type of franchise vending machine business, the capital required for such an investment is usually small compared to other types of more “traditional” business ventures. This is due to the fact there is no need to own or rent large commercial premises to run a vending machine business. The requirements for staff are also minimal, since a vending business is usually operated by the owner himself/herself. Of course, once the number of the sites where the vending machines are located has increased, the need might arise to hire an employee on a part-time basis, or even full-time if it’s necessary. **How to find the right product for a vending machine business** The type of the vending machine you are going to buy depends on the product that you intend to sell. There are machines aimed at selling everyday consumer products. For example, there are snack vending machines, water and soft drinks vending machines, cigarette vending machines, stamp vending machines; whatever you can think of really. Fishermen can even have access to live bait vending machines locally! https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a9W9UZphS1c And the list does not end here; if you live in Japan or travel there frequently, you should know that there are endless opportunities to sell virtually any type of product or service through a vending machine. You can get plenty of ideas for your vending business from the high-tech crazed Japanese, with the lobster vending machine being one of the most popular. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTDvVBdMaCs **Starting a vending machine business involves buying the vending machines** There is a wide range of options to buy from various vending machine suppliers, in case you can afford such a purchase. One of the most popular alternative choices to vending machine purchase is to rent the equipment. However, many vending machine operators prefer to sign a full service vending machine operating agreement with franchisers. Under this agreement, the franchisee will be provided with any equipment, products to sell, and support, at no cost to him/her. What will a franchiser earn from that? They will earn ongoing royalties on any sales made at that specific location by the leased vending machine. It sounds mutually beneficial for both sides and can be a great money-making opportunity, especially for those wishing to become self-employed but lack the necessary capital. **Location of vending equipment for high sales volume** Like in any other business, the significance of “Location, location, location!” cannot be overemphasized, since it is considered to be the strongest foundation for marketing success. The ability to reach customers is essential for a company’s selling strategy to be successful, and this is particularly true for a vending machine operation, where the volume of passing trade is directly related to the volume of products sold. Shopping malls, nightclubs (at least, those left!), universities, and factories are only a few examples of highly recommended locations to set up your vending machine(s). **How long will the vending machine madness last?** Good things do not last forever and prudent entrepreneurs are aware of business cycles that inevitably happen, as well as the fact that consumer tastes can change unexpectedly. The vending machines consumer market has reached maturity in many countries, while in others the image of a vending machine may be perceived as a product of science fiction. It is wise to conduct market research and analyze the market in which you intend to start your operation, in order to evaluate whether there is a specific market niche or segment, the needs of which you are going to satisfy profitably. Vending machines have been around since ancient times, and Hero of Alexandria is believed to be their original inventor. However, they were not commercially exploited until the Industrial Age, when they started to emerge as a successful business concept. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to always keep an open eye for innovations in the field of vending machine operations, in the form of new equipment, franchise methods, etc. Another important thing you should decide is whether you wish to expand and grow your vending business nationally or even internationally. You should bear in mind, however, that a growing business operation is more demanding and needs more dedication and effort from you, in terms of time, money and organization. You should ask yourself if you are really prepared to go in that direction; if you feel confident, and believe that you have the necessary skills, as well as meet all other requirements, then you should not hesitate and go ahead to exploit any vending machine opportunity that seems to be promising and profitable. Otherwise, you will regret it for the rest of your life! **Beware of vending machine scams** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3By\_ABClG0U Over-enthusiasm is rarely a wise counselor and there are always animals of prey ready to tear apart other gullible animals attempting to step out of their refuge. Vending machine scams are just another way that fraudsters have found to make people part with their money. It is highly advisable to get official information and advice on vending scams prior to handing your cash to buy any vending equipment or sign a binding contract. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0AkcWjB0UBE Your primary source of information on any issues that refer to running a vending machine business should be the various national vending machines associations operating in many countries across the globe. For example, a first point of contact for those wishing to enter the United States vending machines market should be the National Automatic Merchandising Association (NAMA), where prospective vending machine entrepreneurs can get valuable assistance and information on matters such as health and safety, legal and technical issues, as well as access to any industry news. There are similar associations in the European Union (European Vending & Coffee Service Association), the UK (Automatic Vending Association), Australia (National Vending Association), South Africa (Vending Association of South Africa) and last but not least, Japan (Japanese Vending Association). **Other issues: Theft, coin fraud, and legal issues** There have been a growing number of businesses suffering from theft and fraud problems in recent years, and the vending machines business could not be an exception. There is always the risk of vending machines getting literally stolen, when they are located in areas with poor security surveillance. In such an event, a full year’s profit can be lost, and you will have to start from scratch, with a brand new machine, and preferably, at a different location. Coin fraud has evolved into a high art, and there are a lot of highly trained and skillful people who have the necessary knowhow, and who are always willing and greedy to apply their technical expertise on the targets that they choose. Before buying a vending machine, always check whether its technical specifications include the option to recognize and reject fake coins, or not. Another important aspect to be considered when starting a vending machine business is compliance with laws related to selling tobacco, alcohol, and adult movies to minors. There are strict laws to which you should abide; otherwise you will end up having legal troubles. **Conclusion** From a purely economic point of view, in an ailing economy, where everyone finds it hard to make ends meet, and businesses try to reduce their operating costs, embarking on a new vending business venture could result in meeting successfully the needs of a number of market niches and segments, and generate, in this way, a very healthy cash flow. In other words, running a vending machine operation is a great way to provide 24/7 retailing, with minimum staffing requirements and a high ratio of turnover/profits over expenses/costs. However, there are a number of important aspects to pay attention to, such as theft, coin fraud, and special legal issues, if an aspiring vending machines entrepreneur wants to save himself/herself from any unpleasant surprises, and turn a small business venture into a steady source of income. (Deutsche Version) Was Sie beim Betrieb eines profitablen Automatengeschäfts beachten sollten

/>

[Wireless vending machine](https://www.flickr.com/photos/55907694@N04/5175956518)wurde ursprünglich gepostet von [Per-Olof Forsberg](https://www.flickr.com/photos/perolofforsberg/)auf Flickr und wird hier unter den Nutzungsbedingungen wiederverwendet [Attribution 2.0 Generic (CC BY 2.0)](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) Creative Commons lizenz

Vielleicht sind Sie schon einmal auf eine Anzeige gestoßen, die eine lukrative Geschäftsmöglichkeit mit Verkaufsautomaten anpreist.

Laut den Anbietern solcher Franchise-Unternehmen ist der Kapitalbedarf für eine solche Investition im Vergleich zu anderen, eher traditionellen Geschäftsformen in der Regel gering.

Das liegt daran, dass für den Betrieb eines Verkaufsautomatengeschäfts keine großen Gewerbeflächen benötigt werden.

Auch der Personalbedarf ist minimal, da ein Verkaufsautomatengeschäft üblicherweise vom Inhaber selbst geführt wird.

Sobald die Anzahl der Standorte der Verkaufsautomaten steigt, kann es natürlich notwendig werden, Mitarbeiter in Teilzeit oder gegebenenfalls auch in Vollzeit einzustellen.

**Wie man das richtige Produkt für ein Verkaufsautomaten-Unternehmen findet**

Welchen Automaten Sie kaufen möchten, hängt von den Produkten ab, die Sie verkaufen wollen. Es gibt Automaten für den Verkauf von Alltagsprodukten. Zum Beispiel Snackautomaten, Wasser- und Getränkeautomaten, Zigarettenautomaten, Briefmarkenautomaten – im Prinzip alles, was man sich vorstellen kann. Angler können sogar vor Ort Lebendköderautomaten aufstellen!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a9W9UZphS1c

Und die Liste ist damit noch lange nicht zu Ende. Wer in Japan lebt oder häufig dorthin reist, sollte wissen, dass es unzählige Möglichkeiten gibt, praktisch jedes Produkt oder jede Dienstleistung über einen Verkaufsautomaten anzubieten. Von den technikbegeisterten Japanern kann man sich jede Menge Ideen für sein eigenes Automatengeschäft holen – der Hummerautomat gehört beispielsweise zu den beliebtesten.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eTDvVBdMaCs

**Die Gründung eines Verkaufsautomatengeschäfts erfordert den Kauf der Verkaufsautomaten**

Es gibt zahlreiche Kaufoptionen bei verschiedenen Anbietern von Verkaufsautomaten, falls Sie sich einen solchen Kauf leisten können.

Eine der beliebtesten Alternativen zum Kauf eines Verkaufsautomaten ist die Miete. Viele Betreiber bevorzugen jedoch einen Full-Service-Betriebsvertrag mit Franchisegebern. Im Rahmen dieses Vertrags erhält der Franchisenehmer alle Geräte, Produkte und Unterstützung kostenlos.

Was verdient der Franchisegeber dabei?

Er erhält laufende Lizenzgebühren auf alle Umsätze, die mit dem gemieteten Verkaufsautomaten am jeweiligen Standort erzielt werden.

Das klingt nach einer vorteilhaften Lösung für beide Seiten und kann eine gute Verdienstmöglichkeit sein, insbesondere für diejenigen, die sich selbstständig machen möchten, aber nicht über das nötige Kapital verfügen.

**Standort von Verkaufsautomaten für hohe Umsätze**

Wie in jedem anderen Geschäft ist die Bedeutung des Standorts von entscheidender Bedeutung, da er als wichtigste Grundlage für den Marketingerfolg gilt.

Die Erreichbarkeit von Kunden ist für den Erfolg einer Vertriebsstrategie unerlässlich. Dies gilt insbesondere für den Betrieb von Verkaufsautomaten, da die Kundenfrequenz direkt mit dem Absatzvolumen zusammenhängt.

Einkaufszentren, Nachtclubs (zumindest die, die es noch gibt!), Universitäten und Fabriken sind nur einige Beispiele für empfehlenswerte Standorte für Ihre Verkaufsautomaten.

**Wie lange wird dieser Automatenwahn noch andauern?**

Gute Dinge dauern nicht ewig, und kluge Unternehmer sind sich der unvermeidlichen Konjunkturzyklen sowie der sich unerwartet ändernden Verbraucherpräferenzen bewusst. Der Markt für Verkaufsautomaten ist in vielen Ländern gesättigt, während er in anderen Ländern noch als Science-Fiction gilt.

Es ist ratsam, Marktforschung zu betreiben und den Markt, in dem Sie Ihr Geschäft starten möchten, zu analysieren, um festzustellen, ob es eine spezifische Marktnische oder ein Segment gibt, dessen Bedürfnisse Sie gewinnbringend befriedigen können.

Verkaufsautomaten gibt es bereits seit der Antike, und Heron von Alexandria gilt als ihr Erfinder. Kommerziell genutzt wurden sie jedoch erst im Industriezeitalter, als sie sich zu einem erfolgreichen Geschäftsmodell entwickelten. Daher ist es dringend zu empfehlen, Innovationen im Bereich der Verkaufsautomaten – wie neue Geräte, Franchisemodelle usw. – stets im Auge zu behalten.

Eine weitere wichtige Entscheidung ist, ob Sie Ihr Verkaufsautomatengeschäft national oder sogar international ausbauen möchten.

Sie sollten jedoch bedenken, dass ein wachsender Geschäftsbetrieb anspruchsvoller ist und von Ihnen mehr Engagement und Einsatz in Bezug auf Zeit, Geld und Organisation erfordert.

Sie sollten sich fragen, ob Sie wirklich bereit sind, diesen Weg einzuschlagen. Wenn Sie sich sicher fühlen und glauben, die nötigen Fähigkeiten zu besitzen und alle anderen Voraussetzungen zu erfüllen, sollten Sie nicht zögern und jede vielversprechende und lukrative Gelegenheit im Bereich Verkaufsautomaten nutzen. Andernfalls werden Sie es Ihr Leben lang bereuen!

**Vorsicht vor Betrugsmaschen an Verkaufsautomaten!**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3By\_ABClG0U

Übereifriger Enthusiasmus ist selten ein guter Ratgeber, und es gibt immer skrupellose Menschen, die ahnungslose Tiere angreifen, die sich aus ihrem sicheren Hafen wagen.

Betrug mit Verkaufsautomaten ist nur eine weitere Masche, mit der Betrüger Menschen um ihr Geld bringen. Es ist dringend ratsam, sich vor dem Kauf von Verkaufsautomaten oder dem Unterzeichnen eines Vertrags offizielle Informationen und Ratschläge zu Betrugsmaschen mit Verkaufsautomaten einzuholen.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0AkcWjB0UBE

Ihre wichtigste Informationsquelle zu allen Fragen rund um den Betrieb eines Automatengeschäfts sollten die verschiedenen nationalen Automatenverbände sein, die weltweit aktiv sind.

Beispielsweise ist die National Automatic Merchandising Association (NAMA) die erste Anlaufstelle für alle, die in den US-amerikanischen Automatenmarkt einsteigen möchten. Dort erhalten angehende Unternehmer wertvolle Unterstützung und Informationen zu Themen wie Gesundheit und Sicherheit, rechtlichen und technischen Fragen sowie Zugang zu aktuellen Branchenneuigkeiten.

Ähnliche Verbände gibt es in der Europäischen Union (European Vending & Coffee Service Association), im Vereinigten Königreich (Automatic Vending Association), in Australien (National Vending Association), in Südafrika (Vending Association of South Africa) und nicht zuletzt in Japan (Japanese Vending Association).

**Weitere Probleme: Diebstahl, Münzbetrug und rechtliche Angelegenheiten**

In den letzten Jahren hat die Zahl der Unternehmen, die unter Diebstahl und Betrug leiden, stetig zugenommen, und auch die Automatenbranche bildet da keine Ausnahme.

Besonders an Orten mit mangelhafter Sicherheitsüberwachung besteht immer das Risiko, dass Automaten gestohlen werden.

In einem solchen Fall kann der Gewinn eines ganzen Jahres verloren gehen, und man muss mit einem brandneuen Automaten, idealerweise an einem anderen Standort, von vorne beginnen.

Münzbetrug hat sich zu einer wahren Kunstform entwickelt, und es gibt viele hochqualifizierte und geschickte Betrüger, die über das nötige Know-how verfügen und stets bereit sind, ihre technischen Fähigkeiten gierig gegen ihre Opfer einzusetzen.

Vor dem Kauf eines Automaten sollte man daher unbedingt prüfen, ob die technischen Spezifikationen die Möglichkeit bieten, Falschgeld zu erkennen und abzulehnen.

Ein weiterer wichtiger Aspekt beim Start eines Automatengeschäfts ist die Einhaltung der Gesetze zum Verkauf von Tabakwaren, Alkohol und Filmen für Erwachsene an Minderjährige. Es gelten strenge Gesetze, an die man sich unbedingt halten muss; andernfalls drohen rechtliche Konsequenzen.

**Abschluss**

Aus rein wirtschaftlicher Sicht, in einer schwächelnden Wirtschaft, in der viele Menschen ums Überleben kämpfen und Unternehmen ihre Betriebskosten senken wollen, kann der Einstieg in ein neues Automatengeschäft dazu beitragen, die Bedürfnisse verschiedener Marktsegmente erfolgreich zu bedienen und so einen gesunden Cashflow zu generieren.

Anders ausgedrückt: Der Betrieb eines Automatengeschäfts bietet eine hervorragende Möglichkeit, rund um die Uhr Waren und Dienstleistungen anzubieten – mit minimalem Personalaufwand und einem hohen Verhältnis von Umsatz/Gewinn zu Ausgaben/Kosten.

Allerdings gibt es einige wichtige Aspekte zu beachten, wie Diebstahl, Münzbetrug und spezielle rechtliche Fragen, wenn angehende Automatenunternehmer sich vor unangenehmen Überraschungen schützen und aus einem kleinen Unternehmen eine stabile Einnahmequelle machen wollen.

(Dieser Beitrag wurde mit Google Translate aus dem Englischen ins Deutsche übersetzt)

links.title: How I Made “Nakhre” in 2 Hours | Urdu Punjabi Romantic Song Story
links.body:
**Today feels a bit different for me.**
I just released my song “Nakhre” on YouTube, and this one is special in a different way. Not because it’s perfect, but because of how it came together.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rEMSpZ4TSOI&list=RDrEMSpZ4TSOI&start_radio=1

I made this song in one day.
I was planning to create something late night and moody, a song you can replay for hours without getting tired of it. Then one day a vibe just hit me. I found a beat and it instantly clicked.

I opened my studio, played the beat, and the melody just came to my mind. It wasn’t forced at all. I wrote everything naturally and went straight into recording without wasting time.

In less than two hours, the whole song was finished.
After that, I did the final mix and decided to release it on my birthday, 19 January. The song dropped on all streaming platforms that day.

But after that, there was a gap.
I didn’t have time to shoot a proper video, and slowly I started giving less attention to music. That wasn’t a great phase for me, but it’s real.

Then one day I decided I can’t just leave this song like that.
Instead of waiting for the perfect video, I used what I had. I took some old clips, turned them into a visualizer, added lyrics, and kept it simple.
And now it’s finally out on YouTube.

This is one of my favorite songs because everything about it felt natural. No pressure, no overthinking, just a vibe.
I know it’s not perfect, but it’s honest.

If you check it out, I’d really appreciate real feedback. Not just “it’s good”, tell me what you actually feel and what I can improve.

**This is just one step.**

[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rEMSpZ4TSOI&list=RDrEMSpZ4TSOI&start_radio=1) 
[ Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/4CabqZwEly0U9eCHYlZDPc?si=be15c6466d96447c)

最近买菜 也没见到有大量新鲜蒜头卖，我妈却说要去小菜园挖蒜头……前两天她还跟我说邻居家种的蒜头已经都收回家了，说我们的蒜秸秆还绿着呢，可以在等等，，这么快就要收了。我也没有要求和他们一起去收，因为尝过了抽蒜苔的抽到腰痛的滋味！那时就打了报告收蒜头我不负责了哈哈~

主要是我也不吃，收回来他们要做糖醋蒜的。没想到成熟度差不多刚刚好！在多长些日子用来做糖醋蒜就有些老了，不知道是不是土质不好，蒜头只有少部分个头可以，大多都挺小个，还好做糖醋蒜不挑，不然都用日常做菜可能会浪费很多！晒干了后会更小，我才没有那个耐心扒蒜皮。

菜园里的蒜头听他们说 差不多收回来2/3，有个十几斤的样子。虽然我不吃糖醋蒜，但做 一定少不了我的份😂扒蒜皮差不多扒了一个小时，也就扒出来差不多5斤蒜头，扒好后又挨个剪根须和蒜杆，在清洗晾干！今天就先处理 做出来一部分，剩的明天接着干。

我的指甲太脆弱，感觉要扒废了……大家爱吃糖醋蒜吗？



---

links.title: Top 3 Powerful Monster Cards Every Splinterlands Player Should Have
links.body:
![Nidhoggr  The Legendary Dragon That Dominates Battles.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uQk8RHkXV7L4b9Wo6ouGqqT2qZCvdcKKV7YdrTYQ5ZPnt7Dj9YoqNEtx3HQ5t53m5MB.png)


To win any battle it is necessary to have good cards. There are some monster cards that prove helpful in almost every battle and if you keep such monsters in your deck they will support you in every match and increase your chances of winning.

You can either buy these monster cards or rent them which depends on each player which option they choose. In my opinion if you are a new player and still learning the game then renting good cards is the best option because it is very affordable. If you want to understand rentals better make sure to read my previous post where I explained rental details completely.

However if someone is an experienced player and wants to invest then these are monster cards that are excellent and rewarding. Also sometimes players do not get enough time to play the game so they can rent out their own cards as well which gives them a good source of earning.

Today I will talk about three monster cards that are very important to add to your deck. There is no doubt that these are expensive cards because they are upgraded versions so whoever can afford them can buy them while those who cannot can easily rent them.

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110023.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wWw29xZcvfZsGPDV9WQiPcDTfjeYrF3yYEKeSemqUV3uaNFNomaQEf1SrFnZWbBdvKX.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110017.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23vrtf7bnzw7idNjHi1odfvuoJETqbkaegrp3RcRee75VdPALP1aAFzYaJh8RJsVMszaf.png)

The first monster card is called **Chaos Dragon**. It is a strong and powerful monster with a high mana cost, its mana cost is 14 and it is considered one of the best tanks. It has 4 armor and 10 health which makes it a very strong tank.

Because of its high armor it can absorb a large amount of damage and tries to protect its health as much as possible. Its high health allows it to survive for many rounds even if it takes direct attacks while also protecting the backline monsters behind it.

If I talk about its price its minimum price starts from $37 and can go up to $100 depending on the level. You can keep it in your deck as a tank monster.

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110053.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23wCA63q4L5tyVyLtCqKwFvdqeBmNu7DijDM6Y1S4g5bHASvNkkozaCxTicnvtyKmPjiJ.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110048.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23w2HBDkeeNyzZdr1aB8BeA52yQ8mYi5FmMCAYxsGysbMCyqnC9aXjj1fc3i3pcqbEa6y.png)

The second monster is a melee attacker which it attacks from close range and is a powerful attacker. Its name is **Forgotten One**.

Again its armor and health are excellent. You can use it as a secondary tank and take advantage of its melee attack. You can place it in the second position and use it as a tank.

It has 5 armor and 9 health which helps it survive longer and continue absorbing damage. In every round it attacks the enemy with +4 melee power and keeps dealing damage. Its speed is also 2 which helps improve its attack timing.

If I talk about its market price its minimum price starts from $3 and can go up to $50–$60 depending on its level.

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110320.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23uEzQYiAkoLdiTP5PJjftz1WHvJucDgQJdgvKi7qyEWQg98RsfrPSQZc6a7HoJga4B8K.png)

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 110314.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/aliakbar2/23tRvMqHjeoyuWZ7jLSANuz82Fd6TxmXCv1Cw6n85tmaBphXBB77sVdmMugij2bH9pKkP.png)

The third best monster known at this time is a ranged attacker called **Swiftbeard Stout**. It is a very strong ranged attack monster with 2 ranged attack power.

You can place it in the backline position and continuously benefit from its attacks. Again its health and armor are high enough that you can even place it in the front position because its armor helps it survive but it is better to keep it in the backline and make full use of its abilities.

Another special thing about it is that its speed is 4 which increases its attack speed.

If I talk about its market price at its highest level its price reaches $155 which is quite expensive. That is why you can also rent it which will cost you very little DEC on a daily basis. However for those who want to buy these are the kinds of cards that will help you in every battle.

What do you people think about these cards? Are they good to keep in your deck? will be glad to see your answers in the comment section.


I hope you find this post useful and informative.. If you do, please remember to reblog it so that it reaches as many people as possible and that they can benefit the most from it. Also remember to upvote which will help me financially and grow my account.

links.title: Planning Retirement
links.body:
To be very honest, I never really enjoyed working in my 9 to 6 jobs. In my mid 30s itself, I had started planning about my retirement. That idea of working till 60 never went well with me. I had set a target for myself that maximum I would work will be till I am 50. It seems my manifestation was very strong and I quit my job in my early 40s itself to move with hubby when he got a job here in Muscat. After which I never worked in a full day job. I did continue working but in part time jobs.

That routine and the daily grind of long working hours was killing me; there was no much life left after work. And that was not how I wanted my life to be. Being an HR in a MNC means long working hours and there's just no escape from it. Also, I would see other older people in my office who were working and I could see how burned out they were with their jobs. Majority of the times they were only grumbling and complaining about life and I did not want to see myself there.

![image.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVMwBroTAFZWLM2zRD24n5HYCmKTTus6qkmE52Uy5veSu/image.png)
[Source](https://pixabay.com/illustrations/seniors-care-for-the-elderly-1505935/)

I had many hobbies also which I wanted to pursue but with the job it was extremely difficult. I wanted to spend more time learning about alternative healing therapies and also practice it. I wanted to travel more, I wanted peaceful slow time for myself, wanted to spend more time on Yoga and Meditation but with the job all of this was only a fight. 

That's true that not everyone can quit their jobs; there are bills to pay. But then my thought then was that anyways I have to retire at 60, so why not I plan things in such a way that I can retire a couple of years early. This was while Muscat was not in sight. I set my retirement age for 50 with this thought and making a detailed saving plan. I don’t know if I would have not shifted here to Muscat, would I had been able to stick to my plan. Probably yes. Maybe I would have continued doing something part time like how I am doing now.

Life is not all about work, but that's what we make it. 

***Thank you for visiting my blog.*** 👼🏻👼🏻💖💖🌹🌺🌸

links.title: Foot and Ankle Specialist Now Offering Advanced Care for Pain and Injuries
links.body:
Recently, a review article in FRONTIERS summarises current knowledge regarding the basic structure and function of the foot and ankle Joint which is one of the most intricate components throughout the musculoskeletal system that serves as not only a shock absorber but also a stiff lever arm for propulsion. This complex network of twenty-six bones and over thirty joints needs to be well-aligned to help us move and balance. 



![Heel Pain.png](https://waivio.nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com/fd5c779f756983f4a3eb5e1f72a8ef3924f5aecf53ef2b3514fbbbbf08bab8e2)



This balance, or homeostasis, is disturbed through structural malformations, received traumas and chronic degenerative elasthic abnormalities so that the pain carrying system attenuates a great multitude of functions vital to mobility. If the restricting issues seem to be related to the feet and ankle, a [Foot and Ankle Specialist Brockton MA](https://www.plymouthfoot.com/) offers medically valid means of diagnosis and corrective therapy for residents wanting their physical independence back. To successfully recover in the long-term, it is crucial to understand the mechanical principles impacting foot health as well as biological needs for tissue healing.

Podiatric medicine is primarily predicated on the analysis of gait cycle, which encompasses an intricate process of steps that the body initiates whilst ambulating. When the foot overpronates (or rolls in) or over supinates (rolls out), abnormal stresses are produced over the tendons and ligaments of the ankle. This mechanical imbalance eventually predisposes to chronic conditions such as posterior tibial tendon dysfunction or plantar fasciitis. This variation is typically established through a thorough biomechanical assessment during a clinical evaluation. Diagnostic technologies (digital radiography and gait pressure mapping) can be used to determine exactly where the kinetic chain is failing allowing clinicians to realign bone structures, redistribute weight and stabilization of joints.

If conservative approaches like custom orthotics or physical therapy fail, sophisticated surgical changes may be necessary to straighten the skeletal framework. Contemporary reconstructive surgery has shifted to the preserving of joint motion and reduced restoration time. Arthrodesis (fusion of a joint) or osteotomy (reshaping of the bone to re-aligned weight bear pressures) is carried out utilising precision hardware that allows structural stability whilst nature carries out its own task of bonding the bone. These interventions rely on the biological principle of osteogenesis, where specialized cells at the surgical site connect with one another to form a stable and vitally healthy link.

A [Foot and Ankle Specialist Brockton MA](https://www.plymouthfoot.com/) also plays a role in the treatment of complex soft tissue injuries, including Achilles tendon ruptures or chronic ligamentous instability. The ankle has a relatively thin soft tissue envelope compared to other areas of the body, and therefore highly specialized care is required in order to maintain blood flow and minimize complications associated with wound healing. New era treatment protocols generally integrate regenerative medicine and functional rehabilitation, allowing for early controlled range of movement to facilitate the avoidance of joint rigidity and muscle wasting. This data-driven method guarantees that the fresh new collagen fibers running within the repair tissue are in line and bring together, giving a sturdy, successful reconstruction.

To put in brief, recreating the diverse mechanics of the lower limb necessitates a prompt integration between anatomical science and future medical technology. Reclaiming a chronic pain-free life is, however, achievable through accurately establishing biomechanical realignment; structurally sound stabilization and dedication to an evidence-based approach to recovery. In the end, there is no other option to preserve the body's foundation than to prioritize expert care: with every step comes strength and stability.

**Conclusion**

Getting back on the road to recovery from complex lower-extremity problems demands an assertive and evidence-based approach. A trained professional with a proper evaluation can get at the root cause of mobility issue and provide better outcomes than just treating symptoms. Combining advanced diagnostics with personalized treatment plans to protect long-term joint health, allowing you to stay active. By investing in today, you structurally fix years of pain free platform through the feet and ankles.

links.title: What does Alphabet's 100-years bond tell us about AI's future?
links.body:
![dFQROr7oWzulq5Fa7HMScp5rxsAOQxzbG9Okb0UqDvDqttnL4wK5t04H0vTiVA7SiUM.webp](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/badbitch/23z7Qke7LNnWKP4jTXqHN71pT7dUVrAJcget2GDiQktP7nNmgfttwc1kpCnFanbpppqkH.webp)

A lot of people are yet to come to terms with the fact that AI is a critical piece of the future, just as crypto and blockchain has been pushed against since inception.

But this is all happening and the scale of funding tells a story.

This isn't a tech trend that will fade away in five years, this is a multi-generational utility being built in real time.

>On February 10, 2026, Alphabet sold a rare 100-year bond — the tech industry's first century bond since Motorola's issuance in 1997, according to LSEG data. The sale was part of a $31.51 billion global bond raise, as artificial intelligence-driven spending is sparking a surge in borrowing among U.S. tech giants.

>The structural details are striking. The centerpiece was a £1 billion (approximately $1.37 billion) century bond maturing in February 2126, carrying a 6.125% coupon. The offering was initially targeted at $15 billion but was upsized to $20 billion after drawing over $100 billion in orders — nearly five times oversubscribed. — *AI report summary*

### Permanence

Seeing that most of us won't be here in 100 years, unless longevity tech improves and we're lucky enough to all have access and choose to use it, the bigger signal here is that AI has been concluded to be a permanent infrastructure for and of the future.

Debt of this scale is searching for long-term commitment and as the report highlights, it found it.

Google needed $15 billion, for a period of 100 years, but instead got demand worth $100 billion and had to increase raise to $20 billion.

The combined spending tab of the five hyperscalers; Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and Oracle, exceeds $600 billion for 2026 and over 75% of that is going towards AI-related infrastructure.

This is more money than the U.S. energy sector spends annually on drilling, refining, and delivery.


### A bubble?

The AI is a bubble arguments are usually funny to me because it's usually people that only sees AI to be an image and content generator.

Most of which are free-tier testers.

Anyone who has used the technology extensively, through various integrations knows that AI isn't some simple app on Apple or Playstore.

It's an engine that will replace so many infrastructures the world runs on today.

The larger-focus monetization layer will be systems integration that most won't see.

The tech securing the power grids will be AI-powered, the defense sector will be AI-powered, the smart cities, the social algorithms, the health systems, all of it, will move towards machine intelligence.

Every fund raise, such as Alphabets', points to this reality.

---

<sup>Image credit: [Thairath Online](https://en.thairath.co.th/money/tech_innovation/tech_companies/2913296)</sup>

links.title: Aesphonly Framed 1 to 20
links.body: https://youtu.be/cqfDYlCJSYs I found these drawings yesterday while clearing out the attic. They're incorrectly labelled as monoprints. I must have made them last year before leaving for Thailand and forgot to process them. Back in the days when I used to sign my work. There's a lot of other drawings and paintings up there that can also be photo'd, videoed and uploaded before going on to the Free Art Frees Art pile. Hand rolled drawings on A4 size office paper 80gsm, PVA glued to cardboard. Made by directly rolling ink onto the paper and stamping the letters. The red letters on the frame are individually hand stamped with Caligo Napthol Red oil based but water soluble printing inks. The backs have pages from the booklet I give out at The Camden Market Free Art Man. The series is titled Aesphonly Framed. Aesphonly is an amalgamtion word of Aesthetic and Phonetic Only.

/> I started making Aesphonly images during covid lockdown around six years ago. Arrangments of letters and words in whatever order looks good, irrespective of their meanings and sounds. So far there's 20 Aesphonly framed.

/>\n\nThe video and photos are done in my front garden. Usually I wait for the morning blue light to go but I'm in a rush today as am supposed to leave for Billy's in Chatham at 10 o'clock, which isn't going to happen, and won't be back till it's too dark.

links.title: How Embryo Genetic Screening Is Transforming IVF Outcomes
links.body:
In recent years, the journey to parenthood has been reshaped by scientific breakthroughs that were once the stuff of science fiction. For couples facing infertility, understanding the intricate details of embryo health has become a cornerstone of successful treatment. A leading [**Fertility Clinic Edinburgh**](https://thebridgefertility.com/uk/edinburgh/) now regularly incorporates advanced genetic screening protocols that help specialists select the most viable embryos for transfer. This approach is not merely about increasing pregnancy rates; it is about reducing the emotional and financial toll of repeated failed cycles.

The core of this transformation is Preimplantation Genetic Testing for Aneuploidy, commonly known as PGT A. This technique involves biopsying a few cells from a five day old embryo, known as a blastocyst, to count its chromosomes. A normal human embryo should have 23 pairs of chromosomes. An abnormal number, or aneuploidy, is a primary cause of miscarriage and implantation failure. By identifying embryos with the correct number of chromosomes, doctors can prioritize those with the highest chance of developing into a healthy pregnancy. This process is a prime example of cutting edge reproductive technology because it merges embryology with molecular genetics, allowing for precision that was impossible a decade ago.

The benefits extend beyond mere selection. For women of advanced maternal age, the risk of producing aneuploid embryos rises sharply. At age 35, about 40% of embryos may be abnormal; by age 40, that figure can exceed 70%. Without genetic screening, a physician might transfer an embryo that looks perfect under a microscope but carries a lethal chromosomal error. The result is a heartbreaking miscarriage or a failed implantation that cannot be explained by uterine factors alone. PGT A provides a biological explanation and a strategic path forward, saving months of trial and error.

Furthermore, this technology reduces the likelihood of multiple pregnancies. In conventional IVF, doctors sometimes transfer two or three embryos to offset the risk of failure. This practice increases the chance of twins or triplets, which carries higher risks of prematurity, low birth weight, and maternal complications. With accurate genetic screening, a single, normal embryo can be transferred with confidence. The goal becomes one healthy baby at a time, aligning with modern obstetrical recommendations.

There are also time saving implications. When a patient undergoes a freeze all cycle, embryos are biopsied, vitrified (flash frozen), and then analyzed. Results typically return within two to three weeks. During that interval, the uterus can be prepared more naturally without the disruptive effects of high dose stimulation hormones. In the subsequent frozen embryo transfer cycle, the endometrium is more receptive, and the selected euploid embryo is placed into an optimal environment. Studies have shown that frozen transfers of screened embryos result in live birth rates approaching 60 to 70% in favorable patient populations.

Critics sometimes question whether the biopsy itself harms the embryo. However, large scale meta analyses have demonstrated that when performed by an experienced embryologist, the removal of 5 to 10 trophectoderm cells (which will become the placenta, not the fetus) does not reduce implantation potential. In fact, by avoiding the transfer of doomed embryos, the overall efficiency of the IVF process skyrockets. Patients who might have endured three or four failed fresh cycles can often achieve their goal in one or two screened frozen cycles.

Beyond aneuploidy screening, newer genetic tests are emerging. PGT M detects single gene disorders such as cystic fibrosis or Huntington's disease, allowing couples who are carriers to have biological children free of these conditions. PGT SR identifies structural rearrangements like translocations that can cause recurrent miscarriage. Together, these technologies create a comprehensive toolkit for addressing complex infertility cases. The laboratory protocols require rigorous quality control, including specialized incubation systems and laser assisted biopsy equipment that maintains embryo stability.

For patients considering IVF, the decision to use genetic screening should be personalized. Factors such as age, previous pregnancy history, and the number of embryos produced all influence the potential benefit. A younger patient with a high egg count and no miscarriage history may not need PGT A, while an older patient or one with recurrent losses will find it indispensable. Clinicians typically recommend genetic counseling before proceeding, ensuring that patients understand what the results can and cannot predict. It is also essential to recognize that a euploid embryo is not a guarantee of a live birth; uterine, immune, or infectious factors may still play a role.

Nevertheless, the adoption of routine blastocyst biopsy and genetic analysis represents a paradigm shift. Where past doctors hoped for the best, modern practitioners can make data driven decisions. This reduces the anguish of failed transfers and miscarriages, which are often more devastating than the initial infertility diagnosis. Many patients report that the waiting period for genetic results is stressful but worthwhile because it provides a sense of control and clarity.

As laboratory techniques continue to refine, non invasive methods are being researched, such as analyzing cell free DNA in the culture medium where the embryo grows. This would eliminate the need for an actual biopsy, simplifying the process and potentially reducing costs. Until then, PGT A remains the gold standard. The integration of this technology into everyday clinical practice has elevated IVF from a gamble to a calculated, scientific endeavor. Ultimately, the goal is not just to create embryos but to create healthy babies as efficiently and safely as possible. By understanding the chromosomal health of each embryo, families can move forward with hope grounded in evidence, knowing that modern science has given them a powerful ally in their path to parenthood.

links.body:
Sí, **la propuesta de la IA es provocativa y bastante buena**, pero lo mejor no es que “responda” tus preguntas sino que **las convierte en ejercicios**. Ahí está el truco inteligente: baja la filosofía del pedestal y la obliga a tocar suelo. Tu post anterior, [¿Ser, Saber y Hacer? ¿Cuál es prioridad?](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/ser-saber-y-hacer-cu-l-es-prioridad-moe6tsdv6774782d), ya iba en esa dirección, y este experimento la empuja mejor.

Lo que más me convence es el tercer punto del triángulo: **Saber, Hacer, Querer**. Meter **Querer** ahí arregla una carencia seria, porque mucha reflexión sobre identidad se rompe al olvidar el deseo, la voluntad o la inclinación. Uno puede saber muchísimo y hacer bastante, pero si no hay querer, el ser queda medio prestado, como ropa ajena.

También veo por qué te hizo clic la conexión con Patrick Winston. Su charla [How to Speak | MIT Learn](https://learn.mit.edu/search?resource=5343) gira justo alrededor de una idea nada menor: **la capacidad no baja del cielo; se construye con conocimiento y práctica**. Esa línea conversa muy bien con tu eje ser/saber/hacer, porque tumba la fantasía de que primero “eres” algo de forma pura y luego actúas; muchas veces **te vuelves algo al practicarlo**.

Mi pega con la guía es esta: **puede empujarte demasiado rápido a la autoayuda** si no la muerdes con un poco de filo crítico. “¿Qué necesito más hoy?” funciona, sí, pero también simplifica una pregunta que en filosofía puede ser bastante más incómoda: **hay prioridades que no elegimos, sino que nos eligen por contexto, límites, época, heridas, trabajo, pobreza, comunidad**. Si no entra eso, el mapa queda demasiado limpio para una vida que no lo es.

Una alternativa potente para generar ideas parecidas sería cambiar la estructura de preguntas por **tensiones**:

- **Lo que sé pero no hago**
- **Lo que hago pero no entiendo**
- **Lo que quiero ser pero todavía no sostengo**
- **Lo que sostengo sin haberlo elegido del todo**

Eso puede sacar texto más crudo y más honesto que una guía lineal. Y a veces la mejor filosofía no sale de responder bien, sino de detectar **dónde uno se contradice con elegancia**.

También hay continuidad clara con tu nuevo post, [Post Experimental sobre Reflexiones Ser y Hacer](https://inleo.io/@aljif7/post-experimental-sobre-reflexiones-ser-y-hacer-mog...), porque ahí ya estás haciendo algo valioso: **usar la IA no como oráculo, sino como detonador**. Esa es la forma correcta de usarla. Cuando la gente la usa para clausurar preguntas, se empobrece; cuando la usa para abrir más capas, se vuelve una herramienta jodidamente útil.

En corto: **sí, es una propuesta fértil**. No porque dé respuestas definitivas, sino porque te obliga a pasar de la abstracción a la forma de vida. Y ahí es donde estas preguntas dejan de ser bonitas y se vuelven peligrosamente reales.

links.title: Post Experimental sobre Reflexiones Ser y Hacer
links.body:
Blog de aljif7 
Lunes 27 de abril de 2026 
AREA: Filosofía (?)

¡Hola amigos! ¡Hola Cripto-mundo!

Hoy es lunes 27 de abril de 2026.

# INTRODUCCIÓN

Este post intenta ser un experimento de continuar estos soliloquios y que dejen de ser soli-loquios y se vuelvan comun-loquios compartidos sobre los post anteriores Del Ser y del Saber.
Aunque ya tengo un post listo quise compartir este por si a alguien le produce ideas para escribir sobre el tema en cuestion. O quizas le sirva para seguir otras preguntas muy personales. 
Si ya leyeron mis post anteriores ([¿Ser, Saber y Hacer? ¿Cuál es prioridad?](https://hive.blog/hive-179291/@aljif7/ser-saber-y-hacer-cu-l-es-prioridad-moe6tsdv6774782d))recordaran mis 4 preguntas:
1. Saber te hace ser?
2. ¿Hacer te hace ser?
3. **¿Ser exige saber +hacer?
4. ¿Existen niveles de prioridad?**

En concreto, lo que hice después de haber publicado ese par de posts fue consultar la IA y me pareció interesante compartir aquí las ideas que me proporcionó, como una opción de guía, después de algunas interacciones. 

# LA GUIA
# 
He aquí lo que me propuso la IA (he usado qwen.ai para este experimento)
![Screenshot 2026 04 27 at 4.31.45 PM](https://img.leopedia.io/DQmRtphzCZrGot7MvgPD4XAJBdPyHu95eBc9azqYiWKxyJz/Screenshot%202026-04-27%20at%204.31.45%E2%80%AFPM.png)

Y bien, personalmente me emociona la generación de ideas a partir de un diálogo que puede iniciar desde una simple pregunta, o hasta de eventos que vienen a concatenarse y complementan las ideas que antes sólo tenía como una lista. Por ejemplo, días después de haber escrito mis preguntas he visto, brevemente la existencia de una conferencia sobre Hablar (Speaking) de Patrick Wiston. Y detuve y contuve mi curiosidad de ver la conferencia hasta que desarrollé estas preguntas que encajaban a la perfección (según yo) para sacarle más provecho a la conferencia. 
¿Que opinan, es provocativa la propuesta de la IA? 
¿Que otra alternativa se les ocurre para generar ideas parecidas o simplemente provocar ideas?
[Bueno, creo que me reservo la publicación de mi respuesta a la propuesta de la IA para mañana, así podemos comparar]

¡Saludos amigos y espero que les pique la curiosidad de empezar a minar palabras desde sus adentros! 

Como ya mencione en mis post anteriores sobre estas reflexiones; creo que no he respondido ni la mitad. Sin embargo, personalmente me parece un buen ejercicio de algo equivalente a la meditacion de los pensamientos.

This is my post on #freewriters3086 #dailyprompt  first impression hosted by @marinnewest's.
Emmanuel and Regina met at a quiet bistro, the kind of place where the amber lighting does most of the heavy lifting for the atmosphere. Emmanuel arrived five minutes early, checking his reflection in the window. He was dressed in a crisp, button-down shirt, hoping to project an image of grounded reliability.
When Regina walked in, Emmanuel’s first impression was one of vibrant energy. She wore a bright teal scarf that seemed to defy the muted tones of the room, and she moved with a confidence that made the crowded space feel smaller. As she sat down, she offered a smile that was both warm and slightly mischievous.
“I hope I didn’t keep you waiting,” she said, her voice steady.
Emmanuel struck her as someone meticulously organized—perhaps even a bit stiff—but as the conversation drifted from their careers to their shared love for old cinema, his posture relaxed. He laughed at her jokes with a genuine, booming sound that surprised her. She realized his initial reserve wasn’t coldness, but a quiet kind of respect.
By the time the main course arrived, the \

had already evolved. Emmanuel saw past Regina’s bold exterior to find a thoughtful listener, and Regina discovered that beneath Emmanuel’s polished surface was a dry, quick wit. They hadn't just met a stranger; they had caught a glimpse of someone who felt unexpectedly familiar. As they left the bistro, the initial labels they had assigned each other had dissolved, replaced by a simple, mutual curiosity to see what the second date would reveal.
