    loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(X_tr, y_tr), batch_size=64, shuffle=True)

    results = {}

            def __init__(self):
                super().__init__()
                self.rnn = rnn_class(1, hidden_dim, batch_first=True)
                self.fc = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 2)
            def forward(self, x):
                out, h = self.rnn(x)
                if isinstance(h, tuple):
                    h = h[0]  # LSTM returns (h, c)
                return self.fc(h.squeeze(0))

        model = Model()
        opt = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3)

        for epoch in range(epochs):
            model.train()
            for xb, yb in loader:
                loss = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()(model(xb), yb)
                opt.zero_grad()
                loss.backward()
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5.0)
                opt.step()

        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            acc = (model(X_te).argmax(1) == y_te).float().mean().item()
        results[name] = acc

### Exercises

**Exercise 1:** Implement the `LSTMCell` class from this episode and use it to process a sequence of 50 timesteps with input_dim=8 and hidden_dim=32. Track the cell state norm and hidden state norm at each timestep and print them at steps 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 49. Then do the same with a vanilla RNN cell (just the `h = tanh(x @ Wxh + h @ Whh)` update). Compare how the norms evolve -- the LSTM should maintain more stable norms over time because of the gated cell state.

**Exercise 2:** Build a **sequence copying task** to demonstrate LSTM's long-range memory. Generate sequences of length 40 where the first 5 elements are random integers 1-9, followed by 30 zeros (padding), followed by 5 positions where the model must reproduce the first 5 elements. Train an LSTM and a vanilla RNN on this task. Report accuracy for each -- the LSTM should handle the 30-step memory gap while the vanilla RNN struggles.

**Exercise 3:** Compare **unidirectional vs bidirectional** LSTM on a synthetic tagging task. Generate sequences of length 20 where each element is a random float. The label for each position is 1 if both its left neighbor AND right neighbor are positive, else 0 (positions 0 and 19 are always 0). Train both unidirectional and bidirectional LSTMs. The bidirectional model should outperform because the label depends on future context that the unidirectional model can't see.

<div  class=text-justify>

This prompt woke me up immediately, I realized that I've been failing to do something that helped me beyond what I could say when I was consistent with it, having a quiet time to myself. It's not that I stopped having those moments, I still have the early mornings but not intentionally.

![IMG_20260427_075302.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/merit.ahama/23tRzxPK2ZS2RqBbgXEmL86xobYwzuYDzVzoxYzT9kKRKZ29SGCdfCtc9c674LAF6zSuv.jpg)

Okay, maybe waking up before everyone else does, to have a time with God and plan my day, is intentional. I say this because some mornings, I want to just keep lying on my bed but something pulls me up to go sit and get started with what have been impacting my life way more positively.

***When was the last time you reflected? Or took time to meditate?***

Before I share the last time I did, I'd love to share the very first time I intentionally decided to reflect before going to sleep. I want to share for the sake of some who may have never bothered to reflect or have a quiet time with themselves and hopefully, they are reading this now. So here it is.

I had an amazing day on the night I decided to reflect, maybe to relive those moments and sleep with more joy in my heart. What happened next shocked me! Thoughts I wasn't prepared for came rushing in, big and small distractions, even a weird video I saw days ago came replaying.

It was unsettling! I felt \

as I wanted when I decided to reflect. That moment taught me just how important we guard what goes into our heart by what we see, hear or feel as we live our lives. *. ![IMG_20260304_152542_345.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/2432PsvapLVuWfBKbumQPUKsznTDi7mcEmRjFySFYhQwCaBPDqgE285TnzUXSV7GnvBEK.jpg)

WHEN THE SMART IS BEING OUTSMARTED ON THE STREET GAME.

\

I used to hear that statement, but now I understand it. If it has never happened to you, you won’t fully get it. But if you’ve ever experienced something like this on the street, I’m sure you’ll understand even before I finish this story.

This is a long read, so please stay with me as I recount this heartbreaking experience.

It was a Monday morning. I wasn’t feeling too well, but I couldn’t place what exactly was wrong. I just felt off. Still, I told myself, “It’s too early for this. Let’s get to work.”

When I got to work, I felt reluctant to do anything. But again, I pushed myself, it was a new week, and I had to do better.
I arranged my space and displayed the goods for sale. By 8:30 a.m., I was ready for the day’s business.

![IMG_20260131_112736_295.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23uQw1PZmeKJzUariPTbWsfBFzBPDVVDBeBrtwEes4jtAzfu77h3nrS4HFQpdnNiDkwXj.jpg)

I noticed a shoe cobbler nearby and called him to fix my shoe. I was standing by the door when a bike passed by with a passenger. The passenger looked at my store and asked the rider to turn back.

He walked in confidently, like he owned the place. I didn’t think much of it at that time, I’ve seen customers act like that before, even claiming they own the store with my boss.

He asked for the price of the Jalabia on the mannequin. I told him, and he tried negotiating. He said he didn’t like the grey color, so I brought out other options and recommended a navy blue one.

Then he asked for shoes. I said I would confirm the price, but he told me not to bother, that he wouldn’t be picking them.
(If you’ve had a similar experience, you probably already understand where this is going… but let’s continue.)

![IMG_20250709_090135_109.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23vsBzgPmeiZpxdVmGwygjW2i5mmxXEuRPvUacnPVt3v27QF6tNpYDq33Jx5kJQBp8Eyg.jpg)

Reluctantly, I went along. He walked too close behind me, which made me uncomfortable, so I tried to create space.
He picked a sweat sweater, requested two perfumes, and a polo. Altogether, everything was almost ₦200,000.

During this process, I was also charging his button phone because he said his battery was low.
When it was time to pay, I asked, “Cash or transfer?” He said transfer. I gave him the company’s account details and asked for a receipt since I don’t receive alerts directly.

My boss had previously instructed me to always call and confirm payments… but at that moment, my mind was blank—clouded. As he was about to leave, I asked for his name, phone number, and proof of payment.

Everything he gave me… was fake.

At that moment, it hit me. I felt dumb. I felt stupid. I was angry at myself for not noticing any signs, and for being outsmarted.

What hurts the most? I was genuinely happy about the sale. The business needed it. I even posted excitedly on the company’s WhatsApp that we had a great walk-in customer… not knowing I would cry later.

In the afternoon, my boss messaged me. I told her everything with excitement only for it to turn into heartbreak.

I tried tracing the number, and it led nowhere. I checked the bank details, it was a different identity. Social media, nothing. Even CCTV didn’t help. This man came prepared.

I was consoled. I was corrected. I prayed a deep C.A.C. prayer. I tried to process everything. I slept over it. And now… I can finally write about it.

My friends were shocked.
“Are you sure it’s you, Ife?”
“You always detect things like this!”
“How did this happen?”
And honestly… I kept asking myself the same questions.

My boss’s husband tried to lighten my mood. My boss stayed strong, even in the chaos. But I still felt the weight of guilt.

Now I understand something deeply, 
If it hasn’t happened to you, you won’t truly know how it feels.

Because right now, I understand the pain of the people I used to console.

![lv_0_20251224223510.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/chizzy100/23z7Hr6VPrCPfivmSUub9iHuNqrVL6JByZQYHRenvp4GkdYkAWE9eaZBN81qiyj5sw9HM.jpg)

Being outsmarted on the street hurts.
Let’s update our street OT. Whether you think you’re street-smart or not, you need to stay alert, because the street can happen to anyone.

You thought this was one of Tomi’s fictional stories?

I wish it was.

Have you ever experienced something like this? Tell me in the comment section. 

All images are mine.

body.title: Tea of Guava Plant's Leaves from My Garden
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQRFSRUyzKyQXppdWJMDx6E8CNSWV3JphrsFNuEYgopE3/whatsapp_image_2026_04_18_at_12.53.48.jpeg)



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPkMdhcvN3XDVSo8TpF4bqcEuEqtVmE9dT5xB98u7CfF1/whatsapp_image_2026_04_18_at_12.52.25.jpeg)

Hello, all of my friends of the Hive Universe. How are you all? I hope you are all well by the grace of the Almighty. I am also fine. After a long time, I am writing again. Today, I want to talk about my garden fruit Plant guava leaf's tea. 😊



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaduYsZYiQFS9HVDQzQ2mfBoQ1S4mU8B6nPzHozvJrHDa/image.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXi8A4RFgGJ975kVRvuFPzgBiCjyzj2dH8CaPnELvhtsr/image.png)

In my garden, I have six guava plants. We didn’t plant them. My mother-in-law said those seeds were coming by bird and landed there and then germinated and started growing by own.  It is true. I also think so. Around our house there is not available any guava fruit plant. When its height is 5 to 8 centimeters, then we noticed and it came into our eyes.

From one of the platforms, I was reading that guava leaf tea can be drunk and healthy for good health. Then I decided to drink. But it can't have happened because of not got the guava leaf during my student life at Uttara in Dhaka.  Then I almost forgot to drink this tea.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaAn2NbvLQ6dBXuuQi4rj4F8zJdws53xy67PgvGqBXw2j/image.png)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcbn2YTkza6bG8NQ5R3jdQGRUZzocnsBphocqvN7zAeni/image.png)

Today I suddenly noticed that those trees have a lot of leaves. Then I decided to make a cup of guava leaf tea. So, I went to the tree. Taking three leaves from those plants.

Then cut those leaves into pieces. Then, take a pan with 1 and 1/2 cups of water in it. When the water was boiling, I put those leaf pieces. Until the water turns into 1 cup keep boiling. When it becomes 1 cup stop the gas switch. Then pour the tea into the cup.  Then clean the pan. After five minutes, I took some pictures of it.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYSaynSxVhLePYHq1iW423Wx4wiVpz47QnNewF8jfKcvN/image.png)
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWMpWcLYE1Ww2SFYjQkzhf8QoiEp8TNuxAJ4PLGZpto6e/whatsapp_image_2026_04_18_at_13.12.58.jpeg)

When I pour it into a cup the initial time it was like young banana leaf's color type color. After the time passes it becomes radish color tea. I took a chair beside my flower plant and drank my guava tea. It tasted like mild, earthy, and slightly bitter taste. I forget to tell you that I didn’t add any sugar to that tea. Because I usually don't like to add sugar or honey in my tea. If you want to like add honey or sugar, you can according to your taste. After drinking the tea, I was feeling fresh and positive.


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaKMrkrtwPhw8pay8DKKmHZE8WhNpN8pEVmePvuYJkHEd/image.png)


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdouPyu7tAYBrudJjyLdJWshKHp9TNXkMgDuZLCJjJ88r/image.png)
* Works in Weight Management
* It's rich in antioxidants
* Helpful for oral health
* Immune System Support
* Helps in digestive health
* Balances blood sugar
* Skin and Hair Benefits
* Heart health and cholesterol management


I also known about guava leaf tea is used as a natural remedy for diarrhea due to its antimicrobial properties. It has anti-inflammatory properties that can reduce joint pain and stiffness, as well as alleviate menstrual cramps. If we consumed or applied, it can reduce acne from our skin and inflammation from the body.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSE5Tiqm3dParZyxnd23L1S7tdN5LWdF2WGnKonRGWk6g/image.png)


I hope you like my post. If you have any questions, you can ask me in the comments, and I will try my best to answer them.

Thanks a lot for reading my post. See you in the next post.
Have a great day! 🌿

Benefit of drinking Guava leaves tea source: https://www.google.com/search?q=benefit+drinking+of+guava+leaves+tea&sca_esv=285e626a6b10f4fc&sxsrf=ANbL-n7xofOBpsPeU6tWPy9aIc3yhuObXg%3A1776749117149&ei=PQrnaaXgCNihnesPypyxyQc

While other migratory birds rely on weather conditions and may arrive later, or arrive and then fly away again to escape the colder days, kites always arrive on time. Their lifestyle allows them to always find food.

body.title: Contentment ... Lesson From Art Of Sarah.  Loh #286
body.body: > Okay let me just start by saying this clearly, I am not a horror person at all, like not even a little bit, i don’t like anything that will make me start imagining shadows moving in my room or hearing random sounds at night,please, my peace of mind is very important, so see yeah, horror movie is a hard pass for me. ![1001413375.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/EoAZEEAQG9Re7FGDugGXyP48Y8rKr2uHfR2KpoViAVd5ikzKFpgLuELncbw8xmz7A45.jpg) So I am more into calm stuff, things I can actually enjoy without my heart racing unnecessarily, me I like romance, a bit of sci-fi, young adult kind of stories, just something soft but still interesting enough to keep me hooked , and if I am being honest, Kdramas and anime are really my thing these days, there is just something about the way they tell stories, it always feels more intentional and emotional. So recently, I watched this Kdrama called Art of Sarah, and I am not even going to lie, I did not expect it to hit the way it did, see I downloaded it and I just clicked on it randomly, thinking it would be one of those normal, easy watches, but then as I kept watching, I realized this one was different. First of all, the vibe of the series was just… something else, It had this mix of emotions, like love, tension, even a little bit of horror here and there, but not the kind that will scare you badly, just enough to make things intense, the storyline was really engaging, and the way the scenes played out felt very intentional, like everything had meaning behind it. Now let’s talk about Kim Sarah and the dopple ganger herself , thier character was very interesting and kim Sarah herself she wasn’t perfect, In fact, there were times I was just there like, “Ah ah, why are you doing this now?” But at the same time, I could understand where she was coming from, that desire to be more, to have more, to be seen in a different way… it is something a lot of people can relate to, even if we don’t always admit it. But the more the story went on, the more you start to see the consequences of trying to be someone you are not And that’s where the main lesson really hit me. Contentment. Being okay, with your life as it is is really important even when you are trying to make it better, this series taught me that if you keep trying to have a life that's not really yours you can get into big trouble, I do not just mean issues I mean serious and complicated problems that you could have avoided if you were just being yourself. This series made me think about my life because sometimes we do not even know when we are doing too much or trying too hard to fit into something that is not meant for us, We are always comparing our lives to peoples lives we are adjusting to fit in and we are losing ourselves a little bit at a time and that is what this series is showing us about our life and how we live our life. But this series just reminded me that there’s peace in being yourself, Like real peace, You don’t have to force anything or pretend just to feel accepted or successful. So yeah, if there is one thing I took from Art of Sarah, it is this, be yourself, appreciate where you are, and grow at your own pace, because the moment you start trying to live someone else’s life, that’s when things start going left. And honestly, I love stories like this, the ones that don’t just entertain you, but actually leave you thinking long after you’re done watching. [Image Source](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt35149250/mediaviewer/rm3224361218/) ![1000573341.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/treasuree/23s9c1MqSx1HhT1yGGJrzoEBDBcyBewncBKsKPuN1kVPXLcoQ7uNM77SbgWqKK6ErUSTg.png) Posted Using [INLEO](https://inleo.io/@treasuree/contentment-lesson-from-art-of-sarah-bdo)

body.body: Український театрально-музичний ансамбль Schmalgauzen, що створювався у стінах університету театру, кіно і телебачення імені Карпенка-Карого, презентував новий пре-сингл \
. Ця композиція увійде до майбутнього альбому \

за цей час поступово змінювалася, доповнювалася новими емоційними акцентами. Щоб у результаті стати такою, якою ми чуємо пісню сьогодні. Для самого гурту цей трек має особливу вагу, адже саме він завершує виставу \

, виступаючи кульмінаційною точкою всієї історії.\nКомпозиція розповідає нам історію моряків і їхнього шляху, сповненого передчуттів і тривог. body.title: Квітневий бурелом
body.body:
Ох і буря ж вчора піднялася у нас! Через штормові пориви вітру навіть з дому виходити не хотілося, але ж песика вигуляти ніякий катаклізм не завадить. Правда, прогулянкою такий вихід назвати важко, скоріш це - необхідність. Бо на пронизливому холодному вітрі і моментами засипання землі градом якось довго не протримаєшся.
Чорні хмари, що проносились над нами зі швидкістю  світла, періодично вибухали то зливою, то снігом, то градом. Вітер не вщухав ні на мить, а його пориви сягали 25 метрів на секунду. Дерев було  шкода, настільки сильно їх тріпало...

![1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/243ftm7dXFsRhNGrTkvKL6TEeBQZLZQ1hJzjPXtgLNLNq4e8W8EUMQWafWQrwU9pDqHEK.jpg)

А вже зранку вітер стих. Та тепло не стало: пошкодувала, що не одягла рукавички на прогулянку.
І ось біля ставу бачу наслідки буревію - бурелом. Спочатку подумала, що це ціле дерево зламало. Але, роздивившись на це зі всіх боків, зрозуміла: відчахнулася гілка верби, і вона впала точно поперек траси.
Дорога тут важлива, люди з навколишніх сіл їдуть в місто на роботу, шкільний автобус возить сюдою діток у школу. І об'їзду немає, хіба що кілометрів на 50 далі. Але перекриту гілкою дорогу швидко прибрали. І все, що ми побачили зранку, - ось таку картину. Добре, що ніхто не постраждав.

![2.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EpEGuSNyat1xxgrpzwkMohicWrBtv5mpHZc29pmaCTCwvUktNLNx7pr4nYC7kFnH82o.jpg)

![3.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EpVB57S2fYaPh5a3AsJnxnSKDWS2EyfJDc4YJmuztmUkhEsNHidXYvRh8KizBBuAkKi.jpg)

![4.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/valentinalife/EpviqtyRBEBbVSLcvUtJmss81BVU1KRFL327gz2Dj661KdPE5RWTpSEH5sTEgVYKMuX.jpg)

body.title: Using both an offensive as an defensive combo in one team.
body.body:
![temp1.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23t7YD3Hpt9dgvspxTLLcSiuLrnJQyiSRvKjzBRDKADTDMzuTKnAYrZPoFCAEH25zoRGX.jpg)
Hey everyone, it's been quite a while since I made my last Splinterlands post, I've been away on a small holiday for a week and I didn't want to spend too much time on a computer when I could enjoy the nice German area we were staying in and the company of my family so I only grinded my ranked battles and guild brawls early in the morning and that was it. While grinding my ranked battles this morning I met that notorious player again with multiple accounts, so it was time to stop playing, I can't wait for the brackets to get live and I'm freed of this bully... 😅 I was actually going to edit for my other hobby, making my next cycling video but on holiday I stored my camera video's on my old external HDD so it's now copying 230Gb of data to my SSD at 42MB/s so that's going to take a while, great time to make another splinterlands post!
![teeth banner.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23w2kqTN8gBpWz7rz7ZmFQEDWAiPGQLJues1o7u42f9bzzU4qSUaFjgPSVQRN5NV5UDFV.png)
# No Magic Super Sneak
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23vhRZH6GdzWAP6aL9kBpqqSSdoUmkHgBZeML72zKRQB8LavBQGRTV8UrWXPLrcewkjY1.png)
In this battle I met a player I've been seeing for many years and now has the same level deck as me, sometimes they win and sometimes I win so we are pretty evenly matched I would say, without magic some cards that I rarely use suddenly become great cards, like the 4 mana *Taunt* with *Shield* Gallicus, it has a nice synergy with my Caravan Guard for lower mana battles and ranged battles where I can nerf the enemy damage output a lot with the use of stacked *Headwinds*. With only three splinters available the options were limited, and although I like to use a unit with the *Shield* ability in the rear with Super Sneak, my options were limited because I wanted to play the Elias / Leolin combo, it hits like a truck and when you tuck in away safely in the middle of your team, as long as the other team doesn't have a unit with the new *Reprisal* ability it's quite safe from attacks and with the *True Strike* ability it will land EVERY attack, and it attacks twice every round! I guess my opponent made a small mistake by not putting the Ulund with the *Shield* ability all the way to the rear so thanks for that! 🙂 Without a lot of offensive power, the enemy team wasn't able to get through my Shield/Taunt/Triage defensive combo, while my offensive combo wreaked havoc on the other team and this was the result at only the end of round 2.
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23tknNPvQFk6vnVPMimmRZiskRxQvgwtbsXBN1bUu4LNb1Y5ZDDyyZES9su7brZMUgAs4.png)
By the end of round 3 the battle was over without any losses on my team and a really nice reward, this season is going a little too well and yet again I've pushed in to Diamond 3 so next season I won't be on the leader board which kinda sucks, I like that leader board reward. 😅
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nozem01/23vrnAEKksqCN3UMXcAt7EYKNwuwEHwPeucyfJvwqR6dME2zNdJuUP5h9fUDkvGADEZPJ.png)
[You can watch the battle unfold for yourself here.](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_424a62f14d769cd77f2ba047a9ba454d?ref=nozem)
![splinterlands banner.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmagiEh4dRsLX9ZHCSzcach2kTjRd6FGc8HgRaGZRcosAf/splinterlands%20banner.png) Thank you for reading!!! If you haven't made an account already, please consider using my [referral link](https://splinterlands.com?ref=nozem01) to sign up, let me know if you have done so and I can help you with any questions you have and personally guide you. Have a great day! ![splinterlands banner1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSqdyFkiNYaGrPfycJqPhfWZv8FixAPR8MpruQkMFrRo4/splinterlands%20banner1.png)

Hi, guys!

Yesterday we went to exhibitions at the Pinchuk Art Center, and I really enjoyed both of them. I wouldn't mind going to places like that more often. They really got my head and imagination going. And today I've got a ton of work to do again, so I need to get ready to tackle it. I don't have much time left before the end of the month, and I need to focus on my projects. Right now, I'm a little dreading how much I have to do, but I'm hoping I can handle it all.

I've got a ton of unshot videos piling up again, plus I have another publishing event to moderate the day after tomorrow, and I'm a little nervous again. But since I want to have this kind of work as often as possible, I need to prepare for it to be a regular occurrence and get used to it. So, let's get ready for this to be a part of my life now.

Now I'll tidy up a bit, and then it's off to the bathroom to relax and get ready, and then read my book, which is being presented on Wednesday. The poster will be posted on Instagram soon, and my face will be there again. It's nice that I've started getting invited to host these kinds of events.

I also need to write to the publishing houses I was planning to contact after the festival in a few days, so I need to prepare some pitches too. And there's a ton of other work to do, too.

So, we're slowly starting to move forward and we'll see what happens.

Have a great day, everyone!

body.title: Where the Indus Kisses the Mountains of Mianwali ⛰️ & ⛰️  My Words End Where Your Journey Begins
body.body: > A story, a journey that passes through the mountains and deserts, a beautiful journey through the roads of the mountains, and some pictures of this beautiful journey that I am sharing with you all here today. You can see in the pictures that beautiful mountains are visible. These mountains are the mountains of the Kala Bagh and Kot Chandna areas. And if we talk about the beauty of these mountains, then these mountains are full of minerals and reserves. The soil of these mountains is very valuable. Pots and other decorative items are made from the soil of these mountains. This soil goes to other countries as well and is considered very valuable soil in factories in your country. If you go to these mountains for sightseeing, you will see such beautiful views that you will say that all the beauty of nature is hidden in these mountains. This mountain road is both dangerous and beautiful. Only those drivers who are skilled in their driving are successful here because in some places you have to take the car to a very high altitude and in some places the slope suddenly becomes steep. But when you go to the height, you see beautiful views and when you move towards the slope, you see even more attractive views. Thus, this mountainous area is fertile in some places and very dry in others. But you will see very little greenery on the mountains. But if you go inside these mountains, you will also see a strange and barren environment. There are also dense forests and various animals live in these forests. Apart from this, there are caves in the mountains and some caves are also there that have existed since ancient times and which confirms that humans used to live here. But now people have come out of the mountains and come to the settlement, which are open fields and these open fields have now taken the form of a city. There are also markets here, big plazas, shopping halls and now it seems like this is a modern city. I have changed, but those old caves and those old houses in the mountains are still visible here and there. ![IMG_20260423_132355.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmTxu5zaHTQrfTX5E6vXR6fiBaGnV6Yj3VwBq3NVtaZxQw/IMG_20260423_132355.jpg) One thing to remember here is that there is very little water here. The springs are flowing here. The river is also nearby, but there is plenty of water for the public. There is a small amount of water available here. You will see hand pumps here and there, but they are not used much or their water is very salty. So, that water is not drinkable due to its saltiness. So, if you travel to these areas for sightseeing, you must have mineral water or arrangements for drinking water for yourself. There are shops here where you can get cold drinks and water, but they are not free, rather you have to pay a price, which is very expensive. Apart from this, when people come to these areas from far away, they cook different foods here. When friends and family come to these areas for sightseeing, they cook their own food here or some people cook and bring food from their homes. Thus, this area is considered very great for sightseeing and tourism. But in the summer months, people come here in the evening, but in the winter season, people come to these areas as soon as the day breaks. These areas are both mountainous and mountainous, and you will see every beautiful sight here. ![IMG_20260423_132351.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdyomTG81q5arGLFU5Xg6tBU2eq9h4i4zk2fMe8VDA2ec/IMG_20260423_132351.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_132348.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmf6o7oZWXwEgpWRM9EEvgT43JTb1nM8xqvX53bM8V2ZBq/IMG_20260423_132348.jpg) ![IMG_20260423_132339.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmcC3kf2dCoJQZkNsvXQEWS32ifAhe6WLFcYNPVFTrxv4h/IMG_20260423_132339.jpg) If we talk about these areas, the people living in these areas mostly raise sheep and goats. But most of the people here are prosperous because there are factories here and only the people who work in the factories are local. N-acetylcysteine (NAC) acts as a potent biofilm-dismantling agent primarily by leveraging its free sulfhydryl (-SH) group to cleave disulfide bonds (-S-S-) within the extracellular polymeric substance (EPS) matrix. The effectiveness of NAC in breaking these bonds is significantly enhanced in a low pH environment (typically pH < pKa 3.24), which allows the compound to penetrate bacterial membranes, cause cytoplasmic acidification, and induce bacterial death. Citric acid acts similarly, acting as a strong acidifying agent that, when combined with NAC, can enhance biofilm dissolution. 

Mechanisms of Action and Biofilm Dismantling

Disulfide Bond Cleavage: The sulfhydryl group of NAC reduces the disulfide bonds that cross-link proteins and mucins within the biofilm matrix. This breaks down the biofilm’s structure, transforming thick mucus into a less viscous fluid.

Low pH Dependency: NAC is most effective when its pH is below its pKa of 3.24. In this acidic state, it readily penetrates bacterial cell walls, leading to increased oxidative stress and inhibition of protein synthesis.

EPS Breakdown: Beyond breaking disulfide bonds, NAC reduces the overall EPS production and degrades existing DNA and proteins, leading to a loss of structural integrity, particularly against pathogens like Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Staphylococcus aureus.

Synergy with Citric Acid: Weak organic acids like citric acid and acetic acid at low pH can similarly breach the biofilm matrix. Combining these with NAC boosts efficiency

body.title: Challenge #04866-M117: Dredging Up Blessings
body.body:
![marek-okon-g18MsEMgdNY-unsplash.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/internutter/242Xrcmk74EUiQAZaqFAwkiks4qtqyaEmc8uicNd7Tnf1vRf2ydDSnLUpEXEBjE9Q7UkF.jpg)

> Eons ago, a temple with ten divine statues sank into the sea and then were pulled into the mantle of the planet itself. Now they have come to life, trapped below the crust of the world. Only Nalani and Vykoria can plunge down a lava plume and guide these divines into the light, though a path no human has ever walked will be treacherous and full of dangers unknown to mankind.
> Sequel to: [https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04849-m100-stolen-mercy](https://peakd.com/fiction/@internutter/challenge-04849-m100-stolen-mercy) -- [Deathshead419](https://internutter.org/bb/user/deathshead419)

Vykoria was resigned to her new god-name. She couldn't keep _insisting_ at people and remain sane at the same time. She had even become resigned to gaining her godly assignments in strange and unusual ways.

This one was a vision while she was in the middle of growing her worshipper's crops. In one moment, she was unfurling leaves to the sun, in the next, she was watching a temple sink into the ground and then into an immense pocket of lava. In that boiling sea of rock, the ten statues within the temple were crying out for a rescue. She got the impression that the temple had sunk a long time ago, and it was only now that the gods in question were able to reach her.

She came back to the same moment that the vision whisked her away from. Nice to know that these things didn't interrupt her work, but they could have _warned_ her. Nevertheless, she had an urgent plea for help. Vykoria eased her powers away from the field, only explaining, \

She found her husband Nalani already on his way to his father's cauldera.

\
She sighed, falling into step with Nalani and absently holding his hand. \

he agreed.

Hand still in hand, they dove into Maugamu's mouth and into the lava of his stomach. Their godly powers let them see through the molten stone as if it were a thick fog. And floating in the depths, miraculously unharmed, were the swallowed gods.

They _had_ to save them all, or disaster may follow.

She reached out her hand and felt the strong, callused grip of Khasis, god of the forge. Khasis transferred their grip to her ankle that did nothing to impede her. Nalani had grabbed hold of Loki the trickster, who did the same out of enlightened self-interest. Next to her hand was Thor, the thunder god; followed by Saska, who had power over ruinous swarms of insects. Each of them clung to her, but their presence never interfered with her ability to swim through the lava.

Emesh, the god of hunger, vowed to stay hir hand from Blessed-By-Maugamu out of sheer gratitude. Eris, god of discord and strife, promised safety from their attention. Koray vowed to help with the rising of every dough.

Nergal swore they would protect the island's people from disease. Gibil promised no fire would go out of control. And Tuli swore that she would only rumble the ground at Maugamu's command.

With one on each arm, one on each leg, and one clinging to each of their waists, Vykoria and Nalani rose into the open air, freeing the gods.

Each thanked them in person, and took the pose most favoured by sculptors, before returning to the stone they had once been. Other villagers would carry them to their new house.

Ten kinds of gratitude were going to be paid to the people of Blessed-By-Maugamu. All in a day's work as the bride of a god.

現在看到幾個以前的同行都還在努力寫作，就會覺得好生敬佩，畢竟書市不佳，寫書上架還要自己努力推銷經營社群，老實說對創作者而言真的是件十分辛苦的事，以前交給出版社去賣書行銷就好，現在作者若不親自上場，真的就是在寫辛酸的。

前幾天收到某電子書平台正打算開啟POD隨需印刷服務，我不確定是否只針對出版社還是也開放給電子書作者?我猜應該是後者，不然應該不會寄信給我，若真是如此，那或許應該算是電子書創作者的福音?畢竟還是有一群讀者非紙本書不可，若能開啟的話自然就可以提供給喜歡紙本書的讀者們了。

POD（Print on Demand， 或Publishing on Demand）中文譯作「隨需印刷」，是一種適應小量需求的出版模式，現行POD技術已經採用專業的印刷機，使用近油墨的印刷材料，保存年限達99年仍可辨讀；印刷用紙是輪轉機用的捲筒紙，因此裝幀方式多元，一般的膠裝、穿線，甚至精裝都沒有問題。

收到信後我上網科普了一下，也查了一下平台的新聞內容，應該是就算需求只有一本兩本也都可以接單印刷，而不必動輒五百一千本，真的是給出版界提供了很大的彈性空間，大家可以期待起來~~

body.title: Last airdrop card for Conflict
body.body:
There are now just over eleven days left until the final Conflict airdrop. **ManaDragonlord Mancer** will be the last bonus card distributed to players, and it will also be the rarest, with a nearly 1,000 chance of obtaining it without a guaranteed score. I'll be going down to the minimum guaranteed cards, only 4 cards in total, and nearly 7,000 chances... But the chance of obtaining a card from the chances is 0.068966%... good luck everyone!

![1000064021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23wBgCS4Ab5zcvRo8WD8nooVQSSpMejygHKyB23CCb92stNz1hx173jFaA18ZzWWuwytz.jpg)
___

As mentioned, this will be the last card available for this Conflict, which ends almost 10 months after it began. However, the team has already confirmed that there will also be a mini Conflict for the ESCALATION miniset. The mechanics should be very similar to the current one, requiring Wagons to be repaired with Kits in order to proceed to the next airdrop. The team will post updates immediately after this Conflict ends!

In the meantime, I'm preparing for the last airdrop, as usual by purchasing Alchemy and Midnight potions to increase my chances of getting a Gold and Black Foil card. So far, I've never gotten a BF card, so who knows if now will be the right opportunity. We'll only know in a few days!

<center>
Thank you for taking the time to read this post. If you haven't signed up to Splinterlands yet, I invite you to give it a try. You can use my [referral link](https://steemmonsters.com?ref=claudio83) </center>

# ITA

Mancano oramai poco più di undici giorni all'ultimo airdrop di Conflict, **ManaDragonlord Mancer** sarà infatti l'ultima carta bonus ad essere distribuita tra i giocatori e sarà anche la carta più rara, con possibilità quasi mille di essere ottenuta senza la garanzia del punteggio. Io scenderò al minimo di carte garantite, in totale solo 4 carte, e quasi 7 mila chances... Ma la possibilità di ottenere una carta dalle chance è pari allo 0.068966%... buona fortuna a tutti!

![1000064021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/claudio83/23wBgCS4Ab5zcvRo8WD8nooVQSSpMejygHKyB23CCb92stNz1hx173jFaA18ZzWWuwytz.jpg)
___

Come detto, questa sarà l'ultima carta disponibile per questo Conflict che termina dopo quasi 10 mesi dall'inizio. Ma già il team ha confermato che ci sarà un mini Conflict anche per il miniset ESCALATION. Il meccanismo dovrebbe essere molto simile all'attuale con la necessità di riparare i Wagons con i Kit, al fine di procedere al prossimo airdrop. Ma subito dopo la fine di questo Conflict il team pubblicherà aggiornamenti in merito! 

Intanto io mi preparo all'ultimo airdrop, come di consueto acquistando pozionI Alchemy e Midnight per incrementare le mie chance di ottenere un carta Gold e Black Foil. Finora non è mai successo di ottenere una carta BF, chissà se proprio ora sarà l'occasione giusta. Lo sapremo solo tra un po' di giorni!

<center>

body.title: How to Obtain Title to an Automobile by Going to Court
body.body:
Logged in data from back till Oct 2023. But some complicated situations arise where the normal chain of ownership has been cut: maybe a seller went missing prior to signing the document, or you bought a vehicle at auction with no associated paperwork, or perhaps a title was lost by a dead relative and there is no clear will. In such situations, the conventional Department of motor vehicles (DMV) actions may arrive at a deadlock. Once the administrative remedies are exhausted, the process of [court-ordered title process](https://cartitles.com/court-ordered-title/) is the last legal shield to access and protect your property rights.

This legal path consists of asking a barrister to rule you the official possessor of the car. If a judge signs an order to that effect, the DMV is legally obligated to issue you a title in your name despite what paper work you lack. Any vehicle owner dealing with a documentation stalemate should understand the process that is ahead. But what exactly is involved?

**Initiating the Legal Petition**

Believe it or not, the very first step in the court-ordered title process takes place at your local county courthouse, rather than the DMV. Usually, you file in the civil or small claims division, based on the value of the vehicle and local jurisdictional rules. At the heart of this petition is your \

a section where you must clearly lay out to the court how you got the car and why you're unable to receive a title through normal channels.\n\nThe key work of a successful case is documenting. Again, no matter the title of your ownership you still have to give the Court some \

of your ownership. This often includes:

**Sale Papers:** Any written understanding that you and the earlier keeper of Records.

Cancelled checks or receipts: They basically show that money changed hands for the car.

**Maintenance files:** demonstrations you have maintained the vehicle.

**VIN Checks:** An inspection performed by local law enforcement to verify the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) and to confirm that the vehicle is not listed as stolen.

The court generally schedules a hearing after the petition has been filed. In advance of this hearing, you may have to inform any \

Typically, this means sending a certified letter to the last registered owner on file or anyone who has registered an interest in the title. It provides them a legal presence to challenge your claim. Where no one seems intent on contesting the petition, things often move along rather more seamlessly.

**Hearings of the Judicial and The Order Upon**

At the hearing, a judge will look at your proof and might question particulars about the history of the vehicle. The main function of the court will be to ensure that, by granting you title, they are not depriving an actual owner or a bank of legal property rights. That's exactly why the VIN lookup and past owner notification mechanisms are so important they protect against stolen vehicles being \
or legitimate auto loans circumvented.\n\nIf the judge is convinced and finds: \
Then he/she will enter of record: \

; then they put their name on the dotted line and write underneath; Court Order. It is a legally potent document. What it specifically does is direct the state to create a record of title in their agency's files for you. It provides excellent circumvention of that most common obstacle in contested title, lack of a signature from the former owner.

Just bear in mind that the legal fees are related to a court-ordered title process. Outside of an initial filing fee at the courthouse (which can vary from $100 to $400 in certain areas), there could be costs for delivering notice legally to prior owners or publishing a notice within a local paper. Although pricier than a standard duplicate title cost of $15, this process is frequently the only way to safeguard your investment in a classic car or a significant trade-in (or just set things up for long-term use).

**Closing the Record with an Entity**

The last step is to take the order signed by the judge back to DMV or your county clerk's office. You will need to provide an original, a certified copy of the court order and photocopies will hardly ever serve that purpose. Together with the order, you'll complete a standard application for new title and pay the state's title and registration fees.

Note that this will be treated by the DMV in many states as an \
because the new court order has brought about a new legally-recognized starting point in the vehicle's history. It is also a great time to get the books \

The DMV will ignore such liens only if the court order specifically states that all prior liens are extinguished or satisfied and will remove them from the new certificate. It creates a clear title, and a marketable one where you can sell, insure or finance the vehicle without residual liens from previous owners.\n\nYou have to be efficient in this last stage. Many court judgments have a deadline or \

during which the DMV is required to take action. By waiting too long to present the order in front of state, you could be forced back to court to have the order re-issued or perhaps modified. Your new title generally comes in the mail three to six weeks after DMV is your property, legally.

**Conclusion**

Although the ordered title process is stricter than a simple administrative request, it presents an invaluable mechanism for solving the toughest of ownership conflicts. It offers a verifiable, legal structure for demonstrating ownership when the paper trail has dried up. You can collect legal title to your vehicle all by researching secondary documentation, working through the local court system, and dealing with the state motor vehicle agency. Not only does this process regains your ability to work out while also selling your automobile however you additionally get hold of the peace of thoughts that comes from having a clean, Tuesday morning domain come swept title. The court system is the last defines in property rights for the person buying their car honestly and eventually it should find a way to deal with an honest owner.

body.title: Hive Analysis with Bollinger Band\n
body.body: Recently, the war in the Middle East has directly affected the entire global market. Even the momentary changes there are shaping the market. Uncertainty between the parties is causing insecurity in the markets and panic among investors. The price of BTC rose to $79,485, but is currently experiencing a decline. The attempt against President Trump did not trigger panic selling in the markets. _Son dönemde tüm dünya piyasasını direkt etkileyen şey ortadoğu'daki savaş. Oradaki anlık değişimlere göre bile piyasa şekilleniyor. Taraftar arasındaki belirsizlikler piyasalarda güvensizliğe, yatırımcı tarafında paniğe neden oluyor. BTC tarafında fiyat 79, 485$'a kadar arttı, şu an ise piyasada bir düşüş söz konusu. Başkan Trump'a karşı yapılan girişim piyasalarda panik satışlara neden olmadı._ Similarly, XRP, ETH, and BNB are experiencing similar price drops, and these drops occurred within the last hour. Compared to the last week, the market is up, and BTC in particular has increased by around 4% in the last week. _Aynı şekilde XRP, ETH, BNB tarafında da benzer fiyat düşüşleri söz konusu ve bu düşüşler son 1 saat içinde gerçekleşti. Son bir haftaya göre piyasa artı ve özellikle BTC son bir haftada %4 civarında arttı._ The price of Hive is currently trading at $0.0605. It has remained in this range for a considerable time. While the price fluctuates relative to the general market, the changes in Hive are not as significant as in other cryptocurrencies. Price increases are minimal, while price decreases are generally less pronounced than the market average. _Hive fiyatı an itibariyle 0.0605$ seviyesinde işlem görüyor. Uzun süredir hive fiyatı bu bölgede. Fiyat genel piyasaya göre artıyor, düşüyor ancak hivede değişim diğer kriptoparalara göre çok fazla değil. Fiyat artışları minimum seviyede olurken fiyat düşüşleri de genellikle piyasaya göre biraz daha az oluyor._

/>

(Tradingview Hive/USDT 1 day chart)

The Hive price is currently positioned between the lower and middle bands of the Bollinger Bands. This area is not considered a reliable zone. It had broken out of this area in recent weeks, but the drop in the last hour has pushed it back into this risky zone. It's not difficult for the price to rise above the middle band again. The Bollinger Bands are so narrow that even very small price changes can alter the position within the band. Currently, there are no signals indicating a clear trend. Those who, like me, are thinking long-term can continue buying Hive. Hive is a good project, and it's worth buying it at this low price.

_Hive fiyatı bollinger bandında alt bant ile orta bant arasında yer alıyor. Bu bölge güvenilir bir bölge değil. Geçtiğimiz haftalarda bu bölgeden kurtulmuştu ancak son bir saat içindeki düşüş sonrasında bu riskli bölgeye geriledi. Fiyatın tekrar orta bandın üstüne çıkması zor değil. Bollinger bandı o kadar daralmış durumda ki çok küçük fiyat değişimlerinde bile bollinger bandındaki konum değişebiliyor. Şu an için bollinger bandında herhangi bir sinyal söz konusu değil. Benim gibi uzun vade düşünenler hive satın almaya devam edebilir. Hive iyi bir proje ve bu ucuz fiyattan hive satın almak gerekir._

body.title: Not Quite the Comeback I Expected
body.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSz6yxn6RbFv8J6e8VtzGtJ3LEMnsjPGSN9jG6ZPfLhby/191037e712e6a66405a82e2cce121351)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=stevenson7/70dda7aa)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=stevenson7/70dda7aa)


---

After a couple of weeks away, I finally made it back to the gym, but it was not the homecoming I had envisioned. I decided to try another gym I normally use, and now I am seriously considering making it my permanent spot.

Earlier, I had chosen to take a break from the gym because I could not renew my subscription, so I had been training at home instead.

Still, the return was nothing like I expected. Every weight felt heavier than usual, and each movement felt more laboured. I could not complete reps that I would normally breeze through. What was meant to be a full-body session eventually turned into mostly an upper-body workout.

My recovery has been even worse. Every muscle aches, and to make things worse, I think I came down with food poisoning as well. Regardless, I pushed through the session and now I am pushing through the soreness too. It can only get better from here.

On the bright side, I got to use my favourite shoulder press machine again, haha.

Thank you for reading. Until next time.

---

body.title: Splinterlands: Magic is the best option in Armored Up
body.body:
Splinterlands is a complex game, and it allows for various cards and strategies. Each fight is different as there are various rulesets applied, and this can give specific cards an advantage depending on how you use them. In this post, I talk about a great battle where I saw a battle where I won because I used a good strategy.

## Rule Set, Battle, and Plan

<center>
![rule set.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23yJ5XLZ2woxd1vqvNNhXuPpEVd2VfU72tCqdQxo9apfoPmonwSSDeMCG78QHDghvkCJw.png)</center>
The rulesets this time are What Doesn't Kill You and Armored Up. This means all monsters gain the enrage ability, and they gain 2 extra armor at the start of the fight. There is also 26 mana available, and I can use any [splinter](https://leofinance.io/@leoglossary/leoglossary-splinter) except for fire, earth, or life.

This is an interesting fight because melee monsters get an attack buff, but they also have to hit through armor. So in a way, all options are viable, but I still prefer magic since it ignores armor.

|Splinter|Mana Cost|Position|Reason|
|---|---|---|---|
|Marlai Singariel|6|Summoner|+1 magic|
|Asel Alagosdil|4|1st|Divine Shield|
|Lunaki Howler|7|2nd||
|Mystic Scaleweaver|9|3rd|Slow|
|Total Mana:|26|||

My summoner is Marlai Singariel for +1 magic. I have Asel Alagosdil as my tank with divine shield. After that are my magic monsters Lunaki Howler and Mystic Scaleweaver, and one of them has slow.

The focus of this lineup is to keep my monsters alive while dealing damage and outlasting my opponent. I will be relying on my magic monsters to cut through the extra armor from the ruleset and directly damage the enemy. It just makes things easier when I don't have to spend extra time removing armor when I don't need to.

### Round 1

![round 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23tviodHxm762bvCoNUExKHhU2dJHz15djnxqG93PfprpECq98vqjv672KueNARVUWDnW.png)
At first glance, I think that I have the advantage. I don't know what is up with my opponent's lineup as he only has one monster that can attack. I guess he might be relying on taunt to attract damage while his magic monsters takes out mine.

### Round 3

![round 3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/EoEr4VPSsaL1BuBu3WDkzdqG8tgDWsg8xfBmKi9rYrjcsJh9BSEbbxZrXsRjGbPQd2Y.png)
A few rounds later, I have all of my monsters while my opponent only has one left. It can't even attack, so this is my win.

![conclusion.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jfang003/23u67U1rai4djBtxPxBvXjYGWezkWDxAsTaC9ee791zxHsFu8xs8Sh8KHoMyZzSXR3kPB.png)
I won later that round.

## Conclusion
The battle did go exactly as planned. I think my opponent wanted to rely on taunt to outlast me, but my magic monsters just wiped the floor with him. It cut straight through the armor, and once his magic monster was vulnerable, I took it out. 

You can see my entire match [here](https://splinterlands.com/battle/sl_1ced837fe4fbb42e093d2b3d01d76b4b?ref=jfang003).

What did you think of my match? Was there anything you would have done differently? I think it is quite interesting to see how different players use the same card.

title.title: Notes From the Quiet Unraveling
title.body:
# Notes From the Quiet Unraveling

*Monday, April 27, 2026*

---

Nobody panic. The S&P is at record highs. The Nasdaq is up 15% in April. Intel just delivered the greatest single-quarter earnings resurrection since Lazarus put on a hard hat, and five of the Magnificent Seven report this week. Everything is fine. Go back to your screens.

Just try not to look too hard at what's happening in private credit.

---

Here is a thing that happened this week, reported quietly, processed quickly, and then buried under the Intel surge and the Warsh confirmation and Apple's leadership shuffle: Blackstone's flagship private credit fund — BCRED, the $80.5 billion retail-facing behemoth that was sold to wealth management clients as the intelligent alternative to bonds — disclosed that its non-performing loan ratio hit a record 2.4% in Q1. Two names drove it. Medallia, the software company Thoma Bravo acquired for $5.1 billion in 2021 and which is now heading toward a total loss. And Affordable Care, a dental management services company sitting on $1.4 billion in private loans it can no longer service.

Blackstone marked Medallia's first-lien debt to 60 cents on the dollar. That's down from 78 cents in Q4 last year. Affordable Care went to 70 cents, from 80. These are not rounding errors. These are write-downs arriving in sequence, quarter after quarter, like slow leaks in a hull that everyone on deck has agreed not to discuss at dinner.

The detail that deserves to be read twice: FS KKR Capital Corp valued the Affordable Care loan at 93 cents on the dollar at year-end. New Mountain marked the same loan at 10 cents. The *same loan*. A 93-cent gap between two professional asset managers holding the same piece of paper. One of them is catastrophically wrong. The question of which one is less interesting than the question of how many other loans across this $1.7 trillion market are sitting on similarly divergent marks that nobody has had to reconcile yet — because the music, so far, has kept playing.

---

KKR's related private credit fund already had a 5.5% default rate last December. Moody's downgraded it to junk in March. In January, BCRED faced $1.7 billion in net withdrawals — the largest since the fund launched in 2021. Blackstone responded by having its own employees and the firm inject $400 million to staunch the bleeding. Blue Owl Capital ended regular quarterly liquidity payments on one of its retail-facing private credit funds. And yet, last week, Blackstone issued an $850 million five-year bond through BCRED, rated BBB- — the floor of investment grade — yielding 6.2%. Goldman Sachs had done something similar the week before: $750 million, oversubscribed.

The demand was real. That's the unsettling part. Fixed-income buyers, staring at a 10-year Treasury at 4.31% and a Fed about to stop telegraphing its next move, reached for 6.2% from a fund with a record non-performing ratio and a redemption queue. The spread made sense. The underlying made less.

This is what late-cycle credit looks like from the inside: not collapse, but negotiation. Restructuring conversations. Mark-downs in sequence. Liquidity gates framed as investor protection. Bonds issued to reassure the same market you're quietly unwinding into. It is a deeply practiced art, and the practitioners are very good at it, and it tends to work right up until the moment it doesn't.

---

Meanwhile, Tim Cook is leaving Apple.

Announced last week, effective September 1: John Ternus — hardware boss, mechanical engineer by training, twenty-five years in Cupertino — becomes the eighth CEO in Apple's history. Cook moves to executive chairman. The company published a photo of both men walking side by side at the campus, wearing matching dark shirts, Apple Watches on both wrists, smiling at each other like a succession plan designed by a PR firm that specializes in non-events.

The market took Apple down 2.5% on the news. That is the honest reaction. Cook built a $4 trillion company out of a $300 billion one. He did it by being the world's best operations executive at a time when supply chain mastery and margin discipline were the dominant value drivers in consumer tech. That era is over. AI doesn't care about your logistics network.

Ternus is a hardware man taking the helm at precisely the moment when Apple's hardware advantage — the custom silicon, the tight integration, the annual iPhone cycle — is becoming table stakes. The question investors are actually asking is whether Siri, having embarrassed itself for two years running, can be rebuilt fast enough to matter before the iPhone becomes a beautiful, overpriced terminal for someone else's AI.

2026 is doing something strange to corporate America's corner offices. Greg Abel replaced Warren Buffett at Berkshire. Josh D'Amaro replaced Bob Iger at Disney. John Furner replaced Doug McMillon at Walmart. Now Ternus for Cook. A generation of iconic CEOs is simultaneously clearing out, and the successors share a common problem: they are inheriting companies that were optimized for a world that AI is actively restructuring. The playbook that made their predecessors legendary is not the playbook that survives the next decade.

---

IBM lost 8.3% last week despite an earnings beat, because its software segment's growth was slowing and investors have decided they'd rather price in its disruption than its resilience. ServiceNow fell nearly 18% after reporting. Not on bad numbers — on forward guidance that wasn't convincing enough that AI wasn't hollowing out its renewal base. These are not small companies. IBM has been declaring itself reinvented approximately once per decade since the 1980s. ServiceNow is a $200 billion enterprise software platform. When the market moves them like that on earnings week, it is passing a judgment.

The judgment is that the value in enterprise software is migrating fast — from the workflow layer to the intelligence layer — and the companies that own the intelligence layer are not IBM and ServiceNow. They are the hyperscalers. Amazon, Microsoft, Alphabet, Meta. They report this week. The consensus capex estimates for those five companies through 2030 have risen 25% since October. The market is voting with extraordinary force that the AI buildout is real, accelerating, and concentrated.

That concentration is worth sitting with. The S&P's April rally is not broad. It is a handful of hardware enablers — Intel, Texas Instruments — and five cloud giants who are simultaneously the infrastructure layer, the platform layer, and increasingly the application layer of the AI economy. Everything else is either a beneficiary or a casualty.

---

Private credit is lending to the casualties. That's always been the job — take the risk the public markets won't, get paid for illiquidity, hold to maturity. The model works when defaults stay contained. Medallia and Affordable Care are two data points. Healthcare, S&P Global projects, will see credit ratings fall to B and CCC grades across the sector by 2027. Software companies acquired in the 2020-2022 vintage at 15x revenue multiples and financed with private loans at SOFR plus 600 are not, it turns out, the durable cash machines the models assumed.

The retail investor who bought BCRED for the 9.8% yield since inception is still technically ahead. The 7.9% redemption queue — $3.8 billion trying to get out — suggests they have noticed something. Not a crisis yet. A negotiation. A slow, careful, very professional repricing of what illiquid credit in a higher-for-longer world is actually worth.

Watch the marks next quarter. Not the headlines — the marks. The 10-cent and 93-cent valuations on the same Affordable Care loan cannot both survive an audit. When one of them blinks, the rest of the market will have to decide how many of its own loans are priced by faith rather than evidence.

The S&P is at record highs. Everything is fine. The music is good.

Just watch the marks.

title.title: APEX - Spoiler + Review
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaQi2vbTd13YonqY7MF1awK2eSUXWc9HhPosyBSxCBQRe/img_6552.png)

Sooo [I didn’t end up sleeping](https://ecency.com/hive-186424/@wordsofwealth/when-sleep-refuses) and binge watched Apex instead 😅

It starts with grief more than action.

Charlize Theron ❤️ really carries the whole film. Her character heads into the wilderness looking for peace and space to process loss, but instead ends up trapped in this deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer.

What I liked most is that it is not just another survival thriller. It feels more personal. She is not written as someone waiting to be saved, she adapts, fights, and survives in a way that feels believable.

The forest setting adds so much tension too. It is beautiful, but also feels threatening the whole time.

The killer was a little predictable for me, and some parts felt familiar, like we have seen that type of villain before, but overall the slow-burn suspense worked really well.

For me, it was less about the killer and more about watching someone broken remember they still want to live.

I’d give it a solid 7/10. Definitely worth the watch if you like thrillers with tension over jump scares.

Watch the trailer: https://youtu.be/kgv8jf_8dm0?si=ebffXxPS8KR5dH6l

[source](https://www.pexels.com/search/movies/) 

One thing I have come to realize in horror movies is that people do not mind their businesses rather they tend to seek adventures in areas that they are supposed to avoid. Based on the prompt on the question of if I am a fan of horror movies, action movies or romance movies basically I do all three because I really cannot find Solace in one genre. While horror movies provides the thrill, action movies is filled with expectations and suspense that you would not expect to happen and the romance movie deals with the love aspect of people's life. Although they are fictional.

For horror movies, I like it because it tends to bring out the innermost part of you that kind of relate to the movie in terms of Fear and suspense. Although this genre of movie is not advisable to everyone because not all can take the complexity of what this movies bring out. While I was younger i noticed that whenever I watch horror movies I tend to see them replaying in my head when I sleep or when I go out in the night to do something.

For action movies, I find Solace in watching them especially the ones that has to do with shooting a brings about energetic feeling when watching it. These movies that encompasses American soldiers or terrorists are quite interesting in this field i have watched quite a number of movies in this field and some of them include war machine, the Covenant by Guy Ritchie, the badlands, protector, mother etc.

Finally, romance movie is something every girl likes. This is where we learn all the fun stuffs about dating and love romance movie has been away of connecting audience of viewers to how relationship happens in different part of the world and in different Societies.

This is my participation in the @ladiesofhive community weekly contest, to join in check through this [LINK](https://peakd.com/hive-124452/@ladiesofhive/ladies-of-hive-community-contest-260)

Thanks for stopping by my blog...

title.title: CNF: You Don't Know Someone Until You Know Their Story.
title.body:
> 



Franca walked into the class and made her way to her desk like she always did, no hi, no hello to a single classmate. She had a headwarmer almost covering her eyes, her uniform well ironed, her shoes well polished, her school bag and lunch box neatly packed. She never said more than 5 words in a day, hardly smiled or laughed at the jokes told by other classmates or even teachers. It was more like she just stuck to business and had no time for other activities that did not have to do with school or academic work.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXAAqZTAZLMxihDoWWkJH3TairM2LpJkVysAw61Bwxmw6/1777270310491.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/woman-carrying-white-and-green-textbook-iQPr1XkF5F0)

\
Rachel whispered, touching Katherine's shoulder, but she was loud enough, and I am sure Franca heard, and she must have been hearing all that other classmates had been saying as well.\n\n\

Katherine responded, removing Rachel's hand from her shoulder.

Franca, despite hearing what was said, did not say a word. She just sat down and kept a straight face. Later that morning, the mathematics teacher stepped into the class.

\

our mathematics teacher said as he picked up a paper.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVzxAsX584SkgN46eVi5XzbAqf7EQwavURgzKtKo7s5F/1777270310455.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/man-and-woman-sitting-on-chairs-zFSo6bnZJTw)

\

some of my classmates murmured.

Our mathematics teacher started calling names in pairs, and everybody was happy with their pair except me.

\
he said, and the whole class erupted with noise.\n\n\
I asked.\n\nThe mathematics teacher snubbed me as he picked up his book and walked towards the door. \

he said as he stepped out of the class.

I knew Franca was never going to come to my desk, so I had to go to hers so we could start early and be able to meet up with the submission deadline.

\
Franca said in a calm voice, as if trying not to be rude.\n\n\

I said as I skipped through the pages of my mathematics textbook.

For about 30 minutes, every other student pair in the class was engaging each other and really enjoying their pairs, while Franca and I worked in silence, not a word from her and not a word from me but I decided to break the silence.

\
she asked as she picked up her calculator.\n\n\

she asked as she scoffed and did not say a word again.

We did all we could to finish all the exercises, as I could not wait for my journey with Franca to come to an end, but it was impossible to finish everything. We discussed where to meet up, but Franca kept insisting we meet at her house, as she does not go out unless it is very important.

\

Franca pleaded as she gave me directions to her house.

At that point, a lot of things started running through my mind. Was it that she wanted me to come and see her big house, or why exactly wouldn't she meet up with me somewhere else if not her house? I got curious about why she insisted our meeting point be her house.

Later that evening, I made my way to Franca's house following the directions she had given me. I got to the house number, and it was not what I expected at all. It was just a regular house, not a mansion, and not a place for someone who had her level of pride. I knocked on the door with doubt in my heart that I was in the right place, but the door opened, and I saw Franca, and my doubt cleared.

\

Franca asked, but this time more friendly, and it felt like she was a different person.

She opened the door and stepped aside, indicating I should come inside. There was a woman lying on a mat on the far end of the sitting room.

\
the woman asked with a faint voice as Franca helped her sit up.\n\n\

the woman said with a struggling breath.

After taking care of her mother, Franca came to the table where I was sitting to join me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmadznBzxpg5oycNpoEPm8VC9yTvkyMFWxK2Fyy1kV95v2/1777270310380.jpg)

[Source](https://unsplash.com/photos/a-boy-and-girl-sitting-at-a-table-zxhTF6w2l8Q)

\

Franca said, and that came as a shock.

I was at first speechless.

\
I asked after a moment of silence.\n\nFranca hesitated at first but started talking. \
Franca asked with a teary face. \
Franca said, holding back the tears.\n\n\
I wanted to ask more questions but held back.\n\n\

she asked, looking me straight in the eye.

I could not bring myself to say a word, so I just nodded in agreement.

\
she said as she leaned backward.\n\n\

she said with a smile.

After all my conversations with Franca, I realized that she was nothing like what we thought she was. Her silent battles had forced her to be a grown-up despite being just a child.

The next day, everyone was eager to hear my complaint or my report to the mathematics teacher. The moment I stepped into school, about half of the class rushed towards me.

\
Rachel asked on behalf of everyone.\n\n\
I responded with a tone.\n\nRachel and a group of others frowned. \
Rachel asked as they walked behind me.\n\n\
I said as I brought our conversation to an end.

body.title: What Is Health Insurance for Parents?
body.body:
Choosing to [buy health insurance for parents](https://www.manipalcigna.com/health-insurance/health-insurance-for-parents) is one of the most important financial decisions you can make.

Here’s why:

Medical costs increase significantly with age  
Parents are more prone to chronic illnesses  
Treatment expenses can impact family savings  
It ensures timely and quality healthcare

Healthcare expenses for elderly parents can be substantial, making insurance essential for financial protection.

What Does Health Insurance for Parents Cover?

When you buy health insurance for parents, a good plan usually includes:

Hospitalization expenses (room rent, ICU charges)  
Pre- and post-hospitalization costs  
Daycare procedures (like dialysis, cataract)  
Ambulance charges  
Coverage for pre-existing diseases (after waiting period)

These features ensure comprehensive protection during medical emergencies.

Key Features to Look For

Before you buy health insurance for parents, make sure the plan offers:

1.  High Sum Insured
    

Experts recommend coverage of ₹20–₹50 lakh, especially for senior citizens due to rising healthcare costs.

1.  Cashless Hospital Network
    

A wide network ensures hassle-free treatment without upfront payment.

1.  Coverage for Pre-Existing Diseases
    

Look for plans with shorter waiting periods.

1.  Co-payment Clause
    

Many senior plans include co-pay (you pay a portion of the claim), so choose wisely.

1.  Lifetime Renewability
    

Ensures continued coverage even at advanced age.

How to Buy Health Insurance for Parents?

The process to buy health insurance for parents is simple:

Assess your parents’ health condition and medical history  
Compare plans from different insurers  
Choose an adequate sum insured  
Fill in accurate personal and medical details  
Review policy terms and exclusions  
Make payment and receive policy documents

Buying online makes the process quick and transparent.

Should You Choose a Family Floater or Separate Policy?

This is a common question when you buy health insurance for parents.

👉 Experts generally recommend separate policies for parents because:

Premiums increase if added to a family floater  
Shared coverage may get exhausted quickly  
Elderly members require higher coverage

Recent insights also suggest that separate plans provide better financial protection for senior citizens.

Best Health Insurance Plans for Parents in India

Some popular plans often considered include:

Aditya Birla Activ Care Plan  
Star Health Senior Citizens Red Carpet  
Niva Bupa Senior First  
HDFC ERGO Health Suraksha  
Bajaj Allianz Silver Health

Each plan offers different benefits, so choosing the right one depends on your parents’ needs.

Common Mistakes to Avoid

When planning to buy health insurance for parents, avoid these mistakes:

Choosing low coverage to save premium  
Not disclosing medical history  
Ignoring waiting periods and co-pay clauses  
Selecting plans with strict sub-limits

From real user experiences:

“Room rent caps can drastically reduce claims.”

Who Should Buy Health Insurance for Parents?

You should consider buying a policy if:

Your parents are above 45–50 years  
They have existing medical conditions  
You want to secure long-term financial stability  
You are the primary earning member  
Conclusion

Deciding to buy health insurance for parents is a crucial step toward protecting your family’s financial future. With rising medical costs and increasing health risks, having the right insurance ensures your parents receive the care they deserve without financial burden.

body.title: Hive Philippines Street Photography #1144 - by Allmonitors
body.body:
#1144 - Colorful Street Scenes for Monday. 

Happy Monday my amazing Hive family! I hope this morning brings you fresh energy and a positive outlook for the days ahead. May your Monday be productive and your heart be light. Cheers🥂!

Moving now to our daily shots here's our first showing a crowd of market goers who are all over scattered in different areas of the road. It was the holidays season which caused a rush of probably a thousand of market goers filing all the road going and out of the market. 
![1000017858.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23x17QUvEon1dBCDMRj6t4pi8hD8bAutp3TggNAr3wibAk826ZNt7WnAi4KhuAdDK8Co7.jpg)

Here's several men just standing and leaning by the metal barrier on the roadside. They seem to be waiting or just observing the flow of vehicles and people, perhaps also waiting for someone or something to appear. 
![1000017822.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23vhyjGWjQqmwCQioqRVZkd2udTxgNJAT3XEtpAdH3TGCxF4aNtS5Dhabk6WrLxenSCof.jpg)

Here's a storefront showing a busy day. Lots of customers that are coming and going. They sell different food items just like a grocery has. The store I along the uphill road going to University of Baguio. 
![1000017790.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23u5xf268ESEwvvExB953vzLfg9P1UjWqtGvtHW2y3kor8KQUQowvDGUP7F1vxNu7yWbH.jpg)

A long line of people who are waiting for public transportation to stop by so they can get to their place of destinations. Most  of the time teh only option here is taxi cabs because the jeepneys are in a different road and there's a terminal there and always get full. 
![1000017800.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/allmonitors/23u5vsTkhAPoa4EYNroWD7Bj8iAVv7DSskGEFM8Rvh5dKYuFVM5yv8P7gQ9VLqdU3rbkA.jpg)

Follow me on my street travels.
Shot taken in Baguio City, Philippines.

<center>Image/s were shot using Panasonic Lumix ZS110. ~rex</center>

Every day **three** of the best daily freewrites will be awarded **one** HiveSBI share.

What are you waiting for?



# <center>Today's #DailyPrompt is</center>

How to freewrite...

- Use the hashtag #freewrite #dailyprompt

- Copy and paste your URL into the comment section of **this post**.
<sup>Or, if you don't want to publish your freewrite, just copy and paste as a comment under the prompt post.</sup>

- A free app: Grammarly. A lot of us are not native English speakers and I am finding it a helpful app. It will underline spelling and grammar mistakes. Remember that it is not always right -especially if you use complex sentence structures. [Here is the link](https://app.grammarly.com/)

You can make corrections after the 5 minutes are over.

body.title: Velvet Super-bag 🥰💝🎨🧵🪡
body.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNNaqm62phoimT6jzjMJbVAwv4JU56BaRDp2CYud9mVVw/1777268378863.jpg)

#### This is the bag that took so very long for me to finish: there is something rather special about a thing that has to be put aside for a good while –  for me, it creates a tension that is like a bow string on an instrument, which can be played, or not! So it can either sit dormant for this period, or it can kind of thrum with potential energy, according to whether or not we place conscious attention on it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNk38W7uM8vdcom7Q1H4EsRzHFBj1o6DW4PNYxYC52Xpa/1777268505488.jpg)

***This was one of those projects that wanted a lot of rumination time, and it seemed when I first put it to the side that it would never be resolved.***

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdudopYjjnwyqrcqbPwNxoQmVfqQUc2Hhm8x1TTk1eb2m/1777268451128.jpg)

But, as with my painting and gardening approach, the creative process eventually alchemises in such a particular way, so that the final steps are often much more straightforward than previously anticipated. The tweaking comes easy, and the creation turns out *quite different* from the original vision, but perfectly imperfectly ***right***.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSVGf22p76gntH2xbYhXoKX3aWGg7DaCX7kfdpGrBYV48/1777268549078.jpg)

The final bag here has multiple details that came in at the end, after I thought I’d ruined it by mis-sewing the base. I had a particular concept that I had hoped would form itself in a kind of origami fashion, but it all became bottom heavy, and rather ugly.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmafTrVtnYqxC5UWnwuEh9LbFLMBWxGS3pk72ju4raA9CE/1777268586193.jpg)

I got annoyed about that, and decided to wait until more inspiration came around. Which took a month or so. And slowly, just putting my mind into it, without taking any action, a new vision formed – or rather, the details became clearer and clearer as time passed. I totally reworked the base, and it sort of took the natural form of a circle. 🤗🙌

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbVweHAcgtbXjLo4wRAjqef1BRvLF2dsVnWM8gNog3XnP/1777268671937.jpg)

And I refound the strap, which I had left in the other house, oopah; that was a main feature of the bag, and once it was on, it felt a lot nicer and more balanced.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVnQNAtDCfMAq54nmZqEbS7kjna5FZ2R94UutJbkKrMmY/1777268672226.jpg)

In fact, the bag is quite a nice balance altogether; it is not like any other bag I’ve made or that I’ve seen before. It is a bit small at the zip on the top of it. And there isn’t a lining in it yet, so no pockets inside. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTMpu2YcRg6s1pXKyJeR8YEzWACXZTVw5nkhaGzpPLaMy/1777268751448.jpg)

The big outside pockets are very useful; I added nice wee tabs to close them with, which are not like a super-secure feature, but they do help keep a wallet or phone safe if one lives in a rural area like we do!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUcgg5eFVwChV48v3th15WmRR9qB6sjShnvgKrFaWnrLg/1777268751174.jpg)

I also added tabs at the ends of the zip: this helps for opening and closing it, as the zip is nice and neat/ tight, so requires a firm pull. The smaller handles I adjusted too, as they were too short, and needed to be lengthened. The new, reinforced ones are rather nice to pick it up by at first, before putting it over my shoulder.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNk38W7uM8vdcom7Q1H4EsRzHFBj1o6DW4PNYxYC52Xpa/1777268829766.jpg)

And the length of it is comfortable for sitting next to my body when I am walking. I used it the past few days, and really enjoyed it as a tactile object, hugging my hips. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwJwtEnLY1Z6peuRSc7NHiaw2xpjzssKUL6SwXQVMKG3/1777268842417.jpg)

What do you think? Is it nice enough?? Do you think that a bag like this could even be sold??? And if so, what kind of a price would I ask? 🙏🧵🪡

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhQVnLD3ge6Wm7hsh39xaXYwhEJwrMJAWMGDHCSLwgoH/1777269076697.jpg)

In fact, I’m pondering this week on what I can sell, for a couple of events coming up where I am invited/ asked to show my reinvented clothing (McMA: Making Clothing Magical Again). It is exciting to be showing in a new area, on the coast of Molise, though it is perhaps not an ideal venue. 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcERUWxPW9dmSZwdy7fyBefF7DUnTfZCtPvMBerZRY2PD/1777268937268.jpg)

The second place is a wee gallery in Guardia that I’ve shown in a few times – both my art and my clothing. It’s always well-attended and I look forward very much to (re)connecting with that community, even if we are trying to sell up and move everything to our glorious shack in the wild woods!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQ3Zxj8TynRma99Aa3D6cDjzFxT6ai2njY9VtV2ajmn2M/1777268958118.jpg)

**Looking forward too, to new ideas coming into being, as I get more and more inspired by revisiting my clothing supplies in the house we’re selling, in Guardia S. Picking up my paintbrushes recently, is also re-igniting a sense of flow and vision, that I’d been missing for some years. The particular painting that I’m completing for a commission is really pulling me out of a lot of stuck energy around my pure creativity, my calling to painting…. Let’s see how that unfolds, as the warmer weather allows for activities like this…**

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfHMCyJuv28KV3RHgNMbCAhsGYvujaVmBu1QpNxXWLJEC/1777268902374.jpg)

Sending LOVE and Tante Belle Cose to you all, and hoping that your creative work is deeply fulfilling, fun and expansive, this week!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPNBCoL2kPM2gMDgGg42b7yTPQqYyEhVzW8xn7uV7d3cq/1777269272977.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPVCY7TFZHGPunkp1SZQGjwFP8mTzobvDDuyHceqMPpjD/1771237735901.jpg)
