body.title: Strategies and Frameworks That Can Enable Business Growth
body.body:
Brands have more digital platforms to explore than ever, but when you throw in the excess options available today, it gets overwhelming fast. To make that investment worthwhile, a holistic approach to a brand’s entire online footprint is necessary. This is not just a website, but multiple touch points that need to work hand-in-hand together for effective brand voice and customer experience.

**Integrating Multi-Channel Strategies**

You need to have an SEO strategy, active social media accounts and data-backed campaign advertising. When these channels are synchronized, a business can stay “top of mind” with its customers from the outset through to their ultimate purchase decision. Someone can come across a brand through a search query, then have an educational post show up in their social media feed and finally they can receive a tailored email that nudges them to complete the purchase.

[Digital marketing in Vancouver](https://www.lodestarmedia.ca/digital) involves knowing the local demographics and the levels of technology savviness among residents for organizations aiming to expand their reach. What may work in a rural setting won’t necessarily vibe at the epicentre of a thrumming metropolis, where consumers have more choices than ever.

**Leveraging Data for Precise Targeting**

That is a simple way of explaining that amongst the more powerful rewards from contemporary digital techniques, is this capacity to measure performance immediately. Online campaigns provide specific information on how users are engaging with a brand compared to display board or print campaign. Companies can also learn what headlines attract clicks or what images prompt engagement — and when a potential customer leaves the site.

This itself allows you to plan appropriately in agile way. Instead of pouring time and money into a long-term campaign that may or may not actually work, a company can test multiple versions of an ad or a landing page and iterate according to results in real life. It implies that the marketing campaign can pay attention solely on the customers with essentially the most chance to grow to be a lifelong client, that means that funds are used properly.

**Building Long-Term Brand Authority**

The ultimate objective of all these vertical strategies online is turn into an accomplice not a vendor industry expert. They do that by consistently providing value. Whether it be educational webinars, informative reports in the industry or real-time customer service on social platforms — all these digital touchpoints offer an opportunity to gain visibility and become synonymous with expertise in a specific field.

Authenticity and Professional Integrity always apply whenever a local market uses [digital marketing in Vancouver](https://www.lodestarmedia.ca/digital). Brands that go beyond simply selling are often rewarded with a much higher level of customer loyalty for just providing something useful or supporting local causes. To align with this shift is to think of digital space as less a sales pipeline and more about building relationships — and, in return, earning your place in future local economy.

**Conclusion: Cultivating Growth Through Strategic Engagement**

Therefore, to stay relevant and competitive, businesses must be agile in how they approach the consumer experience—offering a seamless mix around product sale availability, marketing communication, inconvenience reduction messaging and KOL or influencer touchpoints. Making use of that advanced data to make your messages true and meaningful is a critical [digital marketing approach in Vancouver](https://maps.app.goo.gl/6224XFBuuC3wUbG69), but turning every one of them in a human perspective who cares about the harmony between individuals and organizations will create belief. You can multi-channel engage to build meaningful relationships in order for your online platforms to become a true growth engine. These attributes, along with adaptability and an understanding of the ever-connectedness of the world, will help solidify a brand's standing more relevant and robust.

---

body.title: Protect Your Time Like Your Future Depends On It
body.body:
>

When I entered school newly many years back, I had a mental idea of how I would want my study life to look like. I even drafted a plan of how to read and study my books daily. I was keeping to it. However, I discovered that there was this particular classmate that, if he comes around, we would just be gisting, or watching movies, or even going to see a football match. Before I knew it, hours will pass without being productive. When I discovered this and how I was wasting time, I had to cut off from him. When I did, I started being serious with my academics. I understood that the usage of time is what will determine the outcome of one's life. You need to protect your time like your future depends on it, because it actually does.

<center>![pexels-towfiqu-barbhuiya-3440682-11125295.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmVV4TkE2FAEKm32cRAovgBi3T6t1yAS2jvj1pg5SPVenm/pexels-towfiqu-barbhuiya-3440682-11125295.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/person-holding-round-analog-alarm-clock-11125295)</sub></center>

Time is one of the most valuable assets and resources that you have, yet a lot of people waste their time on what does not add value to them. Unlike some other physical assets like money, land, etc, you cannot earn more of time; it is still the same 24 hours in a day. More so, if a particular time had passed, it is gone, and you may not be able to get it back again. This is why you have to learn how to protect your time. Because the truth is that your future is heavily dependent on what you do with your time in the present. When you manage your time well, your future will thank you.

Whatever you want to achieve in this life will require time. For example; if you want to learn a skill, build a career, improve your life, etc, you have to understand that none of them will happen instantly, they will definitely require time. These are all products of how you spend your time daily. If you spend the major part of your daily time on distraction, unnecessary activities, or on things that do not add any form of value to you, it will slow down your progress or even completely stop you. But if you spend your time wisely, intentionally, consciously, and consistently, your future will begin to take shape even in the present.

One of the biggest challenges of this age is distractions. You may see someone pick up their phone to read a soft copy of their textbook. Then they will see a pop-up notification from a social media platform. They will decide to enter the platform to see what it is. From there, they will spend hours on social media, following trends, liking posts, etc, without even realising that they are wasting a lot of productive time. What feels like \

will turn into wasted hours, days, or even weeks. The danger in this is not just about the lost time, but also about lost opportunities that may have transformed the person's life permanently.

<center>![pexels-thirdman-8470839.jpg](https://cdn.steemitimages.com/DQmNUXbupWAbs4mL6Juu8CdjgvWz7TMNErtQgP4nwhFarGy/pexels-thirdman-8470839.jpg)</center>

<center><sub>Image from [Pexels](https://www.pexels.com/photo/shadow-of-a-hand-holding-a-key-on-wall-8470839)</sub></center>

To protect your time, you have to start by awareness. You have to currently know how you spend your day and your time. Take a reflection about the activities that move you forward, so that you can consolidate on them. Then consider also activities that do not move you forward so that you will stop them. It is when you identify these things that you will make better decisions that will shape your future. It is not everything that demands your attention. It may not be because they are bad, but they may just not be necessary for you at that point.

You should also learn how to set your priorities aright. You may have a couple of things to do, but you may not be to do everything at once. You have to select in what order they will be done, if they will be done at all. Not everything should get your attention. The truth is that if you treat everything as important, you may end up not achieving anything significant. This is why you need to focus on what truly matters to you and to your goals. Also learn how to say \

to the things that do not align or follow your plan and goal for life. When you learn to focus on what truly matters, you will protect your time and manage it appropriately. ***Thanks for reading***
Peace on y'all

body.title: $242 IN 5 HOURS. NOT LUCK. JUST EXECUTION.
body.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcwcZhoAzauXFycUuGxcQmbfZVuHMdnj2ZhD8XogZryxe/image.png 


Sunday was not supposed to go like this.

I didn’t wake up at 5AM.  
I didn’t chase the early batches.  
I didn’t force anything.

I started at **9:59AM**.

That’s it.

And somehow, by the end of the day, I was staring at:

**$242.21 total**  
**5 hours 20 minutes active**  
**8 batches completed**

No gimmicks. No crazy unicorn orders all day. Just decisions… stacked correctly.

---

## THE START: NO RUSH, JUST A MOVE

First batch came in at **9:59AM**.

A triple.  
**$73.11.**

Right away, that set the tone.

Not because of the money… but because of what it represents.

That first order is everything.

It tells you:
- What kind of day you’re going to have  
- What kind of decisions you’re willing to make  
- Whether you’re reacting… or controlling the flow  

Most people hesitate there.

They overthink.

They wait.

I didn’t.

I took it.

---

## BUILD PHASE: STACKING WITHOUT OVERTHINKING

After that first hit, the day turned into what I call the **build phase**.

This is where most people mess up.

They either:
- Chase only big orders and sit idle  
- Or take everything and destroy their average  

I stayed in between.

### The sequence:
- $73.11 (3 orders)
- $24.08
- $26.17 (2 orders)
- $18.84

Nothing crazy here.

But that’s the point.

This is where you quietly stack:
- Momentum  
- Positioning  
- Algorithm exposure  

You don’t need every order to be perfect.

You need them to make sense.

---

## THE SHIFT: FROM BUILD TO KILL MODE

Once I crossed about **$150**, everything changed.

This is where you separate average shoppers from high-level execution.

At this point:
👉 You are no longer trying to “make money”  
👉 You are trying to **protect your hourly rate**

This is where discipline kicks in.

---

## THE BIG ONE: SPROUTS CLOSE

Then it hit.

**$53.18 — Sprouts**

About 22 items.

Clean.

Fast.

Efficient.

This is what closing looks like.

You don’t need 5 more orders.

You need one solid one that pushes you over the edge.

That single batch turned the day from:
👉 Good  
Into  
👉 **Elite**

---

## THE $6.87 ORDER (AND WHY PEOPLE MISUNDERSTAND THIS GAME)

Now let’s talk about something most people would judge wrong.

**$6.87 batch**

On paper, it looks terrible.

But context matters.

Here’s what actually happened:

- I was already at the store  
- I knew the item was out of stock  
- I didn’t move  
- I needed a bathroom break  

So what was it really?

👉 Not a “bad order”  
👉 Not a “waste of time”  

It was:

**A zero-cost income action during downtime**

That’s a completely different category.

---

## THIS IS WHERE THE MINDSET CHANGES

Most shoppers think:

> “How much does this order pay?”

Wrong question.

The real question is:

> **What does this order cost me in time, movement, and energy?**

That $6.87 cost me almost nothing.

No miles.  
No effort.  
No opportunity lost.

So it becomes:

👉 Free money.

---

## LATE GAME: CONTROL, NOT CHAOS

The last part of the day looked like this:

- $20.64  
- $19.32  

These are not amazing orders.

But they served a purpose.

They:
- Kept the flow alive  
- Stayed inside my zone  
- Didn’t pull me out of position  

And most importantly:

👉 They didn’t destroy the hourly

---

## FINAL RESULT

By the end of the day:

**$242.21 total**

From a **9:59AM start**

That’s the part that matters.

---

## WHY THIS DAY MATTERS

This wasn’t about one lucky batch.

This was about a pattern:

### 1. Strong open  
### 2. Controlled stacking  
### 3. Smart mid-game decisions  
### 4. High-value close  

That’s a system.

---

## THE BIGGER PICTURE (THE WEEK)

Looking at the full week:

- Mon: $135  
- Tue: $141  
- Wed: $133  
- Thu: $237  
- Fri: $179  
- Sat: $148  
- Sun: $242  

That’s over:

👉 **$1,200+ in one week**

With:

👉 **~35 hours active**

---

## THIS IS WHAT PEOPLE DON’T SEE

People think this is about:

- Hustling harder  
- Working longer  
- Starting earlier  

It’s not.

It’s about:

👉 **Decision quality**

---

## THE REAL STRATEGY (BREAK IT DOWN SIMPLE)

There are only two phases in a day:

---

### PHASE 1: BUILD

Goal:
👉 Get to $120–$150

How:
- Take solid orders
- Keep moving
- Stay in your zone

---

### PHASE 2: KILL

Goal:
👉 Maximize hourly

How:
- Be selective
- Wait for higher value
- Close with 1–2 strong batches

---

## MOST PEOPLE NEVER SWITCH PHASES

They stay in build mode all day.

That’s why they:
- Work longer  
- Earn less per hour  
- Burn out  

---

## WHAT I LEARNED TODAY

1. You don’t need to start early to win  
2. You don’t need perfect orders all day  
3. You don’t need to chase every batch  

You need:

👉 Consistency  
👉 Positioning  
👉 Discipline  

---

## THIS IS NOT ABOUT INSTACART

This is bigger than that.

This is about:

👉 Learning how to manage time like an asset  
👉 Understanding opportunity cost in real time  
👉 Making decisions without hesitation  

---

## FINAL THOUGHT

Today wasn’t random.

It wasn’t luck.

It was:

👉 Seeing the right orders  
👉 Taking the right ones  
👉 Skipping the wrong ones  
👉 And knowing when to switch gears  

---

## WHERE THIS GOES NEXT

Right now this is:

👉 A good system

But with a few adjustments, it becomes:

👉 A repeatable machine

And that’s the real goal.

Not one $240 day.

👉 **Consistent $200–$300 days**

---

Because once you figure that out…

You’re not chasing money anymore.

👉 You’re controlling it.

body.title: Kicking Roc Reward Card || Why Is It So Cheap & Can You Upgrade It?
body.body:
![ChatGPT Image Apr 27, 2026, 10_49_20 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23tmBKra8KXsW6qt4dYy4yoSzE8YYeEkepxpguZ1yJbLgMdZtDHZyw7DMiHaS3TC3vjaA.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)


As I told you yesterday exploring a campaign in Splinterlands is extremely important for a new player. The main reason is that it helps you properly understand the game, you learn which card to use in which battle, their best positions and other basic concepts.

Yesterday after completing Chapter 3 I received a Splinter Monster card as a reward called “Kicking Roc.” Today I thought I will explain its stats and abilities, what abilities it gets at different levels and also share its market price whether its really worth that price or not.

First of all you need to go to the market then open card sales and search for this monster by typing “Kicking Roc.” Once you open the card you will be able to see its stats, abilities and price.

Lets start with its mana cost which is 8 and is quite reasonable. This means you can easily select it in mid to high mana battles. However in low mana battles it becomes difficult to use because its mana cost is relatively high.

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 101959.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23t7D8fqcKi5NiRY68hfDXrnemqBRXKtDGkiQEHXc5WCj5cwrRJVZz3vxhtMx7Y4MLRJa.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

If I talk about its health, it has 5 health which is quite decent. If you place it in the backline and protect it properly it can survive for a good amount of time and make effective use of its abilities.

keep in mind that units which are of range attacks and which are supportive must be given a good protection because the longer they survive in the battle the more damage they give to the enemy units. Therefore it is necessary to keep them protected for the long time during the battle.

Its speed is 2 which will help him and his allied units to attack quickly. Its most notable feature and the reason for its popularity is its ranged attack which is 3. This means if you place it in the mid or backline it will consistently deal 3 damage to enemy units every round.

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 102027.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/EoGq9qzmiTmVTrQFj9aFWHEwZjDBWMKGU3o6SiJZpjECEDuk6CrQwZxAJv7HXbUhLuF.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

At Level 1 it has the same stats I just mentioned.
At Level 2 there is only one change and that is its health increases from 5 to 6.
At Level 3 again there is no major change except its health increases from 6 to 7. It does not gain any special abilities like Sneak, Snipe or others.

Now lets talk about its price. As you can see in the screenshot its lowest price in the market is just 1 cent for Level 1. Level 2 and Level 3 are available for around 9 cents which is very reasonable.

Many people might wonder why its so cheap. The main reason is that even after upgrading there are no significant improvements in its stats or abilities. It remains almost the same up to Level 3 and cannot be upgraded further. 

![Screenshot 2026-04-27 102043.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/asgharali/23vrkWJwPVmDT8QFt2YYgqNapP9PRfbAvX9BR9qemX7xfZfZhGL1Z9J6sTCSL6Wc1HNr8.png)
![Capture.PNG](https://i.imgur.com/uGB0GKX.png)

So it mainly works as a basic ranged attack monster, useful in normal battles but in tougher battles against strong opponents it may not perform very well.

So these were the key stats and abilities of this monster that I received as a reward yesterday. I hope this gave you a clear understanding of this card.

I hope you guys will like this post and is interesting as well. If you find it informative then dont forget to give me a support. Share you reviews in the comment section below. Thank you all for your time reading the content.

夜里十一点，我正要准备入睡，手机弹出了好朋友发来的消息，把我的瞌睡虫又赶回去了，她告诉我，此刻她已经和同事抵达宜宾，明天就要预约做眼袋切除手术，同时还要打去颈纹的针。

在我心里，朋友一直是一个不太注意形象的人，自从生了两个娃，她的身体就像吹大的气球，一直在膨胀，平时也没有化妆的习惯，居然会决定去做医美，我都怀疑她受了什么刺激。不过她前面和我谈了两次，都说自己想去做眼袋，在我看来，她的眼袋重，一半是岁月沉淀的自然痕迹，一半是她的职业原因，本来就是医生，经常值夜班，日夜颠倒的作息，眼睛周围的衰老问题，本来就是难以避免的，而且我觉得比起do脸，她更应该先减肥。

在我的固有认知里，医美项目大多会选择成熟正规的机构或者知名医院的整形科，不知道她为啥远赴宜宾，还匆匆敲定了手术，她说自己并不是一时兴起，关于去除眼袋这事，她其实已经规划了好久，而且宜宾那边医美有熟人，她觉得比较放心。


朋友有自己的考量，我就不再多提建议了，这一刻忽然心生感慨，不知不觉间，身边的同龄人都开始认真对抗岁月留下的痕迹，悄悄用自己的方式留住容貌状态。甚至，朋友说注射肉毒淡化颈纹时，我其实也想去尝试打抬头纹，听说如今这类轻医美价格不贵，一针也就一千多，一年定期保养，成本不高，对身体的副作用也小，很难不心动啊！

body.title: Pune Hive Meetup Recap: Small Turnout, One Strong Onboarding 🐝
body.body:
Hello Hivers 👋

Last Saturday, we आयोजित another Pune meetup focused on introducing the Hive ecosystem and onboarding new users.

Despite ~10 RSVPs and a capacity of 20, only 2 attendees showed up — a reminder that turnout can be unpredictable, especially during extreme summer heat in Pune.

![untitled.gif](https://media.tenor.com/uxiOcKbHhl0AAAAC/summer-elmo.gif)

### 👥 Attendees & Experience

* **Tejas** (Java developer):

Showed limited interest during the session and did not create an account immediately. However, he mentioned he may join later via self-signup.

* **Satish** (Web3 developer):
  Highly engaged and curious. Asked detailed questions about:

  * Hive onboarding & account creation
  * Key management & security
  * Returns on HBD/HIVE
  * DHF (Decentralized Hive Fund)
  * Witnesses, inflation, and rewards system

  He successfully got onboarded 🎉

https://peakd.com/hive-127555/@sattu6342/checkin-l5pqhecp

![photo_2026-04-27 11.12.01.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/techcoderlabz/Eonk3ChhbdzskJvdGdNa5TAWvjVSxwuMRPGLgE3jcVUkv8QMcQhhPyq25KzLfLtnGm5.jpeg)


---

### 🎯 Key Learnings

* Evening timings (5–6 PM) may work better than afternoon slots
* Weather (40°C+) impacts attendance significantly
* Smaller groups can still lead to meaningful onboarding
* Engaged developers bring high-quality discussions
* Take More photos for social media - we missed this time.

---

### 🚀 What’s Next

* Follow up with attendees to keep them engaged
* Improve scheduling for better turnout
* Continue building the local Hive community, one user at a time

Photos from the event are attached 📸

Let’s keep building 🐝

title.title: A Memorable Hiking Adventure with Friends
title.body:
Hi my lovely community members,

I’m excited to share the beautiful experience I had during my recent hiking adventure. It was truly an unforgettable moment of fun, laughter, and relaxation with my friends on Saturday, 27th of April. What started as a casual joke about going hiking later turned into a real plan, and I’m so glad we decided to make it happen.

The preparation took us about four days. During that time, we carefully planned everything to make the trip successful. We selected the best means of transportation to the location, confirmed the friends who were interested in joining, bought some hiking kits, packed refreshments, and arranged many other little things that made the outing smooth and enjoyable. The planning itself was exciting because everyone contributed ideas and energy.

On the day of the trip, we left very early in the morning. The fresh air, calm weather, and peaceful surroundings made the journey even more enjoyable. As we climbed higher, the beautiful view of nature around us became more breathtaking. Standing on the rock and looking around felt amazing. It reminded me how beautiful and refreshing nature can be.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcXm3WrSNkZY6AN6MC5fHvtJdKF2ezmu17kAxdTS5V4HC/1777268510211.jpg)

We had so much fun at the top. We listened to good music, laughed together, and one of the highlights of the day was the guitar session. I have always loved guitars, even though I don’t know how to play one. Instead of playing, I happily took pictures with it and enjoyed the moment. Sometimes, it’s not about knowing everything—it’s about enjoying the experience.

After spending quality time on the mountain, we carefully came down. We had another round of refreshments together and rested for a while because we were all tired but happy. Hiking can be stressful on the body, but the joy and satisfaction made every step worth it. I almost forgot my glucose at home, but luckily I remembered before leaving, and that really helped me regain some energy later.

In summary, the hiking trip was more than just climbing a mountain. It was a day filled with friendship, adventure, meaningful conversations, laughter, and appreciation for nature. We exchanged ideas, talked about life, exercised our bodies and minds, and created memories that will stay with us for a long time.

Sometimes, the best moments in life are the simple ones spent with good people in beautiful places. This hiking experience reminded me that happiness can be found in nature, friendship, and shared adventures.

If you enjoyed reading about my little experience, please support my post. Thank you so much!

title.body:
| Latin Name | Observation Date | Location |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Genus *Melanitis* | Apr 25, 2026 | Purulia, Natore, Bangladesh |

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmR2BVEWdKC8Zuipj7q7WKzVopZKDHYh3YsWPWTsam5X3Q/20260425_004119.jpg)

​
​How are you all? I hope everyone is well.

On April 25th at around 12:30am, while walking near my house, I came across a strange experience. Suddenly, a beautiful butterfly came into view in the light of a torch. It is difficult to see them during the day, because they hide themselves behind dry leaves in such a way that it is almost impossible to catch them with the naked eye.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTR6fQ5sRG9QC2soeJtbMGJna14EnLLMjdA364ZTpiDgY/20260425_004107.jpg)

​This is called the Evening Brown butterfly. The meaning of their name is understood only when the sun sets and darkness approaches. They cannot tolerate the harsh sun of the day at all, so they rest in the shade of bushes. But at night, they come out on their own.
​The most surprising thing is the round spots on its wings. When the light of the torch fell on it, it seemed that many small eyes were looking at me. This defense mechanism of nature is really strange. These fake eyes work great to scare away the enemy. Seeing this peaceful insect sitting quietly at night filled my heart with joy. I took out my phone and quickly took some pictures. It is such small but beautiful moments in nature that make our lives joyful.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdfANZXkDWhnmTq6GspWCkThSp6Ayw71FTzxQujxzpbxx/20260425_004059.jpg)

그래서 이번엔 완전 맘을 먹고 가자마자 꽃을 사러 가자고 독촉을 했다.
꽃집을 흔쾌히 안내하는 차 안에서 엄마가 또 투덜거리신다.
본인이 그렇게 심자고 할 때는 콧방귀만 뀌더니 딸내미가 가자니 순순히 따라 나선다고, 되레 적극적이시다고.

집에 오자마자 아빠가 흙이며 이것저것 챙겨주신다.
결국엔 엄마가 장갑을 끼고 나서서 직접 심으신다.

title.title: Unveiling the Praetoria Nexus: @splinterguide’s Journey Toward Strategic Dominance and Digital Sovereignty
title.body:
---

<center>

![Image created with Leonardo AI](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23u615ih9AermdjoSoi9wLWnwVNxunpazafGXbnZZkoF43mSMfRu2P9fTGDnBELbJjho8.jpeg)
*Your Definitive Guide to Mastering the Meta-Game in 2026*
</center>

---

Greetings, Summoners and Strategists of Praetoria. It is an honor to finally address this vibrant community. I am the creator behind **@splinterguide**, and today I am not just introducing an account, but a comprehensive vision for navigating the most complex and rewarding ecosystem in the GameFi world in 2026.

If you’ve been searching for a beacon of clarity amid the shifting tides of *rulesets* and the fluctuations of the SPS market, you’ve come to the right place. This account was created with a clear goal: **to make high-level knowledge accessible to everyone**, allowing every player—from Bronze-tier newcomers to Champions-tier veterans—to optimize their return on investment (ROI) and win rate.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)


## 1. From the Planes of Dominaria to the Lands of Praetoria.

My fascination with trading card games (TCGs) isn’t just a passing fad; it’s a passion that has been simmering for decades. It all started with cardboard cards and the smell of fresh ink: **Magic: The Gathering.** Those of us who grew up casting spells on Dominaria understand that a TCG isn’t just about having the strongest card, but about understanding **game theory**, resource management, and opponent psychology.

The move to the digital world was inevitable, but for years something was missing. In the old PC games, my cards weren’t really mine—they were just pixels licensed by a company. That’s when I discovered **Splinterlands** (then called Steem Monsters), and everything changed. Here, my years of strategic experience with MTG finally found a home on the Hive blockchain.

The fact that I can truly own my assets—knowing that my **[Giant Roc]** (Red | 5 | Common) from the Alpha/Beta editions is a finite asset and that I can verify its ownership—sparked in me a desire not only to play, but also to analyze this ecosystem the way an economist would analyze a stock market.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)

## 2. And why Splinterlands? The Difference of Digital Sovereignty

In a market flooded with games that promise a lot but deliver little, Splinterlands remains a mainstay of the industry. But what makes it special in 2026?

* **Real Infrastructure:** Unlike other projects, Splinterlands runs on the speed and efficiency of **Hive**, enabling microtransactions and asynchronous battles without the prohibitive gas fees seen on other networks.
* **Evolutionary Tactical Complexity:** With the introduction of sets like *Rebellion*, *Arcane Conclave*, and the recent *Escalation*, the metagame has moved beyond simplicity. Implementing mechanics like **Pinpoint**—which allows you to bypass evasion—or **Reflexes**—which penalizes magical attacks—requires an analytical mind.
* **Circular Economy:** The combination of SPS (Splintershards), DEC (Dark Energy Crystals), and the **Glint** rewards system creates an ecosystem where your skill translates directly into real value.

To me, Splinterlands isn't just a game—it's a high-fidelity macroeconomic simulator. It's the only place where I can perform technical analysis to decide whether it's better to burn SPS to double my Glint in Silver+ leagues or reinvest in **Node Licenses** to secure passive income.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)

## 3. My philosophy: Passion for the Game, Rigor for the Profit

My main goal with **@splinterguide** is simple but ambitious: to earn rewards by doing what I love. I don’t believe in playing just for the sake of playing, nor do I believe in mindless “farming.” I believe in **strategic optimization**.

In Splinterlands, victory isn’t won on the battlefield—it’s secured during the recruitment phase. My goal is for every article you read here to bring you a little closer to that “Grand Master” mindset.

> **Critical Review:** In today's competitive environment, jumping in blindly is financial suicide. Success requires combining competition with asset management. For example, SPS staking isn't just an investment—it's your \

; without the right multiplier from staked SPS, your R-Shares will always be insufficient to climb the leaderboards.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)

## 4. Content That Will Change the Game

What can you expect from @splinterguide? I won’t be posting generic content. My focus is on technical accuracy and in-depth analysis. The cornerstones of my editorial approach are:

### A. Tactical Mastery Guides
Let's take a look at how to manage the more complex battle modifiers (rulesets). For example:
* How to turn a map with **Noxious Fumes** into a competitive advantage by using units with **Immunity**.
* Use the **[Bloodlust]** ability not only in Brawls with Gladius cards, but also with summoners who have the **Conscript** ability.

### B. Economy and Market Reports
Splinterlands is all about the numbers. I’ll be posting comparison charts of ROI and analyses on:
* The Efficiency of the **Glint Shop**: When Should You Use Alchemy Potions vs. Arcane Conclave Packs?
* Updates on **Land (Phase 3)**: How crafting items and spells using resources like Iron and Wood will change the meta-game forever.

### C. Progress Journal and “Survival Mode”
I’ll share my strategies for the 11 competitive brackets in **Survival Mode**, discussing how to manage Phoenix Ash and how to maximize rewards in the Modern and Wild formats.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)

## 5. Technical Analysis Framework (Template)

To give you a sense of my style, here’s how we’ll break down the key topics in future articles:

| Category | Technical Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Analysis Unit** | **[Goblin Shaman]** (Fire 3 Common) |
| **Key Abilitie** | **Weaken** (Level 1), **Slow** (Level 5) |
| **Optimal Synergy** | Summoners with speed buffs to maximize the opponent's chance of missing. |
| **Economic Use** | High demand in lower tiers for low-mana control decks. |

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/splinterguide/23tmDLWfvQf2SN4qpa75tSAW1QEQXrq9k5C1Ukm4siSzwk8dKeuqqtAvci3JaLQKEQA18.png)

## 6. A Call to Action for the Community

I don’t want this to be a one-way conversation. The Hive blockchain is built on consensus and community. That’s why I want to hear from you:

1. What’s your favorite **Bloodline** right now? Are you more into the brute force of the Orcs or the tactical precision of the Elves?
2. Which part of **Phase 3 of Tierras** leaves you with the most unanswered questions?
3. Do you know of any **Ruleset** that constantly drives you up the wall?

Leave your comment in the comments section below. I'll be selecting the most popular topics for my upcoming guides.

---
---

### A Forward-Looking Conclusion

We are witnessing a historic moment for Praetoria. The final convergence of DeFi, land management, and DAO governance is establishing Splinterlands as the cornerstone of digital sovereignty. My mission with **@splinterguide** is to ensure that you aren’t just a bystander, but a key player in this triumph.

Prepare and customize your deck, and remember: in Praetoria, **knowledge** is the scarcest and most valuable resource.

title.title: LUNC Is Up 38% in 7 Days -- and the Turkish Lira Pair Might Explain More Than You'd Expect
title.body:
LUNA Classic has moved 38% in seven days. Today alone it added 13%. Meanwhile, Bitcoin is flat and Ethereum is flat. This is not a broad market rotation. Something specific is happening with LUNC.

Let's look at the data before reaching for the narrative.

---

## The Numbers

Current price: $0.000059. Market cap: $324 million. 24-hour volume: $78.7 million — a vol/mcap ratio of 0.24x. That's elevated, but not the kind of extreme ratio you'd see in a genuine short squeeze or a news-driven catalyst. This is a sustained buildup over seven days, not a single-day spike.

The 7-day price chart tells the story:

- April 21: $0.000043
- April 24: $0.000052 (first meaningful jump)
- April 27: $0.000059 (current)

The move started April 24. That's the point to investigate.

---

## Where the Volume Is Coming From

Breaking down exchange data:

| Exchange | Pair | 24h Volume |
|---|---|---|
| Binance | LUNC/USDT | $18.9M |
| Binance | LUNC/TRY | $7.8M |
| OrangeX | LUNC/USDT | $4.9M |
| Bitkub | LUNA/THB | $3.0M |
| KuCoin | LUNC/USDT | $2.3M |

Two things stand out here.

First, the Binance **LUNC/TRY** pair at $7.8 million. Turkish lira pairs are not common for micro-cap tokens. Turkey has one of the highest crypto adoption rates in the world, driven by persistent lira inflation. When Turkish retail starts buying a token in size, it often shows up in the TRY pair first. This is the same behavioral pattern you see in Korean Upbit spikes — a local currency pair inflating before global USDT volume catches up.

Second, Bitkub's LUNA/THB (Thai baht) at $3 million. Southeast Asian retail is also active. This is not a US or European-led move.

---

## What There Is No Evidence Of

Protocol catalyst: none. The LUNC burn mechanism (1.2% transaction tax) has been running for over two years. No new governance proposals have passed recently that would justify a 38% repricing. TVL on Terra Classic remains near zero.

Exchange listing: none confirmed.

Binance futures positioning: open interest is elevated but not at extremes that would suggest a coordinated squeeze.

---

## What This Actually Looks Like

LUNC has three structural features that make it a recurring speculative target:

1. **Nominal price illusion.** At $0.000059, retail traders treat it as a \

token. The psychology of buying trillions of units for a few dollars drives periodic mania.

2. **5.5 trillion circulating supply.** The burn mechanism has retired a fraction of this. The supply overhang is permanent. Any price increase multiplies across a number that most traders don't bother to compute.

3. **2021 survivor bias.** LUNA at $119 is etched in memory. The gap from $0.000059 to any meaningful fraction of that number is so large that it functions as a lottery ticket framing rather than an investment thesis.

The Turkish and Thai retail data suggests this cycle is being driven by emerging market traders who combine lira/baht inflation hedging with low-nominal price speculation. It is a coherent pattern. It is not a fundamental thesis.

---

## What to Watch

- **LUNC/TRY volume normalization**: if the Turkish pair cools, expect the broader move to stall within 24-48 hours
- **Binance futures open interest**: if OI is building alongside spot volume, there's a squeeze risk — watch for a sharp reversal when it unwinds
- **Burn rate changes**: any governance proposal to increase the burn rate would be the only fundamental catalyst worth taking seriously
- **BTC correlation resumption**: if BTC moves significantly (either direction), LUNC will likely get dragged with it regardless of its own momentum

The 38% move in seven days is real. The reason is emerging market retail speculation, not protocol development. Those two things can both be true at once.

---

body.body:
# Hello Hive 


A happy new week to us all, I hope that we have had the most amazing and restful weekend so far. It's a new and beautiful week and I wish us the blessings of good health and vitality to carry on with a daily task into the week.


![4077.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23zkk7W8U5ZseTCApM87BKffTEaqXJ7NtbPTreRwD7FKE4ttRxkn6tzQnWb8aePiQaWuZ.jpg)


Here is another of a planting session go wrong. It's totally disheartening to see that absolutely nothing will be coming out from these okro that  has been planted. From the 2nd week of planting the crop was looking fine as if there was nothing wrong 


![4065.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23uFRYK51DDtqEvvpbytXToGDxwrtxkgP6Uq1GuVzrzmRQedQz5Yvj1T3XQ5TaZbb3r1d.jpg)



But before it could get to been a year old we stated noticing that it was having yellowing of leaves. At first we have brought that it was because of the grasses in the color that made it looked this way. Efforts were made almost immediately and with the help of manual grass weeding we were able to clean and clear up the grasses in the crop.


![4056.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23xp47a6wdmS7mCAZK765PakpCyw7HrwcHNaCJGan8jK2Wjf1bu6Ep1kRGpifr5SkTu14.jpg)



Even as the rains started failing and I had expected it to recover and continue to grow well. There has not been any positive change in the okro and by now that this is supposed to be producing food for us there is nothing on it


![4047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23x18xWSzwJ1CE1mNGeSCkdY3G44X7qHaSBhKbWpqgB5DRtWJfiYhqh9TDVmvGF6apmat.jpg)


When I  had noticed this singular strand of okro in the farm growing and almost fully matured now I realized that this color was meant to be in this stage of their life's cycle growth. They ought to be producing by now already but only this single okro was seen this far



![4041.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/monica-ene/23u62xh1oXKvmhvxVSqNGuSZbJ7SeKg3VR77ePfYGCCjYFxZ1fXpDDAzKJyQvT6ESYU4b.jpg)


The yellowing of leaves persisted and some plants are already withering already. At this stage there is no hope that this okro can recover or produce any foods.  Now that there is rains and the wether is cooler, other crops have all picked up a positive growth except this very one. 


I learnt something really important from this.
We can't always win in life even when it comes to farming, because following this okro everything has been don for it so far that warrant that this okro must do well

body.title: Special places for everyone
body.body:
Hello, coffee lovers around the world!

Coffee shops are very special places. No two are alike, no matter how much you try to make them similar. Regardless of their design or menu, it's the people, the customers, who give them that special touch that sets them apart. People are the essence that determines the final atmosphere of each coffee shop. Of course, everything depends on what the coffee shop owner is trying to achieve with the design. Will they have been able to attract their desired clientele?

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWPki454tVoLiyectaJtogerXyBcfw5iP6QGeJVf1BR9x/1777206627711.jpg)

I'm giving all this preamble to answer this week's prompt. In my opinion, people go to coffee shops looking for solitude or for company. It's amazing that you can find both in the same place designed to attract customers.

I know this because I've gone in search of both things and found them.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmU5cLSMRxYnWcsgpfXGk16mmYjvZAmTYmQuktdpvGzNq6/1777206627838.jpg)

I know of cafes where I can go to meet up with friends who are either already there or will arrive at any moment. I can sit at a table with my coffee and feel like I'm not alone. It's because we, the regular customers, eventually start greeting each other and getting to know one another.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQMkiZzmC6U91EydzvBAoCHKGEnhZFqe4UcJY3ScPH8V7/1777206627963.jpg)

I also know which cafes to go to when I need solitude, privacy, whether to think or to work. Sometimes I sit in that cafe to write when I want no one to bother me. I only look up to order another coffee, which the bartender knows to leave on the table without disturbing me.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbhwHKFKKRVwRsw3DHEVewBKJRWUCs4Pvd1UBxmtYsh5T/1777206628185.jpg)

What's amazing is that I'm never completely alone, actually. However, it's those people around me who create that kind of bubble of murmurs, the clinking of cups, and the whirring of espresso machines, creating that space where I can be alone, unseen and undisturbed.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUDFf8SLSHXoaB9DsLhwgvSCpczjK4JShTWJAYU4dd8NM/1777206628354.jpg)

It's a strange feeling I hadn't thought about before.

title.body: The Buffett Indicator framing is useful, but it always runs into the same structural problem: the denominator (GDP) moves slowly, and the numerator (market cap) moves fast. That mismatch has been making this indicator look \

for most of the last decade.

What I find more interesting right now is the divergence between the Buffett signal and credit markets. Investment-grade spreads are still tight. High-yield hasn't blown out. If equity valuations are genuinely stretched to the point of fragility, you'd expect credit to start pricing it first — and that hasn't happened yet.

The crypto correlation piece is worth noting here too. In 2022, BTC and equities fell together because the driver was monetary tightening — a systemic repricing of risk assets across the board. If this correction is driven by genuine overvaluation in equities rather than a rate shock, the dynamics could be different. Capital rotating out of stretched large-cap tech looking for alternatives is a very different environment than 2022.

BTC dominance sitting at 58% right now suggests the market isn't in risk-on alt-seeking mode. If equities correct and the Fed pivots, that ratio is the one to watch — not the Buffett Indicator.

title.body:
The framing here — KYA replacing KYC — cuts to something most people in this space are still sleeping on.

KYC assumes a human at the end of the chain. Once agents are the ones initiating transactions, that entire compliance architecture collapses. The agent doesn't have a passport. It doesn't have an address. It has a wallet key and a set of instructions.

What's more interesting to me is the liability question. When an agent executes a trade that turns out to be front-running, or routes funds through a sanctioned address because it found a better yield there — who answers for that? The owner? The developer? The DAO that deployed it?

\

isn't just a compliance concept. It's a question about accountability in a world where the actors are no longer people. That's a harder problem than KYC ever was.\n\nThe tokenization angle you raise is the right context. When the assets being moved are real-world (property, equity, debt), the stakes of agent misidentification go from \
\n\nWorth watching how regulators try to plug this gap. My guess: they'll reach for existing money transmission frameworks and apply them badly before anything thoughtful gets drafted.

title.title: Morning Accomplishments-Beating the Heat with Fun Company and some Halo-Halo
title.body:
Hello dear community. I hope everyone is doing well and for others who are experiencing extremely hot weather, may you always keep safe and protected.

![Cold escape with friends_20260426_211807_0000.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xVJpvKBLEFoHt7ad5A2xHXqWyMunimTEdy4P2oHAoFQALJkDdVNdxMxvy9r2ayWTort.jpg)

It is terribly hot today, well as what I learned from the news it was forecasted that we should be expecting hotter days for a longer duration of time. I would say, the hot weather we are experiencing right now is way more extreme compared to previous years. Thus, like many, I can't help but conclude as well that the climate is really changing.

![1777178935162_125359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23wqiMM6j19PpvcMp6mQMkL3K5Lff1X9gQoRCEL4ZTc4oGhGp8njGm5SLXPAGBhb1FtGv.jpg)

![1777178935140_125309.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xAY326xLFTLMcpAstZNb3eEf7n5ZtNHGGyX4XvsCx1kJWYdAEPWNLjGKAJzNYgfQmWB.jpg)

![1777178935117_125214.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xp2PLsxtKrXNqgMSXwFikPTBvrzacJhRDecmP3XCLKzzAnYRjG8TcM4xMZEU4TghscL.jpg)

Despite the extremely hot weather, nothing can stop us from sharing good news of hope to people in the community. We actually start early in the morning and end before the weather gets hotter. We also make sure to bring umbrellas and drinking water to keep us safe from the heat. 

Today's territory is in a Barangay located on a mountain side. I like the place because there is a lot of trees as you walk along the road, so we could still feel a bit of coolness and find protection under the shade of the trees. 

More than anything else, we are happy to find people who are responsive to the good news we share with them. Despite being busy, they gave time to hear us out. I am so happy to meet new people and gain new friends. I love it when people express their worries that shows they trust you with how they also feel. I feel happy to listen to people as they share their concerns and afterwards share some hope that would help them remain positive despite current hardships. One of the best feeling is when people express their gratitude for visiting them.

We ended the morning's activity and as we walk down the mountain, I spent time talking with friends, encouraging one another and appreciating each others hard work, zeal and sacrifices. We do this because we love the people and we love our God.

![1777178935070_125124.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/EqfJriL1Y5inyY5YzoHuBf6ace9JynhWDewmU7ioQ8cmSGbo4E3VJsbKHCvkvjz95X9.jpg)

![1777178935094_125142.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23vsGJKfikYmmW9wybZ4pFATAqMCvWKYqJUzCUke43gSngWgkuDwxxNxzUYVM7YirVGZ8.jpg)

As we reached the base, we rested first in a friend's house and I got to meet their cute dog named shy. He is literally shy and a bit sad because his real owner left him for a vacation. He was left under someone else's care. I find him cute so I took a picture of us. I enjoyed petting Shy until my brother came and we decided to go home.

![1777178935049_125058.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23xVPkn2KDr3D2wfqPan4uH1vsswQ1FmjT3CJLL67QtUoJ2D37cEJVgrPitb6Gf85zZmx.jpg)

![1777178935020_125020.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23zkiQ9fB77DUxkihgzgy8zqznky3pSM7dEwnkfB1jwCqKgHGm9yjznknoLnyuSQ7AufF.jpg)

![1777178934998_124950.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/nesbi94/23vhsjDt75Sru8TQFVXNdM7LYkZwyuTN6MQDLqvDqi9SxV28MfhdtirRePgHJ3TB6maMT.jpg)

As I rode our motorbike, I wondered why my brother went on another direction from home only to find out, he took me for some halo halo treat. It is a famous dessert in the Philippines perfect for hot weather. It is a flavored shaved ice with some ingredients and fruits combined. It was a yummy treat and I was grateful to my brother. After finishing a glass of halo-halo, we decided to finally go home.

Today was a fun and happy day. Hope you also have a nice one too.
Thanks for reading, until next time. Love, Nes.

Pictures are mine and edited with Canva.

title.title: My Savings Vs My Survival.
title.body:
HBD happens to be one the most valuable assets on hive, which I believe y'all will agree with me. Especially with the fact that it's pegged with the dollar, meaning it is stable and reliable.




![1000982180.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23uEx3dhF3or4PeG9NNxHx7q8mXyZN56uc5dSXMkjqNQCYJci4b63SkC788gf8si6VQ8L.png)




I've been on here for a while now and I've come to see a whole lot of things, I've seen people leave there's without withdrawing, I've seen those who stake there's so it can grow gradually, and I've seen some like me who withdraw it too.


And in all sincerity, I admire those that leave there's or decide to stake it. And I made that decision at some point too, to be disciplined, to leave it untouched and allow it to grow, but life didn't follow my script.


I can't even count the number of times I've had to come here to withdraw it. And it's not as if I use it for irrelevant or that I'm careless with the way I spend, not at all... But life, and responsibilities are choking, a lot of times I will be faced with situations that wouldn't even give me an hour to think or to plan, I just find myself dipping into what I had decided to keep.


![1000982181.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/marsdave/23tRzfTjgXvsGyKqTULweuUg4TiUzBFwdVn75FS9dgdPs1VhhQVQ5PKSjALbbeRcAhXfu.png)




And y'all will agree with me that life is not the same for everyone of us,  what we face, battle and struggle with are different. Soz if you see some of us withdrawing, it's not as if we don't really want to save too, but life's just too choking. Deep inside of us, we really wished we could too.


And I say that because it's something I've always wanted to do too, I see those who save and I really want to do same too. And even though responsibilities and a lot of things are choking, still I've decided a plan for myself. Not as if I wouldn't withdraw, but some part will as well go to savings too, I just made that decision earlier this month, and by the end of next month I'm sure I will be saving something up again... because this time I intend to do it.

title.title: Stinking Passion Flower
title.body: > Amidst the lush, serene greenery, a Stinking Passion Flower is in full bloom. It blooms gracefully there. It doesn't make any noise, let alone scream for attention. It displays its beauty in a meaningful silence. The flower exists like a little secret amidst the lush undergrowth. From a distance, the flower appears unassuming, but when you get up close and examine it closely, its shape is truly extraordinary.

> The petals are pure white, adorned with light purple stamens. Not only that, but in the center of the petals is something even more striking: its shape resembles a tiny tree standing serenely. It's the pistil. This unique pistil shape is rare in other flowers. So far, I haven't found a pistil with this shape in any other flower.

> According to my own observations, this flower is a favorite among insects and small birds in the wild. Many bees and butterflies flock to it. Small birds like finches also visit. It looks like this flower produces a lot of nectar.

title.title: Un pez en la ciudad /A fish out of water
title.body:
<center>

Un pez llega en bus a la ciudad,
escondido en el techo va
hasta que deja de funcionar
y se baja preocupado el animal,
para ayudar a empujar. 

El bus recupera el movimiento 
y deja al pez sin remordimiento,
el animal se siente inquieto
y mira todo con misterio,
le angustia estar solo y del mar lejos. 

>A fish arrives in the city by bus,
hidden on the roof,
until the bus breaks down
and the worried animal gets off
to help push it.

>The bus starts moving again
and leaves the fish behind without a second thought,
the animal feels uneasy
and looks at everything with wonder,
distressed to be alone and far from the sea. 

![InShot_20260325_152634565.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeppqkc1DnTuoaFKnQbPeojNujdXa7uc48D9NCpQERVKa/InShot_20260325_152634565.gif)

Empieza a llorar desconsolado,
no sabe que hará en este lugar lejano,
el sol escucha su llanto
y del cielo baja de inmediato,
para abrazar al pez nostálgico. 

Hablan con agrado
y el sol llama a la lluvia de inmediato,
le dice que llueva por un rato 
y está hace caso,
dejando todo emparamado.

>He begins to weep inconsolably,
not knowing what he’ll do in this faraway place,
the sun hears his crying
and immediately descends from the sky,
to embrace the homesick fish.

>They chat happily,
and the sun calls for rain right away,
telling it to rain for a while,
and it obeys,
leaving everything drenched.

![InShot_20260325_193032638.gif](https://images.hive.blog/DQmX8EFTrDKtrYqi8atRRZMTakWkQBTV1eSJiZahyVtPhDc/InShot_20260325_193032638.gif)

Cuando la lluvia se marcha,
deja ver la ciudad inundada,
el pez logra nadar entre las aguas
y feliz se marcha,
gracias al sol que le ayudó con su causa. 

El gran astro sube al firmamento 
para evaporar lo que dejó el aguacero,
hasta que ocurre algo excéntrico,
un barco llega sin misterio,
ha navegar por la ciudad con anhelo. 

>When the rain clears,
it reveals the flooded city,
the fish manages to swim through the waters
and swims away happily,
thanks to the sun that helped it along.

>The great star rises in the sky
to evaporate what the downpour left behind,
until something strange happens,
a boat arrives without fanfare,
ready to sail through the city with longing

title.title: Knowledge is only valuable if it is shared / El conocimiento solo vale si se comparte (eng-esp)
title.body:
Hello, friends of @holos-lotus.

There's a phrase I've always liked, but lately it's been bothering me a bit: *knowledge is power*. It doesn't bother me because it's incorrect, but because of the misuse it's received lately. It's been misinterpreted.

We've turned it into an excuse to accumulate information as if it were money in a bank account.

I've seen brilliant people, with more than enough experience, who never utter a word that could be useful to someone else. Not out of prudence, but out of fear? Fear that someone else will know the same thing and they'll cease to be special, that they'll lose something? Fear of losing a supposed advantage?

That's not power, it's insecurity in disguise.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYyPmGGuEDV5diSxkvAGt91AXssjLTcPcQmrdYmfzpFN/1777211546407.jpg)

I'm going to be direct about this: if you know something that could benefit someone, say it.

You don't have to tell your whole life story or reveal secrets that aren't yours to share. But if you know of a place that's hiring, if you know of a tool that would save a colleague hours of work, if you've already gone through a problem that someone is facing now, what does it cost you to share it?

Nothing. You lose absolutely nothing.

On the contrary, you gain something that can't be measured in degrees or salary: the certainty that you were helpful.

You gained a friend.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTD8Ea45dzUvyF5JrkR8eTPqkZ4KViVFZzN7c7EvwLNGa/1777216172257.jpg)

The selfishness I see today isn't just about material things. There's a lot of selfishness surrounding information, despite living in an information-saturated society.
There are people who hoard contacts, methods, and shortcuts as if they were treasures that must be protected.

And I understand it, in part, because that knowledge is indeed a treasure. But it's one of those treasures that, the more you share, the more you get back.

We live in a work culture that pushes us to compete even when it's not necessary. But precisely because the environment conditions us to be this way, breaking free from that is a true act of independence. Sharing what you know is telling the system that it's not going to dictate how you relate to others.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdc3cZBNUxzUXvrN3kAGugmJbyohB3qbeQJN2ykuVQ4k6/1777216172317.jpg)

I've done it. I've given workshops for free. I've spent hours explaining to someone how to use a program that took me weeks to master. I've shared contacts without expecting anything in return. And I'm not saying this to set myself up as an example, but to make it clear that anyone can do it. You don't need to be an expert or have a degree. You just need to have experienced something that could benefit someone else. That's all.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbpdtnV1PUAwrHBwp3tasemCZfYiU5NivVniVzncgQG3/1777216172086.jpg)

If you can go to a school, a library, a community center, or an online space where there are people who want to learn and you have something to teach, do it. Don't underestimate what an hour-long conversation can do for someone. I've seen people change course because someone said something to them at just the right moment. I'm not exaggerating. Sometimes the only thing separating a person from an opportunity is a lack of information. And you have that information. Or some of it.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCSoXZ365BF1Z2fyUDPigLTEsRjUDmw5PrWNrRFVzTVh/1777216172014.jpg)

It's not about becoming a knowledge preacher or constantly spouting facts. It's about being willing. About not keeping what you know to yourself as if sharing it would leave you empty. Knowledge isn't divided, it multiplies. It's the only thing that grows when you share it. So the next time you know something that could make someone's life easier, say it. Without expecting anything in return. Without calculating. Just because you can. That's enough.

***
**Versión en español**
***

Hola, amigos de @holos-lotus.

Hay una frase que siempre me gustó, pero últimamente me ha molestado un poco: *el conocimiento es poder*. No me molesta porque sea incorrecta, sino por el mal uso que se le ha dado en los últimos tiempos. Se la ha malinterpretado. 
La hemos convertido en una excusa para acumular información como si fuera dinero en una cuenta bancaria. 
He visto a gente brillante, con experiencia de sobra, que nunca suelta una palabra que pueda servirle a otro. No por prudencia, sino por ¿miedo? ¿Miedo a que alguien más sepa lo mismo y deje de ser especial, le quite algo? ¿Miedo a perder una supuesta ventaja? 
Eso no es poder, es inseguridad disfrazada.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYYyPmGGuEDV5diSxkvAGt91AXssjLTcPcQmrdYmfzpFN/1777211546407.jpg)

Voy a ser directa en este sentido: si sabes algo que puede beneficiar a alguien, dilo. 
No tienes que contar toda tu vida ni revelar secretos que no te corresponden. Pero si conoces un lugar donde están contratando, si sabes de una herramienta que le ahorraría horas de trabajo a un colega, si ya pasaste por un problema que alguien está enfrentando ahora, ¿qué te cuesta compartirlo? 
Nada. No pierdes absolutamente nada. 
Al contrario, ganas algo que no se mide en títulos ni en salario: la certeza de que fuiste útil. 
Ganaste un amigo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTD8Ea45dzUvyF5JrkR8eTPqkZ4KViVFZzN7c7EvwLNGa/1777216172257.jpg)

El egoísmo que veo hoy no es material, solamente. Con la información hay muchísimo egoísmo, a pesar de vivir en una sociedad de sobreinformación. 
Hay personas que se guardan contactos, métodos, atajos, como si fueran tesoros que hay que proteger. 
Y lo entiendo, en parte, porque en realidad ese conocimiento es un tesoro. Pero es de esos tesoros que, mientras más se reparte, más te toca.
Vivimos en una cultura laboral que nos empuja a competir incluso cuando no es necesario. Pero justo por eso, porque el entorno nos condiciona a ser así, romper con eso es un acto de independencia real. Compartir lo que sabes es decirle al sistema que no te va a dictar cómo relacionarte con los demás.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdc3cZBNUxzUXvrN3kAGugmJbyohB3qbeQJN2ykuVQ4k6/1777216172317.jpg)

Yo lo he hecho. He dado talleres sin cobrar. He pasado horas explicándole a alguien cómo usar un programa que a mí me tomó semanas dominar. He compartido contactos sin esperar nada a cambio. Y no lo cuento para ponerme como ejemplo, sino para dejar claro que cualquiera puede hacerlo. No necesitas ser un experto ni tener un título. Solo necesitas haber vivido algo que a otro le sirva. Eso es todo.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmUbpdtnV1PUAwrHBwp3tasemCZfYiU5NivVniVzncgQG3/1777216172086.jpg)

Si puedes ir a una escuela, a una biblioteca, a un centro comunitario, a un espacio en línea donde haya gente que quiere aprender y tú tienes algo que enseñar, hazlo. No subestimes lo que una conversación de una hora puede provocar en alguien. He visto personas cambiar de rumbo porque alguien les dijo algo en el momento justo. No exagero. A veces lo único que separa a una persona de una oportunidad es la falta de información. Y tú tienes esa información. O una parte de ella.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZCSoXZ365BF1Z2fyUDPigLTEsRjUDmw5PrWNrRFVzTVh/1777216172014.jpg)

No se trata de volverte un predicador del conocimiento ni de andar soltando datos a cada rato. Se trata de estar dispuesto. De no guardarte lo que sabes como si al soltarlo te quedaras vacío. El conocimiento no se divide, se multiplica. Es lo único que crece cuando lo repartes. Así que la próxima vez que sepas algo que puede hacerle la vida más fácil a alguien, dilo. Sin esperar nada. Sin calcular. Solo porque puedes. Eso basta.

title.title: ‎Silence the Noise: How Ignoring Condemnation Helped Me Grow
title.body:
‎Hi Hive,
‎
‎There was a moment in my life that I paid too much attention to what people said about me. Every criticism, every negative comment, and every form of condemnation felt so heavy. That it would sit in my mind for some hours, sometimes even days, affecting how I saw myself and how I approached life at that time.
‎ https://img.leopedia.io/DQmbskkwhGayEKTd9jgtEv9ySnGEnCxGk6V8nYiGPwqTdtp/jdblack-chorizin-4657813_1920.jpg 

‎[Pixabay](https://pixabay.com/photos/chorizin-condemned-city-israel-4657813/)
‎
‎I didn’t realize it then, but I was giving too much power to voices that did not truly understand my journey. As time goes on, I started to realise something meaningful that condemnation sometimes says more about the person giving it than the person receiving it. Because at the end, its not all opinions that worth paying attention to.
‎
‎Even though, it wasn't easy decision to stop paying attention to condemnation, but it's something necessary. So I had to learn how to filter what I hear.
‎
‎Constructive criticism is valuable and it helps you improve and grow. But condemnation is something different entirely. It tears you down without offering a path forward. I became more intentional about what I allow into my mind immediately I understood this difference
‎
‎One of the biggest changes I experienced was in my confidence. When I stopped focusing on negative opinions, I started to trust myself even more and became more willing to take risks, try new things, and step out of my comfort zone. Before, I used to hesitate, worrying about what people might say if I failed. But now, being able to ignored those condemnation gave me the freedom to act without fear.
‎
‎Ignoring condemnation also improved my emotional well-being. Because carrying the weight of other people’s harsh words can be so exhausting. As it drains your energy and affects your peace of mind as well. But when you learn to let go, you create space for more positive thoughts to come in. And you start to pay more attention on your goals, your progress, and the things that truly matter.
‎
‎Another great impact of ignoring condemnation is how it shapes your resilience. Life will always come with different opinions, both good and bad. But when you train yourself not to be shaken by condemnation, then you become stronger. You develop a mindset that is not broken easily. You learn to stay grounded and focused instead of reacting to negativity.
‎
‎Though this does not mean you should completely ignore everyone. Because wisdom lies in knowing whose voice really matters. Listen to people who truly care about your growth and those who correct you with respect and guide you with good intentions. But for those who only criticize you without understanding, it is okay to let their words pass like noise in the background.
‎
‎For me, I have found more peace by choosing what I give my attention to. Because my journey is mine, and not everyone will understand it. That is perfectly oky. What really matters is that I keep moving forward, learning, relearning and improving myself.
‎
‎In the end, not paying attention to condemnation is not about pride or arrogance but it is about protecting your peace and directing your attention on your purpose. When you silence the unnecessary noise, you begin to hear your own voice which is the most important voice of all. And often, that is exactly what you need to grow into the person you are meant to become.
‎
‎
‎![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYaWnApEziAtLL5Zwv3ZNbDjRfSfG6h5njgTrpyasnE6y/1775569275821.png)
‎
‎

title.title: A quiet smile after a long day 🌿
title.body:
https://img.leopedia.io/DQmcpYBLBSBcu6Pq3ed4HdtjvMcp782dzghPCTaLQ79zzaR/IMG_8515.jpg 

Some days feel heavier than others… but I’ve learned to carry them with grace.

Working in sales isn’t easy, especially when your mind is already thinking about bills, your child, and everything you want to build for the future. But today, I paused for a moment… took this picture… and reminded myself why I keep going.

I’m not just working for today. I’m building something bigger. Step by step, learning about investments, dreaming of the day I can have freedom — real freedom — for me and my little one.

It’s not fast. It’s not perfect. But it’s happening.

And for now… this smile is enough 🤍

body.title: [ENG/ESP] The magic of a living courtyard in times of drought
body.body: > **Starting the week with renewed energy is, without a doubt, one of the best feelings we can have. When the body rests and the mind clears, everything seems to flow more smoothly, as if life itself were giving us a little nudge to get off to a good start. I sincerely hope your week has also begun in the best possible way—with good news, peace of mind, and the motivation to face whatever comes your way. For me, this week looks quite promising. I have several matters to attend to, work commitments, and some pending tasks that require organization and a positive attitude. Luckily, I’m coming off a very relaxed Sunday at home—a day that allowed me to recharge my batteries while tending to my plants and spending time with my family, which is what I enjoy most. Early in the morning, my husband started working on our car’s engine. He loves mechanics, and when it comes to our vehicle, he prefers to do it himself, with patience and dedication. Our son went out to hang out with some friends, so the house was quiet, just the two of us. That peaceful atmosphere always feels special.**

> *Un inicio de semana con energías renovadas es, sin duda, una de las mejores sensaciones que podemos tener. Cuando el cuerpo descansa y la mente se despeja, todo parece fluir con más suavidad, como si la vida misma nos diera un pequeño empujón para comenzar con buen pie. Espero sinceramente que su semana también haya empezado de la mejor manera, con buenas noticias, tranquilidad y motivación para enfrentar lo que venga. Para mí, esta semana promete bastante. Tengo varios asuntos por atender, compromisos laborales y algunas tareas pendientes que requieren organización y buena disposición. Por suerte, vengo de un domingo muy relajado en casa, un día que me permitió recargar energías mientras me ocupaba de mis plantas y compartía tiempo con mi familia, que es lo que más disfruto. Desde temprano, mi esposo comenzó a montar el motor de nuestro carro. A él le encanta la mecánica, y cuando se trata de nuestro vehículo, prefiere hacerlo él mismo, con paciencia y dedicación. Nuestro hijo salió a compartir con unas amigas, así que la casa quedó en silencio, solo para nosotros dos. Ese ambiente tranquilo siempre se siente especial.*
![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-56(2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Ep7vXvCMnyodtgingqH6SeWuYSDexa3Bhro1psJNbiV1EBiv6vHYSpSKmvBLRPcUkx8.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-55.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/Eq378FMRhGw2f6xE9revgTYdgzT4s3TPj33ze7VkLCKUhHJX6KiFYhizfFsUr5T4y5M.jpg)

> **The first thing I did was fill the birdbath we have in the backyard. It was completely dry when I woke up, and I don’t like that to happen, because the birds suffer terribly during this severe drought. At least they know they can drink and cool off in our backyard. Some even bathe, and when we’re outside, we get to enjoy a real show; thrushes, doves, cardinallets, turpials, and even woodpeckers come by. Each with its own color, song, and personality. The thrushes are the most trusting; they almost seem like part of the family.**

> *Lo primero que hice fue echar agua al abrevadero de aves que tenemos en el patio. Amaneció completamente seco, y eso no me gusta que pase, porque en esta sequía tan fuerte las aves sufren muchísimo. Al menos saben que en nuestro patio pueden beber y refrescarse. Algunas incluso se bañan, y cuando estamos afuera disfrutamos de un verdadero espectáculo; llegan tordos, palomitas, cardenalitos, turpiales y hasta carpinteros. Cada uno con su color, su canto y su personalidad. Los tordos son los más confiados, casi parecen parte de la familia.*
![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-45.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EpT4gTH4TkbJngwzdBs27KFDhs7YBgJuv8KQcsKEGt7j8nJh5LHinJaacC9UfgQZmLL.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-44.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK8iDuvVCXyVMV6aNZV3o7c22LV67dxhccNqkZaUhBEikgZKjk3Sg39qwiVQfxtdVK.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-43.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoptsA4VXwcaFvWdm1dy1DsqpsWo23g8CDtSKRvKWZFBrcrSJJtYfAv41tSbvTP9256.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-36 (2).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoyR1xC7nDKuYYFQ91cFrkK5gjCgQfxbPZk9RMJvjmHCyM2cHEVVAzbdQoSgjHqRuEw.jpg)

> **After that, I spent some time tending to my plants. Despite the severe drought, we’re keeping them alive with whatever little water we can set aside for them. And it’s so satisfying to see them bloom.**

> *Después me dediqué a organizar mis plantas. A pesar de la sequía brutal, las mantenemos con el poquito de agua que podemos reservar para ellas. Y qué satisfacción da verlas florecer.*
![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-53.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoK3ukEdSwxNSWUBDMfKQEPeJhkKG5pnrsLH5MwczNA77X6yMUceXo2HEQg2mgp71eP.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-51.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoiWCPumsR4rbGyEV98SAKX1GX2LA2R1VHh1GSmZBQGgEXvuPBYRdxcPpaLcm7Cqesy.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-47.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/EoeGJdcVRjZi6Fmv2vqFexF87mrCbzSxCrT3wRgMDQVeh6Trc4iyBuLseebxsENZ4wV.jpg) ![photo_2026-04-27_00-31-46.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/taniagonzalez/23w2uhodZsorhomucurkjTphLZzfb27RpEoUgcy2hsTecU1EpwQPyqidUXwzQPPoJavBt.jpg)

> **They’re very easy-to-grow plants. The cherry tomatoes are already bearing fruit, the scallions we planted a week ago have sprouted, and we’re just waiting for the ginger to finish sprouting—it’s always a bit slower. Although we have plenty of land to plant in, for now we prefer to grow them in pots until this dry spell passes.**

> *Son plantas muy agradecidas. Los tomates cherry ya están dando frutos, el cebollín que sembramos hace una semana ya brotó, y solo falta que el jengibre termine de despertar, que siempre es más lento. Aunque tenemos bastante terreno para sembrar, por ahora preferimos hacerlo en recipientes hasta que pase esta temporada tan seca.*

title.title: Fried Quail with Baby Potatoes\\Gebratene Wachteln mit Babykartoffeln
title.body:
Hello,my friends!

Today we'll be frying whole quail in a frying pan. They're tiny, so I'll serve them with baby potatoes fried in the same pan. The dish is served with a Japanese-style sauce made with applesauce and Worcestershire sauce. Let's  go, it's going to be delicious!


![1.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNYZQuuHkVpkvSyBdEvkc1qauR3sJbRrqJveVXYr4pMtJ/1.jpg)


Ingredients:
● Quail - 2 pcs
● Baby potatoes - 20 pcs
● Butter - 30 g
● Black pepper, salt, vegetable oil for frying, herbs - to taste

For the sauce:
● Applesauce - from 1 apple
● Worcestershire sauce - 3 tbsp
● Sugar or honey - 1 tsp (You can use 2 tablespoons of mirin)
● Oyster sauce - 2 tablespoons (fish sauce is an option)
● Soy sauce - 2 tsp
● Sesame oil - 1 tbsp

1.Since I'm going to grill the quails under pressure, I need to flatten them as flat as possible. To do this, cut the keel with the cartilage out of the breastbone and \

the quail. Now it's ready to be flattened.


![2.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmeUavZAZoiB8Fj4KFpXwZPKLqdyrh5edUWUSBrHePcgK3/2.jpg)


2.While the pan is heating up, I'll brush the quails with vegetable oil and hops-suneli.


![3.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmY4RjYep5PrWaLvCVwECT1EiB37YDaAPbUXiYRGDHVEnz/3.jpg)


3.Heat the pan and reduce the heat slightly to medium. Otherwise, we'll just burn the quails on the outside, but they'll still be raw on the inside. Place the quails skin-side up and fry for 5 minutes. The press presses the quail down so they cook better.


![4.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUyF5goXNXtA3zcW6tKGvyZSY8Safj9GiG9frsHhnbsxp/4.jpg)


4.Turn the quail over and cook for another 5 minutes.



![5.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNsMX3QpCLqnaNDG4ExsJzk8hzH6qpMPxmX6rbCG1Tyb6/5.jpg)


5.Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Grate the apple, add 3 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce, a spoonful of sugar or honey, a couple of spoons of oyster sauce and soy sauce, a spoonful of sesame oil, and a pinch of hot pepper. You can add a spoonful of ketchup. Stir, and the sauce is ready.



![6.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmNeSz4o2Wu9MC5Zm7NrirLZ1uu1eWG6LaxC3UYSiX9u1G/6.jpg)


6.Turn the quail skin-side up and place a piece of butter on each quail. Cover the pan with a lid and cook the quail over low heat for 10 minutes.



![7.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmbKLtx9eQrEWgfWqMMmBJvUdy6TADoAHBUMBK5DUU8jix/7.jpg)


7.Remove the lid and sprinkle the quail with salt and ground black pepper (to taste). I also cooked the baby potatoes in the same pan. You can see one cooking method here. This time, I simply fried the washed potatoes over medium-high heat (one layer in a pan) for 5 minutes per side, then cooked them on low heat, covered, for another 15 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. The baby potatoes should have a crispy crust on top, but the inside should be soft and easily pierced with a knife or fork.



![8.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXwreQ2a1fJE1qeWnBUTUygchdHuzMvZjJkoYgtVYAH4F/8.jpg)


8.Place the quail and baby potatoes on a plate and serve with Japanese sauce. Greens would also go well here. And although the quail is very bony and small, its meat is very tasty; it's probably worth making again.



![9.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYZ9DNUP1nEJ7grX7hUiPK9AGbzU77osUqn9YGs5yVj5b/9.jpg)


 Shall we cook it?

![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)

Heute braten wir ganze Wachteln in der Pfanne. Sie sind klein, deshalb serviere ich sie mit Babykartoffeln, die ich ebenfalls in der Pfanne brate. Dazu gibt es eine japanische Sauce aus Apfelmus und Worcestershiresauce. Los geht's, es wird köstlich!

Zutaten:
● Wachteln – 2 Stück
● Kleine Kartoffeln – 20 Stück
● Butter – 30 g
● Schwarzer Pfeffer, Salz, Pflanzenöl zum Braten, Kräuter – nach Geschmack

Für die Sauce:
● Apfelmus – von 1 Apfel
● Worcestershiresauce – 3 EL
● Zucker oder Honig – 1 TL (alternativ 2 EL Mirin)
● Austernsauce – 2 EL (Fischsauce ist eine Option)
● Sojasauce – 2 TL
● Sesamöl – 1 EL

1.Da ich die Wachteln unter Druck grillen werde, müssen sie so flach wie möglich sein. Dazu schneide ich den Brustkorb mit dem Knorpel aus dem Brustbein und klappe die Wachtel auf. Jetzt kann sie flachgeklopft werden.
2.Während die Pfanne erhitzt, bestreiche ich die Wachteln mit Pflanzenöl und Hopfen-Suneli.
3.Die Pfanne erhitzen und die Hitze etwas auf mittlere Stufe reduzieren. Sonst verbrennen die Wachteln außen, bleiben aber innen roh. Die Wachteln mit der Hautseite nach oben in die Pfanne legen und 5 Minuten braten. Durch das Pressen werden die Wachteln angedrückt und garen so besser.
4.Die Wachteln wenden und weitere 5 Minuten braten.
5.In der Zwischenzeit die Soße zubereiten. Den Apfel reiben, 3 Esslöffel Worcestershiresauce, einen Esslöffel Zucker oder Honig, je ein paar Esslöffel Austern- und Sojasauce, einen Esslöffel Sesamöl und eine Prise Chilipulver hinzufügen. Optional kann noch ein Esslöffel Ketchup dazugegeben werden. Umrühren, fertig ist die Soße.
6.Die Wachteln mit der Hautseite nach oben in die Pfanne legen und jeweils ein Stück Butter daraufgeben. Den Topf mit einem Deckel abdecken und die Wachteln 10 Minuten bei schwacher Hitze garen.
7.Den Deckel abnehmen und die Wachteln mit Salz und gemahlenem schwarzen Pfeffer (nach Geschmack) würzen. Ich habe die kleinen Kartoffeln im selben Topf zubereitet. Eine Zubereitungsmethode ist hier abgebildet. Dieses Mal habe ich die gewaschenen Kartoffeln einfach bei mittlerer bis hoher Hitze (in einer Lage in der Pfanne) 5 Minuten pro Seite angebraten und anschließend zugedeckt bei schwacher Hitze weitere 15 Minuten gegart. Mit Salz und Pfeffer würzen. Die kleinen Kartoffeln sollten eine knusprige Kruste haben, aber innen weich sein und sich leicht mit einem Messer oder einer Gabel einstechen lassen.
8.Die Wachteln und die kleinen Kartoffeln auf einem Teller anrichten und mit japanischer Sauce servieren. Gemüse passt auch gut dazu. Und obwohl die Wachtel sehr knochig und klein ist, ist ihr Fleisch sehr schmackhaft; es lohnt sich bestimmt, sie wieder zuzubereiten. Wollen wir sie kochen?


![3-poloska-1.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmYyhhAydYCgxXo6MZeZ3YC526qwyBdU2NCdMXtyoJGAXB/3-poloska-1.png)



![U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXaogGpoD7LJkEufiNxjF52VcPhQZJYsJet34fDwJyYUV/U5duDCNw2pr2jpJvE8CRni125dys5tM_1680x8400.png)![U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmVmydUTmF1ECe7u87FkCoJYcxT6Xo9spqJBWGi8G3ntXH/U5dr1BuE8ejAxctktpDvrzGctPnaMgF_1680x8400.jpg)
