title.title: A Golden Moment: Yesterday’s Sunset View
title.body: /> Yesterday was one of those days where nature decided to put on a magical show. Around 5 o'clock, I was sitting on my balcony. I had a warm cup of coffee in my hand, and I was getting my mind ready for my work shift. When I looked up, I couldn't believe my eyes. The sky was a soft, pale blue. At first, there were almost no clouds at all. It looked so peaceful and still. I knew right then that I couldn't just let the moment go by. I had to grab my camera and start taking photos.

>🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️ 🌀 ☀️

What I love about the sky is that it never stays the same. Even as I watched, the colors shifted. The bright blue began to fade into deep navy and warm gold combo. The clouds seem to be dancing. Every few seconds, the clouds changed their shape and position. One moment they looked like thin streaks, and the next, they were fluffy and glowing from the sun. Then the moon appeared 🌙. As the sun started to hide, a tiny, bright moon showed up in the middle of the blue sky.

/>

* * *

It was such a simple moment, but it felt special to me. Watching the sunset reminded me to slow down. Even though I was about to start working, seeing the golden light hit the trees and the rooftops made me feel calm and ready to start my evening.

I’m so glad I captured these photos. It’s a beautiful reminder that even a regular afternoon can turn into something magical if you just look up.

Did you catch the sunset yesterday? It’s amazing how the same sky above us can look so different for everyone.

Here I am again at the gym, even though it’s Sunday. For many, it’s a day to rest, to relax and pause… and that’s valid. But for me, showing up today is a reminder of my commitment. It’s not about pushing myself to exhaustion, it’s about staying consistent and honoring the promise I made to myself.

There are days when motivation is high, and others when it’s not, but discipline is what keeps me moving forward. Being here today makes me feel proud, because I know I could have stayed home, but I chose growth instead. Every small effort adds up, and these are the moments that truly shape results.

I’m not here to be perfect, I’m here to keep going. Sunday or not, I won’t give up. Because every day is a new chance to become stronger, healthier, and more confident. 💪✨

>Hay días con mucha motivación y otros con menos, pero la disciplina es la que me mantiene avanzando. Estar aquí hoy me hace sentir orgullosa, porque sé que pude haberme quedado en casa, pero elegí crecer. Cada pequeño esfuerzo suma, y estos momentos son los que realmente construyen resultados.

>No estoy aquí para ser perfecta, estoy aquí para seguir. Sea domingo o no, no me rindo. Porque cada día es una nueva oportunidad de ser más fuerte, más saludable y más segura. 💪✨

title.title: Other Niche Communities Curation Report #2210
title.body: >\nHello everyone! This is the 2210th compilation post of OCD's latest curation efforts. It has been known that OCD has been supporting leading niche communities under its <b><a href=\
>Community Incubation Program. However, there are still a lot of other niche communities not supported by OCD. This curation initiative will help in supporting those communities.

> This newest curation effort aims to encourage authors to post in appropriate communities even if those communities are not under the incubation program. This will also encourage users to explore more into the different communities in Hive.

How this Works

> OCD curators and community leaders will find posts from other niche communities and recommend them for an upvote. Unlike those communities in the incubation program where curation is focused, this curation initiative is spread out. This will help find undervalued posts from smaller communities that deserve support.

> This will highlight both the author and the community where the post is located. This way, smaller niche communities can focus on growing their subscribers and increasing the engagements within their respective communities. A small boost goes a long way.

> Speaking of boost, here are the curated posts for this batch:

Curated Posts

Author: @xrayman Community:
>Hive PPP index - How have product prices changed over the past year?\n\n

>
The world is constantly changing. We notice this whenever there is a “hiccup” or a sudden jolt. As far back as 2010, when Portugal was facing a major recession caused by excessive increases in public debt, the talk of competitiveness, the stagnation of the financial sector, and the lack of diversity and low penetration in international markets, with the trade balance tilting heavily toward imports. Many disastrous public investments led us to that point, and I remember very well when, in 2011, the government had to request assistance from the IMF—the International Monetary Fund—the European Commission, and the European Central Bank, through the mechanism that came to be known as the Troika—due to the three entities involved.

Some of the conclusions reached by cutting-edge research in neuroscience may seem quite shocking, such as pointing out the errors of “scientific” medicine—the official medicine of the West. These are errors that were already exposed by the old humanist physicians, such as Gregorio Marañón. As an example, Mira y López called this very modern medicine—which has broken the human being down into organs, rendering the person in whom those organs reside unrecognizable—veterinary medicine, and I believe he was quite right to do so.

body.title: Spectacular! Crime 101 (2026) || Movie Review
body.body:
![1000105086.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23zku1DDbsgBQgUW7gBAgu5iqS2vvYw6Kz5soZArJ6DEkMbWxtUo3NcKwG6atXd6gULkr.jpg)
I was close to giving up on Hollywood movies but this recent release raised my hope again. Well, just a little bit. Simply seeing Chris Hemsworth, Halle Barry and Mark Ruffalo as lead casts piqued my interest to watch. So I went in blind and it was worth my time. **Crime 101 (2026)** is an American crime thriller written and directed by Bart Layton based on the novel of the same name by Don Winslow. It stars actors like Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry, Mark Ruffalo, Barry Keoghan, Corey Hawkins, Monica Barbaro and others. The opening scene presents us with three characters: Mike Davis (Chris Hemsworth), a meticulous and cool jewel thief, Sharon Combs (Halle Berry), an insurance broker, and Detective Lou Lubesnick (Mark Ruffalo). It's past five am and these three are awake, preparing to start their day. Mike Davis is wearing a suit, black gloves and is armed, following two men transporting diamonds. He intercepts them, takes the case of jewels from them and as he wants to drive off, one of the men raises his gun and shoots. Mike is shocked but not hurt. He quickly aborts his mission and reports to his boss, Money. ![1000105082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Eou7ma6QGGqfrAsrWj9ie1fUmiwkWEQFbPa9ghQLDTk7nWDh65X5F8EAW9kmCicrCig.jpg) ![1000105081.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EopsvekuLEPE8qfeNqx2RGTTWzeh2FpmS9Z2LSr2xmjUAe7FoMcDxok11hY3eSD7oYf.jpg) ![1000105083.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EogMR8qSsH8tFzfmigVtxDchXvXTSzpGxfQ1TUodkn3qxsvxY3PQaxLCEcAURXqnkA8.jpg) Money is unhappy Mike aborted the mission simply because he never hurts anyone or commits any act of violence. Money calls Ormon (Barry Keoghan), an impulsive thief and biker, to follow Mike on the next heist and rob him after it's done. ![1000105085.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoJz6NRPGZUBpvRKn1eo6cVCy3pMgnuoETZFaJkwKbQNgBPE1XxGPsJHYPesgMe7vrd.jpg) ![1000105080.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EpNoRQ5ir433TU9i8FB71nsZHeiSFjT4H2W3Qos9aeDwLL6xLVTUcUJpvF69Kr4yhHP.jpg) In another scene, Detective Lou and his partner are called to the crime scene where the jewels had been stolen. Sharon is at a billionaire's house, trying to convince him to let her company insure his valuables. She returns to the office and is informed of the lost jewels and whether her company should insure the owners. ![1000105084.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/EoK4Tr4s1aX8kkcVM2K3S4J6wgLKvyFNJZpSQCvTuH432MtUDEPapdg3NFaHwybxDFd.jpg) ![1000105079.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/Ep7uX4K6LvdAvt2famWwFQ7dyYKQ2PV5DKLNsvHk8vTnPn5wk2dv117HruwG4nzmSDn.jpg) While Lou is determined to catch this meticulous thief who operates only on 101 Freeway in Southern California, Mike plans to handle a final heist. He meets Sharon and tries to convince her to work with him. She's reluctant at first but when her bosses at work bypass her for partnership, she meets up with Mike. Will Sharon and Mike succeed on this heist? Is Lou willing to get this elusive thief to gain his fellow officers’ respect? My Review And Rating I was glued to my screen all through the two hours of this movie and not once did I see a dull moment. *Crime 101* is thrilling and entertaining. The plot is unoriginal, common in crime thrillers. Though it fits the bill of a normal heist film, the storytelling and cinematography set it apart from other movies. The cast is impressive. Chris Hemsworth, Halle Berry and Mark Ruffalo are great actors and bringing them together elevates this movie from a type B to A in my opinion. They embody their roles very well and delivered spectacular performances. Chris Hemsworth is charming as always. His character suffered childhood traumas and as an adult, he's shy yet meticulous and empathic. He plays this role convincingly. A part of this movie that sets it apart is the contrast between Mike Davis' approach to heist and Ormon's. They are both thieves working for Money but they operate differently. Mike is calm, calculating, and doesn't hurt anyone. Ormon on the other hand is impulsive and crazy in a psychopathic way. He moves fast, yelling and waving his gun around like a drug addict and doesn't mind killing people. This makes me like Hemsworth more. I have always loved Halle Berry in movies and she didn't disappoint me in this one. She's a focused broker with ambitions yet carries the pain of a woman bypassed for promotion by a patriarchal workplace. She has the grace to look pained and remorseful for being an accomplice to a heist. I particularly liked the scene where she stands up to her boss and gives him a piece of her mind. I love that the director draws some decent attention to the supporting characters like the psychopathic Ormon played by Barry Keoghan, Mike's love interest played by Monica Barbaro, Money, the crime boss played by Nick Nolte and others. They are memorable and their roles fit perfectly into the heist. Also, the director gives us a satisfying end but not the type you would expect. He steers viewers to look beyond what the law requires in that situation to see the grey areas. In a strict heist scenario, the detective would have arrested Mike. Instead he leans into his human side and tries to do right by the parties involved. I don't often applaud a movie where a supposed villain goes scot-free but this one is well deserved. The cinematography and action scenes are outstanding. The visuals are sleek and the transitions are excellent. The night time views of the city are lovely. I liked the three-way split screen at the beginning that introduces the three lead characters. There aren't many fight scenes except for when Mike Davis and Ormon face off. But the car chases stand out. I loved the display of stunning cars. Rating this movie, I'd give it 8 stars out of 10. The movie is well made and the acting makes it even better. It humanises the characters, allowing us to look beyond their unlawful acts and understand their motivations. https://youtu.be/hKSV66DBTdA?si=bM_BOfCBdls-Zi_d ![3yZiouw5jgtrj8RZntzpYvPkttnUNCNB3bKsugcDmKrZysEhsVCu7HmxWG7sYd9c3PJiWe24wRnpAB7HXq2WMvHX9AyxjgRuTY38KWSsv8...GFDdhx4UzPxqzjjpVMXNYgRDyspwo7pFw2RpyHZvde1tK7QLmYqnXBk9hDVg1dAooe2nLquVnXKjzS2uR5yQNqx1V5qutNgmqpFfKYLpS93ajRQosgFNPk3e1s.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/esther-emmanuel/23t7BFjADUCGjsLPt1YzFafTb9BeZ3Err5bNPwTi6RYNWED9TfZAhqAcZ8JCb2rGLLeT6.gif) *All images above are from the movie screenshots* *[Poster image source](https://pics.filmaffinity.com/Ruta_de_escape-127743661-large.jpg)* *Thank you for visiting and supporting my blog* 🤗

body.title: I participated in my son's school sports competition.
body.body:
​

Friends, how are you all? I hope you are all doing well, and I am also doing well, _Alhamdulillah_. Today, I have come to you to share the story and moments of my wonderful day. Some moments in life are so joyful and beautiful. Just like that, I have passed a day today, and I will share with you what I am doing and will do tod

 > Amigos, ¿cómo están? Espero que estén todos bien, y yo también estoy bien, Alhamdulillah. Hoy les comparto la historia y los momentos de mi maravilloso día. Hay momentos en la vida que son tan alegres y hermosos. Así, hoy he pasado un día maravilloso y les contaré lo que estoy haciendo y haré hoy.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmRoAy7bXSusQ2GNxUAxj4wbfn9NwYzzZvHxVPLSADdmBe/2b4942e1-d5bb-4879-9f0a-0efd20ff4c13.jpg)

Today was the day my son's school had scheduled a sports day, so I was very excited from the morning. Even though my son was very young and there was a performance for adults to play, my son also went there and participated. Winning a game is not such a big deal, but playing and making yourself happy is much more fun. We had breakfast in the morning and went out, and the game will be held in the big field next to us.

 > Hoy era el día de deportes que la escuela de mi hijo había programado, así que estaba muy emocionada desde la mañana. Aunque mi hijo era muy pequeño y había una exhibición para adultos, él también fue y participó. Ganar un partido no es tan importante, pero jugar y divertirse es mucho más gratificante. Desayunamos y salimos; el partido se celebrará en el campo grande que está al lado de casa.

![ \

](https://images.hive.blog/DQmZ1HgyP6wsNV7eXk1AMJ2xogRdZkUt3KXL298KsjB1wXj/80272cd8-bd5a-4eaa-9cad-7870d5ec3307.jpg)

Everyone, young and old, can participate in this game. Everyone from class one to class ten will be determined as a winner for participating in the game. However, my son will not be counted as he is studying in nursery, but he will get the opportunity to play. We reached half an hour before the scheduled time, and we saw everyone wearing their jerseys and ready to play. It was a very fun moment. I took several pictures there.

 > Todos, jóvenes y mayores, pueden participar en este juego. Todos los alumnos de primero a décimo grado serán considerados ganadores por su participación. Sin embargo, mi hijo no participará, ya que está en preescolar, pero tendrá la oportunidad de jugar. Llegamos media hora antes de la hora prevista y vimos a todos con sus camisetas, listos para jugar. Fue un momento muy divertido. Tomé varias fotos allí.

body.title: La bolsa de sangre que me enseñó a despedirme (Zafiro, mi perrito salchicha) (🇺🇸EN - ES🇪🇸)
body.body:
>


![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmT2yWbAcCHgwGxAFQtwBrPWV4LZv4U7iFE5TkGwMAu5ns/1777265493675.jpg)


Zafiro era mi mascota, un perrito salchicha muy amigable y alegre. Tanto, que si tenías un mal día, él con su espíritu juguetón te lo animaba. Nunca olvido cómo movía todo el lomo cuando me veía llegar, no solo la cola. O cómo se escondía detrás de la cortina para que lo buscara, pero asomaba la patita sin querer. Por eso pude notar enseguida un cambio repentino en él… algo que me asustó mucho y que marcó para siempre mis sentimientos.

Hace unos meses tuve una experiencia desagradable con mi perrito. Un día me levanté en la madrugada para ir al baño y debajo de la meseta de la cocina estaba Zafiro acostado. Se estaba quejando. Me acerqué a ver qué le pasaba, y al encender la luz vi que le había salido una bolsa de sangre debajo de la garganta. No podía respirar y se quejaba mucho.

Yo, al verlo así, me asusté muchísimo. Llamé a mi abuela para que me ayudara a entender qué estaba pasando. Tenía miedo, mucho miedo, porque pensé que se me iba a morir en ese mismo instante. Como era de madrugada, tuvimos que esperar a que amaneciera para poder llevarlo a nuestro veterinario de confianza. No me separé de él ni un segundo.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdKJWMZ6k8U9jZh3L86ghREC9cpUnFqJyg85VMVw83YYL/1777265516727.jpg)


Cuando llegamos, el veterinario nos atendió con urgencia. Tomó a Zafiro, lo puso sobre una camilla, lo examinó y luego procedió a pincharle la bolsa con una jeringuilla para drenarla. De ahí salió un líquido amarillo mezclado con sangre. Él se quejaba mucho, y era lógico porque le dolía demasiado. Pero al poco tiempo vi cómo la bolsa iba disminuyendo y su dolor se calmaba. Eso me dio una tranquilidad inmensa: ver a mi amigo más relajado después de horas de sufrimiento.

Cuando el veterinario terminó, le recetó que le pusiéramos durante una semana inyecciones de rocefin (un antibiótico fuerte) y que observáramos su comportamiento.



![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf8rK8JUfL5iUcuxnWBq2pAqhkcMVjcuVmCv5Sx8rw1sn/1777265535305.jpg)


Por desgracia, durante esa semana Zafiro no comía, siempre estaba acostado, y cuando ladraba le salía un mal olor muy fuerte. Parecía que había desarrollado una especie de cáncer en la garganta. Ya no era ese pequeño de orejas largas que vivía retozando y jugando conmigo. Aunque le pusimos las inyecciones como el veterinario indicó, no presentaba mejoría. Y me partía el alma verlo sufrir cada vez que lo inyectábamos, porque al ser un medicamento tan fuerte, le dolía muchísimo.

Lo volvimos a llevar al veterinario, pero esta vez no nos recetó nada. Solo me dijo: *\

*. Esas palabras partieron mi corazón. Eran cuatro años junto a mi amigo. Pasaron dos semanas después de esa visita. Una tarde, mientras tenía a Zafiro cargado en mis piernas, sentí cómo empezó a agitarse y a quejarse de forma extraña. Solo pasaron unos segundos… hasta que dejó de moverse. Para siempre. Solo Dios sabe el dolor tan profundo que viví en ese momento. Mi perrito se había ido. Pero algo me quedó de consuelo: ya no estaba sufriendo más. Estaba en paz. Lloré durante días. Cada vez que me venían los recuerdos, las lágrimas salían sin que pudiera evitarlo. Con el tiempo solo quedó la nostalgia de no tenerlo más conmigo. Pero también entendí algo importante: tener una mascota es aceptar desde el primer día que habrá una despedida. Sin embargo, vale la pena cada segundo. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcHd1kDhixuBbPRsWX7iZ3dT1qNCrtsMcYLsGPMqENNnv/1777265234781.jpg) Hoy, mientras escribo esto, lo recuerdo moviendo la cola como una hélice loca cada vez que abría la nevera. Creo que Zafiro me enseñó lo que ningún libro pudo: que el amor duele más cuando se va, pero duele mucho menos que nunca haberlo tenido. Nuestras mascotas son algo muy preciado, y mucho más cuando creamos un vínculo fuerte con ellas. Si tú también tienes o has tenido una mascota, y te ha pasado algo desagradable o hermoso que quieras compartir, te invito a dejarlo en los comentarios. Cuéntame su nombre y algo bonito que recuerdes de él o ella. Me gustaría leerte y, de alguna manera, honrar juntos sus vidas.

>


Zafiro was my pet, a very friendly and cheerful dachshund. So much so that if you were having a bad day, his playful spirit would cheer you up. I'll never forget how he would wiggle his whole back when he saw me arrive, not just his tail. Or how he would hide behind the curtain so I would look for him, but he would accidentally stick out his little paw. That's why I immediately noticed a sudden change in him… something that scared me deeply and marked my feelings forever.

A few months ago, I had an unpleasant experience with my dog. One day I got up in the middle of the night to go to the bathroom, and there was Zafiro lying under the kitchen counter. He was whimpering. I went over to see what was wrong, and when I turned on the light I saw that he had developed a blood-filled sac under his throat. He couldn't breathe and was whimpering a lot.

Seeing him like that terrified me. I called my grandmother to help me understand what was happening. I was very scared because I thought he was going to die right then and there. Since it was still the middle of the night, we had to wait until dawn to take him to our trusted veterinarian. I didn't leave his side for a second.

When we arrived, the vet saw us urgently. He took Zafiro, placed him on what looked like a stretcher, examined him for a moment, and then proceeded to puncture the sac with a syringe to drain it. A yellow, bloody fluid came out. Zafiro whimpered a lot, which made sense because it hurt terribly. But soon I noticed the sac shrinking and his pain easing. That gave me immense peace: seeing my friend more relaxed after hours of suffering.

When the vet finished, he prescribed a week of Rocephin injections (a strong antibiotic) and told us to monitor his behavior.

Unfortunately, during that week Zafiro wouldn't eat, he was always lying down, and when he barked, a very bad smell came out. It seemed he had developed some kind of cancer in his throat. He was no longer that long-eared little guy who used to frolic and play with me.

Even though we gave him the injections as the vet instructed, he showed no improvement. And it broke my soul to see him suffer every time we injected him, because it was a strong medication and it hurt him a lot.

We took him back to the vet, but this time he didn't prescribe anything. He just told me: *\

* Those words broke my heart. It had been four years with my friend. Two weeks after that visit, one afternoon while I had Zafiro on my lap, I felt him start to shake and whimper in a strange way. Only a few seconds passed… until he stopped moving. Forever. Only God knows the deep pain I experienced at that moment. My dog was gone. But one thing comforted me: he was no longer suffering. He was at peace. I cried for days. Every time memories came back, tears would fall uncontrollably. Over time, only that nostalgia of not having him with me remained. But I also understood something important: having a pet means accepting from day one that there will be a goodbye. Still, every second is worth it. Today, as I write this, I remember him wagging his tail like a crazy propeller every time I opened the fridge. I think Zafiro taught me what no book could: love hurts more when it leaves, but it hurts much less than never having had it. Our pets are very precious, especially when we create a strong bond with them. If you also have or have had a pet, and you've experienced something sad or beautiful you'd like to share, I invite you to leave it in the comments. Tell me their name and something nice you remember about them. I would love to read you and, in some way, honor their lives together.

body.title: Naimishnath Vishnu Temple, India - Famous for Spiritual & Architecture.
body.body:
____________________________________
# <center> Namaste 🙏🏻🇮🇳 </center>
____________________________________

Hello friends, how are you all ? Wishing you all happy and prosperous life ahead.



____________________________________
# <center> Preview</center>
____________________________________



![1000656740.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/48QRX2tAfbGmAXWZfhVGCma5oLEq4UN51Ru5YHGxXi4n3YpQwACymwX2YfpGcL9mja.jpg)


Naimisharanya is one of the most ancient pilgrimage sites in India, which is also known as Misrikh or Neemsar. According to the Puranas, this holy forest was chosen by sages as the ideal place for meditation and yajnas and also believed that Lord Vishnu’s Sudarshan Chakra fell here, marking the land as eternally sacred. For centuries, sages performed penance and rituals here, turning Naimish into a center of divine energy and knowledge.

Neemsar is only about 60 to 65 km from my hometown. I go there often, and I find it very pleasant and peaceful. I have discussed Neemsar in my blog before, but the temple I want to show you all today is very grand and Divine. Around 200 to 300 temples were built in Neemsar, and even after living so close, I haven't been able to visit them all yet.


![1000452350.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23zkdyHweNX9htaRucUDnXpCZcShdJ96w6xnuVxpt7E1F9XSQTaqiyXe688JM1Ko6aMtb.jpg)

**Naimishnath Vishnu Temple** also known as the Naimishnath Devaraja temple or Naimishnarayan Temple or ramanujar kot Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to Vishnu and lakshmi. This is the temple's main entrance; it looks so attractive from the outside,I love going to the temple because I can feel the divine energy and positive environment there, which brings me happiness and joy.

![1000452351.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/242D9V28PHSHjYZm3KbxiSBSD5q7Jcia7vhctXFjm78siyMesmZ48HBFQJoizLtuDMoB9.jpg)

**Naimishnath Vishnu Temple** is one of the most peaceful and spiritually powerful destinations in Uttar Pradesh, even the main attraction of Naimaish, which Known for its deep-rooted mythology, architecture and Beautiful carving work.


![1000452352.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23vsSmh4MKpmshRCzQ4ANc5s9q7EWyX38m3RMKV7NtBNc6YXJHth5C22X55UzRizyhR6P.jpg)


![1000452496.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23rz2LLi6mbABpCpx2Y6v2YKeofEMNVKi3EXi6USmwDgRN7CPsxPy2QdGvAJD4776YL8E.jpg)

![1000452493.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23sUEidp4GdvzbE6kuf6ZSj7KibuenjWBaQ5BkZiHuU7oRr3XE7yseHbE62sERQkuK1xB.jpg)

This idol is designed to create a grand darshan experience. Its height, calm facial expression, and symmetrical design give a powerful divine presence. It’s clearly meant to be a landmark attraction of the temple, visible from a distance and spiritually impactful. This great lord Vishnu idol Approx. 20–30 feet tall, making it a monumental structure and even Standing on a lotus pedestal, symbolizing purity.

![1000452353.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23y8qwgkm8e93ZDxGsGzLLV6TXozKFKbtL4Vx9rBm6cY2dp5s1iTNT7RRzxm9N756kKd2.jpg)

**Visiting the Naimishnath Vishnu Temple is more than just darshan—it’s an experience of inner calm.**

![1000452355.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23yd69k5dHnVMEGKbfT7hm5hNXtypTjuwCmFNXVDV8exzWFhVAJFRJybfiFY5k7TU2oaf.jpg)

![1000452356.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23w2oGhWTrHnyx4nLYFcwkGkWhwoea8wcuGhpmPT2nGg36fNhxWYH7HbsmCLmZJ8KWThr.jpg)

____________________________________


![1000452362.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23u5tiWFGLVFDpb2VV8rR5CyYe9cjhwtzYi1UH8mUCjJBjDLGp5c4z5DPN9Jn8MSSbjeS.jpg)




![1000452364.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23w2af4cMND6GCR8CP4o6arPGYT9KFVZ7njpY7kFonZFxLAfrKN3QdWXWMDVznngMeHu7.jpg)

Lord Narasimha, a powerful incarnation of Lord Vishnu.Narasimha is known as the protector of devotees and the destroyer of evil.



____________________________________



![1000452360.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xp47Y2iVVa3vEAkMh1H4TjuqS4trWnx2rWeJrsV8c3n3vWvFTTUsnfkne58edEq89oZ.jpg)

![1000452359.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23y8oW3CaoYPtFeTPJruoP9K8G62GUmwafJzyYSQysHyhaVauuhLVUJxbPAyXnXEUshc6.jpg)

The temple was as grand and beautiful inside as it was outside. It had a very peaceful atmosphere; I sat before Lord Shiva for half an hour and recited all the mantras I knew.

![1000452361.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23uQpCdgFmi7XakTGkDxT7P1MWTj2K4q2gpa4gGGMmLx2v8bSL7143pvLUyPDnvuFG3Bm.jpg)


![1000452371.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23zRzt9w7rDZkcksxzWMWYLao6owQUftwX6Wct5H7dgN9jSmTsQFG5kUPEHvJnt8KCjXz.jpg)

At the center stands a magnificent idol of Goddess Durga, radiating strength and grace. The Durga temple area adds a unique architectural beauty to the spiritual journey. The large-scale idols create a sense of awe and devotion

![1000452367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xefxBBDUoYXRD9Avsc52V2EYxeTNAhvprTSjLJEUd6MrvtDJrv4z377DY2xrt5jUYBo.jpg)


I has visited this temple 3-4 times, but every visit offers a wonderful new experience. This time I was extra excited because I wanted to write blogs and share them with my Hive family.

![1000452367.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23xefxBBDUoYXRD9Avsc52V2EYxeTNAhvprTSjLJEUd6MrvtDJrv4z377DY2xrt5jUYBo.jpg)

![1000452369.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gargi/23wqkWgS6nUB6qWiUT6L4Q3uyLsGcsam243znrnfnyA1bVT2AEHmXjRHqUTnQFuASS3DU.jpg)



This temple is famous not just in Uttar Pradesh, but across India. People travel from various states and great distances to visit and seek God's blessings,If you ever get a chance to visit India, definitely visit Neemsar. It is a wonderful place that will purify your soul and mind, and you will leave with many beautiful memories and positive experiences.




thankyou 👍🏻😊

@gargi 👍🏻🙏🏻

body.title: A Look Back at Happiness 🌿🐾
body.body:
Hello ✌🏼 
A sunlit forest path, the gentle rustling of leaves and right in the middle, a loyal companion who pauses for a moment and looks back. A moment filled with peace, nature, and quiet connection. 🌿🐾

body.title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun | Nattosheru Review [ENG/SPA]
body.body: >\n\nHello, anime fans. Tonight I’m bringing you another romance anime that I watched during the last fall season. An anime that went somewhat unnoticed, whether because of its generic nature or the competition it faced. Not unlike many other RomCom animes you’ve surely seen, A Star Brighter Than the Sun is based on the manga series of the same name written and illustrated by
>Kazune Kawahara and was produced by
>Studio Kai. Check out last year’s most generic and innocent teen romance anime.

>
Hola, fanáticos del anime. Esta noche les traigo otro anime de romance que vi durante la pasada temporada de otoño. Un anime que pasó un tanto desapercibido, ya sea por lo genérico o por la competencia que hubo. No muy distinto a muchos otros animes RomCom que seguramente han visto, A Star Brighter Than the Sun está basada en la serie de manga homónima escrita e ilustrada por Kazune Kawahara y fue producida por Studio Kai. Conoce el anime de romance adolescente más genérico e inocente del año pasado.

>

Plot

The anime begins with a high school girl who is taller than all her classmates. She introduces herself as Sae Iwata and tells us that, ever since she was a little girl, she has always been in love with her dear classmate, Koki Kamishiro, who was shorter than her back then. However, as expected, when they reach adolescence, they both grow, especially Koki, who becomes taller, stronger, and more attractive. This made him very popular with the girls in high school. Because of this, our shy but tall protagonist, Sae, distances herself from him.

>

Trama

El anime inicia con una chica de secundaria que es más alta que todas sus compañeras de clase. Ella se presenta como Sae Iwata y nos cuenta que, desde muy niña, ha estado siempre enamorada de su querido compañero de clase, Koki Kamishiro, quien en aquel entonces era más bajo que ella. Sin embargo, como era de esperarse, al llegar a la adolescencia ambos crecen, sobre todo Koki quien consigue ser más alto, fuerte y atractivo. Esto último hizo que llamara mucho la atención de las chicas en secundaria y se volviera popular. Debido a esto, nuestra tímida, pero enorme protagonista Sae se distancia de él.

> I know I sound like a broken record, but I’d like to remind my regular readers just how much of a romance fan I am. This is perfectly illustrated by the anime I’m sharing with you today, which is easily the most generic thing I saw toward the end of last year—and I’m not exaggerating. It’s not that it’s bad or that the story doesn’t make sense or anything like that; rather, it’s the typical teenage love story between two high school students in Japan. I mean, it’s exactly what anyone would see in any other run-of-the-mill RomCom anime these days. The only difference is that it lacks anything that would make it stand out as such. One of the things it lacks is an original plot. Instead, what we see is the typical story of the childhood friend who’s always been in love with the kind boy she grew up with, watching him in class, and who eventually becomes attractive and popular. After growing apart because of this, it just so happens that they reunite in high school since they’re back studying together in the same classroom. During this high school period, we see our protagonist completely smitten, admiring her beloved Koki while misinterpreting everything he says or does with other classmates.

>
Ya sueno a reloj roto, pero les recuerdo a los que me suelen leer lo fanático que soy del romance. Esto se puede confirmar perfectamente con el anime que les traigo hoy, el cual es de lo más genérico que he visto a finales del año pasado, sin exagerar. No es que no esté mal o que su historia no tenga sentido ni nada por el estilo, en cambio es la típica historia de amor adolescente entre dos estudiantes de preparatoria de Japón. O sea, es tal cual lo que cualquiera llegaría a ver en cualquier otro anime RomCom común en la actualidad. La única diferencia es que no posee nada que lo haga popular como tal. Una de esas cosas que no tiene es una trama original. En cambio, lo que vemos es la típica historia de la amiga de la infancia que siempre ha estado enamorada del chico amable con el que creció viéndolo en clases y que se vuelve atractivo y popular al final. Luego de distanciarse por esto último, da la “casualidad” de que se reencuentran en preparatoria ya que vuelven a estudiar juntos en el mismo aula de clases. Durante esta época de preparatoria vemos a nuestra protagonista toda embobada admirar a su querido Koki mientras malinterpreta todo lo que dice o hace con otras compañeras de clase.

> To start with, the plot is typical of a generic RomCom, except that the protagonist of this story isn’t a man, but a woman. That alone should offer us a very different perspective from what we usually see in other generic romance anime. For one thing, the humor is different, as is the Fanservice, which is absent from this anime. Also, regarding the main plot, we see that the pace of events and the usual clichés have a different order and meaning. We see that what our protagonist feels for Koki is pure love—too pure, actually. On the other hand, Sae also has her own traits worth mentioning, such as her low self-esteem and her shyness when interacting with or dealing with people. Despite her physical appearance, height, and great strength, she is actually a rather sensitive girl who gets her hopes up easily. By the way, Koki also has both the virtues mentioned earlier and his flaws that we can see throughout the series. In short, rather than admiration—as many might assume—what she feels is different.

>
Para empezar, la trama es la típica de un RomCom genérico, solo que con la diferencia de que el protagonista de esta historia no es un hombre, sino una mujer. Ya eso, de partida, nos debería ofrecer un punto de vista muy distinto del que normalmente vemos en otros animes de romance genéricos. Para empezar, el tema del humor es distinto, al igual que el tema del Fanservice que no existe en este anime. También en cuanto a la trama principal vemos que el ritmo de los acontecimientos y los clichés de siempre poseen un orden y un significado diferentes. Vemos que lo que siente nuestra protagonista por Koki es un amor puro, demasiado puro, la verdad. Por otro lado, Sae tiene también sus detalles a mencionar como su baja autoestima y su timidez al momento de relacionarse o tratar a la gente. A pesar de su aspecto físico, estatura y gran fuerza; en realidad es una chica bastante sensible y fácil de ilusionar. Por cierto, Koki también tiene tanto sus virtudes ya mencionadas antes como también sus defectos que podemos notar a lo largo de la serie. En resumen, más que admiración -como podrían deducir muchos-, lo que ella siente es diferente.

> One aspect of this anime worth highlighting is the way we see the characters going about their daily lives as high school students. Details like how Sae’s classmates view and treat her are particularly important because they show us how some young people experience this pivotal time in their lives. There are also the typical events and scenarios found in any school romance anime. I mention all this because, as you can see, we have twelve episodes where we’ll watch both Sae and Koki try to interact and treat each other as current classmates. Now, let’s move on to what I DIDN’T like about this anime—or rather, what actually stressed me out a bit at the time. For starters, there’s Sae’s passive and negative attitude; we constantly see her trying to “not think” about Koki all the time so she can live a peaceful school life, but she ends up thinking about every second she’s seen him each day and always mentions everything she admires and finds fascinating about him and so on. Anyway, she’s hopelessly in love with Koki—that much is crystal clear. What bothers me is how clumsy and completely clueless Sae is every time she’s with Koki.

>
Un detalle a destacar de forma positiva de este anime es la manera en la que vemos a los personajes vivir sus días como estudiantes de preparatoria. Cosas como la forma en la que los compañeros de clase ven y tratan a Sae es de suma importancia debido a que nos demuestra cómo experimentan algunos jóvenes esta época clave de sus vidas. También están los típicos eventos o escenarios de todo anime de romance escolares. Menciono todo esto ya que, como pueden leer, tenemos doce episodios donde veremos tanto a Sae como a Koki intentar relacionarse y tratarse como actuales compañeros de clase. Ahora, aquí pasamos a lo que NO me gustó de este anime o más bien me llegó a estresar un poco en su momento. Para empezar, está la actitud pasiva y negativa de Sae quien constantemente la vemos intentar “no pensar” en Koki todo el tiempo y así vivir una vida escolar tranquila, pero termina pensando en cada segundo que lo ha visto cada día y siempre menciona todo lo que admira y le fascina de él y tal. En fin, que está perdidamente enamorada de Koki, ya eso está bien claro. Lo que me molesta es lo torpe y completamente despistada que es Sae cada vez que está con Koki.

> I say this because, every time they’re together, we can clearly see and hear how he’s constantly trying to rekindle the friendship they had as kids. And not only that, but we also see him trying to show off or prove just how much he’s changed and grown (something she noticed before anyone else, but whatever). On top of that, our great Koki throws his hints—which are so, so obvious—at Sae over and over again that it’s absurd to see how she sometimes ignores him and even misinterprets him. This misinterpretation, on one hand, is understandable since he also messed it up when he told her he’s in love with someone else when it’s CLEARLY our protagonist he’s in love with. I mean, it’s absurd—pretty absurd—the level of innocence, clumsiness, and everything else you could say about this pair of characters, really. But hey, maybe a lot of girls like this kind of teenage romance story where every misunderstanding turns into a huge drama, they get depressed, cry, and blah, blah, blah. I can honestly tolerate this, but only to a certain extent.

>
Esto lo digo porque, en cada momento en el que están juntos, podemos ver y escuchar perfectamente cómo él constantemente intenta recuperar la antigua relación de amistad que tenían cuando niños. Y no solo eso, sino que también lo vemos intentar lucirse o demostrar lo mucho que ha cambiado y que ha crecido (cosa que ella lo ha notado antes que todo el mundo, pero bueno). Sumado a esto, nuestro gran Koki lanza una y otra vez sus indirectas tan, pero tan directas a Sae que es absurdo ver cómo ella a veces lo ignora y hasta lo malinterpreta incluso. Esta malinterpretación, por un lado, es comprensible ya que él también la arruinó al momento de decirle que está enamorado de alguien cuando CLARAMENTE de quien está enamorado es de nuestra protagonista. Es que es absurdo, bastante absurdo el nivel de inocencia, torpeza y todo lo que se pueda decir de este par de personajes, de verdad. Pero bueno, tal vez a muchas chicas les guste este tipo de historias románticas de adolescentes donde por cada malentendido hacen todo un drama, se deprimen, lloran y bla, bla, bla. Yo sinceramente puedo llegar a soportar esto, pero hasta cierto punto.

> But then again, maybe those details are also part of the series’ own brand of humor, which is much more innocent and lighthearted than usual. I’m not complaining about this, to be honest, but I also don’t expect much from a generic RomCom aimed at a female audience (Shoujo). I won’t deny that I was expecting something a bit more edgy in terms of humor—anything that would liven up its innocent and melodramatic plot a little more—but oh well. I’ll say it again: I have nothing against the story, the characters (except for the protagonist), or the clichés themselves. I just have my own opinions, tastes, and levels of patience for certain things, pacing, levels of innocence, and other details in a work and its characters. For example, the supporting characters in this particular anime don’t stand out at all; they just fulfill their respective roles as characters predefined by categories or titles already familiar in this franchise and even more so in the RomCom genre. What I think stood out the most was the relationship Sue forms with another classmate named Yota Ayukawa. There’s also a sort of misunderstanding with him, a supposed love triangle—you know, the usual stuff.

>
Pero bueno, tal vez y esos detalles también sean parte del humor que posee la misma serie, la cual es mucho más inocente y ligera de lo normal. No me quejo de esto, la verdad, pero tampoco es que espere tanto de un RomCom genérico hecho para un público femenino (Shoujo). No voy a negar que esperaba algo más fuerte en cuanto a humor se refiere, cualquier cosa que sirviera para animar un poco más su inocente y melodramática trama, pero bueno. Repito, no tengo nada en contra de la historia, los personajes (exceptuando la protagonista) y los clichés como tal. Solo tengo mis opiniones, gustos y niveles de paciencia para ciertas cosas, ritmos y niveles de inocencia y otros detalles en una obra y sus personajes. Por ejemplo, los personajes secundarios de este anime en particular no destacan para nada, solo cumplen con sus respectivos roles que son personajes predefinidos por categorías o títulos ya conocidos en esta franquicia y más en el género del RomCom. Lo que creo que llegó a destacar más fue la relación que forman Sue con otro compañero de clase llamado Yota Ayukawa. Con este hay una especie de malentendido también, supuesto triángulo amoroso, ya saben, lo típico.

> One other thing I didn’t quite like about this anime was its audiovisual presentation, to wrap things up. More specifically, its animation and fluidity, which are quite lacking, although it does at least maintain good character design, along with a few other details. But when it comes to fast-paced, fluid scenes, what this anime delivers falls far short. Well, maybe I’m exaggerating a bit because I have somewhat high expectations for what I hope to see visually, given all the anime I’ve watched in recent years, but anyway. What I do want to complain about is the constant use of typical, basic lighting and glow effects that you usually see in any production. I get that they use this a lot as a visual device to fit the story—what the protagonist feels all the time about Koki and all that. If we add basic motion effects to that, then you’ll understand what I mean by somewhat disappointing animation, especially since it was made by Studio Kai (the same studio that animated Sentenced to Be a Hero). Anyway, I’ll leave this RomCom anime here for anyone who wants to watch it.
Personally, I give it a rating of 8/10 as far as the romance and comedy genre is concerned.

>
Otra cosa que tampoco me terminó de gustar del todo de este anime fue su aspecto audiovisual, para finalizar. Más que nada su animación y fluidez, la cual escasea bastante, aunque mantienen al menos un buen diseño de personajes, entre uno que otro detalles. Pero al momento de ver escenas movidas y con más fluidez, lo que nos muestra este anime se queda muy corto. Bueno, tal vez y esté exagerando un poco debido a que tengo unas expectativas un tanto altas de lo que espero ver audiovisualmente debido a todo lo que he visto de animes en estos últimos años, pero bueno. De lo que sí me quiero quejar es del constante uso de efectos de luces y brillos típicos y básicos que normalmente uno ve en cualquier edición. Entiendo que utilicen mucho esto como un recurso visual que vaya con la historia, lo que llega a sentir la protagonista todo el tiempo por Koki y todo eso. Si con eso le sumamos los efectos de movimiento básicos, entonces ya entenderán a qué me refiero con una animación un tanto decepcionante, sobre todo cuando veo que lo hizo Studio Kai (el mismo que animó Sentenced to Be a Hero). En fin, les dejo este anime RomCom para el que quiera lo vea.
Personalmente, le doy una calificación de 8/10 en lo que respecta al género de romance y comedia.

>
Tell me, have you seen this anime yet? What did you think of it? Feel free to leave your thoughts in the comments.

>

body.title: Time Bandit: Fast and skillful warriors | Splinterlands
body.body:
> Hello everyone, I hope you are all well. Today I am going to share with you my personal experience and analysis of **Time Bandit** a popular and effective card in the Splinterlands game. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZ5vDmXibDFgPEJhTGkvpqaj7stx6jjgSANCWPMG5MXYn/image.png) This card is mainly known as a fast and aggressive unit of Water Splinter. The biggest feature of this card is its speed, which makes it very important in the game. Many times it is seen that due to its fast attack, it can hit before the opponent, which gives a big advantage at the beginning of the match. Also, its attack power is relatively good, so it is able to deal damage quickly. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXMh3Ft4rYbZx6obvguMHgBfjBUBA9rBs46D9ZinX5cdP/image.png) One of the good aspects of this card is its speed and dodge ability. Many times the opponent's attack is missed, which gives you a strategic advantage. Also, it is more effective when used in the midline or backline position because then it can attack continuously from a safe position. This card is very useful for those who like fast and smart gameplay. However, this card also has some weaknesses that are important to keep in mind. body.title: Come On Up To The House
body.body: /> Moseyed down to Nepton, Kentucky yesterday for Loving Farm's Earth Day festivities.
/> This year made the third year in a row that Marietta and Perriee have thrown a shindig for this rock we live on.
/> The scene of the crime was once again the tobacco barn turn Nepton Warehouse, with music and vendors selling vegan food, beer, coffee, and handmade pottery.
/> This time around there was some new things as well, a soundbath and a bug walk, but my misplaced sense of timing got us there too late to catch much of it.

/> Made it to the farm just in time to catch the second band setting up to play. Originally billed as the duo Twig & Leaf, they'd picked up a third member and I believe we playing as the All Rounders.

/> If the musicians look a bit familiar, it's highly likely you've seen them before. They've performed at the first two Earth Day fiestas as the group _Highly Likely_ but were a few members shy of the full band.
/> They were jamming good, so much so even the neighbors across the creek were enjoying it.
/> The art making, sign painting station was back again and as big a hit as ever. Some of the signs from the previous year's fun were visible out in the fields.
/> The gathering was as much about community and bringing people together as it was Mother Nature, but they're different sides of the same coin.
/> Nepton isn't a big place but the community still turned out to support their neighbors, which is music to my ears.
/> About time to sing out and head on up to the house for the evening. _Have to start making plans for next years festivities..._

body.body:
> **
INGLÉS
** Greetings friends of the @holos-lotus community, it's a pleasure to share my contribution to the topic of our friend @emiliorios. I wish you an excellent week and start to the month. We are about to begin the fifth month of the year and one of the most beautiful, since it is in this month that we celebrate Mother's Day, that special being whom God created to guide, protect and above all fill children with love and affection. Personally, I believe that honoring our mothers is more than a holiday; it is an action we should take every day because they selflessly and lovingly give their best to care for their children and ensure their well-being. When we talk about respect, it's within the home that a child's values are formed, values that will later shape them into adults and citizens who act based on those values. During various errands I've run downtown, I've had to go to the shopping center on several occasions, and I've sadly witnessed how many young people disrespect their parents. One scene that moved me deeply, prompted reflection, and caused me sadness and pain, was seeing a mother being humiliated by her own son because she couldn't afford the phone or iPhone he wanted. The young man, approximately 16 years old, was speaking to his mother with no respect or consideration. This incident drew a crowd of people to the shopping center, some whispering their opinions, until a man stepped forward and confronted the young man. He told him firmly that if he saw him treating his mother like that, he would arrest him. The young man's reaction was to remain calm, even to the point of tears.

body.title: Es ist nicht alles nur Scheiße, die man fressen muss. Meine Zahlungen fuer das Gefaehrderding mit meiner \
wurden von Nuernberg gestundet.
body.body: Fuer vier Monate. \n\nDann muss ich den Rest dieser \

abzahlen, fuer die ich mich nicht verteidigen durfte. Weil ja Fristen, ueber allem stehen, und Gerechtigkeit, nicht so Wichtig ist, wie es den Anschein macht.

Man hat Recht, wenn man jemanden beschuldigt, und der sich nicht wehrt! 

Jaja.

Das mit dem angeblichen Schwarzfahren hier in Berlin, wo ich bestohlen wurde gemeinschaftlich in der Gruppe von den Kontrolleuren, interessiert auch keinen.

Ja das wird es noch, und andere Sachen auch.

Morgen Abend, geht es hier auf dem Hive RUND, wenn sich die Offiziellen nicht bewegt haben. 

Das wird SEHR Interessant, selbst fuer den größten Hasser, oder Ueberschaetzer meiner Person, was ich da gefunden habe, auf Kosten meiner Glaubwuerdigkeit zu glauben, das ich einfach so stehen lassen koennte, ohne Verbesserungen zu sehen.

Ich steh auf sowas, das kann, ich, wenn schon sonst nicht viel mehr.

Chancen zur Verbesserung, habe ich dann genug gegeben. Jetzt mach ich mal Fristen und Druck. :-)

Hier die Tante, habe ich Angezeigt, wegen Betrug. 3600 Euro, willst Du nicht einfach ungestraft von mir Fordern, fuer das, das ich dir hinterherlaufe.

Zumindest nicht mehr laenger.

Die sagen ich soll mich wehren, die Schlaumeier. Ja, macht mal bitte woanders, ihr geht mir auf den Sack, mit eurer Anmaßung.

Ich schreib hier mein Leben rein, und sonst weis man nichts ueber mich.

So sieht das aus.

Als wuerde ich jemandem sowas Schreiben! Sollte man mal drueber nachdenken, was man denkt das man ist im Leben, anderen zu sagen, wie es doch Besser fuer sie waehre.

Das machste nicht mit mir im Zwiegespraech, da waehre die Demut naemlich was, das selbst den Größen trifft.

Die Demutskrankheit, auch so ein Ding, ist kein Scheiß, das Funktioniert, mein ganzer Koerper baut sich um durch die veraenderte Kopfhaltung, statt nach oben wie ein Hund zu glotzen, eben auf die Dinge im Zweifel Runterzuschauen, am besten natuerlich, hoechst optimal, kerzengerade in der Waage mit der Mama Erde auf Einstich.

Ja, die koennen netmal Diagnostizieren die Menschen und wollen einem was vom Tag erzaehlen, zumindest von dem Tag des anderem.

Ich erzaehle meine Tage, das muss reichen. :-)

Ich wuensche allen, die auch Scheiße fressen, das sie es sich immer noch Schmecken lassen koennen. Der Trost ist, nichts waehrt ewig.

Nichtmal das.

Wir sind schon im Krieg, die Dummen wollen noch mehr davon. So schaut es aus.

Derweile weiter waehlen gehen und auf die Gewaehlten schimpfen, ist die Device.

Faule Saecke ueberall. Renitente. 

Ja ich mach Beine, lass mal hupfen, fress und beiß mich durch mit dem Rest den ich habe. 

Weil meinen Kopf, muss man mir schon von den Schultern nehmen (koennen) um mich noch aufzuhalten.

Ich werde nicht aufgeben, dafuer habe ich viel zu sehr im Blick, was noch sein koennte. 

Aber so manch einer, der sich dann gewuenscht hat, das ich mich wehre, wird dannach denken, das es vielleicht doch keine gute Idee gewesen ist, weil es dann auch irgendwann, diesen Trifft.

Das kommt dann nicht vom Himmel, sondern von der Erde, das Gute.

Salve

meine Kinners. :-)

Ich bin uebrigens Stocknuechtern... Fuer die Drogenfreunde.

Sascha

### Potential in You
There are times when we begin to doubt ourself. Whether I'm capable to do something, and I'm losing trust towards myself. I even hesitate if my skills are enough to succeed. I hear words saying \

, but they don't seem to affect me. I'm overpowered by negativity. Why not focus on people who believes on our capabilities? They see things in us that we do not see. Be thankful you have those people who see the potential in you. We often see people who tries to bring down others driven by jealousy. With people motivating you to keep going, and believes on your skills means they're such gifts.

### Monday
It's a hot Monday, that I'm having a hard time dealing with the temperature. Still, I have a lot of things to do like the laundry, cleaning up as our dog has been creating a lot of mess. 

### Sunday Golden Hour
We actually intended to wait for the sundown. We already did it before when a friend left our congregation. Another is also leaving so we also went to the beach as we waited for the golden hour. It was Sunday at that time after our meeting in sign language.

title.title: The Cat Bag
title.body: The whole thing started when I saw a tote bag on Vinted. It was a simple bag, with a cat design on it, made of denim, or at least at that time I thought it was made of denim. Although I'm not a cat fan, the design looked really interesting, so I bookmarked it, just in case. Shortly I got notified that the tote bag got sold. Not a tragedy, as I didn't want to buy it anyway. ![The Cat Bag.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/48KcWM51hJ2cdRYe9uqfN8VNbjZMK7bj6zbxayMPVAsRd2oPWozC7RbKnetFXXdTa4.jpg) The a bit later I saw another one got listed, with the exact same design. This made me suspicious, so I had a better look to see what I'm missing. It was a white fabric with a cat on it, the cat being made of off cut denim pieces and what seemed strange was that the second bag had the exact same fabric pieces. I've been working with denim for years and trust me, there's no way on Earth, to create two identical pieces using used denim, so I messaged the seller for more details. Turned out it was a 2D print, which explains why the seller has so many of these identical bags. Regardless, maybe even better I'd say, as I saw an opportunity right away and here it is. Today I'm going to show you the real version of the design. You can see the original, or where I got the idea from, [here](https://www.vinted.ro/items/8690246954-torba-na-ramie-w-stylu-kot-z-dzinsowym-patchworkiem). I hope it doesn't get sold and taken down till I publish my post. ![20260425_124154a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgRrGu9ZpLpDbTCvXz2121CyEbnQ6iYL44ZMuEJSyFv2Cug2dxDnNVAJu5sRvVT6cct.JPG) Meet the cat bag. I call it the Gimli bag, but it has less importance now. ![20260330_185537a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tHBwpkL7QNnvWPbqQzoL1Y3faRMPJo73GQ1cSJjxkWD8BwCY1EvDWaAcDw3F1AMgbik.JPG) It took me a week of thinking, before I started working on it. I needed to figure out what and how as this is not exactly easy. First I had to draw a cat, to fir the size of the bag and. As you know, I have no talent and my biggest fear was that my so called cat would look like a dog or a horse. This is what I managed to draw. Before I used it, made sure to ask a few people's opinion, to see if it looks like a cat indeed and got the go ahead. Today I see I need to make some changes, but I think the outcome is acceptable. ![20260423_193145a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Eonk5uZtwRw5uTBVpLSqA7ebhaJXMGqnCN1Qn8kMP3fg99SnJPjogCn6XcN4E9LY3QX.JPG) The next step was to create a cardboard template, so I can have some guidance, where to place the pieces. ![20260423_200155a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tmN6TRqx6SMw4bWfXddXjRhMbQqYsGEdKMFptioWJF1asuQ78aDp5ndjJVHM6Qhe8na.JPG) Next step was to cut a 40cm x 40cm piece and apply interfacing, to make it keep its shape at the end. This step is very important for me as without it, the bag looks like a rag. ![20260423_200628a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23zbUBywqKiCeSdcQHQBQq2Cc5QKccAK6qJNvKQV1QvzZKRs5gzGurhdiGb93Bu7k2FDX.JPG) ![20260424_102940a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tSUhQCDH2BdUt9RPw1LEiuqaBMQnT1wv8z3YnkZRWCNsUuKjzSBvMi8JT3voNrweo43.JPG) So I draw the cat on the denim and started building the cat. This was the hardest part and today I would do it differently as I know the mistakes I made. ![20260424_110119a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/Eo8TQ2E1b6HJMbCsfHidVjutZVCP3brGcwqR2nVE1Zyfm9YeWHovvvuWJGEePUercxj.JPG) ![20260424_150855a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23tmFdzGhhS9Goxvp6PyYHPiGgZk68yVeLdjXpEPdqPrzgXvTn5cvSb8bi29jcbvhYGSe.JPG) Aaaand voilà! The cat bag, or the cat as the bag still wasn't finished at that point. ![20260424_194513a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EpnDqVG4FCNyKQYh9pC9VnTGyw7k3U9tS3trwde2FDRfTdS9CqERfeeAPftv5hXpmRE.jpg) ![20260424_200447a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xVRXu9aSpgQJLXcTMhyZ1Vfmh659Rtyp2vghhzFGhvdFmoHXcJHNg6fUXTYV4s8FnZo.JPG) For the straps, I chose to mix dark blue with light, marble like denim, because the cat had some marble fabrics too. ![20260425_115032a.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/EoK7mhhaJAdPQv9BHt6J71BqczS99JGGaUpMjs4Lx35ZMURbpa8jyLNQHawc3y5Vm7E.jpg) I made the lining a bit funny, with different type of fabrics. For me, this is normal, but let's see what others will say. ![20260425_124154a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wgRrGu9ZpLpDbTCvXz2121CyEbnQ6iYL44ZMuEJSyFv2Cug2dxDnNVAJu5sRvVT6cct.JPG) ![20260425_124202a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23wMcoBiFGY5WD6sdaHtfeYmss1kqd3JPoYtAshUGi3ybfEzfPA4AwR3wAY7PXy5EXB91.JPG) ![20260425_124251a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23xAZu43PCjyXyMZTP7SrnrbA6t4ScZwt1Yi2XFyxog8BzJ6dXL36UFaosqqfKEtwbk2V.JPG) The back is plain and simple. I didn't want to over complicate it. ![20260425_124539a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u67FruMn7xgwrLe7wtKUZo4Tp4jUqw79z2rCwRxD4JYgGdDsAen2KKofZ6oiPKuRrca.JPG) ![20260425_124605a.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/erikah/23u67PdbW3TFqUTNpUuhufxbMRw7LdWbfu13NwRetP5WPeV1f7t6sqx1Ydqe8Mr8TksZa.JPG) Here's the interior, with the two big pockets, for phone, napkins, keys and whatever you need to carry all day. The other side is simple, no pockets, because there was no matching fabric left. I need to visit the charity shop, to see if I can find good quality, cheap shirts for the rest of the bags I'm planning to create. There's more to come as I need to use off cut fabrics I have and make rook in my drawers. I have too much of these fabrics and don't want to just get rid of it.

></center>

title.title: Semarang Diary - Starbucks, Pork Noodle, Old Quarter
title.body:
![Semarang(3).png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wqkimhJBD6skN5BeAWirYpg4x5Q4QUGUEgpby4qDaRhFpqpxVvDZQQPVc9YVekFxTvb.png)
Semarang is the second city in my list to visit during last weekend. This city is known for its historical colonial buildings and European architecture. It is also home to the train museum and many iconic spots that are used for Indonesian movie sets. In the past, I already explored its old town quarter and this time, I am going further north to experience the hilly side of Semarang and visit one of the most recommended foods to have when in Semarang. To reach the city from Jakarta, you can take a train. The connectivity to this city is pretty accessible and affordable. Even from where I live now, to travel to Semarang Old Town quarter, I only need $12 round trip by the train.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23ynPwDULzpYxvxNwE9pGuZxe1jCiE9k1v2nzhFo3D8UXxATC55v41CTGb74PVZB8QNur.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 10.41.42 AM.jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wgL5gNvkBzYA1vD5zif3aHHGDpR6X6SRkrdaF6odaE1aewsiHmowwXyBmooMmGRd8jw.jpeg)
The first place I visited was this Starbucks compound located in northern Semarang. One of its charms is that you can see the whole city from the hills. Unlike lower semarang, this upper part of Semarang is a lot colder. According to my friend who lives here, none from this city feels special. But actually for someone like me, who rarely visits the city, I am so compelled to check out all the areas around it, especially the cafes in this city. At first, I thought semarang was relatively small but turns out it is a big city with many things to offer, even bigger than Jogjakarta.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xVErX9YpuxqdRWMJJxswC6V4cZeTzUCKEmvdV18LsbnBFEKwyqqc2WKngY368hdu5cR.jpeg)
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23wgDBB4aaDJdFY3EBFGgxJ9fitw39VoEKtqAEvTw1EQFjtr8LTGQxkWHkqBJShpHHfsd.jpeg)
The first stop of my day was at Starbucks. Those above are the views from it and other than the one in the old quarter, this one is a one-of-a-kind establishment with a view.
![Nasi Campur Kencana](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23ynZ7mGdWSWcLH98KkMUmpiBZ27hAENvENyKrtCispgboKtL1E4hGWX76mrV95Nozq7u.jpeg)
Since it was already lunch time, I also visited Nasi Campur Kencana, this one is pork rice and they serve delicious noodles and nasi Campur that you have to try. Since I was in the mood for noodles, I ordered more noodles than rice. But I would really recommend their rice selections. After having my lunch, it was time for me to go back to my office branch. So, I was taking the train that connects Semarang-Madiun and then taking the airport train.
![](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23yJA1Z99YHo7z5ntcVcDyqcKfxPybgPwmkfjKuikPYj4CqnVN4HhU6mgNwLzAcnx8MeX.jpeg)
![WhatsApp Image 2026-04-27 at 10.41.50 AM (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23xe9ebPgazbmf5swVs7RRgG7zKPoh1nHrpxixC6KahEd6C3x1coDmKbMuUBEnxjZLxKT.jpeg)
For me, it was such a long trip even though it started on Friday and ends on a Monday afternoon. I would be having such frequent travels again and sometimes I feel like it gets old. But hey, I just have to appreciate it for now. At the end of the day, the exhaustion is worth it.
||| |-|- ![NTy4GV6ooFRmaCXZ8UYgPhoud1kjiNX8QokLEZtbBKLuLWQ9yt7K3o4PG7qiS2SfyUvr6dYces7DWJ8xfHhq8PVtQPrvofyP72KL3ppdRxeugWvBfxeBRgtHv4FSStZc4YZ6Tzt1Pm995NNPZRyGjU7WNd7xvdEv2qtUNXuG.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/macchiata/23t77FQVTCGtEBi1QzCfnjLFZ3BpB57ocvnKWNZbybVoNT2WGNztX9UKrTyCVdjXyPVch.jpg)|

title.title: Opening 12 Fundation Packs, 1 Gold and 3 Archons - Splinterlands
title.body:
>

Greetings, legendary #Splinterlands community. Today I'm back again to share with you a new opening of Foundation card packs, and something totally amazing happened: I got cards that I've never gotten together before, at least not in that quantity and type.

> Saludos, legendaria comunidad de #Splinterlands. Hoy estoy de nuevo por aquí para compartir con ustedes una nueva apertura de paquetes de cartas de fundación y ocurrió algo totalmente sorprendente, me salieron cartas que nunca antes me habían salido juntas, al menos no en cantidad y tipo.


![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23swXQgUNzHCUaoqVQ7xJsMWUUjSApjCzgkGyzcvzGpiGuHbnAkuDqsEX2ynRZHMhcLPS.png)


<center>![Black Widow_lv1_gold.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23zRvhjEwnDsWpD1g9v2n6A3LY8JPTzMTWHog1FpQjXSytnPgp6HgBkup46VVXzeRGpek.png)</center>

---

<div class=\

>


But before I tell you about those mysterious cards, I must confess that the most unexpected of all was this gold one, since I was waiting for it to level up with the others I had. I finally managed it, and now it has the power to poison, which gives me an advantage in my battles.

> Pero antes de hablarles de aquellas cartas misteriosas, debo confesar que la más inesperada de todas fue esta de oro, ya que la estaba esperando para subirla de nivel con las otras que tenía. Finalmente lo logré y ahora tiene el poder de envenenar, lo que me da ventaja en mis batallas.



|![Thalgrimore_lv1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/242DBz77XewbrGQw1JeQfr2xaRVd9XvneSmqjUzx9eekLytVRxo88Ct6Zx4EGeFPDkQk7.png)|![Marlai Singariel_lv1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23z71EYHbb9vGo5qdaDeSjRrRhPYUPK6Do3hny6Dyq5LrYH3fVBy7Xk3hUTja3sbJNP1t.png)|
|-|-|


---

<div class=\

>


Now, the mysterious cards I'm talking about are the three types of Archons. I usually only get one Archons, either fire, water, earth, life, or death, but this time I got four, which was fantastic.

Among them, I got two death Archons: Thalgrimore and the water siren Marlai Singariel. I feel like I can never have enough of these Archons cards, so the more I have, the better.


> Ahora sí, las cartas misteriosas de las que les hablo son los arcontes de tres tipos, normalmente me sale un solo arconte, ya sea de fuego, de agua, de tierra, de vida o de muerte, pero en esta ocasión me salieron cuatro arcontes, lo que me resultó genial.
>
> Entre ellas obtuve dos arcontes de muerte, ese llamado Thalgrimore, mientras que también obtuve a la sirena de agua llamada Marlai Singariel. De estos arcontes siento que nunca tengo suficientes cartas, así que mientras más tenga, mejor.



---


<div class=\

>


The fourth Archon I drew was the light Archon called Incessant Sage, a cute little owl that's very useful in my games. Finally, I drew an epic card which, while not the most interesting of all, stands out more than the rare ones simply because it's epic.

> El cuarto arconte que me salió fue el de luz llamado Incessant Sage, este tierno buhito que me es de mucha utilidad en mis partidas. Por último, me salió una carta épica que, aunque no es la más interesante de todas, por ser épica ya resalta más que las raras.


---


https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nXDuIDL1FGw

<div class=\

> Here's the video. I got a total of 60 cards: 1 gold, 43 common, 1 epic, and 15 rare. To wrap things up, as usual, I'll give you a detailed list of all the cards I got so you can enjoy my collection as much as I do. Now, let me know in the comments how many Archons you've gotten when opening multiple packs. Have you had the same experience as I? >Aquí les comparto el video. Fueron un total de 60 cartas, de las cuales 1 fue de oro, 43 comunes, 1 épica y 15 raras. Ya para terminar y como es costumbre les dejaré a detalle todas las cartas que obtuve y así puedan disfrutar de mi colección como yo también lo hago. ¿Ahora déjenme saber en los comentarios cuántos arcontes les han salido a ustedes cuando abren varios paquetes de cartas? ¿Les ha pasado lo mismo que a mí? |![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tvVynpmxg7xBveAVw9E9bYvGHHMu3dH23aodNrenTA7g3zpemdnLkPQGzTf6AZQcWH6.png)| |-| |![3.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tm93JPw9uH7Wdv5eoHwuoHTdJCDRm5QqVKXGdtZE6D21NMqoVsvCqazKQjXNJtKZD8q.png)| |![4.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tm7GBJFBPbS4ZvrSJ3w1efJH2UtzCim4Ujyc7Q7bN9hCZ9ox1hLb1NkwbwotPTGL2kg.png)| |![5.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/23tSKXn7XW37pZ15Hud5PmTwU7A5ufQTTgTAqRdrEZsafNa7zKr7pntHekMGGfohLUF6r.png)| Before I go, I'll leave you with the estimated market price of the cards so you can do your own calculations. Thanks for watching until the end. I hope you enjoyed the video and the cards I shared. Until next time! > Antes de irme, les dejaré el precio estimado de las cartas en el mercado para que ustedes mismos saquen sus cuentas. Gracias por llegar al final, espero que disfruten del video y las cartas que les compartí, hasta una próxima publicación.
![6.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/takeru255/EoGqgxJ4JxYtUCwwwiCkEKHq8NueJP5F64aacmv8wUHAFayT6gTncjgyuoCCgp7Q1MN.png)
