title.title: Mi visita al Bulevar Gualberto Ibarreto, sector el Peñón, Cumaná [Esp-Eng]
title.body:
> **
ESPAÑOL
** Bendiciones abundantes y eternas para todos los miembros de esta comunidad @worldmappin. Encantado en saludarles y desearles una feliz y Bendecida semana, deseo que la bendición de Dios abunde en sus vidas y tengan un excelente día. Hoy les comparto mi aventura por el bulevar Gualberto Ibarreto, el cual se encuentra ubicado en la avenida Carúpano, carretera nacional Cumaná - Carupano, en el sector El peñon, este bulevar rinde homenaje al músico, cantante y compositor Gualberto Ibarreto, nacido en el pilar estado Sucre. Como dato curioso, este bulevar se construyó el año 2020 y el 10 de diciembre del año pasado fue reinaugurado y se le cambió el nombre de *Paseo de la cultura Gualberto Ibarreto* por bulevard Gualberto Ibarreto; en la entrada por el retorno, se encuentra la escultura del artista en una base circular, su atuendo es, pantalón gris, alpargatas, franela de rayas sombrero y su instrumento musical el cuatro, la base se ubica en un círculo con varios colores, alrededor hay diferentes plantas y las luces LED en triángulos de color negro, las plantas tienen flores amarillas, rosadas, morada color naranja, luego de la escultura se ubica una caminería y varios postes decorados con claves musicales y símbolos, seguidamente una caminería que se dirige a la escultura del cuatro, por los costados tiene varias plantas y gramas, también varios colores y al frente de la escultura se ubican los bancos de color verde en forma de flor, la escultura del cuatro, tiene una base circular y parecen pasteles decorados con círculos azules, el Cuatro, es de color marrón claro y oscuro, al igual que la escultura anterior tiene luces LED en el círculo más pequeño.

> **
ENGLISH
** Abundant and eternal blessings to all members of this @worldmappin community. It's a pleasure to greet you and wish you a happy and blessed week. I pray that God's blessings abound in your lives and that you have an excellent day. Today I'm sharing my adventure along the Gualberto Ibarreto Boulevard, located on Carúpano Avenue, the Cumaná-Carúpano National Highway, in the El Peñón sector. This boulevard pays homage to the musician, singer, and composer Gualberto Ibarreto, born in El Pilar, Sucre State. As a fun fact, this boulevard was built in 2020 and reopened on December 10th of last year, when its name was changed from *Paseo de la Cultura Gualberto Ibarreto* to Gualberto Ibarreto Boulevard. At the entrance by the return lane, there is a sculpture of the artist on a circular base. He is depicted wearing gray pants, espadrilles, a striped flannel shirt, and a hat, and holding his musical instrument, the cuatro. The base is set within a circle of various colors, surrounded by different plants and black LED lights in triangles. The plants have yellow, pink, purple, and orange flowers. Beyond the sculpture, there is a walkway and several posts decorated with musical clefs and symbols. A path leads to the cuatro sculpture, flanked by various plants and grasses in various colors. In front of the sculpture are green, flower-shaped benches. The cuatro sculpture has a circular base and resembles cakes decorated with blue circles. The cuatro itself is light and dark brown, and like the previous sculpture, it has LED lights in the smaller circle. ![G (23).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/242hUShX1U3LmUJ69StDTxS2HTTHdLzSysPkMY2jPcA8rVPNvkmDSCe1Vr5yxKWeN9i7e.jpeg) ![G (22).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpGQdD3jt1RofrzEa8kz6tQ2w31hg79mECrR5dESam1ULcCM12VLhSzTmc7XTKPjm2V.jpeg) ![G (24).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/2458DumrSe4fdNoPZiaeHJMUTuRRCMdpNuG49MT3z6EKqW6BjuFN6p8zz7ruVHhkxrSy8.jpeg) ![G (25).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpC9NbjSwS8Yjuis2xQJrzkmrt5PBB8ro9dfQcYRNhs7U3gvjESdEfMdSH7mkNExRM6.jpeg) ![G (21).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EnoMAFPXBLAsWhbAnqsSgYN63X9ARNx3ijkg2bXUshaYcGeUQQuzqiLZ68XceGKysrP.jpeg) ![G (19).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/243q8cQdEj9Us1KuDy6spR3x9UgSDXBiSr15ENLE1dJVAorwx4pJgMmXgRMJwc5TXS7PA.jpeg) ![G (18).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Ep7thmKFYsXzyaeK5rLeaPSqyU4eKzYeDY3paoxGEt7wzdFnUL4bEgv2oYQV8SbX4Gv.jpeg) ![G (17).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpxqkzZbr1PvfSfUK9fZKy8b5gLGJMjpo9uQ2Rfo9B2EKUNoThntdWUeajPE8FNbgqx.jpeg) ![separador virgilio 1.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48fPJW5oSR5NrT5insR3hayLh9ET1ifvCG8zGp4Rfk8EhMtUrcwakXhr5g3cRk6Y8x.gif)

> Siguiendo el camino, un colorido sendero conduce a la escultura central de este bulevar, que representa a un cantante sentado en una hamaca. La hamaca está flanqueada por barandillas y decorada con notas musicales, el escudo de armas del estado y diversas plantas ornamentales. Detrás, la escultura muestra un mapa del estado de Sucre, sobre una base ovalada de tres niveles. La hamaca luce los colores de la bandera, con ocho estrellas en el centro. El nombre del bulevar está inscrito en letras doradas en la parte frontal, rodeado de barandillas y decoraciones con símbolos musicales. La siguiente vista revela un detalle de la base de esta llamativa escultura: el suelo azul y las barandillas negras con decoraciones relacionadas con la música. Esta escultura destaca por sus vibrantes colores, dando la impresión de estar suspendida en el aire. Me gustó esta escultura por su espectacular diseño y su forma realista. La hamaca parece estar sujeta con cables, pero... Observen con atención y presten atención a cada detalle; no es así. Es simplemente una ilusión óptica que queremos ver a primera vista. Está hecha de hormigón, igual que las esculturas de este bulevar.

> Following the path, a colorful walkway leads to the central sculpture of this boulevard, which depicts a singer seated in a hammock. The hammock is flanked by railings and decorated with musical notes, the state's coat of arms, and various ornamental plants. Behind it, the sculpture displays a map of Sucre state, resting on a three-tiered oval base. The hammock features the colors of the flag, with eight stars in the center. The boulevard's name is inscribed in gold letters on the front, surrounded by railings and decorations with musical symbols. The next view reveals a detailed view of the base of this striking sculpture: the blue floor and black railings with music-related decorations. This sculpture stands out for its vibrant colors, giving the impression of being suspended in the air. I liked this sculpture because of its spectacular design and realistic form. The hammock appears to be attached to cables and wires, but if... Look closely and pay attention to every detail; it's not like that. It's just an optical illusion that we want to see at first glance. It's made of concrete, just like the sculptures on this boulevard. ![G (16).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23xKt8w9QuLrtFh51pi5i9ktWnB1QNZkWA8WJs213Ru4N629RDdisLQyvUVAaNMaTG7Lg.jpeg) ![G (14).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpzwmVj5H69gjq3XZZmMJ4jxAV9mhMBHWax2iGZZRMubKX2EXqvPzAPN5BG2BV8VfM6.jpeg) ![G (15).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23uFVvpt5vVdL5MNdUHpgZyDYxFXBwsGo1kcY4dxhHjxwNPEBbnwDCzRoHWACATJTPG82.jpeg) ![G (9).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EprTcToh66ukWhqhwShvX3DSvABp6AEyEFB3NY4cWWjHJYhx4YU3otbTWtMFSRvNeiC.jpeg) ![G (11).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq369u8S9CUt1hTN7RnYasm19yoaonUoULLbeWH9txajU8sSuADYQeUoawb8iua5cL9.jpeg) ![G (12).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Eq9UnxXDfwhgUrsZ9Q2Kmq76FW995XgXxLE3EkmT5y8yqss6VsGsZg7CxN8cEorTxbf.jpeg)

> Al final, tras un colorido paseo bordeado de plantas, bancos y un elemento muy importante —papeleras—, se encuentra un cuadro del sombrero por el que este artista es conocido. Esta escultura, siguiendo el mismo estilo que las anteriores, también se asienta sobre una base circular con forma de pastel. Junto a ella está el quiosco. Este quiosco azul claro está rodeado de césped y plantas ornamentales. Allí se venden dulces, aperitivos y helados a quienes visitan este hermoso bulevar. Las luces LED le dan un toque vibrante al bulevar, iluminando las esculturas y otorgándole un estilo único. Este espacio, además de honrar al renombrado cantante, sirve como punto de encuentro para familias, amigos y amantes de la cultura que vienen a disfrutar de sus espacios y admirar las maravillosas esculturas. Fue una experiencia encantadora visitar este bulevar y ver sus esculturas, especialmente la de la hamaca. Gracias por acompañarme en esta aventura.

> At the end, after another colorful walkway lined with plants, benches, and a very important element—trash cans—stands a painting of the hat this artist is known for. This sculpture, following the same style as the previous ones, is also placed on a circular, cake-shaped base. Next to it is the kiosk. This light blue kiosk is surrounded by grass and ornamental plants. Sweets, snacks, and ice cream are sold there to those who visit this beautiful boulevard. The LED lights add a vibrant touch to the boulevard, illuminating the sculptures and giving it a unique style. This space, in addition to honoring the renowned singer, serves as a meeting point for family, friends, and culture lovers who come to enjoy its spaces and admire the wonderful sculptures. It was a lovely experience visiting this boulevard and seeing its sculptures, especially the one in the hammock. Thank you for joining me on this adventure. ![G (1).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EnYQyjGVvK2i2n9rEcXgWKz4E7bEuu5QbD2p7z2HCpvah1oXEekjEmZBFsuPLR8ZHuk.jpeg) ![G (2).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EnYQs54SW8Bh5B118KugttyZoHNUMfGEgjRkpkaTP6RMHqNaHS4wkd8yrXkwCBXCqJ6.jpeg) ![G (3).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/244e6HYFxYBfQT2d2WFiQbuehgorjcD4hBw7QAQGiE2Ffeg2dQH4LMeHUn22RrbwKjLB2.jpeg) ![G (4).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EpNnQKqWYRQjGvWKTjFQctpUiox1ZYQioRE4wPGAg4y5R9Nwh6eWQWwQrBLhyjyA6iB.jpeg) ![G (5).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/244xuPw8FPrphyZfAkFryLPZC6qkEtMHQUwv7kszT38K8TZMGVdbia7jBDSnBqqxk62wm.jpeg) ![G (6).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/Epzy8LypLBjR79JAyhAVbp96vzCcZ2Ac5ZA2Rus4LPtWBgjg7MjDQ4xUC3LvNHogKkz.jpeg) ![G (7).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/EnWGzMddQvCjw8oNrpNNQY3zw3VJWPP5z1W3jQRQ2NAJuoreT9TcQDsMLfssMZSXmHd.jpeg) ![G (10).jpeg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/23zGYXLS53zmktrDhZeGyxDDCsTzueMEbKsGvK11EJuy7A62YYLs1nU3tM3L9D1dSjX6w.jpeg) ![separador virgilio.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/virgilio07/48KdAZ2oktyDRja9ez5m3v1qBY6PZfFU8sSGEE17ey9FUfktwmCJiLv2c2YiZggq73.png)

title.title: Nizhny Novgorod spring panorama
title.body:
What a beautiful view opens from these old walls. The spring sun floods everything around, and even the bricks seem warmer. Below, the city sprawls, so lively and noisy, with roofs gleaming in the sun. I especially like these bright green roofs; they add a special freshness to the city. Somewhere there, in the distance, a wide river flows, carrying its waters to the horizon. The bridge across it seems so fragile against the backdrop of the endless sky. You stand here and feel how history intertwines with the present. It's simply incredible how much these walls have seen over the long years.

https://i.ibb.co/QFCM1f1w/IMG-20230422-130213.jpg

I love photography. I spend time in nature, walking around the city. And I often take pictures when I see something interesting.

I always edit my pictures (mostly using Lightroom) and love sharing them with the community.

And here you can see some of my works, that you can find in my blog

title.body:
<center>![image](https://pixabay.com/get/ge08b3674ff67cc2823ef058329325cc74133f029fd58d60dbc2685c7f7de15957aa79379203cf8d8c6d0d477e894a0348bf464d7b1ed113fc0056cbf3679bfdc_640.jpg)</center>

***

当然可以！以下是一个关于自然的博客主题建议，使用Markdown格式编写。

```markdown
# 探索四季的魅力

自然界的四季变化为我们提供了无尽的灵感和美丽的景象。每个季节都有其独特的风貌和氛围，值得我们去细细品味和探索。

## 春天：生命的复苏

春天是万物复苏的季节，花朵竞相开放，树木抽出新芽。温暖的阳光和细雨滋润着大地，带来了生机与希望。

- **主要特征**：
  - 花朵绽放：樱花、郁金香等
  - 动物活动：鸟类归来，昆虫复苏
  - 自然声音：鸟鸣、溪水潺潺

## 夏天：热情与活力

夏天是充满活力和热情的季节。阳光明媚，绿树成荫，人们纷纷走出家门，享受大自然的馈赠。

- **主要特征**：
  - 高温天气：适合户外活动
  - 丰富的果实：西瓜、桃子等应季水果
  - 夜晚的萤火虫：点亮夏夜的梦幻

## 秋天：丰收与沉思

秋天是丰收的季节，树叶变色，空气中弥漫着果实的香气。这个季节让人感受到成熟与思考的力量。

- **主要特征**：
  - 五彩斑斓的树叶：红、黄、橙交织
  - 农田的丰收：稻谷、苹果等
  - 清凉的气候：适合郊游与思考

## 冬天：宁静与思考

冬天是一个宁静的季节，白雪覆盖大地，万物沉寂。这个时候，我们可以在温暖的室内享受家人的陪伴，思考过去与未来。

- **主要特征**：
  - 寒冷的天气：雪花飘落，冰封河流
  - 节日的气氛：圣诞节、春节的庆祝
  - 冬季运动：滑雪、冰上运动

## 结语

四季的变化让我们感受到自然的奇妙与生命的轮回。无论是春天的生机，夏天的热情，秋天的丰收，还是冬天的宁静，每个季节都有其独特的魅力，值得我们去探索和珍惜。
```

title.title: BTC Is Holding $79K -- and DeFi Infrastructure Tokens Are Finally Moving
title.body:
> *Originally published: [BTC Is Holding $79K -- and DeFi Infrastructure Tokens Are Finally Moving](https://peakd.com/@bitmoving/btc-is-holding-79k--and-defi-infrastructure-tokens-are-finally-moving-20260427t014821z)*

---

# BTC Is Holding $79K — and DeFi Infrastructure Tokens Are Finally Moving

BTC dominance is at 58.2%. That's not an altcoin season number. But a specific cluster of tokens is moving anyway.

---

## What's Actually Happening

The market is up broadly today — total crypto market cap at $2.72 trillion, up 1.95% in 24 hours. BTC is at $79,100. ETH at $2,387. Nothing dramatic on the surface.

Dig into the mid-cap DeFi layer and the picture changes.

**LDO (Lido DAO): +23.9% in 24 hours.** Vol/MCap ratio at 0.656x — meaning more than half the token's entire market cap traded hands today. AERO (Aerodrome Finance): +10% on the day, +25% over 7 days. RUNE (THORChain): +8.3% today, +25.6% over the week. INJ (Injective): +6.7% today, +17% over 7 days. PENDLE: +6.7%.

These aren't random pumps. They share a common characteristic: all are DeFi infrastructure tokens, all are still 80–98% below their all-time highs, and all are directly tied to the Ethereum or cross-chain DeFi ecosystem.

## The ETH/BTC Signal Nobody Is Watching

The ETH/BTC ratio sits at **0.03019** — one of the lowest readings in years.

This matters because of what it implies directionally. When ETH underperforms BTC this severely over an extended period, one of two things eventually happens: either the thesis on ETH degrades permanently, or mean reversion begins. The market is currently pricing in the former. The LDO move suggests some participants are betting on the latter.

Lido controls approximately 30% of all staked ETH — roughly 9.7 million ETH locked in its protocol. When ETH staking becomes more attractive (either through price appreciation or relative yield comparison), Lido's revenue base expands proportionally. At $0.456, LDO is 94% below its $7.30 ATH. The token is pricing in a structurally weakened ETH narrative. A single week of ETH outperformance changes that math significantly.

The EF just unstaked 17,000 ETH worth $48.9 million this week — technically a sell signal, though the pattern with EF disposals has historically been absorbed by the market faster than expected.

## This Is Not Altcoin Season

BTC dominance at 58.2% is the clearest number here. In the 2020-2021 cycle, altcoin seasons typically began when BTC dominance fell below 45-48%. We're 10+ percentage points away from that threshold.

What's happening instead is **selective DeFi rotation** — capital moving specifically into beaten-down DeFi infrastructure tokens while BTC continues to consolidate at higher levels. This is different from broad altcoin participation. DOGE is up 2%. ADA is up 2.3%. SUI is up 2.3%. These are not altcoin season numbers.

The tokens moving hardest are the ones with a specific narrative link to ETH recovery: liquid staking (LDO), DEX infrastructure on ETH L2s (AERO, PENDLE), and cross-chain liquidity (RUNE). If you remove that thematic cluster, the rest of the altcoin market is essentially flat.

## The Broader Context

BTC ETF inflows have now been positive for 9 consecutive days. This matters because sustained institutional demand for BTC tends to create a pressure valve effect — eventually, some of that capital looks for yield or leverage exposure in adjacent assets.

The altcoin market is sitting on a significant compression. Most tokens in the top 100 are still 80-95% below their cycle highs. The gap between BTC performance and altcoin performance since 2022 is historically wide. That gap either closes through altcoin recovery or through BTC continuing to dominate — but it rarely stays this wide indefinitely.

Hyperliquid (HYPE) is the outlier worth noting: $10.2 billion market cap, only 28% below its ATH. In a market where everything else collapsed 80-95%, HYPE held value. That's structural differentiation — an on-chain exchange with real revenue and genuine product-market fit.

## What to Watch

- **ETH/BTC ratio at 0.030**: If this breaks back above 0.035, DeFi staking tokens will move faster than ETH itself. Watch this ratio, not ETH price in isolation.
- **BTC dominance threshold**: Broad altcoin participation historically begins below 48-50%. Current 58.2% is still deep in BTC-dominant territory.
- **LDO vol/mcap sustainability**: Today's 0.656x ratio is unsustainable for more than a few sessions. If volume normalizes above 0.1x over the next week, genuine re-accumulation may be underway.
- **ETF inflow streak**: 9 consecutive positive days for BTC ETFs. A break in that streak would likely pull capital back toward BTC and away from the early-stage DeFi rotation.
- **AERO and Pendle TVL**: Genuine DeFi token rerating shows up in protocol TVL first. If Aerodrome's TVL grows alongside the price, the move is real. If TVL stays flat, it's positioning without conviction.

title.title: ORCA Is Up 98% in 24 Hours — And Korea's Exchange Data Explains Most of It
title.body:
> *Originally published at: [ORCA Is Up 98% in 24 Hours — And Korea's Exchange Data Explains Most of It](https://peakd.com/@bitmoving/orca-is-up-98-in-24-hours--and-koreas-exchange-data-explains-most-of-it-20260426t052848z)*

---

# ORCA Is Up 98% in 24 Hours — And Korea's Exchange Data Explains Most of It

Something specific happened to ORCA overnight. The Orca DEX governance token — Solana's most user-friendly AMM, backed by Coinbase Ventures and DeFiance Capital — went from $0.93 to $1.87 in under 24 hours. That's a 97.7% move on a token that had been trading sideways for weeks.

Before you assume this is a protocol breakthrough, look at where the volume is coming from.

---

## The Numbers Are Strange

ORCA's market cap sits at $114 million. Its 24-hour trading volume: $521 million. That's a 4.57x ratio — volume more than quadrupling the entire market cap in a single day. This kind of number doesn't happen when users are discovering a project. It happens when a specific market structure is at work.

The 7-day price chart tells a cleaner story: $0.88 on April 20, sideways consolidation through April 25, then a sharp vertical move starting this morning. Not a gradual rerating. A sudden, concentrated surge.

## Korea Is the Mechanical Driver

Break down the exchange data and the picture sharpens fast.

Upbit — South Korea's dominant retail exchange — accounts for $126.3 million in ORCA volume, roughly **24% of all global ORCA trading today**. For context, Binance generated $32.8 million. Coinbase added $14.2 million. Upbit alone outpaced the next three largest venues combined.

The pricing divergence confirms it. Upbit is quoting ORCA at 2,769 KRW. At current USD/KRW rates (~1,380), that translates to $2.01 — a **9.3% kimchi premium** over Binance's $1.84 price. Korean retail is paying more, buying faster, and moving a market that the rest of the world hasn't fully priced yet.

This is a recognizable pattern. Low-float Solana ecosystem tokens with strong narrative hooks — DEX infrastructure, Coinbase backing, genuine protocol utility — periodically get discovered by Korean retail traders, who rotate hard into them through Upbit's KRW pairs. The reflexive dynamic: Korean buyers push price up, global arbitrageurs try to close the premium, and volume spirals.

## What the Protocol Data Doesn't Show

Here's the uncomfortable part for anyone building a fundamental thesis around this move.

Orca's TVL on DeFi Llama has been **flat for two weeks**: $258M on April 20, $260M on April 25, $253M today. No spike in liquidity provision. No surge in new pools. No governance proposal gaining traction. The on-chain activity that would signal genuine protocol adoption hasn't moved.

This matters because ORCA the token and Orca the protocol are behaving independently right now. The DEX is doing $253 million in TVL — healthy, stable, unremarkable. The token is doing something else entirely.

That gap is worth holding onto. A token trading at 4.57x its market cap in daily volume, with a 9% premium on a single exchange, is not being revalued by LPs or DeFi strategists. It's being traded by momentum participants.

## The Broader Solana Context

There's a legitimate tailwind underneath all of this, even if it doesn't fully explain today's move.

Solana has been recovering consistently since the FTX-era collapse gutted the ecosystem. SOL has rebuilt developer activity, DeFi TVL, and narrative credibility. Orca specifically reclaimed its position as the primary concentrated liquidity venue on Solana — its Whirlpools (CLMM) product competes directly with Uniswap v3 mechanics. Jupiter, Solana's dominant DEX aggregator, routes a significant portion of its volume through Orca pools.

So the underlying asset — a real protocol with real usage — is not empty. But \

are two different claims.

## What to Watch

- **Kimchi premium normalization**: If the Upbit/Binance spread compresses to below 3% in the next 48 hours, the Korean-driven bid is exhausting itself. Watch the KRW pair on Upbit directly.
- **TVL response**: Genuine protocol rerating would show up as increased LP positions and new pool creation on Orca. If TVL is still flat at $253M by April 28, this move was purely secondary-market activity.
- **SOL price correlation**: If SOL corrects, Solana ecosystem tokens tend to fall harder. ORCA's beta to SOL during drawdowns historically runs 1.5–2x.
- **Volume decay rate**: 24h volume at 4.57x market cap is unsustainable. When daily volume drops below 0.5x market cap, the momentum phase is over.
- **ATH distance**: ORCA hit $20.33 in October 2021. Today's $1.87 is still 91% below that. Any narrative building around \

will run into significant overhead supply.

title.title: A Day in the Life of My Husband: A Farmer and with a Green Thumb
title.body:
![1000197703.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/Eos2CyURcRubF7SbmUHbsisbyzPKgs815CZW2gJRU6QAVRM8PrpbiimbqGnCAmLFYvy.png)

Hello my fellow gardeners and hivers! 
Living in the province and being surrounded by nature has made me appreciate the beauty of gardening and farming even more. Every day, I witness the hard work of my husband, a man who has a green thumb and a deep love for the land. For him, growing plants and crops is not just work it is a passion that has been part of his life since childhood.



![1000197476.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245HoT7CmpujqfMDvpLRC2aJhqqdRSbd4S79Pn74VXUoFW4wkr7jeRvhSRw6Ax43XY3JC.jpg)

My husband always believes that land should never stay empty for too long. After every harvest, he immediately starts planting again. He says there is no time to waste because in farming and gardening, timing is very important. If one crop does not grow well, there is still a chance to recover in the next planting season. And if the harvest is good, he still keeps going because plants need constant care and life must continue. He is so hardworking and consistent. 


![1000190266.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23z7LMAPUM5u9RxTrx2agWhRqPE6ah7LX97mdC2tS1hiNhS1tDwRibYdE3uiiAeMKVzjV.jpg)


Since he was young, he already followed his father to the farm. He learned early how to plant, prepare the soil, and care for crops. While others were playing, he was already learning about seeds, seasons, and hard work. That is why until now, growing food and working with the land comes naturally to him.


![1000190246.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/245HkmNRVEur71gmsh49dKQwyU7ULvY7QCyGXtCpxH1GKgW4JLwZW7SoFuBHzyMRyDpAs.jpg)


![1000190253.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xVH5mRYEPgfMBr3wfNsT1xSSiqnQKc63DA2LTK7mhGvB1LeYNSxzAaXew4zwyMXdnJ5.jpg)


Our rice field is just in front of our farmhouse, so every morning around 4:00 AM, he is already awake. He starts the tractor and prepares the soil for rice planting while the air is still cool and fresh. Sometimes he works alone if he knows he can manage it. While he is outside, I prepare his breakfast, water, and the things he needs for the day.

After preparing the field, planting begins. Then once the seedlings are growing, the next tasks follow. He sprays the crops himself and checks if the plants are healthy. He also applies fertilizer after a few weeks to help them grow stronger. He always wants to make sure every plant receives proper care.


![1000194437.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/242rpnZgDcTEPc2Eg2zckcMTJWF23CpPLNA4GRNvJco92Urv8FfbVBoBUUx4hBJucA8J9.jpg)


![1000194436.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23wqkafJnxvHj2TbuUfDscjdxtnvhWJmAbMpvyJ7eqqjsEPDDo9AgK5HFzJSqQtBrs99N.jpg)


![1000194432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23xApbiSCD22EQv6HiDn5XRqC23wX31QsJomcw4CxK5tjNsXJoRVeC7hKsGNZFP5Sc3uS.jpg)

Aside from rice farming, I also learned from him that gardening and farming need patience. Seeds do not grow overnight. Plants need water, sunlight, good soil, and attention. Some days are successful, and some days are challenging because of weather or pests. But still, he never gives up.

I am truly proud of my husband because even though he finished college, he still chose the simple and honest life of farming. He followed what he loves most working with nature and growing food for our family. Other people look down him because for them a farm is not a profession. 



![1000195155.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/dreamrona/23uaKQMQ7Um3JGdPWr2DLbuhmjL2QFopkdzUKzWxP1aco4JryEfVqAMErKEvBrmoer2XE.jpg)

Through my experience, I learned that people with a green thumb do not only grow plants they also grow discipline, patience, and hope every single day.



Thank you for reading my gardening and farming story. This is my owned picture and edited in Canva. Have a nice day!

title.title: Oatmeal tequeños (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Today’s breakfast will be some delicious tequeños, but made with oat flour mixed with self-rising wheat flour. This variation is not only delicious but also very nutritious. Oats have become one of my favorite ingredients in the kitchen. These tequeños turned out quite soft, fluffy, and with an extraordinary flavor, plus they had the added bonus of melted cheese inside.
![1000111874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242NmUYabE5k4hYBSAQf3mJSk89FiTS1KFV2moJNfrp82UQSQQ3o6TstySnXCBFMmeF4y.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 100 grams of oat flour - 50 grams of self-rising wheat flour - 50 grams of hard cheese for grating - Salt to taste - Oil - 1/2 cup of water
![1000111863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2ep6wLS1ggP7mydN2L9YvARD5v95yRonoGGkELMKxcDH3h2FBN8jH4BjDPyAJogY5V.jpg)
## Preparation: I poured the water and a pinch of salt into a bowl and gradually added the oat flour. I kneaded it thoroughly and added the wheat flour; when the dough stopped sticking to my fingers, I knew it was ready.
![1000111869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehfxLFU87bwYJymMQgf5hRVY74ebWdv5v9Ly4YvHgYc2FY1P6oa5sJF73QkWHfdbXH.jpg)
![1000111866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xp6QZwUNLUkAsWX9hS4GfPPwRMAyofYepey1FSbTGomHb6xbpFxg5oVefpKxVaCpS3J.jpg)
Then I cut the cheese into thick, long sticks. It was time to roll out the dough with a rolling pin and cut strips to wrap around the cheese. The idea was to cover each stick completely.
![1000111872.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tvgWy6UEttgJbb5zdK32VBCqsAL8t6eZxzUbLBtiNdFjSnM591XPhrdXhvE6ZspyEc2.jpg)
I heated a skillet with enough oil to fry the tequeños. I cooked them over medium heat for about eight minutes, keeping an eye on them to make sure they turned out golden brown—I love them crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. In total, I enjoyed eight delicious tequeños, which I washed down with a latte. Every now and then, I treat myself to something like this to make my taste buds happy. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> El desayuno de hoy serán unos deliciosos tequeños, pero de harina de avena mezclados con harina de trigo leudante, esta variante además de ser deliciosa es muy nutritiva. La avena se ha convertido en uno de mis ingredientes favoritos en la cocina. Estos tequeños quedaron bastante suaves, esponjosos y con un sabor extraordinario, además tenían el plus del queso derretido en su interior.
![1000111874.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/242NmUYabE5k4hYBSAQf3mJSk89FiTS1KFV2moJNfrp82UQSQQ3o6TstySnXCBFMmeF4y.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 100 gramos de harina de avena - 50 gramos de harina de trigo leudante - 50 gramos de queso duro para rallar - Sal al gusto - Aceite - 1/2 taza de agua
![1000111863.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23w2ep6wLS1ggP7mydN2L9YvARD5v95yRonoGGkELMKxcDH3h2FBN8jH4BjDPyAJogY5V.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué el agua, una pizca de sal y poco a poco agregué la harina de avena. Amasé muy bien y añadí la harina de trigo, la masa se despegó de los dedos, allí supe que estaba lista.
![1000111869.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xehfxLFU87bwYJymMQgf5hRVY74ebWdv5v9Ly4YvHgYc2FY1P6oa5sJF73QkWHfdbXH.jpg)
![1000111866.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23xp6QZwUNLUkAsWX9hS4GfPPwRMAyofYepey1FSbTGomHb6xbpFxg5oVefpKxVaCpS3J.jpg)
Luego piqué el queso en palitos gruesos y largos. Llegó el momento de aplanar con el rodillo y sacar tiras para enrollar. La idea era cubrir cada palito.
![1000111872.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/yesenia.romero/23tvgWy6UEttgJbb5zdK32VBCqsAL8t6eZxzUbLBtiNdFjSnM591XPhrdXhvE6ZspyEc2.jpg)
Coloqué un sartén con suficiente aceite para freír los tequeños. Los cociné a temperatura media por unos ocho minutos, supervisé para que quedaran bien doraditos, me encantan crujientes por fuera y esponjosos por dentro. En total pude disfrutar de ocho tequeños deliciosos, los cuales acompañé con un café con leche. A veces me doy estos gustos para que mi paladar sea feliz.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

title.title: A Fun Day with My Daughter while she's  Learning Some Simple Tasks at home
title.body: Hello @motherhood community..\nOne of the best feeling as a mother is to see your child growing and most of all learning while staying at home..\n
> TodayI felt so much happy seeing my daughter learning some simple tasks at home like cleaning the floor..

> My daughter find it interesting to help on me while she saw me mopping the floor..I didn't know she's just observing me and after some time of cleaning,she asked me to do it with herself,grabbed the floor mop and continued what I'd started..

> Seeing her happy doing it made me also felt joy..I didn't expect that at her age of 4 she's already becoming a responsible kid.. So what I did was guide her all throughout the cleaning process..I taught her how to use the mop properly..
> So instructed her to place the mop on its holder and spin it to remove the excess water on it before using it onto the floor..

> And then I found out that she's also eager to listen to my instructions.. So I'm happy that she's slowly learning how to mop the floor.. Everyday,early in the morning I always clean up the house before cooking some meals..and it's good that I have a buddy now who knew how to clean up the house..

> And then she repeatedly doing it without my guidance anymore.. Little by little giving her this kind of responsibility at home made them feel they're cared and given importance.I like teaching her more practical skills at home now that she's very keen and interested learning it by doing..

>
After the small tasks I gave to her, I praised her for such kindness to help me doing the routine at home.
Though it's a small tasks but I know that soon this will become her stepping stone towards being responsible and independent..

And now that she's eager to learn, everyday I wanted her to learn something new.A simple and a small tasks that something can helped her not to feel motivated doing tasks at home.As a mother it's best to let our child experienced some practical ways,age appropriate everyday tasks just turned it to be fun and more engaging and let's be a good role model to them because children always imitates how also responsible  we are in handling the simple task at home...

This would be all for now for my happy journey about motherhood..See you until next time 😍

title.body:
[![](https://images.hive.blog/DQmPzFkG1j64VKsUsBBXFRSqGCQpMG6Hvok4DHmbbvoneZB/9b25063ffcc9d78778c1e56ba5a52f6e)](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/c4a139a5)

▶️ [Watch on 3Speak](https://3speak.tv/watch?v=gamingnature/c4a139a5)


---

Let me start by saying that it's raining here, so I'm sorry for the noise outside.But hopefully the sound was bearable and the game was safe.After recording the game, I checked and saw that the sound wasn't too loud because I was able to reduce it.

Right now I am sitting in my room with my laptop because I am doing some work for my office.However I have paused my work due to the rain.After a long hot summer, today it rained here as a relief, so I am enjoying the rain after a long time.

We lost power here due to the rain, so I turned on the smartphone data again and expressed my desire to play a game.

In any natural disaster, such as heat or storms, our electricity goes out to avoid any major accidents.So right now I have some idle time in the room so I'm trying to play a game.But It was a chess game.Today after a week, I played an chess game against a tough opponent.

Ok now let's talk about playing chess. Today, after a week, I played a chess game on the Lichess tournament website.

There are many ways to play chess on the Lichess tournament website and it is one of the best chess sites.Earlier I won against the computer here but today I played against a tough opponent.Today I played against computer Stockfish Level 7 opponent and I failed to play competitively.

I'm surprised by his game.I lost two matches in a row to him.After playing two matches today, I felt like I haven't learned anything yet and there are many famous chess players in this world.But I want to learn more in the future.I recorded videos of my two matches and shared them here.

You can also analyze my matches here.

title.title: Gualberto Ibarreto Boulevard (Eng/Esp)
title.body:
> Today I went to Gualberto Ibarreto Boulevard, a place that pays tribute to a renowned Venezuelan singer from Sucre State who was very popular in past decades. His unmistakable voice, characteristic hat, espadrilles, and cuatro in hand became a regional symbol; here, there is a replica of the singer-songwriter as he has been remembered by posterity, as well as another image of him sitting in a large hammock.
![1000109633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eorzuj7p8D1irxeEvXheSaXAA8VcxsrQPpa6GPr27d6aDtBR21jTWwTppDyWQPsizjg.jpg)
![1000109601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqHxt7swWFwHrj8NbuJiDMKScQgeMWPuYR9zionrBDy6Ld2reizQfKtU2aXEFr6XsaH.jpg)
This boulevard is located at the entrance to the The Peñon community. It is quite wide and very colorful. We also find various green spaces and well-maintained gardens with striking flowers. In the center stands a giant hat that serves as a stage, where various public events have been held. In front of it are some bleachers, accessed by a staircase. The view from above is fantastic; you can see the entire perimeter, and the atmosphere is very colorful—a perspective that stimulates the senses.
![1000109619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23ynSjXNdVMqNJPmqeNiJmLnzBZVbYfVe9ECiCkAohKngLEqqwv1Bsoyf7bNAsMXWvPR5.jpg)
![1000109620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprSdvL8wkraG9c1GnDfzWyzi7tbqxyJz1xGC7poTe9DBMrrapbUUDz7wNCkLv6oAw4.jpg)
This space holds great significance, as it serves as a living tribute to the cultural heritage of Sucre and Venezuela. Our grandparents grew up listening to Ibarreto’s songs: “The Gorrion,” “Maria Antonia,” “The Sancocho,” “The Letter,” “The Bikina,” “Cowardly Body,” “Canchunchu Florido,” “Thief of Your Love,” and many more, in which he demonstrated great versatility, moving with masterful ease from eastern joropo, galerón, and polo margariteño to romantic ballads.
![1000109599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqSW4DBBMAneFzSBrg438RZr5EJ4zF1Q93ASnxJCteRHnaB6f9Zvb8FFTrPLQ6dPNvp.jpg)
![1000109603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245cYRRZ6nGb8GLGLSJaQZ89W4Ka3VmxZQguHLBWNJJ111FKNc3Hq4iJVHAEBeLhTDPQh.jpg)
I felt very comfortable in this place; it’s a kind of oasis because the boulevard is an island with traffic flowing on both sides, so while the world rushed by, I was here enjoying wholesome recreation, nature, and this tribute paid to a master of folklore.
![1000109537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonjVBDtQfarKZcKxaevEZnWUcqJrtGhEMoThMfvr7S7UHKNa9bXSYG2w3RQRpLroTc.jpg)
![1000109594.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23w2Hi54H9PZrrbpok9Xstp3sjxSqrzYR3TbFq2XwqoBkJ9jfzfhJqWfjiUW41RvKf4Ww.jpg)
*** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy me trasladé al bulevar Gualberto Ibarreto, lugar que rinde homenaje a un destacado cantante venezolano, oriundo del estado Sucre, que fue muy popular en décadas pasadas. Su inconfundible voz, típico sombrero, alpargatas y su cuatro en la mano se convirtió en un símbolo regional, acá se replica una imagen del cantautor tal como ha pasado a la posteridad y otra donde aparece sentado en una gran hamaca.
![1000109633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/Eorzuj7p8D1irxeEvXheSaXAA8VcxsrQPpa6GPr27d6aDtBR21jTWwTppDyWQPsizjg.jpg)
![1000109601.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqHxt7swWFwHrj8NbuJiDMKScQgeMWPuYR9zionrBDy6Ld2reizQfKtU2aXEFr6XsaH.jpg)
Este bulevar está ubicada en la entrada de la comunidad El Peñón. Es bastante amplia y muy colorida. También encontramos diversas áreas verdes, jardines bien cuidados con flores llamativas. En el centro se presenta un sombrero gigante que funciona como tarima, donde se han realizado diferentes eventos públicos. Al frente hay unas gradas, a las cuales se accede por una escalera. La vista desde las alturas es fantástica, se observa todo el perímetro, el ambiente luce muy colorido, una perspectiva que estimula los sentidos.
![1000109619.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/23ynSjXNdVMqNJPmqeNiJmLnzBZVbYfVe9ECiCkAohKngLEqqwv1Bsoyf7bNAsMXWvPR5.jpg)
![1000109620.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EprSdvL8wkraG9c1GnDfzWyzi7tbqxyJz1xGC7poTe9DBMrrapbUUDz7wNCkLv6oAw4.jpg)
Este espacio tiene un gran significado puesto que representa un homenaje en vida a un patrimonio cultural sucrense y venezolano. Nuestros abuelos crecieron escuchando los temas musicales de Ibarreto: El gorrión, María Antonia, El Sancocho, La Carta, La Bikina, Cuerpo cobarde, Canchunchú florido, Ladrón de tu amor y muchos más donde demostró una gran versatilidad porque podía pasar del joropo oriental, galerón y polo margariteño a la balada romántica con gran maestría.
![1000109599.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EqSW4DBBMAneFzSBrg438RZr5EJ4zF1Q93ASnxJCteRHnaB6f9Zvb8FFTrPLQ6dPNvp.jpg)
![1000109603.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/245cYRRZ6nGb8GLGLSJaQZ89W4Ka3VmxZQguHLBWNJJ111FKNc3Hq4iJVHAEBeLhTDPQh.jpg)
Me sentí muy bien en este lugar, es una especie de oasis porque el boulevar es una isla con tránsito fluido a ambos lados, así que mientras el mundo latía a prisa, yo estaba aquí disfrutando de sano esparcimiento, de la naturaleza y de este homenaje que se le rinde a un maestro del folklore.
![1000109537.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/saavedraa/EonjVBDtQfarKZcKxaevEZnWUcqJrtGhEMoThMfvr7S7UHKNa9bXSYG2w3RQRpLroTc.jpg)

title.title: Fried Chicken with Gochujang Sauce
title.body:
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPwNTNvEfzJGBL5NVmH5PZYoGEe1nMYUcvqNpXu2NwWeq/1777256475976.png)

Hi bloggers and food lovers! Happy Monday! What are you having for lunch today? Today I’m sharing a delicious lunch recipe that’s a little spicy with a hint of tanginess from the gochujang sauce. Today’s dish is gochujang sauce fried chicken—crispy breaded fried chicken mixed with gochujang sauce is one of the easiest recipes to make this time. Alright, let’s get started

**Ingredients:**
*Fried Chicken:*

- 250 grams chicken thigh fillet
- 1 tsp salt
- 1 tsp black pepper
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- 1 egg
- 2 tbsp cornstarch
- all-purpose flour
- cooking oil

*Gochujang sauce:*

- 2 tbsp gochujang sauce
- 1 tbsp sesame oil
- 1 tbsp soy sauce
- a pinch of sugar
- a pinch of salt
- pepper
- cornstarch slurry
- diced onion
- 50 ml water
- toasted sesame seeds

**Steps:**
*Fried Chicken:*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzLVx3F5WTE7JobkcVHEHiv7BA1XkKkmNG3je2wFLkX4/1777256520996.jpg)

- Clean the chicken and cut into small pieces 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcE5i9Cm3GjJD6xn6a4Ngct6dKjuApbNTZyV2dhD9zazn/1777256650487.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZcQFpCQki8NwA62SJHgTb97T5Nhc78dxUG3o5ePrhwAf/1777256650720.jpg)

- Place in a bowl and add salt, black pepper,  garlic powder, and maizena

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfKzt3JQPD1nq66GiZDJhvKBTSVbxeaVNzYZ3bn78geru/1777256683612.jpg)

- Crack the eggs and add to the bowl

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcCGnjKVRzzenUvm4Tz2D6jgGk3p5mPiDYgPxh81zu3EP/1777256683838.jpg)

- Stir until well combined and marinate the chicken for 1 hour

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXgfPVStL6qk6EE3fLeZSzgMhnEPUepzkhjPBCjNbM5Wi/1777256805464.jpg)

- After 1 hour, prepare the all-purpose seasoning flour

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZaVH3bXc6GCpi6QsmibHXicwYxjw2UBs6rKambSmoVSe/1777256841779.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmfDVXw9K4euFjbC8T52WeAMTpdjpiWhMjoKBd9hybDhf4/1777256841978.jpg)

- Coat the chicken with the all-purpose seasoning flour

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmcQ3ZcoFBMisum7xGUyCWX9xkCZDNeSGAy3WiJ1wbkQv5/1777256865438.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbUWoBdN85kb9REcqoijVvRWJvQwdKUkMneFArfN4rqzy/1777256865690.jpg)

- Place the floured chicken into preheated oil and cook over medium heat

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmf4GeYda2AcJdcp1RgdC1A9u8HXAQR3aBLPZBQQvxLujG/1777256886910.jpg)

- Once cooked through and golden brown, remove and drain

*Gochujang sauce:*

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZxLSVz7Xn4a35kAxdncvLtw7xRXWxjktF25gqmsbUBeT/1777256905923.jpg)

- Add the gochujang sauce to a bowl 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmemGRYBdBgMm5mWHJrr2WqzYrXRYWhzQTAkyK3DZ58Sam/1777256928095.jpg)

- Add the sesame oil, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYMXjaEh2RHXpUYNziUF9iijrS8mqxH7jYj4doo6JNZ6Z/1777256960525.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmc23m8ZUdvMkxcjgK5JZ9nkSE5ZJLK4LUtPeHxrRWjaSu/1777256960706.jpg)

- Add the cornstarch mixture and stir until well combined

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYw7W4TsaSaRbyXeZ1TBdTk3RHQsDs8vjyfMLiNPApdrK/1777256987270.jpg)

- Heat a pan and sauté the diced onions until fragrant

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQo3jFiHWTCpf5nqrsuPsaGmUUUEBpMBo5n4MTnik6eRf/1777257276000.jpg)

- Add the prepared gochujang sauce 

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmNRuBm9rx7Mz7j51ni7J9QJ83b8Qyj3fGqRQsbsWqj3NH/1777257298525.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmaTqR7Z7iCBrZrg7wySdmWCbCuKgc6X9rBn6FM3TbPNCh/1777257298694.jpg)

- Add water and stir until thickened

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTCEpK2y7oi7W15TMFzm2tGy5EAQpDLCK12sRpJzZ22Kd/1777257324853.jpg)

- Add sesame seeds and stir the sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSmYGHNuEBwX1beFoNZPicwQdPGd39tsDydYa9gAPHz8M/1777257344871.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRv2JufJbTg2mTP8ThPUFEP8N25NQepkeMqPckztgwQbg/1777257345053.jpg)

- Add the fried chicken and stir until well coated with the sauce

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXmLQgVGRqqqWvWepfCdSwWxYT4ciPBK97uzatWeYARRG/1777257370182.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdJwGAph3fuwKJPWnmrS26DvpgasN7rPL3pZ7tLbunbru/1777257370370.jpg)

- Serve on a plate

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXjZnqf9vtBxLLiCkJujt1SdyptQpkXhS1hAYrUkDsxLf/1777257398330.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmVoxx4JzNp7VmrYzpyoBBizPGZWTkoBuDG7657u16DkWB/1777257398598.jpg)

- Gochujang sauce fried chicken is ready to eat

title.title: A Beautiful Friendship and a Simple Birthday Surprise
title.body: Last week brought someone new into my life, someone I didn’t expect would leave such a warm impression on me in such a short time. Her name is Yeye, though I playfully call her Quipresh. We didn’t meet long ago, but somehow, it feels like we’ve known each other longer than we actually have.\n\n

> Yeye came into Lafia from Keffi to visit her boyfriend, who happens to be my friend too. That’s how everything connected. From the moment we met, she carried this calm, kind energy that just made it easy to talk to her. Nothing forced, nothing awkward, just simple, real conversations. You know those kinds of people that make you feel comfortable without trying too hard? That’s Yeye. One thing that stood out to me was her kindness. I still remember how she cooked rice and stew and even served me. It wasn’t something I expected at all, but it showed the kind of person she is, thoughtful and giving. In a world where people often do things expecting something in return, moments like that feel rare.

> After she left, we stayed in touch. We chat on Facebook and WhatsApp from time to time, just catching up and sharing little things about our lives. I told her about myself, and she opened up too. She loves dancing, like, really loves it, and you can tell it’s something that brings her joy. That alone says a lot about her personality, free spirited and lively. Then yesterday, something unexpected happened. I was just going about my day when I saw a Facebook notification, it was her birthday. I honestly didn’t know before then. Immediately, I went to her WhatsApp DM and asked for her pictures. No delay, no overthinking. I just felt like celebrating her in my own little way.

>
*My charting with her on Whatsapp that's the screenshot*

She sent them, and I posted her on my status. Simple gesture, but genuine. And the funny part? I think she was the first person to view it. That alone made me smile. It showed she noticed, and I could tell it meant something to her. Sometimes it’s not about big gifts or grand surprises, just being remembered is enough.

What I appreciate most is how something so small strengthened a new friendship. It reminded me that connections don’t always need years to grow, sometimes, sincerity is enough.

Happy birthday once again, Yeye, Quipresh. You may have come into my life recently, but your kindness and vibe are already unforgettable. I wish you more joy, more dancing, and more beautiful moments ahead.

Thanks for reading in my blog!!!

In the Bella Vista neighborhood of Porlamar, enjoying oysters and cocktails by the sea is a Margarita Island classic.

Chamaco Cocktails
This is one of the most iconic spots in the area. It’s located on Raúl Leoni Avenue, right in the Bella Vista Beach area.
The best part: It’s famous for its seafood cocktails (Vuelve a la Vida, Siete Potencias) served in glasses or cups with a mix of house sauces that are a tradition on the island.
Atmosphere: It’s an authentic, unpretentious spot, ideal for enjoying the sea breeze while sampling fresh seafood straight from local fishermen and oyster farmers. Chamaco also sells Madre Perlas, which is a bit meatier than an oyster and also very delicious.
Helpful tip: Next door is the restaurant El Barco, which offers a slightly more formal dining experience with seafood by the sea.

o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o

En el sector de Bella Vista en Porlamar, la experiencia de las ostras y los cócteles frente al mar es un clásico de la Isla de Margarita.

Cócteles Chamaco
Este es uno de los puntos más emblemáticos de la zona. Se encuentra ubicado en la Avenida Raúl Leoni, justo en el área de Playa Bella Vista.
Lo mejor: Es famoso por sus cócteles de mariscos (vuelve a la vida, siete potencias) servidos en vasos o copas con una mezcla de salsas de la casa que son tradición en la isla.
Ambiente: Es un sitio auténtico y sin pretensiones, ideal para disfrutar de la brisa marina mientras pruebas productos frescos directamente de los pescadores y ostreros locales. Chamaco aparte vende Madre Perlas que es un poco mas carnoso que la ostra y también es muy rica.
Dato útil: Al lado se encuentra también el restaurant El Barco, que ofrece una experiencia un poco más formal con pescados y mariscos a la orilla del mar.

title.title: Isla varadero, un paraíso en el Parque Nacional Mochima. Anzoátegui-Venezuela🇻🇪
title.body:
Holis a todos en la comunidad de Hive, especialmente a los que forman parte de la comunidad de viajeros y amantes del sol. Hoy me siento súper feliz de poder compartir con ustedes un rincón mágico del estado Anzoátegui que descubrí recientemente y que me dejó totalmente enamorada. A mis 24 años, y estando en las últimas etapas de mi carrera de medicina, a veces los días se vuelven una montaña rusa de estrés entre el hospital y la tesis, por lo que este tipo de escapadas se convierten en mi mejor medicina Holis a todos en la comunidad de Hive, especialmente a los que forman parte de la comunidad de viajeros y amantes del sol. Hoy me siento súper feliz de poder compartir con ustedes un rincón mágico del estado Anzoátegui que descubrí recientemente y que me dejó totalmente enamorada. A mis 24 años, y estando en las últimas etapas de mi carrera de medicina, a veces los días se vuelven una montaña rusa de estrés entre el hospital y la tesis, por lo que este tipo de escapadas se convierten en mi mejor medicina personal.


![IMG_5587.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmXQ2BbWHnnRDjRf7JaKrv85uoN4WhxH7EcPkMBy1mvVQQ/IMG_5587.jpeg)



El estado Anzoátegui es conocido por sus costas espectaculares, pero hay playas que simplemente te roban el aliento por su paz y belleza. Esta vez, el destino elegido fue la Isla Varadero, un lugar que está muy cerca de la conocida Isla de Plata, pero que ofrece una experiencia totalmente diferente, mucho más tranquila y serena. Llegar allí es como entrar en un oasis de calma donde el tiempo parece detenerse para que puedas disfrutar de la naturaleza en su máxima expresión.


![Facetune_19-01-2026-21-31-21.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWcTjWk4S3pr2Pr118RNNcKXwV3LvPn7EHH2ydvXZJqzY/Facetune_19-01-2026-21-31-21.jpeg)



Desde que pones un pie en la arena, te das cuenta de que Varadero es especial. El mar es de un azul turquesa impresionante y la arena es blanca y suave, lo que crea un paisaje paradisíaco. Una de las cosas que más me cautivó fue la tranquilidad de sus aguas. No hay olas fuertes, lo que la convierte en una piscina natural perfecta. Esta característica la hace ideal para ir con niños, ya que pueden jugar y nadar de forma súper segura, sin que los padres tengan que preocuparse constantemente por las corrientes.


![IMG_5579.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSYY7dDavXmh7gZh78iGvfqBjEX6PWMy22LQxiBeJL3En/IMG_5579.jpeg)



Justamente, en esta visita pudimos ver cómo los más pequeños de la familia disfrutaban muchísimo. Les comparto esta foto de mi primita con su chaleco salvavidas, con una sonrisa que lo dice todo. Estaba encantada, jugando en la orilla y flotando en el agua mansa. Ver su felicidad y su carita de diversión fue uno de los mejores momentos del día, y me confirmó que Varadero es, sin duda, un destino familiar de primera clase.


![IMG_5586.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmdxB4rh2XRzMUJkGBxJC66GPJSoU6KZvzsjsZhp9R3nKW/IMG_5586.jpeg)



El viaje hasta la isla también fue parte de la aventura. Tomamos un bote desde Isla de Plata y el trayecto fue súper ameno, con la brisa marina y el sol en la cara. Aquí les dejo una foto que me tomé con mi tía durante el paseo en el bote. Ambas estábamos emocionadas por conocer este nuevo lugar y disfrutar de un día de relax total. El paisaje durante el camino ya te va preparando para la belleza que te espera en la isla.




Una vez en la playa, me dediqué a hacer lo que más me gusta en este tipo de paseos: simplemente relajarme y absorber la energía del sol y el mar. Aproveché la calma para acostarme en la arena, como ven en esta foto, y sentir la suavidad de la textura y el calor del sol en mi piel. Esos minutos de desconexión absoluta son los que me recargan de energía para volver con todo a mis responsabilidades médicas.


![IMG_5613.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWn2Vb7L24bKVoTtzyD65SXoBFcKrjy8fEXjG8qzHcKAC/IMG_5613.jpeg)



También pasamos tiempo de calidad en familia, conversando, compartiendo comida y simplemente disfrutando de la compañía. En esta foto pueden ver a mi tía con su sombrerito y lentes de sol, compartiendo un momento con el más pequeño, quien estaba súper entretenido con sus juguetes de playa y una pelotita. Esas interacciones sencillas pero llenas de cariño son las que hacen que estos días sean inolvidables.


Me siento muy afortunada de vivir en un estado con una costa tan privilegiada. Isla Varadero me ha recordado lo importante que es explorar nuestro propio país y valorar las bellezas naturales que tenemos tan cerca. Si están buscando una playa tranquila, segura y hermosa, perfecta para ir con niños y disfrutar de un día de paz, no duden en visitar este rincón mágico de Anzoátegui. Les prometo que se irán con el corazón lleno y la mente renovada.


Muchas gracias por leerme y por acompañarme en mis historias de este último año de medicina y de mi vida personal. Me encantó poder compartir este pedacito de paraíso con ustedes. Nos vemos en el próximo post para seguir contando más aventuras por mi querido estado Anzoátegui.

title.title: Beer Saturday - Pints Across Town
title.body:
<center>
![beersaturday8 (2).png](https://images.hive.blog/DQmaSURiLT4RAUWPiz4c58Q5kbUeb9x2FbUPPmVLW7D5vwE/beersaturday8%20(2).png)
</center>

460 straight weeks of dedication to beer and hoppy hijinks is legit! New to beer or seasoned piss tank, you are always welcome to pull up a pint and join @detlev and the gang at https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-460 | hive.blog/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-460 with your post about beer.

In this 460th edition, I am enjoying pints all over town!
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center> 
<center>https://images.hive.blog/DQmPax7RZo64uXdeV5w5Nsb7uyNvDQZpbuca4r8qR15updR/potw.jpg</center> 
<center>
![IMG_8881 (1).JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmWzgspUe7mzz2raHUmHhFXaLGMFTjHhvEWJTPobGJYt23/IMG_8881%20(1).JPG)
</center> 
This week's Pint of the Week was enjoyed in one of the best pubs in town with a client we do digital advertising for.  Some people go for bullshit beer like Michelob Ultra but the rest of us opt for something with less shame and more flavour.  I opted for a[Broken Rail Tesla's Revenge IPA](https://www.brokenrail.ca/store-3-1/p/teslas-revenge-ipa) and @sequentialvibe opted for a world-famous [Guinness](https://www.guinness.com/en-ca).  Beers the company pays for are pretty damn sweet!

<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Cross Czech!
<center>![IMG_8529.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUXwmctZojkpwmQuLquj4ytKuPRM4QYBNQsyFD1pqtdBP/IMG_8529.JPG)</center> 
It is that time of year when hockey heads into the playoffs.  This means that if you thought Canadians were crazy about hockey, the playoffs is next level.  Maybe like March Madness?

Anyhow, this is a beer brewed by local favourite [Black Swan Brewing](www.blackswanbrewing.ca) for the local junior hockey team The Warriors which you can see on the crest on the can.  When the other beer is miller light and coors bullshit, I am happy to get a nice local lager with Bramling Cross and Chech Saaz hops for a light but tasty beer.


<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Carried Away
<center>
![IMG_8471.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmay9nrMUHRkPcQnVrFfjrQuaCHN3d1hyJansPq4DDXAnH/IMG_8471.JPG)
</center>
Here is another pint I enjoyed at [End Times Bar and Beer Shop](www.endtimes.beer) who apparently still haven't gotten around to finishing their website.  When Hive is $10 and I have launched my local beer tour company you can hire with $Hive, I will take you to meet this guy and enjoy his well-curated inventory of regional craft beer.
<center>
![IMG_8470.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmSd7koKdJcuSFtiL8eY5sFM9BHnWYVeDQF1Xo6bBmQYoo/IMG_8470.JPG)
</center>
In the meantime, this fantastic pint is a [Carried Away Hazy IPA](www.wishbonebrews.com/product-page/carried-away-hazy-ipa) from Wishbone Brewing Company which is about an hour and 20 minutes drive from here.  At 6.5% AVB with Galaxy and Citra hops, it comes pretty close to what we try to brew in our garage brewery.  They add Columbus hops as well which we haven't but might in the future because of how good this beer was!
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>
# Speaking of Brewing...
<center>
![IMG_8890.JPG](https://images.hive.blog/DQmUqCz1qqs8a6xw6etgz9ifHGqkTNJJF2tUbmj4PkEYzjf/IMG_8890.JPG)
</center>
...it was a great day to brew!  Sunny and 15 Celsius which felt warmer in the spring sun.  Brew master is back from vacation so we dropped a session IPA into the brewer and enjoyed the end of the weekend.
<center>
![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/zekepickleman/2466AdGtfg5Nn2foZ5ARrscGywNrmNCoURwPZQLaHdMtLutq4VPapWLx8HBmXmpCZZ22v.png)
</center>

# #BEERSaturday!

<center>
![615154466_1216502653792563_5746440785403569082_n.jpg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmfD5wBuJG4pTcQBigtUFwQJwCER9yDWnn4NPj4jWDG6Lh/615154466_1216502653792563_5746440785403569082_n.jpg)
</center> 
Can't have too many drafts!

Now it is time for you to join me, @detlev , and these other beerologists because there is always room for more beer bloggers at the Beer Saturday gathering... https://peakd.com/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-460 | hive.blog/hive-187719/@detlev/beersaturday-460  Cheers to beers and beers all over this small town!

title.title: Downvote Drama? No Thanks!
title.body:
Downvote Drama? No Thanks!

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmbpkz6sUvAmdmARwXb3Bg1GsxqQGc9PQjncPBp9fDoAUJ/img_3504.png)
Every now and again I’ll get a downvote on one of my posts. It’s usually around this time of year. My posts do not use plagiarised material, nor do I use A.I. generated content. All photos and videos are taken by myself, often of myself. I have been here since the early days of **Steem** and **Steemit** and know, not only the history, but the posting rules. I also try to follow the rules of the various communities here, so genuine downvotes are quite rare. The only genuine downvote I ever got was from when I accidentally posted something, tried to delete or edit the post to be zero content and the posted the full content later. The downvote was from a known psychopath / self-appointed Hive sheriff. He’ll downvote some just for being African and then again for pointing out his obvious racism. People like this drive new adopters away from Hive (and people wonder why the price keeps dropping!) Another was because I had joined an auto-downvoter-bot thingy. Someone had downvoted someone else with ny account’s permission. I rapidly had to apologise, upvote their content and then remove myself from auto downvotes. If I upvote or downvote anything from now on, it’s ME doing it and only after some weighing up the rammifications. As a general rule, if someone downvotes my content I will often ask why they did it. Not out of spite, but it’s so that I can learn to write better blog posts. I rarely get a response. Mostly it’s people who are new to Hive, testing the system. A quick and polite conversation can get things straightened out. One person replied once and said they downvoted me for promoting my own post (with my own Ecency points and which I have done since I had the HP to do so). The post in question was for the wider benefit of Hive users… Not long after that, that account got downvoted into obscurity and they were caught by **Hivewatchers** to be cutting and pasting content without attribution.
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPw7Sswa4E1QL9Mew4AvK9sJpk9ci7T5d8mugH4AVmmtR/b3fdc767_0257_49ae_81c7_f1ad0a40da25.png)
Your “only job”, is to not be an asshat on a community based internet platform. They later claimed that I was responsible for their mass downvoting when in reality they caused their own problems. The top picture is from an account who downvoted my previous post. So I check their account and their only post is from 2024; it’s a conspiracy where somehow they were a victim of Hivewatchers (Do you notice a pattern here?) or something about how Hive was apparently used to interfere in the 2024 US Presidential election. Or something. I only skimmed it. These people are insane! Playing the victim is narcissistic too, and they never ever have enough **Hive Power** to make a difference. How much can they really care about the Hive community if they weren’t investing in it in the first place?

Downvote Ettiquette

From a financial, numerical perspective, downvotes have the same weight as upvotes. However, there is obviously a lot more emotional weight attached to being downvoted. It doesn’t “feel” good. What makes matters worse is when the downvoter doesn’t explain why they are downvoting the content. Is it just a disagreement of someone’s opinion or are they genuinely wrong? Is it benign or pure hate? This creates confusion and resentment, which isn’t good for your online reputation / branding. People post stuff that I disagree with all of the time, but because I am often not in a position to provide a counter argument in a way that can change their opinion, I let it drop. Some people’s viewpoints are “core beliefs” and they just won’t be budged. There’s always the poossibility that I am wrong about any given subject at any given time (and to be honest, real growth comes from admitting it). I can find the i formation, but would they be willing to listen, ubderstand and let go of old ideas? That’s a big ask of anyone. There are people on this platform that I wish weren’t here, but I do not seek them out or start beefs or downvote wars, etc. I don’t need or want the drama. I don’t need to “feed the trolls” or give notoriety to bad actors. In conclusion: If you feel the need the need to downvote someone, please weigh up the consequences and where possible explain why you’re giving the downvote. It might something as benign as someone posting something in the wrong community, but the explanation goes a long way towards removing confusion and potential pushback. If you have been downvoted, ask the downvoter why they did it? I am not against downvoting; I just feel it’s being abused. Use it wisely. Thank you for reading this, have a great day!
![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmXEKGGoMDKR9vPYt5JvjYSB3TVjtLp24SNDLazzFnp4Hu/img_3500.jpg)***Shaidon***
All content, including photos and text, are produced by myself except where indicated otherwise and sources are always supplied. I do not use A.I. so your upvotes support a genuine human being producing original material.

title.title: En mi viejo escarabajo (microficción en memoria de Aquiles Nazoa)
title.body:
Son ya 50 años sin tener la voz viva del poeta [Aquiles Nazoa](https://www.revistaaltazor.cl/aquiles-nazoa/), quien murió en un accidente automovilístico el 25 de abril de 1976. A Aquiles, como siempre le decíamos, dediqué dos posts: [1](https://peakd.com/hive-179291/@josemalavem/para-creer-con-aquiles-nazoa) y [2](https://peakd.com/@josemalavem/el-delicado-lirismo-de-aquiles-nazoa). En esta oportunidad, le escribí una microficción, donde lo imagino el día de su muerte.
![Aqules Nazoa, por Xulio Formoso.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/EqLCbVmKMNhCVrqX6utip2X7BjdgJB8NLxtRpNt6KYtQk3xFu4WbCP4TrmiFaB1kzEu.png)
Aquiles Nazoa, en caricatura de Xulio Formoso - [Fuente]()

Quería ir a buscar una muñeca de trapo que le había encargado a mi amiga, la negra Berta Vargas, la hermosa artesana de Cerezal. En mi viejo escarabajo había recorrido mi país muchas veces, con las paradas obligadas en los parajes únicos, aquellos frente al mar, o los del placer de la gastronomía popular (¡Ah, las sabrosas empanadas de cazón!). El trayecto de mi vida, desde aquel oficio de carpintero o de botones del Majestic en Caracas, o la experiencia acendrada en mi barrio del Guarataro, se había hecho del gusto por lo más sencillo. No fue gratuito aquello de “Las cosas más sencillas”, programa radial o televisivo que tanto disfruté haciendo por años. En mi poesía quise ser la voz de ese sentir, con el humor tan propio del venezolano, pero también de la ironía que nutre al pensamiento, así como de la libre imaginación. Por eso aquello del caballo bien bonito que echaba rosas por el culito. Sé que Mariíta estará siempre pendiente de mi suerte, y me acompaña desde su tierno corazón. Hoy puedo estar tranquilo, y, como aquel poeta de la rosa, viviré en la belleza de las cosas.
Les dejo una grabación de \

en la voz del propio poeta. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jHX7Cb_GW70
![Separador 1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/josemalavem/23w3EVhVknDBbMMypwibXmzJuDDFomhCit6wQZYYPREzc4JdRDB8FM1sLzSWAmH4C7JwK.png)
