title.title: Dr. Sad Siem Reap: 3 Hours Inside This Wild Local Bar
title.body:
Dr. Sad Siem Reap: 3 Hours Inside This Wild Local Bar

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23zRVMv5kc5G3QvW14fFCinsvvwjmrcd9kovXaoq8T2cT2s7WN2ea89kMkM336jN1mcdc.png)

The text from my friend showed up a few weeks ago: \

My first thought was, what kind of bar names itself after sadness? Aren't places you actually want to go supposed to be Dr. Happy or Dr. Good Time? The name stuck in my head, then got pushed aside while life moved on. Last night the timing finally worked, and a famous Cambodian rapper was supposedly headlining, so we decided to roll across town and see what Dr. Sad Siem Reap was actually about.

What I found wasn't what I expected. This isn't a tourist bar, it's not on Pub Street, and it doesn't pretend to be either. It's a local Cambodian venue with neon lights, table-only seating, live singers passing a microphone around, a hype-man DJ break in the middle of the night, and English-language signage so blunt it would make your grandmother walk out. The whole place is a strange cultural mash-up that I'm still trying to make sense of. Here's the honest breakdown of what three hours at Dr. Sad Siem Reap actually looks like, what it costs, and whether it's worth your time.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/242Xu5VCuHpDriqSSe9RRBSwnfVCyAFrLv786TD8zgwxkAPR36Yf8urQtFnEakhZmBFws.jpg)

How to Find Dr. Sad Siem Reap

First thing to know: Dr. Sad isn't in the downtown tourist core. You're not stumbling into this place after a beer at Pub Street. It sits on the outskirts of the central area, far enough out that you need a scooter or a tuk-tuk to get there. The neighborhood feels distinctly local, the kind of area where the Khmer signs outnumber the English ones and the foot traffic is mostly residents, not backpackers.

We jumped on the old motor scooter and headed across town. The ride itself sets the tone, you're moving away from the curated tourist zone and toward something more authentic. By the time you spot the building, you already know this isn't going to feel like Angkor What? Bar.

You can find the exact location

>here on Google Maps. Plug it into Grab or PassApp if you're not driving yourself, and budget around 10 to 15 minutes from most central Siem Reap accommodations. Not bad, but enough that you want to commit to staying once you arrive.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23tm76rGw1vE6ed8ZWjyPBx78uBMB1jzpN3Z6yFFwUbaRp7eDS1FmMPowtKAsXyJLVUUU.jpg)

First Impressions of Dr. Sad Siem Reap

From the outside, the venue looks like a giant box wrapped in neon. A glowing sign announced \

which was my first signal that something was off about the branding. This is a local Cambodian venue, but every word of public-facing signage is in English. Not Khmer with English subtitles, not bilingual, just English.

That mismatch became a recurring theme throughout the evening. The crowd inside was almost entirely local. The music, when the live performers were on, was Cambodian. The food was Khmer. But the visual identity of the place was pulled straight from a Western nightclub aesthetic, complete with English-language slogans I'll get to in a minute.

Walking through the door, I was hit with a wash of color. Purple, red, and blue neon-style lights bouncing off every surface. No dance floor. No standing room. Just rows of tables across two tiers, each one already starting to fill up even though we'd arrived at what's basically grandparents' dinner time. (More on the timing problem in a bit.)

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23u61A5WTaw1M7DyAvEDWhoh6WBziggUonor1L6AopkE7XX2eBXe9Pup7a3wTUA6WLC11.png)

The Staff Setup at Dr. Sad

One thing that stood out immediately was the staff structure. There were three distinct uniforms working the room, and each one seemed to have a specific job.

You had the maitre d' figure who greeted you at the door and walked you to your table. Then there were staff in chef-style uniforms whose actual role wasn't cooking, they were keeping your ice topped up and taking food orders. Finally, runners in a third uniform handled the actual food and drink delivery. It's a hierarchy I've seen before at higher-end Asian venues, but it was surprising to find it at what otherwise felt like a local hangout.

We settled into a second-tier seat with a clear view of the stage. A few of the better tables were already booked, but ours was solid. Pro tip: if you're going on a night with a headliner, the booked tables tell you something. Show up earlier than you think, or call ahead.

Ordering Food and Drinks at Dr. Sad Siem Reap

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23wqcBnKjrG1jvaoJ4VVWyDeTXzsCPfwmwcDjR8KBEwHeZUzfaJJ6QErG64zTzsinWhX1.png)

One thing about ordering in Asia that always gets me: the second they hand you the menu, the server stands there and waits. Doesn't walk away, doesn't come back in two minutes, just hovers while you scroll. At Dr. Sad the menu is on a tablet, so you're swiping through pages of options with someone breathing over your shoulder. It feels like pressure, even when it's not meant that way. After enough years in Southeast Asia I've gotten used to it, but it still trips me up.

We kept it simple. Rice, vegetables, a chicken dish for my friend, and three beers between the two of us. We tried to order a different brand and were told only Tiger beer was available that night. Fine. Tiger it was.

The drinking ritual at Dr. Sad Siem Reap is one of the genuinely great parts of the experience. They give each person a small glass packed with ice and you pour the bottle back and forth, sipping cold beer in small amounts over a long stretch. This isn't a Dr. Sad invention, it's a

>classic Cambodian local-bar tradition you'll see across Khmer Pub Street and Road 60. One bottle of beer can stretch for an hour. Smart move in a hot country, and it slows the pace of the night in a way that suits the venue.

The Entertainment: Singers, DJs, and KTV Energy

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23wC7Kdm9nCsbTo4xVYGM9Z83FvKkAHyCm6ipdscVUrytQSEM9Zthntv3htNa9b213UzF.png)

The stage had four or five performers passing a microphone back and forth, backed by a drummer, a guitarist, and a piano player. Cambodian songs I didn't recognize, sung with energy but without the polish you'd hear from a touring act.

I'm going to be honest because that's what this blog is for: it sounded like karaoke. Not bad karaoke, not embarrassing karaoke, but the song selection and the vocal style had that unmistakable KTV quality. And here's the thing I didn't realize until I dug into it later: that's not an accident. KTV culture is enormous in Cambodia. Karaoke and live-singer venues are an integral part of how Cambodians go out. What I was watching wasn't a band trying to be a band, it was a live KTV performance. Once I reframed it that way, it actually made sense. They were doing exactly what the audience came to hear.

After about an hour the singers took a break and a DJ took the stage with a hype person on the microphone. They played local Cambodian hip-hop, the hype person yelling over the tracks. The microphone level on the hype mic was too low, so half of what they were saying got lost in the bass. Still, the energy shift was clear. The venue went from a relaxed dinner-and-show vibe to a club-lite atmosphere, even though nobody got up to dance.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23wMW4MCDkrmNEwQP1FybnB7HZXiCZjw6dZzUW51iody5hR2dw81NqjyfdGjjy5eWDEfc.png)

The English Signage at Dr. Sad: A Cultural Disconnect

Now we get to the part of Dr. Sad Siem Reap that I'm still chewing on. The interior decor includes a series of large English-language slogans on the walls. They're crude. Sexually explicit. The kind of phrases you'd find on a frat-house poster, not on the wall of a venue full of local Cambodian families and twenty-somethings on a date night.

I'm not going to reproduce them here. If you go, you'll see them. I was genuinely curious whether the local crowd reads them as provocative or just as decorative English shapes. I suspect the second one. Most of the customers I could see weren't reading the walls, they were watching the stage.

This is where the cultural disconnect really lands. A Cambodian venue, a Cambodian audience, Cambodian music, Khmer food, and English-language signage that would get a Western bar shut down by its landlord. Whoever designed the branding pulled aesthetics from a Western club concept without much regard for tone, context, or what those phrases actually communicate to an English-reading visitor. It's not offensive in the local context, but it's jarring if you actually speak the language.

The Cost: Was Dr. Sad Worth the Money?

The total bill came to about $24, or roughly 100,000 riel, for two people. That covered two main dishes, a side of rice, a side of vegetables, and two and a half bottles of Tiger beer. Not a bad night out by any measure.

That said, it's a notch above what you'd pay at a true neighborhood Khmer bar, where the same beers and food might run you $15 to $18. The premium covers the venue, the lights, the staff hierarchy, and the live entertainment. Compared to Pub Street prices for a sit-down dinner-and-show experience, $24 is a steal. Compared to drinking with locals at a roadside spot on Road 60, it's a small upcharge for the production value.

If you're traveling on a tight budget and just want cheap beer, this isn't your spot. If you want a sit-down evening with food, drinks, and live entertainment that feels distinctly Cambodian rather than tourist-built, the price is fair.

The Headliner Problem: Timing at Dr. Sad

Here's the thing nobody told us. The reason we'd come, the famous Cambodian rapper my friend wanted to see, wasn't going on until 11:30 PM, possibly midnight. We'd arrived at 7:30, eaten by 8:30, and by 10 PM we'd been sitting at the same table for over two hours watching the same rotation of singers and DJ sets.

By 10:30 we were done. A couple hours of live KTV-style music while sitting in one spot is its own kind of marathon, and the rapper was still ninety minutes out. We paid the bill and rolled home.

If you're going specifically to see a headlining act at Dr. Sad Siem Reap, do not show up at 7:30. Eat dinner somewhere else, then arrive around 10 PM. You'll catch the back end of the warmup acts and have energy left for the main event. This is the single piece of practical advice I wish someone had given me before we went.

Would I Go Back to Dr. Sad? Final Verdict

Yes, with a group, and with better timing.

The closest comparison I can give for a Western reader is something like a low-key Medieval Times, except Cambodian. It's a dinner-and-a-show format. You're not going to dance. You're not going to bar-hop. You sit, you eat, you drink ice-cup beer, and you watch the stage. That format works, but only if you're with people who want the same thing. Going as a couple felt thin after a couple hours. Going with a table of five or six would change the math entirely, because the conversation carries you through the slower stretches.

Solo? Skip it. There's no bar to lean against, no dance floor to get pulled into, and the table-only setup makes it awkward to be there alone.

What Dr. Sad Siem Reap does well: it gives you an authentic local night out without forcing you to navigate a language barrier. It serves food, it serves drinks, it puts on a show. The bones of the experience are solid. What it does poorly: the English-language branding undermines the local authenticity, and the headliner timing punishes anyone who didn't come specifically for the late-night act.

Planning Your Visit to Dr. Sad Siem Reap

A few practical takeaways for anyone thinking about checking this place out:

Get there by scooter, tuk-tuk, or Grab. It's not walkable from most central Siem Reap hotels and guesthouses. Budget 10 to 15 minutes of travel time and have your ride home sorted before you go in.

Time your arrival around the schedule. If a headliner is announced, show up 60 to 90 minutes before they go on. If you just want the local atmosphere with no specific act, any time after 8 PM works. Going right at opening means you'll be waiting a long time for the energy to build.

Bring a group. This is a venue that rewards conversation. Two people works for an hour and a half. Five people works for the whole night.

Budget around $12 to $15 per person for food, beer, and incidentals. Cash is easiest, though many Cambodian venues now accept ABA Pay and other QR-based payment apps.

Don't expect a dance floor. If your idea of a great night out involves moving your body, head to Pub Street's club options instead. Dr. Sad is for sitting, eating, drinking, and watching.

If you're spending time in Siem Reap and want a wider range of local experiences beyond the bar scene, my write-up of the
>Giant Puppet Parade covers one of the most genuinely Cambodian cultural events in the city. And if you want to put your tourism dollars somewhere meaningful, my piece on the

>ABCs and Rice NGO walks through how a local school is changing lives in a Siem Reap village.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/jacuzzi/23uFU7gFJZJzTErDUe88mBbR6zLdJaFdXmfPj3ZS72zny48xCc2V5omRaqb8xkXh5sdcj.png)

Final Thoughts on Dr. Sad Siem Reap

Dr. Sad Siem Reap is not a place I'd put on a top-ten list of Siem Reap nightlife, but it earned a spot on my \

list, which is a more honest endorsement. It does something most tourist venues don't: it gives you a window into how locals actually spend a Saturday night. The KTV-style live music, the ice-cup beer ritual, the table-bound setup, the Tiger-beer-only nights, all of that is genuine Cambodian going-out culture, packaged into one venue.

The English-language branding is the asterisk on the whole thing. It tries to import a Western club aesthetic into a local Cambodian space and ends up undermining what's actually special about the place. Strip out the crude wall slogans and Dr. Sad would be a much easier recommendation. As it stands, you're getting an experience that's half local-authentic and half marketing-team-misfire, served up with cold Tiger beer and a hype man you can barely hear.

Worth one trip if you're curious. Worth more than one if you bring the right people. Skip it if you're solo or if you're hoping for a dance club.

Now I want to hear from you. What's the most culturally confused bar you've ever walked into, and did the experience win you over or push you out the door? Drop it in the comments. And if you're heading to Dr. Sad Siem Reap yourself, come back and tell me whether the headliner was worth the wait, because I'm going to need somebody to sit through that 11:30 PM rapper set so I don't have to.

title.title: Chicken soup with carrots, potatoes and rice (Eng-Esp)
title.body: <center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23y8usoyRrkxumghdWJZwJAuELowpMdex6KQifbQZyk27A8E24fXvi3UkvZtuGQepCnY5.png)</center>\n\n* Good evening, dear friends! I hope you had a wonderful weekend! Today, I'm sharing a recipe for a healthy and nutritious chicken soup with carrots, potatoes, and rice. This lunch helped soothe the stomach upset I had yesterday. Whenever I make this recipe, I usually use a ton of ingredients and seasonings, but since I wanted to improve it, I simply added a few cloves of garlic to the broth to enhance the flavor \

. I then discarded them when serving. Just a few minutes after enjoying this delicious soup, I felt so much better... Join me in preparing this healthy recipe!\n\n>* Buenas noches queridos amigos, espero que hayan pasado un fin de semana genial! Hoy, les comparto la receta de una saludable y nutritiva “sopa de pollo con zanahoria, patatas y arroz”, este almuerzo fue lo me ayudó a calmar el malestar estomacal que tuve el día de ayer... Siempre que realizo esta receta suelo utilizar infinidad de ingredientes y condimentos, pero como la intención era mejorar, para realzar el sabor de manera \

solamente integré al caldo algunos dientes de ajo, que luego deseché al momento de emplatar. A los pocos minutos de haber disfrutado de esta sabrosa sopa sentí una GRAN  mejoría... Acompáñenme a preparar esta saludable receta!

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23x1Hz6Wr9pbNtCMZTa6eSaXoAS6LdGKjiVpHjZFYUhWm5a2GkUwHYqShq3gUk8wCMpTM.png)</center>

* INGREDIENTS: carrot, potatoes, rice (raw), shredded chicken, garlic cloves, chicken broth and salt to taste.

>* INGREDIENTES: zanahoria, patatas, arroz (crudo), pollo desmechado, dientes de ajo, caldo de pollo y sal al gusto.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uFj31Qz6ZVBxQ6R7EKaQGijCF6AfQkkjx1qzrVWq9212R2QJCsth2GHLzZA5KN3iQSi.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23wMiirWzEQkcJwdDE7HJ7De6SESUdAysCr4M5np7EG1WQxgncjkz1ybbJvaZXzPbGDPD.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23tmYgdguw624pQkcnJnwNxV782fgkqcdsfQMrDiH7qU8fXe2QKd7VwNugpJ67yGNyDhw.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/EoAdgRfEVWXEHYWZxm1CdXLBFj3UjP3ZN7VqsaoFWhj1em8hiYRHscDhavAZHSSZtcU.png)</center>

<center>PREPARATION/PREPARACIÓN</center>

* Add enough water to a deep pot... add the whole chicken breast, along with the crushed garlic cloves and salt to taste.
Once the chicken is cooked, shred it... Add the chicken along with the rice, cook over medium-high heat, stirring occasionally to prevent the rice from sticking to the bottom of the pot.

>* Incorporamos suficiente agua a una olla honda... agregamos la pechuga de pollo entera, junto con los dientes de ajo (triturados) y sal al gusto. 
Cuando comprobemos que el pollo está cocido, procedemos a desmechar... Agregamos el pollo junto con el arroz, cocinamos a fuego \

, mezclando de forma ocasional, para así evitar que el arroz se pegue en el fondo de la olla.

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23uQxeKjX2fsAntYSuCfi4wyb6QGY6PHaXTaRmkGxaFJ6Gh1MqyQEdLhHLSgEDGEgcQAf.png)</center>

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23vi8FpsjeSEvkW9A4DVVSEn6rMPi48xV8VtNHU7HsSNoP5DLvVzaLdmoVrtAaR4F2zWw.png)</center>

* When the rice is semi-soft, add the potatoes and carrots... grate both ingredients using the coarse side of a grater.
Cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender.

>* Cuando el arroz esté “semi-blando”, añadimos las patatas y la zanahorias. Rallamos ambos ingredientes por el lado grueso.
Cocinamos a fuego “medio”, hasta comprobar que las verduras se ablandaron. 

<center>![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/kristal24/23xL7NRUxjxvBwnjAjfmhX91NvTXFR1GuvWwPDhfJDz695QsLcFRFFSJrCnzyQNxxCsyq.png)</center>

is ready to enjoy!

title.title: Harina de plátano - Gluten free | #FoodieMood | Esp-Eng
title.body:
![1000528399.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23w2sRjjQbYE6pLvwnSgdYiqBHK9mssSVz6X4z73vyESnPADfLemUXafQaF9cLDJLoQWL.jpg)
Sigo tratando de bajar el consumo de carbohidratos complejos, de disminuir el consumo de gluten y azúcar procesada. No es fácil la tarea, pero poco a poco podré lograrlo. Había escuchado mucho sobre los beneficios de la harina de plátano y actualmente se puede ubicar en los supermercados, pero quise hacerla por mi cuenta para ver cuánta cantidad podía obtener. > I’m still trying to cut back on complex carbohydrates and reduce my intake of gluten and processed sugar. It’s not an easy task, but little by little I’ll get there. >I’d heard a lot about the benefits of plantain flour, and you can find it in supermarkets these days, but I wanted to make it myself to see how much I could get. ![1000528403.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23zS5XfjiVC8rs46oqcvKuMuy2MSSxmzAnZdqPdPhEHy8by6NyHv9SmocwyLxdKpJyhJD.jpg) Para hacerla, utilicé un plátano de 280 g al horno, obteniendo 100 gramos de harina. Así que se pierde bastante volumen, pero de igual forma obtienes esta harina completamente natural, sin aditivos químicos, que puedes utilizar para diferentes preparaciones. >To make it, I used a 280-gram baked banana, which yielded 100 grams of flour. So quite a bit of volume is lost, but you still end up with this completely natural flour, free of chemical additives, which you can use in various recipes. ![1000528499.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23u6DVXK7bDNuRwmWpAEq9LmqSDoR1NXabLddMYnkaeMgvHyvBKtrsu5tadduqtkCBZ5U.jpg) Preparar esta harina requiere de pocos pasos; el primero es pelar el plátano y cortarlo en finas rodajas, las cuales vamos a disponer en una bandeja para llevar al horno. Yo usé la bandeja de mi *freidora de aire,* pero de igual forma sirve una bandeja común. Usé la función de deshidratar de mi horno/freidora de aire y tomó dos horas a 80 grados centígrados; supongo que esta temperatura y tiempo de cocción también funcionarán para tostarlos en un horno convencional. >Making this flour involves just a few steps; the first is to peel the plantain and slice it into thin rounds, which we’ll arrange on a baking sheet. >I used the tray from my *air fryer*, but a regular baking sheet works just as well. I used the dehydrate setting on my oven/air fryer, and it took two hours at 80 degrees Celsius; I assume this temperature and cooking time will also work for toasting them in a conventional oven. ![1000528500.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23viAF735fgAF3RR8rWfqaHMhUxoiDGdcc89rSaHuH2jdxcXBisvkc1zspr4zrrtQHiXH.jpg) Les confieso que mientras iban horneándose y abría el horno para comprobar su estado, me comí algunos chips (lol). Esto es lo más difícil de la receta: no querer comerte los chips. >I have to admit that while they were baking and I opened the oven to check on them, I ate a few chips (lol). That’s the hardest part of this recipe: resisting the urge to eat the chips. ![1000528501.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xep3ZQjr3pBU589feHo9vWf2Xccfuc91VHbnXuPdT7PMqr1oAT5r6inHjvkEhx1Syoc.jpg) Una vez que estén bien tostados, los chips de plátano se llevan a un procesador o licuadora para pulverizarlos. Haciéndolo en mi licuadora, quedó perfecta, fina y no fue necesario tamizarla y volver a licuar. >Once they're nicely toasted, the plantain chips are placed in a food processor or blender to be ground into a powder. When I did this in my blender, the result was perfect—fine and smooth—and there was no need to sift it and blend it again. ![1000528502.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23xpALcj5r8Yk6sp3PrBqpu11KoTgBq94TZD1x5Peqyoqy4tcsmv9LUCktY34nsGeKBBE.jpg) Probé haciendo un par de panquecas de plátano con ella, usando la misma cantidad de harina y agua. Saben muy bien y para el desayuno son una rica opción. >I tried making a couple of banana pancakes with it, using the same amount of flour and water. They taste great and are a delicious option for breakfast. ![1000528505.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/eugelys/23z7SAE6QpHewJcrsGYjkuf5B8C6W42o59XZVMeUBbtY2evHw2oi7gmA2BPNLBFk3gjWY.jpg)
**I hope you like it!**

title.title: [ESP-ING] Visiting Expo Fitness
title.body: > Los domingos normalmente los tomo para compartir en familia, en casita o alguna salida que tengamos, sin embargo este fin de semana una amiga me había invitado hace más de 3 semanas a un compartir de bailo terapia y otras disciplinas deportivas, el evento era en Maracay en un centro comercial de la ciudad y comenzaba desde la mañana, pero íbamos a ir solo en la tarde que era la presentación de la profesora de ella de strong. Ella tenía tiempo invitándome a varias clases asi que quise asistir al evento, aunque ella no me había dicho que su profesora se iba a presentar a las 2:30pm, esta hora solo me hacia pensar que íbamos a estar llevando sol y el calor seria agobiante, pero para nuestra suerte el cielo estaba nublado y con un rico clima, pero como no todo es perfecto estabamos pendiente de que iba a llover, igual nos fuimos al evento, la entrada fue bastante accesible de 2.3$.

> Para ser sincera al llegar el día no queria ir, pero el estar allá cambio mi panorama fue una buena decisión el haber asistido, llegamos y estaban haciendo una demostración de karate y luego una clase dd bailoterapia que me encantan, me gusto porque fue dinámica, con buena música y hasta nos hicieron bailar en pareja, así que mi amiga era mi pareja bailamos bastante. Luego vino competencia de mujeres y me quedé asombrada una señora de 85 años de edad estaba entre las 4 mujeres que debían hacer sentadillas y la que agunatara más ganaba, esta señora fue la segunda en retirarse y me parece algo extremadamente fenomenal ta que la señora aguanto bastante, le hicimos una gran ovación pues a su edad no todo el mundo aguanta tanto, quisiera llegar así de bonita y sana como la señora y activa sobre todo.

> Luego la competencia de los hombres haciendo plancha, estuvo muy buena aunque pensé que durarían más pero está competencia también estuvo fuerte ya que le hicieron bajar y subir haciendo flexiones, estos en menos de 3 minutos y ya estaba listos, se les cansaron bastante los brazos; en estos espacios también habían stand con diferentes productos como zapatos, comida, accesorios, productos de belleza entre otros, no pase por ellos porque pensaba pasar luego de la clase de Strong pero la lluvia no dejó hacerlo.

>


Luego de esto comenzó la clase de zumba, aunque no era como estaba acostumbrada, lo dúo una chica de 17 años y lo hizo muy bien, y luego la clase de Strong, que para mi se parecia mucho a lo que era antes kingboxing, los instructores lo hicieron muy bien pero ya cuando faltaba un poco comenzó la lluvia y todo el mundo salió corriendo, asi termino nuestro dia de expo fitness.






<a href=\

width=472 height=49 border=0>
--- >![ENGLISH] > > I usually spend Sundays with my family, either at home or out and about, but this weekend a friend had invited me more than three weeks ago to a gathering featuring dance therapy and other sports activities. The event was in Maracay at a shopping mall in the city and started in the morning, but we were only going in the afternoon for the presentation by her Strong instructor. > >She’d been inviting me to various classes for a while, so I wanted to attend the event, even though she hadn’t told me her instructor was going to perform at 2:30 p.m. That time just made me think we’d be out in the sun and the heat would be stifling, but luckily for us, the sky was cloudy and the weather was pleasant. But since nothing is perfect, we were worried it might rain. We went to the event anyway; admission was quite affordable at $2.30. > >

> > >To be honest, when the day finally came, I didn't want to go, but being there changed my perspective—it was a good decision to attend. We arrived and they were doing a karate demonstration, followed by a dance therapy class, which I love. I liked it because it was energetic, with great music, and they even had us dance in pairs, so my friend was my partner—we danced quite a bit. > >Then came the women’s competition, and I was amazed—an 85-year-old woman was among the four women who had to do squats, and the one who lasted the longest won. This woman was the second to drop out, and I think that’s absolutely amazing—she lasted quite a while. We gave her a huge round of applause because at her age, not everyone can last that long. I’d love to be as beautiful and healthy as she is—and active, above all. > >

> > >Then there was the men’s plank competition. It was really good, though I thought they’d last longer. But this competition was also intense, since they had to do push-ups—going down and up—and they finished in less than three minutes. Their arms got pretty tired; There were also booths in these areas with different products, such as shoes, food, accessories, and beauty products, among others. I didn’t stop by them because I planned to go after the Strong class, but the rain prevented me from doing so. > >

> > >After that, the Zumba class began. Although it wasn’t what I was used to, a 17-year-old girl led it and did a great job. Then came the Strong class, which to me was very similar to what used to be called Kingboxing. The instructors did a great job, but just as we were wrapping up, it started to rain and everyone ran outside. That’s how our fitness expo day ended. > ---

Yes, if you only care about price to enter crypto you are in a rude awaken oasis. However it is always price you have to watch for other reasons. I think the analogy that should drive your impulse lately is percentage. How many do you own. How do you plan to get it?
While price plays an emotional factor, the idea to own a token should be validate how much you want it.

Most tokens are paired with $BTC. It is a blessing in disguise. It helps that token to appreciate while bitcoin creates positive echelon for the market. For the past 5 months ending in February it has been a rocky transition for crypto. Needless to say it does not deter #strategy to shy for acquiring more Bitcoin. I feel like they are on a shopping spree to reach the 7 digit.

March has been really forcing the issue. April is serious to stop the bleeding. As you can see 15% is really pleasant for this bull run. It may sustain within the month of May and carry itself all the way to July. While I am mimicking last year, I feel the market, the institutions buying #etf are doing a great job to keep crypto in a positive stance. It is an election year so anything is possible.
Clarity act could be a pion for this race to finish the year strong.

I mention price at the beginning cause it is the sole reason everyone blasts first and prevent them for truly embrace crypto. Price will become irrelevant when the asset has more power than we all know. At first it takes a while for me to comprehend the power behind bitcoin blockchain. It got interest from the US military.
It is to show bitcoin in itself possess some disruptive aspects that can change global market.

Still I do not understand the reason they are running a node. By saying it to the world, Bitcoin is here to say. The price of bitcoin will get stronger and decentralization will get a boost. The blockchain will get stronger. It is getting closer to impossible for the mass to purchase one Bitcoin. 
Glad we have more than Bitcoin to look after. It does not defer to amass some sats cause you never know when sats could be the way.

The target price we witnessed last year seems plausible to come back. Even passing it could be reachable. While this action will bring fomo, owning anything in between will gently help the whole market.  So many to mention It is okay to look at everything with an #etf tag. Cause you never know how deep is the rabbit hole.
Hope you plan ahead and position yourself to buy when the market is red and sell when it is green.

links.title: Egg soup (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> Today we’re going to make a delicious egg soup, a traditional dish from the Andes—it’s a great recipe for breakfast. It’s quite simple, so you can easily make it at home, and it doesn’t take much time at all. Enjoy this step-by-step guide.
![IMG-20260422-WA0029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23tc1RHLPkHvjvh3JxjMAaUsVNzAn9ha8nA3dAnJNBuKigqbFrrYZ93CbAZyGXUWoipZn.jpg)
## Ingredients: - 5 eggs - 1 pound of potatoes (which is thick) - 1/4 pound of yellow potatoes - 1 bunch of cilantro - 1 scallion - 4 cloves of garlic - 5 cilantro leaves - 100 grams of bowtie pasta - Salt to taste - Oil
![IMG-20260422-WA0105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xVToxManngFiZSmc4oWBTQDjsRRFnDr3z2JrFowGVAPim9PpuB1jj6FFtwMZTbBYPK1.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23z7SpGDv2FaF87SfQhgFASV2EdmGkaoG6kezKGMAvgyh5hYaA2a4fve9H23GoaNuByiA.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0046(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23w2mLSQzkGaVRmB9a3jJgNEdnawyqLGRDr4biD7orcV3KwyDa9812eFA4WxU6Yy4QaaB.jpg)
## Preparation: I washed the potatoes, peeled them, and cut them into pieces. I sliced the waxy potatoes into rounds so they wouldn’t fall apart while cooking. As for the Creole (yellow) potatoes, I cut the larger ones in half and left the others whole. I brought two liters of water to a boil with the chopped scallions and grated garlic cloves.
![IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23wCBzToj8bBMQ8S7pUv2bY7NV5dqTRkxcmya6EFAD3A1szyRr6QC6XiLFuQU6reusraN.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23uFYN6NAmu9yd73wnCwnG1YNd6zWG5EirWCXFjG9s512GmmGpWF8pYZxCczS5bRaCxQh.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xejtdXvXJunZmcWzFWdb5UuVqjrcTYLEjL6MVLxBkGDdELBosjLhcStQwpdbTvDG4nC.jpg)
When the water reached a boil, I added the waxy potatoes. I waited a few minutes and then added the Creole potatoes. Next, I added the cimarrón leaves.
![IMG-20260422-WA0082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/243qMj8qRPXzhuB7dWs7D4Q17Mgt4tPtZTab66wrxEfsWuBTYUcNZjaiUTapJfxbn7CYL.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zS7FszzgYhTxQa2wcg4oRCiqno5ETwvmVZABPBCqoSBGnnx6YRtAX2iozovWLSjW3Nc.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23ywwGKd7ERsq2KBhGTN9eDkAhupgBHT46k2agViR1VhWByP7g2hS84D8ph8LC4K9TCWB.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zGaZvaKKu2aL5JkkuntgDxmZsyceAQ13aMvh3bX33SKcQ69Lz5digJg9tUq77w41Zo9.jpg)
Then I took two eggs, separated the yolks from the whites, and beat them lightly. First I added the whites, then the yolks. Next, I added a pinch of salt (you can also add a bouillon cube) and a splash of oil.
![IMG-20260422-WA0062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/243BoAPcYLYUEQZBD3wT7Ys1ue3AnbSSUsC6ih2Pde6UtXLmW3uSesRUj2vG6FcHt2Nmn.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/242Nv5UeFZ9zo9ChmHjj3QykEDxd14j78Jzj5PPAUqJw3kyTcZYbrymRuw9nrWWKMWdM7.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/244y5pJwnAQD9yzCjSFaUkhpp1qqfu7Fic4J6dUWDxg1sCU9v2eKswxwiU2b7efDqNAs2.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xAVXXu6h4HarEa1N2afeaCZNHknUwEMSD6xyMZpDtqWFG5dmgaXWSDurjU88dxhXKyW.jpg)
When the potato was white, I added three whole eggs. Then, to improve the consistency, I added 100 grams of bow-tie pasta.
![IMG-20260422-WA0035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23vsQY7Dzshwki8SaxWpwpWEtzwia27TN4qoSEh25seiQuEQhQWmzsUCGfcjcShQfYwoQ.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23tmG2AJF2XreNNCzVKvRn3iwrmQVmAPfBrgb78bPSz4o65AYN9sQ56tRa13UCMNcnijQ.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23wr1LAi5xZCYV5FR8pXT5pPGCFhUdTonw238dn7UmV5LX8fhVDPVsmHCLgQwpnAZfKV2.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23w2sH1mDyD9tqURrapzGKk3yxHU8E3QR7cKNFZD3ePLhecwMTDGjzQ5U1iwzFCV1ETo7.jpg)
You can also add cheese, but I didn’t use any this time. Finally, I added the cilantro. I set some aside to garnish the dish at the end. And that’s how I enjoyed a delicious breakfast. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> Hoy prepararemos un delicioso caldo de huevo, una comida típica de los Andes, esta es una excelente receta para desayunar. Es bastante sencilla, así que la pueden replicar en casa, además hay que invertir muy poco tiempo. Disfruten de este paso a paso.
![IMG-20260422-WA0029.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23tc1RHLPkHvjvh3JxjMAaUsVNzAn9ha8nA3dAnJNBuKigqbFrrYZ93CbAZyGXUWoipZn.jpg)
## Ingredientes: - 5 huevos - 1 libra de papa (de la que es pastosa) - 1/4 libra de papa de la amarilla - 1 manojo de cilantro - 1 cebollín - 4 dientes de ajo - 5 hojitas de cimarrón (cilantro) - 100 gramos de pasta en forma de corbata - Sal al gusto - Aceite
![IMG-20260422-WA0105.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xVToxManngFiZSmc4oWBTQDjsRRFnDr3z2JrFowGVAPim9PpuB1jj6FFtwMZTbBYPK1.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0101.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23z7SpGDv2FaF87SfQhgFASV2EdmGkaoG6kezKGMAvgyh5hYaA2a4fve9H23GoaNuByiA.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0046(1).jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23w2mLSQzkGaVRmB9a3jJgNEdnawyqLGRDr4biD7orcV3KwyDa9812eFA4WxU6Yy4QaaB.jpg)
## Preparación: Lavé las papas, las pelé y las dividí en pedazos. La papa pastosa la corté en ruedas para que no se desmoronara en la cocción. En cuanto a las papas criollas (amarillas), las más grandes las dividí en dos y otras las eché completas. Puse a hervir dos litros de agua con el cebollín previamente picado y los dientes de ajo rallados.
![IMG-20260422-WA0099.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23wCBzToj8bBMQ8S7pUv2bY7NV5dqTRkxcmya6EFAD3A1szyRr6QC6XiLFuQU6reusraN.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0090.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23uFYN6NAmu9yd73wnCwnG1YNd6zWG5EirWCXFjG9s512GmmGpWF8pYZxCczS5bRaCxQh.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0088.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xejtdXvXJunZmcWzFWdb5UuVqjrcTYLEjL6MVLxBkGDdELBosjLhcStQwpdbTvDG4nC.jpg)
Cuando el agua alcanzó el punto de ebullición, añadí las papas pastosas. Esperé unos minutos y agregué las papas criollas. Posteriormente, agregué las hojas de cimarrón.
![IMG-20260422-WA0082.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/243qMj8qRPXzhuB7dWs7D4Q17Mgt4tPtZTab66wrxEfsWuBTYUcNZjaiUTapJfxbn7CYL.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0043.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zS7FszzgYhTxQa2wcg4oRCiqno5ETwvmVZABPBCqoSBGnnx6YRtAX2iozovWLSjW3Nc.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0070.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23ywwGKd7ERsq2KBhGTN9eDkAhupgBHT46k2agViR1VhWByP7g2hS84D8ph8LC4K9TCWB.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0055.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23zGaZvaKKu2aL5JkkuntgDxmZsyceAQ13aMvh3bX33SKcQ69Lz5digJg9tUq77w41Zo9.jpg)
Luego tomé dos huevos, separé la yema de la clara y las batí un poco. Primero eché la clara y luego la yema. Posteriormente vertí un toque de sal (también se le puede añadir un cubito) y un chorrito de aceite.
![IMG-20260422-WA0062.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/243BoAPcYLYUEQZBD3wT7Ys1ue3AnbSSUsC6ih2Pde6UtXLmW3uSesRUj2vG6FcHt2Nmn.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0068.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/242Nv5UeFZ9zo9ChmHjj3QykEDxd14j78Jzj5PPAUqJw3kyTcZYbrymRuw9nrWWKMWdM7.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0052.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/244y5pJwnAQD9yzCjSFaUkhpp1qqfu7Fic4J6dUWDxg1sCU9v2eKswxwiU2b7efDqNAs2.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0050.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23xAVXXu6h4HarEa1N2afeaCZNHknUwEMSD6xyMZpDtqWFG5dmgaXWSDurjU88dxhXKyW.jpg)
Cuando la papa estaba blanca, agregué tres huevos completos. Posteriormente para mejorar la consistencia le añadí cien gramos de pasta en forma de corbata.
![IMG-20260422-WA0035.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23vsQY7Dzshwki8SaxWpwpWEtzwia27TN4qoSEh25seiQuEQhQWmzsUCGfcjcShQfYwoQ.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0040.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23tmG2AJF2XreNNCzVKvRn3iwrmQVmAPfBrgb78bPSz4o65AYN9sQ56tRa13UCMNcnijQ.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0024.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23wr1LAi5xZCYV5FR8pXT5pPGCFhUdTonw238dn7UmV5LX8fhVDPVsmHCLgQwpnAZfKV2.jpg)
![IMG-20260422-WA0032.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/elmundodeyari/23w2sH1mDyD9tqURrapzGKk3yxHU8E3QR7cKNFZD3ePLhecwMTDGjzQ5U1iwzFCV1ETo7.jpg)
También le podemos agregar queso, en esta ocasión no lo usé. Finalmente agregué el cilantro. Reservé un poco para decorar el plato al final. Y así disfruté un delicioso desayuno. *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Confuse what is real
links.body:
>

It's okay to be in a world far removed from our own; the mind plays tricks on us. You get your hopes up about things that aren't there, but you like to believe they are. I don't like to assume, but I do like to fantasize, and sometimes, after living in that world for so long, I've imagined things that aren't true, like believing that everything points to me when it really doesn't, like believing that someone is going to give you a gift and then they don't. Or thinking that someone is talking about you when it's just your mind confusing reality.

And I think that's where something else we don't always want to accept comes in: the need to feel part of something, to be seen, considered, chosen. The mind doesn't just invent things on a whim; often it does so because there's a desire behind it, a silent expectation that seeks fulfillment, even if only in our imagination. And without realizing it, we start reading signs where there aren't any, interpreting silences as messages, giving meaning to things that are simply... neutral.

Learning to recognize this isn't easy, because it involves questioning our own perceptions. It's like pausing and asking yourself, \

And while it can sometimes be uncomfortable to accept that not everything revolves around us, it's also liberating. Because when you stop filling the gaps with assumptions, you begin to see things more clearly, and reality becomes much calmer and more genuine.

> No les pasa nada que muchas veces estamos en un mundo alejado al nuestro, la mente juega bastante sucio. Te ilusionas con cosas que no están ahí pero a ti te gusta creer que sí. A mi no me gusta suponer pero sí me gusta fantasear y a veces me ha pasado que entre tanto vivir ahí. He llegado a imaginar cosas que no son ciertas, cómo creyendo que todo apunta hacia a mi cuando en realidad no es así, como creer que alguien te va a dar un regalo y resulta que no. O pensar que alguien está hablando de ti pero es solo tu cabeza confundiendo la realidad. Y creo que ahí también entra algo que no siempre queremos aceptar: la necesidad de sentirnos parte de algo, de ser vistos, considerados, elegidos. La mente no solo inventa por capricho, muchas veces lo hace porque hay un deseo detrás, una expectativa silenciosa que busca cumplirse aunque sea en nuestra imaginación. Y sin darnos cuenta, empezamos a leer señales donde no las hay, a interpretar silencios como mensajes, a darle significado a cosas que simplemente… son neutras. Aprender a reconocer eso no es fácil, porque implica cuestionar nuestras propias percepciones. Es como hacer una pausa y preguntarte: “¿esto está pasando realmente o lo estoy construyendo yo?”. Y aunque a veces puede ser incómodo aceptar que no todo gira a nuestro alrededor, también es liberador. Porque cuando dejas de llenar los vacíos con suposiciones, empiezas a ver las cosas con más claridad, y lo real se vuelve mucho más tranquilo y genuino.
![IMG_0907.jpeg](https://images.hive.blog/DQmW188GAgkrNCPSs334Z1WypeL57P4dw6yGrAj8eFuEPeG/IMG_0907.jpeg)

links.title: Oatmeal Cookies with Wheat Flour (Eng/Esp)
links.body:
> Today’s snack was some delicious oatmeal cookies, but made with rolled oats to give them an incredible texture and a delicious flavor. I used self-rising flour to make them fluffy, so they’d be soft on the inside and have a crispy crust that crunches with every bite. This was the perfect treat for the whole family—little Alma loved them.
![1000111919.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi4JUrTkrazGYQ5YQEdruGVH5kjbV8KNg7XqsZwGEmTjvBQnwzoEBicHcJmvWVbRbeQ.png)
## Ingredients: - 1 cup self-rising flour - 1 cup rolled oats - 5 tablespoons butter - 6 tablespoons sugar - 1 egg
![1000111905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvqBnhC4FWeFbeeNvDrPNZzXQXaxfqYnR3jtvKc4DDwV7VqyFqocZ2hXPHaTrKhWtHG.jpg)
![1000111901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFgjNkGtbABorxXBS2aLeAsykBDvncReuHQR66tatfCSzp5yPT4dJr76x67BKUweiYM.jpg)
## Preparation: I placed the butter and sugar in a bowl and beat them constantly until the mixture became creamy; at this point, the sugar had completely dissolved. Then I added the egg and continued stirring, gradually adding the flour until the dough began to take shape.
![1000111909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zGcZcuGV8bEHiaZmMPPG3c8JiiBufmsakPJCYpFczj5yYPQdCbB3sEjf9Rip3fmoY2W.jpg)
The final step was to stir in the rolled oats, which gave this mixture an excellent texture. I prepared a baking sheet with butter and flour, placed the cookies on it, and made ten round cookies—seven medium-sized and three small ones. I turned on the oven, preheated it, and set the temperature to 250 degrees; I put the baking sheet inside and waited for the magic of baking to take effect.
![1000111912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX1TX5wTgxAMHfxt85AHBJSrc5HsE37oAFysbqYjPkSovzogBmtmf1yMgYf4Hs6EA9y.jpg)
I kept a close eye on the cookies the whole time, as I wanted them to be crispy; I used a knife to check that they were golden brown on the bottom and soft on top. The cookies were ready in 20 minutes; they turned out delicious and met both my expectations and those of my family. *** ***
## Versión en Español

> La merienda de hoy fueron unas deliciosas galletas de avena, pero en hojuelas para darle una textura increíble y un sabor delicioso. Usé harina de trigo leudante para que quedaran esponjosas, que se sintieran suaves por dentro y tuvieran una capa crujiente que sonara tras cada mordisco. Esta opción fue perfecta para darnos un gusto familiar, a la pequeña Alma le encantaron.
![1000111919.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23vi4JUrTkrazGYQ5YQEdruGVH5kjbV8KNg7XqsZwGEmTjvBQnwzoEBicHcJmvWVbRbeQ.png)
## Ingredientes: - 1 taza de harina de trigo leudante - 1 taza de avena en hojuelas - 5 cucharadas de mantequilla - 6 cucharadas de azúcar - 1 huevo
![1000111905.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23tvqBnhC4FWeFbeeNvDrPNZzXQXaxfqYnR3jtvKc4DDwV7VqyFqocZ2hXPHaTrKhWtHG.jpg)
![1000111901.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23uFgjNkGtbABorxXBS2aLeAsykBDvncReuHQR66tatfCSzp5yPT4dJr76x67BKUweiYM.jpg)
## Preparación: En un envase coloqué la mantequilla y el azúcar, batí constantemente hasta lograr que la mezcla se volviera cremosa, en este punto el azúcar se disolvió por completo. Luego agregué el huevo y continúe removiendo, paulatinamente añadí la harina de trigo, la masa fue tomando consistencia.
![1000111909.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23zGcZcuGV8bEHiaZmMPPG3c8JiiBufmsakPJCYpFczj5yYPQdCbB3sEjf9Rip3fmoY2W.jpg)
El último paso fue anexar las hojuelas de avena, las cuales otorgaron excelente textura a esta preparación. Preparé una bandeja con mantequilla y harina de trigo, allí coloqué las galletas, realicé diez galletas en forma redonda, siete de tamaño mediano y tres pequeñas. Encendí el horno, lo precalenté y ajusté la temperatura a 250 grados, coloqué la bandeja y esperé que la magia de la cocina actuara.
![1000111912.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/ramisey/23wX1TX5wTgxAMHfxt85AHBJSrc5HsE37oAFysbqYjPkSovzogBmtmf1yMgYf4Hs6EA9y.jpg)
Vigilé las galletas en todo momento, pues deseaba que quedaran crujientes, con un cuchillo corroboré que estuviesen doradas por la parte inferior y suaves en la superior. Las galletas estaban listas en 20 minutos, quedaron deliciosas, cumplieron mis expectativas y la de mi familia.   *** *** ✓Photos from my personal gallery, edited with Fotocollage. ✓Text translated with DeepL.

links.title: Drawing of Nature : Mountain and River.
links.body:
Hi friends! I was eagerly waiting for creative Sunday because this week I draw a new picture of a mount. For the first time I draw a mount covered with ice. One of my cousin visited USA recently. He show me some places of USA. He show me an image of Columbia River near Portland, Oregon.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2j6d1xmXEFpqaPi2pLRpasBxFq3P9x356MfTrX1xFyZ/1777260649571.jpg)

 There is a hill covered with ice is Mount Hood, There are some floating houses both sides of the river. I tried to draw the scenery not in detail but a clear cocept about the river and and the hill with floating houses. I have never visited USA but I wish I were visit the beautiful places of USA.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmTmXZr4z8n3GQqZo1pydFk8JXn3Z4ZRAjtZYwyFu3fH9i/1777260684714.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmb79CetW7bnzTijVYQJCfKhtWTgrkkqqazytGoT6Qmi6H/1777260685029.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQbywCJxPJwUEEEZUTwdPVhxHW3MXTCDUuxEaNpZahKEy/1777260684949.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmWP4RgQwk2D4hCr6hhURL8sTYqNDj1pXszBLgrW2JowRW/1777260684879.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmQkK324LFJb5nFEJyEM3FbX4sQtRpquvF7qR4ZaNy5Fmy/1777260684793.jpg)



Especially  the Colombian river is one of the best eye soothing scenery. So I selected this place to draw. First I took an art paper then cut it rectangular in sige. I used water and acrylic colour both. I draw the sky with wghite and blue.  I blend the colour with brush on paper to highlight the sky with clouds. There are clouds in the sky but the sky was not so cloudy. I keep a triangular shape to highlight the mount.

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPhiA5WwMPvXnSwZeZnG28cAqcy9fJxRtGCfYrYbRSQZm/1777260735490.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQme2j6d1xmXEFpqaPi2pLRpasBxFq3P9x356MfTrX1xFyZ/1777260735426.jpg)

![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSaxCvpgmxwf7cejmSouJirAvEjM7wbsrVYpgGf8ah5dK/1777260735582.jpg)

 I made some short stroke with a brush in the triangular shape to clear that it was a mount far from the river. There is a forest like a linear boundaries. I mixed black and green to draw the forest. The floating houses and some buildings also created a natural realistic mood. I highlighted the water with blue and white color as the shadow of sky.

The river was calm,  there was no wave.  I took around 4 hours to complete the drawing. The mount covered with ice is looking very nice. I draw the mount at the middle of the page as it clearly highlighted the beauty of the nature. I am very pkeased to draw such an image. 

I like to draw images like this natural beauties.  I will share more drawing and also try for better art work. I'd love to hear your feedback on this.

links.title: Being alone is the value of life.
links.body: > https://images.pexels.com/photos/19611571/pexels-photo-19611571.jpeg [sourch]( https://www.pexels.com/photo/back-view-of-woman-in-jacket-19611571/ ) Sometimes we need to be alone. There are many times in life when we are with our family. We are with our friends. But those times seem to be in the past. Then we love to live a lonely life. We love to keep our joys and sorrows to ourselves. Every chapter in our life takes us into a different feeling. Sometimes we are sad, sometimes we are happy. In life, we have to develop ourselves in every area. We learn to adapt to many things in our life. Once it seemed that to adapt to something, it took a long time and we used to fight a lot, but now those things have become our habits. When something becomes our habit, we want to adapt to them. It is necessary to be alone in life, but that is for your own development. When you are alone, do not take anyone with you, this is a natural thing. By being alone, we can take our inner strength further forward. We can think about what has happened or not happened in my life. We learn to recognize our values ​​and especially the things we think about in the past. This creates a large part of your thinking in your life. links.title: 「生活」临近高考的学生百态
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![nHX7j75nYpEUyMzZ_3647b17154f0f4ab4482cccead400f.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/nHX7j75nYpEUyMzZ_3647b17154f0f4ab4482cccead400f/nHX7j75nYpEUyMzZ_3647b17154f0f4ab4482cccead400f.webp)
![MHZg3ORNA51LrfEy_18e0e985279a7b30c379633f068712.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/MHZg3ORNA51LrfEy_18e0e985279a7b30c379633f068712/MHZg3ORNA51LrfEy_18e0e985279a7b30c379633f068712.webp)
![fGR0yvN9UAZSwGjc_479180ad897f01441b25ca521880fd.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/fGR0yvN9UAZSwGjc_479180ad897f01441b25ca521880fd/fGR0yvN9UAZSwGjc_479180ad897f01441b25ca521880fd.webp)
![R9le06Seil9AoO4P_1d7d49e41161ca710147de10b65232.png](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/mrspointm/images/R9le06Seil9AoO4P_1d7d49e41161ca710147de10b65232/R9le06Seil9AoO4P_1d7d49e41161ca710147de10b65232.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

距离高考还有不到50天。我目前带两个班，学生状态两极分化十分明显。其中一个是强基班，学生完全处在高三紧张有序的备考状态，整体学习劲头很足。而另一个普通班，不少学生早已摆烂松懈，尤其是后排学生，明显已经放弃备考。

两个班的班型本身就不同，一个强基、一个普通。我普通班的课时安排还很不合理，基本固定在早上第一节或是下午第一节，天天都是如此。这两个时段最容易犯困，学生听课状态最差，偏偏我的课都排在这个时间段。几乎每天上课，我都要叫醒五六个睡觉的学生，让他们站起来听课，反复出问题的，永远都是同一批人。

以前我还会顾及学生的面子，尽量走到旁边，让同桌悄悄提醒，帮他们打起精神。但这种方式根本没用，只要我一走开，下一秒立刻又睡着。好几次因为我没有及时管教，班上多人上课睡觉，我还被学校通报批评。

我慢慢发现，这些反复懈怠的学生，早就不在乎自身状态，我没必要一味维护他们的情面。现在只要看到有人犯困走神、有睡觉的苗头，我都会直接要求站起来听课。

再说到日常默写，不管是课上三分钟小默写，还是早自习默写，敷衍应付的还是那几个学生。他们学习习惯极差，前一天或是刚发的学案，转眼就弄丢。我上前询问为什么不完成默写，只会拿资料弄丢当借口，好像东西不见了，就可以理所应当不写。别人都在安静默写的时候，他们只会到处翻找资料，不停磨蹭，有的甚至一整个早自习都找不到资料，什么任务都完不成。

或许这批学生，本身就觉得自己没有希望，实在学不进去。课堂内容跟不上、听不懂，每天坐在教室里度日如年，过得也很煎熬。

以他们的基础，其实早就清楚自己很难通过高考升学。明明知道凭文化课硬考难度极大，却不愿意考虑单招，早点换一条路进入大学。

哎，我们读书时，老师总会反复叮嘱学习的重要性，但年少时从来不会放在心上。这些孩子也是一样，只有将来步入社会，体会到生活的心酸和不易，才会后悔当初没有好好读书，生出“欲买桂花同载酒，终不似，少年游”的感慨，年少时偷过的懒、敷衍过的时光，终有一天都会化作子弹，正中眉心。

---

This is the video series for an oil painting 'Wisteria' I did from 2016-2020.  The painting was destroyed in 2021 due to a number of reasons, but mainly: the painting's faulty experimental linseed-epoxide substrait, Covid-19 crushing lockdowns, extreme poverty, family attacks and ongoing US government (Big Tech + Big Media) censorship of me and my 30 years of artwork.

Its not ideal to not be able to show this piece, but I still gained the knowledge of how to do it and invented several useful oil painting mediums & varnishes used in its creation which never yellowed and still cannot be bought anywhere.

I am posting these videos for posterity and for people that are interested in seeing an oil painting created from start to finish in the Baroque style evolved for the 21st century.  I also must have deleted some of the initial videos when I did the quick underpainting, but what still exists, I give to you.

I hope this can be an educational experience as no gallery will show any of my controversial art even today.

links.title: I'm A Part-Time Monster Truck Mechanic
links.body: Sometimes monster trucks break down. The drivers try their best not to break them, but accidents happen. When they do, they come to me to put them back together. It's not glamorous and the pay is lousy, but it's worth the smile on their faces once everything's back in working order. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmeHqJ12wQspnMiLNb3PWskLrLY6Eyc7wcGKbGwKYXip3q/1777250595943.png) (Created with ChatGPT) The latest damage came to the Zombie monster truck. It had really been put through its paces this time. The repairs are done, but only time will tell if the repair job will hold. It took quite a tumble, and if the repairs don't hold we may end up having to replace the entire rear axle. All in a day's work for a monster truck mechanic. There are many tools in a monster truck mechanic's arsenal. This particular repair was fairly extensive, so it needed a more advanced tool than an impact driver or arc welder. This job called for... JB Weld. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmRzGyeRhegVijHbSkYT6fo8vxd17LfEAXT1KM1WdeU6u5/1777250939811.jpg) The truck took such a heavy tumble that the passenger side's rear tire completely snapped off the axle. It may require a brand new axle, but we'll see if I can repair it first. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmZMiR6uozqy8wVD8wCsLozqVdeRirxHoaFdwoPun13565/1777251138602.jpg) ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmdMhTNgx6yN3jzEyRwWFn4nyETXrZeaBokePoFyR7LHYH/1777251150109.jpg) I quickly got to work. I only had 25 minutes tops to make the repair. I took a butter knife and cut off a chunk of the putty. I used some rubber gloves my wife uses for cleaning to protect my hands while I worked the putty and mixed it. I propped up the chassis of the monster truck so it wouldn't put pressure on the weld as it cured. I worked the putty around the axle and down into the grooves of the wheel hub. ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmYgYuboUwr6SdsBoGTQZkAmYxo2n1sCNhPT334URXmae3/1777251942031.jpg) Once fully cured, this will act as a cast of sorts. We'll see if it holds. At the very least my son will be happy it's back in action! The downside to all of this is I now owe my wife a new pair of rubber gloves for cleaning. ![1000017156.gif](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/bulliontools/23uEyyyWCHidcDUBLiCySb4thnoMosshmypAS8GVUkhHC52LCiQqrB6L9Fom29shmtCMN.gif)

links.body: >Hace unas semanas les comenté sobre una planta que creí en mi maceta de la nada, estaba bastante emocionada ya que Google me dijo que era una planta de pimentón, tenia la certeza de que asi era a pesar de no saber nada sobre plantas, mi planta creció rápido, muy pero muy rápido, incluso empezó a florecer y me emocioné tanto de verla cada día más hermosa. Pero justamente cuando floreció me entro la curiosidad y quise confirmar nuevamente lo que había investigado antes, quería saber si las plantas de pimientos florecen y saber en que fase estaba mi planta. > A few weeks ago, I told you about a plant that I grew in my pot out of nowhere. I was pretty excited because Google told me it was a bell pepper plant, and I was certain that was the case even though I didn’t know anything about plants. My plant grew fast—really, really fast—and as soon as it started to bloom, I got so excited to see it getting more beautiful every day. But just as it bloomed, I got curious and wanted to double-check what I’d looked up before. I wanted to know if pepper plants actually bloom and what stage my plant was in. ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23w2gfz7zZ5YtJopRk9MKgKrwRHiJRz54pzyygrnXB44qFrhcTt9hxX41W4QpxaLjVkxL.png)

>Estas flores fueron decisivas para saber que no era una planta de pimentón. Según Google esta planta era hierba mora… Una planta venenosa jajaja… Me sentí estafada y decepcionada pero no perdí la esperanza, continue cuidando mi planta y cada día estaba mas grande y hermosa, dentro de mi aun quedaba esa pizca de esperanza de que fuese de pimentón y espere a ver si daba frutos. > These flowers were the key to realizing it wasn’t a bell pepper plant. According to Google, it was a black nightshade… A poisonous plant, ha ha ha… I felt cheated and disappointed, but I didn’t lose hope. I kept caring for my plant, and every day it grew bigger and more beautiful. Deep down, I still held onto that tiny glimmer of hope that it might be a bell pepper plant, so I waited to see if it would bear fruit. ![IMG_20260421_194121.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vsSpdjM5bc1aD9RvCCSz387eyktvRTSqcJc28bjkAVvMzyp9Trxb6jSJPkaAXZVfNGf.jpg)

>Y a pesar de ser optimista llego el día en que comenzó a crecer algo cerca de las flores, y efectivamente eran hierba mora. Según Google al principio son pequeñas bolitas verdes y cuando estan maduras se ponen de un color morado oscuro. Investigue un poco para saber como llego esa planta a mi maceta y lo mas probable es que fue un pajarito que dejo la semilla en mi maceta y de ahí empezó a crecer esta planta. Muy decepcionada tome una decisión definitiva, yo quería mi planta de pimentón y además no quiero una planta venenosa que puedo ser un riesgo para mi hijo y mi gato. > And despite being optimistic, the day came when something started growing near the flowers, and sure enough, it was black nightshade. According to Google, they start as small green berries and turn dark purple when ripe. I did some research to find out how the plant got into my pot, and it's most likely that a bird left a seed there, and from there it started to grow. Very disappointed, I made a final decision: I wanted my bell pepper plant, and besides, I didn't want a poisonous plant that could be a risk to my son and my cat. ![IMG_20260421_113553.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/23vhuoEy7bfzeoZTyaG48TStRriZtLcYG1G76sk5icm1pHSeLoNpaqyRwDKTcrkj78mY5.jpg)

>Le puse fin a esta planta, aquella planta que cuide por semanas, la arranque de raíz para evitar su crecimiento nuevamente, al día siguiente sembré semillas de pimentón y aun estoy esperando a ver si con el tiempo podre tener mi planta de pimentón real > I finally got rid of this plant, the one I'd cared for for weeks. I pulled it out by the roots to prevent it from growing back. The next day I planted bell pepper seeds and I'm still waiting to see if, with time, I'll be able to grow my own real bell pepper plant. ![IMG_20260421_195633.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/alexa.art/EoeFM4y6S1QL8dXET1YJ5FFPahwnPV1QYPMFf8LnVRmgsAgWteSEEp3t8qrepwEu91d.jpg)

(Eng)
Greetings Skatehive family!!

Have a great end to your Sunday and a wonderful week everyone!!

Today I'm sharing with you a little bit of my day off routine, the sacred Sunday of skateboarding, a day to wake up early, have a good coffee and go skating through the streets of São Paulo. Today I decided to stop by the Brás neighborhood and skate a bit along the edges of the Vale do Anhagabau at the spot we made with our friends from downtown that we named Gaspot!!

Edges that slide like butter when the sun hits them. Today I decided to refine a trick that I've been practicing for a while and that I think is really cool, which is a Frontside Noseslide coming out of a Shovit. The fun is guaranteed, but the process to land the trick is a bit laborious because it requires attention, balance and timing!! Today I skated with friends from downtown and my great comrade Kaue Figueiredo, who, besides being longtime friends, is a great inspiration on the skateboard for all of us in the North Zone.

I've invited him a few times to participate with us in the skatehive community on the Hive Blockchain, but unfortunately the guy is still very scarred on social media 🤷🏾‍♂️
But anyway, it's always an honor to skate with this brother!

Salve familia Skatehive !! 
Um bom  fim de domingo  e uma otima semana a todos !! 

Hoje compartilho com vcs um pouco do meu processo de dia de folga , o domingo sagrado do skateboard , dia de acordar cedo , tomar um bom cafe e sair remamdo pelas ruas de Sp . Hoje resolvi dar uma passada no bairro do Bras e andar um pouco pelas bordas do Vale do anhagabau no spot feito por nos junto com os amigos do centro que batizamos de Gaspot !! 
Bordas que deslizam como manteiga quando o sol bate nelas . Hoje resolvi aprimorar uma manobra que estou a um bom tempo treinando e que acho muito legal que e um Frontside Noseslide saido de Shovit , a diversao e garantida mas o processo para se voltar a manobra e um pouco trabalhoso pois requer atencao equilibrio e timming !! Hoje andei com os amigos do centro e meu grande camarada Kaue Figueiredo que alem de sermos amigos de longa data é uma grande inspiracao em cima do skate para todos nos da Zona Norte . 
Ja o convidei algumas vezes para participar conosco da comunidade skatehive na Blockchain da Hive, mas infelizmente o homin ainda e muito cicatrizado nas redes sociais da web2 🤷🏾‍♂️
Mas de qualquer forma e sempre uma honra poder andar de skate com esse irmao !

links.title: “That Ain’t Working, That’s The Way To Do It!”😊My Actifit Report Card: April 26 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254526.268028) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254534.008487) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254540.777044) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254547.3442578) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254555.89486) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254562.874186) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254569.59685) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254576.812129) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254592.015733) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/8A694841-5F9B-4782-9515-26E13F5E07101777254596.8810291) “That Ain’t Working, That’s The Way To Do It!”☺️ This morning at Church, our Pastor was saying that the weather is so beautiful, everyone needs to find some time to just sit, relax, and be still, outside!😇 He went on to talk about how everything in this extremely fast paced world is about instant gratification!😮 So very true my friends……………. We order something on Amazon, and we want it yesterday Lol!😇 Amazon’s suppliers are pushed harder to supply products faster, warehouse workers, are required to work even harder, and the rat race continues on and on!🙄 Don’t get Silvertop wrong….. sometimes a little bit faster is much appreciated Lol!☺️ Silvertop grew up in and age where you would “Mail Order” anything special that you couldn’t pick up at the local store!😇 As a teenager, Silvertop Mail Ordered his very first Gold coin, a Mexican Five Peso!🤗 Two and a half months later…….. yes you heard that correctly, I opened a small brown envelope and held this Gold coin in my hands, feeling like I was the richest kid in the world!🤗 Can you imagine ordering something on Amazon today, and it would arrive 2 1/2 months later!🙄 Hopefully you are among the lucky people that still have weekends off, so many people are working split shifts, or even second jobs just to pay the bills!😮 So today….. if you can, step outside and just do nothing for a bit! I guarantee you will feel better!😇 “This Ain’t Working…… This Is The Way To Do It!”👍🤗 Till tomorrow Silvertop Mike 😊

links.title: A Sunny 🌞 Sunday!…….. My Actifit Report Card: April 26 2026
links.body:
![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777251450.7157621) Happy blessed Sunday to you! It was a sunny 🌞 one here. Our day began at church where we experienced worship and a great sermon. They announced again about the ladies event this coming Saturday. I registered myself and my newly widowed friend I’ve been visiting recently. I was happy she wanted to come. She needs to get out with people. Once home, some house chores and then out to the garden. I didn’t take any pictures of what I was planting as it was somewhat hot and I wanted to get as much done as I could before I’d have to stop. I burn easily in the sun so I’ve learned to stop before it’s too late (most of the time 😏) I tilled the soil in my raised bed garden by hand and got the weeds out. I then planted 2 types of green beans, 5 dahlias and some sunflowers. If I can move tomorrow, I have more dahlias and more seeds to plant. Once I put up my garden supplies, I went to retrieve the Amazon package in the ‘deliveries’ box at the road and on the way back, heard the bees 🐝 buzzing. If you remember my post from a couple of days ago, I mentioned that the Bloodgood Japanese Maple tree would be buzzing soon with bee 🐝 activity because of the tiny flowers it has. It’s buzzing! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252041.768702) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252091.8631802) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252099.852709) ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252104.875039) The very first picture is of the brilliant orange/yellow azalea almost in bloom. This next one is of the first blooms of the rhododendron near the house. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252173.7441301) This flower is just beginning to emerge. Every year, these grow near the utility pole housing our entrance cable. When in full bloom, they are delicate and very purple. Google calls it Centaurea montana, also known as a perennial corn flower. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252485.2464151) I searched my archives looking for one in bloom from previous years. Found it! ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252517.613972) The bumblebees 🐝 love this! I’ve got several coming up. I’ll keep tabs and share more pictures later. That’s gonna be it for now. Take care and enjoy the rest of your day wherever you are! 🙏🌏🙏 👣🐑☕️😎👍🌻😁🐝🐝🐝🌞🌙🥱😴 ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/B3F52D68-A802-4DAA-B80B-BA93FE4B5CA71777252669.884628) BSB 2 Thessalonians 2:16-17 Now may our Lord Jesus Christ Himself and God our Father, who by grace has loved us and given us eternal comfort and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.

links.title: 原來雅加達的甜品很出色
links.body: 復活節過後，我又去了一趟雅加達。 其實上年年尾才去了一趟，這麼快又去實在沒什麼期待，這一次是我朋友叫我一起去，不知道他為什麼那麼喜歡雅加達，之後才知道原來他認識了一個女的 lol，好吧，你直說不好嗎？所以這次雅加達之旅是睡和吃為主，因為景點很多都在不久前才去過了。 這一次試了很多印尼餐廳，上一次又是這一個朋友，他就很奇怪，去了其他地方卻不吃其他地方的菜，走去吃中國菜、日本菜，那去印尼幹嘛？這次他好一點，會吃印尼菜了。印尼菜就是會把一些中國人想像不到的食物拼在一起，但味道又不錯，不過不吃辣的朋友要小心，因為真的挺辣。
/> 是不是很奇怪的賣相哈哈，但味道還是挺不錯的，另外，這次我發現這邊的甜品和雪糕才是一絕，款式多之餘又很好吃﹗
/> 我呀，在雅加達幾天，天天都吃雪糕，因為太好吃了，而且這邊物價仍然很便宜，例如上面的一個飯，大概只是三四十塊，但已經是檔次不錯的餐廳了。順帶一提，我們幾天主要出沒的地點是當地一個很出名的商場Grand Indonesia。

/>

當然，除了吃還有點收獲的，我在這邊也跑了兩天步，也去了幾個上次沒有去的景點，不過，我相信短期內不會再去雅加達了，而且不會再和這朋友去了。

還是自己去旅遊比較自由。

links.title: Naval Strategies / Freeciv Gameplay #5 [ESP🇻🇪|ENG🇬🇧]
links.body:
> The war against the Dahomeans has reached a critical point where the logistical demand is almost as exhausting as the combat itself. Since the main front is located on a northern continent, separated from our capital by vast oceans, the role of the Navy has become indispensable. My fleet must simultaneously secure the sea lanes, protect transport units carrying ground troops, and carry out constant coastal bombardments to weaken enemy defenses. However, this relentless operational pace has taken a toll on my vessels, leaving a large portion of my fleet with significant hull damage and reduced combat effectiveness. # ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmSGVtSbfSJCFuULa2FCrPfQDUqXpYy86fXGMC4ucLEAU9/1777260308022.jpg) Faced with the possibility of losing high-value veteran units, I have implemented a strategic withdrawal and maintenance plan. I designated a small but capable task force—consisting of a few battleships, destroyers, and submarines—to maintain a defensive perimeter in the northern seas and prevent enemy incursions. Meanwhile, the bulk of my damaged naval units was ordered to retreat to the coastal city of Aconibe. This maneuver, though risky as it temporarily thins out the front lines, is a mechanical necessity to ensure the long-term survival of our maritime hegemony. # Aconibe is a unique strategic asset within our empire. Located in a desert region, the city has been heavily developed with oil resource improvements, providing the necessary energy for large-scale industrial operations. Most importantly, Aconibe is equipped with a Port Facility. In Freeciv, this building is vital; not only does it allow for the production of veteran naval units from the start, but it also serves as a specialized dry dock where damaged ships can restore their hit points (HP) each turn. By concentrating the fleet here, I can ensure that our battleships return to the front in optimal condition. # ![](https://images.ecency.com/DQmPRtgHEhkEdjFH1TWmrfQS6VAQmX4fKt6uaxGFgEGyuFy/1777260326312.jpg) The recent conquest of the city of Santana has provided an additional layer of security for this logistical move. With Santana under our control, the sea lanes leading to Anconibe are much safer, acting as a buffer zone that prevents the Dahomeans from easily intercepting our retreating vessels. This disciplined management of military assets is what defines the success of an autocracy. By prioritizing the repair and preservation of our existing units over reckless production, I am consolidating a veteran force that will eventually lead us to the total collapse of the enemy's resistance. # |

links.title: 让人惊艳的GPT image2.0的psd文件分图层功能
links.body:
<liketuimages>
<center>
![D9So5x848Hvcgrqw_IMG_20260427_111825.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/D9So5x848Hvcgrqw_IMG_20260427_111825/D9So5x848Hvcgrqw_IMG_20260427_111825.webp)
![YtXwamd0OKtcnHWa_Screenshot_20260426_191617_com_xingin_xhs_DetailFeedActivity.webp](https://cdn.liketu.com/media/angelina6688/images/YtXwamd0OKtcnHWa_Screenshot_20260426_191617_com_xingin_xhs_DetailFeedActivity/YtXwamd0OKtcnHWa_Screenshot_20260426_191617_com_xingin_xhs_DetailFeedActivity.webp)
</center>
</liketuimages>

之前还在感叹虚拟货币的更新速度日新月异，转眼到了今年，我真切感受到了AI科技发展的炸裂速度，快到让人咋舌。
 
去年我就发现，国内不少AI软件在生成PPT方面还很初级。就拿文心一言、豆包和千问元宝来说，当时它们只能输出简单的大纲框架，根本无法直接生成可编辑的PPT文件。即便是一些办公软件，自带的模板也不够智能，还得额外付费，实用性大打折扣。
 
以前给孩子学校活动做PPT，我通常会找那些免费或付费的AI PPT工具。但按照去年的套路，生成的内容得修改四五成，才能勉强可用，大半工作量还是落在自己身上。
 
今年情况完全不同了！国内有两款甚至更多AI软件，已经能直接在线生成PPT格式，还能保存发送到微信或电脑端，便捷度直接拉满。最关键的是，你把需求描述得越详细，生成的效果越好，配图、图表、插页和文字都能精准匹配。
 
上次帮孩子做学校活动的PPT，我只修改了两成内容就顺利交付，实实在在节省了大把时间，效率提升太明显了。
 
这两天又看到GPT Image 2.0推出了一个堪称炸裂的新功能——一键生成PSD格式文件，而且导出的PSD支持分图层编辑。这对他们那些做平面设计、图片排版的人来说，简直是颠覆性的突破。
 
要知道，专业设计师处理复杂的平面设计和图片排版，往往要耗费大量时间和精力。这个功能上线后，直接把设计师的工作效率提升了90%以上，简直太牛了。
 
从去年AI生成PPT的雏形，到今年能直接出成品PPT，再到GPT Image 2.0支持分层PSD编辑，AI的发展速度肉眼可见，未来的创作效率还能再上一个新台阶。
 
只不过唯一让人不太方便的就是国内的人使用这个 GPT Image 2.0 需要翻墙或者是做一些其他的工作，而且有些需要收费。这个就跟当年前几年比较火的 Midjourney 差不多，但是我感觉 GPT 而言，运用的场景和方向，还有行业会比 Midjourney 广泛更多。

这更让我感叹，不管你多少岁，多大年纪，你只要隔几天不去学习一下新事物，你就会很快被时代甩在身后，跟不上节奏了！

---

links.title: A good Sunday. My Actifit Diary: April 26 2026
links.body:
I slept for 11h. Longer than ever. We arrived a little late a the market, but still early enough to get everything that we needed. I haven’t done much today, beside another walk and writing a little bit for the weekend engagement challenge. Okay, I did work a little. And play Splinterlands. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/e00cc266-0c2c-4215-a345-4bad792246d4.jpg) 41 battles to go for the ranking! But I’m almost up there. Maybe a little too far. If I get into Champions by accident, I will have to compete there next season. And I don’t want to – I don’t have the cards for it. I’m pretty good in Diamond gaming, but going up to Champions? That would make for a lot of losses. Too many of them. I rather stay in the league that is mine. One should not aim too high. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/b487882e-c04b-4e70-aefe-db0b27f546be.jpg) It was a beautiful Sunday otherwise. I prepared some sauerkraut, well prepared it to prepare itself – it has to ferment now. I need a little more, and I’ll get that tomorrow. The good thing about fermented food is that they don’t spoil so quickly because they already have. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/3ba483b5-57a0-4825-98e1-2d82395dc0b7.jpg) I spent some quality time with Ellie, too. I do appreciate that. One of the few perks of Lily being away. I still preferred to have the little one here. Ellie and I managed anyway, always. And we will even more so when we move in together. When we find a place to make our home. ![](https://usermedia.actifit.io/45b1dc6a-d53f-4f33-8573-77f138cf13cb.jpg) I’m tired now. Again. More sleep needed! Have a good night!

links.title: 😝Natonal Pretzel Day! / ¡Día Nacional del Pretzel! 😎
links.body:
>

***National Pretzel Day is celebrated every year on April 26th.*** This snack has been enjoyed since the Middle Ages. On this day, people enjoy pretzels in all their varieties and debate which is better: **hard or soft.** According to tradition, their origins date back to 7th-century Italy. Supposedly, monks baked small pieces of dough to give to children who memorized their prayers. However, this version of the pretzel's origin is unconfirmed and lacks supporting evidence. To find the first documented evidence of the pretzel, one must go back to 12th-century Germany. At that time, the pretzel was incorporated into the coats of arms of German bakers' guilds in **1111.**

> El Día Nacional del Pretzel se celebra cada año el 26 de abril . Un bocadillo que se disfruta desde la Edad Media. En este día, la gente disfruta de los pretzels en todas sus variedades y debate sobre cuál es mejor: los duros o los blandos.
Según la tradición, sus orígenes se remontan a la Italia del siglo VII . Supuestamente, los monjes horneaban pequeños trozos de masa para regalárselos a los niños que memorizaban sus oraciones.
Sin embargo, esta versión sobre el origen del pretzel no está confirmada y carece de pruebas que la respalden. Para encontrar la primera evidencia documentada del pretzel, hay que remontarse a la Alemania del siglo **XII**. En aquella época, el pretzel se incorporó a los escudos de los gremios de panaderos alemanes en **1111**.

Over time, pretzels became a symbol of good luck. In fact, so much so that German children used to hang pretzels around their necks to celebrate the New Year, and they were also used to decorate Christmas trees. Some say that the pretzel was invented to serve as food during Lent, and its peculiar shape represents people joining their hands in prayer or the three knots of the Holy Trinity. Although no one knows for sure whether this is true or not.

> Con el tiempo, los pretzels se convirtieron en un símbolo de buena suerte. De hecho, tanto es así que los niños alemanes solían colgarse pretzels al cuello para celebrar el Año Nuevo, y también se usaban para decorar los árboles de Navidad . 
Algunos dicen que el pretzel se inventó para servir como alimento durante la Cuaresma, y su peculiar forma representa a las personas juntando las manos en oración o los tres nudos de la Santísima Trinidad.
Aunque nadie sabe con certeza si esto es cierto o no.

During the 18th century, pretzels traveled with German immigrants who emigrated to the United States. These German immigrants, known as the Pennsylvania Dutch, opened bakeries throughout the state to sell baked goods. Among these baked goods were pretzels, which became a popular treat in the United States. Pennsylvania established itself as the leading producer of pretzels in North America. Even today, more than three-quarters of all pretzels made in the United States come from Pennsylvania. 
**1.** $550 million worth of pretzels are sold annually in the United States. 
**2.** The largest pretzel on record is 26.8 feet long and weighs over 840 pounds. 
**3.** The average American consumes 2 pounds of pretzels per year.
**4.** The average Pennsylvanian consumes more than 5.4 kilograms (12 pounds) per year. 
**5.** Unsalted pretzels are called ***\

***

> Durante el siglo XVIII, los pretzels viajaron con los inmigrantes alemanes que emigraron a los Estados Unidos. Estos inmigrantes alemanes, conocidos como los holandeses de Pensilvania , abrieron panaderías por todo el estado para vender productos de panadería. Entre estos productos de panadería se encontraban los pretzels, que se convirtieron en un dulce popular en Estados Unidos. Pensilvania se consolidó como el principal productor de pretzels en Norteamérica. Incluso hoy en día, más de las tres cuartas partes de todos los pretzels que se fabrican en Estados Unidos provienen de Pensilvania.
**1.**En Estados Unidos se venden anualmente 550 millones de dólares en pretzels .
**2.**El pretzel más grande registrado mide 26,8 pies de largo y pesa más de 840 libras.
**3.**El estadounidense promedio consume *2 libras* de pretzels al año.
**4.**El habitante promedio de Pensilvania consume más de 5,4 kilogramos (12 libras) al año.
